api ca yatra api ubhaya dharma adhikaraṇa tvena ubhaya ātmaka tvam ucyate tatra api na sva ātma para ātmā apekṣayā tad ubhaya ātmakam yathā nīlam ca tad utpalam ca iti na hi para ātmanā tat nīlam utpalam ca iti ucyate kim tu sva rūpeṇa eva tathā sat asat ātmaka tvam api sva rūpeṇa eva vācyam na anya rūpeṇa sattvam asattvam vā mukhyam na hi suvarṇa ādeḥ mṛd ā ādi rūpeṇa sattvam na api kha puṣpa ādeḥ stambha ādi rūpeṇa asattvam sva rūpeṇa eva asattvāt iti tat yadi bhāvānām ubhaya ātmaka tvam syāt tadā sva rūpeṇa eva ghaṭaḥ ca aghaṭaḥ ca syāt para rūpeṇa aghaṭa tve hi gauṇam tat aghaṭa tvam vaṭumāṇavaka ādeḥ agni tva siṃha tva ādi vat atas gauṇam tad ubhaya ātmakam vastu mukhyatas tu sva rūpeṇa eva yad ātmakam yat tad ātmakam eva tat iti

sva rūpeṇa eva ubhaya ātmakam vastu iti ced na iṣṭa aniṣṭa svabhāva avyavasthiteḥ prāṇi vyavahāra abhāva prasaṅgāt yathā eva hi prāṇinām sukha ādi sattvam iṣṭam tathā tat asattvam aniṣṭam yathā ca duḥkha ādi sattvam aniṣṭam tathā tat asattvam iṣṭam tatas ca svarūpeṇa eva sat asat ātmaka tvam sukha duḥkha ādi sādhanānām iṣṭa aniṣṭa tvena vyavasthānāt tad prāpti parivarjana arthe pravṛtti nivṛttī na syātām api ca ayam sukha ādi hetuḥ sattvāt sva kārya karaṇa pravṛttaḥ api asattvāt na śaknoti kartum akurvataḥ api asya mokṣaḥ na asti sattvāt tat ayam sattva asattvābhyām ākṛṣyamāṇaḥ kām avasthām ca tat prāpnotu dustare hi vyasane nagna śramaṇaka durbuddhinā ayam varākaḥ patitaḥ iti

api ca tvad tīrthaṅkara vacanam kim satyam āhosvit asatyam iti satyam eva iti na yuktam ekānta vāda prasaṅgāt atha atra api sapta bhaṅgīṣṭā syāt satyam syāt asatyam syāt ubhayam syāt avaktavyam iti evamādikā tadā pramāṇa apramāṇa vyavasthā anupapattiḥ syāt vādasya sarvatra aviśeṣāt tathā tvad tīrthaṅkarāṇām api anuṣṭhānam syāt kutsitam syāt akutsitam syāt ubhayam caura ādīnām api tathā eva iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ tathā ca āśrava ādi vyavasthā anupapattiḥ kila viśiṣṭa anuṣṭhānavatām eva saṃvara nirjara amokṣāḥ bhavanti aviśiṣṭa anuṣṭhānavatām tu āsrava bandhau eva iti abhyupagamaḥ tat ca ubhayam api anuṣṭhānam yadā syāt viśiṣṭam syāt aviśiṣṭam iti avyavasthitam tadā katham āsrava ādi vyavasthā

tathā jīvājīva vyavasthā api ayuktā syāt vāde hi jīvaḥ api ajīvaḥ syāt ajīvaḥ api jīvaḥ syāt iti kutas tayoḥ vyavasthā atha avyavasthā api asti sā kim paramārthataḥ kim vā asmān evam eva pratārayasi na hi ekānta pakṣa anabhyupagame kvacid vyavasthā upapadyate yena ca prakāreṇa arthānām vyavasthā ucyate saḥ eva teṣām tāttvikaḥ svabhāvaḥ yaḥ tu avyavasthita svabhāvaḥ sa na tāttvikaḥ sphaṭika ādeḥ pīta ādi svabhāva vat upapluta tvāt tasmāt na vastutas sat asat ātmakam vastu

na api nitya aniti ātmakam tathā hi yadi ātma ādi vastu svena paryāyi rūpeṇa nityam tadā vastutas tat nityam eva tatra paryāya anitya tvena anitya tvam kalpyamānam gauṇam eva syāt na ca svarūpeṇa eva ca tat naṣṭam anaṣṭam ca iti upapadyate naṣṭam eva iti niścaya pūrvakaḥ sarva prāṇi vyavahāraḥ ca dṛśyate saḥ api na syāt atha ātmanaḥ sukha ādi rūpeṇa anitya tvam api asti na sukha ādeḥ tatas anya tvāt tad anya tvam ca śākya mata dūṣaṇa prastāve samarthitam ananya tvam api asti iti ced na anya tva niścayena eva ananya tvasya bādhita tvāt candra ādityayoḥ iva ananya tvasya vāstava tve ca anya tvam avāstavam taimirika upalabdha candra antara vat

kenacid rūpeṇa nityaḥ puruṣaḥ kenacid anityaḥ iti bruvāṇaḥ idam ca praṣṭvyaḥ atha te rūpe puruṣāt parasparam ca kim bhinne uta abhinne ca iti bheda pakṣe tāvat na tayoḥ nitya anitya tvena puruṣasya nitya anitya tvam atiprasaṅgāt abheda pakṣe tu yena eva rūpeṇa nitya tvam tena eva anitya tvam iti prāptam tatra uktam eva dūṣaṇam atha bhinna abhinne tatra api kim yena eva rūpeṇa bhedaḥ tena eva abhedaḥ atha rūpa antareṇa iti yadi tena eva tadā punar tat eva dūṣaṇam atha rūpa antareṇa tatas anavasthā prasaṅgaḥ tatas ca idam ittham eva iti niścayaḥ kvacid na syāt tad niścaya abhāve tu tad pūrvaka vyavahāra sādhyaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ kasyacid na syāt dṛśyate ca buddhimatām niścaya pūrvakāt vyavahārāt uruṣa arthaḥ tasmāt na nitya anitya bhinna abhinna ādya vyavasthā iti

mīmāṃsaka pakṣe tu bhinna abhinna tvam nitya antam anupapannam tad mate hi nityaḥ eva ātmā iṣyate tasya anityaiḥ sukha ādibhiḥ tādātmyam na yuktam nitya tva eka tva virodhāt sukha ādīnām vā nānātvam anitya tvam ca virudhyate na tu atādātmyam api asti bhinna abhinna tva abhyupagamāt na ca abheda pakṣaḥ doṣa abhidhānāt bheda abhyupagame api abheda pakṣaḥ tvayā atyantam na tyaktaḥ tena abheda pakṣe puruṣasya anitya tva nānātva prasaktiḥ bheda pakṣe tu aprasaktiḥ iti jina mata anupraveśaḥ

etena sāmānyasya vyaktibhyaḥ bhinna abhinna tvam api apāstam tatra api yāvatā aṃśena bhedaḥ tāvatā aṃśena sāmānya vyakti dharma aniṣaṅgaḥ tatas ca nitya tva vyāpaka tva ādi dharmakam sāmānyam na syāt vyaktīnām vā sāmānya tādātmyena nitya tva ādi anuṣaṅgaḥ prāptaḥ tathā ca ekāntena anitya tva avyāpaka tva ādi dharmakāḥ pradīpa ādayaḥ api na upalabhyeran atha sāmānyam nitya tva ādi rūpeṇa viśeṣebhyaḥ ekāntena bhidyate na tarhi kathaṃcid tat abhinnam tat eva hi sāmānyasya rūpam yat viśeṣebhyaḥ artha antaram tat ca nitya tva ādi dharmakam na abhinnam iti bhedaḥ eva sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ svarūpa antareṇa abhede api na abhedaḥ svarūpa antarasya asāmānya ātmaka tvāt

nanu yadi ekāntena bhinnam sāmānyam tad ādeśa bhedena api kadācid upalabhyeta na sva rūpa ādibhiḥ anekāntāt yathā vā sukha ādayaḥ śarīrāt na deśa bhedena upalabhyante kim ca deśa bhedaḥ yadi anyena deśa bhedena upalabhyate saḥ api deśa bhedaḥ anyena deśa bhedena iti anavasthā paramāṇu ākāśa ādīnām tu bhede api deśa bheda abhāvāt abhedaḥ prāptaḥ etena indriya bhedāt bhedaḥ pratyuktaḥ svarūpa bhedaḥ tu sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ api upalabhyate nitya anitya anugata vyāvṛtta ādi svarūpa bheda pratīteḥ iti alam prasaṅgena tat evam dharma dharmiṇoḥ ca ekānta bheda siddhau nitya tva vyāpaka tva ādi dharma upapannaḥ puruṣaḥ jñāna ādi āśrayaḥ sidhyati iti

nanu ca jñāna sukha duḥkha ādi āśraya tvam puruṣasya na yuktam pradhāna kārya tva prasaṅgāt yat yat sukha duḥkha mohaiḥ anvitam tat sarvam pradhāna kāryam yathā śabda ādayaḥ viṣayāḥ iti na pramāṇa abhāvāt na hi pradhāna astitve pramāṇam kiṃcid asti

na na asti anvaya parimāṇa śakti pravṛtti kārya kāraṇa bhāva vaiśvarūpyebhyaḥ asti pradhānam pradhatte vikārān pradhīyante vā asmin vikārāḥ iti pradhānam mūla bhūtam kāraṇam tat ca pañcabhyaḥ vītebhyaḥ niścīyate tathā hi
vivāda gocara āpannā bhedāḥ eka kāraṇa pūrvakā anvita tvāt ghaṭa śarāva ādi vat yat tat ekam kāraṇam tat pradhānam

kim ca parimita tvāt mūla ādi vat yathā vrīhau saṃśliṣṭānām mūla aṅkura parṇa nāla kāṇḍa prasava śūka tuṣa puṣpa kṣīra taṇḍula kaṇānām parimāṇam dṛṣṭam tathā ca pakṣīkṛtānām bhedānām asti parimāṇam ekādeśa indriyāṇi pañca tanmātrāṇi pañcabhūtāni pañca viparyaya bhedāḥ iti evamādi tasmāt ete api bhedāḥ kvacid ekasmin kāraṇe saṃsṛṣṭāḥ yatra saṃsṛṣṭāḥ tat pradhānam

kim ca śaktitas pravṛtteḥ triṣu api kāleṣu kārya pravṛtti samarthā śaktiḥ mṛd tattva ādi dṛṣṭāntena mṛd tattva ādi śaktiḥ api tad kāraṇeṣu avasthitā gamyate tad kāraṇa śaktiḥ api tad kāraṇa kāraṇeṣu iti evam tāvat yāvat akāraṇam

śakti śabdena ca avyakta rūpeṇa avasthitam kāryam eva ucyate tasya vyakta bhāva āpattiḥ pravṛttiḥ iti ucyate pravṛtteḥ prāk api asti śaktiḥ labdha ātmakānām pravṛtti darśanāt pravṛtti kāle api asti tirobhāva darśanāt tad ūrdhvam api asti punar pravṛtti darśanāt tat evam yatas śakteḥ sarvam vyaktam pravartate sā śaktiḥ sadā avasthāyinī pradhānam iti ucyate

itas ca asti pradhānam kārya kāraṇa bhāva upalabdheḥ āsandikā ādi vat kārya kāraṇa bhāva śabdena upakārya upakāraka bhāvaḥ ucyate upakārya upakāraka bhāvena avasthitānām hi eka kāraṇa prabhava tvam dṛṣṭam yathāsandikā ādīnām asti ca kārya kāraṇānām bhūtānām ca parasparam upakārya upakāraka bhāvaḥ evam manuṣya ādīnām ca atas asti eṣām ekam kāraṇam iti

itas ca asti pradhānam vaiśvarūpya upalabdheḥ kṣīra ādi vat tat yathā kṣīrāt dadhi dadhnaḥ takram ghṛtam ca tad upayogāt puṣṭiḥ tatas api putra ādayaḥ kadācid mṛtasya śarīrasya kvāthaḥ kuthitasya kṛmi bhāvena pariṇāmaḥ kuthitam śarīram vṛkṣāyurvede vṛkṣāṇām vṛddhi artham iti śrūyate tena ca vṛkṣāṇām api tad kārya tvam vṛkṣāt ca phalam phalāt rasaḥ tad upayogāt puṣṭi balam iti etat sarvam kṣīre asti kārya kāraṇayoḥ abhedāt evam sthāvarāṇām jaṅgameṣu sadbhāvaḥ jaṅgamānām ca sthāvareṣu iti evam jāti anucchedena sarvam sarva ātmakam deśa kāla ākāra nimitta pratibandhāt na samāna kāla abhivyaktiḥ tat etat sthāvara jaṅgama vaiśvarūpyam jala bhūmyoḥ pāriṇāmikam jala ādi pariṇāmaḥ api anyasya kasyacid saḥ api anyasya saḥ api anyasya saḥ api anyasya tāvat yāvat avibhāgaḥ kvacid abhūt yatra ca avibhāgaḥ tat pradhānam iti

tat etat sarvam ayuktam yat tāvat anvita tvāt iti tat na anaikāntika tvāt puruṣāḥ api caitanya sattva jñeya tva ādibhiḥ anvitā iti atha kāraṇa dharma saṃsargi tvam anvita tvam abhipretam tathā api dṛṣṭāntasya sādhya vikala tvam ghaṭa śarāva ādīnām eka kāraṇa pūrvakatva asiddheḥ atha ye bhedāḥ yena anvitāḥ te tad ātmakāḥ eva dṛṣṭāḥ yathā candanena anvitāni candana śakalāni candanāt na vyatiricyante mṛdā ca anvitāḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ na amṛd ātmakāḥ tathā sarve bhāvāḥ sukha duḥkha mohaiḥ anvitāḥ tasmāt sarve sukha ādi ātmakāḥ iti na asiddha tvāt na hi sarva bhāvānām sukha ādi anvita tve pramāṇam kiṃcid asti

nanu uktam pramāṇam śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandhāḥ pañca api trayāṇām sukha duḥkha mohānām sanniveśa viśeṣāḥ kasmāt pañcānām pañcānām eka kārya bhāvāt sāttvika rājasa tāmasa pañcaka traya avarodha artham vīpsā abhidhānam eka kārya bhāvāt iti atra api vīpsā draṣṭavyā tatra sāttvikānām pañcānām ekam kāryam dṛṣṭam prasāda lāghava prasava abhiṣvaṅga uddharṣa prītayaḥ tathā hi putraḥ te jātaḥ iti śabdam śrutvā asya prasādaḥ svastha indriyam bhavati dehasya laghu tvam lāghavam tuṣṭa sādhana dātṛ tvam prasavaḥ tatra eṣā śaktiḥ abhiṣvaṅgaḥ romāñcanam uddharṣaḥ prītiḥ sukham iti evam sparśa ādiṣu api yojyam

tathā rājasānām pañcānām ekam kāryam dṛṣṭam śoṣa tāpa bheda stambha udvega apadveṣāḥ tatra putraḥ te mṛtaḥ iti śabdam śrutvā asya śoṣaḥ bhavati udaka prārthana paratvam tāpaḥ duḥkham bhedaḥ aśru prasveda amedhya ādi utsargaḥ stambhaḥ kim karomi iti upāya aparijñānam aratiḥ udvegaḥ pratikūla karaṇa icśāpadveṣaḥ evam sparśa ādiṣu api yojyam

tathā tāmasānām pañcānām ekam kāryam dṛṣṭam varaṇa sādana apadhu aṃsa bībhatsa dainya gauravāṇi tatra putraḥ te mṛtaḥ iti śabdam śrutvā asya varaṇam kriyā pratibandhaḥ sādanam viṣaṇṇa tā apadhvaṃsanam nistejaḥ tvam pratyaya lopaḥ vā bībhatso vikṣata rūpa tvam dainyam yat kiṃcid prārthana paratvam gauravam sva hasta ādīnām api utkṣepaṇa ādya sāmarthyam evam sparśa ādiṣu api yojyam etaiḥ ca śabda ādibhiḥ ārabdhāni pṛthivī ādīni pañca mahābhūtāni tasmāt tāni api sattva ādīnām sanniveśa viśeṣa mātram tathā karaṇa ātmanām sukha duḥkha mohānām trayodaśānām tat eva kāryam prasāda ādi tathā deva manuṣya tiryagyoni ātmakānām prakāśa pravṛtti niyamānām tat eva kāryam prasāda ādi tasmāt sarvam jagat sukha ādīnām sanniveśa mātram iti

tat etat api ayuktam yadi nāma śabda ādīnām prasāda ādi kārya janaka tvam sukha ādi svabhāva tve kim āyātām na hi atra pratibandhaḥ kaścid asti nanu atra uktam śabda ādayaḥ sukha ādi svabhāvāḥ prasāda ādi janaka tvāt sukha ādi vat iti na kāla atyaya apadiṣṭa tvāt sukha ādi svabhāva tve hi śabda ādīnām antaḥkaraṇa eka saṃvedya tva prasaṅgaḥ badhira ādi abhāva prasaṅgaḥ ca na hi sukha ādayaḥ śrotra ādi vikalaiḥ na gṛhyante iti śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandhānām pratiniyata indriya grāhya tvam ca na syāt eka svabhāva tvāt nīla ādi buddhi vat aviśeṣeṇa sukha ādi buddhi prasaṅgaḥ ca yathā nīla ādi svabhāve vastuni sarveṣām tad draṣṭṝṇām aviśiṣṭaḥ nīla ādi pratibhāsaḥ bhavati evam yadi sukha ādi svabhāvaḥ api bāhyaḥ arthaḥ syāt tadā tatra sukha ādi pratibhāsaḥ api sarveṣām tad draṣṭṝṇām aviśiṣṭaḥ syāt tasmin eva arthe kasyacid sukham kasyacid duḥkham kasyacid tīvram kasyacid mandam iti evamādi viśeṣaḥ na syāt tasmāt na sukha ādi svabhāvāḥ śabda ādayaḥ iti

yat ca uktam etaiḥ ca śabda ādibhiḥ ārabdhāni ityādi tad viparītam eva kalpitam yasmāt ākāśa ādibhiḥ śabda ādayaḥ ārabhyante na tu śabda ādibhiḥ ākāśa ādīni iti ākāśasya paramāṇūnām ca nitya tvāt na ca yena yat ā ārabdham tat tad ātmakam eva bheda abhāve hi kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ eva na syāt siddha asiddha avasthayoḥ sva ātmani kriyā virodhāt na api eka jāti tvam niyamena kārya kāraṇayoḥ pratyakṣeṇa api kuvinda turī paṭa ādīnām jāti bheda upalambhāt na ca jāti jāti matoḥ tādātmyam siddham yena eka jāti tve api kārya kāraṇayoḥ abhedaḥ syāt jāti tadvatoḥ atyanta bhedasya vistareṇa prasādhita tvāt sattā sambandhi tvena ca puruṣāṇām api ekatva prasaṅgāt tatas ca mūlaprakṛtiḥ avikṛtiḥ mahat ādyāḥ prakṛti vikṛtayaḥ sapta ṣoḍaśakaḥ ca vikāraḥ na prakṛtiḥ na vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ iti ayam abhyupagamaḥ virudhyate

rūpa ādi vaidharmyāt ca na sukha ādi svabhāvāḥ pṛthivī ādayaḥ sukha ādīnām pariṇāma viśeṣāḥ pṛthivī ādayaḥ iti ced te kim sukha ādibhyaḥ anye ananye vā anya tve puruṣa vat atri guṇa tvam ananya tve tu rūpa ādimat tvam aindriyaka tvam ca virudhyeta pradhāna vat dharma antara āpattau sattva ādiṣu eva pṛthivī ādi vyavahāraḥ iti ced dharma antarasya tatas anya tve puruṣa vat atri guṇa tvam ananya tve ca pradhāna vat niyata deśa kāla tva anupapattiḥ svabhāva vailakṣaṇya abhāva prasaṅgaḥ ca kenacid rūpeṇa anyat kenacid tat eva na anyat iti atra api uktam eva pṛthivī ādīnām ca dūṣaṇam tattva anya tvābhyām anirvacanīya tvāt iti ced na pañcaviṃśati tattva abhyupagama virodhāt

na hi buddhi ādīnām pradhānāt anya tvena avacane pañcaviṃśati tattvāni upapadyante viruddha dharma adhyāsāt ca mithas śabda ādīnām indriyāṇām ca pṛthivī ādīnām ca bheda siddheḥ katham anya tva avacanam puruṣasya api vā anya tva avacanam syāt api ca sukha duḥkha mohānām eka indriya saṃvedyā rūpa ādi tva sādharmye api ekāntena bhedaḥ iṣyate śabda ādīnām tu pratiniyata indriya grāhya tva ādi vaidharmye api na ekāntena bhedaḥ iti aho prāmāṇika tvam pratyakṣa ādinā upalabhyamāne api sukha ādibhyaḥ śabda ādīnām atyanta bhede kiṃcid sādharmyāt abheda siddhau advaita siddhiḥ eva syāt guṇa puruṣāṇām api sādharmi a sadbhāvāt tasmāt na anvayāt pradhāna siddhiḥ

na api parimāṇa asiddhiḥ parimitānām eka kāraṇa saṃsṛṣṭa tve dṛṣṭānta asiddheḥ mūla aṅkura ādīnām tu brīhi avayavebhyaḥ avayava antara sahitebhyaḥ pūrva pūrva avayava vināśe sati krameṇa utpattiḥ na ekatra saṃsargaḥ asti na api ekasmāt utpattiḥ sarva kāryāṇām kartṛka karaṇa upādāna pūrvakatva siddheḥ na api eka upādāna pūrvaka tvam kasyacid dravyasya ekasya api asti atha eka jātīya upādāna pūrvaka tvam tadā siddha sādhya tā dravya eka jātīyasya eva upādāna tva abhyupagamāt avāntara jāti bhedaḥ tu kṣiti udaka ādi upādānānām pratyakṣeṇa api upalabhyate tatas tad apahnave pratyakṣa ādi bādhā api syāt sukha ādīnām tu na kvacid upādāna tvam siddham guṇa tvāt tat na parimāṇāt api pradhāna siddhiḥ
etena upakārya upakāraka bhāvāt pradhāna siddhiḥ iti apāstam

na api śakti pravṛtteḥ pradhāna siddhiḥ triṣu api kāleṣu kāryam kāraṇeṣu avasthitam asti iti kena etat śraddheyam na hi kanyakā udare putra pautra ādayaḥ prāk api avasthitāḥ santi iti atra pramāṇam kiṃcid asti
etena vaiśvarūpya hetuḥ api apāstaḥ satkārya tva sāmarthyāt eteṣām siddhiḥ iti ced na tasya eva asiddha tvāt na hi kāryasya prāk astitve pramāṇam kiṃcid asti

nanu uktam pramāṇam asat akaraṇāt upādāna grahaṇāt sarva sambhava abhāvāt śaktasya śakti akaraṇāt kāraṇa bhāvāt ca satkāryam ete ca avīta hetavaḥ yadi asat kriyate śaśa viṣāṇa ādi api kriyate na tu kriyate tasmāt sat eva kāryam yadi ca tantu ādiṣu paṭa ādi kāryam na asti tadā paṭa ādi arthinaḥ tantu ādi upādānam na kuryuḥ tad kārya śūnya tvāt vīraṇa ādi vat

yadi ca āsan eva paṭaḥ tantubhyaḥ bhavati tatas sarvam kāryam bhavet asattva aviśeṣāt na tu bhavati atas sarva sambhava abhāvāt niścīyate yat eva yatra asti tat eva tatas bhavati iti śaktasya ca kartṛ tvam sarvaiḥ eva iṣyate na ca śakti vikalam śaktam yuktam śaktim ca na kāryāt anyām paśyāmaḥ śakyam ca kriyate tena na asataḥ śakya tvam yuktam kim ca yadi asya kāraṇam tat tatas bhavati na ca asati kārye asya idam kāraṇam iti upapadyate tasmāt sat eva kāryam iti

tat etat api ayuktam yat tāvat asat akaraṇāt iti tat na paratibandha asiddheḥ yadi nāma śaśa viṣāṇāt yasat kriyamāṇam na dṛṣṭam paṭa ādi api asat na kriyate iti kutas yathā eva hi śaśa viṣāṇa ādeḥ asattvam akriyamāṇa tvam ca sarva loka avisaṃvādinā pratyakṣa ādinā pramāṇena siddham tathā eva paṭa ādīnām prāk asattvam kriyamāṇa tvam ca siddham kim na iṣyate kim ca asat akaraṇāt asat kāryam kim na iṣṭam tatra api evam śakyate vaktum yadi sat kriyate puruṣa ādi api kriyeta na tu kriyate tasmāt asat kāryam iti

yat tu uktam upādāna grahaṇāt iti tat api ayuktam viruddha tvāt yadi hi prāk api asti kāryam tatas tad artham tad kāraṇeṣu na kaścid pravarteta vaiyarthyāt na hi loke yasya yat asti sa tad artham yatate iti nanu pṛṣṭham me kuru keśān me kuru ityādi vyavahāra darśanāt sataḥ api kriyamāṇa tvam siddham na tasya aupacārika tvāt pṛṣṭha keśa ādiṣu anyat eva kiṃcid kāryam kriyate pṛṣṭha keśa ādikam tu upacāreṇa kriyate iti ucyate na tu aṃjasā tasya prāk eva niṣpanna tvāt niṣpannasya ca niṣpādanā sambhavaḥ tatra anarthakaḥ hetuḥ syāt yadi asan eva paṭaḥ tantubhiḥ kriyate vīraṇa ādibhiḥ api kim na kriyate iti ced na vīraṇa ādīnām tatra asāmarthyāt sāmarthyam eva kāryam iti ced na śakteḥ kāraṇa dharma tvāt tatas paścāt bhavat kāryam katham tad ātmakam syat yogyatām vijñāya ca pratiniyata kāraṇa upādānam na tu kārya darśanāt na hi aniṣpannaḥ paṭaḥ draṣṭum śakyate kim ca sarvam sarva ātmakam iti evaṃvādīnām vīraṇa ādiṣu api paṭaḥ asti iti kim na taiḥ paṭaḥ kriyate kasmāt ca na tāni paṭa arthibhiḥ upādīyante
etena sarva sambhava abhāvaḥ api pratyuktaḥ yathā uktam śakyam ca kriyate na ca asat kartum śakyam iti sat katham śakyam na hi pradhānam puruṣaḥ vā kenacid kartum śakyate

yat ca uktam kāraṇa bhāvāt iti tat api viruddha tva apayuktam yadi hi prāk api asti kāryam tadā kāraṇena kim kartavyam akiṃcitkaram ca katham kāraṇam na hi kṣetrajñānām parasparam kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ sambhavati kāryasya abhivyaktiḥ kāraṇena kriyate iti ced sā yadi asatī kriyate tatas asat kāryam syāt sati ced abhivyaktiḥ tad avastham kāraka ānarthakyam abhivyakteḥ api abhivyaktiḥ kriyate iti ced sā api satī syāt asatī vā iti aparyavasānam sarvatra sattva abhyupagame sarvam sadā eva abhivyaktim iti ānarthakyam eva kārakāṇām etena dharma antara apravṛtti lābhāt yukti bhedaḥ pratyuktaḥ yat kiṃcid prayojanam kārakāṇām ucyate tat sarvam sarva ākāreṇa prāk eva asti iti ānarthakyam eva kārakāṇām yena vā ākāreṇa prāk asti sa tasya akāraḥ prāk asan eva paścāt dhetubhyaḥ bhavati iti katham na asatkāryam

mādhava mata abhyupagame tu sāṃkhya nāśaḥ eva syāt katham yadi hi abhivyaktiḥ anyaḥ vā kaścid dharmaḥ asan eva kriyate tatas asat akaraṇāt iti evamādayaḥ asamarthāḥ hetavaḥ syuḥ tatas satkārya tva asiddhau vaiśvarūpya ādya siddheḥ pradhāna ādya siddhiḥ iti na ca atra viśeṣaḥ kaścid asti yena paṭa ādi kāryasya eva asataḥ karaṇam sataḥ ca ātmahānam ca na sambhavati tad dharmasya tu kasyacid sambhavati eva iti na ca kiṃcid api asat na bhavati iti śakyam vaktum visphūrjata api hi kārakāṇām avaśyam kiṃcid phalam vācyam yat asiddham taiḥ sādhyate iti yadi kiṃcid na asat jāyate na sannivartate tadā deśa kāla ākāra nimitta pratibandhāt na samāna kāla abhivyaktiḥ iti etat api vyāhanyate

yadi hi sadā eva santi abhivyaktayaḥ katham na samāna kālāḥ na ced santi paścāt api katham na bhaviṣyanti tathā deśa ādi pratibandhaḥ api san ced na kadācid nivartiṣyate iti sadā eva anabhivyakti prasaṅgaḥ atha āsan eva pratibandhaḥ tathā api kutas anabhivyaktiḥ iti yat punar etat na vastutas kiṃcid utpadyate nivartate vā guṇānām hi saṃyoga viyoga mātre pravṛtti nivṛtti vyavahāraḥ sattva ādīnām eva anyathā sanniveśe kārya bheda upacāraḥ śikyākṣa sūtra ādi vat iti tat ayuktam avayavebhyaḥ artha antarasya avayavinaḥ samarthita tvāt saṃyogasya ca artha antara tvāt utpatti vināśa dharmaka tvāt ca katham na kiṃcid utpadyate

api ca rajju ādīnām mūrta tvāt sāvayava tvāt avayava kriyā dvāreṇa anyathā anyathā sanniveśaḥ kartum śakyate sattva ādīnām vibhu tva niravayava tvāt puruṣa vat na anyathā anyathā sanniveśeḥ sambhavati viyogaḥ api vibhūnām ayuktaḥ kim ca arūpādimatām sanniveśa viśeṣe api katham rūpa ādi upalabdhiḥ na hi vāyūnām sanniveśa viśeṣe api śukla ādi rūpam upalabhyate yeṣām hi yathā bhūtāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ teṣām anyathā anyathā āsanniveśe api tathābhūtāḥ eva rūpa ādayaḥ upalabhyante yathā kṛṣṇa tantūnām tasmāt na guṇa sanniveśa mātre pṛthivī ādi vyavahāraḥ atas eva na pradhānasya upādāna tvam tad upādāna tve hi pṛthivī ādīnām vicitra rūpa ādi yogi tvam na syat kārya dravyasya upādāna rūpa ādi anuvidhāna darśanāt pradhānasya api vicitra rūpa ādi yogitva abhyupagame paramāṇuṣu eva pradhāna saṃjñā kṛtā syāt ekasya vicitra rūpa ādi yoga asambhavāt dravya upādānasya ca alpa parimāṇa tva nānātva niyama upalambhāt paramāṇūnām ca sukha ādi āśraya tvam prāk eva pratiṣiddham tasmāt na sukha ādi āśraya tve puruṣasya pradhāna tva prasaṅgaḥ pradhānasya ca sukha ādi āśraya tve puruṣaḥ niṣprāmāṇikaḥ syāt

nanu bhogyena bhoktuḥ anumānam uktam sa vikāram pradhānam bhoktra vinābhūtam bhogya tvāt odana ādi vat tathā para arthaḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ saṃhata tvāt śayana ādi vat iti tat ayuktam bhoga svarūpa asiddheḥ sukha duḥkhe tat jñānam ca loke api bhoga tvena prasiddham tat ca bhavatā buddheḥ karaṇasya iṣṭam tad anyaḥ tu kaḥ puruṣasya bhogaḥ iti etena parārtha tvam pratyuktam kaḥ hi deha ādibhiḥ puruṣasya arthaḥ sampādyate dharma ādayaḥ api hi buddheḥ eva iṣyante

nanu dvividhaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ uktaḥ śabda ādi upalabdhiḥ guṇa puruṣa antara darśanam ca pūrvena bhogaḥ uktaḥ uttareṇa mokṣaḥ iti katham bhogaḥ iti ced ucyate buddheḥ ākūtam viditvā indriyāṇi viṣaya ākāreṇa pariṇamante tatas tad indriya vṛtti ākāreṇa buddheḥ parimāṇaḥ tasyām buddhi vṛttau caitanya abhivyaktiḥ na bhavati yathā sūryakāntāt iti araśmi sannipāte tala ādiṣu agni jvālā abhivyajyate tathā viṣaya indriya manaḥ vṛtti sannipāte antaḥkaraṇa vṛttau caitanyam abhivyajyate saḥ ayam buddheḥ abhivyaktiḥ pariṇāmaḥ bhogaḥ iti ucyate tatra yasya mate trayāt aśavidham karaṇam tad mate mahat tattvam buddhi śabdena ucyate ye tu ekādaśavidham karaṇam icchanti tad mate tu manaḥ eva buddhiḥ tat uktam puruṣaḥ avikṛta ātmā eva sva nirbhāsam acetanam manaḥ karoti sānnidhyāt upādhiḥ sphaṭikam yathā vivikte dṛś pariṇatau buddhau bhogaḥ asya kathyate pratibimba udayaḥ svacche yathā candramasaḥ ambhasi

saḥ ayam prakṛti puruṣayoḥ bhoktṛ bhogya lakṣaṇaḥ anādi sambandhaḥ bandhaḥ iti ucyate sa ca adarśana mūlaḥ tena asau darśanāt nivartate tad nivṛttau ca nirupādhiḥ puruṣaḥ svabhāva nirmalaḥ muktaḥ iti ucyate tat uktam pañcaviṃśati tattva jñaḥ yatra tatra āśrame rataḥ jaṭī muṇḍī śikhī vā api mucyate na atra saṃśayaḥ

punar api uktam samyak jñāna adhigamāt dharma ādīnām akāraṇa prāptau tiṣṭhati saṃskāra vaśāt cakra bhrama vat ghṛta śarīraḥ prāpte śarīra bhede caritārtha tvāt pradhāna vinivṛttau ekāntikam ātyantikam ubhayam kaivalyam āpnoti autsukya nivṛtti artham yathā kriyāsu pravartate lokaḥ puruṣasya vimokṣa artham pravartate tadvat avyaktam raṅgasya darśayitvā nivartate nartakī yathā nṛtyāt puruṣasya tathā ātmānam prakāśya vinivartate prakṛtiḥ nānāvidhaiḥ upāyaiḥ upakāriṇi anupakāriṇaḥ puṃsaḥ guṇavatī aguṇasya sataḥ tasya artham apārthakam carati prakṛteḥ sukumārataram na kiṃcid asti iti me matiḥ bhavati yā dṛṣṭā asmi iti punar na darśanam upaiti puruṣasya tat evam dvividha puruṣa artha upapatteḥ na parārtha tva anupapattiḥ iti

tat etat ākāśa carvaṇa vat anupapannam yat tāvat agni jvālā vat caitanyam abhivyajyate iti tat na satkārya tva niṣedhāt agni jvālāyāḥ api abhivyakti anupapatteḥ satkārya pakṣe api tirohitasya abhivyaktiḥ sambhavati na ca tvad mate caitanyasya tirobhāvaḥ asti apariṇamitvā abhyupagamāt na hi viśiṣṭa ākāra pariṇatāyām api buddhau citeḥ pūrva svabhāvānyathātvam bhavati apariṇāmi tva virodhāt

svabhāva aviśeṣe api bhoga abhyupagame tu sadā eva aviśeṣeṇa bhogaḥ syāt tathā ca kaḥ puṃsaḥ pradhāna kṛtaḥ bhogaḥ caitanya ākāreṇa eva buddheḥ pariṇāmaḥ eva bhogaḥ iti ced sa kim puruṣa nimittaḥ vā na vā puruṣa nimittaḥ ced na tarhi udāsīnaḥ puruṣaḥ sva bhoga kartṛ tvāt atha kriyā pariṇāmaḥ api tasya na asti sannidhi mātreṇa kartṛ tvāt tena kurvan api udāsīnaḥ iti ucyate na atiprasaṅgāt yadi nirvyāpārasya api sannidhi mātreṇa kartṛ tvam tad ātmanām vyāpaka tvena sarvatra sānnidhyāt sarva ātmānaḥ sarveṣām kartāraḥ syuḥ mukta ātmānaḥ api bhoktāraḥ syuḥ tad sannidhi mātrā viśeṣāt atha bhogam akurvan eva bhoktā na aprasiddha tvāt na hi bhuji kriyām akurvan eva kaścid bhoktā prasiddhaḥ kim ca mukta ātmanām api bhoktṛ tva prasaṅgāt viśeṣa abhāvāt etena pratibimba udayaḥ pratyuktaḥ citi svabhāva aviśeṣe api sarva puṃsām vyāpaka tvena sannidhāna aviśeṣe api ca kasyacid eva puṃsaḥ pratibimba udayaḥ na sarva puṃsām iti kiṃkṛtaḥ ayam niyamaḥ kleśa karma ādi viśeṣa kṛtaḥ iti ced na kleśa ādeḥ buddhi vṛtti tva abhyupagamāt

nanu buddhi vṛtti tve api sva svāmi sambandha niyamāt puruṣa vṛtti tva upacāraḥ śrūyate hi bhṛtya aparādhena svāminaḥ daṇḍaḥ iti na sarvathā udāsīnasya svāmi tvena dṛṣṭānta aprasiddheḥ viparyaye tu rāja ādi dṛṣṭāntaḥ asti sva tvam api upakārakasya eva bhṛtya ādeḥ dṛṣṭam na ca buddhiḥ puṃsaḥ svabhāva nirmalasya kiṃcid upakāram kartum śaknoti

nartakī vat ātmānam darśayanti eva upakārikā iti ced na etat asti nartakī hi raṅgasya sva ātma darśanam janayantī sva ātmānam darśayati iti ucyate na ca buddhiḥ puṃsaḥ kiṃcid janayati sarvathā anupakārya tvāt na ca nartakī api adidṛkṣoḥ kasyacid ātmānam darśayitum śaknoti didṛkṣavaḥ ca sukha abhilāṣāt punar punar cakṣuḥ vyāpārayantaḥ paśyanti iti katham udāsīnāḥ tasmāt na udāsīnasya bhogaḥ kvacid prasiddhaḥ iti

etena mokṣaḥ api prayuktaḥ kim ca yasya sambandhaḥ tasya tad abhāvāt mokṣaḥ iti ucyate bandhaḥ ca ajñānam abhimataḥ yasmāt uktam dharmeṇa gamanam ūrdhvam gamanam adhastāt bhavati adharmeṇa jñānena ca apavargaḥ viparyayāt iṣyate bandhaḥ vairāgyāt prakṛti layaḥ saṃsāraḥ bhavati rājasāt rāgāt aiśvaryāt avighātaḥ viparyayāt tad viparyāsaḥ tat ca ajñāna rāga ādikam buddheḥ eva iṣṭam na puruṣasya iti katham anya kṛtena ajñāna ādinā puruṣasya bandha saṃsāra ādi upapattiḥ na hi taskara aparādhāt sādhūnām bandhaḥ nyāyyaḥ sādhu kṛtāt vā sukṛtāt taskarāṇām mokṣaḥ iti

nanu upacāreṇa eva puruṣasya bandha ādikam ucyate yasmāt uktam rūpaiḥ saptabhiḥ eva tu badhnāti ātmānam ātmanā prakṛtiḥ sā eva ca puruṣasya artham vimocayati eka rūpeṇa iti na nimitta abhāvāt upacārasya api anupapatteḥ sva svāmi bhāvaḥ api tvad pakṣe na upapayate iti uktam bhinna abhinna anupapatteḥ ca na tāvat sva svāmi bhāvaḥ prakṛti puruṣābhyām bhinnaḥ svayam anabhyupagamāt na hi guṇa puruṣa vyatiriktam tvayā kiṃcid abhyupagamyate atha abhinnaḥ tadā prakṛti puruṣayoḥ anucchedāt anucchedyaḥ sva svāmi bhāvaḥ tatas mokṣa anupapattiḥ

caritārtham pradhānam na pravartate iti etat api anena pratyuktam pravṛtti nimittasya anucchedāt ucchede vā pradhānasya api ucchedaḥ tat abhedāt etena autmukya nivṛttiḥ pratyuktā śabda ādi upalabdhi vat vā yathā śabda ādi upalabdhim kṛtvā na carita artham bhavati punar śabda ādi upalabdhi darśanāt tathā kṛtvā api guṇa puruṣa antara darśanam punar tad artham eva pravarteta

syāt etat śabda ādi upalabdhim kṛtvā guṇa puruṣa antara darśana artham pravartate tasmin api kṛte na aparam pravṛtti nimittam asti iti kutas pravarteta yadi evam śabda ādi upalambham kṛtvā tam prati nivṛtta autsukya tvāt guṇa puruṣa antara darśanam eva karotu kimartham janmani janmani śabda ādi upalambham eva karoti evam hi apuruṣa arthā eva prakṛteḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt yad artham pravṛttā na tat sampādayati śabda ādi upalambha artham ca na pravṛttiḥ ghaṭate tatra autsukya abhāvāt janma antareṣu kṛta tvāt aprekṣā pūrva kāri tvāt anya artham pravṛttā api anyat sampādayati iti ced yadi evam saṃsārya ātma artham pravṛttā api kadācid mukta ātmanaḥ api bhogam sampādayet viveka vikala tvāt

buddheḥ ākūtam viditvā ityādi api ayuktam karaṇa tvāt indriyāṇām vā asya ādi vat na ākūta parijñānam na api svatas pravṛttiḥ iti buddheḥ api dharma jñāna ādi adhikaraṇa tvam ayuktam karaṇa tvāt acetana tvāt ca khanitra ādi vat puruṣasya api na dharma ādi adhikaraṇa tvam cetana tvāt mukta ātma vat iti ced na dharmi dṛṣṭānta grāhaka pramāṇa bādhita tvāt na hi jñāna vyatiriktam caitanyam kutaścid siddham yasya jñānam tasya eva sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma saṃskārāḥ ca iti samarthitam duḥkha tad hetu viyuktaḥ tu loke api muktaḥ prasiddhaḥ tena amukta ātmanām duḥkham tad nimittam adharma avidyā ādikam ca abhyupagantavyam iti vyavasthitam tāvat yathā uktam apara ātma jñānam niḥśreyasa aṅgam iti
atha idānīm paramātma jñānam niḥśreyasa aṅga tvena vaktavyam

nanu ca para apara bhedena ātma jñānam na eva niḥśreyasa sādhanam kasmāt avidyā rūpa tvāt bheda jñānasya candra ādi bheda jñāna vat tathā ca śrutiḥ ekam eva idam na dvitīyam dvitīyāt vai bhayam bhavet mṛtyoḥ sa mṛtyum āpnoti yaḥ iha nānā iva paśyati sarvam khalu idam brahma yasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni ātmā eva abhūt vijānataḥ tasya kaḥ śokaḥ mohaḥ eka tvam anupaśyataḥ yaḥ tu sarvāṇi bhūtāni ātmani eva anupaśyati sarva bhūteṣu ca ātmānam tatas na vijugupsate ekaḥ eva hi bhūtātmā dehe dehe vyavasthitaḥ ekadhā bahudhā ca eva dṛśyate jala candra vat

anumānam api ucyate sarvam jagat paramātmanaḥ na bhidyate sattva jñeya tva ādibhyaḥ tad svarūpa vat na ca pratyakṣa virodhaḥ tasya bheda aviṣaya tvāt tat uktam āhuḥ vidhātṛ pratyakṣam na niṣeddhṛ vipaścitaḥ na ekatva āgamaḥ tena pratyakṣeṇa virudhyate kim ca sarvam vivāda āspadībhūtam bheda jñānam bhrāntam bheda jñāna tvāt candra ādi bheda jñāna vat advaita jñānam bheda jñānasya bādhakam eva tad uttara kāla bhāvi tvāt śuktikā ādi jñāna vat veda artha paryālocanāt uttara kālam advaita jñānam bhavati bheda jñānam tu anādya vidyā vaśāt sarveṣām prāk eva asti tatas tat na bādhakam rajata jñāna ādi vat

trailokya agrahaṇe ca tatas bhinnaḥ katham ghaṭaḥ pratīyate na hi yena aśvaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ saḥ aśvāt bhedena anaśvam pratipattum śaknoti ghaṭa paṭayoḥ api bhedaḥ katham gṛhyate yadi lakṣaṇa bhedāt lakṣaṇayoḥ api katham bhedaḥ tatra api lakṣaṇa bheda āśrayaṇe anavasthā syāt atha pratibhāsa bhedāt bhedaḥ pratibhāsayoḥ api katham bhedaḥ tatra api pratibhāsa bheda āśrayaṇe anavasthā prasarantī kena vāryate itaretara āśraya doṣāt ca yāvat na ghaṭaḥ paṭāt vyāvṛttaḥ pratītaḥ tāvat na ghaṭāt vyāvṛttaḥ paṭaḥ pratipattum śakyate yāvat ca na ghaṭāt vyāvṛttaḥ paṭaḥ pratītaḥ tāvat na paṭāt vyāvṛttaḥ ghaṭaḥ pratipattum śakyate iti

sat ākāra pratīti aviśeṣāt ca na hi eka ākāreṇa pratīyamānasya nānātvam yuktam abheda vyavahāra uccheda prasaṅgāt atha ghaṭa ādi ākāreṇa nānātvam pratīyate ghaṭa ādi ākāraḥ sat ākārāt anyaḥ ananyaḥ vā yadi anyaḥ tatas asan eva asau sataḥ anya tvāt śaśa viṣāṇa vat vastunaḥ ca advaitam cintyate atha abhinnaḥ tadā ghaṭa ādi ākāraḥ api sat ākāraḥ eva iti katham bhedaḥ tasmāt avidyā nibandhanaḥ ayam bheda pratibhāsaḥ sā ca avidyā brahmaṇaḥ tattva anya tvābhyām anirvacanīyā tena advaita pakṣe api jagat vaicitryam na virudhyate svapna upalabdha artha vaicitrya vat avicāra kṣama tvāt iti

tat etat sarvam ayuktam yat tāvat āgama balena advaita sādhanam tat na dvaita pakṣe api āgama sadbhāvāt tatra śrutau tāvat uktam dvā suparṇā sa yujā sakhāyā samānam vṛkṣam pariṣasvajāte tayoḥ anyaḥ pippalam svādvatti anaśnan anyaḥ abhicākaśīti tathā dve brahmaṇī veditavye param ca aparam ca ityādi tathā tam īśvarāṇām paramam maheśvaram tam daivatānām paramam ca daivatam patim patīnām paramam parastāt vidāma devam bhuvaneśam īḍyam karmabhiḥ mṛtyum ṛṣayaḥ niṣeduḥ prajāvantaḥ draviṇam īhamānāḥ atha apare ṛṣayaḥ manīṣiṇaḥ param karmabhyaḥ amṛta tvam ānaśuḥ iti evamādi smṛtau api uktam uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ tu anyaḥ paramātmā iti udāhṛtaḥ yaḥ lokatrayam āviśya bibharti avyayaḥ īśvaraḥ iti evamādi

tatra dvaita pakṣe yāni advaita abhidhāyīni vākyāni tāni paramātma viṣaya tvena arthavanti vyākhyeyāni ekam eva idam param brahma iti draṣṭavyam sarvam ca jagat brahma adhiṣṭhita tvena brahma kṛta tvena vā sarvam khalu idam brahma iti uktam evam anyāni vākyāni avirodhena vyākhyeyāni yasya tu mate dvitīyam na kiṃcid asti tasya dvaita abhidhāyīni vākyāni apramāṇāni eva prāptāni na hi teṣām upacāreṇa api arthaḥ sambhavati upacāra animitta abhāvāt na ca ekasmin eva āgame keṣāṃcid vākyānām prāmāṇyam keṣāṃcid aprāmāṇyam iti atra nyāyaḥ kaścid asti atha saṃsāra avasthāyām dvaitam mokṣa avasthāyām tu advaitam iti ubhayeṣām viṣaya vibhāgena prāmāṇyam varṇyate tat ayuktam dvaita an abhyupagame saṃsārasya eva anupapatteḥ yaḥ hi tāvat paramātmā saṃsthāna śarīra ādi ākāraḥ na bhavati na api asau rāga ādi yogāt deva manuṣya tiryakṣu saṃsarati na tasya kāryam karaṇam ca vidyate ityādi vākyaiḥ tasya sadā eva rūpa ādi rahita tva asaṃsāri tva pratipādanāt tad vikāra saṃsāra upapattiḥ iti ced na pariṇāma pakṣasya niṣiddha tvāt

syāt matiḥ eṣā dvividhā tasya paramātmanaḥ śaktiḥ kriyā jñāna lakṣaṇā tatra kriyāśaktitaḥ tāvat pradhānam bhavati pradhānāt tu mahat ādi vikāra prapañcaḥ kārya kāraṇayoḥ ca bhedaḥ na asti tena pradhāna ādeḥ kriyāśaktitaḥ na bhedaḥ śakti śaktimatoḥ api bhedaḥ na asti atas sarvam viśvam brahma ātmakam jñāna śaktitaḥ tu jīva ātmānaḥ bhavanti te api tatas na bhidyante teṣām ca avidyā vaśena utpannānām rāga ādi yogāt saṃsāraḥ tatra ye jīvāḥ avidyāvantaḥ eva pare brahmaṇi layam gacchanti teṣām maṇḍūka cūrṇa vat anirdagdha bīja bhāva tvāt punar utapattiḥ tatas rāga ādi yogāt punar saṃsāraḥ iti ye tu jñāna agninā dvaita bhāvanā sthirībhūta lakṣaṇena bheda vāsanā ākhyam saṃsāra bījam dagdhvā brahmaṇi līyante teṣām nirdagdha bīja tvāt na punar āvṛttiḥ tathā ca śrutiḥ kāmayamānaḥ atha akāmayamānaḥ yaḥ akāmaḥ niṣkāmaḥ ātma kāmaḥ āpta kāmaḥ bhavati na tasya prāṇāḥ utkrāmanti tatra eva samavalīyante brahma eva san brahma āpnoti iti tathā na paśyati iti āhuḥ ekī bhavati na śṛṇoti iti āhuḥ ekībhavati ityādi

tat ca na evam kasmāt pariṇāma pakṣasya niṣiddha tvāt na hi rūpa ādi vihīnasya rūpa ādi ākāreṇa pariṇatau kiṃcid pramāṇam asti satkārya pratiṣedhāt ca kārya kāraṇayoḥ abhedaḥ api niṣiddhaḥ śakti śaktimatoḥ api bhedaḥ prasādhitaḥ upādānakāraṇa tvam ca mūrtam prati amūrtasya na asti iti uktam tasmāt na īśvarasya upādāna kāraṇa tvam brahma eva san iti ādi a āgamena yoga utkarṣaḥ praśasyate parama utkarṣāt naḥ hi yogī brahma vat atyanta nirmala tvāt brahma eva iti uktaḥ tathābhūtaḥ eva san param brahma paśyati iti arthaḥ ekībhavati iti atra api upamā draṣṭavyā para brahma niṣṭhaḥ hi yogī na dvitīyam ātmānam api paśyati tena ekībhavan iva ekībhavati iti ucyate yat vā mukta eka varga antar bhavan ekībhavati iti ucyate na tu vastutas artha antara bhūtānām ekībhāvaḥ kadācid sambhavati

nanu toya ādīnām ekībhavaḥ dṛśyate toyam toya antareṇa saṃśliṣṭam ekībhavati dīpaḥ dīpa antareṇa mṛd mṛd antareṇa ghṛta taila ādikam ghṛta taila ādi antareṇa iti na etat asti na hi toya ādīnām api vastutas ekībhāvaḥ siddhaḥ kim tarhi teṣām pareṇa saṃśliṣṭānām eka avayava vyārambhaka tvena ekatvam upacaryate vibhāga adarśana mātreṇa vā toya ādi vat ekībhāva abhyupagame ca ātmanām vināśaḥ api tadvat eva syāt tasmāt na mokṣa avasthāyām api advaitam ye tu īśvarasya pariṇāmam na icchanti tad mate tu na īśvarasya kāraṇa tvam kārya abhāvāt na hi kāryam akurvat kāraṇam yuktam na ca ātmānam eva karoti sva ātmani kriyā virodhāt

saṃsāra mokṣayoḥ api anupapattiḥ īśvarasya sadā eva mukta tvāt tad vyatirikta bandha abhāvāt ca avidyā prayoktṛ tvam eva bhagavataḥ kartṛ tvam iti ced na advaita pakṣe tasya api anupapatteḥ nānātve hi sati avidyā prayoktṛ tvam api dṛṣṭam yathā indrajāla ādi kartā mantra auṣadha ādi prayoga dvāreṇa laukikānām viparyaya jñāna ākhyām avidyām pravartayati bheda abhāvāt ca keṣām avidyā kiṃlakṣaṇā vā avidyā kena ca nimittena īśvaraḥ tām prayuṅkte vidyā api kā yadi brahma svabhāvā eva tadā nityam vidyā asti iti avidyā utthānam eva na syāt na hi vidyāyām satyām avidyā avakāśam labhate tayoḥ saha avasthiti virodhāt avirodhe vā na kadācid avidyā ucchittiḥ iti apavarga anupapattiḥ

tattva anyatva aniḥ vacanīya tva parihāraḥ api ayuktaḥ tattva pratiṣedhāt eva anya tva siddheḥ anya tva pratiṣedhāt vā ananya tva siddheḥ iti katham ubhayathā api anirvacanīya tvam keśoṇḍukasya jñānāt anya tvena nirvacanīya tvāt tathā ca viparīta khyātiḥ samarthitā tatra eva sat asat tva anirvacanīya tva pratiṣedhaḥ api kṛtaḥ sataḥ eka deśa kāla ākāra anyatvena pratibhāsanāt iti uktam

na ca keśoṇḍukaḥ eva avidyā kim tu tad avabhāsi jñānam tat ca utpatti vināśa dharmaka tvāt katham kūṭasthāt brahmaṇaḥ na bhinnam anādi tvam ca avidyāyāḥ pravāha apekṣayā anyathā pratyakṣa virodhaḥ api syāt tasmāt advaite sati avidyā api na sambhavati iti atas na avidyā kṛta bheda apekṣayā api bheda abhidhāyīni veda vākyāni arthavanti sambhavanti

etena yat āhuḥ pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ upaplava darśanāt vedānām tu anupaplava tvāt na tad pratipāditasya advaitasya pratyakṣa anumānābhyām bādhāḥ iti tat api apāsatam veda vākyaiḥ eva bādha pratipādanāt kim ca pratyakṣasya upapluta tve veda siddhiḥ kutas syāt agṛhītāt ca vedān na artha pratipattiḥ pauruṣeya tvam ca vedānām samarthitam tena pratyakṣa mūla tvena eva īṣām prāmāṇyam anumānasya api upapluta tve pada vākya artheṣu vipratipattau katham nirṇayaḥ kutas viruddha aviruddha vya ākhyāna niścayaḥ sva para vākyānām ca prāmāṇya aprāmāṇya niścayaḥ kutas iti yat api uktam āhuḥ vidhātṛ pratyakṣam ityādi tat api ayuktam niṣeddhṛ tvena api pratyakṣasya samarthita tvāt pramāṇa antarbhāva prastāve tena bhū tala ādiṣu ghaṭa ādi abhāva vat itaretarābhāvaḥ api pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate tathā ca akṣavyā pāra bhāva anuvidhāyinī ghaṭa ādīnām sattā saṃvitti vat paraspara bheda saṃvittiḥ api sarva loka avisaṃvādena bhavantī dṛśyate tasmāt pratyakṣeṇa api advaita jñānam bādhyate aṅgulyā agre kari śatam asti ityādi jñāna vat

yat ca uktam vivāda āspadībhūtam bheda jñānam bhrāntam bheda jñāna tvāt candra ādi bheda jñāna vat iti tat api ayuktam vidyā vidyayoḥ bheda jñānena anaikāntika tvāt tasya api pakṣa tvam eva iti ced tat kim idānīm avidyā eva ekāti tattva jñānam tu na asti eva tathā ca advaita siddhiḥ api kutas bhrānta jñānena eva advaita siddhau bheda siddhiḥ api tatas syāt aviśeṣāt atha advaita jñānam bhrāntam na bhavati bhrāntāt bhinnam tarhi tat pratipattavyam tad bheda pratipattiḥ ca na bhrāntā iti katham na anaikāntika tvam

hetu arthaḥ ca kaḥ kim pratijñā arthaḥ eva kim vā tatas artha antaram yadi pratijñā arthaḥ eva tadā artha punarukta tvam sādhya aviśiṣṭa tvam ca syāt na hi bhavati agniḥ atra vahneḥ iti atha bhinnaḥ eva hetu arthaḥ tadā api advaita virodhaḥ tathā dṛṣṭāntaḥ api yadi pratijñā arthaḥ eva tadā na sādhakaḥ asiddha tvāt punarukta doṣaḥ ca bheda abhyupagame tu advaita virodhaḥ pratijñā arthaḥ ca kaḥ kim pramāṇa prameya ityādi sūtrasya yaḥ arthaḥ saḥ eva kim vā tatas anyaḥ yadi pramāṇa ādi sūtra arthaḥ eva sādhyaḥ tatas siddha sādhanam tatas anyaḥ ced tadā api advaita virodhaḥ

yat api uktam advaita jñānam bheda jñānasya bādhakam eva tad uttara kāla bhāvi tvāt śuktikā ādi jñāna vat iti tat api anaikāntikam nakha agre kari śatam asti iti jñānam anāpta vacanāt paścāt bhavat na pūrva bhāvinaḥ tad abhāva jñānasya bādhakam iti na ca advaite sādhya sādhana pratipādya pratipādaka ādi bhāvaḥ upapadyate iti maunam eva advaitam icchatā kartavyam iti uktam

yat punar etat trailokya agrahaṇe tatas anyaḥ katham ghaṭaḥ pratīyate iti tat na nirvikalpaka buddhau pratiyogi grahaṇam antareṇa api abhāva pratibhāsanāt gṛhīteṣu ca abhāveṣu yathā yathā pratiyogi jñānam bhavati tathā tathā tad vikalpena smṛtiḥ eva bhavati iti uktam yaḥ asau arthaḥ mayā dṛṣṭaḥ saḥ etat ātmakaḥ na bhavati iti evam smṛtiḥ sarva avisaṃvādena bhavantī dṛśyate tasmāt nirvikalpaka jñānena trailokya agrahaṇe api tatas bhinnaḥ eva ghaṭaḥ gṛhītaḥ tatas ghaṭa smṛti sahakāriṇā indriyeṇa ghaṭāt bhinnaḥ paṭaḥ iti jñānam sa vikalpakam eva janyate tatas ca na itaretarāśrayaḥ doṣaḥ eka deśa avasthitānām ca ghaṭa paṭa ādīnām aṅgulyoḥ iva yugapad api bhedaḥ gṛhyate tatas api na itaretara āśraya tvam

yat ca uktam kim lakṣaṇa bhedāt bhedaḥ pratibhāsa bhedāt vā iti tat na ukta uttara tvāt uktam atra ādau eva saṃśaya viṣaye lakṣaṇa bhedāt bhedaḥ gamyate sarvatra ca saṃśaya nimittam na asti tatas nānā avasthā pratibhāsa bhedāt bhede api nānā avasthā na hi pratibhāsānām bheda grahaṇe na arthānām bheda vyavasthitiḥ iṣyate yena anavasthā syāt kim tarhi arthānām bheda pratibhāsi jñānam ekam api pratibhāsa bhedaḥ iti ucyate tasya agrahaṇe api tad viṣayasya na agrahaṇam iti samarthitam saha upalambha nirākaraṇa prastāve

yat punar etat sat ākāra pratīti aviśeṣāt iti tat na tulya pramāṇa tvāt yatas eva pramāṇāt sat ākāra pratīti aviśeṣaḥ avagamyate tatas eva pramāṇāt deśa kāla avayava guṇa kriyā jāti ādi viśeṣa ākāraiḥ pratīti viśeṣaḥ api pratibhāti eva iti viśeṣa ākārāṇām sat ākārāt anya an anya tvābhyām anupapatteḥ iti ced kaḥ ayam sat ākāraḥ kim sattā eva kim tadvān iti yadi sattā sāmānyam tadā tatas bhinnāḥ eva viśeṣa ākārāḥ sāmānya tadvatoḥ bheda samarthanāt na ca śaśa viṣāṇa vat asattva prasaṅgaḥ śaśa viṣāṇasya sattā sambandha abhāvāt vivakṣita viśeṣāṇām tu sattā sambandhi tvāt

atha sattāvān eva sat ākāraḥ ucyate tatas sat ākārān na deśa kāla ādi viśeṣa ākārāḥ bhidyante tathā api sat ākāra aviśeṣāt varga eka tvam sidhyatu na vyaktyā ekatvam vyakti eka tva sādhane hi pratyakṣa ādi virodhaḥ uktaḥ tathā ca sūtram saṃkhyā ekānta asiddhiḥ pramāṇa anupapatti upapattibhyām iti pramāṇa anupapattau tāvat na siddhiḥ sarva vāda siddhi prasaṅgāt pramāṇa upapattau ca pramātṛ ādi bheda siddhiḥ tathā ca uktam catasṛṣu ca idam vidhāsu tattvam parisamāpyate iti avidyā nibandhanaḥ sarvaḥ ayam bheda pratibhāsaḥ iti atra api pramāṇam vaktavyam na hi vāc mātreṇa kasyacid arthasya siddhiḥ sarva vāda siddhi prasaṅgāt iti uktam pramāṇa abhidhānena ca pratipādya pratipādaka ādi bheda siddhiḥ aparihārya iti

etena śabda advaitam pratyuktam yat āhuḥ anādya nidhanam brahma śabda tattvam yat akṣaram vivartate artha bhāvena prakriyā jagataḥ yatas na saḥ asti pratyayaḥ loke yaḥ śabda anugamāt ṛte anuviddham iva ābhāti sarvam śabde pratiṣṭhitam yat yena anuviddham tat tatas na bhidyate yathā mṛdā anuviddhāḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ na amṛd ātmakāḥ yaḥ vā yasya parivartaḥ sa tatas na bhidyate yathā candra parivartaḥ jalacandraḥ śabda parivartaḥ ca sarvaḥ arthaḥ śabda ākāreṇa pratibhāsanāt tasmāt sarvaḥ arthaḥ śabda ātmakaḥ iti śabdāḥ api sarvaiḥ varṇaiḥ anuviddhā varṇāḥ ca svaraiḥ anuviddhāḥ svarāḥ ca nādena ekena anuviddhāḥ tasmāt ekam śabda ātmakam sarvam jagat iti advaita abhidhānāt eva vijñāna advaita brahma advaita śabda advaita ādīnām na kaścid viśeṣaḥ pratiṣṭhāpana prakriyā bhedam muktvā vijñāna advaitam anyathā pratiṣṭhāpayanti brahma advaitam anyathā śabda advaitam anyathā iti etāvat mātreṇa advaita vādinām mata bhedaḥ na tu advaite api kaścid bhedaḥ tathā ca sūtra kṛtā sarveṣām advaita vādinām pratiṣedha artham ekam eva sūtram uktam sāṃkhya ekānta asiddhiḥ ityādi satkārya pratiṣedhāt na sparśa ādi ākāreṇa śabda tattvasya pariṇāmaḥ iti

na api avidyā vaśena bheda pratītiḥ avidyā hi mithyājñānam ucyate tat ca deśa kāla bhedena nimitta bhedena ca svarūpataḥ ca bhidyate anyathā sarvatra sarvadā sarveṣām ca keśa ādi bhrānti prasaṅgaḥ tattva jñānānudaya prasaṅgaḥ ca nimitta abhāvāt nimitta sadbhāve ca nimittā naimittakayoḥ bheda advaita virodhaḥ tatra api avidyātaḥ eva bhedaḥ iti ced evam tarhi na vastutas tattva jñānam kutaścid kadācid utpadyate iti apavarga anupapattiḥ avidyā nimitta tve ca tattva jñāna apavargayoḥ keśoṇḍuka ādi vat avāstava tva prasaṅgaḥ tatas ca itara śāstra vat advaita śāstram api apuruṣa artham vastutas prāptam

api ca mokṣaḥ kasya cintyate tasya eva brahmaṇaḥ iti ayuktam tasya svabhāva m ukta tvāt saṃsāri tve vā na kaścid muktaḥ asti iti mokṣa tad upāyayoḥ kenacid api adṛṣṭa tvāt anupadeśa prasaṅgaḥ tad anupadeśe ca kutas tatra pravṛttiḥ pravartamānaḥ api yadā ekaḥ muktaḥ tadā eva saṃsāra uccheda prasaṅgaḥ anyasya saṃsāriṇaḥ asambhavāt avidyā vaśāt na ātma abhimānaḥ iti ced kim apavarge api avidyā na kṣīṇā na ca muktāt anyaḥ api ātmā asti yasya avidyā syāt jīvātmānaḥ santi iti ced te kim anye ananye vā yadi anye tadā ekatva virodhaḥ atha muktāt ananye tatas katham jīva ātmanām saṃsāraḥ

etena jala candra vat iti apu nirastam yathā eva hi rāhu channe candre na kvacid jalacandraḥ upalabhyate evam parama ātmanā apavarga prāpte saṃsārī na kvacid upalabhyate sukha duḥkha ādi vyavasthā anupapatti prasaṅgaḥ ca yathā yādṛśam ākāśa sthasya candrasya rūpam upalabhyate tādṛśam eva sarva jala candrāṇām na praticandram rūpa vyavasthā asti tathā yādṛśam eva sva ātmanaḥ sukham duḥkham vā jñāna icchā ādikam vā tādṛśam eva sarvasya syāt prati puruṣam sukha ādi vyavasthā anupapattiḥ śarīra bhedāt vyavasthā iti ced na adṛṣṭa tvāt bāla kaumāra yauvana ādi śarīra bhede api vyavasthā na dṛṣṭā pūrva śarīreṣu anubhūtāni sukha ādīni śāstra ādīni ca vṛddha śarīre api anusandhatte mama sukham āsīt iti

etena ghaṭa ākāśa maṭha ākāśa ādi udāharaṇam pratyuktam kim ca yathā ghaṭa nivṛttau eva ghaṭa ākāśam muktam bhavati evam deha nivṛttau eva tad avacchinnaḥ pumān muktaḥ syāt iti ayatna siddhaḥ mokṣaḥ prasaktaḥ tatas ca mokṣa śāstram vyartham

deha nivṛttau api avidyā ādi saṃskāraḥ tad kṛtaḥ asti tad avacchinnasya pṛthak bhūtasya iva ātma pradeśasya saṃsāraḥ iti ced na vikalpa anupapatteḥ sa hi deha kṛtaḥ saṃskāraḥ kim deha vat paricchinna deśaḥ kim vā ākāśa sat tāvat vyāpakaḥ iti prācye pakṣe citrakūṭa deśa sthena dehena sva avacchinnaḥ eva ātma pradeśaḥ kṛta saṃskāraḥ tatra eva janma antaram janayet sukha duḥkha ādi upabhogaḥ api tatra eva syāt anya pradeśasya tad saṃskāreṇa avachinna tvāt atha gatvaraḥ saṃskāraḥ pradeśa antaram api avachinatti na avidyā dharma ādi saṃskārasya niṣkriya tvena gamana anupapattiḥ kim ca muktam api pradeśam gatvā avacchindyāt tad avacchede ca muktasya punar saṃsāri tva prasaṅgaḥ tatra eva avasthitaḥ pradeśa antare api sva kāryam saṃskāraḥ karoti iti ced evam api mukta pradeśe api kuryāt iti saḥ eva prasaṅgaḥ atha ākāśa sattāvat vyāpakaḥ saṃskāraḥ tena tarhi sarve api ātma pradeśāḥ vyāptāḥ iti na kaścid pradeśaḥ apavṛktaḥ syāt etena maṇi sūtra ādi nidarśanam pratyuktam ghaṭa ākāśa ādi dhvāntena asya api tulya doṣa tvāt tasmāt na sarva deheṣu ekaḥ eva ātmā iti

atha tapta ayaḥ piṇḍāt agni kaṇāḥ iva ātma tattvāt jīva ātmānaḥ asaṃkhyātāḥ utpadyante teṣām saṃsāra mokṣa jñāna ādi vyavasthā iti na saṃsāriṇām api ātmanām anādi tvasya prasādhita tvāt kṛtakānām ca anitya tva prasaṅgaḥ tatas apara loki tvam

atha samudrāt udaka vat tatas eva niḥsaranti punar tatra eva līyante iti na samudra vat brahmaṇaḥ sāvayava tva ādi doṣa prasaṅgāt pratiṣiddhaḥ ca satkārya vādaḥ tena pariṇāma laya pakṣe na dṛṣṭāntaḥ kaścid siddhaḥ

atha avidyā eva jīva ātmā tasya ca anādi tvam asaṃkhyāta tvam saṃsāri tvam ca tad nivṛttiḥ ca mokṣaḥ iti sa kasya iti vācyam brāhmaṇaḥ tāvat na sambhavati iti uktam pradīpa nirvāṇa vat iti ced tad artham kaḥ pravartate jīvātmā eva iti ced na ātma nivṛtteḥ apuruṣa artha tvāt avidyā svabhāvaḥ hi jīvātmā kim artham ātmānam nivartayati na ca tasya ātma nivṛttau upāyaḥ asti vidyā hi tāvat na avidyā ātmake jīve prādurbhavati virodhāt na api brahmaṇi tatra nitya tvāt na ca upāya antareṇa avidyāyāḥ ātyantikaḥ kṣayaḥ sambhavati na ca mithyājñānāt anyā kācid avidyā asti jñānasya ca sarvasya āśrita tvam samarthitam tena avidyā kasya iti vācyam brahmaṇaḥ tad pradeśasya vā na sambhavati iti uktam na hi eka āśraya tve sukha duḥkha smṛti ādīnām vyavasthā sambhavati śarīra bhede api anusandhāna darśanāt garbha śarīra anubhūteṣu ananu sandhāna vat iti ced na tatra smṛti hetoḥ saṃskārasya anutpanna tvāt vinaṣṭa tvāt vā abhibhūta tvāt vā śarīra antareṣu api evam iti ced na tatra api asmṛti prasaṅgāt

dṛśyate ca upādhyāyasya śāstra artha ādi anusmṛtiḥ tatas tad saṃskāraḥ anabhibhūtaḥ eva asti iti gamyate tatas śiṣya ādeḥ api smṛti prasaṅgaḥ tad ātmā eka tvāt kaumāra ādi śarīreṣu iva tasmāt pratiśarīram sukha duḥkha smṛti ādi vyavasthā upalambhāt na anā ātmā iti nanu bhavat pakṣe api sarve api ātmānaḥ vyāpaka tvāt sarvasmin api śarīre santi iti vyavasthā anupapattiḥ ekasmin ca śarīre sarva puruṣāṇām liṅgam gṛhyeta na adṛṣṭa niyamāt vyavasthā upapatteḥ yad kṛtena adṛṣṭa viśeṣeṇa yat śarīram utpāditam tat tasya eva bhoga āyatanam bhavati ātma antarāṇām tu tatra sannidhi mātreṇa sattvam na tu adhiṣṭhātṛ tvena iti atas na ekasmin api śarīre sarveṣām liṅga upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ iti tat evam sthitam etat saṃsārya ātmānaḥ asaṃkhyātāḥ paramātmā tu ekaḥ eva iti atas parama upāsana dvāreṇa keṣāṃcid mokṣa gamane api avirodhaḥ tasmāt paramātmanā upāsana aṅga tvena apavarga sādhana tvāt uktam paramātmanaḥ aparam ātmabhyaḥ artha antara tvena parijñānam iti

kaḥ punar tasya upāsana vidhiḥ iti ucyate sa ca upāsana vidhiḥ kleśa kṣaya samādhi lābha artham anuṣṭhānam yena kenacid upāyena kleśāḥ rāga dveṣa moha ākhyāḥ kṣīyante maheśvara viṣayam citta aikāgryam ca prāpyate saḥ upāyaḥ anuṣṭhīyamānaḥ parameśvara upāsana vidhiḥ iti ucyate tatra yogāt ca adhyātma vidhi upāyaiḥ iti vacanāt pātañjala ādi śāstreṣu api upadiṣṭaḥ upāyaḥ sva śāstra virodhena pratipattavyaḥ tatra yukti sāmarthyāt ca para matam apratiṣiddham anumatam iti hi tantra yuktiḥ tena ajñāna ātmakāḥ suvarṇa dāna ādīkṣa ādayaḥ upāyāḥ na atra gṛhyante teṣām rāga ādi kṣapaṇe sāmarthya abhāvāt akṣapiteṣu ca saṃsāra nivṛttiḥ na sambhavati iti vicāritam duḥkha sūtre dvādaśavidha prameya tattva jñānam antareṇa anyathā jñānam na upāyaḥ iti api vicāritam dvādaśa prameya jñānam api na utpanna mātram asahāyam rāga ādi nivṛttau samartham kim tarhi yoga upāya anuṣṭhāna sahitam

yogaḥ ca vyutthita avyutthita avasthā bhedena dvividhaḥ tatra vyutthita avasthāyām tapaḥ svādhyāya ādi lakṣaṇaḥ kriyā yogaḥ sevanīyaḥ tathā ca uktam tapaḥ svādhyāya īśvara praṇidhānāni kriyā yogaḥ kleśa tanu karaṇa arthaḥ samādhi bhāvanā arthaḥ ca artha kramam āśritya iha viparyayeṇa pāṭhaḥ kṛtaḥ pātañjale tu sūtre samādhi bhāvanā arthaḥ kleśa tanu karaṇa arthaḥ ca iti pāṭhaḥ tatra ādhyātmika ādi duḥkha sahiṣṇu tvam tapaḥ bāhya nimitta nirapekṣam śarīram mānasam ca duḥkham ādhyātmikam manuṣya paśu ādīni bhūtāni adhikṛtya utpannam ādhibhautikam deva prayuktam śīta ātapa ādi nimittam adhikṛtya utpannam ādhidaivikam tat etat trividham api duḥkham śānta bhāvena niyamam kṛtvā sahamānasya dharma adharmayoḥ saṃcaya kṣayau kurvat tapaḥ iti ucyate tatas dharma saṃcayāt yoga pravṛtti hetuḥ śraddhā ādi atiśayaḥ bhavati adharma kṣayāt ca vyādhi saṃstyāna saṃśaya pramāda ālasya ādīnām antarāyāṇām upaśamaḥ tatas anākulam cittam samādhīyate

nanu duḥkhebhyaḥ citta vikṣepaḥ eva bhavati atas na yoga arthinā tapaḥ kartavyam dharma adharmayoḥ saṃcaya kṣayau ca japa pratyāhāra ādibhyaḥ eva bhavataḥ tapaḥ sādhana tve tu pramāṇam na asti iti na etat asti yaḥ hi unmāda kāma ādibhiḥ abhibhūtaḥ sa katham japa pratyāhāra ādikam kartum śaknoti atas tena tapaḥ kartavyam yathā vastrasya sthūlaḥ malaḥ sthūla upāyena nivartyate sūkṣmaḥ tu sūkṣma upāyena iti tathā ātmanaḥ sthūlaḥ malaḥ tāvat sthūla upāyena nivartyate sūkṣmaḥ tu paścāt sūkṣma upāyena japa pratyāhāra ādinā nivartyate iti

yat ca uktam dharma saṃcaya ādeḥ tapaḥ sādhana tve pramāṇam na asti iti tat na āgama siddha tvāt tathā ca manuḥ tapaḥ mūlam idam sarvam yat daivam mānuṣam sukham tapaḥ madhyam budhaiḥ proktam tapaḥ antam veda darśibhiḥ mahāpātakinaḥ ca eva śeṣāḥ ca akārya kāriṇaḥ tapasā eva su taptena mucyante kilbiṣāt tatas yat kiṃcid enaḥ kurvanti manaḥ vāc mūrtibhiḥ janāḥ tat sarvam ninudanti āśu tapasā eva tapodhanāḥ

yadi api tapaḥ svarga ādi phalakam api bhavati tathā api viśiṣṭa jñāna vairāgya ādi sahakārī upakṛtam citta prasādam eva īṣat vyavadhānena karoti prasanne tu citte tapaḥ niyamam cāndrāyaṇa ādikam parisamāpya yoga aṅgāni eva anutiṣṭheta yaḥ tu pūrva janma kṛta tapaḥ sāmarthyāt pratyāhāra ādiṣu samarthaḥ eva tam prati tapaḥ na upadiśyate tad arthasya siddha tvāt iti

praśānta mantrasya īśvara vācinaḥ abhyāsaḥ svādhyāyaḥ kṣudra siddhi hetuḥ api īśvara vācī mantraḥ asti iti tad pratiṣedha artham praśānta grahaṇam parama ātma ekaniṣṭhena bhavitavyam iti jñāna artham īśvara grahaṇam yoga śāstra artha abhyāsaḥ vā svādhyāyaḥ iti parameśvara tattvasya bhakti atiśayāt prabandhena anucintanam paryālocanam īśvara praṇidhānam stuti japa puṣpa ādibhiḥ ārādhanam vā sarva kriyāṇām parama gurau arpaṇam vā tad vācakasya praṇavasya japaḥ tad artha bhāvanam ca iti sā iyam tapaḥ svādhyāya ādi lakṣaṇa kriyā yoga hetutvāt yogaḥ iti ucyate sa ca kriyā yogaḥ saṃsevyamānaḥ samādhim bhāvayati kleśān ca tanūkaroti

ke punar atra kleśāḥ kriyantaḥ vā iti ucyate samāsatas rāga dveṣa mohāḥ kleśāḥ te hi samādhi pratyanīka tvena saṃsāra āpatti hetu tvena ca puruṣam kleśayanti iti tatra aśakti lakṣaṇaḥ rāgaḥ asahiṣṇu tva lakṣaṇaḥ dvaṣaḥ mithyā pratyayaḥ mohaḥ iti nanu avidyā smitā rāga dveṣa abhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ iti patañjaliḥ tatas asmitā abhiniśeśayoḥ kim na atra abhidhānam na asambhavāt atra eva antarbhāvāt ca tathā hi dṛś darśana śaktyoḥ eka ātma tā iva asmitāḥ iti lakṣaṇam uktam asya arthaḥ puruṣaḥ dṛś śaktiḥ buddhiḥ darśana śaktiḥ tayoḥ eka svarūpa āpattiḥ iva asmitā bhoktṛ bhogya śaktyoḥ atyanta asaṃkīrṇayoḥ avibhāga prātvau iva satyām bhogaḥ prakalpyate svarūpa pratilambhe hi tayoḥ kaivalyam eva bhavati iti etat ca pradhāna pratiṣedhāt bhoga pratiṣedhāt ca pratiṣīddham vibhakte ca avibhāga jñānam avidyā eva na tatas anya asmitā tathā abhiniveśa lakṣaṇam svarasa avāhī viduṣe api tathā rūdhaḥ abhiniveśaḥ yaḥ ayam ātma āśīḥ jāta mātrasya api sarva prāṇinaḥ bhavati mā na bhūvam bhūyasam iti maraṇa trāsaḥ saḥ abhiniveśaḥ

saḥ anādi maraṇa duḥkha anubhava ārūḍha vāsanā ātma tvāt svarasa vāhī iti ucyate sa ca yathā atyanta mūḍheṣu dṛśyate tathā viduṣaḥ api jñāta pūrva apara antasya ārūḍhaḥ pratīyate iti asya api mohe dveṣe vā antarbhāvaḥ avaśyambhāvini maraṇe jīvita āśā tasmin tat iti pratyaya rūpa tvāt mohaḥ viduṣaḥ api adhyātma doṣa vaśāt diś moha ādi vat mohaḥ sambhavati iti uktam maraṇa duḥkha asahiṣṇu tvam eva maraṇa trāsaḥ tena dveṣāt na bhidyate kiṃcid vaidharmyāt bhede tu īrṣyāmanyu mātsarya mada māna ādīnām api bheda prasaṅgaḥ tatas ca pañcatva niyamaḥ api na syāt tasmāt trividhaḥ eva kleśaḥ tathā ca sūtram tad trairāśya rāga dveśa moha artha antara bhāvāt iti nanu doṣāṇām trairāśyam uktam kleśāḥ kim tatas anye doṣāḥ eva hi na pravṛttiḥ pratisandhānāya hīna kleśasya iti atra kleśa śabdena uktāḥ sūtra kṛtā iti te ete kleśāḥ kriyā yogam anutiṣṭhadbhiḥ vidvadbhiḥ pratidinam tanūbhavantaḥ pratyakṣeṇa api upalabhyante iti yathā ca kriyā yogaḥ kleśa kṣaya hetuḥ tathā yoga aṅgāni api iti atas tāni api ati yatnena anuṣṭheyāni

kāni punar tāni yoga aṅgāni kiyanti ca iti ucyante yama niyama āsana prāṇāyāma pratyāhāra dhāraṇa dhyāna samādhayaḥ aṣṭau aṅgāni aṅgāni nirvartakāni iti arthaḥ samādhitaḥ kaḥ anyaḥ yogaḥ yasya samādhiḥ aṅgam iti ced samādhiḥ eva antya prakarṣa āpannaḥ yogaḥ tasya pūrvaḥ samādhiḥ aṅgam antya śabdasya ādya madhya śabda vat atha vā sarvaḥ api samādhi prakarṣaḥ pūrva samādhi janya tvena yogaḥ uttara prakarṣa janaka tvena aṅgam iti yadi samādhitaḥ eva samādhiḥ bhavati nanu evam ekam eva aṅgam prāptam atas aṣṭau aṅgāni iti na vācyam na pūrva pūrva siddhau uttarottra asiddheḥ na hi yama asiddhau niyamaḥ sidhyati niyama asiddhau ca āsanam na sidhyati āsana asiddhau ca prāṇayāmaḥ na sidhyati tad asiddhau pratyāhāraḥ na sidhyati tad asiddhau dhāraṇā na sidhyati tad asiddhau dhyānam na sidhyati dhyāna asiddhau ca samādhiḥ na sidhyati atas ṣṭa aṅgānām api yoga aṅga tvam iti

tatra deśa kāla avasthābhiḥ aniyatāḥ puruṣasya śuddhi vṛddhi hetavaḥ yamāḥ śuddhiḥ adharma kṣayaḥ vṛddhiḥ dharma upacayaḥ atha vā śuddhiḥ citta vaimalyam vṛddhiḥ yoga utkarśaḥ tad hetavaḥ ye deśa ādibhiḥ aniyatāḥ sarvasmin deśe anuṣṭhīyante sarvasmin kāle sarvasyām avasthāyām te yamāḥ ahiṃsā ādayaḥ nanu ahiṃsā ādayaḥ api kaiścid deśa ādi niyamena anuṣṭhīyante yathā tīrthe hiṃsām na kariṣyāmi sarva divaseṣu vā ayuddha avasthāyām vā prāṇi vadham na kariṣyāmi iti na deśa ādi apekṣi tve ahiṃsā ādīnām api niyama tvāt atas eva gṛhastha ādeḥ paramārthataḥ niyamāḥ santi yamaiḥ upetaḥ hi yatiḥ iti ucyate yama abhāve katham gṛhastha ādeḥ niyama niṣpattiḥ iti ced na pravartaka dharma niṣpādaka niyama niṣpatteḥ avirodhāt nivartakaḥ hi yati dharmaḥ tad hetavaḥ niyama abhraṣṭayam asya na niṣpadyante iti

deśa kāla avasthāpekṣiṇaḥ puṇya hetavaḥ kriyā viśeṣa niyamāḥ tatra deśa apekṣi devatā pradakṣiṇam kāla apekṣi sandhyā upāsanam japa kriyā tu śudhi avasthā mātram apekṣate puṇya atiśayam pratideśa ādi apekṣita tvam asti anantam śiva sannidhau ityādi śravaṇāt evam anye api kriyā viśeṣāḥ deśa ādi apekṣa tvena niyamāḥ iti pātañjala abhiprāyeṇa tu nivṛtti lakṣaṇāḥ yamāḥ pravṛtti lakṣaṇāḥ niyamāḥ iti yama niyama lakṣaṇam draṣṭavyam tathā ca uktam ahiṃsā satya asteya brahmacarya aparigrahāḥ yamāḥ śauca santoṣa tapaḥ svāya adhya īśvara praṇidhānāni niyamāḥ iti

yoga karma virodhi kleśa jayā artham karaṇa bandhaḥ āsanam yoga kriyāyāḥ virodhinaḥ kleśāḥ vyādhi ādayaḥ teṣām hi āsana jayāt jayaḥ śruyate karaṇāni atra śarīra avayavāḥ pāda ādayaḥ teṣām bandhaḥ saṃyamaḥ prāṇāyāma ādi siddhi arthaḥ tat āsanam sthiram sukhena upaveśanam iti arthaḥ tat ca padmaka svastika ādi aneka prakāram

koṣṭha sthavāyoḥ śvāsa praśvāsa lakṣaṇasya gati chedaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ pracchanne nivāte nirjane niḥśabde ca pradeśe yathāsukham āsanam baddhvā recaka pūraka kumbhaka prakāraḥ kartavyaḥ sa ca śanais śanais jetavyaḥ vana gaja indra vat yathā vana gaja indraḥ prayogena śanais jīyamānaḥ mahāntam upakāram karoti haṭhāt aprayogena gṛhītaḥ tu vināśam eva karoti tathā vāyuḥ prayogeṇa śanais jīyamānaḥ aśeṣam adharmam rāga ādi malam ca nirnāśya yogam prāpayati aprayogeṇa atikramya avagṛhītaḥ tu vāta gulma ādi anartham eva karoti iti

samādhi prayatnīka arthebhyaḥ samantāt cetasaḥ vyāvartanam pratyāhāraḥ pratyāhṛte hi cetasi indriyāṇi api pratyāhṛtāni bhavati kasmāt tad mūlana tvāt indriyāṇām pravṛtteḥ pratyāhāra abhiyuktasya indriya jayaḥ samādhi lābhaḥ ca bhavati na anyathā iti

deśa bandhaḥ cittasya dhāraṇā kaḥ atra deśaḥ kaḥ ca deśaḥ cittasya bandhaḥ iti śarīra ādi avayavaḥ pāda ādiḥ bāhyaḥ vā sūrya maṇḍala ādiḥ deśaḥ iti eke vayam tu brūmaḥ paramātmā eva atra deśaḥ abhipretaḥ tad ārādhana pravṛtta tvāt mokṣa asthinaḥ pāda ādiṣu dhāraṇānam hi viṣṇu loka ādi prāptiḥ phalam śrūyate cittasya manasaḥ prayatnena dhāraṇam niścalīkaraṇam bandhaḥ iti ucyate sādhāraṇa iti

tatra ekatānātā dhyānam tasmin dhāraṇā deśe dhyeya ālambanasya pratyayasya sadṛśaḥ pravāhaḥ pratyaya antareṇa apareṇa aparāmṛṣṭaḥ dhyānam tatra ekatānatā iti ukte api cittasya iti anuvṛtteḥ cittasya ekatānatā iti gamyate manasaḥ ca sadṛśa pratyaya pravāha kartṛ tvam eva ekatānatā iti

tat eva artha mātra nirbhāsa svarūpeṇa śūnyam iva samādhiḥ dhyānam eva dhyeya ākāra mātra nirbhāsa pratyaya ātmakena svarūpeṇa śūnyam iva yadā bhavati upādhi saṃsargāt sphaṭika vat tadā samādhiḥ iti ucyate yat vā dhyāna utkarṣāt nivāta acala pradīpa avasthānam iva ekatra eva cetasaḥ avasthānam samādhiḥ abhidhīyate sa ca prajñā loka cihnaḥ samādhi utkarṣa tāratamyāt vipra jñā loka utkarṣa tāratamyam bhavati

tat evam etāni yoga aṅgāni mumukṣuṇā sarveṣu brahma ādi sthāneṣu aneka prakārāṇi sa atiśaya kṣaya vadha bandha parikleśa ādīni duḥkhāni bhāvayatā sarvatra anabhirati saṃjñitam param vairāgyam āśritya maheśvare tu atyanta utkṛṣṭa guṇa darśanāt paramām bhaktim āśritya tad darśana artham atyanta abhiyogena sevitavyāni tatas samādhi prakarṣa atiśayam prāptau acireṇa eva kālena bhagavantam anaupamya svabhāvam śivam avitatham pratyakṣatas paśyati dṛṣṭvā niratiśayam śreyaḥ apavarga ākhyam prāpnoti tathā ca uktam yadā carma vat ākāśam veṣṭayiṣyanti mānavāḥ tadā śivam avijñāya duḥkhasya antaḥ bhaviṣyati tam eva viditvā atimṛtyum eti ityādi ca ātma tva aviśeṣa iti kasmāt na anya darśanāt mokṣaḥ iti ced na anyasya sarva animitta tvāt na hi anyaḥ api ātmā sarva utpattimatām nimittam iti diś kālayoḥ api sarva utpattimatām nimitta kāraṇa tvāt aviśeṣaḥ iti ced na apramāṇaka tvāt

nanu apramāṇaka tvam asiddham yatas kālaḥ parāpara vyatikara yaugapadya ayaugapadi acira kṣipra pratyaya liṅgaḥ teṣām viṣayeṣu pūrva pratyaya vilakṣaṇānām utpattau anya nimitta asambhavāt yat atra nimittam sa kālaḥ kṣaṇa lava nimeṣa kāṣṭhākalā mūhūrttayām āhorātra ardha māsa māsa tvaryana saṃvatsara yuga kalpa manvantara pralaya mahāpralaya vyavahāra hetuḥ ca sarva kriyāṇām ca utpatti sthiti vināśa hetuḥ tad vyapadeśāt sa ca tad liṅga viśeṣāt ekaḥ eva kriyā bhedāt mati vat pācaka vat vā nānā upacaryate guṇavat tvāt anāśrita tvāt ca dravyam iti

tathā diś pūrva apara ādi pratyaya liṅgā mūrta dravyam avadhim kṛtvā mūrteṣu eva etasmāt idam pūrveṇa idam paścimena idam dakṣiṇena iti evamādayaḥ daśa pratyayāḥ yatas bhavanti sā diś iti nimitta asambhavāt dravyam ca diś guṇavat tvāt anāśrita tvāt ca diś liṅga aviśeṣāt eka tve api sūrya saṃyoga upādhi vaśāt pracīti ādi bhedena daśa diśaḥ iti upacāraḥ tathā lokapāla parigraha vaśāt moha indrīya ādi bhedena tad daśatvā upacāraḥ sarva kārya utpatti ādi hetu tvam ca diśaḥ api tad vyapadeśāt gamyate iti

atra ucyate sāmānyena nimitta mātra pūrvaka tve sādhye siddha sādhanam īśvara ādi nimitta tvāt bhūta ātmā antaḥkaraṇa tad guṇa ādi vyatirikta nimitta pūrvaka tve sādhye tu dṛṣṭāntaḥ na asti nanu pariśeṣa siddhiḥ iṣṭā yasmāt uktam teṣām ityādiḥ teṣām yugapad ādi pratyayānām viṣayeṣu paṭa ādiṣu pūrva pratyayaḥ kriyā guṇa sāmānya ādi viśeṣaṇāḥ paṭa ādi pratyayāḥ tad vilakṣaṇaḥ tu yugapad a ādi pratyayaḥ eva teṣām utpattau kālāt anya nimittam na sambhavati iti arthaḥ na pariśeṣasya asiddha tvāt

tathā hi bhagavān īśvaraḥ tāvat sarveṣām jñāna ajñāna ātmakānām kāryāṇām nimittam asti karma īdriyā ādikam ca yathāsambhavam asti navī īśvara ādi nimittam paṭa ādi pratyayeṣu api sādhāraṇam tatas tad nimitta tve paṭa ādi pratyayaiḥ aviśeṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti na samāna tvāt diś kālāyoḥ api sarva utpattimatām nimitta kāraṇa tvam bhavadbhiḥ iṣṭam tatas tad nimitta tve api aviśeṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti

nanu yugapad ādi pratyayeṣu eva kālasya asādhāraṇa nimitta tvam pūrva apara ādiṣu eva diśaḥ asādhāraṇa nimitta tvam kārya antareṣu ca sarveṣu sādhāraṇam tatas na aviśeṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti na tad ātma bhedāt na hi kālasya diśaḥ vā kārya viśeṣam pratyātma bhedaḥ asti abhinne ca ātmanā sarva kārya nimitta tve maheśvara vat katham kvacid asādhāraṇa tvam atha ekasya iva ittham svabhāvaḥ abhyupagamyate yena keṣāṃcid utpattau sādhāraṇam nimittam bhavati keṣāṃcid asādhāraṇam iti tathā api na kiṃcid kāla kalpanayā maheśvarasya eva tathā svabhāvaḥ kalpyatām tasya hi jagat nimitta tvam sādhitam diś kālayoḥ tu na sarva kārya nimitta tve asti pramāṇam

nanu tad vyapadeśāt iti uktam satyam uktam idam ayuktam tu uktam na hi yena yat vyapadiśyate tat tasya nimittam iti asti vyāptiḥ kākadaṇḍa ādīnām gṛha puruṣa ādi a nimitta tve api tad vyapadeśaka tvāt utpatti ādi api rūpa ādinā vyapadiśyamānam dṛṣṭam śuklam utpannam śuklam tiṣṭhati śuklam vinaṣṭam iti tṛtīyāsaptamī antena api ajanakena vyapadeśaḥ dṛśyate yathā devadattasya sutaḥ kṛṣṇena rūpeṇa viśālena akṣṇā ca utpannaḥ śikhayā parivrājakaḥ tiṣṭhati raktena vāntena mṛtaḥ puruṣaḥ iti sabhāyām me śūlam utpannam sabhāyām caitraḥ tiṣṭhati mṛtaḥ ca iti mama bhrātar yāgate sutaḥ utpannaḥ tvayi āgate vṛṣṭiḥ utpannā iti evamādi

atha yugapad ādi pratyaya viśeṣāṇām eva nimittam kālaḥ iṣyate na yugapad pratyaya abhāva prasaṅgāt tathā hi yat kārya jātam ekasmin kāle kṛtam tat yugapad kṛtam iti ucyate tat yadi ekaḥ eva kālaḥ tatas sarva kriyāṇām eka kāla utpādāt na kiṃcid ayugapad kṛtam syāt cira kṣipra vyavahāra abhāva prasaṅgaḥ ca yat khalu bahunā kālena kṛtam tat cireṇa kṛtam iti ucyate yat ca su alpena kālena kṛtam tat kṣipram kṛtam iti ucyate tat ca etat ubhayam kāla eka tve durghaṭam

nanu maṇi vat upādhi bhedāt kāla bhedam iti uktam kaḥ punar atra upādhi bhedaḥ kriyā bhedaḥ eva iti ced nanu yugapad kṛtam iti atra api kriyā bhedaḥ asti eva kim iti ayugapad pratyayaḥ na bhavati krama bhā vi kriyā bhedaḥ kāla abheda vyavahāra hetuḥ iti ced krama bhāvaḥ iti kaḥ arthaḥ yugapad anutpādaḥ yugapad anutpādaḥ iti kaḥ arthaḥ ekasmin kāle anutpādaḥ nanu evam itaretara āśraya tva prasaṅgaḥ yāvat na kālasya bhedaḥ sidhyati tāvat na kriyāṇām bhinna kāla utpāda lakṣaṇaḥ kramaḥ sidhyati yāvat ca kriyāṇām na krama bhāvaḥ sidhyati tāvat na kālasya upādhi bhedāt bhedaḥ sidhyati iti tasmāt kriyā dharmaḥ eva kaścid kṣaṇa paryāyaḥ kāla śabdasya arthaḥ tad samāhāreṣu lava nimeṣa ādi vyavahāraḥ api draṣṭavyaḥ eka samāhāreṣu dvi tri ādi vyavahāra vat guru tva samāhāreṣu karṣa pala ādi vyavahāra vat ca evam ca eka kālam idam cira utpannam kṣipram utpannam anantara utpannam iti evamādi vyavahāraḥ upapadyate

etena para apara vyatikaraḥ pratyuktaḥ katham dikkṛta aparatva ādhāre yūni aparatvam dikkṛta paratva ādhāre tu sthavire paratvam iti ayam parāparayoḥ vyatikaraḥ saḥ api kāla eka tve durghaṭaḥ yathā hi bhūmi avayavaiḥ āloka avayavaiḥ vā bahubhiḥ antaritam vastu viprakṛṣṭam param iti ca ucyate su alpaiḥ tu antaritam sannikṛṣṭam aparam iti ca ucyate tathā bahubhiḥ kṣaṇaiḥ ahorātra ādibhiḥ vā antaritam viprakṛṣṭam param iti ca ucyate su alpaiḥ tu antaritam sannikṛṣṭam aparam iti ca ucyate iti bahu alpa bhāvaḥ ca guru tva parimāṇa ādi vat apekṣā nibandhanaḥ kāla eka tve durghaṭaḥ iti

na api kriyā eva kālaḥ tad viśeṣaṇa tvāt parimāṇa ādi vat yathā eṣām ekam parimāṇam eteṣām bhinnam parimāṇa tvam tathā eṣām ekaḥ kālaḥ eteṣām bhinna kāla tvam iti pratītiḥ tatra yathā aṇu tva mahat tva ādayaḥ parimāṇa viśeṣāḥ tathā kṣaṇa lava ādayaḥ kāla viśeṣāḥ tathā hi yatas na alpataram parimāṇam tat parama aṇu tvam tathā yatas na alpataraḥ kālaḥ sa kṣaṇaḥ iti evam ca tad liṅga aviśeṣāt ekatvam iti ayuktam guru tva parimāṇa ādeḥ api ekatva prasaṅgaḥ tulya codya parihāra tvāt

dravya tvam api anena eva pratyuktam kālasya kriyā viśeṣaṇa tvena parimāṇa ādi vat pratibhāsamānāt anāśrita tvam asiddham parimāṇa ādeḥ api vānāśritasya eva viśeṣaṇa tvam astu na ca viśeṣaṇa viśeṣaṇa tve api daṇḍa ādeḥ iva mad tvam upalabhyante tat na guṇavat tvam api asti saṃkhyā ādi mātreṇa ca sāmānya ādeḥ api guṇavat tva prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt na dravyam kālaḥ

etena diśaḥ api dravya tvam pratyuktam mūrta dravya dharma tvāt diśām dīrgha tva hrasva tva ādi vat tad viśiṣṭa pratyayānām mūrteṣu eva bhāvāt daśadhā bhedaḥ tu diśām vāstavaḥ api astu kaḥ virodhaḥ nanu vāstava tve yathā vārāṇasyāḥ paścimena prayāgaḥ tathā kānyakubjāt api syāt na anaikāntāt sannikarṣa viprakarṣa ādayaḥ hi dharmāḥ vāstavāḥ iṣyante na ca yathā pratiṣṭhāna apekṣayā sannikṛṣṭaḥ prayāgaḥ tathā kān kubja apekṣayā api iti tasmāt pratiniyata nimitta apekṣayā prācī a ādi dharmāṇām api abhivyaktiḥ iti alam prasaṅgena tat na diś kālayoḥ sarva utpattimatām nimitta kāraṇa tvam

api ca yadi upādāna ādi abhijñasya kālasya diśaḥ vā jagat nimitta tvam iṣṭam tadā maheśvaraḥ eva nāma antareṇa uktaḥ syāt acetana tve tu anupāsya tvāt na tad darśanam śreyaḥ sādhanam syāt cetanaḥ hi rājarṣi prabhṛtibhiḥ pratidinam vinayena dṛśyamānaḥ kadācid prasannaḥ bhūtvā anugraham yathāsāmārthyena kurvan upalabhyate na acetanaḥ asamarthaḥ vā tasmāt śiva darśanāt eva mokṣaḥ iti

kaḥ punar ayam mokṣaḥ iti eke tāvat varṇayanti samasta ātma viśeṣa guṇa ucchittau saṃhāra avasthāyām ākāśa vat ātmanaḥ sarvadā avasthānam mokṣaḥ kasmāt sukha duḥkhayoḥ avinā abhauvi tvena viveka hāna anutpatteḥ na ca sukha arthā eva prekṣāvatām pravṛttiḥ kaṇṭaka ādi duḥkha parihāra artha tvena api pravṛtteḥ upalambhāt na ca etat śāstram viṣayiṇaḥ pratyārabdham yena nirviṣaye mokṣe pravṛttiḥ na syāt kim tu ye atyantam duḥkhāt nirviṇṇāḥ tān prati duḥkha uccheda artham mokṣe pravartate teṣām duḥkha traya abhighātāt tad uccheda mātra arthi tvāt iti

moha avasthātvāt mūrcchā ādi avasthāvat atra vivekinām pravṛttiḥ na yuktā iti āhuḥ anye tat uktam duḥkha hānāya naḥ yuktam sukham duḥkha ātmakam varam na hi kaścid padārtha jñaḥ moha siddhyai pravartate varam vṛndāvane ramye śṛgāla tvam vṛṇomi aham na tu nirviṣayam mokṣam gautamaḥ gantum icchati

kim ca yathā saṃsāra avasthāyām sukham iṣṭam duḥkham vā aniṣṭam tathā mokṣa avasthāyām duḥkha nivṛttiḥ iṣṭā sukha nivṛttiḥ tu aniṣṭā iti samavyaya phala tvāt tatra pravṛttiḥ ayuktā yat uktam anantāni durantāni samavyaya phalāni ca aśakyāni ca vastūni na ārabheta vicakṣaṇaḥ tasmāt prekṣāvatām pravṛtti anyathā anupapatteḥ sukha saṃvittiḥ muktasya abhyupagantavyā

yat punar etat duḥkha parihāra arthā api pravṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā iti tat na duḥkha parihāra mātra arthāyām pravṛttau dṛṣṭānta asiddheḥ tathā hi duḥkhe sati sukha upabhogasya asambhavāt kaṇṭaka ādi duḥkha parihāraḥ api sukha upabhoga artham eva iti asamaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ duḥkha avinā bhāvi tvam tu vaiṣayikasya eva sukhasya na tu nityasya iti

kutas muktasya sukha upabhoga siddhiḥ iti ced nanu arthāpatteḥ iti uktam kim ca āgamāt uktam hi sukham ātyantikam yat tat buddhi grāhyam atīndriyam tam vai mokṣam vijānīyāt duṣprapyam akṛtātmabhiḥ ānandam brahmaṇaḥ rūpam tat ca mokṣe abhivyajyate vijñānam ānandam brahma iti ca

duḥkha abhāva mātre ayam sukha śabdaḥ iti ced na mukhya gauṇa asambhavāt na tāvat añjasā duḥkha abhāvaḥ eva sukham yena kenacid āhāreṇa kṣudh duḥkha nivṛtteḥ viśeṣāt ānanda viśeṣaḥ na syāt tathā yuvati mātreṇa kāma duḥkha nivṛtteḥ yuvati viśeṣāt ānanda viśeṣaḥ na syāt gandha rūpa śabda viśeṣebhyaḥ tu sukha viśeṣaḥ eva bhavan upalabhyate tatra api autsukya duḥkham nivartate iti ced na autsukya abhāve api śabda ādi viśeṣa upanipāte sukha viśeṣa upalabdheḥ

tat na duḥkha abhāvaḥ eva sukham atha upacāreṇa duḥkha abhāve sukha śabdaḥ pravartate yathā bhāra apagame sukhī saṃvṛttaḥ asmi iti na mokṣasya apuruṣa artha tva prasaktau prekṣāvatām tatra apravṛtti prasaṅgāt tathā hi duḥkha abhāvaḥ api na āvedyaḥ puruṣa arthatayā iṣyate na hi mūrcchā ādi avastha artham pravṛttaḥ dṛśyate sudhīḥ kim ca bhāra udvahana ādi duḥkha apagame pratibandhaka abhāvāt iṣṭa māruta ādi samāgamāt api sukham bhaviṣyati iti manyamānaḥ sukhī saṃvṛttaḥ asmi iti upacarati na etat upacāra nimittam mokṣe asti na ca asaṃvedyamāne api duḥkha abhāve bhāktaḥ api sukha śabdaḥ pravartate

mūrcchā avasthāyām api pravarteta suṣuptau avasthāyām sukha śabda pravṛtti vat iti ced na tatra saṃvedana abhāva siddhau pramāṇa abhāvāt anyasya khalu abhāvaḥ saṃvedanena gṛhyate saṃvedanasya ca abhāvaḥ kena gṛhyate yadi saṃvedanena eva tatas katham saṃvedanam na asti tathā ca sarva saṃvedana abhāvena sambandhaḥ api liṅgasya pratipattum na śakyate iti liṅgataḥ api na suṣuptasya sarva jñāna abhāva gatiḥ

kim ca sukhena aham asvāpsam iti anusmṛteḥ sukham tad saṃvedanam ca suṣuptasya abhyupagantavyam pūrva dineṣu api tad abhyupagame ayam eva nyāyaḥ duḥkha smṛti anupalambha mātrāt anubhava abhāvam anumāya nirduḥkhaḥ aham asvāpsam iti enam artham sukhena aham asvāpsam iti upacarati iti ced na smṛti anupalambhasya anubhava abhāva siddhau anaikāntika tvāt sukha anubhava smṛtau bādhaka abhāvāt ca

nanu yadi suṣupta avasthāyām jñānam asti tadā supta avasthātaḥ mokṣasya kaḥ viśeṣaḥ sarva jñāna viraha upalakṣitā suṣupta avasthā iti ucyate na anyathā viśeṣa upapatteḥ tathā hi bāhya indriya ja jñāna upalakṣitā tāvat jāgrat avasthā bāhya indriyeṣu nirvyāpāreṣu satsu yatra bāhya indriya jam iva jñānam bāhya artham smaraṇam bhavati sā supta avasthā yatra uparata indriya grāmasya aśeṣa vikalpa śūnyasya sukha mātra avabhāsi jñānam sā suṣupta avasthā tatra ca sukham nityam vā pratibhātu nidrā sahakāri dharma viśeṣa janitam vā iti tasmāt na asaṃvedye duḥkha abhāve sukha upacāraḥ kvacid prasiddhaḥ mukhya arthe bādhaka abhāvāt ca na khalu mokṣe sukha astitva abhidhāyinām āgamānām mukhya arthe bādhakam kiṃcid paśyāmaḥ yena bhāktam artham pratipadyemahi

sukha tad saṃvedanayoḥ nitya tvāt mukta saṃsāra avasthāyoḥ aviśeṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na cakṣuḥ ghaṭayoḥ kuḍya ādeḥ iva sukha saṃvedanayoḥ viṣaya viṣayi sambandha pratyanīkasya adharma duḥkha ādeḥ saṃsāra avasthāyām sadbhāvāt tad nāśe ca muktā avasthāyām bhavati sukha saṃvedanayoḥ sambandhaḥ kuḍya ādi nāśe cakṣuḥ ghaṭa sambandha vat sambandha virodhi tva mātreṇa kuḍya ādi udāhṛtam na kuḍya ādi vat adharma ādeḥ vyavadhāyaka tvam asti amūrtavāt eka deśayoḥ vyavadhānāsambhavāt ca kim tu tat ca mokṣe abhivyajyate iti vacanāt samasta adharma ādi nivṛttau sukha saṃvedanayoḥ sambandha viśeṣa lakṣaṇa abhivyaktiḥ bhavati iti gamyate tena upacāreṇa adharma ādeḥ vyavadhāyaka tva abhidhāne api adoṣaḥ tasmāt abhivyakti viśeṣāt na mokṣa saṃsārayoḥ aviśeṣaḥ

tasya sambandhasya kṛtaka tvena kadācid nāśa prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na pradhvaṃsena anekāntāt vastu tve sati iti ced na dravya ādiṣu anantara bhāvena tat asiddha tvāt tad antarbhāve vā sāmānya samavāya abhāvaiḥ saha tad saṃvedanasya sambandhaḥ na syāt adṛṣṭa ādi vaśāt karma kārakam viṣayaḥ tat janitam jñānam viṣayi iti ced na īśvara jñānasya nityasya arthaiḥ saha sambandha abhāva prasaṅgāt asmad ādi jñānasya api atīta anāgata arthaiḥ saha sambandha abhāva prasaṅgāt ca tasmāt nitya sukha saṃvedanayoḥ sambandhasya kṛtaka tve api vināśa kāraṇa abhāvāt nitya tvam eva iti

nanu rāgasya sambandhana ātmaka tvāt nitya sukha rāgena pravṛttaḥ na mucyate na rāgasya viṣaya śakti lakṣaṇa tvāt yaḥ hi sukha sādhaneṣu śabda ādi viṣayeṣu abhiṣvaṅgaḥ sa rāgaḥ iti ucyate sa hi bandhana ātmakaḥ tasya viṣaya arjana rakṣaṇa ādi pravṛtti dvāreṇa saṃsāra hetu tvāt nitye tu sukhe yadi api rāgaḥ tathā api asau sarva viṣaya arjana ādi nivṛtti mokṣa upāya pravṛtteḥ eva hetuḥ anyathā tasya sukhya prāptum aśakya tvāt na hi tad viṣaya sādhyam na api tat kṣiyate yena viṣaya sukha artham iva punar punar tad artham hiṃsā ādiṣu api pravarteta tat na bandha prasaṅgaḥ

kim ca evam dveṣasya api banda ātmaka tvāt saṃsāra duḥkha dveṣeṇa pravṛttaḥ na mucyeta atha na asti eva asya tatra api dveṣaḥ tatas katham saṃsāra hetum pariharati kim ca atyantika duḥkha abhāva rāgeṇa api pravṛttasya mokṣaḥ na syāt duḥkha abhāve na mānam asti iti ced kutas tam prārthayate rāgam vinā evam eva iti ced nitya sukhe api tarhi asya rāgaḥ na asti tat api rāgam vinā evam eva prārthyate iti yat kiṃcid etat tasmāt viṣaya rajata icchā lakṣaṇaḥ rāgaḥ puṇyaḥ puṇya pravṛtti hetu tvāt bandha hetuḥ na tu arthi tva mātram dveṣaḥ api na jihāsā mātram kin tu śrīmat ācārya bhāsarvajñaviracite nyāya bhūṣaṇe saṅgraha vārttike tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptaḥ sampūrṇaḥ ayam granthaḥ
namaḥ mañjunāthāya
parokṣa artha pratipatteḥ anumāna āśraya tvāt saṅkṣepataḥ tad vyutpādana artham idam ārabhyate

pakṣaḥ dharmī avayave samudāya upacarāt prayojana abhāvāt anupacāraḥ iti ced na sarva dharmi dharma pratiṣedha artha tvāt upacārasya evam hi cākṣuṣa tva ādi parihṛtam bhavati dharma vacanena api dharma āśraya siddhau para āśraya tvāt dharmasya dharma vacanāt pratyāsatteḥ sādhya dharmi siddhiḥ iti ced na dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇaḥ api pratyāsatteḥ tad aṃśa vyāptyā dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇi sattva siddheḥ dharmi dharma vacanāt sādhya dharmi parigrahaḥ siddhe punarvacanam niyama artham āśaṅkyeta sajātīyaḥ eva sattvam iti siddhe api tad abhāve vyatireke sādhya abhāve asattva vacana vat dharmi dharma vacanam siddhe api dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇi bhāve tad aṃśa vyāpti vacanāt tatra eva bhāva niyama artham āśaṅkyeta tat sāmarthyāt artha gatau upacāra mātrāt samāna nirdeśāt pratipatti gauravam ca parihṛtam bhavati pakṣasya dharma tve tad viśeṣaṇa apekṣasya anyatra ananuvṛtteḥ asādhāraṇa tā iti ced na ayoga vyavacchedena viśeṣaṇāt yathā caitraḥ dhanurdharaḥ iti na anya yoga vyavacchedena yathā pārthaḥ dhanurdhadaraḥ iti
tad aṃśaḥ tad dharmaḥ
vyāptiḥ vyāpakasya tatra bhāvaḥ eva vyāpyasya vā tatra eva bhāvaḥ

etena anvayaḥ vyatirekaḥ vā yathāsvam pramāṇena niścitaḥ uktaḥ veditavyaḥ pakṣa dharmaḥ ca sarvatra hetau asatā sādhya dharmeṇa hetoḥ vyāpti asiddheḥ vyāpakasya vā nivṛttau nivṛtti abhāvāt iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām niścitābhyām tad aṃśa vyāptiḥ niścitā bhavati

tatra pakṣa dharmasya sādhya dharmiṇi pratyakṣataḥ anumānataḥ vā prasiddhiḥ niścayaḥ yathā pradeśe dhūmasya śabde vā kṛtaka tvasya sa dhūmam hi pradeśam artha antara vivikta rūpam asādhāraṇa ātmanā dṛṣṭavataḥ pratyakṣeṇa yathā dṛṣṭa bheda parama artha viṣayam smārtam liṅga jñānam utpadyate
tatra tat ādyam asādhāraṇa viṣayam darśanam eva pramāṇam

tasmin tathābhūte dṛṣṭe sa yena yena asādhāraṇaḥ tat asādhāraṇa tām tatas bhedam abhilapantī smṛtiḥ utpannā pratyakṣa balena atad vyāvṛtti viṣayāḥ yathā dṛṣṭa ākāra grahaṇāt na pramāṇam prāk asādhāraṇam dṛṣṭvā asādhāraṇam iti abhilapataḥ apūrvā artha adhigama abhāvāt artha kriyā sādhanasya darśanāt adṛṣṭasya tad sādhanasya punar svabhāvasya vikalpena apratipatteḥ ca anumāna vat artha kriyā arthī hi sarvaḥ pramāṇam apramāṇam vā anveṣate prekṣāvān na ca sāmānyam kāñcid artha kriyām upakalpayati sva lakṣaṇa pratipatteḥ ūrdhvam tad sāmarthya utpanna vikalpa jñāna grāhyam

yathā nīlam dṛṣṭvā nīlam iti jñāne tat eva hi nīla sva lakṣaṇam tathāvidha sādhya artha kriyā kāri tat ca tena ātmanā pratyakṣeṇa dṛṣṭam eva na ca tad sva lakṣaṇa grahaṇa uttara kāla bhāvinaḥ nīla vikalpasya viṣayeṇa nīla sādhya artha kriyā sādhyate tasmāt anadhigata artha viṣayam pramāṇam iti api anadhigate sva lakṣaṇaḥ iti viśeṣaṇīyam adhigate sva lakṣaṇe tad sāmarthya janmā vikalpaḥ tad anukārī kāryataḥ tad viṣaya tvāt smṛtiḥ eva na pramāṇam anadhigata vastu rūpa an adhigateḥ vastu adhiṣṭhāna tvāt pramāṇa vyavasthāyāḥ artha kriyā yogya viṣaya tvāt tad arthi pravṛtteḥ artha kriyā yogya lakṣaṇa tvāt vastunaḥ tatas api vikalpāt tad adhyavasāyena vastuni eva pravṛtteḥ pravṛttau tu vikalpasya pratyakṣeṇa abhinna yogakṣema tvāt

pūrva pratyakṣa kṣaṇena kvacid abhinna upayoga tvāt uttareṣām aprāmāṇya prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na kṣaṇa viśeṣa sādhya arthavāñchāyām nānā yoga kṣema tvāt sādhāraṇe hi kārye na teṣām sāmarthya bhedaḥ apara apara dhūma pramita sannikṛṣṭa agni vat agni mātra sādhye arthe etena dharmi dharma liṅga ādi vikalpasya pramāṇa pṛṣṭha bhāvinaḥ prāmāṇyam pratyuktam

anvaya niścayaḥ api svabhāva hetau sādhya dharmasya vastutas tad bhāva tayā sādhana dharma bhāva mātra anubandha siddhiḥ sā sādhya viparyaye hetoḥ bādhaka pramāṇa vṛttiḥ yathā yat sat tat kṣaṇikam eva akṣaṇika tve artha kriyā virodhāt tad lakṣaṇam vastu tvam hīyate iti

kārya hetau kārya kāraṇa bhāva siddhiḥ yathā idam asya upalambhe upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam anupalabdham upalabhyate satsu api anyeṣu hetuṣu asya abhāve na bhavati iti tad bhāve bhāvaḥ abhāve abhāvaḥ ca pratyakṣa anupalambha sādhanaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tasya siddhiḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ eva hi artha antarasya evam syāt yatra dhūmaḥ tatra avaśyam agniḥ iti agni bhāvaḥ eva hi bhāvaḥ dhūmasya tad kārya tvam iti
anupalabdhau api asat vyavahārasya upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta anupalabdhi mātra vṛtti sādhanam anvaya niścayaḥ nimitta antara abhāva upadarśanāt

vyatireka niścayaḥ api kārya svabhāva hetvoḥ kārya kāraṇa vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva siddhau kāraṇa vyāpaka anupalabdhibhyām dṛśya viṣayābhyām sādhya abhāve hetu abhāva siddhiḥ uddiṣṭa viṣayasya abhāvasya upadarśane anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anyathā kvacid abhāva asiddheḥ anuddiṣṭa viṣayam punar sādhya abhāve abhāva khyāpanam pratibandha mātra siddhau sidhyati iti na tatra dṛśya viṣaya tā anupalabdheḥ vyatireka sādhane apekṣyate
vyatireka niścayaḥ anupalabdhau upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptāt sataḥ anupalambha abhāva darśanam

etad lakṣaṇaḥ tridhā eva sa hetuḥ tri prakāraḥ eva svabhāvaḥ kāryam anupalabdhiḥ ca iti yathā anitye kasmiṃścid gamye sattvam agnimati pradeśe dhūmaḥ abhāve ca upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdhiḥ iti asmin eva tri prakāre avinābhāva niyamāt yathā uktā vyāptiḥ avinābhāvaḥ pakṣa dharmasya na sa trividhāt dhetoḥ anyatra asti iti atra eva niyataḥ ucyate

tatra sādhana dharma bhāva mātra anvayini sādhya dharme svabhāvaḥ hetuḥ vastutas liṅgi svabhāvaḥ eva apara apara vyāvṛttyā dharma bhede api hetuḥ hetu svabhāve anvaya vyabhicāra abhāvāt viśeṣaṇam lakṣaṇe tanmātra anvayena parama tāpekṣam pare hi artha antara nimittam atadbhāva mātra anvayinam api dharmam svabhāvam icchanti iti viśeṣaṇena tathāvidhasya atad svabhāva tām tasmin sādhye hetoḥ vyabhicāram ca āha yathā vināśe hetumati kṛtaka tvasya

tasya dvidhā prayogaḥ sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa ca yathā yat sat tat sarvam kṣaṇikam yathā ghaṭa ādayaḥ san ca śabdaḥ iti tathā kṣaṇika tva abhāve sattva abhāvaḥ yathā vandhyā sute san ca śabdaḥ iti sarva upasaṃhāreṇa anvayena vyatirekeṇa ca vyāpti pradarśana lakṣaṇau sādharmya vaidharmya prayogau

atra sāmarthyāt eva pratijñā artha pratīteḥ na pratijñā prayogaḥ apradarśite prameye katham tad pratītiḥ iti ced svayam pratipattau kaḥ prameyasya darśayitā pradeśa stham dhūmam upalabdhavataḥ tasya agninā vyāpti smaraṇe tad sāmarthyāt eva agniḥ atra iti bhavati na ca tatra kaścid agniḥ atra iti asmai nivedayati na api svayam prāk eva pratipadyate kiñcid pramāṇam antareṇa evam pratīteḥ nimitta abhāvāt pratītau vā liṅgasya vaiyarthyāt svayam eva akasmāt agniḥ atra iti prameyam vyavasthāpya punar tad pratipattaye liṅgam anusarati iti kaḥ ayam pratipatti kramaḥ pareṇa api tat ucyamānam plavate eva upayoga abhāvāt
