atha punar ubhaya dharmam brūyāt anāśrita vastunaḥ aparyudāsena vyatireka mātrasya abhāve api avirodhāt yathā na bhavati mūrtaḥ iti amūrta tvam nirupākhye api syāt nirupākhyasya abhāvāt apratiṣedha viṣaya tā iti ced tat kim idānīm vidhi viṣayaḥ astu tat api na iti ced katham idānīm na pratiṣedha viṣayaḥ vidhi nivṛtti rūpa tvāt pratiṣedhasya parisaṅkhyāteṣu eva pratiṣedha vṛttiḥ iṣṭā tat na anupākhyeṣu amūrta tva ādikam iti ced duḥkham vatā ayam tapasvī sa aṅketikam icchā mātra anurodhinam artham niyantu kāmaḥ jīvati tasya sa uraḥ tāḍam krandataḥ api lokasya anivṛtteḥ yathā saṅketam pratipatteḥ tanmātra prayojana tvāt śabda prayogasya iṣṭa aviśeṣāt ubhayatra apratīti prasaṅgāt tatas api pratīteḥ samāśrayāt tasya anyatra api tulya tvāt tat etat vyavaccheda mātram dvayoḥ api sambhavat vipakṣa pracāra śaṅkā vyavacchedena labhyam gamaka tvam katham ātmasāt kuryāt

avyavaccheda rūpāḥ api khalu jñeya tva ādayaḥ dharmāḥ kathañcid avastūnām api buddhyā vyavasthāpanāt sādhāraṇāḥ santi te api etena vyākhyātāḥ sa ca sva vāca ubhaya dharma tām bruvāṇaḥ sataḥ anyatra api asya vṛttim bhāṣate sattāyām ca avyabhicāram iti katham na unmattaḥ vipakṣa vṛttyā vyabhicāraḥ tad pakṣa sa pakṣa ani atara tva ādīnām avipakṣa vṛtteḥ ubhaya dharma tve api adoṣaḥ na hi pakṣaḥ eva vyabhicāra viṣayaḥ kam punar atra bhavān vipakṣam pratyeti sādhya abhāvam katham idānīm hetuḥ avipakṣa vṛttiḥ ubhaya dharmaḥ ca na hi pakṣa vipakṣa pravibhāga apekṣayā hetoḥ avyabhicāraḥ vāstava tvāt na hi avinābhāvaḥ hetoḥ vyavasthayā darśyate sarvaḥ apakṣaḥ kṛtakaḥ anityaḥ iti kim tarhi vastu bala āyātā eva khalu vyāptiḥ pramāṇaiḥ upadarśyate sarvam kṛtakam anityam iti tathā asiddhau eva hi sa dharmaḥ tasya gamakaḥ syāt

na anyathā puruṣa pravṛtteḥ avastu pāratantryāt yam hi puruṣaḥ sādhayitum icchati sa pakṣaḥ sa yam evam vyabhicāra viṣayam paśyati tam eva pakṣīkuryāt na ca anumāna viṣaye pratyakṣa ādi bādhā asti pramāṇasya pramāṇa antareṇa bādhāyām tasya aprāmāṇya prasaṅgāt lakṣaṇa yukte bādhā sambhave tad lakṣaṇam eva dūṣitam syāt iti uktam abādhanasya api lakṣaṇa tve tasya aniścaya lakṣaṇa tā tathā ca āgamaka tvam iti kim kasya sādhanam yad artham avyabhicāraḥ cintyate tasmāt vastutas yat yena vyāptam avyāptam vā tat tasya gamakam agamakam ca iti na puruṣa icchayā vastu dharmaḥ vyavatiṣṭhate yadā ayam pakṣīkaroti tadā na vyabhicāraḥ anyadā tena vyabhicāraḥ iti su vyavadātam prāmāṇyam

abhāva dharmam tu bhāva mātra vyāpinaḥ arthasya vyavacchedam hetum sattāyām vadataḥ asya viruddhaḥ hetuḥ syāt tasya bhāve kvacid asambhavāt abhāve ca sarvatra bhāva vyavacchedasya bhāvāt tat ayam tri prakāraḥ api dharmaḥ sattā sādhane na hetu lakṣaṇa bhāj na ca anyā gatiḥ asti tasmāt na sattā sādhyate

sādhana tve punar asyāḥ sāmānyena tanmātra vyāpini vastu dharme siddha sattāke dharmiṇi na asiddhiḥ tena ca sādhya dharmeṇa vyāptiḥ yadi kathañcid niścīyeta tadā na virodha vyabhicārau iti na ayam prasaṅgaḥ iti eṣa dvividhaḥ hetuḥ svabhāva lakṣaṇaḥ kārya lakṣaṇaḥ ca saḥ eva sva vyāpaka viparyaye sādhye viruddhaḥ iti darśayan caturaḥ pakṣa dharmān āha bheda sāmānyayoḥ ca anaikāntikayoḥ aikāntika tām bruvāṇam prativahan dvau tat ca hetvābhāseṣu eva avasara prāptam vakṣyāmaḥ

vyāvṛtti prādhānya sādhana artham hetoḥ trīn pakṣa dharmān āha tathā hi na anvaya mukhena hetuḥ gamakaḥ anitya tvāt aprayatna anantarīyaka tvasya āgateḥ mā bhūt atas gatiḥ kevala tvāt avyatirekatayā anvayasya iti ced iha tarhi bhavatu asparśa tvāt nityaḥ iti na atra api anvayasya aprādhānyāt iti ced iha tu balavān anvayaḥ vyatirekaḥ ca durbalaḥ hetoḥ sa pakṣa vyāpteḥ vipakṣe ca kvacid abhāvāt yathā prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ anitya tvāt iti na bhavati sarvatas vipakṣāt avyāvṛtteḥ iti ced evam tarhi yaḥ kṛtakaḥ saḥ anityaḥ eva iti nitya vyavacchedena gamakateṣṭā syāt anyathā sarvatas vipakṣāt vyāvṛtteḥ darśayitum aśakyatvāt tat asya na bhāva mātreṇa na sāmyena na prādhānyena gatiḥ

aprādhānye api anvayasya vyatireka vyāptau asti yathā anityaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt iti tasmāt evam eva hetuḥ gamakaḥ yaḥ prayatna ānantarīyaḥ saḥ anityaḥ eva iti nitya vyavacchedena asya vākyasya śabda pradeśa ādiṣu nitya anagni vyavacchedena vyatireka gatau sāmarthya parisamāpteḥ na ca eteṣām bheda mātram gamyate kim tu tat eva sāmānyam apratipakṣam idam eva iha na anyat iti yadi avaśyam ete ananya saṃsargiṇaḥ gamyāḥ saḥ eva eṣām asaṃsargaḥ gamyaḥ astu tāvatā kārya parisamāpteḥ kim antar gaḍunā sāmānyena iti vyāvṛtti sādhanena darśayati yaḥ tarhi samarthena hetunā kārya utpādaḥ anumīyate sa katham trividhe hetau antarbhavati hetunā yaḥ samarthena kārya utpādaḥ anumīyate artha antara anapekṣa tvāt sa svabhāvaḥ anuvarṇitaḥ

asau api yathāsannihitāt na anyam apekṣate iti tanmātra anubandhī svabhāvaḥ bhāvasya tatra hi kevalam samagrāṇām kāraṇānām kārya utpādana yogya tā anumīyate yogyatā ca sāmagrī mātra anubandhinī iti svabhāva bhūtā eva kim punar kāraṇam sāmagryāḥ kāryam eva na anumīyate yena na samagrāṇi iti eva kāraṇa dravyāṇi sva kāryam janayanti sāmagrī janmanām śaktīnām pariṇāma apekṣa tvāt kārya utpādasya atra antare ca pratibandha sambhavān na kārya anumānam yogyatāyāḥ tu dravya antara anapekṣa tvāt aviruddham uttarottara śakti pariṇāmena samartheyam kāraṇa sāmagrī kārya utpādane śakti pariṇāma pratyayasya anyasya apekṣaṇīyasya abhāvāt iti pūrva sva jāti mātra hetu tvāt śakti prasūteḥ sāmagryā yogyatā ananyā apekṣaṇī iti ucyate

samagrāṇi eva kāraṇāni yogyatām api anumāpayanti asamagrasya ekānta asāmrthyāt iti na tatas kārya anumānam vipakṣe vṛtti adarśane api śeṣavat yathā deha indriya buddhibhyaḥ rāga ādi anumānam ātma ātmīya abhiniveśa pūrvakāḥ hi rāga ādayaḥ aham mama iti ca apaśyataḥ anunaya pratighā abhāvāt ayoni śomanaskāram antareṇa doṣāṇām anutpatteḥ deha ādīnām hetu tve api na kevalānām sāmarthyam asti iti vipakṣa vṛtteḥ adṛṣṭau api śeṣavat etat vyabhicāri liṅgam

yā tarhi akārya kāraṇa bhūtena anyena rasa ādinā rūpa ādi gatiḥ sā katham sā api eka sāmagrī adhīnasya rūpa ādeḥ asatas gatiḥ hetu dharma anumānena dhūma indhana vikāra vat tatra api hetuḥ eva tathābhūtaḥ anumīyate pravṛtta śakti rūpa upādāna kāraṇa sahakāri pratyayaḥ hi rasa hetuḥ rasam janayati indhana vikāra upādāna hetu sahakāri pratyaya agni dhūma janana vat tathā hi sva kāraṇasya phala utpādanam pratyābhimukhyena vinā na rasaḥ tat eva ca rūpa upādāna hetūnām pravṛtti kāraṇam sā api rasa upādāna kāraṇa pravṛttiḥ rūpa upādāna kāraṇa pravṛtti sahakāriṇī tasmāt yathābhūtāt hetaḥ rasaḥ utpannaḥ tathābhūta m anumāpayan rūpam anumāpayati tatra api atīta eka kālānām gatiḥ nā anāgatānām vyabhicārāt tasmāt iyam api kārya liṅga jā

etena pipīlika utsaraṇa matsya vikāra ādeḥ varṣa ādi anumānam vyākhyātam tatra api bhūta pariṇāmaḥ eva kaścid varṣa hetuḥ pipīlikā saṅkṣobha ādi hetuḥ ca iti rūpāt sparśa anumānam kārya liṅga jam rūpa ādīnām bhūta āśraya tvāt yat tarhi idam viṣāṇī go tvāt iti tat katham tatra api samudāya vyavasthāyāḥ kāraṇam samudāyinaḥ asatsu teṣu sā na syāt iti go tvāt viṣāṇitā

sāsnā viṣāṇa ādi samudāyaḥ hi gauḥ tat iyam samudāya vyavasthā samudāyi nibandhana tvāt tad abhāve na syāt bhavantī sva nimitta sannidhim sūcayati iti go tvāt viṣāṇita apratipattiḥ kārya liṅga jā ādhārataḥ abhinirvṛtteḥ ātmanaḥ tādṛśaḥ ambhasaḥ kāryam tasya yaḥ api sthiram ambhaḥ dṛṣṭvā adṛṣṭaḥ api adhastāt ādhāra sambhavaḥ anumīyate tat api kārya liṅga jam eva tādṛśasya ātmanaḥ ambhasaḥ tatas ādhārāt abhinirvṛtteḥ na hi tasmāt upakāram ananubhavataḥ tatas avasthā viśeṣa pratilambhaḥ yuktaḥ upakārasya artha antara tve api uktam

na vai tatas ātma viśeṣa utpatteḥ ambhasaḥ tathā sthitiḥ kim tarhi saṃyogāt kim punar sa tayoḥ saṃyogaḥ tābhyām jananāt samavāyāt vā sa kim ekatra na samavaiti janyate vā tasya asāmarthyāt tat asamartham pṛthak tatra sahitam api tādṛśam eva iti anupakāraka tvāt na saṃyogena tadvat syāt sahitasya tad anya upakārāt viśeṣa utpatteḥ sāmarthyam kaḥ ayam ajanya janaka bhūtānām upakāraḥ svarūpasya siddheḥ akārya tvāt para rūpa kriyāyām api tatra anupakārāt ubhayathā akārakasya akiñcid kara tvena anupakāraka tvāt iti ukta prāyam tasmāt sarve eva vastu sambandhāḥ janakasya eva upayoga viśeṣa vaśāt pravibhāgena kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt vyavasthāpyante tat ayam kuṇḍa bhū tala ādīnām api ādhāra bhāvaḥ badara udaka ādiṣu janana śaktiḥ eva tasmāt eteṣu tad ātmanā vyapadeśa ādayaḥ janya janaka bhāva kṛtāḥ eva bhavantu sati api saṃyoge tat na antarīyaka tvāt eṣām paramparā kalpanāyāḥ ca vaiyarthyāt

sthāpaka tvāt ādhāraḥ na janaka tvāt iti ced sthiteḥ artha antara anartha antara tve upakāreṇa vyākhyāte pāta pratibandhāt sthāpakaḥ iti ced kaḥ pratibandhaḥ sa hi tasya pāta pratibandhaḥ na artha antaram eva yaḥ sthāpayitrā kriyate artha antara tve tatra eva upayogaḥ iti kaḥ patataḥ pratibandhaḥ pratibandhāt apāte api tulyaḥ paryanuyogaḥ kṛtaḥ nāma sa tena pratibandha ākhyaḥ padārthaḥ sa tu bhāvaḥ prasarpaṇa dharma apracyuta anutpanna ātma bhūta viśeṣaḥ kim na patati iti pratibandhāt atiśaya pratipattau tasya api ātma antara tve tat eva vastunaḥ tādātmyāt patanam anavasthā ca na ca tathābhūta ātma kriyām pratibandham abhyupaiti tasmāt pāta abhāvaḥ pratibandhaḥ sa katham kenacid kriyate abhāvam karoti iti hi na abhāvaḥ nāma kaścid kāryaḥ

tasya kathañcid kārya tve abhāva ayogāt pūrvavat prasaṅgāt ca tasmāt bhāva kriyā pratiṣedhaḥ eṣa bhāvam na karoti iti yāvat tena ayam evam vācyaḥ syāt pātam na karoti iti tat api iṣṭam eva na hi tasya tad kṛtaḥ pātaḥ svayam patana dharma tayā pātāt ākāśa kṣipta vat tathā ca ayam atra akiñcitkaraḥ katham asya sthāpayitā tat ayam na kenacid pratibaddhaḥ iti na kadācid tiṣṭhet tasmāt pāta pratibandhaḥ iti api kṣaṇikānām bhāvānām upādānasamāna deśa utpādaḥ ucyate

tasmāt siddhā tādṛśaḥ ambhasaḥ ādhārāt utpattiḥ balākā api vṛtteḥ toya samāśrayāt kāryam tasya iti anuvartate toya āśritā hi balākāyāḥ vṛttiḥ tatas śarīra sthitim pratilabhamānā tad kārya tayā pratibandhena toyam gamayati deśa ādi apekṣayā anayā diśā anyeṣu api gamakeṣu pratibandhaḥ sādhyaḥ tat na trividhāt hetoḥ anyaḥ gamakaḥ asti apratibaddha svabhāvasya avinābhāva niyama abhāvāt iti

asiddha jñāpana aṅgasya jñāpanam pratyaśaktitaḥ trairūpya asiddhi sandehe prapattṝṇām asādhanam jñāpakaḥ hi hetuḥ yat ātma tayā jñāpayati tad asiddhau sandehe vā na jñāpakaḥ śabda vat trairūpyāt ca hetuḥ artham gamayati asambaddhāt apratipatteḥ mahānasa ādi dṛṣṭa dhūma āt iva udadhau agneḥ apratibandhāt ca sarvatas sarva pratipatti prasaṅgāt tasmāt pratipādya pratipāda kayoḥ asiddha sandigdha dharmi sambandha anvaya vyatirekāḥ dharmāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ tatra eka aprasiddhi sandehe aprasiddhaḥ vyabhicāra bhāj dvayoḥ viruddhaḥ asiddhau ca sandehe vyabhicāra bhāj ekaikasya rūpasya asiddhau sandehe vā asiddhaḥ anaikāntikaḥ ca hetvābhāsaḥ bhavati dharmi sambandha asiddha avasiddhaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ cākṣuṣa tvāt

cetanāḥ taravaḥ sarva tvac apaharaṇe maraṇāt iti prativādi anabhyupagataḥ vijñāna indriya āyuḥ nirodha lakṣaṇa tvāt maraṇasya katham ca maraṇam abhyupayat na caitanyam abhyupeyāt maraṇa śabda pravṛtteḥ siddham eva iti ced icchātaḥ śabdāḥ pravartante na tad vaśāt vastu sthitiḥ atiprasaṅgāt tasmāt śoṣa mayam taruṣu maraṇam āha na ca īdṛśam prāṇi maraṇam iti na idam taruṣu sidhyati na hi anapekṣita vastukam śabda mātram icchā vṛtti vidyate iti vastu gamyam vastu sidhyati etena anitya tva saṃsthāna viśeṣa ādayaḥ acetana tva viśiṣṭa buddhi pūrvaka tva ādi sādhanāḥ buddhi bhuvana ādīnām vyākhyātāḥ tatra api hi śabdaḥ eva kevalaḥ siddhaḥ na arthaḥ

na hi pare apracyuta ātmanaḥ upalayanam anitya tām icchanti nanu avivakṣita viśeṣam sāmānyam siddham eva tad siddhau viśeṣa vikalpena asiddhi codanā mithyā uttaram eva bhavati syāt mithyā uttaram yadi dvayoḥ api iṣṭam kiñcid vastu sāmānyam syāt yat nibandhanaḥ ayam anitya śabdaḥ kṛtaka tva ādi vat nanu asti eva tirodhānam na vai paraḥ tat anitya tvam āha kim tarhi vināśam nanu vinaṣṭa tirohitayoḥ dvayoḥ api avyaktiḥ tulya iti asti eva sāmānyam atha kā iyam avyaktiḥ adṛśya ātma tā nanu anena lakṣaṇena pradhāna puruṣa ādayaḥ api anityāḥ prasajanti prāc anya dharmaṇaḥ avyaktiḥ anitya tā iti ced anya dharmā ca prāc apracyuta ātmā iti ca su vyāhṛtam

etena tad avasthā nivṛttiḥ vyākhyātā yaḥ api avasthā nivṛttim tirodhāna sadṛśīm śabda viṣayam āha tasya api sā katham nivṛttā apracyutā ca avasthā nivartate na avasthāta iti ced kā iyam avasthā yā iyam udaka dhāraṇa ādi artha kriyāyām upanidhīyate yāmayam jantuḥ adhyakṣa madhyavasyati ghaṭaḥ ayam iti tad nivṛttau anivṛttau api aparasya asya sarvasya abhāvāt evam tarhi sā eva avasthā ghaṭaḥ astu yathā ukta lakṣaṇa tvāt asya sa ca nivṛttaḥ iti anivṛttaḥ avasthāta avasthitaḥ paryanuyojyaḥ sanvā na ghaṭaḥ bhāvikaḥ atad lakṣaṇa tvāt vastu ekam eva avasthā antara āveśāt bheda dṛṣṭiḥ iti ced

saḥ eva avasthā bhedaḥ vastu bheda lakṣaṇam kim na iṣyate evam hi sukha ādīnām asandigdhaḥ bhedaḥ bhavati kasyacid rūpasya anukārāt avasthā bhede api abhedaḥ iti ced nanu etat sukha ādīnām puruṣāṇām ca tulyam bhede krama abhivyakti virodhāt aikyam iti ced tad kim idānīm akrama abhivyakteḥ ghaṭa dadhi ādiḥ anekaḥ kaḥ vā virodhaḥ krama abhivyakteḥ abheda vyāpana asiddhau kramaḥ tu tad kārya tvāt tasya tad aniṣpattau aniṣpatteḥ abhedaḥ eva atitarāma krama tva prasaṅgaḥ eka ātma tva vat kārya tvāt eva abhedaḥ iti ced yuktaḥ yadi pratibandhaḥ sidhyet sa ca ananvayasya na sidhyati iti vakṣyāmaḥ

sarvathā na asti samānaḥ dharmaḥ dhvasta itarayoḥ abheda kalpanāyām api yam ayam anitya śabdaḥ samāviśet yathā utpattim hetubhyaḥ kṛtaka śabdaḥ sambandhi bheda vyudāse api tathā maraṇa sāmānyam vṛkṣa puruṣayoḥ yad darśanāt prāṇi antare mṛta pratipattiḥ tādṛśam yadi taruṣu upalabhyeta syāt etat atha śoṣa ādikam eva maraṇa śabdena vadet tasya api pratibandhaḥ caitanyena sampradhāryaḥ yatas sidhyet tathā saṃsthānam api yādṛśam prāsāda ādi bhedeṣu anuvṛttimat buddhi pūrvakam dṛṣṭam yat dṛṣṭeḥ akriyā darśinaḥ api kṛta buddhiḥ bhavati yadi tādṛśam syāt sarve eva hetavaḥ tathā syuḥ api ca

siddham yādṛś adhiṣṭhātṛ bhāva abhāva anuvṛttimat sanniveśa ādi tat yuktam tasmāt yat anumīyate vastu bhede prasiddhasya śabda sāmyāt abhedinaḥ na yuktā anumitiḥ pāṇḍu dravyāt iva hutāśane anyathā kumbhakāreṇa mṛd vikārasya kasyacid ghaṭa ādeḥ karaṇāt sidhyet valmīkasya api tad kṛtiḥ sādhyena anugamāt kārye sāmānyena api sādhane sambandhi bhedāt bheda ukti doṣaḥ kārya samaḥ mataḥ jāti antare prasiddhasya śabda sāmānya darśanāt na yuktam sādhanam go tvāt vāc ādīnām viṣāṇi vat vivakṣā paratantra tvāt na śabdāḥ santi kutra vā tad bhāvāt artha siddhau tu sarvam sarvasya sidhyati vastu svarūpe asiddhe ayam nyāyaḥ siddhe viśeṣaṇam adoṣa kṛt asiddhau api ākāśa āśraya vat hvaneḥ asiddhau api śabdasya siddhe vastuni sidhyati aulūkyasya yathā bauddhena uktam mūrti ādi sādhanam iti antaraślokāḥ

yā punar śāstra āśrayeṇa anyatarā siddhiḥ udbhāvyate yathā abhivyakti vādinaḥ kṛtaka tvam asiddham iti na tat sarvatra anumāne pramāṇa dṛṣṭasya pratijñayā asiddhi codanā ayogāt anadhikārāt ca śāstrasya anumāne pramāṇena eva bādhane tad bhāva pramāṇa apratītau vā kim abhivyakti vādena tasmāt śāstra āśrayaḥ eva anumāne anyatara asiddhiḥ śāstreṇa anyatra tu ajñānāt iti na vāda udāharaṇam udāharaṇa diśam tu ācāryaḥ prāha

yaḥ punar pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ asiddhaḥ ucyate yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ śabda tvāt iti saḥ api sādhya sādhanayoḥ bhedāt sādhyasya dharmiṇaḥ sva sādhane sādhana tva asiddheḥ hetu bhāvena asiddhaḥ ucyate na hi saḥ eva tasya sādhanam bhavati tad bhāva mātra anuṣaṅgiṇi punar tad nirdeśasya vaiyarthyāt na hi tatra aparaḥ viśeṣaḥ nirdiśyate sa śabda tayā tathā abhavan pakṣa nirdeśaḥ eva tathā sidhyati punar api svatas eva tathā abhāvāt tasmāt sa svayam ātmanaḥ hetuḥ asiddhaḥ

katham vai śabdaḥ asiddhaḥ siddhaḥ śabdaḥ saḥ ātmani hetu rūpaḥ na siddhaḥ iti asiddhaḥ ucyate sa ca śabdaḥ pakṣīkṛtaḥ na ca aparaḥ śabdaḥ yaḥ hetuḥ syāt tasya eva ca hetu tve apunar nirdeśyaḥ iti uktam avivādaḥ ca nityam tad bhāva siddheḥ anvaya adṛṣṭeḥ asiddhiḥ iti ced tat kim idānīm dharmī dharmi antare anvayībhavitā pradīpa ādayaḥ tu svabhāva yogyatayā ātmani jñānam utpādayantaḥ tathā prakāśamānāḥ sva ātma prakāśakāḥ iti ucyante na evam liṅga liṅginoḥ bheda āśraya tvāt tad bhāvasya na hi svayam jñāna viṣaya tā liṅgasya liṅgi pratipādanam dharmiṇaḥ tu sva sādhane ayam prasaṅgaḥ

sarva bhāveṣu dharmi dharma bheda asiddheḥ sarvatra eṣa doṣaḥ tulyaḥ iti ced uktam atra bhāvānām vyāvṛtti samāśraya vyavahāra bhedāt sādhya sādhana bhedaḥ iti parama artha vicāreṣu tathābhūta asiddheḥ tattva anya tvam padārtheṣu sāṃvṛteṣu pratiṣidhyate anumāna anumeya vyavahāraḥ punar pratyaya siddham bhedam avalambya prakalpyate

yathāsvam bheda niṣṭheṣu pratyayeṣu vivekinaḥ dharmī dharmāḥ ca bhāsante vyavahāraḥ tad āśrayaḥ vyavahāra upanītaḥ atra saḥ eva āśliṣṭa bheda dhīḥ sādhyaḥ sādhana tām nītaḥ tena asiddhaḥ prakāśitaḥ iti saṅgraha ślokau tasmāt na dharmī hetuḥ ubhaya asiddheḥ etena dharmaḥ api vyākhyātaḥ tatra api yadi tatas eva siddhiḥ sa prāk eva nirdiṣṭaḥ iti pūrvavat prasaṅgaḥ vācyaḥ anvayā siddhi vacane api na hi saḥ eva ātmānam anveti iti asambaddham

yadā tarhi vipakṣa vyatirekaḥ hetuḥ ucyate tadā katham tatra api sādhya abhāvaḥ vipakṣaḥ iti tad vyatirekaḥ sādhya dharmaḥ eva iti asiddhaḥ nanu pakṣa ādīnām para sparataḥ bhedāt avipakṣa tvam pakṣe asti eva kaḥ pakṣaḥ kaḥ vā vipakṣaḥ yatra kaścid dharmaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ sa pakṣaḥ tad vyatirekaḥ vipakṣaḥ sa tarhi icchayā vyavasthita lakṣaṇaḥ katham vipakṣasya vastu vaśāt vyavasthām apanudet hetuḥ ca evam na kaścid anaikāntikaḥ syāt vipakṣasya api icchā kṛta tvāt iti ukta prāyam sādhya vyatireke ca vipakṣe tad vyatirekaḥ yadi dharmiṇi siddhaḥ kim asiddham yad artham hetuḥ ucyate

na vai sādhya asiddhi mātreṇa sarvaḥ vipakṣaḥ kim tarhi tad vyatirekeṇa ubhaya niścitaḥ iti aniścayāt siddham avipakṣa tvam dharmiṇi sandigdha sādhya dharmā api evam avipakṣaḥ iti tad avipakṣa tvam aniścita sādhya vyatireka vyāvṛtti rūpam katham sādhanam aniścita tad lakṣaṇa tvāt tena eva niścayaḥ kriyate iti ced katham aniścayāt niścayaḥ vyatireka aniścayaḥ hi avipakṣa śabdena ucyate tatas eva katham abhāva niścayaḥ yasmāt idam iha sandigdham tasmāt idam iha na asti iti ca subhāṣitam

tasmāt anapekṣita pakṣa vyavasthau dharmāṇām vṛtti vyatirekau paraspara parihāra sthita lakṣaṇau na tṛtīyam rāśim vyatirecayataḥ tayoḥ ekasya nivṛttiḥ aparasya vṛttiḥ iti katham anitya abhāva vyatirekaḥ anitye sādhye dharmiṇi sidhyet tat kim idānīm pakṣaḥ api vipakṣaḥ syāt api paryāyeṇa lakṣaṇa bhedaḥ tu kathitaḥ eva na hi avipakṣa śaṅkāyām sādhya abhāva vyavaccheda artham hetuḥ ucyate na ca hetoḥ sambandha upadarśana kāle pakṣa ādi vikalpaḥ asti yatas ayam doṣaḥ syāt sa hi kevalaḥ eva kasyacid bhāva abhāvayoḥ vṛtti vyatirekavān upadarśitaḥ svayam bhavat sāmarthyena tat tathābhūtam āpādayati iti sa tasya pāścātyaḥ sāmarthya viṣayaḥ pakṣaḥ ucyate tena tad lakṣaṇa mukhena āyātaḥ dharmaḥ na pratyāyana kāla bhāvi iti anaṅgam

yat tarhī damita rata dviparīta vinirmukta tvāt iti na tatra eṣa doṣaḥ itara grahaṇāt kevalaḥ hi tad viparīta virahaḥ sādhya dharmaḥ syāt na punar kutaścid asate iti asti sādhya sādhanayoḥ viśeṣaḥ atra api viśeṣaṇa upādānam iṣṭasya eva bādhakam na hi tasya asattā anabhyupagamaḥ itara grahaṇam samartham bhavati yathā māṭharāditaraḥ brāhmaṇaḥ bhojanīyaḥ iti māṭharasya abrāhmaṇye brāhmaṇaḥ bhojanīyaḥ iti eva vācyam syāt

parasya ayam abhiprāyaḥ asat iti tad abhiprāya vaśāt evam uktam tena itara asat viraheṇa tvayā upagata tvāt iti arthaḥ tatra api kaḥ pāramārthikaḥ asatām parasparataḥ vibhāgaḥ ekasya hi rūpam anyatra apaśyantī buddhiḥ idam asmāt vibhaktam iti pratyeti tad arūpāṇām kutas bhāve vā na asantaḥ syuḥ tad lakṣaṇa tvāt sattvasya kevalam vikalpa viracitam asantam api eṣām ātmānam vibhāgavantam iva anyānyaiḥ vyapadeśaiḥ vaktāraḥ pradarśayanti na ca tad kṛtaḥ vibhāgaḥ vastu vyavasthāyāḥ samāśrayaḥ atiprasaṅgāt iti uktam itaretara vibhāgam ca anena sattā anuṣaṅgiṇam prathayatā asattā eva sarvatra utsāditā bhavati tathā api īdam asiddham eva asataḥ virahāt iti vyabhicāri vā

atha api tad abhimatāt kutaścid nānā bhāvaḥ evambhāvaḥ syāt na tarhi tatas nānābhāvāt evambhāvaḥ bhavati kim tarhi tad mateḥ punar icchā parāvṛttau anyatra api evambhāvasya abhimateḥ tat iha icchāyām eva sāmarthyam avasthitam iti sā eva iṣṭa vastu svabhāva anukarṣiṇī proktā syāt tat kim eṣām paraspara viraheṇa sā eva hetuḥ vācyaḥ syāt tatra ca vastu pratibandhaḥ vācyaḥ anyathā asiddheḥ etena ātma para upagama ādayaḥ puruṣa vyavasthā samāśrayāḥ sarve hetavaḥ vyākhyātāḥ yathā avipakṣa tvāt tad samudāya eka deśa tvāt ityādayaḥ anayā diśā sarva prayogeṣu vacana parāvṛtti kṛtam vibhramam utsṛjya artha vyavasthāpana nītiḥ anusartavyā

anityaḥ prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt iti eṣa katham na pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ tasya eva abhinna vyāvṛtti samāśraya tvāt abhinna pratyaya viṣayasya vyavahāra upanītasya sādhya dharmiṇaḥ sādhana tve pratijñā artha eka deśa tvam uktam viśeṣam punar sādhya dharmiṇam kṛtvā sāmānyam hetum bruvāṇasya dharma bhedāt aṅga aṅgitā na virudhyate

bheda sāmānyayoḥ dharma bhedāt aṅga aṅgita iṣyate yathā anityaḥ prayatna utthaḥ prayatna uttha tayā dhvaniḥ pakṣa aṅga tve api abādha tvāt na asiddhiḥ bhinna dharmiṇi yathā aśvaḥ na viṣāṇi tvāt eṣa piṇḍaḥ viṣāṇavān sādhya kāla aṅga tā vā na nivṛtteḥ upalakṣya tat tatas eva apratijñā arthaḥ viśeṣaḥ dharma bhedataḥ iti antaraślokāḥ

tathā svayam tad āśrayasya vā sandehe ahetuḥ yathā bāṣpa ādi bhāvena sandigdhaḥ bhūta saṃhātaḥ agni siddhau yathā ca iha nikuñje mayūraḥ kekāyitāt iti tad āpāta deśa vibhrame dharmya siddhau api yathā sarvatra sukha ādi sambhavāt vibhuḥ ātmā iti evam ekasya pakṣa dharmasya hetu rūpasya asiddhau sandehe vā asiddhaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ tathā ekasya rūpasya asiddhau sandehe vā anaikāntikaḥ katamasya ekasya vyatirekasya asiddhau yathā caturvidhaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ pakṣa dharma prabhede nirdiṣṭaḥ sandehe yathā asarva jñaḥ kaścid vivakṣitaḥ puruṣaḥ rāga ādimān vā vacana ādeḥ iti

sandigdhaḥ atra vyatirekaḥ sarvajñaḥ vaktā na upalabdhaḥ iti evamprakārasya anupalambhasya adṛśya ātma viṣaya tvena sandeha hetu tvāt iti uktam kaḥ hi atra virodhaḥ yadi vaktā ca syāt sarva jñaḥ ca yadi atra bhavataḥ manda buddhi cakṣuṣaḥ anupalabdhiḥ artha anapākuryāt hanta hataḥ asi pitṛ vyapadeśa nibandhanasya api apāvṛtti prasaṅgāt vacana sarvajña tvayoḥ dvividhasya api virodhasya abhāvāt yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sa vaktā na bhavati iti vyatirekaḥ adarśane api na sidhyati sandehāt bādhaka bhāve hi aparābhāvaḥ niścīyate na ca aviruddha lakṣaṇam atīndriyam su jñāna bādhanam tat na vyāpti siddhiḥ sarvaḥ vaktā sarva jñaḥ iti

sarva vaktṛ dharma tā paricchedasya ca kartum aśakyatvāt saḥ eva hi evam sarvajñaḥ syāt iti apratiṣedhaḥ sva ātmani sva saṃviditena anena aparatra paricchedaḥ iti ced nanu evam ātmani dṛṣṭasya aparatra upanaye ati prasaṅgaḥ dṛṣṭa viruddhasya anupanayaḥ iti ced tulye nyāye kim na upanayaḥ na ca eṣa nyāyaḥ lakṣaṇa yukte virodha sambhavāt na darśana mātreṇa kim tarhi vyatirekāt api tad abhāvāt ananya upanayaḥ iti ced tulyā vṛtti tad sandehābhyām abhāva asiddhiḥ iti anupanayaḥ dṛśya tayā ca tayoḥ ātmanoḥ virodha upalabdhiḥ iti asādhya tvam adṛśya ātmanām tu sva pratiyogibhiḥ virodhaḥ api mā bhūt yena nirasta pratipakṣāḥ niyamena niścīyante tat ayam puruṣaḥ ātmānam āntaraiḥ kaiścid ananya vedyaiḥ dharmaiḥ yuktam pratisaṃvedayamānaḥ tad upasaṃhāreṇa sarvatra vyavaharan prakāmam āsādita vidyā śrama phalaḥ yaḥ strī śūdra sādhāraṇam api vivekam na avagāhate tasmāt ātmani darśana mātreṇa anupasaṃhāraḥ tāvatā vyāpti asiddheḥ atas sandigdhaḥ vyatirekaḥ

pūrva uktāt ca anupalabdhi lakṣaṇāt i īdṛśām prayogāṇām sandeha hetu tvam unneyam rāga ādīnām api artha antara tvāt agatiḥ vacanāt anumāna lakṣaṇāt abhyūhyā apratibandhāt asati rāge vacanam na asti iti aniścitaḥ vyatirekaḥ na hi rāga ādīnām eva kāryam spanda vacana ādayaḥ vaktu kāma tā sāmānya hetutvāt sā eva rāgaḥ iti ced iṣṭa tvāt adoṣaḥ nitya sukha ātma ātmīya darśana ākṣiptam sa āsrava dharma viṣayam abhūta guṇa abhinandanam rāgam āhuḥ tad ānanda viṣaya uparodhini tad kṛtaḥ cetasaḥ vyāroṣaḥ dveṣaḥ saḥ eva ubhaya āśrayaḥ pūrvakaḥ viparyāsaḥ mohaḥ na evam karuṇā ādayaḥ anyathā api bhāvāt iti vyākhyātam vārttike tatra yathā raktaḥ bravīti tathā viraktaḥ api iti vacana mātrāt apratītiḥ na api viśeṣāt abhiprāyasya durbodha tvāt vyavahāra saṅkareṇa sarveṣām vyabhicārāt

prayojana abhāvāt avyāhāraḥ iti ced na para artha tvāt na yuktaḥ vīta rāga tvāt iti ced na karuṇayā api vṛtteḥ sā eva rāgaḥ iti ced iṣṭam na nāma nivāryate rūpam tu bhinnam aśubha abhinandinaḥ pratisandhi bandhāt atas eva aviparyāsa udbhavā sā na doṣaḥ asatya ātma grahe duḥkha viśeṣa darśana mātreṇa abhyāsa bala utpādinī bhavati eva karuṇā tathā hi dharma ālambana ādayaḥ maitrī ādayaḥ sūtre deśitāḥ etāḥ ca sajātīya abhyāsa vṛttayaḥ na evam rāga ādayaḥ viparyāsa abhāve abhāvāt kāruṇikasya api niṣphalaḥ ārambhaḥ viparyāsāt iti ced na para arthasya eva phala tvena iṣṭa tvāt tad lakṣaṇa tvāt ca phalasya

vaktari ātmani rāga ādi darśanena anyatra tad anumāne ati prasaṅgaḥ api uktaḥ vyabhicārāt ananya anumānaḥ iha avyabhicāraḥ iti kutas niścayaḥ adarśane api uktam dṛśya ātmanoḥ nāma ayam arvāk darśanaḥ sahabhāvam itaram vā paśyet viprakṛṣṭe punar arthe abhāva nirṇayaḥ anaikāntikaḥ tasmāt karaṇa guṇa vaktu kāmate vacanam anumāpayet nanu atra api eṣa tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ na ātmani darśanena anumānam iti na tayoḥ iha anvaya vyatirekābhyām kārya kāraṇa bhāva siddheḥ anyatra anumānāt na tu evam aśubha abhinandena viparyāsena ca vacanasya tad siddhiḥ ātmani eva anyathā darśanāt

rāga utpatti yogya tā ra hite vacana adarśanāt tad anumāne vyatireka asiddheḥ na kārya kāraṇa tā siddhiḥ acetanā vyatireka viṣayaḥ iti ced na evaṃvidhāt vyatirekāt kāraṇa śakti siddhiḥ satsu hi samartheṣu tad anyeṣu kāraṇeṣu kārya anutpattiḥ kāraṇa antaram anumāpayati na ca evaṃvidhaḥ vyatirekaḥ acetaneṣu sambhavati caitanya karaṇa guṇa ādeḥ eva dṛṣṭa śakteḥ hetoḥ teṣu asambhavāt saṃśayaḥ rāgasya anupayoge katham tat śaktiḥ upayujyate svabhāva guṇasya śaktau upacārāt yatra saḥ asamarthaḥ na tatra śakteḥ sāmarthyam asti iti

tasmāt na āntarīyakam eva kāryam kāraṇam anumāpayati tad pratibandhāt na anyat vipakṣe adarśane api sarva darśinaḥ hi darśana vyāvṛttiḥ sarva abhāvam gamayet kvacid tathā adṛṣṭānām api deśa kāla bhedena anyathā darśanāt yathā āmalakyaḥ kṣīra avasekena madhura phalāḥ bhavanti na ca evam bahulam dṛśyante tena evam syāt yuktam vaktum mādṛśaḥ vaktā rāgī iti rāga utpatti pratyaya viśeṣeṇa ātma darśana ayoni śoma naskāreṇa yogāt tadā api apārthakaḥ vacana udāhāraḥ tasmāt na asya api vipakṣe adṛṣṭi mātreṇa vyāvṛttiḥ asandigdhā tena ayam api ekasya rūpasya sandehāt anaikāntikaḥ dvayoḥ viruddhaḥ asiddhau ca yathā kṛtaka tva prayatna ānantarīyaka tve nitya tva sādhane tayoḥ sa pakṣe asattvam vipakṣe bhāvaḥ ca iti dvayaḥ rūpayoḥ asiddhiḥ viparyaya siddhiḥ iti yāvat tat etau dvau hetū viparyaya sādhanāt viruddhau

nanu tṛtīyaḥ api iṣṭa vighāta kṛt viruddhaḥ asti yathā para arthāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ saṅghāta tvāt śayana āsana ādi aṅga vat iti tad iṣṭa asaṃhata pārārthya viparyaya sādhanāt viruddhaḥ sa kasmāt na uktaḥ sādhya tā abhedāt na hi ayamābhyām sādhya viparyaya sādhana tvena bhidyate na hi iṣṭa uktayoḥ sādhya tve kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti uktam viśeṣe tu viruddha vat hetuḥ api pṛthak iṣṭa sādhanaḥ vācyaḥ syāt ekasya eva tu vacanena sādhya tā aviśeṣaḥ darśitaḥ tatas eva tad viparyaya sādhanaḥ viruddhaḥ api ekaḥ eva prayoga bhedāt tu tad bhedaḥ kvacid ukti sāmarthyābhyām kvacid vivakṣayā dharma dharmiṇoḥ viśeṣaṇa tvena upādānāt viruddha vat hetuḥ api evam kim na bhinnaḥ iti ced kaḥ pratiṣeddhāḥ vibhettuḥ anukta sāmarthya ākṣiptam iṣṭam paraḥ abhipraiti iti tad abhiprāya vaśa ādiṣṭa vighāta kṛt iti ucyate na punar lakṣaṇa bhedāt atas eva apṛthak nirdeśaḥ iti uktam

nanu saṃhatānām asaṃhata para upakāra niyama abhāvāt anaikāntikaḥ eva iti aviruddhaḥ kaḥ hi eṣa niyamaḥ saṃhatāḥ para upakāriṇaḥ iti yadi api kvacid kārye avadhānavatām arthānām sāmagrī saṅghātaḥ tathā api na avaśyam kāraṇāni kāryavanti bhavanti pratibandha ādi sambhavāt iti vyabhicāraḥ eva apratibaddha upakārāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ para upakāriṇaḥ ced atra api saṃhata upakāriṇaḥ eva iti kaḥ pratibandha niyamaḥ

pratyupayogam tebhyaḥ upakāryasya svabhāva antara utpatteḥ tathā upayoginām nānā svabhāva upakāra sādhanam etat na eka kāla aneka upakāra sādhanam upakārasya artha antara tve atad upakāra ādayaḥ api uktāḥ anubhaya kāriṇāma anartha kyāt tāt arthya sādhanam vipratiṣiddham tasmāt upakurvāṇāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ ādheya atiśayam eva upakurvate sa tasmāt eka svabhāvaḥ na bhavati iti viruddhaḥ

caśabdaḥ dvayoḥ ekasya asiddhau aparasya ca sandehe vyabhicāra bhāj iti sūcanā arthaḥ yathā vīta rāgaḥ sarvajñaḥ vā vacanāt iti vyatirekaḥ atra asiddhaḥ sandigdhaḥ anvayaḥ sarvajña vīta rāgayoḥ viprakarṣāt vacana ādeḥ tatra sattvam asat tvam vā sandigdham sandehe vyabhicāra bhāj dvayoḥ iti vartate yatra anvayaḥ vyatirekaḥ ca sandigdhaḥ yathā sa ātmakam jīvat śarīram prāṇa ādimattvāt iti

na hi sa ātmakān ātmakābhyām anyaḥ rāśiḥ asti yatra prāṇa ādiḥ varteta ātma vṛtti vyavacchedābhyām sarvasya saṅgrahāt na api anayoḥ ekatra vṛtti niścayaḥ tādātmyena prasiddhe asiddheḥ tasmāt jīvat śarīra sambandhī prāṇa ādiḥ anubhaya ātma tā bahis bhāvāt tābhyām na vyatiricyate na tatra anveti eka ātmani api asiddheḥ atas eva anvaya vyatirekayoḥ sandehāt anaikāntikaḥ sādhyetarayoḥ atas aniścayāt

na api apratipattiḥ kenacid sambandhāt asambandhāt vimarśaḥ na jāyate yathā cākṣuṣa tvāt śabde sambandhāt kiṃsambaddhaḥ ayam iti katham na vimṛśet aparijñāta sambandhāt garbhāt puruṣa viśeṣa sambandhe asambandha ayogāt yathā saṃśete tathā iha api sarva anantarbhāva ayogāt saṃśayaḥ apratipattiḥ anubhaya pratipatti saṃśaya rūpā sa ubhaya bahis bhāve syāt antarbhāve katham apratipattiḥ evam tarhi cākṣuṣa tvāt api astu na asambandhāt iti uktam tasmāt saṃśaya hetu rasa ādhāraṇaḥ

viśeṣataḥ prāṇa ādayaḥ viprakarṣāt ātmanaḥ vṛtti vyatireka asiddheḥ tatra prāṇa ādīnām api artha antarāt akārya bhūtāt asiddheḥ ca na hi kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ prāṇa ādīnām ātmanaḥ ca sidhyati tasya upalambha anupalambha āśraya tvāt tena na apratibaddhasya bhāve bhāvaḥ iti saṃśayaḥ gamakāḥ eva ātmanaḥ prāṇa ādayaḥ tad vyatirekasya aikāntika tvāt iti a paraḥ vipakṣāt eva hi prāṇa ādayaḥ nivartante na sa pakṣāt asataḥ nivṛtti ayogāt tasmāt aikāntika anvayavat aikāntika vyatirekaḥ api gamakaḥ eva na ca evam śrāvaṇa tvam ubhayatas vyāvṛtteḥ iti

tena evamprakāram vyatirekam varṇayatā vinābhāvaḥ eva uktaḥ bhavati tathā hi ātmā abhāvaḥ eva na bhavati eva iti arthāt ananya saṃsargiṇī ātma vṛttiḥ sūcitā bhavati sā eva avinābhāvaḥ tatas eva anvaya siddhiḥ iti na vyatirekī pratibandhaḥ ca avinābhāvaḥ sa ca ātma pratibandhaḥ tādātmya tad utpattibhyām anyaḥ na asti iti uktam te ca darśanena vinā na sidhyataḥ tat na ātma avinā bhāvī prāṇa ādiḥ tatas eva na ātma nivṛttau asya nivṛttiḥ api yatas vyatirekī iti ucyate na hi apratibaddhaḥ kasyacid nivṛttau niyamena nivartate tasmāt viśeṣasya na vyatirekaḥ na anvayaḥ adarśana mātram āśritya ācāryeṇa śrāvaṇa tve vyatirekaḥ uktaḥ na tāvatā abhāva gatiḥ iti uktam anyathā saṃśaya hetuḥ eva na syāt na hi yaḥ yatra na sambhavati tad upalabdhyā tatra saṃśayaḥ yuktaḥ

prāṇa ādi abhāvena nairātmyasya vyāpteḥ ātma nivṛttau prāṇa ādi nivṛttiḥ iti ced na apratibaddha abhāvena anupayoginaḥ abhāvasya vyāpti asiddheḥ yadi prāṇa ādayaḥ tad ātma tayā tad utpattyā vā ātma pratibaddhāḥ syuḥ te tad nivṛttyā nivarteran tadā prāṇa ādi abhāvaḥ nairātmyam vyāpnuyāt tad abhāve abhāva siddhyā vyāptiḥ iti sā na sidhyati viparyaye pratibandha asiddheḥ upalambha anupalambhābhyām hi tayoḥ pratibandham jānīyāt tau ca atyanta parokṣasya na sidhyataḥ ke ca nirātmānaḥ prāṇa ādi abhāvena vyāptāḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ ced anyatra adṛṣṭaḥ sa ghaṭa ādau na iti kutas tena ajñāta vyatirekasya vyāvṛtti vyāptiḥ asiddhā prāṇa ādayaḥ api hi kvacid darśanāt eva sat asantaḥ pratīyante na ca evam ātmā iti na tasya sat asattva pratītiḥ yat api āha yadi na sa ātmakam jīvat śarīram prāṇa ādi viraha prasaṅgaḥ nairātmyāt ghaṭa ādi vat iti tat api akārya kāraṇa bhāve na sidhyati uktam hi prāk na anupalabdhau akārya kāraṇa pratiṣedhaḥ gamakaḥ iti sa ca kāraṇa bhāvaḥ adarśanāt ātmanaḥ na sidhyati iti uktam

darśane api vyatireka asiddheḥ na sidhyati ghaṭa ādayaḥ vyatireka viṣayāḥ iti ced na evaṃvidhāt vyatirekāt kāraṇa sāmarthya siddhiḥ satsu samartheṣu anyeṣu hetuṣu kārya anutpattiḥ kāraṇa antara bhāvam gamayati iti uktam buddhi ādayaḥ api hi prāṇa ādeḥ hetavaḥ ghaṭa ādau na santi tasmāt sandigdha sāmarthya ātmanaḥ vyatirekaḥ te api buddhi ādayaḥ nairātmye na syuḥ iti ced na tatra anyeṣām eva sāmarthya darśanāt cakṣuḥ ādi buddhīnām tāvat yathāsvam indriya viṣayau hetū pūrvakam ca aviguṇam vijñānam tasya viṣaya antara vikṣepa pratighāta ādau uttara vijñāna anutpatti vyākulatā ādi darśanāt manaḥ vijñānasya pūrvakam aviguṇam vijñānam indriya ādīnām api pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ sabhāga avasthā bhedaḥ upādāna hetuḥ buddhiḥ ca pratyayaḥ iti etāvataḥ ayam ātma bhāvaḥ anvaya vyatireka bhāj iti ayam eva hetuḥ anavasthānya kalpane syāt

yasmin sati bhavati eva yat tatas anyasya kalpane tad hetu tvena sarvatra hetūnām anavasthitiḥ iti saṅgrahaślokaḥ tulyaḥ ca śrāvaṇa tvena prāṇa ādiḥ vyabhicāreṇa na tad vyatirekasya vyabhicārāt katham vyabhicāraḥ na hi tasya āsapakṣāt eva vyatirekaḥ iti nanu evam asya sa pakṣe anuvṛtti abhāvaḥ kathyate saḥ aparasya api tulyaḥ iti katham asamaḥ prāṇa ādiḥ

asapakṣaḥ eva na asti iti ca asya sa pakṣe astitā ucyate pratiṣedha dvayena prakṛta gamanāt anyathā vyavacchedya abhāvāt avadhāraṇasya kim phalam syāt anavadhāraṇe ca vākyasya vyatirekasya avyabhicāra asiddheḥ tatas eva sa pakṣaḥ eva asti asapakṣaḥ eva na asti iti dṛṣṭāntayoḥ anyatareṇa artha apattyā ubhaya pradarśanam āha tasmāt īdṛśaḥ vyatireka avyabhicāraḥ ananvayeṣu na sidhyati sidhyan ca balāt anvayam āpādayati pratiṣedha niṣedhasya vidhāna rūpa tvāt

asataḥ sa pakṣāt na nivṛttiḥ iti asa pakṣaḥ eva na asti iti ced na iti sā eva nivṛtteḥ nivṛttiḥ asataḥ katham iṣṭā abhāva pratiṣedhaḥ hi bhāvaḥ asati api asti bhāva pratiṣedhaḥ tu na sambhavati iti askhalita prajñaḥ devānām priyaḥ yaḥ tad viṣayam pratiṣedham na icchati asat abhāvaḥ iti evamādi ca vyavaharati nirloṭhitaḥ ca ayam arthaḥ asati na astitā iti atra antare tena na iha pratanyate na ca āsannātmā sattā sādhana vṛtteḥ sandigdhaḥ syāt na ca pareṇa tathā upagataḥ iti apramāṇāt abhyupagamāt tathā eva bhavati atiprasaṅgāt na ca upagama balena sa pakṣāsa pakṣau vyavasthāpya pramāṇa pravartanam yuktam evam hi āgama siddhaḥ ātmā syāt na anumāna siddhaḥ

tasmāt avyatireke api asataḥ sa pakṣāt vyatirekaḥ sandigdhaḥ syāt prāṇa ādīnām ātmanaḥ sandehāt atas eva vipakṣāt api ekatra hi niyame siddhe anya nivartanam sidhyet anyathā hi kvacid dṛṣṭe abhāva siddhau api syāt eva adṛṣṭeṣu saṃśayaḥ tathā hi asakala vyakti bheda vyāpinaḥ api arthāḥ kecid tad jāti sambhavinaḥ dṛṣṭāḥ pārthiva āloha lekhya vat virodhasya ca adṛṣṭeḥ sandehaḥ eva nairātmyena prāṇa ādīnām ukta lakṣaṇasya virodhasya asiddheḥ sandigdhaḥ nairātmyāt vyatirekaḥ ātma pratiniyame hi tad kārya ātma tayā prāṇa ādīnām nairātmyena saha virodhaḥ syāt sa ca na sidhyati iti uktam

astu nāma nirātmakebhyaḥ vyatirekaḥ prāṇa ādīnām tad bhāve ca nairātmya vyāvṛttiḥ tathā api na anairātmyāt ātmā jīvat śarīre sidhyati yena ayam na vyatirekasya abhāvam bhāvam icchati yathā vyatireka abhāve api sa pakṣe prāṇa ādiḥ neṣṭaḥ sa pakṣāvyatirekī ced hetuḥ hetuḥ atas anvayī na anvayya vyatirekī ced anairātmyam na sa ātmakam iti saṅgrahaślokaḥ

na prāṇa ādi sambhavena nairātmya vyāvartanāt ātma gatiḥ kim tarhi vidhi mukhena eva prāṇa ādayaḥ ātmānam gamayanti iti ced kim idānīm nairātmyāt vyatirekasya phalam sa hi tatra asambhavan sva sambhavena tat asambhavam sādhayati iti tatas vyatirekī varṇyeta anyathā ātma sannidhāyane kaḥ nairātmyāt vyatirekasya upayogaḥ katham vā aprasiddha ātma niyamāḥ prāṇa ādayaḥ ātmānam vidadhati iti vaktavyam atiprasaṅgaḥ hi evam syāt iti asādhāraṇa anaikāntikaḥ eva prāṇa ādiḥ sādhāraṇam api khalu prameya tvam asaṃskṛta apavādinaḥ asati anvayā yogāt avyabhicarita anvayam sa pakṣaḥ eva asti iti anvayinam eva hetum āha

atra api katham avyatirekaḥ vipakṣāt katham vā sa pakṣaḥ eva asti iti kim hi asya avadhāraṇasya phalam yadi na vipakṣe astitvam vyavacchidyeta vyavacchede vā katham avyatirekaḥ na hi sattā pratiṣedhāt anyaḥ vyatirekaḥ vipratiṣiddham ca etat na anvayaḥ na vyatirekaḥ iti yaḥ eva khalu na iti anvaya pratiṣedhaḥ saḥ eva vyatirekaḥ iti

tat punar idam āyātam asataḥ vyatireka ayogāt iti atra idam eva punar vācyam katham asataḥ anvaya pratiṣedhaḥ iti vastu rūpa anukarṣī khalu asati pratiṣedhaḥ na sambhavet na hi paryudāsaḥ eva ekaḥ nañaḥ viṣayaḥ kim tarhi prasajya pratiṣedhaḥ api na hi tasya asati virodhaḥ saḥ api na sambhavati adhikaraṇa ādi arthānām pratiṣedha viṣaya upadarśanīnām vibhaktīnām ayogāt iti ced ukta uttaram etat tasmāt na hetuḥ kaścid anvayī nāma

na ca prameya tvasya vipakṣe anvayā yogaḥ trividhaḥ hi dharmaḥ bhāva abhāva ubhayāśrayaḥ iti uktam na abhāvasya kaścid dharmaḥ iti ced nanu ayam eva asya dharma virahaḥ dharmaḥ na hi vastu rūpam eva dharmaḥ asantaḥ api kenacid prakaraṇena imam vyavahāra patham upanīyante anyathā hi tatra avyavahāraḥ eva syāt na ca satām api paramārthataḥ kaścid dharma dharmi bhāvaḥ kevalam buddhiḥ evaṃsambandham uparacayati iti uktam vārttike buddhi kṛtā ca ghaṭanāsatsu kena nivāryate

sat asat ubhaya anubhaya vyavasthāḥ ca tat atad samayavatām aniścita sādhanāḥ na ekānta grāhiṇyaḥ syuḥ tasmāt yathā kathañcid api anena asataḥ niścinvatā prameyāḥ vaktavyāḥ na hi bhāva viṣayam eva pramāṇam avisaṃvāda lakṣaṇa tvāt pramāṇasya tad sadasatī tad bhāvena vyavasthāpayan na ced sva viṣaye pareṇa bādhyate tat asya pramāṇa lakṣaṇam asti iti prameyaḥ abhāvaḥ

na eva abhāvaḥ kaścid sarveṣām kathañcid bhāvāt iti ced yathā te na santi sa prakāraḥ abhāvaḥ śaśa viṣāṇayoḥ ca ayam bhāvāt śaśa viṣāṇa abhāva vādinam upahasan ātmānam eva upahasati śaśa avayava bhūtam viṣāṇam na asti iti abhidhātari kaḥ prastāvaḥ śaśaḥ api asti viṣāṇam ca iti uttarasya na hi ayam viṣāṇa mātram apahnute yatas tena pratirudhyeta kim tarhi śaśa sambandhi yadi evam sambandhaḥ na asti iti vaktavyam na viṣāṇam kim vai sambandha mātram viśiṣyate viṣāṇinām api viṣāṇeṣu na dravya svabhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ api pratikāryam kāraṇa svabhāva bhedāt tat kaḥ ayam sambandha abhāvaḥ vācyaḥ iti upālambhaḥ asti viṣāṇinām viṣāṇa svabhāva bhedaḥ na tadvat kiñcit śaśasya bhinna svabhāvam viṣāṇam iti ced vayam api etat eva brūmaḥ yaḥ vā sambandhaḥ na asti iti ucyate saḥ eva abhāvaḥ sambandhī vidyate na sambandhaḥ iti ca nipuṇā vācaḥ yuktiḥ aṅgīkṛta sambandham dravyam api na iti ced priyam anuṣṭhitam yadi idam eva prathamamucyeta na parikleśitaḥ devānām priyaḥ syāt iti

viruddha avyabhicārī api saṃśaya hetuḥ uktaḥ saḥ iha na uktaḥ anumāna viṣaye asambhavāt na hi sambhavaḥ asti kārya svabhāvayoḥ ukta lakṣaṇayoḥ anupalambhasya vā viruddha avyabhicāritāyām na ca anyaḥ avyabhicārī tasmāt avastu darśana bala pravṛttam āgama āśrayam anumānam āśritya tad artha vicāreṣu viruddha avyabhicārī sādhana doṣaḥ uktaḥ śāstra kārāṇām artheṣu bhrāntyā viparīta svabhāva upasaṃhāra sambhavāt na hi asti sambhavaḥ yathā avasthita vastu sthitiṣu ātma kārya anupalambheṣu tatra udāharaṇam sarva gatam sāmānyam sarva deśa avasthitaiḥ sva sambandhibhiḥ yugapad sambandhāt ākāśa vat iti

tad sambandhi svabhāva mātra anubandhinī tad deśa sannihita svabhāva tā na hi yaḥ yatra na asti sa tad deśam ātmanā vyāpnoti nanu na ākāśa deśe rūpa ādayaḥ tad deśān ca ghaṭa ādīn vyāpnuvanti āstām tāvat ayam pradeśa pradeśi bhāvaḥ yaḥ saṃyoga samavāyābhyām laukikam tu pradeśam āśritya brūmaḥ vicchinnā vicchinna avabhāsi vijñāna utpādana yogya tā lakṣaṇam yuta ayuta siddhayoḥ sambandhau saṃyoga samavāyau iti śāstre api vyavasthā tat iyam sva sattā mātra anubandhini tad deśa sannidhau sādhye tad sambandhitāḥ hetuḥ

nanu sva āśraya vyāpti vādinā api tad deśa sannidhiḥ iṣyate eva iti kim aniṣṭam akriyasya eka vyakti sambandhinaḥ deśa antare apūrva vyakti prādurbhāve prākta tra asataḥ tad sambandha ayogaḥ tasmāt bhinna deśaiḥ yugapad sambandhaḥ sarva vyāpini sidhyati tad eka sambandhinaḥ deśa antare agatvā tat deśaiḥ apūrvaiḥ abhisambandhaḥ ekasya tad antar āla vyāptinā antarīyakaḥ ātapa ādeḥ iva ghaṭa ādibhiḥ iti

dvitīyaḥ api prayogaḥ na sarva gatam sāmānyam upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya tad antarāleṣu anupalambhāt upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ abhivyaktiḥ abhedāt eka vyaktyā sarva vyakteḥ avyakta rūpa virahaḥ avyavadhāna m adūra sthānam dṛśya ātmatā indriyasya sva āśrayeṇa sambandhaḥ abhedāt eva āśraya asamaveta rūpa virahaḥ ca samāna deśa āśraya indriya yoga apekṣāyām āśraya samāna asamāna deśa rūpasya abheda virodhaḥ dṛśya adṛśya ātmata ādi virodhāḥ api vācyāḥ

tat ayam anupalambhaḥ svabhāvaḥ ca paraspara viruddha artha sādhanau ekatra saṃśayam janayataḥ śāstra kāraḥ viruddha dharmanā antarīyaka tām dvayoḥ apaśyan tayoḥ avirodha darśi tayā prāha iti sambhavaḥ viruddha avyabhicāriṇaḥ vastu anurodhini punar anumāne yathā virodhinoḥ ekatrāsambhavaḥ tathā tad abhivyāptayoḥ api iti na tau ekatra staḥ tat na atra viruddha avyabhicārī tat ayam abhyupagama bala pravṛttaḥ

ācāryeṇa punar diś mātra darśanāya idam udāharaṇam uktam anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt nityaḥ śrāvaṇa tvāt iti atra hi trayam apramāṇakam abhyupeyam vyatireki śabda tva sāmānyam indriya gamyam nityam ca atas asya pramāṇasya vṛttiḥ tat na etat vastu bala āyātam kṛtaka tvam pratibadhnāti kṛtaka tva prastāve ca anāgama āśrayāt na āgama upanyāsaḥ sādhyaḥ ca pratibandhaḥ yat śrāvaṇam tat nityam iti avyabhicāraḥ api na sidhyati iti

hetoḥ tri lakṣaṇa tvāt na dṛṣṭāntaḥ pṛthak ucyate tri lakṣaṇaḥ hetuḥ uktaḥ tāvatā ca artha pratītiḥ iti na pṛthak dṛṣṭāntaḥ nāma kaścid sādhana avayavaḥ tena na asya lakṣaṇam pṛthak ucyate gata artha tvāt hetoḥ sa pakṣaḥ eva sattvam vipakṣāt ca sarvatas vyāvṛttiḥ rūpam uktam abhedena punar viśeṣeṇa kārya svabhāvayoḥ janma tanmātra anubandhau darśanīyau uktau tat ca darśayatā yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ asati agnau na kvacid dhūmaḥ yathā mahānasa itarayoḥ yatra kṛtaka tvam tatra anitya tvam anitya tva abhāve kṛtaka tvasya asambhavaḥ yathā ghaṭa ākāśayoḥ iti darśanīyam na hi anyathā sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ sat asat tve yathā ukta prakāre śakye darśayitum tad kāryatā pratiniyamaḥ svabhāva vyāptiḥ vā asmin ca arthe darśite darśitaḥ eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ bhavati etāvat mātra rūpa tvāt tasya

etena eva dṛṣṭānta doṣāḥ api nirastāḥ bhavanti yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ amūrta tvāt karma vat paramāṇu vat ghaṭa vat iti sādhya ādi vikalāḥ sandigdhāḥ ca rāga ādimān vacanāt rathyā puruṣa vat iti ādayaḥ ananvayaḥ apradarśita anvayaḥ ca yathā yaḥ vaktā sa rāga ādima aniṣṭa puruṣa vat anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti tathā viparīta anvayaḥ yat anityam tat kṛtakam iti sādharmyeṇa

vaidharmyeṇa api paramāṇu vat karma vat ākāśa vat iti sādhyādi a vyatirekiṇaḥ tathā sandigdha vyatireka ādayaḥ vācyāḥ na hi ebhiḥ hetoḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇam viśeṣa lakṣaṇam vā śakyam darśayitum tad arthāpattyā eṣām nirāsaḥ veditavyaḥ yadi punar heturūpā saṃsparśī svatantraḥ eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhana avayavaḥ syāt tadā tad rūpā sparśane ca syāt asambandhāt apārthakaḥ

yadi na hetoḥ avyabhicāra dharma tā dṛṣṭāntena pradarśyeta kaḥ sādhya sādhane tasya upayogaḥ asambandhāt na hi kathañcid sādṛśya mātreṇa arthānām kenacid ātma antara pratiniyamaḥ yena upamānāt sādhanam syāt na hi arthasya kenacid kathañcin na sāmyam tatas tad ātma tāyām sarvam sarva ātmakam syāt na ca etat yuktam tasmāt tad abhivyāpta dharma yogāt eva bhāvāḥ tadvantaḥ syuḥ iti abhivyāptiḥ asya dṛṣṭāntena pradarśyate tat ayam na svatantraḥ tad asambandhī cāpa arthakaḥ tena eva artha parisamāpteḥ iti

dūṣaṇā nyūna tādi uktiḥ ye pūrvam nyūna tā ādayaḥ sādhana doṣāḥ uktāḥ teṣām udbhāvanam dūṣaṇam tena para iṣṭa artha siddhi pratibandhāt nanu anudbhāvite api doṣe arthasya eva asāmarthyāt na bhavati prasiddhiḥ evam etat kim tu na arthānām niṣpatti aniṣpattī sādhana dūṣaṇābhyām kriyete teṣām sarvadā tādavasthyāt kim tarhi puruṣa sāmarthya siddhiḥ sā vacanam antareṇa na sidhyati iti sa tathābhūtam eva khyāpayan tasya kartā iti ucyate yadi punar udbhāvite api doṣe sampūrṇa vacana ādinā pratisamādadhīta na tad iṣṭa pratibandhaḥ iti na dūṣaṇam syāt na tasya sādhana antara tvāt yadi pūrva pakṣa vādī sa ākāṅkṣaḥ syāt asamāpta vākyaḥ eva iti na dūṣaṇa avasaraḥ sthita vacane tu tasmin doṣam udbhāvayan dūṣakaḥ eva tasya sādhanasya tad ābhāsāḥ tu jātayaḥ mithyā uttarāṇām ānantyāt pratanyante na tāḥ iha

mithyā uttarāṇi jātayaḥ teṣām ca na antaḥ ayoniśaḥ vikalpānām apratiṣṭhānāt yathā āha paraḥ na asti ātmā iti pratijñāvirodhaḥ nāma pratijñā doṣaḥ artha apahnave śabda prayoga asambhavāt prayuñjānaḥ artham upasthāpayati apahnute ca iti pratijñā padayoḥ virodhāt pratijñā doṣaḥ iti yathā ca āha dharmi viśeṣaṇa tvena upādānāt anityaḥ prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt iti pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ iti na hi evamādīni yathā ukta lakṣaṇāsu jātiṣu antar bhavanti na ca dūṣaṇāni śabda arthān apahnavena sva lakṣaṇa pratiṣedhāt sādhya dharmi bahirbhāvāt ca iti uktam tāni api kenacid leśena asu eva antarbhavanti iti ced āsām api parasparam eṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti ekam eva kiñcid sāmānya lakṣaṇam vācyam syāt viśeṣe anantarbhāvāt tat ca sāmānya lakṣaṇam uktam eva dūṣaṇa ābhāsāḥ tu jātayaḥ iti tāḥ sādhana dūṣaṇa lakṣaṇa jñānāt eva aviṣaye apravṛtteḥ pratipatteḥ apratibandhāt pratibandha lakṣaṇa virahāt ca uttara ābhāsa tvena su jñānāḥ prabhedaḥ punar āsām ānantyāt aśakyanirdeśaḥ iti na nirdiśyate yuktaḥ ayam arthaḥ iti sūtram amoghanīteḥ draṣṭuḥ mayā āgamitam āgamam adhyupekṣya tasya api avaśyam avadāta dhiyaḥ ayam eva bhāvaḥ avibhāvita dhiyā viditaḥ janena

pāratantryam hi sambandhaḥ siddhe kā paratantra tā tasmāt sarvasya bhāvasya sambandhaḥ na asti tattvataḥ rūpa śleṣaḥ hi sambandhaḥ dvi tve sa ca katham bhavet tasmāt prakṛti bhinnānām sambandhaḥ na asti tattvataḥ para apekṣāḥ hi sambandhaḥ saḥ asan katham apekṣate san ca sarva nirāśaṃsaḥ bhāvaḥ katham apekṣate

dvayoḥ eka abhisambandhāt sambandhaḥ yadi tad dvayoḥ kaḥ sambandhaḥ anavasthā ca na sambandha matiḥ tathā tau ca bhāvau tad anyaḥ ca sarve te sva ātmani sthitāḥ iti amiśrāḥ svayam bhāvāḥ tān miśrayati kalpanā tām eva ca anurundhānaiḥ kriyā kāraka vācinaḥ bhāva bheda pratīti artham saṃyojyante abhidhāyakāḥ

kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ api tayoḥ asahabhāvataḥ prasiddhyati katham dviṣṭhaḥ adviṣṭhe sambandha tā katham krameṇa bhāvaḥ ekatra vartamāṇaḥ anya nispṛhaḥ tad abhāve api tad bhāvāt sambandhaḥ na eka vṛttimān yadi apekṣya tayoḥ ekam anyatra asau pravartate upakārī hi apekṣyaḥ syāt katham ca upakaroti asan

yadi eka artha abhisambandhāt kārya kāraṇa tā tayoḥ prāptāḥ dvi tva ādi sambandhāt savya itara viśāṇayoḥ dviṣṭhaḥ hi kaścid sambandhaḥ na atas anyat tasya lakṣaṇam bhāva abhāva upadhiḥ yogaḥ kārya kāraṇa tā yadi yoga upādhī na tau eva kārya kāraṇa tā atra kim bhedāt ced nanu ayam śabdaḥ niyoktāram samāśritaḥ paśyan ekam adṛṣṭasya darśane tad adarśane apaśyat kāryam anveti vinā vyākhyātṛbhiḥ janaḥ

darśana adarśane muktvā kārya buddheḥ asambhavāt kārya ādi śrutiḥ api atra lāghava artham niveśitā tad bhāva abhāvāt tad kārya gatiḥ yā api anuvarṇyate saṃketa viṣaya ākhyā sā sāsnādeḥ go gatiḥ yathā bhāve bhāvini tad bhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ eva ca bhāvitā prasiddhe hetu phalate pratyakṣa anupalambhataḥ etāvat mātra tattva arthāḥ kārya kāraṇa gocarāḥ vikalpāḥ darśayanti arthān mithyā arthāḥ ghaṭitān iva

bhinne kā ghaṭanā bhinne kārya kāraṇa tā api kā bhāve hi anyasya viśliṣṭau śliṣṭau syātām katham ca tau saṃyogi sama vāyi ādi sarvam etena cintitam anyonya anupakārāt ca na sambandhī ca tādṛśaḥ janane api hi kāryasya kenacid samavāyinā samavāyī tadā na asau na tatas ati prasaṅgataḥ tayoḥ anupakāre api samavāye paratra vā sambandhaḥ yadi viśvam syāt samavāyi parasparam

saṃyoga janane api iṣṭau tatas saṃyoginau na tau karma ādi yogita āpatteḥ sthiteḥ ca prativarṇitā saṃyoga ādi āśraye yogyam ayogyam tat ca jāyate nityam yogya svabhāvasya tad vaikalya virodhataḥ iti tad yogya tā vācyaḥ svabhāvaḥ asya nirucyatām vibhāga yoga gatibhiḥ kim anyaiḥ gamana ādibhiḥ teṣu satsu api tasya iti sambandhasya aprasiddhitaḥ yuktaḥ svabhāva bhedaḥ ayam tat pratikṣaṇa janmanām

buddhi pūrvām kriyām dṛṣṭvā sva dehe anyatra tad grahāt jñāyate yadi dhīḥ cittamātre api eṣa nayaḥ samaḥ ātmani citta spandana pūrvau kriyā abhilāpau dṛṣṭvā anyatra tayoḥ darśanāt yadi spandanam anumīyeta cittamātre api eṣa nayaḥ samaḥ atas cittamātra tā vādī api para cittam anumātum śaknoti tat ca kāya vāc vijñapti pratibhāsi jñānam jñāna antara spandana veśeṣeṇa vinā bhavati evam na matam

para pratyaya vyāpārān upalambhāt na para buddhi anumānam yuktam iti ced na tulya tvāt na hi pareṇa api para pratyaya pūrvakau tau kadācid api dṛṣṭau iti 〈tena api tat na pratīyate 〉 anya gatayoḥ ātma citta nimitta tva ayogāt para citta pratītiḥ bhavati iti ced katham sva samutthāpaka cittasya pratisaṃvedana abhāvāt

ātma citta āśrayasya ca ātmani darśanāt tayoḥ api tathā abhāve tadvat upalambhaḥ syāt anyathā ca dṛṣṭau iti hetoḥ anya siddhiḥ iti ced parasya api sva samutthāpaka cittasya pratisaṃvedana abhāvāt samānam sva citta spandana nimittake vijñapti pratibhāsinī jñāne ca antarmukha pratibhāsinī pratīteḥ bahirmukha pratibhāsinī anya nimittat utpadyete

animitte eva bahirmukha pratibhāsinī iti kid na iṣyate ced animitta tve sarvasya animitta tvam prasajyeta vicchinna avicchinna pratibhāsa kṛtaḥ bhedaḥ na jñānayoḥ spandana tva nimitta bheda vibhāga kṛt tena avicchinna pratibhāsinoḥ api animitta tvam bhavet viśeṣa abhāvāt tathā sati avicchinna tva viśiṣṭaḥ pratibhāsa bhedaḥ eva spandana pūrvakaḥ na bhavati kin tarhi vicchinnasya api kriyā viśeṣasya pratibhāsaḥ eva śara upala prakṣepaṇa yantra nirmāṇa para pracālana ādi kriyā viśeṣa pratibhāsinām vicchinnasya api pratibhāsasya spandana pūrvaka tvāt para kṛta cālana ādinām ca avicchinnasya api atat pūrvaka tvāt

tena hi atra kriyā viśeṣa mātreṇa spandanasya pratītiḥ itī yujyate tatra yadi kasyacid pūrvaka tvam na kaḥ api tad pūrvakaḥ syāt viśeṣa abhāvāt atas kriyā viśeṣa sāmānyam spandana viśeṣa sāmānyasya gamakam tatra yathā kriyām upalabhya ātmani spandana anupalambhāt anyatra spandana pratītiḥ tathā kriyā pratibhāsa upalambhane api

paraḥ api paratra vyāpāra vya āhārau nimittam antareṇa bhavataḥ iti kim na icchati tat samānam tena avaśyam vyāpāra vyāhārayoḥ īha animitta tvāt na tad abhāve saṃbhavaḥ iti vaktavyam tathā paraḥ api tad pratibhāsinoḥ brūyāt iti na tau parasparam atiśayāte tad pratibhāsinoḥ īha animittam bruvāṇaḥ svapne api kim na bravīti iti ced

sarvam samānam svapna upalabdhayoḥ para kriyā vacanayoḥ kim na pareha ahetu tām paraḥ api ācaṣṭe tayoḥ abhāvāt iti ced tathā upalambhe samāne katham abhāvaḥ puruṣasya middha abhibhavāt artha śūnya vijñānasya vṛtteḥ iti ced parasya api tasmāt eva anya ādhipatya śūnyasya vijñānasya vṛttiḥ bhaviṣyati

bhavatu svapne api arthavat vijñānam sattva antaram ca tadā upalabdham iti ced yadi para spardhayā apeta yuktyāgamam evam asat vādam āśrayet paraḥ api tad anya ādhipatyam icchan kena nivāryeta asya eva sarvasya jñānasya asti eva para santāna ādhipatyam bhedaḥ tu sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa ca kadācid svapne api sākṣāt api bhāvasya para santāna ādhipatyam iṣṭam eva devatā ādi adhiṣṭhānāt sat svapna darśanam

tasmāt asya na etat asat vāda samāśrayaḥ tāvat tayā kriyayā api tat cittam katham jñāyate cittasya kāryatvāt tasya kārya tvam tu citta antare api tulyam iti kathat na jñāyate api ca yadi tad kriyā sva sattā mātreṇa sva santānam pratyāyet tadā anupalabhyamānena api syāt tathā pratipattiḥ na jñāna apekṣa tvāt liṅgasya iti ced tadā tatra kim anayā paramparayā para cittāt kriyā kriyā ataḥ jñānam jñānāt tasya pratipattiḥ iti

para citta prabhava dharmi kriyā pratibhāsi jñānam eva asya gamakam bhavati tasya adhigatiḥ tu antaśas tad āśrita tvāt spandana mātra sāmānyam kriyā abhilāpa jñāna sāmānyasya kāraṇa tvāt kāryeṇa kāraṇasya gatiḥ tatra ātma spandana nimittakasya antar mukha vṛttiḥ anyasya anyathā prāyeṇa adhikṛtya asau bhedaḥ etayoḥ saḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ svāpa ādi avasthāyām itarasyām api ca samānaḥ bhrānti avasthāyām yathāsvam pratyaya viśeṣa upāśrayāt para spandana dinimitta udbhūta vijñāna vāsanā eva kadācid parābhoga ādeḥ vyavahitāt api vṛttim labhate : na tu atyanta asat ābhogāt tasmāt sarva avasthāsu kriyā ādi vijñapteḥ citta spandanam anumīyate eva

kriyātaḥ spandana pratipattau svāpaḥ itarasmin ca syāt pratipattiḥ atha vā na eva kadācana para spandana bhāve api kriyā ālambana udayāt bhavatu ālambana udayaḥ na tu kriyā kriyayā spandanam gamyate bhrānti avasthānām kriyā eva na bhavati artha śūnya jñāna udayāt na doṣaḥ sarva prakāra vyapadeśa sāmyāt kadācid jñānam artha śūnyam anyadā anyathā iti eṣaḥ adhikāraḥ kutas labdhaḥ atha middha ādinā avasthāni atha abhāvaḥ ced yadi evam sambhavet bhavatu avidyā upapluta tvāt tathā udayaḥ tathā sati artha antara vāda hānyāḥ ete aneka aśakya nigūhana doṣa prasaṅgāḥ mahā kṛcchrāḥ uttareṇa ekena nihatāḥ bhavanti

nanu tayoḥ darśanāt kāya vāc vijñaptibhyām svam utthāpaka cittasya anumānam iti nyāyyam na tu santāna antara sambaddha vijñapti pratibhāsi jñāne para vijñaptī bhavitum arhataḥ tayoḥ anupādāna upādeya tvāt iti ced na ucyate para citta samutthita vijñapti rūpa tvāt tatra pratibhāsi jñānena samutthāpaka cittam gamyate iti kim tarhi tasya kāryatvāt vijñaptiḥ iti samutthāpaka citta santānāt jāte kriyā vāc ākārake jñāne eva samutthāpaka cittam ca tayoḥ eva upādāna kāraṇam santāna antara jñānayoḥ tu adhipati pratyayaḥ vijñapteḥ upādānāt te janite tad sambandhena upacārāt vijñaptī bhavataḥ

ātma parayoḥ sva sva pratibhāsā anubhavaḥ taimirika dvaya dvi candra darśana vat tathāvidha vijñānasya hetoḥ vāsanāyāḥ utpatteḥ svabhāva viśeṣasya anādi kālāt eka artha grahaṇena vyavasāyāt eka kāraṇa ja tvena sva para vijñapti pratyayayoḥ vijñapti tvena upacāraḥ atha kriyā ādi pratibhāsi vijñānāt kārya liṅgāt jātayoḥ para citta pratyayoḥ para cittam viṣayīkaraṇam āhosvit na viṣayīkaraṇe artha antaram syāt aviṣaya tve tu katham jñānena para citta sattā pratīyate tad svarūpa ajñāne tad siddhaiḥ asambhavāt iti ced eṣa prasaṅgaḥ api samaḥ kriyā vāgbhyām para cittam pratipattimatām api tad svarūpa viṣayīkaraṇe sva citta jñāna vat tad ākārasya api jñānam prasajyeta tad ajñāne tu tena tad svarūpasya grahaṇam katham

atha liṅgāt sāmāni adhigateḥ na ākārasya pratītiḥ iti ced kiñ ca tad sāmānyam para cittam eva anyat vā āhosvid avācyam anyatva avācya tvayoḥ ekatve tu anena tad sāmānyam eva gṛhyeta na para cittam tat katham anena tat gamyate na api sāmānyam para cittam eva tathā sati tad ākārasya api jñānam prasahyeta iti uktam

na hi eṣā anumāna prakriyā na hi anumānam artha svarūpasya grāhakam pratyakṣa vat pratibhāsā viśiṣṭa tva ādeḥ prasaṅgāt tena na asya prāmāṇyam tad svarūpa āgrahe api abhipreta artha avisaṃvādāt prāmāṇyam dhūma ādi liṅgāt jātam api na vahni ādi svarūpa viṣayi dṛṣṭena aviśeṣa prasaṅgāt anumānasya atīta ādau niḥsvabhāva tāyāḥ ca apravṛtteḥ artha kriyā prasaṅgāt ca

para citta anumāne api abhipreta artha avisaṃvādaḥ asti eva tad pravartana dvāreṇa prāṇi antara sat tām pratipadya punar punar vyavahāra pravṛttau tadā adhipati ādāga arthasya prāpteḥ tanmātra phala cintakasya lokasya prāṇi antara anumāne pravṛtteḥ ca uttara artha viśeṣa pratibhāsi jñāna anubhava udaya mātreṇa puruṣasya nirākāṅkṣa tvāt pūrva jñānena vyavahāra samāpteḥ kṛtārthata tvam pramāṇa tvena siddha tvāt

nanu svapne api pūrva jñānāt uttara artha pratibhāsi jñānam utpadyate na tanmātreṇa pūrva jñānasya prāmāṇyam yujyate tadānīm sarveṣām jñānānām bhrānta tvāt tatra vijñapti jñānam na kadācid citta spandana ādhipatyena vinā udbhavati iti atas tābhyām ye anumīyate bhrānti vaśāt kadācid vyavahite api udeti na tu tad ādhipatya rahita tvam viśeṣaḥ tu asti sākṣāt paramparayā ca iti uktam tatra yathā pūrva vijñapti jñānānām paramparayā spandana ādhipatyāt udayaḥ tathā tad uttara avasthā bhāvinām api vijñapti jñāna āśraya spandana uttara avasthā citta santānāt eva paramparayā utpādaḥ tatra api yādṛś anumānam tādṛś avisaṃvādaḥ vyavahāraḥ ca api asti eva iti kena api na gṛhyate

para citta anumānena tad svarūpa āgrahe api avisaṃvādāt bhavatu tathā prāmāṇyam sākṣāt para citta vidām tu katham yadi te para cittasya svarūpam sākṣāt jānanti tadā tasya artha antara grahaṇam syāt atha na jānanti katham te sākṣāt vidaḥ katham nāma pratyakṣeṇa artha svarūpasya agrahaṇam ca bhavati atha na gṛhyate katham tarhi pramāṇam iti ced aprahīṇa grāhya grāhaka vikalpa yoginām para citta jñānam api vyavahāre avisaṃvādāt eva pramāṇam rūpa ādi darśana vat āśraya aparāvṛteḥ yoga balāt dhi teṣām jñānam para citta ākāra viśeṣa anukāri sphuṭa ābham upajāyate karma deva ādi adhiṣṭhāna balāt satya svapna darśana vat teṣām api na para citta viṣayi tvena jñānam udeti te api tad ākāra sadṛśa sva citta pratibhāsam eva jānanti iti evam avadhāraṇāt para citta vidaḥ iti vyavahāraḥ tad ākāra anukāri sṛṣṭa ābha tvāt tad pratyakṣam avisaṃvādi tvāt ca pramāṇam iti matam acintyaḥ hi bhagavataḥ sarva artha adhigamaḥ sarvathā jñāna bhidhāna viṣaya atīta tvāt
nyāya vādinam api vādeṣu asat vyavasthā upanyāsaiḥ śaṭhāḥ nigṛhṇanti tad niṣedha artham idam ārabhyate asādhana aṅga vacanam adoṣa udbhāvanam dvayoḥ nigraha sthānam anyat tu na yuktam iti na iṣyate

iṣṭasya arthasya siddhiḥ sādhanam tasya nirvartakam aṅgam tasya avacanam tasya aṅgasya anuccāraṇam vādinaḥ nigraha adhikaraṇam tat abhyupagamya apratibhayā tūṣṇīṃbhāvāt sādhana aṅgasya asamarthanāt vā trividham eva hi liṅgam apratyakṣasya siddheḥ aṅgam svabhāvaḥ kāryam anupalabdhaḥ ca tasya samarthanam sādhyena vyāptim prasādhya dharmiṇi bhāva sādhanam yathā yat sat kṛtakam vā tat sarvam anityam yathā ghaṭa ādiḥ san kṛtakaḥ vā śabdaḥ iti atra api na kaścid krama niyamaḥ iṣṭa artha siddheḥ ubhayatra aviśeṣāt dharmiṇi prāk sattvam prasādhya paścāt api vyāptiḥ prasādhyate eva yathā san śabdaḥ kṛtakaḥ vā yaḥ ca evam sa sarvaḥ anityaḥ yathā ghaṭa ādiḥ iti

atra vyāpti sādhanam viparyaye bādhaka pramāṇa upadarśanam yadi na sarvam sat kṛtakam vā pratikṣaṇa vināśi syāt akṣaṇikasya krama yaugapadyābhyām artha kriyā yogāt artha kriyā sāmarthya lakṣaṇataḥ nivṛttam iti asat eva syāt sarva sāmarthya upākhyā viraha lakṣaṇam hi nirupākhyam iti evam sādhanasya sādhya viparyaye bādhaka pramāṇa anupadarśane virodha abhāvāt asya viparyaye vṛtteḥ adarśane api san kṛtakaḥ vā syāt nityaḥ ca iti anivṛttiḥ eva śaṅkāyāḥ tatas vyatirekasya sandehāt anaikāntikaḥ syāt dhetu ābhāsaḥ na api adarśana mātrāt vyāvṛttiḥ viprakṛṣṭeṣu asarva darśinaḥ adarśanasya abhāva asādhanāt arvāk darśanena satām api keṣāṃcid arthānām adarśanāt

bādhakam punar pramāṇam yatra krama yaugapadyā yogaḥ na tasya kvacid sāmarthyam asti ca akṣaṇike saḥ iti pravartamānam asāmarthyam asat lakṣaṇam ākarṣati tena yat sat kṛtakam vā tat anityam eva iti sidhyati tāvatā ca sādhana dharma mātra anvayaḥ sādhya dharmasya svabhāva hetu lakṣaṇam ca siddham bhavati

atra api adarśanam apramāṇayataḥ krama yaugapadyā yogasya eva asāmarthyena vyāpti asiddheḥ pūrvakasya api hetoḥ avyāptiḥ iha api punar sādhana upakrame anavasthā prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na abhāva sādhanasya adarśanasya apratiṣedhāt yat adarśanam viparyayam sādhayati hetoḥ sādhya viparyaye tat asya viruddha pratyupasthāpanāt bādhakam pramāṇam ucyate evam hi sa hetuḥ sādhya abhāve asan sidhyet yadi tatra pramāṇavatā sva viruddhena bādhyeta anyathā tatra asya bādhakā siddhau saṃśayaḥ durnivāraḥ na ca sarva anupalabdhiḥ bhāvasya bādhikā tatra sāmarthyam krama akrama yogena vyāptam siddham prakāra antara abhāvāt tena vyāpaka dharma anupalabdhiḥ akṣaṇike sāmarthyam bādhate iti krama yaugapadyā yogasya sāmarthya abhāvena vyāpti siddheḥ na anavasthā prasaṅgaḥ evam svabhāva hetu prayogeṣu samarthitam sādhana aṅgam bhavati tasya asamarthanam sādhana aṅgāvacanam tad vādinaḥ parājaya sthānam ārabdha artha aprasādhanāt vastutas samarthasya hetoḥ upādāne api sāmarthya apratipādanāt

kārya hetau api sādhana aṅgasya samarthanam yat kārya liṅgam kāraṇasya sādhanāya upādīyate tasya tena saha kārya kāraṇa bhāva prasādhanam bhāva abhāva sādhana pramāṇābhyām yathā idam asmin sati bhavati satsu api tad anyeṣu samartheṣu tad hetuṣu tad abhāve na bhavati iti evam hi asya asandigdham tat kārya tvam samarthitam bhavati anyathā kevalam tad abhāve na bhavati iti upadarśane anyasya api tatra abhāve sandigdham asya sāmarthyam anyat tatra samartham tad abhāvāt tat na bhūtam etad nivṛttau punar nivṛttiḥ yadṛcchā saṃvādaḥ mātṛ vivāha ucita deśa janmaḥ piṇḍa kharjūrasya deśa antareṣu mātṛ vivāha abhāve abhāva vat

evam samarthitam tat tasya kāryam sidhyati siddham sat sva sambhavena tad sambhavam sādhayati kāryasya kāraṇa avyabhicārāt avyabhicāre ca sva kāraṇaiḥ sarva kāryāṇām sadṛśaḥ nyāyaḥ evam asamarthanam kārya hetau api sādhana aṅgāvacanam tad vādinaḥ parājaya sthānam asamarthite tasmin kāryatva asiddheḥ artha antarasya tad bhāva apratibaddha svabhāvasya bhāve tad bhāva niyama abhāvāt ārabdha artha asiddheḥ vastutas kāryasya api upādāne tad apratipādanāt

anupalabdhau api pratipattuḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdhi sādhanam samarthanam tādṛśyāḥ eva anupalabdheḥ asat vyavahāra siddheḥ anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya pratipattṛ pratyakṣa upalabdhi nivṛttau api abhāva asiddheḥ tatra upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ svabhāva viśeṣaḥ kāraṇa antara sākalyam ca svabhāva viśeṣaḥ yat na trividhena viprakarṣeṇa viprakṛṣṭam yat anātma rūpa pratibhāsa vivekena pratipattṛ pratyakṣa pratibhāsa rūpam tādṛśaḥ satsu anyeṣu upalambha pratyayeṣu tathā anupalabdhaḥ asat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ tatas anyathā sati liṅge saṃśayaḥ

atra api sarvam evaṃvidham asat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ iti vyāptiḥ kasyacid asataḥ abhyupagame tad lakṣaṇa aviśeṣāt na hi evaṃvidhasya asattvān abhyupagame anyatra tasya yogaḥ na hi evaṃvidhasya sataḥ satsu anyeṣu upalambha kāraṇeṣu anupalabdhiḥ anupalabhyamāṇam tu īdṛśam na asti iti etāvat mātra nimittaḥ ayam asat vyavahāraḥ anyasya tad nimittasya abhāvāt sarva sāmarthya vivekaḥ nimittam iti ced evam etat tasya eva sarva sāmarthya vivekinaḥ evam pratītiḥ anyasya tad pratipatti upāya abhāvāt tad pratipattau ca satyām asat vyavahāraḥ iti idam tad nimittam ucyate

buddhi vyapadeśa artha kriyābhyaḥ sat vyavahāraḥ viparyaye ca asat vyavahāraḥ iti ced bhavati buddheḥ yathā ukta pratibhāsāyāḥ sat vyavahāraḥ viparyaye asat vyavahāraḥ pratyakṣa aviṣaye tu syāt liṅga jāyāḥ api kutaścid sat vyavahāraḥ asat vyavahāraḥ tu tad viparyaye anaikāntikaḥ viprakṛṣṭe arthe pratipattṛ pratyakṣasya anyasya vā pramāṇasya nivṛttau api saṃśayāt

na ca sarve buddhi vyapadeśāḥ tad bheda abhedau vā vastu sattām vastu bheda abheda sattām vā sādhayanti asatsu api kathaṃcid atīta anāgata ādiṣu nānā eka artha kriyā kāriṣu vā artheṣu tad bhāva sthāpanāya nānā eka ātma abhāve api nānā eka rūpāṇām vṛtteḥ rājā mahā sammataḥ prabhavaḥ rāja vaṃśasya śaṅkhaḥ cakravartī mahā sammata nirmitasya yūpasya utthāpayitā śaśa viṣāṇam rūpam sa nidarśanam sa pratigham ghaṭaḥ ca iti na hi sa nidarśana ādi śabdāḥ nānā vastu viṣayāḥ ekatra upasaṃhārāt

nānā viṣaya tve api ekatra upasaṃhāraḥ tad nimittānān tatra samavāyāt iti ced āyāse vatā ayam tapasvī padārthaḥ patitaḥ aneka sambandhinam upakṛtya anekam śabdam ātmani tebhyaḥ samāśaṃsan sa yaiḥ śakti bhedaiḥ anekam sambandhinam upakaroti taiḥ eva anekam śabdam kim na utthāpayati evam hi anena paraṃpara anusāra pariśramaḥ parihṛtaḥ bhavati nānā śabda utthāpana asāmarthye nānā sambandhi upakāraḥ api mā bhūt anupakāre hi teṣām tad sambandhitā api na sidhyati

ghaṭaḥ iti api ca rūpa ādayaḥ eva bahavaḥ eka artha kriyā kāriṇaḥ eka śabda vācyāḥ bhavantu kim artha antara kalpanayā bahavaḥ api hi eka artha kāriṇaḥ bhaveyuḥ cakṣuḥ ādi vat tad sāmarthya sthāpanāya tatra eka śabda niyogaḥ api syāt iti yuktam paśyāmaḥ na ca niḥprayojanā lokasya artheṣu śabda yojanā tatra ye arthāḥ saha pṛthak vā eka prayojanāḥ teṣām tad bhāva sthāpanāya hi eka śabdaḥ niyujyate yadi kim syāt tad artha kriyā śakti sthāpanāya niyuktasya samudāya śabdasya eka vacana virodhaḥ api na asti eva sahitānām sā śaktiḥ ekā na pratyekam iti samudāya śabdaḥ ekasmin samudāye vācye eka vacanam ghaṭaḥ iti jāti śabdeṣu arthānām pratyekam sahitānām ca śakteḥ na anā ekā ca śaktiḥ iti nānā eka śakti vivakṣāyām bahuvacanam eka vacanam ca icchātaḥ vṛkṣāḥ vṛkṣaḥ iti syāt yadi eṣa niyamaḥ bahuṣu eva bahuvacanam ekasmin eka vacanam iti asmākan tu sāṃketikeṣu artheṣu saṃketa vaśāt vṛttiḥ iti anabhiniveśaḥ eva

na anekaḥ rūpa ādiḥ eka śabda utthāpane śaktaḥ iti ced kim vai puruṣa vṛtteḥ anapekṣāḥ śabdān arthāḥ svayam utthāpayanti āhosvit puruṣaiḥ śabdāḥ vyavahāra artham artheṣu niyujyante svayam utthāpane hi bhāva śaktiḥ aśaktiḥ vā cintyeta na ca tat yuktam puruṣaiḥ teṣām niyoge yatheṣṭam niyuñjīran iti kaḥ tatra upālambhaḥ nimittam ca niyogasya uktam eva api ca yadi na rūpa ādīnām ekena śabdena sambandhaḥ katham ekena eṣām āśraya abhimatena dravyeṇa sambandhaḥ iti kevalam ayam asat bhūta abhiniveśaḥ eva

na vayam eka sambandha virodhāt ekam śabdam na icchāmaḥ api tu abhinnānām rūpa ādīnām ghaṭa kambala ādiṣu nānā artha kriya śabda virodhāt te eka rūpāḥ samudāya antara asambhāvinīm artha kriyām eva na kuryuḥ tena tad prakāśanāya ekena api śabdena na ucyeran bhavatu nāma kasyacid ayam vāñchā bhaveyuḥ eka rūpāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ sarva samudāyeṣu iti kim idam paraspara vivikta rūpa pratibhāsā adhyakṣa darśanam enām upekṣate aniṣṭam ca idam rūpa ādīnām pratisamudāyam svabhāva bheda upagamāt

yadi anyaḥ eva rūpa ādibhyaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti ekaḥ syāt kim syāt astu pratyakṣasya sataḥ arūpa ādi rūpasya tad vivekena buddhau svarūpeṇa pratibhāsena kim āvaraṇam pratibhāsamānāḥ ca vivekena pratyakṣāḥ arthāḥ dṛśyante apṛthak deśa tve api gandharasa ādayaḥ vāta ātapa sparśa ādayaḥ ca eka indriya grāhya tve api idam eva ca pratyakṣasya pratyakṣa tvam yat anātma rūpa vivekena svarūpasya buddhau samarpaṇam ayam punar ghaṭaḥ amūlya dāna krayī yaḥ svarūpam ca na upadarśayati pratyakṣatām ca svīkartum icchati etena buddhi śabda ādayaḥ api vyākhyātā yadi taiḥ tad sādhanam iṣyeta na ca pratyakṣasya anabhibhave rūpa anupalakṣaṇam yena tad sādhanāya liṅgam ucyate apratyakṣa tve api apramāṇasya satta upagamaḥ na yuktaḥ tat na rūpa ādibhyaḥ anyaḥ ghaṭaḥ evam tāvat na buddhi vyapadeśābhyām sattā vyavahāraḥ sattā bheda abheda vyavahāraḥ vā atas eva na tad viparyayāt viparyayaḥ

artha kriyātaḥ tu sattā vyavahāraḥ syāt na sattā bheda abheda vyavahāraḥ ekasya api aneka artha kriyā darśanāt yathā pradīpasya vijñāna varti vikāra jvālā antara utpādanāni anekasya api cakṣuḥ ādeḥ eka vijñāna kriyā darśanāt na brūmaḥ artha kriyā bheda mātreṇa sattā bhedaḥ iti kim tarhi adṛṣṭa artha kriyā bhedena yā artha kriyā yasmin adṛṣṭā punar dṛśyate sā sattā bhedam sādhayati yathā mṛdi adṛṣṭā sati udaka dhāraṇa ādi artha kriyā ghaṭe dṛśyamānā adṛṣṭā api tantuṣu prāvaraṇa ādi artha kriyā paṭe dṛśyate iti sattā bhedaḥ

sidhyati evam artha antaram tathā api avayavī na sidhyati yathāpratyayam saṃskāra santatau svabhāva bheda utpatteḥ artha kriyā bhedaḥ araṇi nirmathana avasthā bhedāt iva agneḥ sthūla karīṣa tṛṇa kāṣṭha dahana śakti bhedaḥ tathā yathāpratyayam svabhāva bheda utpatteḥ tantu ādiṣu artha kriyā bhedaḥ etena buddhi vyapadeśa bheda abhedau vyākhyātau

tatra yat uktam artha kriyātaḥ sattā vyavahāra siddhiḥ viparyayāt viparyayaḥ iti satyam etat saḥ eva tu viparyayaḥ anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpteṣu na sidhyati tatra punar idam anicchataḥ api āyātam yasya idam sāmarthyam upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam san na upalabhyate saḥ asat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ sāmarthya lakṣaṇa tvāt sattvasya iti tathā api kaḥ atiśayaḥ pūrvakāt asya na hi svabhāvāt artha antaram sāmarthyam tasya upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya yaḥ anupalambhaḥ sa svabhāvasya eva iti pūrvakā eva iyam anupalabdhiḥ tasmāt anena kvacid keṣāṃcid asat vyavahāram abhyupagacchatā atas anupalambhāt abhyupagantavyaḥ na vā kvacid viśeṣa abhāvāt saḥ anyatra api tathāvidhe aviśiṣṭaḥ iti saḥ api tathā astu iti vyāptiḥ : sarve evaṃvidhaḥ anupalabdhaḥ asat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ iti

na eva kaścid kvacid kathaṃcid anupalabdhaḥ api asat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ iti ced sarvasya sarva rūpāṇām sarvadā anivṛtteḥ sarvam sarvatra sarvadā samupayujyeta idam ca na syāt : idam atas na atas idam iha idam iha na idam idānīm idam idānīm na idam idam evam idam na evam iti kasyacid api rūpasya kathaṃcid kvacid kadācid viveka hetoḥ abhāvāt ananvaya vyatirekam viśvam syāt bheda abhāvāt

avasthānivṛtti pravṛtti bhedebhyaḥ vyavasthā iti ced nanu te eva sarva viṣayasya asat vyavahārasya abhāvāt na sambhavanti yatas tebhyaḥ vyavasthā syāt kvacid viṣaye asat vyavahāra upagame sa kutas iti vaktavyam na hi anupalambhāt anyaḥ vyavaccheda hetuḥ asti vidhi pratiṣedhābhyām vyavacchede sarvadā anupalambhasya eva sādhana tvāt anupalambhāt eva tad abhyupagame sa yatra eva asti sarvaḥ asat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ iti vaktavyam viśeṣa abhāvāt

sarva pramāṇa nivṛttiḥ anupalabdhiḥ sā yatra saḥ asat viṣayaḥ iṣṭaḥ iti ced sukumāra prajñaḥ devānāṃpriyaḥ na sahate pramāṇa cintā vyavahāra parikleśam yena na atra ādaram kṛtavān na hi anumāna ādi nivṛttiḥ abhāvam gamayati vyabhicārāt na sarva pratyakṣa nivṛttiḥ asiddheḥ na ātma pratyakṣā viśeṣa nivṛttiḥ api viprakṛṣṭeṣu tasmāt svabhāva viśeṣaḥ yatas pramāṇān niyamena sat vyavahāram pratipadyate tad nivṛttiḥ tasya asat vyavahāram sādhayati tad svabhāva sattāyāḥ tad pramāṇa sattayā vyāpteḥ na ca upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya arthasya pratyakṣāt anya upalabdhiḥ yena anumānāt asya upalabdhiḥ syāt na ca tad rūpāni atha abhāvam antareṇa apratyakṣatāni atha abhāve ca tat eva na syāt

api ca kutas idam amantra auṣadham indrajālam bhāvena śikṣitam yat ayam ajātān aṣṭa rūpa atiśayaḥ avyavadhānādūra sthānaḥ tasya eva tad avastha indriya ādeḥ eva puruṣasya kadācid pratyakṣaḥ apratyakṣaḥ ca yena kadācid asya anumānam upalabdhiḥ kadācid pratyakṣam kadācid āgamaḥ etasmin eva anatiśaye amīṣām prakārāṇām virodhāt na anatiśayaḥ eka atiśaya nivṛttyā apara atiśaya utpattyā ca vyavahāra bheda upagamāt saḥ atiśayaḥ tasya ātma bhūtaḥ ananvayaḥ nivartamānaḥ pravartamānaḥ ca katham na svabhāva nānātvam ākarṣayati sukha duḥkha vat sa anvaya tve ca kā kasya pravṛttiḥ nivṛttiḥ vā iti yat kiṃcid etat

athavā yadi kasyacid svabhāvasya pravṛtti nivṛttī svayam abhyanujñāyete tat eva paraḥ bruvāṇaḥ kim iti na anumanyate tasya niranvaya upajanana vināśa upagamāt iti ced kaḥ ayam anvayaḥ nāma bhāvasya janma vināśayoḥ śaktiḥ sā asti eva prāk api janmanaḥ nirodhāt api ūrdhvam tena ayam na apūrvaḥ sarvathā jāyate na pūrvaḥ vināśyati iti yadi sā sarva dā anatiśayā kim idānīm atiśaya vat yat kṛtaḥ ayam vyavahāra vibhāgaḥ tāḥ avasthā atiśayavatyaḥ iti ced tāḥ avasthāḥ sā ca śaktiḥ kim ekaḥ bhāvaḥ āhosvit nānā ekaḥ ced katham idānīm idam ekatra avibhakta ātmani niṣparyāyam paraspara vyāhatam yokṣyate : janma ajanma nivṛttiḥ anivṛttiḥ ekatvam nānātvam pratyakṣatā pratyakṣata artha kriyā upayogaḥ anupayogaḥ ca ityādi

asti paryāyaḥ avasthā śaktiḥ iti tena avirodhaḥ iti ced vismaraṇa śīlaḥ devānāṃpriyaḥ prakaraṇam na lakṣayati śaktiḥ avasthā iti ekaḥ bhāvaḥ avibhāgaḥ iti pakṣe ayam virodhaḥ uktaḥ atha asti anayoḥ vibhāgaḥ na kaścid virodhaḥ kevalam sa anvayau bhāvasya janma vināśau iti na syāt yasmāt yasya anvayaḥ na tasya janma vināśau yasya ca tau na tasya anvayaḥ

tayoḥ abhedāt adoṣaḥ iti ced anuttaram bata doṣa saṅkaṭam atrabhavān dṛṣṭi rāgeṇa praveśyamānaḥ api na ātmānam cetayati abhedaḥ hi nāma aikyam tau iti ca bheda adhiṣṭhānaḥ bhāvikaḥ vyavahāraḥ nivṛtti prādurbhāvayoḥ anivṛtti prādurbhāvau sthitau asthitiḥ iti ādikam nānātva lakṣaṇam ca katham yojyate eṣa hi bhāvānām bhedaḥ etat virahaḥ ca abhedaḥ yathā sukha ādiṣu śakti avasthayoḥ ca eka ātmani anyathā bheda abheda lakṣaṇa abhāvāt bheda abhedayoḥ avyavasthā syāt sarvatra

tad ātmani prādurbhāvaḥ abhedaḥ viparyaye bhedaḥ yathā mṛdā ātmani prādurbhavataḥ ghaṭasya tasmāt abhedaḥ bhedaḥ ca viparyaye sukha duḥkhayoḥ iti idam bheda abheda lakṣaṇam tena avirodhaḥ iti ced na vai mṛdā ātmani ghaṭasya prādurbhāvaḥ kim tarhi mṛd ātmā eva kaścid ghaṭaḥ na hi ekaḥ trailokye mṛd ātmā prativijñapti pratibhāsa bhedāt dravya svabhāva bhedāt evam hi asya api sukha ādiṣu caitanyeṣu ca bheda avagamaḥ samarthaḥ bhavati yadi evam bhedaḥ syāt

sati api etasmin kasyacid ātmanaḥ anvayāt aikyam iti ced sukha ādiṣu api ayam prasaṅgaḥ caitanyeṣu ca na ca ghaṭa ādiṣu api sarva ātmanā anvayaḥ avaiśva rūpya saha utpatti ādi prasaṅgāt na ca ghaṭam mṛdā ātmānam ca kaścid vivekena upalakṣayati yena evam syāt idam iha prādurbhūtam iti na hi adhiṣṭhāna adhiṣṭhā ninoḥ vivekena anupalakṣaṇe evam bhavati na ca śakteḥ śakti ātmani prādurbhāvaḥ iti tasyāḥ sva ātmanaḥ abhedaḥ na syāt

etena pariṇāmaḥ pratyuktaḥ yaḥ api hi kalpayet yaḥ yasya pariṇāmaḥ sa tasmāt abhinnaḥ iti na hi śakteḥ ātma apariṇāmaḥ iti kim ca idam uktam bhavati pariṇāmaḥ iti avasthitasya dravyasya dharma antara nivṛttiḥ dharma antara prādurbhāvaḥ ca pariṇāmaḥ yat tat dharma antaram nivartate prādurbhavati ca kim tat tat eva avasthitam dravyam syāt tatas artha antaram vā anya vikalpa abhāvāt

yadi tat tat eva tasya avasthānām na nivṛtti prādurbhāvau iti kasya tau iti vaktavyam avasthitasya dharma antaram iti ca na sidhyati na hi tat eva tasya anapāśrita vyapekṣā bhedam dharma antaram bhavati atha dravyāt artha antaram dharmaḥ tadā tasya nivṛtti prādurbhāvābhyām na dravyasya pariṇatiḥ na hi artha antara gatābhyām nivṛtti prādurbhāvābhyām artha antarasya pariṇatiḥ caitanye api prasaṅgāt

dravyasya dharmaḥ iti ca vyapadeśaḥ na sidhyati sambandha abhāvāt na hi kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt anyaḥ vastu sambandhaḥ asti na ca anayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ svayam atada ātmanaḥ atad kāraṇa tvāt dharmasya dravyāt artha antara bhūta tvāt artha antara tve api dharma kāraṇa tve dharma antarasya kāryasya utpādanāt dravyasya pariṇāmaḥ iti iṣṭam syāt tat aviruddham anyasya api hetu phala santāne mṛd dravya ākhye pūrvakāt mṛd piṇḍa dravyāt kāraṇāt uttarasya ghaṭa dravyasya kāryasya utpattau mṛd dravyam pariṇatam iti vyavahārasya upagamāt na ca dharmasya dravyāt tattva anya tvābhyām anyaḥ vikalpaḥ sambhavati ubhayathā api na pariṇāmaḥ

na nirvivekam dravyam eva dharmaḥ na api dravyāt artha antaram kim tarhi dravyasya saṃniveśaḥ avasthā antaram yathā aṅgulīnām muṣṭiḥ na hi aṅgulī eva nirvivekā muṣṭiḥ prasāritānām amuṣṭi tvāt na api artha antaram pṛthak svabhāvena anupalabdheḥ iti ced na muṣṭeḥ aṅguli viśeṣa tvāt aṅgulyaḥ eva hi kāścid muṣṭiḥ na sarvāḥ na hi prasāritāḥ aṅgulyaḥ nirviveka svabhāvā muṣṭi aṅgulyaḥ avasthā dvaye api ubhaya pratipatti prasaṅgāt yaḥ eva hi khalu vivekaḥ svabhāva bhūtaḥ saḥ eva vastu bheda lakṣaṇam sukha duḥkha vat para bhūte ca viveka utpāde aṅgulyaḥ prasāritāḥ eva upalabhyeran na hi svayam svabhāvāt acyutasya artha antara utpāde anyathā upalabdhiḥ atiprasaṅgāt

nanu uktam na dravyam eva nirvivekam avasthā na api dravyāt artha antaram iti uktam idam na punar yuktam na hi sataḥ vastunaḥ tattva anya tve muktvā anyaḥ prakāraḥ sambhavati tayoḥ vastuni paraspara parihāra sthita lakṣaṇa tvena eka tyāgasya apara upāda ānana āntarīyaka tvāt aṅgulīṣu punar pratikṣaṇa vināśinīṣu anyāḥ eva prasāritāḥ anyā muṣṭiḥ tatra muṣṭi ādi śabdāḥ viśeṣa viṣayāḥ aṅgulī śabdaḥ sāmānya viṣayaḥ bīja aṅkura ādi śabda vat vrīhi ādi śabda vat ca tena aṅgulyaḥ prasāritā na muṣṭiḥ

tat yadi prāk asat eva kāraṇe kāryam bhavet kim na sarvaḥ sarvasmāt bhavati na hi asattve kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti nanu sarvatra sarvasya sattve api ayam tulyaḥ doṣaḥ na hi sattve kaścid viśeṣaḥ viśeṣe vā sa viśeṣaḥ traiguṇyāt bhinnaḥ syāt tad bhāve viśeṣasya ananvayāt sataḥ ca sarva ātmanā niṣpanna avasthāyām iva kim jāyate sādhana vaiphalyam ca sādhyasya kasyacid abhāvāt yasya kasyacid atiśayasya tatra kathaṃcid asataḥ utpattau saḥ atiśayaḥ tatra āsan katham jāyate jātau vā sarvaḥ sarvasmāt jāyeta iti tulyaḥ paryanuyogaḥ

na atiśayaḥ tatra sarvathā na asti kathaṃcid sataḥ eva bhāvāt iti ced yathā na asti sa prakāraḥ tatra āsan katham jāyeta na ca sarvathā sataḥ kaścid janma arthaḥ iti uktam asataḥ api kāryasya kāraṇāt utpāde yaḥ yat janana svabhāvaḥ tatas eva tasya janma na anyasmāt iti niyamaḥ tasya api sa svabhāva niyamaḥ sva hetoḥ iti anādi bhāva svabhāva niyamaḥ

api ca yadi mṛd piṇḍe ghaṭaḥ asti katham tad avasthāyām na paścāt vat upalabdhiḥ tad artha kriyā vā vyakteḥ aprādurbhāvāt iti ced tasya eva tad artha kriyā ādi bhāve ghaṭa tvāt tad rūpasya ca prāk asattvāt katham ghaṭaḥ asti na hi rūpa antarasya sattve rūpa antaram asti na ca rūpa pratibhāsa bhede vastu abhedaḥ yuktaḥ atiprasaṅgāt tasmāt yaḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta svabhāvaḥ anupalabdhaḥ sa na asti eva na hi tasya tad svabhāva sthitau anupalabdhiḥ tad asthitiḥ ca atattvam paraspara svabhāva āsthitayoḥ iva duḥkha sukhayoḥ iti vyāptiḥ asat vyavahāra niścayena anupalabdhi viśeṣasya

tena anupalabdhyā kasyacid vyavacchedam prasādhayatā tasya yathā ukta upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ upadarśanīyā upadarśya anupalabdhi nirdeśaḥ samarthanam svabhāva anupalabdhau vyāpaka anupalabdhau api dharmayoḥ vyāpya vyāpaka bhāvam prasādhya vyāpakasya nivṛtti prasādhanam samarthanam kāraṇa anupalabdhau api kārya kāraṇa bhāvam prasādhya kāraṇasya nivṛtti prasādhanam samarthanam tad viruddha upalabdhiṣu api dvayoḥ viruddhayoḥ ekasya viruddhasya upadarśanam samarthanam

evam anupalabdhau sādhana aṅgasya asamarthanam sādhana aṅgāvacanam tat vādinaḥ nigraha sthānam asamarthane tasmin sādhya asiddheḥ athavā sādhyate tena pareṣām apratītaḥ arthaḥ iti sādhanam tri rūpa hetu vacana samudāyaḥ tasya aṅgam pakṣa dharma ādi vacanam tasya ekasya api avacanam asādhana aṅga vacanam tat api vādinaḥ nigraha sthānam tat avacane hetu rūpasya eva avacanena siddheḥ abhāvāt

athavā tasya eva sādhanasya yat na aṅgam pratijñā upanaya nigamana ādi tasya asādhana aṅgasya sādhana vākye upādānam vādinaḥ nigraha sthānam vyartha abhidhānāt anvaya vyatirekayoḥ vā sādharmyavati vaidharmyavati ca sādhana prayogaḥ ekasya eva abhidhānena siddheḥ bhāvāt dvitīyasya asāmarthyam iti tasya api asādhana aṅgasya abhidhānam nigraha sthānam vyartha abhidhānāt eva

nanu ca viṣaya upadarśanāya pratijñā vacanam asādhana aṅgam api upadeyam eva na vaiyarthyāt asati api pratijñā vacane yathā uktāt sādhana vākyāt bhavati eva iṣṭā artha siddhiḥ iti apārthakam tasya upādānam yadi ca viṣaya upadarśanam antareṇa pratīteḥ anutpattiḥ katham na pratijñā sādhana avayavaḥ na hi pakṣa dharma ādi vacanasya api pratīti hetu bhāvāt anyaḥ sādhana arthaḥ sa pratijñā vacane api tulyaḥ iti katham na sādhanam

kevalasya asāmarthyāt asādhana tvam iti ced tat tulyam pakṣa dharma vacanasya api iti tat api na sādhana avayavaḥ syāt na hi pakṣa dharma vacanāt kevalāt pratipatteḥ utpattiḥ etena saṃśaya utpattiḥ pratyuktā pakṣa dharma vacanāt api kevalāt apradarśite sambandhe saṃśaya utpatteḥ tasmāt vyartham eva sādhana vākye pratijñā vacana upādānam vādinaḥ nigraha sthānam

athavā sādhanasya siddheḥ yat na aṅgam asiddhaḥ viruddhaḥ anaikāntikaḥ vā hetvābhāsaḥ tasya api vacanam vādinaḥ nigraha sthānam asamartha upādānāt tathā sādhya ādi vikalasya ananvayā pradarśita anvaya ādeḥ api dṛṣṭānta ābhāsasya asādhana aṅgasya vacanam api vādinaḥ nigraha sthānam asamartha upādānāt eva na hi taiḥ hetoḥ sambandhaḥ śakyate pradarśayitum apradarśanāt asāmarthyam

athavā siddhiḥ sādhanam tad aṅgam dharmaḥ yasya arthasya vivāda āśrayasya vāda prastāva hetoḥ sa sādhana aṅgaḥ tad vyatirekeṇa aparasya api ajijñāsitasya viśeṣasya śāstra āśraya vyāja ādibhiḥ prakṣepaḥ ghoṣaṇam ca para vyāmohana anubhāṣaṇa śakti vighāta ādi hetoḥ tat api asādhana aṅga vacanam vādinaḥ nigraha sthānam aprastuta abhidhānāt tathā viśeṣa sahitasya arthasya prativādinaḥ aji jñāsita tvāt jijñāsāyām adoṣaḥ jijñāsitam punar arthasya anyasya prasaṅga paraṃparayā yeṣa panu a ādinā bahis prativādinaḥ prāśnikānām ca nyāya darśinām iti ebhiḥ kathā vicchedaḥ eva karaṇīyaḥ na hi kaścid arthaḥ kvacid kriyamāṇa prasaṅge na prayujyate nairātmya vādinaḥ tu tad sādhane nṛtya gi iti ādeḥ api tatra prasaṅgāt

yathā pratijñā abhidhāna pūrvakam kaścid kuryāt na asti ātmā iti vayam bauddhāḥ brūmaḥ ke bauddhāḥ ye buddhasya bhagavataḥ śāsanam abhyupagatāḥ kaḥ buddhaḥ bhagavān yasya śāsane bhadanta aśva ghoṣaḥ pravrajitaḥ kaḥ punar bhadanta aśva ghoṣaḥ yasya rāṣṭrapālam nāma nāṭakam kīdṛśam rāṣṭrapālam nāma nāṭakam iti prasaṅgam kṛtvā nāndyante tatas praviśati sūtradhāraḥ iti paṭhet nṛtyet gāyet ca prativādī tam ca sarva prasaṅgam na anukartum samarthaḥ iti parājitaḥ syāt iti sabhyaḥ sādhu sammatānām viduṣām tattva cintā prakāraḥ na ca evam prastutasya paryavasānam sambhavati aniścaya phala tvāt anārambhaḥ eva vādasya
