katham ca evam jaya parājayau prativādinaḥ api ananubhāṣaṇasya evaṃprakārasya prasaṅgasya vistareṇa anubhāṣaṇa vyājena sambhavāt aniścita tvāt ca tasmāt pratijñā vacanam eva tāvat na nyāyyam kutas punar tatra ajijñāsita viśeṣa prasaṅga upanyāsaḥ tad vyākhyā prasaṅga vitatha pralāpaḥ ca sarvaḥ ca ayam prakāraḥ durmatibhiḥ śaṭhaiḥ nyāya sāmarthyena artha pratipādane asamarthaiḥ pravartitaḥ yathā puruṣa atiśaya pūrvakāṇi tanu karaṇa bhuvana ādīni iti pratijñāya tanu karaṇa bhuvana vyākhyā vyājena sakala vaiśeṣika śāstra artha ghoṣaṇam nityaḥ śabdaḥ anityaḥ vā iti vāde dvādaśa lakṣaṇa prapañca prakāśana śāstra praṇetuḥ jaimini pratijñāta tattva niti atā adhikaraṇa śabda ghaṭa anyatarasa dvitīyaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti pratijñām uparacayya dvādaśa lakṣaṇa artha vyākhyānam sarvaḥ ayam durmatīnām asāmarthya pracchādana upāyaḥ na tu satyaiḥ asti upetaḥ tattva parīkṣāyām phala ādi pratisaraṇa daṇḍa prayoga ādīnām ayukta tvāt

bhavati eva nāṭaka ādi ghoṣaṇe artha antara gamanāt parājaya iti ced anyasya api ajijñāsitasya kim na bhavati na hi tasya api kācid vivakṣita sādhya dharma siddhau na antarīyaka tā yathā hetu pratyaya pāratantrya lakṣaṇa saṃskāra duḥkha tā ādi siddhim antareṇa na anitya tā siddhiḥ tathāvidhaḥ tu dharmaḥ pṛthak anuktaḥ api sādhya dharme antarbhāvāt pakṣīkṛtaḥ eva iti na pṛthak asya upanyāsaḥ vyākhyānam vā tasmāt evaṃvidhasya api tadānīm prativādinā ajijñāsitasya arthasya pratijñāyām anyatra vā upanyāsaḥ vyākhyānam vā artha antara gamanāt nigraha sthānam eva tena jijñāsita dharma mātram eva sādhana aṅgam vācyam na prasaṅgaḥ upakṣeptavyaḥ tat upakṣepe ati prasaṅgāt evam asādhana aṅga vacanam vādinaḥ nigraha sthānam prativādinā tathā abhāve pratipādite anyathā dvayoḥ ekasya api na jaya parājayau iti

adoṣa udbhāvanam prativādinaḥ nigraha sthānam vādinā sādhane prayukte abhyupagata uttara pakṣaḥ yatra viṣaye prativādī yadā na doṣam udbhāvayati tadā parājitaḥ vaktavyaḥ sādhana doṣāḥ punar nyūna tvam asiddhiḥ anaikāntika tā vādinaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭasya arthasya viparyaya sādhanam aṣṭādaśa dṛṣṭānta doṣāḥ ca teṣām anudbhāvanam apratyāyanam apratipādanam prativādinaḥ parājaya adhikaraṇam tat punar sādhanasya nirdoṣa tvāt sa doṣa tve api prativādinaḥ ajñānāt pratipādana asāmarthyāt vā na hi duṣṭa sādhana abhidhāne api vādinaḥ prativādinā apratipādite doṣe parājaya vyavasthāpanā yuktā tayoḥ eva paraspara sāmarthya upaghāta apekṣayā jaya parājaya vyavasthāpanāt kevalam hetvābhāsāt bhūta pratipatteḥ abhāvāt apratipādakasya jayaḥ api na asti eva na hi tattva cintāyām kaścid chala vyavahāraḥ

yadi evam kim na parājayaḥ tattva siddhi bhraṃśāt na anirākaraṇāt nirākaraṇam hi tasya anyena parājayaḥ na siddhi abhāvaḥ pratiyogi anapekṣaṇāt siddhi abhāvasya sādhana abhāve asati api pratiyogini bhāvāt pratiyoginaḥ ca tad nirākaraṇe asāmarthyāt parājayasya anutpatteḥ aparājayaḥ tasmāt ayam asamartha sādhana abhidhāyi api pareṇa tathā abhāve apratipādite aparājitaḥ vaktavyaḥ

chala vyavahāre api vijigīṣūṇām vādaḥ iti ced na durjana vipratipatti adhikāre satām śāstra apravṛtteḥ na hi para anugraha pravṛttāḥ mithyā pralāpa ārambha ātmā utkarṣa para paṃsana ādīn asat vyavahārān upadiśanti na ca para vipaṃsanena lābha satkāra śloka upārjanam satām ācāraḥ na api tathā apravṛttebhyaḥ sva hasta dānena prāṇinām upatāpanam sat sammatānām śāstra kāra sabhā sadām yuktam na ca nyāya śāstrāṇi sadbhiḥ lābha ādi upārjanāya praṇīyante tasmāt na yoga vihitaḥ kaścid vijigīṣuvādaḥ nāma para anugraha pravṛttāḥ tu santaḥ vipratipannam pratipādayantaḥ nyāyam anusareyuḥ sat sādhana abhidhānena bhūta doṣa udbhāvanena vā sākṣi pratyakṣam tasya eva anuprabodhāya tat eva nyāya anusaraṇam satām vādaḥ ukte nyāye tattva arthī ced pratipadyeta tad apratipattau api anyaḥ na pratipadyeta iti

tattva rakṣaṇa artham sadbhiḥ upahartavyam eva chala ādi vijigīṣubhiḥ iti ced na nakha capeṭa śastra prahāra ādīpana ādibhiḥ api iti vaktavyam tasmāt na jyāyān ayam tattva rakṣaṇa upāyaḥ sādhana prakhyāpanam satām tattva rakṣaṇa upāyaḥ sādhana ābhāsa dūṣaṇam ca tad abhāve mithyā pralāpāt atra para upatāpa vidhāne api tattva apratiṣṭhāpanāt anyathā api nyāya upavarṇane vidvat pratiṣṭhānāt tasmāt para anugrahāya tattva khyāpanam vādinaḥ vijayaḥ bhūta doṣa darśanena mithyā pratipatti nivartanam prativādinaḥ

athavā yaḥ na doṣaḥ sādhanasya tad bhāve api vādinā sādhayitum iṣṭasya arthasya siddheḥ vighāta abhāvāt tasya udbhāvanam prativādinaḥ nigraha adhikaraṇam mithyā uttara abhidhānāt yathā sādhya tayā aniṣṭaḥ api vādinaḥ dharmaḥ śāstra upagamāt sādhyaḥ iti tad viparyāsena virodha udbhāvanam na asti ātmā iti tava pratijñāpadayoḥ virodhaḥ iti pratijñā doṣa udbhāvanam prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ anityaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt iti hetoḥ dharmi viśeṣa tvāt pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ iti asiddha udbhāvanam sarvāṇi sādharmya vaidharmya sama ādīni jāti uttarāṇi iti evamādeḥ doṣasya udbhāvanam adoṣa udbhāvanam

tasya vādinā doṣa ābhāsa tve prakhyāpite prativādī parājitaḥ vaktavyaḥ pūrva pakṣe sādhanasya nirdoṣa tvāt doṣavati punar sādhane na dvayoḥ ekasya api jaya parājayau tattva aprakhyāpanāt adoṣa udbhāvanāt ca apratipakṣāyām ca pakṣa siddhau kṛtāyām jetā bhavati tasmāt jigīṣatā sva pakṣaḥ ca sthāpanīyaḥ para pakṣaḥ ca nirākartavyaḥ nirdoṣe sādhana abhidhāne api vādinaḥ prativādinā doṣa ābhāsaḥ udbhāvite dūṣaṇa ābhāsa tva khyāpanaḥ eva jaya parājayau na anyathā bhāvataḥ tattva abhidhāne api pratipakṣa nirākaraṇena tattvasya prakhyāpanā sāmarthyāt na prativādinaḥ api atra bhāvataḥ mithyā pratipatteḥ iti idam nyāyyam nigraha sthāna lakṣaṇam uktam asmābhiḥ
anyat tu na yuktam iti na iṣyate yatra idam yathoktam nigraha sthāna lakṣaṇam na asti tasya nigraha sthāna tvam ayuktam iti na uktam asmābhiḥ

pratidṛṣṭānta dharma abhyanujñāsu adṛṣṭānte pratijñā hāniḥ nigraha sthānam iti atra bhāṣya kāra matam dūṣayitvā vārtikakāraḥ ayam sthita pakṣam āha tam eva brūmaḥ pratidṛṣṭāntasya yaḥ dharmaḥ tam yadā sva dṛṣṭānte abhyanujānāti nigṛhītaḥ veditavyaḥ tatra dṛṣṭaḥ ca asau ante ca vyavasthitaḥ iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ sva dṛṣṭāntaḥ sva pakṣaḥ pratidṛṣṭāntaḥ pratipakṣaḥ pratipakṣasya dharmam sva pakṣe abhyanujānan parājitaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt iti brūvan pratipakṣa vādini sāmānyena pratyavasthite āha yadi sāmānyam aindriyakam nityam śabdaḥ api evam astu iti eṣā pratijñāhāniḥ prāc pratijñātasya śabda anitya tvasya tyāgāt iti

atra upagata pratijñā tyāgāt pratijñāhānau viśeṣa pratiniyamaḥ kim kṛtaḥ anena prakāreṇa pratijñām tyajataḥ pratijñā hāniḥ iti sambhavati hi anyena api prakāreṇa hetu doṣa udbhāvana ādinā pratipakṣa sādhana abhidhānena ca sva pakṣa parityāgaḥ para pakṣa upagamaḥ ca idam eva ca pratijñā hāneḥ pradhānam nimittam evam pratipāditena pratijñā hātavyāḥ hānau ca parājaya iti

idam punar asambaddham eva sāmānyam nityam aindriyakam iti ukte śabdaḥ api evam astu iti kaḥ svastha ātmā svayam aindriyaka tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ ghaṭa vat iti bruvan sāmānyena upadarśana mātreṇa nityam śabdam pratipadyate sāmānyasya api nityasya aindriyaka tve api anitye ghaṭe darśanāt saṃśayitaḥ syāt jāḍyāt pratipadyeta api iti ced tathā api kim sāmānyasya upadarśanena evam eva nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti vaktavyam jaḍasya pratipattau vicāra abhāvāt

na ca nitya sāmānya upadarśanena tad dharmam śabde pratipadyamāne pratipakṣa dharma abhyanujñātaḥ bhavati anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti ca vadataḥ nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti āñjasaḥ pratipakṣaḥ syāt na nityam sāmānyam iti tasmāt aindriyaka tvasya nitya anitya pakṣa vṛtteḥ vyabhicārāt asādhana aṅgasya upādānāt nigraha arhaḥ na pratipakṣa dharma anujñayā anena prakāreṇa pratijñā hāneḥ

pratijñā artha pratiṣedhe dharma vikalpāt tad artha nirdeśaḥ pratijñāntaram pratijñātaḥ arthaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt iti eva tasya hetu vyabhicāra upadarśanena pratiṣedhe kṛte dharma bheda vikalpāt sāmānya ghaṭayoḥ sarva gata tva asarva gata tva dharma vikalpena pratijñāntaram karoti yathā ghaṭaḥ asarva gataḥ anityaḥ eva śabdaḥ api asarva gataḥ anityaḥ iti etat pratijñāntaram nāma nigraha sthānam sādhana sāmarthye api aparijñānāt sa hi pūrvasyāḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñāyāḥ sādhanāya uttarām asarva gataḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñām āha tad darśanāya tad artha nirdeśaḥ iti āha tad arthaḥ pūrva ukta sādhya siddhi arthaḥ uttara pratijñā nirdeśaḥ tad artha nirdeśaḥ na ca pratijñā pratijñā antara sādhane samartha iti nigraha sthānam

atra api na evambruvatā pratijñāntaram pūrva pratijñā sādhanāya uktam bhavati kim tarhi viśeṣaṇam aindriyaka tvasya hetoḥ sāmānye vṛttyā vyabhicāraḥ udbhāvite asarva gata tve sati aindriyaka tvasya hetoḥ viśeṣaṇa upādāne vyabhicāram pariharati na punar pratijñā antaram āha asarva gata tvasya śabde siddha tvāt pratijñāyāḥ ca sādhya nirdeśa lakṣaṇa tvāt

yat api uktam pūrva pratijñā sādhanāya uttarām pratijñām āha iti tat api ayuktam na hi pratijñā pratijñā sādhanāya ucyamānā pratijñā antaram bhavati kim tarhi hetu ādeḥ ananyatamaḥ sādhya sādhanāya upādānāt sādhana nirdeśaḥ sa syāt na sādhya nirdeśaḥ udāharaṇa sādharmi ādeḥ ca hetu lakṣaṇasya asarva ga tve bhāvāt pratijñā lakṣaṇasya ca abhāvāt hetu tvam asarva ga tve prayuktam na pratijñā antara tvam atyanta asambaddham ca idam pratijñām pratijñā sādhanāyāha iti yaḥ hi prāk pratijñām uktvā hetu udāharaṇa ādikam vaktum jānāti sa kiṃcid anukramam sādhanasya jānāti eva hi jānan katham avikala antaḥkaraṇaḥ pratijñām eva pratijñā sādhanāya upādadīta upādadatā ca anena pratijñā mātreṇa siddhiḥ iṣṭā bhavati tatas ca na prāk api hetum brūyāt

evaṃprakārāṇām asambaddhānām parisaṃkhyātum aśakya tvāt lakṣaṇa niyamaḥ api asambaddhaḥ eva pratijñā antara abhidhāne pratijñāntaram nāma nigraha sthānam iti asambaddha abhidhānam nigraha sthānam iti evaṃprakārāṇām ekam eva lakṣaṇam vācyam syāt na ca evaṃvidhaḥ kaścid vivādeṣu dṛṣṭa pūrvaḥ vyavahāraḥ yena tad artham yatnaḥ kriyate na ca bāla pralāpa anudiśya śāstram pravartate pravṛttau ca kā niṣṭhā teṣām aniṣṭānāt dṛśyate ca viduṣām api na ati nirūpaṇāt asiddha abhidhānam iti vyavahāra darśanāt tādṛśam parājaya adhikaraṇam vyavasthāpyate

tasmāt iha api yadi nivṛtta ākāṅkṣe vādini paraḥ anaikāntika tām udbhāvayet asādhana aṅgasya anaikāntikasya abhidhānāt nigraha sthānam vādinaḥ evam yadi prativādī sat sāmānyam aindriyakam nityam ca pramāṇena pratipādayitum śaknuyāt anudiśya apramāṇakam śāstra upagamam pramāṇena eṣām arthānām apratipādane na bhūta doṣa udbhāvanam iti na kaścid parājayaḥ abhyupagama mātreṇa vastu siddheḥ abhāvāt prativādinā doṣasya apratipādita tvāt pramāṇaiḥ asamarthita sādhana abhidhānāt tu jetā api na bhavati iti anitya ākāṅkṣe punar vādini na kaścid doṣaḥ viśeṣaṇa abhidhānena hetoḥ samarthana upakramāt

pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ pratijñā virodhaḥ yathā guṇa vyatiriktam dravyam iti pratijñā rūpa ādibhyaḥ artha antarasya anupalabdheḥ iti hetuḥ saḥ ayam pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ etena eva pratijñā virodhaḥ api uktaḥ yatra pratijñā sva vacanena virudhyate yathā śramaṇā garbhiṇī na asti ātmā iti vā hetu virodhaḥ api yatra pratijñayā hetuḥ virudhyate yathā sarvam pṛthak samūhe bhāva śabda prayogāt iti etena pratijñayā dṛṣṭānta virodhaḥ api vyākhyātaḥ hetoḥ ca dṛṣṭānta ādibhiḥ virodhaḥ pramāṇa virodhaḥ ca pratijñā hetvoḥ vaktavyaḥ para pakṣe sva siddhena go tva ādinā anaikāntika codanāt virodhaḥ yaḥ para pakṣam sva siddhena go tva ādinā vyabhicārayati tat viruddham uttaram veditavyam sva pakṣa anapekṣam ca yaḥ ca sva pakṣa anapekṣam hetum prayuṅkte anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt iti tasya sva siddhasya go tva ādeḥ anitya tva virodhāt viruddhaḥ ubhaya pakṣa sampratipannaḥ tu anaikāntikaḥ yat ubhaya pakṣa pratipannam vastu tena anaikāntika codanā iti

atra api pratijñāyāḥ sādhana vākye prayoga pratiṣedhāt tad āśrayaḥ tad kṛtaḥ vā hetu dṛṣṭāntayoḥ na virodhaḥ iti na pratijñāvirodhaḥ nāma kiṃcid nigraha sthānam syāt etat asati api pratijñā prayoge gamyamānaḥ api pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ bhavati yathā rūpa ādibhyaḥ artha antarasya anupalabdhiḥ tat guṇa vyatiriktam na upalabhyate ca rūpa ādibhyaḥ artha antaram dravyam iti ukte api gamyate eva sādhya sādhanayoḥ virodhaḥ katham tatas artha antarasya anupalabdhiḥ tad vyatirekaḥ ca iti

satyam syāt ayam virodhaḥ yadi hetuḥ sādhya dharma viparyayam sādhayet yadi hi upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta tvena upagatasya sataḥ dravyasya rūpa ādi pratibhāsa viu ekena sva pratibhāsā anupalabdhiḥ tat tad vyatirekeṇa na asti iti iṣṭa vyatireka viparyaya sādhanāt viruddhaḥ hetuḥ asmābhiḥ uktaḥ eva iti bhavati eva idam nigraha adhikaraṇam yadi evaṃvidhaḥ pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ iṣṭaḥ atha punar asya upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ lupyate tadā na kaścid pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ vyatiriktānām api bhāvānām kutaścid vipra karṣiṇām tad vyatirekeṇa anupalabdhau api vyatirekasya bhāvāt

yat uktam pratijñāyāḥ sva vacana virodhe pratijñā virodhaḥ iti tatra idam eva nigraha adhikaraṇam asādhana aṅga bhūtāyāḥ pratijñāyāḥ sādhana vākye prayogaḥ na virodhaḥ tad adhikaraṇa tvāt yadi pratijñānapekṣaḥ virodhaḥ syāt syāt parājaya āśrayaḥ pratijña adhikaraṇa tve punar tad prayoga kṛtaḥ eva parājayaḥ asya prastāva upasaṃhāra avasāna tvāt vyartham virodha udbhāvanam parājita parājaya abhāvāt bhasmīkṛta prajvalana vat ye tu kecid vicāra prasaṅgeṣu ekatra sādhye bahavaḥ hetavaḥ ucyante teṣām vikalpena tad sādhya sādhanāya vṛtteḥ sāmarthyam anyathā dvitīyasya vaiyarthyāt yadi hi tatra api eka prayogam antareṇa aparasya prayogaḥ na sambhavet na tadā dvitīyasya kaścid sādhana arthaḥ pratīta pratipādana abhāvāt tasmāt na pratijñāyāḥ svavacanavirodhaḥ nāma kiṃcid nigraha sthānam

na ca na asti ātmā iti atra kaścid pratijñā virodhaḥ na asti ātma śabda arthasya bhāva upādāna tva niṣedhāt śabda artha niṣedhe hi virodhaḥ syāt na ca sva lakṣaṇam śabda arthaḥ iti yaḥ punar pratijñayā bādhanāt dhetu virodhaḥ uktaḥ yathā sarvam pṛthak samūhe bhāva śabda prayogāt iti na atra pratijñāyāḥ prayogaḥ na api hetoḥ yena virodhaḥ syāt kim tarhi pratipādita artha upadarśanena upasaṃhāra vacanam etasmāt

anyaiḥ eva hetubhiḥ śabdasya eka viśeṣān abhidhānam aneka artha sāmānya abhidhānam ca pratipādya sarvasya śabda arthasya nānā artha rūpa tayā eka vastu viśeṣa svabhāvatā bhāvam upadarśayan śabda artham adhikṛtya sarvam pṛthak iti brūyāt etena tad virodhaḥ pratyuktaḥ dṛṣṭānta upadarśanam ca etat anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka anitya tvāt iti yathā kvacid arthe vipratipattau prasiddham aneka artha sāmānye śabda prayogam upadarśya pratipādita vipratipatti sthānaḥ sāmānyena upasaṃharati sarvam pṛthak iti

yadi dṛṣṭānta prayogaḥ kim ṛjunā eva tad prayoga krameṇa na prayuktaḥ vipratipatti viṣayaḥ ca kim na darśitaḥ iti ced na samāsa nirdeśāt evam api prayoga darśanāt asādhana vākya tvāt ca atas eva na pratijñayā hetoḥ bādhanam na ca ekam eva kiṃcid na asti iti bruvāṇaḥ kaścid tat samuccaya rūpam ekam samūham icchati yena virodhaḥ syāt yaḥ api yugapad ṣaṭkena yogāt ityādinā paramāṇoḥ bhedam āha na tasya api ekaḥ samuccaya rūpaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ kim tarhi abhāvaḥ eva eka aneka pratiṣedhāt atas saḥ api na samūhaḥ tasya iṣṭaḥ na tatra śabdaḥ iti na virodhaḥ

na virodhaḥ ayam pūrvakāt pratijñā hetu virodhāt bhidyate yena pṛthak ucyeta tatra hetu pratijñāyoḥ bādhanam iha pratijñayā hetoḥ iti asti bhedaḥ iti ced artha virodhe hi hetu pratijñayoḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ syāt sarvaḥ artha virodhaḥ dviṣu iti api parasparam bādhakam eka artha saṃnidhau apara artha asambhavāt tatra hetu pratijñāyoḥ pṛthak bādha udāharaṇayoḥ na kaścid artha bhedaḥ

api ca ayam viruddhaḥ aviruddhaḥ vā sati hetu prayoge vyadhikaraṇa tvāt asiddhaḥ iti asiddha tā hetoḥ nigraha sthānam sa khalu ucyamānaḥ eva atad dharma tayā pratītaḥ vaktuḥ parājayam ānayati parājite tasmin tad artha virodha cintayā na kiṃcid api ca sarvatra ayam pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ sambhavat na dvayīm hetu doṣa jātim atipatati viruddha tām asiddha tām ca iti viruddha tā siddhe hetoḥ dharmiṇi bhāve sādhya dharma viparyayaḥ eva bhāvena pratijñā artha virodhāt asiddha tā punar dharmiṇi pratijñāta artha siddhau viruddhayoḥ svabhāvayoḥ ekatra asambhavāt na ca anyathā virodhaḥ

asiddhe dharmi svabhāve abhihitayoḥ hetu pratijñā arthayoḥ virodhāt virodha sambhavaḥ iti ced apramāṇa yoge tu ubhayoḥ dharmiṇi saṃśayaḥ tathā sati hetoḥ dharmiṇi bhāva saṃśaye asiddha tā eva hetu doṣaḥ iti asiddha viruddhābhyām anyaḥ na pratijñayā virodhaḥ nāma parājaya hetuḥ asiddha viruddhe ca hetvābhāsa vacanāt eva uktaḥ iti na pṛthak pratijñā virodhaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti

ubhaya āśrita tvāt virodhasya vivakṣātaḥ anyatara nirdeśaḥ iti ced syāt etat pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ iti pratijñā ahetu āśritya ubhaya āśrayaḥ bhavati tatra yadā pratijñā virodhaḥ vivakṣitaḥ tadā pratijñā virodhaḥ iti ucyate yadā pratijñāyāḥ hetoḥ vā virodhaḥ tadā viruddhaḥ hetuḥ iti atas pratijñā virodhaḥ hetu virodhaḥ vā iti adoṣaḥ tatra hetoḥ udāharaṇam nityaḥ śabdaḥ utpatti dharmaka tvāt iti pratijñā virodhasya na asti ātmā iti pratijñā hetvoḥ paraspara viruddha udāharaṇam guṇa vyatiriktam ityādi pratijñayā hetu virodha udāharaṇam na asti ekaḥ bhāvaḥ iti ādikam iti

na sarvatra hetu apekṣasya virodhasya hetvābhāsa anatikramāt yathā uktam prāk anapekṣe ca kevale svatas pratijñā virodhe vivakṣite pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ iti hetu grahaṇam asambaddham na ca utpatti dharmaka tvāt nityam iti atra api hetu virodhaḥ yuktaḥ pratijñayā hi hetoḥ bādhane hetu virodhaḥ iha tu hetunā pratijñā bādhyate iti pratijñā virodhaḥ yuktaḥ ubhaya āśraye api virodhe bādhyamāna vivakṣayā tad virodha vyavasthāpanāt

yat api uktam etena pratijñayā dṛṣṭānta virodha ādayaḥ api vaktavyā bhaṇḍālekhya nyāyena iti tatra api pakṣīkṛta dharma viparyayavati dṛṣṭānte virodhaḥ syāt viruddhe ca dṛṣṭānte yadi pakṣa dharmasya vṛttiḥ ananya sādhāraṇā prasādhyate viruddhaḥ tadā hetvābhāsaḥ sādhāraṇāyām aprasādhite vā tad vṛtti niyame anaikāntikaḥ avṛttau vāsā dhāraṇaḥ

viruddha dṛṣṭānta āvṛttau viparyaya vṛttau ca hetoḥ na kaścid dhetu doṣaḥ dṛṣṭānta virodhaḥ ca pratijñayā iti ced na tat api saṃśaya hetu tva anativṛtteḥ dṛṣṭānta virodhaḥ hi pratijñāyāḥ sādharmye doṣaḥ na vaidharmye abhimata tvāt sādharmya dṛṣṭānte ca viparīta dharmavati vastutas sādhya avyabhicāre api hetoḥ na avyabhicāra dharma tā śakyāḥ darśayitum iti na apradarśita avina abhāva sambaddhāt dhetoḥ niścayaḥ tat na pratijñayā dṛṣṭānta virodhaḥ hetvābhāsān ativartate

ubhayathā api doṣaḥ astu iti ced na hetu doṣasya prāk prasaṅgena parājitasya doṣa antara anapekṣaṇāt viśeṣeṇa sādhana avayava anukrama niyama vādinaḥ udāharaṇa sādharmyam hetu lakṣaṇam viruddhe dṛṣṭānte na sambhavati iti prāk prayuktasya hetoḥ doṣeṇa parājaya iti na uttara dṛṣṭānta apekṣayā virodhaḥ cintām arhati hetoḥ api dṛṣṭānta virodhe asādhāraṇa tvam viruddha tvam vā vaidharmye yadi vṛttiḥ syāt pramāṇa virodhe tu hetoḥ yathā na dahanaḥ agniḥ śaityāt ityādi hi asiddhaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ pratijñāyāḥ pramāṇa virodhaḥ sva vacana virodhena vyākhyātaḥ iti sarve ete sādhana virodhāḥ hetvābhāseṣu eva antarbhavanti iti hetvābhāsa vacanena eva uktāḥ

yat tu viruddham uttaram para pakṣe sva siddhena go tva ādinā anaikāntika codanā iti tat asambaddham eva yadi hi sva siddhena go tva ādinā parasya vyabhicāra siddhim ākāṅkṣeta tasya tat sva pakṣa viruddham nābhimatam iti virodhaḥ yujyeta sa hi svayam pratipanne go tve hetu vṛtteḥ saṃśayānaḥ apratipattim ātmanaḥ tathā khyāpayati sa ca hetuḥ sati asati go tve aprasādhita sādhana sāmarthyaḥ saṃśaya hetu tvāt anaikāntikaḥ eva prasādhite tu sāmarthye go tve avṛttyā hetoḥ na saṃśayaḥ eva sarva saṃśaya prakārāṇām parihāreṇa samarthanāt etena sva pakṣa anapekṣa hetu prayogasya anaikāntika tā vyākhyātā saḥ api sva abhimata nitya go tva vṛttim hetum anitya tve bruvāṇaḥ asamarthita sādhana aṅga tayā saṃśaya hetum eva aha iti yat punar uktam ubhaya pakṣa sampratipannena vastunā anā ekāntika codanā iti tatra api avaśyam saṃśaya hetu tva mukhena eva anaikāntikaḥ vaktavyaḥ tat asamarthite anyatra api tulyam iti na ubhaya siddha itarayoḥ anaikāntika tvaiḥ viśeṣaḥ

yat api uktam dṛṣṭānta ābhāsa hetvābhāsa pūrvaka tvāt tad abhidhānena eva uktāḥ iti na pṛthak nigraha sthāneṣu uktāḥ iti tat api avayava antara vādinaḥ ayuktam yaḥ avayava antaram dṛṣṭāntam hetoḥ āha tasya na hetvābhāsa uktyā dṛṣṭānta ābhāsa uktiḥ vyāpyā tad vacanena gamyamānasya tasmāt sādhana antara abhāva prasaṅgāt dṛṣṭānta ābhāsānām hetvābhāseṣu antarbhāvāt dṛṣṭāntasya api hetau antarbhāvaḥ iṣṭaḥ bhavati tathā ca na dṛṣṭāntaḥ pṛthak sādhana avayavaḥ syāt apṛthak vṛtteḥ yaḥ dṛṣṭānta sādhyaḥ arthaḥ tasya hetau antarbhāvāt dhetunā eva sādhitaḥ iti na dṛṣṭāntasya pṛthak kiṃcid sāmarthyam

api ca na kiṃcid pūrva pakṣa vādinaḥ hetvābhāsa asaṃsparṣe nyāyyam nigraha sthānam asti iti tad sambandhīni sarvāṇi eva hetvābhāsa vacanena eva uktāni iti na pṛthak vācyāni syuḥ artha antara gamana ādeḥ api hetoḥ asāmarthyaḥ eva sambhavāt na hi samarthe hetau sādhye ca siddhe artha antara gamanam kaścid ārabhate asamarthasya mithyā pravṛtteḥ iti

pakṣa pratiṣedhe pratijñāta artha apanayanam pratijñāsaṃnyāsaḥ yaḥ pratijñātam artham anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt iti sāmānya vṛttyā hetoḥ vyabhicāra pradarśanena pratiṣedhe kṛte kaḥ evam āha anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti parityajati tasya pratijñāsaṃnyāsaḥ nāma nigraha sthānam iti atra api yadi udbhāvite api hetoḥ vyabhicāre na sa pakṣam parityajati kim na gṛhyeta nigṛhītaḥ eva hetvābhāsa abhidhānāt iti ced kim idānīm uttara pratijñāsāṃnyāsa apekṣayā tasya tat eva ādyam nigraha sthānam iti kim anyaiḥ aśakya paricchedaiḥ klība pralāpa ceṣṭitaiḥ upanyastaiḥ evam hi atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt pakṣa pratiṣedhe tūṣṇīṃbhavataḥ tūṣṇīṃbhāvaḥ nāma nigraha sthāna prapalāyamānasya prapalāyi tvam nāma nigraha sthānam iti evamādi api vācyam syāt tasmāt etat api asambaddham iti

aviśeṣa ukte hetau pratiṣiddhe viśeṣam icchataḥ hetu antaram nidarśanam eka prakṛti idam vyaktam parimāṇāt mṛd pūrvakāṇām śarāva prabhṛtīnām dṛṣṭam parimāṇam iti asya vyabhicāreṇa pratyavasthānam nānā prākṛtīnām eka prakṛtīnām ca dṛṣṭam parimāṇam iti evam pratyavasthitaḥ āha eka prakṛti samanvaya vikārāṇām parimāṇa darśanāt sukha duḥkha moha samanvitam hi idam sarvam vyaktam parimitam gṛhyate tasya prakṛti antara rūpa samanvaya abhāve sati eka prakṛtika tvam iti tat idam aviśeṣa ukte hetau pratiṣiddhe viśeṣam bruvataḥ hetu antaram bhavati sati ca hetu antara bhāve pūrvasya hetoḥ asādhaka tvāt nigraha sthānam atra api pūrvasya eva hetoḥ anaikāntikasya abhidhānāt nigṛhīte hetu antara cintā kva upayujyate yadi prāc sādhana vādī hetum anaikāntikam uktvā datta uttara avasaraḥ tena eva nigṛhyate adatta uttara avasaraḥ hetu antara abhidhāne api na nigraham arhati avirāmāt

prakṛtāt arthāt apratibaddha artham artha antaram yathā ukta lakṣaṇe pakṣa pratipakṣa parigrahe hetutaḥ sādhya siddhau prakṛtyāyām kuryāt nityaḥ śabdaḥ asparśa tvāt iti hetuḥ hetuḥ ca nāma hinoteḥ dhātoḥ tuśabde pratyaye kṛdantam padam padam ca nāma ākhyāta upasarga nipātāḥ iti prastutya nāma ādīni vyācaṣṭe idam arthāntaram nāma nigraha sthānam abhyupagata artha asaṃgata tvāt iti

nyāyyam etat nigraha sthānam pūrva uttara pakṣa vādinoḥ pratipādite doṣe prakṛtam parityajya asādhana aṅga vacanam adoṣa udbhāvanam ca sādhana vādinaḥ hi upanyasta sādhanasya samarthane kartavye tat akṛtvā aparasya prasaṅgena aprasaṅgena vā ātanna antarīyakasya api abhidhānam parājaya sthānam uttara vādinaḥ api doṣa udbhāvana mātrāt aparasya upakṣepaḥ iti

varṇa krama nirdeśa vat nirarthakam yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ jabagaḍa daśa tvāt jhabhan ghaḍha dhaṣa vat iti sādhana anupādānāt nigṛhyate iti idam api asambaddham na hi varṇa krama nirdeśāt eva iṣṭā artha siddhau ānarthakyam yat eva kiṃcid asādhana aṅgasya vacanam tat eva anarthakam sādhya siddhi upayoginaḥ abhidheyasya abhāvāt niṣprayojana tvāt ca iti prakāra viśeṣa upādānam asambaddham

vateḥ upādānāt adoṣaḥ iti ced syāt etat varṇa krama nirdeśa vat iti vatiḥ atra upāttar saḥ anyadā api ananurūpam gṛhnati iti adoṣaḥ iti na artha antara ādeḥ nigraha sthānasya avacana prasaṅgāt evam hi tāḥ na pṛthak vācyāḥ nirarthakena eva abhidhānāt na sādhya siddhau anarthakam nirarthakam yasya na eva kaścid arthaḥ tat nirarthakam iṣṭam iti ced yasya kasyacid avādinaḥ api hi nirarthaka abhidhāne kim na nigrahaḥ nigraha nimitta aviśeṣāt

na tasya iha aprastāvāt iti ced āyātam iha yaḥ nirarthakam bravīti tasya tena eva nigrahaḥ iti tat tulyam sarvasya asādhana aṅga vādinaḥ iti sa sarvaḥ nirarthaka abhidhāyi anena eva nigraha sthānena nigraha arhaḥ na ca varṇa krama nirdeśaḥ sarvatra nirarthakaḥ kvacid prakaraṇe tasya api arthavat tvāt tasmāt atra eva asya ānarthakyāt nigraha sthāna tvam api ca ati alpam idam ucyate varṇa krama nirdeśaḥ nigraha sthānam iti kapola vādita kakṣa ghaṭṭitakam iti evamādīnām api vācya tvāt

parṣad prativādibhyām tris abhihitam api avijñātam avijñāta artham yat vākyam parṣadā prativādinā ca tris abhihitam na vijñāyate śliṣṭa śabdam apratīta prayogam atidruta uccāritam iti evamādinā kāraṇena tat avijñāta artham asāmarthya saṃvaraṇāya prayuktam nigraha sthānam iti na idam nirarthakāt bhidyate sa yadi prakṛta artha sambaddham gamakam eva kuryāt na asya asāmarthyam tatra jāḍyāt parṣad a ādayaḥ na pratipadyante iti na vidvān nigraham arhati parṣad prajñām aparikalpya vacanāt nigraha arhaḥ eva iti ced nyāya vādinaḥ jāḍyāt uktam ajānan kim na prativādī nigṛhyate jāḍyāt parṣad ādeḥ avijñāta pratipādana asāmarthyaḥ iti vijetā na syāt na nigraha arhaḥ asambaddha abhidhāne nirarthakam eva iti na pṛthak avijñāta artham nāma nigraha sthānam iti

paurvāparya ayogāt apratibaddha artham apārthakam yatra anekasya padasya vākyasya vā paurvāparyeṇa yogaḥ na asti iti asambaddha artha tā gṛhyate tat samudāya arthasya apāyāt apārthakam daśa dāḍima ādi vākya vat idam kila padānām asambandhāt asambaddha varṇān nirarthakāt pṛthak uktam nanu evam asambaddha vākyam api pṛthak vācyam syāt na ubhaya saṃgrahāt apārthakam nirarthakasya api saṃgraha prasaṅgāt evaṃvidhāt ca viśeṣa samāśrayāt pṛthak nigraha sthāna lakṣaṇa pralapane ati prasaṅgaḥ api uktaḥ na ca saṃgraha nirdeśe kiṃcid doṣam paśyāmaḥ prabhede vā guṇa antaram iti yat kiṃcid etat

avayava viparyāsa vacanam aprāpta kālam pratijña ādīnām yathālakṣaṇam artha vaśāt kramaḥ tatra avayavānām viparyayeṇa abhidhānam nigraha sthānam na evam api siddheḥ iti ced na prayoga apeta śabda tulya tvāt yathā gauḥ iti asya padasya arthe goṇī iti prayujyamānam padam kakudādimantam artham pratipādyati iti na śabdānvākhyānam vyartham anena padena go śabdam eva pratipadyate go śabdāt kakudādimantam artham tathā pratijña ādi ava yava viparyayeṇa ānupūrvīm pratipadyate ānupūrvyā ca artham iti tathā hi pūrvam karma upādīyate tatas karaṇam mṛd piṇḍa ādikam lokaḥ iti

tat etat unmattasya unmatta saṃvarṇanam iva prayoga apeta śabda vat etat iti yadi goṇī śabdāt kakudādimatī arthe pratītiḥ śabdānvākhyāna prayatnena artham na paśyāmaḥ goṇī śabdasya artha pratipādane asāmarthyāt pratipādaka vyutpatti artham anvākhyānam iti ced nanu goṇī śabdāt api loke pratītiḥ dṛṣṭā satyam dṛṣṭā na tu sākṣāt iti uktam uktam etat na punar yuktam strī śūdrāṇām ubhaya pratīteḥ abhāvāt yaḥ khalu ubhayam vetti śabdam apaśabdam ca saḥ evam pratipadyate yaḥ tu nakka śabdam mukka śabdam eva vā vetti na nāsā śabdam sa katham apaśabdāt śabdam pratipadya tatas artham pratipadyeta dṛṣṭā ca anubhaya vedinaḥ api pratītiḥ iti na paraṃparayā pratītiḥ

arthe asamarthasya śabde api pratīti jananā sāmarthyāt ca na hi arthe api vācaka tvam nāma anyat eva tad viṣaya pratīti jananāt apaśabdaḥ ced śabde pratītim janayet arthaḥ eva kim na janayati na hi etasya arthāt kiṃcid bhayam paśyāmaḥ yena tam pariharet akṛta samayasya śabde api apratīti jananāt ca na hi ayam apaśabdaḥ śabde api svabhāvataḥ pratītim janayati adarśanāt samayate eva tu janayet samaya vaśāt vartamānaḥ arthaḥ eva kim na pravartate evam hi pratipatti paraṃpara apariśramaḥ parihṛtaḥ bhavati viparyaya darśanāt ca śabdāt artham apratipadyamānāḥ apaśabdaiḥ eva bahulam vyutpadyamānāḥ loke dṛśyante iti vyartham śabda anuśāsanam

na vyartham saṃskṛta śabda vyutpatti artha tvāt iti ced kaḥ ayam śabdānām saṃskāraḥ na hi eṣām prajñā bāhu śruti ādikam saṃskāram paśyāmaḥ na api eṣām ekāntena śravya tā na api artha pratyāyane kaścid atiśayaḥ na dharma sādhana tā mithyā vṛtti codanebhyaḥ saṃskṛtebhyaḥ api adharma utpatteḥ anyebhyaḥ api viparyaye dharma utpatteḥ śabdasya su prayogāt eva svargam odana ghoṣaṇā vacana mātram na ca evaṃvidhān āgamān ādriyante yukti jñāḥ na ca dāna ādi dharma sādhana codanā śūnya kevala śabda su prayogāt naraka pātam iti bruvāṇasya kasyacid mukham vakrībhavati tasmāt na saṃskṛtaḥ nāma kaścid śabdaḥ

śiṣṭa prayogaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti ced ke śiṣṭāḥ ye vidita vedya tā ādi guṇa yuktāḥ kaḥ punar eṣām guṇa utkarṣa anapekṣaḥ alīka nirbandhaḥ yat te amūn eva śabdān prayuñjate na aparān na ca atra kaścid śabde parokṣaḥ sākṣī yatas idam evam niścinumaḥ prayuñjate nāma śiṣṭāḥ nanu evam vayam guṇa atiśayam apaśyantaḥ saṃskāram keṣāṃcid śabdānām anumanyāmahe tad anvākhyāna yatnam vā guṇa atiśaya abhāvāt veda rakṣā ādikam ca aprayojanam eva atad samaya sthāyinaḥ sati api guṇa atiśaye na karaṇīyaḥ eva anvākhyāne yatnaḥ tad svabhāvasya anyatas api siddheḥ prākṛta apabhraṃśa dramiḍāndhra ādi bhāṣā vat na hi pratideśam bhāṣāṇām kiṃcid lakṣaṇam asti atha ca sampradāya vaśāt tāḥ lokaḥ tathā eva pratipadyate tāsām ca prayoga bhraṃśam tathā saṃskṛtānām śabdānām pratītiḥ bhaviṣyati iti jaḍa pravṛttiḥ eva eṣā yā śabdānām lakṣaṇe pravṛttiḥ

avayava viparyaye api yadi teṣām vacanānām pratītiḥ na viparyayaḥ na api arthāpratītiḥ sāmarthyāt na hi atra kaścid samayaḥ pratyāyanā viśeṣe api evam eva avayavāḥ prayoktavyāḥ iti saḥ eva teṣām kramaḥ yathā avasthitebhyaḥ artha pratītiḥ bhavati iti na viparyayāt pratītiḥ tatas ānupūrvī pratipattyā pratītiḥ iti ced na apratīyamāna sambandhebhyaḥ ānupūrvī pratipattiḥ yeṣām śabdānām kaścid sambandhaḥ jāyate idam iha sambadhyate iti teṣu vidita sambandheṣu kaḥ kasya pūrvaḥ aparaḥ vā kramaḥ yena krameṇa vyavasthāpyeran sambandha pratipattau saḥ eva teṣām kramaḥ yaḥ yathā avasthitānām sambandhaḥ pratīyate na hi vākyeṣu padānām krama niyamaḥ kaścid yathā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ rajñaḥ iti yāvadbhiḥ padaiḥ artha parisamāptiḥ tadā ekam vākyam yathā devadatta gām ānaya kṛṣṇām iti atra padānām yathākāmam prayoge api na artha pratītau viśeṣaḥ iti kaścid krama abhiniveśaḥ

pratipāditam ca pratijñā vacana antareṇa api yathārtham pratītiḥ bhaviṣyati iti pratīyamāna arthasya ca śabdasya prayoge ati prasaṅgaḥ pariśiṣṭeṣu ca sambandham pradarśya dharmiṇi bhāvaḥ pradarśyeta dharmiṇi bhāvam pradarśya sambandhaḥ pradarśyeta iti na niyamaḥ kaścid ubhayathā api prati iti utpatteḥ iti uktam apratīyamāna sambandheṣu ca padeṣu na tebhyaḥ ānupūrvyā api pratītiḥ iti na idam apārthakāt bhidyate iti na aprāpta kālam pṛthak vācyam syāt iti

hīnam anyatamena api avayavena nyūnam yasmin vākye pratijña ādīnām anyatamaḥ avayavaḥ na bhavati tat vākyam hīnam sādhana abhāve sādhya asiddheḥ na pratijñānyūnam hīnam tad abhāve pratīti bhāvāt iti pratipāditam hīnam eva tat nyūna tāyām api nigrahāt iti aparaḥ yaḥ pratīyamāna artham anarthakam śabdam prayuṅkte sa nigraham arhet na artha upasaṃhitasya abhidhātā iti asamīkṣita abhidhānam etat atas eva ca pratijñāyāḥ na sādhana aṅga bhāvaḥ iti

hetu udāharaṇa adhikam adhikam ekena kṛta tvāt anyatarasya ānarthakyam iti tat etat niyama abhyupagame veditavyam yatra eka sādhana vākya prayoga pūrvakaḥ vicāraḥ tatra adhika abhidhānam anarthakam iti nigraha sthānam prapañca kathāyām tu na kaścid doṣaḥ niyama abhāvāt iti

śabda arthayoḥ punarvacanam punar uktam anyatra anuvādāt śabda punaruktam anityaḥ śabdaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti artha punaruktam anityaḥ śabdaḥ nirodha dharmakaḥ dhvānaḥ iti atra na śabda punaruktam pṛthak vācyam artha punarukta vacanena eva gata tvāt na hi artha bhede śabda sāmye api kaścid doṣaḥ yathā hasati hasati svāmini uccais rudati atiroditi kṛta parikaram sveda udgāram pradhāvati dhāvati guṇa samuditam doṣa apetam praṇindati nindati dhana lava parikrītam yantram pranṛtyati nṛtyati yathā vā yat yasmin bhavati bhavati na bhavati na bhavati tat tasya kāryam itarat kāraṇam iti

gamyamāna artham punarvacanam api punaruktam niyata pada prayoge sādhana vākye yathā pratijñā vacanam iti artha punaruktena eva gata artha tvāt na pṛthak vācyam ayam api niyata sādhana vākyaḥ eva doṣaḥ vaktavyaḥ na vistara kathāyām vyācakṣāṇaḥ hi kadācid asamyak śravaṇa pratipatti śaṅkayā sākṣi prabhṛtīnām punar punar brūyāt api na tatra kiṃcid chalam

na aviṣaya tvāt iti ced na ayam guruḥ na śiṣyaḥ iti na yatnatas pratipādanīyaḥ yena punar punar ucyate iti punarvacane nigrahaḥ eva iti ced na sākṣiṇām yatnena pratipādya tvāt tad apratipādane doṣa abhidhānāt pratipādyasya śiṣya tvāt vijigīṣu vāda pratiṣedha tvāt tris abhidhāna vacanāt punarvacana prasaṅge samaya niyama abhāvāt ca na ca idam adhikāt bhidyate iti na pṛthak vācyam viniyata pada prayoge hi sādhana vākye ādhikya doṣaḥ iti punarvacane api gata arthasya ādhikyam eva padasya iti

prapañca kathāyām api akathita eka artha sādhana adhikaraṇāyām nānā artha sādhana īpsāyām nānā sādhana īpsāyām vā śrotuḥ hetu ādi bāhulasya punarvacanasya adoṣa tvāt pratīta pratyaya abhāvāt dhetu ādi bāhulyam vacana bāhulyam ca sādhana doṣaḥ iti ādhikya punarvacanayoḥ tulya doṣaḥ iti saṃgraha vacanam nyāyyam doṣa abhāvāt eva guṇa abhāvāt evaṃprakārāṇām bhedānām vacane ca atiprasaṅgāt iti uktam paryāya śabda kalpaḥ hi aparaḥ hetuḥ eka hetu pratipādite viṣaye vartamānaḥ pratipādyasya viśeṣa abhāvāt arthaḥ punar pratipādanāt na bhidyate yat punar uktam anuvāde tu apunaruktam śabda abhyāsāt artha viśeṣa upapatteḥ yathā hetu apadeśāt pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanam nigamanam iti pratijñāyāḥ eva gamyamāna arthāyāḥ vacanam punarvacanam kim punar asyāḥ punarvacanam iti ayuktam nigamanam

vijñātasya parṣadā tris abhihitasya apratyuccāraṇam ananubhāṣaṇam vijñāta vākya arthasya parṣadā prativādinā tris abhihitasya yat apratyuccāraṇam tat ananubhāṣaṇam nāma nigraha sthānam apratyuccārayan kim āśrayam para pakṣa pratiṣedham kuryāt iti uttareṇa avasānāt na idam nigraha sthānam iti ced syāt etat uttareṇa guṇa doṣavatā mūḍhāmūḍha tvam gamyate iti kim punar uccāritena asti hi kaścid uttare samarthaḥ na pratyuccāraṇe na asau tāvatā nigraham arhet iti

na uttara viṣaya aparijñānāt yadi ayam na pratyuccārayati nirviṣayam uttaram prasajyeta atha uttaram bravīti katham na uccārayati tat idam vyāhatam ucyate na uccārayati uttaram ca bravīti iti apratijñānāt ca na ca idam pratijñāyate pūrvam sarvam uccārayitavyam paścāt uttaram abhidhātavyam iti api tu yathā kathaṃcid uttaram vācyam uttaram ca āśraya abhāve ayuktam iti yuktam apratyuccāraṇam nigraha sthānam iti

yadi nāma vādī sva sādhana artha vivaraṇa vyājena prasaṅgāt apara aparam ghoṣayet vivāda āspadam ca jijñāsitam artha mātram uktvā pratijña ādiṣu artha viśeṣa paraṃparayā aparān arthān upakṣipya kathām vistārayet tat ca sarvam yadā na anuvaktum śaknuyāt kaḥ tasya vivāda āśraya artha mātra uttara vacane sāmarthya vighātaḥ yena vādi vacana ananubhāṣaṇam nigraha sthānam ucyate tasmāt sarvām vādi kathām ananubhāṣamāṇaḥ na uttare asamarthaḥ

yat vacanana antarīyakā jijñāsita artha siddhiḥ yathā pakṣa dharma tā vyāpti prasādhana mātram na tatra api prasaṅga antara upakṣepaḥ tat avaśyam sādhana aṅga viṣaya tvāt dūṣaṇena upadarśyate eva tatra api na sarvam prāk anukrameṇa uccāritavyam paścāt dūṣaṇam vācyam dvis uccāraṇa prasaṅgāt dūṣaṇa viṣaya upadarśana arthe anubhāṣaṇe vādi vacana anukrama ghoṣaṇam vyartham iti na kāryam eva dūṣayatā asya ayam doṣaḥ iti na antarīya tvāt pratidoṣa vacanam viṣaya upadarśanam kriyate eva na hi sarva viṣaya upadarśanam kṛtvā yugapad doṣaḥ śakyate abhidhātum pratyartham doṣa bhedāt

tasmāt yam padārtham dūṣayati saḥ eva tad dūṣaṇa viṣayaḥ tadā pradarśanīyaḥ na aparaḥ tad dūṣaṇe apara upadarśanasya asambhavāt tasmin dūṣite punar anyaḥ arthaḥ apara doṣa viṣayaḥ iti ayam anubhāṣaṇe dūṣaṇe ca nyāyaḥ sakṛt sarva anubhāṣaṇe api doṣa vacana kāle punar viṣayaḥ pradarśanīyaḥ eva apradarśite doṣasya vaktum aśakya tvāt tathā ca dvis anubhāṣaṇam kṛtam syāt tatra prathamam sarva anukrama anubhāṣaṇam niṣprayojanam dūṣaṇa vādinā dūṣaṇe vaktavye yat na tatra upayujyate tasya abhidhānam adoṣa udbhāvanam dviruktiḥ ca iti sakṛt sarva anubhāṣaṇam parājaya adhikaraṇam vācyam

tathā astu iti ced syāt etat uktam etat artha antaram nigraha sthānam iti tatra sādhane yatas kutaścid prasaṅga ādi nānāntarīyaka abhidhānam vādinaḥ artha antara gamanam eva iti sa nigraha arhaḥ na kaścid tad kathita kriyamāṇa prasaṅgaḥ na prasajyate na api tat tasya anubhāṣaṇīyam na ca idam api asmābhiḥ anujñāyate sarvam prāk sakṛt vaktavyam paścāt dūṣaṇam iti kim tu dūṣayata avaśyam viṣayaḥ darśanīyaḥ anyathā dūṣaṇa āvṛtteḥ iti

evam tarhi na ananubhāṣaṇam pṛthak nigraha sthānam vācyam apratibhayā gata tvāt uttarasya hi apratipattiḥ apratibhā na ca uttara viṣayam apradarśayan uttaram pratipattum samarthaḥ na hi anākṣipta anuttara pratipattikam ananubhāṣaṇam tena ananubhāṣaṇasya vyāpikāyām apratibhāyām vihitam nigraha sthāna tvam ananubhāṣaṇe labdham eva gavi vihitam iva sāsnādimattvam bāhuleye api tasmāt apratibhā eva nigraha adhikaraṇa tvena vācyā na ananubhāṣaṇam

kaḥ ca ayam samaya niyamaḥ tris abhihitasya ananubhāṣaṇam iti yadi tāvat para pratipādana arthā pravṛttiḥ kim tris abhidhīyeta tathā tathā sa grāhaṇīyaḥ yathā asya pratipattiḥ bhavati atha para upatāpana arthā tadā api kim tris abhidhīyate sākṣiṇām karṇe nivedya prativādī kaṣṭā pratīta druta saṃkṣipta ādibhiḥ upadrotavyaḥ yathā uttara pratipatti vimūḍhaḥ tūṣṇīṃbhavati na hi para upatāpana krame kaścid nyāyaḥ yena kaṣṭa apratīta prayoga druta uccāritāni nivāryante tris abhidhānam vā vidhīyate na ca para upatāpāya santaḥ pravartante śāstrāṇi vā praṇīyante iti adaḥ vaktavyam tasmāt tāvat vaktavyam yāvat anena na gṛhītam na tris eva agrahaṇa sāmarthye prāk eva paricchinna sāmarthyena parihartavyaḥ parān anupratibodhya iti

avijñātam ca ajñānam vijñātam parṣadā prativādinā yat avijñātam tat ajñānam nāma nigraha sthānam arthe khalu avijñāte na tasya pratiṣedham brūyāt iti etat api ananubhāṣaṇa vat apratibhayā eva gamya tvāt avācyam yathā ananubhāṣaṇe apradarśita viṣaya tvāt uttara pratipattiḥ aśakyā iti anuttara pratipattyā eva nigraha sthāna tvam uttara viṣaya pradarśana prasaṅgam antareṇa anubhāṣaṇasya vaiyarthyāt tathā ajñāne api uttara apratipattyā eva nigraha sthāna tvam ajānānaḥ katham uttaram uttara viṣayam ca uttaram brūyāt iti viṣaya ajñānam uttara ajñānam ca nigraha sthānam anyathā pratibhāyāḥ nirviṣaya tvāt anavadhārita arthaḥ hi na anubhāṣet ananubhāṣamāṇaḥ viṣayam apradarśya uttaram pratipattum na śaknuyāt iti uttaram na pratipadyeta jñāta uttara tad viṣayasya uttara apratipatteḥ asambhavāt ubhayam etat uttara apratipatteḥ kāraṇam iti

tad abhāve pratipattiḥ bhavati eva iti tayoḥ pṛthak vacane apratibhāyāḥ kaḥ viṣayaḥ iti vaktavyam nirviṣaya tvāt avācyā eva syāt na uttara ajñānam ajñānam kim tarhi viṣaya ajñānam ajñāte hi viṣaye uttara ajñānāt tat na pratipadyeta iti asti viṣayaḥ apratibhāyāḥ iti ced evam tarhi ananubhāṣaṇam nirviṣayam ajñānena ākṣepāt na hi viṣayam samyak pratipadyamānaḥ kaścid na anubhāṣeta iti na ananubhāṣaṇam pṛthak vācyam uttara ajñānasya ca ākṣepāt viṣaya ajñānena uttara ajñānam api ākṣiptam eva na hi viṣayam ajānan uttaram jānāti iti na eva apratibhāyāḥ viṣayaḥ asti

jñāte api viṣaye punar uttara ajñānam apratibhāyāḥ viṣayaḥ iti ced evam tarhi viṣaya uttara ajñānayoḥ api prabhedāt nigraha sthāna antarāṇi vācyāni yathājñānasya viṣaya ajñānam uttara ajñānam iti prabhedāt asati api guṇa atiśaye nigraha sthāna antara vyavasthā kriyate tathā ajñānayoḥ api sarva ajñāna ardha ajñānam ityādi prabhedāt nigraha sthāna antarāṇi kim na ucyante na ca ubhayasya api ajñānasya saṃgraha vacane kaścid doṣaḥ guṇaḥ tu syāt iti saṃgraha vacanam nyāyyam tasmāt ananubhāṣaṇa jñānayoḥ apratibhā viṣaya tvāt na pṛthak vacanam api ca na pūrva uttara vādinaḥ hetvābhāsā pratibhābhyām anyat nigraha sthānam nyāyyam asti tad ubhaya vacanena eva sarvam uktam iti tad ubhaya ākṣipteṣu prabhedeṣu guṇa atiśayam antareṇa vacana ādeḥ atiprasaṅgāt vyarthaḥ prapañcaḥ iti

uttarasya apratipattiḥ apratibhā para pakṣa pratiṣedhaḥ uttaram yadā na pratipadyate tadā nigṛhītaḥ vaktavyaḥ sādhana vacana anantaram prativiṣayam uttare vyartham tad ajñāna krama ghoṣaṇa śloka pāṭhā ādinā kālam gamayan kartavyā pratipattyā nigraha arhaḥ iti nyāyyam nigraha sthānam iti

kārya vyāsaṅgāt kathā vicchedaḥ vikṣepaḥ yat kiṃcid kartavyam vyāsajya kathām vicchinatti idam me karaṇīyam parihīyate asmin avasite paścāt kariṣyāmi pratiśyāya kalā me kaṇṭham kṣiṇoti evamādinā kathām vicchinatti sa vikṣepaḥ nāma nigraha sthānam ekatara nigraha antāyām kathāyām svayam eva kathā antam pratipadyate iti

idam api yadi pūrva pakṣa vādī kuryāt vyāja upakṣepa mātreṇa na punar bhūtasya tathāvidha kathā uparodhinaḥ kāryasya bhāve tasya sva sādhana āsāmarthya paricchedāt eva vikṣepaḥ syāt tathā ca idam artha antara gamanaḥ eva antar bhavet asamartha sādhana abhidhānāt dhetu ābhāseṣu vā prakṛta sādhana asambaddha pratipatteḥ ca nirarthaka apārthakābhyām na bhidyate atiprasaṅgaḥ ca evaṃprakārāṇām asambaddha sādhana vākya pratipatti bhedānām pṛthak nigraha sthāna vyavasthāpane proktaḥ atha uttara pakṣa vādī evam vikṣipet tasya api sādhana anantaram uttare pratipattavye tad apratipattyā vikṣepa pratipattiḥ apratibhāyām artha antare vā antarbhavati

nanu na avaśyam sādhana dūṣaṇābhyām eva sarvasya pratipattiḥ yena sarvāḥ vādi prativādinoḥ na asamyak pratipattiḥ hetvābhāseṣu apratibhāyām vā antar bhavet bhavati hi anibaddhena api kathā prapañcena vivādaḥ iti na asambhavāt ekatra adhikaraṇe viruddha abhyupagamayoḥ vivādaḥ syāt aviruddha abhyupagamayoḥ anabhyupagamayoḥ vā vivāda abhāvāt tatra avaśyam ekasya prāc vacana pravṛttiḥ yugapad pravṛttau paraspara vacana śravaṇa avadhāraṇa uttarāṇām asambhavena pravṛtti vaiphalyāt svastha ātmanām apravṛtteḥ tena ca sva upagama upanyāse avaśyam sādhanam vaktavyam anyathā pareṣām apratipatteḥ apareṇa ca tad sambandhi dūṣaṇam ubhayoḥ asamyak pratipattau hetvābhāsā pratibhayoḥ prasaṅgaḥ iti sarvaḥ nyāya pravṛttaḥ pūrva uttara pakṣa upanyāsaḥ dvayam na atipatati etena eva vitaṇḍā pratyukta abhyupagama abhāve vivāda abhāvāt

yadā tarhi abhyupagamya vādam viphala tayā na kiṃcid vakti anyat vā yat kiṃcid pralapati tadā katham hetvābhāsa antarbhāvaḥ asamarthita sādhana abhidhānaḥ evam uktam anabhidhānāni a abhidhānayoḥ api parājaya eva iti uktam abhyupagamya vādam asādhana aṅga vacanāt etena adhikasya punar uktasya ca pratijña ādeḥ vacanasya ca nigraha sthāna tvam vyākhyātam tat api hi pratipādita artha viparyaya tvāt sādhana sāmarthyān abhidhānam apratīta pratyaya tayā lakṣaṇāt sādhanasya asādhana aṅga vacanam iti nigraha sthānam iti

sva pakṣa doṣa abhyupagamāt para pakṣe doṣa prasaṅgaḥ mata anujñā yaḥ pareṇa coditam doṣam anuddhṛtya bhavataḥ api ayam doṣaḥ iti bravīti yathā bhavān cauraḥ puruṣa tvāt iti ukte sa tam pratibrūyāt bhavān api iti sa sva pakṣe doṣa abhyupagamāt para pakṣe tam doṣam prasañjayan para matam anujānāti iti mata anujñā nigraha sthānam iti atra api yadi puruṣa tvāt cauraḥ bhavān api syāt na ca bhavatā ātmā evam iṣṭaḥ tasmāt na ayam caurya hetuḥ iti yadi ayam abhiprāyaḥ tadā na kaścid doṣaḥ anabhimate tad ātmani caura tvena hetu darśanena dūṣaṇāt

prasaṅgam antareṇa añjasena eva kim na vyabhicāritaḥ iti ced yat kiṃcid etat santi hi evaṃprakārāḥ api vyavahārāḥ lokaḥ iti atha tat upakṣepam abhyupagacchati eva tadā api asau uttara apratipattyā eva tad sādhane nigraha arhaḥ na aparatra sva doṣa upakṣepāt tad sādhana nirdoṣa tāyām hi tad abhyupagamaḥ eva uttara apratipattiḥ iti tāvatā eva pūrvam āpanna nigrahasya para doṣa upakṣepasya anapekṣaṇīya tvāt iti

nigraha prāptasya anigrahaḥ paryanuyojya upekṣaṇam paryanuyojyaḥ nāma nigraha upapattyā codanīyaḥ tasya upekṣaṇam nigraha prāptaḥ asi iti ananuyogaḥ etat ca kasya parājaya iti anuyuktayā parṣadāḥ vaktavyam na khalu nigraha prāptaḥ sva kaupīnam vivṛṇuyāt iti atra api yadi sādhana vādinam nigraha prāptam uttaravādī na paryanuyuṅkte apratibhā eva asya uttara apratipatteḥ iti na paryanuyojya upekṣaṇam pṛthak nigraha sthānam nyāya cintāyām punar na dvayoḥ ekasya api atra jaya parājayau sādhana ābhāsena artha apratipādanāt bhūta doṣān abhidhānāt ca atha kaṃcid doṣam udbhāvayati kaṃcid na na tadā nigraham arhati uttara pratipatteḥ

arhati eva sarvasya sataḥ doṣasya anudbhāvanāt iti ced na santaḥ iti kṛtvā sarve doṣāḥ avaśyam vaktavyāḥ avacane vā nigrahaḥ ekena api tad sādhana vighātāt eka sādhana vacana vat yathā ekasya artha asya aneka sādhana sadbhāve api ekena eva tad siddheḥ na sarva upādānam iti na doṣam udbhāvayan eva aparasya anudbhāvanāt nigraha arhaḥ

atha pūrva pakṣa vādī uttara pakṣa vādinam nigraha prāptam na nigṛhṇāti tadā tayoḥ nyāyena na ekasya api pūrvavat jaya parājayau doṣa ābhāsam brūvānam uttara vādinam sva sādhanāt anutsārayataḥ asamarthita sādhana aṅga tvāt na jayaḥ vādinaḥ sarva doṣa asambhava pradarśanena sādhana aṅga samarthanāt na api uttara vādinaḥ bhūta doṣa apratipādanāt tasmāt evam api na paryanuyojya upekṣaṇam nāma parājaya adhikaraṇam iti

asthāne nigraha sthāna anuyogaḥ niranuyojya anuyogaḥ nigraha sthāna lakṣaṇasya mithyā avasāyāt anigraha sthāne nigṛhītaḥ asi iti bruvan niranuyojya anuyogāt nigṛhītaḥ vaktavyaḥ atra api yadi tad sādhana vādinam abhūtaiḥ doṣaiḥ uttaravādi abhiyuñjīta saḥ asthāne nirdoṣe nigraha sthānasya abhiyoktā udbhāvayitā na bhavati tathā ca bhūta doṣa udbhāvana lakṣaṇasya uttarasya apratipatteḥ itareṇa uttara ābhāsa tve pratipādite apratibhayā eva nigṛhītaḥ iti na idam atas nigraha sthāna antaram

atha uttara vādinam bhūtam sādhana doṣam udbhāvayantam aparaḥ doṣa ābhāsa vacanena abhiyuñjīta tasya tena bhūta doṣa tve pratipādite sādhana ābhāsa vacanena eva nigṛhītaḥ iti evam api na idam hetvābhāsebhyaḥ bhidyate avaśyam hi viṣaya antara vyāpti artham hetvābhāsāḥ nigraha sthāna tvena vaktavyāḥ tad uktau aparoktiḥ anarthaka iti

siddhāntam abhyupetya aniyamāt kathā prasaṅgaḥ apasiddhāntaḥ kasyacid arthasya tathā abhāvam pratijñāya pratijñāta artha viparyayāt kathā prasaṅgam kurvataḥ apasiddhāntaḥ vijñeyaḥ yathā na sataḥ vināśaḥ na asat utpadyate iti siddhāntam abhyupetya pakṣam avasthāpayati ekā prakṛtiḥ vyaktasya vikārāṇām anvaya darśanāt mṛd anvayānām śarāva ādīnām dṛṣṭam eka prakṛtika tvam tathā ca ayam vyakta bhedas sukha duḥkha moha samanvitaḥ gṛhyate tat sukha ādibhiḥ eka prakṛtiḥ iti saḥ evam uktavān paryanuyujyate atha prakṛtiḥ vikāraḥ iti katham lakṣayitavyam iti yasya avasthitasya dharma antara nivṛttau dharma antaram pravartate sā prakṛtiḥ yat tat dharma antaram sa vikāraḥ iti saḥ ayam prakṛta artha viparyayāt aniyamāt kathām prasañjayati pratijñātam khalu anena na asat āvirbhavati na sat tirobhavati iti sat asatoḥ ca tirobhāva āvirbhāvau antareṇa na kasyacid pravṛtti uparamaḥ pravṛttiḥ vā iti evam pratyavasthitaḥ yadi sataḥ ātma hānam asataḥ ca ātma lābham abhyupaiti apasiddhāntaḥ bhavati atha na abhyupaiti pakṣaḥ asya na sidhyati iti

iha api na kaścid aniyamāt kathā prasaṅgaḥ yat tena upagatam na asat utpadyate na sat vinaśyati iti tasya samarthanāya idam uktam eka prakṛtikam idam vyaktam anvaya darśanāt iti tatra ekā prakṛtiḥ sukha duḥkha mohaḥ tad avibhaktayonikam idam vyaktam tad anvaya darśanāt vyaktasya tad svabhāvatā bheda upalabdheḥ iti sukha ādīnām utpatti vināśa abhyupagama abhāvāt sarvasya tad ātmakasya na utpatti vināśau iti siddham bhavati atra tat uktasya hetoḥ doṣam anudbhāvya vikāra prakṛti lakṣaṇam pṛcchan svayam ayam prakṛta asambandhena aniyamāt kathām pravartayati

tatra idam syāt vācyam vyaktam nāma pravṛtti nivṛtti dharmakam na tathā sukha ādayaḥ vyaktasya sukha ādi anvaye sukha ādi svabhāvatāyām pravṛtti nivṛtti dharma tā lakṣaṇam avahīyate iti na tad rahita sukha ādi svabhāva tā vyakta lakṣaṇa virodhāt iti sukha ādi anvaya darśanāt iti asiddhaḥ hetuḥ iti evam hi tasya sādhana doṣa udbhāvanena pakṣaḥ dūṣitaḥ bhavati saḥ anupasaṃhṛtya sādhana doṣam kathām pratānayan sva doṣam paratra upakṣipati

ayam eva doṣaḥ anena prakaraṇena ucyate iti ced eṣa naimittikāṇām viṣayaḥ na lokaḥ śabdaiḥ apratipāditam artham pratipattum samarthaḥ iti saḥ eva ayam bhaṇḍa ālekhya nyāyaḥ atra api yathā uktena nyāyena pūrvakasya asādhana aṅgasya asiddhasya hetoḥ abhidhānāt eva nigrahaḥ na api aniyamāt kathā prasaṅgāt iti idam api hetvābhāseṣu antarbhāvāt na pṛthak vācyam

hetvābhāsāḥ ca yathā uktāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ ca nigraha sthānāni kim punar lakṣaṇa antara yogāt dhetu ābhāsāḥ nigraha sthāna bhāvam āpadyante yathā pramāṇāni prameya tvam iti atas āha yathā ukta hetvābhāsa lakṣaṇena eva nigraha sthāna bhāvaḥ iti atra api yathoktam kṛtvā cintyam eva kim te yathālakṣita prabhedāḥ tathā eva āhosvit anyathā iti tat tu cintyamānam iha ati prasajyate iti na pratanyate hetvābhāsāḥ ca yathānyāyam nigraha sthānam iti etāvat mātram iṣṭam iti

loke avidyā timira paṭala ullekhanaḥ tattva dṛṣṭeḥ vāda nyāyaḥ para hita rataiḥ eṣa sadbhiḥ praṇītaḥ tattva ālokam timirayati tam durvidagdhaḥ janaḥ ayam tasmāt yatnaḥ kṛtaḥ iha mayā tat samujjvālanāya vādanyāyaḥ nāma prakaraṇam samāptam
om namaḥ vīttarāgāya

jayanti jāti vyasana prabandha prasūti hetoḥ jagataḥ vijetuḥ rāga ādi arāteḥ sugatasya vācaḥ manastamata anavama ādadhānāḥ samyak jñāna pūrvikā ityādinā asya prakaraṇasya abhidheya prayojanam ucyate dvividham hi prakaraṇa śarīram śabdaḥ arthaḥ ca tatra śabdasya sva abhidheya pratipādanam eva prayojanam na anyat atas tat na nirūpyate

abhidheyam tu yadi niṣprayojanam syāt tadā tad pratipattaye śabda sandarbhaḥ api na ārambhaṇīyaḥ syāt yathā kāka danta prayojana abhāvāt na tad parīkṣā ārambhaṇīyā prekṣāvatā tasmāt asya prakaraṇasya ārambhaṇīya tvam darśayatā adhiya prayojanam anena ucyate yasmāt samyak jñāna pūrvikā sarva puruṣa artha siddhiḥ tasmāt tad pratipattaye idam ārabhyate iti ayam atra vākya arthaḥ

atra ca prakaraṇa abhidheyasya samyak jñānasya sarva puruṣa artha siddhi hetu tvam prayojanam uktam masmin ca arthaḥ ucyamāne sambandha prayojana abhidheyāni uktāni bhavanti tathā hi puruṣa artha upayogi samyak jñānam vyutpādayitavyam anena prakaraṇena iti bruvatā samyak jñānam asya śabda sandarbhasya abhidheyam tad vyutpādanam prayojanam prakaraṇam ca idam apāyaḥ vyutpādanasya iti uktam bhavati

tasmāt abhidheya bhāga pra yojana abhidhāna sāmarthyāt sambandha ādīni uktāni bhavanti na tu idam ekam dhākyam sambandham abhidheyam prayojanam ca vaktum sākṣāt samartham ekam tu vadat trayam sāmarthyāt darśayati tatra tat iti abhidheya padam vyutpādyate iti prayojana padam prayojanam ca atra vaktuḥ prakaraṇa karaṇa vyāpārasya cintyate śrotuḥ ca śravaṇa vyāpārasya

tathā hi sarve prekṣāvantaḥ pravṛtti prayojanam anviṣya pravarttante tatas ca ācāryeṇa prakaraṇam kim artham kṛtam śrotṛbhiḥ ca kim artham śrūyate iti saṃśaye vyutpādanam prayojanam abhidhīyate samyak jñānam vyutpadyamānānām ātmānam vyutpādakam karttum prakaraṇam idam kṛtam śiṣyaiḥ ca ācārya prayuktām ātmanaḥ vyutpattim iccha dibhaḥ prakaraṇam idam śrūyate iti prakaraṇa karaṇa śravaṇayoḥ prayojanam vyutpādanam

sambandha pradarśana padam tu na vidyate sāmarthyāt eva tu sa pratipattavyaḥ prekṣāvatā hi samyak jñānava vyutpādanāya prakaraṇam idam ārabdhavatā ayam eva upāyo na anyaḥ iti darśitaḥ eva upāya upeya bhāvaḥ prakaraṇa prayojanayoḥ sambandhaḥ iti nanu ca prakaraṇa śravaṇāt prāk uktāni api abhidheya ādīni pramāṇa abhāvāt prekṣāvadbhiḥ na gṛhyante tat kim etaiḥ ārambha pradeśe uktaiḥ satyam aśrute prakaraṇe kathitāni api na niścīyante ukteṣu tu apramāṇakeṣu api abhidheya ādiṣu saṃśayaḥ utpadyate saṃśayāt ca pravarttante artha saṃśayaḥ api hi pravṛtti aṅgam prekṣāvatām anartham saṃśayaḥ api nivṛtti aṅgam atas eva śāstra kāreṇa eva pūrva sambandha ādīni yujyante vaktum

vyākhyātṛṇām hi vacanam krīḍā ādi artham anyathā api sambhāvyate śāstra kṛtām tu prakaraṇa prārambhe na viparīta abhidheya ādi abhidhāne prayojanam utpaśyāmaḥ na api pravṛttim atas teṣu saṃśayaḥ yuktaḥ anukteṣu tu pratipattṛbhiḥ niṣprayojanam abhidheyam saṃbhāvyetā asya prakaraṇasya kāka danta parīkṣāyāḥ iva aśakya anuṣṭhānam vā jvara hara takṣaka cūḍā ratna alaṅkāra upadeśa vat anabhimatam vā prayojanam mātṛ vivāha krama upadeśa vat atas vā prakaraṇāt laghutaraḥ upāyaḥ prayojanasya anupāyaḥ eva vā prakaraṇam sambhāvyeta

etāsu ca anartha sambhāvanāsu ekasyām api anartha sambhāvanāyām na prekṣāvantaḥ pravartante abhidheya ādiṣu tu ukteṣu artha saṃbhāvanā anartha sambhāvana aviruddhāḥ utpadyate tayā prekṣāvantaḥ pravartante iti prekṣāvatām pravṛttanyaṅgam artha sambhāvanām kartum sambandha ādīni abhidhīyante iti sthitam avisaṃvādakam jñānam samyak jñānam

loke ca pūrvam upadarśitam artham prāpayan saṃvādakaḥ ucyate tadvat jñānam api svayam pradarśitam artham prāpayat saṃvādakam ucyate pradarśite ca arthe pravarttaka tvam eva prāpaka tvam na anyat tathā hi na jñānam janayat artham prāpayati api tu arthe puruṣam pravarttayat prāpayati artham pravarttaka tvam api pravṛtti viṣaya pradarśaka tvam eva na hi puruṣam haṭhāt pravarttayitu śaknoti vijñānam

atas eva ca artha adhigatiḥ eva pramāṇa phalam adhigate ca arthe pravartitaḥ puruṣaḥ prāpitaḥ ca arthaḥ tathā ca satyartha adhigamāt samāptaḥ pramāṇa vyāpāraḥ atas eva ca anadhigata viṣayam pramāṇam yena eva hi jñāna na prathamam adhigataḥ arthaḥ tena eva pravarttitaḥ puruṣaḥ prāpitaḥ ca arthaḥ tatra eva ca atha kim anyena jñānena adhikam kāryam atas adhigata viṣayam apramāṇam

tatra yorthaḥ dṛṣṭa tvena jñātaḥ sa pratyakṣeṇa pravṛtti viṣayīkṛtaḥ yasmāt yasmin arthe pratyakṣasya sākṣātkāri tva vyāpāraḥ vikalpena anugamyate tasya pradarśakam pratyakṣam tasmāt dṛṣṭa tayā jñātaḥ pratyakṣa darśitaḥ anumānam tu liga darśanāt niṃścinvat pravṛtti viṣayam darśayati tathā ca pratyakṣam pratibhāsanam niyatam artham darśayati anumānam ca liṅga sambaddham niyatam artham darśayati atas ete niyatasya arthasya pradarśake tena te pramāṇe na anyat vijñānam

prāptum śakyam artham ādarśayat prāpakam prāpaka tvāt ca pramāṇam ābhyām pramāṇābhyām anyena ca jñānena darśitaḥ arthaḥ kaścid atyanta viparyastaḥ yathā marīcikāsu jalam sa ca asattvāt prāptum aśakyaḥ kaścid aniyataḥ bhāva abhāvayoḥ yathā saṃśaya arthaḥ na ca bhāva abhāvābhyām yuktaḥ arthaḥ jagati asti tatas prāptum aśakyaḥ tādṛśaḥ

sarveṇa ca āliṅgena vikalpena niyāmakam adṛṣṭvā pravṛttena bhāva abhāvayoḥ aniyataḥ eva arthaḥ darśayitavyaḥ sa ca prāptum aśakyaḥ tasmāt aśakya prāpaṇam atyanta viparītam bhāva abhāva aniyatam ca artham darśayat apramāṇam anyat jñānam artha kriyā arthibhiḥ ca artha kriyā samartha vastu prāpti nimitam jñānam mṛgyate yat ca taiḥ mṛgyate tat eva śāstre vicāryate tatas artha kriyā samartha vastu pradarśakam samyak jñānam

yat ca tena pradarśitam tat eva prāpaṇīyam artha adhigama ātmakam hi prāpakam iti uktam tatra pradarśitāt anyat vastu bhinna ākāram bhinna deśam bhinna kālam ca viruddha dharma saṃsargāt hi anyat vastu deśa kāla ākāra bhedaḥ ca viruddha dharma saṃsargaḥ tasmāt anya ākāra vat vastu grāhi na ākāra antaravati vastuni pramāṇam yathā pīta śaṅkha grāhi śukle śaṅkhe deśa antara stha grāhi ca na deśa antara sthe pramāṇam yathā kuñcikā vivara deśa sthāyām maṇi prabhāyām maṇigrāhi jñānam na apavaraka sthe maṇau kāla antara yukta grāhi ca na kāla antaravati vastuni pramāṇam yathā arddha rātre madhyāhna kāla vastu grāhi svapna jñānam na ardharātra kāle vastuni pramāṇam

nanu ca deśa niyatam ākāra niyatam ca prāpayitum śakyam yad kālam tu paricchinnam tad kālam na śakyam prāpayitum na ucyate yasmin eva kāle paricchidyate tasmin eva kāle prāpayitavyam iti anyaḥ hi darśana kālaḥ anyaḥ ca prāpti kālaḥ kintu yad kālam paricchinnam tat eva tena prāpaṇīyam abheda adhyavasāyāt ca santāna gatam eka tvam draṣṭavyam iti

samyak jñānam pūrvam kāraṇam yasyāḥ sā tathā uktā kāryāt pūrvam bhavat kāraṇam pūrvam uktam kāraṇa śabda upādāne tu puruṣa artha siddheḥ sākṣāt kāraṇam gamyeta pūrva śabde tu pūrva mātram dvividham ca samyak jñānam artha kriyā nirbhāsam artha kriyā samarthe ca pravarttakam tayoḥ madhye yat pravartakam tat iha parīkṣyate tat ca pūrva mātram na tu sākṣāt kāraṇam samyak jñāne hi sati pūrva dṛṣṭa smaraṇam smaraṇāt abhilāṣaḥ abhilāṣāt pravṛttiḥ pravṛtteḥ ca prāptiḥ tatas na sākṣāt hetuḥ

artha kriyā nirbhāsam tu yadi api sākṣāt prāptiḥ tathā api tat na parīkṣaṇīyam yatra eva hi prekṣāvantaḥ arthinaḥ sa āśaṅkāḥ tat parīkṣyate artha kriyā nirbhāse ca jñāte sati siddhaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ tena tatra na sa āśaṅkāḥ arthinaḥ atas tat na parīkṣaṇīyam tasmāt parīkṣā arham asākṣāt kāraṇam samyak jñānam ādarśayitum kāraṇa śabdam parityajya pūrva grahaṇam kṛtam

puruṣasya arthaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ arthyate iti arthaḥ kāmyate iti yāvat hayaḥ arthaḥ upādeyaḥ vā heyaḥ hi arthaḥ hātum iṣyate upādeyaḥ api upādātum na ca heya upādeyābhyām anyaḥ rāśiḥ asti upekṣaṇīyaḥ hi anupādeya tvāt heyaḥ eva tasya siddhiḥ hānam upādānam ca hetu nibandhanā hi siddhiḥ utpattiḥ ucyate jñāna nibandhanā tu siddhiḥ anuṣṭhānam heyasya ca hānam anuṣṭhānam upādeyasya ca upādānam tatas heya upādeyayoḥ hāna upādāna lakṣaṇa anuṣṭhitiḥ siddhiḥ iti ucyate

sarvā ca asau puruṣa artha siddhiḥ ca iti sarva śabdaḥ iha dravya kārtsanye vṛttaḥ na tu prakārakārtsnye tatas na ayam arthaḥ dvi prakārā api siddhiḥ samyak jñāna nibandhana eva iti api tu ayam arthaḥ yā kācid siddhiḥ sā sarvā kṛtsnā eva asau samyak jñāna nibandhana iti mithyājñānāt hi kākatālīyā api na asti artha siddhiḥ tathā hi yadi pradarśitam artham prāpayati evam tatas bhavati artha siddhiḥ pradarśitam ca prāpayat samyak jñānam eva pradarśitam ca aprāpayat mithyājñānam aprāpakam ca katham artha siddhi nibandhanam syāt tasmāt yat mithyā jñānam na tatas artha siddhiḥ yatas ca artha siddhiḥ tat samyak jñānam eva atas eva samyak jñānam yatnatas vyutpādanīyam yatas tat eva puruṣa artha siddhi nibandhanam

tatas yāvat brūyāt yā kācid puruṣa artha siddhiḥ sā samyak jñāna nibandhana eva iti tāvat uktam sarvā sā samyak jñāna pūrvikā iti iti śabdaḥ tasmāt iti asmin arthe yat tadoḥ ca nityam abhisambandhaḥ tat ayam arthaḥ yasmāt samyak jñāna pūrvikā sarva puruṣa artha siddhiḥ tasmāt tat samyak jñānam vyutpādyate yadi api ca samāse guṇībhūtam samya jñānam tathā api iha prakaraṇe vyutpādayitavya tvāt pradhānam tatas tasya eva tad śabdena sambandhaḥ vyutpādyate iti vipratipatti nirākaraṇena pratipādyate iti

caturvidhā ca atra vipratipattiḥ saṃkhyā lakṣaṇa gocara phala viṣayā tatra saṃkhyā vipratiprattim nirākarttum āha dvividham iti dvau vidhau prakārau asya iti dvividham saṃkhyā pradarśana dvāreṇa ca vyakti bhedaḥ darśitaḥ bhavati dve eva samyak jñāna vyaktī iti vyakti bhede ca pradarśite prativyakti niyatam samyak jñāna lakṣaṇam ākhyātum śakyam apradarśite tu vyakti bhede sakala vyaktati anuyāyi samyak jñāna lakṣaṇam ekam na śakyam vaktum tatas lakṣaṇa kathana aṅgam eva saṃkhyā bheda kathanam apradarśite tu vyakti bheda ātmake saṃkhyā bhede lakṣaṇa bhedasya darśayitum aśakyatvāt lakṣaṇa nirdeśa aṅga tvāt eva ca prathamam saṃkhyā bheda kathanam

kim punar tat dvaividhyam iti āha pratyakṣam iti pratigatam āśritam akṣam ati ādayaḥ krānta ādi arthe dvitīyayā iti samāsaḥ prāpta āpannālaṅgati samāseṣu para vat liṅga pratiṣedhāt abhidheya valliṅge sati sarva liṅgaḥ pratyakṣa śabdaḥ siddhaḥ akṣa āśrita tvam ca vyutpattiḥ nimittam śabdasya na tu pravṛtti nimittam anena tvakṣa āśrita tvena ekā rtha samaveta martha sākṣāt kāri tvam lakṣyate tat eva śabdasya pravṛtti nimittam tatas cā yat kiñcidarthasya sākṣātkāri jñānam tat pratyakṣam ucyate

yadi tvakṣa āśrita tvam eva pravṛtti nimittam syāt indriya vijñānam eva pratyakṣamucyeta na mānasa ādi yathā gacchati iti gauḥ iti gamana kriyāyām vyutpāditaḥ api go śabdaḥ gamana kriyā upalakṣitam ekārtha samavetam go tvam pravṛtti nimittīkaroti tathā ca gacchati agacchati ca gavi go śabdaḥ siddhaḥ bhavati mīyate anena iti mānam karaṇa sādhanena māna śabdena sārūpya lakṣaṇam pramāṇam abhidhīyate liṅga grahaṇa sambandha smaraṇasya paścāt mānam anumānam gṛhīte pakṣa dharme smṛte ca sādhya sādhana sambandhe anumānam pravarttate iti paścāt kāla bhāvi ucyate cakāraḥ pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ tulya bala tvam samuccinoti yathā artha avinā bhāvi tvāt artham prāpayat pratyakṣam pramāṇam tadvat artha avinā bhāvi tvāt anumānam api paricchinnam artham prāyapat pramāṇam iti

tatra iti saptamī arthe varttamānaḥ nirdhāraṇe varttate tatoyam vākya arthaḥ tatra tayoḥ pratyakṣānamānayoḥ iti samudāya nirdeśaḥ pratyakṣam iti eka deśa nirdeśaḥ tatra samudāyāt pratyakṣa tva jātya eka deśasya pṛthak karaṇam nirdhāraṇam tatra pratyakṣam anūdya kalpanā apoḍha tvam abhrānta tvam ca vidhīyate yat tat bhavatām asmākam ca artheṣu sākṣātkāri jñānam prasiddham tat kalpanā apoḍha abhra anta tva yuktam draṣṭavyam

na ca etat mantavyam kalpanā apoḍhā abhra anta tvam ced aprasiddham kim anyat pratyakṣasya jñānasya rūpam avaśiṣyate yat pratyakṣa śabda vācyam sat anūdyeta iti yasmāt indriya anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi artheṣu sākṣātkāri jñānam pratyakṣa śabda vācyam sarveṣām prasiddham tad anuvādena kalpanā apoḍha abhra anta tva vidhiḥ kalpanāyāḥ apoḍham apetam kalpanā apoḍham kalpanā svabhāvena rahitam iti arthaḥ abhra antam artha kriyā kṣame vastu rūpe aviparyastam ucyate artha kriyā kṣamam ca vastu rūpam sanniveśa upādhi varṇa ātmakam tatra yat na bhrāmyati tat abhra antam

etat ca lakṣaṇa dvayam vipratipatti nirāsa artham na tu anumāna nivṛtti artham yatas kalpanā apoḍha grahaṇena eva anumānam nivartitam tatra asati abhrānta grahaṇe gacchat vṛkṣa darśana ādi pratyakṣam kalpanā apoḍha tvāt syāt tatas hi pravṛttena vṛkṣa mātram avāpyate iti saṃvādaka tvāt samyak jñānam kalpanā apoḍha tvāt ca pratyakṣam iti syāt āśaṅkā tad nivṛtti artham abhrānta grahaṇam tat hi bhrānta tvāt na pratyakṣam trirūpa liṅga ja tvā abhāvāt ca na anumānam na ca pramāṇa antaram asti atas gacchat vṛkṣa darśana ādi mithyājñānam iti uktam bhavati

yadi mithyājñānam katham tatas vṛkṣa avāptiḥ iti ced na tatas vṛkṣa avāptiḥ nānā deśa gāmī hi vṛkṣaḥ tena paricchinnaḥ eka deśa niyataḥ ca vṛkṣaḥ avāpyate tatas yat deśaḥ gacchat vṛkṣaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tad deśaḥ na avāpyate yat deśaḥ ca avāpyate sa na dṛṣṭaḥ iti na tasmāt kaścid arthaḥ avāpyate jñāna antarāt eva tu vṛkṣa ādiḥ arthaḥ avāpyate iti evam abhra anta grahaṇam vipratipatti nirāsa artham tathā abhra anta grahaṇena api anumāne nivartite kalpanā apoḍha grahaṇam vipratipatti nirākaraṇa artham bhrāntam hi anumānam sva pratibhāse anarthe artha adhyavasāyena pravṛtta tvāt pratyakṣam tu grāhye rūpe na viparyastam

na tu avisaṃvādakam abhrāntam iha grahītavyam yatas samyak jñānam eva pratyakṣam na anyat tatra samyak jñāna tvāt evā avisaṃvādaka tve labdhe punar avisaṃvādaka grahaṇam niṣprayojanam eva evam hi vākya arthaḥ syāt pratyakṣa ākhyam yat avisaṃvādakam jñānam tat kalpanā apoḍham avisaṃvādakam ca iti na ca anena dvis avi saṃvādaka grahaṇena kiñcid tasmāt grāhye artha kriyā kṣame vastu rūpe yat aviparyastam tat abhra antam iha veditavyam

kīdṛśī punar kalpanā iha gṛhyate iti āha abhilāpa ityādi abhilapyate anena iti abhilāpaḥ vācakaḥ śabdaḥ abhilāpena saṃsargaḥ abhilāpa saṃsargaḥ ekasmin jñāne abhidheya ākārasya abhidhāna ākāreṇa saha grāhya ākāra tayā tatas yadā ekasmin jñāne abhidheya abhidhānayoḥ ākārau saṃniviṣṭau bhavataḥ tadā saṃsṛṣṭe abhidhāna abhidheye bhavataḥ abhilāpa saṃsargāya yogyaḥ abhidheya ākāra bhāsaḥ yasyām pratītau sā tathā uktā

tatra kācid pratītiḥ abhilāpa saṃsṛṣṭa ābhāsā bhavati yathā vyutpanna saṅketasya ghaṭa artha kalpanā ghaṭa śabda saṃsṛṣṭa artha avabhāsā bhavati kācid tu abhilāpena asaṃsṛṣṭā api abhilāpa saṃsarga yogya ābhāsā bhavati yathā bālakasya avyutpanna saṅketasya kalpanā tatra abhilāpa saṃsṛṣṭa ābhāsā kalpanā iti uktau avyutpanna saṅketasya kalpanā na saṃgṛhyeta yogya grahaṇe tusā api saṃgṛhyate yadi api abhilāpa saṃsṛṣṭa ābhāsā na bhavati tat ahar jātasya bālakasya kalpanā abhilāpa saṃsarga yogya pratibhāsā tu bhavati eva yā ca abhilāpa saṃsṛṣṭā sā api yogyā tatas ubhayoḥ api yogya grahaṇena saṃgrahaḥ

asati abhilāpa saṃsarge kutas yogyatāvasitiḥ iti ced aniyata pratibhāsa tvāt aniyata pratibhāsa tvam ca pratibhāsa niyama hetoḥ abhāvāt grāhyaḥ hi arthaḥ vijñānam janayat niyata pratibhāsam kuryāt yathā rūpam cakṣuḥ vijñānam janayat niyata pratibhāsam janayati vikalpa vijñānam tu arthān na utpadyate tatas pratibhāsa niyama hetoḥ abhāvāt aniyata pratibhāsam

kutas punar etat vikalpaḥ arthāt na utpadyate iti artha sannidhi nirapekṣa tvāt bālaḥ api hi yāvat dṛśyamānam stanam saḥ eva ayam iti pūrva dṛṣṭa tvena na pratyavamṛśati tāvat na uparata ruditaḥ mukham arpayati stane pūrva dṛṣṭa apara dṛṣṭam ca artham ekīkurvat vijñānam asat nihita viṣayam pūrva dṛṣṭa tvasya asat nihita tvāt asat nihita viṣayam ca artha nirapekṣam anapekṣam ca pratibhāsa niyama hetoḥ abhāvāt aniyata pratibhāsam tādṛśam ca abhilāpa saṃsarga yogyam

indriya vijñānam tu sannihita artha mātra grāhi tvāt artha sāpekṣam arthasya ca pratibhāsa nivam ahetu tvāt niyata pratibhāsam tatas nābhilāpa saṃsarga yogyam atas eva sva lakṣaṇasya api vācya vācaka bhāvam abhyupagamya etat avikalpaka tvam ucyate yadi api hi sva lakṣaṇam eva vācyam vācakam ca bhavet tathā api abhilāpa saṃsṛṣṭa artha vijñānam sa vikalpakam na ca indriya vijñānam arthena niyamita pratibhāsa tvāt abhilāpa saṃsarga yogya pratibhāsam bhavati iti nirvikalpa kram

śrotra jñānam tarhi śabda sva lakṣaṇa grāhi śabda sva lakṣaṇam ca kiñcid vācyam kiñcid vācakam iti abhilāpa saṃsarga yogya pratibhāsam syāt tathā ca sa vikalpakam syāt na eṣa doṣaḥ sati api sva lakṣaṇasya vācya vācaka bhāve saṃketa kāla dṛṣṭa tvena gṛhyamāṇam sva lakṣaṇam vācyam vācakam ca gṛhītam syāt na ca saṃketa kāla bhāvi darśana viṣaya tvam vastunaḥ samprati asti yathā hi saṃketa kāla bhāvi darśanam adya niruddham tadvat tad viṣaya tvam api arthasya adya na asti tatas pūrva kāla dṛṣṭa tvam apaśyat śotra jñānam na vācya vācaka bhāva grāhi anena eva nyāyena yogi jñānam api sakala śabda artha avabhāsi tve api saṃketa kāla dṛṣṭa tva agrahaṇāt nirvikalpakam

tayā kalpanayā kalpanā svabhāvena rahitam śūnyam sat jñānam yat abhra antam tat pratyakṣam iti pareṇa sambandhaḥ kalpanā apoḍha tva abhra anta tve paraspara sāpekṣe pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam na pratyekam iti darśayitum tayā rahitam yat abhra antam tat pratyakṣam iti lakṣaṇayoḥ parasparasa apekṣayoḥ pratyakṣa viṣatyavam darśitam iti

timiram akṣṇoḥ viplavaḥ indriya gatam idam vibhrama kāraṇam āśu bhramaṇam alāta ādeḥ mandam hi bhramyamāṇe alātā ādau na cakra bhrāntiḥ utpadyate tad artham āśu grahaṇena viśeṣyate bhramaṇam etat ca viṣaya gatam vibhrama kāraṇam nāvā gamanam nauyānam gacchantyām nāvi sthitasya gacchat vṛkṣa ādi bhrāntiḥ utpadyate iti yāna grahaṇam etat ca bāhya āśraya sthitaṃra vibhrama kāraṇam saṃkṣobhaḥ vāta pitta śleṣmaṇām vāta ādiṣu hi kṣobham gateṣu jvalita stambha ādi bhrāntiḥ utpadyate etat ca adhyātma gatam vibhrama kāraṇam

sarvaiḥ eva ca vibhrama kāraṇaiḥ indriya viṣaya bāhya ādhyātmika āśraya gataiḥ indriyam eva vikarttavyam avikṛte indriye indriya bhrānti ayogāt ete saṃkṣobha paryantāḥ ādayaḥ yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ ādi grahaṇena kāca kāmalā ādayaḥ indriya sthāḥ gṛhyante āśunayana ānayana ādayaḥ viṣaya sthāḥ āśunayana ānayane hi kāryamāṇe alāte annivarṇa daṇḍa ābhāsā bhrāntiḥ bhavati hasti yāna ādayaḥ bāhya āśraya sthāḥ gāḍha marma prahāra ādayaḥ ādhyātmika āśraya sthāḥ vibhrama hetavaḥ gṛhyante taiḥ anāhitaḥ vibhramaḥ yasmin tathāvidham jñānam pratyakṣam

tat evam lakṣaṇam ākhyāya yaiḥ indriyam eva draṣṭṛ kalpitam mānasa pratyakṣa lakṣaṇe ca doṣaḥ udbhāvitaḥ sva saṃvedanam ca na abhyupagatam yogi jñānam ca teṣām vipratipatti nirākaraṇa artham prakāra bhedam pratyakṣasya darśayan āha tat caturvidham iti
indriyasya jñānam indriya jñānam indriya āśritam yat tat pratyakṣam

mānasa pratyakṣe paraiḥ yaḥ doṣaḥ udbhauvitaḥ tam nirākarttum mānasa pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam āha sve ātmīyaḥ viṣayaḥ indriya jñānasya tasya anantaraḥ na vidyate antaram asya iti antaram ca vyavadhānam viśeṣaḥ ca ucyate tatas ca antare pratiṣiddhe samāna jātīyaḥ dvitīya kṣaṇa bhāvi upādeya kṣaṇaḥ indriya vijñāna viṣayasya gṛhyate tathā ca sati indriya jñāna viṣa ya kṣaṇāt uttarakṣaṇaḥ eka santāna antarbhūtaḥ gṛhītaḥ sa sahakārī yasya indriya jñānasya tat tathā uktam dvividhaḥ ca sahakārī paraspara upakārī eka kārya kārī ca iha ca kṣaṇike vastuni atiśaya ādhānā ayogāt eka kārya kāri tvena sahakārī gṛhyate

viṣaya vijñānābhyām hi manaḥ vijñānam ekam kriyate yatas tad anayoḥ paraspara sahakāri tvam īdṛśena īdrinya vijñānena ālambana bhūtena api yogi jñānam janyate tad nirāsa artham samanantara pratyaya grahaṇam kṛtam samaḥ ca asau jñāna tvena anantaraḥ ca asau avyavahita tvena sa ca asau pratyayaḥ ca hetu tvāt samanantara pratyayaḥ tena janitam

tad anena eka santāna antarbhūtayoḥ eva indriya jñāna manaḥ vijñānayoḥ janya janaka bhāve manaḥ vijñānam pratyakṣam iti uktam bhavati tatas yogi jñānam para santāna vartti nirastam yadā ca indriya jñāna viṣayāt anyaḥ viṣayaḥ manaḥ vijñānasya tadā gṛhīta grahaṇāt āsañjitaḥ aprāmāṇya doṣaḥ nirastaḥ yadā ca indriya vijñāna viṣaya upādeya bhūtaḥ kṣaṇaḥ gṛhītaḥ tadā indriya jñānena agṛhītasya viṣaya antarasya grahaṇāt andha badhira ādi abhāva doṣa prasaṅgaḥ nirastaḥ

etat ca manaḥ vijñānam uparata vyāpāre cakṣuṣi pratyakṣam ivyate vyāpāravati tu cakṣuṣi yat rūpa jñānam tat sarvam cakṣuḥ āśritam eva itarathā cakṣuḥ āśrita tva anupapattiḥ kasyacid api vijñānasya etat ca siddhānta prasiddham mānasam pratyakṣam na tu asya prasādhakam asti pramāṇam evaṃjātīyakam tat yadi syāt na kaścid doṣaḥ syāt iti vaktum lakṣaṇam ākhyātam asya iti

sva saṃvedanam ākhyātum āha sarva citta ityādi cittam artha mātra grāhi caittāḥ viśeṣa avasthā grāhiṇaḥ sukha ādayaḥ sarve ca te citta caittāḥ ca sarva citta caittāḥ sukha ādayaḥ eva sphuṭa anubhava tvāt sva saṃviditāḥ na anyā citta avasthā iti etat āśaṅkā nivṛtti artham sarva grahaṇam kṛtam na asti sā kācid citta avasthā yasyām ātmanaḥ saṃvedanam na pratyakṣam syāt

yena hi rūpeṇa ātmā vedyate tad rūpam ātma saṃvedanam pratyakṣam iha ca rūpa ādau vastuni dṛśyamāne āntaraḥ sukha ādi ākāraḥ tulya kālam saṃvedyate na ca gṛhyamāṇa ākāraḥ nīla ādiḥ sāta rūpaḥ vedyate iti śakyam vaktum yatas nīla ādiḥ sāta rūpeṇa anubhūyate iti na niścīyate yadi hi sāta rūpaḥ ayam nīlādiḥ anubhūyate iti niścīyeta syāt tadā tasya sātā ādi rūpa tvam yasmin rūpe pratyakṣasya sākṣātkāri tva vyāpāraḥ vikalpena anugamyate tat pratyakṣam na ca nīlasya sāta rūpa tvam anugamyate tasmāt asātān nīla ādi arthāt anyat eva sātam anubhūyate nīla anubhava kāle tat ca jñānam eva tatas asti jñāna anubhavaḥ tat ca jñāna rūpa vedanam ātmanaḥ sākṣātkāri nirvikalpakam abhrāntam ca tatas pratyakṣam

yogi pratyakṣam vyākhyātum āha bhūtaḥ sat bhūtaḥ arthaḥ pramāṇena dṛṣṭaḥ ca sadbhūtaḥ yathā catvāri ārya satyāni bhūtasya bhāvanā punar punar cetasi viniveśanam bhāvanāyāḥ prakarṣaḥ bhāvyamāna artha ābhāsasya jñānasya sphuṭa ābha tva ārambhaḥ prakarṣasya paryantaḥ yadā sphuṭa ābha tvam īṣat asampūrṇam bhavati yāvat hi sphuṭa ābha tvam aparipūrṇam tāvat tasya prakarṣa gamanam

sampūrṇa tu yadā tadā na asti prakarṣa gatiḥ tatas sampūrṇa avasthāyāḥ prāc tani avasthā sphuṭa ābha tva prakarṣa paryantaḥ ucyate tasmāt paryantāt yat jātam bhāvyamānasya arthasya sannihitasya iva sphuṭatara ākāra grāhi jñānam yoginaḥ pratyakṣam tat iha sphuṭa ābha tva ārambha avasthāḥ bhāvanā prakarṣaḥ abhraka vyavahitam iva yadā bhāvyamānam vastu paśyati sā prakarṣa paryanta avasthā kara tala āmalaka vat bhāvyamānasya arthasya yat darśanam tat yoginaḥ pratyakṣam tat hi sphuṭa ābham

sphuṭa ābha tvāt eva ca nirvikalpakam vikalpa vijñānam hi saṅketa kāla dṛṣṭa tvena vastu gṛhṇat śabda saṃsarga yogyam gṛhṇīyāt saṅketa kāla dṛṣṭa tvam ca saṅketa kāla utpanna jñāna viṣaya tvam yathā ca pūrva utpannam vinaṣṭam jñānam samprati asat tadvat pūrva vinaṣṭa jñāna viṣaya tvam api samprati na asti vastunaḥ tat asat rūpam vastunaḥ gṛhṇat asannihi tārtha grāhi tvāt asphuṭa ābham vikalpakam tatas sphuṭa ābha tvāt nirvikalpakam pramāṇa śuddha artha grāhi tvāt ca saṃvādakam atas pratyakṣam itara pratyakṣa vat yogaḥ samādhiḥ sa yasya asti sa yogī tasya jñānam pratyakṣam iti śabdaḥ parisamāpti vacanaḥ iyat eva pratyakṣam iti

tat evam pratyakṣasya kalpanā apoḍha tva abhra anta tva yuktasya prakāra bhedam pratipādya viṣaya vipratipattim nirākarttum āha tasya ityādi tasya caturvidhasya pratyakṣasya viṣayaḥ boddhavyaḥ sva lakṣaṇam svam asa ādhāraṇam lakṣaṇam tattvam sva lakṣaṇam vastunaḥ hi āsa dhāraṇam ca tattvam asti sāmānyam ca tatra yat asādhāraṇam tat pratyakṣasya grāhyam

dvividhaḥ hi viṣayaḥ pramāṇasya grāhyaḥ ca yat ākāram utyadyate prāpaṇīyaḥ ca yam adhyavasyati anyaḥ hi grāhyaḥ anyaḥ ca adhyavaseyaḥ pratyakṣasya hi kṣaṇaḥ ekaḥ grāhyaḥ adhyavaseyaḥ tu pratyakṣa bala utpannena niścayena saṃtānaḥ eva santānaḥ eva ca pratyakṣasya prāpaṇīyaḥ kṣaṇasya prāpayitum aśakyatvāt

tathā anumānam api sva pratibhāse anarthe artha avyavasāyena pravṛtteḥ anartha grāhi sa punar āropitaḥ arthaḥ gṛhyamāṇaḥ sva lakṣaṇa tvena avasīyate yatas tatas sva lakṣaṇam avasitam pravṛtti viṣayaḥ anumānasya anarthaḥ tu grāhyaḥ tat atra pramāṇasya grāhyam viṣayam darśayatā pratyakṣasya sva lakṣaṇam viṣayaḥ uktaḥ

kaḥ punar asau viṣayaḥ jñānasya yaḥ sva lakṣaṇam pratipattavyaḥ iti āha yasya arthasya ityādi artha śabdaḥ viṣaya paryāyaḥ yasya jñāna viṣayasya saṃnidhānam nikaṭa deśa avasthānam asaṃnidhānam dūra deśa avasthānam tasmāt saṃnidhānāt asaṃnidhānāt ca jñāna pratibhāsasya grāhya ākārasya bhedaḥ sphuṭa tva asphuṭa tvābhyām yaḥ hi jñāna viṣayaḥ saṃnihitaḥ san sphuṭa ābhāsam jñānasya karoti asaṃnihitaḥ tu yogya deśa sthaḥ eva asphuṭam karoti tat sva lakṣaṇam sarvāṇi eva hi vastūni dūrāt asphuṭāni dṛśyante samīpe sphuṭāni tāni eva sva lakṣaṇāni

kasmāt punar pratyakṣa viṣayaḥ eva sva lakṣaṇam tathā hi vikalpa viṣayaḥ api vahniḥ dṛśya ātmakaḥ eva avasīyate iti āha tat eva paramārtha sat iti paramaḥ arthaḥ akṛtrimam anāropitam rūpam tena asti iti paramārtha sat yaḥ eva arthaḥ sannidhāna āsannidhānābhyām sphuṭam asphuṭam ca pratibhāsam karoti paramārtha san saḥ eva sa ca pratyakṣasya viṣayaḥ yatas tasmāt tat eva sva lakṣaṇam

kasmāt punar tat eva parama artha sat iti āha arthyate iti arthaḥ heyaḥ upādeyaḥ ca heyaḥ hi hātum iṣyate upādeyaḥ ca upādātum arthasya prayojanasya kriyā niṣpattiḥ tasyām sāmarthyam śaktiḥ tat eva lakṣaṇam rūpam yasya vastunaḥ tat artha kriyā sāmarthya lakṣaṇam tasya bhāvaḥ tasmāt vastu śabdaḥ parama artha paryāyaḥ tat ayam arthaḥ yasmāt artha kriyā samartham paramārtha sat ucyate sannidhāna asannidhānābhyām ca jñāna pratibhāsasya bhedakaḥ arthaḥ artha kriyā samarthaḥ tasmāt saḥ eva paramārtha san tatas eva hi pratyakṣa viṣayāt artha kriyā prāpyate na vikalpa viṣayāt atas eva yadi api vikalpa viṣayaḥ dṛśyaḥ iva avasīyate tathā api na sa dṛśyaḥ eva tatas artha kriyāyāḥ abhāvāt dṛśyāt ca bhāvāt atas tat eva sva lakṣaṇam na vikalpa viṣayaḥ

anyat ityādi etasmāt sva lakṣaṇāt yat anyat sva lakṣaṇam yaḥ na bhavati jñāna viṣayaḥ tat sāmānya lakṣaṇam vikalpa jñānena avasīyamānaḥ hi arthaḥ sannidhāna āsannidhānābhyām jñāna pratibhāsam na bhinatti tathā hi āropyamāṇaḥ vahniḥ āropāt asti āropāt ca dūra sthaḥ nikaṭa sthaḥ ca tasya samāropitasya sannidhāna āsat nidhānāt ca jñāna pratibhāsasya na bhedaḥ sphuṭa tvena asphuṭa tvena vā tatas sva lakṣaṇāt anyaḥ ucyate sāmānyena lakṣaṇam sāmānya lakṣaṇam sādhāraṇam rūpam iti arthaḥ samāropyamāṇam hi rūpam sakala vahni sādhāraṇam tatas tat sāmānya lakṣaṇam

tat ca anumānasya grāhyam darśayitum āha saḥ anumānasya viṣayaḥ grāhya rūpaḥ sarva nāmnaḥ abhidheya vat liṅga parigrahaḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇam anumānasya viṣayam vyākhyātu kāmena ayam sva lakṣaṇa svarūpa ākhyāna granthaḥ āvarttanīyaḥ syāt tatas lāghava artham pratyakṣa paricchedaḥ eva anumāna viṣayaḥ uktaḥ
viṣaya vipratipattim nirākṛtya phala vipratiparttim nirākarttum āha tat eva iti yat eva anantaram uktam pratyakṣam jñānam tat eva pramāṇasya phalam

katham pramāṇa phalam iti āha arthasya pratītiḥ avagamaḥ sā eva rūpam yasya pratyakṣa jñānasya tad artha pratīti rūpam tasya bhāvaḥ tasmāt etat uktam bhavati prāpakam jñānam pramāṇam prāpaṇa śaktiḥ ca na kevalāt artha avinā bhāvi tvāt bhavati bīja ādi a vinābhāvinaḥ api aṅkura ādeḥ aprāpaka tvāt tasmāt prāpyāt arthāt utpattau api asya jñānasyā asti kaścid avaśya karttavyaḥ prāpa kavya apāroyena kṛtena arthaḥ prāpitaḥ bhavati saḥ eva ca pramāṇa phalam yat anuṣṭhānāt prāpakam bhavati jñānam uktam ca purastāt pravṛtti viṣaya pradarśanam eva prāpakasya prāpaka vyāpāraḥ nāma tat eva ca pratyakṣam artha pratīti rūpam artha pradarśana rūpam atas tat eva pramāṇa phalam

yadi tarhi jñānam pramiti rūpa tvāt pramāṇa phalam kim tarhi pramāṇam iti āha arthena saha yat sārūpyam sādṛśyam asya jñānasya tat pramāṇam iha yasmāt viṣayāt vijñānam udeti tad viṣaya sadṛśam tat bhavati yathā nīlāt utpadyamānam nīla sadṛśam tat ca sārūpyam sādṛśyam ākāraḥ iti ābhāsaḥ iti api vyapadiśyate

nanu ca jñānāt avyatiriktam sādṛśyam tathā ca sati tat eva jñānam pramāṇam tat eva ca pramāṇa phalam na ca ekam vastu sādhyam sādhanam ca upapadyate tat katham sārūpyam pramāṇam iti āha tad vaśāt iti tat iti sārūpyam tasya vaśāt sārūpya sāmarthyāt arthasya pratītiḥ avabodhaḥ tasyāḥ siddhiḥ tad siddheḥ kāraṇāt arthasya pratīti rūpam pratyakṣam vijñānam sārūpya vaśāt siddhyati pratītam bhavati iti arthaḥ nīla nirbhāsam hi vijñānam yatas tasmāt nīlasya pratītiḥ avasīyate yebhyaḥ hi cakṣuḥ ādibhyaḥ vijñānam utpadyate na tad vaśāt tat jñānam nīlasya saṃvedanam śakyate avasthāpayitum nīla sadṛśam tu anubhūyamānam nīlasya saṃvedanam avasthāpyate

na ca atra janya janaka bhāva nibandhanaḥ sādhya sādhana bhāvaḥ yena ekasmin vastuni virodhaḥ syāt api tu vyavasthāpya vyavasthāpana bhāvena tatas ekasya vastunaḥ kiñcid rūpam pramāṇam kiñcid pramāṇa phalam na virudhyate vyavasthāpana hetuḥ hi sārūpyam tasya jñānasya vyavasthāpyam ca nīla saṃvedana rūpam

vyavasthāpya vyavasthāpaka bhāvaḥ api katham ekaraya jñānasya iti ced ucyate nīla sadṛśam anubhūya tat vijñānam yatas nīlasya grāhakam avasthāpyate niścaya pratyayena tasmāt sārūpyam anubhūtam vyavasthāpana hetuḥ niścaya pratyayena ca tat jñānam nīla saṃvedanam avasthāpyamānam vyavasthāpyam tasmāt asārūpya vyāvṛttyā sārūpyam jñānasya vyavasthāpana hetuḥ anīla bodha vyāvṛttyā ca nīla bodha rūpa tvam vyavasthāpyam

vyavasthāpakaḥ ca vikalpa pratyayaḥ pratyakṣa bala utpannaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ na tu nirvikalpaka tvāt pratyakṣam eva nīla bodha rūpa tvena ātmānam avasthāpayitum śaknoti niścaya pratyayena avyavasthāpitam sat api nīla bodha rūpam vijñānam asat kalpam eva tasmāt niścayena nīla bodha rūpam vyavasthāpitam vijñānam nīla bodha ātmanā sat bhavati

tasmāt adhyavasāyam kurvat eva pratyakṣam pramāṇam bhavati akṛte tu adhyavasāye nīla bodha rūpa tvena avyavasthāpitam bhavati vijñānam tathā ca pramāṇa phalam artha adhigama rūpam aniṣpannam atas sādhakatama tva abhāvāt pramāṇam eva na syāt jñānam janitena tu adhyavasāyena sārūpya vaśāt nīla bodha rūpe jñāne vyavasthāpyamāne sārūpyam vyavasthāpana hetu tvāt pramāṇam siddham bhavati

yadi eva madhyavasāya sahitam eva pratyakṣam pramāṇam syāt na kevalam iti ced na etat evam yasmāt pratyakṣa bala utpannena adhyavasāyena dṛśya tvena arthaḥ avasīyate na utprekṣita tvena darśanañca artha sākṣāt karaṇa ākhyam pratyakṣa vyāpāraḥ utprekṣaṇam tu vikalpa vyāpāraḥ tathā hi parokṣam artham vikalpayantaḥ utprekṣāmahe na tu paśyāmaḥ iti utprekṣa ātmakam vikalpa vyāpāram anubhavāt adhyavasyanti tasmāt sva vyāpāram tiraskṛtya pratyakṣa vyāpāram ādarśayati yatra arthe pratyakṣa pūrvakaḥ adhyavasāyaḥ tatra pratyakṣam kevalam eva pramāṇam iti

evam pratyakṣam vyākhyāya anumānam vyākhyātu kāmaḥ āha anumānam dvidhā dvi prakāram atha anumāna lakṣaṇe vaktavye kim akasmāt prakāra bhedaḥ kathyate ucyate para artha anumānam śabda ātmakam sva artha anumānam tu jñāna ātmakam tayoḥ atyanta bhedāt na ekam lakṣaṇam asti tatas tayoḥ pratiniyatam lakṣaṇam ākhyātum prakāra bhedaḥ kathyate prakāra bhedaḥ hi vyakti bhedaḥ vyakti bhede ca kathite prativyakti niyatam lakṣaṇam śakyate vaktum na anyathā tatas lakṣaṇa nirdeśa aṅgam eva prakāra bheda kathanam aśakyatām ca prakāra bheda kathanam antareṇa lakṣaṇa nirdeśasya jñātvā prāk prakāra bhedaḥ kathyate iti
kim punar tat dvaividhyam iti āha svasmāyidam sva artham yena svayam pratipadyate tat sva artham para smāyidam para artham yena param pratipādayati tat para artham

tatra tayoḥ sva artha para artha anumānayoḥ madhye sva artham jñānam kiṃviśiṣṭam iti āha trirūpāt iti trīṇi rūpāṇi yasya vakṣyamāṇa lakṣaṇāni tat trirūpam liṅgyate gamyate anenā arthaḥ iti liṅgam tasmāt trirūpāt liṅgāt yat jātam jñānam iti etat hetu dvāreṇa viśeṣaṇam tat trirūpāt ca liṅgāt trirūpa liṅga ālambanam api utpadyate iti viśinaṣṭi anumeyaḥ iti etat ca viṣaya dvāreṇa viśe ṣaṇam trirūpāt liṅgāt yat utpannam anumeya ālambanam jñānam tat sva artham anumānam iti
lakṣaṇa vipratipattim nirākṛtya phala vipratipattim nirākarttum āha pramāṇasya yat phalam tasya yā vyavasthā sā atra anumāne api pratyakṣaḥ iva pratyakṣa vat veditavyā
