yadi evam dvi candra tikta śarkarā ādi pratyayeṣu katham smṛti pramoṣaḥ āḥ kuṇḍaśekhara katham asakṛt abhihitam api na budhyase na sarvatra smṛteḥ eva pramoṣaḥ abhyupagamyate kintva khyātiḥ atas ca asau kathañcid kasya cit kvacid bhavati anubhava smṛtyoḥ viveka agrahaṇam kvacid kvacid tu smaryamāṇasya tathā tvena anupagrahaḥ dvidhā kṛtā kvacid vṛttiḥ netrasya timira ādinā na hi grahītum aikyena śaknoti śiśira tviṣam kvacid rasana saṃpṛkte pitte tikta tva vedanāt paricchettum na śaknoti mādhuryam śarkarā gatam gṛhṇāti yat tu tikta tvam vastutas pitta varti tat tathā tu na vijānāti nigiran eṣa śarkarām etena pīta śaṅkha ādi khyātayaḥ api vyākhyātāḥ

tat evam sati sarvatra samyak agrahaṇam bhramaḥ na mithyā pratyayaḥ kaścid asti śaṅkā nibandhanam ajāta mithyā āśaṅkaḥ ca na saṃvādam apekṣate tasmāt na kaścid paratas prāmāṇyam adhigacchati evam svatas pramāṇa tve siddhe vede api sā gatiḥ aṃpavāda dvaya abhāvaḥ vaktavyaḥ ca atra pūrvavat

atra pratividhīyate yat uktam idam rajata miti smaraṇa anubhava svabhāve vivekena āgṛhyamāṇe dve ete jñāne iti tat asāṃpratam pratyabhijñāvat eka tvena eva saṃvedyamāna tvāt yat eva idam puras avasthitam bhāsvara rūpa ādi adhikaraṇam dharmi sāmānyam tat eva rajatam iti viśeṣataḥ pratipādyate yat idam agratas sthitam tat rajatam iti satya rajata pratīti vat anubhūta tayā hi na rajatam atra prakāśate kintu anubhūyamāna tayā anubhūta tā grahaṇam ca smaraṇam ucyate na anubhūyamāna tā grahaṇam

sva prakāśā ca saṃvittiḥ iti bhavatām darśanam tatra eṣām rajata saṃvittiḥ kena rūpeṇa prakāśa tām iti cintyam yadi smaraṇa ātmanā kaḥ pramoṣa arthaḥ atha anubhava ātmanā tat iyam viparīta khyātiḥ eva smṛteḥ anubhava tvena śukteḥ iva rajata tvena pratibhāsāt

atha saṃvid mātra tayā eva prakāśate tat api na yuktam rajata viṣaya ullekhāt smaraṇa anubhava viśeṣa rahitāyāḥ ca viṣaya saṃvitteḥ anupapatteḥ na ca iyam apratipattiḥ eva iti vaktum ucitam mada mūrchā ādi daśa avisadṛśa sva prakāśa saṃvedana anubhavāt yathā idam iti aṃśe sva prakāśam saṃvedanam tathā eva rajatam iti atra api

api ca dvayoḥ ca aṃśayoḥ samāne saṃvedane tatra ekam pratyakṣa labdham aparam smaraṇa phalam iti kutastyaḥ vibhāgaḥ idam iti atra ca kim avabhāsate iti nirūpyatām yadi śukti kāśa kalam sakala svagata viśeṣa khacitam avabhāti tadā tad darśane sati rajata smaraṇasya kaḥ avasaraḥ bhavat api vā sādṛśya kṛtam smaraṇam na tad avivekāya kalpate devadatta darśana anantara udgata tad sadṛśa puruṣa antara smaraṇa vat

atha dharmi mātram idam iti pratyaye pratibhāti na śukti śakalam tat vāḍham iṣyate tat eva ca idam sāmānya dharma grahaṇa vaśa viruddha saṃskāra upanibandhana viruddha viśeṣa smaraṇa kāraṇakam idam rajatam iti sāmānya upakrame viśeṣa paryavasānam jñānam yat idam tat rajatam iti sāmānādhikaraṇya avamarśāt rajata anubhava abhimānena eva ca rajata arthī tatra pravartate

nanu smaraṇa anubhavayoḥ vivekam apratipadyamānaḥ pravartate iti uktam śrutam idam yat atra bhavadbhiḥ dharma kīrti gṛhāt āhṛtam dṛśya vikalpau arthau ekīkṛtya pravartate iti kiñca cauryam api idam na kathañcana sva artham puṣṇāti yāvat hi dṛśyam gṛhītam iti na jātaḥ pratyayaḥ tāvat katham dṛśya arthinaḥ tatra pravṛttiḥ evam iha api yāvat rajatam gṛhītam iti na jātaḥ pratyayaḥ tāvat kutas tad arthinām pravṛttiḥ tasmāt asti rajata grahaṇam na tu tad smaraṇa pramoṣa mātram

nanu rajata smaraṇam viparīta khyāti vādibhiḥ api aṅgīkṛtam iti uktam satyam rajata gata viśeṣa smaraṇam abhyupagatam yathā hi puras avasthite dharmiṇī ūrdhva tva ādi sādhāraṇa dharma grahaṇāt sthāṇu puruṣa gata viśeṣa agrahaṇāt ubhaya viśeṣa smṛteḥ saṃśayaḥ bhavati evam iha api tejasvi ta ādi sāmānya dharma grahaṇāt viśeṣa agrahaṇāt rajata gata viśeṣa smṛteḥ ca tasmin dharmiṇi rajata pratyayaḥ bhavati viparyaya ātmakaḥ saṃśaye hi ubhaya viśeṣa smaraṇam kāraṇam iha tu anyatara viśeṣa smaraṇam iti viśeṣaḥ atas eva ca agṛhīta rajatasya idam jñānam na utpadyate sadṛśa agrahaṇe vā niśītha ādau iti

na tu etāvatā smaraṇa mātram eva idam itīyati sthātavyam smaraṇa janyasya viparyaya pratyayasya api saṃvedanāt atas eva tad pṛṣṭha bhā vi parāmarśa vādinaḥ varam satya vācaḥ te hi pratibhāsam na nihnuvate

yat tu viparyaya avagateḥ kāraṇam vikalpitam tatra uktam eva prāmāṇikaiḥ kāryam ced avagamyeta kim kāraṇa parīkṣayā kāryam ced na avagamyeta kim kāraṇa parīkṣayā iti kārya akasmika tā anupapatteḥ ca kalpyatām kāraṇam tat ca kḷptam eva doṣa sahitam indriyam yathā saṃskāra sahakāri pratyabhijñāyām iti

suvate śālayaḥ duṣṭā na yadi api yava aṅkuram śāli kāryam tu apūpa ādi janayanti eva kalmaṣam tasmāt doṣa kalitāt indriyāt puras avasthita dharmi gata trikoṇa tva ādi viśeṣa avamarśa kauśala śūnyāt sāmānya dharma sahacarita padārtha antara gata viśeṣa smaraṇa upakṛtāt bhavati viparīta pratyayaḥ samyat jñāna apekṣayā ca tat duṣṭam ucyate sva kārye tu viparyaya jñāne tad kāraṇam eva na duṣṭam tasmāt rajatam iti anubhavaḥ eva na pramuṣita smṛtiḥ

api ca na idam rajatam iti bādhaka jñānam pūrva anubhava viṣayīkṛta rajata niṣedham adhigamayat utpadyate na idam rajatam iti yat aham adrākṣam tat rajatam na bhavati iti prasaktasya ca ayam niṣedhaḥ ananubhūtam tu aprasaktam api pratiṣidhyamānam rajatam iva kanakam api kim iti na pratiṣidhyate

yat tu vyākhyātam prāc anavagata smaraṇa anubhava viveka pratipādakam bādhaka jñānam iti tat vyākhyāna mātram eva tathā ananubhavāt na hi evam bādhakam utpadyateyat aviviktam tat viviktam iti atas yat kiñcid etat tasmāt na rajata smaraṇam rajate vā kadācid anubhavaḥ abhūt iti smaraṇam abhidhīyamānam na atyantam alaukikam

svapne tu sva śira cheda ādeḥ atyantān anubhūtasya smṛtiḥ iti kathyamānam eva trapākaram janma antare nijam asta kalavanam anubhūtam anena iti ced idam api subhāṣitataram yat janma antara anubhūtam smaryate tatra ca kutastyaḥ eṣa niyamaḥ yat kadācid eva smaryate na sarvadā sarvam iti
nanu bhavatā api asat khyātim nirasyatā svapna jñāneṣu tādṛkṣu kim vaktam yat vaktavyam tat tatra eva śroṣyasi asat na pratibhāti iti ucyate na tu ananubhūtam iti

nanu ananubhūtam sat katham jānīṣe sat iti ced jñānam tad anubhūtam iti mā evam mayā tat na anubhūtam anyena anubhaviṣyate para anubhūtam ca sat iti śakyate vaktum para anubhūte tu smaraṇam aghaṭamānam iti na āvayoḥ atra vastuni samāna yogakṣema tvam

api ca bhavat mate svapna smṛteḥ smṛti tvena agrahaṇe kena rūpeṇa grahaṇam iti cintyam rūpa antareṇa grahaṇe viparīta khyātiḥ sarva ātmanā tu agrahaṇe svapna suṣuptyoḥ avi śeṣa prasaṅgaḥ anubhava pratyayaḥ ca svapne saṃvedyate na smaraṇa anullekha mātram iti durabhi niveśaḥ eva smṛti pramoṣa samarthanam nāma iti

dvi candra ādi pratyayeṣu katham akhyātiḥ nanu uktam timira sīmanti tā nayana vṛttiḥ eka tvena gṛhītum na śaknoti śaśāṅkam iti bhoḥ śrotriya tādṛśī dṛśaḥ vṛttiḥ eka tvam indoḥ mā grahīt dvi tva anubhavam tu bhāntam kva pracchādayāmaḥ nanu cakṣuḥ vṛttau tad dvi tvam tad gata tvena tu yat tasya agrahaṇam saḥ eva bhramaḥ na etat evam netra vṛtteḥ sarvatra parokṣa tvāt kim eka candra bodhe api vṛtti eka tvam pratīyate iyam hi agṛhyamāṇā eva cakṣuḥ vṛttiḥ prakāśikā evam ucyamāne ca eka candra grahaṇe api vṛtti ekatva agrahaṇāt akhyātiḥ eva bhavet

yat api tiktaśarkarā ādi pratyayeṣu akhyāti samarthana ka dā āśayā pitta vṛtteḥ tikta tvasya saṃvedyamānasya tad sthatvena agrahaṇam upavarṇitam tat api kuśa kāśa avalambana prāyam mohāt pitta gata tvena tikta tā ced na gṛhyate mā grāhi śarkarāyām tu kiṃkṛtā tikta tā matiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena hi tiktā śarkarā iti tad adhikaraṇā tikta tā pratītiḥ upajāyate pittam tu indriya stham timira vat agṛhyamāṇam api bhramam upajanayati śarīra stham iva jvaram śiraḥ arti ādi rogam iti alam prasaṅgena

evam sarvatra na akhyātiḥ nirvahanti iva lakṣyate na ca etayā api paratas prāmāṇyam upahanyate rajate anubhavaḥ kim syāt uta pramuṣitā matiḥ dvaividhya darśanāt evam bhavet tatra api saṃśayaḥ saṃśayānaḥ ca saṃvādam nūnam anveṣate janaḥ tad apekṣā akṛtam tasmāt prāmāṇyam paratas dhruvam
na ca eṣa śūnya vādasya pratīkāra kriyā kramaḥ anartha jā hi nirdagdha pitṛ ādau bhavati smṛtiḥ dṛṣṭāntīkṛtya tām eva śūnya vādī samutthitaḥ bhrama apahnava mātreṇa pratihantum na śakyate

atha asti kācid paratas prāmāṇyasya niṣedhikā śūnya vādasya yā yuktiḥ sā eva vācyā kim etayā tasmāt yathārtham asyāḥ saṃśrayaṇam tat na niṣiddhamakhyāteḥ saṃvid virodhaḥ eva prakaṭitaḥ iti dhik pramādi tvam tat uktam kṛtaḥ ca śīla vidhvaṃsaḥ na ca anaṅgaḥ ca saṅgataḥ ātmā ca lāghavam nītaḥ tat ca kāryam na sādhitam iti

yat punar viparīta khyātau pakṣa trayam āśaṅkya dūṣitam tat api na yuktam astu tāvat ayam eva ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ rajatam ālambanam tat eva ca asyām pratītau parisphurati iti nanu atra coditam asat khyātiḥ eva sā bhavet iti na etat sādhu deśa antara ādau rajatasya vidyamāna tvāt asat khyāti pakṣe hi ekānta asataḥ arthasya pratibhānam aṅgīkriyate iha tu deśa antara ādau vidyamānasya iti mahān bhedaḥ

nanu tatra asataḥ arthasya kim deśa antara cintayā kim kurmaḥ tādṛśasya eva vastunaḥ khyāti darśanāt yaḥ tu deśa antare api arthaḥ na asti kāla antare api vā na tasya grahaṇam dṛṣṭam gagana indīvara ādi vat ayam eva ca dvayoḥ asattvayoḥ viśeṣaḥ yat ekasya grahaṇam dṛṣṭam itarasya na dṛṣṭam iti

nanu uktam tatra asataḥ arthasya katham jñāna janaka tvam ajanakasya vā katham pratibhāsaḥ uktam atra sadṛśa padārtha darśana udbhūta smṛti upasthāpitasya rajatasya atra pratibhāsanam iti na ca asya upasthāpanam paśoḥ iva rajvā saṃyamya ḍhaukanam api tu hṛdaye parisphurataḥ arthasya bahis avabhāsanam na ca etāvatā iyam ātma khyātiḥ asat khyātiḥ vā iti vaktavyam vijñānāt viccheda pratīteḥ atyanta asad artha pratibhāsā bhāvāt ca iti

athavā pihita sva ākārā parigṛhīta parākārā śuktikā eva atra pratibhāti iti bhavatu dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ nanu uktam kṛtyā sītā vat kim idam veśa bhāṣā parivartanam katham ca rajata jñāne śuktikā avabhāsitum arhati iti śrutam idam nāṭakam na tu vayam atra upahāsa pātram śuktikā iti vastu sthitiḥ eṣā kathyate puras avasthitam dharmi mātram bhāsvara rūpa ādi sādṛśya upajanita rajata viśeṣa smaraṇam atra pratibhāti iti brūmaḥ yat etat puras kim api vartate tat rajatam iti anubhavāt vastu sthityā tu śuktiḥ eva sā trikoṇa tva ādi viśeṣa grahaṇa abhāvāt ca nigūhita nija ākārā iti ucyate rajata viśeṣa smaraṇāt ca parigṛhīta rajata ākāra iti

etat ca viṣaya indriya ādi doṣa prabhaveṣu śuktikā rajata avabhāsa bhāskara kiraṇa jala avagama jalada gandharvanagara nirvarṇana rajju bhujaga grahaṇa rohiṇī ramaṇa dvaya darśana śaṅkha śarkarā pīta tikta tāvasāya keśa kūrcaka ālokana ādi vibhrameṣu abhyupagamyate manaḥ doṣa nibandhaneṣu tu mithyā pratyayeṣu nirālambaneṣu smṛti ullikhitaḥ eva ākāraḥ prakāśate iti

yaḥ tu tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ anyat ālambanam anyaḥ ca pratibhāti iti kaiścid āśritaḥ tatra api na sannihitasya ālambana tvam ucyate yena bhū pradeśasya api tathā atvam āśaṅkyeta na api janakasya ālambana tvam yat cakṣuḥ ādau api prasajyeta kintu idam iti aṅgulyā nirdiśyamānam karma tayā yat jñānasya janakam tad ālambanam iti ucyamāne na kaścid doṣaḥ

nanu keśoṇḍuka jñāne kim ālambana kāraṇam kiñcid tu timiram romarājiḥ iva nayana dhāmnaḥ madhye eva āste tena dvidhā kṛtā nayana vṛttiḥ dvi tvena candramasam gṛhṇāti kiñcid tu timiram tatra vivara vat antarā antarā tiṣṭhati cakṣuṣaḥ tena virala prasṛtāḥ nayana raśmayaḥ sūkṣmāḥ sūrya aṃśubhiḥ upahanyamānāḥ keśa kūrcaka ākārāḥ bhavanti iti tat eva ālambanam anudite astamite vā savitari keśoṇḍuka pratyayasya anutpādāt gandharvanagara jñāne jaladāḥ pāṇḍura tviṣaḥ ālambanam gṛha aṭṭala prakāra ākāra dhāriṇaḥ tasmāt viparīta khyātau pakṣa trayam api niravadyam

yaḥ punar itaretara saṅkaraḥ khyātīnām udāhāri tatra ātma khyāti akhyātī apavarga āhnike vayam api vijñānāt vaitam apākariṣyantaḥ parākariṣyāmaḥ iti kim tad cintayā viparīta khyātau tu tat sāṅkaryam parihṛtam

yat punar avādi sarva vādibhiḥ smṛti pramoṣaḥ abhyupagataḥ eva prābhākaraiḥ tuyaśaḥ pītam iti tatra vādi antarāṇi tāvat yathā bhavanti tathā bhavantu vayam tu smṛti upārūḍha rajata ādi ākāra pratibhāsam abhivadantaḥ bāḍham smṛti pramopam abhyupagatavantaḥ kintu na tāvatī eva viśrāmyati matiḥ api tu rajata ādi anubhavaḥ api saṃvedyate iti na smṛti pramoṣa mātraḥ eva virantavyam atas viparīta khyāti pakṣaḥ eva niravadyaḥ iti sthitam

yaḥ tu bādha prakāraḥ prāc vikalpitaḥ tatra saha anavasthāna saṃskāra uccheda ādi pakṣāḥ anabhyupagamena eva nirastāḥ iti asthāne kaṇṭha śoṣaḥ āyuṣmatā anubhūtaḥ viṣaya apahāraḥ tāvat astu bādhaḥ viṣayasya ca na pratibhāta tvam apahriyate kintu pratibhātasya asattvam khyāpyate iti apahāra arthaḥ asattvam api na idānīm upanatasya khyāpyate yena pūrva dṛṣṭaḥ draghaṇa bhagna kumbha abhāva pratibhāsa vat a bādhaḥ syāt na ca tadānīm api abhāva grahaṇe vastunaḥ dvi ātmaka tvam āśaṅkanīyam pūrva avagata ākāra upamarda dvāreṇa bādhaka pratyaya utpādāt yat mayā tadā rajatam iti gṛhītam tat rajatam na bhavati anyat eva tat vastu iti

nanu sva kāla niyata tvāt jñānānām katham uttarasya jñānasya pūrva jñāna utpāda kāla avacchinna tad viṣaya abhāva grahaṇa sāmarthyam kim kurmaḥ tathā pratyaya utpādāt na bhagna ghaṭa vat idānīm tat na astitāḥ gṛhyate api tu tadā eva tat asat iti pratītiḥ yathā ca na vartamāna eka niṣṭhāḥ eva viṣaya pratītayaḥ tathā kṣaṇa bhaṅga bhaṅge vakṣyāmaḥ

athavā phala apahāraḥ bhavatu bādhaḥ pramāṇa phala tvam ca hāna ādi buddhīnām pratyakṣa lakṣaṇe varṇitam iti tad apaharaṇāt pramāṇam bādhitam bhavati eva kiṃkurvatā bādhakena pramāṇa phalam apahṛtam iti ced gāyatā nṛtyatā vā api japatā juhvatā api vā tat ced kāryam kṛtam tena kim avāntara karmaṇā tad abhyupagame vā api tat kim vidadhatā kṛtam tat ca kim kurvata iti evam avadhiḥ kaḥ bhaviṣyati tad alam amunā avāntara praśnena sarvathā bādhaka pratyaya upajanane sati hāna ādi rūpam pūrva pramāṇa phalam nivartate iti tena tat bādhitam ucyate

samāna asamāna viṣaya vikalpaḥ api na peśalaḥ ekasmin viṣaye viruddha ākāra grāhiṇoḥ jñānayoḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāva abhyupagamāt citra ādi pratyaye katham na bādhaḥ iti ced pūrva jñāna upamardena uttara vijñāna anutpādāt atas eva ekatra api dharmiṇi bahūnām dharmāṇām itaretarān upamardena vedyamānānām asti eva samāveśaḥ

pūrva upamardena uttara vijñāna janmataḥ ca etat api pratyuktam bhavati yat uktam pūrvasmin pratyaye prāpta pratiṣṭhe satya āgantu jñānam uttaram bādhyatām iti yatas pūrva upamardena eva tad uttaram jñānam udeti viṣaya sahāya tvāt pramāṇa antara anugṛhyamāṇa tvāt ca uttaram eva jñānam bādhakam iti yuktam tasmāt asti jñānānām bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ sa ca ayam bādha vyavahāraḥ viparīta khyāti pakṣaḥ eva sāmarthyam askhalitam dadhāti iti saḥ eva jyāyān

ajñaḥ kaḥ api nāma mīmāṃsakaḥ tu āha yā iyam śuktikāyām rajata pratītiḥ viparīta khyātiḥ iti tad vādinām abhimatā sā tathā na bhavati iti satya rajata pratīti vat atra api avabhāsya rajata sadbhāvāt laukika alaukika tve tu viśeṣaḥ rajata jñāna avabhāsyam hi rajatam ucyate tat ca kiñcid vyavahāra pravartakam kiñcinnā iti tatra vyavahāra pravartakam laukikam ucyate tatas anyat alaukikam iti yat ca śukti kāśakalam iti bhavantaḥ badanti tat alaukikam rajatam rajata jñāna avabhāsya tvāt rajatam tat vyavahāra apravṛtteḥ alaukikam iti

tat etat aparāmṛṣṭa saṃvedana iti vṛttasya abhinava padārtha sarga prajāpateḥ abhidhānam bādhaka pratyayena tatra rajata abhāvasya khyāpanāt na idam rajatam iti hi rajatam pratiṣedhati eṣa pratyayaḥ na vidyamāna rajatasya alaukika tvam avadyotayati iti atha na idam laukikam iti vyākhyāyate hanta vākya śeṣaḥ kriyatām saṃyajatraiḥ aṅgāni itivat saḥ ayam śrotriyaḥ sva śāstra vartanīm iha api na tām tyajati na tu tasyāḥ ayam avasaraḥ agṛhyamāṇe tu rajata ākhye anya dharmiṇi katham tad dharma tvena laukika tvam gṛhyate rajata abhāva grahaṇe tu eṣa na doṣaḥ bhāva tad abhāvayoḥ dharma dharmi bhāva abhāvāt smaryamāṇa pratiyogi avacchinnaḥ hi abhāvaḥ gṛhyate eva tasmāt atra mā asti eva rajatam na punar ala ekikam tat asti
na ca rajata jñāna avabhāsya tva mātram rajata lakṣaṇam api tu abādhita rejata jñāna gamya tvam

api ca laukika alaukika pravibhāgaḥ pratibhāsa nibandhanaḥ vā syāt vyavahāra sat asadbhāva nibandhanaḥ vā na tāvat pratibhāsa nibandhanaḥ tathā pratīti abhāvāt kvacid hi rajatam kvacid ca tad abhāvaḥ pratīyate na tu laukika tvam alaukika tvam vā atha vyavahāra pravṛtti apravṛttibhyām laukika alaukika tve vyavasthā apyete tat vaktavyam kaḥ ayam vyavahāraḥ nāma iti jñāna abhidhāna svabhāvaḥ hi vyavahāraḥ sa ca tad viṣayaḥ na asti iti uktam tad artha kriyā nirvartanam vyavahāraḥ iti ced tarhi svapne parirabhyamāṇāyāḥ yoṣitaḥ kūṭa kārṣa āpaṇasya ca laukika tvam prāpnoti utpadya naṣṭe ghaṭe artha kriyāyāḥ nivṛtteḥ alaukika tvam syāt api ca yaḥ śuktikāyām rajata vyavahāram na karoti sa rajata abhāvam eva buddhvā na rajatasya sataḥ tasya alaukika tām

yadi ca idam alaukikam rajatam tat kimartham iha tad artha kriyā artham pravartate alaukikam laukika tvena gṛhītvā iti ced sā eva iyam tapasvinī viparīta khyātiḥ āyātā tasmāt viparīta khyāti dveṣeṇa kṛtam īdṛśā atra api loka siddhā eva pratītiḥ anugamyatām

na vā mīmāṃsakāḥ ete sva bhāryām api veśmataḥ nissārayitum icchanti svatas prāmāṇya tṛṣṇayā na ca evam api tad siddhiḥ buddhi dvaividhya darśanāt saṃśaye sati saṃvādasa apekṣa tvam tathā eva tat kleśena tad amunā api sva arthaḥ teṣām prasiddhyati na kaścid yat bhavati daiva gatyā rāja pathena eva tat bhavatu
na ātma khyātiḥ bāhya tayā artha pratibhāsāt na asat khyātiḥ na hi asatām dhī viṣaya tvam uktaḥ akhyātau dūṣaṇa mārgaḥ viparīta khyātiḥ tasmāt āśrayaṇīyā matimadbhiḥ

sthite ca tasmin viparīta vedane tadīya sādharmya kṛtaḥ asti saṃśayaḥ tadā ca saṃvāda mukha pratīkṣaṇāt bhajanti bodhāḥ paratas pramāṇa tām pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇānām tat yathā astu tathā astu vā śabdasya hi pramāṇa tvam paratas mukta saṃśayam

dṛṣṭe hi viṣaye prāmāṇya niścayam antareṇa eva laghu pariśrameṣu karmasu pravṛttiḥ iti tad upayogi pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇa prāmāṇya niścaye durupapāde kaḥ abhiniveśaḥ śabde punar adṛṣṭa puruṣa artha patha upadeśini prāmāṇyam aniniścatya mahā prayatna nirvartyāni jyotiṣṭoma ādīni na prekṣā pūrva kāriṇaḥ yajvānaḥ prayuñjīrat iti a vaśyam niścetavyam tatra prāmāṇyam tat ca paratas eva iti brūmaḥ

śabdasya vṛddha vyavahāra adhigata sambandha upakṛtasya sataḥ pratīti janaka tvam nāma rūpam avadhṛtam tat tu naisargika śakti ātmaka sambandha mahimnā vā puruṣa ghaṭita samaya sambandha valena vā iti vicārayiṣyāmaḥ prakāśaka tva mātram tu dīpa ādeḥ iva tasya rūpam yathā hi dīpaḥ prakāśamānaḥ śucim aśucim vā yathāsannitahitam artham avadyotayati tathā śabdaḥ api puruṣeṇa prayojyamānaḥ śravaṇa patham upagataḥ satye anṛte avā samanvite asamanvite vā sa phale niṣphale vā siddhe kārye vā arthe pramitim upajanayati iti tāvat eva asya rūpam ayam tu dīpāt śabdasya viśeṣaḥ yat eṣa sambandha vyutpattim apekṣamāṇaḥ pramām utpādayati iti dīpaḥ tu tad nirapekṣaḥ iti

tasyāḥ śabda janitāyāḥ pramiteḥ yathārtha itara tvam puruṣa darśana adhīnam samyak darśini śucau puruṣe sati satya arthā sā bhavati pratītiḥ itarathā tu tad viparītā iti tatra yathā naisargikam artha saṃsparśi tvam śabdasya rūpam iti samarthitam evam asya svābhāvikam satya artha tvam api na rūpam evam abhyupagamyamāne vipralambha kavacā asi visaṃvāda darśanam na bhavet tasmāt puruṣa guṇa doṣa adhīnau eva śābde pratyaye saṃvāda visaṃvādau

na ca indriya ādau iva tatra durbhaṇāḥ guṇāḥ rāga ādayaḥ doṣāḥ karuṇā ādayaḥ guṇāḥ puruṣāṇām atiprasiddhāḥ eva puruṣa guṇāḥ eva śabdasya guṇāḥ na sva śarīra saṃsthāḥ cakṣuḥ ādeḥ iva iti tatra yadi puruṣa guṇānām prāmāṇya kāraṇa tā na iṣyate doṣāṇām api viplava hetu tā mā bhūt

yat tu doṣa praśamana caritārthāḥ eva puruṣa guṇāḥ prāmāṇya hetavaḥ tu na bhavanti iti atra śapatha śaraṇāḥ eva śrotriyāḥ na ca bādha anutpatti mātreṇa vaidikyāḥ pratīteḥ prāmāṇyam bhavitum arhati pakṣmalākṣī lakṣam abhiramayet vidyādhara pada kāmaḥ iti ādau api prāmāṇya prasaṅgāt uktam ca kena cit yathā hi svapna dṛṣṭaḥ arthaḥ kaścid vīpa antara ādiṣu asaṃbhavat visaṃvādaḥ śraddhātum na eva śakyate tathā ca udanayā api artham bodhyamānam atīndriyam asaṃbhavat visaṃvādam na śraddadhati ke cana iti

tatra svapna jñāne hetuḥ nidrā ādi doṣaḥ asti iti duṣṭa kāraṇa jñānāt aprāmāṇyam iti ced lola akṣī lakṣa vākye kim vakṣyasi prabhavaḥ tasya na jñāyate iti ced na tarāmasau vede api tvad mate jñāyate iti kaḥ viśeṣaḥ mahā jana ādi parigrahaḥ asya na asti iti ced anveṣaṇīyam tarhi prāmāṇya kāraṇam na buddhi utpādaka tvāt eva autsargikam prāmāṇyam iti yuktam sākṣāt draṣṭṛ nara ukta tvam śabde yāvat na niścitam bādhā anutpatti mātreṇa na tāvat tad pramāṇa tā

yat api vede kāraṇa doṣa nirākaraṇāya kathyate yat vā vaktuḥ abhāvena na syuḥ doṣāḥ nirāśrayāḥ iti tat api asāṃpratam asati vaktari prāmāṇya hetūnām guṇānām api abhāvena tad prāmāṇyasya api abhāvāt na ca vede vaktuḥ abhāvaḥ su vacaḥ tathā hi etat eva tāvat vicārayāmaḥ kim vede vaktā vidyate na vā iti

nanu vede pramāṇa antara saṃsparśa rahita vicitra karma phala gata sādhya sādhana bhāva upadeśini katham tad artha sākṣāt darśī puruṣaḥ upadeṣṭā bhavet ucyate vedasya puruṣaḥ kartā na hi yādṛśa tādṛśaḥ kintu trailokya nirmāṇa nipuṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ sa devaḥ paramaḥ jñātā nitya ānandaḥ kṛpā anvitaḥ kleśa karma vipāka ādi parāmarśa vivarjitaḥ
atra āha kim brūṣe trailokya nirmāṇa nipuṇa matiḥ iti aho tava saralam ati tvam na hi tathāvidha puruṣa sadbhāve kiñcana pramāṇam asti
tathā hi īśvara sadbhāvaḥ na pratyakṣa pramāṇakaḥ na hi asau akṣa vijñāne rūpa ādiḥ iva bhāsate na ca mānasa vijñāna saṃvedyaḥ ayam sukha ādi vat yogi nām aprasiddha tvāt na tad pratyakṣa gocaraḥ
pratyakṣa pratiṣedhena tad pūrvakam apākṛtam anumānam anirjñāte tasmin vyāpti anupagrahāt

na ca sāmānyatas dṛṣṭam liṅgam asya asti kiñcana kṣiti ādīnām tu kārya tvam asiddham sudhiyaḥ prati śaila ādi sanniveśaḥ api na eṣa kartṛ anumāpakaḥ kartṛ pūrvaka kumbha ādi sanniveśa vilakṣaṇaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kartṛ avinābhāvī sanniveśaḥ hi yādṛśaḥ tādṛś naga ādau na asti iti kāryatva vat asiddha tā
siddha tve api na hetu tvam anaikāntyāt tṛṇādimiḥ akṛṣṭa jātaiḥ kartāram antareṇa āpta janmabhiḥ teṣām utpatti samaya pratyakṣa tvena labhyate kartuḥ dṛśya tvam api evam abhāvaḥ anupalabdhitaḥ
na ca kṣiti jala prāya dṛṣṭa hetu atirekiṇaḥ kasya api kalpanam teṣu yujyate ati prasaṅgataḥ tena kartuḥ abhāve api sanniveśa ādi darśanāt anaikāntika tā hetoḥ vipra tve puruṣa tva vat

kiñca vyāpti anusāreṇa kalpyamānaḥ prasiddhyati kulāla tulyaḥ kartā iti syāt viśeṣa viruddha tā vyāpāra vān a sarva jñaḥ śarīrī kleśa saṃkulaḥ ghaṭasya yādṛśaḥ kartā tādṛś eva bhavet bhuvaḥ viśeṣa sādhyatāyām vā sādhya hīnam nidarśanam kartṛ sāmānya siddhau tu viśeṣa avagatiḥ kutas

api ca sa śarīraḥ vā jaganti racayet īśvaraḥ śarīra rahitaḥ vā śarīram api ca tadīyam kāryam nityam vā bhavet sarvathā anupapattiḥ aśarīrasya kartṛ tvam dṛśyate na hi kasya cit dehaḥ api utpatti mānasya deha tvāt caitra deha vat kāryam api īśvara śarīram tat kartṛkam vā syāt īśvara antara kartṛkam vā tatra svayam nija śarīrasya nirmāṇam iti sāhasam kartṛ antara kṛte tasmin īśvara ānantyam āpatet bhavatu kaḥ doṣaḥ iti ced pramāṇa abhāvaḥ eva doṣaḥ ekasya api tāvat īśvasya sādhane paryākula tām gatāḥ kim punar anantānām
kiñca vyāpāreṇa vā kulāla ādiḥ iva kāryāṇi sṛjet īśvaraḥ icchā mātreṇa vā dvayam api durghaṭam vyāpāreṇa jagat sṛṣṭiḥ kutas yuga śataiḥ api tad icchām ca anuvartante na jaḍāḥ paramāṇavaḥ

api ca kim kim api prayojanam anusandhāya jagat sarge pravartate prajāpatiḥ evam eva vā niṣprayojanāyām pravṛttau aprekṣā pūrva kāri tvāt unmatta tulyaḥ asau bhavet pūrvaḥ api na asti pakṣaḥ avāpta sarva ānandasya rāga ādi rahita ātmanaḥ jagat ārabhamāṇasya na vidmaḥ kim prayojanam

anukampayā pravartate iti ced mā evam sargāt pūrvam hi niśśeṣa kleśa saṃsparśa varjitāḥ na asya muktāḥ iva ātmānaḥ bhavanti karuṇā āspadam parama kāruṇikānām api dussaha duḥkha dahana dandahyamāna manasaḥ jantūn abalokayatām udeti dayā na punar apavarga daśā vat aśeṣa duḥkha śūnyān iti karuṇā amṛta saṃsikta hṛdayaḥ vā jagat sṛjan katham sṛjati durvāra duḥkha prāgbhāra dāruṇam

atha kevalam sukha upabhoga prāyam jagat sraṣṭum eva na jānāti sṛṣṭam api vā na ciram avatiṣṭhate iti ucyate tat api acāru niratiśaya svātantrya si imani vartamānasya sva icchā anuvarti sakala padārtha sthiteḥ parameśvarasya krima sādhyam nāma bhavet
nānā ātma gata śubha aśubha karma kalāpa apekṣaḥ sraṣṭā prajāpatiḥ iti ced karmāṇi eva hi tarhi sṛjantu jaganti kim prajāpatinā

atha acetanānām cetanā anadhiṣṭhitānām sraṣṭṛ tvam aghaṭa mānam iti teṣām adhiṣṭhātā cetanaḥ kalpyate iti ced na tad āśrayāṇām ātmanām eva cetana tvāt te eva adhiṣṭhātāraḥ bhaviṣyanti kim adhiṣṭhā tṛ antareṇa īśvareṇa

tasya api tādṛśā parakīya karma antara apekṣā saṅkocita svātantryeṇa kim aiśvaryeṇa kāryam rājyam iva mantri para vaśam aiśvaryam kva upayujyate tādṛś yatra apara nirapekṣam rucyā eva na racyate abhimatam anyena api uktam kim īśvaratayā īśvaraḥ yadi na vartate sva icchayā na hi prabhavatām kriyā vidhiṣu hetuḥ anviṣyate iti

atha krīḍā arthāḥ jagat sarge bhagavataḥ pravṛttiḥ īdṛśā ca śubha aśubha rūpeṇa jagatā sṛṣṭena krīḍati parameśvaraḥ iti ucyate tarhi krīḍā sādhya sukha rahita tvena sṛṣṭeḥ pūrvam avāpta sakala ānanda tvam nāma tasya rūpam apa hīyeta na ca krīḍā api niśśeṣa jana tā aataṅka kāriṇī āyāsa bahulā ca iyam kartum yuktāḥ mahātmanaḥ tasmāt na jagatām nāthaḥ īśvaraḥ sraṣṭā saṃhartā api bhavati
na hi asya dhriyamāṇeṣu pūryate jantu karmasu sakṛt samasta trailokya nirmūlana manorathaḥ karma uparama pakṣe tu punar sṛṣṭiḥ na yujyate na karma nirapekṣaḥ hi sarga vaicitrya saṃbhavaḥ

atha brāhmeṇa mānena saṃvatsara śata niṣṭhām adhitiṣṭhati parameṣṭhini maheśvarasya saṃjihīrṣā jāyate tayā tirohita sva phala ārambha śaktīni karmāṇi saṃbhavanti iti saṃpadyate sakala bhuvana pralayaḥ punar ca tāvatī eva rātri prāye kāle vyatīte sisṛkṣā bhavati bhagavataḥ tayā abhivyakta śaktīni karmāṇi kāryam āranbhate iti tat api ayuktam udbhava abhibhavau teṣām syātām ced īśvara icchayā tarhi sā eva astu jagatām sarga saṃhāra kāraṇam

kim karmabhiḥ evam astu iticed na īśvara icchā vaśi tva pakṣe hi trayaḥ duratikramāḥ doṣāḥ tasya eva tāvat mahātmanaḥ niṣkaruṇa tvam akāraṇam eva dāruṇa sarga kāriṇaḥ tathā vaidikīnām vidhi niṣedha codanānām ānarthakyam īśvara icchātaḥ eva śubha aśubha phala upabhoga saṃbhavāt anirmokṣa prasaṅgaḥ ca muktāḥ api pralaya samayaḥ iva jīvāḥ punar īśvara icchayā saṃsareyuḥ tasmāt na īśvara adhīnaḥ jagatām sargaḥ saṃhāraḥ vā
iti anantara gītena nayena īśvara sādhane na anumānasya sāmarthyam upamāne tu kā kathā

agamasya api nityasya tat paratvam asāṃpratam tad praṇīte tu visraṃbhaḥ katham bhavatu mādṛśām kiñca āgamasya prāmāṇyam tad praṇīta tva hetukam tad prāmāṇyāt ca tad siddhiḥ iti anyonya āśrayam bhavet anyathā anupapattyā tu na śakyaḥ labdhum īśvaraḥ na hi tat dṛśyate kāryam tam vinā yat na siddhyati tasmāt sarva sat viṣaya pramāṇa an avagamyamāna svarūpa tvāt abhāvaḥ eva īśvarasya iti siddham

na ca prasiddhi mātreṇa yuktam etasya kalpanam nirmūla tvāt tathā ca uktam prasiddhiḥ vaṭa yakṣa vat atas eva nirīkṣya durghaṭam jagataḥ janma vināśa ḍambaram na kadācid anīdṛśam jagat kathitam nīti rahasya vedibhiḥ

atra vadāmaḥ yat tāvat idamagādi naga ādi nirmāṇa nipuṇa puruṣa pariccheda dakṣam pratyakṣam na bhavati iti tat evam eva pratyakṣa pūrvakam anumānam api tena eva pathā pratiṣṭhitam iti tat api āstām sāmānyatodṛṣṭam tu liṅgam īśvara sattāyām idam brūmahe pṛthivī ādi kāryam dharmi tad utpatti prakāra prayojana ādi abhijña kartṛ pūrvakam iti sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ kāryatvāt ghaṭa ādi vat

nanu kāryatvam asiddham iti uktam kaḥ evam ācaṣṭe cārvākaḥ śākyaḥ mīmāṃsakaḥ vā cārvākaḥ tāvat veda racanāyāḥ racanā antara vilakṣaṇāyāḥ api kāryatvam abhyupagacchati yaḥ sa katham pṛthvī ādi racanāyāḥ kārya tvam apahnuvīta mīmāṃsakaḥ api na kāryatvam apahnotum arhati yatas evam āha yeṣām api anavagata utpattīnām rūpam upalabhyate tantu vyatiṣakta janitaḥ ayam paṭaḥ tad vyatiṣaṅga vimocanāt tantu vināśāt vā naṅkṣyati iti kalpyate iti evam avayava saṃyoga nirvartyamāna vapuṣaḥ kṣitidhara ādeḥ api nāśa saṃpratyayaḥ saṃbhavati eva dṛśyate ca kvacid vināśa pratītiḥ prāvṛṣeṇya jala dhara dhārā sāra nirluṭhitaḥ eva parvata eka deśe parvatasya khaṇḍaḥ patitaḥ iti vastu gatayoḥ ca kāryatva vināśi tvayoḥ samavyāptika tā vārtika kṛtā api uktā eva tena yatra api ubhau dharmau vyāpya vyāpaka sammatau tatra api vyāpya tā eva syāt aṅgam na vyāpita amatiḥ iti vadatā tasmāt vināśi tvena api kāryatva anumānāt tad mate api na kārya tvam asiddham śākyaḥ api kāryatvasya katham asiddha tām abhidadhīta yena nityaḥ nāma padārthaḥ praṇaya keliṣu api na viṣahyate tasmāt sarva vādibhiḥ apraṇodyam pṛthivī ādeḥ kāryatvam
athavā sanniveśa viśiṣṭa tvam eva hetum abhidadhmahe yasmin pratyakṣataḥ upalabhyamāne sarva apalāpa lampaṭāḥ api na kecana vipratipattum utsahante tasmāt na asiddhaḥ hetuḥ

nanu kartṛ avinābhāvitayā yathāvidhasya sanniveśasya śarāva ādiṣu darśanam tādaśam eva sanniveśam upalabhya kvacid anupalabhyamāna kartṛke kalaśa ādau kartṛ anumānam iti yuktam ayam tu anyaḥ eva kalaśa ādi sanniveśāt parvata ādi sanniveśaḥ na atra sanniveśa sāmānyam kiñcid upalabhante laukikāḥ sanniveśa śabdam eva sādhāraṇam prayuñjate na ca vastunoḥ atyanta bhede sati śabda sādhāraṇa tā mātreṇa tad anumānam upapadyate na hi pāṇḍu tā mātra sādhāraṇa tvena dhūmāt iva kakkola rajaḥ rāśeḥ api kṛśānuḥ anumātum śakyate iti tat uktam siddham yādṛś adhiṣṭhātṛ bhāva abhāva anuvṛttimat sanniveśa ādi tat tasmāt yuktam yat anumīyate vastu bhede prasiddhasya śabda sāmyāt abhedinaḥ na yuktā anumitiḥ pāṇḍu dravyāt iva hutāśane iti

ucyate yādṛś iti na buddhyāmahe dhūmaḥ hi mahānase kumbha dāsī phūtkāra māruta sandhukṣyamāṇa manda jvalana janmā kṛśa prāya prakṛtiḥ upalabdhaḥ sa yadi parvate pravala samīraṇa ullasita hutavaha pluṣyamāṇa mahā mahīruha skandha indhana prabhavaḥ bahula bahulaḥ kha maṇḍalam akhilam ākrāman upalabhyate tat kim idānīm anala pramitim mā kārṣīt
atha viśeṣa rahitam dhūma mātram agni mātreṇa vyāptam avagatam iti tatas tad anumānam iha api sanniveśa mātram kartṛ mātreṇa vyāptam iti tatas api tad anumīyatām

nanu sanniveśa śabda mātra sādhāraṇyam atra na vastu sāmānyam kiñcid asti bhikṣaḥ dhūmaḥ api bhavat darśane kim vastu sāmānyam asti mā bhūt vastu sāmānyam ākāśa kāla ādi vyāvṛtti rūpam tu saṃvyavahāra kāraṇam asti eva hanta tarhi prakṛte api asanniveśa vyāvṛtti rūpam bhavatu sāmānyam ākāśa kāla ādi vilakṣaṇa rūpa tvāt pṛthivī ādeḥ
nanu tatra dhūmaḥ dhūmaḥ iti anuvṛtta vikalpa balena kalpitam apoha svabhāvam sāmānyam abhyupagatam iha api sanniveśa vikalpa anuvṛtteḥ tvad prakalpitam apoha rūpam eva sāmānyam iṣyatām

apica sa kartṛka tva abhimateṣu api saṃsthāneṣu na sarva ātmanā tulya tvam pratīyate na hi ghaṭa saṃsthānam catur śāla saṃsthānam ca su sadṛśam iti saṃsthāna sāmānyam tu parvata ādau api vidyate eva iti sarvathā yādṛś itya vācakaḥ granthaḥ
yat api vyabhicāra udbhāvanam akṛṣṭa jātaiḥ sthāvara ādibhiḥ akāri tat api na cāru teṣām pakṣīkṛta tvāt pakṣeṇa ca vyabhicāra codanāyām sarva anumāna uccheda prasaṅgaḥ

nanu ca pṛthivī ādeḥ utpatti kālasya parokṣa tvāt kartā na dṛśyate iti tad anupalabdhyā tad asattva niścaya anupapatteḥ kāmam saṃśayaḥ astu vanaspati prabhṛtīnām tu prasava kāla madya tvena vayam evapaśyāmaḥ na ca yatnataḥ api anveṣamāṇāḥ kartāram eṣām upalabhāmahe tasmāt asau dṛśya anupalabdheḥ na asti eva iti avagacchāmaḥ
api ca yena yena vayam vyabhicāram udbhāvayiṣyāmaḥ tam tam ced pakṣīkariṣyati bhavān sutarām anumāna ucchedaḥ savyabhicārāṇām api evam anumāna tva anapāyāt

ucyate sthāvarāṇām utpatti kāla pratyakṣa tve api kartuḥ adṛśya tvam eva aśarīra tva niścayāt aśarīrasya tarhi tad utpattau avyāpriyamāṇa tvāt kartṛ tvam api katham iti ced etat agratas nirṇeṣyate adṛśyasya ca kartuḥ anupalabdhitaḥ na astitva niścaya anupapatteḥ na ākṛṣṭa jāta banaspatīnām akartṛka tvam iti na vipakṣatā

yat tu uktam paridṛśyamāna kṣiti salila ādi kāraṇa kārya tvāt sthāvarāṇām kim adṛśyamāna kartṛ kalpanayā iti tad apeśalam para loka vādibhiḥ adṛśyamānānām karmaṇām api kāraṇa tva abhyupagamāt bārhaspatyānām tu tad samarthanam eva samādhiḥ

atha jagat vaicitryam karma vyatirekeṇa na ghaṭataḥ iti karmaṇām adṛśyamānānām api kāraṇa tvam kalpyate tatra yadi evam acetanebhyaḥ kārakebhyaḥ cetana anadhiṣṭhitebhyaḥ kārya utpāda anupapatteḥ kartā api cetanaḥ teṣām adhiṣṭhātā kalpyatām tasmāt sthāvarāṇām akartṛka tva abhāvāt na vipakṣata iti na taiḥ vyabhicāraḥ

yat api uktam yena yena vyabhicāraḥ udbhāvyate sa ced pakṣe antar bhāvayiṣyate kaḥ idānīm anumānasya niyamaḥ iti etat api na sādhu yadi hi bhavān niścite vipakṣe vṛttim upadarśayet kaḥ tam pakṣe antar bhāvayet na hi vipra tve puṃstvasya nityatāyām vā prameya tvasya vyabhicāre codyamāne vedhasā api vipakṣaḥ pakṣīkartum śakyaḥ vādī icchayā vastu vyavasthāyāḥ abhāvāt iha tu sthāvara ādau kartṛ abhāva niścayaḥ na asti iti uktam

nanu sthāvareṣu pakṣīkṛteṣu api vyabhicāraḥ na nivartate eva na hi sa pakṣa vipakṣa vyatirekeṇa tāttvikaḥ pakṣaḥ nāma kaścid asti vastunaḥ dvairūpya anupapatteḥ vastu sthityā sa kartṛkāḥ ced vanaspati prabhṛtayaḥ sa pakṣāḥ eva te no ced tarhi vipakṣāḥ eva na rāśi antaram samasti iti ucyate pakṣa abhāve sa pakṣa vipakṣa vācaḥ yuktiḥ eva tāvat kim apekṣā pakṣa anukūlaḥ hi sa pakṣaḥ ucyate tad pratikūlaḥ ca vipakṣaḥ iti

yadi evam vaktavyam tarhi kaḥ ayam pakṣaḥ nāma iti sādhya dharma anvita tvena dvābhyām api avadhāritaḥ sa pakṣaḥ tad abhāvena niścitasya vipakṣatā vimataḥ yatra tu tayoḥ tam pakṣam saṃpracakṣmahe vastunaḥ dvi ātmaka tvam tu na anumanyāmahe vayam vādi buddhi anusāreṇa sthitiḥ pakṣasya yadi api tathā api vyavahāraḥ asti vastutas tad nibandhanaḥ sandigdhe hi nyāyaḥ pravartate na anupalabdhe na nirṇītaḥ iti uktam etat sandihyamānaḥ eva ca arthaḥ pakṣaḥ ucyate kiñcid kālam tasya pakṣa tvam yāvat nirṇayaḥ na utpannaḥ tad utpāde tu nūnam sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ anyataratra anupravekṣyati asau atas ca pakṣa avasthāyām tena vyabhicāra udbhāvanam asamīcīnam

nanu niścita vipakṣa vṛttiḥ iva sandigdha vipakṣa vṛttiḥ api na hetuḥ eva tat evam vīrudha ādiṣu sandigdhe api kartari sanniveśasya darśanāt ahetutvam na etat sāram sat asat pāvaka tayā parvate sandigdhe vipakṣe vartamānasya dhūmasya ahetu tva prasaṅgāt sarve eva ca sādhya aṃśa saṃśayāt vipakṣāḥ eva jātāḥ iti pakṣa vṛttayaḥ hetavaḥ idānīm vipakṣa gāminaḥ bhaveyuḥ iti anumāna ucchedaḥ

atha pakṣīkṛte api dharmiṇi sat asat sādhyadheḥ matayā sandigdhe api vartamānaḥ dhūma ādiḥ anyatra vyāpti niścayāt gamakaḥ iṣyate tarhi sat asat kartṛka tayā sandigdhe api vasundharā vanaspati ādau vartamānam kāryatvam anyatra vyāpti niścayāt gamakam iṣyatām viśeṣaḥ vā vaktavyaḥ

anye manyante kim akṛṣṭa jāta sthāvara ādi vyabhicāra sthāna anveṣaṇena pṛthivī ādibhiḥ eva atra vyabhicāraḥ asya vyāpti grahaṇasya pratighātāt vyāptiḥ hi gṛhyamāṇā sakala sapakṣa vipakṣa kroḍīkāreṇa gṛhyate ittham ca tasyām gṛhyamāṇāyām eva yat yat sanniveśa viśiṣṭam tat tad buddhimat kartṛkam iti asmin eva avasare sanniveśavantaḥ api kartṛ śūnya tayā śaila ādayaḥ cetasi sphuranti yathā kṛtaka tvena bahneḥ anuṣṇa tā anumāne yat yat kṛtakam tat tad anuṣṇam iti vyāpti pariccheda velāyām eva vahniḥ uṣṇaḥ api kṛtakaḥ iti hṛdaya patham avatarati tat varjam tu vyāptau gṛhyamāṇāyām tatas hetoḥ ṣaṇḍāt iva putra jana nam aghaṭa mānam eva sādhya anumānam iti

tat etat anupapannam viśeṣa ullekha rahita sāmānya mātra pratiṣṭhitasya vyāpti paricchedasya anumāna lakṣaṇe nirṇīta tvāt agni anuṣṇa tā anumāne hi na vyāpti grahaṇa pratīghātāt aprāmāṇyam api tu pratyakṣa virodhāt iti uktam etat

api ca ayam pṛthivī ādau kartṛ anumāna nirāsa prakāraḥ śabda ādi upalabdhayaḥ karaṇa pūrvikāḥ kriyā tvāt chidi kriyā vat iti atra śrotra ādi karaṇa anumāne api samānaḥ pratibandha avadhāraṇa velāyām eva karaṇa śūnyānām śabda ādi upalabdhi kriyāṇām avadhāraṇāt tābhiḥ eva vyabhicārāt pakṣeṇa ca pṛthivī ādinā vyabhicāra codanam atyantam alaukikam

nanu vastu sthityā parvata ādayaḥ api vipakṣāḥ eva tvayā tu teṣām pakṣaḥ iti nāma kṛtam na ca tvad icchayā vastu sthitiḥ viparivartate nanu evam śabda ādi upalabdhayaḥ api vastu sthityā vipakṣāḥ eva tāsām api pakṣaḥ iti nāmakaraṇam eva syāt na tāsām karaṇa abhāva niścaya anutpādāt na vipakṣa tvam parvata ādau api kartṛ abhāva niścaya anutpādāt na vipakṣa tvam

teṣu kartā na upalabhyate iti ced śabda ādi upalabdhika mapi na upalabhyate eva karaṇam adṛśyamāna tvāt eva na upalabhyate na nāstitvāt iti ced kartā api adṛśya tvāt eva na upalabhyate na nāstitvāt anumānāt karaṇam upalabhyate tad vyatirekeṇa kriyā anupapatteḥ iti ced kartā api anumānāt upalapsyate kartāram antareṇa kārya anupapatteḥ

tena anumāna gamya tvāt na kartuḥ na astita āgrahaḥ tad abhāvāt vipakṣa tvam kṣiti ādeḥ api durbhaṇam liṅgāt pūrvam tu sandehaḥ dahane api na vāryate tathā sati prapadyeta dhūmaḥ api ananumāna tām atha asya liṅga ābhāsa tvam kṣiti ādau kartṛ adarśanāt dhūme api liṅga ābhāsa tvam tatra deśe agni adarśanāt nanu tam deśam āsādya gṛhyate dhūma lāñchanaḥ anayā eva dhiyā sādho vardhasva śaradām śatam yat paścāt darśanam tena kim liṅgasya pramāṇa tā anarthi tvāt adṛṣṭe vā kṛśānau kim kariṣyasi tasmāt sarvathā na ayam anaikāntikaḥ hetuḥ

yat api viśeṣa viruddha tvam asya pratipā tat api asamīkṣita abhidhānam viśeṣa viruddhasya hetvābhāsasya abhāvāt abhyupagame vā sarva anumāna uccheda prasaṅgāt śrotra ādi anumāne api yathā udāhṛte śakyam evam abhidhātum yādṛś eva lavana kriyāyām dātṛ ādi karaṇam kāṭhinya ādi dharmakam avagatam tādṛś eva śrotra ādi syāt tad vilakṣaṇa karaṇa sādhyatāyām tu sādhya vikalaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ chedana ādi kriyāṇām atīndriya karaṇa kārya tva adarśanāt iti

atha kriyā mātram karaṇa mātreṇa vyāptam avagatam iti tāvat mātram anumāpayati tat iha api sanniveśa mātram adhiṣṭhātṛ mātreṇa vyāptam upalabdham iti tāvat mātram eva anumāpayatu viśeṣāṇām tu na tat liṅgam asti yatra bādhakam anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt iti ayam api śrāvaṇa tva ādi śabdasya viśeṣa jātam bādhataḥ eva dhūmaḥ api parvata agni viśeṣān kāṃścid mahānasa agnau adṛṣṭān apahanti eva tasmāt yathā nirdiṣṭa sādhya viparyaya sādhanam eva viruddhaḥ hetuḥ na hi viśeṣa viparyaya āvahaḥ prakṛta hetuḥ ca sādhya viparyayasya akartṛ pūrvaka tvasya na sādhakaḥ aśvaḥ ayam viṣāṇi tvāt iti vat tasmāt na viruddhaḥ
na api kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ pratyakṣa āgamayoḥ bādhakayoḥ adarśanāt pratyuta āgamam anugrāhakam iha udāhariṣyāmaḥ
na api sat pratipakṣaḥ ayam hetuḥ saṃśaya bījasya viśeṣa agrahaṇa ādeḥ iha hetu tvena anupādānāt

na api ayama prayojakaḥ hetuḥ yathā paramāṇūnām anitya tve sati mūrta tvam abhidhāsyate na hi mūrta tva prayuktam anitya tvam iha tu kāryatva prayuktam eva sa kartṛka tvam tatra tatra upalabdham iti atas eva anumāna virodhasya iṣṭa vighāta kṛtaḥ ca na kaścid iha avasaraḥ prayojake hetau prayukte tathāvidha pāṃsu prakṣepa prayoga anavakāśāt tasmāt para udīrita aśeṣa doṣa vikala kārya anumāna mahimnā nūnam īśvaraḥ kalpanīyaḥ sakala loka sākṣikam api ca anumāna prāmāṇyam api īkṣaṇīyam anumāna prāmāṇya rakṣaṇe ca kṛtaḥ eva parikara bandhaḥ prāk iti siddhaḥ eva īśvaraḥ

anyat api tad anumānam anyaiḥ uktam mahābhūta ādi vyaktam cetanā adhiṣṭhitam sat sukha duḥkhe janayati rūpa ādimat tvāt tūrya ādi vat tathā pṛthivī ādīni bhūtāni cetanā adhiṣṭhitāni santi dhāraṇa ādi kriyām kurvanti yugi ādi vat iti atra api doṣāḥ pūrvavat eva parihartavyāḥ

yat punar avādi kartṛ sāmānya siddhau vā viśeṣa avagatiḥ kutas iti tatra kecid āgamāt viśeṣa pratipattim āhuḥ viśvatas cakṣuḥ uta viśvatas mukhaḥ viśvatas bāhuḥ uta viśvataspād saṃbāhubhyām dhamati saṃpatatraiḥ dyāvābhūmī janayan devaḥ ekaḥ iti tathā apāṇi pādaḥ javanaḥ gṛhītā paśyati acakṣuḥ sa śṛṇoti akarṇaḥ sa vetti sarvam na hi tasya vettā tam āhuḥ agryam puruṣam mahāntam iti śrutau paṭhyate tatas sarvasya kartā sarvajñaḥ īśvaraḥ jñāpyate

na ca kāryaḥ eva arthe vedāḥ pramāṇam iti mantra arthavādānām atatparatvam abhidhātum ucitam kāryaḥ iva siddhe api arthe veda prāmāṇyasya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt na ca itaretara āśrayam āgama eka śaraṇa tva abhāvāt īśvara siddheḥ

anye tu anvaya vyatireki hetu mūla kevala vyatireki balena viśeṣa siddhim abhidadhati deha ādi vyatirikta ātma kalpanam iva sukha duḥkha ādi gatena kāryatvena varṇayiṣyate pṛthivī ādi kāryam asmad ādi vilakṣaṇa sarvajña eka kartṛkam asmad ādiṣu bādhaka utpattau satyām kārya tvāt iti

apare pakṣa dharma tā balāt eva viśeṣa lābham abhyupagacchanti na hi īdṛśam paridṛśyamānam aneka rūpam aparimitam ananta prāṇi gata vicitra sukha duḥkha sādhanam bhuvana ādi kāryam anatiśayena puṃsā kartum śakyam iti yathā candana dhūmam itara dhūma visadṛśam avalokya candanaḥ eva vahniḥ anumīyate tathā vilakṣaṇāt kāryāt vilakṣaṇaḥ eva kartā anumāsyate

yathā prāvarakebhyaḥ iva tat kuśalaḥ kuvindaḥ yathā ca kulālaḥ sakala kalaśa ādi kārya kalāpa utpatti saṃvidhāna prayojana ādi abhijñaḥ bhavan tasya kārya cakrasya kartā tathā iyatas trailokyasya niravadhi prāṇi sukha duḥkha sādhanasya sṛṣṭi saṃhāra saṃvidhānam sa prayojanam bahu śākham jānan eva sraṣṭā bhavitum arhati maheśvaraḥ tasmāt sarvajñaḥ

api ca yathā niyata viṣaya vṛttīnām cakṣuḥ ādi indriyāṇām adhiṣṭhātā kṣetrajñaḥ tad apekṣayā sarvajñaḥ evam sakala kṣetrajña karma viniyogeṣu prabhavan i īśvaraḥ tad apekṣayā sarvajñaḥ tathā ca āha vyāsaḥ dvau imau puruṣau loke kṣaraḥ ca akṣaraḥ eva ca kṣaraḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭasthaḥ akṣaraḥ ucyate uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ tu anyaḥ paramātmā iti udāhṛtaḥ yaḥ lokatrayam āviśya vibharti avyayaḥ īśvaraḥ mantraḥ ca tad artha anuvādī paṭhyate dvā suparṇā sa yujā sakhāyā samānam vṛkṣam pariṣasvajāte tayoḥ anyaḥ pippalam svādu atti anaśnan anyaḥ abhicākaśīti iti atas ca sarvajñaḥ īśvaraḥ

puṃsām asarva vid tvam hi rāga ādi mala bandhanam na ca rāga ādibhiḥ spṛṣṭaḥ bhagavān iti sarva vid iṣṭa aniṣṭa artha saṃbhoga prabhavāḥ khalu dehinām rāga ādayaḥ katham te syuḥ niti ānanda ātmake śive mithyājñāna mūlāḥ ca rāga ādayaḥ doṣāḥ te katham nitya nirmala jñānavatī īśvare bhaveyuḥ

nityam tat jñānam katham iti ced tasmin kṣaṇam api ajñātari sati tad icchā preryamāṇa karma adhīna nānā prakāra vyavahāra virama prasaṅgāt pralaya velāyām tarhi kutas tad nitya tva kalpanā iti ced mā evam āpralayāt siddhe nitya tve tadā vināśa kāraṇa abhāvāt asya ātmanaḥ iva tat jñānasya nitya tvam setsyati punar ca sarga kāle tad utpatti kāraṇa abhāvāt api nityam jñānam

evañca tad atīta anāgata sūkṣma vyavahita ādi samasta vastu viṣayam na bhinnam krama yaugapadya vikalpa anupapatteḥ krama āśrayaṇe kvacid ajñātṛ tvam syāt iti vyavahāra lopaḥ yaugapadyena sarvajñātṛ tve kutastyaḥ jñāna bhedaḥ
pratyakṣa sādharmyāt ca tat jñānam pratyakṣam ucyate na punar indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna tvam asya asti ajanakānām eva arthānām savitṛ prakāśena iva tena grahaṇāt

jñāna vat anye api ātma guṇāḥ ye asya santi te nityāḥ eva manassaṃyoga an apekṣa janma tvāt duḥkha dveṣāḥ tasya tāvat na santi eva bhāvanā ākhyena saṃskāreṇa api na prayojanam sarvadā sarva artha darśi tvena smṛti abhāvāt atas eva na tasya anumānikam jñānam iṣyate dharmaḥ tu bhūta anugrahavataḥ vastu svābhāvyāt bhavat na vāryate tasya ca phalam para artha niṣpattiḥ eva sukham tu asya nityam eva nitya ānanda tvena āgamāt pratīteḥ asukhitasya ca evaṃvidha kārya ārambha yogya tā abhāvāt

nanu jñāna ānanda vat icchā api nityā ced īśvarasya tarhi sarvadā tad icchā sambhavāt sarvadā jagat utpattiḥ iti jagat ānanti aprasaṅgaḥ sarga icchā nitya tvāt ca saṃhāraḥ na prāpnoti saṃhāra icchāyāḥ api nitya tva abhyupagamena naktaṃdinam pralaya prabandhaḥ na viramet eva jagatām iti na eṣa doṣaḥ anātma mana ssaṃyoga ja tvāt icchā sva rūpa mātreṇa nityā api kadācid sargeṇa kadācid saṃhāreṇa vā viṣayeṇa anurajyate sarga saṃhārayoḥ antarāle tu jagataḥ sthiti avasthāyām asmāt karmaṇaḥ idam asya saṃpadyatām iti icchā bhavati prajāpateḥ prayatnaḥ tasya sa kalpa viśeṣa ātmakaḥ eva tathā ca āgamaḥ satyakāmaḥ satya saṅkalpaḥ iti kāmaḥ iti icchā ucyate saṃkalpaḥ iti prayatnaḥ

tat evam navabhyaḥ ātma guṇebhyaḥ pañca jñāna sukha icchā prayatna dharmāḥ santi īśvare catvāraḥ tu duḥkha dveṣa adharma saṃskārāḥ na santi iti ātma viśeṣa aiva īśvaraḥ na dravya antaram āha ca patañjaliḥ klaśa karma vipāka āśayaiḥ aparāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣa viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ iti saḥ ayam āgamāt anumānāt pakṣa dharmataḥ vā viśeṣa lābhaḥ iti sthitam
yat punar vikalpitam sa śarīraḥ īśvaraḥ sṛjati jagat aśarīraḥ vā iti tatra aśarīrasya eva sraṣṭṛ tvam abhyupagacchāmaḥ

nanu kriyā aaveśa nibandhanam kartṛ tvam na pāribhāṣikam tat aśarīrasya kriyā virahāt katham bhavet kasya ca kutra aśarīrasya kartṛ tvam dṛṣṭam iti ucyate jñāna cikīrṣā prayatna yogi tvam kartṛ tvamā cakṣate tat ca īśvare vidyate eva iti uktam etat sva śarīra preraṇe ca dṛṣṭam aśarīrasya api ātmanaḥ kartṛ tvam
icchā mātreṇa ca tasya kartṛ tvāt aneka vyāpāra nirvartana upātta durvaha kleśa kāluṣya vikalpaḥ api pratyuktaḥ

nanu atra uktam kulāla vat ca na etasya vyāpāraḥ yadi kalpyate acetanaḥ katham bhāvaḥ tad icchām anuvartate iti asmābhiḥ api uktam eva yathā hi acetanaḥ kāyaḥ ātmā icchām anuvartate tad icchām anuvartsyante tathā eva paramāṇavaḥ

yaḥ tu prayojana vikalpaḥ kimartham sṛjati jaganti bhagavān iti saḥ api na peśalaḥ svabhāvaḥ eva eṣa bhagavataḥ yat kadācid sṛjati kadācid ca saṃharati viśvam iti katham punar niyata kāle eṣaḥ asya svabhāvaḥ iti ced ādityam paśyatu devānāṃpriyaḥ yaḥ niyata kālam udetyaḥ tam eti ca prāṇi karma sāpekṣam etat vivasvataḥ rūpam iti ced īśvare api tulyaḥ samādhiḥ
krīḍā arthe api jagat sarge na hīyeta kṛtārtha tā pravartamānāḥ dṛśyante na hi krīḍāsu duḥkhitāḥ
athavā anukampayā eva sarga saṃhārau ārabhatām īśvaraḥ
nanu atra coditam na tathāvidhāḥ prāṇinaḥ anukampyāḥ bhavanti kevala sukha svabhāvā vā sṛṣṭiḥ anukampāvatā kriyeta iti satyam coditam anupapannam tu anādi tvāt saṃsārasya

śubha aśubha saṃskāra anuviddhāḥ eva ātmānaḥ te ca dharma adharma nigaḍa saṃyata tvāt apavarga pura dvāra praveśam alabhamānāḥ katham na anukampyāḥ anupabhukta phalānām karmaṇām na prakṣayaḥ sargam antareṇa ca tad phala upabhoga asaṃbhavaḥ iti śubha phala upabhogāya svarga ādi sargam aśubha phala upabhogāya naraka ādi sṛṣṭim ārabhate dayāluḥ eva bhagavān upabhoga prabandhena pariśrāntānām antarā antarā viśrāntaye jantūnām bhuvana upasaṃhāram api karoti iti sarvam etat kṛpā nibandhanam eva

nanu ca yugapad eva sakala jagat pralaya karaṇam anupapannam avināśinām karmaṇām phala upabhoga pratibandha asaṃbhavāt iti coditam na yuktam etat īśvara icchā pratibaddhānām karmaṇām stimita śaktīnām avasthānāt tad icchā preritāni karmāṇi phalam ādadhati tad icchā pratibaddhāni ca tatra udāsate kasmāt evam iti ced acetanānām cetanā anadhiṣṭhitānām sva kārya karaṇa anupalabdheḥ

nanu teṣām eva karmaṇām kartāraḥ ātmānaḥ cetanāḥ adhiṣṭhātāraḥ bhaviṣyanti yathā āha bhaṭṭaḥ karmabhiḥ sarva jīvānām tad siddheḥ siddha sādhanam iti na etat evam na ete adhiṣṭhātāraḥ bhavitum arhanti bahu tvāt viruddha abhiprāya tvāt ca tathā hi ekaḥ eva kaścid sthāvara ādi viśeṣaḥ rāja ādi viśeṣaḥ vā prāṇi koṭīnām anekavidha sukha duḥkha upabhogasya hetuḥ sa taiḥ bahubhiḥ avyavasthita abhiprāyaiḥ katham ārabheta teṣām ekatra saṃmāna abhāvāt maṭha pariṣadaḥ api kvacid eva sakala sādhāraṇa upakāriṇi kārye bhavati aikamatyam na sarvatra mahā prāsāda ādi a āraṃbhe bahūnām takṣa ādīnām ekasthapati āśaya anuvarti tvam dṛśyate pipīlikānām api mṛd kūṭa karaṇe tulyaḥ kaścid upakāraḥ pravartakaḥ sthapati vat ekāśaya anuvarti tvam vā kalpyam iha tu tad sthāvaram śarīram keṣāñcit upakāra kāraṇam itareṣām api bhūyasā ām apakāra kāraṇam iti katham taiḥ saṃbhūya sṛjyate anadhiṣṭhitānān tva cetanānām ārambhaka tvam ayuktam eva tasmāt avaśyam ekaḥ teṣām karmaṇām adhiṣṭhātā kalpanīyaḥ yat icchām antareṇa bhavanti api karmāṇi na phala janmane prabhavanti

atas eva ekaḥ īśvaraḥ iṣyate na dvau bahavaḥ vā bhinna abhiprāya tayā loka anugraha upaghāta vaiśasa prasaṅgāt icchā visaṃvāda saṃbhavena ca tatas kasya cit saṅkalpa vighāta dvārakān aiśvarya prasaṅgāt iti ekaḥ eva īśvaraḥ tad icchayā karmāṇi kāryeṣu pravartante iti upapannaḥ sargaḥ tad icchā pratibandhāt stimita śaktīni karmāṇi udāsate iti upapannaḥ pralayaḥ
evañca yat uktam tasmāt adyavat eva atra sarga pralaya kalpanā samasta kṣaya janmabhyām na siddhi ati apramāṇikāḥ iti etat api asāṃpratam

tiṣṭhatu vā sarga pralaya kālaḥ adyatve api yathā ukta nayena tad icchām antareṇa prāṇinām karma vipāka anupapatteḥ avaśyam īśvaraḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ itarathā sarva vyavahāra vipralopaḥ tat uktam ajñaḥ jantuḥ anīśaḥ ayam ātmanaḥ sukha duḥkhayoḥ īśvara preritaḥ gacchet svargam vā śvabhram eva vā iti

nanu evam tarhi īśvara icchā eva bhavatu kartrī saṃhartrī ca kim karmabhiḥ mā evam karmabhiḥ vinā jagat vaicitrya anupapatteḥ karma nairapekṣya pakṣe api trayaḥ doṣāḥ darśitāḥ eva īśvarasya nirdaya tvam karma codanā narthakyam anirmokṣa prasaṅgaḥ ca iti tasmāt karmaṇām eva niyojane svātantryam īśvarasya na tad nirapekṣam

kim tādṛś a aiśvaryeṇa prayojanam iti ced na na prayojana anuvarti pramāṇam bhavitum arhati kim vā bhagavataḥ karma apekṣiṇaḥ api na prabhu tva miti alam ku tarka lava lipta mukha nāsti ka ālāpa parimardena
tasmāt kutārkikā udgīta dūṣaṇa ābhāsa vāraṇāt siddhaḥ trailokya nirmāṇa nipuṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ

ye tu īśvaram nirapavāda dṛḍha pramāṇa siddha svarūpam api na abhyupayanti mūḍhāḥ pāpāya taiḥ saha kathā api vitanyamānā jāyeta nūnam iti yuktam atas virantum yasya icchayā eva bhuvanāni samudbhavanti tiṣṭhanti yānti ca punar vilayam yuga ante tasmai samasta phala bhoga nibandhanāya nitya prabuddha muditāya namaḥ śivāya

nanu trailokya nirmāṇa nipuṇe parameśvare siddhe api tad praṇīta tvam na vedasya avakalpate pade śabda artha sambandhe vedasya racanāsu vā kartṛ tvam asya āśaṅkyeta tat ca sarvatra durvacam varṇa rāśiḥ krama vyaktaḥ padam iti abhidhīyate varṇānām ca avināśi tvāt katham īśvara kārya tā sambandhaḥ api na tad kāryaḥ sa hi śakti svabhāvakaḥ śabde vācaka śaktiḥ ca nityā eva agnau iva uṣṇa tā racanāḥ api vaidikyaḥ na etāḥ puruṣa nirmitāḥ kavi praṇīta kāvya ādi racanābhyaḥ vilakṣaṇāḥ evam ca vede svātantryam īśvarasya na kutracid kāmam tu parvatān eṣa vidadhātu bhinattu vā svatas prāmāṇya siddhau tu vede vaktra napekṣa tām vadāmaḥ na tu sarvatra puruṣa dveṣiṇaḥ vayam anapekṣa tvam eva atas veda prāmāṇya kāraṇam yuktam vaktā api vedasya kurvan api karotu kim

katham punar amī varṇāḥ śruta mātra tirohitāḥ nityāḥ bhavantu kaḥ ayam vā śabda svātantrya doha daḥ ucyate śabdasya na hi anitya tve yuktiḥ sphurati kācana pratyakṣam arthāpattiḥ ca nityatām tu adhigacchataḥ

tathā hi anitya tva hetavaḥ ime kila kathyante prayatna anantaram upalabdheḥ kāryaḥ śabdaḥ iti kāryatva anitya tvayoḥ paraspara āvinā abhāvāt ekatara siddhau anyatara siddhiḥ bhavati eva iti kvacid kiñcid sādhanam ucyate prayatna prerita kauṣṭhya māruta saṃyoga vibhāga anantaram upalabhyamānaḥ śabdaḥ tad kāryaḥ eva iti gamyate uccāraṇāt ūrdhvam anupalabdheḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ na hi enam uccaritam muhūrtam api upalabhāmahe tasmāt vinaṣṭaḥ iti avagacchāmaḥ
karoti śabda vyapadeśāt ca kāryaḥ bdaḥ śabdam kuru śabdam mā kārṣīḥ iti vyavahartāraḥ prayuñjate te nūnam avagacchanti kāryaḥ śabdaḥ iti

nānā deśeṣu ca yugapad upalambhāt teṣu teṣu deśeṣu śabdena vyavahārāt sarvatra yugapad upalabhyate śabdaḥ tat ekasya nityasya sataḥ anupapannam kāryatve tu bahūnām nānā deśeṣu kriyamāṇānām upapadyate aneka deśa sambandhaḥ iti
śabda antara vikārya tvāt ca anityaḥ śabdaḥ dadhi atra iti ikāraḥ eva yakārībhavati iti sādṛśyāt smṛteḥ ca avagamyate vikārya tvāt ca drākṣā ikṣu rasa ādi vat anitya tvam asya iti

kāraṇa vṛddhyā ca vardhamāna tvāt bahubhiḥ mahā prayatnaiḥ uccāryamāṇaḥ mahān go śabdaḥ upalabhyate alpaiḥ alpa prayatnaiḥ uccāryamāṇaḥ alpaḥ iti etat ca tantu vṛddhyā vardhamānaḥ paṭaḥ iva śabdaḥ api hetu vṛddhyā vardhamānaḥ kāryaḥ bhavitum arhati iti

te ete sarve eva aprayojakāḥ hetavaḥ tathā hi prātyabhijñātaḥ siddhe nitya tve prayatna anantaram upalaṃbhāt abhivyaktiḥ prayatna kāryā śabdasya na utpattiḥ iti gamyate tat evam vyaṅgye api prayatna anantaram upalambha saṃbhavāt anaikāntika tvam abhivyañjakānām ca pavana saṃyoga vibhāgānām acira sthāyi tvāt na ciram uccāraṇāt ūrdhvam upalabhyate śabdaḥ prayoga abhiprāyaḥ ca karoti śabda vyapadeśaḥ asya bhaviṣyati gomayāni kuru kāṣṭhāni kuru iti vat tasmāt saḥ api na aikāntikaḥ nānā deśeṣu yugapad upalambhanam ekasya sthirasya api śabdasya vivasvataḥ iva setsyati

vikārya tvam tu asiddham eva śabda antara tvāt dadhi śabdaḥ ikāra antar saṃhitā vyatirikta viṣaya vṛttiḥ yakāraḥ tu ayam anyaḥ eva aci paratas saṃhitā viṣaye prayujyamānaḥ na punar ikāraḥ eva ayam yakārībhūtaḥ kṣīram iva dadhi bhūtam upalabhyate na hi icu yaśāḥ tālavyāḥ iti sthāna sādṛśya mātreṇa tad vikāra tva varṇanam ucitam aprakṛti vikārayoḥ api nayana utpala pallavayoḥ sādṛśya darśanāt ikaḥ yaṇaci iti pāṇinismṛteḥ api na ayam arthaḥ ikāraḥ yakārībhavati kṣīram iva dadhībhavati iti kintvā asmin viṣaye ayam varṇaḥ prayoktavyaḥ asmin ayam iti sūtra arthaḥ siddhe śabde arthe sambandhe ca tat śāstram pravṛttam iti api ca kṣīram dadhi tvam upaiti na tu dadhi kṣīra tām iha tu yakāraḥ api kvacid ikāra tām upaiti vidhyati iti saṃprasāraṇe sati tasmāt asiddhaḥ eva varṇānām prakṛti vikāra bhāvaḥ
na api kāraṇa vṛddhyā vardhate śabdaḥ balavatā api uccāryamāṇāni bahubhiḥ ca tāvanti eva akṣarāṇi dhvanayaḥ eva tathā tatra pravṛddhāḥ upalabhyante na varṇāḥ iti

tasmāt anitya tā asiddhiḥ na evam prāyairasādhanaiḥ śabdasya nityatāyām tu sā eṣā artha āpattiḥ iṣyate śabdasya uccāraṇam tāvat artha gati artham iṣyate na ca uccārita naṣṭaḥ ayam artham gamayitum kṣamaḥ sarveṣām avivādaḥ atra śabda artha vyavahāriṇām yat avijñāta sambandhaḥ śabdaḥ na arthasya vācakaḥ vedyamānaḥ sa sambandhaḥ sthavira vyavahārataḥ drāghīyasā na kālena vinā śakyeta veditum

tathā hi gām śuklām ānayaḥ iti eka vṛddha prayukta śabda śravaṇe sati ceṣṭamānam itaram vṛddham avalokayan bālaḥ taṭa sthaḥ tasya artha pratītim tāvat kalpayati ātmani tad pūrvikāyāḥ ceṣṭāyāḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt pramāṇa antara asannidhānāt etat vṛddha prayukta śabda samanantaram ca pravṛtteḥ tatas eva śabdāt kim api anena pratipannam iti manyate tatas kṣaṇa antare tam artham tena vṛddhena ānīyamānam upalabhamānaḥ evam buddhyate ayam arthaḥ amutas śabdāt anena avagataḥ iti sa ca arthaḥ aneka guṇa kriyā jāti vyakti ādi rūpa saṃkulaḥ upalabhyate śabdaḥ api aneka pada kadambaka ātmā śrutaḥ tat katamasya vākya aṃśasya katamaḥ artha aṃśaḥ vācyaḥ iti āvāpa udvāpa yogena bahu kṛtvas śṛṇvan guṇa kriyā ādi parihāreṇa go tva sāmānyam asman mate tvad mate vā tadvat mātram go śabdasya abhidheyam nirdhārayati iti evam dīrgha adhvasāpekṣa sambandha adhigama avadhi śabdasya jīvitam siddham iti na āśu vināśi tā

bhavatu vā vinaśvarasya api śabdasya sambandha grahaṇam tathā api tasmin gṛhīta sambandhe śabde vinaṣṭe sati katham anavagata sambandhāt abhinavāt idānīm anyasmāt śabdāt artha pratipattiḥ anyasmin jñāta sambandhe yadi anyaḥ vācakaḥ bhavet vācakāḥ sarva śabdāḥ syuḥ ekasmin jñāta saṅgatau na ca vaktā vyavaharamāṇaḥ tadā eva śabdam ca uccārayati sambandham karoti ca evam ca vyutpādayati param ca vyavahārayati iti na hi yugapad imāḥ kriyā bhavitum arhanti evam adarśanāt

atha ādau sambandha grahaṇe vṛtte tasmin vinaṣṭe api go śabde tad sadṛśam abhinava kṛtam api śabdam upaśrutya artham pratipatsyante vyavahartāraḥ iti ucyate tat api na caturaśram sādṛśyasya agrahaṇāt na hi go śabdaḥ iva ayam iti pratītiḥ dṛṣṭā api tu go śabdaḥ eva iti na ca bhūyas avayava sāmānya yoga rūpam sādṛśyam varṇānām anavayavānām upapadyate abhinavasya śabdasya svayam arthavat tva anavadhāraṇāt katham ayam amutas śrotā pratipadyeta iti śaṅkamānaḥ vaktā katham prayogam kuryāt

atha saḥ api arthavat sadṛśam eva prayuṅkte na arthavantam tarhi yat sadṛśam asau prayuṅkte tasya api anya sādṛśyāt eva arthavat tā iti jagat sarga kāla kṛtasya mūla bhūtasya arthavataḥ śabdasya smaraṇam syāt tad mūla tvāt vyavahārasya na ca evam asti na ca tatas prabhṛti adyayāvat sādṛśyam anuvartate tad sādṛśya kalpanāyām mūla sādṛśya vināśāt viśeṣataḥ tu śabdānām

bhinnaiḥ vaktṛ mukha sthāna prayatna karaṇa ādibhiḥ na nirvahati sādṛśyam śabdānām dūra vartinām sādṛśya janita tve ca mithyā eva artha gatiḥ bhavet dhūma anukāri nī hāra janya jvalana buddhi vat tasmāt sādṛśya nibandhana artha prati iti anupapatteḥ go śabdaḥ eva sthāyī iti abhyupagamanīyam

nanu yathā dhūma vyakti bhede api dhūma tva matim abalambya sambandha grahaṇa ādivya bahāra nivaha nirvahaṇam evam iha gakāra ādi varṇa vyakti bhede api sāmānya nibandhanaḥ tad nirvāhaḥ kariṣyate iti mā evam tatra hi dhūma tva sāmānyam vidyate dhruvam śabda tvam vyabhicāryatra go śabda tvam tu durghaṭam bhinnaiḥ ayugapad kālaiḥ asaṃsṛṣṭaiḥ vinaśvaraiḥ varṇaiḥ ghaṭayitum śakyaḥ go śabda avayavī katham anārabdhe ca go śabde go śabda tvam kva vartatām paṭa tvam nāma sāmānyam na hi tantuṣu vartate

nanu mā bhūt go śabda tvam sāmānyam bhinna ākāra gakāra ādi vyakti vṛttibhiḥ eva vā gatvā ādi jātibhiḥ kāryam pūrva uktam upapadyate etat api na asti gatvā ādi jātīnām anupapatteḥ bheda abheda pratyaya pratiṣṭhaḥ hi vyakti jāti pravibhāga vyavahāraḥ iha ca ayam abheda pratyayaḥ varṇa aikya nibandhanaḥ eva na jāti kṛtaḥ bheda pratibhāsaḥ tu vyañjaka bheda adhīnaḥ iti kutas jāti vyakti vyavahāraḥ

go tva ādi jāti nirākaraṇe api eṣa prakāraḥ samānaḥ iti ced na vyakti bhedasya su spaṣṭa siddha tvena vyañjaka ādi upādhi nibandhanatva anupapatteḥ paraspara vibhakta svarūpa tayā hi śābaleya bāhuleya piṇḍāḥ pratyakṣam upalabhyante sthite ca vyakti bhede sarvatra gauḥ iti tad abheda pratyayasya ananya viṣaya tvāt iṣyate eva go tva jātiḥ iha punar gakāra vyaktayaḥ bhinnāḥ śābaleya ādi piṇḍa vat kva nāma bhavatā dṛṣṭāḥ yena āsām jātim icchasi śiśau paṭhati vṛddhe vā strī jane vā śuke api vā vaktṛ bhedam prapadyante na varṇa vyakti bhinna tām

tathā ca gargaḥ paṭhati māṭharaḥ paṭhati iti uccārayitṛ bhedaḥ eva pratīyate amum gaviśeṣam eṣa paṭhati iti na uccāryamāṇa bhedaḥ eka vaktṛ prayoge api tasya eva uccāraṇam punar gaṅgā gagana gargā ādau na rūpa antara darśanam druta ādi bheda bodhaḥ api nāda bheda nibandhanaḥ na vyakti bheda janitaḥ śābaleya ādi bodha vat

abhyupagate api gatva sāmānye tasya druta ādi bheda pratibhāse sati api na bhinna tvam eṣitavyam aupādhikaḥ eva tasmin bheda pratibhāsaḥ varṇanīyaḥ saḥ ayam gakāra vyaktau eva katham na varṇyate tasyāḥ evai katvāt eka pratyayaḥ bheda bhramaḥ tu vyañjaka adhīnaḥ iti evam hi kalpanā laghīyasī bhavati tasmāt na nānāgakāra vṛtti gatvasāmānyam nāma kiñcid asti

api ca go guru geha ādau bhinna ājupa śleṣa kāritaḥ eva vyañjaneṣu buddhi bhedaḥ para upādhiḥ avadhāryate saḥ ayam akṣu api para upādhiḥ eva bhavitum arhati varṇa āśrita tvāt vyañjaka bheda pratyaya vat iti tasmāt gatva vat atva sāmānyam api na asti

yat punar aṣṭādaśa bhedam avarṇa kulam ucyate tadaupādhikam eva hrasva dīrgha pluta saṃvṛta vivṛta ādi buddhīnām dhvani bheda anuvidhāyi tvāt vivṛtaḥ saṃvṛtāt anyaḥ na gakārāt vakāra vat api tu akāraḥ eva asau pratibhāti yathā tathā

katham tarhi śabda bheda abhāve bhinne artha pratipattī araṇyam āraṇyam iti dhvani kṛte eva te bhaviṣyataḥ aśabda dharmasya dīrgha tvāde katham artha prati iti aṅga tvam iti ced turaga vegavat bhaviṣyati yathā turaga deha sthaḥ vegaḥ puṃsaḥ artha siddhaye para dharmaḥ api dīrgha ādiḥ evam tasya upakārakaḥ

itas ca etat akāra sāmānyam anupapannam atvam hi na dīrgha plutayoḥ anugatam bhavati ātvam na hrasva plutayoḥ ātvam na hrasva dīrghayoḥ iti tasmāt ekatvāt varṇānām nāvā antara jātayaḥ saṃbhavanti śabda tvam tu niyata artha pratipattau vyabhicāri iti atas na atra dhūma ādi nyāyaḥ
tena artha pratyayaḥ śabdāt anyathā na upapadyate na ced nitya tvam iti asmin arthāpatteḥ pramāṇa tā

anumānāt anyathātvam arthāpatteḥ na dṛśyate tena anumānam api etat prayoktum na na śakyate tat idam ucyate śabdaḥ dharmī nityaḥ iti sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ sambandha grahaṇa sāpekṣa artha pratipādaka tvāt dhūma ādi jāti vat tat idam uktam nitya tvam tu syāt darśanasya para artha tvāt iti evam sambandha grahaṇāt prabhṛti ārtha pratipatteḥ avasthitasya vināśa hetu abhāvāt ātma ādi vat nitya tvam

na hi ayam avayava vināśāt naśyati śabdaḥ niravayava tvāt tat eva katham iti ced ucyate su alpena api prayatnena yadi varṇaḥ prayujyate yadi vā na anubhūyeta śakalaḥ na anubhūyate sa avayave hi vastuni dvidhā avayavāḥ dṛśyante ārabdha kāryāḥ ca anārabdha kāryāḥ ca iti iha punar ārabdha kāryāḥ anārabdha kāryāḥ vā paṭe tantu ādayaḥ iva varṇe na kvacid avayavāḥ upalabhyante na ca anumīyante liṅga abhāvāt

na api aśraya vināśāt vināśaḥ śabdasya ātma ādi vat ana āśrita tvāt ākāśa āśrita pakṣe vā tad nitya tvāt na ca anyaḥ kaścana śabda nāśasya hetuḥ asti kṣayaḥ yathā upabhogena śastra ādi chedanena vā saṃbhāvyate paṭa ādīnām na evam śabdasya karhi cit tasmāt tirohitaḥ api āste yadi śabdaḥ kṣaṇa antaram mṛtyoḥ mukhāt apakrāntaḥ punar kena eṣa hanyate

itas ca nityaḥ śabdaḥ saṅkhyā bhāvāt aṣṭa kṛtvas go śabdaḥ uccāritaḥ iti vadanti na tu aṣṭau go śabdāḥ iti tena ekatvam avagamyate yaḥ ayam kriyā abhyāvṛtti gaṇane vihitaḥ kṛtvasucpratyayaḥ sa kriyāvatām abhede bhavati tena uccāraṇa āvṛtti mātram tat uktam kriyāvatām abhede hi kriyā aavṛttiṣu kṛtvasu c tad prayogāt dhruvam tasya śabdasya āvartate kriyāḥ iti kriyā abhyāvṛtti sattāyām abhede ca kriyāvatām saṃkhyā abhidhācinaḥ śabdāt kṛtvasucpratyayam viduḥ
tat anena prakāreṇa pratyabhijñānam ucyate pramāṇam śabda nitya tve sakala śrotṛ sākṣikam tathā hi asti saḥ eva ayam go śabdaḥ iti vedanam śrautram karaṇa kāluṣya bādha sandeha varjitam

śrotra indriya vyāpāra anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānāt śrautram idam vijñānam na ca etat janakasya karaṇasya kim api daurbalyam upalabhyate na ca kiṃsvid iti koṭi dvaya saṃsparśitayā idam vijñānam upajāyate na ca na etat evam iti pratyaya antaram asmin bādhakam utpaśyāmaḥ idānīṃtana astitva prameya ādhikya grahaṇāt ca idam anadhigata artha grāhī api bhavitum arhati bhavat mate ca gṛhīta grāhi tve api pratyabhijñāyāḥ prāmāṇyam iṣyate na hi tad aprāmāṇyam vaktum śakyate śākyaiḥ iva bhavadbhiḥ kṣaṇika padārtha anabhyupagamāt

na sādṛśya nimitta tvam vaktum tasyāḥ ca yujyate sāmānya viṣaya tvam vā dvayasya api niṣedhanāt kaiścid tirohite bhāva āditya prāmāṇyam ucyate tat asat tat pratītya eva tirodhāna niṣedhanāt jīvati tvad mate api eṣa śabdaḥ tricaturān kṣaṇān pratyabhijñā ca kālena tāvatā na na siddhyati ekakṣaṇa āyuṣi tu asmin pratītiḥ ati durlabhā na khalva janakam kiñcid vastu jñānena gṛhyate iti kṣaṇa bhaṅga bhaṅge vakṣyate
api ca yathā niśīthe rolamba śyāmala ambuda ḍambare pratyabhijñāyate kiñcid acira dyuti dhāmabhiḥ tathā avirata saṃyoga vibhāga krama janmabhiḥ pratyabhijñāyate śabdaḥ kṣaṇikaiḥ api mārutaiḥ

atra āha mārutaiḥ iti upoddhātena sādhu smṛtam tiṣṭhatu tāvat pratyabhijñānam prathamam eva śabdasya yat niyata grahaṇam tad abhivyakti pakṣe durghaṭam nitya tvāt vyāpaka tvāt ca sarve savatra sarvadā śabdāḥ santi iti bhedena grahaṇe kim niyāmakam dhvanayaḥ hi nāma saṃyoga vibhāga viśeṣitāḥ vāyavaḥ vāyu vṛttayaḥ vā saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ te hi śabdasya vyañjakāḥ iṣyante taiḥ ca karaṇam vā saṃskriyate karma vā dvayam vā sarvathā ca pramādaḥ

karaṇe saṃskṛte tāvat sarva śabda śrutiḥ bhavet gakārāya eva saṃskāraḥ iti eṣa niyamaḥ kutas apica stimita samīraṇa apasaraṇam eva karaṇasya saṃskāraḥ sa ca ayam tad deśa vyavasthita sakala tad viṣaya sādhāraṇaḥ eva yathā javanikā prāya prāpta prasaram īkṣaṇam raṅga bhūmiṣu tad deśam aśeṣam vastu paśyati tathā prasara saṃrodhi samīra utsāraṇe sati śrotram tad deśa niḥśeṣa śabda grāhi bhaviṣyati

ākāśam ca śrotram ācakṣate bhavantaḥ tat ca vibhu niravayavam ca iti kvacid eva tasmin saṃskṛte sati sarve ca tadā eva saṃskṛta karaṇāḥ saṃpannāḥ iti sarve eva śṛṇuyuḥ iti badhira itara vyavasthā dusthitā

viṣaye tu saṃskriyamāṇe tasya anavayavasya vyāpinaḥ ca saṃskṛta tvāt sarvatra śravaṇam iti madreṣu abhivyaktaḥ go śabdaḥ kaśmīreṣu api śrūyeta na hi tasya ādhāra dvārakaḥ saṃskāraḥ ākāśa vat ana āśrita tvāt ākāśa āśrita tva pakṣe api tad eka tvāt na api bhāgaśas saṃskriyate go śabdaḥ tasya niravaya tvāt uktam hi alpīyasā prayatnena śabdem uccaritam matiḥ yadi vā na eva gṛhṇāti varṇam vā sakalam sphuṭam iti

ubhaya saṃskāra pakṣe tu doṣa dvayasya api anativṛttiḥ sarveṣām grahaṇam sarvatra śravaṇam iti na ca samāna deśānām samāna indriya grāhyāṇām ca bhāvānām pratiniyata vyañjaka vyaṅgya tvam upalabdham gṛhe dadhi ghaṭīm draṣṭum ānītaḥ gṛhamedhinā apūpān api tad deśān prakāśayati dīpakaḥ tasmāt kṛtaka pakṣaḥ eva niyata deśam śabdasya grahaṇam parikalpate na abhi vyakti pakṣaḥ iti

api ca abhivyakti pakṣe tīvra manda vibhāgaḥ abhibhavaḥ ca śabdasya śabda antareṇa na prāpnoti na hi śabdaḥ tīvraḥ mandaḥ vā kaścid svatas tasya bheda abhāvāt saṃskārasya ca tad abhivyakti hetoḥ na kācana tīvra tā manda tā vā yad anusāreṇa viṣaye tathā buddhiḥ syāt

pavana dharmaḥ vā tīvra ādiḥ bhavan katham śrotreṇa gṛhyeta sa avayave hi vastuni sakala viśeṣa grahaṇa agrahaṇa saṃbhavāt tad apekṣayā pratīti bhedaḥ bhavet iha tu niravayave śabde na tathā upapadyate iti tasmāt kṛtaka pakṣaḥ eva śreyām iti

atra ucyate karaṇa saṃskāra pakṣaḥ eva tāvat astu tat ca karaṇam kiñcid eva marudbhiḥ upāhita saṃskāram kañcid eva śabdam gṛhṇāti yathā tālu ādi saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ bhavatām mate utpādaka tayā iṣyante kecid varṇasya kasyacid tathā tad vāyu saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ kecid eva naḥ kasyacid grahaṇe śaktāḥ śrotram kurvanti saṃskṛtam yathā ca teṣām utpattau sāmarthya niyamaḥ tava tathā eva eṣām abhivyaktau sāmarthya niyamaḥ mama

vyañjakānām niyamaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ iti ced kaḥ evam āha sahasrākṣaḥ tathā hi pṛthivyām eva vartamānaḥ gandhaḥ samāna deśaḥ bhavati samāna indriya grāhyaḥ ca ghrāṇa eka viṣaya tvāt tasya ca niyata vyañjaka vyaṅgya tā dṛśyate eva kvacid pāvaka saṃparkāt arka aṃśu sparśataḥ kvacid kvacid salila saṃsekāt gandhaḥ abhivyajyate bhuvaḥ na ca stimita pavana apanodana mātram karaṇasya saṃskāraḥ iṣyate yaḥ sarva sādhāraṇaḥ syāt kintu anyaḥ eva niyataḥ prativiṣayam yogya tā lakṣaṇaḥ

yat punar abhyadhāyi nabhasi śrotre abhyupagamyamāne sarva prāṇinām ekam eva śrotram bhavet iti tat api asādhu dharma adharmayoḥ niyāmaka tvāt ākāśasya api ghaṭa ākāśa vat anyā avat cheda upapatteḥ dharma adharma nibandhanaḥ eva badhira itara vibhāgaḥ

api ca bhavatām eva eṣa doṣaḥ yeṣām ākāśam eva śrotram iti abhyupagama niyamaḥ mīmāṃsakānām tu na avaśyam ākāśam eva śrotram kārya artha āpatti kalpitam tu kim api karaṇa mātram prati puruṣa niyatam śrotram iti na ati prasaṅgaḥ tathā ca bhartṛ mitraḥ pavana janita saṃskāram eva śrotram manyate

atha vā viṣaya saṃskāra pakṣaḥ bhavatu tathā api na ati prasaṅgaḥ niyata deśasya eva tatra saṃskārāt na ca asya bhāgaśas saṃskāraḥ niravayava tvāt tathā api jāti vat asya grahaṇa niyamaḥ bhaviṣyati tathā ca bhavatām eva pakṣe yathā sarva gatā jātiḥ piṇḍa deśā eva gṛhyate na ca kārtsnya gṛhītā api piṇḍe anyatra na dṛśyate tathā sarva gataḥ śabdaḥ nāda deśeṣu gṛhyate kārtsnyena ca gṛhītaḥ api punar anyatra gṛhyate piṇḍaḥ abhivyañjakaḥ jāteḥ śabdasya vyañjakaḥ dhvaniḥ āśrita anāśrita tva ādi viśeṣaḥ kva upayujyate

sarva gata tva niravaya tva aviśeṣāt tīvra manda tva ādayaḥ ca dhvani dharmāḥ api bhavantaḥ śabda vṛtti tayā avabhānti yathā sthūla tva kṛśa tvādaya piṇḍa dharmāḥ api jāti vṛtti tvena kvacid gṛhyantaḥ dṛśyante agṛhīta śābaleya ādi viśeṣasya kṛśāḥ gāvaḥ ityādi pratibhāsa darśanāt

yat vā na tīvra manda ādeḥ varṇa dharma tayā grahaḥ buddhiḥ eva tathā udeti vyañjaka anuvidhāyinī tāvantaḥ eva te varṇāḥ pracaya apacaya spṛśaḥ evam ca abhibhavaḥ api eṣām svatas na asti parasparam marudbhiḥ abhibhūyante mārutāḥ iva durbalāḥ tejobhiḥ iva dīpta aṃśoḥ divā dīpa prabhā ādayaḥ
dvaya saṃskāra pakṣaḥ api evam samāhitaḥ bhavati ubhayeṣām api doṣāṇām utsāraṇāt tasmāt pratyabhijñā pratyaya prabhāva siddha nitya tvasya śabdasya abhivyaktiḥ eva sādhīyasī

idam ca ālocya tām āryāḥ kārya abhivyaṅgya pakṣayoḥ śabdasya grahaṇe gurvī laghvī vā kutra kalpanā tathā hi bhavantaḥ vaiśeṣikāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ jaināḥ saugatāḥ ca kārya śabda vādinaḥ cārvākāḥ tu varākāḥ kasya evaṃvidhāsu goṣṭhīṣu smṛti patham upayānti

tatra bhavatām vaiśeṣikāṇām ca śabdasya śravaṇe tāvat eṣā tulyā eva kalpanā saṃyogāt vā vibhāgāt vā śabdaḥ upajāyate jātaḥ ca asau tiryak ūrdhvam adhas ca sarvatodikkāni kadamba golaka ākāreṇa sajātīya nikaṭa deśāni śabda antarāṇi ārabhate tāni api tathā iti evam vīcī santāna vṛtti ārambha prabandha prāptaḥ antyaḥ śrotra ākāśa janmā śabdaḥ tad samavetaḥ tena eva gṛhyate iti

tat iyam tāvat ati ghargharā kalpanā śabdaḥ śabda antaram sūtaḥ iti tāvat alaukikam kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ hi na dṛṣṭaḥ teṣu buddhi vat janyante anantare deśe śabdāḥ sva sadṛśāḥ ca te tiryak ūrdhvam adhas ca iti kā iyam vaḥ śraddadhāna tā śabda antarāṇi kurvantaḥ katham ca viramanti te na hi vega kṣayaḥ teṣām marutām iva kalpyate kuḍya ādi vyavadhāne ca śabdasya akaraṇam katham vyomnaḥ sarva gata tvāt hi kuḍya madhye vyavasthitiḥ

atha āvaraṇa ātmaka kuḍya ādi dravya saṃyoga rahitam ākāśam śabda janmani samavāyi kāraṇam iṣyate tat atra pramāṇam viśeṣe vaktavyam tulya ārambhe ca tīvreṇa mandasya jananam katham śrūyate ca antikāt tīvraḥ śabdaḥ mandaḥ tu dūratas vīcī santāna tulya tvam api śabdeṣu durvacam mūrtimat tva kriyā yoga vega ādi rahita ātmasu

yat api ucyate sajātīya janakaḥ śabdaḥ guṇa tvāt rūpa ādi vat iti tat idam asiddham asiddhena sādhyam guṇa tvasya asiddha tvāt na śabdaḥ pāratantryeṇa kadācid upalabhyate dravya sthaḥ iva rūpa ādiḥ atas asya guṇatā kutas api ca na śabda antara ārambhakaḥ śabdaḥ guṇa tvāt rūpavat śabdam na ārabhate śabdaḥ śabda tvāt śrotra śabda vat na saṃyoga vibhāgau śabdasya janakau saṃyoga vibhāga tvāt anya saṃyoga vibhāga vat iti ādayaḥ pratihetavaḥ api atra sulabhāḥ iti yat kiñcid etat

kāpilāḥ tu bruvate śrotra vṛttiḥ śabda deśam gacchati sā śabdena vikriyate iti tatra śrotrasya vyāmiśra tvāt nikaṭa deśena eva śabdena tad vṛttiḥ vikriyate na dūra deśena iti atra kaḥ niyamaḥ niyama abhāvāt ca kānyakubja prayuktaḥ go śabdaḥ gauramūlake api śrūyeta amūrtā ca śrotra vṛttiḥ prasarantī na mūrtaiḥ kuḍya ādibhiḥ abhihantum śakyate iti vyavahitasya api śabdasya śravaṇam syāt

vāyau śabda anukūle ca na tasya śravaṇam bhavet gacchantyāḥ pratikūlaḥ hi śrotra vṛtteḥ sa mārutaḥ dūre api anuvātam śabdasya śravaṇam yat dṛṣṭam prativātam ca nikaṭe api yat aśravaṇam tat asmin pakṣe viparītam syāt vṛtti vṛttimatoḥ bhedaḥ na asti iti indriya vat bhavet vyāpikā vṛttiḥ iti evam katham sarvatra na śrutiḥ

ārhatāḥ tu āduḥ sūkṣmaiḥ śabda pudgalaiḥ ārabdha śarīraḥ śabdaḥ sva prabhava bhūmeḥ niṣkramya prati puruṣam karṇa mūlam upasarpati iti tat etat ati su bhāṣitam varṇasya avayavāḥ sūkṣmāḥ santi kecana pudgalāḥ taiḥ varṇaḥ avayavī nāma janyate paśya kautukam teṣām adṛśyamānānām kīdṛśaḥ racanā kramaḥ kena tad sanniveśena kaḥ śabdaḥ upajāyatām laghavaḥ avayavāḥ ca ete nibaddhā na ca kenacid na ca enam kaṭhinam kartum varṇa avayavinam kṣamāḥ kṛśaḥ ca gacchan sa katham na vikṣipyeta mārutaiḥ dalaśas vā na bhajyeta vṛkṣa ādi abhihataḥ katham prayāṇaka avadhiḥ kaḥ ca gacchataḥ asya tapasvinaḥ eka śrotra praviṣṭaḥ vā sa śrūyeta aparaiḥ katham niṣkamya karṇāt ekasmāt praveśaḥ śravaṇa antare yadīṣyeta katham tasya yugapad bahubhiḥ śrutiḥ śrotṛ saṃkhyā anusāreṇa na nānā varṇa saṃbhavaḥ vaktuḥ tulya prayatna tvāt śrotṛ bheda tad aikyayoḥ tat alam parihāsasya mahataḥ hetu bhūtayā nagna kṣapaṇaka ācārya prajñā cāturya carcayā

śākya prāyāḥ tu ācakṣate aprāptaḥ eva śabdaḥ śrotra śaktyā gṛhyate iti tat etat ativyāmūḍha bhāṣitam aprāpti tulya tāyām dūra vyavahita ādīnām aśravaṇa kāraṇa abhāvāt prāpya kārita ākhya karma dharma aprasaṅgāt ca na ca cārvāka vat aparīkṣitaḥ eva ayam arthaḥ upekṣitum yuktaḥ iti kāryatva pakṣe amūḥ śrutāḥ tārkika kalpanāḥ atha abhivyakti pakṣe asya śṛṇu śrotriya kalpanām

vivakṣā pūrvaka prayatna preryamāṇaḥ tāvat vegavat tayā kriyāvat tayā ca kauṣṭhyaḥ bahis nissarati samīraṇaḥ iti su spaṣṭam etat pratyakṣa nikaṭa pavana vādinām pakṣe pavana samaye vaktṛ vadana nikaṭa nihita hasta sparśena eva saḥ upalabhyate anumeya māruta pakṣe api tadā ānīm āsya samīpa sannidhāpita tūlaka karmaṇā saḥ anumīyate sa gacchan sarva todikkaḥ stimita anila nodanam karoti karṇa ākāśe ca prayāti śruti yogyatām sa ca prayatna tīvra tva manda tvena tad ātmakaḥ śabde tathāvidha jñapti hetutām avalambate sa ca eṣa gacchan uddāma vega yoga āhita kriyaḥ śaravat vega śāntyā eva na dūram gantum arhati sa mūrtaḥ prasarat mūrtaiḥ aparaiḥ pratibadhyate kuḍya ādibhiḥ atas na asya śrutiḥ vyavahita ātmanaḥ sa vega gati yogi tvāt āgacchati yatas yatas śrotā tatas tatas śabdam āyāntam abhimanyate sa tu śaṅkha ādi saṃyoga preryamāṇaḥ samīraṇaḥ śabdasya avarṇa rūpasya bhavati vyakti kāraṇam śabdaḥ yadi api varṇa ātmā śrotra grāhyaḥ na vidyate tathā api tatra śabda tvam śravaṇena grahīṣyate

tat iha na kadācid asmābhiḥ adhikā kalpanā kṛtā māruta gateḥ asyāḥ sarva loka prasiddha tvāt karṇa ākāśa saṃskāra mātram adṛṣṭam kalpitam tat api kārya arthāpatti gamya tvāt na apūrvam iti apakṣapātinaḥ sabhyāḥ satyam utpatti apekṣayā śabdasya kalpanām āhuḥ abhivyaktau laghīyasīm tat evam abhivyakti pakṣe niyata grahaṇa upapatteḥ pratyabhijñā pratyaya prāmāṇyāt nitya tvam eva upagantavyam

yā tu anaikāntika tva uktiḥ dhī karma pratyabhijñayā pratyakṣe codyamānā asau darśayati ati mūḍha tām tena anumāna doṣeṇa pratyakṣam na hi dūṣyate siddhānta antara cintā tu bhavet bhṛśam asaṅga tā nirbādham pratyabhijñānam asti ced buddhi karmaṇoḥ tayoḥ api astu nitya tvam no ced kā śabda tulya tā tasmāt nityaḥ pratyabhijñā prabhāvāt siddhaḥ śabdaḥ paśyatām tārkikāṇām arthāpattiḥ pūrvam uktā ca tasmin asthāyi tve yuktayaḥ ca vyudastāḥ asti ca vede vacanam siddhām anuvadati yat dhruvām vācam tad liṅga darśanāt api nityaḥ śabdaḥ abhimantavyaḥ śikṣā vidaḥ tu pavana ātmakam eva śabdam ācakṣaṃte tad asamañja sam a pratīteḥ arhan mata prathita pudgala paryudāsa nītyā ca vāyu avayavāḥ api vāraṇīyāḥ ye api sthūla vināśa darśana vaśāt brūyuḥ kṣaṇa dhvaṃsinaḥ bhāvān te api na śaknuvanti gaditum śabdasya vidhvaṃsitām ante hi kṣaya darśanāt kila tathā teṣām bhramaḥ asmin punar śabde na anta parikṣayau iti katham kumbha ādi vat bhaṅgi tā
atra brūmahe na khalu bhavat abhihitamet pramāṇa dvayam api śabda nityatām prasādhayitum arhati
yāvatā yad artha āpattiḥ avādi darśanasya para artha tvāt iti sā kṣīṇā eva artha pratīteḥ anyathā api upapanna tvāt
tatra sādṛśyam api anabhyupagatam eva dūṣita mitya sthāne kliṣṭāḥ bhavantaḥ gatvā ādi jātīḥ a āśritya sambabdha grahaṇa ādikaḥ artha avagati paryantaḥ vyavahāraḥ prasetsyati

nanu ga tvam pratikṣiptam etat eva parīkṣyatām asmin samāpyate vādaḥ marma sthānam idam ca naḥ pratikṣipte ca gatvā ādau na artha saṃpratyayaḥ anyathā pratyabhijñāna bhūmiḥ ca na anyā asti iti vayam jitāḥ siddhe tu gatva sāmānye tatas eva artha vedanam tat eva pratyabhijñeyam iti yūyam parājitāḥ tena anyat sarvam utsṛjya vāda sthāna kaḍambaram gatvā ādi jāti siddhi artham atha atas prayatāmahe

tatra idam vicāryatām yaḥ eṣa gakāra bheda pratibhāsaḥ sa kim vyañjaka bheda kṛtaḥ uta varṇa bheda viṣayaḥ iti vyañjaka bheda kṛte tasmin eka tvāt gakārasya kiṃvṛtti gatva sāmānyaṃsyāt varṇa bheda viṣaya tve tu tad bheda siddheḥ abheda pratyayasya viṣayaḥ mṛgyaḥ iti tad grāhyam aparihāryam gatvasāmānyam

tat ucyate na ayam vyañjaka bheda kṛtaḥ gakāra bheda pratyayaḥ yadi hi vyañjaka bheda adhīnaḥ eṣa bheda pratibhāsaḥ tarhi yara lava ādi varṇa bheda pratyayaḥ api tad kṛtaḥ eva kim iti na bhavati tatas ca sakala varṇa vikalpa atītam ekam anavayavam śabdabrahma vaiyākaraṇa vat abhyupagantavyam

atha manuṣe yara lava ādīnām itaretara vibhakta svarūpa paricchedāt viṣaya bheda kṛtaḥ eva bheda pratyayaḥ na upādhi nibandhanaḥ iti tarhi gaṅgā gagana gargā ādau gakāra bheda pratibhāsaḥ api eṣa na vyañjaka bheda adhīnaḥ bhavitum arhati tatra api paraspara vibhinna gakāra svarūpa pratibhāsāt śuka sārikā manuṣyeṣu hi vaktṛ bhede sati vyañjaka nānātva saṃbhāvanayā varṇa bheda pratyayasya tad kṛta tvam kāmam āśaṅkyeta api vaktṛ eka tve tu gagana ādau kutas tad kṛtaḥ bhedaḥ
nanu tatra api marutaḥ bhinnāḥ eva vyañjakāḥ mukham tu ekam bhavatu kim tena tat api vā bhinnam iti eke ucyate sa tarhi marutām bhedaḥ yara lava ādiṣu api tulyaḥ iti mā bhūt teṣām api bhedaḥ

nanu yara lavānām viśeṣa pratītiḥ asti gakāre tu sā na asti iti uktam uccāraṇasya eva tatra bhedaḥ na uccāryasya iti na etat sāram mā bhūt eṣa viśeṣaḥ iti pratītiḥ bheda buddhiḥ tu vidyate eva anyā ca viśeṣa buddhiḥ ucyate anyā ca bheda buddhiḥ iti viśeṣa apratibhāse api kvacid viccheda pratīti viśeṣāt

nanu atra ucyate dṛśyate śābaleya ādi vyakti antara vilakṣaṇā bāhuleya ādi go vyaktiḥ tena bhedaḥ asti vāstavaḥ na tu druta ādi bhedena niṣpannā saṃpratīyate gavyakti antara vicchinnā gavyaktiḥ aparā sphuṭā iti na etat yuktam śābalaiyādau prativyakti sāsnā ākhura kakudādi avayava vartinaḥ viśeṣāḥ pratibhāsante te ca sthūla tvāt sugamāḥ bhavanti yatra tu tila taṇḍula kulattha ādau pratisiktham viśeṣāḥ na pratibhāsante tatra viśeṣa pratīti abhāve api viccheda pratibhāsaḥ vidyate eva sikthāt sikthā antara tvena pratibhāsāt evam iha api eṣa gakāra viśeṣaḥ iti pratibhāsā bhāve api viccheda grahaṇāt gakāra nānā tvam

nanu taṇḍula ādau api sikthāt siktha antare viśeṣāḥ pratibhāsantaḥ eva tad apratibhāse bhedasya api grahītum aśakyatvāt mā evam vādīḥ yatne sati caturaśratri koṇa vartula tva ādi viśeṣāḥ api amutra pratibhāsiṣyante evam gakāreṣu api prayatnam vinā api tu prathama akṣa nipātaḥ eva viccheda buddhiḥ utpadyate iti tayā eva nānātva siddhiḥ
nanu na eva anadhigata viśeṣasya viccheda buddhiḥ utpattum arhati iti viśeṣa buddhiḥ eva viccheda buddhiḥ na etat evam bhramaṇa ādi karma kṣaṇānām sūkṣma viśeṣa apratibhāse api viccheda pratibhāsāt
nanu tatra api viśeṣa grahaṇam kalpyate anyathā viccheda pratīti anupapatteḥ yadi evam varṇeṣu api gagana ādau viccheda pratīti darśanāt kalpyatām viśeṣa grahaṇam

nanu asti eva tat kintvaupādhikam sphaṭike rakta tā pratyaya vat viṣamaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ sphaṭikasya śuddhasya dṛṣṭa tvāt lākṣā ādi upādhi nimittakaḥ bhavatu rakta tā pratyayaḥ varṇānām tu nityam eva udātta ādi viśeṣavatām pratibhāsāt tad rahitānām anupalabdheḥ ca naisargikaḥ eva ayam bhedaḥ tat yathā buddhīnām ghaṭa paṭa ādi viṣaya viśeṣa śūnyānām asaṃvedanāt prativiṣayam nānā tvam tathā varṇānām api pratyudātta ādi viśeṣam nānātvam na ca buddhiḥ ekā eva nityā ca viṣaya bheda upādhi nibandhanaḥ tad bhedaḥ iti sāmpratam svayam eva buddhi janma pratyakṣam iti abhidhānāt asmābhiḥ ca buddhi nityatāyāḥ upariṣṭāt nirākariṣyamāṇa tvāt viṣaya bhedāt ca tad bheda abhidhāne viṣayasya api kutas idānīm bhedaḥ buddhi bhedāt iti ced itaretara āśraya prasaṅgaḥ tat imāḥ svatas eva bhedavatyaḥ buddhayaḥ viṣayāṇām api svatas eva bhedaḥ bhavati sa tu buddhibhiḥ jñāyate iti alam artha antara gamanena

yathā ca śukla guṇasya bhāsvara dhūsara ādi bhedavataḥ nānā tvam tathā varṇasya api udātta ādi bhedavataḥ śukla guṇaḥ api ekaḥ eva āśraya bhedāt tu tad bhedaḥ iti ced aho rasa samārūḍhaḥ bhaṭṭaḥ karma ekam buddhiḥ api ekā jagati ekaḥ sitaḥ guṇaḥ tat ca etat nityam iti etāḥ strī gṛhe kāmuka uktayaḥ

api ca eka ātmavādaḥ api evam eva avataret sukhi duḥkhya ādi bhedasya śarīra bhedena api upapatteḥ advaitasya ca na ati davīyān eṣa panthāḥ iti alam alīka vikatthanena tasmāt buddhi ādi vat sarvadā sa viśeṣāṇām eva varṇānām grahaṇāt nānātvam

tatra etat syāt gaganāda avakāra upaśleṣa kṛtaḥ eva bheda pratyayaḥ na svarūpa bhedaḥ iti tat ayuktam akārasya api bhavat mate bheda abhāvāt avidyamāne ca tad upaśleṣe digajaḥ diggajaḥ iti bhedena pratibhāsaḥ bhavati eva tathā ca samadaḥ sammadaḥ paṭaḥ paṭṭaḥ āsanam āsannam malaḥ mallaḥ avikaḥ avikkaḥ patiḥ pattiḥ patanam pattanam iti ādau api varṇa bheda pratītiḥ artha pratīti bhedaḥ api diś aja diggaja ādau śabda antara nimittakaḥ bhavitum arhati na dvis uccāraṇa kṛtaḥ grantha ādhikyāt artha ādhikyam na uccāraṇa bhedāt śata kṛtvas api prayukte go śabde sāsnādi mad artha vyatirikta vācya saṃpratyaya abhāvāt tathā ca diggajaḥ iti dviga kārakaḥ nirdeśaḥ iti ācakṣate śabda vidaḥ na dvis gakāraḥ uccāritaḥ iti

nanu go guru giri geha āda avajbhede api gakāra pratyaya anuvṛtteḥ ekaḥ eva ayam gakāraḥ mā evam vocaḥ eṣaḥ eva hi bheda pratyayaḥ asmābhiḥ upadarśitaḥ vinā api ca ajupaśleṣam diggaja ādau bheda pratyayaḥ varṇitaḥ na ca vayam abheda pratyayam apahnumahe kintu bheda pratyayasya api abādhitasya bhāvāt ananyathā siddha tvāt ca gavā ādi vat sāmānya viśeṣa rūpa tām brūmaḥ vyañjaka bheda nibandhana tvam tu yara lavādau api vaktum śakyam iti uktam eva api ca śāvaleya ādi bheda pratyayasya api vyañjaka bheda nibandhana tvāt ekaḥ eva asau syāt

nanu tatra kaḥ vyañjakaḥ yad bheda kṛtaḥ piṇḍa bheda pratyayaḥ iṣyate āha ca na piṇḍa vyatirekeṇa vyañjakaḥ atra dhvaniḥ yathā piṇḍa vyaṅgyā eva go tva ādi jātiḥ nityam pratīyate iti tat ayuktam go tva jāteḥ gatva vat idānīm avivāda āspadībhūta tvāt piṇḍa bheda pratyayasya cakṣuḥ vyāpāra bhedāt api upapatteḥ
nanu sakṛt api vyāpṛta locanasya paraspara vibhakta piṇḍa pratibhāsaḥ bhavati mā evam tadānīm go mātra pratītiḥ eṣa śābaleyaḥ eṣa bāhuleyaḥ iti tu viśeṣa grahaṇe cakṣuḥ vyāpāra bhedaḥ aparihāryaḥ

yadi ca ādya gopiṇḍa bhede prathama akṣa sannipāta jā buddhiḥ subhaga tām gatā gakāra bhede tarhi kim kṛtam asyāḥ daurbhāgyam tatra api prathama śrotra vyāpāra velāyām anavagata vyañjaka vibhāgasya api gagana gaṅgā ādau gakāra bhedaḥ pratibhāsate eva iti alam prasaṅgena
tat ayam vastu saṃkṣepaḥ upekṣyatām vā sarvatra sāmānya viśeṣa vyavahāraḥ iṣyatām vā go tva ādi vat gakāra bheda vṛtti gatvasāmānyam
