atvam api gatva vat apratyākhyeyam itaretara vilakṣaṇānām akārāṇām hrasva dīrgha pluta ādi bhedena pratibhāsāt yaḥ punar ākāre api akāra pratyabhijñānam brūyāt tasya īkāra ukāra pratītiṣu api akārasya eva grahaṇa prasaktiḥ actvā aviśeṣāt atha tad aviśeṣe api avarṇāt iva ṛṇasya bhedaḥ iṣyate sa tarhi ākārasya na nihrotavyaḥ evañca sati araṇya araṇya śabdābhyām bhinna artha pratītiḥ upapatsyate udātta anudātta svarita saṃvṛta vivṛta ādi bhedaḥ api śabda vidām pratyakṣaḥ eva gīta jñānām iva svara grāma bhāṣā vibhāgaḥ tasmāt aṣṭādaśa bhedam akāram ācakṣate atvam ca tad sāmānyam avarṇa kula śabdena vyavaharanti iti

yat tu dhvani dharmasya api dīrgha ādeḥ artha pratipatti aṅga tvam turaga vega vat uktam tat api ahṛdayaṅgamam śabdāt artham pratipadyante lokāḥ na marudbhyaḥ atha marutām api tathā vyutpatteḥ artha pratīti hetu tvam tarhi vyutpattiḥ eva pramāṇam syāt na śabdaḥ vyutpatteḥ avyabhicārāt śabdasya ca vyabhicārāt iti āstām etat tasmāt gatvā ādi sāmānyaiḥ artha saṃpratyaya ātmanaḥ kāryasya pariniṣpatteḥ na varṇa vyakti nityatā

aparaḥ āha tiṣṭhatu tāvat dūratas eva gatvā ādya para sāmānyam mahāsāmānyam api śabda tvam varṇeṣu na upapadyate vyakti antara anusandhānam yatra eka vyakti darśane tatra eka rūpa sāmānyam iṣyate tad kṛtam ca tat gakāra śruti velāyām na vakāra avamarśanam bāhuleya parāmarśaḥ śābaleya grahe yathā śabdaḥ śabdaḥ ayam iti evam pratītiḥ tu aprayojikā eṣā hi śrotra gamya tvam upādhim anurudhyate

tat etat niranusandhānasya abhidhānam anusandhāna pratyayasya sāmānya siddhau aprayojaka tvāt anusandhānam hi sārūpyāt vijātīyeṣu api bhavati gavaya grahaṇa samaye gopiṇḍa anusandhāna vat tasmāt abādhita eka rūpa pratyaya pratiṣṭhaḥ eva sāmānya vyavahāraḥ samāna buddhi grāhye api sāmānye avasthite kvacid bhavati anya anusandhānam kvacid vā na bhavati api tat asti khaṇḍa muṇḍa ādau piṇḍa sārūpya kāritam gakāra ādiṣu varṇeṣu tad abhāvāt tu na asti tat na tu sāmānya abhāvāt

na ca sārūpyam eva sāmānyam sāṅkhya vat abhidhātum yuktam vijātīyeṣu api gogavaya ādiṣu tasya dṛṣṭa tvāt yadi ca śabdaḥ śabdaḥ iti anuvṛtta buddheḥ śrotra gamya tva upādhi kṛta tvam ucyate tarhi gavā ādau api ekabuddheḥ vāha doha ādi eka artha kriyā kāri tva nibandhana tvāt go tva ādi jāti nihnavaḥ bauddhavat mantavyaḥ na ca etat evam tat go tva vat śabda tvam api na pratyākhyeyam

etena brāhmaṇa tva ādi sāmānyam api samarthitam veditavyam upadeśa sahāya pratyakṣa gamya tvāt na ca upadeśa apekṣaṇāt apratyakṣa tvam tasya bhavituḥ mahati go tva ādi pratyayasya api sambandha grahaṇa kāle tad apekṣa tva darśanāt uktam ca na hi yat giri śṛṅgam āruhya gṛhyate tat apratyakṣam iti

na ca aupādhikaḥ paiṭhīna sipaippala ādi prabhṛtiṣu brāhmaṇa pratyayaḥ upādheḥ agrahaṇāt aupādhika tvasya go tva ādau api vaktum śakya tvāt api ca upadeśa nirapekṣam api cakṣuḥ kṣatriya ādi vilakṣaṇām saumya ākṛtim brāhmaṇa jātim avagacchati iti eke tat alam anayā kathayā

prakṛtam ucyate gatvā ādibhiḥ jātibhiḥ eva artha saṃpratyaya upapatteḥ yat uktam darśanasya para artha tvāt iti etat ayuktam etena sarvatra yaugapadyāt iti etat api pratyuktam sambandha niyamasya gatvā ādibhyaḥ eva siddheḥ

yat api saṅkhyā bhāvāt kṛtu a sucprayoga darśanam udagrāhi tat api vyabhicāri kṛtam kāntasya tanu aṅgyā tris apāṅga vilokanam catur āliṅganam gāḍham aṣṭa kṛtvas ca cumbanam iti tad bhede api darśanāt atha tatra strīpuṃsayoḥ abhede cumbana ādi kriyā mātra bhedaḥ eva iti ucyate tathā api apūrveṣu brāhmaṇeṣu bhuktavatsu pañca kṛtvas brāhmaṇāḥ bhuktabantaḥ iti vyavahāraḥ dṛśyate

evam śabde api tad saṅkhyā vyavahāraḥ hi dṛśyate kavinā sat anuprāse nibaddhe akṣara ḍambare gakāraḥ bahavaḥ dṛṣṭāḥ iti vyavaharanti hi yat api pratyabhijñānam tat dvārakam udāhṛtam tasya api siddhe prāmāṇye jāti ālambanatā bhavet nṛtta abhinaya ceṣṭā ādi pratyabhijñānataḥ vayam na śabda pratyabhijñānam uttārayitum īśmahe viśeṣam pratyabhijñāne na paśyāmaḥ manāk api stambha ādi pratyabhijñāsu na tadā eva vināśa dhīḥ kṣaṇa bhaṅga pratīkāram tena tāḥ kartum īśate śabdasya pratyabhijñāna velāyām eva dṛśyate śabda rūpasya vidhvaṃsaḥ iti tat nitya tā kutas

yadi api kṣaṇa bhaṅga bhaṅge pratyabhijñā prāmāṇyam asmābhiḥ api samarthayiṣyate tathā api stambha ādi pratyabhijñāyāḥ śabda pratyabhijñāyāḥ eṣaḥ eva viśeṣaḥ yat atra dhvastaḥ śabdaḥ iti tadā eva pratyayaḥ jāyate atas eva tirohite api bhāvāt iyam apramāṇam pratyabhijñā iti āhuḥ

yadi api dhriyate asmākam śabdaḥ dvitrān api kṣaṇān pratyabhijñā tu kālena tāvatā na avakalpate tathā hi śabdaḥ utpadyate tāvat tatas sva viṣayam jñānam janayati ajanakasya pratibhāsā yogāt tatas tena jñānena śabdaḥ gṛhyate tatas saṃskāra bodhaḥ tatas pūrva jñāta śabda smaraṇam tatas tat sacivam śrotram manaḥ vā śabda pratyabhijñānam janayiṣyati tadā śabdaḥ grahīṣyataitīyat kutas asya dīrgham āyuḥ pratyabhijñā prāmāṇyāt eva tāvat āyuḥ tasya kalpyate iti ced satyam kalpyeta yadi vināśa pratyayaḥ tadā eva na syāt api ca go śabdaḥ ayam aśva śabdaḥ ayam iti tad abhidhāna viśeṣa ullekhāt nānā anusmaraṇam tasya tadā eva avaśyam āpatet vijñāna ayaugapadyāt ca kālaḥ dīrghataraḥ bhavet
yat api udita muhāma megha śyāmāsu rātriṣu sāmyam saudāminī dhāma janyayā pratyabhijñayā tat asat kāla dairghyeṇa tad avasthiti asaṃbhavāt vidyut dṛṣṭe ca vṛkṣa ādau nāśa saṃvitti a saṃbhavāt
pratyabhijñā nāma smaryamāṇa anubhūyamāna sāmānādhikaraṇya grāhiṇī saṃskāra saciva indriya janyā pratītiḥ iti kecid

anye manyante smaryamāṇa pūrva jñāna viśeṣita artha grāhi tvāt pratyabhijñāyāḥ tad viśeṣaṇasya ca arthasya bāhya indriya grāhya tva anupapatteḥ stambha ādau api mānasī pratyabhijñā iti nirbandhaḥ tu iha na asmākam sā yathā astu tathā astu vā śabde vināśa jñānāt tu na sā nitya tva sādhikā
bādhya bādhaka bhāve tu niyamaḥ nanu kiṃkṛtaḥ śabdasya pratyabhijñāna vināśa pratibhāsayoḥ ucyate pratyabhijñānam anyathā api upapadyate gatvā ādi jāti viṣayam yat vā sādṛśya hetukam

nanu abhivyañjaka dhvaṃsāt nāśadhīḥ api setsyati tad asau api bādhyā astu yat vā bhavatu saṃśayaḥ mā evam vināśitā buddhiḥ bheda budhi upabṛṃhitā sā ca iyam ca anyathā siddhe iti vaktum asāṃpratam pratyabhijñā ca sa apekṣā nirapekṣā tu abhāva dhīḥ tena evamādau viṣaye pratyabhijñā eva bādhyate śabda abhāvasya jhagiti grahaṇāt tat pratyabhijñāyāḥ ca pūrva anusandhāna ādi savyapekṣa tvāt

api ca pratyabhijñā vyabhicarantī karma ādiṣu gṛhyate tena asyām śabde api abhāva pratyaya upahata vapuṣi kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ na ca idam pratyakṣe api anaikāntika tva udbhāvanam api tu vināśaka pratyaya pratihata prabhāvā pratyabhijñā nitya tvam karma ādiṣu iva śabde api na sādhayitum prabhavati iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ eṣa pradarśyate
nanu pratyakṣe api dṛṣṭāntasya kaḥ avasaraḥ satyam grāhakāḥ tu bhavādṛśāḥ svayam anavabudhyamānāḥ evam budhyante

yat tu pravṛddha rabhasa tayā buddhi karma ādau api nitya tva samarthanam tat atyantam alaukikam iti uktam kim nāma śabda nitya tva samarthana tṛṣā aaturaḥ jaṅgamam sthāvaram ca eva sakalam pātum icchasi tasmāt ala mati rabhasa pravṛttābhiḥ buddhi karma ādi nitya tva samarthana kathābhiḥ

yat punar abhivyakti pakṣe śabdasya grahaṇe niyama abhāvam āśaṅkya śrotra saṃskāreṇa viṣaya saṃskāreṇa ubhaya saṃskāreṇa vā niyatam grahaṇam upavarṇitam tad vañcanā mātram samāna deśānām samāna indriya grāhyāṇām pratiniyata vyañjaka vyaṅgya tva adarśanāt

ye punar atra gandhāḥ udāhṛtāḥ te samāna indriya grāhyāḥ bhavanti na samāna deśāḥ eka bhūmi āśrita tvena tulya deśa tva kalpane bhavet samāna deśa tvam himavat vindhyayoḥ api ekatve api bhuvaḥ bhānti padārthāḥ pārthivāḥ pṛthak vyajyante tad adhiṣṭhānāḥ gandhāḥ taiḥ taiḥ nibandhanaiḥ bhavantu anāśritāḥ śabdāḥ yadi vā aakāśa saṃśritāḥ sarvathā bhinna deśa tvam eṣām vaktum na śakyate

nanu yathā ekatve api nabhasaḥ tad bhāga kalpanayā prati puruṣam śrotra indriya bhedaḥ evam tad bhāga kalpanayā eva śabdānām api asamāna deśa tvāt niyata vyañjaka vyaṅgyatā bhaviṣyati na evam upapadyate yatra eva vaktṛ mukha ākāśa deśe śrotṛ śrotra ākāśa deśe vā go śabdaḥ upalabdhaḥ tatra eva aśva śabdaḥ idānīm upalabhyate na punar atimukta kusume yaḥ upalabdhaḥ gandhaḥ sa bandhūke madhūke vā kadācid upalabhyate iti

tasmāt samāna deśa tvāt na vyaktau niyamaḥ bhavet utpattau tu vyavasthāyām tad bhedaḥ upapadyate nādaiḥ saṃskriyatām śabdaḥ śrotram vā dvayam eva vā sarvathā niyamaḥ na asti vyañjakeṣu iti niścayaḥ vyavasthā vyañjakānām ced ucyate adṛṣṭa kāri tā utpattau dṛśyamānāyām dṛṣṭam api avirodhakam

na ca stimita māruta apanayana vyatiriktaḥ kaścana śrotra saṃskāraḥ vidyate tatra ca atiprasaṅgaḥ uktaḥ etad atirikta saṃskāra kalpanāyām tu adṛṣṭa kalpanā sthire ca śabda saṃskāra grāhiṇi sati punar abhivyaktasya api go śabdasya śravaṇam syāt tad grahaṇa hetoḥ saṃskārasya sthira tvāt tad kṣaṇika tve tu śabdakṣaṇika tā eva sādhvī pratīyamāna tvāt

yat tu bhartṛ mitraḥ tam eva saṃskāram śrotra indriyam abhyupaiti tat idam apūvikam kim api pāṇḍityam indriyasya hi saṃskāryasya saṃskāraḥ na saṃskāraḥ eva indriyam loka āgama viruddha tvāt prati puruṣam yāvat śabdam bhinnasya kṣaṇikasya ca indriyasya kalpanam anupapannam anaśvara tve tu śaśvat eva śabda kolāhala prasaṅgaḥ iti yat kiñcid etat bhaṭṭena eva sa upahāsam eṣa dūṣitaḥ pakṣaḥ iti kim atra vimardena

yat api bhaṭṭaḥ āha yadi tu avaśyam vaktavyaḥ tārkikā ukti viparyayaḥ tatas veda anusāreṇa kāryā diś śrotra tā matiḥ iti tat api asāṃpratam diśām kārya antara ākṣepāt āgamāni aparatvataḥ āhopuruṣikā mātram diś dravya śrotra kalpanam indriyāṇām bhautika tvasya sādhayiṣyamāṇa tvāt diśaḥ ca amūrta tvāt na indriya prakṛti tvam vyāpaka tva aviśeṣe vā kāla ātmanoḥ api tathā abhāva prasaṅgaḥ tayoḥ anyatra vyāpāraka tvāt na indriya prakṛti tvam iti ced diś dravye api tulyam etat āgamaḥ tu anya paraḥ eva yathā hi sūryam cakṣuḥ gamayatāt diśaḥ śrotram iti paṭhyate evam antarikṣam asum iti ca paṭhyate eva na ca āsavaḥ antarikṣa prakṛtikāḥ pavana ātmaka tvāt tasmāt kṛtam diśā ākāśa deśaḥ eva karṇa śaṣkulī avacchinnaḥ śabda nimitta upabhoga prāpaka dharma adharma upanibaddhaḥ śrotram iti uktam

nanu dharma adharma kṛta śrotra niyama vat abhivyakti niyamaḥ api śabdasya tad kṛtaḥ eva bhaviṣyati kim iti tad aniyamaḥ nitya tva pakṣe codyate iti na etat yuktam cakṣuḥ ādi indriyāṇām vaikalyam adṛṣṭa nibandhanam andhakāra prabhṛtiṣu dṛśyate na punar padārtha sthitiḥ adṛṣṭa vaśāt viparivartate vyañjaka dharma atikrame hi himam api śaityam svadharmam atikrāmet vyañjakeṣu niyamaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ iti uktam dṛṣṭe ca varṇa bhede niyata upalabdhi hetau saṃbhavati sati kim ayam adṛṣṭa mastake bhāraḥ āropyate

katham ca abhivyakti pakṣe tīvra manda vibhāgaḥ tīvra tā ādayaḥ hi varṇa dharmāḥ vā syuḥ dhvani dharmā vā varṇa dharma tve tīvrāt gakārāt anya tvam mandasya iti asmad mata anupraveśaḥ dhvani dharma tva pakṣe tu śrotreṇa grahaṇam katham na hi vāyu gataḥ vegaḥ śravaṇena upalabhyate

yat tu vyakti dharmāḥ kṛśa tva sthūla tva ādayaḥ jāta abupalabhyante iti darśitam tat kāmam upapadyeta api jāteḥ vyakteḥ tad dharmāṇām ca samāna indriya grāhya tvāt iha tu sparśana grāhyaḥ pavanaḥ atīndriyaḥ atha vā tad dharmāḥ śravaṇe śabde gṛhyante iti vismayaḥ

yat tu buddhiḥ eva tīvra mandavatī iti tat atīva subhāṣitam asati viṣaya bhede buddhi bheda anupapatteḥ kiñca nitya parokṣā te buddhiḥ evam ca nāda vat tad agrahe na tīvra ādi tad dharma graha saṃbhavaḥ aho tīvra ādayaḥ tīvre prapāte patitā amī yaḥ gṛhyate na tad dharmā yat dharmā sa na gṛhyate
yaḥ ca abhibhava vṛttāntaḥ tvad mate marutām asau anile ca abhibhūte api śabdaḥ na śrūyate katham dīpe abhibhūte raviṇā na hi rūpam na gṛhyate niyata vyañjaka tvam tu pratikṣiptam adarśanāt

yat tu śaṅkha ādi śabdānām śrotra grāhya tva siddhaye śabda tvam tatra tat grāhyam iti avādi tat api asat satyam vadata dṛṣṭam vā śrutam vā kvacid īdṛśam āśrayasya parokṣa tve tad sāmānya upalambhanam śabdaḥ na te asti avarṇa ātmā na śaṅkhaḥ varṇa sambhavaḥ na nāda vṛtti śabda tvam iti tad grahaṇam katham

yat punar saṃpradhāritam vyaṅgya kārya pakṣayoḥ kva śabda grahaṇe gurvī kalpanā bhavati kva vā laghvī iti tat api maula pramāṇa vicāra sāpekṣa tvāt aprayojakam yadi maula pramāṇena sādhitā nitya śabda tā tvad uktā kalpanā sādhvī mad uktā tu viparyaye

kauṣṭhyena bahis prasaratā samīraṇena sarvatas stimita māruta apasaraṇam kriyate iti etat eva tāvat alaukikam kalpitam agneḥ ūrdhva jvalanam vāyoḥ tiryak gamanam aṇu manasoḥ ca ādyam karma iti adṛṣṭa kāritāni iti marutām tiryak gamana svabhāva tvāt ūrdhvam adhas ca śabda śravaṇam na bhavet yāvat na veginā anyena preritaḥ mātariśvanā tāvat naisargikaḥ vāyuḥ na tiryak gatim ujjhati adhomukha prayuktaḥ api śabdaḥ ūrdhvam pratīyate uttāna vadana uktaḥ api na adhas na śrūyate ca saḥ kadamba golaka ākāra śabda ārambhaḥ hi saṃbhavet na punar dṛśyate loke tādṛśī marutām gatiḥ ākaṇṭha ānaddha nī randhra carma āvṛta mukha uditaḥ śabdaḥ yaḥ śrūyate tatra na kauṣṭhya anila sarpaṇam kuḍya ādi pratibandhena bāyoḥ aprasaraṇam bhavadbhiḥ api kathitam eva nirvivara carma puṭa uparuddhaḥ api asau na prasaret

api ca sarvatas niruddha sarva dvārasya api jaṭhare gura gurā śabdaḥ manda agneḥ śrūyate atra kutas vyañjakānām kauṣṭhī a pavanānām nissṛtiḥ romakūpa nissṛtānām api sūkṣma tayā stimita bāhya vāyu apasaraṇa sāmarthya abhāvaḥ
kiñca manāk api bahis vāyau vāti na śabda śravaṇam syāt iti durbalaḥ api bāhyaḥ pavanaḥ prabalāt api kauṣṭhyavāyoḥ balīyān bhavati iti katham tena apasāryeta

anyaḥ eva sūkṣmāḥ vāyavaḥ śabda āvaraṇa kāriṇaḥ na punar ete paridṛśyamānāḥ śyāmā kala tālā asya upadeśinaḥ mātariśvānaḥ iti ced na viśeṣe pramāṇa abhāvāt yam ca sūkṣmāḥ api vāyavaḥ tirodadhati tam sutarām balīyāṃsaḥ api vivṛṇuyuḥ iti yat kiñcid etat

tasmāt sajātīya śabda santāna ārambha pakṣaḥ eva yukti anuguṇaḥ tathā hi sajātīya guṇa ārambhiṇaḥ guṇāḥ tāvat dṛśyante eva rūpa ādayaḥ amūrtā api ca buddhiḥ buddhi antaram ārabhamāṇā dṛśyate deśa antare api sā eva kāryam ārabhate pathi gacchataḥ devadatta ādeḥ ekasmāt ātma pradeśāt pradeśa antare buddhi utpāda darśanāt kārya ārambha viratiḥ api bhavati adṛṣṭa adhīna saṃsargāṇām sahakāriṇām anavasthānāt tīvreṇa api śanais evam atīvra ārambha sambhavaḥ sīdat saciva sāmarthya sāpekṣa kṣīṇa vṛttinā vīcī santāna dṛṣṭāntaḥ kiñcid sāmyāt udāhṛtaḥ na tu vega ādi sāmarthyam śabdānām asti apām iva
yat tu kuḍya ādi vyavadhāne kim iti viramati śabda santāna ārambhaḥ iti na eṣa doṣaḥ nirāvaraṇasya hi vyomnaḥ śabda ārambhe samavāyi kāraṇa tvam tathā adarśanāt kalpyate na ākāśa mātrasya iti

yat api guṇa tvam asiddham śabdasya iti tatra kecid aśrita tvāt guṇa tvam ācakṣate tat ayuktam āśrita tvam guṇa tve hi na prayojakam iṣyate ṣaṇṇām api padārthānām āśrita tvasya saṃbhavāt diś kāla paramāṇu ādi niti a dravya atirekiṇaḥ āśritāḥ ṣaṭ apīṣyante padārthāḥ kaṇa bhojinā na ca vyoma āśrita tvam api śabdasya pratyakṣam apratyakṣe nabhasi tad āśrita tvasya api apratyakṣa tvāt

katham ādhāra pārokṣye śabda pratyakṣata iti ced yathā evā aatma parokṣa tve buddhi ādeḥ upalambhanam etat eva asiddham iti ced alam bāda antara gamanena upariṣṭāt nirṇeṣyamāṇa tvāt kim etarhi śabdasya guṇa tve pramāṇam pariśeṣa anumānam iti brūmaḥ prasaktayoḥ dravya karmaṇoḥ pratiṣedhe sāmānyādau aprasaṅgāt ca guṇaḥ eva avaśiṣyate śabdaḥ
katham punar na dravyam śabdaḥ eka dravya tvāt adravyam vā bhavati dravyam ākāśa paramāṇu ādi aneka dravyam vā dvaṇuka ādi kārya dravyam eka dravyam tu śabdaḥ eka ākāśa āśrita tvāt tasmāt na dravyam

na api śabdaḥ karma śabda antara janaka tvāt karmaṇaḥ hi samāna jāti ārambhaka tvam na asti sattā śabda tva ādi sāmānya sambandhāt ca sāmānya ādi traya prasaṅgaḥ asya na asti iti pāriśeṣyāt guṇaḥ eva śabdaḥ

nanu guṇa tva siddhau satyām ākāśa āśrita tvam śabdasya bhaviṣyati guṇasya dravyān āśritasya adarśanāt pṛthivī ādīnām ca śabda āśraya tva anupapatteḥ tatas ca guṇa tve sati eka dravya tvam eka dravya tve sati guṇa tvam iti itaretara āśraya tvam tathā ca samāna jātīya ārambhaka tvam api guṇa tva siddhi mūlam eva guṇa tve sati śabdasya ākāśa āśrita tvāt tad ātmakena śrotreṇa grahaṇam tat ca deśa antara gata saṃyoga vibhāga prabhavasya śabdasya santānam antareṇa śrotra deśa prāpti abhāvāt na sidhyati iti guṇa tva siddhi mūlā santāna kalpanā santāna kalpanāyām ca samāna jāti ārambhaka tvāt karma vyavacchede sati guṇa tva siddhiḥ iti ita retara āśraya tvam eva

ucyate na ubhayatra api eṣa doṣaḥ śrotra grāhya tvāt eva śabdasya ākāśa āśrita tvam kalpyate samāna jātīya ārambhaka tvam ca guṇa tvāt ākāśa eka deśaḥ hi śrotram iti prasādhitam etat prāpya kāri tvam ca indriyāṇām vakṣyate na ca ākāśānāśrita tve śabdasya śrotreṇa prāptiḥ bhavati na ca aprāptasya grahaṇam iti tad āśrita tvam kalpyate evam samāna jātīya ārambhaka tvam api tatas eva śrāvaṇa tvāt dūra vartinaḥ śabdasya śravaṇe sati kalpyate na tu guṇa tvāt iti na itaretara āśrayam

kārya tvāt ākāśa āśrita tvam kalpyate iti eke nanu kāryatvāt api ākāśa āśrita tva kalpanāyām tad avastham eva itaretara āśrayam kārya tvāt ākāśa āśrita tvam ākāśa āśrita tve sati niyata grahaṇa pūrvam pūrva rītyā kāryatvam iti na etat evam bheda vināśa pratibhāsābhyām eva kāryatva siddheḥ kimarthaḥ tarhi niyata grahaṇa samarthanāya ayam iyān prayāsaḥ kriyate niyata grahaṇam api kārya pakṣa anuguṇam iti darśayitum na punar eṣā eva kāryatve yuktiḥ iti alam sūkṣma īkṣikayā

aparaḥ āha parispanda vilakṣaṇa tvasya pratyakṣa tvāt akarma tvam śabdasya sādhyate na samāna jāti ārambhaka tvāt iti itaretara āśraya sparśaḥ api na asti iti tasmāt sarvathā pariśeṣa anumānāt śabdasya guṇa tva siddhiḥ

katham tarhi asya mahat tva ādi yogaḥ nirguṇāḥ guṇāḥ iti hi kāṇādāḥ asti hi pratītiḥ mahān śabdaḥ iti samāna jātīya guṇa abhiprāyam tat kaṇāda vacanam iti na doṣaḥ tasmāt ākāśaguṇaḥ śabdaḥ api ca yathā aatma guṇa tā hi icchā dveṣa ādeḥ upapatsyate śabdaḥ nayena tena eva bhaviṣyati nabhaḥ guṇaḥ

ye tu samāna jātīya śabda ārambhaka tva niṣedha hetavaḥ śabda tvāt ityādayaḥ paraiḥ upanyaḥ tāḥ teṣām aprayojaka tvāt na sādhana tvam ittham santāna vṛttyā ca śabda grahaṇa sambhave kalpanā alpatarā asmākam na śabda vyakti vādinām śākyakāpila nirgrantha grathita prakriyām prati yat tu dūṣaṇam ākhyātam asmākam priyam eva tat

tasmāt kārya pakṣe niyata grahaṇa upapatteḥ abhivyakti pakṣe ca tad abhāvāt kāryaḥ eva śabdaḥ iti sthitam tat idam uktam sūtra kṛtā ādimattvā t aindriyaka tvāt kṛtaka vat upacārāt ca anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti ādima tvāt iti saṃyoga vibhāga ādīnām śabde kāraka tvam na vyañjaka tvam iti darśitam atas ca na prayatna ānantarīyaka tvam anaikāntikam

aindriyaka tvāt iti kārya pakṣaḥ eva śabdasya niyatam grahaṇam iti uktam prati puruṣam pratyuccāraṇam ca śabda bhedasya aindriyaka tvāt iti vā hetu arthaḥ tena pratyabhijñā durāśā śrotriyāṇām apākṛtā bhavati kṛtaka vat upacārāt iti tīvra manda vibhāga abhibhava ādi vyavahāra adarśanāt sukha duḥkha ādi vat anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti darśitam

tathā prāk ūrdhvam uccāraṇāt anupalabdheḥ āvaraṇa anupalabdheḥ ca iti anena sūtreṇa śabda abhāva kṛtam eva tat agrahaṇam iti uktam na hi stimitāḥ vāyavaḥ śabdam āvarītum arhanti mūrtam hi mūrtena vyavadhīyate na amūrtam ākāśa ādi vat na ca prakṛtyā eva ākāśa ādi vat ati indriyaḥ śabdaḥ tasmāt kṣaṇika pratīteḥ tad kālam eva śabdasya avasthānam iti asthāna hetoḥ api na anyathā siddha tvam
vārtika kṛtā śabda anitya tve sādhanam abhihitam anityaḥ śabdaḥ jātimat tve satya smad ādi bāhya karaṇa pratyakṣa tvāt ghaṭa vat iti

yat tu atra jātīnām api jātimat tvāt anaikāntika tvam udbhāvitam eka artha samavāyena jātiḥ jātimatī yatas iti tat atyantam anupapannam nissāmānyāni sāmānya ādīni iti su prasiddha tvāt na hi ghaṭe ghaṭa tva pārthiva tve staḥ iti ghaṭa tva sāmānye api pārthiva tva sāmānyam asti iti śakyate vaktum atas niravadya eva ayam hetuḥ tena yat ucyate jātimattva aindriya tva ādi vastu sanmātra bandhanam śabda anitya tva sidhi artham kaḥ vadet yaḥ na tārkikaḥ iti tad avidita tārkika parispandasya vyāhṛtam

iha tu aprayojakāḥ hetavaḥ bhavanti hyastana uccāritaḥ tasmāt go śabdaḥ adya api vartate go śabda jñāna gamya tvāt yathā uktaḥ adya eṣa gauḥ iti vijñāna grāhya tā nāma vastu svābhāvya bandhanā nitya tve kṛtaka tve vā na khalu eṣā prayojikā aprayojaka tā ca evaṃprāyāṇām ca evam ucyate svayam ca ete prayujyante hetu tvena iti kim nu idam
evam nitya tve durbalaḥ yukti mārgaḥ tasmāt mantavyaḥ kāryaḥ eva iti śabdaḥ vācaḥ yukti tve vaidikaḥ yaḥ anuvādaḥ nyāye pratyukte kiṃphalaḥ tad prayogaḥ

kṣaṇa bhaṅgi bhāvasya abhāvāt api śabdasya kṣaṇika tām na vaktum alam sthūla vināśa bhāvāt iti yat uktam tat api anṛtam sṛkṣma vināśa apekṣī nāśaḥ sthūla sthirasya kumbha ādeḥ prakṛti taralasya nāśaḥ śabdasya saḥ eva hi sthūlaḥ sattvāt yadi kṣaṇika tām kathayet purā vā śabdaḥ tadā eṣa katham akṣaṇikaḥ abhidheyaḥ yukti antarāt yadi tat eva hi tarhi cintyam kim prauḍhi vāda bahu māna parigraheṇa alam ativitata uktyā tyajyatām nitya vādaḥ kṛtakaḥ iti naya jñaiḥ gṛhyatām eṣa śabdaḥ sati ca kṛtaka bhāve tasya kartā purāṇaḥ kavi ravirala śaktiḥ yuktaḥ eva indu mauliḥ

evam kṛtaka tve varṇānām sādhite sati varṇa ātmanaḥ padāt prabhṛti sarvatra puruṣasya svātantryam siddham bhavati pada nitya tva pakṣe api vākye tat racana ātmake kartṛ tva saṃbhavāt puṃsaḥ vedaḥ katham akṛtrimaḥ tathā ca vaidikyaḥ racanāḥ kartṛ pūrvikāḥ racanā tvāt laukika racanā vat eṣa ca pañca lakṣaṇaḥ hetuḥ prayojakaḥ ca iti gamakaḥ eva na hetvābhāsaḥ

na tāvat ayam asiddhaḥ hetuḥ śannaḥ devīḥ abhiṣṭaye ityādiṣu veda vākya sandarbheṣu pada racanāyāḥ svara krama ādi viśeṣavatyāḥ pratyakṣa tvena pakṣe hetoḥ vartamāna tvāt na api viruddhaḥ kartṛ pūrvakatvavati sa pakṣe kumāra sambhava ādau racanā tu asya vidyamāna tvāt na api anaikāntikaḥ kartṛ rahiteṣu gagana ādiṣu gagana kusuma ādiṣu vā racanāyāḥ adṛṣṭa tvāt

na api kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ pratyakṣeṇa āgamena vā vede vaktra bhāva niścaya anutpādāt na api sat pratipakṣaḥ prakaraṇa cintā hetoḥ sthāṇu puruṣa viśeṣa anupalabdheḥ iva hetu tvena anabhidhānāt na api paramāṇu anitya tāyām iva mūrta tvam aprayojakam idam sādhanam racanā vyāpārāṇām kartṛ vyā pāra sādhya tva avadhāraṇāt yathā dhūmasya jvalana adhīnaḥ ātma lābhaḥ jñaptiḥ tu dhūmāt agneḥ tathā kartṛ adhīnā racanānām abhinirvṛttiḥ pratītiḥ tu tābhyaḥ kartuḥ iti tasmāt prayojakaḥ eva ayam hetuḥ

nanu sat pratipakṣa tve vivadante tathā ca mīmāṃsakaiḥ pratihetuḥ iha gīyate vedasya adhyayanam sarvam guru adhyayana pūrvakam veda adhyayana vācya tvāt adhunā adhyayanam yathā iti na etat yuktam evaṃprāyāṇām prayogāṇām aprayojaka tvāt na hi tad śabda vācya tva kṛtam anādi tvam upapadyate anaikāntikaḥ ca ayam hetuḥ bhārate api evam abhidhātum śakya tvāt bhārata adhyayanam sarvam guru adhyayana pūrvakam bhārata adhyayana vācya tvāt idānīṃtana bhāra ta adhyayana vat iti

nanu bhārate kartṛ smṛtiḥ avigītā vidyate yadi evam vede api prajāpatiḥ kartā smaryate eva atha vaidika mantra artha vāda mūlā iyam prajāpati kartṛ tva smṛtiḥ prajāpatinā catvāraḥ vedāḥ asṛjyanta catvāraḥ varṇāḥ catvāraḥ āśramāḥ iti tatra pāṭhāt iti ucyate hanta tarhi bhārate api tatratya vacana mūlā eva pārāśarya smṛtiḥ iti śakyate vaktum

yathā prajāpatiḥ vede tatra tatra praśasyate bhārate api tathā vyāsaḥ tatra tatra praśasyate atha praṇetā vedasya na dṛṣṭaḥ kenacid kvacid dvaipāyanaḥ api kim dṛṣṭaḥ bhavat pitṛ pitāmahaiḥ sarveṣām avigītā ced smṛtiḥ satyavatī sute prajāpatiḥ api sraṣṭā loke sarvatra gīyate

āha kim iti sat asat viveka vikala śā kaṭikā ādi pravāda vipralabdhaḥ evam bhrāmyasi kila svalpam api karma pitrā mātrā vā upadiśyamānam tad vacana pratyayāt anuṣṭhīyate tat ayam iyān aneka kleśa vitta vyayā ādi nirvartyaḥ vaidikaḥ karma kalāpaḥ evam eva tad upadeśinam āptam saṃsmṛtvā eva kriyate iti mahān pramādaḥ evañca sati uccāvacaka viracita jarat pustaka likhita kāvya vat asmaryamāṇa kartṛkeṇa vedena vyavahāra anupapatteḥ avaśya smaraṇīyaḥ tatra kartā syāt na ca kadācana vedeṣu vyavahāra vicchedaḥ saṃbhāvyate yena tat kṛtam jaratkūpa ārām a ādiṣu iva teṣu kartṛ asmaraṇam syāt tasmāt avaśyam smaryeta kartā na ca saṃsmaryate smartum śakyate vā smṛtiḥ hi bhavantī tad anubhava mūlā bhavati na ca mūle api kartṛ anubhavaḥ kasyacid jātaḥ sarga ādeḥ abhāvāt bhāve vā kartuḥ aśarīra tvena darśana yogya tva abhāvāt

sa śarīra tva pakṣe vā puruṣaḥ kaḥ api tādṛśaḥ tadānīm dṛśyamānaḥ api vedam kurvan na dṛśyate adhīyamāne dṛṣṭe asmin tadā saṃśerate janāḥ kim eṣa racayet vedam uta vā anya kṛtam paṭhet yat kṛtam vā paṭhet eṣaḥ tasmin api hi saṃśayaḥ bhaṅgyā ca idam anādi tvam unmīlat iva dṛśyate asatya ādi pramāṇe ca kartṛ tā anubhavam prati smṛtiḥ prabandha siddhā api spṛśati andha paramparām yogibhiḥ grahaṇam kartuḥ iti etat api durvacam kartṛ tā hṛdi durbodhā katham gṛhyeta taiḥ api yogibhiḥ sā gṛhītā iti vayam etat na manmahe amanvānāḥ ca gacchema visrabdhāḥ tat patham katham vedāt kartṛ avabodhe tu spaṣṭam anyonya saṃśrayam tatas veda pramāṇa tvam vedāt kartuḥ ca niścayaḥ tasmāt paurvāparya paryālocanā rahita yathā śruta mantra artha vāda mūlā bhrāntiḥ eṣā na punar paramārthataḥ kaścid kañcid vedasya kartāram smarati tasmāt akṛtakāḥ vedāḥ avaśya smaraṇīyasya api kartuḥ asmaraṇāt na ca vyadhikaraṇaḥ hetuḥ asmaryamāṇa kartṛka tvāt iti evam sādhana prayogāt

atra ucyate api tat guru adhyayana pūrvaka tvam sādhanam upekṣitam yājñikaiḥ ayam abhinavaḥ hetuḥ asmaryamāṇa kartṛka tvāt iti prayuktaḥ tasmāt astu nāma na enān hetu antara upanyāsinaḥ nigṛhṇīmaḥ akṣuda kathā iyam prastutā ayam api asmaryamāṇa kartṛka tvāt iti hetuḥ kim svatantraḥ eva akartṛka tva siddhaye prayujyate uta asmad uparacita racanā tu a pratighātāya iti

tatra na tāvat anumānam anumāna antara paripanthi kathayitum ucitam pratyakṣa āgama vat anumānasya api anumāna bādhaka tva anupapatteḥ na hi tulya balayoḥ anumānayoḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ tulya bala tvāt eva atulya bala tve tu yat kṛtam anyatarasya daurbalyam tatas eva tad aprāmāṇya siddheḥ kim anumāna bādhayā tad viḍambana artham tat abhidhānam iti ced tat api ayuktam ekatra dharmiṇi yugapad ita retara virodhi dharma dvaya prayojaka hetu dvaya upanipāta ayogāt na hi dvi ātmakāni vastūni bhavitum arhanti iti avaśyam anyataraḥ tatra aprayojaka hetuḥ aprayojaka tvāt eva tasya āgamaka tve kim viḍambana arthena hetu antareṇa prayuktena viruddha avyabhicārī api nāma na kaścid hetu ābhāsaḥ iti vakṣyāmaḥ

prakaraṇa samaḥ api na yaḥ kaścid sat pratipakṣaḥ hetuḥ iṣyate api tu saṃśaya bīja bhūtaḥ anyatara viśeṣa anupalambhaḥ bhrāntyā hetu tvena prayujyamānaḥ tathā ucyate iti darśayiṣyāmaḥ tasmāt para udīritam hetum nirācikīrṣatā vādinā tad gata pakṣa vṛtti ta ādi dharma parīkṣaṇe manaḥ khedanīyam na hi pratihetu anveṣiṇā vṛthā aṭāṭyā kartavyā

nanu kataradanayoḥ sādhanayoḥ aprayojakam racanā tvāt asmaryamāṇa kartṛka tvāt iti ca ucyate racanā tvam eva prayojakam na hi puruṣam antareṇa kvacid akṣara vinyāsaḥ iṣṭavya bho bhagavantaḥ sabhyāḥ kva idam dṛṣṭam kva vā śrutam loke yad vākyeṣu padānām racanā naisargikī bhavati yadi svābhāvikī vede padānām racanā bhavet paṭe hi hanta tantūnām katham naisargikī na sā śannaḥ devīḥ abhiṣṭaye nārāyaṇam namaskṛtya asti uttarasyām diśi devatā ātmā iti tulye racanā tve kvacid kartṛ pūrvaka tvam aparatra tad viparyayaḥ iti mahān vyāmohaḥ evam hi dhūmaḥ api kaścid anannikaḥ iti api syāt

kim idānīm kumāra saṃbhava tulyaḥ asau vedaḥ saṃpannaḥ aho sarva astika dhuryeṇa veda prāmāṇyam sādhitam naiyāyikena alam upahāsena racanā mātram eva tulyam vedasya kumāra saṃbhavena na anyat na ceyata upahasitum yuktam kim asya śabda tva sāmānyam śaṅkha śabda sādhāraṇam na asti sattā sāmānyam vā sarva sādhāraṇam iti

nanu yāḥ kāli dāsa ādi racanāḥ kartṛ pūrvikāḥ tābhyaḥ vilakṣaṇā eva iyam racanā bhāti vaidikī iha adhyayana velāyām rūpāt eva pratīyate akṛtrima tvam vedasya bhedaiḥ taiḥ taiḥ ananya gaiḥ nāma ākhyāta upasarga ādi prayoga gatayaḥ navāḥ stuti nindā purā kalpa parakṛti ādi gītayaḥ śākhā antara ukta sāpekṣa vikṣipta artha upavarṇanā ityādayaḥ na dṛśyante laukike sannibandhane tena adhyetṛ gaṇāḥ sarve rūpāt vedam akṛtrimam manyante eva loke tu pītam mīmāṃsakaiḥ yaśaḥ vedāḥ na paṭhitāḥ yaiḥ tu tvādṛśaiḥ kuṇṭha buddhibhiḥ kāryatvam bruvate te asya racanā sāmya mohitāḥ

ucyate mīmāṃsakāḥ yaśaḥ pibantu payaḥ vā pibantu buddhi jāḍya apanayanāya brāhmī ghṛtam vā pibantu vedaḥ tu puruṣa praṇītaḥ eva na atra bhrāntiḥ yathā ghaṭa ādi saṃsthānāt bhinnam api acala ādiṣu saṃsthānam kartṛmat siddham vede api racanā tathā yat ca atra kiñcid vaktavyam tat pūrvam eva sa vistaram uktam

api ca yat vilakṣaṇā iyam racanā tad vilakṣaṇaḥ eva kartā anumīyatām na punar tad apalāpaḥ yuktaḥ iti api uktam yāḥ ca etāḥ nirvivāda sidva kartṛkāḥ kāli dāsa ādi racanāḥ camatkāriṇyaḥ tāsām anyonya visadṛśam rūpam upalabhyate eva amṛtena iva saṃsiktāḥ candanena iva carcitāḥ candra aṃśubhiḥ iva unmṛṣṭāḥ kāli dāsasya sūktayaḥ prakaṭa rasa anuguṇa vikaṭa akṣara racanā camat kārita sakalaka vikulāḥ bāṇasya vācaḥ pratikāvyam ca tāni tāni vaicitryāṇi dṛśyante eva nāma ākhyāta ādi vaicitrya mātreṇa kartṛ abhāvaḥ vede rūpāt eva pratīyate iti nūtaneyam vācā uyuktiḥ
api ca yadi rūpe samāśvasiti bhavataḥ manaḥ tadā ādimad artha abhidhānam api vedasya rūpam katham na parīkṣase babaraḥ prāvāhaṇiḥ akāmayata kusura binda auddālakiḥ akāmayata purūravaḥ mā prapataḥ iti

pratisargam punar teṣām bhāvāt anādi tvam iti ced pratisargam tarhi veda anyatvam api bhaviṣyati yathā uktam pratimanvantaram ca eṣā śrutiḥ anyā abhidhīyate iti rūpāt akṛtrimat tve ca kalpanā kalpitā eva sā ādimat vastu buddhiḥ tu vācakaiḥ akṣaraiḥ sphuṭaiḥ teṣām anyathā vyākhyānam tu vyākhyānam eva paṭhantaḥ eva tu adhyetāraḥ tatas ādim ataḥ arthān bahūn avagacchanti iti nānādirvedaḥ tasmāt na racanā tvam aprayojakam

kartṛ asmaraṇam eva tu aprayojakam asiddha tvāt siddham api vā vede kartṛ asmaraṇam anyathā siddham veda karaṇa kālasya ati davīyaḥ tvāt tad praṇetuḥ ca puṃsaḥ sakala puruṣa vilakṣaṇa tvāt niyata śarīra parigraha abhāvāt idantayā asya pāṇi nipiṅgala ādi vat smaraṇam na asti na tu sa na asti eva anumāna āgamābhyām tad avagamāt katham pakṣa dharma tayā grahītum śakyate kartṛ asmaraṇam

tad hi eka puruṣa sambandhi vyabhicarati sarva puruṣa sambandhi tu duravagamam sarve pumāṃsaḥ kartāram vedasya na smaranti iti katham jānāti bhavān na hi tava sakala loka hṛdayāni pratyakṣāṇi sarvajña tva prasaṅgāt na ca yat tvam na jānāsi tat anyaḥ api na jānāti iti yuktam atiprasaṅgāt tasmāt asmaryamāṇa kartṛka tvam durbodham eva

api ca kartuḥ asmaraṇe sati sutarām veda artha anuṣṭhānam prekṣāvatām śithilībhavet na hi akartṛkaḥ eva upadeśaḥ saṃbhavati saṃbhavan api vā prāmāṇya niścaya nimitta abhāvāt katham visraṃbhabhūmiḥ asau bhavet bādhaka abhāva mātrāt ca na prāmāṇya niścayaḥ vacasām iti uktam prāk tasmāt āpta pratyayāt eva nirvicikitsam veda artha anuṣṭhānam sa pratiṣṭhānam saṃbhavati na anyathā iti tasmāt na kartṛ asmaraṇasya racanā tu apratipakṣa tayā upanyāsaḥ upapannaḥ

na api svatantram eva idam kartṛ abhāva sādhanam bhavitum arhati anupalabdhiḥ iyam anena prakāreṇa kila ucyate sā anupapannā anumānena kartuḥ upalambhāt anumānena api yat upalabdham tad upalabdham eva bhavati

nanu kartṛ abhāva smaraṇa bādhita tvāt anumānam idam ayuktam itaretara āśraya prasaṅgāt anupalabdhau siddhāyām anumāna nirāsaḥ anumāna nirāse ca sati anupalabdhi siddhiḥ anumāna prāmāṇye api samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti ced na tasya pratibandha mahimnā prāmāṇya siddheḥ na hi tasya anupalabdhi nirāsa apekṣam prāmāṇyam

tatra etat syāt na vayam kartṛ abhāve prāmāṇyam brūmaḥ sakala loka padārtha vyavahāriṇaḥ hi mīmāṃsakāḥ param tu vedasya pauruṣeya tām bruvāṇam pramāṇam pṛcchāmaḥ tat ca asya na asti iti balāt anupalabdhyā tad abhāva niścayaḥ vyavatiṣṭhate iti syāt etat evam yadi anumānam na syāt uktam ca racanā tvāt iti anumānam

yat punar avādi vedeṣu puruṣasya kartṛ tvam aśakyam grahītum iti tat api asādhu parokṣasya kuvinda ādeḥ abhinava prāvaraka paṭa ādau kārye katham kartṛtā avagamyate paṭa ādi racanām dṛṣṭvā tasya ced sā anumīyate vede api racanām dṛṣṭvā kartṛ tvam tasya gamyatām

śarīra parigraham antareṇa prāṇinām upadeśasya kartum aśakyatvāt kadācid īśvaraḥ śarīram api gṛhṇīyāt iti kalpyate niyata śarīra parigraha abhāvāt ca vyāsa ādi vat asau na smaryate tatas ca adya sadyas kaviḥ kāvye yathā kartā iti mīyate tathā tad kāla jaiḥ puṃbhiḥ saḥ api kartā iti māsyate yathā para kṛtā śaṅkā tasmin kāvye vyapaiti te vede api anya kṛtā śaṅkā tathā teṣām vyapaiṣyati parokṣam anumānena yat ca budhyāmahe vayam pratyakṣam yoginām tat ca iti uktam pratyakṣa lakṣaṇe pratyakṣam anumānam ca tat evam kartṛ tā amitau mūla pramāṇam asti iti smṛtau na andha paraṃparā mantra artha vāda mūla tvam tatas eva na tad smṛteḥ yathā udita anumāna ādi pramāṇa antara saṃbhavāt

yat api itaretara āśrayam abhāṣi puruṣa ukte vedeprāmāṇyam veda prāmāṇyāt puruṣa siddhiḥ iti tat api na samyak pūrvam parihṛta tvāt anumānāt prasiddhe kartari veda vākyaiḥ tat pratīteḥ upodbalanam iṣyate na tu āgama eka śaraṇaḥ eva kartṛ avagamaḥ uktam ca pūrvam api pṛthivī ādinā kāryeṇa kartuḥ anumānam

kim yena eva kartrā pṛthivī ādi kāryam nirmitam tena eva vaidikyaḥ racanāḥ nirmitāḥ iti ced om iti ucyate kim atra pramāṇam iti ced ucyate tarhi sarvajñaḥ sraṣṭum prabhavati īdṛśam vicitram prāṇibhṛt karma phala bhoga āśrayam jagat tad karma phala sambandha vidā tad upadeśinaḥ tena eva vedāḥ racitāḥ iti na anyasya kalpanā ekena eva ca siddhe arthe dvitīyam kalpayema kim aneka kalpanā bījam na hi kiñcana vidyate

jagat sarge tāvat ekaḥ eva īśvaraḥ iṣyate na dvau bahavaḥ vā bhinna abhinna āśaya kalpane ekatra vaiyarthyāt itaratra vyabahāra vaiśasa prasaṅgena tatas ekasya īśvara tva vighātāt tathā hi aneka īśvara vādaḥ hi na atīva hṛdayaṅgamaḥ te ced sadṛśa saṅkalpāḥ kaḥ arthaḥ bahubhiḥ īśvaraiḥ saṃkalpayati yat ekaḥ śubham aśubham vā api satya saṅkalpaḥ tat sidhyati tad vibhavāt iti aparaḥ tatra kim kuryāt bhinna abhiprāyatāyām tu kārya vipratiṣedhataḥ nūnam ekaḥ sva saṅkalpa vihatyā anīśvaraḥ bhavet ekasya kila saṅkalpaḥ rājā ayam kriyatām iti hanyatām iti ca anyasya tau samāviśataḥ katham rājya saṅkalpa sāphalye vihatā badha kāmanā tasyāḥ sa phala tāyām vā rājya saṅkalpa viplavaḥ tena citra jagat kārya saṃvāha anuguṇa āśayaḥ ekaḥ eva īśvaraḥ sraṣṭā jagatām iti sādhitam evam jagat sarga vat saḥ eva vedānām api ekaḥ praṇetā bhavitum arhati nānā tva kalpanāyām pramāṇa abhāvāt kalpanā gaurava prasaṅgāt ca tena yat ucyate nanu ekaḥ sarva śākhānām kartā iti avagatam kutas bahavaḥ bahubhiḥ granthāḥ katham na racitāḥ ime iti tad parihṛtam bhavati

atas ca eka kartṛkāḥ vedāḥ yatas paraspara vyatiṣakta artha upadeśinaḥ dṛśyante ekam eva hi karma veda catuṣṭaya upadiṣṭaiḥ pṛthak bhūtaiḥ api eka artha sama vāyibhiḥ aṅgaiḥ anvitam prayujyate tatra hi hautram ṛgvedena yajurvedena adhvarya vam audgātram sāmavedena brahma tvam atharvavedena ca kriyate paippala ādi śākhā bheda upadiṣṭam ca tad tad aṅga jātam tatra tatra apekṣyate tatra sarva śākhā pratyayam ekam karma iti āhuḥ etat ca adūraḥ eva agre nirṇeṣyate eka abhiprāya baddha tvam tena sarvatra gamyate bhavet bhinnāśayānām hi katham eka artha mīlanam

kāvya samasya āpūraṇe kā vārtā iti ced tatra api prathamasya eva kaveḥ tad vastu darśanāt tad abhiprāya vedī tu saḥ anyastam anuvartate anyathā ananvitam kāvyam syāt viśva vasu kāvyavat anvita tve tu sā nūnam ādyasya eva kaveḥ matiḥ iha api ekāśaya abhijña dvitīya īśvara kalpane eka abhiprāya tā eva syāt kim ca tad kalpane phalam tasmāt ekaḥ eva kartā sarva śākhānām kāṭhaka ādi vyapadeśaḥ tu prakṛṣṭa adhyayana nibandhanaḥ bhaviṣyati iti bhavadbhiḥ api uktam

api ca yathā taroḥ vikṣiptāḥ śākhāḥ bhavanti na ca kṛtsnam puṣpa phala patram ekasyām śākhāyām sannihitam bhavati kintu kasyāñcitkasyāñcid evam vedasya api śākhāḥ pṛthak aṅga karma upadeśinyaḥ vikṣiptāḥ ca tāsām ca vṛkṣa śākhānām ekasmāt janma bījataḥ tathā eva sarva śākhānām ekasmāt puruṣottamāt

kartā yaḥ eva jagatām akhilātma vṛtti karma prapañca paripāka vicitra tājñaḥ viśva ātmanā tad upadeśa parāḥ praṇītāḥ tena eva veda racanā iti yuktam etat āptam tam eva bhagavantam anādim īśam āśritya viśvasiti veda vacassu lokaḥ teṣām akartṛka tayā na hi kaścid evam visrambham eti matimān iti varṇitam prāk evañca pada vākya racanā ādau tāvat vedeṣu puruṣa apekṣi tvam upapāditam

yat api sambandha karaṇe puruṣa anapekṣa tvam ucyate citra bhānoḥ iva dahana śaktiḥ śabdasya naisargikī vācaka śaktiḥ vyutpattiḥ tu vṛddhebhyaḥ eva vyavaharamāṇebhyaḥ upalabhyate iti kim atra puruṣaḥ kariṣyati iti tat api aghaṭamānam puruṣa parighaṭita samaya sambandha vyatirekeṇa śabdāt artha pratyaya anupapatteḥ

nanu na eva śabdasya arthena sambandhaḥ kaścid asti kasya idam puruṣa sāpekṣa tvam vā nirapekṣa tvam vā cintyate na hi śabda arthayoḥ kuḍya badarayoḥ iva saṃyoga svabhāvaḥ tantu paṭayoḥ iva samavāya ātmā vā sambandhaḥ pratyakṣaḥ upalabhyate tad mūla tvāt ca sambandha antarāṇi api na santi tat uktam mukhe śabdam upalabhāmahe bhūmau artham iti na api anumīyate śabdasya arthena sambandhaḥ kṣurama udaka śabda uccāraṇe mukhasya pāṭana pūraṇa anupalambhāt na ca śabda deśe arthaḥ saṃbhavati na ca artha deśe śabdaḥ sthāna karaṇa prayatnānām tad hetūnām ghaṭa ādi artha pradeśe anupalambhāt vyāpaka tvam tu śabdasya pratiṣiddham eva

ucyate na saṃśleṣa lakṣaṇaḥ śabda artha sambandhaḥ asmābhiḥ abhyupagamyate tat kim kārya kāraṇa nimitta naimittika āśraya āśrayi bhāva ādayaḥ śabdasya arthena sambandhāḥ ete api na tarām na tarhi tasya kaścid arthena sambandhaḥ na na asti śabdasya arthena sambandhaḥ pratyaya nimitta hetu tvāt dhūma ādi vat tat kim śabda arthayoḥ avinā bhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ saḥ api na asti evam hi śabdaḥ anumānam eva syāt kaḥ tarhi samayaḥ iti brūmaḥ

kaḥ ayam samayaḥ nāma abhidhāna abhidheya niyama niyogaḥ samayaḥ ucyate yadi evam kim anā śaṅkanīya saṃśleṣa paricodanena tad dūṣaṇena ca ucyate śabda artha abheda vādinām hi vaiyākaraṇānām eṣa saṃśleṣa rūpaḥ sambandhaḥ balāt āpatati iti te eva pratikṣepyante

āha yadi vaiyākaraṇa varṇitaḥ na saṃśleṣaḥ upapattimān samayaḥ ayam anupapanne eva sa hi puruṣa kṛtaḥ saṅketaḥ na ca puruṣa icchayā vastu niyamaḥ avakalpate tad icchāyāḥ avyāhata prasara tvāt arthaḥ api kim iti vācakaḥ na bhavati śabdaḥ ca vācyaḥ na ca evam asti dahanam anicchan api puruṣaḥ dhūmāt na tam pratyeti jalam vā tatas icchan api pratipadyate tatra yathā dhūma agnyoḥ naisargikaḥ eva avinābhāvaḥ nāma sambandhaḥ jñaptaye tu bhūyas darśana ādi nimittam āśrīyate evam śabda arthayoḥ sāṃsiddhikaḥ eva śakti ātmā sambandhaḥ tad vyutpattaye tu vṛddha vyavahāra prasiddhi samāśrayaṇam

svābhāvike sambandhe sati dīpa ādi vat kim tad vyutpatti apekṣaṇena iti ced na śabdasya jñāpaka tvāt jñāpakasya dhūma ādeḥ etat rūpam yat sambandha grahaṇa apekṣam sva jñāpyajñāpaka tvam udyota ādayaḥ tu pratyakṣa sāmagrī antargata tvāt na vyutpatti apekṣyāḥ bhavanti śaktiḥ tu naisargikī yathā rūpa prakāśinī dīpa ādeḥ tathā śabdasya artha pratipādane tasmāt na samaya mātrāt artha pratipattiḥ
api ca abhidhāna abhidheya niyama niyoga rūpaḥ samayaḥ jñānam eva na tatas artha antaram jñānam ca ātmani vartate na ca śabda arthayoḥ iti na tayoḥ sambandhaḥ syāt

kiñca samayaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ pratyuccāraṇam vā kriyate prati puruṣam vā sarga ādau vā sakṛt īśvareṇa iti pratyuccāraṇam prāktanaḥ eva kriyate nūtanaḥ vā navasya tāvat kriyamāṇasya katham artha pratyāyana sāmarthyam avagamyate tad avagatau vā kim tad karaṇena pūrva kṛtasya tu kṛta tvāt eva punar karaṇam anupapannam ekasya vastunaḥ jñaptiḥ asakṛt āvartate na utpattiḥ

prati puruṣam api sambandhaḥ bhinnaḥ abhinnaḥ vā kriyate bheda pakṣe katham eka artha saṃjñānam go śabdasya sa asrādimānarthaḥ kesara ādimān aśva śabdasya iti abhede api tathā eva kṛtasya karaṇa ayogāt jñānam eva sambandhasya karaṇam sarga ādau api sakṛt sambandha karaṇam ayuktam tathāvidha kāla asambhavāt eva na hi śabda artha vyavahāra rahitaḥ kaścid kāle upapadyate tasmāt nityasya eva sambandhasya lokataḥ vyutpattiḥ na punar karaṇam

vyutpatti pakṣam ca na karaṇa pakṣa abhihitāḥ doṣāḥ spṛśanti pratyakṣa siddha tvāt pratyakṣam hi idam upalabhyate vṛddhānām hi sva arthe vyavaharamāṇānām upaśṛṇvantaḥ bālāḥ tatas tatas śabdāt tam tam artham pratiyanti te api vṛddhāḥ yadā bālāḥ āsan tadā anyebhyaḥ vṛddhebhyaḥ tathā eva pratipanna bantaḥ te api anyebhyaḥ iti na asti ādissaṃsārasyati

api ca samaya mātra śaraṇaḥ śakti śūnyaḥ śabdaḥ katham akṣi nikoca hasta saṃjñā ādibhyaḥ midyeta sa hi tadānīm kaśā aṅkuśa pratoda abhighāta sthānīyaḥ eva bhavet tathā ca śabdāt artham pratipadyāmahe iti laukikaḥ vyapadeśaḥ bādhyeta samayāt artham pratipadyāmahe iti syāt samaya pakṣe ca yadṛcchā śabda tulya tvam sarva śabdānām prāpnoti tena gavāśvādi śabdānām niyata viṣaya tvam na syāt

yat punar ucyate jāti viśeṣe ca aniyamāt samaya rūpaḥ sambandhaḥ iti jāti śabdena atra deśaḥ vivakṣitaḥ kila kvacid deśe kaścid śabdaḥ deśa antara prasiddham artham utsṛjya tatas artha antare vartate yathā cora śabdaḥ taskara vacanaḥ odane dākṣiṇātyaiḥ prayujyate etat ca samaya pakṣe yujyate nitye tu sambandhe katham tad artha vyabhicāraḥ iti tat api ayuktam sarva śabdānām sarva artha pratyāyana śakti yukta tvāt kvacid deśe kenacid arthena vyabahāraḥ atas eva ca anavagata sambandhe śrute sati sandehaḥ bhavati kam artham pratyāyayitum anena ayam śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ syāt iti asatyām hi śaktau akṛta samaye nirālambanā pratyāyaka tvā aaśaṅkā iti

athavā ārya deśa prasiddhaḥ eva śabdānām arthaḥ itaraḥ tu mleccha jana sammataḥ anādaraṇīyaḥ eva tasmāt samaya pakṣasya ati daurbalyāt akṛtrimaḥ eva śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ iti na tatra puruṣasya prabhaviṣṇu tā
atra ucyate na nityaḥ sambandhaḥ upapadyate śabda vat arthavat ca tṛtīyasya tasya pratyakṣa ādinā pramāṇena apratīyamāna tvāt

nanu śakti rūpaḥ sambandhaḥ iti uktam śaktiḥ ca tad āśritā iti katham dharmyantara vat pṛthaktayā pratīyeta na etat sāṃpratam svarūpa sahakāri vyatiriktāyāḥ śakteḥ sūkṣmāyāḥ prāk eva vistarataḥ pratikṣipta tvāt na ca śaktiḥ pratyakṣa gamyā dravya svarūpa vat anupalambhāt na anumeyā kāryāṇām anyathā api ghaṭamāna tvāt kalpayitvā ca śaktim aparihāryaḥ samayaḥ samayam antareṇa artha pratipatteḥ asiddheḥ siddhe ca samaye tatas eva artha siddheḥ kim nitya sambandha āśrayaṇena

yat tu uktam samayasya puruṣa icchā adhīna tvāt tasyāḥ ca avyāhata prasara tvāt vācya vācaka vyatyayaḥ syāt iti tat ayuktam śakti abhāve śabdasya eva vācaka tve yogya tvāt kā punar śakti abhāve yogyatā asya iti ced yaḥ ayam gatvā ādi jāti yogaḥ krama viśeṣa upakṛtaḥ gatvā autu a ādi sāmānya sambandhaḥ hi yasya bhavati sa vācaka tve yogyaḥ iti itaraḥ tu vācya tve yathā dravya tva ādi aviśeṣe api vīraṇa tva ādi sāmānyavatām kaṭa niṣpattau tantu tva ādi sāmānyavatām ca paṭa niṣpattau na ca tatra śaktiḥ asti iti uktam na ca kāraṇe kāryam sat iti sāṅkhyaiḥ iva bhavadbhiḥ iṣyate tasyām asatyām api śaktau sāmānya viśeṣa sambandhasya niyāmaka tvāt na vācya vācakayoḥ vyatyayaḥ iti na śakti rūpaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ

na ca tayoḥ avinā abhāvaḥ dhūma agnyoḥ iva sambandhaḥ tatra hi sambandhaḥ pratīyamānaḥ evam pratīyate dhūmaḥ agnim vinā na bhavati iti iha punar ayam asmāt pratīyate iti etāvatī eva vyutpatti paryavasānam atas eva avagati pūrvikā eva avagatiḥ iha iti anumānāt śabdasya bhedaḥ uktaḥ prakāśaka tvam api śabdasya samaya prasāda upanatam eva na svābhāvikam sāṃsiddhike hi tathā tve bhramitvā ādi prayuktāt anyatas vā yatas kutaścid abhinavāt api dīpāt iva śabdāt artha pratītiḥ syāt

yat tu naisargike api prakāśaka tve śabdasya dhūma ādeḥ iva jñāpaka tvāt sambandha grahaṇa sāpekṣa tvam uktam saḥ eṣa viṣamaḥ upanyāsaḥ na hi dhūma ādeḥ pratyāyaka tvam svābhāvikam analāvinā bhāvi tvam tu tasya nijam balam tatra ca agṛhyate tasmin pratītiḥ eva na jāyate iti yuktam tat grahaṇam prati iti artham iha tu pratīti śaktiḥ eva svābhāvikī bhavatā abhyupagamyate sā ced svābhāvikī kim vyutpatti apekṣaṇena iti

yadi ca ucyate pratyāyakaḥ iti pratyayam dṛṣṭvā avagacchāmaḥ na prathama śravaṇaḥ iti yāvat kṛtvas śrutena iyam saṃjñā ayam saṃjñī iti avagamyate tāvat kṛtvas śrutāt artha avagamaḥ iti saḥ ayam samaya upayogaḥ eva kathitaḥ bhavati saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandhaḥ hi samayaḥ eva ucyate tad upayogam antareṇa pratyāyaka tvānavagamāt na svābhāvikī śaktiḥ
yat tu abhyadhāyi samayasya jñāna ātmaka tvāt ātmani vṛttiḥ na śabda arthayoḥ iti etat api acaturaśram tad āśraya tva abhāve api jñānasya tad viṣaya tva upapatteḥ

yat api abhāṣaṇe samaya mātra śaraṇe sṛṇi pratoda nodana nirviśeṣe śabde śabdāt artham pratipadyāmahe iti vyapadeśaḥ na syāt iti tat api yat kiñcit naisargika śakti pakṣe api śakteḥ artham pratipadyāmahe na śabdāt iti vyapadeśaḥ syāt avinā abhāvāt agnim pratipadyāmahe na dhūmāt iti syāt tad aṅga tvāt avinā abhāva ādeḥ na tathā vyapadeśaḥ iti ced tat itaratra api samānam dhūme hi vyāpti pūrva tvam śabde samaya pūrva tā na anayoḥ tad apekṣāyām karaṇa tvam vihanyate

api ca laukikaḥ vyapadeśaḥ samaya pakṣa sākṣitām eva bhajate devadattā iva uktam amutas śabdāt amum artham pratipadyasva iti iti evam hi vyapadiśati lokaḥ tasmāt samayaḥ eva atas ca evam deśa antare saṅketa vaśena tatas eva śabdāt artha antara pratipattiḥ

nanu atra uktam sarve śabdāḥ sarva artha pratyāyana śakti yuktāḥ iti kenacid arthena kvacid vyavahāraḥ iti tat etat ayuktam śaktīnām bheda abheda vikalpa anupapatteḥ na śabda svarūpāt bhinnāḥ śaktayaḥ tathā anavabhāsāt avyatireke ca ekasmāt śabdāt ananya tvāt parasparam avyatirekaḥ tāsām syāt na ca bhinna kārya anumeyāḥ bhinnāḥ śaktayaḥ kārya bhedasya anyathā api upapatteḥ sarva śakti yoge ca sarva artha pratyaya prasaṅgaḥ samaya upayogaḥ niyāmakaḥ iti ced saḥ eva astu kim śaktibhiḥ

yat api aga ādi śabda śravaṇe sati sarva artha viṣaya sandeha darśanāt sarvatra tasya śaktiḥ kalpyate iti tat api asāram na hi śakti kṛtaḥ sandehaḥ kintu gatvā ādi varṇa sāmānya nibandhanaḥ tathā ca gatvā ādi jātimatām varṇānām arthe vācaka tvam avagatam amī tad jāti yoginaḥ varṇāḥ kasya arthasya vācakāḥ syuḥ iti bhavati sandehaḥ

yat punar avādi saḥ eva śabdasya arthaḥ yatra enam āryāḥ prayuñjata na mleccha jana prasiddhaḥ iti tat etat katham iva śapatham antareṇa pratipadyemahi na hi mleccha deśe api tad artha pratyayaḥ na jāyate bādhyate vā sandigdhaḥ vā iti katham na śabda arthaḥ ārya prasiddhiḥ bādhikā iti ced ārya prasiddheḥ api mleccha prasiddhiḥ katham na bādhikā akṣa ādi vat ca vikalpyamāna artha upapatteḥ vyavasthita viṣayaḥ eva vikalpaḥ bhaviṣyati pika nema tāmarasa ādi śabdānām ca bhavadbhiḥ mleccha prayogāt artha niścayaḥ āśritaḥ eva aveṣṭi adhikaraṇe rāja śabdam āndhra prasiddhe arthe varṇitavantaḥ bhavantaḥ iti alam avāntara cintanena tasmāt samayaḥ eva sambandhaḥ iti yuktam tat uktam jāti viśeṣe ca aniyamāt iti

atha yat uktam samayaḥ pratyuccāraṇam prati puruṣam sarga ādau sakṛt kriyate iti pratyuccāraṇam prati puruṣam ca tad karaṇam anabhyupagatam eva dūṣitam sarga ādau sakṛt eva samaya karaṇam iti naḥ pakṣaḥ atas eva na sarva śabdānām yadṛcchā tulya tvam keṣāñcid eva śabdānām asmad ādibhiḥ adya tve saṅketakaraṇāt tatas eva yadṛcchā śabdāḥ ucyante sarga ādiḥ ca samarthitaḥ eva īśvara siddhau api avikalam anumānam upanyastam

eṣaḥ eva ca āvayoḥ viśeṣaḥ yat eṣa śabda artha sambandha vyabahāraḥ tava anādiḥ mama tu jagat sargāt prabhṛti pravṛttaḥ iti adya tve tu śabda artha sambandha vyutpattau tulyaḥ eva āvayoḥ panthāḥ tatra api tu ayam viśeṣaḥ yat tava śakti paryantā vyutpattiḥ mama tu tad varjam iti

tathā ca iyam iyatī vyutpattiḥ loke dṛśyate yat ayam asya vācyaḥ ayam asya vācakaḥ iti na punar śakti paryantā vyutpattiṃrasti tathā hi yatra śṛṅga grāhikayā śabdam artham ca nirdiśya sambandhaḥ kriyate tatra iyantam eva enam kriyamāṇam paśyāmaḥ ayam asya vācyaḥ ayam asya vācakaḥ iti yatra api ca vṛddhebhyaḥ vyavaharamāṇebhyaḥ vyutpadyate tatra apīyadeva asau jānāti ayam arthaḥ amutas śabdāt anena pratipannaḥ iti na tu anyā asya kācid śaktiḥ asti iti iyatyā eva ca vyutpattyā śabdāt artha pratyaya upapatteḥ asyāḥ ca aparihārya tvāt adhika kalpanā bīja abhāvāt ca na nityaḥ śabda artha sambandhaḥ

atas eva ca sambandhaḥ tri pramāṇakaḥ iti yat tvayā ucyate tat asmābhiḥ na mṛṣyate śabda vṛddha abhidheyān ca pratyakṣeṇa atra paśyati iti satyam śrotuḥ ca pratipanna tvam anumānena ceṣṭayā iti etat api satyam anyathā anupapattyā tu vetti śaktim dvaya ātmikām iti etat tu na satyam anyathā api upapatteḥ iti ukta tvāt tasmāt dvi pramāṇakaḥ sambandha niścayaḥ na tri pramāṇakaḥ tat evam śabdasya naisargika śakti ātmaka sambandha abhāvāt īśvara viracita samaya nibandhanaḥ śabda artha vyavahāraḥ nānā ādiḥ

nanu īśvaraḥ api sambandham kurvan avaśyam kenacid śabdena karoti tasya kena kṛtaḥ sambandhaḥ śabda antareṇa ced tasya api kena kṛtaḥ tasya api kena iti na kaścid avadhiḥ tasmāt avaśyam anena sambandham kurvatā vṛddha vyavahāra siddhāḥ kecid akṛta sambandhāḥ eva śabdāḥ abhyupagantavyāḥ asti ced vyavahāra siddhiḥ kim īśvareṇa kim vā tad kṛtena samayena iti anādi pakṣaḥ eva śreyān

ucyate astram āyuṣmatā jñātam viṣayaḥ tu na lakṣitaḥ asmad ādiṣu doṣaḥ ayam īśvare tu na yujyate nānā karma phala sthānam icchayā eva īdṛśam jagat sraṣṭum prabhavataḥ tasya kauśalam kaḥ vikalpayet icchā mātreṇa pṛthivī ādeḥ iyataḥ kāryasya karaṇam asmad ādīnām yat manoratha padavīm api na adhirohati tat api yatas saṃpadyate tasya kiyānayam prayāsaḥ tad atra īśvara sadbhāve param vipratipattayaḥ tasmin tu siddhe kaḥ evam vikalpānām avasaraḥ uktam ca tad siddhau nirapavādam anumānam vayam tu na kartāraḥ eva sambandhasya yatas evam anuyujyemahi aṅgusi agreṇa nirdiśya kañcid artham puras sthitam vyutpādayantaḥ dṛśyante bālān asmadvidhāḥ api tasmāt īśvara viracita sambandha adhigama upāya bhūta vṛddha vyavahāra labdha tad vyutpatti sāpekṣaḥ śabdaḥ artham avagamayati iti siddham

na ca nitya sambandha abhāve api śabdasya artha asaṃsparśi tvam samaya balena artha pratyayasya ābādhitasya siddheḥ iti ukta tvāt iti alam vistareṇa tasmāt pade ca vākye ca sambandhe ca svatantra tā puruṣasya upapannā iti vedānām tad praṇīta tā tasmāt āpta ukta tvāt eva vedāḥ pramāṇam na nitya tvāt

nanu āpta ukta tvasya hetoḥ pakṣa dharma tvam katham avagamyate na pratyakṣeṇa kṣoṇīdhara dharma tvam iva dhūmasya vedānām āpta praṇīta tvam avagamyate śravaṇa yugala bala labdha janmani pratyaye veda ākhya śabda rāśeḥ eva pratibhāsāt na ca udātta ādi vat varṇa dharma tvena āpta ukta tvam gṛhyate na api anumānam asmin arthe liṅga abhāvāt prāmāṇye hi vedasya āpta ukta tvam liṅgam āpta ukta tva anumitau tu na liṅga antaram upalabhāmahe iti kutastyaḥ pakṣa dharma tva niścayaḥ

ucyate alam sarasvatī kṣodena uktaḥ eva pakṣa dharma tva niścaya upāyaḥ tathā hi śabdasya sādhitam tāvat anitya tvam sa vistaram racanāḥ kartṛmatyaḥ ca racanā tvāt iti sthitam kartā sarvasya sarvajñaḥ puruṣaḥ asti iti sādhitam kāryeṇa anuguṇam kalpyam nimittam iti ca sthitam pratyakṣa ādi visaṃvādaḥ vede parihariṣyate vyāghāta paunarukti ādi doṣāḥ ca vacana antare vidhi artha vāda mantrāṇām upayogaḥ ca vakṣyate na mātrā mātram api asti vede khiñcid apārthakam śabdabrahma vivartā ādi kalpanāḥ ca purā uditāḥ sarvāḥ parihariṣyante kāryatvasya virodhikāḥ

ittham ca sthite kim anyat avaśiṣṭam vedeṣu āpta ukta tā niścayasya saḥ ayam sakala śāstra artha sthitau satyām pakṣa dharma tva niścayaḥ hetoḥ āpta ukta tvasya gīyate yat tu pratyakṣam anumānam vā tad niścaya animittam iti vikalpitam tatra pratyakṣam āstām anumāna ādīni ca yāni racanā tu ādīni uktāni yāni ca para darśana dviṃṣi vakṣyante tāni sarvāṇi āpta uktatāyāḥ pakṣa dharmatā siddhi aupayikāni iti alam vistareṇa

vyāptiḥ punar asya hetoḥ āyurveda ādi vākyeṣu niścīyate pippalī paṭola mūla ādeḥ api auṣadhasya ittham upayogāt idam abhimatam āsādyate asya ca kṣīra cukra ādi virodhi aśanasya parihārāt idam aniṣṭam upaśāmyati iti ādiṣu āyurveda śāstreṣu pratyakṣeṇa tasya arthasya tathā niścayāt artha avisaṃvādi tvam nāma prāmāṇyam pratipannam tat ca idam āpta vāda prayuktam atas yatra āptavāda tvam tatra prāmāṇyam iti vyāptiḥ gṛhyate tathā mantrāṇām prayoge vṛścika bhujaga t aṣṭasya bhakṣita viṣasya vā nirviṣa tvam apasmāra piśāca rūpikā gṛhītasya tat unmocanam ati rabhasā ujjihāneṣu duṣṭa megheṣu sasya rakṣaṇam iti evam upalabdham atas teṣām viṣa bhūta aśani śamana kuśalānām āptāḥ upadeṣṭāraḥ iti tatra api tathā eva vyāpti niścayaḥ

nanu āyurveda ādau prāmāṇyam pratyakṣa ādi saṃvādāt pratipannam na āpta prāmāṇyāt atas katham āpta ukta tvasya tatra vyāpti grahaṇam na etat evam pratyakṣa ādi saṃvādāt tat niścīyatām nāma prāmāṇyam utthitam tu tat āpta ukta tvāt pratyakṣa ādau api artha kriyā jñāna saṃvādāt prāmāṇyasya jñaptiḥ utpattiḥ tu guṇavat kāraka kṛtyā iti uktam nadī ādi vākyāni ca vipralambhaka puruṣa bhāṣitāni visaṃvadanti loke dṛśyante tena āpta praṇīta tvam eva teṣām prāmāṇya kāraṇam kāraṇa śuddhim antareṇa samyak pratyaya anutpādāt niścaya upāvastu pratyakṣam bhavatu na tu tat kṛtam eva prāmāṇyam atas yuktam āpta ukta tāyāḥ āyurveda ādau vyāpti grahaṇam

nanu evam api na yuktam āpta ukta tvasya tatra paricchettum aśakyatvāt anvaya vyatireka mūlam eva āyurveda vākyānām prāmāṇyam na āpta kṛtam anvaya vyatirekau ca yāvatī eva dṛśyete tāvatī eva arthe prāmāṇyam yathā harītakī ādi vākya arthe yatra tu tayoḥ adarśanam tatra aprāmāṇyam yathā somarājī upayoge samāḥ sahasram jīvyate iti āpte tu kalpyamāne argha jaratīyam syāt ardhe tasya āptatvam ardhe ca katham anāpta tvam iti

tat idam anupapannam anvaya vyatirekayoḥ grahītum aśakyatvāt tau hi sva ātmani vā grahītum śakyete vyaktayantare vā vyakti antare api sarvatra kvacid eva vā vyakti viśeṣe sarvathā saṃkaṭaḥ ayam panthāḥ vyādhīnām tad nidānānām tad upacaya apacayānām tad upaśama upāyānām auṣadhānām tad saṃyoga viyoga viśeṣāṇām tad parimāṇānām tad rasa vīrya vipākānām deśa kāla puruṣa daśā bhedena śakti bhedasya ekena janmanā grahītum aśakyatvāt janma antara anubhūtānām ca bhāvānām asmaraṇāt

janaḥ anantaḥ tāvat nirabadhiḥ iha vyādhi nivahaḥ na saṃkhyātum śakyāḥ bahu guṇa rasa dravya gatayaḥ vicitrāḥ saṃyogāḥ pariṇatiḥ apūrvā iti ca kutas cikitsāyāḥ pāram tarati yuga lakṣaiḥ api naraḥ yat eva dravyam ekasya dhātoḥ bhavati śāntaye yoga antarāt tat eva asya punar kopāya kalpate yā dravya śaktiḥ ekatra puṃsi na asau nara antare harītakyā api na udbhūta vāta kuṣṭhe virecyate śaradi udrikta pittasya jvarāya dadhi kalpate tat eva bhuktam varṣāsu jvaram hanti daśa antare na ca upalakṣaṇam kiñcid asti tad śakti vedane yena ekatra gṛhītā asau sarvatra avagatā bhavet yaḥ vā jñātum prabhavati puruṣaḥ tad sāmarthyam niravadhi viṣayam syāt sarvajñaḥ saḥ iti na vimatiḥ tasmin kāryā sva vacana kathite

atha ucyeta anādiḥ eva eṣā cikitsaka smṛtiḥ vyākaraṇa ādi smṛti vat saṃkṣepa vistara vivakṣayā eva caraka ādayaḥ kartāraḥ na tu te sarva darśinaḥ na ca smṛtau andha paraṃparā doṣaḥ sa mūla tvāt yathā vyākaraṇa smṛteḥ śiṣṭa prayogaḥ mūlam evam iha anvaya vyatirekau śiṣṭa virodhe sati yathā mūla virodhinī pāṇini ādi smṛtiḥ apramāṇam tathā ca āhuḥ iha na bhavati anabhidhānāt iti evam vaidya smṛtiḥ api anvaya vyatireka viruddhāḥ na pramāṇam iti tat etat ayuktam anvaya vyatirekayoḥ yathā ukta nayena pariccheda asambhavena tad mūla tva anupapatteḥ

yadi hi anvaya vyatirekābhyām aśeṣa dravya śaktīḥ niścitya caraka ādibhiḥ viracitam śāstram iti īdṛśam anvaya vyatireki tvam ucyate tat api ayākṛtam adya tve yāvantau anvaya vyatirekau vayam upalabdhum śaknumaḥ tāvadbhyām tābhyām eka deśa saṃvādāt prāmāṇya kalpanāt tatra pravartatām na tu tau tāvantau śāstrasya mūlam bhavitum arhataḥ sarvaiḥ asmad ādibhiḥ tādṛśa śāstra praṇayana prasaṅgāt

anādi tvam api śāstrāṇām veda vat anupapannam caraka ādi kartṛ smṛteḥ kāli dāsa ādi smṛti vat avigīta tvāt na ca cikitsā smaraṇa prabandhaḥ eva ayam anādiḥ tathā tve andha paraṃparā kāraṇa anavadhāraṇāt na ca tat uktam unmūlam bhavitum arhati vyudasta tvāt tasmāt sarvajña praṇītaḥ eva āyurvedaḥ

nanu aviduṣām upadeśaḥ na avakalpate iti vidvāṃsaḥ caraka ādayaḥ kalpyantām te tu pratyakṣeṇa eva sarvam vidita bante iti atra kim mānam ucyate anvaya vyatirekayoḥ nirāsāt na anumānasya eṣa viṣayaḥ veda mūla tvam api manu ādi smṛti vat ayuktam kalpayitum kartṛ sāmānya asaṃbhavāt iti varṇaviṣyāmaḥ puruṣa antara upadeśa pūrvaka tve carakeṇava kim aparāddham upamāna m anāśaṅkanīyam eva asmin arthe arthāpattiḥ tum na pramāṇa antaram aprāmāṇyam tu na asti bahu kṛtvas saṃvāda darśanāt atas pariśeṣāt pratyakṣīkṛta deśa kāla puruṣa daśā bheda anusāri samasta vyastapadārtha sārtha śakti niścayāḥ caraka ādayaḥ iti yuktam kalpayitum

yadi evam katham tarhi somarājya ādi vākyeṣu vyabhicāraḥ vyabhicāre ca ardha jaratīyam iti uktam na eṣa doṣaḥ karma kartṛ sādhana vaiguṇyāt eṣu vyabhicāraḥ bhaviṣyati vaidikeṣu ca karmasu mīmāṃsakasya samānaḥ guṇaḥ kārīrya ādau kā te vārtā yasyām na syāt iṣṭau vṛṣṭiḥ vaiguṇyam ced kartṛ ādīnām atra api evam śakyam vaktum yadi vidhuram abhuktam karma śāstrīyam anyat phala vighaṭana hetuḥ kalpyate saḥ api tulyaḥ kvacid atha phala saṃpad dṛśyate tad prayoge tat iha dṛḍha śarīrāḥ santi dīrgha āyuṣaḥ ca āyurvedaḥ tasmāt āpta kṛtaḥ na anya mūlaḥ iti siddham evaṃphala veda ādau prakāśam āpta praṇīta tvam

tasmāt āpta ukta tvasya siddham āyurveda ādau vyāpti grahaṇam vyāpti pradarśanāya eva sūtra kṛtā sa dvividhaḥ dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa artha tvāt iti uktam dṛṣṭa artha śabde gṛhīta avinābhāvam āpta ukta tvam adṛṣṭa arthe api prāmāṇyam sādhayati iti atas eva uktam mantra āyurveda prāmāṇya vat ca tad prāmāṇyam āpta prāmāṇyāt iti

nanu atra api na vaidyakam viracayan dṛṣṭaḥ muniḥ sarva vid tad vyāpti grahaṇam jane yadi vṛthā aayurveda saṃkīrtanam satyam kintu dṛḍhā tathā api caraka ādi āpta smṛtiḥ vaidyake na asau ca anya nibandhanā iti kathitā tasya iha dṛṣṭānta tā iti āyurveda vākya prabhṛtiṣu bhavati vyāptiḥ āpta ukta tāyāḥ pūrva uktena krameṇa sphuṭam akathi tathā pakṣa dharma tvam asyāḥ na pratyakṣa āgamābhyām apahṛta viṣayā na anumāna antareṇa vyādhūtā vā iti sā eṣā bhajati gamaka tām pañca rūpa upapatteḥ anapekṣa tayā na veda vācām ghaṭate niṣpratimaḥ pramāṇa bhāvaḥ kva girām ayathārtha tā nivṛttiḥ puruṣa pratyayam antareṇa dṛṣṭā tad pratyayāt bahutara draviṇa vyaya ādi sādhyeṣu karmasu tapassu ca vaidikeṣu yuktam pravartanam abādhanakena na eva tad siddhiḥ iti alam asammataḥ eṣa mārgaḥ tasmāt āpta ukta tvāt eva vedāḥ pramāṇam iti siddham

anye tu anyathā veda prāmāṇyam varṇayanti tasya hi prāmāṇye abhyupagata para lokaḥ anabhyupagata para lokaḥ vā paraḥ vipratipadyate tatra anabhyupagata para lokam prati tāvat ātma nitya tā ādi nyāya pūrvakam para loka samarthanam eva vidheyam para loka vādinām tu mate yat etat sukhi duḥkhya ādi bhedena jagataḥ vaicitryam dṛśyate tat avaśyam karma vaicitrya nibandhanam eva karmāṇi ca ananuṣṭhitāni na ātmānam labhante alabdha ātmanām ca nabhaḥ kusuma nibhānām kutas vicitra sukha duḥkha ādi phala sādhana tvam tasmāt anuṣṭhānam eṣām eṣitavyam anuṣṭhānam ca na avidita svarūpāṇām karmaṇām upapannam ajānan puruṣaḥ tapasvī kim anutiṣṭhet tat avaśyam jñātvā anuṣṭheyāni karmāṇi

tat idānīm teṣām parijñāne kaḥ abhyupāyaḥ na pratyakṣam asmad ādīnām svarga ādi adṛṣṭa puruṣa artha sādhanāni karmāṇi darśayitum prabhavati na api anumānam anvaya vyatirekābhyām tṛpti bhojanayoḥ iva svarga yāgayoḥ sādhya sādhana sambandha ān abadhāraṇāt na api arthāpattiḥ jagat vaicitryānyathā anupapattyā tu vicitram kāraṇa mātram anumīyate na ca tāvatā anuṣṭhāna siddhiḥ uktam ca adharme dharma rūpe vā api avibhakte phalam prati kim api asti iti vijñānam narāṇām kva upayujyate iti

upamānam tu atra śaṅkyamānam api na śobhate na api parasparam upadiśantaḥ laukikāḥ karmāṇi para loka phalāni jānīyuḥ iti vaktum yuktam ajñātvā upapādayatām āpta tva ayogāt jñānam tu laukikānām durghaṭam pramāṇa abhāvāt iti ukta tvāt evam eva hi puruṣa upadeśa paraṃparākalpanāyām andha paraṃpara anyāyaḥ syāt tasmāt avaśyam abhyupagata para lokaiḥ para loka phalāni karmāṇi kurvadbhiḥ śāstrāt karma avabodhaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ śāstram ca vedāḥ eva iti siddham tad prāmāṇyam

nanu loka prasiddhitaḥ eva dharma adharma sādhanāni karmāṇi śāsyante kim śāstreṇa upakāra apakārau hi dharma adharmayoḥ lakṣaṇam iti prasiddham eva etat tathā aaha vyāsaḥ idam puṇyam idam pāpam iti etasmin pada dvaye ācaṇḍālam manuṣyāṇām alpam śāstra prayojanam iti na etat yuktam loka prasiddheḥ nirmūlāyāḥ pramāṇa tva ācupapatteḥ lokaprasiddhiḥ nāma laukikānām avicchinnā smṛtiḥ smṛtit ca prabhabantī pramāṇa antara mūlā bhavati na svatantrā iti avagryam asyāḥ mūlam anveṣaṇīyam tat ca pratyakṣa ādi na upapadyate iti nūnam śāstra mūlā eva loka prasiddhiḥ viruddha aneka prakāra tvāt ca loka prasiddheḥ na tasyām svatantrāyām samāśvasiti lokaḥ na ca upakāra apakāraka mātra lakṣaṇau eva dharma adharmau vaktum yujyete japa śīdhu pāna ādau tad abhāvāt guru dāra gamana ādau ca viparyaya āditya caśyam śāstra śaraṇau eva tau eṣitavyau

api ca idam iṣṭi mantra ādikam evaṃphalam ayam asmin adhikṛtaḥ iti iyam itikartavya tā eṣa deśaḥ eṣa kālaḥ ime ṛtvijaḥ ityādi kim loka prasiddheḥ adhigantum śakyate tasmāt avaśyam śāstra adhīnaḥ eva viśiṣṭa karma avabodhaḥ eṣitavyaḥ śāstram ca vedaḥ eva iti uktam atas tasya nirvivāda siddham eva prāmāṇyam iti

evam tu varṇyamāne saṃsāra anādi tvam tāvat uktam syāt vedasya anādi tvam karma jñānānādi tvāt tatas ca mīmāṃsaka vartmanā eva pramāṇa tā sidhyati na āptavādāt tasmāt yathā udāhṛtaḥ eva mārgaḥ pramāṇa tāyām anuvartanīyaḥ

athavā vayam api na na śiṣmaḥ anādi saṃsāra pakṣam yugapad akhila sarga dhvaṃsa vāde tu bhedaḥ akathi ca racanānām kārya tā tena sargāt prabhṛti bhagavatā idam veda śāstram praṇītam anādiḥ eva īśvara kartṛkaḥ api sadā eva sarga pralaya prabandhaḥ sarga antareṣu eva ca karma bodhaḥ veda antarebhyaḥ api janasya sidhyet anya tve kim pramāṇam nanu tava sumate kim tad aikye pramāṇam dhvastam tāvat samastam bhuvanam iti tadā veda nāśaḥ api avaśyam ekaḥ tu īśaḥ aviśiṣṭaḥ sa ca racayati vā prāktanam saṃsmaret bā vede svātantryam asmin niyatam ubhayathā api asti candra ardha mauleḥ ekasya tasya manasi pratibhāsamānaḥ vedaḥ tadā hi kṛtakān na viśiṣyate asau pratyakṣa sarva viṣayasya tu na īśvarasya yuktā smṛtiḥ karaṇam eva tatas anavadyam tena āpta nirmitat tayā eva niratyaya artha saṃpratyaya upajananāya janasya vede śāstram su vistara kṣapāḥ taku tarka mūla moha prapañcam akarot muniḥ akṣapādaḥ

atra kaścid āha yuktam itaretara vyatiṣakta artha upadeśi tvena eka kartṛkatva anumāna dvārakam tri vedyāḥ prāmāṇyam atharvavedasya tu trayī āmnāta dharma upayoga anupalabdheḥ trayī bāhya tvena na tad samāna yogakṣema tvam

anapekṣa tva lakṣaṇa prāmāṇya pakṣe api vikṣipta śāstra antara upadiṣṭa viśiṣṭa jyotiṣṭoma ādi aneka karma anupraviṣṭa hautra adhvarya vādi vyāpāra vyatiṣaṅga darśanāt tad arthā trayyā iva yathā pramāṇa bhāva bhāginī bhavitum arhati na tathā pṛthak vyavahārā ātharvaṇa śrutiḥ

tathā ca loke catasraḥ imāḥ vidyāḥ prāṇinām anugrahāya pravṛttāḥ ānvīkṣakī trayī vārtā daṇḍanītiḥ iti prasiddhiḥ śruti smṛtī api tad anuguṇa arthe eva dṛśyete śrutiḥ tāvat ṛgbhiḥ prātar divi devaḥ īyate yajurvedena tiṣṭhati madhye ahnaḥ sāmavedena astam eti vedaiḥ aśūn yaḥ tribhiḥ eti sūryaḥ iti tathā prajāpatiḥ akāmayata bahusyām prajāyeya iti sa tapaḥ atapyata sa tapaḥ taptvā imān lokān asṛjata pṛthivīm antarikṣam divam iti tān lokān abhyatapat tebhyaḥ trīṇi jyortīṣyajāyanta agniḥ eva pṛthivyāḥ ajāyata vāyuḥ antarikṣāt divaḥ ādityaḥ iti tāni jyortīṣi abhyatapat tebhyaḥ trayaḥ vedāḥ ajāyanta agneḥ ṛgvedaḥ vāyoḥ yajurvedaḥ ādityāt sāmavedaḥ tathā sā eṣā vidyā trayī tapati iti

smṛtiḥ api mānavī prativedam dvādaśa vārṣika brahmacarya upadeśinī dṛśyate ṣaṭtriṃśat vārṣikam caryam gurau traivedikam vratam iti śrāddha prakaraṇe api yatnena bhojayet śrāddhe bahu ṛcam vedapāragam śākhā anta gam athā adhvaryum chandogam vā samāpti gam iti tri vedapāragān eva śrāddha bhujaḥ brāhmaṇān darśayati nātharvavedā dhyāyinaḥ pratyuta niṣedhaḥ kvacid upadiśyate tasmāt ātharvaṇam na pravṛñjayāt iti

evam ākṣepe sati kecid ācakṣate yadi yajña upayogi tvam na iha asti ātharvaṇa śruteḥ artha antare pramāṇa tvam kena asyāḥ pratihanyate śānti puṣṭi abhicāra arthāḥ eka brahma ṛtvij āśritāḥ kriyāḥ tayā pramīyante trayī vā ātmīya gocaraḥ iti

etat tu sarvam na sādhu abhidhīyate tathā hi tad pramāṇam bādarāyaṇasya anapekṣa tvāt iti yaḥ eṣa veda prāmāṇya adhigatau jaimininā niradeśi panthāḥ yaḥ vai akṣapādena kaṇā ādena ca prakaṭitaḥ tad vacanāt āmnāya prāmāṇyam iti mantra āyurveda prāmāṇya vat ca tad prāmāṇyam āpta prāmāṇyāt iti sa caturṣu api vedeṣu tulyaḥ tatra viśeṣa tuṣaḥ api na kaścid atiprayatnena anviṣyamāṇaḥ prāpyate na hi mīmāṃsaka pakṣe evam vaktum śakyate trayī eva anādimatī nātharva śrutiḥ tasyām kartṛ smaraṇa saṃbhavāt iti

na api naiyāyika pakṣe evam vaktum śakyam āpta praṇītāḥ trayaḥ vedāḥ caturthaḥ tu na āpta praṇītaḥ iti tena prāmāṇya adhigama upāya aviśeṣāt samāna yoga kṣema tayā catvāraḥ api vedāḥ pramāṇam vyabahāraḥ hi sarveṣām sāretara vicāra catura cetasām caturbhiḥ api vedaiḥ caturṇām varṇānām āśramāṇām catasṛṣu dikṣu catur abdhi mekhalāyām avanau prasiddhaḥ iti kaḥ ayam atra anyathātva bhramaḥ

śruti smṛti mūlaḥ ca āryāvarta nivāsinām bhavati vyavahāraḥ te ca śruti smṛtī caturaḥ api vedān samāna kakṣya an abhivadataḥ ṛc yajussāma vedeṣu api atharvaveda āśaṃsīni bhūyāṃsi vacāṃsi bhavanti tat yathā śatapathe atha tṛtīye ahan iti upakramya aśvamedhe pāriplava ākhyāne saḥ ayam ātharvaṇaḥ vedaḥ iti śrūyate chānda ugya upaniṣadi ca ṛgvedaḥ yajurvedaḥ sāmavedaḥ ātharvaṇaḥ caturthaḥ iti paṭhyate

nanu itihāsa purāṇaḥ pañcamaḥ iti tatra paṭhyate eva kiñcātas kim iyatā atharvaṇaḥ caturthaḥ na bhavati vedaḥ caturtha śabda upādānāt itihāsa ādi tulyaḥ asau na veda samāna kakṣyaḥ iti ced kā iyam kalpanā caturtha śabda upādānāt aprādhānye trayaḥ vedāḥ asṛjyante ityādau tritva saṃkhyā upādānāt te api na pradhāna tām adhigaccheyuḥ itihāsa ādibhiḥ vā saha parigaṇanam aprādhānya kāraṇam yat ucyate tat api sarva veda sādhāraṇam iti yat kiñcid etat

tathā śata adhyayane api ṛcaḥ vai brahmaṇaḥ prāṇāḥ iti abhyupakramya ātharvaṇaḥ vai brahmaṇaḥ samānaḥ iti paṭhyate tathā ye asya prāñcaḥ raśmayaḥ tāḥ eva asya prācyaḥ madhunāḍyaḥ ṛcaḥ eva puṣpam iti upakramya paṭhita atha ye asya udañcaḥ raśmayaḥ tāḥ eva asya udīcyaḥ madhunāḍyaḥ atharva aṅgirasaḥ eva madhukṛtaḥ iti

tathā taittarīye tasmāt vā etasmāt prāṇa mayāt anyaḥ antaraḥ ātmā manaḥ mayaḥ iti prastutya tasya yajuḥ eva śiraḥ ṛc dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ sāma uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ ādeśaḥ ātmā atharva aṅgirasaḥ puccham pratiṣṭhā iti paṭhyate tathā anyatra ṛcām prācī mahatī diś ucyate dakṣiṇām āhuḥ yajuṣām sāmnām uttarām atharvaṇām aṅgirasām pratīcī mahatī diś ucyate iti śatapathe brahma yajña vidhi prakrame madhyame payaḥ āhutayaḥ ha vai etāḥ devānām yadṛcaḥ iti upakramya medaḥ āhutayaḥ ha vai etāḥ devānām yat atharva aṅgirasaḥ sa yaḥ evam vidvān atharvā aṅgirasaḥ aharahar svādhyāyam adhīte medaḥ āhutibhiḥ eva tad devān sa tarpayati te enam tṛptāḥ tarpayanti iti

mantrāḥ api tad artha prakāśana parāḥ anuśrūyante tvām agne puṣkarāt adhi atharvā niramanthate ityādayaḥ na ca eṣām atharvā nāma kaścid ṛṣiḥ iti evaṃprakāram vyākhyānam yuktam anyatra api asamāśvāsa prasaṅgāt iti evan jātīyakāḥ tāvat udāhṛtāḥ śruti vācaḥ

smṛti vākyāni khalu api manuḥ tāvat śrutīratharva āṅgirasīḥ kuryāt iti avicārayan iti śruti śabdena trayī vat iha vyavaharati yājñavalkyaḥ caturdaśa vidyā sthānāni gaṇayan purāṇa tarka mīmāṃsā dharma śāstra aṅga miśritāḥ vedāḥ sthānāni vidyānām dharmasya ca caturdaśaḥ iti caturaḥ eva vedān āvedayate na anyathā hi caturdaśa saṃkhyā pūryate

smṛti antare ca spaṣṭam eva uktam aṅgāni vedāḥ catvāraḥ mīmāṃsā nyāya vistaraḥ purāṇam dharma śāstram ca vidyāḥ hi etāḥ caturdaśa iti anyatra api uktam purāṇam dharma śāstram mīmāṃsā nyāyaḥ catvāraḥ vedāḥ ṣaṣ aṅgāni iti caturdaśa vidyā sthānāni iti śātātapaḥ api āha ṛc sāma yajuḥ aṅgānām atharva aṅgirasām api aṇoḥ api asya vijñānāt yaḥ anūcānaḥ sa naḥ mahān iti

tathā anyatra catvāraḥ caturṇām vedānām pāragāḥ dharma jñāḥ pariṣad iti uktam śaṅkha likhitau ca ṛc yajussāma atharva vidaḥ ṣaḍaṅga vid dharma vid vākya vid naiyāyikaḥ naiṣṭhikaḥ brahmacārī pañca agniḥ iti daśa avarā pariṣad iti ūcatuḥ prācetase catvāraḥ veda vidaḥ dharma śāstra vid iti pañca avarā pariṣad iti uktam tathā ca paṅkti pāvana prastāve catur veda ṣaḍaṅga vid jyeṣṭha sāma gaḥ atharva aṅgirasaḥ api ete paṅkti pāvanāḥ gaṇyante tat ayam evam ādi veda catuṣṭaya pratiṣṭhā praguṇaḥ eva prācuryeṇa dharma śāstra kārāṇām vyavahāraḥ

anye api śāstra kārāḥ tathā eva vyavaharantaḥ dṛśyante tathā ca mahā bhāṣya kāraḥ bhagavān patañjaliḥ atharvavedam eva prathamam udāhṛtavān śannaḥ devīḥ abhiṣṭaye iti mīmāṃsā bhāṣya kāreṇa api veda adhikaraṇe kāṭhakam kālāpam maudgalam paippalādakam iti yajurveda ādi vat atharvavede api paippalādakam udājahne sarva śākhā adhikaraṇe api veda antara śāsvāntara vat maudgala paippalādaka ākhye atharva śākhe api udāhṛtya vicāraḥ kṛtaḥ tathā ca prathama yajñaḥ nāma caturṣu na kaścid asti iti adhikaraṇa antaḥ eva likhitam evam śruti smṛti viśiṣṭa ācāra vyavahāra vidām atra vipratipatti saṃbhāvanā eva na asti

āha na brūmaḥ atharvavedaḥ na pramāṇam iti kintu trayī bāhyaḥ iti ucyate trayī api iyam atharvaveda bāhyā eva na kevalam evam trayyām api paraspara bāhya tvam asti eva ṛc sāma bāhyāni yajūṃṣi yaju ssāma bāhyāḥ ṛcaḥ ṛc yajuḥ bāhyāni sāmāni iti kiyānayam doṣaḥ sarva bhāvānām itaretarasāṅkarya sahita tvāt ye hi śabda ātmānaḥ grantha sandarbha svabhāvāḥ ye ca tad abhidheyāḥ artha svabhāvāḥ te sarve anyonya saṃmiśrita ātmānaḥ eva na ca pareṇa ātmānam saṃmiśrayantaḥ api te svarūpam apahārayanti iti

atha ucyeta na īdṛśam trayī bāhya tvam atharvavede vivakṣitam api tu yat eva na trayī pratyayam karma upadiśati na tad sambaddham kiṃcid iti tat asya trayī bāhya tvam iti etat api na sādhu upadiṣṭam iṣṭi paśu eka ahā hīna satra ādi karmaṇām tatra upadeśa darśanāt sarva śākhā pratyayam ekam karma iti nyāyāt trayī upadiṣṭe api karmaṇi sambaddham atharvavedāt kim api lamyate eva

nanu bhavati sarva śākhā pratyayam ekam karma tat punar tri vedī sambaddha sarva śākhā pratyayam eva nātharva śākhā pratyayam yatas soma yāga ādi karmaṇām ṛgvedena hautram yajurvedena adhvarya vam samāvedena audgātram kiyate nātharvavedena kiñcid iti tat ayuktam atharvavedena brahma tvasya karaṇāt tathā ca gopatha brāhmaṇam prajāpatissomena yakṣyamāṇaḥ vedān uvāca kam vaḥ hotāram vṛṇīyam iti iti prakramya tasmāt ṛgu idam eva hotāram vṛṇīṣva sa hi hautram veda yajurvidam eva adhvaryum vṛṇīṣva sa hi ādhvaryavam veda

sāmavidam eva udgātāram vṛṇīṣva sa hi odgātram veda atharva aṅgiraḥ vidam eva brahmāṇam vṛṇīṣva sa hi brahma tvam vedaḥ iti abhidhāya punar āha atha ced na evaṃvidham hotāram adhvaryu mudgātāram brahmāṇam vā vṛṇute purastāt eva vā eṣām yajñaḥ ricyate iti tasmāt ṛgu idam eva hotāram kuryāt yajurvidam eva adhvaryum sāmavidam eva udgātāram atharva aṅgiraḥ vidam eva brahmāṇam iti tathā yat ūnam ca viriṣṭam ca yātayāmam ca karoti tad atharvaṇām tejasā pratyāpyāyayet iti na ṛte bhṛgu aṅgirobhyaḥ somaḥ pātavyaḥ iti

nanu etāḥ śrutīḥ atharvāṇaḥ eva ādhīyate na anye trayī vidaḥ te tu evam paṭhanti yadṛcā hautram kriyate yajuṣā aadhvaryavam sāmnā audgātram atha kena brahma tvam kriyate iti trayyā vidyayā iti brūyāt iti tathā ca yadṛcā eva hautram akurvata yajuṣā aadhvaryavam sāmnā audgātram yat eva trayyai vidyāyai śukram tena brahma tvam iti ucyate vayam api evamādīni vākyāni na na adhīmahi kim tu eṣām ayam eva arthaḥ atharva aṅgiraḥ vid eva brahma iti katham yatas na trayī nāma kim api vastu antaram api tu trayāṇām vedānām samāhāraḥ iti samāhāraḥ ca samāhriyamāṇa niṣṭhaḥ bhavati samāhriyamāṇāḥ ca ṛgveda ādayaḥ trayaḥ hautra ādi paratvena caritārthāḥ na punar tatra bhedam arhanti ekaikaśas caritārthānām samudāyaḥ api caritārthaḥ eva samudāya buddhau hi vibhajyamānāyām samudāyinaḥ eva sphuranti na avaya vivat arthāntaram te ca anyatra vyāpṛtāḥ

kim nu khalu ṛgveda ādīnām brahma tvam kurvatām atibhāraḥ bhavati na brūmaḥ atibhāraḥ iti kintu tri ātmaka tvena brahma tva kartavyatā upadiśyate tri ātmakaḥ ca anyatamaḥ api tebhyaḥ na bhavati vedaḥ atharvavedaḥ tu tri ātmakaḥ eva tatra hi ṛcaḥ yajūṃṣi sāmāni iti trīṇi api santi tena brahma tvam kriyamāṇam trayyā kṛtam bhavati

nanu yaḥ trīn vedān adhīte tena ced brahma tvam kriyeta tat kim trayyā na kṛtam bhavati bāḍham iti ucyate saḥ api ekasmai vā kāmāyā anye yajña kratavaḥ samādhīyante sarvebhyaḥ jyotiṣṭomaḥ sarvebhyaḥ darśa pūrṇamāsau iti śrutau api yoga siddhi adhikaraṇa nyāyena asyatamam eva buddha ābādhāya vidadhyāt na samudāyam buddhau āropayitum śaknuyāt iti ekena eva tat kṛtam bhavati na trayyā iti

nanu anye api tri ātmakāḥ vedāḥ yadi evam sutarām atharvavedaḥ na pṛthakkaraṇīyaḥ sarveṣām rūpa aviśeṣāt teṣām pṛthak pratiṣṭhaiḥ svaiḥ svaiḥ ṛc ādibhiḥ eva vyapadeśaḥ iti na te samudāya śabda vyapadeśyāḥ

yat tu vākya antare trayyai vidyāyai śukram tena brahma tvam iti tatra iyam caturthī ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne prayuktā śukram iti sāram ācakṣate tena trayī vidyāyāḥ sāreṇa brahma tvam kriyate iti uktam bhavati na ca trayyā iva trayyāḥ śukram bhavati na ca atyantam tatas artha antaram eva tena idam atharvaveda ātmakam eva trayyāḥ śukram iti manyāmahe tri ātmaka tvāt iti manyāmahe tri ātmaka tvāt iti śukram iti ca guhyam āhuḥ atharva śabdaḥ api rahasya vacanaḥ yajña atharvāṇam vaidikasyāḥ iṣṭayaḥ iti tena trayī śukra rūpeṇa atharvavedena brahma tvam iti ittham atharvavedasya na trayī bāhya tvam ittham sarva śākhā pratyayam ekam karma iti atra na sarva śabdaḥ saṅka ucitaḥ bhavati

atas eva brahma vedaḥ atharvavedaḥ iti pūrva uttara brāhmaṇe paṭhyate ṛgvedaḥ yajurvedaḥ sāmavedaḥ brahma vedaḥ iti tathā ca kāṭhaka śata adhyayane brāhmaṇe brahmaudane śrūyate brahma vādinaḥ vadanti purodhāḥ auddālakirāruṇim uvāca brahmaṇe tvā prāṇāya juṣṭam nirvapāmi brahmaṇe tvā vyānāya juṣṭam nirvapāmi iti upakramya ātharvaṇau vai brahmaṇaḥ samānaḥ atharvaṇam eva etat juṣṭam nirvapati catur śarāvaḥ bhavati catvāraḥ hi ime vedāḥ tān eva bhāginaḥ karoti mūlam vai brahmaṇaḥ vedāḥ vedānām etat mūlam yat ṛtvijaḥ prāśnanti tad drahmaudanasya brahmaudana tvam iti

tathā sāmavede pṛṣṭhyasya caturthe ahanyārbhave pavamāne atharvaṇe sāmnaḥ gānam yat tad vidhāne śrūyate caturvidham ātharvaṇam bhavati catūrātrasya vṛttvai catuṣpada āmānuṣṭubhā anuṣṭubham eva etat aharyaḥ caturtham bheṣajam vā atharvaṇam tat hi bhaiṣajyam eva tad karoti ātharvaṇāni yāga bheṣajāni iti etat ālambanā iyam stutiḥ atas eva prāk uktam yajñe yat ūnam ca viriṣṭam ca yātayāmam ca karoti tad atharvaṇām tejasā aapyāyayati iti tasmāt ātharvaṇaḥ eva brahma iti etat ca śāstra antare vistareṇa abhiyuktaiḥ yuktibhiḥ upapāditam iti na iha atyantāya pratāyate

yat tu na ātharvaṇena pravṛñjyāt iti tat kalpa sūtra vākya tvāt veda viruddham iti anādṛtam atha api śrautam idam vākyam tadā api prakaraṇa adhītam ced tatra eva kvacid karmaṇi nivekṣyate anārabhyavāda pakṣe api pūrva ukta vākya visadṛśa artha tvāt atharvavedasya ca trayya bāhya tvena saṃparka parihāra an ardda tvāt niyata viṣayam eva vyākhyāsyate

yat api ucyate uccais ṛcā kriyate uccaissāmnā upāṃśu yajuṣā iti vat atharvadharmaḥ api na kaścid āmnātaḥ iti tat api asāram maṃtra dharmaḥ hi ayam upadiśyate na veda dharmaḥ mantra brāhmaṇa samudāya svabhāvāḥ hi catvāraḥ ime veda granthāḥ mantrāḥ tu vastutas gadya padya bhedāt dvividhāḥ eva gadya bandhaḥ yajuḥ ucyate padyabandhaḥ ṛc iti gīti nibandhanam tu bheda antaram sāma iti atas eva jaimininā mantra vibhāgam prastutya teṣām ṛgī atra artha vaśena pāda vyavasthā gītiṣu sāma ākhyā śeṣe yajuḥ śabdaḥ ittham eva teṣām traividhyam upapāditam teṣām eva ca ayam uccais tva ādi dharmaḥ na veda śabda vācyānām mantra brāhmaṇa samudāya ātmanām granthānām atharvavede api iyam trividhā eva mantra jātiḥ iti tatra api idam dharma jātam upadiṣṭam bhavati mantra vibhāga kṛtaḥ eva ayam trayī vyapadeśaḥ iti atas casa eṣā trayī vidyā tapati ityādi api na virotsyate evam ṛc yajussāma samudāya ātmaka mantra upabandhāt trayī antargataḥ ca atharbavedaḥ pṛthak vyavasthita grantha sandarbha svabhāva tvāt ca bhinnaḥ saḥ iti siddham
anye punar ṛc pracura tvāt pravirala yajuḥ vākya tvāt agīyamāna sāma mantra tā vaśāt ca ṛgvedam eva atharvavedam ācakṣate ayam api pakṣaḥ astu na kaścid virodhaḥ

yat punar abhidhīyate veda śabdaḥ trayāṇām eva vācakaḥ na caturthasya iti saḥ ayamati utkaṭaḥ dveṣaḥ vṛddha vyavahāraḥ hi atra pramāṇam vedaḥ ayam brāhmaṇaḥ ayam iti tatra tatra veda śabde uccārite catvāraḥ api pratīyante vedaḥ mayā adhītaḥ iti vadantam pṛcchanti vyavahartāraḥ katamaḥ tvayā adhītaḥ vedaḥ iti saḥ āha atharvavedaḥ iti na tam evam ākṣipanti na asau vedaḥ yaḥ tvayā paṭhitaḥ iti sa upapadaḥ atharvavede veda śabdaḥ iti ced veda antareṣu api tulyam etat ṛgvedaḥ yajurvedaḥ sāmavedaḥ iti nirupapadaḥ api teṣu veda śabdaḥ prayujyate iti ced tat itaratra api samānam iti uktam catur veda adhyāyī bharadvājaḥ iti ca prasiddham eva sarvathā tu sa upapadaḥ eva āyurveda ādiṣu veda śabdaḥ iti na tad tulya kakṣya tā adhikṣepa kṣetra tām atharvavedaḥ netavyaḥ

brahma yajña vidhiḥ ca śrautaḥ caturṣu api aviśiṣṭaḥ iti uktam smārtaḥ api tathāvidhaḥ eva asti yathā aaha yājñavalkyaḥ bhedasā tarpayet devān atharva aṅgirasaḥ paṭhan pitṝn ca madhu sarpirbhyām anvaham śaktitaḥ dvijaḥ iti sāṃpradāyikam adhyāpana adhyayana ādi sarvam abhinnam eva iti alam prasaṅgena tena pramāṇa tāyām veda svādhyāya śabda vācya tve puruṣa artha sādhana vidhau api catvāraḥ samāḥ vedāḥ

yadi punar auttarādharyeṇa vinā na parituṣyate tat atharvavedaḥ eva prathamaḥ tatas paramasya maṃtrasya brahmaṇaḥ praṇavasya abhivyakteḥ tathā ca śrutiḥ brahma ha vā idam agre āsīt iti upakramya ātharvaṇam vedam abhyaśrāmyat abhyatapat samatapat tasmāt śāntāt taptāt santaptāt om iti manaḥ eva ūrdhvam akṣaram udakrāmat ityādi tathā mahāvyāhṛtīnām śākhā antara prasiddhānām aprasiddhānām ca bṛhat iti ādīnām tat eva utthānam

atharvaveda kṛta upanayana saṃskārasya veda antara adhyayanam aviruddham anya veda upanīyamānasya tu na atharvaṇa upanayana saṃskāram aprāpitasya atharvaveda adhyayane adhikāraḥ tat uktam bhṛgu aṅgiraḥ vidā saṃskṛtaḥ anyān vedān adhīyīta na anyatra saṃskṛtaḥ bhṛgu aṅgirasaḥ adhīyīta iti trayī eka śaraṇaiḥ api ca etat avaśya āśrayaṇīyam atharvaveda vihitam sva karma bhraṃśe prāyaścittam ācaradbhiḥ iti atharvavedaḥ eva jyāyān

yat tu mānavam vākyam udāhṛtam ṣaṭtriṃśat ābdikam tat tri veda adhyayana viṣayam vaikalpikam vedān adhītya vedau vā vedam vā api yathākramam iti ekasmin vede dvādaśa varṣāṇi vratam dvayoḥ caturviṃśatiḥ trayāṇām ṣaṭtriṃśat iti yaḥ tu caturaḥ vedān adhīte tasya aṣṭacatvāriṃśat varṣam veda brahmacaryam upāsītaḥ iti smṛti antaram asti na ca tad ā āryaiḥ na ādṛtam tatra tri vedā dhyāyinām eva prativarṣam ṣoḍaśa varṣāṇi vratam caret iti vyākhyānam asaṅgatam upakrama virodhāt anupayogāt ca tena veda antara adhyayana kṛtaḥ eva ayam vikalpa vidhiḥ na dvādaśa ṣoḍaśa varṣa apekṣaḥ iti anādaraḥ api asyām smṛtau kṛṣṇa keśaḥ agnīnāt adhītaḥ iti śruti virodha kṛtaḥ nātharvaveda adhyayana niṣedha garbhaḥ iti traivedika brahmacarya smṛtiḥ api ca iyam atharvaveda adhyayana paryudāsam eva viṣayīkaroti na ca veda antara adhyayana niṣedham iti atra api na viśeṣa hetuḥ asti triṣu vedeṣu idam vratam na punar eṣu eva triṣu iti niyāmakam vacanam asti

yat api śrāddha prakaraṇe yatnena bhojayet iti tri vedī pāraga parikīrtanam tat vedapāragam iti śākhā anta gam iti samāpti gam iti viśeṣaṇa pada paryālocanayā ṛgveda ādi eka deśa adhyāyinām anadhikāram eva śrāddhe sūcayati atharvaṇaḥ tu atharvaśiraḥ adhyayana mātra labdha paṅkti pāvana bhāvasya eka deśa pāṭhinaḥ api tatra adhikāraḥ upapadyate darśitam ca atharva śiraḥ dhyayana mātrāt api paṅkti pāvana tvam paṅkti pāvanaḥ ca śrāddha bhojane anadhikṛtaḥ iti vipratiṣiddham

yaḥ tu jyeṣṭha sāma gaḥ trimadhuḥ trisuparṇikaḥ iti veda antara eka deśa adhyāyinām api śrāddha bhojana abhyanujñānam tat anukalpa rūpam iva bhāti prathama kalpena samagra veda adhyayana upadeśāt iti tasmāt nātharva niṣedha artham etat vākyam iti

tat evam avasthite yat vārtikakāreṇa bhayāt iva dveṣāt iva mohāt iva sa anukampam iva vā idam ucyate yadi yajña upayogi tvam ityādi tad ahṛdayaṅgamam atharvavede pūrva uttara brāhmaṇe vispaṣṭam iṣṭi pa śvāhā hīna satrāṇām upadeśāt veda antareṣu tad codanā bhāvāt kim atharvavede tad upadeśena iti ced su bhāpitam idam evam api hi vaktum śakyam atharvavede tad codanāyāḥ darśanāt kim veda antareṣu tad upadeśena iti na ca jāne kasya epa paryanuyogaḥ kim nityasya vedasya kim vā tad praṇetuḥ īśvarasya iti dvau api tau apari anuyojyau iti uktam artha antara śānti puṣṭi abhicāra ādi veda antareṣu api na na dṛśyate śyenaḥ hi sāmavedaḥ utpannaḥ adbhuta śāntyādayaḥ ca yajurvedaḥ iti tat api samānam

eka brahma ṛtvij āśritāḥ iti etat api na satyam yatas evam tatra paṭhyate dve yajña vṛttī bhavataḥ vaihārikī ca pākayajña vṛttiḥ ca iti tatra vaihārikī nāma aneka ṛtvij āśritānām eka kriyāṇām upadeśaḥ śrutau eka brahma ṛtvij āśritāḥ tu śānti ādi kriyāḥ smṛtau iti abhūmi jñoktiḥ eṣā

trayī ā iva ātmīya gocara iti etat api parama m ādhyasthyam na hi ātmīyaḥ parakīyaḥ vā kaścid asti veda arthaḥ sarva śākhā pratyaya tvāt ekasya karmaṇaḥ tasmāt samāna yogakṣema tvāt sarva vedānām ekasya tatas pṛthak karaṇam veda nindā prāyaścitta nirbhaya dhiyām eva cetasi parisphurati na sādhūnām iti uparamyate

iti tulya prabhāva ṛddhi vardhamāna ucita stavāḥ vividha abhimata sphīta phala saṃpādana udyatāḥ catvāraḥ api parākṣepa parihāra sthira sthitim bhajanti vedāḥ prāmāṇya lakṣmīm haribhujāḥ iva catusskandha upetaḥ prathita pṛthak aryaiḥ avayavaiḥ kṛta anyonya śleṣaiḥ upacita vapuḥ veda viṭapī pratiskandham śākhā phala kusuma sandarbha subhagāḥ prakāśante tasya dvija mukha nipīta uttama rasāḥ
