atra ucyate pratijñāyāḥ tāvat asādhana aṅga vacana tā na asti iti avayava lakṣaṇe nirṇītam etat pratijñā asiddhi arthaḥ eva sarva vādinām prayāsaḥ anirdiṣṭā ca sā sādhayitum aśakyā eva iti na tad vacanam asādhana aṅga vacanam laukikeṣu api ṛṇa ādāna ādi vivāda padeṣu pratijñā ahānim eva mukhyam parājaya kāraṇam āhuḥ yathā aaha nāradaḥ sāraḥ tu vyavahārāṇām pratijñā samudāhṛtā tad hānau hīyate vādī taran tām uttaraḥ bhavet iti pratidṛṣṭānta dharmam ca sva dṛṣṭānte abhyupagacchan utsṛjati eva pratijñām nitya tvam hi sāmānya vat ghaṭasya api sahate tad ṛṣṭānta balena śabde api siṣādhayiṣati iti nūnam idānīm nitya tvam eva ghaṭa dharmaḥ śabde siddhyet iti katham tat anitya tva pratijñā asya na hīyate

yat tu uktam hetvābhāsa prayogaḥ eva nigraha nimittam na pratijñā hāniḥ iti syāt etat evam yadi dvitīye vacasi vyavasthitena prativādinā vyabhicāra udbhāvanayā pratyavasthitaḥ vādī tāvatī eva viramet sa tu tṛtīye vacasivartamānaḥ tad uddharaṇa buddhyā tathāvidham abhidhatte yena pratijñām jahāti atas ca vyabhicāra pariharaṇa lobha abhihita pratidṛṣṭānta dharma abhyanujña vacana upanata tad artha pratijñā ahāni nibandha naḥ eva asya nigrahaḥ yuktaḥ na hetvābhāsa prayoga kṛtaḥ iti ayam eva mukhyaḥ pratijñā hāneḥ viṣayaḥ

pratijñāta artha pratiṣedhe dharme vikalpāt tad artha nirdeśaḥ pratijñāntaram pratijñāta artha pratiṣedhe pareṇa kṛte tatra eva dharmiṇi dharma antaram sādhanīya vādinaḥ pratisā antaram mabhidadhataḥ nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt iti ukte pūrvavat sāmānyena vyabhicāra udbhāvanayā pratyavasthitaḥ āha sāmānyam aindriyakam yat nityam tat yuktam tat hi sarva gatam asarva gataḥ tu śabdaḥ iti naḥ darśanam iti saḥ ayam anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pūrva pratijñātaḥ anyam asarva gataḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñām kurvan pratijñā antareṇa nigṛhītaḥ bhavati

atra āha na idam aprastuta pratijñā antara karaṇam api tu para udbhāvita vyabhicāra nirākaraṇa viśeṣa utpādanam etat uktam bhavati asarva gata tve satya aindriyaka tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti tat idam asarva gata tva pratijñā siddhi artham upāttam katham nigraha sthānam yaḥ hi mīmāṃsakam prati anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt iti uktavān tena kṛtaka tvam asiddham iti upālabdhaḥ kṛtaka tva siddhaye yateta sa kim kṛtaka tva pratijña antara kara ṇāt nigṛhyeta yaḥ tu pūrva pratijñām avadhīrya tat anaupayikam akasmāt eva pratijñāntaram ārabheta sa tadā unmattaḥ eva bhavet na ca unmatta pralāpānām śāstre lakṣaṇa karaṇam yuktam spaṣṭe ca nigraha hetau hetvābhāsa abhidhāne saṃbhavati kim iti pratijñā antaram nigraha sthānam ucyate iti

atra ucyate pratijñā siddhaye hetu dṛṣṭāntau prayoktavyau na punar pratijñāntaram karaṇīyam iti sthitiḥ iha ca yaḥ hetuḥ anena upāttaḥ tasmin pareṇa anaikāntikīkṛte sati na tad parihāra prakāram anuguṇam ayam āsthitavān api tu asarva gata tva pratijñām anyām ārūḍhaḥ nanu viśeṣaṇam etat aneka antika tva parihāra artham na pratijñāntaram iti uktam na asiddha tvāt siddham hi viśeṣaṇam bhavati nitya tva vādinam ca prati śabdasya asarva gata tvam asiddham sādhyate ced tarhi pratijñā antaram eva idam hetu ādi avayava vailakṣaṇyāt pratijñā lakṣaṇasya ca sādhya nirdeśasya upapatteḥ anaikāntika tva parihṛtaye hi hetu viśeṣaṇam siddham vācyam na tu dharmi viśeṣaṇam sādhyam ca iti

anyatara asiddhe tu hetvābhāse tad samarthanam prakrama anurūpam eva iti na pratijñā antaram nigraha sthānam bhavati iha tu anaikāntika tva parihārāya yatamānaḥ mārgam anuguṇam apaśyan skhalitaḥ iti nigṛhyate na ca hetu udādaraṇa ādi prayoga nipuṇa mateḥ api bhramāt evaṃvidham abhidhānam na saṃbhavati na ca pratijñā mātreṇa siddhim icchan evam bravīti api tu vyabhicāram parijihīrṣan iti

na ca ayam unmatta pralāpaḥ eva prastuta anuguṇya buddhyā prayogāt api ca anityaḥ śabdaḥ cākṣuṣa tvāt iti ubhayāsiddhaḥ nāma hetvābhāsaḥ bhavadbhiḥ api śāstre lakṣitaḥ eva saḥ unmatta pralāpaḥ na bhavati yathā udāhṛtam tat pratijñā antaram unmatta pralāpaḥ iti apūrvaḥ eṣa bhikṣoḥ sva darśane rāgaḥ para darśane dveṣaḥ vā kaḥ hi nāma śiśuḥ api śabde cākṣuṣa tām brūyāt idam tu saṃbhavati eva abhidhānam kevalam hetu viśeṣaṇe siddhe ca vaktavye bhramāt dharmi viśeṣaṇam sādhyam ca ayam uktavān iti nigṛhyate tṛtīye vacasi sthitaḥ ca evam asau uktavān iti nimitta antaram idam asya nigrahe nirūpitam dvitīyaḥ eva tu vacasi kathā viratau hetvābhāsa prayogāt eva nigraham āpnuyāt iti pratijñā hāni prastāvaḥ eva uktam

pratijñā hetvaḥ virodhaḥ pratijñā virodhaḥ yatra pratijñā hetunā viruddhayate hetuḥ vā pratijñayā saḥ pratijñāvirodhaḥ nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati guṇa vyatiriktam dravyam iti pratijñā rūpa ādibhyaḥ artha antarasya anupalabdheḥ iti hetuḥ saḥ ayam pratijñā hetvaḥ virodhaḥ yadi guṇa vyatiriktam dravyam na tarhi rūpa ādibhyaḥ artha antarasya anumalabdhiḥ atha rūpa ādibhyaḥ artha antarasya anupalabdhiḥ na tarhi guṇa vyatiriktam dravyam guṇa vyatirikta ca dravyam ca rūpa ādi vyatiriktasya anupaladheḥ iti yāhatam

atra āha na idam pratijñā hetvoḥ virodha udāharaṇam bhavatum arhati hetoḥ asaṃbhavāt saṃbhavan hi hetuḥ pratijñāyāḥ viruṇaddhi tayā vā viruddhyate iha tu upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdhiḥ na samasti eva rūpa ādibhyaḥ artha antarasya pṛthaktvena upalabdhi yogyatva anupapatteḥ saṃbhavan api ca evaṃvidhe viṣaye pratijñā virodhe hetuḥ na dvayīm doṣa jātim ativartate viruddha tvam asiddha tvam vā guṇa vyatirikta dravya vādinaḥ hi bhedena agrahaṇam asiddhaḥ hetuḥ siddha tve vā sādhya viparyaya sādhanāt viruddhaḥ iti atas hetvābhāsa grahaṇena gata artha tvāt na pṛthak vaktavyam idam nigraha sthānam

yat anyat anyaiḥ udāharaṇam abhāṇi nityaḥ śabdaḥ sarvasya anitya tvāt iti tat api asādhu vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntasya anena prakāreṇa kuśikṣitaiḥ abhidhānāt tathā hi sarva śabdaḥ atra sa avayava vacanaḥ iti niravayava tvam hetuḥ vivakṣitaḥ nityaḥ śabdaḥ niravayava tvāt iti tatra vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhya abhāve hetoḥ abhāvam pradarśayatā vaktavyam nityaḥ śabdaḥ anitya sarva tvāt sāvayava tvāt iti saḥ ayam aśikṣita vaidharmya dṛṣṭāṃta pradarśana prakramaiḥ viparyayeṇa vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ eva kathitaḥ sarvasya anisya tvāt iti tad uktam sa hi duṣṭa antaḥ eva uktaḥ vaidharmyeṇa su śikṣitaiḥ iti tasmāt na idam api pratijñā hetu virodha udāharaṇam iti

atra ucyate yat uktam hetoḥ asaṃbhavān na idam nigraha sthānam iti tat acāru paṃcami anta nirdiṣṭasya hetoḥ pradarśita tvāt niravadya hetu abhāvāt tu yadi tat asaṃbhavaḥ ucyate tarhi hetvābhāsa vyākaraṇam api akaraṇīyam bhavet puruṣa buddhi pramāda nibandhana hetu prayogaḥ tu tathāvidham api abhidhānam saṃbhavati eva

yappunar abhyadhāyi saṃbhavan api hetuḥ ayam asiddha viruddhayoḥ anyataraḥ bhavet na dūṣaṇa antaram iti tatra brūmaḥ satyam etat kintu hetu svarūpa nirūpaṇa avasare sa yadi tad gata doṣa adoṣa darśanāt viruddha tā tasya abhidhīyate yathā bhavadbhiḥ nityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt iti viruddha hetau varṇite kvacid siddha sādhya tva dṛṣṭānta hīna tā ādi doṣa antara saṃbhave tad avadhīraṇayā viruddha tvam eva darśitam yathā vā hetvābhāsa lakṣaṇe kathitam asmābhiḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ cākṣuṣa tvāt iti asya anaikāntika tva doṣe sati api prathama tarama siddha tā eva hṛdaya patham avatarati tena asiddhaḥ ayam ucyate na savyabhicāraḥ iti evam iha api hetu guṇa doṣa vicāre kriyamāṇe viruddha tā ādi hetvābhāsa tā asya kathyate

yadā tu para artha anumāna vākyasya paṃcāvayavasya para matena vā vyavayavasya paraspara anvita padārtha samudāya ātmā vākya arthaḥ cintyate tatra itaretara vyāhata artha vādinoḥ pratijñā hetu padayoḥ asaṃsargāt tad virodhaḥ eva jhaṭiti manasi viparivartate iti saḥ eva nigraha nimittam bhavitum arhati yatas itaretara virodhinam ananvitā artham am idadhati vākye api vipratipattiḥ apratipattiḥ vā bhavet iti adaḥ eva nigraha sthānam

api ca sādhya viparyaya sādhakaḥ eva viruddha hetuḥ ucyate yaḥ pratijñām eva bādhate iha tu pratijñayā hetuḥ vā adhyate pratijñā vā hetunā iti vikalpyamāna tvāt nigraha sthāna antaram eva idam ittham asya eva udāharaṇasya upapatteḥ udāharaṇa antara nirūpaṇam vṛthā aṭāṭyā eva

bhāṭṭauḥ tu bhavadīyam nirālambana sādhanam pratijñā virodha udāharaṇam varṇitam nirālambanāḥ sarve pratyayāḥ pratyaya tvāt iti yatas pratyaya tva hetu grāhaka jñāna sālambana tve tena eva eṣā pratijñā viruddhadhyate tad nirālambana tve tu hetu abhāvaḥ eva syāt iti tat uktam vispaṣṭaḥ ca akṣapāda uktaḥ virodhaḥ hetu sādhyayoḥ yama dṛṣṭavā paraiḥ uktam adūṣaṇam idam kila iti tat sarvathā sulabha udāharaṇam idam pratijñā hetu virodha ākhyam nigraha sthānam iti sthitiḥ

pakṣa pratiṣedhe pratijñāta artha apanayanam pratijñāsannyāsaḥ pakṣa sādhane pareṇa dūṣite tad uddhāraṇā śaktyā pratijñām eva nihnuvānasya pratijñāsannyāsaḥ nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt iti ukte tathā eva sāmānyena anaikāntika tāyām uddhāṭitāyām yat pratibravīti kaḥ evam āhānityaḥ śabdaḥ iti saḥ ayam evaṃbruvan pratijñāsannyāsāt parājīyate

atra āha atisthūlaḥ khalu ayam pramādaḥ kaḥ hi nāma prativādī prāśnika sannidhāne pratijñām kṛtvā tadā eva teṣām eva abhraṣṭa saṃskārāṇām puratas apasmāraka ādi anupapluta matiḥ tām eva nihnuvīta api ca dyūta parājita paṇa rahita śaṭha kitava vat udāsīnaḥ pratijñām ajahat api hetau anaikāntike kim asau na nigṛhyate na hi pratijñāyāḥ tyāga atyāgau tadīyayoḥ nigraha anigrahayoḥ prayojakau api tu hetu guṇa doṣau eva sa ca ayam sādhana vyabhicārāt eva anitya pakṣaḥ parājīyate iti alam sannyāsena iti

atra ucyate para udbhāvita hetu anaikāntika tva dūṣaṇa uddharaṇa raṇa raṇa katara lita mateḥ bhavet api ayam pramādaḥ evam hi asau vadati mayā uktam saṃyoga viyoga vyaṅgyaḥ śabdaḥ na bhavati na tu anityaḥ iti ayam āśayaḥ tu evaṃdataḥ kila saṃyoga vibhāga anabhivyaṅgya tve mayā pakṣīkṛte sāmānyena vyabhicāraḥ na bhaviṣyati iti tat api hi tādṛśam eva sva āśraya vyaṅgya tvāt iti muhyataḥ na ati sthūlam amum īdṛśam pramādam pratipannasya bhavati eva nigraha hetuḥ apramādinoḥ tu nigrahaḥ nāma na asti eva kaścid iha loke para loke vā yat tu tadīyayoḥ pratijñā tyāga atyāgayoḥ anaikāntika tvena eva asau nigṛhyate iti syāt etat evam yadi vyabhicāra udbhāvana samanantaram asau tūṣṇīm eva āsīta tathāvidham tu bruvāṇaḥ tasya eva parājaya hetoḥ sannikṛṣṭa tvāt tena eva nigṛhītaḥ bhavati na anaikāntika prayogeṇa iti

aviśeṣa ukte hetau pratiṣiddhe viśeṣam icchataḥ hetu antaram aviśeṣa abhihite hetau pratiṣiddhe tad viśeṣaṇam abhidadhataḥ hetu antaram nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati yathā sāṃkhyasya itthaṃvadataḥ eka prakṛti idam vyaktam parimāṇāt ghaṭa ādi vat iti dvividham ca vikāreṣu dṛṣṭam iyattā lakṣaṇam aṅkura ādeḥ phala antarasya caturaśratā ca ghaṭa ādeḥ mṛd pūrvakasya tade tad parimitam nikāra jātam eka prakṛtikam dṛṣṭam iti atas sarvam idam eka prakṛti bhavitum arhati yā ca sā ekā prakṛtiḥ tat pradhānam iti

asya hetoḥ vyabhicāraḥ nānā prakṛtīnām api pariṇāma darśanāt iti tad parijihīrṣayā viśeṣaṇam āha samanvayāt iti sukha duḥkha moha samanvitam hi sarvam vyaktam parimitam dṛśyate iti tasya prakṛti antara rūpa samanvaya abhāvāt eka prakṛtika tvām iti tat idam hetu antaram nigraha sthānam prāk uktā viśeṣaṇa hetoḥ svayam eva hetu tva amarṣaṇāt iti

atra āha kim ayam dagdhaḥ dahyate mṛtaḥ vā māryate anaikāntika hetu upanyāsena eva khalu ayam tapasvī nigṛhītaḥ eva asādhana aṅga vacanāt iti kṛtam hetu antarākhya nigraha sthāna antara udīraṇena iti atra ucyate yuktam eva tat dvitīye vacasi kathā samāptau yathā tu bhavān āha yadā tu vyabhicāra nirākaraṇāya viśeṣaṇam aparam adhika madhunā abhidhātum pravṛttaḥ tadā tad upādānāt eva nigṛhyate iti piṣṭapeṣaṇam saṃprati eva ayam iṣyate puruṣa śakti parīkṣā ātmake ca jalpe nigraha sthānam idam vāde tu viśuddha āśaya tayā vastuni parīkṣyamāṇe viśeṣaṇa antara upādāne api tad vicāraḥ prastotavyaḥ na nigrahaḥ kāryaḥ iti abhiyuktāḥ

prakṛtāt arthāt apratisaṃbaddha artham artha antaram prakṛtāt arthāt artha antaram tat anaupayikam abhidadhataḥ arthāntaram nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati yathā kaścid vaiyākaraṇa viṭaḥ sphoṭa ātmānam śabdam cetasi nidhāya tat nitya tu asiddhaye nityaḥ śabdaḥ niravayava tvāt iti abhidhitsurā iva durita karma ādibhiḥ anaikāntika tām āśaṅka mānaḥ arthāntaram nāma nigraha sthānam jigamiṣuḥ tatra eva vākya śeṣa chāyayā uttiṣṭhati nityaḥ śabdaḥ niradha yava tvāt iti vayam pāṇinīyāḥ pratipannoḥ ye bhagavataḥ pāṇineḥ chātrāḥ iti kaḥ punar bhagavān pāṇiniḥ iti yena akṣara samāmnāyam adhigamya maheśvarāt kṛtsnam vyākaraṇam proktam ācāryaḥ nassa pāṇiniḥ

kaḥ punar maheśvaraḥ yatas akṣara samāmnāyam adhijagāma pāṇiniḥ iti ati udbhaṭa jaṭā jūṭa koṭi grathita candramāḥ viśva sthiti bhava dhvaṃsa hetuḥ ekaḥ maheśvaraḥ api ca acintya veṣa ābharaṇasya tat ktaḥ yadṛcchayā yasya niśāsu tāṇḍavam sa bhasma bhaktīni bibharti maulinā kṛta aṃjaliḥ pāda rajāṃsi vāsavaḥ

kīdṛśam punar tāṇḍavam tanoti khaṇḍaparaśuḥ iti itthaṃcārī kramaḥ yasmin ittham ca kara vartanāḥ ittham yatra kaṭi chedāḥ daṇḍa pādāḥ tathā īdṛśāḥ iti ekaikam upadeśayan utthāya nṛtyati tat etat artha antaram nigraha sthānam asādhana aṅgam iti kīrtinā api anumoditam dvayoḥ api ca vādi prativādinoḥ prakṛta an anuguṇam abhidadhatoḥ bhavati adaḥ nigraha sthānam yathākramam ekasya sādhanam anavadyam apaśyataḥ dvitīyasya dūṣaṇam iti

varṇa krama nirdeśa vat nirarthakam abhidheya rahita varṇa ānupūrvī prayoga mātram nirarthakam nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati anityaḥ śabdaḥ kacaṭatapānām gaja ḍada ba tvāt ghajhaḍha dhama vat iti evam prakāram idam api vādi prativādinoḥ prakṛta an anuguṇam abhidadhatoḥ bhavati adaḥ nigraha sthānam yathākramam sādhanam dūṣaṇam ca yathā uvitam abhidhātum ajānatoḥ pūrvavat ubhayoḥ api nigraha sthānam

atra āha saḥ ayam unmatta pralāpam eva śāstre lakṣayitum upakrāntaḥ na hi anunmattānām īdṛṃśī akṣarāṇi mukhāt nirgacchanti īdṛśām ca nirdeśe kapola vāditra kakṣyā abhitāḍana ādīni api kāmam śāstre nirdiśyantām api ca varṇa krama nirdeśa vat iti matupāḥ nirdeśaḥ eṣa sūtre vat iti vati prayogaḥ vā matuppakṣe sarvam varṇa krama nirdeśa yuktam nigraha sthānam bhavet iti hasta saṃjñā ādibhiḥ idānīm udgrāhiṇikāḥ prastūyeran

atha anarthakakram asiderśa yuktam iti vyākhyāyate tathā api niyama anupapattiḥ na hi artha rahita varṇa uccāraṇam eva prakṛta anupayogāt nirarthakam eva varṇa krama nirdeśasya api ca kvacid prakaraṇe sārthaka tā dṛśyate eva pratyāhāra vat vati pakṣe tu bhavati diva pradarśanam etat kintu artha antareṇa eva gata artha tvāt pṛthaṅana vaktavyam

atra ucyate matupā vatinā vā abhidheya śūnya tva mātram atra vivakṣitam abhidheya śūnyam vacaḥ nirarthakam iti uktam iti bhavati eṣaḥ eva ca artha antarāt asya viśeṣaḥ tatra abhidheyasya bhāve api prakṛta anupayogaḥ ihatu abhidheyam eva na asti iti yatra kvacid prakaraṇa vaśena varṇa krama nirveśasya api sārthaka tā na tat iha udāharaṇam udāharaṇam yadi sphuṭam pṛcchasi na kupyasi ced tat bhavadīyam sarvam eva vacanam iha udāharaṇam saugata darśane śabdānām artha asaṃsparśi tvāt sva lakṣaṇe teṣām apravṛtteḥ apohasya ca ati tuccha tvāt sarvam tad abhidhāne nararthakam

atas eva ca unmatta pralāpinaḥ śākī abhikṣavaḥ api pariśuddha vṛttayaḥ para lokayāthārthya darśinaḥ śauca ācāra vyavahāreṣu abāhyāḥ mahāntaḥ vidvāṃsaḥ te kāmam artha śūnyam api kathayantaḥ na unmattā bhavitum arhanti evam anyasyārpi prajñā pramādāt kacaṭata pādi vyāharataḥ na unmatta tā yacya uktam īdṛśām gaṇane kā pariniṣṭhā iti tat parihṛtam asakṛt asaṅkīrṇa udāharaṇa vivakṣayā dvāviṃśati bheda tvam āśritam iti kapola vādana ādīni punar akadhā svabhāva tvāt acintyāni eva yasya ca asmin kathā prasaṅge gaṇḍa vāditra ādi cetasi sphurati tasya anyat ati jaghanyam api hṛdayam avataret iti alam kaśmala goṣṭhyā iti

parṣad prativādibhyām tris abhihitam api avijñātam avijñāta artham yat sādhana vārkya dūṣaṇa vākyam vā tris abhihitam parṣadā prativādinā na vijñāyate kliṣṭa śabda prayogam aprasiddha prayogam atidruta uccarita minyā ivaṃprakāram avijñāta artham nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati asāmarthya saṃvaraṇāya ca dhūrtaiḥ idam āśrīyate

atra āha artha asaṃpratyayasya samāna tvāt kaḥ asya nirarthakāt bhedaḥ atha prakṛta upayoga yogyam artham asau vadati tadā parṣad prativādinā uramedha avitā kāmam bhavet na tu viduṣaḥ vaktum vivadataḥ parājayaḥ bhavitum arhati kiṃkṛtaḥ ca eṣa tris uccāraṇa niyamaḥ kim rāja ājñayā uta svākyena iti na vidmaḥ atra ucyate nirarthake sarveṇa sarva artha śūnyatā iha tu bhavan api arthaḥ na avagamyate drutatara uccāraṇa ādi vyatikara vaśāt iti katham aviśeṣaḥ tatra ca kalpyate nūnam asāmarthyam ātmīyam āvarītu manāḥ evam abhidhatte na hi samarthaḥ vidvān vispaṣṭam na vakti iti

tri tva niyamaḥ api na veda vacana nara pati śāsana nibandhanaḥ kintu vastu sthityu panataḥ eva yatas sakṛt dvis api abhihitam api anavadhāna ādinā na gṛhītam iti saṃbhāvyate tris tu yat uktam na jñāyate tatra vaktuḥ eva jāḍyam aneka prāśnika ādi samāje kathitam avaśyam kena api avagamyeta sarveḥ anavagamāt tu vaktā eva nigṛhyate caturdhā paṃcadhā vā abhidhāne tu iṣyamāṇe niravadhitā abhidhānasya prasajyate iti yuktaḥ tris vaṃcana niyamaḥ iti

paurvāparya ādi yāgāt apratisaṃbaddha artham apārthakam pūrva apara asaṅgatapada kadambaka uccāraṇāt apratiṣṭhita vākya artham apārthakam nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati tat yathā daśa dāḍimāni ṣaṣ apūpā kuṇḍam ajājiḥ na palala piṇḍaḥ kumāryāḥ caitrasya pitā pratiśīnaḥ iti

atra āha apratisaṃbaddhavat eva asaṃbaddha vākyam asaṃbaddha prakaraṇam ca nigraha sthāna antaram kasmāt na uktam etena eva gata artha tvāt iti ced yadi evam anarthakena eva gata artha tvāt apārthakam api pṛthaṅana vaktavyam atra ucyate nirarthake na padārthaḥ na vākya arthaḥ kevalam varṇāḥ eva śuṣkāḥ uccāryante artha antare api samanvita padārthe vyavasthāpita vākya artham anupakṛtam tu ucyate iha tu padārtha saṃpratyaye api tad anvayā saṃbhavena vākya artha anavasāyaḥ iti spaṣṭaḥ bhedaḥ prakṛta vivāda āspadībhūte vastuni kaḥ vā viśeṣaḥ iti ced uktam atra saṃkṣepa vivakṣāyām dve eva nigraha sthāne asaṃkīrṇa udāharaṇa vivakṣayā tu dvāviṃśati bheda tvam prakṛta vastu siddhiḥ tu dvāviṃśatau api tulyā eva

yat tu asaṃbaddha vākyam asaṃbaddha prakaraṇam ca pṛthak upasaṃkhyeyam iti tat na apratisaṃbaddha padārthena eva tad saṃgrahāt yadi tu asaṃbaddha vākyam asaṃbaddha prakaraṇam ca avaśyam vaktavyam tat yuktam eva bhavadīyam śāstram tathā hi vaibhāṣikāṇām asti bāhyaḥ arthaḥ sa ca pratyakṣaḥ sautra antikānām ca san apya sau anumeyaḥ yoga ācārāṇām sa ākāram jñānam eva na bāhyaḥ arthaḥ sa ca pratyakṣaḥ mādhyamikānām ākāra śūnyam svaccham jñāna mātram eva iti evam itaretarān anvita vākya prakaraṇam idam aśeṣam eva śākya śāstram āha ca daśa dāḍima vākyasya bauddha śāstrasya ca īdṛśaḥ anyasya ca api abaddhasya pratiṣṭhā kena labhyate
avayava viparyāsa vacanam aprāpta kālam pratijñā hetu udāharaṇa upanaya nigamana vacana kramam ati laṅghya avayava viparyā sena prayujyamānam anumāna vākyam aprāpta kālam nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati

atra āha na hi padānām vākyeṣu niyataḥ kramaḥ kaścid asti niyata kramakāḥ hi varṇāḥ padatām āpadyante iti yuktam tad antareṇa tad arthān avagamāt na hi ghaṭaḥ iti ukte ghaṭa avagatiḥ bhaṃvati vākyeṣu tu devadatta gām śuklām abhyāja daṇḍena daṇḍena śuklām gām abhyāja devadatta iti krama antareṇa api tathā eva artha pratipatteḥ kim krameṇa anumāna vākye tu paṃca avayavāḥ iti etat eva tāvat prathamam asāṃpratam pratijña ādi ava yavānām asādhāna aṅga vacana tvāt tatra teṣām paṃca avayavānām api prayogaḥ prayoge api ca kramaḥ vivakṣitaḥ tad ullaṅghanam ca nigraha sthānam iti mahatī mūrkha prakriyā iti

atra ucyate vākya antareṣu krama vivakṣā bhavatu mā vā bhūt na anena naḥ prayojanam anumāna vākye tu ārthaḥ krama balāt āpatati sva pratipatti anusāreṇa para pratipateḥ utpādanāt sva pratipattau ca dharmi darśana tad gata hetu dharma avadhāraṇa pratibandha smaraṇa parāmarśa jñāna sādhya niścayānām krameṇa darśanāt param prati tathā eva tad abhidhānam kartavyam iti sa vistaram avayava lakṣaṇam nirṇitam etat asādhana aṅga tvacana tvam api pratijña ādi avayavānām tatra eva nirastam atas kramasya iha yukti yukta tvāt tavatikramaḥ bhavati eva nigraha sthānam
hīnam anyatamena api avathavena nyūnam paṃca avayave vākye prayoktavye sthite tad anyatamena api avayavena hīnam prayuṃjānasya nyūnam nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati

atra āha pratijña ādi ava yava jātam asādhana aṅga vacanam iti atas tad anabhidadhataḥ na nigrahaḥ pratyuta vadataḥ nigrahaḥ yuktaḥ iti atra ucyate anantaram evai tat parihṛtam vistarataḥ ca avayava lakṣaṇe tathā hi śrotuḥ ākāṅkṣā nivṛttaye anumāna vākyam prayujyate iti prathamam tad ākāṅkṣā viṣayaḥ sādhya dharma viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī pradarśyate tatas kāraṇa ākāṅkṣāyām hetu vacanam abhidhīyate kva asya pratibandhaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti bubhutsāyām udāharaṇam upapādyate ittham eṣa siddha pratibandhaḥ hetuḥ dharmiṇi bhavet na vā iti śaṅkāyām upanaya vacanam uccāryate tad anantaram sarva avayavānām ekatra upasaṃhārāya nigamanam prayujyate iti anyatamasya aprayogāt nigraha arha tā bhavati eva iti alam atra eva vastuni pade pave kalaha prastāvanena iti

hetu udāharaṇa adhikam adhikam ekena eva hetunā dṛṣṭāntena vā pratipādite arthe hetu antaram dṛṣṭānta antaram vā prayuṃjānasya adhikam nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati etat ca vāde tāvat vīta rāga kathā ātmake vastu nirṇaya phale neṣyate eva jalpe api niyama abhyupagamena vadataḥ vādinaḥ idam nigraha sthānam yaḥ hi na mayā āvābhyām vā sādhanam adhikam abhidheyam udāharaṇam vā iti niyamya udgrāhayati saḥ eva tathā nigṛhyate na anyaḥ iti etat ca kīrtinā api evam eva kathitam prapaṃca kathāyām tu na doṣaḥ iti

aparaḥ āha niyama abhyupāme api na ayam doṣaḥ pratipatti dra ḍhimne tad abhi dhānāt iti tat ayuktam abhyupagata niyama tyāgāt asau nigraha arhaḥ bhavet kaḥ ca ayam pratipatti draḍhimā prathama prayuktasya hi hetoḥ mṛdu pratipatti kāriṇaḥ hetu tvam eva na syāt utpannasya pratyayasya punar utpādanam yuktam tatra na pūrva hetuḥ adra ḍhimne na api uttaraḥ draḍhimne tasmāt niyama abhyupagame adhika abhidhānam doṣaḥ eva aparam matam akṛta niyamasya api doṣaḥ eva prapaṃca kathāyām apye kena hetunā dṛṣṭāntena vā kṛte nirṇaye dvitīyasya vaiyarthyāt nirṇītasya nirṇaya anupapatteḥ anirṇaya kāriṇaḥ ca prathamasya hetoḥ prayoga anarha tvāt iti

śabda arthayoḥ punar uccāraṇam punarvacanam anyatra anuvādāt arthāt āpannasya sva kaṇṭhena punarvacanam śabdasya vā arthasya vā abhihitasya punar abhidhānam punaruktam nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati anuvādam varjayitvā śabda punaruktam tāvat yatra pūrva uccāritaḥ eva śabdaḥ punar uccāryate yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ nitya śabdaḥ iti

artha punaruktam tu yatra saḥ arthaḥ pūrvam anyena śabdena uktaḥ paryāya antareṇa punar ucyate yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ nirodha dharmakaḥ dhvānaḥ iti yadi api ca śabda punarukte api artha paunaruktyam asti eva tathā api śabda pūrvaka tvāt artha pratyabhijñāyāḥ prathamataram śabda pratyabhijñānāt tat paunaruktyam eva tat ucyate jāti apekṣaḥ ca śabda paunarukti a vyavahāraḥ na vyakti apekṣaḥ kṣaṇam bhaṅgi tvāt varṇānām punar prayoga asaṃbhavāt

anuvāde tu paunarukti ama doṣaḥ yathā hetu apadeśāt pratijñāyāḥ puna rvacanam nigamanam iti arthāt āpannasya api sva śabdena punarvacanam bhavati eva punaruktam yathā asatsu megheṣu vṛṣṭiḥ na bhavati iti ukte arthāt āpadyate satsu bhavati iti tat kim artham sva kaṇṭhena punar ucyate artha prati iti arthaḥ hi śabda prayogaḥ pratīte arthe kim tena iti etat ca niyama abhyupagame nigraha sthānam veditavyam akṛta niyamasyam tu na atīva mahān ayam aparādhaḥ

atra āha na artha punaruktāt anyat śabda punaruktam upapadyate śabda sāmye api artha bheda darśanāt smarata giriśam giriśaḥ nagarī yasya asamaradveṣasya kaḥ iva yadīyasya mudā na garīyasyā samasmaradveṣasya iti tasmāt arthataḥ eva paunaruktyam na śabdataḥ api ca vistara kathāsu kadācana samyak aśravaṇa śaṅkrāyām punar abhidhānam nāma kiyān pramādaḥ arthāt āpannasya ca sva śabdena punarvacanam yadi nigraha sthānam ucyate tarhi pratijñā vacanam eva prathamam nigraha sthānam

adhika punaruktayoḥ vā kaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti vaktavyam yādṛśam tādṛśam ca viśeṣa leśam āśritya pṛthak abhidhāne nigraha sthāna bheda parigaṇanam aśakya kriyam syāt anuvādaḥ ced ucyate hetu apadeśāt pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanam nigamanam iti tatra pratijñā eva tāvat asādhvī tasyāḥ punarvacanam sādhu bhaviṣyati iti kā iyam kathā

atra ucyate yat uktam artha punaruktāt anyat na śabda punaruktam iti tat evam eva pṛthak nirdeśaḥ tu anayā vivakṣayā yaḥ hi śakti atiśaya cikhyā apayiṣayā sakṛt prayuktaḥ śabdaḥ punar mayā na prayoktavyaḥ iti pratijñāya jalpam pravartayati sa śabda punaruktena api nigṛhyate iti niyamya vādinaḥ eva nigrahāt tatas anyasya samyak aśravaṇa śaṅkayā punar vadataḥ api na doṣaḥ artha ākṣipta kathanam api kṛta niyamasya eva doṣaḥ na anyasya iti

atas eva vāde na nigraha sthānam idam api tu jalpa vitaṇḍayoḥ eva vijigīṣu kathayoḥ tayoḥ ca sa prayojana tvam kathā antara tvam ca purā samarthitam eva yat tu pratijña uccāraṇam artha ākṣipta tvāt tad anuvādaḥ ca nigamana vacanam aphalataram iti tad avayava lakṣaṇe vistareṇa samāhitam adhika punaruktayoḥ tu ayam vispaṣṭaḥ eva viśeṣaḥ anyam hetum anyam vā dṛṣṭāntam tatra eva sādhye abhidadhat adhika vādī bhavati tam eva hetum dṛṣṭāntam vā punar cadan punar ukta vādi iti yat tu evaṃvidha viśeṣa āśrayaṇe parigaṇa nam adhaṭamānam iti tat avāntara viśeṣa vivakṣayā evam eva asaṅkīrṇa udāharaṇa pradarśanāya tu dvāviṃśati nirdeśa aiti uktam

vijñātasya parṣadā tris abhihitasya api anuccāraṇam ananubhāṣaṇam parṣadā viditasya vādinā tris uccāritasya api yat apratyuccāraṇam tat ananubhāṣaṇam nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati apratyuccārayan kim āspadam dūṣaṇam abhidadhīta nanu yadi ananu bhāṣya api tatra uttaram brūyāt kim iti nigṛhyeta na ca yaḥ anubhāṣitum asamarthaḥ saḥ uttaram api dātum akṣamaḥ bhavati vicitra tvāt puruṣa śaktīnām na etat evam ananubhāṣaṇe tad uttara viṣaya aparijñānāt kva uttaram prayujyeta prayuktam vā katham avadhāryeta

na ca evam brūmaḥ yāvat kiṃcid vādinā sa vistaram abhidhīyate tad akhilam anyūnā anatiriktam anujjhita kramakam prativādī tathā eva anubhāṣeta iti yaḥ tu samasta anubhāṣaṇam tathā kuryāt api nāma tena sva kauśalam eva kevalam mupadarśitam bhavati medhāvi tvam vā na tu evam akurvan pratyaveyāt iti stoka stokam anubhāṣamāṇaḥ tathā eva ca krameṇa dūṣayan na nigraham āpnuyāt iti

atra āha yadi vādī sva pakṣa mādhana vivaraṇa vartmanā bahutaram akṛta kama prakṛta artham upakṣipet tat kim prativādinā sarvam anubhāṣaṇīyam hetu mātram tu anūdya dūṣaṇam udbhāvayataḥ na asya nigrahaḥ yuktaḥ dūṣaṇa viṣayam tu hetu mātram api yaḥ anubhāṣitum akauśalaḥ saḥ uttara viṣaya aparijñānāt uttaram api pratipattum asamarthaḥ eva iti apratibhayā nigṛhyatām kim ananubhāṣaṇena

api ca tris abhihitasya iti kā iyam paribhāṣā tathā ca vādī para avabodha artham vākyam prayuṃjīta para upadrava artham vā tatra para avabodha arthe vākye para avabodhaḥ eva abhidhāna vidhiḥ na dvis tris vā niyamaḥ yāvat kṛtvas prayukte vākye parasya ayabodhaḥ jāyate tāvat kṛtvas prayoktavyam para upadrava artham tu vākya uccāraṇam akṣataḥ eva dharmaḥ prāśnikān yathā tathā saṅketena api brodhayitvā duḥśliṣṭa kaṣṭa śabda prayoga ādi āḍambara viracanayā api āndhyam utpādya parān uparudhyeta iti mahat kaśmalam etat na ca īdṛśam śāstre vyutpādana arham tasmāt bahu kṛtvas api abhidhāya prativādī bodhayitavyaḥ na tu dvis uccāritam apratyuccaran nigṛhītavyaḥ iti

atra ucyate na khalu sakṛt eva sakala para viracita vacana saṃdarbha anubhāṣaṇam avilambita kramakam asmābhiḥ api kartavya tayā upadiṣṭam api tu yathocita dūṣaṇa viṣaya anubhāṣaṇa mātram eva yaḥ tu stokam api anubhāṣitum apragalbhaḥ tasya uttara pratibhānam api na asti iti yat ucyate tad asamyak anyat ananubhāṣaṇam anyat uttarā pratibhānam kasyacid aśeṣam anubhāṣitavataḥ api uttara apratibhāna darśanāt tat idam anuttara viṣayānuddha ūṣaṇam nigraha sthānam ucyate na uttara apratibhānam uttara apratibhānam anantaram vakṣyate

yat tu tris uccāraṇa paribhāṣā kutastyeti vikalpitam tad avijñāta artha nāmni nigraha sthāne prativihitam vīta rāga kathā ātmake vāde śiṣṭa ādi bhiḥ saha kriyamāṇe kāmam astu para avabodha avadhi vākya uccāraṇam jalpe tu vijigīṣu kathāyām puruṣa śakti parīkṣaṇāt avaśyam uccāraṇa niyamaḥ āśrayaṇīyaḥ tatra sakṛt vā dvis vā abhihitasya agrahaṇam anavadhāna ādinā api saṃbhavan na nigrahāya kalpate tris abhihitasya tu sarvaiḥ agrahaṇe vaktuḥ eva aparādhaḥ anyaiḥ gṛhītasya prativādinā tu agrahaṇe tasya nigrahaḥ vāra trayāt ūrdhvam api abhidhāne tu āśrīyamāṇe jalpa ādau kathā samāptiḥ eva na syāt chātra śālā hi asau bhavet na udgrāhiṇikā bhūmiḥ iti

avijñānam ca ajñānam pariṣadā vijñātasya api vādi vākyasya prativādinā yat avijñānam tat ajñānam nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati avidita uttara viṣayaḥ hi kva uttaram brūyāt iti ajñānam apratibhā iti na anayoḥ viśeṣam paśyāmaḥ atra ucyate bhinna viṣaya tvāt adoṣaḥ uttara viṣaya apratipattiḥ ajñānam uttara apratipattiḥ tu apratibhā iti

nanu uttara viṣarya yaḥ na jānāti saḥ uttaram api na jānāti eva mā evam uttara viṣayam jānan api kiṃcid uttaram na jānāti iti loka dṛṣṭam etat evam tarhi ananubhāṣaṇena gata artham ajñānam ajñāte hi parakīye vākya arthe tad anubhāṣaṇe sāmarthya abhāva darśanāt santi hi kecid ye anubhāṣitum aśaknuvantaḥ patrikā ādi likhitam tadā āvedayanti iti evam trayāṇām api ca na paunaruktyam uttara viṣaya apratipattiḥ ajñānam pratipattau api tat apratyuccāraṇam ananubhāṣaṇam anubhāṣite api uttarā pratipattiḥ apratibhā iti

nanu yadi ajñāna sāmye api viṣaya bhedam āśritya nigraha sthāna nānā tvam ityam abhidhīyate tarhi ajñāna prakāra vaicitryāt bheda antarāṇi api vaktavyāni iti uktam atra sāra saṃgraha vivakṣayā dve eva nigraha sthāne vipratipattiḥ apratipattiḥ ca iti itaretara visadṛśa udāharaṇa diś pradarśanāya dvāviṃśati bheda tvam ucyate avāntara viśeṣaiḥ tu tat ānantyam abhyupagamyate eva tathā ca dvāviṃśati varge hetvābhāsāḥ ca iti paṭhitam te ca sva rūpeṇa eva tāvat paṃca savyabhicāra viruddha prakaraṇa sama sādhya sama atīta kālāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ iti avāntara bhedāḥ ca teṣām atibahavaḥ santi eva iha tu ekam eva tad nigraha sthānam ādiṣṭam hetvābhāsāḥ ca yathā uktāḥ iti tasmāt ittham samāsa vyāsa varṇanāt alam pade pade paryanuyogena iti

uttarasya apratipattiḥ apratibhā para pakṣe gṛhīte api tasmin uttara apratibhānam apratibhā nāma prativādinaḥ nigraha sthānam bhavati ajñāna ādibhyaḥ bhinna tā asya darśitā eva kīrtiḥ api ca etat anumanyate eva nigraha sthānam nanu uttaram apratipadyamānaḥ sadasi prativādī katham āsīta yat kiṃcid vikatthamānaḥ tat yathā hṛd puṇḍarīka vikasat sakalān avadya vidyā avadāta vadanaḥ kva janaḥ asmad ādiḥ kva ayam vaṭuḥ katipaya akṣara leśa lipta jihvā anvitaḥ katham anena saha abhidadhmaḥ dāna ārdra gandha gaja kumbha kapāṭa bhedi bhīma sphurat nakha śikhā śikharaḥ kva siṃhaḥ kva amī samīraṇa vidhūta pūrāṇaparṇa pāta udbhavat bhaya vilola dṛśaḥ kuraṅgāḥ ityādi yat vā tat vā pralapan āste

kārya vyāsaṃgāt kathā vicchedaḥ vikṣepaḥ udgrāhaṇikām upakramya vā tat grāhayitavyam mayā iti pratiśratya vā abhimukham prativādini sannihiteṣu prāśnikeṣu kārya vyāsaṅgam vyapadiśati idam me karaṇīyam apahīyate gacchāmi iti abhidhāya kathām vicchinatti yaḥ sa vikṣepeṇa parājīyate anyatara nigraha antā hikathā bhavati sa cattham kathām kurvan ātmanā eva ātmānam nigṛhṇāti pratiśyāyena me kaṇṭha uparodhaḥ udapādi padam api vaktum na yujyate jananī me jīvitam jahāti sma tām śmaśāna bhuvam prāpayya vahnisāt karomi iti

atra āha yadi tāvat paramārthataḥ eva mātṛmarāṇa ādi kāryaṃmasya upasthitam tat kim iti tapasvī parājīyate udgrāhaṇikā ajitaḥ mā bhūvam iti kim asau mṛtām mātaram api mā dhākṣīt iti mahat subhāṣitam iti pīnasa avaruddha sthāna karaṇaḥ vā katham vācam udīrayatu atha asāmarthya sthaganāya vitatham api kathayati tathāvidham asau kārya vyāsaṅgam tarhi satyam nigṛhyate na tu vikṣepeṇa kintu anyena eva vādī tāvat druta kartavya vyāja vyapadeśāt artha antara gamana ādinā nigṛhyate prativādī tu apratibhayā eva iti atiprasaṅgaḥ ca evaṃprakāraṇām nirdeśe bhavet iti

atra ucyate kathām upakramya pratijñām vā hetum abhidhāya tad vivaraṇa saraṇimiṣam abalambya kiṃcid artha antaram upanyasyati yat tat artha antaram udāhṛtam ādau eva iha tu kathā pūrva raṅge kathāyām vā kim api karaṇīya nibham abhidhāya sa bhayam apasarati sadasaḥ iti katham iva tad tulya tā bhavati apratibhayā api śruta pūrva pakṣaḥ parājīyate iha tu pūrva pakṣam eva na śṛṇoti vā na karoti vā prathamam eva palāyate iti mahān viśeṣaḥ atiprasaṅgaḥ tu asakṛt parākṛtaḥ yat tu hetvābhāseṣu antar bhāvam asya kīrtiḥ akīrtayat tat atīva subhāṣitam kva hetvābhāsaḥ kva kārya vyāsaṅgaḥ saṃpradhāraṇā eva ramaṇīyeyam ahetavau hetu vat avabhāsamānāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ kim asya kārya vyāsaṅgasya ahetoḥ hetu vat ābhāsanam kīrtinā dṛṣṭam iti param naḥ kutūhalam

sva pakṣe doṣa abhyupagamāt para pakṣe doṣa prasaṃgaḥ mata anujñā sva dakṣe para āpādita doṣam anuddhṛtya abhyupagamya tam eva para pakṣe pratīpa mā āpādayataḥ para ma tā anujñānāt mata anujñā nāma nigraha sthānam bhavati yathā cauraḥ bhavān puruṣa tvāt prasiddha caura vat iti ukte sati āha bhavān api cauraḥ puruṣa tvāt iti saḥ ayam evam vadan ātmanaḥ para āpāditam doṣam abhyupagatavān iti mata anujñayā nigṛhyate

atra āha anaikāntike hetau pareṇa ukteḥ tad udbhāvanam anena prakāreṇa prativādī karoti iti kim iti nigṛhyate vādyā iva hetvābhāsa prayogāt nigṛhyate iti atra ucyate uktam ādau eva sva pakṣe doṣam anuddhṛtya iti evam hi tena vaktavyam anaikāntikaḥ ayam hetuḥ acaure api puruṣa tvasya darśanāt iti evam hi sa doṣaḥ uddhṛtaḥ bhavati evam tu anabhidhāya bhavān api coraḥ puruṣa tvāt iti vadan anujānāti eva para matam atas anaikāntika tve vaktavye tad udbhāvanā anukramam avadhīrya atiprasaṅgam āpādayat nigraha arhaḥ bhavaṣi eva iti vādinaḥ ca anaikāntika hetu prayoge api tad anudbhāvanānna parājayaḥ prativādinaḥ eva hi idam sannikṛṣṭam nigraha sthānam iti

nigraha prāptasya anigrahaḥ paryanuyojya upekṣaṇam paryanuyojyaḥ nāma nigraha upapattyā codanīyaḥ idam te nigraha sthānam upanatam atas nigṛhītaḥ asi iti evam vacanīyaḥ te yaḥ upekṣate na anuyuṅkte sa paryanuyojya upekṣaṇāt nigṛhyate

atra āha kaḥ kasya idam nigraha sthānam āpādayati kim paryanuyojyaḥ uta tad upekṣakaḥ upekṣakaḥ tāvat asya paryanuyojyatām eva na jānāti jānan vā katham enam upekṣeta upekṣya vā kim ātmanaḥ eva nigraha sthānam udbhāvayan evam ācaṣṭām eṣa paryanuyojyaḥ api mayā upekṣitaḥ iti nigṛhītaḥ asmi iti paryanuyojyaḥ api katham ātmīyam avadyam prakāśayet idam me dūṣaṇam tat ca bhavatā na udbhāvitam atas bhavān jitaḥ iti sa khalu evam abhidadhat amedhyam pāṇau nidhāya param kalaṅkayitu kāmaḥ param kalaṅkayan eva ātma kalaṅakam anubhavati eva iti

api ca na idam nigraha sthāna antaram apadiśyate kintva pratibhā eva iti tathā hi yadi tāvat uttara pākṣikaḥ pūrva pākṣikam sādhana ābhāsam avyācakṣāṇam upekṣeta tatra dūṣaṇam na udbhāvayet tad uttara apratipattyā na nigṛhyate na paryanuyojya upekṣaṇena vastutas tu dvayoḥ api tatra jaya parājaya nirdhāraṇam anupapannam ekasya sādhana ābhāsa va ādi tvāt itarasya ca tad uttara apratibhānāt atha pūrva pākṣikaḥ dūṣaṇa ābhāsa vādinam doṣa prāptam uttara pākṣikam na nigṛhṇāti tathā api tasya duruttara apratibhā eva na ca anyatarasya api jayaḥ parājayaḥ vā nirdhāryate ekasya dūṣaṇa ābhāsa va ādi tvāt itarasya ca tadanu dbhāvanāt

atra ucyate na apratibhāyāḥ samyak sādhana viṣaya tvāt samyak sādhane ca prayukte tad uttarasya apratipattiḥ apratibhā bhavati sādhana ābhāse tu prayukte tad ābhāsatānudbhāvanāt paryanuyojya upekṣaṇam bhavati atra tu sādhana ābhāsa vādī paryanuyojyaḥ saḥ upekṣitaḥ tatra samyak sādhana vādī tu aparyanuyojyaḥ eva iti viśeṣaḥ yat tu vastu vṛttena na kasyacid api jayaḥ parājayaḥ vā iti tat evam eva kintu jalpe puruṣa śakti parīkṣāyām idam nigraha sthānam ucyate

tad udbhāvayitā api yat vikalpitaḥ tatra api ucyate pūrva pākṣikeṇa sādhanā bhāse prayukte uttara pākṣikeṇa tasmin tathā tvena anudbhāvite prāśnikānām apṛṣṭānām vaktum avasara abhāvāt saḥ eva sādhana ābhāsa vādī kadācid vaiyātyāt evam brūyāt mayā asya śaktim jijñāsamānena sādhana ābhāsa prayogaḥ kṛtaḥ eṣa tu mūrkhaḥ tam na jānāti iti tadā katham na nigṛhyate etena dūṣaṇa ābhāsava ādī api vyākhyātaḥ athavā ubhaya abhyarthitāḥ sabhā pati niyuktāḥ vā prāśnikāḥ tathā kathayantaḥ nigṛhṇanti eva paryanuyojya upekṣiṇam sādhana ābhāsa vādinaḥ hi dhūrta tayā tad abhidhānam samyak sādhanam ajānataḥ artha saṃśayāt vā saṃbhavati uttara pākṣikasya tu tad anudbhāvanam mohāt eva iti saḥ eva parājīyate

anigraha sthāne nigraha sthāna abhiyogaḥ niranuyojya anuyogaḥ anujjhita yathā ucita kramam upapanna vādinam apramādi nam anigraha aham api nigṛhītaḥ asi iti yaḥ brūyāt saḥ eva abhūta doṣa udbhāvanāt nigṛhyate

atra āha yadi tāvat uttara pākṣikaḥ pūrva pākṣikam aduṣṭa sādhana vādinam abhūtaiḥ eva doṣaiḥ abhiyuṅkte tathā sati bhūta doṣa udbhāvanasya uttarasya apratipatteḥ apratibhayā eva sa nigṛhyatām kim niranuyojya anuyoga ākhya nūtana nigraha sthāna parājīyate bhūta doṣa abhiyoga pakṣe tu pūrva pākṣikaḥ eva sādhana ābhāsa yogāt anuyojyaḥ eva khalu asau na niranuyojya anuyogasya viṣayaḥ bhavitum arhati kathanena

atra ucyate aho nu khalu ayam tapasvī paryudāsasya prasajya pratiṣedhasya ca viśeṣam apaśyan atimātram muhyati bhūta doṣa apratibhānam anyat anyat ca abhūta doṣa pratibhānam ekatra apratipattiḥ itaratra viparīta pratipattiḥ tatra bhūta doṣa apratipattiḥ apratibhā abhūta doṣa pratipattiḥ ananuyojya anuyogaḥ api ca asādhana aṅga vacanam adoṣa udbhāvanam ca yat bhavatā nigraha sthānam ākhyātam tatra kathyate

tatra prasajya pratiṣedhaḥ eva kevalam āśriyamāṇe hetvābhāsāḥ api na nigraha sthāne bhaveyuḥ sādhanaṅgasya anabhidhānam maukyam eva kevalam nigraha sthānam bhavet tasmāt asādhana aṅga vacanam adīṣa udbhāvanam api paryudāsa vyākhyāna arha bhavati eva tatas ca bhūta doṣa anudbhāvanam apratibhā abhuta doṣaḥ dbhāvanam ca niranuyojya anuyogaḥ atha abhūta doṣa udbhāvane api bhūta doṣa apratibhānam asti eva iti tat eva astu nigraha sthānam iti ucyate tarhi mūka tvam eva ekam nigraha sthānam syāt asādhana aṅga vacane api evam vaktum śakya tvāt iti uktam eva

siddhāntam abhyupetya aniyamāt kathā prasaṅgaḥ aprasiddha antaḥ yaḥ kaṃcana prathamam siddhāntam abhyupagamya kathām upakramate tathā pravṛttaḥ ca siṣā dhayiṣita artha samarthana rabhasena dūṣaṇa uddharaṇa śraddhayā vā siddhānta viruddham abhidhatte saḥ apasiddhāntena parājoyate tat yathā sāṃkhyaḥ prativādi sannidhāne na asataḥ vidyate bhāvaḥ na abhāvaḥ vidyate sataḥ

iti sva siddhāntam prathamam pratijñāya pradhāna siddhaye sādhana prayogam karoti vyaktam vikāra jātam eka prakṛti samanvaya darśanāt mṛd anvitāḥ hi mṛd vikārāḥ kuṇḍa piṭhara śarāva prabhṛtayaḥ eka prakṛtikāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ evam asya api gavāśvādi vikāra jātasya sukha duḥkha moha anvaya darśanāt tad ātmaka eka prakṛti prabhava tvena bhavitavyam

evam uktavān asau naiyāyikena anuyujyate atha kā prakṛtiḥ nāma kā ca dikṛtiḥ iti avidita prakṛti vikṛti svarūpaḥ hi katham vikṛtīnām eka prakṛti tvam eka tvam jānīyāt iti evam anuyuktaḥ kāpilaḥ āha yasya avasthitasya dharma antara nivṛttau dharma antaram pravartate sā prakṛtiḥ yat tad dharma antaram pravartate sā vikṛtiḥ iti

saḥ ayam evam vadan prāc abhyupagata sada sannirodha prabhava abhāva siddhānta viruddha abhidhānāt apasiddhāntena nigṛhyate yadi pūrva dharma nirodhe dharma antara prādurbhāvaḥ tadā na asataḥ vidyate bhāvaḥ na abhāvaḥ vidyate sataḥ iti sva siddhāntaḥ hīyete atha siddhāntaḥ na tyajyate tarhi prakṛti vikāra aniścayāt hetu asiddhau sādhya abhāvaḥ prasajyate iti

atra āha hetu prayogam kṛtavati kapile naiyāyikaḥ tad asiddha tā udbhāvanayā pratyavatiṣṭhatām prakṛti vikṛti svarūpa praśnasya kaḥ avasaraḥ tat idam artha antara gamanam asya bhavet evam pṛcchataḥ artha antara gamanam sva granthe nigraha sthānaḥ ucyate atha ca adhunā tena eva vyavahniyate iti kaḥ ayam nayaḥ yadi tu sāṃkhya matam nirācikīrṣitam tat asiddha tā eva hetoḥ udbhāvyatām prakṛti anvayasya vikāreṣu asaṃbhavāt iti vikārāḥ hi pravṛtti nivṛtti dharmakāḥ na ca evaṃprakāram avyaktam avyakta dharma anvaye hi vikārāṇām pravutti nivṛtti ātmaka tvam hīyeta iti evam asiddha tvāt hetoḥ hetvābhāsa prayogāt eva sāṃkhyaḥ nigṛhītaḥ iti na nigraha sthāna antaram apasiddhāntaḥ iti

atra ucyate satyam asiddhaḥ bhavatu ayam kāpila kalpitaḥ hetuḥ prakṛti vikṛti praśna krameṇa api tat asiddha tvam avadhārayitum śakyataḥ eva kintu hetu rūpe avadhārite tat dūṣaṇam abhidhānīyam anavadhāritasya dūṣayitum aśakya tvāt iti tad praśnaḥ na artha antara gamanam praśna uttaram eva bhāṣamāṇaḥ parāmarśe nikaṭatara parisphura dapasiddhānta abhidhāna nibandhana nigraha antara viṣaya tām pratipannaḥ iti hetvābhāsa vartmani na dūram gamyate kvacid api para nigrahasya hetau hṛdaya patham prathamam kila avatīrṇe aparam api na kāraṇam vicintyam kim iva phalam khalu piṣṭapeṣaṇasya

hetvābhāsāḥ ca yathā uktāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ tu pūrva ukta lakṣaṇaiḥ eva lakṣitāḥ nigraha sthāna tām yānti yathā uktā iti atas abravīt pramāṇasya prameya tvam prameyasya pramāṇa tā yathā lakṣaṇa bhedena na tathā eteṣu dṛśyate bhedena uktāḥ kimartham te iti nigaditā pūrvam eva atra yuktiḥ vāde hi ete prayojyāḥ praguṇanaya vidā tattva śuddhim vidhātum eteṣām dharma kīrteḥ api ca na vimatiḥ nigraha sthāna tāyām ittham dvāviṃśatiḥ naḥ gurubhiḥ abhihitāḥ nigraha sthāna bhedāḥ

iti evam sūtra kāra āgamam anusara tā anujjhatā bhāṣya bhūmim sthāne sthāne pareṣām matam atula gati kṣiṇvatā tārkikāṇām kāṃcid vākya artha carcām api viracayatā anukrameṇa avatīrṇā nirṇītaḥ sve nibandhe nipuṇam iha mayā ṣoḍaśā ete padārthāḥ nyāya udgāra gabhīra nirmala girā gaurīpatiḥ toṣitaḥ vāde yena kirīṭinā iva samare devaḥ kirāta ākṛtiḥ prāpta udāra varaḥ tatassa jayati jñāna amṛta prārthanā namra aneka mahā ṛṣi mastaka valat pādaḥ akṣapādaḥ muniḥ vādeṣu ātta jayaḥ jayantaḥ iti yaḥ khyātaḥ satām agraṇīḥ anvarthaḥ nava vṛtti kāraḥ iti yam śaṃsanti nāmnā budhāḥ sūnuḥ vyāpta digantarasya yaśasā candrasya candra tviṣā cakre candra kalā ardha cūḍa caraṇa dhyāyī sa dhanyām kṛtim namaḥ śaśikalā koṭi kalpyamāna aṅkura śriye prapanna jana saṃkalpa kalpavṛkṣāya śambhave

tām muna tattva upaplava siṃhaḥ eṣa viṣamaḥ nūnam mayā na asti tad phalam vā svarga ādi satyam tāvat āttasya karmaṇaḥ sambhā uktam ca parama artha vidbhiḥ api laukikaḥ mārgaḥ anusartavyaḥ a loka vyavahāram prati sadṛśau bāla paṇḍitau ityādi nanu yadi upaplavaḥ tattvānām kim āyā atha atas tattvam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ pṛthivī āpaḥ tejaḥ vāyuḥ iti tattvāni tad samudāye śarīra indriya viṣaya sañjñā ityādi na anyārtha tvāt kimartham pratibimbana artham kim punar atra pratibimbyate pṛthivī ādīni tattvāni loke prasiddhāni tāni api vicāryamāṇāni na vyavatiṣṭhante kim punar anyāni atha katham tāni na santi tat ucyate sat lakṣaṇa nibandhanam māna vyavasthānam māna nibandhanā ca meya sthitiḥ tad abhāve tayoḥ sat vyavahāra viṣaya tvam katham tām atha na ba vyavahāraḥ kriyate tad ātmani rūpa astitva vyavahāraḥ ghaṭa ādau ca sukha astitva vyavahāraḥ pravartayitavyaḥ

a indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam jñānam avyapadeśyam avyabhicāri vyavasāya ātmakam pratyakṣam iti tad lakṣaṇam tat ca avyabhicāri tvam kim aduṣṭa kāraka sandoha utpādya tvena āhosvit bādhā rahita tvena pravṛtti sāmarthyena anyathā vā tat yadi aduṣṭa kāraka sandoha utpādya tvena avyabhicāri tvam sā eva kāraṇānām aduṣṭa tā kena avagamyate

na pratyakṣeṇa nayana kuśala ādeḥ atīndriya tvāt na api anumānena liṅga antara anavagateḥ nanu idam eva jñānam liṅgam tat uttham tasya viśiṣṭa tām gamayati yadi evam itaretara āśraya tvam duruttaram āpanīpadyate kim ca indriyāṇām guṇa doṣa āśraya tve tad utthe vijñāne doṣa āśaṅkā na ativartate puṃvya apāra utpādita śabda vijñānaḥ iva

atha bādhā anutpattyā avyabhicāri tvam jñāyate bādhā anutpattiḥ vijñānasya kim yathārtha gṛhīti tvena āhosvit bādhaka jñāna utpādaka kāraka vaikalyāt iti sandihmaḥ dṛśyate hi bādhaka jñāna utpādaka kāraka vaikalyāt bādhānutpādaḥ yathā dūre marīci nicaye jala jñāne jāte bādhā na sampadyate abhyāsa deśa avasthitasya kāraka upa nipāte sati utpadyate sā ca upajāyamānā saṃvatsara ādi kāla vikalpena san jāyate kadācid ca kāraka vaikalyāt na eva sampadyate na ca etāvatā tasya yathārthatā upapadyate

api ca bādhā virahe eva na bādhā sadbhāvā vedakas tad upalabdha tvena tad sadbhāva upalabdheḥ anyat ca bādhā virahaḥ kim sarva puruṣa apekṣayā āhosvit pratipattṛ apekṣayā tat yadi sarva puruṣa apekṣayā tad virahaḥ api a sarva jñāḥ syuḥ bhavantu nāma sarve sarvajñāḥ kaḥ doṣaḥ asarvajña vyavahāra abhāva prasaṅgaḥ

atha pratipattṛ apekṣayā bādhā anutpādaḥ pratipattuḥ bādhakam vijñānam na utpadyate tena tat avyabhicāri tat ayuktam pratipattuḥ bādhaka jñāna anutpāde api deśa antara gamana maraṇa ādinā maṇi marīci ādi viparyaya jñāna darśanāt atha vā tat viparyaya jñānam tathāvidham eva utpannam sva prabhava svabhāva anupraveśena yat bādhaka vijñāna utpāda pratibandha kṛt tad hvaṃsaḥ api tathābhūtaḥ eva pareṣṭa samyak jñāna vat evam sati yat uktam yasya ca duṣṭam karaṇam yatra ca mithyā iti pratyayaḥ saḥ eva asamīcīnaḥ pratyayaḥ iti etat eva asamīcīnam

atha pravṛtti sāmarthyena avyabhicāritām vetsi pravṛtti sāmarthyam phalena abhisambandhaḥ phalam ca sraj candana vanitodaka ādi teṣu satya phala niṣpatteḥ teṣu phala upacāra s tad deha sambandhaḥ pravṛtti sāmarthyam pravṛttiḥ kāyasthā kriyā tad sāmarthyam avyabhicāritām gamayati tat kim avagatam anavagatam vā yadi na avagatam tat asti iti katham vetsi atha avagatam tad avagateḥ avyabhicāritā katham avagamyate iti pūrva uktam anusartavyam

udaka prāptyā pūrva utpanna udaka vijñānasya avyabhicāritā vyavasthāpyate kim tad pratibhāta udaka prāpti āhosvit tad jātīya udaka prāptyā tad vaṃśa ja jala prāptyā vā tat yadi pratibhāta udaka prāptyā tat ayuktam pratibhāta udakasya avasthānam na upapadyate jhaṣa mahiṣa parivartana abhighāta upajāta avayava kriyā nyāyena pratyasta maya sambhavāt

atha tad jātīya udaka prāptyā evam tarhi asatya udaka jñāne api jāte kvacid toyam āsādayanti pumāṃsaḥ tat api avitatham syāt atha tad deśa kāla saṃlagnam udakam na prāpayati mithyājñānam samyak jñānam tu tad deśa kāla saṃlagnam udakam prāpayati tena tat avyabhicāri iti ced yat na prāpayati tat vyabhicāri tarhi mumūrṣu padārtha utpāditam jñānam candra arka graha nakṣatra tāraka ādi saṃvedanam ca vyabhicāri prāpnoti na ca tad deśa kāla saṃlagna udaka prāpaka tvam asti deśasya api udaka vat vināśa sambhavāt

na ca jāteḥ sambhavaḥ asti saḥ eva katham kathyate sa udaka vyaktibhyaḥ abhinnāḥ bhinnā bhinna abhinnā vā iti tat yadi tādātmya vyavasthitā tadā iha tāsām nānātvena tasyāḥ api nānā tva upapattiḥ tat eka tve ca sarvāsām eka tā āpattiḥ eka tve ca niḥsāmānya tā tādātmya viparyāsaḥ vā atha artha antara bhūtāḥ sā vyāvṛtta ākāra anugata ākārā vā tat yadi vyāvṛtta ākārā na tasyāḥ sāmānya rūpa tvam vyāvṛtta eka svabhāva tvāt toya ādi vat

atha anusyūta rūpā tat kim ātma rūpa anusyūtā para rūpa anusyūtā vā tat yadi ātma rūpa anusyūtā tat ayuktam ātmani anugama abhāvāt atha para rūpa anusyūtā kā iyam para rūpa anusyūta tā kim tad tādātmyam tad samavāyaḥ vā tat yadi tādātmyam sāmānya tadvatoḥ abheda prasaṅgaḥ atha para rūpa samavāyaḥ anusyūta ākāra tā tat ayuktam sāmānyāt bhinnaḥ samavāyaḥ sāmānyasya anugatam rūpam ālocayitum ārabdham na tatas anyasya yadi ca udaka jātīya artha prāptyā avyabhicāritā pūrva udita udaka vijñānasya vyavasthāpyate tadā udaka jāteḥ gavā ādau api sambhavaḥ asti gavā ādi prāptyā avyabhicārita udaka vijñānasya syāt atha udaka tvasya gavā ādau abhāvaḥ iti ced kim itaretarābhāvaḥ prāc abhāvaḥ pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ vā

tat yadi itaretara abhāvaḥ tadā udaka ādau api samānam udaka tvasya abhāva prasaṅgaḥ udaka rūpa tā na udaka tvasya udaka tva rūpa tā ca na udakasya atha prāc abhāvaḥ tadā udake api udaka tvasya abhāva prasaṅgaḥ atha pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ tadā udake api abhāva prasaṅgaḥ atha anyatra asti na ekatra pratyasta mitasya anyatra sambhavaḥ upapadyate atha atyanta abhāvaḥ tadā udake api tasya abhāva prasaṅgaḥ atha sambandha abhāvāt gavā ādau udaka tva abhāvaḥ iti ced tatra api kim itaretarābhāvaḥ prāc abhāvaḥ pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ vā iti pūrvavat vaktavyam nimitta antara abhāvāt gavā ādau udaka tva abhāvaḥ iti ced saḥ atra api samānaḥ

na ca udaka vyaktīnām nānātvam upapādayitum pāryate udakam anudaka ākārāt udaka ākāra tayā vyāvartata udaka ākārāt tu katham vyāvartate kim udaka ākāra tayā āhosvit ākāra antareṇa tat yadi udaka ākāra tayā vyāvartate tadā anyāsām udaka vyaktīnām anudaka ākāra tā prāpnoti rasa ādeḥ iva atha anudaka ākāra tayā udaka ākārāt nivartate tatas dahana ādeḥ iva anudaka tva prasaṅgaḥ

atha udaka ākāra rūpa tā viśeṣe api avāntara gaṇikā ākāra bheda parikḷptiḥ iti ced satyam avāntara gaṇikā ākāraḥ toya tādātmya vyavasthitaḥ atādātmya vyavasthitaḥ vā tat yadi tādātmya vyavasthita s tadā udaka ākāra tayā udaka antarāt bhidyate evam ca anyāsām udaka vyaktīnām anudaka rūpa tā prāpnoti pūrva uditam eva dūṣaṇam

atha ātādātmya vyavasthita s tarhi anudaka tvam rasa ādeḥ iva atha udaka tva vyāvṛttyānudaka ākārāt vyāvartate śṛṇvantu amī bāla lapitam vipaścitaḥ yadi udaka tva vyāvṛttyānudakāt vyāvartate toyam udaka tvam ca udakāt anudakāt ca katham vyāvartate na jāti antaram vyāvartakam asti abhyupagame vāniṣṭha upaplava anubandhaḥ syāt tasmāt svena eva rūpeṇa itara itara ātmanā vyāvartate na jāti ādinā vyāvartate jāti ādeḥ avyāvṛtti prasaṅgāt tasmāt sthitam etat na udaka vyaktīnām nānā tva upapattiḥ tad anupapattau na udaka tvam nāma sāmānyam asti sva tva vat

itas api na vidyate sāmānyam nityasya sataḥ vijñāna janaka tva ayogāt tat eva katham vyutpādyate vijñāna janaka avasthāyām yat eva svarūpam sāmānya ātmakam śaktimat śakti rūpam ca kāraka antara anapekṣayā ajanaka avasthāyām tat eva rūpam atas pūrvam api kārya utpāda prasaṅgaḥ anutpāde vā prāk iva idānīm api na janayet atha kāraka antaram apekṣya utpādayati kāryam kim tena kāraka antareṇa tasya kriyate kāraka tvam jñāpyate vā

tat yadi utpādyate su sthitam nitya tvam uta jñāpyate siddham tarhi kāraka tvam tad abhāve api vidyamānasya avat yotanāt bhavatu nāma kāraka tvam kaḥ doṣaḥ kārya utpatti prasaṅgaḥ atha kāraka tve api kāryam na janayet aho rājā ājñā garīyasī naiyāyika paśoḥ itas api na asti sāmānyam tad upapādaka māna vyatirekāt nanu asti pramāṇam anayoḥ sādṛśyam eṣām sārūpyam tena sadṛśaḥ ayam asau vā tena sadṛśaḥ ityādi jñānam sāmānya satta avabodhakam apratipanna sāmānyasya na upapadyate asti tu idam vijñānam bādhā vikalam jāti tanu vyavasthāpakam tat etat ayuktam kim nimitta bhūtena tena evaṃvidham jñānam utpādyate karma tā āpannena vā

tat yadi nimitta bhūtena utpādyate tadā na sāmānyam kalpanīyam asāmānya ātmakam eva nimittam ittham bhūta sāmānya jñāna utpādanāya alam sāmānya kalpanayā atha karma tā āpannena utpādyate tat asat na eva avabhāti vijñāne sāmānyam dhūrtaiḥ aviparyāsita saṃvidām nanu sādṛśyam avabhāti satyam avabhāti na apahnūyate api tu dravya guṇa karma ātmakam sat pācaka ādi bhedeṣu yathā eṣām pācaka tvam ete pācakāḥ tad pācaka sadṛśaḥ ayam asau anena sadṛśaḥ iti viśeṣa ādau api draṣṭavyam atra api sāmānya parijñaptiḥ iti ced

na sūtra vyāghātāt sāmānya viśeṣeṣu sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvāt tatas eva jñānam aniṣṭhā ca viśeṣeṣu sāmānye parikalpyamāne sati sandehaḥ sati sandehe teṣu viśeṣa antaram parikalpanīyam punar sāmānyam iti aniṣṭhā iti alam asat graha abhiniveśena atha bhinna abhinnam sāmānyam bhavadbhiḥ pratipādyata ākāra bhedena vyaktibhyaḥ upalabhyate iti artha antaram deśa bhedena tu na eva upalabhyate iti avyatiriktam tat etat mahā subhāṣitam na deśa bhedena eva vastūnām bhedaḥ api tu ākāra bhedena eva bhāvāḥ bhedam upayānti yathā ca ākāra bhedaḥ na asti tathā anantaram eva niveditam

sāmānyam samavāya vṛttyā vyaktiṣu vartate iti na ca asau vidyate samavāyaḥ hi vyāvṛtta eka svabhāvaḥ anugata eka svabhāvaḥ vā tat yadi vyāvṛtta eka svabhāvaḥ kasya asau samavāyaḥ sarvatas vyāvṛtteḥ nīla ādi vat atha anugata eka svabhāvaḥ sāmānyam tarhi na samavāyaḥ nityasya sataḥ anekatra vṛtteḥ go tva ādi vat

upapādaka pramāṇa abhāvāt ca nanu pratyakṣa buddhi avaseyaḥ asau tat ayuktam kim sambandha buddhyā adhyavasīyate āhosvit ihabuddhyā samavāya buddhyā vā ucyate tat yadi sambandha buddhyā kaḥ ayam sambandhaḥ kim sambandha jāti yuktaḥ sambandhaḥ āhosvit aneka upādāna janitaḥ aneka āśritaḥ vā sambandha buddhi viśeṣaḥ vā sambandha buddhi utpādakaḥ vā sambandha ākāraḥ vā

tat yadi sambandha jāti yuktaḥ te sambandhaḥ saḥ anupapannaḥ samavāya asambandha tva prasaṅgaḥ atha aneka upādāna janitaḥ sambandha s tadā kumbha ādeḥ api sambandha tva prasaṅgaḥ atha aneka āśritaḥ sambandha s tadā ghaṭa jāti ādeḥ sambandha tvam prasajyate atha sambandha buddhi utpādakaḥ te sambandhaḥ ucyate tadā locana ādeḥ api sambandha tva prasaṅgaḥ atha sambandha buddhi avaseyaḥ sambandhaḥ abhidhīyate tadā kauleyaka kari kumāra ādiṣu api sambandha śabda vyutpādane sambandha tva prasaṅgaḥ sambandha itarayoḥ eka vijñāna viṣaya tvaḥ itarasya sambandha rūpa tā prāptā

atha sambandha ākāraḥ sambandhaḥ saṃyoga abheda prasaṅgaḥ avāntara gaṇikā ākāraḥ tu yathā na bhedakaḥ tathā purastāt uktam eva dūṣaṇam atha iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iti ihabuddhyā adhyavasīyate na iha buddheḥ adhikaraṇa saṃvid rūpa tvāt na ca anyasmin ākāre pratīyamāne anyat parikalpayitum nyāyyam atiprasaṅgāt atha samavāya buddhi ātmasāt kriyate saḥ api anupapannaḥ eva samavāya buddheḥ anupapatteḥ ayam tantuḥ ayam paṭaḥ ayam anayoḥ samavāyaḥ iti na jātu jānate janāḥ

atha anumānena anumīyate dve anumāne dṛṣṭam sāmānyatas dṛṣṭam ca na dṛṣṭam pratyakṣa vyatirekāt sāmānyatas dṛṣṭam api na asti tad prabhava kārya anupalabdheḥ nanu ihabuddhiḥ eva samavāyajñāpikā iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iti pratyayaḥ sambandha nimittaḥ abādhita iha pratyaya tvāt iha kuṇḍe dadhi iti pratyaya vat kim anena anumīyate kim nimitta mātram uta sambandhaḥ

yadi nimitta mātram tatas siddha sādhya tayā sambodhayitavyaḥ atha sambandhaḥ saṃyogaḥ samavāyaḥ vā saṃyoga anumānaḥ upagama hāniḥ samavāya anumāne sambandha vyatirekaḥ na ca anyasya sambandhe anyasya gamaka tvam atiprasaṅgāt na jātu deva datta nayana kuṭa sambandhe yajñadatta indriyam rūpa ādikam artham karaṇa tva sāmyāt prakāśayat dṛṣṭam evam sati sāmānya samavāya virahe katham dravya ādi vyavasthā iti cintyate

atha tad vaṃśa ja jala prāptyā avyabhicāritā jñāyate tat ayuktam antya avaya vidravyāṇām janakatva vyatirekāt na ca udaka vyaktīnām nānātvam asti yathā ca na vidyate tathā niveditam purastāt kim ca pravṛtti sāmarthyena avyabhicāritā pūrva udita jñānasya jñāpyate kim liṅga bhūtena aho adhyakṣa ātmakena tat yadi liṅga bhūtena tat ayuktam tena sākam sambandha anavagateḥ avagatau vālam pravṛtti sāmarthyena

atha adhyakṣa ātmakena tat ayuktam pūrva udita pratyasta mitena sākam sannikarṣa abhāvāt tad viṣaya vijñānam na pratyakṣa phalam nirālambana tvāt keśoṇḍuka ādi saṃvedana vat na vijñānasya abhāvaḥ avabhāti na bhāvaḥ tad abhāvāt avidyamānasya viṣaya arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ kim ākāra arpaka tvena vā mahat tva ādi dharma upeta tvena vā sattā mātreṇa vā saha utpādena vā sarvasya pratyasta mita tvāt katham asau viṣayaḥ tad viṣaya tve keśoṇḍuka ādi vijñānasya eva mithyātve bījam anveṣaṇīyam ātma sattā mātreṇa mithyātve sarvasya mithyātvam āpadyate tatas tattva upaplavaḥ syāt

atha anyathā avyabhicāri tvam gṛhyata ātma antaḥkaraṇa sambandhena utpannam vijñānam avyabhicārita aviśiṣṭam pradyotyate tat ayuktam tat avyabhicāri tvam tad dharmaḥ vā tad svarūpam vā tat yadi tad dharmaḥ sa nityaḥ anityaḥ vā yadi nitya s tadā jāti doṣeṇa āpoditaḥ veditavyaḥ atha anityaḥ sa pūrva utpannaḥ saha paścāt vā jātaḥ tat yadi pūrva utpanna s tadā kasya asau dharmaḥ na hi dharmiṇam antareṇa dharmaḥ bhavitum arhati sarvatas vyāvṛtta rūpa tvāt kaḥ kasya iti vaktavyam atha saha utpannaḥ kaḥ tayoḥ sambandhaḥ iti vaktavyam tādātmya tad utpatti samavāya sambandha abhāve sati ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ tasya avyabhicāri tvam iti

atha pṛṣṭha utpannaḥ tarhi pūrvam vyabhicāritā vijñānasya prāpnoti na ca ādhyātmikaḥ avyabhicāri rūpaḥ dharmaḥ asti sukha ādi vyatirikta s tad pratītya sambhavena svayam anabhyupagamāt yadi ca avyabhicāra ādayaḥ dharmāḥ artha antara bhūtāḥ abhyupagamyante taiḥ avacchinnam vijñānam sāmagryāḥ avasthāpakam udghuṣyate tat ca anupapannam pratyekam aneka viśeṣaṇa avacchinna vijñāna pratipatti kāla avasthāna ayogāt jñāpyajñāpakayoḥ abhāve kartṛ mātra prabandhi jñānam syāt

atha tad svarūpam avyabhicāri tvam tat kim sva sattā mātra anurodhena artha antara satta anurodhena vā tat yadi jñāna sattā mātra tā eva avyabhicāri tvam ucyate tadā keśoṇḍuka saṃvidaḥ api avyabhicāritā syāt na ca jñāna sattā mātra anurodhena jñānam vyabhicārī avyabhicāri vā udgīyate atha artha antara satta anurodhena avyabhicāri tvam kim anupakāraka artha antara satta anurodhena āhosvit upakāraka artha antara satta anurodhena

tat yadi tāvat anupakāraka artha antara satta anurodhena tadā keśoṇḍuka indu dvaya saṃvidaḥ api avyabhicārita aprasaṅgaḥ atha upakāraka artha antara sattā anurodhena avyabhicāritā kim pratīyamāna artha antara upakāraka satta anurodhena tad viparīta artha antara upakāraka satta anurodhena vā tat yadi pūrva pakṣa abhyupagamas tadā atīta anāgata anumāna vijñānasya yogi pratyakṣasya ca codanā vacana janita vijñānasya vā avyabhicāritā na bhavet tad avagata upakāraka artha abhāvāt bhāve vā vitāna kriyā ālopa prasaṅgaḥ

atha uttaraḥ matas tadā keśoṇḍuka indu dvaya saṃvidaḥ avyabhicāri tvam prasajyate iti asat gṛhītam kim ca tat vijñānam avyabhicāri avagatam sāmagryāḥ jñāpakam anavagatam vā yadi avagatam tasya avagatiḥ ātma saṃvid rūpā vā jñāna antara vedyā vā tat yadi ātma saṃvedana rūpa avagati s tat ayuktam svayam anabhyupagamāt abhyupagame vā upagama virodhaḥ atha jñāna antara vedyam vetsi vijñānayoḥ bhede bījam anveṣṭavyam jñānam ajñāna ākārāt jñāna ātma tayā vyāvartate jñāna antarāt tu katham vyāvartate kim jñāna ātma tayā vyāvartate āhosvit ākāra antareṇa tat yadi jñāna ātma tayā vyāvartate tadā anyasya jñāna ātma tā nivartate toya ādeḥ yathā

atha ākāra antareṇa ākāra antara svīkaraṇe jñāna ākāra virahaḥ syāt ākārayoḥ tādātmya ayogāt tādātmye vā ekam tat vastu jñānam ajñānam vā yadi jñānam na tarhi ākāra antareṇa vyāvartate kim tu jñāna ātma tayā eva anyasya ajñāna ātmaka tva prasaṅgaḥ atha ajñānam siddham naḥ samīhitam atha jñāna tvam vyāvartakam tat kena vyāvartate iti pūrva uktam anusartavyam vijñāna antara vedyam api na sambhavati atha na vedyate tat asti iti katham punar vetsi anena eva vartmanā satyetara vijñānayoḥ vibhāga abhāvaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ atas avyabhicāri padam apārthakam

itas api apārthakam indriya artha sannikarṣa padena āpodita tvāt na hi keśoṇḍuka vijñānasya nayana artha sannikarṣa udbhūtiḥ asti nanu asti marīci udaka vijñānasya tad apanodāya avi abhicāri padam tat na yatas udakam pratibhāti na ca tena saha sambandhaḥ asti vidyamānena sākam sambadhyate na avidyamānena tad sambandhe vā na tad viṣaya jñānasya mithyātvam iha upapadyate satya udaka saṃvedana vat nanu yadi api pratīyamāna udakena saha sambandhaḥ na asti cakṣuṣaḥ tathā api ālambya marīci nicayena sākam sambandhaḥ asti tasya eva ālambana tvāt tad deśam prati pravṛtteḥ atas eva mithyātvam anyat ālambanam anyat ca pratibhāti

kaḥ ayam ālambana arthaḥ nāma yena idam udghuṣyate anyat ālambanam ca anyat pratibhāti kim vijñāna janaka tvam ākāra arpaka tvam vijñāna adhikaraṇa tvam vijñāna avabhāsita tā vā tat yadi vijñāna janaka tvam ālambana artha s tadā nayana āloka ādeḥ api ālambana tvam prasajyate atha ākāra arpaka tvam ālambana tvam tat ayuktam naiyāyika samaye anabhyupagamāt yathā ca viṣaya ākāraḥ vijñāne na yujyate tathā upariṣṭāt pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ atha vijñāna adhikaraṇa tvam ālambana tvam na marīci cakra utkalitam udīyate jñānam api tu ātma samavetam ātmānam āsādayate atha vijñāna avabhāsita tā ālambana tvam tadā udaka vijñānaḥ udakam pratīyate na marīcayaḥ atha udaka ākāra tayā marīcayaḥ eva pratīyante saḥ udaka ākāraḥ marīcibhyaḥ vyatiriktaḥ avyatiriktaḥ vā

tat yadi avyatiriktaḥ sa tāttvikaḥ atāttvikaḥ vā yadi tāttvikaḥ katham tad avagateḥ mithyātvam atha atāttvikaḥ tadā marīcīnām api atāt tvika tvam prasajyate atāttvika udaka tādātmye sati tat udaka jñānam atathyam kim uktam bhavati marīci vijñānam atathyam ekasmin ca udaka ākāre pratīyamāne kena etat ākhyātam marīcayaḥ pratibhānti devānām priyasya

atha artha antara bhūta s tarhi na vaktavyam marīcaye udaka ākāra tayā pratīyanta udaka ākāra antaritāḥ marīcayaḥ atha keśoṇḍuka vijñāne kim avabhāti kim ālambate keśoṇḍukasya eva ālambana tvam pratīyamāna tvam ca tathā udakasya eva ālambana tvam pratīyamāna tvam ca na ālambana antaram parikalpyam na ca udaka jñānasya pratīyamāna udakāni ālambana tvena mithyātvam api tu abhāvāt tāttvika tvena anyathā keśoṇḍuka saṃvidaḥ api mithyātvam na prāpnoti anya ālambana vyatirekāt

yat api uktam marīci deśam prati gamanāt marīcīnām ālambana tvam yadi evam deśasya api ālambana tvam anayā rītyā upapadyate na ca avabhāta udaka bhinna artha sannikarṣa ja tvam udaka vijñānasya upapadyate satya udaka jñāne adṛṣṭa tvāt anyathā anumeya dahana jñānasya api indriya artha sannikarṣa ja tvam āpanīpadyeta ātma manaḥ sannikarṣa ja tvāt atha pratīyamāna dahanena saha manasaḥ na asti sambandha s tat iha api pratīyamānena ambhasā saha na asti sambandhaḥ cakṣuṣaḥ tasmāt avyabhicāri padam na yuktam indriya artha sannikarṣa padena āpodita tvāt

itas api anupapannam apohya jñāna asambhavāt atha marīci udaka vijñāna apaninīṣayā upādīyate tat katham apanīyate avidyamāna udaka viṣaya tvāt yadi avidyamānam kaḥ ayam viṣaya arthaḥ pūrva uditam anusaraṇīyam yadi tatra udakam pratibhāti katham na asti satyam pratibhāti kim tu atathyam pratibhāti atathyatā kā kim pratīyamānasya abhāvaḥ uta pratīyamānaḥ eva abhāvaḥ tat yadi pratīyamānasya abhāvaḥ sa kim tadā eva āhosvit kāla antareṇa yadi tadā eva sa kim avagataḥ anavagataḥ vā yadi avagataḥ sa kena avagamyate kim udaka vijñānena jñāna antareṇa vā

tat yadi udaka jñānena tat na tasya udaka viṣaya tvāt tad viṣaya tve vā na tarhi udaka jñānam bhrāntam iti upapadyate abhāva viṣayasya parama artha sattvāt na ca udaka ākāra avagāhini vijñāne toya vinivṛttayaḥ avabhānti atiprasaṅgāt atha jñāna antareṇa na jñāna yaugapadyā sambhavāt yadi ca abhāva jñānena abhāva vyavasthā kriyate bhāva jñānena ca bhāva vyavasthā tadā udakasya bhāva abhāvau eka kālau syātām atha bhāva jñānam bhāva vyavasthām na karoti abhāva jñānam ca abhāva vyavasthām karoti aho rāja ājñā naiyāyikapaśoḥ yadi ca bhāva jñānam bhāva vyavasthām na karoti tadā sarva bhāveṣu anāśvāsa prasaṅgaḥ tad prasaktau abhāvasya api anavasthitiḥ tad anavasthitau ca tattva upaplavaḥ syāt atha anavagataḥ saḥ asti iti katham punar vetsi

atha kāla antare tadā na kiñcid bādhyate satya udakasya api kāla antare abhāva upapatteḥ atha pratīyamānaḥ eva abhāvaḥ katham tad viṣaya jñānasya mithyātvam upapadyate pratīyamānasya eva abhāvasya upapatteḥ na ca bhāva ākāre pratīyamane abhāva kalpanā nyāyyā ati prasaṅgāt anyathā rūpa ādau pratīyamāne rasa ādi kalpanā kartavyā na ca kriyate tathā iha api udakam pratīyate nanu pratīyate kim tu atathyam yadi evam udaka prapañcaḥ ayam dīrgha udakam madhura udakam iti yathā nanu atra sarvāsu avasthā sūdakam pratīyate tena tāsu ambhaḥ prakalpyate yadi evam tat iha api avasthā dvaye api udakam pratīyate satya udakam asatya udakam ca satya udaka jñāne satya udakam avabhāti nāsatya udakam anudakam vā tathā asatya udaka jñāne asatya udakam pratibhāti na satya udakam anudakam vā sva viṣaya paryavasāyinyaḥ hi buddhayaḥ

atha bādhyamāna tvena mithyātvam iti ced kim bādhyate arthaḥ jñānam ubhayam vā yadi arthasya bādhā sa kena bādhyate kim svayam eva ātmānam bādhataḥ āho artha antareṇa jñānena vā yadi svayam eva ātmānam bādhate tadā bādhā tena kriyate jñāpyate vā yadi kriyate avyatiriktā vyatiriktā vā yadi avyatiriktā tadā bādhā kriyate iti ātmā anena utpādyate tat ca na jāghaṭī iti sva ātmani kriyā virodhāt atha vyatiriktā kriyate tathā api vidyamānasya kartṛ tvam na pratīyamānasya apalāpaḥ atha bādhā jñāpyate sā api abhinnāḥ bhinnā vā yadi abhinnā tadā bādhā tena jñāpyate kim uktam bhavati udakam jñāpyate atha bhinnā tadā vidyamānasya jñāpaka tvam siddham pratīyamānasya ca astitvam

atha artha antareṇa bādhyate tathā api vidyamānayoḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ bhūpālayoḥ iva na ca ekasya bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ upapadyate bādhā api tena pratīyamānasya kim kriyate jñāpyate vā yadi kriyate avyatiriktā vyatiriktā vā yadi avyatiriktā tadā avyatiriktā bādha utpādyate kim uktam bhavet udakam utpādyate tad utpādane ca tad saṃvidaḥ amithyā tvam atha vyatirikta utpādyate tathā api toya sambandhi tayā upalabdheḥ ambhasaḥ upapattiḥ na jātu devadattasya asattve tad nayana vyavahāra siddhiḥ atha jñāpyate tadā sa avyatiriktā vyatiriktā vā yadi avyatiriktā jñāpyate tadā bādhā tena jñāpyate kim uktam bhavati udakam jñāpyate atha vyatiriktā satī jñāpyate tathā api udakasya iyam bādhā iti anya tantra tayā pratibhāsanāt na atyanta abhāva upapattiḥ tasmāt artha antareṇa api na bādha upapattiḥ

atha jñānena bādhyate kim tad viṣayeṇa anya viṣayeṇa nirviṣayeṇa vā yadi tad viṣayeṇa tadā tat svarūpam vidhatte na tu viparyāsayati tad ākāra paryavasita rūpa tvāt atha anya viṣayam bādhakam tat api na yujyate yat yat viṣayam tat tasya eva sattām vidhatte na tu anyasya vidhāyakam pratiṣedhakam vā sva viṣaya paryavasāyinyaḥ hi buddhayaḥ atha nirviṣayeṇa bādhyate na kiñcid vidadhāti pratiṣedhati vā nirviṣaya tvāt eva

atha jñānam bādhyate tasya api bādhā kā kim sva rūpa vyāvṛtti rūpā svarūpa apahnava rūpāḥ vā viṣaya apahāra lakṣaṇā vā tat yadi sva rūpa vyāvṛtti rūpā bādhā tadā sarvam bādhitam syāt vijñānasya vijñāna antareṇa nivartyamāna tvāt atha svarūpa apahnava rūpā tat ayuktam mithyā udaka vijñānasya api anubhūyamāna tvāt atha viṣaya apahāra lakṣaṇā bādhā ucyate sā api na yuktā yathā ca viṣaya apahāraḥ na śakyate kartum tathā ana antaram eva niveditam yadi na bādhyate kim iti asau artha kriyām na karoti bhāvaḥ kā iyam artha kriyā yā tena na sampādyate puṃsām kim vijñāna rūpā pravṛtti rūpā prāpti rūpā sukha duḥkha utpāda bhoga rūpā vā

tat yadi vijñāna lakṣaṇām na karoti tat ayuktam vijñāna lakṣaṇām artha kriyām karoti eva toyam atha pravṛtti rūpām na karoti tat ayuktam pravṛttiḥ hi puruṣa icchā anuvidhāyinī na artha svarūpa bhāva abhāvau anugamayati puruṣaḥ hi kāmataḥ pravartate vā na vā na hi etāvatā tad abhāva siddhiḥ atha prāpti rūpām artha kriyām na karoti tena asattvam tat api ayuktam candra arka graha nakṣatra tāraka ādeḥ prāpti abhāve api sattva sambhavāt atha sukha duḥkha rūpām artha kriyām na karoti kim darśana jam sukham na karoti āho deha sambandha jam

tat yadi darśana jam na karoti tat ayuktam karoti eva atha deha sambandha jam na karoti tadā candra arka graha nakṣatra ādau vyabhicāra s teṣām deha sambandha ja sukha janaka tvam na asti atha ca sattvam na ca artha kriyā kartṛ tvena vastūnām asattvam sva hetoḥ eva vijñāna janana mātrasya utpatteḥ sahakāri virahāt vā na karoti kim ca artha kriyām na karoti kim ekasya pratipattuḥ sarva pratipattṝṇām vā

tat yadi ekasya pratipattuḥ artha kriyām na karoti tena asattvam tadā candra arka graha nakṣatra tāraka ādau vyabhicāraḥ mumūrṣu arthe ca atha sarva pratipattṝṇām artha kriyām na karoti tena asattvam evam tarhi sarva bhāvānām asattva prasaṅgaḥ na hi sarve bhāvāḥ sarva puruṣa artha hetavaḥ na ca sarva puruṣa artha kriyā vihīnam etat iti avagantum pāryate arvāk vidā tasmāt sthitam etat avyabhicāri padam anarthakam

anye tu marīci udaka vijñānasya smṛti tvam pratipadyante na bhrānti rūpa tām tasya katham smṛti tvam kim udaka gṛhīti tvena gṛhīta udaka gṛhīti tvena vā udaka grahaṇa anantara kāla bhāvi tvena vā nirviṣaya tvena vā yam aham adrākṣam iti anena ākāreṇa upajāyamāna tvena vā tat yadi udaka gṛhīti tvena tadā sarva udaka vijñānānām smṛti tva prasaṅgaḥ atha gṛhīta udaka gṛhīti tvena smṛti tvam tad ādyasya api gṛhīta udaka gṛhīti tve smṛti tvam prasajyate gṛhīta udaka grāhi tvā viśeṣāt

atha ādyasya gṛhīta udaka grāhi tvam na asti tadānīm bhinna viṣaya tvam bhinna viṣaya tve ca dvitīyasya api gṛhīta grāhi tvam vihīyate atha eka viṣaya tvam āyātam tarhi prathamasya api gṛhīta grāhi tvam aviśiṣṭa artha gṛhīti rūpa tvāt prathama uttara vijñāna vat yathā eka nīla sva lakṣaṇa grāhaka yugapad utpanna aneka vijñānānām nīla jñāna rūpa tā na bhidyate tathā iha api tathā dhārāvāhi vijñānānām smṛti rūpa tā prāpnoti tathā pratyabhijñānasya ca gṛhīta grāhi tvena smṛti tvam prasajyate atha pratyabhijñānasya gṛhīta artha grāhi tvam na vidyate tadā pratyabhijñāna tvam nivartate na hi ādyam darśanam saḥ eva ayam iti upajāyate tathā anumānikam api vijñānam gṛhīta artha grāhi tvena smṛti tvam āpadyate

atha udaka grahaṇa uttara kāla bhāvi tvena smṛti tvam tadā saṃskārasya smaraṇa rūpa tā prāpnoti udaka grahaṇa uttara kāla bhāvi tvena rasa saṃvedanasya ca atha nirviṣaya tvena smṛti rūpatā ucyate tat ayuktam pūrva udita anubhava āvedita artha ākāra āvedaka tvena udīyamānāyāḥ katham nirviṣaya tvam atha pūrva anubhūta artha pratyasta maye sati samāna kāla artha abhāvāt nirviṣayatā tadā codanā janita vijñānasya nirviṣaya tvena smṛti tvam āpanīpadyate kartavya tā rūpa arthasya tadā abhāvāt bhāve vā kartavya rūpa tā na upapadyate tad anupapattau sapta tantu kriyāyāḥ vilopa prasaṅgaḥ yadi ca nirviṣaya tvena smṛti tvam tadā vidyamāna ghaṭa jāti ādeḥ smaraṇasya asmṛti tva prasaṅgaḥ atha adrākṣam iti anena ākāreṇa upajāyamāna tvena smṛti tvam tat ayuktam iha udakam iti anena ākāreṇa upajāyamānāyāḥ katham adrākṣam iti evaṃrūpatā upapadyate

atha vipramuṣita tayā anayā bhaṅgyā upajāyate kaḥ ayam vipramoṣaḥ nāma kim anubhava ākāra svīkaraṇam smaraṇa ākāra pradhvaṃsaḥ vā apūrva artha gṛhīti tvam vā indriya artha sannikarṣa ja tvam vā indriya artha āsat nikarṣa ja tvam vā tat yadi anubhava ākāra svīkaraṇam tadā smṛti rūpa tā na upapadyate atha smṛti rūpa tā tadā anubhava ākāra svīkaraṇam na upapadyate smṛti anubhava ākārayoḥ itaretara parihāra sthiti lakṣaṇa tvāt atha smaraṇa ākāra pradhvaṃsas tat ayuktam vijñānasya svayam smṛti tvena abhyupagamāt pradhvaṃsaḥ hi avijñāna ātmakaḥ katham smṛti rūpa tām vidhatte

atha apūrva artha viṣaya gṛhīti tvam smṛti pramoṣaḥ ucyate tadā atyantān anubhūta kanaka panasa ādi saṃvittīnām smṛti vipra moṣa tvam āpadyate atha indriya artha sannikarṣa ja tvam smṛti vipra moṣaḥ ucyate tadā saṃvittīnām smṛti vipramoṣa tva prasaṅgaḥ atha indriya āsannikarṣa ja tvam smṛti vipra moṣaḥ ucyate tadā codanā janita vijñānasya anumāna upamāna vijñānasya ca smṛti vipra moṣa tvam āpadyate tasmāt yathā yathā vicāryate smṛti vipramoṣaḥ tathā tathā nyāyam na viṣahataḥ iti tasmāt marīci udaka vijñānasya na smṛti vipra moṣa rūpa tā api tu viparīta khyāti tvam samyak jñāna tvam vā

tathā vyavasāya ātmaka padam api na upādeyam apaneya abhāvāt nanu sthāṇu ādike arthaḥ indriya artha sannikarṣāt sāmānya mātra darśanāt viśeṣa anupalabdhau sandeha jñānam upajāyate tat apanīyate tasmin sandeha jñāne jāte kiñcid pratibhāti āho na pratibhāti tat yadi pratibhāti sa kim dharmī dharmaḥ vā tat yadi dharmī pratibhāti sa tāttvikaḥ atāttvikaḥ vā

yadi tāttvikaḥ na apaneya tā tad viṣaya vijñānasya atha atāttvikaḥ tadā avyabhicāri padena apanīta tvāt na vyavasāya ātmaka padam upādeyam atha dharmaḥ pratibhāti sa sthāṇu tva lakṣaṇaḥ puruṣa tva lakṣaṇaḥ ubhayam vā tat yadi sthāṇu tva lakṣaṇaḥ dharmaḥ pratibhāti sa tāttvikaḥ atāttvikaḥ vā yadi tāttvikaḥ katham tad buddheḥ sandeha rūpa tā tāttvika artha gṛhīti rūpa tvena satya udaka saṃvedana vat atha atāttvikaḥ tadā avyabhicāri padena āpodita tvāt na vyavasāya ātmaka padam upādeyam atha puruṣa tva lakṣaṇaḥ dharmaḥ pratibhāti asau api tāttvikaḥ atāttvikaḥ vā yadi tāttvikaḥ katham tad buddheḥ sandeha rūpa tā atha atāttvikaḥ tadā avyabhicāri padena āpodita tvāt vyavasāya ātmaka padam na sādhīyaḥ

atha ubhayam pratibhāti tadā ubhayoḥ tāttvika tvam atāt tvika tvam vā atha ekasya tāttvika tvam anyasya atāt tvika tvam tat yadi ubhayoḥ tāttvika tvam tada tad vijñānasya tāttvika tvam eva na sandeha ātma tā atha ubhau api atāttvikau tadā tad vijñānasya viparyaya rūpa tā na sandeha ātma tā atha ekasya tāttvika tvam anyasya atāt tvika tvam tadā tat eva jñānam vyabhicāri tat eva avyabhicāri atāt tvika artha gṛhīti rūpa tvāt vyabhicāri tāttvika artha gṛhīti rūpa tvāt avyabhicāri etena dvi candra jñānam udghāṭitam tatra hi dravya ākāraḥ pratibhāti na guṇa ākāraḥ atha sandigdha artha ākāra pratibhāsi sandeha jñānam iti ced sa sandigdhaḥ arthaḥ vidyate vā na vā

tat yadi vidyate katham tad saṃvedanasya sandeha rūpa tā ābādhita artha gṛhīti rūpa tvāt satya udaka saṃvedana vat atha na vidyate tadā avyabhicāri padena āpodita tvāt vyavasāya ātmaka padam apārthakam atha na kiñcid api pratibhāti na tarhi tasya indriya artha sannikarṣa ja tvam bhrānta udaka vijñāna vat tasmāt vyavasāya ātmaka padam api anupādeyam

avyapadeśya padam ca yathā na sādhīyaḥ tathā lakṣaṇa sāre draṣṭavyam tathā indriya artha sannikarṣa ja tvam api na upapadyate tad gati abhāvāt indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ hi vyavahita artha anupalabdhi liṅgaḥ vā āvaraṇa liṅgaḥ vā tad utpādita ghaṭa ādi jñāna avaseyaḥ vā tat yadi vyavahita artha anupalabdhi liṅga s tat ayuktam tena saha sambandha anupapatteḥ tad abhāve api anupalambha sadbhāva darśanāt yad abhāve api yasya sadbhāvaḥ sa katham tad sadbhāvā vedakaḥ

atha āvaraṇa liṅga s tat ayuktam tena saha saṅgateḥ abhāvāt tad abhāve api sadbhāva darśanāt tad bhāve vā āvaraṇa ānarthakyam tad abhāve tad gatiḥ katham atha tad bhava kumbha ādi jñānena avagamyate tat ayuktam tad anavagatau tad udbhava tvasya anavagateḥ piśāca paramāṇu maheśvara kalpaḥ asau sannikarṣaḥ katham tat āyatta tā vedyate jñāne katham ca tad indriya artha sannikarṣam āvedayati jñānam kim vijñāna ākāra tayā aho kārya akāra tayā indriya artha sannikarṣa janya ākāra tayā vā

tat yadi jñāna svabhāvatayā tat ayuktam tad abhāve api jñāna ākārasya sambhavaḥ upamāna ādi jñāne atha kārya ātma tayā gamayati tat api ayuktam upamāna anumāna jñāna marīci nīla jala ādau tasya sadbhāva upapatteḥ yaḥ yena vinā bhavati sa katham tasya jñāpakaḥ nāma anyathā sattva ādeḥ api gamaka tvam syāt atha indriya artha sannikarṣa janya ākāra tayā saṃsūcayati iti ced asau indriya artha sannikarṣa janya ākāraḥ jñāna ākārāt avyatiriktaḥ vyatiriktaḥ vā yadi avyatirikta s tadā jñāna ātma tā mātram nākāra atirekaḥ anyaḥ asti vibhāvyamānaḥ anumāna ādi jñāneṣu yathā ākāra antara atireke vā jñāna rūpa tā hīyate atha vyatirikta s tasya eva tarhi gamaka tvam na jñāna ākārasya tasya api agamaka tvam tad avedanāt

kim ca tad utpannam indriya artha sannikarṣāt vijñānam svarūpeṇa avagāhanīyam tatas vyāpti smaraṇam tadanu parāmarśa jñānam tatas anumeya avagatiḥ iti na ca etāvantam kālam vijñānam sthiti padam badhnāti āśu bhāvi tvena pratyasta mita tvāt atha buddhi ārūḍhena dharma dharmi nyāyena parikalpyate anumānam tadauvāstavam prāpnoti sugata anumāna vat

tathā indriya utpādya tvam api na upapadyate indriya utpādya tva atireka anavagateḥ vijñānam svabhāva tayā eva vedyate na ākāra antareṇa tad jñaptau vā jñāna ākāra viraha prasaṅgaḥ na ca jñānam indriya sambaddham dṛṣṭam yena tat upalabhyamānam indriyam gamayati atha kriyā anyatra karaṇa sādhyā dṛṣṭā sā eva gamikāḥ tu yasyāḥ karaṇa sambandhaḥ avagataḥ na ca anyasya sambandhe anyasya gamaka tvam kiñcid sāmyāt upapadyate na jātu devadatta nayana nīla sambandhe sati yajñadatta indriyam ghaṭa ādikam artham asati sambandhe karaṇa tva sāmyāt prakāśayat dṛṣṭam

tathā artha janyā kāraḥ api vijñāne anena eva prakāreṇa paryudastaḥ veditavyaḥ tathā arthaḥ api vijñānam utpādayati anupajāta atiśayaḥ upajāta atiśayaḥ vā avyatirikta upajāta atiśayaḥ vā vyatirikta upajāta atiśayaḥ vā tat yadi anupajāta atiśayaḥ karoti tadā sarvadā kuryāt na vā karaṇam akaraṇam ca na upapadyeta tad svarūpa anativṛtteḥ tathā avyatirikta upajāta atiśayaḥ api na karoti akāraka ākārasya anugateḥ ananugatau vā na tarhi tat avyatiriktaḥ atiśayaḥ atha vyatirikta upajāta atiśayena janyate tathā api na upapadyate akāraka ākāra anativṛtteḥ ativṛttau vā āyātam kṣaṇika tvam tatas ca na indriya artha sannikarṣa jam vijñānam pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam

anye tu anadhigata artha gantṛ tvena pramāṇa lakṣaṇam abhidadhati te tu ayukta vādinaḥ draṣṭavyāḥ katham ayukta vādi tā teṣām iti ced ucyate vibhinna kāraka utpādita eka artha vijñānānām yathā vyavasthita eka artha gṛhīti rūpa tva aviśeṣe api pūrva utpanna vijñānasya prāmāṇyam na uttarasya iti atra niyāmakam vaktavyam atha yathāvyavasthita artha gṛhīti rūpa tva aviśeṣe api pūrva utpanna vijñānasya prāmāṇyam upapadyate na prathama uttara vijñānasya tadā anena eva nyāyena prathamasya api aprāmāṇyam prasaktam gṛhīta artha grāhi tvā viśeṣāt yathā eka nīla sva lakṣaṇa avabhāsita yugapad utpanna aneka nīla vijñānānām nīla eka artha gṛhīti rūpa tā na bhidyate tathā pūrva apara utpanna vijñānānām api gṛhīta artha gṛhīti rūpa tā na nivartsyati

atha niyata viṣaya tvam pūrva uttara vijñānayoḥ pūrva utpanna vijñānam anadhigata artha ākāra svīkaraṇa mukhena upādīyata uttaram tu adhigata artha ākāra viṣayam upajāyate yadi gṛhīta artha viṣaya tvam katham pratiniyata viṣaya tvam atha pratiniyata viṣaya tvam katham gṛhīta artha grāhi tvam niyata viṣaya tva gṛhīta grāhi tvayoḥ virodhāt yadi ca niyata viṣaya tvam tad ā ubhayoḥ api prāmāṇyam anadhigata artha gantṛ tva aviśeṣāt atha eka viṣaya tvam tad ā ubhayoḥ api prāmāṇyam aprāmāṇyam vā gṛhīta grāhitvā aviśeṣāt saḥ ayam gaḍu praveśa akṣi tāraka vinirgama nyāya upanipātaḥ śruti lālasānām duruttaraḥ

nanu adhigata viṣaya tve sati api prāmāṇya abhyupagame smṛteḥ api prāmāṇyam anuṣajyate pramāṇa phala tā vā kaḥ atra nivārayitā smṛtiḥ iha upajāyamāna ādya anubhava āvedita artha ākāra viṣayāḥ vā anya viṣayā vā nirviṣayā vā tat yadi pūrva udita anubhava āvedita artha ākāra viṣayā tadā tasyāḥ pramāṇa phala tā na eva nivārayitum pāryate gṛhīta artha grāhi tvā aviśeṣāt iti uktam evam ca smṛti sañjñakam saptamam pramāṇam prasaktam mīmāṃsakānām atha pūrva vijñāna anavadhārita artha viṣayā yadi evam katham tasyāḥ pramāṇa phala tvam apanetum pāryate ādya anubhavasya iva smṛti rūpa tā ca na prāpnoti dṛṣṭa śruta artha viṣayā hi smṛtiḥ na agṛhīta artha viṣayā

atha nirviṣaya iṣyate tadā na gṛhīta artha grāhi tvena smṛteḥ aprāmāṇyam api tu keśoṇḍuka saṃvedana vat nirviṣaya tvena api ca yadi nirviṣayā tadā gṛhīta artha grāhiṇī katham gṛhīta artha grāhiṇī iti ced nirviṣaya iti na vaktavyam na ca nirviṣayā mātaram pitaram śuśrūṣitavān aham santi me pañcabhṛtyāḥ iti pūrva anubhava āvedita artha ākāra paryavasāyinyaḥ hi smṛtayaḥ smṛti jñānena pūrva anubhava āvedita artha ākārasya pratibhāsanāt atha smṛti vijñāna kāle pūrva prabodha viṣayīkṛtārthasya pratyasta mitatvāt na tat viṣaya tvam evam ca nirviṣaya tvena smṛteḥ aprāmāṇyam na gṛhīta artha grāhi tvena iti uktam

yadi ca avadhārita artha viṣayam pramāṇam apramāṇam upapādyate tadā anumāna jñānasya aprāmāṇyam āpanīpadyeta tat eva katham kathyate yat eva avina abhauva sambandha grahaṇa kāla avadhāritam agni tva sāmānyam liṅga ajahat vṛtti tvena pratyakṣeṇa tat eva anumānāt avagacchati āhosvit pāvaka svarūpam matvartham vā liṅga vyāpāra samāna kālī nāstitvam vā liṅga upasarjana tvam vā agni vyakti pāratantryam vā agni tva sāmānyasya

tat yadi pūrva avadhārita sāmānya viṣayam abhyupeyate tadā prāmāṇyam na eva samāsādayati gṛhīta artha grāhi tvena smṛti vat eva tad aprāmāṇye na agnimattva vyavasthā upapattiḥ tad anupapattau ca na artha āpattyā agni vyakti saṃsthitiḥ tatas ca amutra agniḥ agniḥ ānīyatām iti sakala loka vyavahāra virahaḥ syāt atha mā bhūt etat vyavahāra hāniḥ iti ced pūrva avadhārite api arthe anumānasya prāmāṇyam abhyupeyate tadā anadhigata artha gantṛ viśeṣaṇam apārthakam śrotriyāṇām iti

atha pāvaka svarūpam anumimīṣe tat liṅga ajahat vṛtti tvena pūrvam avadhāritam vā na vā yadi pūrva upalabdham adhigata artha viṣaya tvam āyātam anumānasya atha na pūrva upalabdham avyāpakaḥ agniḥ anumānāt tarhi pratīyate tad abhyupagame tṛṇa jala ādi viṣayam api anumānam prasajyate atha matvarthaḥ anumīyate sa pūrva avadhāritaḥ vā na vā yadi avadhāritaḥ katham anadhigata artha gantṛ viśeṣaṇam anumāne sambhavati atha na eva avagata s tadānīm jala tṛṇa ādi viṣayam api anumānam prasajyeta iti uktam

atha liṅga vyāpāra samāna kālī nāstitvam agni tva sāmānyasya anumīyate tat anumāna vyāpāra samāna kālī nāstitvam agni tva sāmānyāt vyatiriktam avyatiriktam vā tat yadi avyatiriktam tadānīm pūrva upalabdha astitva viṣayam eva anumānam katham anadhigata artha gantṛ viśeṣaṇam apārthakam na bhavet atha vyatiriktam tat kim pūrva upalabdham anupalabdham vā yadi pūrva upalabdham tad viṣaya tve anumānasya na anadhigata artha gantṛ viśeṣaṇam upapadyate atha na upalabdham tat katham anumīyate jala ādi kalpam dhūmena

atha liṅga upasarjana tvam agni tva sāmānyasya anumānāt pratīyate tat liṅga upasarjana tvam agni tva sāmānyāt bhinnam abhinnam vā yadi abhinnam pūrva upalabdha agni tva sāmānya viṣayam eva anumānam katham prāmāṇya bhāj bhavati atha bhinnam tad avinā abhāva sambandha grahaṇa kāle liṅga vyāpaka tvena avadhāritam vā na vā yadi avadhāritam katham anadhigata artha viṣayam anumānam atha liṅga vyāpaka tvena anavagatam tadā tad viṣaya tve anumānasya parikalpyamāne tribhuvana āvedaka tvam dhūmasya kim na parikalpyate sambandha abhāva aviśeṣāt

atha agni vyakti pāratantryam anumīyate dhūmena agni tva sāmānyasya iti ced tat pāratantryam agni tva sāmānyasya dhūma vyāpaka tvena avadhāritam vā na vā yadi avadhāritam punar api gṛhīta grāhi tvam na ativartate anumānam atha na avadhāritam dhūma vyāpaka tvena pāratantryam agni sāmānyasya iti ced katham anumīyate iti uktam purastāt
