atha para rūpasya abhāvaḥ tat avirodhi tu aikatvam tasyāḥ abhāvaḥ na hi tasmin sati bhavān tasya anupalabdheḥ draṣṭā anyathā hi ātmanaḥ api abhāvaḥ bhavet atha ātma sattā avirodhi tvena sva ātmanaḥ abhāvaḥ na bhavati eva para sattā virodhi tvāt parasya api abhāvaḥ na bhavati atha apara ākāra tayā na upalabhyate tena parasya bhāvaḥ na bhavati abhāva ākāra tayā ca anupalabdheḥ parasya abhāvaḥ api na bhavet

atha abhāva ākāra tayā upalabhyate tadā bhāvaḥ anyaḥ na asti abhāva ākāra antarita tvāt abhāva svabhāva avagāhinā avabodhena abhāvaḥ eva dyotitaḥ na bhāvaḥ yathā sukha avagāhakena vijñānena sukham evā avadyotitam na duḥkham atha sukha jñānena duḥkham api gṛhyate tat idānīm sukha duḥkhayoḥ ekatā prāpnoti tatas ca paryāya rūpa tayā bheda abhyupagamaḥ hīyate abhinna ātmakam jagata syāt evam ca sthite yat uktam bhāge siṃhaḥ naraḥ bhāge yaḥ arthaḥ bhāga dvaya ātmakaḥ tam abhāgam vibhāgena narasiṃham pracakṣate iti tat na prāpnoti viśvasyā akhaṇḍa rūpa tvāt etat api na vaktavyam ekaḥ bhāvaḥ sarva bhāva svabhāvaḥ sarve bhāvāḥ eka bhāva svabhāvāḥ ekaḥ bhāvaḥ tattvataḥ yena dṛṣṭaḥ sarve bhāvāḥ tattvataḥ tena dṛṣṭāḥ atha paryāyāḥ itaretara ātmanā bhidyante sarva bhāvānām evam tarhi bhāvā abhāva paryāyayoḥ api bhedaḥ astu imām eva mūrkha tām digambarāṇām aṅgīkṛtya uktam sūtrakāreṇa yathā namra śramaṇaka durbuddhe kāya kleśa parāyaṇa jīvikā arthe api ca ārambhe kena tvam asi śikṣitaḥ cha

tathā sāṃkhya matena api ātmanaḥ bhogaḥ na eva sampadyate bhogasya ātmani avṛtteḥ bhoga śabdena sukham abhidhīyate tad saṃvedanam vā tat ubhayam buddhaḥ vartate na ātmani evam ca vyavasthite buddhoḥ bhoktṛ tvam na ātmanaḥ atha buddhi gatena api bhogena eva ātmanaḥ bhoktṛ tvam abhidhīyate tadā buddhi gatena kartṛ tvena ātmanaḥ kartṛ tvam prasajyate tatas ca kartā na bhavati iti etat na vaktavyam atha ātmani kartṛ tvasyā avṛtteḥ akartā iti apadiśyate bhogasya api atad vṛtteḥ saṃbhuj na bhavati ātmā

atha asti kartṛ tvam yadi nāma aupacārikam yathā bhṛtye jaya parājayau vartamānau svāmini upacaryete tathā buddhau vartamānam kartṛ tvam puṃsi upacaryate yadi evam bhogaḥ api buddhau vartamānaḥ puruṣasya aupacārikaḥ prāptaḥ aupacārikaḥ api ātmani na saṃbhavati anyatra mukhya tayā anabhyupagamāt bhogā abhāve ca ātmanaḥ mokṣa cintā na kartavyā bandhanavān mucyate na ca ātmani bandhanam asti bhogaḥ hi bandhanam sa ca ātmani na eva vidyate tad abhāvāt mokṣaḥ api nirupapattikaḥ

tathā ātmanaḥ astitvam na sidhyati bhoktṛ tvasya abhāve bhogyena bhoktuḥ anumānam yathā sūpa ādi mātram bhoktra vinābhūtam vṛṣṭam tathā pradhānam sa vikāram bhogyam tena bhoktā anumīyate etat ca ayuktam ātmanaḥ bhoktṛ tva abhāve katham bhogyena ātmā anumīyate ātmanā saha bhogyasya sambandha anavagateḥ tad anavagatiḥ ca ātmanaḥ pratyakṣa aviṣaya tvāt tad aviṣaya tvam ca viśeṣe anugama abhāvaḥ iti uktam atha pratyakṣeṇa ātmā avadhāryate tadā pratyakṣa viṣaya tvena ātmanaḥ samāna tā pratyakṣa anumāna viṣaya tvena tatas ca siddha sādhya tā

su upa ādi bhoktra vinābhūtam dṛṣṭam tat kim deha ādi vyatirikta bhoktra vinābhūtam dṛṣṭam āhosvit deha mātra bhoktra vinābhūtam dṛṣṭam tat yadi deha ādi vyatirikta bhoktra vinābhūtam dṛṣṭam tadā dṛṣṭāntaḥ api dārṣṭa antika prati tulyaḥ ātmanaḥ atīndriya tvena atha pratyakṣeṇa avadhāritaḥ ātmā tadā siddhaḥ ātmā kim anumānena

atha deha mātra bhoktra vinābhūtam dṛṣṭam tadā deha vikārāṇām bhoga yogena na ātmanaḥ siddhiḥ bhavatu vā ātmanaḥ bhogaḥ tathā api akṛta kṛta abhyāgama nāśa doṣa prasaṅgaḥ akṛtasya karmaṇaḥ phalam abhyeti ātmanaḥ kṛtasya ca karmaṇaḥ phalam na sampadyate buddhiḥ yadi ca akṛtasya karmaṇaḥ phalam abhyeti tadā mukta ātmanām api tat phalam syāt ātma vṛtti niyama hetoḥ abhāvāt tatas cā akaivalya prasaṅgaḥ

itas ca kaivalyam na upapadyate bhogya bhojakayoḥ avasthānāt na hi bhavatām pakṣe sadā ātmānam parityajati bhogyam yena ākāreṇa ātmanaḥ bhogya tvena avasthitam na hi tat ākāram ativartate ātmanaḥ bhoktṛ tva ākārasya anativṛtteḥ ativṛttau ca ātma uccheda prasaṅgaḥ cha

ye api ānanda rūpam ātmanaḥ kaivalyam abhidadhati te api yukti vādinaḥ na bhavanti katham yadi ātmanaḥ ānanda rūpam sva saṃvedyam ca tadā saṃsāra avasthāyām api tat vedyam prasaktam tatas ca mokṣa artha prayāsaḥ niṣphalaḥ atha saṃsāra avasthāyām na vedyate anādi mala avaguṇṭhitam ātmanaḥ svarūpam yathā paṭa antarite ghaṭe ghaṭa buddhiḥ na bhavati evam mala lipte ātmani ātma buddhiḥ na bhavati tat etat ayuktam dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭa antikayoḥ vaiṣamyāt paṭa antarite ghaṭe ghaṭa buddhiḥ na bhavati paṭa antardhāne sati indriyeṇa sākam sambandhaḥ na asti tad bhāvāt ghaṭe na indriya jam vijñānam sampadyate iha tu punar mala avaguṇṭhanena kasya vyavadhānam kriyate na vedya vedakayoḥ vyavadhānam kriyate vedyam vedakam ca ātma svarūpam eva yathā bauddhānām sva saṃvedyam vijñānam tat ca viṣaya sadbhāve api vedyate tad abhāve api vedyate tathā ātmanaḥ sva saṃvedyam svarūpam mala sadbhāve api vedyate tad asadbhāve api vedyate malasyā akiṃcitkara tvāt ātmanaḥ artha antara tvenā avasthānāt atha tādātmyena sthitāni malāni tadā malāni apanīyante kim uktam bhavati ātmā apanīyate tatas ca mokṣa abhāva prasaṅgaḥ cha

tathā mīmāṃsaka matena api ātma anumānam na pravartate pramāṇa antara anavadhārita artha viṣaya tva abhyupagamāt pramāṇānām niyata viṣayāṇi hi pramāṇāni pratipadyante pratyakṣa avaseye na anumānam pravartate anumāna avaseye ca pratyakṣam na pravartate tatas ca itaretara vyāvṛtti viśeṣa viṣayāṇi tat uktam viśeṣe anugama abhāvaḥ viśeṣaḥ niyata pramāṇa grāhyaḥ arthaḥ tathābhūte arthe aṅgīkriyamāṇe anumānasyā anugama abhāvaḥ anugamaḥ sambandhaḥ tad grahaṇa anupapattiḥ

artha pratyakṣa ādi avadhārite api arthe anumānam pravartate nanu evam pratyakṣa anumāna sādhāraṇaḥ arthaḥ prasaktaḥ sādhāraṇa tā samāna tā sāmānye siddha sādhya tā pratyakṣa avagata tvāt anadhigata artha gantṛ viśeṣaṇam ca apārthakam athavā sāmānye siddhe sādhanam iti anyaḥ arthaḥ sāmānyayoḥ gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ abhyupagamyate mīmāṃsakena na ca tat sāmānyam vidyate yathā ca na vidyate tathā prāk eva uditam tatas ca siddhasya sādhanam vidyamānasya sādhanam na ca agni tvam asti tad abhāve kasya idam jñāpakam

athavā siddham sādhanam siddha sādhanam iti anyaḥ arthaḥ vidyamānam sādhanam na ca dhūma tva sāmānyam asti ttu avidyamānam sāmānyam katham sāmānyam sādhanam bhavitum arhati athavā siddha sādhanam jñātam anumānam sādhanam bhavati na ca dhūma tvam jñātam svayam asattvāt athavā grahaṇa upāya abhāvāt tasya anusyūtam rūpam na ca tat ātmani anusyūtam na api ekasyām vyaktau api tu bahvīṣu vyaktiṣu na ca bahvyaḥ vyaktayaḥ upalabhyante api tu ekā eva dhūma vyaktiḥ upalabhyate na ca ekasyām vyaktau anugata ātma tayā sāmānya saṃvittiḥ asti na ca ākāra antara sāmānyam cha

tathā tāthāgatānām api anumānam na pravartate sambandha anavagateḥ tad anavagatiḥ ca kim sāmānyayoḥ sambandha avadhāraṇam āhosvit sāmānya sva lakṣaṇayoḥ sva lakṣaṇayoḥ vā tat yadi sāmānyayoḥ sambandha avadhāraṇam kriyate tat ayuktam sāmānyasyā asaṃbhavān na tayoḥ sambandhaḥ na api sāmānya sva lakṣaṇayoḥ sambandha avadhāraṇam kriyate sāmānyasyā asattvāt

atha sva lakṣaṇayoḥ sambandha avadhāraṇam tatra api kim arthayoḥ jñānayoḥ jñāna arthayoḥ vā tat yadi arthayoḥ sambandha avadhāraṇam tad dahana dhūmayoḥ hetu phala bhāva jñānam kim sattā mātreṇa āhosvit tad ākāra yogi tvena tat janya tvena vā sāmastyena vā tat yadi sattā mātreṇa dahana dhūma saṃvedanam apadiśyate na kevalam tat dahanasya tat saṃvedanam trailokyasya tad saṃvedanam prasaktam upakāra vinirmuktasya sattā aviśeṣāt

atha tad dahana ākāra yogi tvena tasya saṃvedanam abhidhīyate yathā dahanena sva nirbhāsam utpāditam tathā gandha ākāra uparakta gandha ādi jñānena api sva nirbhāsam utpāditam tatas ca jñāna ākāram tat utpadyate iti yuktam bhavati gandha ādi ākāram tatas ca aneka ākāra yogi tve sati pratikarma vyavasthā na labhyate atha gandha ādi jñānam na gandha ādi ākāram arpayati dahana jñāne tadānīm jñāna ākāra arpaka tvam api na labhyate jñāna tādātmya vyavasthitaḥ asau gandha ākāraḥ tad anarpaka tve jñāna ākāraḥ api na arpitaḥ syāt tatas ca dahana vijñānam avijñānam niravayavam ca gandha ādi jñānam na eka deśena ākāra arpaka tvam atha nirākāram gandha ādi jñānam pratikarma vyavasthā tarhi na labhyate tasya dahana jñānasya api nirākāra tā astu

kim ca dahana ākāra yogi tvena yadi dahana saṃvedanam tadā pūrva vijñāna ākāra yogi tvena pūrva vijñānasya api tad vedanam prāptam tad ākāra yogi tvāt tad utpādya tvāt ca atha tad ākāra yogi tve tad utpādya tve ca tasya tad vedanam na bhavati viṣayasya api tarhi tad vedanam kim iha dvayasya visaṃvādāt atha tat vijñānam viditam iti kṛtvā na vedyate jñāna antareṇa evam viṣayasya api tad vedanam na prāpnoti puruṣa antara avadhāryamāṇasya

api ca yadi dahana ākāra yogi tvena dahanasya tad vedanam vastutva ākāra yogi tvena nayana ādeḥ api tad saṃvedanam prasaktam atha nayana ādeḥ asādhāraṇa ākāra arpaka tvam na vidyate tena teṣām tad saṃvedanam na bhavati nīlasya sva bhavana deśa kāla svabhāva anarpaka tvāt sva kāraṇa kalāpa utpādya svabhāva ānarpaka tvāt ca tad arpaka tve ca nīla ākāra yogitā syāt tad kāraṇa janya tvam ca eka kālīna tve eka kāraṇa janya tve ca hetu phala bhāva anupapattiḥ saha utpannayoḥ go viṣāṇayoḥ iva atha asādhāraṇa ākāra tayā na upajāyate api tu nīla mātram praticchāyatayā eva upajāyate yadi evam nayana ādi sva lakṣaṇa ākāra tayā upajāyamānam nayana ādeḥ tad grahaṇam bhavet

api ca dahana ākāra tā dahana vijñānāt kim bhinnā abhinnā vā yadi bhinnā sā kim tāttvikī āhosvit atāttvikī tat yadi tāttvikī tad gatiḥ katham na sva saṃvedya tvena na api janakatvā aakāra arpaka tvena sva saṃvedyā na bhavati vijñāna kāya vyatirekāt na api janakatvā aakāra arpaka tvena gṛhyate arthaḥ hi ākāram arpayati na viṣaya ākāra tā tad ākāra arpaka tve vā prāptā ākāra paramparā atha atāttvikī viṣaya ākāra tā sā atāttvika tvena asaṃvidita dehā katham pratikarma niyāmikā bhavati

atha avyatiriktā sā kim tāttvikī āhosvit atāttvikī yadi tāttvikī sā kim jaḍa ātmikā āhosvit cit svabhāvā tat yadi jaḍa ātmikā tadā jñānā avyatireki tvam na saṃbhavati cit acidoḥ eka tva ayogāt anyonya parihāra sthiti dharma tvena atha cit ātmikā tadā paribhāṣā mātram bhidyate jñānam viṣaya ākāraḥ iti atha atāttvikī tadā jñānasya api atāt tvika tvam na ca jñāna vyatiriktā viṣaya ākāra tā na asti api tu jñāna svarūpam eva viṣaya ākāra tā ātmakam apadiśyate tat ca nayana artha āloka sādhāraṇaḥ utpādya tvena samam saṃvedanam prasaktam sarva kārakāṇām

yat api uktam kena api ādarśa maṇḍalam mukha rūpa tām svīkaroti na ca ādarśa rūpa tām parityajati tathā jñānam api viṣaya rūpa tām svīkurvan na vijñāna rūpa tām tyajati tat api ayuktam ādarśa maṇḍalasya mukha rūpa tā svīkaraṇa arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ kim mukha tādātmyam āhosvit avirala deśa utpādaḥ tat yadi tādātmyam katham naḥ ādarśa rūpa tām jahāti ekam hi idam vastu tad tādātmye mukham ādarśaḥ vā atha avirala deśa utpādaḥ mukhasya svīkaraṇam tadānīm ākārasya api svīkaraṇam avirala deśa utpādaḥ eva prāptaḥ tatas ca na ākāreṇa pratikarma vyavasthā kriyate anavagata rūpeṇa eva ca sthiteḥ dahana jñānam yadi sa ākāram tathā api dahana grahaṇam na bhavati

itas api dahana grahaṇam na bhavati kim tat avagatam anavagatam tat kim jñāna antara vedyam sva saṃviditam vā yadi jñāna antara vedyam tat ayuktam na jñānam jñāna antara vedyam bhavat pakṣe atha sva saṃvedyam tat ayuktam viṣaya dṛṣṭānta balena nirākṛtam naiyāyikaiḥ atha anavagatam na tarhi tat dahanasya grahaṇam apratyakṣa upalambhasya na artha dṛṣṭiḥ prasidhayati iti nyāyāt

api ca yat tat dahana grahaṇam tatra kim avabhāti kim arthaḥ jñānam ubhayam vā yadi arthaḥ pratibhāti tat ayuktam asaṃviditāyām saṃvittau tad saṃvitti ayogāt atha jñānam na tarhi dahana dhūmayoḥ sambandhaḥ avagataḥ tad saṃvitti pūrvaka tvāt sambandha buddheḥ atha ubhayam pratibhāti tat ayuktam eka upalambhasya dvitīya ākāra parihāra sthiti dharma tvāt na ca dahana jñāne jñāna artha ākārau pratīyete api tu dahanasya eva pratibhāsanāt

atha dahana utpādya tvena tat dahanasya saṃvedanam katham tat dahanena utpādyate kim atajjanana svabhāvena tad janana svabhāvena vā yadi atajjanana svabhāvena atajjanana svabhāvaḥ katham asau tat janayet atha tad janana svabhāvaḥ na tarhi dahanāt dhūmasya utpattiḥ dahanasya dahana jñāna utpādaka svābhāvyena dhūma utpādaka tva ayogāt atha tena eva svabhāvena dhūmam utpādayati prāptā vijñānasya api dhūma rūpa tā dhūmasya vā vijñāna rūpa tā abhinna ātmā utpādyate bhedakam ca na bījam asti

atha svabhāva antareṇa janayati na ekasya svabhāva dvaya abhāvāt svabhāva dvaye ca eka tā anupapannā tatas ca dahanena dhūma utpādanam kriyate na tadā sva jñānam utpādayati jñānam vinā kena hetu phala avadhāraṇam kriyate atha dahanaḥ dahana jñānam utpādayati na tarhi dahanasya dhūma utpādaka tvam tad abhāvāt na bāhya arthayoḥ hetu phala bhāva avadhāraṇam dahana ādi jñānena śakyate kartum

itas api dahana dhūmayoḥ hetu phala bhāva anupapattiḥ yathā avicalita dahana svarūpasya pūrva apara aneka kārya āvirbhāvaka tvam na pratipadyate bhavadbhiḥ tathā anāyatta vikārasya yugapad utpanna aneka kārya āvirbhāvaka tvam api na pratyetavyam atha abhyupagamyate yugapad aneka kārya utpādaka tvam yugapad aneka kārya utpādana śakti yuktasya utpatteḥ yadi evam krama bhāvi aneka kārya āvirbhāvaka tvasya utpatteḥ ayugapad ekam kāryam vidadhyāt vidadhāti eva iti ced idam āpekṣika tvam yat krama bhāvi aneka kārya janaka ātmakam svarūpam etat abhyupagame abhyupeta hānam āpadyate atha avicalita rūpeṇa pūrva apara kāryam na janyate tadā yugapad api na kuryāt anāyatta vikāraḥ tatas ca na dahanāt dhūmasya utpattiḥ

atha ekam eva tena jvalanena janyate kim tat ekam vijñānam dhūmaḥ vā tat yadi vijñānam eva janyate na tarhi dhūmam dṛṣṭvā agniḥ pratīyate atat vyāpāra labdha janmavat tvāt atha dhūmaḥ eva utpādyate tadā tad vijñānam vinā kena hetu phala bhāvaḥ avagamyate itas api dahanasya dhūma āvirbhāvaka tvam na jāghaṭī iti kim nimitta bhūtena dhūma utpādanam kriyate kim vā upādāna bhūtena tat yadi nimitta bhūtena utpādyate tadā dhūma rūpa tā na prāpnoti upādānam vinā

atha upādāna bhūtena utpādanam kriyate nanu asamāna jātīyam katham upādānakāraṇam bhavet abhyupagame vā deha indriya saṃghātāt eva garbha ādau vijñānam bhaviṣyati alam para loka vijñāna kalpanayā atha samāna jātīyena vijñānena vinā na vijñānasya udgatiḥ iti ced evam tarhi dhūmasya api asamāna jātīyāt dahanāt katham utpatti atha rūpa rūpa tayā vahneḥ samāna jātīya tvam evam deha ādeḥ api samāna jātīya tvam sva lakṣaṇa rūpa tayā idam eva cetasi samāropya uktam śarīrāt eva iti bṛhaspatiḥ

atha jñāna rūpa tayā na samāna jātīya tvam dehasya dahanasya api dhūma rūpa tayā asamāna jātīya tvam niyata kāraṇa janya ākāra tayā niyata deśa kāla svabhāva tayā ca sarve bhāvāḥ anyonya vyāvṛtta tanavaḥ na ca teṣām anyonya ākāra anugamaḥ asti na api eka jāti anugamaḥ tat uktam sarve bhāvāḥ svabhāvena sva svabhāva vyavasthiteḥ svabhāva para bhāvābhyām yasmāt vyāvṛtti bhāginaḥ

tatas ca bhinna jātīyāt sarvam jāyamānam dṛṣṭam na samāna jātīyāt bhavat kiṃcid dṛṣṭa pūrvam evam ca bhinna jātīyam deha ādikam garbha ādau vijñānam utpādayiṣyati tatas ca na para lokaḥ prasidhyati atha samāna jātīyam vijñānam vinā vijñānam na utpadyate tadā na kasyacid utpattiḥ syāt samāna jātīya kāraṇā saṃbhavāt tatas ca kārya anumānam hīyate

itas api dahana dhūmayoḥ hetu phala bhāva avadhāraṇam kartum na eva śakyate kim ekena jñānena dahana dhūmayoḥ hetu phala bhāva avadhāraṇam kriyate āhosvit pratiniyatena jñānena tat yadi ekam jñānam ubhaya avagāhakam gīyate tadā jñānasya akṣaṇika tvam āpadyate dhūma hetoḥ vā atha pratiniyatena jñānena pūrva apara avadhāraṇam kriyate tat ayuktam dhūma avagāhakena vijñānena tad sattā mātram pradyotyate tad svarūpa mātra paryavasāyinā tad svarūpa astitvam vidhīyate tat uktam sāmānye siddha sādhya tā sāmānye dhūma astitva mātre dhūma jñānasya prāmāṇyam asti

viśeṣe anugama abhāvaḥ viśeṣe bhede dahanena saha pūrva apara vikalpe anugama abhāvaḥ vyāpāra abhāvaḥ na śaknoti dhūma jñānam avagantum kim etat dhūma svarūpam dahanāt pūrvam saha paścāt vā jātam dhūma jñānasya dahana ātmā piśāca tulya tayā vyavasthitaḥ yathā dhūma jñānam piśāca ādi svarūpam na viṣayayati tena saha pūrva apara sahabhāvam na śaknoti sthāpayitum dhūmasya dahanasya api dhūma jñānena svarūpam na avasitam tena saha pūrva apara sahabhāvena dhūma jñānam dhūma svarūpam na avagantum śaknoti

atha yadi api dhūma jñānam dahanasya svarūpam na viṣayayati tathā api sva jñānena dahana svarūpam viṣayīkriyate piśāca ādeḥ tu svarūpam na kena api avasitam tena saha pūrva apara bhāvaḥ na avagamyate dhūmasya tat etat ayuktam dahana jñānena api dahana astitva mātram avasitam na tu dhūmena saha pūrva apara saha vikalpaḥ satī sattā dahana jñānena pradyotyate sā tu dhūmāt kim pūrvam saha paścāt vā cira utpannā pratyaya utpannā anutpannā vā na ayam dahana jñāna vyāpārasya viṣayaḥ api tu tad sattā mātra pratibaddham tat astitvam vidadhāti piśācaḥ api sva jñānena avagataḥ katham jñāyate saḥ api sva jñāna avagāhita dehaḥ astu yadi nāma tena saha dhūma jñānam pūrva apara sahabhāvam na śaknoti prakāśayitum dhūmasya

itas api dahana dhūmayoḥ hetu phala bhāva avadhāraṇam na śakyate kartum dhūma jñāna sattā kāle dhūma sattā na vidyate jvalana jñāna sattā kāle jvalana sattā na vidyate na avidyamānasya grahaṇam nāma anyathā agrāhya keśoṇḍukasya api grahaṇam syāt atha keśoṇḍukasya sarvadā sattā na vidyate na jñāna kāle na api pūrvam dahana ādeḥ tu pūrvam sattā vidyate yadi nāma jñāna kāle na asti pūrvam tu vidyate iti su vyāhṛtam etat gṛhīti kāle na asti gṛhīteḥ tu pūrvam asti gṛhītim antareṇa susthitāni vastūni atha jñāna janaka tvena pūrvam vidyate tad janaka tvam kenā avagamyate vijñānasya sva tanudyotaka tvena paryavasiteḥ tatas ca piśāca kalpau dahana dhūma ākārau tayoḥ hetu phala bhāva avadhāraṇāya na pratyakṣam

atha jñāna avalīḍha tad ākārāni atha anupapattyā tayoḥ sva rūpa vyavasthā kriyate tat ayuktam ākāraḥ hi prāk eva apoditaḥ na ca ākāra arthayoḥ pratibandhaḥ avadhāritaḥ tad anavadhāraṇe katham ākāraḥ artham gamayati evam tāvat artha janya tvam na śakyate jñānasya avadhārayitum na api arthasya artha janya tvam evam hetu phala bhāvān avadhāraṇāt katham dhūmam dṛṣṭvā anuminoti agnim

api ca ānumānikam jñānam kiṃviṣayam kim agni ādi sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam āhosvit vastu bhūta sāmānya viṣayam avastu bhūta sāmānya viṣayam vā vikalpa viṣayam sva aṃśa viṣayam nirviṣayam vā tat yadi sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam tadā pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ bhedaḥ na prāpnoti sva lakṣaṇa viṣaya tvena spaṣṭa ākāra tā anumāna jñānasya api prasajyate aspaṣṭa ābham ca bhavadbhiḥ pratipadyate na tu anyaiḥ

anye tu vadanti sva lakṣaṇam eva spaṣṭa ākāram yadi nāma pratyakṣa grāhyam sva lakṣaṇam vispaṣṭam anumāna grāhyam avispaṣṭam sva lakṣaṇasya eva ayam bhedaḥ ekaḥ agniḥ pratyakṣa janana yogyaḥ anyaḥ agniḥ anumāna janana yogyaḥ pratyakṣa janana yogye agnau ānumānikam jñānam yadi bhavati bhavati pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ bhedaḥ kadācid yāvatā ānumānika jñāna janana yogyaḥ agniḥ anyaḥ eva atha sva lakṣaṇa viṣaya sāmyāt abheda parikalpanā pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ yadi evam gandha rasa ādi jñānānām sva lakṣaṇa viṣaya sāmyāt sarveṣām abhedaḥ prāpnoti sarvam gandha jñānam rasa jñānam vā vaktavyam atha sva lakṣaṇa viṣaya tve sati api avāntara bheda vivakṣayā gandha ādi jñānam apadiśyate yadi evam sati api agni viṣaya tve pratyakṣa anumāna jñānayoḥ avāntara bheda vivakṣayā pratyakṣa anumāna jñāna vyapadeśaḥ atha karaṇa bhedena gandha ādi jñānāni bhidyante tadā pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ karaṇa bheda upapatteḥ bhedaḥ astu evam ca yat uktam sva lakṣaṇa viṣaya anumānam bhavati tat mūḍha uktam agni prapañcasya pratibhāsanāt

atha vastu bhūta sāmānya viṣayam na tad abhāvāt vijñāna janakatva asaṃbhavāt ca na ca janaka tvam antareṇa viṣaya arthaḥ upalabhyate atha avastu bhūta sāmānya viṣayam tat uktam vaikalpikam sāmānyam buddhi upadarśita rūpam etat api na yuktam avidyamānam sāmānyam katham buddheḥ viṣaya bhāvam pratipadyate kim sattā mātreṇa saha utpādena vā janakatvā aakāra arpaka tvena vā sarvasya asaṃbhave viṣaya arthaḥ bhaṇanīyaḥ yadi ca janakatva ādi abhāve api buddhau pratibhāti sāmānyam tadā rūpa ādeḥ api janaka tvam na kalpanīyam rūpam vijñānam akurvat pratyakṣam syāt

yat api dṛśya vikalpyau arthau ekīkṛtya tat adhyavasāyena pravartate iti uktam dṛśyam bāhyam rūpa ādi svalakṣaṇam vikalpyaḥ buddhi samāropita ākāraḥ kim punar anayoḥ ekīkaraṇam kim abhedena utpādanam kim vā abhedena avadhāraṇam āhosvit saṃghaṭanā kriyate tat yadi abhedena utpādanam sat asatoḥ abhedena utpādanam hata trapādṛte na anyaḥ vaktum arhati abhedena utpādane ca bhāvasya abhāva prasaṅgaḥ sāmānyasya vā vastu tvam prāpnoti tat vastu tve sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam anumānam pratyakṣā anumānayoḥ bheda bījam anveṣṭavyam

atha ekīkaraṇam eka tvena pratīyamāna tvam dṛśya vikalpyayoḥ tat ayuktam kim ekaḥ eva ākāraḥ pratibhāti āhosvit ākāra dvayam tat yadi ekaḥ eva ākāraḥ pratibhāti tat kim dṛśya ākāraḥ āhosvit vikalpa ākāraḥ tat yadi dṛśya ākāraḥ pratibhāti tadā sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam eva anumānam prasajyate atha vikalpa ākāraḥ pratibhāti tasya sarva upākhyā rahita tvena pratibhāsā viṣaya tvāt vā api etat vaktavyam sva lakṣaṇam eṣa

kāra avyatirikta avyatiriktaḥ vā yadi avyatiriktaḥ tadā sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam anumānam prāptam samāropitam ca sāmānyam pratīyate iti na vaktavyam tāttvikam ca sāmānyam prasajyate dṛśyā tāt tvika tva prasaṅgaḥ vā atha vyatiriktaḥ vikalpa ākāraḥ tarhi na vaktavyam tad āropa dvāreṇa pratīyate sva lakṣaṇa vikalpa ākāra antarita tvāt atha ghaṭanā kriyate sva lakṣaṇena sāmānyasya tat asat sat asatoḥ ghaṭanā ayogāt satoḥ ghaṭanā dṛṣṭāḥ yathā cakṣuḥ ghaṭayoḥ

atha sāmānya sva lakṣaṇa ākāra dvayam pratīyate evam tarhi anyonya vilakṣaṇau sāmānya sva lakṣaṇa ākārau pratīyate tatas ca na vaktavyam dṛśya vikalpyau arthau ekīkṛtya tat adhyavasāyena pravartate iti yadi ca viviktam ākāra dvayam pratibhāti tadā sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam anumānam prasaktam tad viṣaya tve mānayoḥ bheda kāraṇam vaktavyam sarva upākhyā vinirmuktasya ca sāmānyasya pratīyamāna tvam na upapadyate

anyat ca dhūma utpādite agni vijñāne anagni vyavaccheda rūpam sāmānyam pratibhāti iti vyapadiśyate ajala vyavacchedena pratibhāti iti kim na abhyupagamyate nā ajala vyavacchedena janyate na api anagni vyavacchedena tad anutpattau pratikarma niyama anupapattiḥ atha nirviṣayam ānumānikam jñānam tat ayuktam sva aṃśa viṣaya tvāt na hi bhavatām pakṣe nirālambanam kiṃcid vijñānam asti ātma avagāhaka tvena utpatteḥ yadi ca nirālambanam jñānam kva pravarteta nivarteta vā puruṣaḥ agatiḥ syāt atha dahanena tat utpāditam iti kṛtvā dahana antikam upasarpati evam dhūma jñāna utpāde api yāyāt atha sva aṃśa viṣayam anumānam tadā pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ bheda anupapattiḥ pratīyamāna jñānasya sva lakṣaṇa ātmaka tvāt

atha jñānayoḥ hetu phala bhāva avadhāraṇam kriyate tat api ayuktam jñānayoḥ api hetu phala bhāva avadhāraṇam na śakyate kartum kārya jñānam hi sva saṃvid paryavasitam na jñāna antaram ātmasāt karoti tad akaraṇe kena nirvartitam mama svarūpam iti etat katham vetti tad bhinna jñānasya piśāca tulya tvāt tat na jñānam jñāna antarāt bhidyate tad abhede katham hetu phala bhāvaḥ sva ātmani kriyā virodhāt

yā api yuktiḥ apadiṣṭā vijñāna mātra sthitau avayavi nirākaraṇa parā vṛtti anupapatti ādi rūpā na kila avayavī eka deśena vartate na api sarva ātmanā eka deśa vṛtti abhyupagame hi avayavinaḥ bheda prasaṃgaḥ atha sarva ātmanā vartate tarhi anyatra āvṛtti prasaṃgaḥ iti ādikā sā api na yukti yuktā katham kim eka deśa śabdena avayavī abhidhīyate avayavaḥ vā yadi avayavi abhidhīyate tadā eka deśena eva sarvatra vartate iti brūmaḥ sva kāraṇāt niyamitasya tathābhūtasya utpatteḥ

atha avayavaḥ abhidhīyate tad eka deśa śabdena tadā na eka deśena avayavī vartate avayavasya avayave vṛtti ayogāt bhavatu vai avayaveṣu vṛtteḥ abhāvaḥ avayavinaḥ tathā api asattvam na sidhyati tad deha upalambhasya tad astitva vidhāna paratvāt yathā anudakaḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ iti ukte sati udakaka maṇḍalu sambandha abhāvaḥ pratīyate na tu kamaṇḍaloḥ abhāvaḥ tat udakasya vā

atha avayavinaḥ upalabdhiḥ eva na asti sā kim dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ āhosvit adṛśya anupalabdhiḥ yadi dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ sā na upapadyate dṛśya śabdena kim apadiśyate upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptaḥ arthaḥ abhidhīyate upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ ca pratyaya antara sākalyam svabhāva viśeṣaḥ ca etat ced vidyate katham anupalambhaḥ upalabdhi kāraka sākalye sati upalabdhyā bhavitavyam na anupalabdhyā tad svabhāva nibandhana tvāt tad upalabdheḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya yadi anupalambhaḥ anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya tarhi upalambhaḥ syāt aniṣṭam ca etat

yadi ca ghaṭa vivikta bhūtala upalambhaḥ eva ghaṭasya anupalambhaḥ tadā bhū talasya api upalambhaḥ na bhavet tasya api upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta tvāt atha upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam upalabhyate bhū talam ghaṭasya api upalabdhi prasaṃgaḥ atha bhū tala jñāne ghaṭa svarūpam na avabhāti tena tasya anupalambhaḥ ghaṭa abhāva vyavahāraḥ kriyate tat ayuktam ghaṭa avaṣṭabdhe api bhū tale bhū tala jñāne ghaṭaḥ na avabhāti tatra api ghaṭa abhāva vyavahāra prasaktiḥ

tathā jñānasya api upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya saṃvedanam na bhavet tatas ca sarvasya asaṃvedane na anupalabdhiḥ upalabdheḥ eva yatas anupalabdhiḥ yadi ca bhū tala ādi upalabdhiḥ eva ghaṭa anupalabdhiḥ piśāca ādeḥ api sā evā anupalabdhiḥ astu bhavatu kaḥ doṣaḥ piśāca abhāva viniścayaḥ syāt atha na bhavati piśāca abhāva viniścayaḥ kumbha abhāva viniścaya abhāva prasaṃgaḥ syāt atha nirālambana jñānam dṛśyasyā anupalabdhiḥ na hi bhavatām pakṣe nirālambana jñānam asti sva aṃśa paryavasita tvāt

atha adṛśya anupalambhaḥ avayavi anupalambhaḥ saḥ api tad sattām na vyāvartayati yathā upalabhyamāna tvam vastu svarūpam tathā anupalabhyamāna tvam api vastu svarūpam eva yathā kāryasya sva kāraṇā janaka tvam vastu svarūpam tathā anupalabhyamāna tvam api vastu svarūpam eva na hi sva kāraṇā janaka tve vastu svarūpam ativartate tathā avayavi api kārya ajanaka tve api na svarūpam hāsyati sva hetoḥ eva kārya ajanaka ātmakasya utpatteḥ

yat api sādhanam anyat upadiṣṭam rakta ārakta prasaṃga rūpam tat api asat rakta tā nāma kāḥ avayavinaḥ kim nīla guṇa ātmaka tvam āhosvit nīla guṇa adhikaraṇa tvam nīla guṇa adhikaraṇa dravya saṃyogi tvam vā tad avirala deśa utpādaḥ vā yadi tāvat nīla guṇa ātmaka tvam rakta tā tat ayuktam sphaṭika paṭa ādeḥ anīla ātmaka tvāt atha nīla guṇa adhikaraṇa tvam rakta tā sā api anupapannā sphaṭika paṭa ādeḥ avadāta rūpa yogi tvāt

atha nīla guṇa adhikaraṇa dravya saṃyogi tvam rakta tā sā svayam anabhyupagatā katham avayavinam vyāvartayati atha pareṇa iṣṭā yatheṣṭā tathā avirodhi tvenā abhyupagatā na hi saṃyoga avayavinoḥ virodhaḥ abhyupagamyate pareṇa yathākṛtaka tvā anitya tvayoḥ sā aviruddhā katham avayavinam viparyāsayati rakta tā adhikaraṇaḥ ca na asti ca iti asaṃgatam yathā na asti śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt tādṛś etat atha rakta tā na asti ghaṭasya tathā api asattvam na sidhyati rakta tā bhāve tu abhāvaḥ katham bhavet tad abhāve vijñāna abhāva prasaṃgaḥ

atha ekasya viruddhau etau rakta tā arakta tā ākārau kena iṣṭau viruddha tayā nīla dravya saṃyogaḥ hi rakta tā tad abhāvaḥ arakta tā tau ca artha antara bhūtau na ca tayoḥ bhede avayavinaḥ bhedaḥ upapadyate tābhyām tasya bhinna tvāt na ca anyasya bhede anyasya bhedaḥ upapadyate vijñāna bheda prasaṃgāt yadi ca raktā rakta bhedena avayavī bhidyate tadā avayavi dvayam syāt nā asattvam vijñānā avyatireki tvam vā atha avirala deśa utpādaḥ rakta tā nīla dravya paṭayoḥ tathā api asattvam na sidhyati saṃskṛtānām sattva abhyupagamāt

yat ca anyat sādhanam uktam āvṛtā anāvṛta prasaṃga rūpam ekasmin avayave āvṛte āvṛtaḥ anāvṛte anāvṛtaḥ tat etat ayuktam tat yadi avayava āvaraṇe avayavī āvṛtaḥ anāvṛtaḥ vā abhyupagamyate paraiḥ tad avayavānām atīndriya tve api hi upalambha abhyupagamāt na ca avayavānām āvṛta tve anāvṛta tve vā avayavi āvṛtaḥ anāvṛtaḥ vā api tu yadā vastra ādi āvaraṇena devadatta indriya ghaṭa sambandha vighātaḥ kriyate tadā āvṛtaḥ iti apadiśyate yasya tu vastra ādinā aavaraṇena devadatta indriya ghaṭa sambandha vighātaḥ na kriyate tad apekṣayā anāvṛta vyapadeśaḥ yathā bhavat pakṣe sva kāraṇa anutpādaka tvena ajanaka tvam abhidhīyate na ca svarūpa bhedam āsādayati cha

yat api aparam abhihitam cala acala tva sādhanam avayave calati calati avayavī avayava antare cā acalati na calati tatas cala acala tve avayavinaḥ bheda prasaṃgaḥ tat etat ayuktam calanasya svayam anabhyupagamāt tad abhāve katham tena avayavī bhidyate atha calanam vidyate tarhi idam vaktavyam sva viṣaya lakṣaṇam calana rūpa arthasya utpatteḥ atha pareṇa iṣṭam calanam iti kṛtvā vyapadiśyate satyam iṣṭam pareṇa na tu avayave calati avayavinaḥ calanam iṣṭam tatas bhinna tvāt na api avayava antarasya acalane avayavinaḥ acalanam iṣyate tasya anya tvāt api tu calana yuktaḥ calati iti vyapadiśyate calana vikalaḥ niṣkampaḥ iti abhidhīyate

atha tat eva dravyam upajāta kriyam calati anupajāta kriyam ca na calati satyam tat eva calati tat eva na calati nanu avayavinaḥ bhedaḥ prasajyate na prasaṃgaḥ calanasya tatas anya tvāt cala acala vyapadeśaḥ ca anya upādhi kṛtaḥ yathā bhavat pakṣe jñānam kāryam kāraṇam ca vyapadiśyate sva kārya apekṣayā kāraṇam sva kāraṇa apekṣayā kāryam na ca tasya bhedaḥ asti tathā avayavi cala acala tvena na bhedaḥ dṛśyate

yat api uktam kim sarva avayava grahaṇena avayavī gṛhyate kim vā katipaya avayava grahaṇena gṛhyate yadi ca sarva avayava grahaṇena gṛhyate tadā madhya bhāga para bhāgā agrahaṇe avayavi agrahaṇa prasaṃgaḥ atha katipayā avayava grahaṇe avayavi grahaṇam abhyupagamyate tadā karāṃhri grahaṇe avayavi grahaṇam syāt atha avayava grahaṇam antareṇa avayavi grahaṇam tadā sarvadā grahaṇam syāt tat etat sarvam ayuktam na sarva avayava grahaṇa pūrvakam avayavi grahaṇam na api katipaya avayava grahaṇa pūrvakam avayavinaḥ grahaṇam api tu tad deha indriya sannikarṣa āloka ādi sākalye sati upalambhaḥ anyathā hi avayava grahaṇa pūrvake grahaṇe abhyupagamyamāne avayavi ādeḥ anupalambhaḥ syāt

yat api anyat uktam avayavi nirākaraṇa param sādhanam yatra bhinne na tad buddhiḥ anya apohe dhiyā ca tat ghaṭa ambu vat saṃvṛtisat parama artha sat anyathā tatra yadi avarugṇe ghaṭe ghaṭa buddhiḥ na bhavati ghaṭasyā aparama artha sattvam nīle api pratyasta mite nīla buddhiḥ na bhavati nīlasyā astamita tvāt tadā nīlam api aparama artha sat prāptam tathā vijñānam astam upagatam na vedyate tat api aparama artha sat prāpnoti

atha prāktane vijñāne nīla antare pratyasta mite jñāna antaram vedyate nīla antaram ca na tu ghaṭe avarugṇe ghaṭa antaram vedyate tat kim utpannam na vedyate āhosvit anutpannam tat yadi utpannam na gṛhyate tatra api hi vijñāna utpādana samartham utpannam na gṛhyate tad viparītam vā tat yadi vijñāna utpādana samartham utpannam na gṛhyate tat ayuktam yadi vijñāna utpādana samartham utpannam ghaṭa jātam tat avaśyam gṛhyate anyathā nīlasya api agrahaṇam syāt atha vijñāna janaka utpannasya agrahaṇam tadā nīlasya api anayā vṛttyā agrahaṇe tasya api aparama artha sattvam syāt

atha anutpanna ghaṭa jātam na vedyate tena tasya aparama artha sattvam nīla jñāne api anutpanne na vedyete tayoḥ api aparama artha sattvam āpadyate atha avarugṇe ghaṭe ghaṭa antaram na prādurbhavati vijñāna janakam kapāla avasthāyām yadi evam nirvikalpake rūpa jñāne naṣṭe na anyat nirvikalpakam rūpa jñānam jāyate sa vikalpaka avasthāyām tathā sthūle nīle naṣṭe na anyat sthūlam nīla antaram bhavati sūkṣma nīla utpāda kāle atha tatra nīla rūpa tā anugatā jñāna rūpa tā vā anugatā yadi evam iha api kapāla ghaṭayoḥ sva lakṣaṇa rūpa tā anugatā

yat api uktam dhiyā ca na sā dhiyā buddhyā vivecyamāne na sā ghaṭa buddhiḥ bhavati nīla buddhiḥ tu bhavati tat etat ayuktam kiṃbhūtayā buddhyā vivecyate kim nirālambanayā āhosvit sa ālambanayā tat yadi nirālambanayā vivecyate tadā vivecanīya arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ yadi ca nirālambanayā vivecyamānasya asattvam tadā anayā rītyā nīla ādeḥ api asattvam āpanīpadyate na ca nirālambana matiḥ asti

atha sa ālambanayā ghaṭaḥ vivecyate sā kim ātma ālambanā āhosvit sva kāya vyatirikta ālambanā tat yadi sva kāya ālambanā satī ghaṭasya vivecikā tadā vivecanīya arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ yadi nāma sva kāya mātra avabhāsā samutpannā ghaṭasyā asattve kim āyātam atha tasyām buddhau ghaṭaḥ na avabhāti tena tasyāḥ asattvam anayā bhaṅgyā nīla ādeḥ api asattvam āpadyate

atha sva kāya vyatirikta artha ālambanayā ghaṭaḥ vivecyate kim ghaṭa ālambanayā ghaṭaḥ vivecyate ghaṭa vyatirikta ālambanayā vā tat yadi ghaṭa ālambanayā vivecyate tatra api vivecana arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ tayā kim kriyate kim ghaṭasyā asattvam pradyotyate āhosvit sattvam ubhayam vā na kiṃcid vā tat yadi asattvam tat ayuktam na hi anya viṣayā satī etasya prabodhikā bhavitum arhati atiprasaṃgāt na jātu rūpa viṣaya vijñānam rasa sthāpanāya alam atha sattvam pradyotyate tathā api sattvam saṃvṛti sattve vā nīla ādeḥ api saṃvṛti sattva prasaṃgaḥ atha ubhayam pratibhāti na tad abhāvasya aviṣaya tvāt yathā vijñānasya viṣaya tām na yāti tathā prāk eva prapañcitam kim ca ubhayam pradyotayantyāḥ bhāvaḥ api pradyotitaḥ tayā tad pradyotane ca katham ghaṭasya saṃvṛti sattvam

atha na kiṃcid api pradyotyate tayā katham tarhi ghaṭa viṣayā sā apadiśyate atha ghaṭa bhinna artha viṣayā sā tatra vartamānā na kumbhasya astitva vidhāyikā na vyāvartikā atha tasyām buddhau kumbhaḥ na pratibhāti tena tasya saṃvṛti sattvam yadi evam buddhi viṣayaḥ api buddhi antare na pratibhāti tasya api āyātam saṃvṛti sattvam sarva jñānāni ca itaretara jñāne na pratibhānti sarveṣām saṃvṛti sattvam prāptam na ca etat abhyupagamyate

yat api anyat sādhanam apadiṣṭam bāhya artha apahnave na kila vijñānam asaṃviditam arthasya vedanam yadi aviditam artha vedanam tadā ajāte api jñāne arthaḥ vedyaḥ syāt santāna antara jñāne ca jāte devadatta vedyaḥ saḥ arthaḥ syāt na ca etat upapadyate tathā sva santati patite parokṣa jñāne jāte arthaḥ na vedyaḥ syāt atha jñāna antara viditam arthasya vedanam tat api jñāna antara viditam iti āyātam āndhyam jagataḥ atha sva saṃviditam tad arthasya vedanam tatas ca saha upalambhāt eka upalambhataḥ vā bāhya artha vilopaḥ prāptaḥ

tat etat ayuktam yat tāvat uktam jñāna antara viditam yadi jñānam arthasya vedanam tadā aniṣṭhā prāpnoti etat anabhyupagamena eva paryudastam api tu aviditam eva jñānam arthasya vedanam nanu ajāte api jñāne arthaḥ vedyaḥ syāt na vedyaḥ vedanasya abhāvāt arthaḥ na vedyate na tu vedana vedanasya abhāvāt arthaḥ na vedyate

yat api anyat uktam santāna antara jāte ca jñāne saḥ arthaḥ vedyaḥ syāt tat api ayuktam devadatta santati patite jāte devadattasya saḥ arthaḥ aparokṣaḥ na tu santāna antara patite jñāne anyathā hi santāna antara patitam vijñānam sva saṃvidita rūpam jātam tasmin jāte saḥ arthaḥ devadattasyā aparokṣaḥ syāt api ca rūpa jñānam kim rūpa gṛhi iti ātmakam āhosvit agṛhi iti ātmakam tat yadi rūpa gṛhi iti ātmakam tadā gṛhītam eva rūpam jñānam jñāna antara vedyam bhavatu sva saṃvedyam vā na jñāna grahaṇa purassaram arthasya grahaṇam

atha rūpa gṛhīti svabhāvakam na bhavati rūpa jñānam evam tarhi sva saṃvedyam bhavatu vyatirikta saṃvedaka saṃvedyam vā bhavatu avedyam vā na rūpasya pratyakṣatā yathā rasa jñāna sva saṃvedya tve api na rūpasya pratyakṣatā tadvat rūpa jñāna sadbhāve api na rūpasya pratyakṣatā rūpa gṛhīti svabhāvatayā anupapatteḥ

yat api uktam sva saṃvedya tve saha upalambhāt vijñāna arthayoḥ aikyam etat api apanītam draṣṭavyam sva saṃvedya tvā asaṃbhavāt eva na ca saha upalambhāt arthasya aabhāvaḥ sidhyati avyatirekaḥ vā saha upalambhaḥ hi jñānaka dharmaḥ artha eka dharmaḥ ubhaya dharmaḥ vā tat yadi jñānaka dharmaḥ tadā saha śabda arthaḥ na upapadyate jñāna eka dharma tve ca jñānasya eva astitva sthāpakam na arthasya vyatireka abhāvā vedakam saha upalambha sādhanam atad dharma tvāt atha atha eka dharmaḥ saha upalambhaḥ atra api saha śabda arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ atha eka dharma tve vā arthasya eva sattām vyavasthāpayati tatas ca viparīta sādhanāt viruddhaḥ

atha ubhaya dharmaḥ katham ubhaya dharma tve anyatara lopaḥ anyatara lopaḥ ced na ubhaya dharmatā upapadyate ubhaya dharmatā ca anyatara lopaḥ ca iti vyāhatam apadiśyate ubhaya dharma tve ca arthasya eva vilopaḥ na jñānasya iti atra niyāmakam vaktavyam tat ca na asti na ca upalambhaḥ anyatara sadbhāvam vyāvartayati sadbhāve api dṛṣṭa tvāt yathā jñāne

api ca kasya atra pakṣīkaraṇam kim vijñānasya uta arthasya tat yadi jñānam pakṣayasi tasya kim sādhyate abhāvaḥ avyatirekaḥ vā tat yadi abhāvaḥ sa kim jñānasya uta arthasya iti yadi jñānasya tadā abhyupetahānam hetoḥ ca pakṣa dharma tā na labhyate atha arthasya tadā asambaddha tvam jñānam pakṣayasi arthaḥ na asti iti vyāhatam apadiśyate saha upalambhasya ca vyadhikaraṇa tvam

atha avyatirekaḥ sādhyate sa kim jñānasya āhosvit arthasya tat yadi arthasya tadā asambaddha abhidhātṛ tvam jñānam pakṣayasi arthasya cā avyatireka pratipādanam karoṣi iti vyāhatam apadiśyate artha avyatirekaḥ hi artha dharmaḥ atha jñānasya eva avyatireka pratipādanam kriyate tat kim svasmāt svarūpāt avyatiriktam āhosvit para rūpāt avyatiriktam tat yadi svasmāt svarūpāt avyatiriktam jñānam tadā avivādena sambodhayitavyāḥ

atha parasmāt avyatireka pratipādanam kriyate sa para ātmā tāttvikaḥ atāttvikaḥ vā tat yadi atāttvikaḥ tatas avyatiriktam jñānam api atāttvikam bhavet atha tāttvikaḥ saḥ api avadhārita dehaḥ vā anavadhārita dehaḥ vā tat yadi avadhārita dehaḥ sa kim bhinna ākāra tayā avagataḥ abhinna ākāra tayā vā yadi bhinna ākāra tayā avadhāritaḥ tadā bhinna ākāra avagāhaka vijñāna dūṣita pakṣa tvena saha upalambha hetoḥ asiddha tā kāla atyaya apadiṣṭa tā vā

atha abhinna svabhāvatayā avadhāritaḥ na tarhi para ātmā para ātmā ca abhinna svabhāvatayā avadhāritaḥ iti ca vyāghātaḥ kim ca abhinna svabhāva tayā yadi prāk evā avagāhitaḥ tadā kim tatra saha upalambha sādhanena prayojanam niṣpādita kriye karmaṇi sādhanam sādhana nyāyam atipatati atha anavadhārita dehaḥ sa parātmā asti iti katham jānīṣe na ca avadhārita anavadhārita ākārayoḥ eka tvam bahu vidaḥ vadanti anavadhārita ākāra eka tve ca jñānasya api asaṃvedanam prasaktam

api ca saha upalambhaḥ kim jñānayoḥ uta arthayoḥ jñāna arthayoḥ vā tat yadi jñānayoḥ saha upalambhaḥ tadā na dvitīyasya abhāvaḥ avyatirekaḥ vā sidhyati asiddhaḥ ca hetuḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ ca sādhana vikalaḥ dvi candra jñāne na jñānayoḥ saha upalambhaḥ asti atha arthayoḥ tadā asiddhaḥ hetuḥ na ca anyatara artha lopaḥ lope vā anyatara siddhau bāhya artha vyavasthitiḥ atha jñāna arthayoḥ saha upalambhaḥ tathā api hetoḥ asiddha tā dṛṣṭāntaḥ ca sādhana vikalaḥ

atha saha upalambhāt iti asya ayam arthaḥ eka upalambhāt eka upalambhena jñāna arthayoḥ ekatā upapādyate nanu eka upalambhāt iti asya kaḥ arthaḥ kim jñāna arthayoḥ ekaḥ eva upalambhaḥ uta ekasya eva upalambhaḥ āhosvit ekena eva upalambhaḥ iti tat yadi jñāna arthayoḥ ekaḥ eva upalambhaḥ iti na tarhi artha abhāva siddhiḥ saṃvedyamāna tvena vijñāna sattāvat artha sattā api susthitā asiddhaḥ api ayam hetuḥ nīla ādau aneka upalambha saṃbhavāt anaikāntikaḥ api ayam hetuḥ yasmāt aneka nīla lohita ādi ākārāṇām eka upalambhe api na anyatama vyāvṛttiḥ abhedaḥ vā dṛṣṭaḥ

atha ekasya eva upalambhaḥ eka upalambhaḥ tat ekam kim vijñāna ātmakam āhosvit jñāna ātmakam tat yadi vijñāna ātmakam tat asat nīla maṇi kumbha ādeḥ vijñāna utpādaka tvena svarūpam avadhāryate na tu vijñāna ātma tayā yasmāt anena utpāditam vijñānam atra mama utpannam iti evam pravadanti santaḥ na tu idam eva jñānam iti evam vaktāraḥ bhavanti yathā hi vastu tvena pratīyamānam nīla jala ādikam eka upalambha anurodhena na avastu tvena pratipadyate tathā avijñāna ātmaka tayā adhyavasīyamānam na vijñāna ātma tayā vyavasthāpayitum pāryate anyathā vastu tva hāni prasaṃgāt atha avijñāna ātma tayā tat ekam avadhāryate tadā iṣṭa siddheḥ asiddhiḥ siddha sādhya tā ca syāt atha ekena eva upalambhaḥ saḥ api anupapannaḥ eva jala candra arka ādeḥ bahubhiḥ upalabhyamāna tvāt cha

yat api uktam avayavi nirākaraṇe kṣaṇika tvam yadi hi kila akṣaṇikaḥ bhavati bhāvaḥ tadā bhavati avayavā avaya vi bhāvaḥ tad abhāve tasyāḥ abhāvāt atha katham tasya abhāvaḥ sthāyinaḥ artha kriyā akaraṇāt tat eva katham kathyate kim yena svabhāvena ādyām artha kriyām karoti kim tena eva svabhāvena uttarottarāṇi api kāryāṇi karoti atha samāsādita svabhāva antaraḥ karoti yadi tena eva karoti tadā eka kāla yogi tvam sarva kāryāṇām prasajyate krama karaṇam hīyate tasya na hi eka svabhāva āyattaḥ vastūnām kāla vikalpaḥ nāma vikalpe vai eka svabhāva āyattatām atikrāmanti atha svabhāva antara āpattau janayati svabhāva antara āpattiḥ ca pūrva ākāra parihārana āntarīyaka rūpā tad aparityāge na ākāra antara anupraveśaḥ asti ākārayoḥ eka tva ayogāt atha pūrva ākāra parihāraḥ tadā etat eva kṣaṇika tvam yat pūrva apara kārya kāraṇam

tat etat ayuktam yadi krameṇa kāryam na karoti yugapad api katham karoti ekam nīla sva lakṣaṇam anekam vijñāna nīla ādikam kāryam karoti iti vaḥ siddhāntaḥ tat anekam kāryam kim ekena ākāreṇa karoti ākāra bhedena vā tat yadi ekena karoti tadā aayātā sarva kāryāṇām eka ākāra rūpa tā eka tvam ekasya ca aneka tvam āpadyate atha ākāra bhedena aneka kāryam janayati ākāra bhedāt tat eka tvam vyāvartate yat vyāvṛttau na ekam anekam kāryam karoti atha itthaṃbhūtam sva hetubhyaḥ tat udgatam yat aneka yugapad kārya karaṇa ātmakam yadi evam mama api krama bhāvi aneka kārya karaṇa ātmakam samudbhūtam sva hetubhyaḥ

yat api anyat uktam vināśa hetu abhāvāt kṣīṇakaḥ bhāvaḥ tat anupapannam katham te idam praṣṭavyāḥ vināśaḥ asti vā na vā tat yadi na asti kasya sa hetuka tvam nirhetuka tvam vā vicārayanti manīṣiṇaḥ na hi vandhyā sutasya abhāve sa hetuka tvam nirhetuka tvam vā vicārayanti santaḥ atha vidyate vināśaḥ sa vastu svabhāva anubandhī vā vicchinna utpannaḥ vā tat yadi vastu svabhāva anubandhī na tarhi nirhetuka tvam vastunaḥ vā nirhetuka tva prasaṃgaḥ sat svabhāva anubandhi tva vyatireka prasaṃgaḥ vā atha vyatiriktaḥ tasya nirhetuka tve kopa pattiḥ sa hetuka tve niyata deśa kāla yogi tvena upalabdhiḥ yadi nāma nirhetukaḥ vināśaḥ vastūnām kṣaṇika tve kim āyātam vastubhyaḥ artha antara tvāt

atha nirhetuka tve vastu utpatti anantaram ātmānam samāsādayati vināśaḥ tat ayuktam atra paṃca pakṣāḥ bhavanti vastu utpatteḥ pūrvam saha vā anantaram vā kāla antare vā bhavanam na vā bhavanam tat yadi pūrva bhavanam tadā bhāva udbhava anupapattiḥ atha saha tadā bhāvānupalambha prasaṃgaḥ tad sadbhāva upalambhe vā satata upalambha prasaṃgaḥ abhāvasyā akiṃcitkara tvāt tathā anantara bhūte api vināśe satata upalambha prasaṃgaḥ eva atha kāla antare bhavanam na tarhi kṣaṇika tvam vastūnām vināśasya nirhetuka tve sati api atha na eva bhavanam vināśasya tadā sarva bhāvānām nitya tvam āpadyate vināśasyā asaṃbhavāt

atha sa hetuke vināśe na avaśyaṃbhāvaḥ vināśasya vastre rāga vat kāraṇa vyāpāra para adhīna vṛtti tvāt tad abhāve tasya abhāvaḥ katham bhavet tat ayuktam sva hetoḥ eva dhruva bhāvi vināśa arhasya utpatteḥ bhavatu vā abhāvasya anudgamaḥ na kaścid virodhaḥ na tu nirmokṣa prasaṃgaḥ guṇānām vināśānutpatteḥ na idam asmad virodheṣu rājate mokṣa parikḷptyakaraṇāt atha kṛtakasya nitya tvam prāpnoti vināśa asaṃbhave sati sau adhikā sattā anityā niravadhikā tu nityā tat katham kṛtakasya nitya tvam vināśa asaṃbhave sati bhavatu vā nitya tvam na doṣaḥ asti

yat api apadiṣṭam pratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇika tvam vastūnām viṣayīkriyate atīta anāgata kāla vikalā vastu sattā vartamāna kāla āliṅgitā pratyakṣeṇa ātmasāt kriyate tat etat ayuktam atīta anāgata vartamāna kālānām kim pratīyamānāt avyatireki tvam vyatireki tvam vā tat yadi avyatireki tvam tadā kāla traya anumatam vastu upalabdham atha vyatireki tvam vastu avagame na atīta anāgata vartamāna kāla avagatiḥ asti vastu mātra upalabdheḥ tat astitvam siddham tad abhāvaḥ ca niṣpramāṇakaḥ

atha saḥ eva bhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ anyaḥ tarhi vaktavyaḥ abhāvasya sarva upākhyā vinivṛtti lakṣaṇa tvāt atha kāla antare tasya anyaḥ abhāvaḥ tasya akiṃcitkara tvāt sattā khaṇḍanam prati atha apara kārya akartṛ tvam kāla antare tad abhāvaḥ tat ayuktam sarva apara kārya kartṛ tvam ekasya pratyakṣāt pratyabhijñānena ca pūrva udita anubhava āveditā sattā ātmasāt kriyate sā eva sattā pratyabhijñānena ātmasāt kriyate katham punar vetsi iti ced pratyabhijñānāt eva jānīmaḥ sā eva sattā pratibhāti ādya anubhave api sā sattā pratibhāti kutas avagatā evam jñānayoḥ api hetu phala bhāva avadhāraṇam na śakyate kartum tad abhāvāt na kārya anumānam cha

tathā svabhāva anumānasya api na sambandha avadhāraṇam upapadyate tad abhāvāt bhinnayoḥ sambaddhayoḥ sambandhaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na hi ekasya sambandhaḥ upapadyate kim ca kṛtaka tvena anitya tva anumānam kriyate kim avagatena anavagatena vā tat yadi anavagatena tat katham svayam anavagatam sādhanam bhavitum arhati atha avagatena tasyām kṛtaka tva avagatau anitya tvam pratibhāti vā na vā yadi na pratibhāti katham pratibhā asamānā apratibhā samānayoḥ tādātmyam atha pratibhāti kim anumānena niṣpādita kriye karmaṇi sādhana ānarthakyam anyathā hi kṛtaka tva pratipattau api anumānam upādeyam syāt

atha kṛtaka tvam pratipannam iti kṛtvā na anumānam upādīyate tad svabhāva anubandhya nitya tvam api avagatam kim anumānena avagate ca anitya tve yat sādhanam upādīyate tat kadācid anitya tā pratipatti artham kadācid ca nitya tā samāra upa vyavaccheda artham kadācid tva nitya tā vyavahāra artham tat yadi anitya tā pratipatti artham sā jñātā eva vyarthaḥ prayāsaḥ

atha samāropa vyavaccheda artham samāropa vyavacchedaḥ anitya tvāt avyatiriktaḥ vyatiriktaḥ vā tat yadi avyatiriktaḥ asau api anitya tva avagamena eva avagata tvāt na sādhana antaram apekṣate atha vyatiriktaḥ sa kim vastu bhūtaḥ avastu bhūtaḥ vā tat yadi vastu bhūtaḥ tena saha śabda gata kṛtaka tvasya tādātmya anupapattiḥ tādātmye vā tad avagamena eva avagamāt na anumānam apekṣate

atha avastu bhūtaḥ sa kim kriyate jñāpyate vā tat yadi kriyate tat ayuktam sarva upākhyā vinirmuktasya karaṇa ayogāt karaṇe vā vastu tva prasaṃgaḥ atha jñāpyate tena saha kṛtaka tvasya sambandha vyatirekāt avyatireke vā tasya vastu tvam kṛtaka tva asattvam vā atha anitya tā vyavahāraḥ kriyate yaḥ hi kṛtaka tvam jānan api anitya tā vyavahāram na karoti sa hi atra vyavahāryate saḥ api vyavahāraḥ anitya tvāt avyatiriktaḥ vyatiriktaḥ vā yadi avyatiriktaḥ asau api pratipannaḥ eva anumānikaḥ

atha vyatiriktaḥ sa kim kṛtaka tvena utpādyate jñāpyate vā yadi utpādyate tadā na śabda utpādaka hetūnām anumāna tvam atha jñāpyate tena sākam sambandhaḥ abhidheyaḥ na tādātmya lakṣaṇaḥ jñāpyāt bhinna tvāt atha tad utpatti lakṣaṇaḥ saḥ api anupapannaḥ eva kim vyavahāreṇa utpādyate ghaṭaḥ ghaṭena vā utpādyate vyavahāraḥ na tāvat vyavahāreṇa utpādyate ghaṭaḥ ādau ghaṭa sattā tadanu vyavahāraḥ atha ghaṭena utpādyate vyavahāraḥ tadā kāraṇa anumānam na svabhāva anumānam tat ca svayam eva paryudastam cha

evam arthāpatti ādīnām api aprāmāṇyam kim punar arthāpatti ādeḥ svarūpam katham vā prāmāṇyam tatra darśana artha āpatteḥ tāvat svarūpam vyutpādyate rūpa darśanāni atha anupapattyā cakṣuḥ pratipattiḥ tathā anumāna pūrvikā anumānāt agni tva pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā agni vyakti pratipattiḥ abhāva pūrvikā arthāpattiḥ jīvati devadattaḥ gehe na asti geha abhāvānyathā anupapattyā bahirbhāva pratipattiḥ tathā āgamaparvikā arthāpattiḥ śabda artha pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā śabda artha sambandha nitya tā pratipattiḥ tathā arthāpatti pūrvikā arthāpattiḥ śabda artha sambandha nitya tā pratipattiḥ tathā upamāna pūrvikā arthāpattiḥ gavaya piṇḍa grahaṇa anantaram geha avasthita gopiṇḍe go gavaya sādṛśya avacchinne pratipattiḥ upamānāt piṇḍa avacchinne vā sādṛśye tasya piṇḍasya vāha doha prasava sāmarthyam arthāpattyā pratyeti eṣā ṣaṣ prakārā arthāpattiḥ

iyam ca anupapannā yat uktam rūpa darśanāni atha anupapattyā cakṣuḥ indriyam pratīyate tat ayuktam cakṣuḥ indriya anvaya vyatireka sambandha avadhāraṇam antareṇa anya kāraṇa parihāreṇa niyata kāraṇa pratipattiḥ arthāpattyā anupapannā cakṣuḥ ādi karaṇasya piśāca ādi tulya tvāt na tad avagatiḥ avagatau vā arthāpatti anupapattiḥ yat api uktam anyathā upapadyate iti atra kā anumā athavā rūpa ādi jñānasya eva dharmi tvam karaṇa pūrvakam iti sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ kāryatvāt ratha ādi vat evam sarva arthāpatti viṣaya tvena prayoga vyutpādanam kāryam pratyakṣa pūrvaka tvāt ca arthāpatteḥ tad abhāve tad abhāvāt cha

tathā upamānam api saṃbhavati kānana gata gavaya piṇḍa darśana anantaram geha avasthita gopiṇḍe gavaya sādṛśya avacchedena yat vijñānam tat upamāna phalam gopiṇḍa avacchinne sādṛśye vā yat vijñānam tat vā upamāna phalam gavaya piṇḍa jñānam utpādanam tat etat ayuktam pratyakṣa mūlam upamānam tad apagame tasya api apagamāt

atha kim idam go gavaya sādṛśyam yat gopiṇḍa grahaṇa kāle na avagatam upamānāt avagamyate kim avayavānām saṃsthānam kim vā viṣāṇa ādi avayavāḥ vā sāmānyam vā atha dharma antaram tat yadi avayavānām saṃsthānam sādṛśyam tad upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam vā na vā tat yadi upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam avagatam tarhi avagata pūrvam yat bhavati gavaya piṇḍa darśana anantaram tat smaraṇāt na atiricyate

atha upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam api na upalabhyate tadā gavaya piṇḍe api tasya grahaṇam na asti tad agrahaṇe piṇḍa mātra grahaṇe sati bhavati madīyā gauḥ anena sadṛśī iti tadā aśva viṣayam api syāt madīyaḥ anena sadṛśaḥ iti atha anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam tarhi tasya kvacid api grahaṇam tatas ca mahiṣī ādi darśane api madīyā gauḥ anena sadṛśī aśvaḥ vā madīyaḥ anena sadṛśaḥ iti upaplavaḥ syāt

atha viṣāṇa ādi avayavāḥ sādṛśya śabda vācyāḥ te ca avagatāḥ eva teṣu yat bhavati uttara kālam vijñānam tat smṛti rūpa tām atipatati atha go gavaya sāmānyam sādṛśya śabda vācyam tat ca anupapannam yathā ca na saṃbhavati tathā prāk eva āveditam bhavatu nāma kim tad upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam vā pūrvavat vibhajya dūṣaṇam vaktavyam

atha dharma antaram tat api aindriyakam atīndriyam vā tat yadi aindriyakam tadā tasya pūrva upalambhe sati uttara kāla bhāvi yat tasya vijñānam na tat smaraṇa ākāra tām parityajati atha tad upalabdhi lakṣaṇam aprāptam na tarhi tasya kvacid api grahaṇam tad agrahaṇe na gavaya darśane sati madīyā gauḥ anena sadṛśī ityādi jñānena śakyate bhavitum bhavane vā gavaya darśane api syāt

anye tu anyathā upamānam vyācakṣate vipaścitaḥ go gavaya sādṛśyam sva jñāna viśiṣṭam upamānam saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandha pratipattiḥ upamāna phalam etat cā asamīcīnam prāk eva vanecara vacanāt avagatam go sadṛśaḥ gavayaḥ iti kaḥ arthaḥ go sadṛśasya gavayaḥ iti nāma evam ca sarvam eva saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandha avadhāraṇam kṛtam na upamānam kalpanīyam atha saṃplava nyāyena kalpyate bhavatu tathā api saṃjñī vidyate saṃjñā tu na vidyate kva upamānam parikalpyeta

eke vadanti svayam uccārya saṃjñā pratyeti tat ayuktam saṃjñā kāle sādṛśya jñānasya anavasthiteḥ anye tu buddhi upasthāpitā saṃjñā pratyeti evam āmananti tat ayuktam avidyamānasya viṣaya artha tā na labhyate na sattā mātreṇa janakatvena vā ityādinā prāk eva upapāditam pratyakṣa pūrvakam ca upamānam udgīyate tad abhāve tat katham bhavet avyabhicāraḥ yena vijñāna utpādaka tvena upamāna tā tat ca avyabhicāri tvam na śakya vijñānam iti pūrvam eva āveditam cha

apare tu abhāva ākhyam pramāṇam sat upalambhaka pramāṇa pañcaka vyāvṛtti rūpam vyāharanti abhāva viṣayam tat kim avagatam anavagatam vā yadi avagatam tat kena avagatam kim meya vyāvṛttyā māna vyāvṛttyā vā sat upalambhakena vā tat yadi meya vyāvṛttyā tad gatiḥ katham atha māna vyāvṛttyā tadā itaretara āśraya tvam duruttaram āpadyate

atha samāna vyāvṛttyā avadhāryate sā eva jñātum ārabdhā katham jñāpikā bhavati na ca ekā jñāpyā anyā jñāpikā bhavati sat upalambhaka pramāṇa mātrā apagamasya jñāpaka tvena iṣṭa tvāt aniṣṭhā doṣa prasaṃgāt ca sā api jñāpikā katham jñānāḥ ityādinā atha sat upalambhakena avagamyate hīyate tarhi abhāva ākhyam pramāṇam meyā abhāva avagame api tat evā astu

atha anavagatam eva meyā abhāve anugamam karoti yadi evam devadattasya deśa antare vināśe jāte devadatta upalambhaka pramāṇa pañcaka vyāvṛttau devadatta abhāva niścayaḥ syāt na tu bhavati prabhu samānasya api atha vastu bhūta nimitta antara vaikalye sati na bhavati tat eva astu tat na antarīya tvāt tad gateḥ abhāvasya ca pratyakṣa pramāṇa grāhya tām pratipādayanti naiyāyikāḥ sambandhaḥ ca viṣaya viṣayi bhāva lakṣaṇaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva lakṣaṇaḥ vā

saṃbhavasya anumāne antara bhāvāḥ sambandha eka nimitta mardarśane sati artha antare pratipattiḥ anumānam cha aitihyasya ca āgame antarbhāvaḥ tasya ca prāmāṇyam na saṃbhavati na anumāna antargatasya na api svatantrasya

eke vadanti vācaka tvena go śabdasya prāmāṇyam tat ca asamīcīnam śabda arthayoḥ sambandha vyatirekāt na tāvat tādātmya lakṣaṇaḥ tayoḥ ākāra bhedāt na api tad utpatti lakṣaṇaḥ artha apāye api śabda udaya darśanāt na api sāmayikaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ śabda artha vyaktīnām ānantyāt abhinna eka nimittasya cā asaṃbhavāt na ca saṃketita śabdasya artha pratipatti kāle avasthānam vidyate na ca artha pratyāyaka śabdasya saṃketaḥ avagataḥ samaya karaṇa kāle tad abhāvāt na ca sva kārya sambandham antareṇa pūrva śabda sambandham svāsa ārūpyāt vācakam atiprasaṃgāt

na api svābhāvikaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ tad gati abhāvāt na pratyakṣeṇa na api anumānena atha arthāpattyā anumīyate sā api anupapannā pratyakṣa ādi parvikā hi arthāpattiḥ pratyakṣa ādi abhāve tasyāḥ api abhāvaḥ na sā anumānāt bhidyate arthāpattiḥ na ca anumāna grāhyaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ bhavadbhiḥ pratipādyate na ca tad anumānam asti na ca nitya sambandhasya vijñāna janaka tvam iha upapadyate ukta nyāyāt

evam ca sati sambandham antareṇa padānām vācaka tvam na yujyate tad avācaka tve ca tad pūrvaka vākyasya api vācaka tvam na labhyate atha katham na labhyate prasiddha pada padārtha sambandha pūrvakam hi vākyam vācaka tvena gīyate tad aprasiddhau vākyasya api vācaka tvam na saṃgacchate evam cā avācaka tve veda vākyānām katham prāmāṇyam

atha aprasiddha pada padārtha pūrvakam api vākyam vācaka tvena udgīyate tadā sarva pramātṝṇām veda upalambhe sati veda artha pratipattiḥ syāt kim ca adṛṣṭa viṣaye veda vākyānām prāmāṇyam katham vetsi veda eka deśa tvena iti ced na artha vāda vākyena vyabhicārāt grāvāṇaḥ plavante ādityaḥ vaiṣṇavaḥ iti catuḥṣaṣṭi varṇān āloḍya prajāpatiḥ papau ityādinā cha

anye tu āpta ukta tvena prāmāṇyam uśanti āptāḥ sākṣātkṛta dharmāṇaḥ taiḥ yat uktam samam āptam tat kila avisaṃvādakam kṣīṇa doṣaḥ anṛtam vākyam na brūyāt hetu asaṃbhavāt tat etat ayuktam āptasya atyantā apratyakṣa tayā tad āyatta tāyāḥ anadhigateḥ vīta rāga jñāpakam ca anumānam na vidyate tasya apramāṇa tvāt

bhavatu vā āpta ukta tvam prāmāṇye kim āyātam kim sattā mātreṇa prāmāṇyam vijñāna janaka tvena vā yadi sattā mātreṇa tat ayuktam akārakasya prāmāṇyā ayogāt atha vijñāna janaka tvena prāmāṇyam tat kim ekalasya sahakāri kāraṇa upacaritasya vā tat yadi ekalasya tat ayuktam svayam anabhyupagamāt krama yaugapadya asaṃbhavāt ca

atha sahakāri kāraṇa upacaritena janyate yadi evam tadā sahakāri kāraṇam duṣṭam api abhyeti tad anurodhena viparītam api jñānam janayati āpta ukta tve sati api yathā abhinava kambala sambandhinam māṇavakam dṛṣṭvā pravaktā vākyam uccārayati nava kambalakaḥ ayam māṇavakaḥ iti śrotā tu adharma manaḥ kṣobha ādinā nimittena nava tu a saṃkhyā yukta kambala sambandhinam pratipadyate tathā pratāraṇa buddhyā nava tva saṃkhyā yukta kambala sambandhī māṇavakaḥ iti ukte avadāta karma anurodhena pratipattā abhinava kambala sambandhinam pratyeti tathā veda vākyānām api avadāna itara karma anuvedhena viparīta artha avabodha utpādaka tvam upapadyate tathā bhūta upaghāta cetaḥ vikāra manaḥ kṣobha ādinā vā nimittena cha

anye tu kumati mata anusāriṇaḥ vadanti vedasya prāmāṇyam anyathā apauruṣeya tvena puruṣāḥ hi rāga ādi viparīta cetasaḥ viparītam upapādayanti na ca veda vidhātṛ saṃbhavaḥ asti tat uktam nityaḥ vedaḥ asmaryamāṇa kartṛka tvāt vyoma ādi vat veda vedhasaḥ apagame tad āyattāḥ doṣāḥ vyapagatāḥ bhavanti te hi vidhātṛ satta anuvartinaḥ tad apagame katham avatiṣṭheran teṣām apāye katham apramāṇam āśaṃkyate vedaḥ yat uktam doṣāḥ santi na santi iti pauruṣeyeṣu yujyate vede kartuḥ abhāvāt tu doṣa aśaṃkā eva na asti naḥ codanā janitā buddhiḥ pramāṇam doṣa varjitaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ janyamāna tvāt liṅga āpta ukta akṣa buddhi vat na ca codanā janitam vijñānam sandigdham kiṃsvid iti anena ākāreṇa anupajāyamāna tvāt na ca idam bhrāntam deśa antara ādau abādhyamāna tvāt yat deśa antara ādau bādhyate tat mithyā yathā marīci nicaye ambu jñānam kāla antare ca bādhā yathā ārakta paṭe hāṭaka vijñānam iti evamādi na ca idam bhrāntam tathā tasmāt avitatham

yat tāvat uktam nityaḥ vedaḥ kartṛ asmaraṇāt tat ayuktam kūpa ārāma ādibhiḥ anaikāntika tvāt teṣām hi kartā na smaryate atha ca anitya tvam atha deśa kāla ucchedāt tatra kartuḥ asmaraṇam evam tarhi aviśeṣa abhihite arthe viśeṣam icchataḥ hetu antaram nāma nigraha sthānam athavā sati api viśeṣaṇa upādāne hetoḥ vipakṣa gamanam na nivārayitum pāryate yathā kṛtaka tva viśeṣaṇa upādāne api na prameya tvasya vyāvṛttiḥ asti atha kṛtaka tvam tat eva gamakam vyāvṛtta tvāt na hi ekasya vyāvṛttau anyasya vyāvṛttiḥ asti atiprasaṃgāt

kim ca sādhya viruddhe hetau kim viśeṣaṇa upādanam tad viparīte vā tat yadi viruddhe tadā anarthakam viśeṣaṇa upādānam atha aviruddhe api evam eva na hi viśeṣaṇena viruddha svabhāva tā vyāvartate yathā kṛtaka tva viśeṣaṇa upādāne api na cākṣuṣa tvasya śabde vṛtti lābhaḥ tathā deśa kāla uccheda abhāva viśeṣaṇa upādāne api asmaryamāṇa kartṛka tvasya na vipakṣāt vyāvṛttiḥ asti asiddhaḥ api ayam hetuḥ yasmāt smaranti eva kartāram kāṇādāḥ tathā laukikāḥ api bahulam vaktāraḥ bhavanti bramaṇā vedāḥ praṇītāḥ iti api ca kim aśeṣa jana smaraṇa nivṛttiḥ iha hetu tvena vivakṣitā āhosvit katipaya puruṣa smaraṇa vinivṛttiḥ tat yadi sakala jana smaraṇa vinivṛttiḥ tadā asiddhā avadhārayitum aśakya tvāt ca arvāc bhāga vidbhiḥ avadhāraṇe vā te eva sarvajñāḥ syuḥ arvāc bhāga vidaḥ na bhaveyuḥ

atha katipaya puruṣa apekṣayā tadā anaikāntikaḥ hetuḥ vidyamāna kartṛkeṣu api kartā na smaryate kaiścid anyat ca katipayaiḥ puruṣaiḥ na smaryate arthāt āpadyate puruṣa antara smaryamāṇa kartṛkaḥ vedaḥ viśeṣa pratiṣedhasya śeṣa abhyanujñā viṣaya tvāt na ca puruṣa janya tvena vedasyā aprāmāṇyam api tu puruṣa doṣa utpādya tvena atas saḥ eva apaneyaḥ na puruṣa vyāpāraḥ atha puruṣasya doṣa adhikaraṇa tve tad janya tve doṣa janya tvam api āśaṃkyate iti ced yadi evam indriyāṇām api doṣa adhikaraṇa tvena tad utpādita vijñānānām aprāmāṇyam samāśaṃkyate iti sarvatra prāmāṇya anāśvāsaḥ syāt

na ca asmaryamāṇa kartṛka tvena veda śabdānām apauruṣeya tva saṃsiddhiḥ anyathā api asmaryamāṇa kartṛka tvam upapadyate kena api vidagdha matinā veda sandoham utpādya ātmā apahnūyate na aham vedānām vidhātā iti bhavatu vai apauruṣeyaḥ vedaḥ prāmāṇye kim āyātam atha puruṣa vyāvṛttyā tad doṣa vyāvṛtti nibandhanam prāmāṇyam tad vyāvṛttyā tad guṇa vyāvṛtti nibandhanam aprāmāṇyam kid na iṣyate atha puruṣa gata guṇa doṣa vyāvṛttau nisarga guṇa anuvedhena prāmāṇyam iṣyate puruṣa guṇa doṣa vyāvṛttau nisarga doṣa anuvedhena aprāmāṇyam kid na gīyate api ca yathā apauruṣeya tve sati api rāga ādi doṣa sambandhitā upalabhyate tathā vede api bhaviṣyati

kim ca apauruṣeya tvena kartṛ doṣa apagamaḥ kṛtaḥ śrotṛ doṣāḥ tu kena apanīyante tathā hi artha pratipattau tān apekṣya viparītām pratipattim abhinivartayiṣyati tatas ca nityānām api kartṛ karmaṇām duṣṭa sahakāri kāraṇa anuvedhena viparyaya ādi jñāna hetu tvam upapadyate na vākyānām pramāṇa pratilambhaḥ

yat api uktam deśa antara ādau abādhyamāna tvāt pramāṇam codanā janitā buddhiḥ tat ayuktam smṛteḥ bādhā rahita tve api apramāṇa tvāt kim ca bādhā śabdena viparīta vijñānam apadiśyate tat ca na utpadyate kim codanā janita vijñānasya yathārtha tvena uta tad utpādaka kāraṇa vaikalyena iti sandihyate

api ca bādhā rahita tve api aprāmāṇyam dṛṣṭam bādhaka vijñāna utpatteḥ pūrvam bādhā api upajāyamānā kāla vikalpena upajāyate kvacid ardha māsena kvacid māsa vyavadhānena kvacid ca abda dvaya traya vyavadhānena anyatra tu kāraka vaikalyāt na eva saṃpatsyate na ca etāvatā pramāṇam codanā janitā buddhiḥ

kim ca bādhā rahita tvam api kim aśeṣa puruṣa apekṣayā katipaya puruṣa apekṣayā vā yadi aśeṣa puruṣa apekṣayā tadā avagantum na śakyate para citta vṛttīnām duranvaya tvāt atha katipaya puruṣa apekṣayā bādhā rahita tvam tadā anaikāntikaḥ hetuḥ yathā asatya udake jāta udaka buddhiḥ tasmāt deśāt deśa antaram yadā prayāti tatra eva daśārdha tām upayāti na ca tasya bādhakam vijñānam utpannam kim etāvatā tat pramāṇam bhavatu athavā codanā janita vijñānasya nirviṣaya tvam eva bhrānta tvam codanā janita vijñāna samāna kālīnakartavya tārūpārthasyā asaṃbhavāt saṃbhave vā codanā vacasaḥ vaikalyam vitāna kriyā vilopaḥ atha na vidyate kartavyatā rūpaḥ arthaḥ katham codanā vacana udbhūtam vijñānam na mithyā anyathā keśoṇḍuka saṃvidaḥ mithyātvam na bhavet atha tasyāḥ pratīyamāna arthā asaṃbhavena mithyātvam tat iha api tat eva astu

atha codanā janita vijñāna arthasya punar sadbhāvaḥ bhavati tena tasya yathārtha tvam na tu keśoṇḍuka vijñānasya kadācid api sadbhāvaḥ asti saḥ ayam viṣa bhakṣaṇena param pratyāyayati tapasvī codanā arthasya paścāt bhavanam tad vijñāna anupayogi tasmin kāle jñānasya astamita tvāt vijñāna kāle ca arthasya asaṃbhavāt

athavā iyam eva bādhā yat uta asaṃbhāvyamāna arthasya pratipādaka tvam yathā tantu turikārakopa nipāte sati vastra ādi kāryam upajāyamānam dṛṣṭam punar paṭa arthine upadeśaḥ dīyate tantūnām upādānam kuruṣva iti na tu evam sapta tantu avadāta karmaṇoḥ sādhya sādhana sambandha avadhāraṇam na apūrvam yena atra upadeśasya sāphalyam bhavati evam tāvat uktena nyāyena śabdānām vācaka tvena prāmāṇyam na yujyate

atha vivakṣā sūcaka tvena liṅga bhūtasya prāmāṇyam tat uktam vivakṣā prabhavāḥ hi śabdāḥ tām eva saṃsūcayeyuḥ iti tat etat ayuktam yathā hetu phala bhāvaḥ na asti saugate mate tathā prāk eva prapañcitam cha

anye tu sādhu pada śabdāt artha pratipattim varṇayanti sādhu tvam ca lakṣaṇa yogi tvena lakṣaṇam ca sūtrāṇi eva lakṣyam gauḥ ityādi padam atha kim idam nāma yat lakṣaṇena parama ṛṣi gaditena sūtra kalāpena lakṣyate kim gakāra ādayaḥ varṇāḥ varṇebhyaḥ artha antaram vā padam sphoṭa rūpam tat yadi varṇāḥ te kim nityāḥ santaḥ pada saṃjñāḥ bhavanti uta upajanana dharmakāḥ tat yadi nityāḥ kūṭasthāḥ santaḥ varṇāḥ pada saṃjñāḥ bhavanti tatra kim vyastāḥ samuditā vā tat yadi vyastāḥ sanātanāḥ ete pada saṃjñāḥ bhavanti tadā gavarṇena eva kevalena go artha pratipādanam kriyate okāreṇa vā artha pratipādanam kriyate tatas ca pūrva apara varṇa uccāraṇa ānarthakyam na ca atra ekasmin varṇe vibhakti anta tā asti api tu varṇa kadambake vibhakti utpāda abhyupagamāt

atha samuditānām pada saṃjñā tat uktam bahūnām saṃghāta śabda vācya tvam na hi ekasmin saṃghāta śabda prayogaḥ asti api tu gakāraukāra visarjanīyeṣu samudāya śabdaḥ prayujyate tat ayuktam varṇānām nānātā vidyate varṇaḥ hi avarṇāt varṇa ātmatayā vyāvartate varṇa antarāt tu katham vyāvartate kim varṇa ākāra tayā avarṇa ātma tayā vā tat yadi varṇa ākāra tayā vyāvartate tadā anyeṣām varṇa rūpa tā na prāpnoti nīratīra ādeḥ iva atha avarṇa ātma tayā vyāvartate tadā avarṇa ātma tā vyāvartate uktānām iva tatas ca ekaḥ eva varṇa ātmā jagati saṃjātaḥ tasya go arthavācaka tvam na yujyate supvibhakti anupapatteḥ

na api varṇānām nitya tva pratyāyakam pramāṇam asti evam pratyakṣa ādīnām aprāmāṇya pratipādanāt tīvra manda ātma tayā gavarṇasya nānātva upalabdheḥ gakāraḥ api bhedavān na gakāra eka tvam atha vyañjaka vaśena tīvra manda ādi buddheḥ utpattiḥ na gavarṇasya bhedaḥ asti tat ayuktam gavarṇaḥ eva pratīyate tīvra manda ādya ātma tayā na vyañjakāni gavarṇa buddhiḥ vā yadi vyañjaka bhedena tīvra manda ādi bheda parikḷptiḥ kriyate gavarṇa ātmā tu na bhidyate tadā gakāra ādi vibhāgaḥ api vyañjaka bheda nibandhanaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ varṇa ātmā tu ekaḥ eva tatas ca gavārtha pratipattiḥ na prāpnoti ekasmin varṇe supvibhakti anupapatteḥ

kim ca bhinna ākāra tayā pratīyamānasya yadi eka tvam abhyupagamyate na anekam jagat syāt abhinna ātmake ca jagati māna meya vyavasthā eva hīyate na ca nityasya anupajāta vikārasya vijñāna udaya dāna sāmarthyam asti atha kriyate kim anupajāta atiśayena vā avyatirikta upajāta atiśayena vā vyatirikta upajāta atiśayena vā tat yadi anupajāta atiśayena kriyate tadā sarvadā kuryāt ekasmin vā kāle kuryāt tad deha mātra anubandhena kāla vilambana ayogāt atha avyatirikta upajāta atiśayena kriyate tathā api sanātanāḥ varṇāḥ avyatirikta atiśaya karaṇa pakṣe saḥ eva upajāyate phala aniṣpatti karaṇa svarūpā anativṛtteḥ

atha vyatirikta upajāta atiśayena kriyate tasya atiśayaḥ katham yaḥ yasya kena api sambandhena saṃbandhyate sa tasya atiśayaḥ yadi ca antarhita varṇa smaraṇa viśiṣṭaḥ antyaḥ varṇaḥ padam tasya api smaraṇa kāle tirohita tvāt avācaka tvam tasya vyañjakānām kṣaṇika tvāt kṣaṇa upalabdhiḥ iti vacanāt yadi varṇāḥ vyañjakaiḥ vyajyante tadā samāna deśa avasthitam samāna indriya grāhayāṇām pratiniyata vyañjaka tvena iṣṭam eka antargata udaka kanaka ādīnām vadanti vaiśeṣikāḥ

atha anityāḥ varṇāḥ pada saṃjñāḥ bhavanti iti ced tatra api kim vyastāḥ samastāḥ vā tat yadi vyastāḥ tadā gakāra aukāra visarjanīya anyatame varṇe na vibhakti utpādaḥ asti utpāde vai ekaḥ varṇaḥ vācakaḥ syāt varṇa antara uccāraṇa ānarthakyam atha varṇa samudāyaḥ padam pratikṣaṇa dhvaṃsinām samudāya arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ bahūnām avasthita rūpāṇām samudāyaḥ loke dṛṣṭaḥ na ca varṇānām bhūyas tvam asti uktān nyāyāt kim ca antya varṇa grahaṇa anantaram pūrva varṇa smaraṇam pūrva varṇa smaraṇa anantaram antya varṇe jñānam tatas ca asya artha pratipatti kāle padam na vidyate tenā apadikā artha pratipattiḥ syāt

na ca kārya rūpa tā varṇānām vidyate satī sattā saṃvedyate vijñāna utpatteḥ pūrvam vedyasya sattā paścāt vijñānam tat vedyam kim adhunā utpannam viṣaya tām yāti cira utpannam anutpannam vā na alam ālocayitum jñānam tad svarūpa mātra astitva vidhāyaka tvena tad utpatteḥ na ca tad kāraṇam vidyate nanu prayatna ādikam vidyate tat ayuktam teṣām prayatna ādīnām svarūpam katham gṛhyate kim sattā mātreṇa kāraka tvena vā tat yadi sattā mātreṇa tadā janakam rūpam na syāt

atha kāraka tvena gṛhyate kim ātma janaka tvena āhosvit anya janaka tvena tat yadi ātma janaka tvena gṛhyate tad ātmā tena utpādyate na varṇaḥ atha anya janaka tvena avadhāryate tadā anyasya sattā siddhā na hi ākṣiptāni asadbhāvaḥ eva sadbhāvaḥ asya adhyavasīyate tatas tad samāna kālīna tvena hetu phala bhāvā asiddhiḥ

kim ca pūrva apara bhāvena hetu phala bhāvaḥ kim vā pūrva apara grahaṇena tat yadi pūrva apara bhāvena hetu phala bhāvaḥ tadā jñānam vinā asti katham jñāyate jñāna abhāvenā ajñāne kim pūrva utpannau saha utpannau vā atha pūrva apara grahaṇena hetu phala bhāva vyavasthāḥ iti tat ayuktam aniyatam grahaṇam dṛṣṭam kāryam dṛṣṭvā kāraṇam gṛhṇāti kāraṇam dṛṣṭvā kāryam gṛhṇāti ubhayam ca yugapad gṛhṇāti evam ca sthite na hetu phala bhāva viniścayaḥ asti tad abhāvāt nā anityāḥ varṇāḥ padam bhavitum arhati

atha varṇebhyaḥ artha antara bhūtam padam varṇa vyaṅgya sphoṭa rūpam abhyupagamyate varṇānām kila artha pratyāyaka tvam vyasta samastānām saṃbhavati asti ca sā artha pratipattiḥ tena artha antara bhūtam varṇebhyaḥ padam vidmaḥ abhinna ākārā ca pratipattiḥ varṇeṣu anupapannā tena varṇebhyaḥ bhinnam abhinna ākāram padam adhyavasīyate

yat tāvat uktam artha pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā padam avagamyate tat ayuktam arthāpatteḥ prāmāṇyam eva na asti yathā ca na vidyate tathā prāk eva prapañcitam na ca padena saha pratibaddhā artha pratipattiḥ avagata pūrvā yena anya kāraṇa parihāreṇa padam bodhayati pratyakṣam ca pramāṇam eva na bhavati katham tat pada pratipādanāya alam na ca nityasya vijñāna ādi artha kriyā karaṇa sāmarthyam asti evam lakṣya bhūtam padam na vidyate tad abhāvāt nirviṣayam pāramarṣam lakṣaṇam iti api ca yāni lakṣaṇa parāṇi sūtrāṇi teṣām lakṣaṇam vidyate na vā yadi vidyate tatra api anyat atra api anyat iti aniṣṭhāyām ca na kiṃcid padam jñātam syāt atha na vidyate kim evam tarhi teṣām sādhu tvam na vidyate

atha lakṣaṇa abhāve api teṣām sādhu tvam vidyate evam gāvī goṇī goputtalikā iti evamādīnām api apabhraṃśānām lakṣaṇa abhāve api sādhu tvam bhaviṣyati atha lakṣaṇa abhāvāt na gāvi ādīnām sādhu tvam tadā sūtrapadānām api tad abhāvāt eva asādhu tvam api ca yadi nāma lakṣaṇa vikala tā śabdasya tadā kim bhavati kim uccārayituḥ mukha bhaṅgaḥ saṃpadyate śabdasya vā avācaka tvam arthasya vā rūpa viparyāsaḥ jāyate kim vā apaśabda pratipādita arthasya artha kriyā kartṛ tvam hīyate apaśabda uccāraṇe sati amaṅgala udayaḥ vā bhavati

tat yadi tāvat pravaktṛ mukha bhaṅgaḥ bhavati gāvī śabda uccāraṇe sati tadā ete bahulam gāvī śabda uccāraṇam kurvāṇāḥ samupalabhyante pravaktāraḥ na ca teṣām mukha bhaṅgaḥ samupalabhyate atha gāvī śabdasya vācaka tvam na upapadyate tat ayuktam gāvī śabdena bahulam vyāharanti pramātāraḥ atha go artha pratipitsūnām gāvī śabda śravaṇa anantaram go śabde smṛtiḥ upajāyate sa ca gavā ādi artha vācakaḥ iti ced tat ayuktam mleccha ādīnām sādhu śabda parijñāna abhāvāt katham tat viṣayā smṛtiḥ tad abhāve na go artha pratipattiḥ syāt

atha arthasya rūpa viparyāsaḥ bhavati tat ayuktam na gāvī śabdena abhidhīyamānasya go rūpa tā vyāvartamānā dṛṣṭā atha artha kriyā kartṛ tvam hīyate tat ayuktam gāvī śabdena abhidhīyamānasya vāha doha prasava sāmarthyam na ativartate gopiṇḍasya atha gāvī śabda uccāraṇāt amaṅgala udayaḥ bhavati na tu vācaka tvam nirākriyate asādhu śabdasya tat uktam apaśabdaḥ anumānena vācakaḥ kaiścid iṣyate vācaka tvā aviśeṣe api niyamaḥ puṇya pāpayoḥ tat ayuktam tena saha pratibandha abhāvāt na ca apostitva grāhakam pramāṇam asti anyathā eva kāle ca na mlecchitavyam iti niyamaḥ abhyupagamyate na ca śuddham anyatra paṇḍitānām api vyavahāra udaya dāna darśanāt

tat evam upapluteṣu eva tattveṣu avicārita ramaṇīyāḥ sarve vyavahārā ghaṭantaḥ iti ye yātāḥ na hi gocaram sura guroḥ buddheḥ vikalpāḥ dṛḍhāḥ prāpyante nanu te api yatra vimale pākhaṇḍa darpa chidi bhaṭṭa śrī jaya rāśi deva gurubhiḥ sṛṣṭaḥ mahārtha udayaḥ tattva upaplava siṃhaḥ eṣaḥ iti yaḥ khyātim parām yāsyati pākhaṇḍa khaṇḍanābhi jñāḥ jñāna udadhi vivarddhitāḥ jaya rāśeḥ jayanti iha vikalpāḥ vādi jiṣṇavaḥ cha

atha atas dharmam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ yatas abhyudaya niḥśreyasa siddhiḥ sa dharmaḥ tad vacanāt āmnāya prāmāṇyam pṛthivī āpaḥ tejaḥ vāyuḥ ākāśam kālaḥ diś ātmā manaḥ iti dravyāṇi rūpa rasa gandha sparśāḥ saṃkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthaktvam saṃyoga vibhāgau paratva aparatve buddhayaḥ sukha duḥkhe icchā dveṣau prayatnaḥ ca guṇāḥ

utkṣepaṇam avakṣepaṇam ākuñcanam prasāraṇam gamanam iti karmāṇi sat anityam dravya vat kāryam kāraṇam sāmānya viśeṣa vat iti dravya guṇa karmaṇām aviśeṣaḥ dravyāṇi dravya antaram ārabhante guṇāḥ ca guṇa antaram karma karma sādhyam na vidyate kārya avirodhi dravyam kāraṇa avirodhi ca ubhaya tathā guṇaḥ

kārya virodhi karma kriyāvat guṇavat samavāyi kāraṇam iti dravya lakṣaṇam dravya āśrayī aguṇavān saṃyoga vibhāgeṣu akāraṇam anapekṣaḥ iti guṇa lakṣaṇam eka dravyam aguṇam saṃyoga vibhāgeṣu anapekṣam kāraṇam iti karma lakṣaṇam dravya guṇa karmaṇām dravyam kāraṇam sāmānyam tathā guṇaḥ saṃyoga vibhāgānām karma

na dravyāṇām vyatirekāt guṇa vaidharmyāt na karmaṇām dravyāṇām dravyam kāryam sāmānyam dvi tva prabhṛtayaḥ ca saṃkhyāḥ pṛthaktvam saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ ca asamavāyāt sāmānyam karma kāryam na vidyate saṃyogānām dravyam rūpānām rūpam guru tva prayatna saṃyogānām utkṣepaṇam saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ karmaṇām kāraṇa sāmānye dravya karmaṇām karma akāraṇam uktam

kāraṇa abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ na tu kārya abhavāt kāraṇa abhāvaḥ sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ iti buddhi apekṣam bhāvaḥ sāmānyam eva dravya tvam guṇa tvam karma tvam ca sāmānyāni viśeṣāḥ ca anyatra antyebhyaḥ viśeṣebhyaḥ sat iti yatas dravya guṇa karmasu dravya guṇa karmabhyaḥ artha antaram sattā eka dravyavat tvāt na dravyam

guṇa karmasu ca bhāvān na karma na guṇaḥ sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvāt ca eka dravyavat tvena dravya tvam uktam sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvena ca guṇe bhāvāt guṇa tvam uktam sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvāt ca karmaṇi bhāvāt karma tvam uktam sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvāt ca sat liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt ca ekaḥ bhāvaḥ

rūpa rasa gandha sparśavatī pṛthivī rūpa rasa sparśavatyaḥ āpaḥ dravāḥ snigdhāḥ ca tejaḥ rūpa sparśa vat vāyuḥ sparśavān te ākāśe na vidyante sarpiḥ jatu madhūcchiṣṭānām pārthivānām agni saṃyogāt drava ta adbhiḥ sāmānyam trapu sīsa loha rajata suvarṇānām taijasānām agni saṃyogāt drava ta adbhiḥ sāmānyam

viṣāṇī kakudmān prāntevāladhiḥ sāsnāvān iti go tve dṛṣṭam liṅgam sparśaḥ ca na ca dṛṣṭānām sparśaḥ iti adṛṣṭa liṅgaḥ vāyuḥ adravyavat tvāt dravyam kriyāvat tvāt guṇavat tvāt ca adravyavat tvena nitya tvam uktam vāyoḥ vāyu saṃmūrcchanam nānātve liṅgam vāyoḥ iti sati snnikarṣe pratyakṣa abhāvāt dṛṣṭam liṅgam na vidyate

sāmānyatodṛṣṭāt ca aviśeṣaḥ tasmāt āgamikam saṃjñā akarma tu asmad viśiṣṭānām liṅgam pratyakṣa pūrvaka tvāt saṃjñā karmaṇaḥ niṣkramaṇam praveśanam iti ākāśasya liṅgam tat aliṅgam eka dravyavat tvāt karmaṇaḥ kāraṇa antara anukḷpti vaidharmyāt ca saṃyogāt abhāvaḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇa guṇa pūrvaḥ kārye guṇaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kārya antara aprādurbhāvāt ca śabdaḥ sparśavatām aguṇaḥ paratra samavāyāt pratyakṣa tvāt ca na ātma guṇaḥ na manaḥ guṇaḥ liṅgam ākāśasya dravya tva nitya tve vāyunā vyākhyāte tattvam bhāvena

puṣpa vastrayoḥ sati sannikarṣe gandha antara aprādurbhāvaḥ vastre gandha abhāva liṅgam etena apsu uṣṇa tā vyākhyātā vyavasthitaḥ pṛthivyām gandhaḥ tejasi uṣṇa tā apsu śīta tā aparasmin param yugapad ayugapad ciram kṣipram iti kāla liṅgāni dravya tva nitya tve vāyunā vyākhyāte tattvam bhāvena kārya viśeṣeṇa nānātvam

nityeṣu abhāvāt anityeṣu bhāvāt kāraṇe kāla ākhyā itas idam iti yatas tat diśaḥ liṅgam dravya tva nitya tve vāyunā vyākhyāte tattvam bhāvena kārya viśeṣeṇa nānātvam āditya saṃyogāt bhūta pūrvāt bhaviṣyataḥ bhūtāt ca prācī tathā dakṣiṇā pratīcī udīci ca etena digantarāṇi vyākhyātāni sāmānya pratyakṣāt viśeṣa apratyakṣāt viśeṣa smṛteḥ ca saṃśayaḥ

dṛṣṭam adṛṣṭām dṛṣṭam ca dṛṣṭāvat dṛṣṭam yathā dṛṣṭām ayathā dṛṣṭām ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt vidyā avidyātaḥ ca saṃśayaḥ śrotra grahaṇaḥ yaḥ arthaḥ sa śabdaḥ tasmin dravyam karma guṇaḥ iti saṃśayaḥ tulya jātīyeṣu artha antara bhūteṣu ca viśeṣasya ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt eka dravyavat tvāt na dravyam acākṣuṣa tvāt na karma

guṇasya sataḥ apavargaḥ karmabhiḥ sādharmyam sataḥ liṅga abhāvāt nitya vaidharmyāt kāryatvāt abhāvāt kāraṇaḥ vikārāt doṣāt saṃyogāt vibhāgāt śabdāt ca śabda niṣpatteḥ liṅgāt ca anityaḥ dvayoḥ tu pravṛttyoḥ abhāvāt saṃkhyā bhāvāt prathamā śabdāt sampratipatti bhāvāt ca sandigdhāḥ sati bahu tve saṃkhyā bhāvaḥ sāmānyatas

prasiddhāḥ indriya arthāḥ indriya artha prasiddhiḥ indriya arthebhyaḥ artha antara tve hetuḥ saḥ anapadeśaḥ kāraṇa ajñānāt kārya ajñānāt ajñānāt ca anyaḥ eva hetuḥ iti anapadeśaḥ saṃyogi samavāyi eka artha samavāyi virodhi ca kāryam kārya antarasya kāraṇam kāraṇa antarasya virodhi abhūtam bhūtasya bhūtam abhūtasya abhūtam abhūtasya bhūtam bhūtasya prasiddha pūrvaka tvāt apadeśasya aprasiddhaḥ anapadeśaḥ asan sandigdhaḥ ca anapadeśaḥ viṣāṇī tasmāt aśvaḥ viṣāṇī tasmāt gauḥ iti ca ātma indriya manaḥ artha sannikarṣāt yat niṣpadyate tat anyat pravṛtti nivṛttī ca pratyagātmani dṛṣṭe paratra liṅgam

ātma indriya artha sannikarṣe jñānasya abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca manasaḥ liṅgam dravya tva nitya tve vāyunā vyākhyāte prayatna ayaugapadyāt jñāna ayaugapadyāt ca ekam manaḥ prāṇa apāna nimeṣa unmeṣa jīvana manaḥ gati indriya antara vikārāḥ sukha duḥkhe icchā dveṣau prayatnaḥ ca iti ātma liṅgāni dravya tva nitya tve vāyunā vyākhyāte

yajñadattaḥ iti sati sannikarṣe pratyakṣa abhāvāt dṛṣṭam liṅgam na vidyate sāmānyatodṛṣṭāt ca aviśeṣaḥ tasmāt āgamikam aham iti śabda vyatirekāt na āgamikam yadi ca dṛṣṭa pratyakṣaḥ aham devadattaḥ aham yajñadattaḥ iti devadattaḥ gacchati viṣṇu mitraḥ gacchati iti ca upacārāt śarīra pratyakṣaḥ sandigdhaḥ tu upacāraḥ aham iti pratyagātmani bhāvāt paratra abhāvāt artha antara pratyakṣaḥ na tu śarīra viśeṣāt yajñadatta viṣṇu mitrayoḥ jñāna viśeṣaḥ sukha duḥkha jñāna niṣpatti aviśeṣāt aikātmyam nānā vyavasthātaḥ śāstra sāmarthyāt ca

sat akāraṇa vat tat nityam tasya kāryam liṅgam kāraṇa bhāvāt dhi kārya bhāvaḥ anityam iti ca viśeṣa pratiṣedha bhāvaḥ avidyā ca mahatī aneka dravyavat tvāt rūpāt ca upalabdhiḥ adravyavat tvāt paramāṇau anupalabdhiḥ rūpa saṃskāra abhāvāt vāyau anupalabdhiḥ aneka dravyeṇa dravyeṇa samavāyāt rūpa viśeṣāt ca upalabdhiḥ etena rasa gandha sparśeṣu jñānam vyākhyātam tad abhāvāt avyabhicāraḥ saṃkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthaktvam saṃyoga vibhāgau paratva aparatve karma ca rūpi dravya samavāyāt cākṣuṣāṇi arūpiṣu acākṣuṣa tvāt etena guṇa tve bhāve ca sarva indriya jñānam vyākhyātam

pratyakṣa apratyakṣāṇām apratyakṣa tvāt saṃyogasya pañca ātmakam na vidyate guṇa antara aprādurbhāvāt ca tri ātmakam api na ātma saṃyogaḥ tu avipratiṣiddhaḥ mithas pañcānām aneka deśa pūrvaka tvāt dharma viśeṣāt kārya viśeṣāt samākhyā bhāvāt saṃjñā ādimattvāt santi ayonijā veda liṅgāt ca

ātma saṃyoga prayatnābhyām haste karma tathā musala karma hasta saṃyogāt ca abhighāta je musala karmaṇi vyatirekāt akāraṇam hasta saṃyogaḥ tathā ātma saṃyogaḥ hasta musala karmaṇi musala abhighātāt tu musala saṃyogāt dhaste karma tathā ātma karma hasta saṃyogāt ca saṃyoga abhāve guru tvāt patanam nodana viśeṣa abhāvāt na ūrdhvam na tiryak gamanam

prayatna viśeṣāt nodana viśeṣaḥ nodana viśeṣāt udasana viśeṣaḥ hasta karmaṇā dāraka karma vyākhyātam tathā dagdhasya visphoṭanam prayatna abhāve guru tvāt suptasya patanam tṛṇa karma vāyu saṃyogāt maṇi gamanam sūcī abhisarpaṇam iti adṛṣṭa kāritāni iṣau ayugapad saṃyoga viśeṣāḥ karma anya tve hetuḥ nodanāt ādyam iṣoḥ karma karma kāritāt ca saṃskārāt uttaram tathā uttaram uttaram ca saṃskāra abhāve guru tvāt patanam

nodanāt abhighātāt saṃyukta saṃyogāt ca pṛthivyām karma tat viśeṣeṇa adṛṣṭa kāritam apām saṃyoga abhāve guru tvāt patanam tat viśeṣeṇa adṛṣṭa kāritam drava tvāt syandanam nāḍyā vāyu saṃyogāt ārohaṇam nodanāt pīḍanāt saṃyukta saṃyogāt ca vṛkṣa abhisarpaṇam iti adṛṣṭa kāritam apām saṅghātaḥ vilayanam ca tejasaḥ saṃyogāt

tatra avasphūrjathuḥ liṅgam vaidikam ca apām saṃyogāt vibhāgāt ca stanayitnuḥ pṛthivī karmaṇā tejaḥ karma vāyu karma ca vyākhyātam agneḥ ūrdhva jvalanam vāyoḥ ca tiryak pavanam aṇu manasoḥ ca ādyam karma iti adṛṣṭa kāritāni hasta karmaṇā manasaḥ karma vyākhyātam ātma indriya manaḥ artha sannikarṣāt sukha duḥkhe tad anārambhaḥ

ātma sthe manasi sa śarīrasya sukha duḥkha abhāvaḥ sa yogaḥ kāya karmaṇā ātma karma vyākhyātam apasarpaṇam upasarpaṇam aśita pīta saṃyogaḥ kārya antara saṃyogāḥ ca iti adṛṣṭa kāritāni tad abhāve saṃyoga abhāvaḥ aprādurbhāvaḥ sa mokṣaḥ dravya guṇa karma vaidharmyāt bhāva abhāva mātram tamaḥ tejasaḥ dravya antareṇa āvaraṇāt ca diś kālau ākāśam ca kriyāvadbhyaḥ vaidharmyāt niṣkriyāṇi etena karmāṇi guṇāḥ ca vyākhyātāḥ niṣkriyāṇām samavāyaḥ karmabhyaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ kāraṇam tu asamavāyinaḥ guṇāḥ guṇaiḥ diś vyākhyātā kāraṇena kālaḥ

buddhi pūrvā vākya kṛtiḥ vede na ca asmad buddhibhyaḥ liṅgam ṛṣeḥ tathā brāhmaṇe saṃjñā karma siddhiḥ liṅgam buddhi pūrvaḥ dadātiḥ tathā pratigrahaḥ tayoḥ kramaḥ yathā anitara itara aṅga bhūtānām ātma guṇeṣu ātma antara guṇānām akāraṇa tvāt aduṣṭa bhojanāt samabhivyāhārataḥ abhyudayaḥ tat duṣṭa bhojane na vidyate duṣṭam hiṃsāyām samabhivyāhārataḥ doṣaḥ tat aduṣṭe na vidyate viśiṣṭe pravṛttiḥ same hīne ca apravṛttiḥ etena hīna sama viśiṣṭa dhārmikebhyaḥ parādānam vyākhyātam tathā viruddhānām tyāgaḥ samaḥ ātma tyāgaḥ para tyāgaḥ vā viśiṣṭe ātma tyāgaḥ

dṛṣṭānām dṛṣṭa prayojanānām dṛṣṭa abhāve prayogaḥ abhyudayāya abhiṣecana upavāsa brahmacarya guru kula vāsavān aprasthya yajña dāna prokṣaṇa diś nakṣatra mantra kāla niyamāḥ ca adṛṣṭāya cāturāśramyam upadhāt ca anupadhāt ca bhāva doṣaḥ upadhā adoṣaḥ anupadhā iṣṭa rūpa rasa gandha sparśam prokṣitam abhyukṣitam ca tat śuci

aśuci iti śuci pratiṣedhaḥ artha antaram ca ayatasya śuci bhojanāt abhyudayaḥ na vidyate yama abhāvāt vidyate ca anartha antara tvāt yamasya asati ca abhāvāt sukhāt rāgaḥ tad maya tvāt tṛpteḥ adṛṣṭāt jāti viśeṣāt ca rāga viśeṣaḥ icchā dveṣa pūrvikā dharma adharmayoḥ pravṛttiḥ tatas saṃyogaḥ vibhāgaḥ ca ātma karmasu mokṣaḥ vyākhyātaḥ

uktāḥ guṇāḥ guṇa lakṣaṇam ca uktam idam evaṃguṇam idam evaṃguṇam iti ca uktam pṛthivyām rūpa rasa gandha sparśāḥ dravya anitya tvāt anityāḥ agni saṃyogāt ca guṇa antara prādurbhāvāt etena nityeṣu anitya tvam uktam apsu tejasi vāyau ca nityāḥ dravya nitya tvāt anityeṣu anityāḥ dravya anitya tvāt kāraṇa guṇa pūrvāḥ pṛthivyām pāka jāḥ ca

apsu tejasi vāyau ca kāraṇa guṇa pūrvāḥ pāka jāḥ na vidyante aguṇavataḥ dravyasya guṇa ārambhāt karma guṇāḥ aguṇāḥ etena pāka jāḥ vyākhyātāḥ eka dravyavat tvāt aṇoḥ mahataḥ ca upalabdhi anupalabdhī nitye vyākhyāte kāraṇa bahu tvāt kāraṇa mahat tvāt pracaya viśeṣāt ca mahat tad viparītam aṇu aṇu mahat iti tasmin viśeṣa bhāvāt viśeṣa abhāvāt ca

eka kāla tvāt aṇu tva mahat tvayoḥ aṇu tva mahat tva abhāvaḥ karma guṇaiḥ vyākhyātaḥ aṇu tva mahat tvābhyām karma guṇāḥ aguṇāḥ etena dīrgha tva hrasva tve vyākhyāte karmabhiḥ karmāṇi guṇaiḥ guṇāḥ tat anitye nityam parimaṇḍalam avidyā vidyā liṅgam vibhavān mahān ākāśaḥ tathā ca ātmā tad abhāvāt aṇu manaḥ guṇaiḥ diś vyākhyātā kāraṇena kālaḥ

rūpa rasa gandha sparśa vyatirekāt artha antaram eka tvam tathā pṛthaktvam tayoḥ nitya tva anitya tve tejasaḥ rūpa sparśābhyām vyākhyāte niṣpattiḥ ca ekatva pṛthaktvayoḥ ekatva pṛthaktva abhāvaḥ aṇu tva mahat tvābhyām vyākhyātaḥ karmabhiḥ karmāṇi guṇaiḥ guṇāḥ niḥsaṃkhya tvāt karma guṇānām sarva eka tvam na vidyate
