lakṣaṇa ādi pravṛttiḥ ca na śāstreṇa anugamyate tad saṅkare ca tena eva vācya vācaka nirṇayaḥ na ca tena saha etasya vijñātā saha vācitā loka prayukta śabda arthaḥ na upāya tvāt ca mucyate ākhyāta pratyayena api saha asau upalakṣitaḥ kāmam tadīyam api artham gamayet anumānataḥ tāvatī aṃśe na kalpyau ca prakṛti pratyayau punar

saḥ eva artha dvi śakti tve varam kleśaḥ samāśritaḥ nirjñāta parimāṇasya smaraṇa anugamāt vinā nānātvam kalpayitvā asya kaḥ śaktim kalpayiṣyati dadhi atra iti yat anyādṛś padam pūrva avadhāritāt ke cit āhuḥ tat eva idam ajānantarya dūṣitam pratyabhijñāyate tat dhi sa ca arthaḥ sampratīyate ikāre tu yavijñāna makāra para saṃhite

atha vā ātmīya siddhāntāt yakāra tve asya sati api dadhi vācya artham sāmarthyam lakṣaṇāt avagamyate tathā hi aśru ta dadhyatraḥ lakṣaṇa anugamāt vinā vyutpanna dadhi śabdaḥ api dadhi atra iti na buddhyate vikāra ānantyatas yaḥ tu sambandha jñapti asambhavaḥ lakṣaṇāt tad vid ukteḥ vā na ati kleśaḥ bhaviṣyati

kiyat padam iti jñānam yat tu tatra na jāyate svara antam vyañjana antam vā na ca ajñāte artha nirṇayaḥ tat ucyate pada chede tad apabhraṃśa tām vrajet saṃhitā viṣaye ca asya smaryate sādhu śabda tā etasmin tu pratīmaḥ artham agṛhīta avadhau api tena sati api vicchede pade bhedaḥ artha bhedataḥ

jñāyate ca avadhiḥ tatra vyañjana antaḥ na tu ucyate dadhi śabdau abodhya tvāt nityam nitya samāsa vat etena rāja rājñā ādi śabdānām dattam uttaram kiñ cit aṃśa samānam hi tad artham tat pada antaram yat tu brāhmaṇa vastra ādau brāhmaṇa arthaḥ na gamyate avadhyantarataḥ tatra tad pada antara jṛmbhitam utsargasya apavādena bādhaḥ kasya na sammataḥ

tat brāhma padam utsṛṣṭam bādhyate anya avadhau pade tattvena avadhim utkṛṣya yadi ucyeta pada antaram kena sva arthaḥ asya vāryeta devadatta ādi śabda vat evam eva aśvakarṇa ādau samudāya prasiddhitaḥ vāryate avayavasya arthaḥ vṛkṣa ādi artha avadhāraṇāt artha prakaraṇa adhīna bādhita sva arthayoḥ api samasta vyastayoḥ bhūyas saḥ eva arthaḥ pratīyate

go śukla ādi padānām tu samasta vyasta bhāvinām sva artha hāniḥ na dṛṣṭā iti kva ānarthakyam bhaviṣyati padārtha anugataḥ ca eṣa vā adya arthaḥ gamyate sadā na viśiṣṭa artha tā tasmāt vākya svātantrya sādhinī na vimuñcanti sāmarthyam vākya artheṣu padāni naḥ tanmātrau asiteṣu eṣu padārthebhyaḥ sa gamyate

aśābde ca api vākya arthai na padārtheṣu aśābda tā vākya arthasya iva na eteṣām nimitta antara sambhavaḥ sambaddham eva ca ete artham gamayanti avinābhuvam sāmānyam sva viśeṣeṇa vinā na hi upapadyate na ca anumānam eṣā dhīḥ tanmātreṇa prasajyate pratijñā artha eka deśa tvāt padārthānām hi aliṅga tā

padārthaiḥ anuraktaḥ asau vākya arthaḥ sampratīyate na ātmanā gamayanti enam vinā dhūmaḥ agnimattva vat pakṣa dharma tvam eteṣām vākya arthe na ca gamyate na hi deśa ādi vat pūrvam niṣpannaḥ sa pratīyate asattva bhūtam enam hi pratipadyāmahe tatas kriyā kāraka saṃsarga viśiṣṭaḥ prāk asau kutas

dharmiṇi anavabuddhe ca na tad dharma avadhāraṇam na ca prāk bodhakam kiñ cit vākya arthasya upapadyate avabuddhe tu vākya arthe yadi tad dharmatā bhavet vijñāte arthe tatas kim nu prameyam avaśiṣyate anvayaḥ ca padārthānām na vākya arthaiḥ apekṣyate sarvasmin eva su jñānaḥ bhūta bhāvitirohite

anya vākya artha sambandha jñānāt ca anyaḥ na gamyate anya tvāt ca padārthānām te ced na anya artha dhīḥ bhavet sāmānya dṛṣṭa kḷptau vā labhyate na viśeṣa dhīḥ vākya artha avagatiḥ sarvā tu asādhāraṇa gocarā asambandha pratīteḥ ca prāmāṇyam upapāditam sarva loka prasiddhā ca pratipattiḥ iha sphuṭā

yatra kva cana vijñātān padārthān pratipadya hi dūra deśa ādivār tāsu na āpta ukte dhīḥ vihanyate āpta vāda avisaṃvādāt atra ced anumāna tā nirṇayaḥ tāvatā sidhyet buddhi utpattiḥ na tad kṛtā anyat eva hi satya tvam āpta vāda tva hetukam vākya arthaḥ ca anyaḥ eva iti jñātaḥ pūrvataram tatas tatra ced āpta vādena satya tvam anumīyate

vākya artha pratyayasya atra katham syāt anumāna tā janma tulyam hi buddhīnām āpta anāpta girām śrutau janma adhika upayogī ca na anumāyāḥ tri lakṣaṇaḥ śabda prāmāṇya nirṇītyai padārthebhyaḥ yathā iṣyate atyanta adṛṣṭa vākya artha pratipattiḥ tathā ucyate bhāvanā vacanaḥ tāvat tām smārayati loka vat anvaya vyatirekābhyām pratyaya arthaḥ tu sa iṣyate

kaiḥ cit anyaiḥ tu dhātvarthaḥ tad sāmīpya upakārataḥ aparaiḥ samudāya arthaḥ tatas eva hi gamyate pāka ādau yat na dṛṣṭā asau bhavati ādau tathā eva ca viveka phala manda tvāt pacati ādau yatheṣṭa tā sā sādhya sādhana upāya sāmānya artha avadhāraṇāt anya labhyam viśeṣa aṃśam yam kañ cit abhikāṅkṣati

kāma avagata sādhya tvaḥ svargaḥ kāṅkṣati bhāvanām tatra sannidhi yogya tvāt sambandhaḥ kalpyate tayoḥ tatas sā kḷpta sambandhā sādhana aṃśam apekṣate dhātu artha asādhanam kiñ cit na anuṣṭhānam hi siddhyati dhātuvācyaḥ ca yāga ādiḥ atṛtīyā paraḥ api san svabhāvāt bhāvanā saktaḥ sādhyam kiñ cit apekṣate

pratyāsatti nimittaḥ ayam sambandhaḥ kalpyate anayoḥ tam ca vispaṣṭam ākhyātum yāgena iti prayujyate yathā aupagava śabda artham tasya apatyam iti īdṛśāt kathayanti na ca etasmin ṣaṣṭhī anta upagu sama bhavaḥ na kevalam tṛtīyā eva karaṇa tvam niyacchati pramāṇa antara gamye api na kiñ cit viruṇaddhi sā

prajñāta karaṇa tve vā dhātau sati api na iṣyate aprātipadika tvena tṛtīyā yāga śabda vat atas yā śabda sāmarthya labhyā karaṇa tā yajeḥ kevalasya aprayogi tvāt sā yāgena iti kathyate tathā utpanna kathaṃbhāvāḥ bhāvanā upāya mātrake upāyaḥ api ca kartavya mātra ākāṅkṣī niyamyate yogya tva sannidhānābhyām anyathā anupapattitaḥ

sa ca sva vākya labhyaḥ vā vākya antara gataḥ api vā prakṛti pratyayau yadvat apekṣete parasparam padam pada antaram yadvat vākyam vākya antaram tathā karaṇaiḥ sādhyate kiñ cit na upāya rahitaiḥ phalam prayāja ādi vidhānam ca na ca syāt niṣprayojanam prayojana antarāt tatra pratyāsatteḥ apekṣitaḥ

phalavat bhāvanā aṃśa stha karaṇa anugrahaḥ varam eka bhāvanayā upāttāḥ trayaḥ api aṃśāḥ parasparam upakārya upakāri tvam paścāt anubhavanti te bhāvanā apekṣamāṇā hi sādhanam kim phalasya me sādhana an ugraḥ kaḥ vā iti anusyūtam apekṣate ākāṅkṣa evam aviccheda siddhā śukla gava ādiṣu eka kriyā gṛhīteṣu sambandhaḥ ca parasparam

dravya dvāreṇa ca eteṣām viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya tā itara upakṛta dravya vartti tvāt tatra karmaṇi dravya antaram anicchantyā kriyayā ca parigrahāt eka dravya āśraya prāptiḥ iti na anyonya saṃśrayam paraspara anurāgaḥ ca sutarām upakārakaḥ arthāt ca anya vyavacchedaḥ sambandhaḥ atas na duṣyati tatra anaikāntika aneka vākya artha upaplave sati

anyonya ātma vyavacchedāt ekatra sthāpyate matiḥ atas anvayātirekābhyām anumā na iyam iṣyate eka artha ekāntika tvam tat anyathā eva atra labhyate evam padārtha vākya artha saṅghātaiḥ upakalpitām viśiṣṭām bhāvanām prāpya vṛttiḥ vidhi niṣedhayoḥ yadi api anyaiḥ asaṃspṛṣṭām vidhiḥ spṛśati bhāvanām

tathā api aśaktitaḥ na asau tanmātre paryavasyati anuṣṭheye hi viṣaye vidhiḥ puṃsām pravartakaḥ aṃśa trayeṇa ca āpūrṇām na anutiṣṭhati bhāvanām tasmāt prakrānta rūpaḥ api vidhiḥ tāvat pratīkṣate yāvat yogya tvam āpannā bhāvanā anya anapekṣiṇī upasarga nipātānām prayoga niyame sati arthaḥ tad āgama nyāyāt syāt samāsapadeṣu iva

vācakadyotaka tvam tu na atīva atra upayujyate tad bhāvāt vācaka tvam vā parasya anugrahī astu vā īṣat artha ādayaḥ tāvat sākṣāt nāmnā eva saṅgatāḥ aprayukta kriyā dvārāḥ viśeṣa ādhānataḥ apare āpiṅgaḥ pravayāḥ ca iti dvayasya etat nidarśanam kva cit prakṛṣṭa tā ādīnām bhāvanā upanipātinām itikartavya tā tvena pratipatti parigrahau

eka artha samavāyi tvāt kartṛ dharmaḥ api bhāvanām gamiṣyati na kartṛṇām svarūpe sa hi kīrtyate ye tu anya artham viruddha artha dhātu śakti avalopinaḥ teṣām tad aṅga tā eva iṣṭāḥ dhātu bhāga samāḥ hi te praśabdena upasṛṣṭasya tiṣṭhateḥ gati śakta tā na hi praśabda velāyām gamane jāyate matiḥ sāmānyatas kriyāśaktiḥ kḷptā dhātoḥ purā eva tu

viśeṣaḥ eva tatra syāt itarasya dvaye punar yā ca śakti antara udbhūtiḥ iyam eva viśeṣyatā na sāmānya aparityāgī kevalaḥ anyaiḥ viśeṣyate ukteḥ viśeṣaṇam kiñ cit ucyamāna viśeṣaṇam tena śakti apavādaḥ ayam bhavet artha apavāda vat tathā eva jvalana ādīnām pāka sambandhitā iṣyate itikartavya tā aṃśa tvāt pāke vā tad phale api vā

odane sādhyamāne hi pākaḥ karaṇam iṣyate akṛtaḥ saḥ api na asti iti punar karaṇa vāñchanam karaṇam jvalana ādīni tasya kāṣṭha ādi vā tathā itikarttavyatā kāṅkṣā yāvat karaṇa saṃśrayā itikarttavyatā api anyat apekṣya karaṇam bhavet jvalana ādi nimittā atas kāṣṭha ādeḥ pāka saṅgatiḥ karmaṇaḥ karma sādhya tvam na asmad pakṣe viruddhyate

anātma samavetasya nimittam karma hi iṣyate jvalana ādi svarūpam ca na kāṣṭha ādi bhari īpsitam pāka prayojitānām hi tad vṛttiḥ na antarīyakī kartṛ tve api ca kāṣṭha ādeḥ pāke syāt karaṇa ādi tā āvibhūtāni aśakti tvāt ekatve ca api apekṣayā jvalana ādiṣu sarveṣām svātantryāt kartṛ tā iṣyate tad svātantrya avagatyā eva prayuṅkte hi prayojakaḥ

niyuktānām tu tena eṣām karaṇa tvāt iva acyatā udbhūta devadatta ādi vyāpāra abhibhavāt bhavet yatra tu abhibhavaḥ teṣām na ekena api vivakṣyate kāṣṭha ādīni pacanti iti prayogaḥ tatra jāyate eka śabda gṛhīte api guṇa prādhānyam iṣyate ākhyāta pratyaya upātta bhāvanā kartṛ saṃkhya vat tasmāt yasya vivakṣyeta pradhānam dhātubhiḥ kriyā

sa kartā guṇa bhūtāni avyāpāre karaṇa ādi tā itikartavya tā aṃśena sarveṣām tena saṅgatiḥ avāntara kriyā yogāt pradhāna kriyayā saha vikalpa pratiṣedha ādeḥ virodhaḥ na ca vastunā abhāvam eva nan prāha vartamāna ādi kālikam nāma dhātu artha yogī ca niṣedhaḥ anya artha bhāj bhavet tatra vastu antara unmuktam vastu eva anuguṇam ca tat

ākhyāta pratyayaiḥ yoge nivṛtti arthaḥ pratīyate tatra ca ajñāta sandigdha viparīta artha vāraṇam asti na asti iti sandehe pākṣikā astitva bodhanam nivartyate nañā yat vā na astitā eva ucyate satī avyutpannasya tatra eva jāyate na astitāmatiḥ astitva māninaḥ sā eva vāryate viparīta dhīḥ apūrva abhāva vijñāna virodhāt svayam eva tu

nivartate astita abuddhiḥ mṛgatṛṣṇā ādi buddhi vat tat ca etat aniṣedhe api sthāṇu ādau īdṛś eva naḥ tatra api ajñāta sandigdha viparīta artha bādhanāt abhāvasya ca vastu tve purastāt pratipāmite ghaṭa ādi tulya tā tasya pratiṣedhaḥ na ca api ayam vidhāyakaiḥ asaṃyuktaḥ na hi nan pratiṣedhakaḥ abhāva kathanam hi etat na avaśyam prāpti pūrvakam

na ca śabdena sadbhāvaḥ tasya ca arthasya bodhitaḥ astitva ādi anapekṣam hi sāmānyam tena gamyate asti śabda prayogaḥ api tena eva atra upapadyate jāteḥ astitva nā asi tve na ca kaḥ cit vivakṣati nitya tvāt lakṣyamāṇāyāḥ vyakteḥ te hi viśeṣaṇe tena atra na virodhi tvam śrutyā pūrva uktayā nañaḥ yatra api asti iti upādāya prayujyeran naña ādayaḥ

tatra tasya apavāda tvāt pūrva jñāna upamardanam astitvam vā sat eva atra smaryate pūrva lakṣitam abhāva uttara kālam syāt viśeṣe tad vivakṣite vidhinā yujyate yatra na hanyāt na pibet iti tatra abhāva artha tā na eva svayam saḥ ruṇaddhi hi anyathā eva pravarttante bhāva abhāva dhiyaḥ aparāḥ vyavasthita bahis vastu pariccheda phala ātmikāḥ

anyathā anāgata utpādya bhāva preraṇa vārikā antar saṅkalpa mūla ātmā vṛttiḥ vidhi niṣedhayoḥ vikalpaḥ api anayoḥ eva viṣayeṣu pravarttate prāpteṣu pratiṣedha artham aprāpteṣu vidhitsayā yugapad ca viruddha artha pratipatteḥ asambhavaḥ paryāyeṇa kadā cit tu kā cit vṛttiḥ bhaviṣyati prāpta aprāpta vikalpaḥ tu na eva iṣṭaḥ loka vedayoḥ

na vikalpa artha vācī tu vā śabdaḥ viṣaya antare sthāṇuḥ vā puruṣaḥ vā iti yāti tiṣṭhati vā iti ayam sandeha kathana arthaḥ syāt na hi vastu vikalpate viṣaye bāhyaḥ eva evam pratiṣedha ādi sambhavaḥ na hi tad sambhavaḥ kaḥ cit jñāne svarasa bhaṅgini jñānam yat tāvat utpannam na anutpanam tat iṣyate

vināśe api samāna tvam satya mithyā avabodhayoḥ bāhya artha vādinaḥ tu arthe yat jñānam jāyate anyathā tad mithyā tva upasaṃkhyānāt pūrva badha ādi sambhavaḥ tatra api tu na tad rūpam bādhyate na ca bodhyate artha jñāna ādi rūpāt tu phalatas viprayujyate pratibhā an ekadhā puṃsām yadi api artheṣu jāyate

tathā api bāhyaḥ eva arthaḥ tasya vākyasya ca iṣyate vākya prayojana tvena janya tvena atha vā yadi ucyate pratibhā api arthaḥ na naḥ kiñ cit virudhyate śabda ādi utthāpitaiḥ jñānaiḥ ātma aṃśa grahaṇa akṣamaiḥ yat bāhyam āpyate vastu sa tu arthaḥ pāramārthikaḥ pratyakṣa vyatiriktam tu vijñānam upavarṇitam

tri kāla viṣayam yasmāt asannidhiḥ adūṣaṇam aneka ākāra tā yā api śūra bhīrudhiyam prati vāsanā anugrahāt sa uktā kuṇapa ādi mateḥ iva bhāvanā eva ca vākya arthaḥ sarvatra ākhyātavattayā aneka guṇa jāti ādi kāraka artha anurañjitā ekayā eva tu buddhyā asau gṛhyate citra rūpayā padārthā aahita saṃskāra citra piṇḍa prasūtayā

padārtha pada buddhīnām saṃsargaḥ tad apekṣayā padavyavadhinā ca eṣām na asaṃsargaḥ bhaviṣyati tulya kakṣaḥ hi asambandhī vyavadhāta iti kīrtyate aṅga tvāt tu padaiḥ na syāt aṅgivi a vadhi kalpanā ekasmin ca gṛhīte arthe sa upāyaḥ anyaḥ api apekṣyate apekṣyā ca sarvaḥ asau sambandham pratipadyate

padānām api sambandhaḥ evam vākyeṣu sidhyati padārtha pūrvakaḥ tasmāt vākya arthaḥ ayam avasthitaḥ artha rūpam iva āpannam vākyam vākyasya vākyasya gocaraḥ na iṣyate na hi abhedena vṛttiḥ asti iti sādhitam prasaṅgika ādi yat kāryam padārtha upanibandhanam ākāṅkṣā vidita praśnau yau ca dṛṣṭau pika ādiṣu

asatyam tat apa uddhṛtya na ca evam kalpyiṣyati śaśaśṛṅgādi apa uddhṛtya vākya arthaḥ na hi dṛśyate asatyaiḥ gamyamāne arthe satya tā na iti udāhṛtam svarūpeṇa asataḥ dṛṣṭam na upāya tvam hi kasya cit avācaka tvam vākyasya tad bhūtānām iti īritam hetuḥ syāt tad nimitta tm mūlam vā arthasya kathyate

padārtha mūlakaḥ hi eṣa na bhrāntiḥ iti gamyatām sākṣāt yadi api kurvanti padārtha pratipādanam varṇāḥ tathā api na etasmin paryavasyanti niṣphale vākya artha mitaye teṣām pravṛttau na antarīyakam pāke jvālā iva kāṣṭhānām padārtha pratipādanam prayojana tayā ca eṣām artham icchanti bhāvanām

kriyā arthena iti tena āha samāmnāya prayojanam śuklaḥ gauḥ iti vākya artha vākyayoḥ yat udāhṛtam sambandha kathana artham tat na jñeyam pāramārthikam na hi prayojana apetam vākyam uccāryate kva cit prayojana kṣamam na api padam ākhyāta varjitam gauḥ aśvaḥ iti vā śrutyā yat go tva ādi avabodhitam viśeṣe yadi tat na syāt tatra syāt śruti bādhanam

jāti vyaktī gṛhītvā eva vayam tu śruti lakṣite kṛṣṇa ādi yadi muñcāmaḥ kā śrutiḥ tatra bādhyate lakṣaṇa atas api paratas yaḥ sandehaḥ pravarttate kā nāma pīḍyate tatra śukla śrutyā nivartate agṛhṇataḥ tu śukla tvam śrutiḥ te bādhyatetarām asya vākyam asambaddham sarvam eva aprayojanam vākya arthaḥ api iti bhāṣyeṇa sa ulluṇṭham abhidhīyate

na sarvatra iti anena api kva cit sā na iti avocata prakṛti artha anuraktāyām buddhau nipatatā dhruvam karma ādīnām viśeṣya tvam iti kā vā śrutiḥ bhavet prakṛti pratyayau na api prayujyete ca kevalau yena yuṣmad abhipretā śrutiḥ labhyeta karhi cit yatra api nāma dṛśyete devalā vadhunā ādiva vat

tatra api anya artha saṃyuktau iti pūrvam nirūpitam ayam eva viśeṣaḥ ca kathyate pada vākyayoḥ arthavat bhāga tulya tve prakṛti pratyaya arthataḥ dṛṣṭāḥ yathā hi sa ākāṅkṣāḥ padārthāḥ kevalāḥ kva cit svātantryeṇa gṛhītāḥ ca viśīṣṭa artha avabodhakāḥ prakṛti pratyayau na evam kadā cit api lakṣitau

prakṛti artha anuraktaḥ hi pratyaya arthaḥ sadā iṣyate paśyataḥ śvetim ārūpam hreṣa aśabdam ca śṛṇvataḥ khura nikṣepa śabdam ca śvetaḥ aśvaḥ dhāvati iti dhīḥ dṛṣṭā vākya vinirmuktā na padārthaiḥ vinā kva cit mānasāt iti atas na asya vākya agrahaṇam uttaram mānasena aparādhena padārthān ye na gṛhṇate

te tat vākyam gṛhītvā api na artham gṛhṇanti karhi cit vākyena tena na ucyeta vākya arthaḥ anyaiḥ nirūpaṇāt tat śrutau api abodhāt vā palāśena iva vṛkṣa tā varṇāḥ vā na bruvanti enam tad sambandhi artha bodhanāt sattve api agamaka tvāt vā vṛkṣa tvam iva śiṃśapā padārthāḥ gamayanti etam pratyekam saṃśaye sati

sāmastye nirṇaya utpādāt sthāṇu mūrddha stha kāka vat tad abhāva apratīteḥ vā tad gamyaḥ ayam bhaviṣyati śrotra abhāvā pratīteḥ hi śrautram śabdam pracakṣate sambandha ākaraṇa nyāyāt vaktavyā vākya nitya tā saṅghāta tvasya vaktavyam īdṛśam pratisādhanam vedasya adhyayanam sarva guru adhyayana pūrvakam

veda adhyayana vācya tvāt adhunā adhyayanam yathā bhārate api bhavet evam kartṛ smṛtyā tu bādhyate vede api tad smṛtiḥ yā tu sārtha vāda nibandhanā pāramparyeṇa kartāram na adhyetāraḥ smaranti hi teṣām anevam ātma tvāt bhrāntiḥ sā iti ca vakṣyate teṣu ca dhriyamāṇeṣu na mūla antara kalpanā tathā hi adyatanasya api te kurvanti īdṛśīm matim

vacana antara sādharmyāt kartuḥ sāmānya samplave samākhyayā viśeṣaḥ ayam kaṭhādiḥ avadhāryate anapekṣa tva sūtre yā rūpāt kṛta katā uditā vede sā dṛśyate spaṣṭā kṛtaka artha abhidhāyini smṛti prayojana abhāvāt kartṛ mātre anapekṣite sāmānya siddhi apekṣa tvāt na samākhyā niyāmikā anyathā api upapanna tvāt iyam pravacana ādinā

na śaktā kartṛ mūlāya prokte ca smaraṇam sthitam śruti ādeḥ durbalā ca asau na śaktā tāni bādhitum aṅga bhūya aṃsam ekā iyam śabda rāśim na bādhate kāmam vā nirnimittā iyam śākhām ekām vadiṣyati śruti sāmānya mātram hi na atra daṇḍena vāyate sati sādhāraṇa tve vā sambhavena viśeṣaṇam yathā vairūpasāma iti sat tayā eva pratīyate

avyāsaṅgi ca sarveṣu pravaktṛ tvam kaṭha ādiṣu tena eka vyapadeśya tvam lakṣyate ḍittha mātṛ vat anyaiḥ tulye api sambandhe yat taiḥ na vyapadiśyatem na hi eṣa kartṛ saṃskāraḥ pārārthye ca ekaḥ iṣyate vidyamāna nimittam ca kathyate na asataḥ kriyā sādhāraṇam ca tīrtha ādi kena cit vyapadiśyate

yadi ca apauruṣeyī eṣā na anitya pratipādinī pauruṣeyyāḥ tu satya tvam katham adhyavasīyate nityam eva nimittam vā kaṭha tvam jātiḥ asti naḥ kāṭhaka ādi pravṛtti artham vyāvṛttam caraṇa antarāt anitya artha abhidhāyi tvam svayam eva eṣa muñcati nitya anitya vikalpena vedaḥ tādarthya varjanāt nityasya nityaḥ eva arthaḥ kṛtakasya apramāṇa tā unmatta vacana tvam tu pūrvam eva nirākṛtam iti pramāṇa tvam idam prasiddham yuktyā iha dharmam prati codanāyāḥ atas param tu pravibhajya vedam tredhā tatas vakṣyati yasya yaḥ arthaḥ

na svatas na api paratas na dvābhyām na api ahetutaḥ utpannāḥ jātu vidyante bhāvāḥ kva cana ke cana catvāraḥ pratyayāḥ hetuḥ ārambaṇam anantaram tathā eva ādhipateyam ca pratyayaḥ na asti pañcamaḥ na hi svabhāvaḥ bhāvānām pratyaya ādiṣu vidyate avidyamāne svabhāve para bhāvaḥ na vidyate kriyā na pratyayavatī na apratyayavatī kriyā pratyayāḥ na akriyāvantaḥ kriyāvantaḥ ca santi uta

utpadyate pratītya imān iti ime pratyayāḥ kila yāvat na utpadyate ime tāvat na apratyayāḥ katham na eva asataḥ na eva sataḥ pratyayaḥ arthasya yujyate asataḥ pratyayaḥ kasya sataḥ ca pratyayena kim na san na āsat na sat asan dharmaḥ nirvartate yadā katham nirvartakaḥ hetuḥ evam sati hi yujyate anārambaṇaḥ eva ayam san dharmaḥ upadiśyate atha anārambaṇe dharme kutas ārambaṇam punar

anutpanneṣu dharmeṣu nirodhaḥ na upapadyate na anantaram atas yuktam niruddhe pratyayaḥ ca kaḥ bhāvānām niḥsvabhāvānām na sattā vidyate yatas sati idam asmin bhavati iti etat na eva upapadyate na ca vyasta samasteṣu pratyayeṣu asti tat phalam pratyayebhyaḥ katham tat ca bhavet na pratyayeṣu yat

atha asat api tat tebhyaḥ pratyayebhyaḥ pravartate apratyayebhyaḥ api kasmāt na abhipravartate phalam phalam ca pratyaya mayam pratyayāḥ ca asvayaṃmayāḥ phalam asvamayebhyaḥ yat tat pratyaya mayam katham tasmāt na pratyaya mayam na apratyaya mayam phalam saṃvidyate phala abhāvāt pratyaya apratyayāḥ kutas

gatam na gamyate tāvat agatam na eva gamyate gatāgata vinirmuktam gamyamānam na gamyate ceṣṭā yatra gatiḥ tatra gamyamāne ca sā yatas na gate na āgate ceṣṭā gamyamāne gatiḥ tatas gamyamānasya gamanam katham nāma upapatsyate gamyamānam vigamanam yadā na eva upapadyate gamyamānasya gamanam yasya tasya prasajyate ṛte gateḥ gamyamānam gamyamānam hi gamyate

gamyamānasya gamane prasaktam gamana dvayam yena tat gamyamānam ca yat ca atra gamanam punar dvau gantārau prasajyete prasakte gamana dvaye gantāram hi tiraskṛtya gamanam na upapadyate gantāram ced tiraskṛtya gamanam na upapadyate gamane asati gantā atha kutas eva bhaviṣyati gantā na gacchati tāvat agantā na eva gacchati anyaḥ gantuḥ agantuḥ ca kaḥ tṛtīyaḥ atha gacchati

gantā tāvat gacchati iti katham eva upapatsyate gamanena vinā gantā yadā na eva upapadyate pakṣaḥ gantā gacchati iti yasya tasya prasajyate gamanena vinā gantā gantuḥ gamanam icchataḥ gamane dve prasajyete gantā yadi uta gacchati gantā iti ca ajyate yena gantā san yat ca gacchati gate na ārabhyate gantum gantum na ārabhyate agate na ārabhyate gamyamāne gantum ārabhyate kuha

na pūrvam gamana ārambhāt gamyamānam na vā gatam yatra ārabhyeta gamanam agate gamanam kutas gatam kim gamyamānam kim agatam kim vikalpyate adṛśyamānaḥ ārambhe gamanasya eva sarvathā gantā na tiṣṭhati tāvat agantā na eva tiṣṭhati anyaḥ gantuḥ agantuḥ ca kaḥ tṛtīyaḥ atha tiṣṭhati gantā tāvat tiṣṭhati iti katham eva upapatsyate gamanena vinā gantā yadā na eva upapadyate

na tiṣṭhati gamyamānāt na gatān na āgatāt api gamanam saṃpravṛttiḥ ca nivṛttiḥ ca gateḥ samā yat eva gamanam gantā saḥ eva iti na yujyate anyaḥ eva punar gantā gateḥ iti na yujyate yat eva gamanam gantā saḥ eva hi bhavet yadi ekībhāvaḥ prasajyeta kartuḥ karmaṇaḥ eva ca anyaḥ eva punar gantā gateḥ yadi vikalpyate gamanam syāt ṛte gantuḥ gantā syāt gamanāt ṛte

ekībhāvena vā siddhiḥ nānā bhāvena vā yayoḥ na vidyate tayoḥ siddhiḥ katham nu khalu vidyate gatyā yayā ajyate gantā gatim tām sa na gacchati yasmāt na gati pūrvaḥ asti kaścid kiṃcid dhi gacchati gatyā yayā ajyate gantā tatas anyām sa na gacchati gatī dve na upapadyete yasmāt eke tu gantari sadbhūtaḥ gamanam gantā tri prakāram na gacchati na asat bhūtaḥ api gamanam tri prakāram sa gacchati gamanam sat asat bhūtaḥ tri prakāram na gacchati tasmāt gatiḥ ca gantā ca gantavyam ca na vidyate

darśanam śravaṇam ghrāṇam rasanam sparśanam manaḥ indriyāṇi ṣaṭ eteṣām draṣṭavī a ādīni gocaraḥ svam ātmānam darśanam hi tat tam eva na paśyati na paśyati yat ātmānam katham drakṣyati tat parān na paryāptaḥ agni dṛṣṭāntaḥ darśanasya prasiddhaye sa darśanaḥ sa pratyuktaḥ gamyamāna gata āgataiḥ

na apaśyamānam bhavati yadā kim cana darśanam darśanam paśyati iti evam katham etat tu yujyate paśyati darśanam na eva na eva paśyati adarśanam vyākhyātaḥ darśanena eva draṣṭā ca api avagamyatām draṣṭā na asti atiraskṛtya tiraskṛtya ca darśanam draṣṭavyam darśanam ca eva draṣṭari asati te kutas pratītya mātā pitarau yathā uktaḥ putra saṃbhavaḥ cakṣū rūpe pratītyā evam uktaḥ vijñāna saṃbhavaḥ draṣṭavya darśana abhāvāt vijñāna ādi catuṣṭayam na asti iti upādāna ādīni bhaviṣyanti punar katham vyākhyātam śravaṇam ghrāṇam rasanam sparśanam manaḥ darśanena eva jānīyāt śrotṛ śrotavyaka ādi ca

rūpa kāraṇa nirmuktam na rūpam upalabhyate rūpeṇa api na nirmuktam dṛśyate rūpa kāraṇam rūpa kāraṇa nirmukte rūpe rūpam prasajyate āhetukam na ca asti arthaḥ kaścid āhetukaḥ kva cit rūpeṇa tu vinirmuktam yadi syāt rūpa kāraṇam akāryakam kāraṇam syāt na asti akāryam ca kāraṇam rūpe sati eva rūpasya kāraṇam na upapadyate rūpe asati eva rūpasya kāraṇam na upapadyate

niṣkāraṇam punā rūpam na eva na eva upapadyate tasmāt rūpa gatān kāṃścid na vikalpān vikalpayet na kāraṇasya sadṛśam kāryam iti upapadyate na kāraṇasya asadṛśam kāryam iti upapadyate vedanā citta saṃjñānām saṃskārāṇām ca sarvaśas sarveṣām eva bhāvānām rūpeṇa eva samaḥ kramaḥ vigrahe yaḥ parīhāram kṛte śūnyatayā vadet sarvam tasya aparihṛtam samam sādhyena jāyate vyākhyāne yaḥ upālambham kṛte śūnyatayā vadet sarvam tasya anupālabdham samam sādhyena jāyate

na ākāśam vidyate kiṃcid pūrvam ākāśa lakṣaṇāt alakṣaṇam prasajyeta syāt pūrvam yadi lakṣaṇāt alakṣaṇaḥ na kaścid ca bhāvaḥ saṃvidyate kva cit asati alakṣaṇe bhāve kramatām kuha lakṣaṇam na alakṣaṇe lakṣaṇasya pravṛttiḥ na sa lakṣaṇe sa lakṣaṇa alakṣaṇābhyām na api anyatra pravartate lakṣaṇa asaṃpravṛttau ca na lakṣyam upapadyate lakṣyasya anupapattau ca lakṣaṇasya api asaṃbhavaḥ

tasmāt na vidyate lakṣyam lakṣaṇam na eva vidyate lakṣya lakṣaṇa nirmuktaḥ na eva bhāvaḥ api vidyate avidyamāne bhāve ca kasya abhāvaḥ bhaviṣyati bhāva abhāva vidharmā ca bhāva abhāvau avaiti kaḥ tasmāt na bhāvaḥ na abhāvaḥ na lakṣyam na api lakṣaṇam ākāśam ākāśa samāḥ dhātavaḥ pañca ye apare astitvam ye tu paśyanti nāstitvam ca alpabuddhayaḥ bhāvānām te na paśyanti draṣṭavya upaśamam śivam

rāgāt yadi bhavet pūrvam raktaḥ rāga tiraskṛtaḥ tam pratītya bhavet rāgaḥ rakte rāgaḥ bhavet sati rakte asati punā rāgaḥ kutas eva bhaviṣyati sati vā asati vā rāge rakte api eṣa samaḥ kramaḥ saha eva punar udbhūtiḥ na yuktā rāga raktayoḥ bhavetām rāga raktau hi nirapekṣau parasparam na ekatve sahabhāvaḥ asti na tena eva hi tat saha pṛthaktve sahabhāvaḥ atha kutas eva bhaviṣyati

eka tve sahabhāvaḥ ced syāt sahāyam vinā api saḥ pṛthaktve sahabhāvaḥ ced syāt sahāyam vinā api saḥ pṛthaktve sahabhāvaḥ ca yadi kim rāga raktayoḥ siddhaḥ pṛthak pṛthagbhāvaḥ sahabhāvaḥ yatas tayoḥ siddhaḥ pṛthak pṛthagbhāvaḥ yadi vā rāga raktayoḥ sahabhāvam kimartham tu parikalpayase tayoḥ

pṛthak na sidhyati iti evam sahabhāvam vikāṅkṣasi sahabhāva prasiddhi artham pṛthaktvam bhūyas icchasi pṛthak bhāva aprasiddheḥ ca sahabhāvaḥ na sidhyati katamasmin pṛthagbhāve sahabhāvam sati icchasi evam raktena rāgasya siddhiḥ na saha na asaha rāga vat sarva dharmāṇām siddhiḥ na saha na asaha

yadi saṃskṛtaḥ utpādaḥ tatra yuktā tri lakṣaṇī atha asaṃskṛtaḥ utpādaḥ katham saṃskṛta lakṣaṇam utpāda ādyāḥ trayaḥ vyastāḥ na alam lakṣaṇa karmaṇi saṃskṛtasya samastāḥ syuḥ ekatra katham ekadā utpāda sthiti bhaṅgānām anyat saṃskṛta lakṣaṇam asti ced anavasthā evam na asti ced te na saṃskṛtāḥ utpāda utpādaḥ utpādaḥ mūla utpādasya kevalam utpāda utpādam utpādaḥ maulaḥ janayate punar

utpāda utpādaḥ utpādaḥ mūla utpādasya te yadi maulena ajanitaḥ tam te sa katham janayiṣyati sa te maulena janitaḥ maulam janayate yadi maulaḥ sa tena ajanitaḥ tam utpādayate katham ayam utpādyamānaḥ te kāmam utpādayet imam yadi imam utpādayitum ajātaḥ śaknuyāt ayam pradīpaḥ sva para ātmānau saṃprakāśayate yathā utpādaḥ sva para ātmānau ubhau utpādayet tathā

pradīpe na andhakāraḥ asti yatra ca asau pratiṣṭhitaḥ kim prakāśayate dīpaḥ prakāśaḥ hi tamaḥ vadhaḥ katham utpadyamānena pradīpena tamaḥ hatam na utpadyamānaḥ hi tamaḥ pradīpaḥ prāpnute yadā aprāpya eva pradīpena yadi vā nihatam tamaḥ ihasthaḥ sarva loka stham sa tamaḥ nihaniṣyati pradīpaḥ sva para ātmānau saṃprakāśayate yadi tamaḥ api sva para ātmānau chādayiṣyati asaṃśayam

anutpannaḥ ayam utpādaḥ sva ātmānam janayet katham atha utpannaḥ janayate jāte kim janyate punar na utpadyamānam na utpannam na anutpannam katham cana utpadyate tat ākhyātam gamyamāna gata āgataiḥ utpadyamānam utpattau idam na kramate yadā katham utpadyamānam tu pratītya utpattim ucyate pratītya yat yat bhavati tat tat śāntam svabhāvataḥ tasmāt utpadyamānam ca śāntam utpattiḥ eva ca

yadi kaścid anutpannaḥ bhāvaḥ saṃvidyate kva cit utpadyeta sa kim tasmin bhāvaḥ utpadyate asati utpadyamānam utpādaḥ yadi ca utpādayati ayam utpādayet tam utpādam utpādaḥ katamaḥ punar anyaḥ utpādayati enam yadi utpādaḥ anavasthitiḥ atha anutpādaḥ utpannaḥ sarvam utpadyatām tathā sataḥ ca tāvat utpattiḥ asataḥ ca na yujyate na sataḥ ca asataḥ ca iti pūrvam eva upapāditam

nirudhyamānasya utpattiḥ na bhāvasya upapadyate yaḥ ca anirudhyamānaḥ tu sa bhāvaḥ na upapadyate na āsthitaḥ tiṣṭhate bhāvaḥ sthitaḥ bhāvaḥ na tiṣṭhati na tiṣṭhate tiṣṭhamānaḥ kaḥ anutpannaḥ ca tiṣṭhati sthitiḥ nirudhyamānasya na bhāvasya upapadyate yaḥ ca anirudhyamānaḥ tu sa bhāvaḥ na upapadyate jarā maraṇa dharmeṣu sarva bhāveṣu sarvadā tiṣṭhanti katame bhāvāḥ ye jarā maraṇam vinā

sthityā anyayā sthiteḥ sthānam tayā eva ca na yujyate utpādasya yathā utpādaḥ na ātmanā na para ātmanā nirudhyate na aniruddham na niruddham nirudhyate tathā nirudhyamānam ca kim ajātam nirudhyate sthitasya tāvat bhāvasya nirodhaḥ na upapadyate na asthitasya api bhāvasya nirodhaḥ upapadyate tayā eva avasthayā avasthā na hi sā eva nirudhyate anyayā avasthayā avasthā na ca anyā eva nirudhyate

yadā eva sarva dharmāṇām utpādaḥ na upapadyate tadā evam sarva dharmāṇām nirodhaḥ na upapadyate sataḥ ca tāvat bhāvasya nirodhaḥ na upapadyate eka tve na hi bhāvaḥ ca na abhāvaḥ ca upapadyate asataḥ api na bhāvasya nirodhaḥ upapadyate na dvitīyasya śirasaḥ chedanam vidyate yathā na sva ātmanā nirodhaḥ asti nirodhaḥ na para ātmanā utpādasya yathā utpādaḥ na ātmanā na para ātmanā utpāda sthiti bhaṅgānām asiddheḥ na asti saṃskṛtam saṃskṛtasya aprasiddhau ca katham setsyati asaṃskṛtam yathā māyā yathā svapnaḥ gandharvanagaram yathā tathā utpādaḥ tathā sthānam tathā bhaṅgaḥ udāhṛtam

sadbhūtaḥ kārakaḥ karma sadbhūtam na karoti ayam kārakaḥ na api asat bhūtaḥ karma asadbhūtam īhate sadbhūtasya kriyā na asti karma ca syāt akartṛkam sadbhūtasya kriyā na asti kartā ca syāt akarmakaḥ karoti yadi asat bhūtaḥ asat bhūtam karma kārakaḥ ahetukam bhavet karma kartā ca ahetukaḥ bhavet hetau asati kāryam ca kāraṇam ca na vidyate tad abhāve kriyā kartā kāraṇam ca na vidyate

dharma adharmau na vidyete kriyā ādīnām asaṃbhave dharme ca asati adharme ca phalam tad jam na vidyate phale asati na mokṣāya na svargāya upapadyate mārgaḥ sarva kriyāṇām ca nairarthakyam prasajyate kārakaḥ sadasat bhūtaḥ sat asat kurute na tat paraspara viruddham hi sat ca asat ca ekatas kutas

satā ca kriyate na asat na asatā kriyate ca sat kartrā sarve prasajyante doṣāḥ tatra te eva hi na asat bhūtam na sadbhūtaḥ sadasat bhūtam eva vā karoti kārakaḥ karma pūrva uktaiḥ eva hetubhiḥ na asat bhūtaḥ api sadbhūtam sadasat bhūtam eva vā karoti kārakaḥ karma pūrva uktaiḥ eva hetubhiḥ karoti sat asat bhūtaḥ na san na asat ca kārakaḥ karma tat tu vijānīyāt pūrva uktaiḥ eva hetubhiḥ pratītya kārakaḥ karma tam pratītya ca kārakam karma pravartate na anyat paśyāmaḥ siddhi kāraṇam evam vidyāt upādānam vyutsargāt iti karmaṇaḥ kartuḥ ca karma kartṛbhyām śeṣān bhāvān vibhāvayet

darśana śravaṇa ādīni vedanā ādīni ca api atha bhavanti yasya prāk ebhyaḥ saḥ asti iti eke vadanti uta katham hi avidyamānasya darśana ādi bhaviṣyati bhāvasya tasmāt prāk ebhyaḥ saḥ asti bhāvaḥ vyavasthitaḥ darśana śravaṇa ādibhyaḥ vedanā ādibhyaḥ eva ca yaḥ prāk vyavasthitaḥ bhāvaḥ kena prajñapyate atha saḥ

vinā api darśana ādīni yadi ca asau vyavasthitaḥ amūni api bhaviṣyanti vinā tena na saṃśayaḥ ajyate kenacid kaścid kiṃcid kena cit ajyate kutas kiṃcid vinā kaścid kiṃcid kiṃcid vinā kutas sarvebhyaḥ darśana ādibhyaḥ kaścid pūrvaḥ na vidyate ajyate darśana ādinām anyena punar anyadā sarvebhyaḥ darśana ādibhyaḥ yadi pūrvaḥ na vidyate ekaikasmāt katham pūrvaḥ darśana ādeḥ sa vidyate

draṣṭā saḥ eva sa śrotā saḥ eva yadi vedakaḥ ekaikasmāt bhavet pūrvam evam ca etat na yujyate draṣṭā anyaḥ eva śrotā anyaḥ vedakaḥ anyaḥ punar yadi sati syāt draṣṭari śrotā bahu tvam ca ātmanām bhavet darśana śravaṇa ādīni vedanā ādīni ca api atha bhavanti yebhyaḥ teṣu eṣa bhūteṣu api na vidyate darśana śravaṇa ādīni vedanā ādīni ca api atha na vidyate ced yasya sa na vidyante imāni api prāk ca yaḥ darśana ādibhyaḥ sāṃpratam ca ūrdhvam eva ca na vidyate asti na asti iti nivṛttāḥ tatra kalpanāḥ

yat indhanam sa ced agniḥ ekatvam kartṛ karmaṇoḥ anyaḥ ced indhanāt agniḥ indhanāt api ṛte bhavet nitya pradīptaḥ eva syāt apradīpana hetukaḥ punar ārambha vaiyarthyam evam ca akarmakaḥ sati paratra nirapekṣa tvāt apradīpana hetukaḥ punar ārambha vaiyarthyam nitya dīptaḥ prasajyate tatra etat syāt idhyamānam indhanam bhavati iti ced kena idhyatām indhanam tat tāvat mātram idam yadā

anyaḥ na prāpsyate apraptaḥ na dhakṣyati adahan punar na nirvāsyati anirvāṇaḥ sthāsyate vā sva liṅgavān anyaḥ evandhanāt agniḥ indhanam prāpnuyāt yadi strī saṃprāpnoti puruṣam puruṣaḥ ca striyam yathā anyaḥ eva indhanāt agniḥ indhanam kāmam āpnuyāt agni indhane yadi syātām anyonyena tiraskṛte

yadi indhanam apekṣya agniḥ apekṣya agnim yadi indhanam katarat pūrva niṣpannam yat apekṣya agniḥ indhanam yadi indhanam apekṣya agniḥ agneḥ siddhasya sādhanam evam sati indhanam ca api bhaviṣyati niragnikam yaḥ apekṣya sidhyate bhāvaḥ tam eva apekṣya sidhyati yadi yaḥ apekṣitavyaḥ sa sidhyatām kam apekṣya kaḥ

yaḥ apekṣya sidhyate bhāvaḥ saḥ asiddhaḥ apekṣate katham atha api apekṣate siddhaḥ tu apekṣā asya na yujyate apekṣya indhanam agniḥ na na anapekṣya agniḥ indhanam apekṣya indhanam agnim na na anapekṣya agnim indhanam āgacchati anyatas na agniḥ indhane agniḥ na vidyate atra indhane śeṣam uktam gamyamāna gata āgataiḥ

indhanam punar agniḥ na na agniḥ anyatra ca indhanāt na agniḥ indhanavān na agnau indhanāni na teṣu saḥ agni indhanābhyām vyākhyātaḥ ātma upādānayoḥ kramaḥ sarvaḥ niravaśeṣeṇa sārdham ghaṭa paṭa ādibhiḥ ātmanaḥ ca satattvam ye bhāvānām ca pṛthak pṛthak nirdiśanti na tān manye śāsanasya artha kovidān

pūrvā prajñāyate koṭiḥ na iti uvāca mahā muniḥ saṃsāraḥ anavara agraḥ hi na asya ādiḥ na api paścimam na eva agram na avaram yasya tasya madhyam kutas bhavet tasmāt na atra upapadyante pūrva apara saha kramāḥ pūrvam jātiḥ yadi bhavet jarā maraṇam uttaram nirjarā maraṇā jātiḥ bhavet jāyeta ca amṛtaḥ paścāt jātiḥ yadi bhavet jarā maraṇam āditas ahetukam ajātasya syāt jarā maraṇam katham

na jarā maraṇam ca eva jātiḥ ca saha yujyate mriyeta jāyamānaḥ ca syāt ca ahetu katobhayoḥ yatra na prabhavanti ete pūrva apara sahakramāḥ prapañcayanti tām jātim tat jarā maraṇam ca kim kāryam ca kāraṇam ca eva lakṣyam lakṣaṇam eva ca vedanā vedakaḥ ca eva santi arthāḥ ye ca ke cana pūrvā na vidyate koṭiḥ saṃsārasya na kevalam sarveṣām api bhāvānām pūrvā koṭī na vidyate

svayam kṛtam para kṛtam dvābhyām kṛtam ahetukam duḥkham iti ekaḥ icchanti tat ca kāryam na yujyate svayam kṛtam yadi bhavet pratītya na tatas bhavet skandhān imān amī skandhāḥ saṃbhavanti pratītya hi yadi amībhyaḥ ime anye syuḥ ebhyaḥ vā amī pare yadi bhavet para kṛtam duḥkham paraiḥ ebhiḥ amī kṛtāḥ

sva pudgala kṛtam duḥkham yadi duḥkham punar vinā sva pudgalaḥ sa katamaḥ yena duḥkham svayam kṛtam para pudgala jam duḥkham yadi yasmai pradīyate pareṇa kṛtvā tat duḥkham sa duḥkhena vinā kutas para pudgala jam duḥkham yadi kaḥ para pudgalaḥ vinā duḥkhena yaḥ kṛtvā parasmai prahiṇoti tat

svayam kṛtasya aprasiddheḥ duḥkham para kṛtam kutas paraḥ hi duḥkham yat kuryāt tat tasya syāt svayam kṛtam na tāvat sva kṛtam duḥkham na hi tena eva tat kṛtam paraḥ na ātma kṛtaḥ ced syāt duḥkham para kṛtam katham syāt ubhābhyām kṛtam duḥkham syāt ekaika kṛtam yadi para ākāra asvayaṃkāram duḥkham ahetukam kutas na kevalam hi duḥkhasya cāturvidhyam na vidyate bāhyānām api bhāvānām cāturvidhyam na vidyate

tat mṛṣā moṣa dharma yat bhagavān iti abhāṣata sarve ca moṣa dharmāṇaḥ saṃskārāḥ tena te mṛṣā tat mṛṣā moṣa dharma yat yadi kim tatra muṣyate etat tu uktam bhagavatā śūnyatā paridīpakam bhāvānām niḥsvabhāva tvam anyathā abhāva darśanāt na asvabhāvaḥ ca bhāvaḥ asti bhāvānām śūnyatā yatas kasya syāt anyathā bhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ ced na vidyate kasya syāt anyathā bhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ yadi vidyate

tasya eva na anyathā bhāvaḥ na api anyasya eva yujyate yuvā na jīryate yasmāt yasmāt jīrṇaḥ na jīryate tasya ced anyathā bhāvaḥ kṣīram eva bhavet dadhi kṣīrāt anyasya kasyacid dadhi bhāvaḥ bhaviṣyati yadi aśūnyam bhavet kiṃcid syāt śūnyam iti kim cana na kiṃcid asti aśūnyam ca kutas śūnyam bhaviṣyati śūnyatā sarva dṛṣṭīnām proktā niḥsaraṇam jinaiḥ yeṣām tu śūnyatā dṛṣṭiḥ tān asādhyān babhāṣire

draṣṭavyam darśanam draṣṭā trīṇi etāni dviśas dviśas sarvaśas ca na saṃsargam anyonyena vrajanti uta evam rāgaḥ ca raktaḥ ca rañjanīyam ca dṛśyatām traidhena śeṣāḥ kleśāḥ ca śeṣāṇi āyatanāni ca anyena anyasya saṃsargaḥ tat ca anya tvam na vidyate draṣṭavya prabhṛtīnām yat na saṃsargam vrajanti atas

na ca kevalam anya tvam draṣṭavī a ādeḥ na vidyate kasyacid kenacid sārdham na anyatvam upapadyate anyat anyat pratītya anyat na anyat anyat ṛte anyatas yat pratītya ca yat tasmāt tat anyat na upapadyate yadi anyat anyat anyasmāt anyasmāt api ṛte bhavet tat anyat anyat anyasmāt ṛte na asti ca na asti atas na anyasmin vidyate anya tvam ananyasmin na vidyate avidyamāne ca anya tve na asti anyat vā tat eva vā na tena tasya saṃsargaḥ na anyena anyasya yujyate saṃsṛjyamānam saṃsṛṣṭam saṃsraṣṭā ca na vidyate

na saṃbhavaḥ svabhāvasya yuktaḥ pratyaya hetubhiḥ hetu pratyaya saṃbhūtaḥ svabhāvaḥ kṛtakaḥ bhavet svabhāvaḥ kṛtakaḥ nāma bhaviṣyati punar katham akṛtrimaḥ svabhāvaḥ hi nirapekṣaḥ paratra ca kutas svabhāvasya abhāve para bhāvaḥ bhaviṣyati svabhāvaḥ para bhāvasya para bhāvaḥ hi kathyate svabhāva para bhāvābhyām ṛte bhāvaḥ kutas punar svabhāve para bhāve ca sati bhāvaḥ hi sidhyati

bhāvasya ced aprasiddhiḥ abhāvaḥ na eva sidhyati bhāvasya hi anyathābhāvam abhāvam bruvate janāḥ svabhāvam para bhāvam ca bhāvam ca abhāvam eva ca ye paśyanti na paśyanti te tattvam buddha śāsane kātyāyana avavāde ca asti iti na asti iti ca ubhayam pratiṣiddham bhagavatā bhāva abhāva vibhāvinā yadi astitvam prakṛtyā syāt na bhavet asya na astitā prakṛteḥ anyathā bhāvaḥ na hi jātu upapadyate

prakṛtau kasya vāsatyām anyathātvam bhaviṣyati prakṛtau kasya vā satyām anyathātvam bhaviṣyati asti iti śāśvata grāhaḥ na asti iti uccheda darśanam tasmāt astitvanā astitve na aśrīyeta vicakṣaṇaḥ asti yat dhi svabhāvena na tat na asti iti śāśvatam na asti idānīm abhūt pūrvam iti ucchedaḥ prasajyate

saṃskārāḥ saṃsaranti ced na nityāḥ saṃsaranti te saṃsaranti ca na anityāḥ sattve api eṣa samaḥ kramaḥ pudgalaḥ saṃsarati ced skandha āyatana dhātuṣu pañcadhā mṛgyamāṇaḥ asau na asti kaḥ saṃsariṣyati upādānāt upādānam saṃsaran vibhavaḥ bhavet vibhavaḥ ca anupādānaḥ kaḥ sa kim saṃsariṣyati saṃskārāṇām na nirvāṇam katham cit upapadyate sattvasya api na nirvāṇam katham cit upapadyate

na badhyante na mucyante udaya vyaya dharmiṇaḥ saṃskārāḥ pūrvavat sattvaḥ badhyate na na mucyate bandhanam ced upādānam sa upādānaḥ na badhyate badhyate na anupādānaḥ kimavasthaḥ atha badhyate badhnīyāt bandhanam kāmam bandhyāt pūrvam bhavet yadi na ca asti tat śeṣam uktam gamyamāna gata āgataiḥ baddhaḥ na mucyate tāvat abaddhaḥ na eva mucyate syātām baddhe mucyamāne yugapad bandha mokṣaṇe nirvāsyāmi anupādānaḥ nirvāṇam me bhaviṣyati iti yeṣām grahaḥ teṣām upādāna mahā grahaḥ na nirvāṇa samāropaḥ na saṃsāra apakarṣaṇam yatra kaḥ tatra saṃsāraḥ nirvāṇam kim vikalpyate

ātma saṃyamakam cetaḥ para anugrāhakam ca yat maitram sa dharamaḥ tat bījam phalasya pretya ca iha ca cetanā cetayitvā ca karma uktam parama ṛṣiṇā tasya anekavidhaḥ bhedaḥ karmaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ tatra yat cetanā iti uktam karma tat mānasam smṛtam cetayitvā ca yat tu uktam tat tu kāyika vācikam vāc viṣpandaḥ aviratayaḥ yāḥ ca avijñapti saṃjñitāḥ avijñaptayaḥ eva anyāḥ smṛtāḥ viratayaḥ tathā

paribhoga anvayam puṇyam apuṇyam ca tathāvidham cetanā ca iti saptā ete dharmāḥ karma añjanāḥ smṛtāḥ tiṣṭhati ā pāka kālāt ced karma tat nityatām iyāt niruddham ced niruddham sat kim phalam janayiṣyati yaḥ aṅkura prabhṛtiḥ bījāt saṃtānaḥ abhipravartate tatas phalam ṛte bījāt sa ca na abhipravartate

bījāt ca yasmāt saṃtānaḥ saṃtānāt ca phala udbhavaḥ bīja pūrvam phalam tasmāt na ucchinnam na api śāśvatam yaḥ tasmāt citta saṃtānaḥ cetasaḥ abhipravartate tatas phalam ṛte cittāt sa ca na abhipravartate cittāt ca yasmāt saṃtānaḥ saṃtānāt ca phala udbhavaḥ karma pūrvam phalam tasmāt na ucchinnam na api śāśvatam

dharmasya sādhana upāyāḥ śuklāḥ karma pathāḥ daśa phalam kāma guṇāḥ pañca dharmasya pretya ca iha ca bahavaḥ ca mahāntaḥ ca doṣāḥ syuḥ yadi kalpanā syāt eṣā tena na eva eṣā kalpanātra upapadyate imām punar pravakṣyāmi kalpanām yā atra yojyate buddhaiḥ pratyekabuddhaiḥ ca śrāvakaiḥ ca anuvarṇitām

pattram yathā avipraṇāśaḥ tathā ṛṇam iva karma ca caturvidhaḥ dhātutaḥ sa prakṛtyā vyākṛtaḥ ca saḥ prahāṇataḥ na praheyaḥ bhāvanā heyaḥ eva vā tasmāt avipraṇāśena jāyate karmaṇām phalam prahāṇataḥ praheyaḥ syāt karmaṇaḥ saṃkrameṇa vā yadi doṣāḥ prasajyeran tatra karma vadha ādayaḥ sarveṣām visa bhāgānām sa bhāgānām ca karmaṇām pratisaṃdhau sa dhātūnām ekaḥ utpadyate tu saḥ

karmaṇaḥ karmaṇaḥ dṛṣṭe dharmaḥ utpadyate tu saḥ dvi prakārasya sarvasya vipakve api ca tiṣṭhati phala vyatikramāt vā sa maraṇāt vā nirudhyate anāsravam sa āsravam ca vibhāgam tatra lakṣayet śūnyatā ca na ca ucchedaḥ saṃsāraḥ ca na śāśvatam karmaṇaḥ avipraṇāśaḥ ca dharmaḥ buddhena deśitaḥ

karma na utpadyate kasmāt niḥsvabhāvam yatas tatas yasmāt ca tat anutpannam na tasmāt vipraṇaśyati karma svabhāvataḥ ced syāt śāśvatam syāt asaṃśayam akṛtam ca bhavet karma kriyate na hi śāśvatam akṛta abhyāgam abhayam syāt karma akṛtakam yadi abrahmacarya vāsaḥ ca doṣaḥ tatra prasajyate

vyavahārāḥ virudhyante sarve eva na saṃśayaḥ puṇya pāpa kṛtoḥ na eva pravibhāgaḥ ca yujyate tat vipakva vipākam ca punar eva vipakṣyati karma vyavasthitam yasmāt tasmāt svābhāvikam yadi karma kleśa ātmakam ca idam te ca kleśāḥ na tattvataḥ na ced te tattvataḥ kleśāḥ karma syāt tattvataḥ katham

karma kleśāḥ ca dehānām pratyayāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ karma kleśāḥ ca te śūnyā yadi deheṣu kā kathā avidyā nivṛtaḥ jantuḥ tṛṣṇā saṃyojanaḥ ca saḥ sa bhoktā sa ca na kartuḥ anyaḥ na ca saḥ eva saḥ na pratyaya samutpannam na apratyaya samutthitam asti yasmāt idam karma tasmāt kartā api na asti atas karma ced na asti kartā ca kutas syāt karma jam phalam asatī atha phale bhoktā kutas eva bhaviṣyati yathā nirmitakam śāstā nirmimīta rddhi saṃpadā nirmitaḥ nirmimīta anyam sa ca nirmitakaḥ punar tathā nirmitaka ākāraḥ kartā yat karma tat kṛtam tat yathā nirmitena anyaḥ nirmitaḥ nirmitaḥ tathā kleśāḥ karmāṇi dehāḥ ca kartāraḥ ca phalāni ca gandharvanagara ākārāḥ marīci svapna saṃnibhāḥ

ātmā skandhā yadi bhavet udayavyaya bhāj bhavet skandhebhyaḥ anyaḥ yadi bhavet bhavet askandha lakṣaṇaḥ ātmani asati ca ātmīyam kutas eva bhaviṣyati nirmamaḥ nirahaṃkāraḥ śamāt ātma ātmanīnayoḥ nirmamaḥ nirahaṃkāraḥ yaḥ ca saḥ api na vidyate nirmamam nirahaṃkāram yaḥ paśyati na paśyati mama iti aham iti kṣīṇe bahirdhā adhyātmam eva ca nirudhyate upādānam tad kṣayāt janmanaḥ kṣayaḥ

karma kleśa kṣayāt mokṣaḥ karma kleśāḥ vikalpataḥ te prapañcāt prapañcaḥ tu śūnyatāyām nirudhyate ātmā iti api prajñapitam anātmā iti api deśitam buddhaiḥ na ātmā na ca anātmā kaścid iti api deśitam nivṛttam abhidhātavyam nivṛttaḥ citta gocaraḥ anutpanna aniruddhā hi nirvāṇam iva dharma tā sarvam tathyam na vā tathyam tathyam ca atathyam eva ca na eva atathyam na eva tathyam etat buddha anuśāsanam

apara pratyayam śāntam prapañcaiḥ aprapañcitam nirvikalpam anāna artham etat tattvasya lakṣaṇam pratītya yat yat bhavati na hi tāvat tat eva tat na ca anyat api tat tasmāt na ucchinnam na api śāśvatam aneka artham anāna artham anucchedam aśāśvatam etat tat lokanāthānām buddhānām śāsana amṛtam saṃbuddhānām anutpāde śrāvakāṇām punar kṣaye jñānam pratyekabuddhānām asaṃsargāt pravartate

pratyutpannaḥ anāgataḥ ca yadi atītam apekṣya hi pratyutpannaḥ anāgataḥ ca kāle atīte bhaviṣyataḥ pratyutpannaḥ anāgataḥ ca na staḥ tatra punar yadi pratyutpannaḥ anāgataḥ ca syātām katham apekṣya tam anapekṣya punar siddhiḥ na atītam vidyate tayoḥ pratyutpannaḥ anāgataḥ ca tasmāt kālaḥ na vidyate etena eva avaśiṣṭau dvau krameṇa parivartakau uttama adhama madhya ādīn eka tva ādīn ca lakṣayet na āsthitaḥ gṛhyate kālaḥ sthitaḥ kālaḥ na vidyate yaḥ gṛhyeta agṛhītaḥ ca kālaḥ prajñapyate katham bhāvam pratītya kālaḥ ced kālaḥ bhāvāt ṛte kutas na ca kaḥ cana bhāvaḥ asti kutas kālaḥ bhaviṣyati

hetoḥ ca pratyayānām ca sāmagryā jāyate yadi phalam asti ca sāmagryām sāmagryā jāyate katham hetoḥ ca pratyayānām ca sāmagryā jāyate yadi phalam na asti ca sāmagryām sāmagryā jāyate katham hetoḥ ca pratyayānām ca sāmagryām asti ced phalam gṛhyeta nanu sāmagryām sāmagryām ca na gṛhyate

hetoḥ ca pratyayānām ca sāmagryām na asti ced phalam hetavaḥ pratyayāḥ ca syuḥ ahetu pratyayaiḥ samāḥ hetum phalasya dattvā ca yadi hetuḥ nirudhyate yat dattam yat nirudham ca hetoḥ ātma dvayam bhavet hetum phalasya adattvā ca yadi hetuḥ nirudhyate hetau niruddhe jātam tat phalam āhetukam bhavet

phalam saha eva sāmagryāḥ yadi prādurbhavet punar eka kālau prasajyete janakaḥ yaḥ ca janyate pūrvam eva ca sāmagryāḥ phalam prādurbhavet yadi hetu pratyaya nirmuktam phalam āhetukam bhavet niruddhe ced phalam hetau hetoḥ saṃkramaṇam bhavet pūrva jātasya hetoḥ ca punarjanma prasajyate janayet phalam utpannam niruddhaḥ astaṃgataḥ katham hetuḥ tiṣṭhan api katham phalena janayet vṛtaḥ

atha āvṛtaḥ phalena asau katamat janayet phalam na hi adṛṣṭvā na dṛṣṭvā api hetuḥ janayate phalam na atītasya hi atītena phalasya saha hetunā na ajātena na jātena saṃgatiḥ jātu vidyate na jātasya hi ajātena phalasya saha hetunā na atītena na jātena saṃgatiḥ jātu vidyate na ajātasya hi jātena phalasya saha hetunā na ajātena na naṣṭena saṃgatiḥ jātu vidyate

asatyām saṃgatau hetuḥ katham janayate phalam satyām vā saṃgatau hetuḥ katham janayate phalam hetuḥ phalena śūnyaḥ ced katham janayate phalam hetuḥ phalena aśūnyaḥ ced katham janayate phalam phalam na utpatsyate aśūnyam aśūnyam na nirotsyate aniruddham anutpannam aśūnyam tat bhaviṣyati

katham utpatsyate śūnyam katham śūnyam nirotsyate śūnyam api aniruddham tat anutpannam prasajyate hetoḥ phalasya ca eka tvam na hi jātu upapadyate hetoḥ phalasya ca anya tvam na hi jātu upapadyate eka tve phala hetvoḥ syāt aikyam janaka janyayoḥ pṛthaktve phala hetvoḥ syāt tulyaḥ hetuḥ ahetunā

phalam svabhāva sadbhūtam kim hetuḥ janayiṣyati phalam svabhāvāsadbhūtam kim hetuḥ janayiṣyati na ca ajanayamānasya hetu tvam upapadyate hetutva anupapattau ca phalam kasya bhaviṣyati na ca pratyaya hetūnām iyam ātmānam ātmanā yā sāmagrī janayate sā katham janayet phalam na sāmagrī kṛtam phalam na āsām agrīkṛtam phalam asti pratyaya sāmagrī kutas eva phalam vinā

vinā vā saha vā na asti vibhavaḥ saṃbhavena vai vinā vā saha vā na asti saṃbhavaḥ vibhavena vai bhaviṣyati katham nāma vibhavaḥ saṃbhavam vinā vinā eva janma maraṇam vibhavaḥ na udbhavam vinā saṃbhavena eva vibhavaḥ katham saha bhaviṣyati na janma maraṇam ca evam tulya kālam hi vidyate bhaviṣyati katham nāma saṃbhavaḥ vibhavam vinā anitya tā hi bhāveṣu na kadācid na vidyate

saṃbhavaḥ vibhavena eva katham saha bhaviṣyati na janma maraṇam ca eva tulya kālam hi vidyate saha anyonyena vā siddhiḥ vinā anyonyena vā yayoḥ na vidyate tayoḥ siddhiḥ katham nu khalu vidyate kṣayasya saṃbhavaḥ na asti na akṣayasya asti saṃbhavaḥ kṣayasya vibhavaḥ na asti vibhavaḥ na akṣayasya ca saṃbhavaḥ vibhavaḥ ca eva vinā bhāvam na vidyate saṃbhavam vibhavam ca eva vinā bhāvaḥ na vidyate

saṃbhavaḥ vibhavaḥ ca eva na śūnyasya upapadyate saṃbhavaḥ vibhavaḥ ca eva na aśūni asya upapadyate saṃbhavaḥ vibhavaḥ ca eva na ekaḥ iti upapadyate saṃbhavaḥ vibhavaḥ ca eva na nānā iti upapadyate dṛśyate saṃbhavaḥ ca eva vibhavaḥ ca eva te bhavet dṛśyate saṃbhavaḥ ca eva mohāt vibhavaḥ eva ca na bhāvāt jāyate bhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ abhāvāt na jāyate na abhāvāt jāyate abhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ bhāvāt na jāyate

na svatas jāyate bhāvaḥ paratas na eva jāyate na svatas paratas ca eva jāyate jāyate kutas bhāvam abhyupapannasya śāśvata uccheda darśanam prasajyate sa bhāvaḥ hi nityaḥ anityaḥ atha vā bhavet bhāvam abhyupapannasya na eva ucchedaḥ na śāśvatam udaya vyaya saṃtānaḥ phala hetvoḥ bhavaḥ sa hi udaya vyaya saṃtānaḥ phala hetvoḥ bhavaḥ sa ced vyayasya apunar utpatteḥ hetu ucchedaḥ prasajyate

sadbhāvasya svabhāvena na asadbhāvaḥ ca yujyate nirvāṇa kāle ca ucchedaḥ praśamāt bhava saṃtateḥ carame na niruddhe ca prathamaḥ yujyate bhavaḥ carame na aniruddhe ca prathamaḥ yujyate bhavaḥ nirudhyamāne carame prathamaḥ yadi jāyate nirudhyamānaḥ ekaḥ syāt jāyamānaḥ aparaḥ bhavet na ced nirudhyamānaḥ ca jāyamānaḥ ca yujyate sārdham ca mriyate yeṣu teṣu skandheṣu jāyate evam triṣu api kāleṣu na yuktā bhava saṃtatiḥ triṣu kāleṣu yā na asti sā katham bhava saṃtatiḥ

skandhāḥ na na anyaḥ skandhebhyaḥ na asmin skandhāḥ na teṣu saḥ tathāgataḥ skandhavān na katamaḥ atra tathāgataḥ buddhaḥ skandhān upādāya yadi na asti svabhāvataḥ svabhāvataḥ ca yaḥ na asti kutas sa para bhāvataḥ pratītya para bhāvam yaḥ saḥ anātmā iti upapadyate yaḥ ca anātmā sa ca katham bhaviṣyati tathāgataḥ

yadi na asti svabhāvaḥ ca para bhāvaḥ katham bhavet svabhāva para bhāvābhyām ṛte kaḥ sa tathāgataḥ skandhān yadi anupādāya bhavet kaścid tathāgataḥ saḥ idānīm upādadyāt upādāya tatas bhavet skandhān ca api anupādāya na asti kaścid tathāgataḥ yaḥ ca na asti anupādāya saḥ upādāsyate katham na bhavati anupādattam upādānam ca kim cana na ca asti nirupādānaḥ katham cana tathāgataḥ

tattva anya tvena yaḥ na asti mṛgyamāṇaḥ ca pañcadhā upādānena sa katham prajñapyate tathāgataḥ yat api idam upādānam tat svabhāvāt na vidyate svabhāvataḥ ca yat na asti kutas tat para bhāvataḥ evam śūnyam upādānam upādātā ca sarvaśas prajñapyate ca śūnyena katham śūnyaḥ tathāgataḥ śūnyam iti na vaktavyam aśūnyam iti vā bhavet ubhayam na ubhayam ca iti prajñapti artham tu kathyate

śāśvata aśāśvata ādi atra kutas śānte catuṣṭayam anta ananta ādi ca api atra kutas śānte catuṣṭayam ghana grāhaḥ gṛhītaḥ tu yena asti iti tathāgataḥ na asti iti sa vikalpayan nirvṛtasya api kalpayet svabhāvataḥ ca śūnye asmin cintā na eva upapadyate param nirodhāt bhavati buddhaḥ na bhavati iti vā prapañcayanti ye buddham prapañca atītam avyayam te prapañca hatāḥ sarve na paśyanti tathāgatam tathāgataḥ yat svabhāvaḥ tad svabhāvam idam jagat tathāgataḥ niḥsvabhāvaḥ niḥsvabhāvam idam jagat

saṃkalpa prabhavaḥ rāgaḥ dveṣaḥ mohaḥ ca kathyate śubha aśubha viparyāsān saṃbhavanti pratītya hi śubha aśubha viparyāsān saṃbhavanti pratītya ye te svabhāvān na vidyante tasmāt kleśāḥ na tattvataḥ ātmanaḥ astitvana astitve na katham cit ca sidhyataḥ tam vinā asti tvana astitve kleśānām sidhyataḥ katham

kasya cit dhi bhavanti ime kleśāḥ sa ca na sidhyati kaścid āho vinā kaṃcid santi kleśāḥ na kasyacid sva kāya dṛṣṭi vat kleśāḥ kliṣṭe santi na pañcadhā sva kāya dṛṣṭi vat kliṣṭam kleśeṣu api na pañcadhā svabhāvataḥ na vidyante śubha aśubha viparyayāḥ pratītya katamān kleśāḥ śubha aśubha viparyayān

rūpa śabda rasa sparśāḥ gandhāḥ dharmāḥ ca ṣaḍvidham vastu rāgasya doṣasya mohasya ca vikalpyate rūpa śabda rasa sparśāḥ gandhāḥ dharmāḥ ca kevalāḥ gandharvanagara ākārāḥ marīci svapna saṃnibhāḥ aśubham vā śubham vā api kutas teṣu bhaviṣyati māyā puruṣa kalpeṣu pratibimba sameṣu ca anapekṣya śubham na asti aśubham prajñapayemahi yat pratītya śubham tasmāt śubham na eva upapadyate

anapekṣya aśubham na asti śubham prajñapayemahi yat pratītya aśubham tasmāt aśubham na eva vidyate avidyamāne ca śubhe kutas rāgaḥ bhaviṣyati aśubhe avidyamāne ca kutas dveṣaḥ bhaviṣyati anitye nityam iti evam yadi grāhaḥ viparyayaḥ na anityam vidyate śūnye kutas grāhaḥ viparyayaḥ anitye nityam iti evam yadi grāhaḥ viparyayaḥ anityam iti api grāhaḥ śūnye kim na viparyayaḥ

yena gṛhṇāti yaḥ grāhaḥ grahītā yat ca gṛhyate upaśāntāni sarvāṇi tasmāt grāhaḥ na vidyate avidyamāne grāhe ca mithyā vā samyak eva vā bhavet viparyayaḥ kasya bhavet kasya aviparyayaḥ na ca api viparītasya saṃbhavanti viparyayāḥ na ca api aviparītasya saṃbhavanti viparyayāḥ na viparyasyamānasya saṃbhavanti viparyayāḥ vimṛśasva svayam kasya saṃbhavanti viparyayāḥ

anutpannāḥ katham nāma bhaviṣyanti viparyayāḥ viparyayeṣu ajāteṣu viparyaya gataḥ kutas na svatas jāyate bhāvaḥ paratas na eva jāyate na svatas paratas ca iti viparyaya gataḥ kutas ātmā ca śuci nityam ca sukham ca yadi vidyate ātmā ca śuci nityam ca sukham ca na viparyayaḥ na ātmā ca śuci nityam ca sukham ca yadi vidyate anātmā aśuci anityam ca na eva duḥkham ca vidyate

evam nirudhyate avidyā viparyaya nirodhanāt avidyāyām niruddhāyām saṃskāra ādyam nirudhyate yadi bhūtāḥ svabhāvena kleśāḥ kecid dhi kasyacid katham nāma prahīyeran kaḥ svabhāvam prahāsyati yadi abhūtāḥ svabhāvena kleśāḥ kecid dhi kasyacid katham nāma prahīyeran kaḥ asadbhāvam prahāsyati

yadi śūnyam idam sarvam udayaḥ na asti na vyayaḥ caturṇām ārya satyānām abhāvaḥ te prasajyate parijñā ca prahāṇam ca bhāvanā sākṣi karma ca caturṇām ārya satyānām abhāvāt na upapadyate tad abhāvāt na vidyante catvāri ārya phalāni ca phala abhāve phala sthāḥ naḥ na santi pratipannakāḥ saṃghaḥ na asti na ced santi te aṣṭau puruṣa pudgalāḥ abhāvāt cārya satyānām saddharmaḥ api na vidyate

dharme ca asati saṃghe ca katham buddhaḥ bhaviṣyati evam trīṇi api ratnāni bruvāṇaḥ pratibādhase śūnyatām phala sadbhāvam adharmam dharmam eva ca sarva saṃvyavahārān ca laukikān pratibādhase atra brūmaḥ śūnyatāyām na tvam vetsi prayojanam śūnyatām śūnyatā artham ca tatas evam vihanyase

dve satye samupāśritya buddhānām dharma deśanā loka saṃvṛti satyam ca satyam ca paramārthataḥ ye anayoḥ na vijānanti vibhāgam satyayoḥ dvayoḥ te tattvam na vijānanti gambhīram buddha śāsane vyavahāram anāśritya parama arthaḥ na deśyate parama artham anāgamya nirvāṇam na adhigamyate vināśayati durdṛṣṭā śūnyatā manda medhasam sarpaḥ yathā durgṛhītaḥ vidyā vā duṣprasādhitā

atas ca pratyudāvṛttam cittam deśayitum muneḥ dharmam matvā asya dharmasya mandaiḥ duravaga āhatām śūnyatāyām adhilayam yam punar kurute bhavān doṣa prasaṅgaḥ na asmākam sa śūnye na upapadyate sarvam ca yujyate tasya śūnyatā yasya yujyate sarvam na yujyate tasya śūnyam yasya na yujyate sa tvam doṣān ātmanīyān asmāsu paripātayan aśvam eva abhirūḍhaḥ san aśvam eva asi vismṛtaḥ

svabhāvāt yadi bhāvānām sadbhāvam anupaśyasi ahetu pratyayān bhāvān tvam evam sati paśyasi kāryam ca kāraṇam ca eva kartāram karaṇam kriyām utpādam ca nirodham ca phalam ca pratibādhase yaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ śūnyatām tām pracakṣmahe sā prajñaptiḥ upādāya pratipad sā eva madhyamā apratītya samutpannaḥ dharmaḥ kaścid na vidyate yasmāt tasmāt aśūnyaḥ hi dharmaḥ kaścid na vidyate

yadi aśūnyam idam sarvam udayaḥ na asti na vyayaḥ caturṇām ārya satyānām abhāvaḥ te prasajyate apratītya samutpannam kutas duḥkham bhaviṣyati anityam uktam duḥkham hi tat svābhāvye na vidyate svabhāvataḥ vidyamānam kim punar samudeṣyate tasmāt samudayaḥ na asti śūnyatām pratibādhataḥ na nirodhaḥ svabhāvena sataḥ duḥkhasya vidyate svabhāva paryavasthānāt nirodham pratibādhase

svābhāvye sati mārgasya bhāvanā na upapadyate atha asau bhāvyate mārgaḥ svābhāvyam te na vidyate yadā duḥkham samudayaḥ nirodhaḥ ca na vidyate mārgaḥ duḥkha nirodha tvāt katamaḥ prāpayiṣyati svabhāvena aparijñānam yadi tasya punar katham parijñānam nanu kila svabhāvaḥ samavasthitaḥ prahāṇa sākṣāt karaṇe bhāvanā ca evam eva te parijñāvan na yujyante catvāri api phalāni ca

svabhāvena anadhigatam yat phalam tat punar katham śakyam samadhigantum syāt svabhāvam parigṛhṇataḥ phala abhāve phala sthāḥ naḥ na santi pratipannakāḥ saṃghaḥ na asti na ced santi te aṣṭau puruṣa pudgalāḥ abhāvāt cārya satyānām saddharmaḥ api na vidyate dharme ca asati saṃghe ca katham buddhaḥ bhaviṣyati

apratītya api bodhim ca tava buddhaḥ prasajyate apratītya api buddham ca tava bodhiḥ prasajyate yaḥ ca abuddhaḥ svabhāvena sa bodhāya ghaṭan api na bodhisattva caryāyām bodhim te adhigamiṣyati na ca dharmam adharmam vā kaścid jātu kariṣyati kim aṣūni asya kartavyam svabhāvaḥ kriyate na hi

vinā dharmam adharmam ca phalam hi tava vidyate dharma adharma nimittam ca phalam tava na vidyate dharma adharma nimittam vā yadi te vidyate phalam dharma adharma samutpannam aśūnyam te katham phalam sarva saṃvyvahārān ca laukikān pratibādhase yat pratītyasamutpāda śūnyatām pratibādhase na kartavyam bhavet kiṃcid anārabdhā bhavet kriyā kārakaḥ syāt akurvāṇaḥ śūnyatām pratibādhataḥ ajātam aniruddham ca kūṭastham ca bhaviṣyati vicitrābhiḥ avasthābhiḥ svabhāve rahitam jagat asaṃprāptasya ca prāptiḥ duḥkha paryanta karma ca sarva kleśa prahāṇam ca yadi aśūnyam na vidyate yaḥ pratītyasamutpādam paśyati idam sa paśyati duḥkham samudayam ca eva nirodham mārgam eva ca

yadi śūnyam idam sarvam udayaḥ na asti na vyayaḥ prahāṇāt vā nirodhāt vā kasya nirvāṇam iṣyate yadi aśūnyam idam sarvam udayaḥ na asti na vyayaḥ prahāṇāt vā nirodhāt vā kasya nirvāṇam iṣyate aprahīṇam asaṃprāptam anucchinnam aśāśvatam aniruddham anutpannam etat nirvāṇam ucyate bhāvaḥ tāvat na nirvāṇam jarā maraṇa lakṣaṇam prasajyeta asti bhāvaḥ hi na jarā maraṇam vinā

bhāvaḥ ca yadi nirvāṇam nirvāṇam saṃskṛtam bhavet na asaṃskṛtaḥ hi vidyate bhāvaḥ kva cana kaḥ cana bhāvaḥ ca yadi nirvāṇam anupādāya tat katham nirvāṇam na anupādāya kaścid bhāvaḥ hi vidyate bhāvaḥ yadi na nirvāṇam abhāvaḥ kim bhaviṣyati nirvāṇam yatra bhāvaḥ na na abhāvaḥ tatra vidyate yadi abhāvaḥ ca nirvāṇam anupādāya tat katham nirvāṇam na hi abhāvaḥ asti yaḥ anupādāya vidyate

yaḥ ājavaṃjavībhāvaḥ upādāya pratītya vā saḥ apratītya anupādāya nirvāṇam upadiśyate prahāṇam ca abravīt śāstā bhavasya vibhavasya ca tasmāt na bhāvaḥ na abhāvaḥ nirvāṇam iti yujyate bhavet abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca nirvāṇam ubhayam yadi bhavet abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca mokṣaḥ tat ca na yujyate bhavet abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca nirvāṇam ubhayam yadi na anupādāya nirvāṇam upādāya ubhayam hi tat

bhavet abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca nirvāṇam ubhayam katham asaṃskṛtam hi nirvāṇam bhāva abhāvau ca saṃskṛtau bhavet abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca nirvāṇaḥ ubhayam katham tayoḥ abhāvaḥ hi ekatra prakāśa tamasoḥ iva na eva abhāvaḥ na eva bhāvaḥ nirvāṇam iti yā añjanā abhāve ca eva bhāve ca sā siddhe sati sidhyati na eva abhāvaḥ na eva bhāvaḥ nirvāṇam yadi vidyate na eva abhāvaḥ na eva bhāvaḥ iti kena tat ajyate

param nirodhāt bhagavān bhavati iti eva na ajyate na bhavati ubhayam ca iti na ubhayam ca iti na ajyate tiṣṭhamānaḥ api bhagavān bhavati iti eva na ajyate na bhavati ubhayam ca iti na ubhayam ca iti na ajyate na saṃsārasya nirvāṇāt kiṃcid asti viśeṣaṇam na nirvāṇasya saṃsārāt kiṃcid asti viśeṣaṇam nirvāṇasya ca yā koṭiḥ koṭiḥ saṃsaraṇasya ca na tayoḥ antaram kiṃcid su sūkṣmam api vidyate

param nirodhāt anta ādyāḥ śāśvata ādyāḥ ca dṛṣṭayaḥ nirvāṇam apara antam ca pūrva antam ca samāśritāḥ śūnyeṣu sarva dharmeṣu kim anantam kim antavat kim anantam antavat ca na anantam na anta vat ca kim kim tat eva kim anyat kim śāśvatam kim aśāśvatam aśāśvatam śāśvatam ca kim vā na ubhayam api atha sarva upalambha upaśamaḥ prapañca upaśamaḥ śivaḥ na kva cit kasyacid kaścid dharmaḥ buddhena deśitaḥ

punarbhavāya saṃskārān avidyā nivṛtaḥ tridhā abhisaṃskurute yān taiḥ gatim gacchati karmabhiḥ vijñānam saṃniviśate saṃskāra pratyayam gatau saṃniviṣṭe atha vijñāne nāma rūpam niṣicyate niṣikte nāma rūpe tu ṣaṣ āyatana saṃbhavaḥ ṣaṣ āyatanam āgamya saṃsparśaḥ saṃpravartate cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpam ca samanvāhāram eva ca nāma rūpam pratītya evam vijñānam saṃpravartate

saṃnipātaḥ trayāṇām yaḥ rūpa vijñāna cakṣuṣām sparśaḥ sa tasmāt sparśāt ca vedanā saṃpravartate vedanā pratyayā tṛṣṇā vedanā artham hi tṛṣyate tṛṣyamāṇaḥ upādānam upādatte caturvidham upādāne sati bhavaḥ upādātuḥ pravartate syāt dhi yadi anupādānaḥ mucyeta na bhavet bhavaḥ pañca skandhāḥ sa ca bhavaḥ bhavāt jātiḥ pravartate jarā maraṇa duḥkha ādi śokāḥ sa paridevanāḥ

daurmanasyam upāyāsāḥ jāteḥ etat pravartate kevalasya evam etasya duḥkha skandhasya saṃbhavaḥ saṃsāra mūlam saṃskārān avidvān saṃskaroti atas avidvān kārakaḥ tasmāt na vidvān tattva darśanāt avidyāyām niruddhāyām saṃskārāṇām asaṃbhavaḥ avidyāyāḥ nirodhaḥ tu jñānasya asya eva bhāvanāt tasya tasya nirodhena tat tat na abhipravartate duḥkha skandhaḥ kevalaḥ ayam evam samyak nirudhyate

abhūm atītam adhvānam na abhūvam iti dṛṣṭayaḥ yāḥ tāḥ śāśvata loka ādyāḥ pūrva antam samupāśritāḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ na bhaviṣyāmi kim anyaḥ anāgate adhvani bhaviṣyāmi iti ca antādyāḥ apara antam samāśritāḥ abhūm atītam adhvānam iti etat na upapadyate yaḥ hi janmasu pūrveṣu saḥ eva na bhavati ayam saḥ eva ātmā iti tu bhavet upādānam viśiṣyate upādāna vinirmuktaḥ ātmā te katamaḥ punar

upādāna vinirmuktaḥ na asti ātmā iti kṛte sati syāt upādānam eva ātmā na asti ca ātmā iti vaḥ punar na ca upādānam eva ātmā vyeti tat samudeti ca katham hi nāma upādānam upādātā bhaviṣyati anyaḥ punar upādānāt ātmā na eva upapadyate gṛhyeta hi anupādānaḥ yadi anyaḥ na ca gṛhyate evam na anyaḥ upādānāt na ca upādānam eva saḥ ātmā na asti anupādānaḥ na api na asti eṣa niścayaḥ

nābhūm atītam adhvānam iti etat na upapadyate yaḥ hi janmasu pūrveṣu tatas anyaḥ na bhavati ayam yadi hi ayam bhavet anyaḥ pratyākhyāya api tam bhavet tathā eva ca sa saṃtiṣṭhet tatra jāyeta ca amṛtaḥ ucchedaḥ karmaṇām nāśaḥ kṛtam anyena karma ca pratisaṃvedayet anyaḥ evam ādi prasajyate na api abhūtvā samudbhūtaḥ doṣaḥ hi atra prasajyate kṛtakaḥ vā bhavet ātmā saṃbhūtaḥ vā api ahetukaḥ

evam dṛṣṭiḥ atīte yā nābhūm aham abhūm aham ubhayam na ubhayam ca iti na eṣā samupapadyate adhvani anāgate kim nu bhaviṣyāmi iti darśanam na bhaviṣyāmi ca iti etat atītena adhvanā samam sa devaḥ sa manuṣyaḥ ced evam bhavati śāśvatam anutpannaḥ ca devaḥ syāt jāyate na hi śāśvatam devāt anyaḥ manuṣyaḥ ced aśāśvatam atas bhavet devāt anyaḥ manuṣyaḥ ced saṃtatiḥ na upapadyate

divyaḥ yadi eka deśaḥ syāt eka deśaḥ ca mānuṣaḥ aśāśvatam śāśvatam ca bhavet tat ca na yujyate aśāśvatam śāśvatam ca prasiddham ubhayam yadi siddhe na śāśvatam kāmam na eva aśāśvatam iti api kutaścid āgataḥ kaścid kiṃcid gacchet punar kva cit yadi tasmāt anādiḥ tu saṃsāraḥ syāt na ca asti saḥ

na asti ced śāśvataḥ kaścid kaḥ bhaviṣyati aśāśvataḥ śāśvataḥ aśāśvataḥ ca api dvābhyām ābhyām tiraskṛtaḥ antavān yadi lokaḥ syāt para lokaḥ katham bhavet atha api anantavān lokaḥ para lokaḥ katham bhavet skandhānām eṣa saṃtānaḥ yasmāt dīpa arciṣām iva tasmāt na anantavat tvam ca na antavat tvam ca yujyate

pūrve yadi ca bhajyeran utpadyeran na ca api amī skandhāḥ skandhān pratītya imān atha lokaḥ antavān bhavet pūrve yadi na bhajyeran utpadyeran na ca api amī skandhāḥ skandhān pratītya imāt lokaḥ anantaḥ bhavet atha antavān eka deśaḥ ced eka deśaḥ tu anantavān syāt antavān anantaḥ ca lokaḥ tat ca na yujyate

katham tāvat upādātuḥ eka deśaḥ vinaṅkṣyate na naṅkṣyate ca eka deśaḥ evam ca etat na yujyate upādāna eka deśaḥ ca katham nāma vinaṅkṣyate na naṅkṣyate ca eka deśaḥ na etat api upapadyate antavat ca api anantam ca prasiddham ubhayam yadi siddhe na eva anta vat kāmam na eva ananta vat iti api atha vā sarva bhāvānām śūnya tvāt śāśvata ādayaḥ kva kasya katamāḥ kasmāt saṃbhaviṣyanti dṛṣṭayaḥ sarva dṛṣṭi prahāṇāya yaḥ saddharmam adeśayat anukampām upādāya tam namasyāmi gautamam

sarveṣām bhāvānām sarvatra na vidyate svabhāvaḥ ced tvad vacanam asvabhāvam na nivartayitum svabhāvam alam yadi sarveṣām bhāvānām hetau pratyayeṣu ca hetu pratyaya sāmagryām ca pṛthak ca sarvatra svabhāvaḥ na vidyate iti kṛtvā śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti na hi bīje hetu bhūte aṅkuraḥ asti na pṛthivī ap tejaḥ vāyu ādīnām ekaikasmin pratyaya saṃjñite na pratyayeṣu samagreṣu na hetu pratyaya sāmagryām na hetu pratyaya vinirmuktaḥ pṛthak eva ca yasmāt atra sarvatra svabhāvaḥ na asti tasmāt niḥsvabhāvaḥ aṅkuraḥ yasmāt niḥsvabhāvaḥ tasmāt śūnyaḥ yathā ca ayam aṅkuraḥ niḥsvabhāvaḥ niḥsvabhāva tvāt ca śūnyaḥ tathā sarva bhāvāḥ api niḥsvabhāva tvāt śūnyāḥ iti

atra vayam brūmaḥ yadi evam tava api vacanam yat etat śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat api śūnyam kim kāraṇam tat api hetau na asti mahābhūteṣu saṃprayukteṣu viprayukteṣu vā pratyayeṣu na asti uraḥ kaṇṭha oṣṭha jihvā danta mūla tālu nāsikā mūrdha prabhṛtiṣu yatneṣu ubhaya sāmagryām na asti hetu pratyaya vinirmuktam pṛthak eva ca na asti yasmāt atra sarvatra na asti tasmāt niḥsvabhāvam yasmāt niḥsvabhāvam tasmāt śūnyam tasmāt anena sarva bhāva svabhāva vyāvartanam aśakyam kartum na hi asatā agninā śakyam dagdhum na hi asatā śastreṇa śakyam chettum na hi asatībhiḥ adbhiḥ śakyam kledayitum evam asatā vacanena na śakyaḥ sarva bhāva svabhāva pratiṣedhaḥ kartum tatra yat uktam sarva bhāva svabhāvaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ iti tat na

atha sa svabhāvam etat vākyam pūrvā hatā pratijñā te vaiṣamika tvam tasmin viśeṣa hetuḥ ca vaktavyaḥ atha api manyase mā bhūt eṣa doṣaḥ iti sa svabhāvam etat vākyam sa svabhāva tvāt ca aśūnyam tasmāt anena sarva bhāva svabhāvaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ iti atra brūmaḥ yadi evam yā te pūrvā pratijñā śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti hatā sā

kim ca anyat sarva bhāva antargatam ca tvad vacanam kasmāt śūnyeṣu sarva bhāveṣu tvad vacanam aśūnyam yena aśūnya tvāt sarva bhāva svabhāvaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ evam ṣaṣ koṭikaḥ vādaḥ prasaktaḥ sa punar katham iti hanta ced punar śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ tena tvad vacanam śūnyam sarva bhāva antargata tvāt tena śūnyena pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ tatra yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti saḥ anupapannaḥ upapannaḥ ced punar śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti pratiṣedhaḥ tena tvad vacanam api aśūnyam aśūnya tvāt anena pratiṣedhaḥ anupapannaḥ atha śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ tvad vacanam ca aśūnyam yena pratiṣedhaḥ

tena tvad vacanam sarvatra asaṃgṛhītam tatra dṛṣṭānta virodhaḥ sarvatra ced punar saṃgṛhītam tvad vacanam sarva bhāvāḥ ca śūnyāḥ tena tat api śūnyam śūnya tvāt anena na asti pratiṣedhaḥ atha śūnyam asti ca anena pratiṣedhaḥ śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tena śūnyāḥ api sarva bhāvāḥ kārya kriyā samarthāḥ bhaveyuḥ na ca etat iṣṭam atha śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ na ca kārya kriyā samarthāḥ bhavanti mā bhūt dṛṣṭānta virodhaḥ iti kṛtvā śūnyena tvad vacanena sarva bhāva svabhāva pratiṣedhaḥ na upapannaḥ iti kim ca anyat evam tad astitvāt vaiṣamika tva prasaṅgaḥ kim cit śūnyam kim cit aśūnyam iti tasmin ca vaisamika tve viśeṣa hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ yena kim cit śūnyam kim cit aśūnyam syāt sa ca na upadiṣṭaḥ hetuḥ tatra yat uktam śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat mā śabda vat iti etat syāt te buddhiḥ na ca etat upapannam śabdena hi atra satā bhaviṣyataḥ vāraṇam tasya syāt te buddhiḥ yathā nāma kaścid brūyāt mā śabdam kārṣīḥ iti svayam eva śabdam kuryāt tena ca śabdena tasya śabdasya vyāvartanam kriyeta evam eva śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti śūnyena vacanena sarva bhāva svabhāvasya vyāvartanam kriyate iti atra vayam brūmaḥ etat api anupapannam kim kāraṇam satā hi atra śabdena bhaviṣyataḥ śabdasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate na punar iha bhavataḥ satā vacanena sarva bhāva svabhāva pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate tava hi matena vacanam api asat sarva bhāva svabhāvaḥ api asan tasmāt ayam mā śabda vat iti viṣama upanyāsaḥ

pratiṣedha pratiṣedhaḥ api evam iti matam bhavet tat asat eva evam tava pratijñā lakṣaṇataḥ dūṣyate na mama syāt te buddhiḥ pratiṣedha pratiṣedhaḥ api anena eva kalpena anupapannaḥ tatra yat bhavān sarva bhāva svabhāva pratiṣedha vacanam pratiṣedhayati tat anupapannam iti atra vayam brūmaḥ etat api asat eva kasmāt tava hi pratijñā lakṣaṇa prāptam na mama bhavān bravīti śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti na aham pūrvakaḥ pakṣaḥ na mama tatra yat uktam pratiṣedha pratiṣedhaḥ api evam sati anupapannaḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat pratyakṣeṇa hi tāvat yadi upalabhya vinivartayasi bhāvān tat na asti pratyakṣam bhāvāḥ yena upalabhyante yadi pratyakṣatas sarva bhāvān upalabhya bhavān nivartayati śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat anupapannam kasmāt pratyakṣam api hi pramāṇam sarva bhāva antargata tvāt śūnyam yaḥ bhāvān upalabhate saḥ api śūnyaḥ tasmāt pratyakṣeṇa pramāṇena na upalambha bhāvaḥ anupalabdhasya ca pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ tatra yat uktam śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat anupapannam

syāt te buddhiḥ anumānena āgamena upamānena vā sarva bhāvān upalabhya sarva bhāva vyāvartanam kriyate iti atra brūmaḥ anumānam pratyuktam pratyakṣeṇa āgama upamāne ca anumāna āgama sādhyāḥ ye arthāḥ dṛṣṭānta sādhyāḥ ca anumāna upamānāgamāḥ ca pratyakṣeṇa pramāṇena pratyuktāḥ yathā hi pratyakṣam pramāṇam śūnyam sarva bhāvānām śūnya tvāt evam anumāna upamānāgamāḥ api śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvānām śūnya tvāt ye anumāna sādhyāḥ arthāḥ āgama sādhyāḥ upamāna sādhyāḥ ca te api śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvānām śūnya tvāt anumāna upamāna āgamaiḥ ca yaḥ bhāvān upalabhate saḥ api śūnyaḥ tasmāt bhāvānām upalambha abhāvaḥ anupalabdhānām ca svabhāva pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ tatra yat uktam śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat kuśalānām dharmāṇām dharma avasthā vidaḥ ca manyante kuśalam janāḥ svabhāvam śeṣeṣu api eṣa viniyogaḥ iha janāḥ dharma avasthā vidaḥ manyante kuśalānām dharmāṇām ekonaviṃśa śatam tat yathā eka deśaḥ vijñānasya vedanāyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ cetanāyāḥ sparśasya manasikārasya cchandasya adhimokṣasya vīryasya smṛteḥ samādheḥ prajñāyāḥ upekṣāyāḥ prayogasya saṃprayogasya prāpteḥ adhyāśayasya apratighasya rateḥ vyavasāyasya autsukyasya unmugdheḥ utsāhasya avighātasya vaśitāyāḥ pratighātasya avipratisārasya parigrahasya aparigrahasya dhṛteḥ adhyavasāyasya anautsukyasya anunmugdheḥ anutsāhasya prārthanāyāḥ praṇidheḥ madasya viṣayāṇām viprayogasya anairyāṇika tāyāḥ utpādasya sthiteḥ anitya tāyāḥ samanvāgamasya jarāyāḥ paritāpasya arateḥ vitarkasya prīteḥ prasādasya

premṇaḥ pratikūlasya pradakṣiṇa grāhasya vaiśāradyasya gauravasya citrīkārasya bhakteḥ abhakteḥ śuśrūṣāyāḥ ādarasya anādarasya praśrabdheḥ hāsasya vācaḥ vispandanāyāḥ siddhasya aprasādasya apraśrabdheḥ dākṣyasya sauratyasya vipratisārasya śokasya upāyāsā āyāsasya apradakṣiṇa grāhasya saṃśayasya saṃvarāṇām pariśuddheḥ adhyātma saṃprasādasya bhīru tāyāḥ śraddhā hrīḥ ārjavam avañcanam upaśamaḥ acāpalam apramādaḥ mārdavam pratisaṃkhyānam nirvaira paridāha avamadaḥ alobhaḥ adoṣaḥ amohaḥ sarvajña tā pratiniḥsargaḥ vibhavaḥ apatra api ama paricchadanam mananam kāruṇyam maitrī adīna tāraṇā anupanāhaḥ anīrṣyā cetasaḥ aparyādānam kṣāntiḥ vyavasargaḥ asauratyam paribhoga anvayaḥ puṇyam asaṃjñi samāpattiḥ nairyāṇika tā sarvajña tā saṃskṛtāḥ dharmāḥ iti ekonaviṃśa śatam kuśalānām dharmāṇām kuśalaḥ svabhāvaḥ

tathā akuśalānām dharmāṇām akuśalaḥ svabhāvaḥ nivṛta avyākṛtānām nivṛta avyākṛtaḥ prakṛta avyākṛtānām prakṛta avyākṛtaḥ kāma uktānām kāma uktaḥ rūpa uktānām rūpa uktaḥ ārūpya uktānām ārūpya uktaḥ anāśravāṇām anāsravaḥ duḥkha samudaya nirodha mārga uktānām duḥkha samudaya nirodha mārga uktaḥ bhāvanā prahātavyānām bhāvanā prahātavyaḥ aprahātavyānām aprahātavyaḥ yasmāt evam aneka prakāraḥ dharma svabhāvaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasmāt yat uktam niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ niḥsvabhāva tvāt śūnyāḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat nairyāṇika svabhāvaḥ dharmāḥ nairyāṇikāḥ ca ye teṣām dharma avasthā uktānām evam anairyāṇikā ādīnām iha ca dharma avasthā uktānām nairyāṇikānām dharmāṇām nairyāṇikaḥ svabhāvaḥ anairyāṇikānām anairyāṇikaḥ bodhi aṅgikānām bodhi aṅgikaḥ abodhyaṅgikānām abodhyaṅgikaḥ bodhi pakṣikāṇām bodhipakṣikaḥ abodhi pakṣikāṇām abodhipakṣikaḥ evam api śeṣāṇām tat yasmāt evam aneka prakāraḥ dharmāṇām svabhāvaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasmāt yadi uktam niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ niḥsvabhāva tvāt śūnyāḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat yadi ca na bhavet svabhāvaḥ dharmāṇām niḥsvabhāvaḥ iti eva nāma api bhavet na evam nāma hi nirvastukam na asti yadi sarva dharmāṇām svabhāvaḥ na bhavet tatra api niḥsvabhāvaḥ bhavet tatra niḥsvabhāvaḥ iti evam nāma api na bhavet kasmāt nāma hi nirvastukam kiṃcid api na asti tasmāt nāma sadbhāvāt svabhāvaḥ abhāvānām asti svabhāva sadbhāvāt ca aśūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ tasmāt yat yat uktam niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ niḥsvabhāva tvāt śūnyāḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat atha vidyate svabhāvaḥ sa ca dharmāṇām na vidyate tasmāt dharmaiḥ vinā svabhāvaḥ sa yasya tat yuktam upadeṣṭum atha manyase mā bhūt avastukam nāma iti kṛtvā asti svabhāvaḥ sa punar dharmāṇām na saṃbhavati evam dharma śūnyatā niḥsvabhāva tvāt dharmāṇām siddhā bhaviṣyati na ca nirvastukam nāma iti atra vayam brūmaḥ evam kasya idānīm sa svabhāvaḥ dharma vinirmuktasya arthasya sa yuktam upadeṣṭum arthaḥ sa ca na upadiṣṭaḥ tasmāt yā kalpanā asti svabhāvaḥ na sa punar dharmāṇām iti sā hīnā

kim ca anyat sataḥ eva pratiṣedhaḥ na asti ghaṭaḥ gehaḥ iti ayam yasmāt dṛṣṭaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ayam sataḥ svabhāvasya te tasmāt iha ca sataḥ arthasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate na asataḥ tat yathā na asti ghaṭaḥ gehaḥ iti sataḥ ghaṭasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate na asataḥ evam eva na asti svabhāvaḥ dharmāṇām iti sataḥ svabhāvasya pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti na asataḥ tatra yat uktam niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat na pratiṣedha saṃbhavāt eva sarva bhāva svabhāvaḥ apratiṣiddhaḥ

kim ca anyat atha na asti sa svabhāvaḥ kim nu pratiṣidhyate tvayā anena vacanena ṛte vacanāt pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyate hi asataḥ atha na asti eva sa svabhāvaḥ anena vacanena niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti kim bhavatā pratiṣidhyate asataḥ hi vacanāt vinā siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ tat yathā agneḥ śaityasya apām auṣṇyasya

kim ca anyat bālānām iva mithyā mṛgatṛṣṇāyām yathā jala grāhaḥ evam mithyāgrāhaḥ syāt te pratiṣedhyataḥ hi asataḥ syāt te buddhiḥ yathā bālānām mṛgatṛṣṇāyām mithyā jalam iti grāhaḥ bhavati nanu nirjalā sā mṛgatṛṣṇā iti tatra paṇḍita jātīyena puruṣeṇa ucyate tasya grāhasya vinivartana artham evam niḥsvabhāveṣu yaḥ svabhāve grāhaḥ sattvānām tasya vyāvartana artham niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti ucyate iti

atra brūmaḥ nanu evam sati asti grāhaḥ grāhyam ca tat grahītā ca pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣedhyam pratiṣeddhā ca iti ṣaṭkam tat yadi evam asti tāvat sattvānām grāhaḥ asti grāhyam santi ca tat grahītāraḥ asti pratiṣedhaḥ tasya api mithyā grāhasya asti pratiṣedhyam yat idam mithyāgrāhaḥ nāma santi ca pratiṣedhāraḥ yuṣmad ādayaḥ asya grāhasya iti siddham ṣaṭkam tasya ṣaṭkasya prasiddha tvāt yat uktam śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat na

atha na eva asti grāhaḥ na eva grāhyam na ca grahītāraḥ pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣedhyam pratiṣeddhāraḥ nanu na santi atha mā bhūt eṣa doṣaḥ iti kṛtvā na eva grāhaḥ asti na eva grāhyam na ca grahītāraḥ iti evam sati grāhasya yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti saḥ api na asti pratiṣedhyam api na asti pratiṣeddhāraḥ api na santi

pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣedhyam pratiṣeddhāraḥ ca yadi uta na santi siddhāḥ hi sarva bhāvāḥ teṣām eva svabhāvaḥ ca yadi ca na pratiṣedhaḥ na pratiṣedhyam na pratiṣeddhāraḥ santi apratiṣiddhāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ asti ca sarva bhāvānām svabhāvaḥ

kim ca anyat hetoḥ ca te na siddhiḥ naiḥsvābhāvyāt kutas hi te hetuḥ nirhetukasya siddhiḥ na ca upapanna asya te arthasya niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti etasmin arthe te hetoḥ asiddhiḥ kim kāraṇam niḥsvabhāva tvāt dhi sarva bhāvānām śūnya tvāt tatas hetuḥ kutas asati hetau nirhetukasya arthasya śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti kutas eva prasiddhiḥ tatra yat uktam śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat yadi ca ahetoḥ siddhiḥ svabhāva vinivartanasya te bhavati svābhāvyasya astitvam mama api nirhetukam siddham atha manyase nirhetukī siddhiḥ niḥsvabhāva tvasya bhāvānām iti yathā tava svabhāva vinirvartanam nirhetukam siddham tathā mama api svabhāva sadbhāvaḥ nirhetukaḥ siddhaḥ

atha hetoḥ astitvam bhāva asvābhāvyam iti anupapannam lokeṣu niḥsvabhāvaḥ na hi kaścana vidyate bhāvaḥ yadi hetoḥ astitvam manyase niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat anupapannam kim kāraṇam na hi loke niḥsvabhāvaḥ kaścid bhāvaḥ asti

kim ca anyat pūrvam ced pratiṣedhaḥ paścāt pratiṣedhyam iti anupapannam paścāt ca anupapannaḥ yugapad ca yatas svabhāvaḥ san iha pūrvam ced pratiṣedhaḥ paścāt ca pratiṣedhyam iti na upapannam asati hi pratiṣedhye kasya pratiṣedhaḥ atha paścāt pratiṣedhaḥ pūrvam pratiṣedhyam iti ca na upapannam siddhe hi pratiṣedhye kim pratiṣedhaḥ karoti atha yugapad pratiṣedha pratiṣedhyaḥ iti tathā api na pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣedhyasya arthasya kāraṇam pratiṣedhyaḥ na pratiṣedhasya ca yathā yugapad utpannayoḥ śaśa viṣāṇayoḥ na eva dakṣiṇam savyasya kāraṇam savyam vā dakṣiṇasya kāraṇam bhavati iti tatra yat uktam niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat na

atra ucyate yat tāvat bhavatā uktam sarveṣām bhāvānām sarvatra na vidyate svabhāvaḥ ced tvad vacanam asvabhāvam na nivartayitum svabhāvam alam iti atra brūmaḥ hetu pratyaya sāmagryām ca pṛthak ca api mad vacaḥ na yadi nanu śūnya tvam siddham bhāvānām asvabhāva tvāt yadi mad vacaḥ hetau na asti mahābhūteṣu saṃprayukteṣu viprayukteṣu vā pratyayeṣu na asti uraḥ kaṇṭha oṣṭha jihvā danta mūla tālu nāsikā mūrdha prabhṛtiṣu yatneṣu na ubhaya sāmagryām asti hetu pratyaya sāmagrī vi nirmuktam pṛthak eva ca na asti tasmāt niḥsvabhāvam niḥsvabhāva tvāt śūnyam nanu śūnya tvam siddham niḥsvabhāva tvāt asya madīya vacasaḥ yathā ca etat mad vacanam niḥsvabhāva tvāt śūnyam tathā sarva bhāvāḥ api niḥsvabhāva tvāt śūnyāḥ iti tatra yat bhavatā uktam tvadīya vacasaḥ śūnya tvāt śūnyatā sarva bhāvānām na upapadyate iti tat na

kim ca anyat yaḥ ca prati ityabhāvaḥ bhāvānām śūnyatā iti sā proktā yaḥ ca pratīti abhāvaḥ bhavati hi tasya asvabhāva tvam śūnyatā artham ca bhavān bhāvānām anavasāya pravṛttaḥ upālambham vaktum tvad vacanasya niḥsvabhāva tvāt bhāvānām svabhāva pratiṣedhaḥ na upapadyate iti iha hi yaḥ prati iti abhavaḥ bhāvānām sā śūnyatā kasmāt niḥsvabhāva tvāt ye hi pratītyasamutpannāḥ bhāvāḥ te na sa svabhāvāḥ bhavanti svabhāva abhāvāt kasmāt hetu pratyaya sāpekṣa tvāt yadi hi svabhāvataḥ bhāvāḥ bhaveyuḥ

pratyākhyāya api hetu pratyayam ca bhaveyuḥ na ca evam bhavanti tasmāt niḥsvabhāvāḥ niḥsvabhāva tvāt śūnyāḥ iti abhidhīyante evam madīyam api vacanam pratītyasamutpanna tvāt niḥsvabhāvam niḥsvabhāva tvāt śūnyam iti upapannam yathā ca pratītyasamutpanna tvāt svabhāva śūnya api ratha paṭa ghaṭa ādayaḥ sveṣu sveṣu kāryeṣu kāṣṭha tṛṇa mṛttikā haraṇe madhu udaka payasām dhāraṇe śīta vāta ātapa paritrāṇa prabhṛtiṣu vartante evam idam madīya vacanam pratītyasamutpanna tvāt niḥsvabhāvam api niḥsvabhāva tva prasādhane bhāvānām vartate tatra yat uktam niḥsvabhāva tvāt tvadīya vacanasya śūnya tvam śūnya tvāt tasya ca tena sarva bhāva svabhāva pratiṣedhaḥ na upapannaḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat nirmitakaḥ nirmitakam māyā puruṣaḥ sva māyayā sṛṣṭam pratiṣedhayeta yadvat pratiṣedhaḥ ayam tathā eva syāt yathā nirmitakaḥ puruṣaḥ anyam nirmitakam puruṣam kasmiṃścid arthe vartamānam pratiṣedhayet māyā kāreṇa vā sṛṣṭaḥ māyā puruṣaḥ anyam māyā puruṣam sva māyayā sṛṣṭam kasmiṃścid arthe vartamānam pratiṣedhayet tatra yaḥ nirmitakaḥ puruṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate saḥ api śūnyaḥ yaḥ pratiṣedhayati saḥ api śūnyaḥ yaḥ māyā puruṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate saḥ api śūnyaḥ yaḥ pratiṣedhayati saḥ api śūnyaḥ evam eva mad vacanena śūnyena api sarva bhāvānām svabhāva pratiṣedhaḥ upapannaḥ tatra yat bhavatā uktam śūnya tvāt tvad vacanasya sarva bhāva svabhāva pratiṣedhaḥ na upapannaḥ iti tat na tatra yaḥ bhavatā ṣaṣ koṭikaḥ vādaḥ uktaḥ saḥ api tena eva pratiṣiddhaḥ na eva hi evam sati na sarva bhāva antargatam mad vacanam na asti aśūnyam na api sarva bhāvāḥ aśūnyāḥ

yat punar bhavatā uktam atha sa svabhāvam etat vākyam pūrvā hatā pratijñā te vaiṣamika tvam tasmin viśeṣa hetuḥ ca vaktavya iti atra api brūmaḥ na svābhāvikam etat vākyam tasmāt na vāda hāniḥ me na asti ca vaiṣamika tvam viśeṣa hetuḥ ca na nigadyaḥ na tāvat mama etat vacanam pratītyasamutpanna tvāt svabhāva upapannam yathā pūrvam uktam svabhāva anupapanna tvāt śūnyam iti yasmāt ca idam api mad vacanam śūnyam śeṣāḥ api sarva bhāvāḥ śūnyāḥ tasmāt na asti vaiṣamika tvam yadi hi vayam brūmaḥ idam vacanam aśūnyam śeṣāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ śūnyāḥ iti tatas vaiṣamika tvam syāt na ca etat evam tasmāt na vaiṣamika tvam yasmāt ca vaiṣamika tvam na saṃbhavati idam vacanam aśūnyam śeṣāḥ punar sarva bhāvāḥ śūnyāḥ iti tasmāt asmābhiḥ viśeṣa hetuḥ na vaktavyaḥ anena hetunā idam vacanam aśūnyam sarva bhāvāḥ punar śūnyāḥ iti tatra yat bhavatā uktam vāda hāniḥ te vaiṣamika tvam ca viśeṣa hetuḥ ca tvayā vaktavyaḥ iti tat na

yat punar bhavatā uktam mā śabda vat iti etat syāt te buddhiḥ na ca etat upapannam śabdena hi atra satā bhaviṣyataḥ vāraṇam tasya iti atra brūmaḥ mā śabda vat iti na ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ yaḥ tvayā samārabdhaḥ śabdena tat ca śabdasya vāraṇam na evam eva etat na api ayam asmākam dṛṣṭāntaḥ yathā kaścid mā śabdam kārṣīḥ iti bruvan śabdam eva karoti śabdam ca pratiṣedhayati tadvat tat śūnyam vacanam na śūnyatām pratiṣedhayati kim kāraṇam atra hi dṛṣṭānte śabdena śabdasya vyāvartanam kriyate na ca etat evam vayam brūmaḥ niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ niḥsvabhāva tvāt śūnyāḥ iti

kim kāraṇam naiḥsvābhāvyānām ced naiḥsvābhāvyena vāraṇam yadi hi naiḥsvābhāvya nivṛttau svābhāvyam hi prasiddham syāt yathā mā śabdam kārṣīḥ iti śabdena śabdasya vyāvartanam kriyate evam yadi naiḥsvābhāvyena vacanena naiḥsvābhāvyānām bhāvānām vyāvartanam kriyate tatas ayam dṛṣṭānte upapannaḥ syāt iha tu naiḥsvābhāvyena vacanena bhāvānām svabhāva pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate yadi naiḥsvābhāvyena vacanena bhāvānām naiḥsvābhāvya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate naiḥsvābhāvya pratiṣiddha tvāt eva bhāvāḥ sa svabhāvāḥ bhaveyuḥ sa svabhāva tvāt aśūnyāḥ syuḥ śūnyatām ca vayam bhāvānām ācakṣmahe na aśūnyatām iti adṛṣṭāntaḥ eva ayam iti

atha vā nirmitakāyām yathā striyām strī iyam iti asat grāham nirmitakaḥ pratihanyāt kasyacid evam bhavet etat atha vā kasyacid puruṣasya nirmitakāyām striyām svabhāva śūnyāyām paramārthataḥ striyam iti asat grāhaḥ syāt evam tasyām tena asat grāheṇa sa rāgam utpādayet tathāgatena vā tathāgata śrāvakeṇa vā nirmitakaḥ nirmitaḥ syāt tathāgata adhiṣṭhānena vā tathāgata śrāvaka adhiṣṭhānena vā sa tasya tam asat grāham vinivartayet evam eva nirmitaka upamena śūnyena mad vacanena nirmitaka strī sadṛśeṣu sarva bhāveṣu niḥsvabhāveṣu yaḥ ayam svabhāva grāhaḥ sa nivartyate tasmāt ayam atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ śūnyatā prasādhanam pratyupapadyamānaḥ na itaraḥ
