atha vā sādhya samaḥ ayam hetuḥ na hi vidyate dhvaneḥ sattā saṃvyavahāram ca vayam na anabhyupagamya kathayāmaḥ mā śabda vat iti sādhya samaḥ eva ayam hetuḥ kasmāt sarva bhāvānām naiḥsvabhāvyena aviśiṣṭa tvāt na hi tasya dhvaneḥ pratītyasamutpanna tvāt sva bhava sattā vidyate tasyāḥ svabhāva sattāyāḥ avidyamāna tvāt yat uktam śabdena hi atra satā bhaviṣyataḥ vāraṇam tasya iti tat vyāhanyate api ca na vayam vyavahāra satyam anabhyupagamya vyavahāra satyam pratyākhyāya kathayāmaḥ śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti na hi vyavahāra satyam anāgamya śakyā dharma deśanā kartum yathā uktam vyavahāram anāśritya parama arthaḥ na deśyate parama artham anāgamya nirvāṇam na adhigamyate iti tasmāt mad vacana vat śūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ sarva bhāvānām ca niḥsvabhāva tvam ubhayathā upapadyamānam iti yat punar bhavatā uktam pratiṣedha pratiṣedhaḥ api evam iti matam bhavet tat asat eva evam tava pratijñā lakṣaṇataḥ dūṣyate na mama iti

atra brūmaḥ yadi kācana pratijñā syāt me tatas eṣa me bhavet doṣaḥ na asti ca mama pratijñā tasmāt na eva asti me doṣaḥ yadi ca kācid mama pratijñā syāt tatas mama pratijñā lakṣaṇa prāpta tvāt pūrvakaḥ doṣaḥ yathā tvayā uktaḥ tathā mama syāt na mama kācid asti pratijñā tasmāt sarva bhāveṣu śūnyeṣu atyanta upaśānteṣu prakṛti vivikteṣu kutas pratijñā kutas pratijñā lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ kutas pratijñā lakṣaṇa prāpti kṛtaḥ doṣaḥ tatra yat bhavatā uktam tava pratijñā lakṣaṇa prāpta tvāt tava eva doṣaḥ iti tat na

yat punar bhavatā uktam pratyakṣeṇa hi tāvat yadi upalabhya vinivartayasi bhāvān tat na asti pratyakṣam bhāvāḥ yena upalabhyante anumānam pratyuktam pratyakṣeṇa āgama upamāne ca anumāna āgama sādhyāḥ ye arthāḥ dṛṣṭānta sādhyāḥ ca iti atra vayam brūmaḥ yadi kiṃcid upalabheyam pravartayeyam nivartayeyam vā pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ arthaiḥ tad abhāvāt me anupālambhaḥ

yadi aham kaṃcid artham upalabheyam pratyakṣa anumāna upamāna āgamaiḥ caturbhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ caturṇām vā pramāṇānām anyatamena atas eva pravartayeyam vā nivartayeyam vā yathārtham eva aham kaṃcid na upalabhe tasmāt na pravartayāmi na nivartayāmi tatra evam sati yaḥ bhavatā upālambhaḥ uktaḥ yadi pratyakṣa ādīnām pramāṇānām anyatamena upalabhya bhāvān vinivartayasi nanu tāni pramāṇāni na santi taiś ca pramāṇaiḥ api gamyāḥ arthāḥ na santi iti sa me bhavati eva anupālambhaḥ

kim ca anyat yadi ca pramāṇataḥ te teṣām teṣām prasiddhiḥ arthānām teṣām punar prasiddhim brūhi katham te pramāṇānām yadi ca pramāṇataḥ teṣām teṣām arthānām prameyāṇām prasiddhim manyase yathā mānaiḥ meyānām teṣām idānīm pratyakṣa anumāna upamānāgamānām caturṇām pramāṇānām kutas prasiddhiḥ yadi tāvat niṣpramāṇānām pramāṇānām syāt prasiddhiḥ pramāṇataḥ arthānām prasiddhiḥ iti hīyate pratijñā

tathā api anyaiḥ yadi pramāṇaiḥ pramāṇa siddhiḥ bhavet tad anavasthā yadi punar manyase pramāṇaiḥ prameyāṇām prasiddhiḥ teṣām pramāṇānām anyaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ prasiddhiḥ evam anavasthā prasaṅgaḥ anavasthā prasaṅge kaḥ doṣaḥ na ādeḥ siddhiḥ tatra asti na eva madhyasya na antasya anavasthā prasaṅgaḥ ādeḥ siddhiḥ na asti kim kāraṇam teṣām api hi pramāṇānām anyaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ siddhiḥ teṣām anyaiḥ iti na asti ādiḥ ādeḥ asadbhāvāt kutas madhyam kutas antar tasmāt teṣām pramāṇānām anyaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ prasiddhiḥ iti yat uktam tat na upapadyate iti

teṣām atha pramāṇaiḥ vinā prasiddhiḥ vihīyate vādaḥ vaiṣamika tvam tasmin viśeṣa hetuḥ ca vaktavyaḥ atha manyase teṣām pramāṇānām vinā pramāṇaiḥ prasiddhiḥ prameyāṇām punar arthānām pramāṇaiḥ prasiddhiḥ iti evam sati yaḥ te vādaḥ pramāṇaiḥ prasiddhiḥ arthānām iti sa hīyate vaiṣamika tvam ca bhavati keṣāṃcid arthānām pramāṇaiḥ prasiddhiḥ keṣāṃcid na iti viśeṣa hetuḥ ca vaktavyaḥ yena hetunā keṣāṃcid arthānām pramāṇaiḥ prasiddhiḥ keṣāṃcid na iti sa ca na upadiṣṭaḥ tasmāt iyam api kalpanā na upapanna iti atra āha pramāṇāni eva sva ātmānam para ātmānam ca prasādhayanti yathā uktam dyotayati sva ātmānam yathā hutāśaḥ tathā para ātmānam sva para ātmānau evam prasādhayanti pramāṇāni iti yathā agniḥ sva ātmānam para ātmānam ca prakāśayati tathā eva pramāṇāni prasādhayanti sva ātmānam para ātmānam ca iti

atra ucyate viṣama upanyāsaḥ ayam na hi ātmānam prakāśayati agniḥ na hi tasya anupalabdhiḥ dṛṣṭā tamasi iva kumbhasya viṣamaḥ eva upanyāsaḥ agni vat pramāṇāni sva ātmānam ca prasādhayanti para ātmānam ca prasādhayanti iti na hi agniḥ ātmānam prakāśayati yathā prāk eva agninā prakāśitaḥ tamasi kumbhaḥ na upalabhyate atha uttara kālam upalabhyate agninā prakāśitaḥ san evam eva yadi aprakāśitaḥ prāk agniḥ tamasi syāt uttara kālam agneḥ prakāśanam syāt atas sva ātmānam prakāśayet na ca etat evam tasmāt iyam api kalpanā na upapadyate iti

kim ca anyat yadi ca sva ātmānam ayam tvad vacanena prakāśayati agniḥ param iva nanu ātmānam paridhakṣyati api hutāśaḥ yadi ca tvad vacanena yathā para ātmānam prakāśayati agniḥ evam eva sva ātmānam api prakāśayati nanu yathā para ātmānam dahati evam eva sva ātmānam api dhakṣyati na ca etat evam tatra yat uktam para ātmānam iva sva ātmānam api prakāśayati agniḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat yadi ca sva para ātmānau tvad vacanena prakāśayati agniḥ pracchādayiṣyati tamaḥ sva para ātmānau hutāśaḥ iva yadi ca bhavataḥ matena sva para ātmānau prakāśayati agniḥ nanu idānīm tad pratipakṣa bhūtam tamaḥ api sva para ātmānau chādayet na ca etat dṛṣṭam tatra yat uktam sva para ātmānau prakāśayati agniḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat na asti tamaḥ ca jvalane yatra ca tiṣṭhati para ātmani jvalanaḥ kurute katham prakāśam sa hi prakāśaḥ andhakāra vadhaḥ iha ca agnau na asti tamaḥ na api ca yatra agniḥ tatra asti tamaḥ prakāśaḥ ca nāma tamasaḥ pratighātaḥ yasmāt ca agnau na asti tamaḥ na api ca yatra agniḥ tatra asti tamaḥ tatra kasya tamasaḥ pratighātam agniḥ karoti yasya pratighātāt agniḥ sva para ātmānau prakāśayati iti

atra āha nanu yasmāt evam na agnau tamaḥ asti na api yatra agniḥ tatra tamaḥ asti tasmāt evam sva para ātmānau na prakāśayati agniḥ kutas tena hi utpadyamānena eva agninā tamasaḥ pratighātaḥ tasmāt na agnau tamaḥ asti na api yatra agniḥ tatra tamaḥ asti yasmāt utpadyamānaḥ eva ubhayam prakāśayati agniḥ sva ātmānam para ātmānam ca iti

atra ucyate utpadyamānaḥ eva prakāśayati agniḥ iti asat vādaḥ utpadyamānaḥ eva prāpnoti tamaḥ na hi hutāśaḥ ayam agniḥ utpadyamānaḥ eva prakāśayati sva ātmānam para ātmānam ca iti na ayam upapadyate vādaḥ kasmāt na hi utpadyamānaḥ eva agniḥ tamaḥ prāpnoti aprāpta tvāt na eva upahanti tamasaḥ ca anupaghātāt na asti prakāśaḥ

kim ca anyat aprāptaḥ api jvalanaḥ yadi vā punar andhakāram upahanyāt sarveṣu lokadhātuṣu tamaḥ ayam iha saṃsthitaḥ ha anyāt atha api manyase aprāptaḥ api agniḥ andhakāram upahanti iti nanu idānīm iha saṃsthitaḥ agniḥ sarva loka dhātu stham upahaniṣyati tamaḥ tulyam ayam aprāptaḥ na ca etat evam dṛṣṭam tasmāt aprāpya eva agniḥ andhakāram upahanti iti yat iṣṭam tat na

kim ca anyat yadi svatas ca pramāṇa siddhiḥ anapekṣya tava prameyāṇi bhavati pramāṇa siddhiḥ na para apekṣā svatas siddhiḥ yadi ca agni vat svatas pramāṇa siddhiḥ iti manyase anapekṣya api prameyān arthān pramāṇānām prasiddhiḥ bhaviṣyati kim kāraṇam na hi svatas siddhiḥ param apekṣate atha apekṣate na svatas siddhiḥ

atra āha yadi na apekṣante prameyān arthān pramāṇāni kaḥ doṣaḥ bhaviṣyati iti atra ucyate anapeksya hi prameyān arthān yadi te pramāṇa siddhiḥ iti na bhavanti kasyacid evam imāni tāni pramāṇāni yadi prameyān arthān anapekṣya prasiddhiḥ bhavati pramāṇānām iti evam tāni imāni pramāṇāni na kasyacid pramāṇāni bhavanti evam doṣaḥ atha kasyacid bhavanti pramāṇāni na eva idānīm anapekṣya prameyān arthān pramāṇāni bhavanti

atha matam apekṣya siddhiḥ teṣām iti atra bhavati kaḥ doṣaḥ siddhasya sādhanam syāt na asiddhaḥ apekṣate hi anyat atha api matam apekṣya prameyān arthān pramāṇānām siddhiḥ bhavati iti evam siddhasya pramāṇa catuṣṭayasya sādhanam bhavati kim kāraṇam na hi asiddhasya arthasya apekṣaṇam bhavati na hi asiddhaḥ devadattaḥ kaṃcid artham apekṣate na ca siddhasya sādhanam iṣṭam kṛtasya kāraṇa anupapatteḥ iti

kim ca anyat sidhyanti hi prameyāṇi apekṣya yadi sarvathā pramāṇāni bhavanti prameya siddhiḥ na apekṣya eva pramāṇāni yadi prameyāṇi apekṣya pramāṇāni sidhyanti na idānīm pramāṇāni apekṣya prameyāṇi sidhyanti kim kāraṇam na hi sādhyam sādhanam sādhayati sādhanāni ca kila prameyāṇām pramāṇāni

kim ca anyat yadi ca prameya siddhiḥ na apekṣya eva bhavati pramāṇāni kim te pramāṇa siddhyā tāni yat artham prasiddham tat yadi ca manyase anapekṣya eva pramāṇāni prameyāṇām prasiddhiḥ bhavati iti kim idānīm te pramāṇa siddhyā paryanviṣṭayā kim kāraṇam yat artham hi tāni pramāṇāni paryanviṣyeran te prameyāḥ arthāḥ vinā api pramāṇaiḥ siddhāḥ tatra kim pramāṇaiḥ kṛtyam

atha tu pramāṇa siddhiḥ bhavati apekṣya eva te prameyāṇi vyatyayaḥ evam sati te dhruvam pramāṇa prameyāṇām atha api manyase apekṣya eva prameyān arthān pramāṇāni bhavanti iti mā bhūt pūrva ukta doṣaḥ iti kṛtvā evam te sati vyatyayaḥ pramāṇa prameyāṇām bhavati pramāṇāni te prameyāṇi bhavanti prameyaiḥ sādhita tvat prameyāṇi ca pramāṇāni bhavanti pramāṇānām sādhaka tvāt

atha te pramāṇa siddhyā prameya siddhiḥ prameya siddhyā ca bhavati pramāṇa siddhiḥ na asti ubhayasya api te siddhiḥ atha manyase pramāṇa siddhyā prameya siddhiḥ bhavati pramāṇa apekṣa tvāt prameya siddhyā ca pramāṇa siddhiḥ bhavati prameya apekṣa tvāt iti evam te sati ubhayasya api siddhiḥ na bhavati kim kāraṇam

sidhyanti hi pramāṇaiḥ yadi prameyāṇi tāni taiḥ eva sādhyāni ca prameyaiḥ tāni katham sādhayiṣyanti yadi hi pramāṇaiḥ prameyāṇi sidhyanti tāni ca pramāṇāni taiḥ eva prameyaiḥ sādhayitavyāni nanu asiddheṣu prameyeṣu kāraṇasya asiddha tvāt asiddhāni katham sādhayiṣyanti prameyāṇi

sidhyanti ca prameyaiḥ yadi pramāṇāni tāni taiḥ eva sādhyāni ca pramāṇaiḥ tāni katham sādhayiṣyanti yadi ca prameyaiḥ pramāṇāni sidhyanti tāni ca prameyāṇi taiḥ eva pramāṇaiḥ sādhayitavyāni nanu asiddheṣu pramāṇeṣu kāraṇasya asiddha tvāt asiddhāni katham sādhayiṣyanti pramāṇāni

pitrā yadi utpādyaḥ putraḥ yadi tena ca eva putreṇa utpādyaḥ sa yadi pitā vada tatra utpādayati kaḥ kam yathā api nāma kaścid brūyāt pitrā putraḥ utpādanīyaḥ sa ca pitā tena eva putreṇa utpādanīyaḥ iti tatra idānīm brūhi kena kaḥ utpādayitavyaḥ iti tathā eva khalu bhavān bravīti pramāṇaiḥ prameyāṇi sādhayitavyāni tāni eva ca punar pramāṇāni taiḥ eva prameyaiḥ iti tatra idānīm te katamaiḥ katamāni sādhayitavyāni

kaḥ ca pitā kaḥ putraḥ tatra tvam brūhi tau ubhau api ca pitṛ putra lakṣaṇa dharau yatas bhavati naḥ atra saṃdehaḥ tayoḥ ca pūrva upadiṣṭayoḥ pitṛ putrayoḥ kataraḥ putraḥ kataraḥ pitā ubhau api tau utpādaka tvāt pitṛ lakṣaṇa dharau utpādya tvāt ca putra lakṣaṇa dharau atra naḥ saṃdehaḥ bhavati kataraḥ tatra pitā kataraḥ putraḥ iti evam eva yāni etāni bhavataḥ pramāṇa prameyāṇi tatra katarāṇi pramāṇāni katarāṇi prameyāṇi ubhayāni api hi etāni sādhaka tvāt pramāṇāni sādhya tvāt prameyāṇi atra naḥ saṃdehaḥ bhavati katarāṇi atra pramāṇāni katarāṇi prameyāṇi iti

na eva svatas prasiddhiḥ na parasparataḥ para pramāṇaiḥ vā na bhavati na ca prameyaiḥ na ca api akasmāt pramāṇānām na svatas prasiddhiḥ pratyakṣasya tena eva pratyakṣeṇa anumānasya tena eva anumānena upamānasya tena eva upamānena āgamasya tena eva āgamena na api parasparataḥ pratyakṣasya anumāna upamāna āgamaiḥ anumānasya pratyakṣa upamāna āgamaiḥ upamānasya pratyakṣa anumāna āgamaiḥ āgamasya pratyakṣa anumāna upamānaiḥ na api pratyakṣa anumāna upama anāgamānām anyaiḥ pratyakṣa anumāna upamāna āgamaiḥ yathāsvam na api prameyaiḥ samasta vyastaiḥ sva viṣaya para viṣaya saṃgṛhītaiḥ na api akasmāt na api samuccayena eteṣām kāraṇānām pūrva uddiṣṭānām viṃśat triṃśat catvāriṃśat ṣaṭviṃśateḥ vā tatra yat uktam pramāṇa adhigamya tvāt prameyāṇām bhāvānām santi ca te prameyāḥ bhāvāḥ tāni ca pramāṇāni yaiḥ te pramāṇaiḥ prameyāḥ bhāvāḥ samadhigatāḥ iti tat na

yat punar bhavatā uktam kuśalānām dharmāṇām dharma avasthā vidaḥ ca manyante kuśalam janāḥ svabhāvam śeṣeṣu api eṣa viniyogaḥ iti atra brūmaḥ kuśalānām dharmāṇām dharma avasthā vidaḥ bruvanti yadi kuśalam svabhāvam evam pravibhāgena abhidheyaḥ syāt kuśalānām dharmāṇām dharma avasthā vidaḥ kuśalam svabhāvam manyante sa ca bhavatā pravibhāgena upadeṣṭavyaḥ syāt ayam sa kuśalaḥ svabhāvaḥ ime te kuśalāḥ dharmāḥ idam tat kuśalam vijñānam ayam sa kuśala vijñāna svabhāvaḥ evam sarveṣām na ca etat evam dṛṣṭam tasmāt yat uktam yathāsvam upadiṣṭaḥ svabhāvaḥ dharmāṇām iti tat na

kim ca anyat yadi ca pratītya kuśalaḥ svabhāvaḥ utpadyate sa kuśalānām dharmāṇām para bhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ evam katham bhavati yadi ca kuśalānām dharmāṇām svabhāvaḥ hetu pratyaya sāmagrīm pratītya utpadyate sa para bhāvāt utpannaḥ kuśalānām dharmāṇām katham svabhāvaḥ bhavati evam eva akuśala prabhṛtīnām tatra yat uktam kuśalānām dharmāṇām kuśalaḥ svabhāvaḥ api upadiṣṭaḥ evam akuśala ādīnām ca akuśala ādiḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat atha na pratītya kiṃcid svabhāvaḥ utpadyate sa kuśalānām dharmāṇām evam syāt vāsaḥ na brahmacaryasya atha manyase na kiṃcid pratītya kuśalānām dharmāṇām kuśalaḥ svabhāvaḥ utpadyate evam akuśalānām dharmāṇām akuśalaḥ avyākṛtānām avyākṛtaḥ iti evam sati abrahmacarya vāsaḥ bhavati kim kāraṇam pratītyasamutpādasya hi evam sati pratyākhyānam bhavati pratītyasamutpādasya pratyākhyānāt pratītyasamutpāda darśaṇa pratyākhyānam bhavati na hi avidyamānasya pratītyasamutpādasya darśanam upapadyamānam bhavati asati pratītyasamutpāda darśane dharma darśanam na bhavati uktam hi bhagavatā yaḥ hi bhikṣavaḥ pratītyasamutpādam paśyati sa dharmam paśyati iti dharma darśana abhāvāt brahmacarya vāsa abhāvaḥ

athavā pratītyasamutpāda pratyākhyānāt duḥkha samudaya pratyākhyānam bhavati pratītyasamutpādaḥ hi duḥkhasya samudayaḥ duḥkha samudayasya pratyākhyānāt duḥkha pratyākhyānam bhavati asati hi samudaye tat kutas duḥkham samudeṣyati duḥkha pratyākhyānāt samudaya pratyākhyānāt ca duḥkha nirodhasya pratyākhyānam bhavati asati hi duḥkha samudaye kasya prahāṇāt nirodhaḥ bhaviṣyati asati hi duḥkha samudaye kasya prahāṇāt nirodhaḥ bhaviṣyati duḥkha nirodha pratyākhyānāt mārgasya pratyākhyānam bhavati asati hi duḥkha nirodhe kasya prāptaye mārge bhaviṣyati duḥkha nirodha gāmī evam caturṇām ārya satyānām abhāvaḥ teṣām abhāvāt śrāmaṇya phala abhāvaḥ satya darśanāt śrāmaṇya phalāni hi samadhigamyante śrāmaṇya phalānām abhāvāt abrahmacarya vāsaḥ iti

kim ca anyat na adharmaḥ dharmaḥ vā saṃvyavahārāḥ ca laukikāḥ na syuḥ nityāḥ ca sa svabhāvāḥ syuḥ nitya tvāt ahetumataḥ evam sati pratītyasamutpādam pratyācakṣāṇasya bhavataḥ kaḥ doṣaḥ prasajyate dharmaḥ na bhavati adharmaḥ na bhavati saṃvyavahārāḥ ca laukikāḥ na bhavanti kim kāraṇam pratītyasamutpannam hi etat sarvam asati pratītyasamutpāde kutas bhaviṣyati api ca sa svabhāvaḥ apratītya samutpannaḥ nirhetukaḥ nityaḥ syāt kim kāraṇam nirhetukāḥ hi bhāvāḥ nityāḥ saḥ eva ca abrahmacarya vāsaḥ prasajyeta sva siddhānta virodhaḥ ca kim kāraṇam anityāḥ hi bhagavatā sarve saṃskārāḥ nirdiṣṭāḥ te sa svabhāva nitya tvāt nityāḥ hi bhavanti

evam akuśaleṣu avyākṛteṣu nairyāṇika ādiṣu ca doṣaḥ tasmāt sarvam saṃskṛtam asaṃskṛtam te bhavati eva yaḥ ca eṣa kuśaleṣu dharmeṣu nirdiṣṭaḥ kalpaḥ saḥ eva akuśaleṣu saḥ eva avyākṛteṣu saḥ eva nairyāṇika prabhṛtiṣu tasmāt te sarvam idam saṃskṛtam asaṃskṛtam saṃpadyate kim kāraṇam hetau hi asati utpāda sthiti bhaṅgāḥ na bhavanti utpāda sthiti bhaṅgeṣu asatsu saṃskṛta lakṣaṇa abhāvāt sarvam saṃskṛtam asaṃskṛtam saṃpadyate tatra yat uktam kuśala ādīnām bhāvānām svabhāva sadbhāvāt aśūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat na

yat punar bhavatā uktam yadi ca na bhavet svabhāvaḥ dharmāṇām niḥsvabhāvaḥ iti eva nāma api bhavet na evam nāma hi nirvastukam na asti iti atra brūmaḥ yaḥ sadbhūtam nāma atra brūyāt sa svabhāvaḥ iti evam bhavatā prativaktavyaḥ nāma brūmaḥ ca na vayam tat yaḥ nāma atra sadbhūtam brūyāt sa svabhāvaḥ iti sa bhavatā prativaktavyaḥ syāt yasya sadbhūtam nāma svabhāvasya tasmāt tena api svabhāvena sat bhūtena bhavitavyam na hi asadbhūtasya svabhāvasya sadbhūtam nāma bhavati iti na punar vayam nāma sadbhūtam brūmaḥ tat api hi bhāva svabhāvasya abhāvāt nāma niḥsvabhāvam tasmāt śūnyam śūnya tvāt asat bhūtam tatra yat bhavatā uktam nāma sadbhāvāt sadbhūtaḥ svabhāvaḥ iti tat na

kim ca anyat nāma asat iti ca yat idam tat kim nu sataḥ bhavati uta api asataḥ yadi hi sataḥ yadi asataḥ dvidhā api te hīyate vādaḥ yat ca etat nāma asat iti tat kim sataḥ asataḥ vā yadi hi sataḥ tat nāma yadi asataḥ ubhayathā api pratijñā hīyate tatra yadi tāvat sataḥ nāma asat iti pratijñā hīyate na hi idānīm tat asat idānīm sat atha asataḥ asat iti nāma asat bhūtasya nāma na bhavati tasmāt yā pratijñā nāmnaḥ sadbhūtaḥ svabhāvaḥ iti sā hīnā

kim ca anyat sarveṣām bhāvānām śūnya tvam ca upapāditam pūrvam saḥ upālambhaḥ tasmāt bhavati ayam ca apratijñāyāḥ iha ca asmābhiḥ pūrvam eva sarveṣām bhāvānām vistarataḥ śūnya tvam upapāditam tatra prāk nāmnaḥ api śūnya tvam uktam sa bhavān aśūnya tvam parigṛhya parivṛttaḥ vaktum yadi bhāvānām svābhāvaḥ na syāt asvabhāvaḥ iti nāma api idam na syāt iti tasmāt apratijñā upālambhaḥ ayam bhavataḥ saṃpadyate na hi vayam nāma sadbhūtam iti brūmaḥ

yat punar bhavatā uktam atha vidyate svabhāvaḥ sa ca dharmāṇām na vidyate tasmāt dharmaiḥ vinā svabhāvaḥ sa yasya tat yuktam upadeṣṭum iti atra brūmaḥ atha vidyate svabhāvaḥ sa ca dharmāṇām na vidyate iti idam āśaṅkitam yat uktam bhavati anāśaṅkitam tat ca na hi vayam dharmāṇām svabhāvam pratiṣedhayāmaḥ dharma vinirmuktasya vā kasyacid arthasya svabhāvam abhyupagacchāmaḥ nanu evam sati yaḥ upālambhaḥ bhavataḥ yadi dharmāḥ niḥsvabhāvāḥ kasya khalu idānīm anyasya arthasya dharma vinirmuktasya svabhāvaḥ bhavati sa yuktam upadeṣṭum iti dūra apakṛṣṭam eva etat bhavati upālambhaḥ na bhavati

yat punar bhavatā uktam sataḥ eva pratiṣedhaḥ na asti ghaṭaḥ gehaḥ iti ayam yasmāt dṛṣṭaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ayam sataḥ svabhāvasya te tasmāt iti atra brūmaḥ sataḥ eva pratiṣedhaḥ yadi śūnya tvam nanu prasiddham idam pratiṣedhayate hi bhavān bhāvānām niḥsvabhāva tvam yadi sataḥ eva pratiṣedhaḥ bhavati na asataḥ bhavān ca sarva bhāvānām niḥsvabhāva tvam pratiṣedhayati nanu prasiddham sarva bhāvānām niḥsvabhāva tvam tvad vacanena pratiṣedha sadbhāvāt niḥsvabhāva tvasya ca sarva bhāvānām pratiṣiddha tvāt prasiddhā śūnyatā

pratiṣedhayase atha tvam śūnya tvam tat ca na asti śūnya tvam pratiṣedhaḥ sataḥ iti te nanu eṣa vihīyate vādaḥ atha pratiṣedhayasi tvam sarva bhāvānām niḥsvabhāva tvam śūnya tvam na asti tat ca śūnya tvam yā tarhi te pratijñā sataḥ pratiṣedhaḥ bhavati na asataḥ iti sā hīnā

kim ca anyat pratiṣedhayāmi na aham kiṃcid pratiṣedhyam asti na ca kiṃcid tasmāt pratiṣedhayasi iti adhilayaḥ eṣa tvayā kriyate yadi aham kiṃcid pratiṣedhayāmi tatas tat api tvayā yuktam eva vaktum syāt na ca eva aham kiṃcid pratiṣedhayāmi yasmāt na kiṃcid pratiṣeddhavyam asti tasmāt śūnyeṣu sarva bhāveṣu avidyamāne pratiṣedhye pratiṣedhe ca pratiṣedhayasi iti eṣa tvayā aprastutaḥ adhilayaḥ kriyate iti

yat punar bhavatā uktam atha na asti sa svabhāvaḥ kim nu pratiṣidhyate tvayā anena vacanena ṛte vacanāt pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyate hi asataḥ iti atra brūmaḥ yat ca āhaṛte vacanāt asataḥ pratiṣedha vacana siddhiḥ iti atra jñāpayate vāc asat iti tat na pratinihanti yat ca bhavān bravīti ṛte api vacanāt asataḥ pratiṣedhaḥ prasiddhaḥ tatra kim niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti etat tvad vacanam karoti iti atra brūmaḥ niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti etat khalu vacanam na niḥsvabhāvān eva sarva bhāvān karoti kim tu asati svabhāve bhāvāḥ niḥsvabhāvāḥ iti jñāpayati tat yathā kaścid brūyāt avidyamāna gṛhe devadatte asti gṛhe devadattaḥ iti tatra enam kaścid pratibrūyāt na asti iti na tat vacanam devadattasya asadbhāvam karoti kim tu jñāpayati kevalam asaṃbhavam gṛhe devadattasya tadvat na asti svabhāvaḥ bhāvānām iti etat vacanam na bhāvānām niḥsvabhāva tvam karoti kim tu sarva bhāveṣu svabhāvasya abhāvam jñāpayati tatra yat bhavatā uktam kim asati svabhāve na asti svabhāvaḥ iti etat vacanam karoti ṛte api vacanāt prasiddhaḥ svabhāvasya abhāvaḥ iti tat na yuktam

anyat ca bālānām iva mithyā mṛgatṛṣṇāyām yathā jala grāhaḥ evam mithyāgrāhaḥ syāt te pratiṣedhyataḥ hi asataḥ ityādayaḥ yā punar catasraḥ gāthāḥ bhavatā uktāḥ atra brūmaḥ mṛgatṛṣṇā dṛṣṭānte yaḥ punar uktaḥ tvayā mahān carcaḥ tatra api nirṇayam śṛṇu yathā sa dṛṣṭānte upapannaḥ yaḥ eva tvayā mṛgatṛṣṇā dṛṣṭānte mahān carcaḥ uktaḥ tatra api yaḥ nirṇayaḥ sa śrūyatām yathā upapannaḥ eṣa dṛṣṭāntaḥ bhavati

sa yadi svabhāvataḥ syāt grāhaḥ na syāt pratītya saṃbhūtaḥ yaḥ ca pratītya bhavati grāhaḥ nanu śūnyatā sā eva yadi mṛgatṛṣṇāyām sa yathā jala grāhaḥ svabhāvataḥ syāt na syāt pratītyasamutpannaḥ yatas mṛgatṛṣṇām ca pratītya viparītam ca darśanam pratītya ayoni śoma naskāram ca pratītya syāt udbhūtaḥ atas pratītyasamutpannaḥ yatas ca pratītyasamutpannaḥ atas svabhāvataḥ śūnyaḥ eva yathā pūrvam uktam tathā

kim ca anyat yadi ca svabhāvataḥ syāt grāhaḥ kaḥ tam nivartayet grāham śeṣeṣu api eṣa vidhiḥ tasmāt eṣaḥ anupālambhaḥ yadi ca mṛgatṛṣṇāyām jala grāhaḥ svabhāvataḥ syāt kaḥ eva tam vinivartayet na hi svabhāvaḥ śakyaḥ vinivartayitum yathā agneḥ uṣṇa tvam apām drava tvam ākāśasya nirāvaraṇa tvam dṛṣṭam ca asya vinivartanam tasmāt śūnya svabhāvaḥ grāhaḥ yathā ca etat evam śeṣeṣu api dharmeṣu eṣa kramaḥ pratyavagantavyaḥ grāhya prabhṛtiṣu pañcasu tatra yat bhavatā uktam ṣaṭka bhāvāt aśūnyāḥ sarva bhāvāḥ iti tat na

yat punar bhavatā uktam hetoḥ ca te na siddhiḥ naiḥsvābhāvyāt kutas hi te hetuḥ nirhetukasya siddhiḥ na ca upapanna asya te arthasya iti atra brūmaḥ etena hetu abhāvaḥ pratyuktaḥ pūrvam eva sa sama tvāt mṛgatṛṣṇā dṛṣṭānta vyāvṛtti vidhau yaḥ uktaḥ prāk etena ca idānīm ca rcena pūrva uktena hetu abhāvaḥ api pratyuktaḥ avagantavyaḥ yaḥ eva hi carcaḥ pūrvasmin hetau uktaḥ ṣaṭka pratiṣedhasya saḥ eva iha api carcayitavyaḥ

yat punar bhavatā uktam pūrvam ced pratiṣedhaḥ paścāt pratiṣedhyam iti anupapannam paścāt ca anupapannaḥ yugapad ca yatas svabhāvaḥ san iti atra brūmaḥ yaḥ traikālye hetuḥ pratyuktaḥ pūrvam eva sa sama tvāt traikālya pratihetuḥ ca śūnyatā vādinām prāptaḥ yaḥ eva hetuḥ traikālye pratiṣedha vācī saḥ ukta uttaraḥ pratyavagantavyaḥ kasmāt sādhya sama tvāt tathā hi tvad vacanena pratiṣedhaḥ traikālye anupapanna pratiṣedha vat sa pratiṣedhyaḥ api tasmāt pratiṣiddhaḥ iti tat na yaḥ tri kāla pratiṣedha vācī hetuḥ eṣaḥ eva śūnyatā vādinām prāptaḥ sarva bhāva svabhāva pratiṣedhaka tvāt na bhavataḥ

atha vā katham etat ukta uttaram pratiṣedhayāmi na aham kiṃcid pratiṣedhyam asti na ca kiṃcid tasmāt pratiṣedhayasi iti adhilayaḥ eṣa tvayā kriyate iti iti pratyuktam atha manyase triṣu api kāleṣu pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ pūrva kālīnaḥ api hetuḥ uttarakālīnaḥ api yugapad kālīnaḥ api hetuḥ tatra pūrva kalīnaḥ hetuḥ yathā pitā putrasya paścāt kālīnaḥ yathā śiṣyaḥ ācāryasya yugapad kālīnaḥ yathā pradīpaḥ prakāśasya iti atra brūmaḥ na ca etat evam uktāḥ hi etasmim krame trayaḥ pūrva doṣāḥ api ca yadi evam pratiṣedha sadbhāvaḥ tvayā abhyupagamyate pratijñā hāniḥ ca te bhavati etena krameṇa svabhāva pratiṣedhaḥ api siddhaḥ

prabhavati ca śūnyatā iyam yasya prabhavanti tasya sarva arthāḥ prabhavati na tasya kiṃcid na prabhavati śūnyatā yasya yasya śūnyatā iyam prabhavati tasya sarva arthāḥ laukika lokottarāḥ prabhavanti kim kāraṇam yasya hi śūnyatā prabhavati tasya pratītyasamutpādaḥ prabhavati yasya pratītyasamutpādaḥ prabhavati tasya catvāri ārya satyāni prabhavanti yasya catvāri ārya satyāni prabhavanti tasya śrāmaṇya phalāni bhavanti sarva viśeṣa adhigamāḥ prabhavanti yasya sarva viśeṣa adhigamāḥ prabhavanti tasya trīṇi ratnāni buddha dharma saṃghāḥ prabhavanti yasya pratītyasamutpādaḥ prabhavati tasya dharmaḥ dharma hetuḥ dharma phalam ca prabhavanti tasya adharmaḥ adharma hetuḥ adharma phalam ca prabhavanti yasya dharma adharmau dharma adharma hetū dharma adharma phale ca prabhavanti tasya kleśaḥ kleśa samudayaḥ kleśa vastūni ca prabhavanti yasya etat sarvam prabhavati pūrva uktam tasya sugati durgati vyavasthā sugati durgati gamanam sugati durgati gāmī mārgaḥ sugati durgati vyatikramaṇam sugati durgati vyatikrama upāyaḥ sarva saṃvyavahārāḥ ca laukikāḥ vyavasthāpitāḥ svayam adhigantavyāḥ anayā diśā kiṃcid śakyam vacanena upadeṣṭum iti
bhavati ca atra yaḥ śūnyatām pratītyasamutpādam madhyamām pratipadam ca eka arthām nijagāda praṇamāmi tam apratima buddham iti kṛtiḥ iyam ācārya nāgārjuna pādānām

avayavi nirākaraṇam namaḥ lokanāthāya abhyāsa atiśayaḥ tathā na vihitaḥ tādṛś śrutam na arjitam tat me cāpalam artha leśam adhunā nirmātum īhe yadi etat sarvam avekṣya yat nigaditam tat paṇḍitaiḥ dṛśyatām prīṇanti eva viceṣṭitāni hi śiśoḥ prāyas pitṝṇām manaḥ yaḥ viruddha dharma adhyāsavān na asau ekaḥ yathā ghaṭādiḥ arthaḥ viruddha dharma adhyāsavān ca sthūlaḥ nīlādiḥ arthaḥ iti vyāpaka viruddha upalabdhiḥ iha dṛśyamānaḥ sthūlaḥ nīlādiḥ arthaḥ dharmī sa ca anubhava avasitaḥ asati bādhake pratyakṣa siddhaḥ hetoḥ āśraya asiddhim nihanti

nanu bhavadbhiḥ asan eva avayavī pratijñāyate sa katham pratyakṣa siddhaḥ na avayavinam iha dharmiṇam pratipannāḥ smaḥ kim tu pratibhāsamānam sthūla nīla ādikam artham na tarhi viruddha dharma saṃsargāt avayavinaḥ eka tvam pratiṣiddham syāt yadi evam kaḥ tarhi bhavataḥ avayavī ekaḥ aneka avayava samavetaḥ arthaḥ iti ced sa kim pratibhāsamānāt sthūla nīla ādeḥ anyaḥ ananyaḥ vā na tāvat anyaḥ dṛśya tvena abhyupagamāt na ca pratibhāsamāna sthūla nīla artha vyatirekeṇa aparaḥ pratibhāti ananyaḥ ced tasya ekatva pratikṣepe katham apratiṣiddham eka tvam avayavinaḥ

nanu ca pratibhāsamānaḥ ced arthaḥ na avayavi rūpaḥ dharmī kim tarhi rūpam asya aviśiṣṭam prasiddham bhaviṣyati iti ucyate pratibhāsamānaḥ sthūlaḥ nīla ākāraḥ pratyakṣa siddham rūpam avayavi tva anabhyupagame api avaśiṣyate na ca evam mantavyam na paramāṇu saṃcaya vādinām sthūla ākāraḥ kaścid arthaḥ asti yaḥ prasiddhaḥ dharmī syāt iti avayavi anabhyupagame api hi niravayavān eka ātmakaḥ sthūlaḥ arthaḥ abhyupagamyamānaḥ kena niṣiddhaḥ

syāt matam niravayavāḥ paramāṇavaḥ katham pratyakṣe sthūlena ākāreṇa avabhāseran sthūla sūkṣmayoḥ virodhāt iti tat api na yuktam paramāṇavaḥ eva hi para rūpa deśa parihāreṇa utpannāḥ paraspara sahitāḥ avabhāsamānāḥ deśa vitānavantaḥ bhāsante vitata deśa tvam ca sthūla tvam yat tu uktam sthūla sūkṣmayoḥ virodhaḥ iti tat kim para rūpa deśa parihāravatī niravayavānām utpattiḥ paraspara sahitānām eka vijñāna avabhāsi tvam vā aviruddham iti vaktu madhya vasitam

idam ced aviruddham sthūla ākāraḥ kim viruddhaḥ atas eva niravayaveṣu bahuṣu ekasmin vijñāne pratibhāsamāneṣu bhavan pratibhāsa kāla bhāvī pratibhāsa dharmaḥ sthūla ākāraḥ na tu vāstavaḥ pratyekam abhāvāt pratibhāsāt prāk urdhvam vā na tarhi sthūlaḥ iti ced na tadā api pratibhāsa yogya tā saṃbhavāt yadā eva hi saṃcitāḥ bhaveyuḥ tadā eva pratibhāsa yogyāḥ paramāṇavaḥ yadā ca pratibhāsa yogyāḥ tadā sthūlāḥ

yaḥ tu āha niravayaveṣu bahuṣu pratibhāsamāneṣu avaśyam antareṇa api pratibhāsitavyam antarā anavabhāse paraspara viviktāḥ eva na avabhāsitāḥ syuḥ vivikta anavabhāse ca aṇu mātrakam piṇḍaḥ bhavet na ca antaram avabhāsamānam utpaśyāmaḥ tat ayam nirantaraḥ ekaḥ eva sthūlaḥ na niravayavān eka ātmakaḥ bhavitum arhati api tu ekaḥ sthūla ātmakaḥ eva iti saḥ api evam vācyaḥ kim vijātīya paramāṇu antaram antaram āhosvit śūnya ākāśa yogaḥ tatra śūnya ākāśa yogaḥ tāvat avastu tayā na indriya pratyakṣa gocaraḥ artha sāmarthya bhāvini tatra arthasya eva pratibhāsa upapatteḥ vijātīyam tu indriya antara grāhyam katham indriya antara jñāne avabhāseta aviṣaya tvāt tatra kena antareṇa avabhāsitavyam iti na vidmaḥ

yat punar ucyate antarāla anavabhāse viviktā na avabhāseḥ an iti tatra api kim eṣām antaram vivekaḥ para rūpa śūnyatā vā iti cintyam nirūpayantaḥ tu para rūpa śūnyatām eva vivekam vastūnām paśyāmaḥ para rūpa śūnyāḥ ca ime bhāsamānāḥ katham viviktā na avabhāseḥ an iti nanu ca na pratyekam paramāṇūnām sthūla ākāraḥ tatas samuditānām eṣṭavyaḥ yathā ca nīla paramāṇūnām pratyekam asaṃbhavan pīta ākāraḥ bahuṣu api na dṛśyate tathā pratyekam asaṃbhavan sthūla ākāraḥ katham bahuṣu syāt iti uktam atra aviruddhaḥ niravayavāṇām sthūla ākāraḥ iti nīla viruddhaḥ tu pīta ākāraḥ tatas pīta viruddham nīla ākāram vibhrāṇeṣu bahuṣu api katham pīta ākāraḥ bhavet na evam niravayavatu aviruddhaḥ sthūla ākāraḥ yathā ukta nyāyāt tat evam pratyakṣa siddhaḥ sthūlaḥ arthaḥ iha dharmī iti vyavasthitam

tat evam vyavasthite dharmiṇi hetoḥ sattvam asat tvam vā nirūpya tatra pāṇi ādau ekasmin kampamāne sthūlaḥ arthaḥ sa kampa niṣkampe rūpe yugapad pratipadyamānaḥ katham viruddha dharma saṃsargavān na syāt sa kampa niṣkampayoḥ hi rūpayoḥ paraspara abhāva avyabhicāra nimittakaḥ asti virodhaḥ bhāva abhāvayoḥ eva hi paraspara parihāra ātmakaḥ virodhaḥ vastunoḥ tu tad abhāva avyabhicāreṇa eva iha ca sa kampa niṣkampe rūpe gṛhṇat pratyakṣam eva sāmarthyāt paraspara abhāvam sādhayati vyavahārayati tu nirviśeṣaṇā eva anupalabdhiḥ

syāt etat pāṇi ādau ekasmin avayave kampamāne na avayavinaḥ kampa rūpam abhyupeyam avayavaḥ eva hi tadā kriyāvān dṛśyate na ca idam mantavyam avayave kriyāvati tad ādheyena avayavinā api kriyāvatā bhavitavyam yathā rathe calati tadā āruḍhaḥ api calati iti avayava avayavi karmaṇoḥ bhinna nimitta tvāt nimitta ayaugapadyāt ca

yadā hi ātmanaḥ pāṇikampana icchā bhavati tatas prayatnaḥ tadā prayatna vat ātma pāṇi saṃyogāt pāṇau kriyā yadā tu śarīra kampana arthaḥ prayatna viśeṣaḥ ātmanaḥ jāyate tadā tad prayatna vat ātma śarīra saṃyogāt śarīre karma iti nimitta bhedaḥ atas bhinna nimittayoḥ ekasmin jāte katham nimitta antara pratibaddha janmā tad abhāve tad aparaḥ api tathā eva jāyeta ratha tadāruḍha karmaṇoḥ tu sati api nimitta bhede nimitta yaugapadyāt sahabhāvaḥ

tathā hi nodanam rathakarmaṇī asamavāyi kāraṇam tadā āruḍha karmaṇaḥ tu nodya saṃyogaḥ tayoḥ ca sahabhāvāt karmaṇī api yaugapadyena jāyete tat etat sakalam ālocya bhadanta dharma uttareṇa idam uktam na ca atra avayavaḥ kriyāvān avayaveṣu hi kriyā vastu vibhāgaḥ jāyate kriyāyāḥ vibhāga ārambham prati nirapekṣa kāraṇa tvāt tena ca saṃyoge asamavāyi kāraṇe nivartite nivarteta avayavi dravyam iti

idam āhuḥ atra kaṇāda śiṣyāḥ nodanāt abhighātāt vā jāyamānaḥ kriyā viśeṣaḥ dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga pratidvandvi vibhāga ārambhakaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ anyat tu vibhāga mātram ārabhate na tu yathā ukta viśeṣam anyasmin padma saṃkoca vikāśa ādike karmaṇi avayava saṃyoga nivṛtteḥ adarśanāt tadvat prayatna janyasya api karmaṇaḥ na asti saṃyoga nivartana sāmarthyam tatas na asti dravya nivṛttiḥ iti

ayam atra samādhiḥ iha avayavini kriyāvati niyamena avayavaiḥ api kriyāvadbhiḥ bhavitavyam anyathā avayava saṃsṛṣṭebhyaḥ ākāśa deśebhyaḥ vibhāgaḥ avayava asaṃsṛṣṭaiḥ ca saṃyogaḥ avayavinaḥ kriyāvataḥ syāt avayavāḥ tu kriyā virahiṇaḥ pūrva ākrāntebhyaḥ nabhaḥ deśebhyaḥ na apasarpeyuḥ avayavi samākrāntaiḥ ca deśaiḥ na abhisaṃbadhyeran na ca avayavi saṃyoga vibhāgābhyām avayava saṃyoga vibhāgau vācyau kārya saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ kāraṇa saṃyoga vibhāgau prati nimitta bhāva anabhyupagamāt kāraṇa saṃyoga vibhāgau eva hi kārya saṃyoga vibhāgau ārabhete

na ca viparyayaḥ siddhānta hāni prasaṅgāt tena avayava avayavinām pṛthak deśa tvāt ādhārya ādhāra bhāva hānau samavāyaḥ api na vyavatiṣṭheta tasmāt avayavini kriyāvati avayavāḥ kriyāvantaḥ iti akāmakaiḥ api vaiśeṣikaiḥ idam abhyupeyam yathā ca avayavi kriyāyām avayavāḥ kriyāvantaḥ tathā avayaveṣu api kriyāvatsu tad avayavaiḥ kriyāvadbhiḥ bhāvyam iti anayā diśā dvi aṇuke kriyāvati tad ārambhakau paramāṇū kriyāvantau mantavyau atas cala avayava saṃbandhinaḥ calāḥ paramāṇavaḥ niṣkriya avayava saṃbandhinaḥ tu niṣkriyāḥ paramāṇu kriyāyām tadā ārabdham api dvi aṇuka dravyam kriyāvat prasajyeta sarva avayava kriyāyāḥ kārya kriyā vinābhūta tvāt

ekasya paramāṇoḥ kriyā na parasya iti ced sa kriya niṣkriyau tarhi paramāṇū parasparam vibhajyamānau ujjhita dravya ārambhaka saṃyogau syātām tatas ca dravya nāśaḥ evam ca dvi aṇuka dravyasya kriyāvat tve tri aṇuke api kriyā syāt iti anena krameṇa paridṛśyamānaḥ acalaḥ calaḥ syāt avayavaḥ tasmāt niṣkriya avayava saṃbandhinaḥ niṣkriyāḥ paramāṇavaḥ cala avayava saṃbandhibhyaḥ calebhyaḥ vibhajyamānāḥ dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśavantaḥ syuḥ niravayavaḥ hi paramāṇuḥ yam aṇu mātra nabhaḥ deśam ākramya paramāṇu antareṇa saṃyujyate tatas vibhajyamānaḥ katham anujjhita paramāṇu antara pratyāsattikaḥ syāt sa avayavaḥ hi bhāvaḥ ekena avayavena vastu antara saṃyuktaḥ eva avayava antaraiḥ calaiḥ pūrva ākrāntān nabhaḥ deśān virahathya deśa antaram ākrāmet niravayaveṣu tu atyantam astamitā iyam kathā iti yuktam dravya nāśa prasaṅgam utpaśyāmaḥ

atha vā anyathā ayam viruddha dharma saṃsargaḥ tathā hi āvṛte ekasmin pāṇi ādau sthūlasya āvṛta anāvṛte rūpe yugapad udbhavantī viruddha dharma dvaya saṃyogam asya āvedayataḥ na ca anāvṛta eka rūpaḥ eva ayam iti śakyam vaktum arddha āvaraṇe api anāvṛtasya pūrvavat darśana prasaṅgāt tad avayava darśana āyatta upalabdheḥ tad adṛṣṭau asya adṛṣṭiḥ iti ced adṛṣṭiḥ eva tarhi asyāḥ tu na tu dṛṣṭi adṛṣṭī

nanu asti eva avayavi darśanam avayava āvaraṇe api iti kaḥ ayam prasaṅgaḥ evam tarhi sthūlaḥ prāgvat upalabhyeta idam atra āha kaścid bhūyas avayava indriya sannikarṣa sahāyaḥ avayavi indriya sannikarṣaḥ sthūla upalabdheḥ nimittam na ca arddhāvaraṇe bhūyasām avayavānām asti indriya sannikarṣaḥ tatas na sthūla grahaṇam iti

saḥ api evam praṣṭavyaḥ kim sthūlaḥ nāma avayavinaḥ anyaḥ saḥ eva vā aneka vyāpī sthūlaḥ tatra yadi avayavi eva sthūlaḥ tadā tad grahaṇe katham na sthūla grahaṇam iti cintyam atha sthūla tva ākhyaḥ parimāṇa viśeṣaḥ guṇaḥ sa ca dravyāt anyaḥ eva iti ced evam tarhi parimāṇa rahitam etat dravyam upalabhyate na tu asya anyena anyena parimāṇena yogaḥ na ca asya aneka parimāṇa kalpanā api sādhvī yugapad sarveṣām anupalabdheḥ na ca dṛśyasya darśana nivṛttiḥ yuktā

avayavasya eva tat parimāṇam upalabhyate iti ced yadi evam saḥ eva tarhi avayavaḥ svena parimāṇena saṃbaddhaḥ pratyakṣaḥ astu āvaraṇa kāle na avayavī syāt etat eka artha samavāyāt bhrānti nimittāt avayavi eva avayava parimānena saṃbaddhaḥ pratibhāti iti tat api na śobhanam dvayoḥ sama parimāṇayoḥ avayava avayavinoḥ pratibhāsa prasaṅgaḥ yasya hi mahataḥ avayavasya tat parimāṇam sa tāvat svena parimāṇena saṃbaddhaḥ pratibhāti avayavinaḥ ca tad parimāṇa saṃbandha pratibhāsā abhyupagame dvayoḥ sama parimāṇayoḥ avayava avayavinoḥ pratibhāsaḥ āsajyate

na ca asti yathā uktaḥ pratibhāsaḥ parimāṇa rahitaḥ saḥ avayavaḥ pratibhāsate iti ced syāt etat yasya avayavasya parimāṇena avayavī saṃbaddhaḥ pratibhāti sa svam parimāṇam parityajya ābhāti iti idam api parimāṇa virahiṇaḥ avayavasya adṛṣṭeḥ aśakyam kalpayitum eka artha samavāyāt ca bhrānti nimittāt alpatara avayava parimāṇavān api avayavī pratibhāseta na ca bādhakam antareṇa bhrāntiḥ api śakyā vyavasthāpayitum

astu tarhi sthūlaḥ avayavaḥ eva pratyakṣaḥ evam āvaraṇa kāle iva anāvaraṇa avasthāyām api sthūlataraḥ avayavaḥ pratyakṣaḥ astu para madhya vartinām avayavānām indriya sannikarṣa abhāve sthūlatama avayavi darśana anupapatteḥ syāt matam nikhila avayava darśana na sthūla pratyakṣa kāraṇam kim tu bhūyas avayava darśanam iti idam api na samyak abhimukha avasthitasya hi parvata āt eḥ arvācīna avayava darśane na tathā sthūla pratipattiḥ yathā arvāk para madhya vartinām darśane tatas na yāvat niravaśeṣa avayava darśanam tāvat katham sthūlatama artha pratipattiḥ syāt na ca avayavāḥ arvāk para madhya vartinaḥ yugapad dṛśyante tat katham avayavī sthūlaḥ dṛśyeta

krameṇa diśām avayavānām pratyakṣīkaraṇe pratyakṣaḥ sthūlaḥ avayavī iti ced anyadā tu kaḥ pratyakṣaḥ iti vimṛṣyam avayavaḥ iti ced avayavāḥ api para madhya vartinaḥ na yugapad dṛśyante iti katham saḥ api pratyakṣaḥ syāt tat evam na avayavī na avayavāḥ pratyakṣāḥ iti na kiñcid dṛśyeta iti tat siddham āvṛta anāvṛta rūpaḥ sthūlaḥ arthaḥ iti

tathā rāga ārāgābhyām virodhaḥ saṃbhāvanīyaḥ tathā hi ekasmin rakte sthūlaḥ arthaḥ rakta ārakte rūpe yugapad pratipadyamānaḥ viruddha rūpa dvaya yogam ātmanaḥ prakāśayati nanu avayavaḥ eva raktaḥ avayavī tvarakta eka rūpaḥ eva iti yadi evam rakte avayave arakta rūpaḥ avayavī dṛśyeta na ca evam atha vā rāga dravya saṃyogaḥ hi rakta tvam avayavasya ca rāga dravyeṇa saṃyoge avayavinaḥ api tena bhāvyam avaśyam hi kāraṇa saṃyoginā kāryam api saṃyujyate iti samayāt

yaḥ tu āha raktaḥ eva avayavī asti hi kuṅkuma ārakte paṭa avayave kuṅkuma āraktaḥ paṭaḥ iti pratyayaḥ tatas rāga dravya saṃyuktaḥ eva avayavī iti tasya api varṇa antara anavabhāsaḥ syāt avayavinaḥ rāga dravyam hi pratyāsīdat nija rūpam vastunaḥ tirodhatte svena ca rūpeṇa dravyam saṃbadhnāti yathā raktaḥ avayavaḥ tirohita sahaja rūpaḥ rāga dravya samavāyinā rūpeṇa saṃbandhī pratibhāti avayavinī api rāga dravya saṃyogini varṇa antara anava bhāsa prasaṅgaḥ durvāraḥ tat na raktaḥ eva avayavī iti śakyam vaktum

anyaḥ tu saṃyogasya avyāpya vṛttyā samādhatte sa hi āha śabdaḥ iva avyāpya vṛttiḥ saṃyogaḥ tena eka arthaḥ raktaḥ ca āraktaḥ ca saḥ api evam paryanuyojyaḥ katham avyāpya vṛttiḥ yadi hi sva āśraye samavetaḥ rūpa ādi vat vyāpya vṛttiḥ eva ayam asamavetaḥ ca āvṛttiḥ eva api adravyeṣu iva gandhaḥ ekatra saṃyogasya bhāva abhāvā vyāpinī vṛttiḥ iti ced syāt etat yathā viruddhau api rūpa rasau ekam āśrayete tathā saṃyogasya api ekatra bhāva abhāvau yugapad syātām

aho moha vijṛmbhitam abhāvaḥ hi bhāva nivṛtti rūpaḥ na asya bhāva nivṛttim hitvā rūpa antaram īkṣyate yaḥ ca yat nivṛtti rūpaḥ sa katham tasmin sati eva bhavati bhāve vā tad nivṛtti rūpa tām jahyāt tathā hi analam paśyan api salila arthī tatra pravarteta jala viviktasya analasya darśanāt jala abhāva siddheḥ apravṛttiḥ iti ced bhavatu anupalambhāt jala abhāva siddhiḥ tathā api jala sattām saṃbhāvayan jala arthī pravarteta nanu tatra yadi jalam syāt upalabhyeta kim atas atas anupalambhāt abhāvaḥ jalasya iti yadi api abhyupagatā eva jala abhāva siddhiḥ tathā api tad arthinaḥ tad bhāva śaṅkayā pravṛttiḥ syāt yugapad ekatra saṃyogasya bhāva abhāvau dṛśyete tena evam kalpayāmaḥ na sva icchayā

nanu kim abhāvaḥ bhāva pratiṣedha ātmakaḥ pratīyate anyathā vā tatra bhāva nivṛtti rūpe abhāve siddhe katham bhāva upalabdhiḥ na bhrāntā syāt bhāva apratiṣedha ātmakaḥ ca na abhāvaḥ nāma mātram tu syāt na ca nāma mātrāt arthasya tathā abhāvaḥ rūpa rasayoḥ tu na paraspara nivṛttiḥ rūpam iti katham tat udāharaṇam iha śobheta na ca rūpa rasayoḥ ekatra samavāyaḥ asmābhiḥ anumanyate śabdaḥ api evam eva avyāpya vṛttiḥ asiddhaḥ sa katham prakṛta saṃśaya nivṛttaye kalpyeta iti alam bahulāpitayā atha vā sthūlaḥ arthaḥ tad atad deśaḥ pratīyate tad atad deśayoḥ ca paraspara abhāva avyabhicāra nimittaḥ asti virodhaḥ atas viruddha dharma saṃsargaḥ sthūlasya

syāt etat katham tat atad deśayoḥ paraspara abhāva avyabhicāraḥ ucyate iha tāvat ekasmin deśe paricchidyamāne tādrūpya pracyutirasya vyavacchidyate tat avyavacchede tad pariccheda abhāva prasakteḥ pracyuti vat ca pracyutimat api deśa antaram vyavacchidyate yadi hi paricchidyamānaḥ deśa antara svabhāvaḥ bhavet tadā tad rūpaḥ eva upalabdhaḥ bhavet deśa antara rūpam tu virahayya svena rūpeṇa prakāśamānaḥ deśaḥ deśa antara asaṃsṛṣṭaḥ iti avasīyate yathā ca deśasya deśa antara asaṃsargaḥ tathā tena ādhāra bhūtena deśena yat vyāptam rūpam tat api deśa antara saṃsargāt avacchinnam bhavati katham hi tena deśena vyāptam rūpam tat abhāvavati deśa antare varteta yathā ekena deśena vyāptaḥ ghaṭaḥ na deśa antare vartate

deśa antare anupalambhāt apravṛttiḥ iti ced viprakṛṣṭe deśa antare katham asya abhāvaḥ pratipattavyaḥ tasmāt idama kāmakena api vācyam yat uta eka deśa vyāptam rūpam na deśa antare vartate iti tasya tena vyāpana prasaṅgāt tad abhāvati deśa antare vartamānaḥ api tena deśena vyāpyeta na ca vyāptiḥ asya śakya avasātum bhāga antara asaṃbhavāt

etena tat nirastam yat āha kaścid yathā ekaḥ bhāvaḥ tat atad deśam janayan na virudhyate iti tat api na prakṛta anurūpam tathā hi bhāva abhāvau eva paraspara parihāreṇa viruddhau na vastunī vastunoḥ tu paraspara abhāva avyabhicāreṇa virodhaḥ tena yat eva vastu vastu antara pracyutimat tat eva tena viruddham

na ca eka kārya nirvartana śaktiḥ kārya antara śakti abhāva avyabhicāriṇī anupalambhaḥ hi vastunaḥ vastu antara abhāva avyabhicāram sādhayati eka kārya nirvartana śaktimati ca rūpe gṛhyamāṇe kārya antara nirvarttana śaktiḥ api paricchidyate iti katham tad abhāvaḥ eka deśa saṃbaddham tu rūpam deśa antara saṃsargi rūpa parihāreṇa upalabhyamānam tad abhāva avyabhicāri tena viruddham yathā atyanta sadṛśoḥ vastunoḥ yugapad upalabhyamānayoḥ sati api ca ākāra bhede dūrāt anupalakṣyamāṇa bhedayoḥ deśa bheda mātra nimittakam pratyakṣa avasitam virodham āśritya bhedaḥ avasthāpyate

yaḥ tu āha yathā ekam cakṣuḥ vijñānam bhinneṣu cakṣuḥ ādiṣu vartate tad adhīna utpāda tayā tathā anyaḥ api bhinna deśa nivṛttiḥ na bhetsyate iti saḥ api deśa bheda nimitte virodhe avasthāpyamāne vastunaḥ kāraṇa bheda nimittam virodham āsañjayan na naipuṇyam ātmanaḥ nivedayati na hi vijñānasya deśaḥ asti kaścid amūrta tvāt

syāt etat yathā deśa bheda nimittaḥ virodhaḥ tathā kāraṇa bheda nimittaḥ api syāt kaḥ hi vastutas viśeṣaḥ kāraṇa bhedāt deśa bhedasya iti uktam iha paraspara abhāva avyabhicāra nimittaḥ vastūnām asti virodhaḥ sa deśa bhede saṃnidhīyate na kāraṇa bhede deśa bhedavatī hi rūpe anyonya parihāreṇa upalabhyamāne paraspara abhāva avyabhicāriṇī bhavataḥ na kāraṇa bhedavatī tat evam kampa rāga āvaraṇa bhāva abhāva kṛte deśa bheda nibandhane ca caturthe viruddha dharma saṃsarge avayavi viṣaye vyavasthāpite pakṣa dharma tvam siddham hetoḥ adhunā vyāptiḥ eva asya sva sādhyena samarthanīyā

iha viruddha dharma saṃsarga viraha mātra nibandhanaḥ abheda vyavahāraḥ vastūnām dṛṣṭaḥ ahetoḥ ayogāt nimitta antarasya ca adarśanāt tatas viruddha dharma saṃsarge api bhavat abheda vyavahāraḥ vyāpakam nimitta tvam jahyāt tatas vyāpaka anupalabdhyā tasmāt vyāvṛttaḥ viruddha dharma viraheṇa vyāpyate tad viruddhaḥ ca viruddha dharma saṃsargaḥ tena iyam vyāpaka viruddha upalabdhi bhūmikā evam prasādhite asyāḥ trairūpye asiddha viruddha anaikāntikāḥ doṣāḥ na avakāśam labhante iti evam mayā bahuṣu durmati nirmiteṣu pratyuddhṛteṣu khalu dūṣaṇa kaṇṭakeṣu ācārya nīti pathaḥ eva viśodhitaḥ ayam utsārya mad saram anena janaḥ prayātu

yaḥ tyaktvā rūpam ādyam prabhavati jagataḥ anekadhā anugrahāya prakṣīṇa kleśa rāśiḥ viṣama viṣa dharaḥ aneka vaktraḥ subhogī sarva jñāna prasūtiḥ bhujaga parikaraḥ prītaye yasya nityam devaḥ ahīśaḥ sa vaḥ avyāt sita vimala tanuḥ yoga daḥ yoga yuktaḥ

atha yoga anuśāsanam atha iti ayam adhikāra arthaḥ yoga anuśāsanam śāstram adhikṛtam veditavyam yogaḥ samādhiḥ sa ca sārvabhaumaḥ cittasya dharmaḥ kṣiptam mūḍham vikṣiptam ekāgram niruddham iti citta bhūmayaḥ tatra vikṣipte cetasi vikṣepa upasarjanībhūtaḥ samādhiḥ na yoga pakṣe vartate yaḥ tu ekāgre cetasi sadbhūtam artham pradyotayati kṣiṇoti ca kleśān karma bandhanāni ślathayati nirodham abhimukham karoti sa saṃprajñātaḥ yogaḥ iti ākhyāyate sa ca vitarka anugataḥ vicāra anugataḥ ānanda anugataḥ asmitā anugataḥ iti upariṣṭāt nivedayiṣyāmaḥ sarva vṛtti nirodhe tu asaṃprajñātaḥ samādhiḥ tasya lakṣaṇa abhidhitsayā idam sūtram pravavṛte

yogaḥ citta vṛtti nirodhaḥ sarva śabda agrahaṇāt saṃprajñātaḥ api yogaḥ iti ākhyāyate cittam hi prakhyā pravṛtti sthiti śīla tvāt triguṇam prakhyā rūpam hi citta sattvam rajaḥ tamobhyām saṃsṛṣṭam aiśvarya viṣaya priyam bhavati tat eva tamasā anuviddham adharma ajñāna avairāgya anaiśvarya upagam bhavati tat eva prakṣīṇa moha āvaraṇam sarvatas pradyotamānam anuviddham rajaḥ mātrayā dharma jñāna vairāgya aiśvarya upagam bhavati

tat eva rajaḥ leśa mala apetam svarūpa pratiṣṭham sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātram dharma megha dhyāna upagam bhavati tat param prasaṃkhyānam iti ācakṣate dhyāyinaḥ citi śaktiḥ apariṇāminī apratisaṃkramā darśita viṣayā śuddhā ca anantā ca sattva guṇa ātmikā ca iyam atas viparītā viveka khyātiḥ iti atas tasyām viraktam cittam tām api khyātim niruṇaddhi tad avastham saṃskāra upagam bhavati sa nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ na tatra kiṃcid saṃprajñāyate iti asaṃprajñātaḥ dvividhaḥ sa yogaḥ citta vṛtti nirodhaḥ iti tad avasthe cetasi viṣaya abhāvāt buddhi bodha ātmā puruṣaḥ kiṃsvabhāvaḥ iti
tadā draṣṭuḥ svarūpe avasthānam svarūpa pratiṣṭhā tadānīm citi śaktiḥ yathā kaivalye vyutthāna citte tu sati tathā api bhavantī na tathā katham tarhi darśita viṣaya tvāt

vṛtti sārūpyam itaratra vyutthāne yāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ tad aviśiṣṭa vṛttiḥ puruṣaḥ tathā ca sūtram ekam eva darśanam khyātiḥ eva darśanam iti cittam ayaskānta maṇi kalpam saṃnidhi mātra upakāri dṛśya tvena svam bhavati puruṣasya svāminaḥ tasmāt citta vṛtti bodhe puruṣasya anādiḥ saṃbandhaḥ hetuḥ tāḥ punar niroddhavyāḥ bahu tve sati cittasya

vṛttayaḥ pañcatayyaḥ kliṣṭa akliṣṭāḥ kleśa hetukāḥ karma āśaya pracaye kṣetrībhūtāḥ kliṣṭāḥ khyāti viṣayāḥ guṇa adhikāra virodhinyaḥ akliṣṭāḥ kliṣṭa pravāha patitāḥ api akliṣṭāḥ kliṣṭa chidreṣu api akliṣṭāḥ bhavanti akliṣṭa chideṣu kliṣṭāḥ iti tathājātīyakāḥ saṃskārāḥ vṛttibhiḥ eva kriyante saṃskāraiḥ ca vṛttayaḥ iti evam vṛtti saṃskāra cakram aniśam āvartate tat evaṃbhūtam cittam avasita adhikāram ātma kalpena vyavatiṣṭhate pralayam vā gacchati iti tāḥ kliṣṭāḥ ca akliṣṭāḥ ca pañcadhā vṛttayaḥ
pramāṇa viparyaya vikalpa nidrā smṛtayaḥ

pratyakṣa anumāna āgamāḥ pramāṇāni indriya praṇālikayā cittasya bāhya vastu uparāgāt tad viṣayā sāmānya viśeṣa ātmanaḥ arthasya viśeṣa avadhāraṇa pradhānā vṛttiḥ pratyakṣam pramāṇam phalam aviśiṣṭaḥ pauruṣeyaḥ citta vṛtti bodhaḥ pratisaṃvedī puruṣaḥ iti upariṣṭāt upapādayiṣyāmaḥ anumeyasya tulya jātīyeṣu anuvṛttaḥ bhinna jātīyebhyaḥ vyāvṛttaḥ saṃbandhaḥ yaḥ tad viṣayā sāmānya avadhāraṇa pradhānā vṛttiḥ anumānam yathā deśa antara prāpteḥ gatimat candra tārakam caitra vat vindhyaḥ ca aprāptiḥ agatiḥ āptena dṛṣṭaḥ anumitaḥ vā arthaḥ paratra sva bodha saṃkrāntaye śabdena upadiśyate śabdāt tad artha viṣayā vṛttiḥ śrotuḥ āgamaḥ yasya aśraddheya arthaḥ vaktā na dṛṣṭa anumita arthaḥ saḥ āgamaḥ plavate mūla vaktari tu dṛṣṭa anumita arthe nirviplavaḥ syāt

viparyayaḥ mithyājñānam atad rūpa pratiṣṭham sa kasmāt na pramāṇam yatas pramāṇena bādhyate bhūta artha viṣaya tvāt pramāṇasya tatra pramāṇena bādhanam apramāṇasya dṛṣṭam tat yathā dvi candra darśanam sat viṣayeṇa eka candra darśanena bādhyate iti sā iyam pañca parvā bhavati avidyā avidyā smitā rāga dveṣa abhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ iti ete eva sva saṃjñābhiḥ tamaḥ mohaḥ mahāmohaḥ tāmisraḥ andhatāmisraḥ iti ete citta mala prasaṅgena abhidhāsyante

śabda jñāna anupātī vastu śūnyaḥ vikalpaḥ sa na pramāṇa upārohī na viparyaya upārohī ca vastu śūnya tve api śabda jñāna māhātmya nibandhanaḥ vyavahāraḥ dṛśyate tat yathā caitanyam puruṣasya svarūpam iti yadā citiḥ eva puruṣaḥ tadā kim atra kena vyapadiśyate bhavati ca vyapadeśe vṛttiḥ yathā caitrasya gauḥ iti tathā pratiṣiddha vastu dharmaḥ niṣkriyaḥ puruṣaḥ tiṣṭhati bāṇaḥ sthāsyati sthitaḥ iti gati nivṛttau dhātu artha mātram gamyate tathā anutpatti dharmā puruṣaḥ iti utpatti dharmasya abhāva mātram avagamyate na puruṣa anvayī dharmaḥ tasmāt vikalpitaḥ sa dharmaḥ tena ca asti vyavahāraḥ iti

abhāva pratyaya ālambanā vṛttiḥ nidrā sā ca saṃprabodhe pratyavamarśāt pratyaya viśeṣaḥ katham sukham aham asvāpsam prasannam me manaḥ prajñām me viśāradīkaroti duḥkham aham asvāpsam styānam me manaḥ bhramati anavasthitam gāḍham mūḍhaḥ aham asvāpsam gurūṇi me gātrāṇi klāntam me cittam alasam muṣitam iva tiṣṭhati iti sa khalu ayam prabuddhasya pratyavamarśaḥ na syāt asati pratyaya anubhave tad āśritāḥ smṛtayaḥ ca tad viṣayāḥ na syuḥ tasmāt pratyaya viśeṣaḥ nidrā sā ca samādhau itara pratyaya vat niroddhavyā iti

anubhūta viṣaya asaṃpramoṣaḥ smṛtiḥ kim pratyayasya cittam smarati āhosvit viṣayasya iti grāhya uparaktaḥ pratyayaḥ grāhya grahaṇa ubhaya ākāra nirbhāsaḥ tad jātīyakam saṃskāram ārabhate sa saṃskāraḥ sva vyañjaka añjanaḥ tad ākārām eva grāhya grahaṇa ubhaya ātmikām smṛtim janayati tatra grahaṇa ākāra pūrvā buddhiḥ grāhya ākāra pūrvā smṛtiḥ sā ca dvayī bhāvita smartavyā ca abhāvita smartavyā ca svapne bhāvita smartavyā jāgrat samaye tu abhāvita smartavyā iti sarvāḥ smṛtayaḥ pramāṇa viparyaya vikalpa nidrā smṛtīnām anubhavāt prabhavanti sarvāḥ ca etāḥ vṛttayaḥ sukha duḥkha moha ātmikāḥ sukha duḥkha mohāḥ ca kleśeṣu vyākhyeyāḥ sukha anuśayī rāgaḥ duḥkha anuśayī dveṣaḥ mohaḥ punar avidyā iti etāḥ sarvāḥ vṛttayaḥ niroddhavyāḥ āsām nirodhe saṃprajñātaḥ vā samādhiḥ bhavati asaṃprajñātaḥ vā iti atha āsām nirodhe kaḥ upāyaḥ iti

abhyāsa vairāgyābhyām tad nirodhaḥ citta nadī nāma ubhayatas vāhinī vahati kalyāṇāya vahati pāpāya ca yā tu kaivalya prāgbhārā viveka viṣaya nimnā sā kalyāṇa vahā saṃsāra prāgbhārā viveka viṣaya niṃnā pāpa vahā tatra vairāgyeṇa viṣaya srotaḥ khilīkriyate viveka darśana abhyāsena viveka srotaḥ udghāṭyate iti ubhaya adhīnaḥ citta vṛtti nirodhaḥ
tatra sthitau yatnaḥ abhyāsaḥ cittasya avṛttikasya praśānta vāhi tā sthitiḥ tad arthaḥ prayatnaḥ vīryam utsāhaḥ tat saṃpipādayiṣayā tat sādhana anuṣṭhānam abhyāsaḥ

sa tu dīrgha kāla nairantarya satkāra āsevitaḥ dṛḍha bhūmiḥ dīrgha kāla āsevitaḥ nirantara āsevitaḥ satkāra āsevitaḥ tapasā brahmacaryeṇa vidyayā śraddhayā ca saṃpāditaḥ satkāravān dṛḍha bhūmiḥ bhavati vyutthāna saṃskāreṇa drāk iti eva anabhibhūta viṣayaḥ iti arthaḥ

dṛṣṭa ānuśravika viṣaya vitṛṣṇasya vaśīkāra saṃjñā vairāgyam striyaḥ anna pānam aiśvaryam iti dṛṣṭa viṣaye vitṛṣṇasya svarga vaidehya prakṛti laya tva prāptau ānuśravika viṣaye vitṛṣṇasya divya ādivya viṣaya saṃprayoge api cittasya viṣaya doṣa darśinaḥ prasaṃkhyāna balāt anābhoga ātmikā heya upādeya śūnyāḥ vaśīkāra saṃjñā vairāgyam

tat param puruṣa khyāteḥ guṇa vaitṛṣṇyam dṛṣṭa ānuśravika viṣaya doṣa darśī viraktaḥ puruṣa darśana abhyāsāt tad śuddhi praviveka āpyāyita buddhiḥ guṇebhyaḥ vyakta avyakta dharmakebhyaḥ viraktaḥ iti tat dvayam vairāgyam tatra yat uttaram tat jñāna prasāda mātram yasya udaye sati yogī pratyudita khyātiḥ evam manyate prāptam prāpaṇīyam kṣīṇāḥ kṣetavyāḥ kleśāḥ chinnaḥ śliṣṭa parvā bhava saṃkramaḥ yasya avicchedāt janitvā mriyate mṛtvā ca jāyate iti jñānasya eva parā kāṣṭhā vairāgyam etasya eva hi na āntarīyakam kaivalyam iti atha upāya dvayena niruddha citta vṛtteḥ katham ucyate saṃprajñātaḥ samādhiḥ iti

vitarka vicāra ānanda asmitā rūpa anugamāt saṃprajñātaḥ vitarkaḥ cittasya ālambane sthūlaḥ ābhogaḥ sūkṣmaḥ vicāraḥ ānandaḥ hlādaḥ eka ātmikā saṃvid asmitā tatra prathamaḥ catuṣṭaya anugataḥ samādhiḥ sa vitarkaḥ dvitīyaḥ vitarka vikalaḥ sa vicāraḥ tṛtīyaḥ vicāra vikalaḥ sa ānandaḥ caturthaḥ tad vikalaḥ asmitā mātraḥ iti sarve ete sa ālambanāḥ samādhayaḥ atha asaṃprajñātaḥ samādhiḥ kim upāyaḥ kiṃsvabhāvaḥ vā iti

virāma pratyaya abhyāsa pūrvaḥ saṃskāra śeṣaḥ anyaḥ sarva vṛtti pratyasta maye saṃskāra śeṣaḥ nirodhaḥ cittasya samādhiḥ asaṃprajñātaḥ tasya param vairāgyam upāyaḥ sa ālambanaḥ hi abhyāsaḥ tad sādhanāya na kalpate iti virāma pratyayaḥ nirvastukaḥ ālambanīkriyate sa ca artha śūnyaḥ tad abhyāsa pūrvakam hi cittam nirālambanam abhāva prāptam iva bhavati iti eṣa nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ asaṃprajñātaḥ sa khalu ayam dvividhaḥ upāya pratyayaḥ bhava pratyayaḥ ca tatra upāya pratyayaḥ yoginām bhavati

bhava pratyayaḥ videha prakṛti layānām videhānām devānām bhava pratyayaḥ te hi sva saṃskāra mātra upayogena cittena kaivalya padam iva anubhavantaḥ sva saṃskāra vipākam tathājātīyakam ativāhayanti tathā prakṛti layāḥ sa adhikāre cetasi prakṛti līne kaivalya padam iva anubhavanti yāvat na punar āvartate adhikāra vaśāt cittam iti

śraddhā vīrya smṛti samādhi prajñā pūrvakaḥ itareṣām upāya pratyayaḥ yoginām bhavati śraddhā cetasaḥ saṃprasādaḥ sā hi jananī iva kalyāṇī yoginam pāti tasya hi śraddadhānasya viveka arthinaḥ vīryam upajāyate samupajāta vīryasya smṛtiḥ upatiṣṭhate smṛti upasthāne ca cittam anākulam samādhīyate samāhita cittasya prajñā vivekaḥ upāvartate yena yathārtham vastu jānāti tad abhyāsāt tad tad viṣayāt ca vairāgyāt asaṃprajñātaḥ samādhiḥ bhavati te khalu nava yoginaḥ mṛdu madhya adhimātra upāyāḥ bhavanti tat yathā mṛdu upāyaḥ madhya upāyaḥ adhimātra upāyaḥ iti tatra mṛdu upāyaḥ trividhaḥ mṛdu saṃvegaḥ madhya saṃvegaḥ tīvra saṃvegaḥ iti tathā madhya upāyaḥ tathā adhimātra upāyaḥ iti tatra adhimātra upāyānām
tīvra saṃvegānām āsannaḥ samādhi lābhaḥ samādhi phalam ca bhavati iti

mṛdu madhya adhimātra tvāt tatas api viśeṣaḥ mṛdu tīvraḥ madhya tīvraḥ adhimātra tīvraḥ iti tatas api viśeṣaḥ tad viśeṣāt api mṛdu tīvra saṃvegasya āsannaḥ tatas madhya tīvra saṃvegasya āsannataraḥ tasmāt adhimātra tīvra saṃvegasya adhimātra upāyasya api āsannatamaḥ samādhi lābhaḥ samādhi phalam ca iti kim etasmāt eva āsannatamaḥ samādhiḥ bhavati atha asya lābhe bhavati anyaḥ api kaścid upāyaḥ na vā iti

īśvara praṇidhānāt vā praṇidhānāt bhakti viśeṣāt āvarjitaḥ īśvaraḥ tam anugṛhṇāti abhidhyāna mātreṇa tad abhidhyāna mātrāt api yoginaḥ āsannatamaḥ samādhi lābhaḥ samādhi phalam ca bhavati iti atha pradhāna puruṣa vyatiriktaḥ kaḥ ayam īśvaraḥ nāma iti

kleśa karma vipāka āśayaiḥ aparāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣa viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ avidyā ādayaḥ kleśāḥ kuśala akuśalāni karmāṇi tad phalam vipākaḥ tad anuguṇāḥ vāsanāḥ āśayāḥ te ca manasi vartamānāḥ puruṣe vyapadiśyante sa hi tad phalasya bhoktā iti yathā jayaḥ parājayaḥ vā yoddhṛṣu vartamānaḥ svāmini vyapadiśyate yaḥ hi anena bhogena aparāmṛṣṭaḥ sa puruṣa viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ

kaivalyam prāptāḥ tarhi santi ca bahavaḥ kevalinaḥ te hi trīṇi bandhanāni cchittvā kaivalyam prāptāḥ īśvarasya ca tad saṃbandhaḥ na bhūtaḥ na bhāvī yathā muktasya pūrvā bandha koṭiḥ prajñāyate na evam īśvarasya yathā vā prakṛti līnasya uttarā bandha koṭiḥ saṃbhāvyate na evam īśvarasya sa tu sadā eva muktaḥ sadā eva īśvaraḥ iti yaḥ asau prakṛṣṭa sattva upādānāt īśvarasya śāśvatikaḥ utkarṣaḥ sa kim sa nimittaḥ āhosvit nirnimittaḥ iti tasya śāstram nimittam śāstram punar kiṃnimittam prakṛṣṭa sattva nimittam

etayoḥ śāstra utkarṣayoḥ īśvara sattve vartamānayoḥ anādiḥ saṃbandhaḥ etasmāt etat bhavati sadā eva īśvaraḥ sadā eva muktaḥ iti tat ca tasya aiśvaryam sāmya atiśaya vinirmuktam na tāvat aiśvarya antareṇa tat atiśayyate yat eva atiśayi syāt tat eva tat syāt tasmāt yatra kāṣṭhā prāptiḥ aiśvaryasya saḥ īśvaraḥ iti na ca tad samānam aiśvaryam asti kasmāt dvayoḥ tulyayoḥ ekasmin yugapad kāmite arthe navam idam astu purāṇam idam astu iti ekasya siddhau itarasya prākāmya vighātāt ūna tvam prasaktam dvayoḥ ca tulyayoḥ yugapad kāmita artha prāptiḥ na asti arthasya viruddha tvāt tasmāt yasya sāmya atiśayaiḥ vinirmuktam aiśvaryam saḥ eva īśvaraḥ sa ca puruṣa viśeṣaḥ iti kim ca

tatra niratiśayam sarvajña bījam yat idam atīta anāgata pratyutpanna pratyeka samuccaya ati indriya grahaṇam alpam bahu iti sarvajña bījam etat vivardhamānam yatra niratiśayam sa sarvajñaḥ asti kāṣṭhā prāptiḥ sarvajña bījasya sa atiśaya tvāt parimāṇa vat iti yatra kāṣṭhā prāptiḥ jñānasya sa sarvajñaḥ sa ca puruṣa viśeṣaḥ iti

sāmānya mātra upasaṃhāre ca kṛta upakṣayam anumānam na viśeṣa pratipattau samartham iti tasya saṃjñā ādi viśeṣa pratipattiḥ āgamataḥ paryanveṣyā tasya ātma anugraha abhāve api bhūta anugrahaḥ prayojanam jñāna dharma upadeśena kalpa pralaya mahāpralayeṣu saṃsāriṇaḥ puruṣān uddhariṣyāmi iti tathā ca uktam ādi vidvān nirmāṇa cittam adhiṣṭhāya kāruṇyāt bhagavān parama ṛṣiḥ āsuraye jijñāsamānāya tantram provāca iti saḥ eṣaḥ

pūrveṣām api guruḥ kālena anavacchedāt pūrve hi guravaḥ kālena avacchidyante yatra avaccheda arthena kālaḥ na upāvartate saḥ eṣa pūrveṣām api guruḥ yathā asya sargasya ādau prakarṣa gatyā siddhaḥ tathā atikrānta sarga ādiṣu api pratyetavyaḥ

tasya vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ vācyaḥ īśvaraḥ praṇavasya kim asya saṃketa kṛtam vācya vācaka tvam atha pradīpa prakāśa vat avasthitam iti sthitaḥ asya vācyasya vācakena saha saṃbandhaḥ saṃketaḥ tu īśravasya sthitam eva artham abhinayati yathā avasthitaḥ pitṛ putrayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ saṃketena avadyotyate ayam asya pitā ayam asya putraḥ iti sarga antareṣu api vācya vācaka śakti apekṣaḥ tathā eva saṃketaḥ kriyate saṃpratipatti nityatayā nityaḥ śabda artha saṃbandhaḥ iti āgaminaḥ pratijānate vijñāta vācya vācaka tvasya yoginaḥ

tad japaḥ tad artha bhāvanam praṇavasya japaḥ praṇava abhidheyasya ca īśvarasya bhāvanam tat asya yoginaḥ praṇavam japataḥ praṇava artham ca bhāvayataḥ cittam ekāgram saṃpadyate tathā ca uktam svādhyāyāt yogam āsīta yogāt svādhyāyam āmanet svādhyāya yoga saṃpattyā paramātmā prakāśate iti kim ca asya bhavati

tatas pratyak cetanā adhigamaḥ api antarāya abhāvaḥ ca ye tāvat antarāyāḥ vyādhi prabhṛtayaḥ te tāvat īśvara praṇidhānāt na bhavanti sva rūpa darśanam api asya bhavati yathā eva īśvaraḥ puruṣaḥ śuddhaḥ prasannaḥ kevalaḥ anupasargaḥ tathā ayam api buddheḥ pratisaṃvedī yaḥ puruṣaḥ tam adhigacchati atha ke antarāyāḥ ye cittasya vikṣepāḥ ke punar te kiyantaḥ vā iti

vyādhiḥ tyāna saṃśaya pramāda ālasya āvirati bhrānti darśana alabdha bhūmika tva anavasthita tvāni citta vikṣepāḥ te antarāyāḥ nava antarāyāḥ cittasya vikṣepāḥ saha ete citta vṛttibhiḥ bhavanti eteṣām abhāve na bhavanti pūrva uktāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ vyādhiḥ dhātu rasa karaṇa vaiṣamyam styānam akarmaṇya tā cittasya saṃśayaḥ ubhaya koṭi spṛś vijñānam syāt idam evam na evam syāt iti pramādaḥ samādhi sādhanānām abhāvanam ālasyam kāyasya cittasya ca guru tvāt apravṛttiḥ aviratiḥ cittasya viṣaya saṃprayoga ātmā gardhaḥ bhrānti darśanam viparyaya jñānam alabdha bhūmika tvam samādhi bhūmeḥ alābhaḥ anavasthita tvam yat labdhāyām bhūmau cittasya apratiṣṭhā samādhi pratilambhe hi sati tad avasthitam syāt iti ete citta vikṣepāḥ nava yoga malāḥ yoga pratipakṣāḥ yoga antarāyāḥ iti abhidhīyante

duḥkha daurmanasya aṅgamejayatva śvāsa praśvāsāḥ vikṣepa sahabhuvaḥ duḥkham ādhyātmikam ādhibhautikam ādhidaivikam ca yena abhihatāḥ prāṇinaḥ tad apaghātāya prayatante tat duḥkham daurmanasyam icchā vighātāt cetasaḥ kṣobhaḥ yat aṅgāni ejayati kampayati tat aṅgamejaya tvam prāṇaḥ yat bāhyam vāyum ācāmati sa śvāsaḥ yat kauṣṭhyam vāyum niḥsārayati sa praśvāsaḥ ete vikṣepa sahabhuvaḥ vikṣipta cittasya ete bhavanti samāhita cittasya ete na bhavanti atha ete vikṣepāḥ samādhi pratipakṣāḥ tābhyām eva abhyāsa vairāgyābhyām niroddhavyāḥ tatra abhyāsasya viṣayam upasaṃharan idam āha

tad pratiṣedha artham eka tattva abhyāsaḥ vikṣepa pratiṣedha artham eka tattva avalambanam cittam abhyaset yasya tu pratyartha niyatam pratyaya mātram kṣaṇikam ca cittam tasya sarvam eva cittam ekāgram na asti eva vikṣiptam yadi punar idam sarvatas pratyāhṛtya ekasmin arthe samādhīyate tadā bhavati ekāgram iti atas na pratyartha niyatam

yaḥ api sadṛśa pratyaya pravāhena cittam ekāgram manyate tasya ekāgra tā yadi pravāha cittasya dharmaḥ tadā ekam na asti pravāha cittam kṣaṇika tvāt atha pravāha aṃśasya eva pratyayasya dharmaḥ sa sarvaḥ sadṛśa pratyaya pravāhī vā visadṛśa pratyaya pravāhī vā prati artha niyata tvāt ekāgre eva iti vikṣipta citta anupapattiḥ tasmāt ekam aneka artham avasthitam cittam iti yadi ca cittena ekena ananvitāḥ svabhāva bhinnāḥ pratyayāḥ jāyeran atha katham anya pratyaya dṛṣṭasya anyaḥ smartā bhavet anya pratyaya upacitasya ca karma āśayasya anyaḥ pratyayaḥ upabhoktā bhavet kathaṃcid samādhīyamānam api etat gomaya pāyasīya nyāyam ākṣi

kim ca sva ātma anubhava apahnavaḥ cittasya anya tve prāpnoti katham yat aham adrākṣam tat spṛśāmi yat ca asprākṣam tat paśyāmi iti aham iti pratyayaḥ sarvasya pratyayasya bhede sati pratyayini abhedena upasthitaḥ eka pratyaya viṣayaḥ ayam abheda ātmā aham iti pratyayaḥ katham atyanta bhinneṣu citteṣu vartamānaḥ sāmānyam ekam pratyayinam āśrayet sva anubhava grāhyaḥ ca ayam abheda ātmā aham iti pratyayaḥ na ca pratyakṣasya māhātmyam pramāṇa antareṇa abhibhūyate pramāṇa antaram ca pratyakṣa balena eva vyavahāram labhate tasmāt ekam aneka artham avasthitam ca cittam yasya cittasya avasthitasya idam śāstreṇa parikarma nirdiśyate tat katham

maitrī karuṇām udita upekṣāṇām sukha duḥkha puṇya apuṇya viṣayāṇām bhāvanātaḥ citta prasādanam tatra sarva prāṇiṣu sukha saṃbhoga āpanneṣu maitrīm bhāvayet duḥkhiteṣu karuṇām puṇya ātmakeṣu muditām apuṇya śīleṣu upekṣām evam asya bhāvayataḥ śuklaḥ dharmaḥ upajāyate tatas ca cittam prasīdati prasannam ekāgram sthiti padam labhate
pracchardana vidhāraṇābhyām vā prāṇasya kauṣṭhyasya vāyoḥ nāsikā puṭābhyām prayatna viśeṣāt vamanam pracchardanam vidhāraṇam prāṇāyāmaḥ tābhyām vā manasaḥ sthitim saṃpādayet

viṣayavatī vā pravṛttiḥ utpannā manasaḥ sthiti nibandhanī nāsikā agre dhārayataḥ asya yā divya gandha saṃvid sā gandha pravṛttiḥ jihvā agre rasa saṃvid tāluni rūpa saṃvid jihvā madhye sparśa saṃvid jihvā mūle śabda saṃvid iti etāḥ vṛttaye utpannāḥ cittam sthitau nibadhnanti saṃśayam vidhamanti samādhi prajñāyām ca dvārībhavanti iti etena candra āditya graha maṇi pradīpa raśmi ādiṣu pravṛttiḥ utpannāḥ viṣayavatī eva veditavyā yadi api hi tad tad śāstra anumāna ācārya upadeśaiḥ avagatam artha tattvam sat bhūtam eva bhavati

eteṣām yathābhūta artha pratipādana sāmarthyāt tathā api yāvat eka deśaḥ api kaścid na sva karaṇa saṃvedyaḥ bhavati tāvat sarvam parokṣam iva apavarga ādiṣu sūkṣmeṣu artheṣu na dṛḍhām buddhim utpādayati tasmāt śāstra anumāna ācārya upadeśa upodbalana artham eva avaśyam kaścid artha viśeṣaḥ pratyakṣīkartavyaḥ tatra tad upadiṣṭa artha eka deśa pratyakṣa tve sati sarvam sūkṣma viṣayam api āpavargāt śraddhīyate etad artham eva idam citta parikarma nirdiśyate aniyatāsu vṛttiṣu tad viṣayāyām vaśīkāra saṃjñāyām upajātāyām samartham syāt tasya tasya arthasya pratyakṣīkaraṇāya iti tathā ca sati śraddhā vīrya smṛti samādhayaḥ asya apratibandhena bhaviṣyanti iti

viśokā vā jyotiṣmatī pravṛttiḥ utpannā manasaḥ sthiti nibandhanī iti anuvartate hṛdaya puṇḍarīke dhārayataḥ yā buddhi saṃvid buddhi sattvam hi bhāsvaram ākāśa kalpam tatra sthiti vaiśāradyāt pravṛttiḥ sūrya indu graha maṇi prabhā ru upākāreṇa vikalpate tathā asmitāyām samāpannam cittam nistaraṅga mahā udadhi kalpam śāntam anantam asmitā mātram bhavati yatra idam uktam tam aṇu mātram ātmānam anuvidyā asmi iti evam tāvat saṃprajānīte iti eṣā dvayī viśokā viṣayavatī asmitā mātrā ca pravṛttiḥ jyotiṣmatī iti ucyate yayā yoginaḥ cittam sthiti padam labhate iti
vīta rāga viṣayam vā cittam vīta rāga citta ālambana uparaktam vā yoginaḥ cittam sthiti padam labhate iti
svapna nidrā jñāna ālambanam vā svapna jñāna ālambanam vā nidrā jñāna ālambanam vā tad ākāram yoginaḥ cittam sthiti padam labhate iti
yathā abhimata dhyānāt vā yat eva abhimatam tat eva dhyāyet tatra labdha sthitikam anyatra api sthiti padam labhate iti

paramāṇu parama mahat tva antaḥ asya vaśīkāraḥ sūkṣme niviśamānasya paramāṇu antam sthiti padam labhate iti sthūle niviśamānasya parama mahat tva antam sthiti padam cittasya evam tām ubhayīm koṭim anudhāvataḥ yaḥ asya apratīghātaḥ sa paraḥ vaśīkāraḥ tad vaśīkārāt paripūrṇam yoginaḥ cittam na punar abhyāsa kṛtam parikarma apekṣate iti atha labdha sthitikasya cetasaḥ kiṃsvarūpā kiṃviṣayā vā samāpattiḥ iti tat ucyate

kṣīṇa vṛtteḥ abhijātasya iva maṇeḥ grahītṛ grahaṇa grāhyeṣu tad sthatad añjana tā samāpattiḥ kṣīṇa vṛtteḥ iti pratyasta mita pratyayasya iti arthaḥ abhijātasya iva maṇeḥ iti dṛṣṭānta upādānam yathā sphaṭikaḥ upāśraya bhedāt tad tad rūpa uparaktaḥ upāśraya rūpa ākāreṇa nirbhāsate tathā grāhya ālambana uparaktam cittam grāhya samāpannam grāhya svarūpa ākāreṇa nirbhāsate bhūta sūkṣma uparaktam bhūta sūkṣma samāpannam bhūta sūkṣma svarūpa ābhāsam bhavati tathā sthūla ālambana uparaktam sthūla rūpa samāpannam sthūla rūpa ābhāsam bhavati tathā viśvabheda uparaktam viśva bheda samāpannam viśva rūpa ābhāsam bhavati

tathā grahaṇeṣu api indriyeṣu api draṣṭavyam grahaṇa ālambana uparaktam grahaṇa samāpannam grahaṇa svarūpa ākāreṇa nirbhāsate tathā grahītṛ puruṣa ālambana uparaktam grahītṛ puruṣa samāpannam grahītṛ puruṣa svarūpa ākāreṇa nirbhāsate tathā mukta puruṣa ālambana uparaktam mukta puruṣa samāpannam mukta puruṣa svarūpa ākāreṇa nirbhāsate iti tat evam abhijāta maṇi kalpasya cetasaḥ grahītṛ grahaṇa grāhyeṣu puruṣa indriya bhūteṣu yā tad sthatad añjana tā teṣu sthitasya tad ākāra āpattiḥ sā samāpattiḥ iti ucyate

tatra śabda artha jñāna vikalpaiḥ saṃkīrṇā sa vitarkā samāpattiḥ tat yathā gauḥ iti śabdaḥ gauḥ iti arthaḥ gauḥ iti jñānam iti avibhāgena vibhaktānām api grahaṇam dṛṣṭam vibhajyamānāḥ ca anye śabda dharmāḥ anye artha dharmāḥ anye vijñāna dharmāḥ iti eteṣām vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ tatra samāpannasya yoginaḥ yaḥ gavā ādi arthaḥ samādhi prajñāyām samārūḍhaḥ sa ced śabda artha jñāna vikalpa anuviddhaḥ upāvartate sā saṃkīrṇā samāpattiḥ savitarkā iti ucyate

yadā punar śabda saṃketa smṛti pariśuddhau śruta anumāna jñāna vikalpa śūnyāyām samādhi prajñāyām sva rūpa mātreṇa avasthitaḥ arthaḥ tad svarūpa ākāra mātra tayā eva avacchidyate sā ca nirvitarkā samāpattiḥ tat param pratyakṣam tat ca śruta anumānayoḥ bījam tatas śruta anumāne prabhavataḥ na ca śruta anumāna jñāna saha bhūtam tat darśanam tasmāt asaṃkīrṇam praṃmāṇa antareṇa yoginaḥ nirvitarka samādhi jam darśanam iti nirvitarkāyāḥ samāpatteḥ asyāḥ sūtreṇa lakṣaṇam dyotyate

smṛti pariśuddhau svarūpa śūnyā iva artha mātra nirbhāsā nirvitarkā yā śabda saṃketa śruta anumāna jñāna vikalpa smṛti pariśuddhau grāhya svarūpa uparaktā prajñā svam iva prajñā svarūpam grahaṇa ātmakam tyaktvā padārtha mātra svarūpā grāhya svarūpa āpannā iva bhavati sā tadā nirvitarkā samāpattiḥ tathā ca vyākyātam tasyāḥ eka buddhi upakramaḥ hi artha ātmā aṇu pracaya viśeṣa ātmā gavādiḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ vā lokaḥ

sa ca saṃsthāna viśeṣaḥ bhūta sūkṣmāṇām sādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ ātma bhūtaḥ phalena vyaktena anumitaḥ sva vyañjaka añjanaḥ prādurbhavati dharma antarasya kapāla ādeḥ udaye ca tirobhavati saḥ eṣa dharmaḥ avayavi iti ucyate yaḥ asau ekaḥ ca mahān ca aṇīṃyaḥ ca sparśavān ca kriyā dharmakaḥ ca anityaḥ ca tena avayavinā vyavahārāḥ kriyante

yasya punar avastukaḥ sa pracaya viśeṣaḥ sūkṣmam ca kāraṇam anupalabhyam avikalpasya tasya avayavi abhāvāt atad rūpa pratiṣṭham mithyājñānam iti prāyeṇa sarvam eva prāptam mithyājñānam iti tadā ca samyak jñānam api kim syāt viṣaya abhāvāt yat yat upalabhyate tat tat avayavi tvena āmnātam tasmāt asti avayavī yaḥ mahat tva ādi vyavahāra āpannaḥ samāpatteḥ nirvitarkāyāḥ viṣayī bhavati

etayā eva sa vicārā nirvicārā ca sūkṣma viṣayā vyākhyātā tatra bhūta sūkṣmakeṣu abhivyakta dharmakeṣu deśa kāla nimitta anubhava avacchinneṣu yā samāpattiḥ sā sa vicāra iti ucyate tatra api ekabuddhi nirgrāhyam eva udita dharma viśiṣṭam bhūta sūkṣmam ālambanībhūtam samādhi prajñāyām upatiṣṭhate yā punar sarvathā sarvatas śānta udita avyapadeśya dharmān avacchinneṣu sarva dharma anupātiṣu sarva dharma ātmakeṣu samāpattiḥ sā nirvicāra iti ucyate evaṃsvarūpam hi tad bhūta sūkṣmam etena eva svarūpeṇa ālambanībhūtam eva samādhi prajñā svarūpam uparañjayati prajñā ca svarūpa śūnyā iva artha mātrā yadā bhavati tadā nirvicāra iti ucyate tatra mahat vastu viṣayā sa vitarkā nirvitarkā ca sūkṣma vastu viṣayā sa vicārā nirvicārā ca evam ubhayoḥ etayā eva nirvitarkayā vikalpa hāniḥ vyākhyātā iti

sūkṣma viṣaya tvam ca aliṅga paryavasānam pārthivasya aṇoḥ gandha tanmātram sūkṣmaḥ viṣayaḥ āpyasya rasa tanmātram taijasasya rūpa tanmātram vāyavīyasya sparśa tanmātram ākāśasya śabda tanmātram iti teṣām ahaṃkāraḥ asya api liṅga mātram sūkṣmaḥ viṣayaḥ liṅga mātrasya api aliṅgam sūkṣmaḥ viṣayaḥ na ca aliṅgāt param sūkṣmam asti nanu asti puruṣaḥ sūkṣmaḥ iti satyam yathā liṅgāt param aliṅgasya saukṣmyam na ca evam puruṣasya kiṃtu liṅgasya anvayi kāraṇam puruṣaḥ na bhavati hetuḥ tu bhavati iti atas pradhāne saukṣmyam niratiśayam vyākhyātam

tāḥ eva sa bījaḥ samādhiḥ tāḥ catasraḥ samāpattayaḥ bahis vastu bījāḥ iti samādhiḥ api sa bījaḥ tatra sthūle arthe savitarkaḥ nirvitarkaḥ sūkṣme arthe sa vicāraḥ nirvicāraḥ iti caturdhā upasaṃkhyātaḥ samādhiḥ iti

nirvicāra vaiśāradye adhyātma prasādaḥ aśuddhi āvaraṇa mala apetasya prakāśa ātmanaḥ buddhi sattvasya rajaḥ tamobhyām anabhibhūtaḥ svacchaḥ sthiti pravāhaḥ vaiśāradyam yadā nirvicārasya samādheḥ vaiśāradyam idam jāyate tadā yoginaḥ bhavati adhyātma prasādaḥ bhūta artha viṣayaḥ kramān anurodhī sphuṭaḥ prajñā lokaḥ tathā ca uktam prajñā prasādam āruhya aśocyaḥ śocataḥ janān bhūmiṣṭhān iva śaila sthaḥ sarvān prājñaḥ anupaśyati

ṛtaṃbharā tatra prajñā tasmin samāhita cittasya yā prajñā jāyate tasyāḥ ṛtaṃbhara iti saṃjñā bhavati anvarthā ca sā satyam eva bibharti na ca tatra viparyāsa jñāna gandhaḥ api asti iti tathā ca uktam āgamena anumānena dhyāna abhyāsa rasena ca tridhā prakalpayan prajñām labhate yogam uttamam iti sā punar

śruta anumāna prajñābhyām anya viṣayā viśeṣa artha tvāt śrutam āgama vijñānam tat sāmānya viṣayam na hi āgamena śakyaḥ viśeṣaḥ abhidhātum kasmāt na hi viśeṣeṇa kṛta saṃketaḥ śabdaḥ iti tathā anumānam sāmānya viṣayam eva yatra prāptiḥ tatra gatiḥ yatra aprāptiḥ tatra na bhavati gatiḥ iti uktam anumānena ca sāmānyena upasaṃhāraḥ tasmāt śruta anumāna viṣayaḥ na viśeṣaḥ kaścid asti iti

na ca asya sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭasya vastunaḥ loka pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇam asti na ca asya viśeṣasya apramāṇakasya abhāvaḥ asti iti samādhi prajñā nirgrāhyaḥ eva sa viśeṣaḥ bhavati bhūta sūkṣma gataḥ vā puruṣa gataḥ vā tasmāt śruta anumāna prajñābhyām anya viṣayā sā prajñā viśeṣa artha tvāt iti samādhi prajñā pratilambhe yoginaḥ prajñā kṛtaḥ saṃskāraḥ navaḥ navaḥ jāyate

tad jaḥ saṃskāraḥ anya saṃskāra pratibandhī samādhi prajñā prabhavaḥ saṃskāraḥ vyutthāna saṃskāra āśayam bādhate vyutthāna saṃskāra abhibhavāt tad prabhavāḥ pratyayāḥ na bhavanti pratyaya nirodhe samādhiḥ upatiṣṭhate tatas samādhi jā prajñā tatas prajñā kṛtāḥ saṃskārāḥ iti navaḥ navaḥ saṃskāra āśayaḥ jāyate tatas ca prajñā tatas ca saṃskārāḥ iti katham asau saṃskāra atiśayaḥ cittam sādhikāram na kariṣyati iti na te prajñā kṛtāḥ saṃskārāḥ kleśa kṣaya hetu tvāt cittam adhikāra viśiṣṭam kurvanti cittam hi te sva kāryāt avasādayanti khyāti paryavasānam hi citta ceṣṭitam iti kim ca asya bhavati

tasya api nirodhe sarva nirodhāt nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ sa na kevalam samādhi prajñā virodhī prajñā kṛtānām api saṃskārāṇām pratibandhī bhavati kasmāt nirodha jaḥ saṃskāraḥ samādhi jān saṃskārān bādhate iti nirodha sthiti kāla krama anubhavena nirodha citta kṛta saṃskāra astitvam anumeyam vyutthāna nirodha samādhi prabhavaiḥ saha kaivalya bhāgīyaiḥ saṃskāraiḥ cittam svasyām prakṛtau avasthitāyām pravilīyate tasmāt te saṃskārāḥ cittasya adhikāra virodhinaḥ na sthiti hetavaḥ bhavanti iti yasmāt avasita adhikāram saha kaivalya bhāgīyaiḥ saṃskāraiḥ cittam nivartate tasmin nivṛtte puruṣaḥ sva rūpa mātra pratiṣṭhaḥ atas śuddhaḥ kevalaḥ muktaḥ iti ucyate iti
uddiṣṭaḥ samāhita cittasya yogaḥ katham vyutthita cittaḥ api yoga yuktaḥ syāt iti etat ārabhyate

tapaḥ svādhyāya īśvara praṇidhānāni kriyā yogaḥ na atapasvinaḥ yogaḥ sidhyati anādi karma kleśa vāsanā citrā pratyupasthita viṣaya jālā ca aśuddhiḥ na antareṇa tapaḥ saṃbhedam āpadyate iti tapasaḥ upādānam tat ca citta prasādanam abādhamānam anena āsevyam iti manyate svādhyāyaḥ praṇava ādi pavitrāṇām japaḥ mokṣa śāstra adhyayanam vā īśvara praṇidhānam sarva kriyāṇām parama gurau arpaṇam tad phala saṃnyāsaḥ vā sa hi kriyā yogaḥ

samādhi bhāvanā arthaḥ kleśa tanūkaraṇa arthaḥ ca sa hi āsevyamānaḥ samādhim bhāvayati kleśān ca pratanūkaroti pratanūkṛtān kleśān prasaṃkhyāna agninā dagdha bīja kalpān aprasava dharmiṇaḥ kariṣyati iti teṣām tanūkaraṇāt punar kleśaiḥ aparāmṛṣṭā sattva puruṣa anya tā mātra khyātiḥ sūkṣmā prajñā samāpta adhikārā pratiprasavāya kalpiṣyate iti atha ke kleśāḥ kiyantaḥ vā iti

avidyā smitā rāga dveṣa abhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ kleśāḥ iti pañca viparyayāḥ iti arthaḥ te spandamānāḥ guṇa adhikāram draḍhayanti pariṇāmam avasthāpayanti kārya kāraṇa srotaḥ unnamayanti paraspara anugraha tantrī bhūtvā karma vipākam ca abhinirharanti iti

avidyā kṣetram uttareṣām prasupta tanu vicchinna udārāṇām atra avidyā kṣetram prasava bhūmiḥ uttarareṣām asmitā ādīnām caturvidha vikalpānām prasupta tanu vicchinna udārāṇām tatra kā prasuptiḥ cetasi śakti mātra pratiṣṭhānām bīja bhāva upagamaḥ tasya prabodhaḥ ālambane saṃmukhībhāvaḥ prasaṃkhyānavataḥ dagdha kleśa bījasya saṃmukhībhūte api ālambane na asau punar asti dagdha bījasya kutas prarohaḥ iti atas kṣīṇa kleśaḥ kuśalaḥ carama dehaḥ iti ucyate tatra eva sā dagdha bīja bhāvā pañcamī kleśa avasthā na anyatra iti satām kleśānām tadā bīja sāmarthyam dagdham iti viṣayasya saṃmukhībhāve api sati na bhavati eṣām prabodhaḥ iti uktā prasuptiḥ dagdha bījānām aprarohaḥ ca

tanu tvam ucyate pratipakṣa bhāvanā upahatāḥ kleśāḥ tanavaḥ bhavanti tathā vicchidya vicchidya tena tena ātmanā punar punar samudācaranti iti vicchinnāḥ katham rāga kāle krodhasya adarśanāt na hi rāga kāle krodhaḥ samudācarati rāgaḥ ca kvacid dṛśyamānaḥ na viṣaya antare na asti na ekasyām striyām caitraḥ raktaḥ iti anyāsu strīṣu viraktaḥ kiṃtu tatra rāgaḥ labdha vṛttiḥ anyatra tu bhaviṣyat vṛttiḥ iti sa hi tadā prasupta tanu vicchinnaḥ bhavati

viṣaye yaḥ labdha vṛttiḥ saḥ udāraḥ sarve eva ete kleśa viṣaya tvam na atikrāmanti kaḥ tarhi vicchinnaḥ prasuptaḥ tanuḥ udāraḥ vā kleśaḥ iti ucyate satyam eva etat kiṃtu viśiṣṭānām eva eteṣām vicchinna ādi tvam yathā eva pratipakṣa bhāvanātaḥ nivṛttaḥ tathā eva sva vyañjaka añjanena abhivyaktaḥ iti sarve eva amī kleśāḥ avidyā bhedāḥ kasmāt sarveṣu avidyā eva abhiplavate yat avidyayā vastu ākāryate tat eva anuśerate kleśāḥ viparyāsa pratyaya kāle upalabhyante kṣīyamāṇām ca avidyām anu kṣīyante iti tatra avidyā svarūpam ucyate

anitya aśuci duḥkha anātmasu nitya śuci sukha ātma khyātiḥ avidyā anitye kārye nitya khyātiḥ tat yathā dhruvā pṛthivī dhruvā sa candra tārakā dyauḥ amṛtāḥ divaukasaḥ iti tathā aśucau parama bībhatse kāye sthānāt bījāt upaṣṭambhāt niḥsyandāt nidhanāt api kāyam ādheya śauca tvāt paṇḍitāḥ hi aśucim viduḥ

iti aśucau śuci khyātiḥ dṛśyate navā iva śaśāṅka lekhā kamanīyā iyam kanyā madhu amṛta avayava nirmitā iva candram bhittvā niḥsṛtā iva jñāyate nīlotpala patra āyata akṣī ha ava garbhābhyām locanābhyām jīva lokam āśvāsayantī iva iti kasya kena abhisaṃbandhaḥ bhavati ca evam aśucau śuci viparyāsa pratyayaḥ iti etena apuṇye puṇya pratyayaḥ tathā eva anarthe ca artha pratyayaḥ vyākhyātaḥ

tathā duḥkhe sukha khyātim vakṣyati pariṇāma tāpa saṃskāra duḥkhaiḥ guṇa vṛtti virodhāt ca duḥkham eva sarvam vivekinaḥ iti tatra sukha khyātiḥ avidyā tathā anātmani ātma khyātiḥ bāhya upakaraṇeṣu cetana acetaneṣu bhoga adhiṣṭhāne vā śarīre puruṣa upakaraṇe vā manasi anātmani ātma khyātiḥ iti tathā etat atra uktam vyaktam avyaktam vā sattvam ātma tvena abhipratītya tasya saṃpadam anu nandati ātma saṃpadam manvānaḥ tasya vyāpadam anu śocati ātma vyāpadam manvānaḥ sa sarvaḥ apratibuddhaḥ iti eṣā catuṣpadā bhavati avidyā mūlam asya kleśa saṃtānasya karma āśayasya ca sa vipākasya iti

tasyāḥ ca amitrāgoṣpada vat vastu sa tattvam vijñeyam yathā na amitraḥ mitra abhāvaḥ na mitra mātram kiṃtu tad viruddhaḥ sapatnaḥ yathā vāc oṣpadam na goṣpada abhāvaḥ na goṣpada mātram kiṃtu deśaḥ eva tābhyām anyat vastu antaram evam avidyā na pramāṇam na pramāṇa abhāvaḥ kiṃtu vidyā viparītam jñāna antaram avidyā iti

dṛś darśana śaktyoḥ eka ātma tā iva asmitā puruṣaḥ dṛś śaktiḥ buddhiḥ darśana śaktiḥ iti etayoḥ eka svarūpa āpattiḥ iva asmitā kleśaḥ ucyate bhoktṛ bhogya śaktyoḥ atyanta vibhaktayoḥ atyanta asaṃkīrṇayoḥ avibhāga prāptau iva satyām bhogaḥ kalpate svarūpa pratilambhe tu tayoḥ kaivalyam eva bhavati kutas bhogaḥ iti tathā ca uktam buddhitaḥ param puruṣam ākāra śīla vidyā ādibhiḥ vibhaktam apaśyan kuryāt tatra ātma buddhim mohena iti
sukha anuśayī rāgaḥ sukha abhijñasya sukha anusmṛti pūrvaḥ sukhe tad sādhane vā yaḥ gardhaḥ tṛṣṇā lobhaḥ sa rāgaḥ iti
duḥkha anuśayī dveṣaḥ duḥkha abhijñasya duḥkha anusmṛti pūrvaḥ duḥkhe tad sādhane vā yaḥ pratighaḥ manyuḥ jighāṃsā krodhaḥ sa dveṣaḥ

svarasa vāhī viduṣaḥ api tathā rūḍhaḥ abhiniveśaḥ sarvasya prāṇinaḥ iyam ātma āśīḥ nityā bhavati mā na bhūvam bhūyāsam iti na ca ananubhūta maraṇa dharmakasya eṣā bhavati ātma āśīḥ etayā ca pūrva janma anubhavaḥ pratīyate sa ca ayam abhiniveśaḥ kleśaḥ sva rasa vāhī kṛmeḥ api jāta mātrasya pratyakṣa anumāna āgamaiḥ asaṃbhāvitaḥ maraṇa trāsaḥ uccheda dṛṣṭi ātmakaḥ pūrva janma anubhūtam maraṇa duḥkham anumāpayati yathā ca ayam atyanta mūḍheṣu dṛśyate kleśaḥ tathā viduṣaḥ api vijñāta pūrva apara antasya rūḍhaḥ kasmāt samānāḥ hi tayoḥ kuśala akuśalayoḥ maraṇa duḥkha anubhavāt iyam vāsanā iti
te pratiprasava heyāḥ sūkṣmāḥ te pañca kleśāḥ dagdha bīja kalpāḥ yoginaḥ carita adhikāre cetasi pralīne saha tena eva astam gacchanti sthitānām tu bīja bhāva upagatānām

dhyāna heyāḥ tad vṛttayaḥ kleśānām yāḥ vṛttayaḥ sthūlāḥ tāḥ kriyā yogena tanūkṛtāḥ satyaḥ prasaṃkhyānena dhyānena hātavyāḥ yāvat sūkṣmīkṛtāḥ yāvat dagdha bīja kalpāḥ iti yathā vastrāṇām sthūlaḥ malaḥ pūrvam nirdhūyate paścāt sūkṣmaḥ yatnena upāyena ca apanīyate tathā su alpa pratipakṣāḥ sthūlāḥ vṛttayaḥ kleśānām sūkṣmāḥ tu mahā pratipakṣāḥ iti

kleśa mūlaḥ karma āśayaḥ dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyaḥ tatra puṇya apuṇya karma āśayaḥ kāma lobha moha krodha bhavaḥ sa dṛṣṭa janma vedanīyaḥ ca adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyaḥ ca tatra tīvra saṃvegena mantra tapaḥ samādhibhiḥ nirvartitaḥ īśvara devatā mahā ṛṣi mahā anubhāvānām ārādhanāt vā yaḥ pariniṣpannaḥ sa sadyas paripacyate puṇya karma āśayaḥ iti tathā tīvra kleśena bhīta vyādhita kṛpaṇeṣu viśvāsa upagateṣu vā mahā anubhāveṣu vā tapasviṣu kṛtaḥ punar punar apakāraḥ sa ca api pāpa karma āśayaḥ sadyas eva paripacyate yathā nandīśvaraḥ kumāraḥ manuṣya pariṇāmam hitvā deva tvena pariṇataḥ tathā nahuṣaḥ api devānām indraḥ svakam pariṇāmam hitvā tiryaktvena pariṇataḥ iti tatra nārakāṇām na asti dṛṣṭa janma vedanīyaḥ karma āśayaḥ kṣīṇa kleśānām api na asti adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyaḥ karma āśayaḥ iti

sati mūle tad vipākaḥ jāti āyuḥ bhogāḥ satsu kleśeṣu karma āśayaḥ vipāka ārambhī bhavati na ucchinna kleśa mūlaḥ yathā tuṣa avanaddhāḥ śāli taṇḍulāḥ adagdha bīja bhāvāḥ praroha samarthāḥ bhavanti na apanīta tuṣāḥ dagdha bīja bhāvāḥ vā tathā kleśa avanaddhaḥ karma āśayaḥ vipāka prarohī bhavati na apanīta kleśaḥ na prasaṃkhyāna dagdha kleśa bīja bhāvaḥ vā iti sa ca vipākaḥ trividhaḥ jātiḥ āyuḥ bhogaḥ iti

tatra idam vicāryate kim ekam karma ekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam atha ekam karma anekam janma ākṣipati iti dvitīyā vicāraṇā kim anekam karma anekam janma nirvartayati atha anekam karma ekam janma nirvartayati iti na tāvat ekam karma ekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam kasmāt anādi kāla pracitasya asaṃkhyeyasya avaśiṣṭasya karmaṇaḥ sāṃpratikasya ca phala krama aniyamāt anāśvāsaḥ lokasya prasaktaḥ sa ca aniṣṭaḥ iti na ca ekam karma anekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam kasmāt anekeṣu karmasu ekaikam eva karma anekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam iti avaśiṣṭasya vipāka kāla abhāvaḥ prasaktaḥ sa ca api aniṣṭaḥ iti na ca anekam karma anekasya janmanaḥ kāraṇam kasmāt tat anekam janma yugapad na saṃbhavati iti krameṇa eva vācyam tathā ca pūrva doṣa anuṣaṅgaḥ

tasmāt janma prāyaṇa antare kṛtaḥ puṇyā puṇya karma āśaya pracayaḥ vicitraḥ pradhāna upasarjana bhāvena avasthitaḥ prāyaṇa abhivyaktaḥ eka praghaṭṭakena maraṇam prasādhya saṃmūrchitaḥ ekam eva janma karoti tat ca janma tena eva karmaṇā labdha āyuṣkam bhavati tasmin āyuṣi tena eva karmaṇā bhogaḥ saṃpadyate iti asau karma āśayaḥ janma āyuḥ bhoga hetu tvāt tri vipākaḥ abhidhīyate iti atas eka bhavikaḥ karma āśayaḥ uktaḥ iti

dṛṣṭa janma vedanīyaḥ tu eka vipāka ārambhī bhoga hetu tvāt dvi vipāka ārambhī vāyuḥ bhoga hetu tvāt nandīśvara vat nahuṣa vat vā iti kleśa karma vipāka anubhava nirvartitābhiḥ tu vāsanābhiḥ anādi kāla saṃmūrchitam idam cittam vicitrīkṛtam iva sarvatas matsya jālam granthibhiḥ iva ātatam iti etāḥ aneka bhava pūrvikāḥ vāsanāḥ yaḥ tu ayam karma āśayaḥ eṣaḥ eva eka bhavikaḥ uktaḥ iti ye saṃskārāḥ smṛti hetavaḥ tāḥ vāsanāḥ tāḥ ca anādi kālīnāḥ iti

yaḥ tu asau eka bhavikaḥ karma āśayaḥ sa niyata vipākaḥ ca aniyata vipākaḥ ca tatra dṛṣṭa janma vedanīyasya niyata vipākasya eva ayam niyamaḥ na tu adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyasya aniyata vipākasya kasmāt yaḥ hi adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyaḥ aniyata vipākaḥ tasya trayī gatiḥ kṛtasya avipakvasya nāśaḥ pradhāna karmaṇi āvāpa gamanam vā niyata vipāka pradhāna karmaṇā abhibhūtasya vā ciram avasthānam iti

tatra kṛtasya avipakvasya nāśaḥ yathā śukla karma udayāt iha eva nāśaḥ kṛṣṇasya yatra idam uktam dve dve ha vai karmaṇī veditavye pāpakasya ekaḥ rāśiḥ puṇya kṛtaḥ apahanti tat icchasva karmāṇi sukṛtāni kartum iha eva te karma kavayaḥ vedayante pradhāna karmaṇi āvāpa gamanam yatra idam uktam syāt su alpaḥ saṃkaraḥ sa parihāraḥ sa pratyavamarṣaḥ kuśalasya na apakarṣāya alam kasmāt kuśalam hi me bahu anyat asti yatra ayam āvāpam gataḥ svarge api apakarṣam alpam kariṣyati iti

niyata vipāka pradhāna karmaṇā abhibhūtasya vā ciram avasthānam katham iti adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyasya eva niyata vipākasya karmaṇaḥ samānam maraṇam abhivyakti kāraṇam uktam na tu adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyasya aniyata vipākasya yat tu adṛṣṭa janma vedanīyam karma aniyata vipākam tat naśyet āvāpam vā gacchet abhibhūtam vā ciram api upāsīta yāvat samānam karma abhivyañjakam nimittam asya na vipāka abhimukham karoti iti tad vipākasya eva deśa kāla nimittān avadhāraṇāt iyam karma gatiḥ citrā durvijñānā ca iti na ca utsargasya apavādāt nivṛttiḥ iti eka bhavikaḥ karma āśayaḥ anujñāyate iti

te hlāda paritāpa phalāḥ puṇya apuṇya hetu tvāt te janma āyuḥ bhogāḥ puṇya hetukāḥ sukha phalāḥ apuṇya hetukāḥ duḥkha phalāḥ iti yathā ca idam duḥkham pratikūla ātmakam evam viṣaya sukha kāle api duḥkham asti eva pratikūla ātmakam yoginaḥ katham tat upapādyate
