pariṇāma tāpa saṃskāra duḥkhaiḥ guṇa vṛtti virodhāt ca duḥkham eva sarvam vivekinaḥ sarvasya ayam rāga anuviddhaḥ cetana acetana sādhana adhīnaḥ sukha anubhavaḥ iti tatra asti rāga jaḥ karma āśayaḥ tathā ca dveṣṭi duḥkha sādhanāni muhyati ca iti dveṣa moha kṛtaḥ api asti karma āśayaḥ tathā ca uktam na anupahatya bhūtāni upabhogaḥ saṃbhavati iti hiṃsā kṛtaḥ api asti śarīraḥ karma āśayaḥ iti viṣaya sukham ca avidyā iti uktam

yā bhogeṣu indriyāṇām tṛpteḥ upaśāntiḥ tat sukham yā laulyāt anupaśāntiḥ tat duḥkham na ca indriyāṇām bhoga abhyāsena vaitṛṣṇyam kartum śakyam kasmāt yatas bhoga abhyāsam anu vivardhante rāgāḥ kauśalāni ca indriyāṇām iti tasmāt anupāyaḥ sukhasya bhoga abhyāsaḥ iti sa khalu ayam vṛścika viṣa bhītaḥ iva āśīviṣeṇa daṣṭaḥ yaḥ sukha arthī viṣaya anuvāsitaḥ mahati duḥkha paṅke nimagnaḥ iti eṣā pariṇāmaduḥkha tā nāma pratikūlā sukha avasthāyām api yoginam eva kliśnāti

atha kā tāpa duḥkha tā sarvasya dveṣa anuviddhaḥ cetana acetana sādhana adhīnaḥ tāpa anubhavaḥ iti tatra asti dveṣa jaḥ karma āśayaḥ sukha sādhanāni ca prārthayamānaḥ kāyena vācā manasā ca parispandate tatas param anugṛhṇāti upahanti ca iti para anugraha pīḍābhyām dharma adharmau upacinoti sa karma āśayaḥ lobhāt mohāt ca bhavati iti eṣā tāpa duḥkha tā ucyate kā punar saṃskāra duḥkha tā sukha anubhavāt sukha saṃskāra āśayaḥ duḥkha anubhavāt api duḥkha saṃskāra āśayaḥ iti evam karmabhyaḥ vipāke anubhūyamāne sukhe duḥkhe vā punar karma āśaya pracayaḥ iti

evam idam anādi duḥkha srotaḥ viprasṛtam yoginam eva pratikūla ātmaka tvāt udvejayati kasmāt akṣi pātra kalpaḥ hi vidvān iti yathā ūrṇā tantuḥ akṣi pātre nyastaḥ sparśena duḥkhayati na ca anyeṣu gātra avayaveṣu evam etāni duḥkhāni akṣi pātra kalpam yoginam eva kliśnanti na itaram pratipattāram itaram tu sva karma upahṛtam duḥkham upāttam upāttam tyajantam tyaktam tyaktam upādadānam anādi vāsanā vicitrayā citta vṛttyā samantataḥ anuviddham iva avidyayā hātavyaḥ eva ahaṃkāram amakāra anupātinam jātam jātam bāhya ādhyātmika ubhaya nimittāḥ tri parvāṇaḥ tāpāḥ anuplavante tat evam anādinā duḥkha srotasā vyuhyamānam ātmānam bhūta grāmam ca dṛṣṭvā yogī sarva duḥkha kṣaya kāraṇam samyak darśanam śaraṇam prapadyate iti

guṇa vṛtti virodhāt ca duḥkham eva sarvam vivekinaḥ prakhyā pravṛtti sthiti rūpāḥ buddhi guṇāḥ paraspara anugraha tantrī bhūtvā śāntam ghoram mūḍham vā pratyayam triguṇam eva ārabhante calam ca guṇa vṛttam iti kṣipra pariṇāmi cittam uktam rūpa atiśayāḥ vṛtti atiśayāḥ ca paraspareṇa virudhyante sāmānyāni tu atiśayaiḥ saha pravartante evam ete guṇāḥ itaretara āśrayeṇa upārjita sukha duḥkha moha pratyayāḥ sarve sarva rūpāḥ bhavanti iti guṇa pradhāna bhāva kṛtaḥ tu eṣām viśeṣaḥ iti tasmāt duḥkham eva sarvam vivekinaḥ iti

tat asya mahataḥ duḥkha samudāyasya prabhava bījam avidyā tasyāḥ ca samyak darśanam abhāva hetuḥ yathā cikitsā śāstram catur vyūham rogaḥ roga hetuḥ ārogyam bhaiṣajyam iti evam idam api śāstram catur vyūham eva tat yathā saṃsāraḥ saṃsāra hetuḥ mokṣaḥ mokṣa upāyaḥ iti tatra duḥkha bahulaḥ saṃsāraḥ heyaḥ pradhāna puruṣayoḥ saṃyogaḥ heya hetuḥ saṃyogasya ātyantikī nivṛttiḥ hānam hāna upāyaḥ samyak darśanam tatra hātuḥ sva rūpam upādeyam vā heyam vā na bhavitum arhati iti hāne tasya uccheda vāda prasaṅgaḥ upādāne ca hetuvādaḥ ubhaya pratyākhyāne śāśvata vādaḥ iti etat samyak darśanam tat etat śāstram catur vyūham iti abhidhīyate

heyam duḥkham anāgatam duḥkham atītam upabhogena ativāhitam na heya pakṣe vartate vartamānam ca su akṣaṇe bhoga ārūḍham iti na tat kṣaṇa antare heya tām āpadyate tasmāt yat eva anāgatam duḥkham tat eva akṣi pātra kalpam yoginam kliśnāti na itaram pratipattāram tat eva heya tām āpadyate tasmāt yat eva heyam iti ucyate tasya eva kāraṇam pratinirdiśyate

draṣṭṛ dṛśyayoḥ saṃyogaḥ heya hetuḥ draṣṭā buddheḥ pratisaṃvedī puruṣaḥ dṛśyāḥ buddhi sattva upārūḍhāḥ sarve dharmāḥ tat etat dṛśyam ayaskānta maṇi kalpam saṃnidhi mātra upakāri dṛśya tvena svam bhavati puruṣasya dṛśi rūpasya svāminaḥ anubhava karma viṣaya tām āpannam yatas anya svarūpeṇa pratilabdha ātmakam svatantram api para artha tvāt paratantram

tayoḥ dṛś darśana śaktyoḥ anādiḥ artha kṛtaḥ saṃyogaḥ heya hetuḥ duḥkhasya kāraṇam iti arthaḥ tathā ca uktam tad saṃyoga hetu vivarjanāt syāt ayam ātyantikaḥ duḥkha pratīkāraḥ kasmāt duḥkha hetoḥ parihāryasya pratīkāra darśanāt tat yathā pāda talasya bhedya tā kaṇṭakasya bhettṛ tvam parihāraḥ kaṇṭakasya pāda an adhiṣṭhānam pāda trāṇa vyavahitena vā adhiṣṭhānam etat trayam yaḥ veda loke sa tatra pratīkāram ārabhamāṇaḥ bheda jam duḥkham na āpnoti kasmāt tritva upalabdhi sāmarthyāt iti atra api tāpakasya rajasaḥ sattvam eva tapyam kasmāt tapikriyāyāḥ karma stha tvāt sattve karmaṇi tapikriyā na apariṇāmini niṣkriye kṣetrajñe darśita viṣaya tvāt sattve tu tapyamāne tad ākāra anurodhī puruṣaḥ api anutapyate iti dṛśya svarūpam ucyate

prakāśa kriyā sthiti śīlam bhūta indriya ātmakam bhoga apavarga artham dṛśyam prakāśa śīlam sattvam kriyā śīlam rajaḥ sthiti śīlam tamaḥ iti ete guṇāḥ paraspara uparakta pravibhāgāḥ pariṇāminaḥ saṃyoga viyoga dharmāṇaḥ itaretara upāśrayeṇa upārjita mūrtayaḥ paraspara aṅga aṅgi tve api asaṃbhinna śakti pravibhāgāḥ tulya jātīya atulya jātīya śakti bheda anupātinaḥ pradhāna velāyām upadarśita saṃnidhānāḥ guṇa tve api ca vyāpāra mātreṇa pradhāna antarṇīta anumita astitāḥ puruṣa artha kartavya tayā prayukta sāmarthyāḥ saṃnidhi mātra upakāriṇaḥ ayaskānta maṇi kalpāḥ pratyayam antareṇa ekatamasya vṛttim anuvartamānāḥ pradhāna śabda vācyāḥ bhavanti etat dṛśyam iti ucyate

tat etat bhūta indriya ātmakam bhūta bhāvena pṛthivī ādinā sūkṣma sthūlena pariṇamate tathā indriya bhāvena śrotra ādinā sūkṣma sthūlena pariṇamate iti tat tu na aprayojanam api tu prayojanam urarīkṛtya pravartate iti bhoga apavarga artham hi tat dṛśyam puruṣasya iti tatra iṣṭā aniṣṭa guṇa svarūpa avadhāraṇam avibhāga āpannam bhogaḥ bhoktuḥ svarūpa avadhāraṇam apavargaḥ iti dvayoḥ atiriktam anyat darśanam na asti tathā ca uktam ayam tu khalu triṣu guṇeṣu kartṛṣu akartari ca puruṣe tulya atulya jātīye caturthe tad kriyā sākṣiṇī upanīyamānān sarva bhāvān upapannān anupaśyan adarśanam anyat śaṅkataḥ iti

tau etau bhoga apavargau buddhi kṛtau buddhau eva vartamānau katham puruṣe vyapadiśyete iti yathā vijayaḥ parājayaḥ vā yoddhṛṣu vartamānaḥ svāmini vyapadiśyate sa hi tad phalasya bhoktā iti evam bandha mokṣau buddhau eva vartamānau puruṣe vyapadiśyete sa hi tad phalasya bhoktā iti buddheḥ eva puruṣa artha aparisamāptiḥ bandhaḥ tad artha avasāyaḥ mokṣaḥ iti etena grahaṇa dhāraṇa ūha apoha tattva jñāna abhiniveśāḥ buddhau vartamānāḥ puruṣe adhyāropita sadbhāvāḥ sa hi tad phalasya bhoktā iti dṛśyānām guṇānām svarūpa bheda avadhāraṇa artham idam ārabhyate

viśeṣa aviśeṣa liṅga mātra aliṅgāni guṇa parvāṇi tatra ākāśa vāyu agni udaka bhūmayaḥ bhūtāni śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandha tanmātrāṇām aviśeṣāṇām viśeṣāḥ tathā śrotra tvac cakṣuḥ jihvā ghrāṇāni buddhīndriyāṇi vāc pāṇi pāda pāyu upasthāḥ karmendriyāṇi ekādaśam manaḥ sarva artham iti etāni asmitā lakṣaṇasya aviśeṣasya viśeṣāḥ guṇānām eṣa ṣoḍaśakaḥ viśeṣa pariṇāmaḥ

ṣaṭ aviśeṣāḥ tat yathā śabda tanmātram sparśa tanmātram rūpa tanmātram rasa tanmātram gandha tanmātram ca iti eka dvi tri catur pañca lakṣaṇāḥ śabda ādayaḥ pañca aviśeṣāḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ ca aviśeṣaḥ asmitā mātraḥ iti ete sattā mātrasya ātmanaḥ mahataḥ ṣaṣ aviśeṣa pariṇāmāḥ yat tat parama viśeṣebhyaḥ liṅga mātram mahat tattvam tasmin ete sattā mātre mahati ātmani avasthāya vivṛddhi kāṣṭhām anubhavanti pratisaṃsṛjyamānāḥ ca tasmin eva sattā mātre mahati ātmani avasthāya yat tat niḥsattā sattam niḥsadasat nirasat avyaktam aliṅgam pradhānam tat pratiyanti eṣa teṣām liṅga mātraḥ pariṇāmaḥ niḥsattā sattam ca aliṅga pariṇāmaḥ iti

aliṅga avasthāyām na puruṣa arthaḥ hetuḥ na āliṅga avasthāyām ādau puruṣa artha tā kāraṇam bhavati iti na tasyāḥ puruṣa artha tā kāraṇam bhavati iti na asau puruṣa artha kṛtā iti nitya ākhyāyate trayāṇām tu avasthā viśeṣāṇām ādau puruṣa artha tā kāraṇam bhavati sa ca arthaḥ hetuḥ nimittam kāraṇam bhavati iti anitya ākhyāyate guṇāḥ tu sarva dharma anupātinaḥ na pratyastam ayante na upajāyante vyaktibhiḥ eva atīta anāgata vyaya āgamavatībhiḥ guṇa anvayinībhiḥ upajanana apāya dharmakāḥ iva pratyavabhāsante yathā devadattaḥ daridrāti kasmāt yatas asya mriyante gāvaḥ iti gavām eva maraṇāt tasya daridrāṇam na svarūpa hānāt iti samaḥ samādhiḥ

liṅga mātram aliṅgasya pratyāsannam tatra tat saṃsṛṣṭam vivicyate kramān ativṛttayaḥ tathā ṣaṭ aviśeṣāḥ liṅga mātre saṃsṛṣṭāḥ vivicyante pariṇāma krama niyamāt tathā teṣu aviśeṣeṣu bhūta indriyāṇi saṃsṛṣṭāni vivicyante tathā ca uktam purastāt na viśeṣebhyaḥ param tattva antaram asti iti viśeṣāṇām na asti tattva antara pariṇāmaḥ teṣām tu dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāmāḥ vyākhyāyiṣyante vyākhyātam dṛśyam atha draṣṭuḥ svarūpa avadhāraṇa artham idam ārabhyate

draṣṭā dṛśi mātraḥ śuddhaḥ api pratyaya anupaśyaḥ dṛśi mātraḥ iti dṛś śaktiḥ eva viśeṣaṇa aparāmṛṣṭā iti arthaḥ sa puruṣaḥ bhuddheḥ pratisaṃvedī sa buddheḥ na sarūpaḥ na atyantam virūpaḥ iti na tāvat sarūpaḥ kasmāt jñāta ajñāta viṣaya tvāt pariṇāminī hi buddhiḥ tasyāḥ ca viṣayaḥ gavādiḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ vā jñātaḥ ca ajñātaḥ ca iti pariṇāmi tvam darśayati

sadā ajñāta viṣaya tvam tu puruṣasya apariṇāmi tvam paridīpayati kasmāt na hi buddhiḥ ca nāma puruṣa viṣayaḥ ca syāt agṛhītā gṛhītā ca iti siddham puruṣasya sadā ajñāta viṣaya tvam tatas ca apariṇāmi tvam iti kim ca para arthā buddhiḥ saṃhatyakāri tvāt sva arthaḥ puruṣaḥ iti tathā sarva artha adhyavasāyaka tvāt triguṇā buddhiḥ triguṇa tvāt acetana iti guṇānām tu upadraṣṭā puruṣaḥ iti atas na sarūpaḥ

astu tarhi virūpaḥ iti na atyantam virūpaḥ kasmāt śuddhaḥ api asau pratyaya anupaśyaḥ yatas pratyayam bauddham anupaśyati tam anupaśyan atadātmā api tad ātmakaḥ iva pratyavabhāsate tathā ca uktam apariṇāminī hi bhoktṛ śaktiḥ apratisaṃkramā ca pariṇāmini arthe pratisaṃkrāntā iva tad vṛttim anupatati tasyāḥ ca prāpta caitanya upagraha rūpāyāḥ buddhi vṛtteḥ anukāra mātra tayā buddhi vṛtti aviśiṣṭā hi jñāna vṛttiḥ iti ākhyāyate

tad arthaḥ eva dṛśyasya ātmā dṛśi rūpasya puruṣasya karma rūpa tām āpannam dṛśyam iti tad arthaḥ eva dṛśyasya ātmā bhavati svarūpam bhavati iti arthaḥ svarūpam tu para rūpeṇa pratilabdha ātmakam bhoga apavarga artha tāyām kṛtāyām puruṣeṇa na dṛśyate iti svarūpa hānāt asya nāśaḥ prāptaḥ na tu vinaśyati kasmāt

kṛtārtham prati naṣṭam api anaṣṭam tad anya sādhāraṇa tvāt kṛtārtham ekam puruṣam prati dṛśyam naṣṭam api nāśam prāptam api anaṣṭam tad anya puruṣa sādhāraṇa tvāt kuśalam puruṣam prati nāśam prāptam api akuśalān puruṣān prati na kṛtārtham iti teṣām dṛśeḥ karma viṣaya tām āpannam labhate eva para rūpeṇa ātma rūpam iti atas ca dṛś darśana śaktyoḥ nitya tvāt anādiḥ saṃyogaḥ vyākhyātaḥ iti tathā ca uktam dharmiṇām anādi saṃyogāt dharma mātrāṇām api anādiḥ saṃyogaḥ iti saṃyoga svarūpa abhidhitsayā idam sūtram pravavṛte

sva svāmi śaktyoḥ svarūpa upalabdhi hetuḥ saṃyogaḥ puruṣaḥ svāmī dṛśyena svena darśana artham saṃyuktaḥ tasmāt saṃyogāt dṛśyasya upalabdhiḥ yā sa bhogaḥ yā tu draṣṭuḥ svarūpa upalabdhiḥ saḥ apavargaḥ darśana kārya avasānaḥ saṃyogaḥ iti darśanam viyogasya kāraṇam uktam darśanam adarśanasya pratidvandvī iti adarśanam saṃyoga nimittam uktam na atra darśanam mokṣa kāraṇam adarśana abhāvāt eva bandha abhāvaḥ sa mokṣaḥ iti darśanasya bhāve bandha kāraṇasya adarśanasya nāśaḥ iti atas darśanam jñānam kaivalya kāraṇam uktam

kiṃca idam adarśanam nāma kim guṇānām adhikāraḥ āhosvit dṛśi rūpasya svāminaḥ darśita viṣayasya pradhāna cittasya anutpādaḥ svasmin dṛśye vidyamāne yaḥ darśana abhāvaḥ kim arthavat tā guṇānām atha avidyā sva cittena saha niruddhā sva cittasya utpatti bījam kim sthiti saṃskāra kṣaye gati saṃskāra abhivyaktiḥ yatra idam uktam pradhānam sthityā eva vartamānam vikāra akaraṇāt apradhānam syāt

tathā gatyā eva vartamānam vikāra nitya tvāt apradhānam syāt ubhayathā ca asya vṛttiḥ pradhāna vyavahāram labhate na anyathā kāraṇa antareṣu api kalpiteṣu eva samānaḥ carcaḥ darśana śaktiḥ eva adarśanam iti eke pradhānasya ātma khyāpana arthā pravṛttiḥ iti śruteḥ sarva bodhya bodha samarthaḥ prāc pravṛtteḥ puruṣaḥ na paśyati sarva kārya karaṇa samartham dṛśyam tadā na dṛśyate iti ubhayasya api adarśanam dharmaḥ iti eke

tatra idam dṛśyasya sva ātma bhūtam api puruṣa pratyaya apekṣam darśanam dṛśya dharma tvena bhavati tathā puruṣasya anātma bhūtam api dṛśya pratyaya apekṣam puruṣa dharma tvena iva adarśanam avabhāsate darśanam jñānam eva adarśanam iti kecid abhidadhati iti ete śāstra gatāḥ vikalpāḥ tatra vikalpa bahu tvam etat sarva puruṣāṇām guṇānām saṃyoge sādhāraṇa viṣayam yaḥ tu pratyak cetanasya sva buddhi saṃyogaḥ

tasya hetuḥ avidyā viparyaya jñāna vāsanā iti arthaḥ viparyaya jñāna vāsanā vāsitā ca na kārya niṣṭhām puruṣa khyātim buddhiḥ prāpnoti sādhikārā punar āvartate sā tu puruṣa khyāti paryavasānām kārya niṣṭhām prāpnoti carita adhikārāḥ nivṛtta adarśanāḥ bandha kāraṇa abhāvāt na punar āvartate atra kaścid paṇḍaka upākhyānena udghāṭayati mugdhayā bhāryayā abhidhīyate paṇḍa kārya putra apatyavatī me bhaginī kimartham nāma na aham iti sa tām āha mṛtaḥ te aham apatyam utpādayiṣyāmi iti tathā idam vidyamānam jñānam citta nivṛttim na karoti vinaṣṭam kariṣyati iti kā pratyāśā tatra ācārya deśīyaḥ vakti nanu buddhi nivṛttiḥ eva mokṣaḥ adarśana kāraṇa abhāvāt buddhi nivṛttiḥ tat ca adarśanam bandha kāraṇam darśanāt nivartate tatra citta nivṛttiḥ eva mokṣaḥ kimartham asthānaḥ eva asya mati vibhramaḥ heyam duḥkham heya kāraṇam ca saṃyoga ākhyam sa nimittam uktam atas param hānam vaktavyam

tad abhāvāt saṃyoga abhāvaḥ hānam tad dṛśeḥ kaivalyam tasya adarśanasya abhāvāt buddhi puruṣa saṃyoga abhāvaḥ ātyantikaḥ bandhana uparamaḥ iti arthaḥ etat dhānam tad dṛśeḥ kaivalyam puruṣasya amiśrībhāvaḥ punar asaṃyogaḥ guṇaiḥ iti arthaḥ duḥkha kāraṇa nivṛttau duḥkha uparamaḥ hānam tadā svarūpa pratiṣṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ iti uktam atha hānasya kaḥ prāpti upāyaḥ iti

viveka khyātiḥ aviplavā hāna upāyaḥ sattva puruṣa anya tā pratyayaḥ viveka khyātiḥ sā tu anivṛtta mithyā jñānā plavate yadā mithyājñānam dagdha bīja bhāvam vandhya prasavam saṃpadyate tadā vidhūta kleśa rajasaḥ sattvasya pare vaiśāradye parasyām vaśīkāra saṃjñāyām vartamānasya viveka pratyaya pravāhaḥ nirmalaḥ bhavati sā viveka khyātiḥ aviplavā hāna upāyaḥ tatas mithyājñānasya dagdha bīja bhāva upagamaḥ punar ca aprasavaḥ iti eṣa mokṣasya mārgaḥ hānasya upāyaḥ iti

tasya saptadhā prānta bhūmiḥ prajñā tasya iti pratyudita khyāteḥ pratyāmnāyaḥ saptadhā iti aśuddhi āvaraṇa mala apagamāt cittasya pratyaya antara anutpāde sati sapta prakāra eva prajñā vivekinaḥ bhavati tat yathā parijñātam heyam na asya punar parijñeyam asti kṣīṇāḥ heya hetavaḥ na punar eteṣām kṣetavyam asti sākṣātkṛtam nirodha samādhinā hānam bhāvitaḥ viveka khyāti rūpaḥ hāna upāyaḥ iti eṣā catuṣṭayī kāryā vimuktiḥ prajñāyāḥ citta vimuktiḥ tu trayī carita adhikārā buddhiḥ guṇāḥ giri śikhara taṭa cyutāḥ iva grāvāṇaḥ niravasthānāḥ sva kāraṇe pralaya abhimukhāḥ saha tena astam gacchanti na ca eṣām pravilīnānām punar asti utpādaḥ prayojana abhāvāt iti etasyām avasthāyām guṇa saṃbandha atītaḥ sva rūpa mātra jyotiḥ amalaḥ kevalī puruṣaḥ iti etām saptavidhām prānta bhūmi prajñām anupaśyan puruṣaḥ kuśalaḥ iti ākhyāyate pratiprasave pi cittasya muktaḥ kuśalaḥ iti eva bhavati guṇa atīta tvāt iti siddhā bhavati viveka khyātiḥ hāna upāyaḥ iti na ca siddhiḥ antareṇa sādhanam iti etat ārabhyate

yoga aṅga anuṣṭhānāt aśuddhi kṣaye jñāna dīptiḥ ā viveka khyāteḥ yoga aṅgāni aṣṭau abhidhāyiṣyamāṇāni teṣām anuṣṭhānāt pañca parvaṇaḥ viparyayasya aśuddhi rūpasya kṣayaḥ nāśaḥ tad kṣaye samyak jñānasya abhivyaktiḥ yathā yathā ca sādhanāni anuṣṭhīyante tathā tathā tanu tvam aśuddhiḥ āpadyate yathā yathā ca kṣīyate tathā tathā kṣaya krama anurodhinī jñānasya api dīptiḥ vivardhate sā khalu eṣā vivṛddhiḥ prakarṣam anubhavatyā viveka khyāteḥ ā guṇa puruṣa svarūpa vijñānāt iti arthaḥ yoga aṅga anuṣṭhānam aśuddheḥ viyoga kāraṇam yathā paraśuḥ chedyasya viveka khyāteḥ tu prāpti kāraṇam yathā dharmaḥ sukhasya na anyathā kāraṇam kati ca etāni kāraṇāni śāstre bhavanti navā eva iti āha tat yathā

utpatti sthiti abhivyakti vikāra pratyaya āptayaḥ viyoga anyatva dhṛtayaḥ kāraṇam navadhā smṛtam iti tatra utpatti kāraṇam manaḥ bhavati vijñānasya sthiti kāraṇam manasaḥ puruṣa artha tā śarīrasya iva āhāraḥ iti abhivyakti kāraṇam yathā rūpasya ālokaḥ tathā rūpa jñānam vikāra kāraṇam manasaḥ viṣaya antaram yathā agniḥ pākyasya pratyaya kāraṇam dhūma jñānam agni jñānasya prāpti kāraṇam yoga aṅga anuṣṭhānam viveka khyāteḥ

viyoga kāraṇam tat eva aśuddheḥ anya tva kāraṇam yathā suvarṇasya suvarṇakāraḥ evam ekasya strī pratyayasya avidyā mūḍha tve dveṣaḥ duḥkha tve rāgaḥ sukha tve tattva jñānam mādhyasthye dhṛti kāraṇam śarīram indriyāṇām tāni ca tasya mahābhūtāni śarīrāṇām tāni ca parasparam sarveṣām tairyagyauna mānuṣa daivatāni ca paraspara artha tvāt iti evam nava kāraṇāni tāni ca yathāsaṃbhavam padārtha antareṣu api yojyāni yogāṅga anuṣṭhānam tu dvidhā eva kāraṇa tvam labhate iti tatra yoga aṅgāni avadhāryante
yama niyama āsana prāṇāyāma pratyāhāra dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhayaḥ aṣṭau aṅgāni yathākramam eṣām anuṣṭhānam svarūpam ca vakṣyāmaḥ tatra

ahiṃsā satya asteya brahmacarya aparigrahāḥ yamāḥ tatra ahiṃsā sarvathā sarvadā sarva bhūtānām anabhidrohaḥ uttare ca yama niyamāḥ tad mūlāḥ tad siddhi para tayā eva tad pratipādanāya pratipādyante tad avadāta rūpa karaṇāya eva upādīyante tathā ca uktam sa khalu ayam brāhmaṇaḥ yathā yathā vratāni bahūni samāditsate tathā tathā pramāda kṛtebhyaḥ hiṃsā nidānebhyaḥ nivartamānaḥ tām eva avadāta rūpām ahiṃsām karoti

satyam yathārthe vāc manase yathā dṛṣṭam yathā anumitam tathā vāc manaḥ ca iti paratra sva bodha saṃkrāntaye vāc uktā sā yadi na vañcitā bhrāntā vā pratipatti vandhyā vā bhavet iti eṣā sarva bhūta upakāra artham pravṛttā na bhūta upaghātāya yadi ca evam api abhidhīyamānāḥ bhūta upaghāta para eva syāt na satyam bhavet pāpam eva bhavet tena puṇya ābhāsena puṇya pratirūpakeṇa kaṣṭam tamaḥ prāpnuyāt tasmāt parīkṣya sarva bhūta hitam satyam brūyāt steyam aśāstra pūrvakam dravyāṇām paratas svīkaraṇam tad pratiṣedhaḥ punar aspṛhā rūpam asteyam iti brahmacaryam gupta indriyasya upasthasya saṃyamaḥ viṣayāṇām arjana rakṣaṇa kṣaya saṅga hiṃsā doṣa darśanāt asvīkaraṇam aparigrahaḥ iti ete yamāḥ te tu

jāti deśa kāla samayān avacchinnāḥ sārvabhaumāḥ mahā vratam tatra ahiṃsā jāti avacchinnā matsya vadhakasya matsyeṣu eva na anyatra hiṃsā sā eva deśa avacchinnā na tīrthe haniṣyāmi iti sā eva kāla avacchinnāḥ na caturdaśyām na puṇye ahani haniṣyāmi iti sā eva tribhiḥ uparatasya samayā avacchinnā deva brāhmaṇa arthe na anyathā haniṣyāmi iti yathā ca kṣatriyāṇām yuddhaḥ eva hiṃsā na anyatra iti ebhiḥ jāti deśa kāla samayaiḥ anavacchinnāḥ ahiṃsā ādayaḥ sarvathā eva paripālanīyāḥ sarva bhūmiṣu sarva viṣayeṣu sarvathā eva avidita vyabhicārāḥ sārvabhaumāḥ mahā vratam iti ucyante

śauca saṃtoṣa tapaḥ svādhyāya īśvara praṇidhānāni niyamāḥ tatra śaucam mṛd jala ādi janitam medhya abhyavaharaṇa ādi ca bāhyam ābhyantaram citta malānām ākṣālanam saṃtoṣaḥ saṃnihita sādhanāt adhikasya anupāditsā tapaḥ dvaṃdva sahanam dvaṃdvāḥ ca jighatsā pipāse śīta uṣṇe sthāna āsane kāṣṭha mauna ākāra maune ca vratāni ca eṣām yathāyogam kṛcchra cāndrāyaṇa sāṃtapana ādīni svādhyāyaḥ mokṣa śāstrāṇām adhyayanam praṇava japaḥ vā īśvara praṇidhānam tasmin parama gurau sarva karma arpaṇam śayyā āsana sthaḥ atha pathi vrajan vā svasthaḥ parikṣīṇa vitarka jālaḥ saṃsāra bīja kṣayam īkṣamāṇaḥ syāt nitya yuktaḥ amṛta bhoga bhāgī yatra idam uktam tatas pratyak cetanā adhigamaḥ api antarāya abhāvaḥ ca iti eteṣām yama niyamānām

vitarka bādhane pratipakṣa bhāvanam yadā asya brāhmaṇasya hiṃsā ādayaḥ vitarkāḥ jāyeran haniṣyāmi aham apakāriṇam anṛtam api vakṣyāmi dravyam api asya svīkariṣyāmi dāreṣu ca asya vyavāyī bhaviṣyāmi parigraheṣu ca asya svāmī bhaviṣyāmi iti evam unmārga pravaṇa vitarka jvareṇa ati dīptena bādhyamānaḥ tad pratipakṣān bhāvayet ghoreṣu saṃsāra aṅgāreṣu pacyamānena mayā śaraṇam upāgataḥ sarva bhūta abhaya pradānena yoga dharmaḥ sa khalu aham tyaktvā vitarkān punar tān ādadānaḥ tulyaḥ śva vṛttena iti bhāvayet yathā śvā vānta avalehī tathā tyaktasya punar ādadānaḥ iti evamādi sūtra antareṣu api yojyam

vitarkāḥ hiṃsā ādayaḥ kṛta kārita anumoditāḥ lobha krodha moha pūrvakāḥ mṛdu madhya adhimātrāḥ duḥkha ajñāna ananta phalāḥ iti pratipakṣa bhāvanam tatra hiṃsā tāvat kṛtā kārita anumoditā iti tridhā ekaikā punar tridhā lobhena māṃsa carma arthena krodhena apakṛtam anena iti mohena dharmaḥ me bhaviṣyati iti lobha krodha mohāḥ punar trividhāḥ mṛdu madhya adhimātrāḥ iti evam saptaviṃśatiḥ bhedāḥ bhavanti hiṃsāyāḥ mṛdu madhya adhimātrāḥ punar tridhā mṛdu mṛduḥ madhya mṛduḥ tīvra mṛduḥ iti tathā mṛdu madhyaḥ madhya madhyaḥ tīvra madhye iti tathā mṛdu tīvraḥ madhya tīvraḥ adhimātra tīvraḥ iti evam ekāśīti bhedā hiṃsā bhavati sā punar niyama vikalpa samuccaya bhedāt asaṃkhyeyā prāṇabhṛt bhedasya aparisaṃkhyeya tvāt iti evam anṛta ādiṣu api yojyam

te khalu amī vitarkāḥ duḥkha ajñāna ananta phalāḥ iti pratipakṣa bhāvanam duḥkham ajñānam ca anantam phalam yeṣām iti pratipakṣa bhāvanam tathā ca hiṃsakaḥ tāvat prathamam vadhyasya vīryam ākṣipati tatas ca śastra ādi nipātena duḥkhayati tatas jīvitāt api mocayati tatas vīrya ākṣepāt asya cetana acetanam upakaraṇam kṣīṇa vīryam bhavati duḥkha utpādāt naraka tiryak preta ādiṣu duḥkham anubhavati jīvita vyapara upaṇāt pratikṣaṇam ca jīvita atyaye vartamānaḥ maraṇam icchan api duḥkha vipākasya niyata vipāka vedanīya tvāt kathaṃcid eva ucchvasiti yadi ca kathaṃcid puṇya āvāpa gatā hiṃsā bhavet tatra sukha prāptau bhavet alpa āyuḥ iti evam anṛta ādiṣu api yojyam yathāsaṃbhavam evam vitarkāṇām ca amum eva anugatam vipākam aniṣṭam bhāvayan na vitarkeṣu manaḥ praṇidadhīta pratipakṣa bhāvanāt dhetoḥ heyāḥ vitarkāḥ yadā asya syuḥ aprasava dharmāṇaḥ tadā tad kṛtam aiśvaryam yoginaḥ siddhi sūcakam bhavati tat yathā
ahiṃsā pratiṣṭhāyām tad saṃnidhau vaira tyāgaḥ sarva prāṇinām bhavati
satya pratiṣṭhāyām kriyā phala āśraya tvam dhārmikaḥ bhūyāḥ iti bhavati dhārmikaḥ svargam prāpnuhi iti svargam prāpnoti amoghā asya vāc bhavati
asteya pratiṣṭhāyām sarva ratna upasthānam sarva diś sthāni asya upatiṣṭhante ratnāni
brahmacarya pratiṣṭhāyām vīrya lābhaḥ yasya lābhāt apratighān guṇān utkarṣayati siddhaḥ ca vineyeṣu jñānam ādhātum samarthaḥ bhavati iti

aparigraha sthairye janma kathaṃtā saṃbodhaḥ asya bhavati kaḥ aham āsam katham aham āsam kiṃsvid idam kathaṃsvid idam ke vā bhaviṣyāmaḥ katham vā bhaviṣyāmaḥ iti evam asya pūrva anta para anta madhyeṣu ātma bhāva jijāsā sva rūpeṇa upāvartate etāḥ yama sthairye siddhayaḥ niyameṣu vakṣyāmaḥ

śaucāt sva aṅga jugupsā paraiḥ asaṃsargaḥ sva aṅge jugupsāyām śaucam ārabhamāṇaḥ kāya avadya darśī kāya anabhiṣvaṅgī yatiḥ bhavati kiṃca paraiḥ asaṃsargaḥ kāya svabhāva avalokī svam api kāyam jihāsuḥ mṛd jala ādibhiḥ ākṣālayan api kāya śuddhim apaśyan katham para kāyaiḥ atyantam eva aprayataiḥ saṃsṛjyeta kiṃca

sattva śuddhi saumanasya ekāgrya indriya jaya ātma darśana yogya tvāni ca bhavanti iti vākya śeṣaḥ śuceḥ sattva śuddhiḥ tatas saumanasyam tatas aikāgryam tatas indriya jayaḥ tatas ca ātma darśana yogya tvam buddhi sattvasya bhavati iti etat śauca sthaiḥ yāt adhigamyate iti
saṃtoṣāt anuttamaḥ sukha lābhaḥ tathā ca uktam yat ca kāma sukham loke yat ca divyam mahat sukham tṛṣṇā kṣaya sukhasya ete na arhataḥ ṣoḍaśīm kalām iti

kāya indriya siddhiḥ aśuddhi kṣayāt tapasaḥ nirvartyamānam eva tapaḥ hinasti aśuddhi āvaraṇa malam tad āvaraṇa mala apagamāt kāya siddhiḥ aṇima ādyā tathā indriya siddhiḥ dūrāt śravaṇa darśana ādya iti
svādhyāyāt iṣṭadevatā saṃprayogaḥ devāḥ ṛṣayaḥ siddhāḥ ca svādhyāya śīlasya darśanam gacchanti kārye ca asya vartante iti

samādhi siddhiḥ īśvara praṇidhānāt īśvara arpita sarva bhāvasya samādhi siddhiḥ yayā sarvam īpsitam avitatham jānāti deśa antare deha antare kāla antare ca tatas asya prajñā yathābhūtam prajānāti iti uktāḥ saha siddhibhiḥ yama niyamāḥ āsana ādīni vakṣyāmaḥ tatra

sthira sukham āsanam tat yathā padmāsanam bhadrāsanam svastikam daṇḍāsanam sa upāśrayam paryaṅkam krauñca niṣadanam hasti niṣadanam uṣṭra niṣadanam sama saṃsthānam sthira sukham yathāsukham ca iti evamādīni
prayatna śaithilya ananta samāpattibhyām bhavati iti vākya śeṣaḥ prayatna uparamāt sidhyati āsanam yena na aṅgam ejayaḥ bhavati anante vā samāpannam cittam āsanam nirvartayati iti
tatas dvandva anabhighātaḥ śīta uṣṇa ādibhiḥ dvandvaiḥ āsana jayāt na abhibhūyate
tasmin sati śvāsa praśvāsayoḥ gati vicchedaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sati āsana jaye bāhyasya vāyoḥ ācamanam śvāsaḥ kauṣṭhyasya vāyoḥ niḥsāraṇam praśvāsaḥ tayoḥ gati vicchedaḥ ubhaya abhāvaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa tu

bāhya abhyantara stambha vṛttiḥ deśa kāla saṃkhyābhiḥ paridṛṣṭaḥ dīrgha sūkṣmaḥ yatra praśvāsa pūrvakaḥ gati abhāvaḥ sa bāhyaḥ yatra śvāsa pūrvakaḥ gati abhāvaḥ saḥ ābhyantaraḥ tṛtīyaḥ stambha vṛttiḥ yatra ubhaya abhāvaḥ sakṛt prayatnāt bhavati yathā tapte nyastam upale jalam sarvatas saṃkocam āpadyate tathā dvayoḥ yugapad gati abhāvaḥ iti trayaḥ api ete deśena paridṛṣṭāḥ iyān asya viṣayaḥ deśaḥ iti kālena paridṛṣṭāḥ kṣaṇānām iyattā avadhāraṇena avacchinnāḥ iti arthaḥ saṃkhyābhiḥ paridṛṣṭā etāvadbhiḥ śvāsa praśvāsaiḥ prathamaḥ udghātaḥ tadvat nigṛhītasya etāvadbhiḥ dvitīyaḥ udghātaḥ evam tṛtīyaḥ evam mṛduḥ evam madhye evam tīvraḥ iti saṃkhyā paridṛṣṭaḥ sa khalu ayam evam abhyastaḥ dīrgha sūkṣmaḥ

bāhya abhyantara viṣaya ākṣepī caturthaḥ deśa kāla saṃkhyābhiḥ bāhya viṣaya paridṛṣṭaḥ ākṣiptaḥ tathā abhyantara viṣaya paridṛṣṭaḥ ākṣiptaḥ ubhayathā dīrgha sūkṣmaḥ tad pūrvakaḥ bhūmi jayāt krameṇa ubhayoḥ gati abhāvaḥ caturthaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ tṛtīyaḥ tu viṣaya anālocitaḥ gati abhāvaḥ sakṛt ārabdhaḥ eva deśa kāla saṃkhyābhiḥ paridṛṣṭaḥ dīrgha sūkṣmaḥ caturthaḥ tu śvāsa praśvāsayoḥ viṣaya avadhāraṇāt krameṇa bhūmi jayād ubhaya ākṣepa pūrvakaḥ gati abhāvaḥ caturthaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ iti ayam viśeṣaḥ iti

tatas kṣīyate prakāśa āvaraṇam prāṇāyāmān abhyasyataḥ asya yoginaḥ kṣīyate viveka jñāna āvaraṇīyam karma yat tat ācakṣate mahā moha mayena indrajālena prakāśa śīlam sattvam āvṛtya tat eva akārye niyuṅkte iti tat asya prakāśa āvaraṇam karma saṃsāra nibandhanam prāṇāyāma abhyāsāt durbalam bhavati pratikṣaṇam ca kṣīyate tathā ca uktam tapaḥ na param prāṇāyāmāt tatas viśuddhiḥ malānām dīptiḥ ca jñānasya iti kiṃca
dhāraṇāsu ca yogyatā manasaḥ prāṇāyāma abhyāsāt eva pracchardana vidhāraṇābhyām vā prāṇasya iti vacanāt atha kaḥ pratyāhāraḥ

sva viṣaya asaṃprayoge citta svarūpa anukāraḥ iva indriyāṇām pratyāhāraḥ sva viṣaya saṃprayoga abhāve citta svarūpa anukāraḥ iva iti citta nirodhe citta vat niruddhāni indriyāṇi na itara indriya jaya vat upāya antaram apekṣante yathā madhukara rājam makṣikāḥ utpatantam anūtpatanti niviśamānam anu niviśante tathā indriyāṇi citta nirodhe niruddhāni iti eṣa pratyāhāraḥ

tatas paramā vaśya tā indriyāṇām śabda ādiṣu avyasanam indriya jayaḥ iti kecid saktiḥ vyasanam vyasyati enam śreyasaḥ iti aviruddhā pratipattiḥ nyāyyā śabda ādi saṃprayogaḥ sva icchayā iti anye rāga dveṣa abhāve sukha duḥkha śūnyam śabda ādi jñānam indriya jayaḥ iti kecid citta aikāgryāt apratipattiḥ eva iti jaigīṣavyaḥ tatas ca paramā tu iyam vaśya tā yat citta nirodhe niruddhāni indriyāṇi na itara indriya jaya vat prayatna kṛtam upāya antaram apekṣante yoginaḥ iti
uktāni pañca bahis aṅgāni sādhanāni dhāraṇā vaktavyā
deśa bandhaḥ cittasya dhāraṇā nābhi cakre hṛdaya puṇḍarīke mūrdhni jyotiṣi nāsikā agre jihvā agre iti evamādiṣu deśeṣu bāhye vā viṣaye cittasya vṛtti mātreṇa bandhaḥ iti dhāraṇā tatra
pratyaya eka tāna tā dhyānam tasmin deśe dhyeya ālambanasya pratyayasya eka tāna tā sadṛśaḥ pravāhaḥ pratyaya antareṇa aparāmṛṣṭaḥ dhyānam
tat eva artha mātra nirbhāsam svarūpa śūnyam iva samādhiḥ dhyānam eva dhyeya ākāra anirbhāsam pratyaya ātmakena svarūpeṇa śūnyam iva yadā bhavati dhyeya svabhāva āveśāt tadā samādhiḥ iti ucyate
trayam ekatra saṃyamaḥ tat etat dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhi trayam ekatra saṃyamaḥ eka viṣayāṇi trīṇi sādhanāni saṃyamaḥ iti ucyate tat asya trayasya tāntrikī paribhāṣā saṃyamaḥ iti
tad jayāt prajñā lokaḥ tasya saṃyamasya jayāt samādhi prajñāyāḥ bhavati ālokaḥ yathā yathā saṃyamaḥ sthira padaḥ bhavati tathā tathā samādhi prajñā viśāradī bhavati

tasya bhūmiṣu viniyogaḥ tasya saṃyamasya jita bhūmeḥ yā an antarā bhūmiḥ tatra viniyogaḥ na hi ajita adhara bhūmiḥ anantara bhūmim vilaṅghya prānta bhūmiṣu saṃyamam labhate tad abhāvāt ca kutas tasya prajñā lokaḥ īśvara prasādāt jita uttara bhūmikasya ca na adhara bhūmiṣu para citta jñāna ādiṣu saṃyamaḥ yuktaḥ kasmāt tad arthasya anyatas eva avagata tvāt bhūmeḥ asyāḥ iyam anantarā bhūmiḥ iti atra yogaḥ eva upādhyāyaḥ katham evam hi uktam yogena yogaḥ jñātavyaḥ yogaḥ yogāt pravartate yaḥ apramattaḥ tu yogena sa yoge ramate ciram iti
trayam antaraṅgam pūrvebhyaḥ tat etat dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhi trayam antaraṅgam saṃprajñātasya samādheḥ pūrvebhyaḥ yama ādibhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ sādhanebhyaḥ iti

tat api bahis aṅgam nirbījasya tat api antaraṅgam sādhana trayam nirbījasya yogasya bahis aṅgam bhavati kasmāt tad abhāve bhāvāt iti atha nirodha citta kṣaṇeṣu calam guṇa vṛttam iti kīdṛśaḥ tadā citta pariṇāmaḥ

vyutthāna nirodha saṃskārayoḥ abhibhava prādurbhāvau nirodha kṣaṇa citta anvayaḥ nirodha pariṇāmaḥ vyutthāna saṃskārāḥ citta dharmāḥ na te pratyaya ātmakāḥ iti pratyaya nirodhe na niruddhāḥ nirodha saṃskārāḥ api citta dharmāḥ tayoḥ abhibhava prādurbhāvau vyutthāna saṃskārāḥ hīyante nirodha saṃskārāḥ ādhīyante nirodha kṣaṇam cittam anveti tat ekasya cittasya pratikṣaṇam idam saṃskārān yathātvam nirodha pariṇāmaḥ tadā saṃskāra śeṣam cittam iti nirodha samādhau vyākhyātam
tasya praśānta vāhi tā saṃskārāt nirodha saṃskāra abhyāsa pāṭava apekṣā praśānta vāhi tā cittasya bhavati tad saṃskāra māndye vyutthāna dharmiṇā saṃskāreṇa nirodha dharma saṃskāraḥ abhibhūyate iti

sarva artha tā eka agra tayoḥ kṣaya udayau cittasya samādhi pariṇāmaḥ sarva artha tā citta dharmaḥ ekāgra tā api citta dharmaḥ sarva artha tāyāḥ kṣayaḥ tirobhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ ekāgra tāyāḥ udaya āvirbhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ tayoḥ dharmi tvena anugatam cittam tat idam cittam apāya upajanayoḥ sva ātma bhūtayoḥ dharmayoḥ anugatam samādhīyate sa cittasya samādhi pariṇāmaḥ tatas punar

śānta uditau tulya pratyayau cittasya ekāgra tā pariṇāmaḥ samāhita cittasya pūrva pratyayaḥ śāntaḥ uttaraḥ tad sadṛśaḥ uditaḥ samādhi cittam ubhayoḥ anugatam punar tathā eva asamādhi bhreṣāt iti sa khalu ayam dharmiṇaḥ cittasya ekāgra tā pariṇāmaḥ

etena bhūta indriyeṣu dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāmāḥ vyākhyātāḥ etena pūrva uktena citta pariṇāmena dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā rūpeṇa bhūta indriyeṣu dharma pariṇāmaḥ lakṣaṇa pariṇāmaḥ avasthā pariṇāmaḥ ca uktaḥ veditavyaḥ tatra vyutthāna nirodhayoḥ abhibhava prādurbhāvau dharmiṇi dharma pariṇāmaḥ lakṣaṇa pariṇāmaḥ ca nirodhaḥ tri lakṣaṇaḥ tribhiḥ adhvabhiḥ yuktaḥ sa khalu anāgata lakṣaṇam adhvānam prathamam hitvā dharma tvam anatikrāntaḥ vartamāna lakṣaṇam pratipannaḥ yatra asya sva rūpeṇa abhivyaktiḥ eṣaḥ asya dvitīyaḥ adhvā na ca atīta anāgatābhyām lakṣaṇābhyām viyuktaḥ

tathā vyutthānam tri lakṣaṇam tribhiḥ adhvabhiḥ yuktam vartamāna lakṣaṇam hitvā dharma tvam anatikrāntam atīta lakṣaṇam pratipannam eṣaḥ asya tṛtīyaḥ adhvā na ca anāgata vartamānābhyām lakṣaṇābhyām viyuktam evam punar vyutthānam upasaṃpadyamānam anāgata lakṣaṇam hitvā dharma tvam anatikrāntam vartamāna lakṣaṇam pratipannam yatra asya svarūpa abhivyaktau satyām vyāpāraḥ eṣaḥ asya dvitīyaḥ adhvā na ca atīta anāgatābhyām lakṣaṇābhyām viyuktam iti evam punar nirodhaḥ evam punar vyutthānam iti

tathā avasthā pariṇāmaḥ tatra nirodha kṣaṇeṣu nirodha saṃskārāḥ balavantaḥ bhavanti durbalāḥ vyutthāna saṃskārāḥ iti eṣa dharmāṇām avasthā pariṇāmaḥ tatra dharmiṇaḥ dharmaiḥ pariṇāmaḥ dharmāṇām tryadhvanām lakṣaṇaiḥ pariṇāmaḥ lakṣaṇānām api avasthābhiḥ pariṇāmaḥ iti evam dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāmaiḥ śūnyam na kṣaṇam api guṇa vṛttam avatiṣṭhate calam ca guṇa vṛttam guṇa svābhāvyam tu pravṛtti kāraṇam uktam guṇānām iti etena bhūta indriyeṣu dharma dharmi bhedāt trividhaḥ pariṇāmaḥ veditavyaḥ

paramārthataḥ tu ekaḥ eva pariṇāmaḥ dharmi svarūpa mātraḥ hi dharmaḥ dharmi vikriyā eva eṣā dharma dvārā prapañcyate iti tatra dharmasya dharmiṇi vartamānasya eva adhvasu atīta anāgata vartamāneṣu bhāvān yathātvam bhavati na tu dravyānyathātvam yathā suvarṇa bhājanasya bhittvā anyathā kriyamāṇasya bhāvān yathātvam bhavati na suvarṇānyathātvam iti

aparaḥ āha dharmān abhyadhikaḥ dharmī pūrva tattva anatikramāt pūrva apara avasthā bhedam anupatitaḥ kauṭasthyena eva parivarteta yadi anvayī syāt iti ayam adoṣaḥ kasmāt ekānta tā anabhyupagamāt tat etat trailokyam vyakteḥ apaiti nitya tva pratiṣedhāt apetam api asti vināśa pratiṣedhāt saṃsargāt ca asya saukṣmyam saukṣmyāt ca anupalabdhiḥ iti

lakṣaṇa pariṇāmaḥ dharmaḥ adhvasu vartamānaḥ atītaḥ atīta lakṣaṇa yuktaḥ anāgata vartamānābhyām lakṣaṇābhyām aviyuktaḥ tathā anāgataḥ anāgata lakṣaṇa yuktaḥ vartamāna atītābhyām lakṣaṇābhyām aviyuktaḥ tathā vartamānaḥ vartamāna lakṣaṇa yuktaḥ atīta anāgatābhyām lakṣaṇābhyām aviyuktaḥ iti yathā puruṣaḥ ekasyām striyām raktaḥ na śeṣāsu viraktaḥ bhavati iti

atra lakṣaṇa pariṇāme sarvasya sarva lakṣaṇa yogāt adhva saṃkaraḥ prāpnoti iti paraiḥ doṣaḥ ca udyate iti tasya parihāraḥ dharmāṇām dharma tvam aprasādhyam sati ca dharma tve lakṣaṇa bhedaḥ api vācyaḥ na vartamāna samayaḥ eva asya dharma tvam evam hi na cittam rāga dharmakam syāt krodha kāle rāgasya asamudācārāt iti

kiṃca trayāṇām lakṣaṇānām yugapad ekasyām vyaktau na asti saṃbhavaḥ krameṇa tu sva vyañjaka añjanasya bhāvaḥ bhavet iti uktam ca rūpa atiśayāḥ vṛtti atiśayāḥ ca virudhyante sāmānyāni tu atiśayaiḥ saha pravartante tasmāt asaṃkaraḥ yathā rāgasya eva kvacid samudācāraḥ iti na tadānīm anyatra abhāvaḥ kiṃtu kevalam sāmānyena samanvāgataḥ iti asti tadā tatra tasya bhāvaḥ tathā lakṣaṇasya iti

na dharmī tri adhvāḥ dharmāḥ tu tri adhvānaḥ te lakṣitāḥ alakṣitāḥ tatra lakṣitāḥ tām tām avasthām prāpnuvantaḥ anya tvena pratinirdiśyante avasthā antarataḥ na dravya antarataḥ yathā ekā rekhā śata sthāne śatam daśa sthāne daśa ekā ca eka sthāne yathā ca eka tve api strī mātā ca ucyate duhitā ca svasā ca iti avasthā pariṇāme kauṭasthya prasaṅga doṣaḥ kaiścid uktaḥ katham adhvanaḥ vyāpāreṇa vyavahita tvāt yadā dharmaḥ sva vyāpāram na karoti tadā anāgataḥ yadā karoti tadā vartamānaḥ yadā kṛtvā nivṛttaḥ tadā atītaḥ iti evam dharma dharmiṇoḥ lakṣaṇānām avasthānām ca kauṭasthyam prāpnoti iti paraiḥ doṣaḥ ucyate na asau doṣaḥ kasmāt guṇi nitya tve api guṇānām vimarda vaicitryāt yathā saṃsthānam ādimat dharma mātram śabda ādīnām guṇānām vināśya vināśinām evam liṅgam ādimat dharma mātram sattva ādīnām guṇānām vināśya vināśinā tasmin vikāra saṃjñā iti

tatra idam udāharaṇam mṛd dharmī piṇḍa ākārāt dharmāt dharma antaram upasaṃpadyamānaḥ dharmataḥ pariṇamate ghaṭa ākāraḥ iti ghaṭa ākāraḥ anāgatam lakṣaṇam hitvā vartamāna lakṣaṇam pratipadyate iti lakṣaṇataḥ pariṇamate ghaṭaḥ nava purāṇa tām pratikṣaṇam anubhavan avasthā pariṇāmam pratipadyate iti dharmiṇaḥ api dharma antaram avasthā dharmasya api lakṣaṇa antaram avasthā iti ekaḥ eva dravya pariṇāmaḥ bhedena upadarśitaḥ iti evam padārtha antareṣu api yojyam iti te ete dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāmāḥ dharmi svarūpam anatikrāntāḥ iti ekaḥ eva pariṇāmaḥ sarvān amūn viśeṣān abhiplavate atha kaḥ ayam pariṇāmaḥ avasthitasya dravyasya pūrva dharma nivṛttau dharma antara utpattiḥ pariṇāmaḥ iti tatra

śānta udita avyapadeśya dharma anupātī dharmī yogyatā avacchinnāḥ dharmiṇaḥ śaktiḥ eva dharmaḥ sa ca phala prasava bheda anumitaḥ ekasya anyaḥ anyaḥ ca paridṛṣṭaḥ tatra vartamānaḥ sva vyāpāram anubhavan dharmī dharma antarebhyaḥ śāntebhyaḥ ca avyapadeśyebhyaḥ ca bhidyate yadā tu sāmānyena samanvāgataḥ bhavati tadā dharmi svarūpa mātra tvāt kaḥ asau kena bhidyeta

tatra ye khalu dharmiṇaḥ dharmāḥ śāntāḥ uditāḥ avyapadeśyāḥ ca iti tatra śāntāḥ ye kṛtvā vyāpārān uparatāḥ savya apārāḥ uditāḥ te ca anāgatasya lakṣaṇasya samanantarāḥ vartamānasya anantarāḥ atītāḥ kimartham atītasya anantarāḥ na bhavanti vartamānāḥ pūrva paścimatāyāḥ abhāvāt yathā anāgata vartamānayoḥ pūrva paścimatā na evam atītasya tasmāt na atītasya asti samanantaraḥ tad anāgataḥ eva samanantaraḥ bhavati vartamānasya iti atha avyapadeśyāḥ ke sarvam sarva ātmakam iti yatra uktam jala bhūmyoḥ pāriṇāmikam rasa ādi vaiśvarūpyam sthāvareṣu dṛṣṭam tathā sthāvarāṇām jaṅgameṣu jaṅgamānām sthāvareṣu iti evam jāti anucchedena sarvam sarva ātmakam iti

deśa kāla ākāra nimitta apabandhāt na khalu samāna kālam ātmanām abhivyaktiḥ iti yaḥ eteṣu abhivyakta anabhivyakteṣu dharmeṣu anupātī sāmānya viśeṣa ātmā saḥ anvayī dharmī yasya tu dharma mātram eva idam niranvayam tasya bhoga abhāvaḥ kasmāt anyena vijñānena kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ anyat katham bhoktṛ tvena adhikriyate tad smṛti abhāvaḥ ca na anya dṛṣṭasya smaraṇam anyasya asti iti vastu pratyabhijñānāt ca sthitaḥ anvayī dharmī yaḥ dharmān yathātvam abhyupagataḥ pratyabhijñāyate tasmāt na idam dharma mātram niranvayam iti

krama anya tvam pariṇāma anya tve hetuḥ ekasya dharmiṇaḥ ekaḥ eva pariṇāmaḥ iti prasakte krama anya tvam pariṇāma anya tve hetuḥ bhavati iti tat yathā cūrṇa mṛd piṇḍa mṛd ghaṭa mṛd kapāla mṛd kaṇa mṛt iti ca kramaḥ yaḥ yasya dharmasya samanantaraḥ dharmaḥ sa tasya kramaḥ piṇḍaḥ pracyavate ghaṭaḥ upajāyate iti dharma pariṇāma kramaḥ lakṣaṇa pariṇāma kramaḥ ghaṭasya anāgata bhāvāt vartamāna bhāvaḥ kramaḥ tathā piṇḍasya vartamāna bhāvāt atīta bhāvaḥ kramaḥ na atītasya asti kramaḥ kasmāt pūrva para tāyām satyām samanantara tvam sā tu na asti atītasya tasmāt dvayoḥ eva lakṣaṇayoḥ kramaḥ tathā avasthā pariṇāma kramaḥ api ghaṭasya abhinavasya prānte purāṇa tā dṛśyate sā ca kṣaṇa paramparā anupātinā krameṇa abhivyajyamānā parām vyaktim āpadyate iti dharma lakṣaṇābhyām ca viśiṣṭaḥ ayam tṛtīyaḥ pariṇāmaḥ iti

te ete kramāḥ dharma dharmi bhede sati pratilabdha svarūpāḥ dharmaḥ api dharmī bhavati anya dharma svarūpa apekṣayā iti yadā tu paramārthataḥ dharmiṇi abheda upacāraḥ tad dvāreṇa saḥ eva abhidhīyate dharmaḥ tadā ayam eka tvena eva kramaḥ pratyavabhāsate cittasya dvaye dharmāḥ paridṛṣṭāḥ ca aparidṛṣṭāḥ ca tatra pratyaya ātmakāḥ paridṛṣṭāḥ vastu mātra ātmakāḥ aparidṛṣṭāḥ te ca sapta eva bhavanti anumānena prāpita vastu mātra sadbhāvāḥ nirodha dharma saṃskārāḥ pariṇāmaḥ atha jīvanam ceṣṭā śaktiḥ ca cittasya dharmāḥ darśana varjitāḥ iti atas yoginaḥ upātta sarva sādhanasya bubhutsita artha pratipattaye saṃyamasya viṣayaḥ upakṣipyate

pariṇāma traya saṃyamāt atīta anāgata jñānam dharma lakṣaṇa avasthā pariṇāmeṣu saṃyamāt yoginām bhavati atīta anāgata jñānam dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhi trayam ekatra saṃyamaḥ uktaḥ tena pariṇāma trayam sākṣāt kriyamāṇam atīta anāgata jñānam teṣu saṃpādayati

śabda artha pratyayānām itaretara adhyāsāt saṃkaraḥ tad pravibhāga saṃyamāt sarva bhūta ruta jñānam tatra vāc varṇeṣu eva arthavatī śrotram ca dhvani pariṇāma mātra viṣayam padam punar nāda anusaṃhāra buddhi nirgrāhyam iti varṇāḥ eka samaya asaṃbhavi tvāt paraspara niranugraha ātmānaḥ te padam asaṃspṛśya anupasthāpya āvirbhūtāḥ tirobhūtāḥ ca iti pratyekam apada sva rūpāḥ ucyante

varṇaḥ punar ekaikaḥ pada ātmā sarva abhidhāna śakti pracitaḥ sahakāri varṇa antara pratiyogi tvāt vaiśvarūpyam iva āpannaḥ pūrvaḥ ca uttareṇa uttaraḥ ca pūrveṇa viśeṣe avasthāpitaḥ iti evam bahavaḥ varṇāḥ krama anurodhinaḥ artha saṃketena avacchinnāḥ iyante ete sarva abhidhāna śakti parivṛtāḥ gakāra aukāra visarjanīyāḥ sāsnādimantam artham dyotayanti iti

tat eteṣām artha saṃketena avacchinnānām upasaṃhṛta dhvani kramāṇām yaḥ ekaḥ buddhi nirbhāsaḥ tat padam vācakam vācyasya saṃketyate tat ekam padam ekabuddhi viṣayaḥ eka prayatna ākṣiptam abhāgam akramam avarṇam bauddham antya varṇa pratyaya vyāpāra upasthāpitam paratra pratipipādayiṣayā varṇaiḥ eva abhidhīyamānaiḥ śrūyamāṇaiḥ ca śrotṛbhiḥ anādi vāc vyavahāra vāsanā anuviddhayā loka buddhyā siddha vat saṃpratipattyā pratīyate

tasya saṃketa buddhitaḥ pravibhāgaḥ etāvatām evaṃjātīyakaḥ anusaṃhāraḥ ekasya arthasya vācakaḥ iti saṃketaḥ tu pada padārthayoḥ itaretara adhyāsa rūpaḥ smṛti ātmakaḥ yaḥ ayam śabdaḥ saḥ ayam arthaḥ yaḥ ayam arthaḥ saḥ ayam śabdaḥ iti evam itaretara adhyāsa rūpaḥ saṃketaḥ bhavati iti evam ete śabda artha pratyayāḥ itaretara adhyāsāt saṃkīrṇā gauḥ iti śabdaḥ gauḥ iti arthaḥ gauḥ iti jñānam yaḥ eṣām pravibhāga jñaḥ sa sarva vid sarva padeṣu ca asti vākya śakti vṛkṣaḥ iti ukte asti iti gamyate na sattām padārthaḥ vyabhicarati iti tathā na hi asādhanā kriyā asti iti

tathā ca pacati iti ukte sarva kārakāṇām ākṣepaḥ niyama arthaḥ anuvādaḥ kartṛ karaṇa karmaṇām caitra agni taṇḍulānām iti dṛṣṭam ca vākya arthe pada racanam śrotriyaḥ chandaḥ adhīte jīvati prāṇān dhārayati tatra vākye padārtha abhivyaktiḥ tatas padam pravibhajya vyākaraṇīyam kriyā vācakam vā kāraka vācakam vā anyathā bhavati aśvaḥ ajāpayaḥ iti evamādiṣu nāma ākhyāta sārūpyāt anirjñātam katham kriyāyām kārake vā vyākriyeta iti

teṣām śabda artha pratyayānām pravibhāgaḥ tat yathā śvetate prāsādaḥ iti kriyā arthaḥ śvetaḥ prāsādaḥ iti kāraka arthaḥ śabdaḥ kriyākāraka ātmā tad arthaḥ pratyayaḥ ca kasmāt saḥ ayam iti abhisaṃbandhāt eka ākāraḥ eva pratyayaḥ saṃketaḥ iti yaḥ tu śvetaḥ arthaḥ sa śabda pratyayayoḥ ālambanībhūtaḥ sa hi svābhiḥ avasthābhiḥ vikriyamāṇaḥ na śabda sahagataḥ na buddhi sahagataḥ evam śabdaḥ evam pratyayaḥ na itaretara sahagataḥ iti anyathā śabdaḥ anyathā arthaḥ anyathā pratyayaḥ iti vibhāgaḥ evam tad pravibhāga saṃyamāt yoginaḥ sarva bhūta ruta jñānam saṃpadyate iti

saṃskāra sākṣāt karaṇāt pūrva jāti jñānam dvaye khalu amī saṃskārāḥ smṛti kleśa hetavaḥ vāsanā rūpāḥ vipāka hetavaḥ dharma adharma rūpāḥ te pūrva bhava abhisaṃskṛtāḥ pariṇāma ceṣṭā nirodha śakti jīvana dharma vat aparidṛṣṭāḥ citta dharmāḥ teṣu saṃyamaḥ saṃskāra sākṣāt kriyāyai samarthaḥ na ca deśa kāla nimitta anubhavaiḥ vinā teṣām asti sākṣātkaraṇam tat ittham saṃskāra sākṣāt karaṇāt pūrva jāti jñānam utpadyate yoginaḥ paratra api evam eva saṃskāra sākṣāt karaṇāt para jāti saṃvedanam

atra idam ākhyānam śrūyate bhagavataḥ jaigīṣavyasya saṃskāra sākṣāt karaṇāt daśasu mahā sargeṣu janma pariṇāma kramam anupaśyataḥ viveka jam jñānam prādurabhūt atha bhagavān āvaṭyaḥ tanudharaḥ tam uvāca daśasu mahā sargeṣu bhavya tvāt anabhibhūta buddhi sattvena tvayā naraka tiryak garbha saṃbhavam duḥkham saṃpaśyatā deva manuṣyeṣu punar punar utpadyamānena sukha duḥkhayoḥ kim adhikam upalabdham iti bhagavantam āvaṭyam jaigīṣavyaḥ uvāca daśasu mahā sargeṣu bhavya tvāt anabhibhūta buddhi sattvena mayā naraka tiryak bhavam duḥkham saṃpaśyatā deva manuṣyeṣu punar punar utpadyamānena yat kiṃcid anubhūtam tat sarvam duḥkham eva pratyavaimi

bhagavān āvaṭyaḥ uvāca yat idam āyuṣmataḥ pradhāna vaśi tvam anuttamam ca saṃtoṣa sukham kim idam api duḥkha pakṣe nikṣiptam iti bhavagān jaigīṣavyaḥ uvāca viṣaya sukha apekṣayā eva idam anuttamam saṃtoṣa sukham uktam kaivalya sukha apekṣayā duḥkham eva buddhi sattvasya ayam dharmaḥ triguṇaḥ triguṇaḥ ca pratyayaḥ heya pakṣe nyastaḥ iti duḥkha rūpaḥ tṛṣṇā tantuḥ tṛṣṇā duḥkha saṃtāpa apagamāt tu prasannam abādham sarva anukūlam sukham idam uktam iti
pratyayasya para citta jñānam pratyaye saṃyamāt pratyayasya sākṣātkaraṇāt tatas para citta jñānam

na ca tat sa ālambanam tasya aviṣayī bhūta tvāt raktam pratyayam jānāti amuṣmin ālambane raktam iti na jānāti para pratyayasya yat ālambanam tat yogi cittena na ālambanīkṛtam para pratyaya mātram tu yogi cittasya ālambanībhūtam iti

kāya rūpa saṃyamāt tad grāhya śakti stambhe cakṣuḥ prakāśa asaṃprayoge antardhānam kāyasya rūpe saṃyamāt rūpasya yā grāhyā śaktiḥ tām pratiṣṭabhnāti grāhya śakti stambhe sati cakṣuṣprakāśa asaṃprayoge antardhānam utpadyate yoginaḥ etena śabda ādi antardhānam uktam veditavyam

sa upakramam nirupakramam ca karma tad saṃyamāt aparānta jñānam ariṣṭebhyaḥ vā āyuḥ vipākam karma dvividham sa upakramam nirupakramam ca tatra yathā ārdram vastram vitānitam laghīyasā kālena śuṣyet tathā sa upakramam yathā ca tat eva saṃpiṇḍitam cireṇa saṃśuṣyet evam nirupakramam yathā vā agniḥ śuṣke kakṣe muktaḥ vātena samantataḥ yuktaḥ kṣepīyasā kālena dahet tathā sa upakramam yathā vā saḥ eva agniḥ tṛṇa rāśau kramaśas avayaveṣu nyastaḥ cireṇa dahet tathā nirupakramam tadā eka bhavikam āyuṣkaram karma dvividham sa upakramam nirupakramam ca tad saṃyamāt apara antasya prāyaṇasya jñānam

ariṣṭebhyaḥ vā iti trividham ariṣṭam ādhyātmikam ādhibhautikam ādhidaivikam ca iti tatra ādhyātmikam ghoṣam sva dehe pihita karṇaḥ na śṛṇoti jyotiḥ vā netre avaṣṭabdhe na paśyati tathā adhibhautikam yama puruṣān paśyati pitṝn atītān akasmāt paśyati tathā ādhidaivikam svargam akasmāt siddhān vā paśyati viparītam vā sarvam iti anena vā jānāti apara antam upasthitam iti

maitrī ādiṣu balāni maitrī karuṇā muditā iti tisraḥ bhāvanāḥ tatra bhūteṣu sukhiteṣu maitrīm bhāvayitvā maitrī balam labhate duḥkhiteṣu karuṇām bhāvayitvā karuṇā balam labhate puṇya śīleṣu muditām bhāvayitvā mudita abalam labhate bhāvanātaḥ samādhiḥ yaḥ sa saṃyamaḥ tatas balāni avandhya vīryāṇi jāyante pāpa śīleṣu upekṣā na tu bhāvanā tatas ca tasyām na asti samādhiḥ iti atas na balam upekṣātaḥ tatra saṃyama abhāvāt iti
baleṣu hasti bala ādīni hasti bale saṃyamāt dhasti balaḥ bhavati vainateya bale saṃyamāt vainateya balaḥ bhavati vāyu bale saṃyamāt vāyu balaḥ bhavati iti evamādi
pravṛtti āloka nyāsāt sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭa jñānam jyotiṣmatī pravṛttiḥ uktāḥ manasaḥ tasyāḥ yaḥ ālokaḥ tam yogī sūkṣme vā vyavahite vā viprakṛṣṭe vā arthe vinyasya tam artham adhigacchati

bhuvana jñānam sūrye saṃyamāt tad prastāraḥ sapta lokāḥ tatra avīceḥ prabhṛti meru pṛṣṭham yāvat iti evam bhūrlokaḥ meru pṛṣṭhāt ārabhya ādhruvāt graha nakṣatra tārā vicitraḥ antarikṣa lokaḥ tatas paraḥ svarlokaḥ pañcavidhaḥ māhendraḥ tṛtīyaḥ lokaḥ caturthaḥ prājāpatyaḥ mahar lokaḥ trividhaḥ brāhmaḥ tat yathā janalokaḥ tapolokaḥ satya lokaḥ iti brāhmaḥ tribhūmikaḥ loka prājāpatyaḥ tatas mahān māhendraḥ ca svar iti uktaḥ divi tārāḥ bhuvi prajāḥ iti saṃgrahaślokaḥ

tatra avīceḥ upari upari niviṣṭāḥ ṣaṣ mahānaraka bhūmayaḥ ghana salila anala anila ākā śa tamaḥ pratiṣṭhā mahākāla ambarīṣa raurava mahāraurava kālasūtra andhatāmisrāḥ yatra sva karma upārjita duḥkha vedanāḥ prāṇinaḥ kaṣṭam āyuḥ dīrgham ākṣipya jāyante tatas mahā tala rasātalā tala sutala vitala talā tala pātāla ākhyāni sapta pātālāni bhūmiḥ iyam aṣṭamī saptadvīpā vasumatī yasyāḥ sumeruḥ madhye parvata rājaḥ kāñcanaḥ tasya rājata vaidūrya sphaṭika hema maṇi mayāni śṛṅgāṇi tatra vaidūrya prabhā anurāgāt nīlotpala patra śyāmaḥ nabhasaḥ dakṣiṇaḥ bhāgaḥ śvetaḥ pūrvaḥ svacchaḥ paścimaḥ kuraṇṭaka ābhaḥ uttaraḥ

dakṣiṇa pārśve ca asya jambūḥ yatas ayam jambūdvīpaḥ tasya sūrya pracārāt rātriṃdivam lagnam iva vartate tasya nīla śvetaśṛṅgavantaḥ udīcīnāḥ trayaḥ parvatāḥ dvi sāhasra āyāmāḥ tad antareṣu trīṇi varṣāṇi nava nava yojana sāhasrāṇi ramaṇakam hiraṇmayam uttarāḥ kuravaḥ iti niṣadha hema kūṭa hima śailāḥ dakṣiṇatas dvi sāhasra āyāmāḥ tad antareṣu trīṇi varṣāṇi nava nava yojana sāhasrāṇi harivarṣam kiṃpuruṣam bhāratam iti sumeroḥ prācīnāḥ bhadrāśva mālya vat sīmānaḥ pratīcīnāḥ ketumālāḥ gandhamādana sīmānaḥ madhye varṣam ilāvṛtam tat etat yojana śata sāhasram sumeroḥ diśi diśi tad ardhena vyūḍham

sa khalu ayam śata sāhasra āyāmaḥ jambūdvīpaḥ tatas dviguṇena lavaṇa udadhinā valaya ākṛtinā veṣṭitaḥ tatas ca dviguṇāḥ dviguṇāḥ śāka kuśa krauñca śālmala gomedha puṣkaradvīpāḥ samudrāḥ ca sarṣapa rāśi kalpāḥ sa vicitra śaila avataṃsāḥ ikṣu rasa surā sarpiḥ dadhimaṇḍa kṣīrasvādu udakāḥ sapta samudra pariveṣṭitāḥ valaya ākṛtayaḥ lokāloka parvata parivārāḥ pañcāśat yojana koṭi parisaṃkhyātāḥ tat etat sarvam su pratiṣṭhita saṃsthāna m aṇḍa madhye vyūḍham aṇḍam ca pradhānasya aṇuḥ avayavaḥ yathā ākāśe khadyotaḥ iti

tatra pātāle jaladhau parvateṣu eteṣu devanikāyā asura gandharva kiṃnara kiṃpuruṣa yakṣa rākṣasa bhūta preta piśāca apasmāraka apsaraḥ brahma rākṣasa kūṣmāṇḍa vināyakāḥ prativasanti sarveṣu dvīpeṣu puṇya ātmānaḥ deva manuṣyāḥ sumeruḥ tridaśānām udyāna bhūmiḥ tatra miśra vanam nandanam caitraratham sumānasam iti udyānāni sudharmā deva sabhā sudarśanam puram vaijayantaḥ prāsādaḥ graha nakṣatra tārakāḥ tu dhruve nibaddhāḥ vāyu vikṣepa niyamena upalakṣita pracārāḥ sumeroḥ upari upari saṃniviṣṭāḥ divi viparivartante

māhendra nivāsinaḥ ṣaṣ deva nikāyāḥ tridaśāḥ agniṣvāttāḥ yāmyāḥ tuṣitāḥ aparinirmitavaśavartinaḥ parinirmita vaśavartinaḥ ca iti sarve saṃkalpa siddhāḥ aṇima ādi aiśvarya upapannāḥ kalpa āyuṣaḥ vṛndārakāḥ kāma bhoginaḥ aupapādika dehāḥ uttama anukūlābhiḥ apsarobhiḥ kṛta paricārāḥ mahati loke prājāpatye pañcavidhaḥ deva nikāyaḥ kumudāḥ ṛbhavaḥ pratardanāḥ añjana ābhāḥ pracita ābhāḥ iti ete mahābhūta vaśinaḥ dhyāna āhārāḥ kalpa sahasra āyuṣaḥ prathame brahmaṇaḥ jana loke caturvidhaḥ deva nikāyaḥ brahma purohitā brahmakāyikāḥ brahma mahā kāyikāḥ amarāḥ iti te bhūta indriya vaśinaḥ dviguṇa dviguṇa uttara āyuñaḥ

dvitīye tapasi loke trividhaḥ deva nikāyaḥ ābhāsvarāḥ mahā bhāsvarāḥ satya mahā bhāsvarāḥ iti te bhūta indriya prakṛti vaśinaḥ dviguṇa dviguṇa uttara āyuṣaḥ sarve dhyāna āhārāḥ ūrdhvaretasaḥ ūrdhvam apratihata jñānāḥ adhara bhūmiṣu anāvṛta jñāna viṣayāḥ tṛtīye brahmaṇaḥ satya loke catvāraḥ deva nikāyāḥ akṛta bhavana nyāsāḥ sva pratiṣṭhā upari upari sthitāḥ pradhāna vaśinaḥ yāvat sarga āyuṣaḥ

tatra acyutāḥ sa vitarka dhyāna sukhāḥ śuddha nivāsāḥ sa vicāra dhyāna sukhāḥ satya ābhāḥ ānanda mātra dhyāna sukhāḥ saṃjñā saṃjñinaḥ ca asmitā mātra dhyāna sukhāḥ te api trailokya madhye pratitiṣṭhanti te ete sapta lokāḥ sarve eva brahma lokāḥ videha prakṛti layāḥ tu mokṣa pade vartante iti na loka madhye nyastāḥ iti etat yoginā sākṣātkaraṇīyam sūrya dvāre saṃyamam kṛtvā tatas anyatra api evam tāvat abhyaset yāvat idam sarvam dṛṣṭam iti
candre tārā vyūha jñānam candre saṃyamam kṛtvā tārāṇām vyūham vijānīyāt
dhruve tad gati jñānam tatas dhruve saṃyamam kṛtvā tārāṇām gatim vijānīyāt ūrdhva vimāneṣu kṛta saṃyamaḥ tāni vijānīyāt

nābhi cakre kāya vyūha jñānam nābhi cakre saṃyamam kṛtvā kāya vyūham vijānīyāt vāta pitta śleṣmāṇaḥ trayaḥ doṣāḥ dhātavaḥ sapta tvac lohita māṃsa snāyu asthi majjā śukrāṇi pūrvam pūrvam eṣām bāhyam iti eṣa vinyāsaḥ
kaṇṭha kūpe kṣudh pipāsā nivṛttiḥ jihvāyāḥ adhastāt tantuḥ tantoḥ adhastāt kaṇṭhaḥ tatas adhastāt kūpaḥ tatra saṃyamāt kṣudh pipāse na bādhete
kūrmanāḍyām sthairyam kūpāt adhas urasi kūrma ākārā nāḍī tasyām kṛta saṃyamaḥ sthira padam labhate yathā sarpaḥ godhā vā iti
mūrdha jyotiṣi siddha darśanam śiraḥ kapāle antar chidram prabhāsvaram jyotiḥ tatra saṃyamam kṛtvā siddhānām dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ antarāla cāriṇām darśanam
prātibhāt vā sarvam prātibham nāma tārakam tad viveka jasya jñānasya pūrva rūpam yathā udaye prabhā bhāskarasya tena vā sarvam eva jānāti yogī prātibhasya jñānasya utpattau iti
hṛdaye citta saṃvid yat idam asmin brahma pure daharam puṇḍarīkam veśma tatra vijñānam tasmin saṃyamāt citta saṃvid

sattva puruṣayoḥ atyanta asaṃkīrṇayoḥ pratyaya aviśeṣaḥ bhogaḥ parārthāt sva artha saṃyamāt puruṣa jñānam buddhi sattvam prakhyā śīlam samāna sattva upanibandhane rajaḥ tamasī vaśīkṛtya sattva puruṣa anya tā pratyayena pariṇatam tasmāt ca sattvāt pariṇāminaḥ atyanta vidharmā viśuddhaḥ anyaḥ citi mātra rūpaḥ puruṣaḥ tayoḥ atyanta asaṃkīrṇayoḥ pratyaya aviśeṣaḥ bhogaḥ puruṣasya darśita viṣaya tvāt sa bhoga pratyayaḥ sattvasya para artha tvāt dṛśyaḥ yaḥ tu tasmāt viśiṣṭaḥ citi mātra rūpaḥ anyaḥ pauruṣeyaḥ pratyayaḥ tatra saṃyamāt puruṣa viṣayā prajñā jāyate na ca puruṣa pratyayena buddhi sattva ātmanā puruṣaḥ dṛśyate puruṣaḥ eva tam pratyayam sva ātma avalambanam paśyati tathā hi uktam vijñātāram are kena vijānīyāt iti

tatas prātibha śrāvaṇa vedanā ādarśa āsvāda vārtāḥ jāyante prātibhāt sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭa atīta an āgata jñānam śrāvaṇāt divya śabda śravaṇam vedanāt divya sparśa adhigamaḥ ādarśāt divya rūpa saṃvid āsvādāt divya rasa saṃvid vārtātaḥ divya gandha vijñānam iti etāni nityam jāyante
te samādhau upasargāḥ vyutthāne siddhayaḥ te prātibha ādayaḥ samāhita cittasya utpadyamānāḥ upasargāḥ tad darśana pratyanīka tvāt vyutthita cittasya utpadyamānāḥ siddhayaḥ

bandha kāraṇa śaithilyāt pracāra saṃvedanāt ca cittasya para śarīra āveśaḥ lolībhūtasya manasaḥ apratiṣṭhasya śarīre karma āśaya vaśāt bandhaḥ pratiṣṭhā iti arthaḥ tasya karmaṇaḥ bandha kāraṇasya śaithilyam samādhi balāt bhavati pracāra saṃvedanam ca cittasya samādhi jam eva karma bandha kṣayāt sva cittasya pracāra saṃvedanāt ca yogī cittam sva śarīrāt niṣkṛṣya śarīra antareṣu nikṣipati nikṣiptam cittam ca indriyāṇi anu patanti yathā madhukara rājānam makṣikāḥ utpatantam anūtpatanti niviśamānam anu niviśante tathā indriyāṇi para śarīra āveśe cittam anu vidhīyante iti

udāna jayāt jala paṅka kaṇṭaka ādiṣu asaṅgaḥ utkrāntiḥ ca samasta indriya vṛttiḥ prāṇa ādi lakṣaṇā jīvanam tasya kriyā pañcatayī prāṇaḥ mukha nāsikā gatiḥ āhṛdaya vṛttiḥ samam nayanāt samānaḥ ca anābhivṛttiḥ apanayanāt apānaḥ āpāda tala vṛttiḥ unnayanāt udānaḥ āśiraḥ vṛttiḥ vyāpī vyānaḥ iti eṣām pradhānam prāṇaḥ udāna jayāt jala paṅka kaṇṭaka ādiṣu asaṅgaḥ utkrāntiḥ ca prāyaṇa kāle bhavati tām vaśi tvena pratipadyate
samāna jayāt jvalanam jita samānaḥ tejasaḥ upadhmānam kṛtvā jvalayati

śrotra ākāśayoḥ saṃbandha saṃyamāt divyam śrotram sarva śrotrāṇām ākāśam pratiṣṭhā sarva śabdānām ca yathā uktam tulya deśa śravaṇānām eka deśa śruti tvam sarveṣām bhavati iti tat ca etat ākāśasya liṅgam anāvaraṇam ca uktam tathā amūrtasya anāvaraṇa darśanāt vibhu tvam api prakhyātam ākāśasya śabda grahaṇa anumitam śrotram badhirābadhirayoḥ ekaḥ śabdam gṛhṇāti aparaḥ na gṛhṇāti iti tasmāt śrotram eva śabda viṣayam śrotra ākāśayoḥ saṃbandhe kṛta saṃyamasya yoginaḥ divyam śrotram pravartate

kāya ākāśayoḥ saṃbandha saṃyamāt laghu tūla samāpatteḥ ca ākāśa gamanam yatra kāyaḥ tatra ākāśam tasya avakāśa dānāt kāyasya tena saṃbandhaḥ prāptiḥ tatra kṛta saṃyamaḥ jitvā tad saṃbandham laghuṣu vā tūla ādiṣu ā paramāṇubhyaḥ samāpattim labdhvā jita saṃbandhaḥ laghuḥ bhavati laghu tvāt ca jale pādābhyām viharati tatas tu ūrṇanābhi tantu mātre vihṛtya raśmiṣu viharati tatas yatheṣṭam ākāśa gatiḥ asya bhavati iti

bahis akalpitā vṛttiḥ mahāvidehā tatas prakāśa āvaraṇa kṣayaḥ śarīrāt bahis manasaḥ vṛtti lābhaḥ videhā nāma dhāraṇā sā yadi śarīra pratiṣṭhasya manasaḥ bahis vṛtti mātreṇa bhavati sā kalpitā iti ucyate yā tu śarīra nirapekṣā bahis bhūtasya eva manasaḥ bahis vṛttiḥ sā khalu akalpitā tatra kalpitayā sādhayanti akalpitām mahā videhām iti yayā para śarīrāṇi āviśanti yoginaḥ tatas ca dhāraṇātaḥ prakāśa ātmanaḥ buddhi sattvasya yat āvaraṇam kleśa karma vipāka trayam rajaḥ tamaḥ mūlam tasya ca kṣayaḥ bhavati

sthūla svarūpa sūkṣma anvaya arthavattva saṃyamāt bhūta jayaḥ tatra pārthiva ādyāḥ śabda ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ saha ākāra ādibhiḥ dharmaiḥ sthūla śabdena paribhāṣitāḥ etat bhūtānām prathamam rūpam dvitīyam rūpam sva sāmānyam mūrtiḥ bhūmiḥ snehaḥ jalam vahniḥ uṣṇa tā vāyuḥ praṇāmī sarvatas gatiḥ ākāśaḥ iti etat svarūpa śabdena ucyate

asya sāmānyasya śabda ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ tathā ca uktam eka jāti samanvitānām eṣām dharma mātra vyāvṛttiḥ iti sāmānya viśeṣa samudāyaḥ atra dravyam dviṣṭhaḥ hi samūhaḥ pratyastamita bheda avayava anugataḥ śarīram vṛkṣaḥ yūtham vanam iti śabdena upātta bheda avayava anugataḥ samūhaḥ ubhaye deva manuṣyāḥ samūhasya devāḥ ekaḥ bhāgaḥ manuṣyāḥ dvitīyaḥ bhāgaḥ tābhyām eva abhidhīyate samūhaḥ

sa ca bheda abheda vivakṣitaḥ āmrāṇām vanam brāhmaṇānām saṃghaḥ āmravaṇam brāhmaṇa saṃghaḥ iti sa punar dvividhaḥ yutasiddha avayavaḥ ayutasiddha avayavaḥ ca yutasiddha avayavaḥ samūhaḥ vanam saṃghaḥ iti ayutasiddha avayavaḥ saṃghātaḥ śarīram vṛkṣaḥ paramāṇuḥ iti ayutasiddha avayava bheda anugataḥ samūhaḥ dravyam iti patañjaliḥ etat svarūpam iti uktam

atha kim eṣām sūkṣma rūpam tanmātram bhūta kāraṇam tasya ekaḥ avayavaḥ paramāṇuḥ sāmānya viśeṣa ātma ayuta siddha avayava bheda anugataḥ samudāyaḥ iti evam sarva tanmātrāṇi etat tṛtīyam atha bhūtānām caturtham rūpam khyāti kriyā sthiti śīlāḥ guṇāḥ kārya svabhāva anupātinaḥ anvaya śabdena uktāḥ atha eṣām pañcamam rūpam arthavat tvam bhoga apavarga artha tā guṇeṣu eva anvayinī guṇāḥ tanmātra bhūta bhautikeṣu iti sarvam arthavat teṣu idānīm bhūteṣu pañcasu pañca rūpeṣu saṃyamāt tasya tasya rūpasya svarūpa darśanam jayaḥ ca prādurbhavati tatra pañca bhūta svarūpāṇi jitvā bhūta jayī bhavati tad jayād vatsa anusāriṇyaḥ iva gāvaḥ asya saṃkalpa anuvidhāyinyaḥ bhūta prakṛtayaḥ bhavanti

tatas aṇima ādi prādurbhāvaḥ kāya saṃpad tad dharmānabhighātaḥ ca tatra aṇimā bhavati aṇuḥ laghimā laghuḥ bhavati mahimā mahān bhavati prāptiḥ aṅgulī agreṇa api spṛśati candramasam prākāmyam icchā anabhighātaḥ bhūmau unmajjati nimajjati yathā udake vaśitvam bhūta bhautikeṣu vaśī bhavati avaśyaḥ ca anyeṣām īśitṛ tvam teṣām prabhava apyaya vyūhānām īṣṭe yatra kāmāvasāyi tvam satya saṃkalpa tā yathā saṃkalpaḥ tathā bhūta prakṛtīnām avasthānam na ca śaktaḥ api padārtha viparyāsam karoti kasmāt anyasya yatra kāma avasāyinaḥ pūrva siddhasya tathā bhūteṣu saṃkalpāt iti etāni aṣṭau aiśvaryāṇi kāya saṃpad vakṣyamāṇā tad dharmānabhighātaḥ ca pṛthvī mūrtyā na niruṇaddhi yoginaḥ śarīra ādi kriyām śilām api anuviśati iti na apaḥ snigdhāḥ kledayanti na agniḥ uṣṇaḥ dahati na vāyuḥ praṇāmī vahati anāvaraṇa ātmake api ākāśe bhavati āvṛta kāyaḥ siddhānām api adṛśyaḥ bhavati
rūpa lāvaṇya bala vajra saṃhanana tvāni kāya saṃpad darśanīyaḥ kāntimān atiśaya balaḥ vajra saṃhananaḥ ca iti

grahaṇa svarūpa asmita anvaya arthavattva saṃyamāt indriya jayaḥ sāmānya viśeṣa ātmā śabda ādiḥ grāhyaḥ teṣu indriyāṇām vṛttiḥ grahaṇam na ca tad sāmānya mātra grahaṇa ākāram katham anālocitaḥ sa viṣaya viśeṣaḥ indriyeṇa manasā anuvyavasīyeta iti svarūpam punar prakāśa ātmanaḥ buddhi sattvasya sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ ayutasiddha avayava bheda anugataḥ samūhaḥ dravyam indriyam teṣām tṛtīyam rūpam asmitā lakṣaṇaḥ ahaṃkāraḥ tasya sāmānyasya indriyāṇi viśeṣāḥ caturtham rūpam vyavasāya ātmakāḥ prakāśa kriyā sthiti śīlāḥ guṇāḥ yeṣām indriyāṇi sa ahaṃkārāṇi pariṇāmaḥ pañcamam rūpam guṇeṣu yat anugatam puruṣa arthavat tvam iti pañcasu eteṣu indriya rūpeṣu yathākramam saṃyamaḥ tatra tatra jayam kṛtvā pañca rūpa jayāt indriya jayaḥ prādurbhavati yoginaḥ

tatas manojavi tvam vikaraṇa bhāvaḥ pradhāna jayaḥ ca kāyasya anuttamaḥ gati lābhaḥ manojavi tvam videhānām indriyāṇām abhipreta deśa kāla viṣaya apekṣaḥ vṛtti lābhaḥ vikaraṇa bhāvaḥ sarva prakṛti vikāra vaśi tvam pradhāna jayaḥ iti etāḥ tisraḥ siddhayaḥ madhupratīkāḥ ucyante etāḥ ca karaṇa pañca rūpa jayāt adhigamyante

sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātrasya sarva bhāva adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam sarvajñātṛ tvam ca nirdhūta rajaḥ tamaḥ malasya buddhi sattvasya pare vaiśāradye parasyām vaśīkāra saṃjñāyām vartamānasya sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātra rūpa pratiṣṭhasya sarva bhāva adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam sarva ātmānaḥ guṇāḥ vyavasāya vyavaseya ātmakāḥ svāminam kṣetrajñam pratyaśeṣa dṛśya ātma tvena upasthitāḥ iti arthaḥ sarvajñātṛ tvam sarva ātmanām guṇānām śānta udita avyapadeśya dharma tvena vyavasthitānām akrama upārūḍham viveka jam jñānam iti arthaḥ iti eṣā viśokā nāma siddhiḥ yām prāpya yogī sarvajñaḥ kṣīṇa kleśa bandhanaḥ vaśī viharati

tad vairāgyāt api doṣa bīja kṣaye kaivalyam yadā asya evam bhavati kleśa karma kṣaye sattvasya ayam viveka pratyayaḥ dharmaḥ sattvam ca heya pakṣe nyastam puruṣaḥ ca apariṇā amī śuddhaḥ anyaḥ sattvāt iti evam asya tatas virajyamānasya yāni kleśa bījāni dagdha śāli bīja kalpāni aprasava samarthāni tāni saha manasā pratyastam gacchanti teṣu pralīneṣu puruṣaḥ punar idam tāpa trayam na bhuṅkte tat eteṣām guṇānām manasi karma kleśa vipāka svarūpeṇa abhivyaktānām carita arthānām pratiprasave puruṣasya ātyantikaḥ guṇa viyogaḥ kaivalyam tadā svarūpa pratiṣṭhā citi śaktiḥ eva puruṣaḥ iti

sthāni upanimantraṇe saṅga smayā karaṇam punar aniṣṭa prasaṅgāt catvāraḥ khalu amī yoginaḥ prāthamakalpikaḥ madhu bhūmikaḥ prajñā jyotiḥ atikrānta bhāvanīyaḥ ca iti tatra abhyāsī pravṛtta mātra jyotiḥ prathamaḥ ṛtaṃbhara prajñaḥ dvitīyaḥ bhūta indriya jayī tṛtīyaḥ sarveṣu bhāviteṣu bhāvanīyeṣu kṛta rakṣā bandhaḥ kartavya sādhanāt imān caturthaḥ yaḥ tu atikrānta bhāvanīyaḥ tasya citta pratisargaḥ ekaḥ arthaḥ saptavidhā asya prānta bhūmi prajñā

tatra madhumatīm bhūmim sākṣāt kurvataḥ brāhmaṇasya sthāninaḥ devāḥ sattva viśuddhim anupaśyantaḥ sthānaiḥ upanimantrayante bho iha āsyatām iha ramyatām kamanīyaḥ ayam bhogaḥ kamanīyā iyam kanyā rasāyanam idam jarā mṛtyum bādhate vaihāyasam idam yānam amī kalpadrumāḥ puṇyā mandākinī siddhā mahā ṛṣayaḥ uttamā anukūlāḥ apsarasaḥ divye śrotra cakṣuṣī vajra upamaḥ kāyaḥ sva guṇaiḥ sarvam idam upārjitam āyuṣmatā pratipadyatām idam akṣayam ajaram amara sthānam devānām priyam iti evam abhidhīyamānaḥ saṅga doṣān bhāvayet ghoreṣu saṃsāra aṅgāreṣu pacyamānena mayā janana maraṇa andhakāre viparivartamānena kathaṃcid āsāditaḥ kleśa timira vināśī yoga pradīpaḥ tasya ca ete tṛṣṇā ya ūnayaḥ viṣaya vāyavaḥ pratipakṣāḥ sa khalu aham labdha ālokaḥ katham anayā viṣaya mṛga tṛṣṇayā vañcitaḥ tasya eva punar pradīptasya saṃsāra agneḥ ātmānam indhanīkuryām iti svasti vaḥ svapna upamebhyaḥ kṛpaṇa jana prārthanīyebhyaḥ viṣayebhyaḥ iti evam niścita matiḥ samādhim bhāvayet

saṅgam akṛtvā smayam api na kuryāt evam aham devānām api prārthanīyaḥ iti smayāt ayam susthitaṃmanyatayā mṛtyunā keśeṣu gṛhītam iva ātmānam na bhāvayiṣyati tathā ca asya cchidra antara prekṣī nityam yatna upacaryaḥ pramādaḥ labdha vivaraḥ kleśān uttambhayiṣyati tatas punar aniṣṭa prasaṅgaḥ evam asya saṅgasmayau akurvataḥ bhāvitaḥ arthaḥ dṛḍhībhaviṣyati bhāvanīyaḥ ca arthaḥ abhimukhībhaviṣyati iti

kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ saṃyamāt viveka jam jñānam yathā apakarṣa paryantam dravyam paramāṇuḥ evam parama apakarṣa paryantaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ yāvatā vā samayena calitaḥ paramāṇuḥ pūrva deśam jahyāt uttara deśam upasaṃpadyeta sa kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ tad pravāha avicchedaḥ tu kramaḥ kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ na asti vastu samāhāraḥ iti buddhi samāhāraḥ muhūrta ahorātra ādayaḥ sa khalu ayam kālaḥ vastu śūnyaḥ api buddhi nirmāṇaḥ śabda jñāna anupātī laukikānām vyutthita darśanānām vastu svarūpaḥ iva avabhāsate

kṣaṇaḥ tu vastu patitaḥ krama avalambī kramaḥ ca kṣaṇa anantari ātmā tam kāla vidaḥ kālaḥ iti ācakṣate yoginaḥ na ca dvau kṣaṇau saha bhavataḥ kramaḥ ca na dvayoḥ saha bhuvoḥ asaṃbhavāt pūrvasmāt uttara bhāvinaḥ yat ā ānantaryam kṣaṇasya sa kramaḥ tasmāt vartamānaḥ eva ekaḥ kṣaṇaḥ na pūrva uttara kṣaṇāḥ santi iti tasmāt na asti tad samāhāraḥ ye tu bhūta bhāvinaḥ kṣaṇāḥ te pariṇāma anvitā vyākhyeyāḥ tena ekena kṣaṇena kṛtsnaḥ lokaḥ pariṇāmam anubhavati tad kṣaṇa upārūḍhāḥ khalu amī sarve dharmāḥ tayoḥ kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ saṃyamāt tayoḥ sākṣātkaraṇam tatas ca viveka jam jñānam prādurbhavati tasya viṣaya viśeṣaḥ upakṣipyate

jāti lakṣaṇa deśaiḥ anyatā anavacchedāt tulyayoḥ tatas pratipattiḥ tulyayoḥ deśa lakṣaṇa sārūpye jāti bhedaḥ anya tāyāḥ hetuḥ gauḥ iyam baḍaveyam iti tulya deśa jātīya tve lakṣaṇam anya tva karam kālākṣī gauḥ svastimatī gauḥ iti dvayoḥ āmalakayoḥ jāti lakṣaṇa sārūpyāt deśa bhedaḥ anya tva karaḥ idam pūrvam idam uttaram iti yadā tu pūrvam āmalakam anya vyagrasya jñātuḥ uttara deśaḥ upāvartyate tadā tulya deśa tve pūrvam etat uttaram etat iti pravibhāga anupapattiḥ asaṃdigdhena ca tattva jñānena bhavitavyam iti atas idam uktam tatas pratipattiḥ viveka ja jñānāt iti

katham pūrva āmalaka sahakṣaṇaḥ deśaḥ uttara āmalaka sahakṣaṇāt deśāt bhinnaḥ te ca āmalake sva deśa kṣaṇa anubhava bhinne anya deśa kṣaṇa anubhavaḥ tu tayoḥ anya tve hetuḥ iti etena dṛṣṭāntena paramāṇoḥ tulya jāti lakṣaṇa deśasya pūrva paramāṇu deśa sahakṣaṇa sākṣāt karaṇāt uttarasya paramāṇoḥ tad deśānupapattau uttarasya tad deśa anubhavaḥ bhinnaḥ sa hakṣaṇa bhedāt tayoḥ īśvarasya yoginaḥ anya tva pratyayaḥ bhavati iti apare tu varṇayanti ye antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ te anya tā pratyayam kurvanti iti tatra api deśa lakṣaṇa bhedaḥ mūrti vyavadhi jāti bhedaḥ ca anya tve hetuḥ kṣaṇa bhedaḥ tu yogi buddhi gamyaḥ eva iti atas uktam mūrti vyavadhi jāti bheda abhāvāt na asti mūlapṛthaktvam iti vārṣagaṇyaḥ

tārakam sarva viṣayam sarvathā viṣayam akramam ca iti viveka jam jñānam tārakam iti sva pratibhā uttham anaupadeśikam iti arthaḥ sarva viṣayam na asya kiṃcid aviṣayībhūtam iti arthaḥ sarvathā viṣayam atīta anāgata pratyutpannam sarvam paryāyaiḥ sarvathā jānāti iti arthaḥ akramam iti eka kṣaṇa upārūḍham sarvam sarvathā gṛhṇāti iti arthaḥ etat viveka jam jñānam paripūrṇam asya eva aṃśaḥ yoga pradīpaḥ madhumatīm bhūmim upādāya yāvat asya parisamāptiḥ iti prāpta viveka ja jñānasya aprāpta viveka ja jñānasya vā

sattva puruṣayoḥ śuddhi sāmye kaivalyam iti yadā nirdhūta rajaḥ tamaḥ malam buddhi sattvam puruṣasya anya tā pratīti mātra adhikāram dagdha kleśa bījam bhavati tadā puruṣasya śuddhi sārūpyam iva āpannam bhavati tadā puruṣasya upacarita bhoga abhāvaḥ śuddhiḥ etasyām avasthāyām kaivalyam bhavati īśvarasya anīśvarasya vā viveka ja jñāna bhāginaḥ itarasya vā na hi dagdha kleśa bījasya jñāne punar apekṣā kācid asti sattva śuddhi dvāreṇa etat samādhi jam aiśvaryam jñānam ca upakrāntam paramārthataḥ tu jñānāt adarśanam nivartate tasmin nivṛtte na santi uttare kleśāḥ kleśa abhāvāt karma vipāka abhāvaḥ carita adhikārāḥ ca etasyām avasthāyām guṇāḥ na puruṣasya punar dṛśya tvena upatiṣṭhante tatpuruṣasya kaivalyam tadā puruṣaḥ sva rūpa mātra jyotiḥ amalaḥ kevalī bhavati

janma auṣadhi mantra tapaḥ samādhi jāḥ siddhayaḥ deha antaritā janmanā siddhiḥ oṣadhibhiḥ asura bhavaneṣu rasāyanena iti evamādiḥ mantraiḥ ākāśa gamana aṇima ādi lābhaḥ tapasā saṃkalpa siddhiḥ kāmarūpī yatra tatra kāma gaḥ iti evamādi samādhi jāḥ siddhayaḥ vyākhyātāḥ tatra kāya indriyāṇām anya jātīya pariṇatānām

jāti antara pariṇāmaḥ prakṛti āpūrāt pūrva pariṇāma apāyaḥ uttara pariṇāma upajanaḥ teṣām apūrva avayava anupraveśāt bhavati kāya indriya prakṛtayaḥ ca svam svam vikāram anugṛhṇanti āpūreṇa dharma ādi nimittam apekṣamāṇāḥ iti

nimittam aprayojakam prakṛtīnām varaṇa bhedaḥ tu tatas kṣetrika vat na hi dharma ādi nimittam tad prayojakam prakṛtīnām bhavati na kāryeṇa kāraṇam pravartyate iti katham tarhi varaṇa bhedaḥ tu tatas kṣetrika vat yathā kṣetrikaḥ kedārāt apām pūrṇāt kedāra antaram piplāvayiṣuḥ samam nimnam nimnataram vā na apaḥ pāṇinā apakarṣati āvaraṇam tu āsām bhinatti tasmin bhinne svayam eva apaḥ kedāra antaram āplāvayanti tathā dharmaḥ prakṛtīnām āvaraṇa dharmam bhinatti tasmin bhinne svayam eva prakṛtayaḥ svam svam vikāram āplāvayanti yathā vā saḥ eva kṣetrikaḥ tasmin eva kedāre na prabhavati audakān bhaumān vā rasān dhānya mūlāni anupraveśayitum kim tarhi mudga gavedhu ka śyāmāka ādīn tatas apakarṣati apakṛṣṭeṣu teṣu svayam eva rasāḥ dhānya mūlāni anupraviśanti tathā dharmaḥ nivṛtti mātre kāraṇam adharmasya śuddhi aśuddhyoḥ atyanta virodhāt na tu prakṛti pravṛttau dharmaḥ hetuḥ bhavati iti atra nandīśvara ādayaḥ udāhāryāḥ viparyayeṇa api adharmaḥ dharmam bādhate tatas ca aśuddhi pariṇāmaḥ iti tatra api nahuṣa ajagara ādayaḥ udāhāryāḥ yadā tu yogī bahūn kāyāt nirmimīte tadā kim eka manaskāḥ te bhavanti atha aneka manaskāḥ iti
nirmāṇa cittāni asmitā mātrāt asmitā mātram citta kāraṇam upādāya nirmāṇa cittāni karoti tatas sa cittāni bhavanti iti
pravṛtti bhede prayojakam cittam ekam anekeṣām bahūnām cittānām katham ekacitta abhiprāya puraḥsarā pravṛttiḥ iti sarva cittānām prayojakam cittam ekaṭ nirmimīte tatas pravṛtti bhedaḥ

tatra dhyāna jam anāśayam pañcavidham nirmāṇa cittam janma auṣadhi mantra tapaḥ samādhi jāḥ siddhayaḥ iti tatra yat eva dhyāna jam cittam tat eva anāśayam tasya eva na asti āśayaḥ rāga ādi pravṛttiḥ na atas puṇya pāpa abhisaṃbandhaḥ kṣīṇa kleśa tvāt yoginaḥ iti itareṣām tu vidyate karma āśayaḥ yatas

karma aśukla akṛṣṇam yoginaḥ trividham itareṣām catuṣpadī khalu iyam karma jātiḥ kṛṣṇā śukla kṛṣṇā śukla aśukla akṛṣṇā ca iti tatra kṛṣṇā durātmanām śukla kṛṣṇā bahis sādhana sādhyā tatra para pīḍā anugraha dvāreṇa eva karma āśaya pracayaḥ śuklā tapaḥ svādhyāya dhyānavatām sā hi kevale manasi āyatta tvāt abahiḥ sādhana adhīnā na parān pīḍayitvā bhavati aśukla akṛṣṇā saṃnyāsinām kṣīṇa kleśānām carama dehānām iti tatra āśuklam yoginaḥ eva phala saṃnyāsāt akṛṣṇam ca anupādānāt itareṣām tu bhūtānām pūrvam eva trividham iti

tatas tad vipāka anuguṇānām eva abhivyaktiḥ vāsanānām tatas iti trividhāt karmaṇaḥ tad vipāka anuguṇānām eva iti yat jātīyasya karmaṇaḥ yaḥ vipākaḥ tasya anuguṇāḥ yāḥ vāsanāḥ karma vipākam anuśerate tāsām eva abhivyaktiḥ na hi daivam karma vipacyamānam nāraka tiryak manuṣya vāsanā abhivyakti nimittam saṃbhavati kiṃtu daiva anuguṇāḥ eva asya vāsanāḥ vyajyante nāraka tiryak manuṣyeṣu ca evam samānaḥ carcaḥ

jāti deśa kāla vyavahitānām api ānantaryam smṛti saṃskārayoḥ eka rūpa tvāt vṛṣadaṃśa vipāka udayaḥ sva vyañjaka añjana abhivyaktaḥ sa yadi jāti śatena vā dūra deśa tayā vā kalpa śatena vā vyavahitaḥ punar ca sva vyañjaka añjanaḥ eva udiyāt drāk iti evam pūrva anubhūta vṛṣa daṃśa vipāka abhisaṃskṛtāḥ vāsanā upādāya vyajyeta kasmāt yatas vyavahitānām api āsām sadṛśam karma abhivyajñakam nimittībhūtam iti ānantaryam eva kutas ca smṛti saṃskārayoḥ eka rūpa tvāt yathā anubhavāḥ tathā saṃskārāḥ te ca karma vāsanā anurūpāḥ yathā ca vāsanāḥ tathā smṛtiḥ iti jāti deśa kāla vyavahitebhyaḥ saṃskārebhyaḥ smṛtiḥ smṛteḥ ca punar saṃskārāḥ iti evam ete smṛti saṃskārāḥ karma āśaya vṛtti lābha vaśād vyajyante atas ca vyavahitānām api nimitta naimittika bhāva anucchedāt ānantaryam eva siddham iti

tāsām anādi tvam ca āśiṣaḥ nitya tvāt tāsām vāsanānām āśiṣaḥ nitya tvāt anādi tvam yā iyam ātma āśīḥ mā na bhūvam bhūyāsam iti sarvasya dṛśyate sā na svābhāvikī kasmāt jāta mātrasya jantoḥ ananubhūta maraṇa dharmakasya dveṣa duḥkha anusmṛti nimittaḥ maraṇa trāsaḥ katham bhavet na ca svābhāvikam vastu nimittam upādatte tasmāt anādi vāsanā anuviddham idam cittam nimitta vaśāt kāścid eva vāsanāḥ pratilabhya puruṣasya bhogāya upāvartate iti ghaṭa prāsāda pradīpa kalpam saṃkoca vikāsi cittam śarīra parimāṇa ākāra mātram iti apare pratipannāḥ tathā ca antara abhāvaḥ saṃsāraḥ ca yuktaḥ iti

vṛttiḥ eva asya vibhunaḥ cittasya saṃkoca vikāsinī iti ācāryaḥ tat ca dharma ādi nimitta apekṣam nimittam ca dvividham bāhyam ādhyātmikam ca śarīra ādi sādhana apekṣam bāhyam stuti dāna abhivādana ādi citta mātra adhīnam śraddhā ādi adhyātmikam tathā ca uktam ye ca ete maitrī ādayaḥ dhyāyinām vihārāḥ te bāhya sādhana niranugraha ātmānaḥ prakṛṣṭam dharmam abhinirvartayanti tayoḥ mānasam balīyaḥ katham jñāna vairāgye kena atiśayyete daṇḍaka araṇyam ca citta bala vyatirekeṇa śārīreṇa karmaṇā śūnyam kaḥ kartum utsaheta samudram agastya vat vā pibet

hetu phala āśraya ālambanaiḥ saṃgṛhīta tvāt eṣām abhāve tad abhāvaḥ hetuḥ dharmāt sukham adharmāt duḥkham sukhāt rāgaḥ duḥkhāt dveṣaḥ tatas ca prayatnaḥ tena manasā vācā kāyena vā parispandamānaḥ param anugṛhṇāti upahanti vā tatas punar dharma adharmau sukha duḥkhe rāga dveṣau iti pravṛttam idam ṣaṣ aram saṃsāra cakram asya ca pratikṣaṇam āvartamānasya avidyā netrī mūlam sarva kleśānām iti eṣa hetuḥ phalam tu yam āśritya yasya pratyutpanna tā dharma ādeḥ na hi apūrva upajanaḥ manaḥ tu sādhikāram āśrayaḥ vāsanānām na hi avasita adhikāre manasi nirāśrayāḥ vāsanāḥ sthātum utsahante yat abhimukhībhūtam vastu yām vāsanām vyanakti tasyāḥ tad ālambanam evam hetu phala āśraya ālambanaiḥ etaiḥ saṃgṛhītāḥ sarvāḥ vāsanāḥ eṣām abhāve tad saṃśrayāṇām api vāsanānām abhāvaḥ na asti asataḥ saṃbhavaḥ na ca asti sataḥ vināśaḥ iti dravya tvena saṃbhavantyaḥ katham nivartiṣyante vāsanāḥ iti

atīta anāgatam svarūpataḥ asti adhva bhedāt dharmāṇām bhaviṣyat vyaktikam anāgatam anubhūta vyaktikam atītam sva vyāpāra upārūḍham vartamānam trayam ca etat vastu jñānasya jñeyam yadi ca etat svarūpataḥ na abhaviṣyat na idam nirviṣayam jñānam udapatsyata tasmāt atīta anāgatam svarūpataḥ asti iti kiṃca bhoga bhāgīyasya vā apavarga bhāgīyasya vā karmaṇaḥ phalam utpitsu yadi nirupākhyam iti tad uddeśena tena nimittena kuśala anuṣṭhānam na yujyeta sataḥ ca phalasya nimittam vartamānīkaraṇe samartham na apūrva upajanane siddham nimittam naimittikasya viśeṣa anugrahaṇam kurute na apūrvam utpādayati iti

dharmī ca aneka dharma svabhāvaḥ tasya ca adhva bhedena dharmāḥ pratyavasthitāḥ na ca yathā vartamānam vyakti viśeṣa āpannam dravyataḥ asti evam atītam anāgatam ca katham tarhi svena eva vyaṅgyena svarūpeṇa anāgatam asti svena ca anubhūta vyaktikena sva rūpeṇa atītam iti vartamānasya eva adhvanaḥ sva rūpa vyaktiḥ iti na sā bhavati atīta anāgatayoḥ adhvanoḥ ekasya ca adhvanaḥ samaye dvau adhvanau dharmi samanvāgatau bhavataḥ eva iti na abhūtvā bhāvaḥ trayāṇām adhvanām iti

te vyakta sūkṣmā guṇa ātmānaḥ te khalu amī tri adhvanaḥ dharmāḥ vartamānāḥ vyakta ātmānaḥ atīta anāgatāḥ sūkṣma ātmānaḥ ṣaṣ aviśeṣa rūpāḥ sarvam idam guṇānām saṃniveśa viśeṣa mātram iti paramārthataḥ guṇa ātmānaḥ tathā ca śāstra anuśāsanam guṇānām paramam rūpam na dṛṣṭi patham ṛcchati yat tu dṛṣṭi patham prāptam tat māyā iva su tucchakam iti yadā tu sarve guṇāḥ katham ekaḥ śabdaḥ ekam indriyam iti

pariṇāma eka tvāt vastu tattvam prakhyā kriyā sthiti śīlānām guṇānām grahaṇa ātmakānām karaṇa bhāvena ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ śrotram indriyam grāhya ātmakānām śabda tanmātra bhāvena ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ śabdaḥ viṣayaḥ iti śabda ādīnām mūrti samāna jātīyānām ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ pṛthivī paramāṇuḥ tanmātra avayavaḥ teṣām ca ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ pṛthivī gauḥ vṛkṣaḥ parvataḥ iti evamādiḥ bhūta antareṣu api sneha auṣṇya praṇāmi tva avakāśa dānāni upādāya sāmānyam eka vikāra ārambhaḥ samādheyaḥ

na asti arthaḥ vijñāna visaha caraḥ asti tu jñānam artha visahacaram svapna ādau kalpitam iti anayā diśāḥ ye vastu svarūpam apahnuvate jñāna parikalpanā mātram vastu svapna viṣaya upamam na paramārthataḥ asti iti yaḥ āhuḥ te tathā iti pratyupasthitam idam sva māhātmyena vastu katham apramāṇa ātmakena vikalpa jñāna balena vastu svarūpam utsṛjya tat eva apalapantaḥ śraddheya vacanāḥ syuḥ kutas ca etat anyāyyam

vastu sāmye citta bhedāt tayoḥ vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ bahu citta ālambanībhūtam ekam vastu sādhāraṇam tat khalu na eka citta parikalpitam na api aneka citta parikalpitam kiṃtu sva pratiṣṭham katham vastu sāmye citta bhedāt dharma apekṣam cittasya vastu sāmye api sukha jñānam bhavati adharma apekṣam tatas eva duḥkha jñānam avidyā apekṣam tatas eva mūḍha jñānam samyak darśana apekṣam tatas eva mādhyasthya jñānam iti kasya tat cittena parikalpitam na ca anya citta parikalpitena arthena anyasya citta uparāgaḥ yuktaḥ tasmāt vastu jñānayoḥ grāhya grahaṇa bheda bhinnayoḥ vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ na anayoḥ saṃkara gandhaḥ api asti iti

sāṃkhya pakṣe punar vastu triguṇam calam ca guṇa vṛttam iti dharma ādi nimitta apekṣam cittaiḥ abhisaṃbadhyate nimitta anurūpasya ca pratyayasya utpadyamānasya tena tena ātmanā hetuḥ bhavati kecid āhuḥ jñāna saha bhūḥ eva arthaḥ bhogya tvāt sukha ādi vat iti te etayā dvārā sādhāraṇa tvam bādhamānāḥ pūrva uttara kṣaṇeṣu vastu rūpam eva apahnuvate

na ca ekacitta tantram vastu tat apramāṇakam tadā kim syāt ekacitta tantram ced vastu syāt tadā citte vyagre niruddhe vā asvarūpam eva tena aparāmṛṣṭam anyasya aviṣayībhūtam apramāṇakam agṛhīta svabhāvakam kenacid tadānīm kim tat syāt saṃbadhyamānam ca punar cittena kutas utpadyeta ye ca asya anupasthitāḥ bhāgāḥ te ca asya na syuḥ evam na asti pṛṣṭham iti udaram api na gṛhyeta tasmāt svatantraḥ arthaḥ sarva puruṣa sādhāraṇaḥ svatantrāṇi ca cittāni prati puruṣam pravartante tayoḥ saṃbandhāt upalabdhiḥ puruṣasya bhogaḥ iti

tad uparāga apekṣi tvāt cittasya vastu jñāta ajñātam ayaskānta maṇi kalpāḥ viṣayāḥ ayaḥ sadharmakam cittam abhisaṃbandhya uparañjayanti yena ca viṣayeṇa uparaktam cittam sa viṣayaḥ jñātaḥ tatas anyaḥ punar ajñātaḥ vastunaḥ jñāta ajñāta svarūpa tvāt pariṇāmi cittam yasya tu tat eva cittam viṣayaḥ tasya

sadā jñātāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ tad prabhoḥ puruṣasya apariṇāmi tvāt yadi citta vat prabhuḥ api puruṣaḥ pariṇamet tatas tad viṣayāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ śabda ādi viṣaya vat jñāta ajñātāḥ syuḥ sadā ajñāta tvam tu manasaḥ tad prabhoḥ puruṣasya apariṇāmi tvam anumāpayati syāt āśaṅkā cittam eva su ābhāsam viṣaya ābhāsam ca bhaviṣyati iti agni vat

na tat su ābhāsam dṛśya tvāt yathā itarāṇi indriyāṇi śabda ādayaḥ ca dṛśya tvāt na su ābhāsāni tathā manaḥ api pratyetavyam na ca agniḥ atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ na hi agniḥ ātma svarūpam aprakāśam prakāśayati prakāśaḥ ca ayam prakāśya prakāśaka saṃyoge dṛṣṭaḥ na ca sva rūpa mātre asti saṃyogaḥ kiṃca su ābhāsam cittam iti agrāhyam eva kasyacid iti śabda arthaḥ tat yathā sva ātma pratiṣṭham ākāśam na para pratiṣṭham iti arthaḥ sva buddhi pracāra pratisaṃvedanāt sattvānām pravṛttiḥ dṛśyate kruddhaḥ aham bhītaḥ aham amutra me rāgaḥ amutra me krodhaḥ iti etat sva buddheḥ agrahaṇe na yuktam iti

eka samaye ca ubhaya anavadhāraṇam na ca ekasmin kṣaṇe sva para rūpa avadhāraṇam yuktam kṣaṇika vādinaḥ yat bhavanam sā eva kriyā tat eva ca kārakam iti abhyupagamaḥ syāt matiḥ svarasa niruddham cittam citta antareṇa samanantareṇa gṛhyate iti

citta antara dṛśye buddhi buddheḥ atiprasaṅgaḥ smṛti saṃkaraḥ ca atha cittam ced citta antareṇa gṛhyeta buddhi buddhiḥ kena gṛhyate sā api anyayā sā api anyayā iti atiprasaṅgaḥ smṛti saṃkaraḥ ca yāvantaḥ buddhi buddhīnām anubhavāḥ tāvatyaḥ smṛtayaḥ prāpnuvanti tad saṃkarāt ca eka smṛti anavadhāraṇam ca syāt iti evam buddhi pratisaṃvedinam puruṣam apalapadbhiḥ vaināśikaiḥ sarvam eva ākulīkṛtam te tu bhoktṛ svarūpam yatra kvacana kalpayantaḥ na nyāyena saṃgacchante kecid tu sattva mātram api parikalpya asti sa sattvaḥ yaḥ etān pañca skandhān nikṣipya anyān ca pratisaṃdadhāti iti uktvā tatas eva punar trasyanti tathā skandhānām mahat nirvedāya virāgāya anutpādāya praśāntaye guroḥ antike brahmacaryam cariṣyāmi iti uktvā sattvasya punar sattvam eva apahnuvate sāṃkhya yoga ādayaḥ tu pravādāḥ sva śabdena puruṣam eva svāminam cittasya bhoktāram upayanti iti katham

citeḥ apratisaṃkramāyāḥ tad ākāra āpattau sva buddhi saṃvedanam apariṇāminī hi bhoktṛ śaktiḥ apratisaṃkramā ca pariṇāmini arthe pratisaṃkrāntā iva tad vṛttim anupatati tasyāḥ ca prāpta caitanya upagraha svarūpāyāḥ buddhi vṛtteḥ anukāri mātra tayā buddhi vṛtti aviśiṣṭā hi jñāna vṛttiḥ ākhyāyate tathā ca uktam na pātālam na ca vivaram girīṇām na eva andhakāram kukṣayaḥ na udadhīnām guhā yasyām nihitam brahma śāśvatam buddhi vṛttim aviśiṣṭām kavayaḥ vedayante iti atas ca etat abhyupagamyate

draṣṭṛ dṛśya uparaktam cittam sarva artham manaḥ hi mantavyena arthena uparaktam tat svayam ca viṣaya tvāt viṣayiṇā puruṣeṇa ātmīyayā vṛttyā abhisaṃbaddham tat etat cittam eva draṣṭṛ dṛśya uparaktam viṣaya viṣayi nirbhāsam cetana acetana svarūpa āpannam viṣaya ātmakam api aviṣaya ātmakam iva acetanam cetanam iva sphaṭika maṇi kalpam sarva artham iti ucyate

tat anena citta sārūpyeṇa bhrāntāḥ kecid tat eva cetanam iti āhuḥ apare cittamātram eva idam sarvam na asti khalu ayam gavādiḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ ca sa kāraṇaḥ lokaḥ iti anukampanīyāḥ te kasmāt asti hi teṣām bhrānti bījam sarva rūpa ākāra nirbhāsam cittam iti samādhi prajñāyām prajñeyaḥ arthaḥ pratibimbībhūtaḥ tasya ālambanībhūta tvāt anyaḥ sa ced arthaḥ cittamātram syāt katham prajñayā eva prajñā rūpam avadhāryeta tasmāt pratibimbībhūtaḥ arthaḥ prajñāyām yena avadhāryate sa puruṣaḥ iti evam grahītṛ grahaṇa grāhya svarūpa citta bhedāt trayam api etat jātitaḥ pravibhajante te samyak darśinaḥ taiḥ adhigataḥ puruṣaḥ kutas ca

tat asaṃkhyeya vāsanābhiḥ citram api para artham saṃhatyakāri tvāt tat etat cittam asaṃkhyeyābhiḥ vāsanābhiḥ eva citrīkṛtam api para artham parasya bhoga apavarga artham na sva artham saṃhatyakāri tvāt gṛha vat saṃhatya kāriṇā cittena na sva arthena bhavitavyam na sukha cittam sukha artham na jñānam jñāna artham ubhayam api etat para artham yaḥ ca bhogena apavargeṇa ca arthena arthavān puruṣaḥ saḥ eva paraḥ na paraḥ sāmānya mātram yat tu kiṃcid param sāmānya mātram svarūpeṇa udāharet vaināśikaḥ tat sarvam saṃhatyakāri tvāt para artham eva syāt yaḥ tu asau paraḥ viśeṣaḥ sa na saṃhatya kārī puruṣaḥ iti

viśeṣa darśinaḥ ātma bhāva bhāvanā nivṛttiḥ yathā prāvṛṣi tṛṇa aṅkurasya udbhedena tat bīja sattā anumīyate tathā mokṣa mārga śravaṇena yasya roma harṣa aśru pātau dṛśyete tatra api asti viśeṣa darśana bījam apavarga bhāgīyam karma abhinirvartitam iti anumīyate tasya ātma bhāva bhāvanā svābhāvikī pravartate yasya abhāvāt idam uktam svabhāvam muktvā doṣa āt i eṣām pūrva pakṣe ruciḥ bhavati aruciḥ ca nirṇaye bhavati tatra ātma bhāva bhāvanā kaḥ aham āsam katham aham āsam kiṃsvid idam kathaṃsvid idam ke bhaviṣyāmaḥ katham vā bhaviṣyāmaḥ iti sā tu viśeṣa darśinaḥ nivartate kutas cittasya eva eṣa vicitraḥ pariṇāmaḥ puruṣaḥ tu asatyām avidyāyām śuddhaḥ citta dharmaiḥ aparāmṛṣṭaḥ iti tatas asya ātma bhāva bhāvanā kuśalasya nivartate iti
tadā viveka nimnam kaivalya prāgbhāram cittam tadānīm yat asya cittam viṣaya prāgbhāram ajñāna nimnam āsīt tat asya anyathā bhavati kaivalya prāgbhāram viveka ja jñāna nimnam iti

tad chidreṣu pratyaya antarāṇi saṃskārebhyaḥ pratyaya viveka nimnasya sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātra pravāhiṇaḥ cittasya tad chidreṣu pratyaya antarāṇi asmi iti vā mama iti vā jānāmi iti vā na jānāmi iti vā kutas kṣīyamāṇa bījebhyaḥ pūrva saṃskārebhyaḥ iti
