bhūtātmanām vaiśeṣika guṇavat tvam kṣiti udaka ātmanām caturdaśa guṇavat tvam ākāśa ātmanām kṣaṇika eka deśa vṛtti viśeṣa guṇavat tvam diś kālayoḥ pañca guṇavat tvam sarva utpattimatām nimitta kāraṇa tvam ca kṣiti tejasoḥ naimittika drava tva yogaḥ evam sarvatra sādharmyam viparyayāt vaidharmyam ca vācyam iti dravya asaṅkaraḥ
iha idānīm ekaikaśas vaidharmyam ucyate

pṛthivī tva abhisambandhāt pṛthivī rūpa rasa gandha sparśa saṅkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatva guru tva drava tva saṃskāravatī ete ca guṇa viniveśa adhikāre rūpa ādayaḥ guṇa viśeṣāḥ siddhāḥ cākṣuṣa vacanāt sapta saṅkhī ā ādayaḥ patana upadeśāt guru tvam adbhiḥ sāmānya vacanāt dravya tvam uttara karma vacanāt saṃskāraḥ

kṣitau eva gandhaḥ rūpam aneka prakāram śukla ādi rasaḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ madhura ādiḥ gandhaḥ dvividhaḥ surabhiḥ asurabhiḥ ca sparśaḥ asyāḥ anuṣṇa aśīta tve sati pākajaḥ sā tu dvividhā nityā ca anityā ca paramāṇu lakṣaṇā nityā kārya lakṣaṇā tu anityā sā ca sthairya ādi ava yava sanniveśa viśiṣṭa apara jāti bahutva upetā śayana āsana ādi aneka upakāra karī ca trividham ca asyāḥ kāryam śarīra indriya viṣaya saṃjñakam

śarīram dvividham yoni jam ayonijam ca tatra ayonijam anapekṣya śukra śoṇitam deva ṛṣīṇām dharma viśeṣa sahitebhyaḥ aṇubhyaḥ jāyate kṣudra jantūnām yātanā śarīrāṇi adharma viśeṣa sahitebhyaḥ aṇubhyaḥ jāyante śukra śoṇita sannipāta jam yoni jam tat vividham jarāyu jam aṇḍa jam ca māṇuṣa paśu mṛgāṇām jarāyu jam pakṣi sarīsṛpāṇām aṇḍa jam

indriyam gandhavyaṃjakam sarva prāṇinām jala ādi anabhibhūtaiḥ pārthiva avayavaiḥ ārabdham ghrāṇam viṣayaḥ tu dvi aṇuka ādi krameṇa ārabdhaḥ trividhaḥ mṛd pāṣāṇa sthāvara lakṣaṇaḥ tatra bhū pradeśāḥ prākāra iṣṭaka ādayaḥ mṛd prakārāḥ pāṣāṇāḥ upala maṇi vajra ādayaḥ sthāvarāḥ tṛṇa oṣadhi vṛkṣa gulma latā avatāna vanaspatayaḥ iti

aptvā abhisambandhāt āpaḥ rūpa rasa sparśa drava tva sneha saṅkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatva guru tva saṃskāravatyaḥ pūrvavat eṣām siddhiḥ śukla madhura śītāḥ eva rūpa rasa sparśāḥ snehaḥ ambhasi eva sāṃsiddhikam ca drava tvam tāḥ ca pūrvavat dvividhāḥ nitya aniti abhāvāt tāsām tu kāryam trividham śarīra indriya viṣaya saṃjñakam tatra śarīram ayonijam eva varuṇa loke pārthiva avayava upaṣṭambhāt ca upabhoga samartham indriyam sarva prāṇinām rasa vyaṃjakam vijāti anabhibhūtaiḥ jala avayavaiḥ ārabdham rasanam viṣayaḥ tu sarit samudra hima karaka ādiḥ

tejaḥ tvā abhisambandhāt tejaḥ rūpa sparśa saṅkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatva drava tva saṃskāra vat pūrvavat eṣām siddhiḥ tatra śuklam bhāsvaram ca rūpam uṣṇaḥ eva sparśaḥ tat api dvividham aṇu kārya bhāvāt kāryam ca śarīra ādi trayam śarīram ayonijam āditya loke pārthiva avayava upaṣṭambhāt ca upabhoga samartham

indriyam sarva prāṇinām rūpa vyaṃjakam anya avayavān abhibhūtaiḥ tejaḥ avayavaiḥ ārabdham cakṣuḥ viṣaya saṃjñakam caturvidham bhaumam divyam udaryam ākara jam ca tatra bhaumam kāṣṭha indhana prabhavam ūrdhva jvalana svabhāvam pacana dahana svedana ādi samartham divyam ap indhanam saura vidyut ādi bhuktasya āhārasya rasa ādi pariṇāma artham udaryam ākara jam ca suvarṇa ādi tatra saṃyukta samavāyāt rasa ādi upalabdhiḥ iti

vāyu tvā abhisambandhāt vāyuḥ sparśa saṅkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatva saṃskāravān sparśaḥ asya anuṣṇa aśīta tve sati apākajaḥ guṇa viniveśāt siddhaḥ arūpiṣu acākṣuṣa vacanāt sapta saṅkhī ā ādayaḥ tṛṇa karma vacanāt saṃskāraḥ sa ca ayam dvividhaḥ aṇu kārya bhāvāt tatra kārya lakṣaṇaḥ caturvidhaḥ śarīram indriyam viṣayaḥ prāṇaḥ iti

tatra ayonijam eva śarīram marutām loke pārthiva avayava upaṣṭambhāt ca upabhoga samartham indriyam sarva prāṇinām sparśa upalambhakam pṛthivī ādi anabhibhūtaiḥ vāyu avayavaiḥ ārabdham sarva śarīra vyāpi tvac indriyam viṣayaḥ tu upalabhyamāna sparśa adhiṣṭhāna bhūtaḥ sparśa śabda dhṛti kampa liṅgaḥ tiryak gamana svabhāvaḥ megha ādi preraṇa dhāraṇa ādi samarthaḥ

tasya apratyakṣasya api nānātvam sammūrcchanena anumīyate sammūrcchanam punar samāna javayoḥ vāyvoḥ viruddha dikkriyayoḥ sannipātaḥ saḥ api sāvayavinoḥ vāyvoḥ ūrdhva gamanena anumīyate tat api tṛṇa ādi gamanena iti prāṇaḥ antar śarīre rasa mala dhātūnām preraṇa ādi hetuḥ ekaḥ san kriyā bhedāt apāna ādi saṃjñām labhate

iha idānīm caturṇām mahābhūtānām sṛṣṭi saṃhāra vidhiḥ ucyate brāhmaṇe mānena varṣa śata ante vartamānasya brahmaṇaḥ apavarga kāle saṃsāra khinnānām sarva prāṇinām niśi viśrāma artham sakala bhuvana pateḥ maheśvarasya saṃjihīrṣā sama kālam śarīra indriya mahā bhūta upanibandhakānām sarva ātma gatānām adṛṣṭānām vṛtti nirodhe sati maheśvara icchā ātmā aṇu saṃyoga ja karmabhyaḥ śarīra indriya kāraṇa aṇu vibhāgebhyaḥ tad saṃyoga nivṛttau teṣām āparamāṇu antaḥ vināśaḥ

tathā pṛthivī udaka jvalana pavanānām api mahābhūtānām anena eva krameṇa uttarasmin uttarasmin sati pūrvasya pūrvasya vināśaḥ tatas pravibhaktāḥ paramāṇavovatiṣṭhante dharma adharma saṃskāra anuviddhāḥ ātmānaḥ tāvantam eva kālam tatas punar prāṇinām bhoga bhūtaye maheśvara sisṛkṣā anantaram sarva ātma gata vṛtti labdha adṛṣṭa apekṣebhyaḥ tad saṃyogebhyaḥ pavana paramāṇuṣu karma utpattau teṣām paraspara saṃyogebhyaḥ dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa mahān vāyuḥ samutpannaḥ nabhasi dodhūyamānaḥ tiṣṭhati

tad anantaram tasmin eva vāyāva api ebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ tena eva krameṇa mahān salilanidhiḥ utpannaḥ poplūyamānaḥ tiṣṭhati tad anantaram tasmin eva pārthivebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ mahā pṛthivī saṃhatā avatiṣṭhate tad anantaram tasmin eva mahā udadhau taijasebhyaḥ aṇubhyaḥ dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa utpannaḥ mahān tejaḥ rāśiḥ kenacid anabhibhūta tvāt dedīpyamānaḥ tiṣṭhati

evam samutpanneṣu caturṣu mahābhūteṣu maheśvarasya abhidhyāna mātrāt taijasebhyaḥ aṇubhyaḥ pārthiva paramāṇu sahitebhyaḥ mahat aṇḍam ārabhyate tasmin catur vadana kamalam sarva loka pitāmaham brahmāṇam sakala bhuvana sahitam utpādya prajā sarge viniyuṅkte sa ca maheśvareṇa viniyuktaḥ brahma atiśaya jñāna vairāgya aiśvarya sampannaḥ prāṇinām karma vipākam viditvā karma anurūpa jñāna bhoga āyuṣaḥ sutān prajāpatīn mānasān maudeva ṛṣi pitṛ gaṇān mukha bāhu ūru pādataḥ caturaḥ varṇān anyāni ca uccāvacāni bhūtāni ca sṛṣṭvā āśaya aṇu rūpaiḥ dharma jñāna vairāgya aiśvaryaiḥ samyojayati iti

ākāśa kāla diśām ekaika tvāt para jāti abhāve pāribhāṣikyaḥ tisraḥ saṃjñā bhavanti ākāśaḥ kālaḥ diś iti tatra ākāśasya guṇāḥ śabda saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ śabdaḥ pratyakṣa tve satya kāraṇa guṇa pūrvaka tvāt ayāvat dravya bhāvi tvāt āśrayāt anyatra upalabdheḥ ca na sparśa vat viśeṣa guṇaḥ bāhya indriya pratyakṣa tvāt ātma antara grāhya tvāt ātmani asamavāyāt ahaṅkāreṇa vibhakta grahaṇāt ca na ātma guṇaḥ

śrotra grāhya tvāt vaiśeṣika guṇa bhāvāt ca na diś kāla manasām pariśeṣāt guṇaḥ bhūtvā ākāśasya adhigame liṅgam śabda liṅga aviśeṣāt eka tvam siddham tat anuvidhānāt eka pṛthaktvam vibhava vacanāt parama mahat parimāṇam śabda kāraṇa tva vacanāt saṃyoga vibhāgau iti atas guṇavat tvāt anāśrita tvāt ca dravyam samāna asamāna jātoya kāraṇa abhāvāt ca nityam sarva prāṇinām ca śabda upalabdhau nimittam śrotra bhāvena śrotram punar śravaṇa vivara saṃjñakaḥ nabhaḥ deśaḥ śabda nimitta upabhoga prāpaka dharma adharma upanibaddha s tasya ca nitya tve sati upanibandhaka vaikalyāt bādhiryam iti

kālaḥ parāpara vyatikara yaugapadya ayaugapadi acira kṣipra pratyaya liṅgam teṣām viṣayeṣu pūrva pratyaya vilakṣaṇānām utpattau anya nimitta abhāvāt yat atra nimittam sa kālaḥ sarva kāryāṇām ca utpatti sthiti vināśa hetuḥ tad vyapadeśāt kṣaṇa lava nimeṣa kāṣṭhākalā muhūrtayāmāhorātra ardha māsa māsartu ayana saṃvatsara yuga kalapa manvantara pralaya mahāpralaya vyavahāra hetuḥ

tasya guṇāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ kāla liṅga aviśeṣāt eka tvam siddham tat anuvidhānāt pṛthaktvam kāraṇe kālaḥ iti vacanāt parama mahat parimāṇam kāraṇa paratva ādi vacanāt saṃyogaḥ tad vināśaka tvāt vibhāgaḥ iti tasya ākāśa vat dravya tva nitya tve siddhe kāla liṅga aviśeṣāt aṃjasā eka tve pi sarva kāryāṇām ārambha kriyā abhinirvṛtti sthiti nirodha upapādhi bhedāt maṇi vat pācaka vat vā nānātva upacāraḥ iti

diś pūrva apara ādi pratyaya liṅgā mūrta dravyam avadhim kṛtvā mūrteṣu eva dravyeṣu etasmāt idam pūrveṇa dakṣiṇena paścimena uttareṇa pūrva dakṣiṇena dakṣiṇa apareṇa apara uttareṇa uttara pūrveṇa ca adhastāt upariṣṭāt ca iti daśa pratyayāḥ yatas bhavanti sā diś iti anya nimitta asambhavāt tasyāḥ tu guṇāḥ saṃkhyāya parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ kāla vat ete siddhāḥ diś liṅga aviśeṣāt aṃjasā eka tve api diśaḥ parama mahā ṛṣibhiḥ śruti smṛti loka saṃvyavahāra artham merum pradakṣiṇam āvartamānasya bhagavataḥ savituḥ ye saṃyoga viśeṣāḥ lokapāla parigṛhīta diś pradeśānām anvarthāḥ prācī ādi bhedena daśavidhāḥ saṃjñāḥ kṛtāḥ atas bhaktyā daśa diśaḥ siddhāḥ tāsām eva devatā parigrahāt punar daśa saṃjñā bhavanti māhendrī vaiśvānarī yāmyā nairṛtī vāruṇī vāyavyā kauverī aiśānī brāhmī nāgī ca iti

ātma tva abhisambandhāt ātmā tasya saukṣmyāt apratyakṣa tve sati karaṇaiḥ śabda ādi upalabdhi anumitaiḥ śrotra ādibhiḥ samadhigamaḥ kriyate vā asya ādīnām karaṇānām kartṛ prayojya tva darśanāt śabda ādiṣu prasiddhyā ca prasādhakaḥ anumīyate na śarīra indriya manasām ajña tvāt na śarīrasya caitanyam ghaṭa ādi vat bhūta kārya tvāt mṛte ca asambhavāt na indriyāṇām karaṇa tvāt upahateṣu viṣayāsān nidhye ca anusmṛti darśanāt

na api manasaḥ karaṇa antara anapekṣi tve yugapad a ālocana smṛti prasaṅgāt svayam karaṇa bhāvāt ca pariśeṣāt ātma kārya tvāt tena ātmā samadhigamyate śarīra samavāyinībhyām ca hita ahita prāpti parihāra yogyābhyām pravṛtti nivṛttibhyām rathakarmaṇā sārathi vat prayatnavān vigrahasya adhiṣṭhātā anumīyate prāṇa ādibhiḥ ca iti

katham śarīra parigṛhīte vāyau vikṛta karma darśanāt bhastrā ādhmāpayitā iva nimeṣa unmeṣa karmaṇā niyatena dāru yantra prayoktā iva dehasya vṛddhi kṣata bhagna saṃrohaṇa ādi nimitta tvāt gṛhapatiḥ iva abhimata viṣaya grāhaka karaṇa sambandha nimittena manaḥ karmaṇā gṛha koṇeṣu pelaka prerakaḥ iva dārakaḥ nayana viṣaya ālocana anantaram rasa anusmṛti krameṇa rasana vikriyā darśanāt aneka gavākṣa antargata prekṣaka vat ubhaya darśī kaścid ekaḥ vijñāyate

sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatnaiḥ ca guṇaiḥ guṇī anumīyate te ca na śarīra indriya guṇāḥ kasmāt ahaṅkāreṇa eka vākyatā bhāvāt pradeśa vṛtti tvāt ayāvat dravya bhāvi tvāt bāhya indriya apratyakṣa tvāt ca tathā ahaṃśabdena api pṛthivī ādi śabda vyatirekāt iti tasya guṇāḥ buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma saṃskāra saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ ātma liṅga adhikāre buddhi ādayaḥ prayatna antāḥ siddhāḥ dharma adharmau ātma antara guṇānām akāraṇa tva vacanāt saṃskāraḥ smṛti utpattau kāraṇa vacanāt vyavasthā vacanāt saṃkhyā pṛthaktvam api atas eva tathā ca ātma iti vacanāt parama mahat parimāṇam sannikarṣa ja tvāt sukha ādīnām saṃyogaḥ tad vināśaka tvāt vibhāgaḥ iti

manaḥ tu ayogān manaḥ sati api ātma indriya artha sānnidhye jñāna sukha ādīnām abhūtvā utpatti darśanāt karaṇa antaram anumīyate śrotra ādi avyāpāre smṛti utpatti darśanāt bāhya indriyaiḥ agṛhīta sukha ādi grāhya antara bhāvāt ca antaḥkaraṇam tasya guṇāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatva saṃskārāḥ prayatna jñāna ayaugapadya vacanāt pratiśarīram eka tvam siddham pṛthaktvam api atas eva tad abhāva vacanāt aṇu parimāṇam apasarpaṇa upasarpaṇa vacanāt saṃyoga vibhāgau mūrta tvāt paratva aparatve saṃskāraḥ ca asparśavat tvāt dravya anārambhaka tvam kriyāvat tvāt mūrta tvam sādhāraṇa vigraha vat tva prasaṅgāt ajña tvam karaṇa bhāvāt para artham guṇavat tvāt dravyam prayatna adṛṣṭa parigraha vaśāt āśu sañcāri ca iti

atha guṇa padārtha nirūpaṇam rūpa ādīnām guṇānām sarveṣām guṇa tva abhisambandhaḥ dravya āśrita tvam nirguṇa tvam niṣkriya tvam rūpa rasa gandha sparśa paratva aparatva guru tva drava tva sneha vegāḥ mūrta guṇāḥ buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma bhāvanā śabdāḥ amūrta guṇāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ ubhaya guṇāḥ

saṃyoga vibhāga dvi tvat vipṛthaktva ādayaḥ aneka āśritāḥ śeṣāḥ tu ekaika dravya vṛttayaḥ rūpa rasa gandha sparśa sneha sāṃsiddhi ka drava tva buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma bhāvanā śabdāḥ vaiśeṣika guṇāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatva guru tva naimitika drava tva vegāḥ sāmānya guṇāḥ

śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandhāḥ bāhya ekaika indriya grāhyāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatva drava tva sneha vegāḥ dvi indriya grāhyāḥ buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatnāḥ tu antaḥkaraṇa grāhyāḥ guru tva dharma adharma bhāvanāḥ hi atīndriyāḥ apākaja rūpa rasa gandha sparśa parimāṇa eka tva eka pṛthaktva guru tva drava tva sneha vegāḥ kāraṇa guṇa pūrvakāḥ

buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma bhāvanā śabdāḥ akāraṇa guṇa pūrvakāḥ buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma bhāvanā śabda tūla parimāṇa uttara saṃyoga naimittika drava tva paratva aparatva apāka jāḥ saṃyoga jāḥ saṃyoga vibhāga vegāḥ karma jāḥ śabda uttara vibhāgau vibhāga jau

paratva aparatva dvi tvat vipṛthaktva ādayaḥ buddhi apekṣāḥ rūpa rasa gandha anuṣṇa sparśa śabda parimāṇa eka tva eka pṛthaktva snehāḥ samāna jāti ārambhakāḥ sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatnāḥ ca asamāna jāti ārambhakāḥ saṃyoga vibhāga saṃkhyā guru tva drava tva uṣṇa sparśa jñāna dharma adharma saṃskārāḥ samāna asamāna jāti ārambhakāḥ

buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa bhāvanā śabdāḥ sva āśraya samaveta ārambhakāḥ rūpa rasa gandha sparśa parimāṇa sneha prayatnāḥ paratra ārambhakāḥ saṃyoga vibhāga saṃkhyā eka pṛthaktva guru tva drava tva vega dharma adharmāḥ tu ubhayatra ārambhakāḥ guru tva drava tva vega prayatna dharma adharma saṃyoga viśeṣāḥ kriyā hetavaḥ

rūpa rasa gandha anuṣṇa sparśa saṃkhyā parimāṇa eka pṛthaktvasa neha śabdānām asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma bhāvanānām nimitta kāraṇa tvam saṃyoga vibhāga uṣṇa sparśa guru tva drava tva vegānām ubhayathā kāraṇa tvam paratva aparatva dvi tvat vipṛthaktva ādīnām akāraṇa tvam saṃyoga vibhāga śabda ātma viśeṣa guṇānām pradeśa vṛtti tvam śeṣāṇām āśraya vyāpi tvam apākaja rūpa rasa gandha sparśa parimāṇa ekatva eka pṛthaktva sāṃsiddhi kadrava tva guru tva snehānām yāvat dravya bhāvi tvam śeṣāṇām ayāvat dravya bhāvi tvam ca iti

rūpa ādīnām sarveṣām guṇānām pratyekam apara sāmānya sambandhāt rūpa ādi saṃjñāḥ bhavanti tatra rūpam cakṣuḥ grāhyam pṛthivī udaka jvalana vṛtti dravya ādi upalambhakam nayana sahakāri śukla ādi aneka prakāram salila ādi paramāṇuṣu nityam pārthiva paramāṇuṣu agni saṃyoga virodhi sarva kārya dravyeṣu kāraṇa guṇa pūrvakam āśraya vināśāt eva vinaśyati iti
rasaḥ rasana grāhyaḥ pṛthivī udaka vṛttiḥ jīvana puṣṭi bala ārogya nimittam rasana sahakārī madhura aṃla lavaṇa tikta kaṭu kaṣāya bheda bhinnaḥ asya api nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ rūpavat
gandhaḥ ghrāṇa grāhyaḥ pṛthivī vṛttiḥ ghrāṇa saha kārī surabhiḥ asurabhiḥ ca asya api pūrvavat utpatti ādayaḥ vyākhyātāḥ
sparśaḥ tvac indriya grāhyaḥ kṣiti udaka jvalana pavana vṛttiḥ tu akṣahakārī rūpa anuvidhāyī śīta uṣṇa anuṣṇa aśīta bhedāt trividhaḥ asya api nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ pūrvavat

pārthiva paramāṇu rūpa ādīnām pākaja utpatti vidhānam ghaṭa ādeḥ āma dravyasya agninā sambaddhasya agni abhighātāt nodanāt vā tad ārambhakeṣu aṇuṣu karmāṇi utpadyante tebhyaḥ vibhāgāḥ vibhāgebhyaḥ saṃyoga vināśāḥ saṃyoga vināśebhyaḥ ca kārya dravyam vinaśyati tasmin vinaṣṭe svatantreṣu paramāṇuṣu agni saṃyogāt auṣṇya apekṣāt śyāmā ādīnām vināśaḥ punar anyasmāt agni saṃyogāt auṣṇya apekṣāt pāka jāḥ jāyante

tad anantaram bhoginām adṛṣṭa apekṣāt ātmā aṇu saṃyogāt utpanna pāka jeṣu aṇuṣu karma utpattau teṣām paraspara saṃyogāt dvi aṇuka ādi krameṇa kārya dravyam utpadyate tatra ca kāraṇa guṇa prakrameṇa rūpa ādi utpattiḥ na ca kārya dravyaḥ eva rūpa ādi utpattiḥ vināśaḥ vā sambhavati sarva avayaveṣu antar bahis ca vartamānasya agninā vyāpti abhāvāt aṇu praveśāt api ca vyāptiḥ na sambhavati kārya dravya vināśāt iti

eka ādi vyavahāra hetuḥ saṃkhyā sā punar eka dravyā ca aneka dravyā ca tatra eka dravyāyāḥ salila ādi paramāṇu rūpa dīnām iva nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ aneka dravyā tu dvi tva ādikā parārdha antā tasyāḥ khalu ekatvebhyaḥ aneka viṣaya buddhi sahitebhyaḥ niṣpattiḥ apekṣā buddhi vināśāt vināśaḥ iti katham yadā boddhuḥ cakṣuṣā samāna asamāna jātīyayoḥ dravyayoḥ sannikarṣe sati tad saṃyukta samaveta samaveta eka tva sāmānya jñāna utpattau eka tva sāmānyatas sambandha jñānebhyaḥ eka guṇayoḥ aneka viṣayiṇī ekā buddhiḥ utpadyate tadā tām apekṣya eka tvābhyām sva āśrayayoḥ dvi tvam ārambhyate tatas punar tasmin dvi tva sāmānya jñānam utpadyate tasmāt dvi tva sāmānya jñānāt apekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyattā dvi tva sāmānya tad sambandha tad jñānebhyaḥ dvi tva guṇa buddheḥ utpadyam ānatā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

tatas idānīm apekṣā buddhi vināśāt dvi tva guṇasya vinaśyattā dvi tva guṇa jñānam dvi tva sāmānya jñānasya vināśa kāraṇam dvi tva guṇa tad jñāna sambandhebhyaḥ dve dravye iti dravya buddheḥ utpadyam ānatā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tad anantaram dve dravye iti dravya jñānasya utpādaḥ dvi tvasya vināśaḥ dvi tva guṇa buddheḥ vinaśyat tāḥ dravya jñānāt saṃskārasya utpadyam āna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tad anantaram dravya jñānāt dvi tva guṇa buddheḥ vināśaḥ dravya buddheḥ api saṃskārāt

etena tri tva ādi utpattiḥ api vyākhyātā eka tvebhyaḥ aneka viṣaya buddhi sahitebhyaḥ niṣpattiḥ apekṣā buddhi vināśāt ca vināśaḥ iti kvacid ca āśraya vināśāt iti katham yadā ekatva ādhāra avayave karma utpadyate tadā eva eka tva sāmānya jñānam utpadyate karmaṇā ca avayava antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate apekṣā buddheḥ ca utpattiḥ

tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle dvi tvam utpadyate saṃyoga vināśāt dravya vināśaḥ sāmānya buddheḥ ca utpattiḥ tatas yasmin eva kāle sāmānya jñānāt apekṣā buddheḥ vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle āśraya vināśāt dvi tva vināśaḥ iti śobhanam etat vidhānam badhya ghātaka pakṣe saha anavasthāna lakṣaṇe tu virodhe dravya jñāna anutpatti prasaṅgaḥ katham

guṇa buddhi sama kālam apekṣā buddhi vināśāt dvi tva vināśe tad apekṣasya dve dravye iti dravya jñānasya anutpatti prasaṅgaḥ iti laiṅgika vat jñāna mātrāt iti cetasyāt matam yathā abhūtam bhūtasya iti atra liṅga abhāve api jñāna mātrād anumānam tathā guṇa vināśe api guṇa buddhi mātrāt dravya pratyayaḥ syāt iti na viśeṣya jñāna tvāt na hi viśeṣya jñānam sārūpyāt viśeṣaṇa sambandham antareṇa bhavitum arhati tathā ca āha sūtrakāraḥ samavāyinaḥ śvaityāt śvaitya buddheḥ śvete buddhiḥ te kārya kāraṇa bhūte iti

na tu laiṅgikam jñānam abhedena utpadyate tasmāt viṣamaḥ ayam upanyāsaḥ naḥ āśu utpatteḥ yathā śabdavat ākāśam iti atra trīṇi jñānāni āśu utpadyante tathā dvi tva ādi jñana utpattau iti adoṣaḥ badhya ghātaka pakṣe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti ced syāt matam nanu badhya ghātaka pakṣe api tarhi dravya jñāna anutpatti prasaṅgaḥ katham dvi tva sāmānya buddhi sama kālam saṃskārāt apekṣā buddhi vināśāt iti na

samūha jñānasya saṃskāra hetu tvāt samūha jñānm eva saṃskāra kāraṇam na ālocana jñānam iti adoṣaḥ jñāna yaugapadya prasaṅgaḥ iti ced syāt matam nanu jñānānām badhya ghātaka vi rodhe jñāna yaugapadya prasaṅgaḥ iti na avinaśyatoḥ avasthāna pratiṣedhāt jñāna ayaugapadya vacanena jñānayoḥ yugapad utpattiḥ avinaśyatoḥ ca yugapad ava sthānam pratiṣidhyate na hi badhya ghātaka vi rodhe jñānayoḥ yugapad utpattiḥ vinaśyatoḥ ca yugapad ava sthānam asti iti

parimāṇam māna vyavahāra kāraṇam tat caturvidham aṇu mahat dīrgham hrasvam ca iti tatra mahat dvividham nityam anityam ca nityam ākāśa kāla diś ātmasu parama mahat tvam anityam tri aṇuka ādau eva tathā ca aṇu api dvividham nityam anityam ca nityam paramāṇu manassu tat pārimāṇḍaluyam anityam dvi aṇukaḥ eva kuvalayāmalaka bilva ādiṣu mahatsu api tad prakarṣa bhāva abhāvam apekṣya bhāktaḥ aṇu tva vyavahāraḥ

dīrgha tva hrasva tve ca utpādye mahat aṇu tva eka artha samavete samidh ikṣu vaṃśa ādiṣu aṃjasā dīrgheṣu api tad prakarṣa bhāva abhāvam apekṣya bhāktaḥ hrasva tva vyavahāraḥ anityam caturvidham api saṃkhyā parimāṇa pracaya yoni tatra īśvara buddhim apekṣya utpannā paramāṇu dvi aṇukeṣu bahu tva saṃkhyā taiḥ ārabdhe kārya dravye tri aṇuka ādi lakṣaṇe rūpa ādi utpatti sama kālam mahat tvam dīrgha tvam ca karoti

dvi bahubhiḥ mahadbhiḥ ca ārabdhe kārya dravye kāraṇa mahat tvāni eva mahat tvam ārabhante na bahu tvam samāna saṃkhyaiḥ ca ārabdhe atiśaya darśanāt pracaya tūla piṇḍayoḥ vartamānaḥ piṇḍa ārambhaka avayava praśithila saṃyogān apekṣamāṇaḥ itaretara piṇḍa avayava saṃyoga apekṣaḥ vā dvi tūlake mahat tvam ārabhate na bahu tva mahat tvāni

samāna saṃkhyā pala parimāṇaiḥ ārabdhe atiśaya darśanāt dvi tva saṃkhyā ca aṇvoḥ vartamānāḥ dvi aṇuke aṇu tvam ārabhate mahat tva vat tri aṇuka ādau kāraṇa bahu tva mahat tva samāna jātīya pracayebhyaḥ dīrgha tvasya upattiḥ aṇu tva vat dvi aṇuke dvi tva saṃkhyātaḥ hrasva tvasya utpattiḥ atha tri aṇuka ādiṣu vartamānayoḥ mahat tva dīrgha tvayoḥ parasparataḥ kaḥ viśeṣaḥ dvi aṇukeṣu ca aṇu tva hrasva tvayoḥ iti tatra asti mahat tva dīrgha tvayoḥ parasparataḥ viśeṣaḥ mahatsu dīrgham ānīyatām dīrgheṣu ca mahat ānīyatām iti viśiṣṭa vyavahāra darśanāt iti aṇu tva hrasva tvayoḥ tu parasparataḥ viśeṣaḥ tad darśinām pratyakṣaḥ iti tat caturvidham api parimāṇam utpādyam āśraya vināśāt eva vinaśyati iti

pṛthaktvam apoddhāra vyavahāra kāraṇam tat punar eka dravyam aneka dravyam ca tasya tu nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ saṃkhyayā vyākhyātāḥ etāvān tu viśeṣaḥ eka tva ādi vat eka pṛthaktva ādiṣu apara sāmānya abhāvaḥ saṃkhyayā tu viśiṣyate tad viśiṣṭa vyavahāra darśanāt iti

saṃyogaḥ saṃyukta pratyaya nimittam sa ca dravya guṇa karma hetuḥ dravya ārambhe nirapekṣaḥ tathā bhavati iti sa apekṣebhyaḥ nirapekṣebhyaḥ ca iti vacanāt guṇa karma ārambhe tu sa apekṣaḥ saṃyukta samavāyāt agneḥ vaiśeṣikam iti vacanāt atha kathaṃlakṣaṇaḥ katividhaḥ ca iti aprāptayoḥ prāptiḥ saṃyogaḥ sa ca trividhaḥ anyatara karma jaḥ ubhaya karma jaḥ saṃyoga jaḥ ca tatra anyatara karma jaḥ kriyāvatā niṣkriyasya

yathā sthāṇoḥ śyenet na vibhūnām ca mūrttaiḥ ubhaya karma jaḥ viruddha dikkriyayoḥ sannipātaḥ yathā mallayoḥ meṣāyoḥ vā saṃyoga jaḥ tu utpanna mātrasya cira utpannasya vā niṣkriyasya kāraṇa saṃyogibhiḥ akāraṇaiḥ kāraṇa akāraṇa saṃyoga pūrvakaḥ kārya akārya gataḥ saṃyogaḥ sa ca ekasmāt dvābhyām bahubhyaḥ ca bhavati ekasmāt tāvat tantu vīraṇa saṃyogāt dvi tantuka vīraṇa saṃyogaḥ dvābhyām tantu ākāśa saṃyogābhyām ekaḥ dvi tantuka ākāśa saṃyogaḥ bahubhyaḥ ca tantturī saṃyogebhyaḥ ekaḥ paṭa turī saṃyogaḥ

ekasmāt ca dvayoḥ utpattiḥ katham yadā pārthiva āpyayoḥ aṇvoḥ saṃyoge sati anyena pārthivena pārthivasya anyena apyena ca api asya yugapad saṃyogau bhavataḥ tadā tābhyām saṃyogābhyām pārthivāpye dvi aṇuke yugapad ārabhyete tatas yasmin kāle dvi aṇukayoḥ kāraṇa guṇa pūrva krameṇa rūpa ādi utpattiḥ tasmin eva kāle itaretara kāraṇā kāraṇa gatāt saṃyogāt itaretara kāya akārya gatau saṃyogau yugapad utpadyete kim kāraṇam

kāraṇa saṃyoginā hi akāraṇena kāryam avaśyam saṃyujyate iti nyāyaḥ atas pārthivam dvi aṇukam kāraṇa saṃyoginā apyena aṇunā sambaddhyate āpyam api dvi aṇukam kāraṇa saṃyoginā pārthivena iti atha dvi aṇukayoḥ itaretara kāraṇā kāraṇa sambaddhayoḥ katham parasparataḥ sambandhaḥ iti tayoḥ api saṃyoga jābhyām saṃyogābhyām sambandhaḥ iti na asti ajaḥ saṃyogaḥ nitya parimaṇḍala vat pṛthak anabhidhānāt

yathā caturvidham parimāṇam utpādyam uktvā āha nityam parimaṇḍalam iti evam anyatara karma ja ādi saṃyogam utpādyam uktvā pṛthak nityam brūyāt na tu evam abravīt tasmāt na asti ajaḥ saṃyogaḥ paramāṇubhiḥ ākāśa ādīnām pradeśa vṛttiḥ anyatara karma jaḥ saṃyogaḥ vibhūnām tu parasparataḥ saṃyogaḥ na asti yuta siddhi abhāvāt

sā punar dvayoḥ anyatarasya vā pṛthak gatimat tvam pṛthak āśraya āśrayi tvam ca iti vināśaḥ tu sarvasya saṃyogasya eka artha samavetāt vibhāgāt kvacid esraya vināśāt api katham yadā tantvoḥ saṃyoge sati anyatara tantu ārambhake aṃśau karma utpadyate tena karmaṇā aṃśvantatarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate vibhāgāt ca tantu ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ saṃyoga vināśāt tantu vināśaḥ tad vināśe tad āśritasya tantu antara saṃyogasya vināśaḥ iti

vibhāgaḥ vibhakta pratyaya nimittam śabda vibhāga hetuḥ ca prāpti pūrvikā aprāptiḥ vibhāgaḥ sa ca trividhaḥ anyatara karma jaḥ ubhaya karma jaḥ vibhāga jaḥ ca vibhāgaḥ iti tatra anyatara karma ja ubhaya karma jau saṃyoga vat vibhāga jaḥ tu dvividhaḥ kāraṇa vibhāgāt kāraṇa akāraṇa vibhāgāt ca tatra kāraṇa vibhāgāt tāvat kārya āviṣṭe kāraṇe karma utpannam yadā tasya avayava antarāt vibhāgam karoti na tad ākāśa ādi deśāt yadā tu ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam karoti na tadā avayava antarāt iti sthitiḥ

atas avayava karma avayava antarāt eva vibhāgam ārabhate tatas vibhāgāt ca dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin vinaṣṭe kāraṇa abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ iti avayavi vināśaḥ tadā kāraṇayoḥ vartamānaḥ vibhāgaḥ kārya vināśa viśiṣṭam kālam svatantram vā avayavam apekṣya sa kriyasya eva avayavasya kārya saṃyuktāt ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam ārabhate na niṣkriyasya kāraṇa abhāvāt uttara saṃyoga an utpattau anupabhogya tva prasaṅgaḥ na tu tad avayava karma ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam karoti tad ārambha kāla atīta tvāt pradeśa antara saṃyogam tu karoti eva akṛta saṃyogasya karmaṇaḥ kāla atyaya abhāvāt iti

kāraṇa akāraṇa vibhāgāt api katham yadā haste karma utpannam avayava antarāt vibhāgam akurvat ākāśa ādi deśebhyaḥ vibhāgān ārabhya pradeśa antare saṃyogān ārabhate tadā te kāraṇa akāraṇa vibhāgāḥ karma yām diśam prati kārya ārambha abhimukham tām apekṣya kārya akārya vibhāgān ārabhante tad anantaram kāraṇa akāraṇa saṃyogāt ca kārya akārya saṃyogān iti

yadi kāraṇa vibhāga anantaram kārya vibhāga utpattiḥ kāraṇa saṃyoga anantaram kārya saṃyoga utpattiḥ nanu evam avayava a ayavinoḥ yuta siddhi doṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti na yuta siddhi aparijñānāt sā punar dvayoḥ anyatarasya vā pṛthak gatimat tvam iyantu nityānām anityānām tu yuteṣu āśrayeṣu samavāyaḥ yuta siddhiḥ iti

tvac indriya śarīrayoḥ pṛthak gatimat tvam na asti yuteṣu āśrayeṣu samavāya usti iti paraspareṇa saṃyogaḥ siddhaḥ aṇu ākāśayoḥ tu āśraya antara abhāvepi anyatarasya pṛthak gatimat tvāt saṃyoga vibhāgau siddhau tantu paṭayoḥ anityayoḥ āśraya antara abhāvāt parasparataḥ saṃyoga vibhāga abhāvaḥ iti diś ādīnām tu pṛthak gati mat tva abhāvāt iti paraspareṇa saṃyoga vibhāga abhāvaḥ iti

vināśaḥ tu sarvasya vibhāgasya kṣaṇika tvāt uttara saṃyoga avadhi sadbhāvāt kṣaṇikaḥ iti na tu saṃyoga vidyayoḥ eva vibhāgaḥ tayoḥ eva saṃyogāt vināśaḥ bhavati kasmāt saṃyukta pratyaya vat vibhakta pratyaya anuvṛtti abhāvāt tasmāt uttara saṃyoga avadhi sadbhāvāt kṣaṇikaḥ iti kvacid ca āśraya vināśāt eva vinaśyati iti katham

yadā dvi tantuka kāraṇa avayave aṃśau karma utpannam aṃśvantarāt vibhāgām ārabhate tadā eva tantu antare api karma utpadyate vibhāgāt ca tantu ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tantu karmaṇā tantu antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt tantu saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle saṃyoga vināśāt tantu vināśaḥ tasmin vinaṣṭe tad āśritasya tantu antara vibhāgasya vināśaḥ iti evam tarhi uttara vibhāga anutpatti prasaṅgaḥ

kāraṇa vibhāga abhāvāt tatas pradeśa antara saṃyogavati saṃyoga abhāvaḥ iti atas virodhi guṇa asambhavāt karmaṇaḥ cira kāla avasthāyi tvam nitya dravya samavetasya ca nitya tvam iti doṣaḥ katham yadā api advyaṇuka ārambhaka paramāṇau karma utpannam aṇu antarāt vibhāgam karoti tadā eva aṇu antare api karma tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tadā eva aṇu antara karmaṇā dvi aṇukāṇvoḥ vibhāgaḥ kriyate tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt dvi aṇu kāṇu saṃyogasya vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle saṃyoga vināśāt dvi aṇukasya vināśaḥ

tasmin vinaṣṭe tad āśritasya dvi aṇuka aṇu vibhāgasya vināśaḥ tatas ca virodhi guṇa asambhavān nitya dravya samaveta karmaṇaḥ nitya tvam iti tantu aṃśu antara vibhāgāt vibhāgaḥ iti adoṣaḥ āśraya vināśāt tantvoḥ eva vibhāgaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ na tantu aṃśu antara vibhāgaḥ iti etasmāt uttaraḥ vibhāgaḥ jāyate aṅgulī ākāśa vibhāgāt śarīra ākāśa vibhāga vat tasmin eva kāle karma saṃyogam kṛtvā vinaśyati iti adoṣaḥ

athavā aṃśvantara vibhāga utpatti sama kālam tasmin eva tantau karma utpadyate tatoṃśu antara vibhāgāt tantu ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tantu karmaṇā ca tantu antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas saṃyoga vināśāt tantu vināśaḥ tad vināśāt ca tad āśritayoḥ vibhāga karmaṇoḥ yugapad vināśaḥ tantu vīraṇayoḥ vā saṃyoge sati dravya anutpattau pūrva uktena vidhānena āśraya vināśa saṃyogābhyām tantu vīraṇa vibhāga vināśaḥ iti

paratvam aparatvam ca para apara abhidhāna pratyaya nimittam tat tu dvividham diś kṛtam kāla kṛtam ca tatra diś kṛtam diś viśeṣa pratyāyakam kāla kṛtam ca vayaḥ bheda pratyāyakam tatra dikkṛtasya utpattiḥ abhidhīyate katham ekasyām diśi avasthitayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ saṃyukta saṃyoga bahu alpa bhāve sati ekasya draṣṭuḥ sannikṛṣṭam avadhim kṛtvā etasmāt viprakṛṣṭaḥ ayam iti paratva ādhāre asannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate

tatas tām apekṣya pareṇa diś pradeśena saṃyogāt paratvasya utpattiḥ tathā viprakṛṣṭam ca avadhim kṛtvā etasmāt sannikṛṣṭoyam iti aparatva ādhāre itarasmin sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tatas tām apekṣya apareṇa diś pradeśena saṃyogāt aparatvasya utpattiḥ kāla kṛtayoḥ api katham vartamāna kālayoḥ aniyata diś deśa saṃyuktayoḥ yuvastha virayaḥ rūḍha śmaśru kārkaśya bali palita ādi sānnidhye sati ekasya draṣṭuḥ yuvānam avadhim kṛtvā sthivire viprakṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate

tatas tām apekṣya pareṇa kāla pradeśena saṃyogāt paratvasya utpattiḥ sthaviram ca avadhim kṛtvā yūni sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tatas tām apekṣya apareṇa kāla pradeśena saṃyogāt aparatvasya utpattiḥ iti vināśaḥ tu apekṣā buddhi saṃyoga dravya vināśāt apekṣā buddhi vināśāt tāvat utpanne paratve yasmin kāle sāmānya buddhiḥ utpannā bhavati tatas apekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyattā sāmānya jñāna tad sambandhebhyaḥ paratva guṇa buddheḥ utpadyam ānatā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

tatas apekṣā buddheḥ vināśaḥ guṇa buddheḥ ca utpattiḥ tatas apekṣā buddhi vināśāt guṇasya vinaśyattā guṇa jñāna tad sambandhebhyaḥ dravya buddheḥ utpadyam ānatā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas dravya buddheḥ utpattiḥ guṇasya vināśaḥ iti saṃyoga vināśāt api katham apekṣā buddhi sama kālam eva paratva ādhāre karma utpadyate tena karmaṇā diś piṇḍa vibhāgaḥ kriyate apekṣā buddhitaḥ paratvasya utpattiḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

tatas sāmānya buddheḥ utpattiḥ diś piṇḍa saṃyogasya ca vināśaḥ tatas yasmin kāle guṇa buddhiḥ utpadyate tasmin eva kāle diś piṇḍa saṃyoga vināśāt guṇasya vināśaḥ dravya vināśāt api katham paratva ādhāra avayave karma utpannam yasmin eva kāle avayava antarāt vibhāgam karoti tasmin eva kāle apekṣā buddhiḥ utpadyate tatas vibhāgāt yasmin eva kāle saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle paratvam utpadyate tatas saṃyoga vināśāt dravya vināśaḥ tad vināśāt ca tad āśritasya guṇasya vināśaḥ

dravya apekṣā buddhoḥ yugapad vināśāt api katham yadā paratva ādhāra avayave karma utpadyate tadā eva apekṣā buddhiḥ utpadyate karmaṇā ca avayava antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate paratvasya utpattiḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas yasmin eva kāle avayava vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle sāmānya buddhiḥ utpadyate tad anantaram saṃyoga vināśāt dravya vināśaḥ sāmānya buddheḥ ca apekṣā buddhi vināśaḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

tatas dravya apekṣā buddhoḥ vināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ dravya saṃyoga vināśāt api katham yadā paratva ādhāra avayave karma utpannam avayava antarāt vibhāgam karoti tasmin eva kāle piṇḍa karma apekṣā buddhoḥ yugapad utpattiḥ tatas yasmin eva kāle paratvasya utpattiḥ tasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ piṇḍa karmaṇā diś piṇḍasya ca vibhāgaḥ kriyate iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

tatas yasmin eva kāle sāmānya buddhiḥ utpadyate tasmin eva kāle dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśāt piṇḍa vināśaḥ piṇḍa vināśāt ca piṇḍa saṃyoga vināśaḥ tatas guṇa buddhi sama kālam piṇḍa dikpiṇḍa saṃyoga vināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ saṃyoga apekṣā buddhoḥ yugapad vināśāt api katham yadā paratvam utpadyate tadā paratva ādhāre karma tatas yasmin eva kāle paratva sāmānya buddhiḥ utpadyate tasmin eva kāle piṇḍa karmaṇā diś piṇḍa vibhāgaḥ kriyate tatas sāmānya buddhitaḥ apekṣā buddhi vināśaḥ vibhāgāt ca diś piṇḍa saṃyoga vināśaḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

tatas saṃyoga apekṣā buddhi vināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ trayāṇām samavāyi asamavāyi nimitta kāraṇānām yugapad vināśāt api katham yadā apekṣā buddhiḥ utpadyate tadā piṇḍa avayave karma tatas yasmin eva kāle karmaṇā avayava antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate apekṣā buddheḥ paratvasya ca utpattiḥ tasmin eva kāle piṇḍe api karma tatas avayava vibhāgāt piṇḍa ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ piṇḍa karmaṇā ca diś piṇḍa vibhāgaḥ kriyate sāmānya buddheḥ ca utpattiḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas saṃyoga vināśāt piṇḍa vināśaḥ vibhāgāt ca diś piṇḍa saṃyoga vināśaḥ sāmānya jñānāt apekṣā buddheḥ vināśaḥ iti etat sarvam yugapad trayāṇām samavāyi asamavāyi nimitta kāraṇānām vināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ iti

buddhiḥ upalabdhiḥ jñānam pratyayaḥ iti paryāyāḥ sā ca aneka prakāra artha ānantyāt pratyartha niyata tvāt ca tasyāḥ sati api anekavidha tve samāsatas dve vidhe vidyā ca avidyā ca iti tatra avidyā caturvidhā saṃśaya viparyaya anadhyavasāya svapna lakṣaṇā

saṃśayaḥ tāvat prasiddha aneka viśeṣayoḥ sādṛśya mātra darśanāt ubhaya viśeṣa anusmaraṇāt adharmāt ca kiṃsvid iti ubhaya avalambī vimarṣaḥ saṃśayaḥ sa ca dvividhaḥ antar bahis ca antar tāvat ādeśikasya samyak mithyā ca uddiśya punar ādiśataḥ triṣu kāleṣu saṃśayaḥ bhavati kid nu samyak mithyā vā iti bahis dvividhaḥ pratyakṣa viṣaye ca apratyakṣa viṣaye ca

tatra apratyakṣa viṣaye tāvat sādhāraṇa liṅga darśanāt ubhaya viśeṣa anusmaraṇāt adharmāt ca saṃśayaḥ bhavati yathā aṭavyām viṣāṇa mātra darśanāt gauḥ gavayaḥ vā iti pratyakṣa aviṣaye api sthāṇu puruṣayoḥ ūrdhva tā mātra sādṛśya darśanāt vakra ādi viśeṣa anupalabdhitaḥ sthāṇu tva ādi sāmānya viśeṣān abhivyaktau ubhaya viśeṣa anusmaraṇāt ubhayatra ākṛṣyamāṇasya ātmanaḥ pratyayaḥ dolāyate kim nu khalu ayam sthāṇuḥ syāt puruṣaḥ vā iti

viparyayopi pratyakṣa anumāna viṣayaḥ eva bhavati pratyakṣa viṣaye tāvat prasiddha aneka viśeṣayoḥ pitta kapha anila upahata indriyasya ayatha artha ālocanāt asat nihita viṣaya jñāna ja saṃskāra apekṣāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt adharmāt ca ātasmin tat iti pratyayaḥ viparyayaḥ yathā gavyā iva aśvaḥ iti asati api pratyakṣe pratyakṣa abhimānaḥ bhavati yathā vyapagata ghana paṭalam acala jalanidhi sadṛśambaram aṃjana cūrṇa puñja śyāmam śārvaram tamaḥ iti

anumāna viṣaye api bāṣpa ādibhiḥ dhūma abhimataiḥ vahyanumāṇam gavaya viṣāṇa darśanāt ca gauḥ iti trayī darśana viparīteṣu śākya ādi darśaneṣu idam śreyaḥ iti mithyā pratyayaḥ viparyayaḥ śarīra indriya manaḥ sva ātma abhimānaḥ kṛtakeṣu nitya tva darśanam kāraṇa vaikalye kārya utpatti jñānam hitam upadiśatsu ahitam iti jñānam ahitam upadiśatsu hitam iti jñānam

anadhyavasāya upi pratyakṣa anumāna viṣayaḥ eva saṃjāyate tatra pratyakṣa viṣaye tāvat prasiddha artheṣu aprasiddha āryeṣu vā vyāsaṅgāt arthi tvāt vā kim iti ālocana mātram anadhyavasāyaḥ yathā vāhīkasya panasa ādiṣu anadhyavasāyaḥ bhavati tatra sattā dravya tva pṛthvī tva vṛkṣa tva rūpavat tva ādi śākhā ādi apekṣaḥ adhyavasāyaḥ bhavati panasa tvam api panaseṣu anuvṛttam āṃra ādibhyaḥ vyāvṛttam pratyakṣam eva kevalam tu upadeśa abhāvāt viśeṣa saṃjñā pratipattiḥ na bhavati anumāna viṣaye api nārikela dvīpa vāsinaḥ sāsnā mātra darśanāt konu khalu ayam prāṇī syāt iti anadhyavasāyaḥ bhavati

uparata indriya grāmasya pralīna manaskasya indriya dvāreṇa eva yat anubhavanam mānasam tat svapna jñānam katham yadā buddhi pūrvāt ātmanaḥ śarīra vyāpārāt ahani khinnānām prāṇinām niśi viśrama artham āhāra pariṇāma artham vā adṛṣṭa kārita prayatna apekṣāt ātma antaḥkaraṇa sambandhāt manasi kriyā prabandhāt antar hṛdaye nirindriye ātma pradeśe niścalam manaḥ tiṣṭhati tadā pralīna manaskaḥ iti ākhyāyate pralīne ca tasmin uparata indriya grāmaḥ bhavati tasyām avasthāyām prabandhena prāṇa apāna santāna pravṛttau ātma manaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt svāpa ākhyāt saṃskārāt ca indriya dvāreṇa eva asatsu viṣayeṣu pratyakṣa ākāram svapna jñānam utpadyate

tat tu trividham saṃskāra pāṭavāt dhātu doṣāt adṛṣṭāt ca tatra saṃskāra pāṭavāt tāvat kāmī krudhaḥ vā yadā yam artham ādūtaḥ cintayan svapiti tadā sā eva cintā santatiḥ pratyakṣa ākārā saṃjāyate dhātu doṣāt vāta prakṛtiḥ tad dūṣitaḥ vā ākāśa gamana ādīn paśyati pitta prakṛtiḥ pitta dūṣitaḥ vā agnipraveśa kanaka parvata ādīn paśyati

śleṣma prakṛtiḥ śleṣma dūṣitaḥ vā sarit samudra prataraṇa hima parvata ādīn paśyati yat svayam anubhūteṣu ananubhūteṣu vā prasiddha artheṣu aprasiddha artheṣu vā yat śubha avedakam gaja ārohaṇa chattra lābha ādi tat sarvam sa aṃskāra adharmābhyām bhavati viparītam ca taila abhyaṃjana khara uṣṭa ārohaṇa ādi tat sarvam adharma saṃskārābhyām bhavati atyanta aprasiddha artheṣu adṛṣṭāt eva iti svapna antikam yadi api uparata indriya grāmasya bhavati tathā api atītasya jñāna prabandhasya pratyavekṣaṇāt smṛtiḥ eva iti bhavati eṣā caturividhā avidyā iti
vidyā api caturvidhā pratyakṣa laiṅgika smṛti ārṣa lakṣaṇā

tatra akṣam akṣam pratītya utpadyate iti pratyakṣam akṣāṇi indriyāṇi ghrāṇa rasana cakṣuḥ tvac śrotra manāṃsi ṣaḍ tat dhi dravya ādiṣu padārtheṣu utpadyate dravye tāvat dvividhe mahati aneka dravyavattva udbhūta rūpa prakāśa catuṣṭaya sannikarṣāt dharma ādi sāmagrye ca svarūpa ālocana mātram sāmānya viśeṣa dravya guṇa karma viśeṣaṇa apekṣāt ātma manaḥ sannikarṣāt pratyakṣam utpadyate sat dravyam pṛthivī viṣāṇī śuklaḥ gauḥ gacchati iti

rūpa rasa gandha sparśeṣu aneka dravya samavāyāt sva gata viśeṣāt sva āśraya sannikarṣāt niyata indriya nimittam utpadyate tena eva upalabdhiḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatva sneha drava tva vega karmaṇām pratyakṣa dravya samavāyāt cakṣuḥ sparśanābhyām grahaṇam buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatnānām dvayoḥ ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt upalabdhiḥ bhāva dravya tva guṇa tva karma tva ādīnām upalabhya ādhāra samavetānām āśraya grāhakaiḥ indriyaiḥ grahaṇam iti etat asmad ādīnām pratyakṣam

asmad viśiṣṭānām tu yoginām yuktānām yoga ja dharma anugṛhītena manasā sva ātma antara ākāśa diś kāla paramaṇu vāyu manasassu tad samaveta guṇa karma sāmānya viśeṣeṣu samavāye ca avitatham sva rūpa darśanam utpadyate viyuktānām punar catuṣṭaya sannikarṣāt yoga ja dharma anugraha sāmarthayāt sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭeṣu pratyakṣam utpadyate

tatra sāmānya viśeṣeṣu svarūpa ālocana mātram pratyakṣam pramāṇam prameyāḥ dravya ādayaḥ padārthāḥ pramāna ātmā pramitiḥ dravya ādi viṣayam jñānam sāmānya viśeṣa jñāna utpattau avibhaktam ālocana mātram pratyakṣam pramāṇam asmin na anyat pramāṇa antaram asti aphala rūpa tvāt athavā sarveṣu padārtheṣu catuṣṭaya sannikarṣāt avitatham avyapadeśyam yat jñānam utpadyate tat pratyakṣam pramāṇam prameyāḥ dravya ādayaḥ padārthāḥ pramāta ātmā pramitiḥ guṇa doṣa mādhyasthya darśanam iti

liṅga darśanāt saṃjāyamānam laiṅgikam liṅgam punar yat anumeyena sambaddham prasiddham ca tad anvite tad abhāve ca na asti eva tad liṅgam anumāpakam viparītam atas yat syāt ekena dvitayena vā viruddha asiddha sandigdham aliṅgam kāśyapaḥ abravīt yat anumeyena arthena deśa viśeṣe kāla viśeṣe vā sahacaritam anumeya dharma anvite ca anyatra sarvasmin eka deśe vā prasiddham anumeya viparīte ca sarvasmin pramāṇataḥ asat eva tad aprasiddhārthasya anumāpakam liṅgam bhavati iti

yat tu yathā uktāt tri rūpāt liṅgāt ekena dharmeṇa dvābhyām vā viparītam tad anumeyasya adhigame liṅgam na bhavati iti etat eva āha sūtrakāraḥ aprasiddhaḥ anapadeśaḥ asan sandigdhaḥ ca iti vidhiḥ tu yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ agni abhāve dhūmaḥ api na bhavati iti evam prasiddha samayasya asandigdha dhūma darśanāt sāhacarya anusmaraṇāt tad anantaram agni adhyavasāyaḥ bhavati iti

evam sarvatra deśa kāla avinābhūtam itarasya liṅgam śāstre kārya ādi grahaṇam nidarśana artham kṛtam na avadhāraṇa artham kasmādyūtiḥ eka darśanāt tat yathā adhvaryuḥ oṃ śrāvayan vyavahitasya hotuḥ liṅgam candra udayaḥ samudra vṛddheḥ kumuda vikāśasya ca śaradi jala prasādaḥ agastya udayasya iti evamādi tat sarvam asya idam iti sambandha mātra vacanāt siddham tat tu dvividham dṛṣṭam sāmānyatas dṛṣṭam ca

tatra dṛṣṭam prasiddha sādhyayoḥ atyanta jāti abhede anumānam yathā gavi eva sa asnā mātram upalabhya deśa antare api sāsnā mātra darśanāt gavi pratipattiḥ prasiddha sādhyayoḥ atyanta jāti bhede liṅga anumeya dharma sāmānya anuvṛttitaḥ anumānam sāmānyatas dṛṣṭam yathā karṣaka vaṇi grāja puruṣāṇām ca pravṛtteḥ phalavat tvam upalabhya varṇa āśramiṇām api dṛṣṭam prayojanam anuddiśya pravartamānānām phala anumānam iti tatra liṅga darśanam pramāṇam pramitiḥ agni jñānam athavā agni jñānam eva pramāṇam pramitiḥ agnau guṇa doṣa mādhyasthya darśanam iti etat sva niścita artham anumānam

śabda ādīnām api anumāne antarbhāvaḥ samāna vidhi tvāt yathā prasiddha samayasya asan digdha liṅga darśana prasiddhi anusmaraṇābhyām atīndriye arthe bhavati anumānam evam śabda ādibhyaḥ api iti śruti smṛti lakṣaṇaḥ api āmnāyaḥ vaktṛ prāmāṇya apekṣaḥ tad vacanāt āmnāya prāmāṇyam liṅgāt ca anityaḥ buddhi pūrvā vākya kṛtiḥ vede buddhi pūrvaḥ dadātiḥ iti ukta tvāt

prasiddha abhinayasya ceṣṭayā pratipatti darśanāt tat api anumānam eva āptena aprasiddhasya gavayasya gavā gavaya pratipādanāt upamānam āpta vacanam eva darśana arthāt arthāpattiḥ virodhi eva śravaṇāt anumita anumānam sambhavaḥ api avinā abhāvi tvāt anumānam eva abhāvaḥ api anumānam eva yathā utpannam kāryam kāraṇa sadbhāve liṅgam evam anutpannam kāryam kāraṇa asadbhāve liṅgam tathā eva aitihyam api avitatham āpta upadeśaḥ eva iti

pañca avayavena vākyena sva niścita artha pratipādanām para artha anumānam pañca avayavena eva vākyena saṃśayita viparyaḥ tauvyutpannānām pareṣām sva niścita artha pratipādanam para artha anumānam vijñeyam avayavāḥ punar pratijñā apadeśa nidarśana anusandhāna pratyāmnāyāḥ

tatra anumeya uddeśaḥ avirodhī pratijñā pratipipāt ayiṣita dharma viśiṣṭasya dharmiṇā upadeśa viṣayam āpādayitum uddeśa mātram pratijñā yathā dravyam vāyuḥ iti avirodhi grahaṇāt pratyakṣa anumāna abhyupagata sva śāstra sva vacana virodhinaḥ nirastāḥ bhavanti yathā anuṣṇaḥ agniḥ iti pratyakṣa virodhī ghanam ambaram iti anumāna virodhī brāhmaṇena surā peyā iti āgama virodhī vaiśeṣikasya satkāryam itibruvataḥ sva śāstra virodhī na śabdaḥ artha pratyāyakaḥ iti sva vacana virodhī

liṅga vacanam apadeśaḥ yat anumeyena sahacaritam tad samāna jātīye sarvatra sāmānyena prasiddham tad viparīte ca sarvasmin asat eva tad liṅgam uktam tasya vacanam apadeśaḥ yathā kriyāvat tvāt guṇavat tvāt ca tathā ca tad anumeye asti tad samāna jātīye ca sarvasmin guṇavat tvam asāru asmin kriyāvat tvam

ubhayam api etat adravye na asti eva tasmāt tasya vacanam apadeśaḥ iti siddham etena asiddha viruddha sandigdha anadhya vasita vacanānām anapadeśa tvam uktam bhavati tatra asiddhaḥ caturvidhaḥ ubhaya asiddhaḥ anyatara asiddhaḥ tad bhāva asiddhaḥ anumeya asiddhaḥ ca iti tatra ubhaya asiddhaḥ ubhayoḥ vādi prativādinoḥ asiddhaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ sāvayava tvāt iti

anyatara asiddhaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ kāryatvāt iti tad bhāva asiddhaḥ yathā dhūma bhāvena agni adhigatau kartavyāyām upanyasyamānaḥ vā aṣpe dhūma bhāvena asiddhaḥ iti anumeya asiddhaḥ yathā pārthivam dravyam tamaḥ kṛṣṇa rūpavat tvāt iti yaḥ hi anumeye avidyamānaḥ api tad samāna jātīye sarvasmin na asti tad viparīte ca asti sa viparīta sādhanāt viruddhaḥ yathā yasmāt viṣāṇī tasmāt aśvaḥ iti

yaḥ tu san anumeye tad samāna asamāna jātīyayoḥ sādhāraṇaḥ san eva sa sandeha janaka tvāt sandigdhaḥ yathā yasmāt viṣāṇī tasmāt gauḥ iti ekasmin ca dvayoḥ hetvoḥ yathā ukta lakṣaṇayoḥ viruddhayoḥ sannipāte sati saṃśaya darśanāt ayam anyaḥ sandigdhaḥ iti kecid yathā mūrta tva amūrta tvam prati manasaḥ kriyāvat tva asparśavat tvayoḥ iti

nanu ayam asādhāraṇaḥ eva acākṣuṣa tva pratyakṣa tva vat saṃhatayoḥ anyatara pakṣa asambhavāt tatas ca anadhyavasitaḥ iti vakṣyāmaḥ nanu śāstre tatra tatra ubhayathāḥ darśanam saṃśaya kāraṇam apadiśyate iti na saṃśayaḥ viṣaya dvaita darśanāt saṃśaya utpattau viṣaya dvaita darśanam kāraṇam tulya bala tve ca tayoḥ paraspara virodhāt nirṇaya anutpādaka tvam syāt na tu saṃśaya hetu tvam na ca tayoḥ tulya balavat tvam asti anyatarasya anumeya uddeśasya āgama bādhita tvāt ayam tu viruddha bhedaḥ eva

yaḥ ca anumeye vidyamānaḥ tad samāna asamāna jātīyayoḥ asan eva saḥ anyatara asiddhaḥ anadhyavasāya hetutvāt anadhyavasitaḥ yathā satkāryam utpatteḥ iti ayam aprasiddhaḥ anapadeśaḥ iti vacanāt avaruddhaḥ nanu ca ayam viśeṣaḥ saṃśaya hetuḥ abhihitaḥ śāstre tulya jātīyeṣu artha antara bhūteṣu viśeṣasya ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt iti na anyārtha tvāt śabde viśeṣa darśanāt

saṃśaya anutpattiḥ iti ukte na ayam dravya ādīnām anyatamasya viśeṣaḥ syāt śrāvaṇa tvam kim tu sāmānyam eva sampadyate kasmāt tulya jātīyeṣu artha antara bhūteṣu dravya ādi bhedānām ekaikaśas viśeṣasya ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt iti uktam na saṃśaya kāraṇam anyathā ṣaṭsu api padārtheṣu saṃśaya prasaṅgāt tasmāt sāmānya pratyayāt eva saṃśayaḥ iti

dvividham nidarśanam sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa ca tatra anumeya sāmānyena liṅga sāmānyasya anuvidhāna darśanam sādharmya nidarśanam tat yathā yat kriyāvat tat dravyam dṛṣṭam yathā śaraḥ iti anumeya viparyaye ca liṅgasya abhāva darśanam vaidharmya nidarśanam tat yathā yat adravyam tat kriyāvat na bhavati yathā sattā iti

anena nidarśana ābhāsāḥ nirastāḥ bhavanti tat yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ amūra tvāt yat amūrtam dṛṣṭam tat nityam yathā paramāṇuḥ yathā karma yathā sthālī yathā tamaḥ ambara vat iti yat dravyam tat kriyāvat dṛṣṭam iti ca liṅga anumeya ubhaya āśraya asiddhān anugata viparīta anugatāḥ sādharmya nidarśana ābhāsāḥ yat anityam tat mūratam dṛṣṭam yathā karma yathā paramāṇuḥ yathā ākāśam yathā tamaḥ ghaṭa vat yat niṣkriyam tat adravyan ca iti liṅga anumeya ubhaya avi āvṛtta āśraya asiddha avi āvṛtta viparīta vyāvṛttāḥ vaidharmya nidarśana ābhāsāḥ iti

nidarśane anumeya sāmānyena saha dṛṣṭasya liṅga sāmānyasya anumeye anvānayanam anusandhānam anumeya dharma atra tvena abhitam liṅga sāmānyam anupalabdha śaktikam nidarśane sādhya dharma sāmānyena saha dṛṣṭam anumeye yena vacanena anusandhīyate tad anusandhānam tathā ca vāyuḥ kriyāvān iti anumeya abhāve ca tasya asattvam upalabhya na ca tathā vāyuḥ niṣkriyaḥ iti

anumeya tvena uddiṣṭe ca aniścite ca pareṣām niścaya āpādana artham pratijñāyāḥ punar vacanam prapti āmnāyaḥ pratipādya tvena uddiṣṭe ca aniścite ca pareṣām hetu ādibhiḥ avayavaiḥ āhita śaktīnām parisamāptena vākyena niścaya āpādana artham pratijñāyāḥ punar vacanam pratyāmanāyaḥ tasmāt dravyam eva iti na hi etasmin na sati pareṣām avayavānām samastānām vyastānām vā tad artha vācaka tvam asti gamyamāna artha tvāt iti ced na atiprasaṅgāt

tathā hi pratijñā anantaram hetu mātra abhidhānam kartavyam viduṣām anvaya vyatireka smaraṇāt tad artha avagatiḥ bhaviṣyati iti tasmāt atra eva artha parisamāptiḥ katham anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti anena aniścita anitya tva mātra viśiṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ kathyate prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt iti anena anitya tva sādhana dharma mātram abhidhīyate iha yat prayatna ānantarīyakam tat anityam dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭaḥ iti anena sādhya sāmānyena sādhana sāmānyasya anugāma mātram ucyate nityam aprayatna ānantarīyakam dṛṣṭam yathā ākāśam iti anena sādhya abhāvena sādhanasya asattvam pradarśyate

tathā ca prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na ca tathā ākāśa vat aprayatna anantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām dṛṣṭa sāmarthyasya sādhana sāmānyasya śabde anusandhānam gamyate tasmāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ ti anena anityaḥ eva śabdaḥ iti pratipipādayiṣita artha parisamāptiḥ gamyate tasmāt pañca avayavena eva vākyena pareṣām sva niścita artha prti pādanam kriyate iti etat para artha anumānam siddham iti

viśeṣa darśana jam avadhāraṇa jñānam saṃśaya virodhī nirṇayaḥ etat eva pratyakṣam anumānam vā yat viśeṣa darśanāt saṃśaya virodhi utpadyate sa pratyakṣa nirṇayaḥ yathā sthāṇu puruṣayoḥ ūrdhva tā mātra sādṛśya ālocanāt viśeṣeṣu apratyakṣeṣu ubhaya viśeṣa anusmaraṇāt kim ayam sthāṇu puruṣaḥ vā iti saṃśaya utpattau śiraḥ pāṇi ādi darśanāt puruṣaḥ eva ayam iti avadhāraṇa jñānam pratyakṣa nirṇayaḥ viṣāṇa mātra darśanāt gauḥ gavayaḥ vā iti saṃśaya utpattau sāsnā mātra darśanāt gauru eva ayam iti avadhāraṇa jñānam anumāna nirṇayaḥ iti

liṅga darśana icchā anusmaraṇa ādi apekṣāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt paṭvā abhyāsa ādara pratyaya janitāt ca saṃskārāt dṛṣṭa śruta anubhūteṣu artheṣu śeṣa anuvyavasāya icchā anusmaraṇa dveṣa hetuḥ atīta viṣayā smṛtiḥ iti

āmnāya vidhātṝṇām ṛṣīṇām atīta anāgata vartamāneṣu atīndriyeṣu artheṣu dharma ādiṣu grantha upanibaddheṣu anupanibaddheṣu ca ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt dharma viśeṣāt ca yat prātibham yathārtha nivedanam jñānam utpadyate tadā ārṣam iti ācakṣate tat tu prastāreṇa deva ṛṣīṇām kadācid eva laukikānām yathā kanyakā bravīti śvas me bhātā aaganti hṛdayam me kathayati iti

siddha darśanam na jñāna antaram kasmāt prayatna pūrvakam aṃjana pāda lopa khaḍga gulikā ādi siddhānām dṛśya draṣṭṝṇām sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭeṣu artheṣu yat darśanam tat pratyakṣam eva atha divya antarikṣa bhaumānām prāṇinām graha nakṣatra sañcāra ādi nimittam dharma adharma vipāka darśanam iṣṭam tat api anumānam eva atha liṅga anapekṣam dhrama ādiṣu darśanam iṣṭam tat api pratyakṣa ārṣayoḥ anyatarasmin atarbhūtam iti evam buddhiḥ iti

anugraha lakṣaṇam sukham sraj ādi abhipreta viṣaya sānnidhye satīṣṭa upalabdhi indriya artha sannikarṣāt dharma ādi apekṣād ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt anugraha abhiṣvaṅga nayana ādi prasāda janakam utpadyate tat sukham atīteṣu viṣayeṣu smṛti jam anāgateṣu saṅkalpajam yat tu viduṣām asatu viṣaya anusmaraṇa īchā saṅkalpeṣu āvirbhavati tat vidyā śama santoṣa dharma viśeṣa nimittam iti

upaghāta lakṣaṇam duḥkham viṣa ādi anabhipreta viṣaya sānnidhye satya niṣṭa upalabdhi indriya artha sannikarṣāt adharma ādi apekṣād ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt yat amarṣa upaghāta dainya nimittam utpadyate tat duḥkham atīteṣu sarpa vyāghrā caura ādiṣu smṛti jam anāgateṣu saṅkalpa jam iti

sva artham para artham vā aprapta prārthanā icchā sā ca ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt sukha ādi apekṣāt smṛti apekṣāt vā utpadyate prayatna smṛti dhama adharma hetuḥ kāmaḥ abhilāṣaḥ rāgaḥ saṅkalpaḥ kāruṇyam vairāgyam upadhā bhāvaḥ iti evam ādaye icchā bhedāḥ maithuna icchā kāmaḥ abhyavahāra icśā abhilāṣaḥ punar punar viṣaya anuraṃjana icchā rāgaḥ anāsanna kriyā icchā saṅkalpaḥ sva artham anapekṣya para duḥkha prahāṇa icchā kāruṇyam doṣa darśanāt viṣayati āga icchā vairāgyam para vañcana icchā upadhā antar nigūḍha icchā bhāvaḥ cikīrṣā ajihīrṣā iti ādi kriyā bhedāt icchā bhedāḥ bhavanti

prajvalana ātmakaḥ dveṣaḥ yasmin sati prajvalitam iva ātmānam manyate sa dveṣaḥ sa ca ātam manasoḥ saṃyogāt duḥkha apekṣāt smṛti apekṣāt vā utpadyate prayatna smṛti dharma adharma hetuḥ krodhaḥ drohaḥ manyuḥ akṣam āmarṣaḥ iti dveṣa bhedāḥ

prayatnaḥ saṃrambhaḥ utsāhaḥ iti prayāyāḥ sat vividhaḥ jīvana pūrvaḥ icchā dveṣa pūrvakaḥ ca tatra jīvana pūrvakaḥ suptasya prāṇa apāna santāna prerakaḥ prabodha kāle ca antaḥkaraṇasya indriya antara prāpti hetuḥ asya jīvana pūrvakasya ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt dharma adharma apekṣāt utpattiḥ itaraḥ tu hita ahita prāpti parhihāra samarthasya vyāpārasya hetuḥ śarīra vidhārakaḥ ca sa ca ātam manasoḥ saṃyogāt icchā pekṣāt dveṣa apekṣāt vā utpadyate
guru tvam jala bhūmyoḥ patana karma kāraṇam apratyakṣam patana karma anumeyam saṃyoga prayatna sāṃskāra virodhi asya ca ābādi paramāṇu rūpa ādi vat nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ

drava tvam syandana karma kāraṇam tri dravya vṛtti tat tu dvividham sāṃsiddhakam naimittikam ca sāṃsiddhikam apām viśeṣa guṇaḥ naimittikam pṛthivī tejasoḥ sāmānya guṇaḥ sāṃsiddhikasya guru tva vat nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ saṅghāta darśanāt sāṃsiddhikam ayuktam iti ced na divyena tejasā saṃyuktānām āpyānām paramāṇūnām parasparam saṃyogaḥ dravya ārambhakaḥ saṅghāta ākhyaḥ tena paramāṇu drava tva pratibandhāt kārye himakaraka ādau drava tva anupattiḥ

naimittikam ca pṛthivī tejasoḥ agni saṃyoga jam katham sarpiḥ jatu madhūcchiṣṭa ādīnām kāraṇeṣu paramāṇuṣu agni saṃyogāt vega apekṣāt karma utpattau tad jebhyaḥ vibhāgebhyaḥ dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśāt kārya dravya nivṛttau agni saṃyogāt auṣṇya apekṣāt svatantreṣu paramāṇuṣu drava tvam utpadyate tatas teṣu bhoginām adṛṣṭa apekṣāt ātmā aṇu saṃyogāt karma utpattau tad jebhyaḥ saṃyogebhyaḥ dyūṇuka ādi prakrameṇa kārya dravyam utpadyate tasmin ca rūpa ādi utpatti sama kālam kāraṇa guṇa prakrameṇa drava tvam utpadyate iti
snehaḥ apām viśeṣa guṇaḥ saṃgraha mṛjā ādi hetuḥ asya api guru tva vat nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ

saṃskāraḥ trividhaḥ vegaḥ bhāvanā sthiti sthāpakaḥ ca tatra vegaḥ mūrtimatsu pañcasu dravyeṣu nimitta viśeṣa apekṣāt karmaṇaḥ jāyate niyata dikkriyā prabandha hetuḥ sparśavat dravya saṃyoga viśeṣa virodhī kvacid kāraṇa guṇa pūrva krameṇa utpadyate bhāvanā saṃjñakaḥ tu ātma guṇaḥ dṛṣṭa śruta anubhūteṣu artheṣu smṛti pratyabhijñāna hetuḥ bhavati jñānam at aduḥkha ādi virodhī paṭu abhyāsa ādara pratyaya jaḥ paṭu pratyaya apekṣāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt āścarye arthe paṭuḥ saṃskāra atiśayaḥ jāyate yathā dākṣiṇāti asya uṣṭra darśanāt iti vidyā śilpa vyāyāma ādiṣu abhyasyamāneṣu tasmin eva arthe pūrva pūrva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇāt uttarottarasmāt pratyayāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt saṃskāra atiśayaḥ jāyate

prayatnena manaḥ cakṣuṣi sthāpayitvā apūrvam artham didūkṣamāṇasya vidyut sampāta darśana vat ādara pratyayaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt saṃskāra atiśayaḥ jāyate yathā devahradeḥ ājata sauvarṇa padma darśanāt iti sthiti sthāpakaḥ tu sparśa vat dravyeṣu vartamānaḥ ghana avayava sanniveśa viśiṣṭeṣu kāla antara avasthāyiṣu sva āśrayam anyathā akṛtam yathā avasthitam sthāpayati sthāvara jaṅgama vikāreṣu dhanuḥ śākhā śṛṅga danta asthi sūtra vastra ādiṣu bhugna saṃvartiteṣu sthiti sthāpakasya kāryam saṃlakṣyate nitya anitya tva niṣpattayosya api guru tva vat

dharmaḥ puruṣa guṇaḥ kartuḥ priya hita mokṣa hetuḥ atīndiḥ yaḥ antya sukha saṃvijñāna virodhī puruṣa antaḥkaraṇa saṃyoga viśuddha abhisandhi jaḥ varṇa āśramiṇām pratiniyata sādhana nimittaḥ tasya tu sādhanāni śruti smṛti vihitāni varṇa āśramiṇām sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvena avasthitāni dravya guṇa karmāṇi tatra sāmānyāni dharme śraddhā ahiṃsā bhūta hita tvam satya vacanam asteyam brahamacaryam anupadhā krodha varjanam abhiṣecanam śici dravya sevanam viśiṣṭa devatā bhaktiḥ upavāsaḥ apramādaḥ ca brāhmaṇa kṣaciya vaiśyānām ijyā adhyayana dānāni brāhmaṇasya viśiṣṭāni pratigraha adhyāpana yājanāni sva varṇa vihitāḥ ca saṃskārāḥ kṣatriyasya samyak prajā pālanam asādhu nigrahaḥ yuddheṣu anivartanam svakīyāḥ ca saṃskārāḥ vaiśyasya kriya vikraya kṛṣi paśu pālanāni svakīyāḥ ca saṃskārāḥ śūdrasya pūrva varṇa pāratantryam amantrikāḥ ca kriyāḥ āśramiṇām tu brahmacāriṇaḥ guru kula nivāsinaḥ sva śāstra vihitāni guru śuśrūṣā agni indhana bhaikṣya ācaraṇāni madhu māṃsa divāsvapna aṃjana abhyañjana ādi varjanam ca

vidyā vrata snātakasya kṛta dārasya gṛhasthasya śālīnayāya avara vṛtti upārjitaiḥ arthaiḥ bhūta manuṣya deva pitṛ brahma ākhyānām pañcānām mahāyajñānam sāyam prātar anuṣṭhānam eka agni vidhānena pākayajña saṃsthānām ca nityānām śaktau vidyamānāyām agni ādheya ādīnām ca haviḥ yajña saṃsthānām agniṣṭoma ādīnām soma yajña saṃsthānām ca ṛtu antareṣu brahmacaryam apatya utpādanam ca brahmacāriṇaḥ gṛhasthasya vā grāmāt nirgatasya vana vāsaḥ valkaka ajina keśa śmaśru nakha roma dhāraṇam ca vanya huta atithi śeṣa bhojanāni vānaprasthasya trayāṇām anyatamasya śraddhāvataḥ sarva bhūtebhyaḥ nityam abhayam dattvā samnyasya svāni karmāṇi yama niyameṣu apramattasya ṣaṭpadārtha prasaṃkhyānāt yoga prasādhanam pravrajitasya iti dṛṣṭam prayojanam anuddiśya etāni sādhanāni bhāva prasādam ca apekṣyātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt dharma utpattiḥ iti

adharmaḥ api ātma guṇaḥ kartuḥ ahita pratyavāya hetuḥ atīndriyaḥ antya duḥkha saṃvijñāna virodhī tasya tu sādhanāni śāstre pratiṣiddhāni dharma sādhana viparītāni hiṃsā anṛta steya ādīni vihita akaraṇam pramādaḥ ca etāni duṣṭa abhisandhim ca apekṣyātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt adharmasya utpattiḥ

aviduṣaḥ rāga dveṣavataḥ pravartakāt dharmāt prakṛṣṭāt su alpa adharma sahitāt brahma indra prajāpati pitṛ manuṣya lokeṣu āśaya anurūpaiḥ iṣṭa śarīra indriya viṣaya sukha ādibhiḥ yogaḥ bhavati tathā prakṛṣṭāt adharmāt su alpa dharma sahitāt preta tiryagyoni sthāneṣu aniṣṭa śarīra indriya viṣaya duḥkhābhiḥ yogaḥ bhavati evam pravṛtti lakṣaṇāt dharmāt adharma sahitāt deva manuṣya tiryak nārakeṣu punar punar saṃsāra bandhaḥ bhavati

jñāna pūrvakāt tu kṛtāt asaṃkalpita phalāt viśuddhe kule jātasya duḥkha vigama upāya jijñāsoḥ ācāryam upasaṅgamya utpanna ṣaṭpadārtha tattva jñānasya ajñāna nivṛttau viraktasya rāga dveṣa ādi abhāvāt tad jayoḥ dharma adharmayoḥ anutpattau pūrva sañcitayoḥ ca upabhogān nirodhe santoṣa sukham śarīra paricchedam ca utpadya rāga ādi nivṛttau nivṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ kevalaḥ dharmaḥ parama artha darśana jam sukham kṛtvā nivartate tadā nirodhāt nirbījasyāt manaḥ śarīra ādi nivṛttiḥ punar śarīra ādi anutpattau dagdha indhana anala vat upaśamaḥ mokṣaḥ iti

śabdaḥ ambara guṇaḥ śrotra grāhyaḥ kṣaṇikaḥ kārya kāraṇa ubhaya virodhī saṃyoga vibhāga śabda jaḥ pradeśa vṛttiḥ samāna asamāna jātīya kāraṇaḥ sa dvividhaḥ varṇa lakṣaṇaḥ dhvani lakṣaṇaḥ ca tatra akāra ādiḥ varṇa lakṣaṇaḥ śaṅkha ādi nimittaḥ dhvani lakṣaṇaḥ ca tatra varṇa lakṣaṇasya utpattiḥ ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt smṛti apekṣād varṇa uccāraṇa icchā tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma vāyu saṃyogāt vāyau karma jāyate sa ca ūrdhvam gacchan kaṇṭha ādīn abhihanti tatas sthāna vāyu saṃyoga apekṣamāṇāt sthāna ākāśa saṃyogāt varṇa utpattiḥ

avarṇa lakṣaṇaḥ api bherī daṇḍa saṃyoga apekṣāt bherī ākāśa saṃyogāt utpadyate veṇu parva vibhāgāt veṇu ākāśa vibhāgāt ca śabdāt ca saṃyoga vibhāga niṣpannāt vīcī santāna vat śabda santānaḥ iti evamṇ santānena śrotra pradeśam āgatasya grahaṇam śrotra śabdayoḥ gamana āgamana abhāvāt aprāptasya grahaṇam na asti prariśeṣāt santāna siddhiḥ iti
atha karma padārtha nirūpaṇam

utkṣepaṇa ādīnām pañcānām api karma tva sambandhaḥ eka dravyavat tvam kṣaṇika tvam mūrta dravya vṛtti tvam aguṇavat tvam guru tva drava tva prayatna saṃyoga ja tvam sva kārya saṃyoga virodhi tvam saṃyoga vibhāga nirapekṣa kāraṇa tvam asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam sva para āśraya samaveta kārya ārambhaka tvam samāna jātīya anārambhaka tvam dravya anārambhaka tvam ca pratiniyata jāti yogi tvam diś viśiṣṭa kārya ārambhaka tvam ca viśeṣaḥ

tatra utkṣepaṇam śarīra avayaveṣu tat sambaddheṣu ca yat ūrdhva bhāgibhiḥ pradeśaiḥ saṃyoga kāraṇam adhas bhāgbhiḥ ca pradeśaiḥ vibhāga kāraṇam karma utpadyate guru tva prayatna saṃyogebhyaḥ tat utkṣepaṇam tat viparīta saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇam karma apakṣepaṇam

ṛjunaḥ dravyasya agrā ayvānām tat deśaiḥ vibhāgaḥ saṃyogaḥ ca mūla pradeśaiḥ yena karmaṇā avayavī kuṭilaḥ saṃjāyate tat ākuñcanam tad viprayayeṇa saṃyoga vibhāga utpattau yena karmaṇā avayavī ṛjuḥ sampadyate tat prasāraṇam
yat aniyata diś pradeśa saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇam tat gamanam iti

etat pañcavidham api karma śarīra avayaveṣu tat sambaddheṣu ca sat pratyayam asat pratyayam ca yat anyat tat apratyayam eva teṣu anyeṣu ca tat gamanam iti karmaṇām jāti pañcaka tvam ayuktaṃgamanā viśeṣāt sarvam hi kṣaṇikam karma gamana mātram utpannam sva āśrayasya ūrdhvam adhiḥ tiryak vā api aṇu mātraiḥ pradeśaiḥ saṃyoga vibhāgātn karoti sarvatra gamana pratyayaḥ avusiṣṭaḥ tasmāt gamanam eva sarvam iti na vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti darśanāt iha utkṣepaṇam para tra apakṣepaṇam iti evam ādi sarvatra vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛttī dṛṣṭe tat dhetuḥ sāmānya viśeṣa bhedaḥ avagamyate

teṣām udādi upasarga viśeṣāt pratiniyata diś viśiṣṭa kārya ārambha tvāt upalakṣaṇa bhedaḥ api siddhaḥ evam api pañca eva iti avadhāraṇa anupapattiḥ niṣkrāmaṇa praveśana ādiṣu api vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti darśanāt yadi utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu sarvatra vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti darśanāt jāti bhedaḥ iṣyate evam ca niṣkramaṇa praveśana ādiṣu api kārya bhedāt teṣu pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛttī iti ced naḥ utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu api kārya bhedāt eva pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti prasaṅgaḥ

atha samāne vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti sadbhāve utkṣepaṇa ādīnām eva jāti bhedaḥ na niṣkramaṇa ādīnām iti atra viśeṣa hetuḥ asti iti na jāti saṅkara prasaṅgāt niṣkramaṇa ādīnām jāti bhedāt pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛttau jāti saṅkaraḥ prasajyate katham dvayoḥ draṣṭroḥ ekasmāt apavarakāt apavaraka antaram gacchataḥ yugapad niṣkramaṇa praveśana pratyayau dṛṣṭau tathā dvāra pradeśe praviśati niṣkrāmati iti ca yadā tu pratisīra ādi apanītam bhavati tadā na praveśana pratyayaḥ na api niṣkramaṇa pratyayaḥ kin tu gamana pratyayaḥ eva bhavati

tathā nālikāyām vaṃśa pattra ādau patati bahūnām draṣṭṝṇām yugapad bhramaṇa patana praveśana pratyayāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ iti jāti saṅkara prasaṅgaḥ na ca evam utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu pratyaya saṅkaraḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasmāt utkṣepaṇa ādīnām eva jāti bhedāt pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛttī niṣkramaṇa ādīnām tu kārya bhedāt iti katham yugapad prayaya bhedaḥ iti ced atha matam yathā jāti saṅkaraḥ na asit evam aneka karma samāveśaḥ api na asti iti ekasmin karmaṇi yugapad draṣṭṝṇām bhramaṇa patana praveśana pratyayāḥ katham bhavanti iti atra brūmaḥ na avayava a ayavinoḥ diś viśiṣṭa saṃyoga vibhāgānām bhedāt

yaḥ hi draṣṭā avayavānām pārśvatas paryāyeṇa diś pradeśaiḥ saṃyoga vibhāgān paśyati tasya bhramaṇa pratyayaḥ bhavati yaḥ hi avayavini ūrdhva pradeśaiḥ vibhāgam adhas saṃyogam ca avekṣate tasya patana pratyayaḥ bhavati yaḥ punar nālikā antar deśe saṃyogam bahis deśe ca vibhāgam paśyati tasya praveśana pratyayaḥ bhavati iti siddhaḥ kārya bhedāt niṣkramaṇa ādīnām pratyaya bhedaḥ iti bhavatu utkṣepaṇa ādīnām jāti bhedāt pratyaya bhedaḥ niṣkramaṇa ādīnām tu kārya bhedāt iti

atha gamana tvam kim karma tva paryāyaḥ āhosvit aparam sāmānyam iti kutas te saṃśayaḥ samaḥ teṣu utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu karma pratyaya vat gamana pratyaya aviśeṣāt karma tva paryāyaḥ iti gamyate yatas tu utkṣepaṇa ādi vat viśeṣa saṃjñayā abhihitam tasmāt aparam sāmānyam syāt iti na karma tva paryāya tvāt ātma tva puruṣa tva vat karma tva paryāyaḥ eva gamana tvam iti atha viśeṣa saṃjñayā kim artham gamana grahaṇam kṛtam iti na bhramaṇa ādi avarodha artha tvāt utkṣepaṇa ādi śabdaiḥ anavaruddhānām bhramaṇa patana spandana ādīnām avarodha artham gamana grahaṇam kṛtam iti anyathā hi yāni eva catvāri viśeṣa saṃjñayā uktāni tāni eva sāmānya viśeṣa saṃjñā viṣayāṇi prasajyeran iti athavā astu aparam sāmānyam gamana tvam aniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇeṣu bhramaṇa ādiṣu eva vartate gamana śabda ḥ ca utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu bhāktaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ sva āśraya saṃyoga vibhāga kartṛ tva sāmānyāt iti

sat pratyaya karma vidhiḥ katham cikīrṣiteṣu yajña adhyayana dāna kṛṣi ādiṣu yadā hastam utkṣeptum icchati apakṣeptum vā tadā hastavatī ātma pradeśe prayatnaḥ saṃjāyate tam prayatnam gurutvā ca upekṣamāṇāt ātma hasta saṃyogāt dhaste karma bhavati hasta vat sarva śarīra avayaveṣu pāda ādiṣu śarīre ca iti tat sambaddheṣu api katham yadā hastena musalam gṛhītvā icchām karoti utkṣipāmi hastena musalam iti tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣa maṇād ātma hasta saṃyogāt yasmin eva kāle haste utkṣepaṇa karma utpadyate tasmin eva kāle tam eva prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt dhasta musala saṃyogāt musale api karma iti

tatas dūram utkṣipte musale tad artha icchā nivartate punar api apakṣepaṇa icchā utpadyate tad anataram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt yathā uktāt saṃyogāt dhasta musalayoḥ yugapad apakṣepaṇa karmaṇī bhavataḥ tatas antyena musala karmaṇā ulūkhala musalayoḥ abhighāta ākhyaḥ saṃyogaḥ kriyate sa saṃyogaḥ musala gata vegam apekṣamāṇaḥ apratyayam musale utpatana karma karoti tat karma abhighāta apekṣam musale saṃskāram ārabhate tam apekṣya musala hasta saṃyogaḥ aprayayam hate api utpatana karma karoti yadi api prāktanaḥ saṃskāraḥ vinaṣṭaḥ tathā api musala ulūkhalayoḥ saṃyogaḥ paṭu karma utpādakaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣa bhāvāt tasya saṃskāra ārambhe sācivya samarthaḥ bhavati athavā prāktanaḥ eva paṭuḥ saṃskāraḥ abhighātāt avinaśyan avasthitaḥ iti atas saṃskāravati punar saṃskāra ārambhaḥ na asti atas yasmin kāle saṃskāra apekṣāt abhighātāt aprayayam musale utpatana karma tasmin eva kāle tam eva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇāt musala hasta saṃyogāt apratyayam haste api utpatana karma iti

pāṇim ukteṣu gamana vidhiḥ katham yadā tomaram hastena gṛhītvā utkṣeptum icchā utpadyate tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt yathā uktāt saṃyoga dvayāt tomara hastayoḥ yugapad ākarṣaṇa karmaṇī bhavataḥ prasārite ca haste tad ākarṣaṇa arthaḥ prayatnaḥ nivartate tad anantaram tiryak ūrdhva dūram āsannam vā kṣipāmi iti icchā saṃjāyate tad anantaram tat nurūpaḥ prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇaḥ tomara hasta saṃyogaḥ nodana ākhyaḥ tasmāt tomare karma utpannam nodana apekṣam tasmin saṃskāram ārabhate tatas saṃskāra nodanābhyām tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvat dhasta tomara vibhāgaḥ iti tatas vibhāgāt nodane nivṛtte saṃskārāt ūrdhvam tiryak dūram āsannam vā prayatna anurūpāṇi karmāṇi bhavanti āpatanāt iti

tathā yantram ukteṣu gaman vidhiḥ katham yaḥ balavān kṛta vyāyāmaḥ vāmena kareṇa dhanuḥ viṣṭabhya dakṣiṇena śaram sandhāya sa śarām jyām muṣṭinā gṛhītvā ākarṣaṇa icchām karoti sajyeṣu ākarṣayāmi etat dhanuḥ iti tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma hasta saṃyogāt ākarṣaṇa karma haste yadā eva utpadyate tadā eva tam eva prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt dhasta jyā śara saṃyogāt jyāyām śare ca karma prayatna viśiṣṭa hasta jyā śara saṃyogam apekṣamāṇābhyām jyā koṭi saṃyogābhyām karmaṇī bhavataḥ dhanuṣkoṭyoḥ iti etat sarvam yugapad

evam ākarṇāt ākṛṣṭe dhanuṣi na atas param anena gantavyam iti yat jñānam tatas tat ākarśaṇa arthasya prayatnasya vināśaḥ tatas punar mokṣaṇa icchā saṃjāyate tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma aṅguli saṃyogāt aṅguli karma tasmāt jyā aṅguli vibhāgaḥ tatas vibhāgāt saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin vinaṣṭe pratibandhaka abhāvāt yadā dhaṇuṣi vartamānaḥ sthiti sthāpakaḥ saṃskāraḥ maṇḍalībhūtam dhanuḥ yathā avasthitam sthāpayati tadā tam eva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇāt dhanuḥ jyā saṃyogāt jyāyām śare ca karma utpadyate tatsu akāraṇa apekṣam jyāyām saṃskāram karoti tam apekṣamāṇaḥ iṣu jyā saṃyogaḥ nodanam tasmāt iṣau ādyam karma nodana apekṣam iṣau saṃskāram ārabhate

tasmāt saṃskārān nodana sahāyāt tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvat iṣujyā vibhāgaḥ vibhāgāt nivṛtte nodane karmāṇi uttara uttarāni iṣu saṃskārāt eva āpatanāt iti bahūni karmāṇi kramaśas kasmāt saṃyoga bahu tvāt ekaḥ tu saṃskāraḥ antarāle karmaṇaḥ apekṣā kāraṇa abhāvāt iti evam ātma adhiṣṭhiteṣu sat pratyayam asat prayayam ca karma uktam

anadhiṣṭhiteṣu bāhyeṣu caturṣu mahābhūteṣu apratyayam karma gamanam eva nodana ādibhyaḥ bhavati tatra nodanam guru tva drava tva vega prayatnān samastavyaḥ tān apekṣamāṇaḥ yaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ nodanam avibhāga hetoḥ ekasya karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam tasmāt caturṣu api mahābhūteṣu karma bhavati yathā paṅka ākhyāyām pṛthivyām vega apekṣaḥ yaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāḥ vibhāga hetoḥ ekasya karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam saḥ abhighātaḥ tasmāt api caturṣu mahābhūteṣu karma bhavati yathā pāṣāṇa ādiṣu niṣṭhure vastuni abhipatiteṣu tathā pāda ādibhiḥ nudyamānāyām abhihanyamānāyām vā paṅka ākhyāyām pṛthivyām yaḥ saṃyogaḥ nodana abhighātayoḥ anyatara apekṣaḥ ubhaya apekṣaḥ vā sa saṃyukta saṃyogaḥ tasmāt api pṛthivī ādiṣu karma bhavati ye ca pradeśāḥ na nudyante na api abhihanyante teṣu api karma jāyate pṛthivī udakayoḥ guru tva vidhāraka saṃyoga prayatna vega abhāve sati guru tvāt yat adhas gamanam tat patanam yathā musala śarīra ādiṣu uktam tatra ādyam guru tvāt dvitīya ādīni tu guru tva saṃskārābhyām

srotaḥ bhūtānām apām sthalāt nimna abhisarpaṇam yat tat drava tvāt syandanam katham samantāt rodhaḥ saṃyogena avayavi drava tvam pratibaddham avayava drava tvam api eka artha samavetam tena eva pratibaddham uttara uttara avayava drava tvāni saṃyukta saṃyogaiḥ pratibaddhāni yadā tu mātrayā setu bhedaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati tadā samantāt pratibaddha tvāt avayavi drava tu asya kārya ārambhaḥ na asti setu samīpa sthasya avayava drava tu asya uttarottareṣām avayava drava tvānām pratibandhaka abhāvāt vṛtti lābhaḥ tatas kramaśas saṃyuktānām eva abhisarpaṇam tatas pūrva dravya vināśe sati prabandhena avasthitaiḥ avayaviḥ dīrgham dravyam ārabhyate tatra ca kāraṇa guṇa pūrva krameṇa drava tvam utpadyate tatra ca kāraṇānām saṃyuktānām prabandhena gamane yat avayavini karma utpadyate tat syandana ākhyam iti

saṃskārāt karm aiṣu ādiṣu uktam tathā cakra ādiṣu avayavānām pārśvatas pratiniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga utpattau yat avayavinaḥ saṃskārāt aniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga nimittam karma tat bhramaṇam iti evam ādayaḥ gamana viśeṣāḥ prāṇa ākhye tu vāyau karma ātma vāyu saṃyogāt icchā dveṣa pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt jāgrataḥ icchā anuvidhāna darśanāt suptasya tu jīvana pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt ākāśa kāla diś ātmanām sati api dravya bhāve niṣkriya tvam sāmānya ādi vat amūrta tvāt mūrtiḥ asarva gata dravya parimāṇam tat anuvidhāyinī ca kriyā sā ca ākāśa ādiṣu na asti tasmāt na teṣām kriyā sambandhaḥ asti iti

sa vigrahe manasi indriya antara sambandha artham jāgrataḥ karma ātma manaḥ saṃyogāt icchā dveṣa pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt anu abhiprāyam indriya antareṇa viṣaya antara upalabdhi darśanāt suptasya prabodha kāle jīvana pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt apasarpaṇa karma utpasarpaṇa karma ca ātma manaḥ saṃyogāt adṛṣṭa apekṣāt katham yadā jīvana sahakārinoḥ dharma adharmayoḥ upabhogāt prakṣayaḥ anyonya abhibhavaḥ vā tadā jīvana sahāyayoḥ vaikalyāt tad pūrvaka prayatna vaikalyāt prāṇa nirodhe sati anyābhyām labdha vṛttibhyām dharma adharmābhyām ātma manaḥ saṃyoga sahāyābhyām mṛta śarīrāt vibhāga kāraṇam apasarpaṇa karma utpadyate

tatas śarīrāt vahiḥ apagatam tābhyām eva dharma adharmābhyām samutpanena ativāhika śarīreṇa sambandhyate tad saṅkra antam ca svargam narakam vā agatvā āśaya anurūpeṇa śarīreṇa sambadhyate tad saṃyoga artham karma upasarpaṇam iti yoginām ca bahis udrecitasya manasaḥ abhipreta deśa gamanam pratyāgamanam ca tathā sarga kāle pratyagreṇa śarīreṇa sambandha artham karma adṛṣṭa kāritam evam anyat api mahābhūteṣu yat pratyakṣa anumānābhyām anupalabhyamāna kāraṇam upakāra apakāra samartham ca bhavati tat api adṛṣṭa kāritam yathā sarga ādau aṇu karma agni vāyvoḥ ūrdhva tiryak gamane mahābhūtānām prakṣebhaṇam abhiṣiktānām maṇīnām taskaram prati gamanam ayasaḥ ayaskānta abhisarpaṇam ca iti

atha sāmānya padārtha nirūpaṇam sāmānyam dvividham param aparam ca sva viṣaya sarva gatam abhinna ātmakam aneka vṛtti eka dvi bahuṣu ātma svarūpa anugama pratyaya kāri svarūpa abhedena ādhāreṣu prabandhena vartamānam anuvṛtti pratyaya kāraṇam katham pratipiṇḍam sāmānya apekṣam prabandhena jñāna utpattau abhyāsa pratyaya janitāt ca saṃskārāt atīta jñāna prabandha pratyavekṣaṇāt yat anugatam asti tat sāmānyam iti tatra sat tāsā nyam param anuvṛtti pratyaya kāraṇam eva yathā paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu carma vastra kambala ādiṣu ekasma anila dravya abhisambandhāt nīlam nilam iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ tathā paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu dravya guṇa karmasu aviśiṣṭā sat sat iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ sā ca artha antarāt bhavitum arhati iti yat tat artha antaram sā sattā iti siddhā

sattā anusambandhāt sat sat iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ tasmāt sā sāmānyam eva aparam dravya tva guṇa tva karma tva ādi anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ ca bhavati tatra dravya tvam paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu pṛthivī ādiṣu anuvṛtti hetu tvāt sāmānyam guṇa karmabhyaḥ vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt viśeṣaḥ tathā guṇa tvam paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu rūpa ādiṣu anuvṛtti hetu tvāt sāmānyam dravya karmabhyaḥ vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt viśeṣaḥ tathā karma tvam paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu anuvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt sāmānyam dravya guṇebhyaḥ vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt viśeṣaḥ evam pṛthivī tva rūpa tva utkṣepaṇa tva go tva ghaṭa tva paṭa tva ādīnām api prāṇi aprāṇi gatānām anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvaḥ siddhaḥ etāni tu dravya tva ādīni prabhūta viṣaya tvāt prādhānyena sāmānyāni sva āśraya viśeṣaka tvāt bhaktyā viśeṣa ākhyāni iti

lakṣaṇa bhedāt eṣām dravya guṇa karmabhyaḥ padārtha antara tvam siddham atas eva ca nitya tvam dravya ādiṣu vṛtti niyamāt pratyaya bhedāt ca parasparataḥ ca anya tvam pratyekam sva āśrayeṣu lakṣaṇa aviśeṣāt viśeṣa lakṣaṇa abhāvāt ca eka tvam yadi api aparicchinna deśāni sāmānyāni bhavanti tathā api upalakṣaṇa niyamāt kāraṇa sāmagrī niyamāt ca sva viṣaya sarva gatāni antarāle ca saṃyoga samavāya vṛtti abhāvāt avyapadeśyāni iti

atha viśeṣa padārtha nirūpaṇam anteṣu bhavāḥ antyāḥ sva āśraya viśeṣaka tvāt viśeṣāḥ vināśa ārambha rahiteṣu nitya dravyeṣu aṇu ākāśa kāla diś ātma manassu pratidravyam ekaikaśas vartamānāḥ atyanta vyāvṛtti buddhi hetavaḥ yathā asmadīnām gavā ādiṣu aśva ādibhyaḥ tulya ākṛti guṇa kriyā avayava saṃyoga nimittā pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā gauḥ śuklaḥ śīghra gatiḥ pīnaka kudmāt mahā ghaṇṭaḥ iti tathā asmad viśiṣṭānām yoginām nityeṣu tulya ākṛti guṇa kriyeṣu paramāṇuṣu mukta ātma manassu ca anya nimitta asambhavāt yebhyaḥ nimittebhyaḥ pratyādhāram vilakṣaṇaḥ ayam vilakṣaṇaḥ ayam iti pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ deśa kāla viprakarṣe ca paramāṇau saḥ eva ayam iti pratyabhijñānam ca bhavati te antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ

yadi punar antya viśeṣam antareṇa yoginām yoga jāt dharmāt pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ pratyabhijñānam ca syāt tatas kim syāt na evam bhavati yathā na yoga jāt dharmāt aśukle śukla pratyayaḥ saṃjāyate atyanta adṛṣṭe ca pratyabhijñānam yadi syāt mithyā bhavet tathā iha api antya viśeṣam antareṇa yoginām na yoga jāt dharmāt pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ pratyabhijñānam vā bhavitum arhati atha antya viśeṣeṣu iva paramāṇuṣu kasmāt na svatas pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ kalpyate iti ced na tādātmyāt iha atad ātmakeṣu anya nimittaḥ pratyayaḥ bhavati yathā ghaṭa ādiṣu pradīpāt na tu pradīpe pradīpa antarāt yathā gavāśva māṃsa ādīnām svatas eva aśuci tvam tad yogāt anyeṣām tathā iha api tādātmyāt antya viśeṣeṣu svatas eva pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ tad yogāt paramāṇu ādiṣu iti

atha samavāya padārtha nirūpaṇam ayutasiddhānām ādhārya ādhāra bhūtānām yaḥ sambandhaḥ ihapratyaya hetuḥ sa samavāyaḥ dravya guṇa karma sāmānya viśeṣāṇām kārya kāraṇa bhūtānām akārya kāraṇa bhūtānām vā ayuta siddhānām ādhārya ādhāra bhāvena avasthitānām iha idam iti buddhiḥ yatas bhavati yatas ca asarva gatānām adhigata anyatvānām aviṣvagbhāvaḥ sa samavāya ākhyaḥ sambandhaḥ katham yathā iha kuṇḍe dadhīti pratyayaḥ sambandhe sati dṛṣṭaḥ tathā iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iha vīraṇeṣu kaṭaḥ iha dravye guṇakaṃraṇī iha dravya guṇa karmasu sattāḥ iha dravye dravya tvam iha guṇe guṇa tvam iha karmaṇi karma tvam iha nitya dravye antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ iti pratyaya darśanāt asti eṣām sambandhaḥ iti jñāyate

na ca asau saṃyogaḥ sam bandhinām ayutasiddha tvāt anyatara karma ādi nimitta asambhavāt vibhāga anta tva adarśanāt adhikaraṇa adhikartavyayoḥ eva bhāvāt iti sa ca dravya ādibhyaḥ padārtha antaram bhāva vat lakṣaṇa bhedāt yathā bhāvasya dravya tva ādīnām sva ādhāreṣu ātma anurūpa pratyaya kartṛ tvāt sva āśraya ādibhyaḥ parasparataḥ ca artha antara bhāvaḥ tathā samavāyasya api pañcasu padārtheṣu iha iti pratyaya darśanāt tebhyaḥ padārtha antara tvam iti na ca saṃyoga vat nānātvam bhāva vat liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt ca tasmāt bhāva vat sarvatra ekaḥ samavāyaḥ iti

nanu yadi ekaḥ samavāyaḥ dravya guṇa karmaṇām dravya tva guṇa tva karma tva ādi viśeṣaṇaiḥ saha sambandha eka tvāt padārtha saṅkara prasaṅgaḥ iti naḥ ādhāra ādheya niyamāt yadi api ekaḥ samavāyaḥ sarvatra svatantraḥ tathā api ādhāra ādheya niyamaḥ asti katham dravyeṣu eva dravya tvam guṇeṣu eva guṇa tvam karmasu eva karma tvam iti evam ādi kasmāt anvaya vyatireka darśanāt iha iti samavāya nimittasya jñānasya anvaya darśanāt sarvatra ekaḥ samavāyaḥ iti gamyate dravya tva ādi nimittānām vyatireka darśanāt pratiniyamaḥ jñāyate yathā kuṇḍa dadhnoḥ saṃyoga eka tve bhavati āśraya āśrayi bhāva niyamaḥ tathā dravya tva ādīnām api samavāya eka tve api vyaṅgya vyaṃjaka śakti bhedāt ādhāra ādheya niyamaḥ iti

sambandha nitya tve api na saṃyoga vat anitya tvam bhāva vat akāraṇa tvāt yathā pramāṇataḥ kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ nityaḥ bhāvaḥ iti uktam tathā samavāyaḥ api iti na hi asya kiñcid kāraṇam pramāṇataḥ upalabhyate iti kayā punar vṛttyā dravya ādiṣu samavāyaḥ vartate na saṃyogaḥ sambhavati tasya guṇa tvena dravya āśrita tvāt na api samavāyaḥ tasya ekatvāt na ca anyā vṛttiḥ asti iti na tādātmyāt yathā dravya guṇa karmaṇām sat ātmakasya bhāvasya na anyaḥ sattā yogaḥ asti evam avibhāginaḥ vṛtti ātmakasya samavāyasya na anyā vṛttiḥ asti tasmāt sva ātma vṛttiḥ atas eva atīndriyaḥ sattā ādīnām iva pratyakṣeṣu vṛtti abhāvāt sva ātma gata saṃvedana abhāvāt ca tasmāt ihabuddhi anumeyaḥ samavāyaḥ iti
yoga ācāra vibhūtyā yaḥ toṣayitvā maheśvaram cakre vaiśeṣikam śāstram tasmai kaṇabhuje namaḥ

namaḥ buddhāya pudgala dharma nairātmyayoḥ apratipanna vipratipannānām aviparīta pudgala dharma nairātmya pratipādana artham triṃśikā vijñapti prakaraṇa ārambhaḥ pudgala dharma nairātmya pratipādanam punar kleśa jñeya āvaraṇa prahāṇa artham tathā hi ātma dṛṣṭi prabhavāḥ rāga ādayaḥ kleśāḥ pudgala nairātmya avabodhaḥ ca sat kāya dṛṣṭeḥ pratipakṣa tvāt tad prahāṇāya pravartamānaḥ sarva kleśān prajahāti dharma nairātmya jñānāt api jñeya āvaraṇa pratipakṣa tvāt jñeya āvaraṇam prahīyate kleśa jñeya āvaraṇa prahāṇam api mokṣa sarvajña tva adhigama artham kleśāḥ hi mokṣa prāpteḥ āvaraṇam iti atas teṣu prahīṇeṣu mokṣaḥ adhigamyate jñeya āvaraṇam api sarvasmin jñeye jñāna pravṛtti pratibandha bhūtam akliṣṭam ajñānam tasmin prahīṇe sarva ākāre jñeye asaktam apratihatan ca jñānam pravartate iti atas sarvajña tvam adhigamyate

atha vā dharma pudgala abhiniviṣṭāḥ cittamātram yathābhūtam na jānanti iti atas dharma pudgala nairātmya pradarśanena saphale vijñaptimātre anupūrveṇa praveśa artham prakaraṇa ārambhaḥ atha vā vijñāna vat vijñeyam api dravyataḥ eva iti kecid manyante vijñeya vat vijñānam api saṃvṛtitaḥ eva na paramārthataḥ iti asya dvi prakārasya api ekānta vādasya pratiṣedha arthaḥ prakaraṇa ārambhaḥ

ātma dharma upacāraḥ hi vividhaḥ yaḥ pravartate loka śāstrayoḥ iti vākya śeṣaḥ vijñāna pariṇāme asau ātma dharma upacāraḥ iti saṃbadhyate ātmā dharmāḥ ca upacaryante iti ātma dharma upacāraḥ sa punar ātma prajñaptiḥ dharma prajñaptiḥ ca vividhaḥ iti aneka prakāraḥ ātmā jīvaḥ jantuḥ manujaḥ māṇavaḥ iti evam ādikaḥ ātma upacāraḥ skandhāḥ dhātavaḥ āyatanāni rūpam vedanā saṃjñā saṃskārāḥ vijñānam iti evamādikaḥ dharma upacāraḥ

ayam dvi prakāraḥ api upacāraḥ vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ eva na mukhye ātmani dharmeṣu ca iti kutas etat dharmāṇām ātmanaḥ ca vijñāna pariṇāmāt bahis abhāvāt kaḥ ayam pariṇāmaḥ nāma anyathātvam kāraṇa kṣaṇa nirodha sama kālaḥ kāraṇa kṣaṇa vilakṣaṇaḥ kāryasya ātma lābhaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tatra ātma ādi vikalpa vāsanā paripoṣāt rūpa ādi vikalpa vāsanā paripoṣāt ca ālaya vijñānāt ātma ādi nirbhāsaḥ vikalpaḥ rūpa ādi nirbhāsaḥ ca utpadyate tam ātma ādi nirbhāsam rūpa ādi nirbhāsan ca tasmāt vikalpāt bahis bhūtam iva upādāya ātmā ādi upacāraḥ rūpa ādi dharma upacāraḥ ca anādikālikaḥ pravartate vinā api bāhyena ātmanā dharmaiḥ ca tat yathā taimirikasya keśoṇḍukā ādi upacāraḥ iti yat ca yatra na asti tat tatra upacaryate tat yathā bāhīke gauḥ

evam vijñāna svarūpe bahis ca ātma dharma abhāvāt parikalpitaḥ eva ātmā dharmāḥ ca na tu paramārthataḥ santi iti vijñāna vat vijñeyam api dravyataḥ eva iti ayam ekānta vādaḥ na abhyupeyaḥ upacārasya ca nirādhārasya asaṃbhavāt avaśyam vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ vastutas asti iti upagantavyaḥ yatra ātma dharma upacāraḥ pravartate atas ca ayam abhyupagamaḥ na yukti kṣamaḥ vijñānam api vijñeya vat saṃvṛtitaḥ eva na paramārthataḥ iti saṃvṛtitaḥ api abhāva prasaṅgāt na hi saṃvṛtiḥ nirupādānā yujyate

tasmāt ayam ekānta vādaḥ dvi prakāraḥ api niryuktika tvāt tyājyaḥ iti ācārya vacanam evan ca sarvam vijñeyam parikalpita svabhāva tvāt vastutas na vidyate vijñānam punar pratītyasamutpanna tvāt dravyataḥ asti iti abhyupeyam pratītyasamutpanna tvam punar vijñānasya pariṇāma śabdena jñāpitam katham etat gamyate vinā bāhyena arthena vijñānam eva artha ākāram utpadyate iti bāhyaḥ hi arthaḥ sva ābhāsa vijñāna janaka tvena vijñānasya ālambana pratyayaḥ iṣyate na kāraṇa tva mātreṇa samanantara ādi pratyayāt viśeṣa aprasaṅgāt

sañcita ālambanāḥ ca pañca vijñāna kāyāḥ tad ākāra tvāt na ca sañcitam avayava saṃhati mātrāt anyat vidyate tad avayavān apohya sañcita ākāra vijñāna abhāvāt tasmāt vinā eva bāhyena arthena vijñānam sañcita ākāram utpadyate na ca paramāṇavaḥ eva saṃcitāḥ tasya ālambanam paramāṇūnām atadākāra tvāt na hi asañcita avasthātaḥ sañcita avasthāyām paramāṇūnām kaścid ātma atiśayaḥ tasmāt asañcita vat sañcitāḥ api paramāṇavaḥ na eva ālambanam

anyaḥ tu manyate ekaika paramāṇuḥ anya nirapekṣyaḥ atīndriyaḥ bahavaḥ tu paraspara apekṣāḥ indriya grāhyāḥ teṣām api sa apekṣa nirapekṣa avasthayoḥ ātma atiśaya abhāvāt ekāntena indriya grāhya tvam atīndriya tvam vā yadi ca paramāṇavaḥ eva paraspara apekṣāḥ vijñānasya viṣayībhavanti evam sati yaḥ ayam ghaṭa kuḍya ādi ākāra bhedaḥ vijñāne sa na syāt praramāṇūnām atadākāra tvāt na ca anya nirbhāsasya vijñānasya anya ākāraḥ viṣayaḥ yujyate ati prasaṅgāt na ca paramāṇavaḥ stambha ādi vat paramārthataḥ santi arvāk madhya para bhāga sadbhāvāt
