para artha tvāt ca para artham ca upamānam bhavati na hi yathā gauḥ evam gavayaḥ iti etat āgamam antareṇa sārūpya mātra parijñānam upamānam uktam na hi āgama mātram sārūpya parijñānam antareṇa upamānam bhavitum arhati na ca evam anumānam tasmāt yathā liṅga liṅgi saṃbandha smṛti anugrahe sati liṅga parāmarśaḥ anumānam tat ca pratyakṣam tathā āgama āhita saṃskāra smṛti apekṣam sārūpya pratyakṣam upamānam iti pratipatti bhedāt ca na anumānam evam bhavati yathā dhūmaḥ tathā agniḥ iti asti tu upamāne yathā gauḥ evam gavayaḥ iti yatra ca pratipatti bhedaḥ tat pramāṇa antaram yathā pratyakṣāt anumānam apūrvān adhigamāt upamānam na bhavati iti anena pratyuktam

atha avasara prāptaḥ śabdaḥ parīkṣyate kaḥ punar ayam śabdaḥ āpta upadeśaḥ śabdaḥ iti uktam tasya ākṣepaḥ na śabdaḥ pramāṇam sati api aprasiddheḥ yasmāt vidyamānaḥ api ayam śabdaḥ aśrūyamāṇaḥ na pratipatti hetuḥ pratipatti hetuḥ ca pramāṇam iti viṣaya abhāvāt ca na ca pratyakṣa anumāna viṣaya vyatirekī viṣayaḥ śabdasya asti na ca aviṣayam pramāṇam iti avijñāna ātmaka tvāt ca na pramāṇam yat pramāṇam tat vijñāna ātmakam pratyakṣa ādi avijñāna ātmakam ca na pramāṇam ghaṭāt bāhya karaṇa pratyakṣa tvāt ca ghaṭa ādi vat eva na pramāṇam ātmani asamavāyāt na ghaṭa ādi vat eva pramāṇam ākāśa guṇa tvāt tat saṃkhyā ādi vat na pramāṇam

yat tāvat sati api apramiteḥ iti tat na asiddha tvāt na hi kadā cit śabdaḥ upalabhyamāne na pramā bhavati anupalabhyamāne na bhavati iti na asau pramāṇam tadā pramāṇam hi nāma yena pramīyate kadā ca tena pramīyate yadā upalabhyate yat punar etat viṣaya abhāvāt iti kaḥ evam āha pratyakṣa anumāna vyatirekī viṣayaḥ na asti iti ayam api asiddhaḥ hetuḥ yathā ca pratyakṣa ādibhyaḥ viṣaya bhedaḥ tathā uktam yat punar etat avijñāna ātmaka tvāt bāhya karaṇa grāhya tvāt ātmani asamavāyāt ca iti na anekāntāt pradīpa vat pradīpe etat sarvam asti pramāṇam ca pradīpaḥ pratyakṣa aṅga tvāt iti uktam tasmāt anaikāntika tvāt ahetavaḥ eva iti yat punar etat ākāśa guṇa tvāt ayam api anaikāntikaḥ eva yathā ākāśe yat parimāṇam tat mahat pratyaya kartṛ tvāt pramāṇam bhavati tasmāt ākāśa guṇa tvāt iti ayam api ahetuḥ

anumānam śabdaḥ smṛti apekṣa tvāt yasya smṛti apekṣi tvam tat anumānam smṛti apekṣaḥ ca śabdaḥ artha pratyāyane tasmāt anumānam tri kāla viṣaya tvāt ca tri kāla viṣayam anumānam tathā ca śabdaḥ tasmāt anumānam anvaya vyatireka upapatteḥ ca yat anvayavyatireki tat anumānam dṛṣṭam yathā dhūma viśeṣa darśanam agni mat dhūma viśeṣa pratipattau tathā ca śabdaḥ anvaya vyatirekābhyām eva artham pratipādayati tasmāt anumānam itas ca śabdaḥ anumānam śabdaḥ anumānam arthasya anupalabdheḥ anumeya tvāt pratyakṣeṇa anupalabhyamāna artha viṣaya tvāt iti sūtra arthaḥ

itas ca anumānam upalabdheḥ at vipravṛtti tvāt pramāṇa antara bhāve upalabdhi bhedaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā pratyakṣe anumāne ca anyathā hi pratyakṣe upalabdhiḥ anyathā anumāne na tu evam śabde iti tasmāt na pramāṇa antaram
sambaddha artha pratipādaka tvāt ca iti sūtra arthaḥ sambaddha artha pratipādakam anumānam tathā ca śabdaḥ iti

yat tāvat smṛti apekṣa tvāt anumānam śabdaḥ iti tat na anaikāntika tvāt anumāne api smṛti apekṣi tvam asti yathā saṃśaye yathā tarke yathā upamāne iti etena tri kāla viṣaya tvam pratyuktam yat punar etat anvaya vyatireka upapatteḥ iti anvaya vyatireka upapattiḥ pratyakṣe api yathā yatra ghaṭaḥ tatra ghaṭa jñānan yatra na asti tatra tad abhāvaḥ iti yat punar etat anupalabhyamāna artha viṣaya tvāt iti satyam anupalabhyamāna artha viṣayam anumānam na punar svarga apūrva devatā ādi artheṣu laukikasya pratyakṣam anumānam vā api tu āpta upadeśa sāmarthyāt śabdāt artha saṃpratyayaḥ na hi ayam śabda mātrāt svarga ādīn pratipadyate kim tu puruṣa viśeṣa abhihita tvena pramāṇa tvam pratipadyate tathābhūtāt śabdāt svarga ādīn pratipadyate na ca evam anumāne tasmāt na anumānam śabdaḥ iti śabdam ca ullikhantī pratipattiḥ śabdāt na anumānāt iti etena advipravṛtti tvam vyākhyātam

yat punar etat sambandhāt ca iti asti śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ anujñātaḥ asti ca pratiṣiddhaḥ vācya vācaka bhāva lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ anujñātaḥ asya śabdasya ayam arthaḥ vācyaḥ iti yaḥ punar ayam svābhāvikaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ iti kaiḥ cit abhyupagamyate sa pratiṣiddhaḥ na svābhāvikaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ asti katham na asti pramāṇataḥ anupalabdheḥ tatra pratyakṣeṇa tāvat śabda artha saṃbandhasya anupalabdhiḥ atīndriya viṣaya tvāt yasmāt śabdasya atīndriyaḥ api arthaḥ viṣayaḥ tasmāt na pratyakṣeṇa upalabdhiḥ iti

anumānena upalapsyate iti ced na anumānena api vikalpa anupapatteḥ śabdaḥ vā artha deśam upasampadyate arthaḥ vā śabda deśam ubhayam vā na tāvat arthaḥ śabda deśam upasampadyate pūraṇa pradāha pāṭana anupalabdheḥ pūraṇa pradāha pāṭana anupalabdheḥ ca sambandha abhāvaḥ āsyaḥ eka deśa sthāna karaṇa uccāraṇīyaḥ śabdaḥ iti anna agni asi śabda uccāraṇe pūraṇa pradāha pāṭanāni gṛhyeran mūrtimān ca mahān padārthaḥ modaka ādiḥ gavā ādi vat āgacchan upalabhyeta tatas ca śabdena loka vyavahāraḥ ucchidyeta atha śabdaḥ artha antikam upasampadyate tasya api anupapattiḥ vyāghātāt nityaḥ ca śabdaḥ santāna vṛttyā ca āgacchati

iti vyāhatam atha naḥ āgacchati artha deśe eva bhavati iti nityaḥ ca bhavati ca iti anivṛttaḥ vyāghātaḥ sthāna karaṇa prayatna asambhavāt ca artha deśe na bhavati atha na gacchati na bhavati tatra vyajyate ekaḥ vitatya avasthitaḥ iti ced na sarva artha upalabdhi prasaṅgāt yadi sarva śabdāḥ eva vitatya avasthitāḥ sthāna karaṇa ādi nimitta sannidhāne sati vyajyante iti manyase sarva arthānām upalabdhiḥ prāptā yat ekasya śabdasya vyañjakam tat śabda antarāṇām api iti vitatya avasthitasya śabdaḥ vyajyataḥ iti sva viṣaya vyāpti avasthāne sati yatra kva cana avasthitānām go śabda abhivyaktau kakudādimad artha pratyāyanam syāt

atha sāmānya vat etat syāt yathā sāmānyam sva viṣayam vyāpya avasthitam na ca sarvatra upalabhyate tathā śabde api sva viṣayam vyāpya avasthite niyamaḥ bhaviṣyati iti na yuktam evam bhavitum sāmānyasya āśraya upalabdhiḥ vyakti hetuḥ na punar śabdasya āśraya upalabdhiḥ asti na ca vācye vṛttiḥ tasmāt asamaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ yadi ca vācya artha vṛttiḥ śabdaḥ syāt vācya upalabdhau akṛta samayena api pratipādyeta yathā sāmānyam akṛta samayaḥ api pratipadyate iti tasmāt na anumānāt api pratipadyate

itas ca sva āśrayāt anyena na sambandhī śabdaḥ guṇa tvāt anyena gavādinā śabdam prati samavāyaḥ na asti śabdasya ākāśa vṛtti tvāt na api śabda arthayoḥ eka artha samavāyaḥ sva ātmani ekasya anārambhāt upamānāt pratipatsyate iti na upamānasya api na viṣayaḥ āgamāt pratipatsyate iti ced saḥ eva atra vicāryate kim śabda arthau sambaddhau āhosvit asambaddhau iti

yat tu idam bhavatā abhidhīyate smṛti ādi apekṣa tvāt anumāna sādharmyāt anumānam śabdaḥ iti tasmāt eva na anumānam na hi tena eva tasya sādharmyam iti atha smṛti ādi sādharmyāt śabda anumānayoḥ ekatvam eva tarhi ekam pramāṇam prāpnoti asti hi artha paricchedaka tvam sarva pramāṇānām sādharmyam iti bhavatu ekam pramāṇam kim naḥ bādhyate iti katham na bādhyate iti yat abhīṣṭam tat nivartate kim ca abhīṣṭam pratyakṣa anumāne bhinne iti atha sāmānyam āśritya abhedaḥ deśyate tadā upekṣayā vartitavyam sāmānyam āśritya abhedaḥ viśeṣam āśritya bhedaḥ iti na kim cit bādhitam na ca anumānam śabdaḥ sva para ātma pratyāyaka tvāt yat sva para ātma pratyāyakam tat anumānam na bhavati yathā pradīpaḥ pradīpaḥ yena kriyate tasya api upalabdhi sādhanam bhavati itarasya api śabdaḥ api evam tasmāt na anumānam iti

yadi śabda arthau asambaddhau syātām śabda artha pratyaya vyavasthā na syāt śabdaḥ sambaddhaḥ artham pratipādayati pratyaya niyama hetu tvāt pradīpa vat yaḥ pratyaya niyama hetuḥ sa sambaddhaḥ artha pratipādakaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā pradīpaḥ śabdaḥ ca evaṃdharmā tasmāt śabdaḥ api sambaddha artha pratipādakaḥ iti pratyayaḥ vā pakṣīkartavyaḥ sambaddhābhyām śabda arthābhyām vastu pratyayaḥ bhavati niyamāt kuṇḍalī iti pratyaya vat

na sambandha kāritam śabda artha vyavasthānam kim tarhi samaya kāritam kaḥ punar ayam samayaḥ abhidhāna abhidheya niyama niyogaḥ tasmin upayukte śabda artha vyavasthā bhavati kaḥ cit ca sambandhaḥ anujñātaḥ iti yat avocāma samayam tat avocāmaḥ iti sā iyam śabda artha vyavasthāḥ anyathā api bhavati iti ahetuḥ ayam ca vācya vācaka bhāva lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ svābhāvika śabda artha sambandha vādinā abhyanujñeyaḥ na hi svābhāvika sambandha vādinaḥ anupayukta śabda artha sambandhasya śabda śravaṇāt viśeṣa pratyayaḥ bhavati sa punar samayaḥ kutas pratyetavyaḥ pada jñānāt lokataḥ ca iti tat hi śāstram samayasya avilopa artham praṇītam lokataḥ ca samayaḥ boddhavyaḥ mātrā ādīn teṣu teṣu artheṣu tān tān śabdān prayuñjānān upalabhya saḥ api tathā eva śikṣitaḥ tān eva śabdān teṣu teṣu artheṣu prayuṅkte na punar enam kaḥ cit lipim iva śikṣayati iti

na svābhāvikaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ yadi svābhāvikaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ abhaviṣyan na jāti viśeṣe śabda artha vyavasthā abhaviṣyat asti tu yathākāmam prayogaḥ jāti viśeṣe yathākāmam prayogaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na punar svābhāvikena sambandhena sambaddhānām jāti viśeṣe vyabhicāraḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na hi pradīpaḥ asmākam anyathā prakāśayati anyathā jāti viśeṣaḥ iti jāti viśeṣa śabdena punar deśaḥ abhidhīyate iti

tad aprāmāṇyam anṛta vyāghāta punarukta doṣebhyaḥ iti sūtram tat iti adhikṛta śabda abhidhānāt śabda viśeṣa adhikāraḥ yasmāt prāptam api prakaraṇena śabdam tad śabdena punar abhidhatte tat jñāpayati śabda viśeṣam prati iyam cintā na tu śabda mātram prati anyathā evam vaktavyam apramāṇam śabdaḥ anṛta vyāghāta punarukta doṣebhyaḥ iti aprāmāṇyam arthasya apratyāyaka tvam anṛta tvam ayathārtha abhidhānam vyāghātaḥ padayoḥ vākyayoḥ vā saha asambhavaḥ punaruktam pūrva abhihita artha abhidhānam udāharaṇāni bhāṣye

tatra anṛta tve hetuḥ phala adarśanam agnihotram juhuyāt iti vidhi vākyam asya vyāghātaḥ kālāsambhavena udita anudita samaya adhyuṣita pratiṣedhāt na ca anyaḥ kālaḥ vidyate yatra agni hotra havanam syāt udita anudita samaya adhyuṣita vākyānām vā paraspara virodhaḥ prathama uttamayoḥ sāmidhenyoḥ tris abhidhānam punar uktam udāharaṇam ca bhāṣye dṛṣṭānta tvena etāni vākyāni upanyasya eka kartṛka tvena śeṣa vākyānām apramāṇa tvam iti agnihotra ādi vākyānām vā pramāṇa tva pratiṣedhaḥ veda eka deśa tvena tad anya vākya vat punarukta tāyām pūrvam uttaram vā na vākyam ekena pratīyamāna tvāt

yat tāvat anṛta tvāt apramāṇam veda vākyāni phala adarśanāt iti tat atra sampradhāryam kim phala adarśanam veda vākyānām apramāṇa tvāt āho karma kartṛ sādhana vaiguṇyāt iti vayam tu brūmaḥ karma kartṛ sādhana vaiguṇyāt iti phala adarśanāt ca kāraṇānām asāmagryam gamyate iṣṭeḥ karaṇa sādhana tvena abhyupagamāt ca doṣaḥ na ca iyam iṣṭiḥ mayā sākṣāt putra kāraṇa tvena abhyupagamyate api tu pitarau iṣṭyā saṃprayujyamānau putram janayataḥ tatra na jñāyate kim pitroḥ asāt guṇyāt putra janma na bhavati āhosvit iṣṭeḥ asāt guṇyāt iti mantrāḥ ca iṣṭa sādhana tvena prayujyamānāḥ iṣṭi aṅgam bhavanti tatra api na jñāyate kim iṣṭiḥ mantrāṇām vaiguṇyāt na sampannāḥ āhosvit darbha idhma ādeḥ kāraṇasya vaiguṇyāt iti yathā eva mantrāṇām nyūna adhika bhāvena prayujyamānānām iṣṭiḥ na nirvartate tathā darbha idhma ādeḥ api sādhanasya vaiguṇyāt iti

na kevalam sādhana vaikalyāt eva iṣṭeḥ anabhinirvṛttiḥ tathā iṣṭeḥ sādhayituḥ karmaṇaḥ ca asāt guṇyāt iti upetya iṣṭi sampadam na kevalāḥ eva iṣṭiḥ kāraṇam iti uktam tatra putra janma adarśanena na yuktam vaktum manuṣya dharmaṇā mantrāṇām asāmarthyāt puttra anutpattiḥ iti ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt sandehaḥ iti ced na abhyupeta hāneḥ atha manyase tri kāraṇam putra janma tatra anyatara kāraṇa vaikalyāt putraḥ na bhavati iti kāraṇa vaikalyam gamyate tatra yathā eva pitryoḥ vaiguṇyāt putra an utpattiḥ tathā mantrāṇām api apramāṇa tvāt iti sandihyate na abhyupeta hāneḥ pūrvam bhavatā abhyadhāyi vedaḥ apramāṇam iti adhunā tu abhidhīyate sandigdham pramāṇa tvam iti evam ca bruvatā pūrvaḥ vādaḥ tyaktaḥ bhavati samānam iti ced atha manyase samānam etat bhavataḥ api kim pitroḥ vaiguṇyāt putra ajanmaḥ uta aho veda vākyānām apramāṇa tvāt iti sandihyate nāsādhanāt na mayā etat sādhyate veda vākyāni pramāṇam apramāṇam vā iti bhavatā tu sādhyate

tatra mayā bhavataḥ sādhanāni atara vaiguṇyāt putra janma na bhavati iti sandigdhaḥ hetuḥ apadiśyate tad sahakāri tvāt ca upadeśaḥ dāru mathana vat iti na iyam iṣṭiḥ sākṣāt kāraṇa tvena putra janmanaḥ upadiśyate api tu putra kāmaḥ iṣṭim kurvīta iti yathā agni kāmaḥ dāruṇī mathnīyāt iti upadeśaḥ tatra ca kartṛ karmaṇoḥ vaiguṇyāt agniḥ na bhavati iti naḥ upadeśa vaiyarthyam tathā iha api iti adoṣaḥ sāmastye phala niṣpatti darśanāt ca yatra ca samastāni kāraṇāni tatra phala abhinirvṛttiḥ dṛṣṭāḥ iti adoṣaḥ yat ca idam vākyam tad aprāmāṇyam anṛta vyāghāta punarukta doṣebhyaḥ iti tat api veda vākyasya pakṣīkṛta tvāt avyāpakam atha yāni evaṃdharmakāṇi vākyāni tāni pakṣīkriyante teṣu api eṣām dharmāṇām viśeṣaṇa tvena upayukta tvāt aprāmāṇya pratipādakaḥ hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ anṛta tvāt aprāmāṇyam iti ced kim idam anṛta tvam nāma yadi ayathārtha abhidhānam nanu ayam eva pratijñā arthaḥ apramāṇam iti anṛta tvam ca asiddham iti uktam etat

yat punar etat vyāghāta doṣāt iti abhyupetya kāla bhede doṣa vacanāt na vyāghātaḥ agni ādhāna kāle eva ayam niyama parigrahaḥ udite hotavyam anudite hotavyam samaya adhyuṣite hotavyam iti saḥ ayam abhyupetya kālam yadā atikrāmati tadā abhyupeta kāla atikramāt nindyate nindā vacane ca na vyāghātaḥ ubhaya pratiṣedha anabhidhānāt na idam anyathā yadi punar etat ubhaya pratiṣedha abhidhānam syāt bhavet ayam prasaṅgaḥ vyāghātaḥ iti na punar etāni pratiṣedha vākyāni udite hotavyam iti evam ādīni tasmāt aprasaṅgaḥ ayam iti atha punar etāni vākyāni

homa vidhi pratiṣedhakāni syuḥ tadā udita ādi grahaṇam vyartham evam eva vaktavyam iti agnihotram juhuyāt iti yat vākyam tat na kartavyam iti evam ca saṃgata artha tā yathā etat vyākhyātam evam pūrva uttare ca vākye saṅgate bhavataḥ havanam anūdya kāla viśeṣa vidhānāt iti evam etat na punar yathā asmābhiḥ vyāghātaḥ abhidhīyate iti niyama hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ idam eva udita ādi vākyam niyama hetuḥ katham iti idam eva udita ādi vākyam kāmataḥ vā vikalpya ita abhihitam vā anūdyate iti abhihita anuvādaḥ nyāyaḥ tatra hi pramāṇānām avisaṃvādaḥ itaratra vyāghātaḥ iti

yat punar etat punar ukta doṣāt iti na punar ukta doṣaḥ anuvāda upapatteḥ punaruktam nāma tasya eva arthasya anaṅgīkṛta viśeṣasya yat punarvacanam anuvādaḥ tu punar śruti sāmānyāt aṅgīkṛta viśeṣasya arthasya vādaḥ evam ca sati yathā uktaḥ na doṣaḥ udāharaṇam bhāṣye putra kāma iṣṭi ādi vākyāni pramā veda eka deśa tvāt bhūmiḥ āvapanam mahat iti vākya vat itas ca pada ādi niyamāt dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ iti vākya vat itas ca kartṛ viśeṣa abhihita tvāt agniḥ himasya bheṣajam iti vākya vat

samastāni vā veda vākyāni pakṣīkṛtya abhidhīyante pramāṇam veda vākyāni artha vibhāgavat tvāt manu ādi vākya vat yathā manu ādi vākyāni artha vibhāgavanti artha vibhāgavat tve sati prāmāṇyam tathā ca veda vākyāni artha vibhāgavanti tasmāt pramāṇam iti
vibhāgaḥ ca trividhaḥ bhavati vidhi artha vāda anuvāda vacana viniyogāt tridhā khalu brāhmaṇa vākyāni bhavanti vidhi vacanāni arthavāda vacanāni anuvāda vacanāni ca

tatra vidhiḥ vidhāyakaḥ yat vākyam vidhāyakam deśakam sa vidhiḥ vidhiḥ tu niyogaḥ anujñā vā yat vākyam vidhatte idam kuryāt iti sa niyogaḥ anujñā tu yat kurvāṇukam anujānāti tat anujñā vākyam yathā agnihotra vākyam eva tad sādhana avāpti pravṛtti pūrvaka tvam anujānāti
eṣām udāharaṇāni bhāṣye

vidhi anuvacanam ca anuvādaḥ vihita anuvacanam ca pūrvaḥ śabda anuvādaḥ paraḥ artha anuvādaḥ yathā punaruktam dvividham śabda punaruktam artha punaruktam ca śabda punaruktam anityaḥ nityaḥ iti artha punaruktam anityaḥ nirodha dharmakaḥ iti
kaḥ asya sūtrasya arthaḥ pratīta artha śabda abhyāsaḥ anuvāda punaruktayoḥ sāmyam punaruktaḥ api pratīta arthaḥ śabdaḥ abhyasyate anuvāde api evam atas pratīta artha śabda abhyāsāt ubhayam asādhu iti

śīghratara gamana upadeśa vat abhyāsāt na aviśeṣaḥ iti yathā śīghram gamyatām śīghrataram gamyatām iti ca tarapā kriyā atiśayaḥ abhidhīyate tathā anuvāda lakṣaṇena api abhyāsena kriyā atiśayaḥ abhidhīyate iti asya prayogaḥ arthavān anuvāda lakṣaṇaḥ abhyāsaḥ pratyaya viśeṣa hetu tvāt śīghratara gamana upadeśa vat yathā śīghra śabdāt śīghratara śabdaḥ prayujyamānaḥ pratyaya viśeṣa hetu tvāt na punar ukta doṣam labhate tathā anuvāda lakṣaṇaḥ abhyāsaḥ pratyaya viśeṣa hetu tvāt na punarukta doṣam lapsyate iti kaḥ punar asau viśeṣaḥ bhavati iti vaktavyam tat ucyate

ādye pacati śabda prayoge pākaḥ nirvartanīyaḥ iti paktuḥ pratyayaḥ bhavati dvitīyāt tu pacati śabdāt avadhāraṇa pratyayaḥ bhavati mayā eva paktavyam iti sātatya pratyayaḥ vā bhavati satatam mayā pakta vayam iti adhyeṣaṇa pratyayaḥ vā bhavati mām eva ayam adhikurutaḥ iti āśu pratyayaḥ vā bhavati āśu mayā paktavyam iti evam śrotuḥ yathā ca śrotuḥ tathā ca vaktuḥ api ete eva pratyayāḥ bhavanti iti punarukte tu na kaḥ cit viśeṣaḥ gamyate iti asti mahān viśeṣaḥ punar ukta anuvādayoḥ evam anyaḥ api anuvādasya prayogaḥ loke boddhavyaḥ iti

kim punar pratiṣedha hetu uddhārāt eva pramāṇatā veda vākyānām siddhā na kim kāraṇam na sādhanam antareṇa siddhiḥ asti iti kutas tarhi pramāṇataḥ kim tat pramāṇam artha vibhāgavat tvam mantra āyurveda prāmāṇya vat ca tad prāmāṇyam āpta prāmāṇyāt ca śabdaḥ pūrva hetu anukarṣaṇa arthaḥ yathā mantra āyurveda vākyāni puruṣa viśeṣa abhihita tvāt pramāṇam tathā veda vākyāni iti puruṣa viśeṣa abhihita tvam hetuḥ kim āyurvedasya prāmāṇyam yat tat āyurvedena upadiśyate idam kṛtvā iṣṭam adhigacchati idam kṛtvā aniṣṭam jahāti tasya anuṣṭhīyamānasya tathā abhāvaḥ aviparyayaḥ etat prāmāṇyam kiṃkṛtam etat āpta prāmāṇya kṛtam kim punar āptānām pramāṇa tvam sākṣāt kṛta dharma tā yam te padārtham upadiśanti sa taiḥ sākṣāt kṛtaḥ bhavati iti bhūta dayā ca yasmai ca upadiśanti tam pratyeṣām anukampā bhavati yathā parijñāna artha cikhyā payiṣā ca asya bhavati etena trividhena viśeṣaṇena viśiṣṭaḥ vaktā āptaḥ tena yaḥ upadeśaḥ kriyate sa pramāṇam iti

dṛṣṭa artha vākya avisaṃvādena vā śeṣa anumānam yat vākyam dṛṣṭa artham yathā grāma kāmaḥ yajeta iti evam ādi tena śeṣa anumānam pramāṇam iti laukikam api vākyam anenaḥ eva tri prakāreṇa viśeṣaṇena viśiṣṭasya vaktuḥ pramāṇam bhavati asya prayogaḥ pramāṇam veda vākyāni vaktṛ viśeṣa abhihita tvāt mantra āyurveda vākya vat iti

eka kartṛka tvena vā mantra āyurveda vākyāni pakṣīkṛtya alaukika viṣaya pratipādaka tvena vaidharmya hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ pauruṣeya tvam asiddham nitya tvāt iti ced atha manyase nityāni veda vākyāni nitya tvāt ca eṣām prāmāṇyam tasmāt pauruṣeya tvam asiddham na asiddha tvāt siddhe nitya tve etat yuktam vaktum tat tu na siddham iti atas na yuktam etat yadi na nityāni katham pramāṇam pratipādaka tvāt pramāṇam na nitya tvāt

ke cit tu bruvate na kim cit nityam pramāṇam asti iti pramāṇa tvāt eva anityāni iti tat tu na samyak iti paśyāmaḥ nityam api pramāṇam yathā manaḥ ātmā ca pramāṇa śabdasya samudāya vāci tvāt ayam khalu pramāṇa śabdaḥ samudāye vartate tatra ca nityam anityam ca anekam samudāyi pramāṇasya aṅga tvāt pramāṇam iti ucyate yathā pradīpaḥ evam ca nityam api pramāṇam asti iti yadā ca paramāṇu ādi nityam itara vastu sādhaka tvena upādīyate tadā paramāṇu ādeḥ nityasya pramāṇa bhāvāt pramāṇa tvāt anityaḥ iti anekāntaḥ bhavati iti anuttaram etat

tasmāt yuktam artha vibhāgavat tvāt antiya tvam laukika vākya vat iti yathārtha vibhāgavanti laukika vākyāni tathā ca veda vākyāni tasmāt na nityāni iti laukika vākyāni api nityāni iti ced atha manyase yāni api etāni laukika vākyāni artha vibhāgavanti tāni api nityāni iti artha visaṃvādaḥ na syāt yaḥ ayam artha visaṃvādaḥ laukike vākye sa na syāt dṛṣṭaḥ tu tāni anityāni iti ced viśeṣa hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ tulye artha vibhāgavat tve tulye ca artha pratipādaka tve laukikāni anityāni vaidikāni nityāni iti viśeṣa hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ tulyam bhavataḥ api anitya tve viśeṣa hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ iti

uktaḥ artha vibhāgavat tvam hetuḥ itas ca varṇavat tvāt varṇavanti laukikāni vākyāni anityāni ca tathā ca veda vākyāni tasmāt tāni api anityāni itas ca sāmānya viśeṣavat tve sati śrotra grāhya tvāt laukika vākya vat eva itas ca pada ādi niyamāt laukika vākya vat darśanasya para artha tvāt iti ced atha manyase darśanam para artham dṛṣṭam darśana śabdaḥ uccāraṇa arthaḥ tat ca uccāraṇam para pratipādana artham na hi kaḥ cit ātma pratipattaye śabdam uccārayati yadi ca ayam nityaḥ bhavati tatas śabdāt artha pratyayaḥ yuktaḥ atha anityaḥ utpanna pradhvaṃsī tatas asya śrotuḥ nityam apūrvaḥ śabdaḥ śrotra viṣayam iti na ca apūrva śabda śravaṇāt sampratipattiḥ yuktā na hi nārikela dvīpa vāsinaḥ aprasiddha go śabdasya go śabda śravaṇāt kakudādimad artha pratipattiḥ bhavati tathā ca anitya vādinaḥ sarve śabdāḥ tasmāt asya api śabdāt pratyaya niyamaḥ

na prāptaḥ iti na anekāntāt kṣaṇa vidhvaṃsiṣu api pradīpeṣu para pratyāyanam dṛṣṭam iti na udāharaṇa vaidharmyāt pradīpaḥ anākhyātaḥ prakāśanīya artha sambandhāt prakāśanīya artha sampratipattim karoti na punar anākhyātaḥ śabdaḥ iti kaḥ evam āha anākhyātaḥ śabdaḥ pratipādayati iti sambandhasya adarśanāt ākhyānam anupapannam uktam etat yathā na śabda arthayoḥ prāpti lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ asti iti vācya vācaka bhāva lakṣaṇaḥ tu pauruṣeyaḥ sambandhaḥ sa ca kṛtakaḥ iti sa ca saṃsāra anādi tvāt lokataḥ avagamyate ye tu saṃsāram anādimantam varṇayanti te evam upālabhyāḥ

atha yaḥ ayam abhilāpaḥ nityāḥ vedāḥ iti sa katham sampradāyasya avicchedāt tāni eva veda vākyāni manvantara catur yuga antareṣu sampradāya abhyāsa avi chedena pravartante tad apekṣayā laukikāḥ śabdāt na prayuñjate nityāḥ vedāḥ iti yathā nityāḥ saritaḥ nityāḥ parvatāḥ iti etat ca manu ādi vākyeṣu samānam kutas etat sampradāya abhyāsa avi chedāt nitya tvam na punar nitya tvāt eva anitya tve pramāṇa avighātāt yāni mayā anitya tve pramāṇāni upadiṣṭāni tāni na vihanyante teṣām avighātāt anitya tve sati sampradāya abhyāsa avi chedāt nitya tva upacāraḥ iti

pratyakṣa anumāna upamāna śabdāḥ pramāṇāni iti sūtram tasya apekṣaḥ na catuṣṭvam aitihya arthāpatti sambhava abhāva prāmāṇyāt asya arthaḥ ayathārthaḥ ayam pramāṇa uddeśaḥ iti na catvāri eva pramāṇāni aitihya arthāpatti sambhava abhāvāḥ api pramāṇāni iti saṃśaya vyudāsa artham vai aitihya ādayaḥ upakṣipya pratiṣidhyante pratyakṣa ādīni ca pramāṇāni iti aitihya ādīni ca iti ke cit manyante tatra śrotuḥ saṃśayaḥ syāt kim vidyamānāḥ aitihi ādayaḥ na abhihitāḥ uta avidyamānāḥ iti

vidhini ūna tā parihāra artham vā prakaraṇam vidyamānāni aitihyādīni na abhihitāni iti vidhi hīnam śāstram syāt doṣavatām doṣān abhidhānāt doṣa hīnam vā śāstram syāt iti atas uddiśya nivartyante doṣavantaḥ aitihi āt ayaḥ iti atas na abhidhīyante iti doṣaḥ tarhi vaktavyaḥ atha doṣaḥ na abhidhīyate doṣa hīnam śāstram iti tad parihāra artham prakaraṇam upadiśyate

pratyakṣa ādiṣu antarbhāva pradarśana artham vā aitihya ādīni pratyakṣa ādiṣu antar bhāvayitum ye yatra antarbhavanti tatra teṣām pradarśana artham prakaraṇam iti siddha tvāt anārambhaḥ nanu ayam arthaḥ catvāri eva pramāṇāni iti etasmin eva vibhāga uddeśa sūtre siddhaḥ iti siddha tvāt punar anārambhaḥ iti na avadhāraṇa prayojanasya itas siddheḥ yena nyāyena catvāri eva pramāṇāni iti etat avasthāpyate sa nyāyaḥ iha prakaraṇe varṇyate tasmāt ārabhyam eva iti

kim idam aitihyam nāma anirdiṣṭa pravaktṛkam pravāda pāramparyam iti ha ūcuḥ vṛddhāḥ kathayanti iti arthāt āpattiḥ arthāpattiḥ āpattiḥ prāptiḥ prasaṅgaḥ yasmin vākye abhidhīyamānāt arthāt anyaḥ arthaḥ āpadyate sārtha āpattiḥ yathā asatsu megheṣu vṛṣṭiḥ na bhavati iti kim atra arthāt āpadayate satsu bhavati iti

sambhavaḥ nāma āvina abhāvavartinaḥ padārthasya grahaṇāt anyasya sattā vijñānam yathā droṇasya sattā grahaṇāt āḍhakasya sattā iti abhāvaḥ pratyanīkasya grahaṇāt tad virodhinaḥ grahaṇam yathā vidhārake vāyu abhra saṃyoge sati guru tva pratibandhāt apām apātar pratiṣiddhaḥ tad apām apātena virodhinam vāyu abhra saṃyogam pratipadyate iti

tāni etāni aitihya ādīni iti evaṃbhūtāni lakṣaṇa bhedāt eteṣu eva antarbhavanti iti na pṛthak ucyante viṣaya abhāvāt ca na hi pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇa vyatirekī viṣayaḥ aitihya ādīnām sambhavati atas ca na pramāṇa antarāṇi atha prayojana bhedāt bhedam pratipadyase evam tarhi aṣṭa tvam nivartate yat abhyupagatam pramāṇa aṣṭa tvam tat nivartate prayojana bhedāt pramāṇa bhedam abhyupagacchate iti eka karaṇa nimittaḥ ca prayojana bhedaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti anekāntaḥ yathā ekam cakṣuḥ aneka nīla ādi bhinna rūpa grahaṇa prayojanam iti indriya aneka tvam vā atha prayojana bhedāt bhedam manyase ekam indriyam anekam prāpnoti atha viṣaya sāmānya avyatirekāt ekam indriyam na yuktaḥ tarhi pratiṣedhaḥ na catuṣṭvam aitihya arthāpatti sambhava abhāva prāmāṇyāt iti

yadi etāni pramāṇāni na pramāṇa antarāṇi tarhi kva antarbhavanti iti vaktavyam antarbhāva pradarśana artham sūtram śabdaḥ aitihya anartha antara bhāvāt anumāne arthāpatti sambhava abhāva anartha antara bhāvāt ca apratiṣedhaḥ śabde aitihyam antarbhavati samāna lakṣaṇa tvāt na śabda lakṣaṇam aitihyāt nivartate saḥ ayam bhedaḥ sāmānyena saṃgṛhītaḥ anumāne arthāpatti sambhava abhāvānām antara bhāvaḥ samāna lakṣaṇa tvāt anumāne arthāpatti sambhava abhāvāḥ antarbhavanti katham arthāpattiḥ anumānena saṃgṛhyate dvayoḥ ekatara pratiṣedhasya dvitīya abhyanujñā viṣaya tvāt yatra yatra dvayoḥ vastunoḥ ekatarat vastu pratiṣidhyate tatra tatra dvitīya abhyanujñā dṛṣṭā yathā divā na bhuṅkte iti abhidhānāt rātrau bhuṅkte iti gamyate

eke tu bruvate naḥ iyam arthāpattiḥ divā na bhuṅkte iti atra kila avadhāraṇa dvayam divā na bhuṅkte eva divā eva na bhuṅkte iti ca ubhaya prāptau na vaktavyam rātrau bhuṅkte iti etat tu na samyak asambhavāt divā na bhuṅkte eva iti ayam arthaḥ asambhavena nirākṛtaḥ na hi kaḥ cit divā bhuṅkte eva bhuñjānaḥ api tāvat na bhuṅkte eva kim punar abhuñjānaḥ iti tasmāt asambhavena asya arthasya nirākṛta tvāt kāla pratiṣedhaḥ anena vākyena divā na bhuṅkte iti anyathā anarthakam syāt kriyā antara nivṛtteḥ asambhavena nirākṛta tvāt kāla pratiṣedhasya ca anabhyupagamāt anarthakam vākyam bhavatu anarthakam vākyam kim naḥ bādhyate katham na bādhyate yat abhyupetam tat nivartate kim ca abhyupetam kriyā antara pratiṣedhaḥ yam na kāla pratiṣedhaḥ iti na ca idam anarthakam tasmāt ubhayoḥ sāmarthya prāptayoḥ ekatara pratiṣedhe dvitīya abhyanujñānāt anumānam eva arthāpattiḥ katamat anumānam sāmānyatodṛṣṭam etena sambhava abhāvau vyākhyātau sambhavaḥ anumānam abhāvaḥ api evam eva tat ca varṇitam anayoḥ api sāmānyatodṛṣṭe eva antarbhāvaḥ iti tat evam antarbhāvāt pṛthak anapadeśaḥ iti

satyam etāni pramāṇāni na tu pramāṇa antarāṇi iti uktam tatra artha āpatteḥ pramāṇa bhāva abhyanujñā naḥ upapadyate tathā iha iyam arthāpattiḥ apramāṇam anaikāntika tvāt yā iyam bhavatā arthāpattiḥ pramāṇa tvena pratipādyate sā na pramāṇam apramāṇam iti na arthasya ekadā api pratipādikā yathā megheṣu asatsu vṛṣṭiḥ na bhavati satsu bhavati iti arthāt āpannam satsu api ekadā na bhavati iti anaikāntikī arthāpattiḥ arthāpatti mātrasya pakṣīkaraṇe anaikāntika tvam avyāpakam yadi tāvat arthāpatti mātram pakṣayasi tatas

arthāpatteḥ anaikāntika tvam aśakyam darśayitum atha anaikāntikī yā sā pakṣīkriyate tadā abhyupagamaḥ vayam api brūmaḥ anaikāntikī apramāṇam iti hetuḥ ca na asti hetoḥ pratijñā viśeṣaṇa tvāt yā anaikāntikī sā apramāṇam iti pratijñā tatra hetuḥ na asti na ca ayam arthaḥ sādhyaḥ iti hetu abhāvaḥ vyāghātaḥ ca abhyupagamāt anaikāntikī yā arthāpattiḥ sā pramāṇam na bhavati iti bruvatā yā aikāntikī sā pramāṇam iti abhyupagatam bhavati anarthakam ca idam abhidhānam yā anaikāntikī arthāpattiḥ sā na pramāṇam iti

yām api bhavān anaikāntikīm arthāpattim manyate sā api na anaikāntikī anartha āpattau arthāpatti abhimānāt na iyam arthāpattiḥ anaikāntikī arthāpattiḥ ca satsu megheṣu vṛṣṭiḥ bhavati iti sā iyam anaikāntikī katham na satsu bhavati eva api tu satsu eva bhavati iti yat tu satsu megheṣu vṛṣṭiḥ na bhavati iti kāraṇa pratibandhaḥ asau na tat arthāpatteḥ prameyam kim punar asyāḥ prameyam kāraṇe sati kāryam bhavati iti sā iyam anaikāntikī katham syāt yadi asati api kāraṇe kāryam utpadyate tat tu na dṛṣṭam iti na kadā cit anaikāntika tvam

yaḥ ayam bhavatā pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate arthāpattiḥ na pramāṇam anaikāntika tvāt iti ayam api anaikāntikaḥ sattā pratiṣedhāt na anena pratiṣedhena arthāpatteḥ sattā pratiṣidhyate katham na sattā pratiṣidhyate yasmāt arthāpatteḥ viśeṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate na arthāpatti mātram tena sattā pratiṣedhāt anaikāntikaḥ bhavati iti

atha manyase na pratiṣedhasya sattvam viṣayaḥ kim tu pramāṇa tvam saḥ ayam pratiṣedhaḥ sva viṣaye pravartamānaḥ na anaikāntikaḥ bhavitum arhati iti anaikāntikaḥ hi nāma sa jñeyaḥ yaḥ sva viṣaya tajjātīya anyavṛttiḥ na ca anaikāntikam prāmāṇya pratiṣedhe asti tasmāt na anaikāntikaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti tad prāmāṇye vā na arthāpatti aprāmāṇyam yadi sva viṣaya tajjātīya anyavṛttim anaikāntikam manyase arthāpattiḥ api tarhi anaikāntikī na bhavati na hi asati kāraṇe kvacid api kāryam utpadyamānam dṛṣṭam iti tat idam sūtram vyāghāta deśana artham yat uktam bhavatā sva viṣayāt anyatra vartamānam anaikāntikam na bhavati arthāpattiḥ ca anaikāntikī iti vyāhatam ajñānam vā atha abuddhvā ekāntikān aikāntika vyavahāram idam ucyate arthāpattiḥ apramāṇam anaikāntika tvāt iti tadā upekṣayā vartitavyam na unmatta vākyāni pratisamādheyāni iti

na abhāvaḥ pramāṇam viṣaya abhāvāt yat aviṣayam tat apramāṇam yathā go śabdaḥ aśva pratipādane tathā ca abhāvaḥ tasmāt apramāṇam kaḥ ca evam āha abhāvaḥ pramāṇam iti api tu abhāva viṣayā pratipattiḥ pramāṇam tayā pratīyate iti kaḥ punar asyāḥ viṣayaḥ abhāvaḥ iti uktam

tatra anekadhā bhinnasya abhāva prapañcasya udāharaṇa artham sūtram lakṣiteṣu alakṣaṇa lakṣita tvāt alakṣitānām tad prameya siddhiḥ alakṣitāni vāsāṃsi ānayaḥ iti prayuktaḥ ubhaya sannidhau yeṣu vāsaḥsu lakṣaṇāni na paśyati tāni lakṣaṇa abhāvena eva pratipadyate praiṣa sampratipattyoḥ eka viṣaya tvāt pratipadya ca ānayati pratipatti hetuḥ ca pramāṇam tasmāt sidhyati abhāvasya pramāṇa tvam

asati arthe na abhāvaḥ iti ced atha manyase yatra yat bhavati tat tatra na bhavati na ca ālakṣiteṣu vāsaḥsu lakṣaṇāni bhavanti tasmāt na tatra na bhavanti iti na aparijñānāt na bhavatā asmad abhiprāyaḥ abodhi na brūmaḥ yat yatra bhavati tatra tat na bhavati iti api tu lakṣitāni vāsāṃsi upalabhamānaḥ itarāṇi lakṣaṇa abhāva viśiṣṭāni pratipadyate iti ayathārthaḥ ayam upala ambhaḥ iti atas ukta artham sūtram na anya lakṣaṇa upapatteḥ iti
yāni tāni lakṣiteṣu vāsaḥsu lakṣaṇāni tāni na kasya cit na santi iti yāni ca santi teṣām abhāvaḥ vyāhataḥ atra uktam na aparijñānāt iti

asya ca arthasya jñāpana artham sūtram na lakṣaṇa avasthita apekṣa siddheḥ na brūmaḥ yāni bhavanti teṣām tatra eva abhāvaḥ iti api tu keṣu cit lakṣaṇāni avasthitāni apekṣya yeṣu tāni na bahvanti tāni lakṣaṇa abhāvena pratipadyate iti

abhāva dvaitam khalu bhavati iti prāk ca utpatteḥ avidyamāna tā ūrdhvam ca vināśāt avidyamāna tā iti tatra yaḥ ayam vināśāt abhāvaḥ lakṣaṇānām alakṣiteṣu vāsaḥsu saḥ anupapannaḥ naḥ itaraḥ iti asati arthe na abhāvaḥ tad siddheḥ alakṣiteṣu ahetuḥ iti ca ubhe api ete chala sūtre chalasya uktam uttaram jñātvā ajñātvā vā asambaddham ajñānam vā tasmāt aprayojyam chalam iti

āpta upadeśaḥ śabdaḥ iti pramāṇa bhāve viśeṣaṇam bruvatā nānā prakāraḥ śabdaḥ iti jñāpyate katham na asati bhede viśeṣaṇam arthavat na ca anarthakam viśeṣaṇam yuktam iti yuktam nānā bhūtaḥ śabdaḥ viśeṣaṇa sāmarthyāt iti tasmin sāmānyena vicāraḥ nityaḥ anityaḥ vā vicāraḥ parīkṣā vimarśa hetu anuyoge ca vipratipatteḥ saṃśayaḥ viparti patti śabdasya uktaḥ arthaḥ tatra ākāśa guṇaḥ śabdaḥ mahattva vat abhivyakti dharmā iti eke eke tāvat bruvate nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti avinaśyat ādhāra eka dravya ākāśa guṇa tvāt yat avinaśyat ādhāram eka dravyam ākāśa guṇaḥ ca tat nityam dṛṣṭam yathā ākāśa mahat tvam tathā ca śabdaḥ tasmāt nityaḥ iti saḥ ayam nityaḥ san abhivyakti dharmā tasya abhivyañjakāḥ saṃyoga vibhāga nādāḥ iti

gandha ādi saha vṛttiḥ dravyeṣu sanniviṣṭaḥ gandha ādi vat avasthitaḥ abhivyakti dharmā iti apare apare punar bruvate gandha ādibhiḥ saha sanniviṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ gandha ādi vat eva abhivyajyate tasya abhivyañjakāḥ bhūta viśeṣa abhighātāḥ iti ākāśa guṇaḥ śabdaḥ utpatti nirodha dharmakaḥ iti ca anye anye punar varṇayanti anityaḥ śabdaḥ ākāśa guṇaḥ utpatti nirodha dharmakaḥ iti mahābhūta saṃkṣobha jaḥ śabdaḥ na āśritaḥ utpatti nirodha dharmakaḥ iti ca apare atas saṃśayaḥ kim atra tattvam iti

anityaḥ iti etat tattvam kim idam anitya tvam nāma yatas anityaḥ iti bhavati kim punar tat prāc pradhvaṃsa abhāvau iti eke eke tāvat varṇayanti yasya prāc pradhvaṃsa abhāvau staḥ tat anityam iti na sambandhāt na hi prāc pradhvaṃsa abhāvābhyām bhāvaḥ sambadhyate iti anutpanna vinaṣṭayoḥ ca prasaṅgāt yadi ca prāc pradhvaṃsa abhāvau anitya tā iti manyase anutpanne vastuni prāc abhāvaḥ asti ūrdhvam ca vastunaḥ pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ asti iti ghaṭa ādau asati prāc pradhvaṃsa abhāva nimittataḥ anitya pratyayaḥ syāt anityasya bhāvaḥ anitya tā iti prāk pradhvaṃsayoḥ abhāva tvāt bhāva śabdena anabhidhānam anityam nāma yasya na asti atyantam bhāvaḥ tasya anityasya yaḥ bhāvaḥ sā anitya tā prāc pradhvaṃsa abhāvau ca bhāva pratiṣedhau na ca abhāvaḥ bhāva abhidhānena vaktum yuktau tasmāt na prāc pradhvaṃsa abhāvau anitya tā iti

ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ ca na asti iti tasya bhāvaḥ tu atalau iti tasya iti dharmī apadiśyate bhāvaḥ iti dharmiṇaḥ dharmaḥ na ca abhāvaḥ dharmaḥ na ca dharma kāle tad śabda vācyaḥ dharmī vidyate na ca avidhyamānasya ṣaṣṭhyā yogaḥ iti atha yat bhavati tat prāk na bhavati ūrdhvam ca na prabhavati iti manyase evam api na kim cit pratiṣiddham vayam api brūmaḥ yat prāk na bhavati tat ūrdhvam na bhavati iti ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ tu pūrvavat na asti ghaṭasya prāc abhāvaḥ ghaṭasya pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ iti etat katham na atra ṣaṣṭhyā sambandhaḥ abhidhīyate api tu prāk idam vastu na asti paścāt jātam iti arthaḥ ūrdhvam ca vināśāt idam vastu na bhaviṣyati iti anityam iti ucyate tasya ca bhāvaḥ anitya tā iti

vartamāne ca asambhavāt yadi ca prāc pradhvaṃsa abhāvau anitya tā iti manyase vartamāne vastuni na prāc abhāvaḥ na pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ iti anitya abhilāpaḥ na syāt pācaka ādi śabda vat iti ced atha manyase yathā amī pācaka ādi śabdāḥ tri kāla viṣayāḥ tathā ayam anitya śabdaḥ tri kāla viṣayaḥ bhaviṣyati iti na ṇvulaḥ tri kāla viṣaya tvāt ṇvulaḥ prayogaḥ tri kāla viṣayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ pācakaḥ bhavati pācakaḥ bhaviṣyati pācakaḥ abhūt iti tyapaḥ api tri kāla viṣaya tvam iti ced atha manyase tyapaḥ api tri kāla viṣaya tvam iti tat ca na adarśanāt na hi asati anitye anityaḥ iti prayogam paśyāmaḥ tasmāt tyapaḥ tri kāla viṣaya tvam ayuktam iti atas na prāc pradhvaṃsa abhāvau anitya tā iti

vināśa hetu bhāvaḥ iti anye apare punar bruvate vināśa hetoḥ astitvam anitya tā iti etat tu na yuktam asati bhāvāt prāk vināśa hetu bhāvāt anityaḥ iti pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ anupajāta kapāla vibhāgeṣu ghaṭa ādiṣu yadi punar vināśa hetu bhāvaḥ anitya tā syāt vartamāneṣu ghaṭa ādiṣu na syāt na hi asati jvare jvaritaḥ iti pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ vināśa hetu bhāvāt ca vināśasya hetuḥ asti iti pratyayaḥ yuktaḥ na anityaḥ iti na hi go tvāt aśva pratyayaḥ bhavati iti

atha manyase yasya vināśa hetuḥ asti tad vināśa vat yat ca vināśa vat tat anityam iti etat api na budhyāmahe yasya vināśa hetuḥ asti tad vināśa vat iti kim tu yasya vināśa hetuḥ asti tad vināśa hetumat iti vaktum yuktam na ca anyena yogāt anya nimittaḥ pratyayaḥ yuktaḥ na hi daṇḍa yogāt kuṇḍalī iti bhavati

vināśa vat śarīram iti prayoga darśanāt yuktam iti ced atha manyase vināśa vat śarīram iti dṛṣṭaḥ prayogaḥ na ca asati sambandhe prayogaḥ bhavitum arhati na matupaḥ asatsu a darśanāt na ayam matubh kva cit api asatsu dṛṣṭaḥ na hi asatā kuṇḍalena kuṇḍalī iti bhavati na ca bhāvasya vināśena yogaḥ asti tasmāt vināśa vat śarīram iti ayuktaḥ prayogaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti ced atha manyase dṛṣṭaḥ ayam prayogaḥ vināśi etat śarīrakam adhruvāḥ ete viṣayāḥ iti na upacārāt vināśi iti upacāreṇa prayogaḥ vināśaḥ asya avaśyantayā iti adhruvā iti anitya tā eva ucyate tasmāt na vināśa hetu bhāvaḥ anitya tā

upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya atyanta tiraḥ bhāvaḥ anitya tā iti anye anye punar anitya tā śabdasya artham anyathā varṇayanti yat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam vastu tena eva ātmanā atyantam tirobhūtam naḥ upalabhyate tat anityam iti ucyate etat tu śūnyam abhidhānam upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam atyanta tiraḥ bhūtam naḥ upalabhyate iti bruvāṇaḥ siddhāntam bādhate na hi kim cit vastu atyantam naḥ upalabhyate iti siddhāntaḥ anupajāta viśeṣasya ca vastunaḥ tirobhāvaḥ na yuktaḥ iti anekadhā varṇitam tasmāt iyam anitya tā na yuktā

ye punar varṇayanti saḥ eva ca bhāvaḥ abhūtvā bhavan bhūtvā ca abhavan anityaḥ iti ucyate sā ca avasthāḥ bhāva pratyayena anitya tā iti abhidhīyate etat tu na yuktam sva arthe bhāva pratyayasya adarśanāt na hi kaḥ cit sva arthe bhāva pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ vinaya ādi pāṭhāt iti ced nanu ca vinaya ādibhyaḥ ṭhak iti sva arthe pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ vinayaḥ eva vainayikam iti na anabhyupagamāt na ayam sva arthe pratyayaḥ kim tarhi vinayena yogaḥ vainayikam iti ucyate evam sarvatra draṣṭavyam anupalabhyamāna bhedānām api anumānataḥ bhedaḥ anumeyaḥ yān ca api bhavān anupalabhyamāna bhedān pratyayān sva arthe manyate teṣu api anumānataḥ bhedaḥ anumeyaḥ kim anumānam ṣaṣṭhyā bheda viṣaya tvam sarvā ṣaṣṭhī bhede dṛṣṭāḥ iti yathā ca anartha antare ṣaṣṭhī na asti tathā uktam guṇa guṇivāde iti

tat kim idānīm anitya tā iti ayam śabdaḥ anabhidheyaḥ eva na anabhidheyaḥ avadhya pekṣā anapekṣā bhedāt sattā eva ubhayathā yāḥ ubhayānta paricchinna vastu sattā sā anitya tā iti yā aparicchinna vastu sattā sā nityatā iti yathā samavāyaḥ ekaḥ san sa ca kāryeṇa viśiṣyamāṇaḥ kāraṇa tvam iti abhidhīyate kāraṇena viśiṣyamāṇaḥ kāryatvam iti abhidhīyate katham iti kāraṇam iti ayam pratyayaḥ na animittakaḥ kadā cit bhāvāt na vastu nimittaḥ avastu pratyayaḥ vyatireki tvāt na sattātaḥ vailakṣaṇyāt sattātaḥ sat iti syāt ayam tu sattā pratyayāt vilakṣaṇaḥ tasmāt na sattātaḥ

iha viśeṣaṇa nimitta tvāt ca sambandha nimittaḥ iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iti ādhāra viśiṣṭaḥ pratyayaḥ upajāyate na ca asati sambandhe ihapratyayena śakyam bhavitum yatas ayam ihapratyayaḥ sa samavāyaḥ kārya samavāye sati kāraṇam iti abhidhīyate yasya guṇasya yogāt yasmin arthe śabda niveśaḥ tad abhidhāne tu atalau kārya samavāyasya ca bhāvāt etat bhavati iti kārya samavāyaḥ kāraṇa tvam

etena kāryatvam vyākhyātam kārya ātma lābha hetuḥ samavāyaḥ kāraṇa viśiṣṭaḥ kāryatvam yathā samavāyaḥ evam sattā api ekā satī ubhaya anta paricchinna vastu sambandhi tve sati anitya tā iti ucyate viparyayāt nityatā iti etayā anitya tayā yogāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti ādimattvāt aindriyaka tvāt kṛtaka vat upacārāt ca ādimattvāt ādiḥ yoniḥ kāraṇam iti kāraṇavat tvāt anityaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ kim punar idam kāraṇavat tvam nāma nimitta kāraṇa bheda anuvidhānam utpatti dharmaka tvam iti tad abhivyaṅgyeṣu na asti na hi kim cit abhivyajyamānam nimitta kāraṇa bheda anuvidhāyi dṛṣṭam iti saṃyoga vibhāga anantaram upalabdheḥ sandehaḥ iti ced atha manyase saṃyoga vibhāga anantaram upalabhyate śabdaḥ sā ca tad anantara upalabdhiḥ vyajyamānasya api yuktā atas sandehaḥ kim ayam saṃyoga vibhāgābhyām vyajyate atha kriyate iti

na vyajyate aindriyaka tvāt kim idam aindriyaka tvam indriya pratyāsatti grāhyaḥ aindriyakaḥ iti tatas kim yadi indriya pratyāsatti grāhyaḥ aindriyakaḥ tatas na vyajyate na hi vyajyamānasya indriyeṇa prāptiḥ yuktā katham iti śrotram tāvat śabda deśam na gacchati amūrta tvāt yat amūrtam tat niṣkriyam dṛṣṭam yathā rūpa ādi amūrtam ca ākāśam tasmāt niṣkriyam iti

kriyā kāraṇa guṇa samavāyāt kriyāvat tvam iti ced atha manyase yasmin kriyā kāraṇam guṇaḥ vartate tat kriyāvat dṛṣṭam yathā loṣṭa ādi tathā ca ākāśam tasmāt tat api kriyāvat iti na anekāntāt kriyā kāraṇam ca guṇaḥ ātmani na ca kriyāvān ātmā iti anekāntaḥ vidyamānasya api na kriyā hetu tvam mahā parimāṇa pratibandhāt vidyamānaḥ api ākāśe abhighātaḥ na kriyā hetuḥ mahat parimāṇa pratibandhāt yat ākāśe vartate mahat tvam tena eka artha samavetena tad vṛttiḥ abhighātaḥ pratibadhyate iti yathā loṣṭa guru tvam tad eka artha vṛttinā saṃyogena iti

saṃyoga pratibandhāt guru tvasya sa apekṣa tva prasaṅgaḥ iti ced atha manyase yadi saṃyogena pratibadhyamānam guru tvam kriyām naḥ ārabhate tat pratibandha apagama apekṣam ārabhate iti nanu evam guru tvam sa apekṣam kriyā kāraṇam iti prāptam evam ca śāstra vyāghātaḥ nirapekṣam guru tvam karma kāraṇam iti hi śāstram na nirapekṣasya anyathā vyākhyānāt na ayam nirapekṣa arthaḥ guru tvam na kim cit apekṣate iti api tu carama bhāvi nimitta antaram na apekṣate iti nirapekṣam guru tvam karma kāraṇam iti na asti vyāghātaḥ tathā ca śāstram saṃyoga abhāve guru tvāt patanam iti

viṣaya abhāvāt ca na kriyā kāraṇa guṇa samavāya mātram kriyāvat tve hetuḥ api tu kriyā kāraṇa guṇa samavāye sati yadi kriyā viṣayaḥ mūrtiḥ bhavati kriyā kāraṇam ca guṇaḥ apratibaddhaḥ bhavati tadā kriyā utpadyate iti tasmāt niṣkriya tvāt ākāśam tāvat na gacchati śabdaḥ api na āgacchati niṣkriya tvāt eva na ca aprāptasya grahaṇam asti sarva śabda upalabdhi prasaṅgāt pariśeṣāt tu santāna siddhiḥ

tatra ādyaḥ śabdaḥ saṃyoga vibhāga hetukaḥ tasmāt śabda antarāṇi kadamba golaka nyāyena sarva dikkāni tebhyaḥ api pratyekam ekaikaḥ śabdaḥ mandataratamādi nyāyena āśraya apratibandham anuvidhīyamānaḥ prādur asti tatas antyasya atimāndyāt śabda antara utpatti śakti vyāghātaḥ yena kena cit pratibandhāt bhavati iti atas śabda santāna ucchedaḥ tatra yaḥ karṇa śaṣkulīm antam ākāśa deśam prāpnoti saḥ upalabhyate naḥ itaraḥ iti tasmāt aindriyaka tvam tat ca anyathā na yuktam iti atas anityaḥ iti

ekaḥ eva iti ced atha manyase ne eva śabda antarāṇi mayā abhyupagamyante api tu ekaḥ eva ayam śabdaḥ vitati a ākāśam avatiṣṭhate saṃyoga vibhāgābhyām vyaktaḥ san upalabhyate yathā ghaṭa ādi apavaraka ādiṣu avasthitam pradīpa saṃyogena iti tat ca na sarvaiḥ upalabdhi prasaṅgāt yadi ekaḥ śabdaḥ vitatya avasthitaḥ saṃyogena vyaktaḥ śrotravataḥ artha pratyayam karoti iti manyase tadā yena kena cit yatra tatra avasthitena śabdaḥ vyaktaḥ iti sarvaiḥ śrotravadbhiḥ upalabhyeta na ca upalabhyate tasmāt akalpanā iyam

eka deśa abhivyaktiḥ iti ced atha manyase satyam vitatya avasthitaḥ śabdaḥ tasya tu avasthitasya eka deśaḥ nimittena vyajyate iti na kimaḥ tādātmya anupapatteḥ yān tān eka deśān śabdasya manyase te kim śabda ātmakāḥ āho naḥ iti kim ca atas yadi śabda ātmakāḥ tatas aneke śabdāḥ iti vyāghātaḥ atha aśabda ātmakāḥ na śabdāt artha pratyayaḥ iti prāptam teṣām ca svabhāvaḥ vaktavyaḥ

eka deśa artha anabhidhānāt ca eka deśaḥ iti samāsapadam etat ekaḥ ca asau deśaḥ ca iti tatra deśaḥ ādhāra arthaḥ kāraṇa arthaḥ vā syāt tatra ādhāra arthaḥ tāvat na yuktaḥ śabdasya ākāśa vṛtti tvāt ākāśa vṛttiḥ śabdaḥ tad guṇa tvāt tasmāt ākāśa vyatiriktaḥ naḥ ādhāraḥ iti kāraṇa arthaḥ api na asti akṛtaka tva abhyupagamāt akṛtakaḥ śabdaḥ iti svayam pratipadyamānāḥ bhavantaḥ na arhanti vaktum kāraṇam eka deśaḥ iti na ca anyaḥ eka deśa arthaḥ sambhavati iti śūnyam abhidhānam eka deśaḥ śabdasya vyajyate iti eka deśa abhivyaktau ca artha pratyayaḥ na syāt varṇa vat varṇāḥ sarve eva vyāpakāḥ bhavanti iti etasmin pakṣe varṇa eka deśa vyaktiḥ na ca varṇa eka deśaḥ śakyaḥ nirūpayitum na ca nirūpitāt api tasmāt artha pratipattiḥ sambhavati varṇānām api artha pratyāyaka tva anabhyupagamāt varṇāḥ eva tāvat ekaikaśas artha pratyāyakāḥ na bhavanti kutas tat eka deśāḥ iti

etena bahu tvam pratyuktam yathā ekasya śabdasya vyaktau doṣaḥ evam aneka śabdasya api vyāpi tve doṣaḥ iti kolāhalam ca syāt yadi ca aneka śabdāḥ ākāśe vartante yugapad vartante iti pratipadyase eka śabda abhivyañjaka upādāne samāna deśānām śabdānām vyaktiḥ iti kolāhalam syāt yathā malla naṭaraṅga samājeṣu prayoga karaṇa atiśaya āvarjiteṣu nadatsu na tu bhavati tasmāt na anekaḥ vyāpakaḥ iti niyamaḥ ca na syāt yadi ca aneke śabdāḥ yugapad ākāśe vartante iti evam ca yat kim cit vyañjakam upāttam samāna deśān sarva śabdān abhivyanakti iti yadā vīṇā vādyate tadā rāsabha dhvaniḥ api śrūyate na hi samāna aindriya grāhyāṇām samāna deśānām vyañjakeṣu niyamaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ

yat yasya vyañjakam tena tasya vyaktiḥ iti ced tat na adṛṣṭa tvāt atha manyase aneka śabda sannipāte api vyañjakāni bhidyante vyañjaka bheda anuvidhāyinyaḥ vyaktayaḥ pratiśabdam upajāyante iti tat na adṛṣṭa tvāt na hi samāna deśānām eka indriya grāhyāṇām vyañjakeṣu niyamaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti na hi pradīpaḥ eka indriya grāhyam anekam artham yugapad sannipatitam na prakāśayati iti

sāmānya vat etat syāt iti ced na anabhyupagamāt atha manyase aneka artha sannipāte sati sarvābhiḥ vyaktibhiḥ sāmānyāni sambadhyante aneka artha sambandhe sati api sāmānyasya kena cit arthena kim cit sāmānyam vyajyate evam aneka śabda sannipāte sati kim cit vyañjakam kim cit śabdam vyanakti iti na anabhyupagamāt sāmānyam anekena bhinna jātīyena arthena sambadhyate iti na abhyupagamyate api tu sva viṣaya sarva gatam sāmānyam go tvam goṣu eva na aśva ādiṣu aśva tvam aśveṣu eva na gavā ādiṣu tasmāt asamaḥ ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ

vyañjaka abhāve ca upalabdheḥ na vyajyate śabdaḥ yadi ca saṃyoga vibhāgābhyām vyaktaḥ śabdaḥ upalabhyate iti manyase saḥ api saṃyoga abhāve na upalabhyeta upalabhyate ca dāruvraścane dāruparaśu saṃyoga nivṛttau iti abhighātāt vāyuḥ iti ced atha manyase dāru paraśvoḥ abhighātāt vāyuḥ jāyate sa vāyuḥ santāna vṛttyā vartate santāna vṛttyā ca vartamānaḥ karṇa śaṣkulīm antam ākāśa deśam prāpnoti tad prāptau tatrasthaḥ śabdaḥ vyajyate iti atra uktam yathā ekaḥ śabdaḥ karṇa śaṣkulīm ati ākāśa deśe vartate tathā sarve eva śabdāḥ vartante iti yat kim cit vyañjakam upāttam yasya kasya cit śabdasya vyañjakam syāt iti sarva śabda upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ niyamaḥ ca na syāt iti

nimitta sannidhāne ca sarvatra upalabdheḥ na vyajyate yat khalu vyajyate tat nimitta sannidhāne sati api na sarvatra vyajyamānam dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭa arthinaḥ vibhrāṇāḥ pradīpam ghaṭa ādi rahita anapavaraka ādīn praviśya na ghaṭa ādīn upalabhante iti abhivyaktim ghaṭa ādīnām pratipadyante na punar tālu ādi abhighāta bhūta sannidhāne sati kva cit api śabdāt na paśyāmaḥ tasmāt na vyajyate iti

sarvatra santi iti ced na ukta uttara tvāt atha manyase yasya eka deśa vṛttayaḥ śabdāḥ tam pratyayam upālambhaḥ asmākam tu sarve eva vyāpakāḥ tasmāt naḥ eṣaḥ doṣaḥ iti na ukta uttara tvāt ukta uttaram etat vākyam na punar pratisamādhānam prayojayati iti tasmāt na vyajyate iti nāda upalabdhau ca viprakṛṣṭa deśa avasthitena nāda samāna deśasya śabda anupalabdheḥ na vyañjakaḥ nādaḥ etena vāyavīyāḥ saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ śabda vyañjakāḥ iti pratyuktam

kṛtaka vat upacārāt ca tīvram mandam iti kṛtakam upacaryate tīvram sukham duḥkham mandam sukham duḥkham iti upacaryate tīvraḥ śabdaḥ mandaḥ śabdaḥ iti atra prayogaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ tīvra manda viṣaya tvāt sukha duḥkha vat iti kṛtaka vat upacārāt iti anena sūtreṇa sarva anitya tva dharma sādhana saṃgrahaḥ kṛtaka vat grahaṇasya udāharaṇa artha tvāt yathā sāmānya viśeṣavataḥ asmad ādi bāhya karaṇa pratyakṣa tvāt upalabhyasya anupalabdhi kāraṇa abhāve sati anupalabdhiḥ guṇasya sataḥ asmad ādi bāhya karaṇa pratyakṣa tvam iti evam ādi

tīvra śabdasya tīvra artha viṣaya tvāt na śabda ādi viṣaya tvam iti ced atha manyase tīvra śabdena tīvra arthaḥ abhidhīyate na śabdaḥ na ca anya viṣayaḥ śabdaḥ anyasya arthasya pratipādakaḥ iti na śabda śabda samāna adhikaraṇasya tīvra śabdasya abhidhānāt satyam ayam tīvra śabdaḥ kevalaḥ uccaran dravya guṇa karmaṇām samānam dharmam pratipādayati śabda śabdaḥ api uccaran aneka dharma yoginam śabdam abhidhatte yadā punar etau tīvra śabda śabdau viśeṣaṇā viśeṣya bhāva āpannau abhidhīyete tadā tīvra śabdena dharma antarāṇi vyavacchidyante śabda śabdena ca dharmi antarāṇi iti ubhaya śabda prayogāt śabdaḥ gamyate tasmāt upapannam tīvra manda śabda viṣaya tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti

vyañjakasya tathā abhāvāt grahaṇasya tīvra manda tā rūpavat iti ced na abhibhava upapatteḥ śeṣam bhāṣye grahaṇam nimitta bheda anuvidhāyi iti ced na grahaṇa bhedasya ekatra adṛṣṭa tvāt atha manyase na śabdaḥ bhidyate śabde tu abhinne grahaṇam nimitta bheda anuvidhāyi bhavati grahaṇa bhedāt ca abhibhavaḥ iti na grahaṇa bhedasya ekatra adṛṣṭa tvāt yadi abhinnaḥ śabdaḥ grahaṇa bhedaḥ na prāpnoti na hi abhinne viṣaye bheda grahaṇam paśyāmaḥ

atha abhinne viṣaye grahaṇāni bhidyante iti manyase nityam grahaṇa bhedaḥ syāt tatas ca bhinnaḥ abhinnaḥ iti bhinna abhinna pratyayau na syātām abhibhava anupapattiḥ ca grahaṇayoḥ yugapad asambhavāt na hi grahaṇe yugapad bhavataḥ na ca ekam grahaṇam ātmanaḥ eva abhibhāvakam na ca ayam abhibhavaḥ na asti tasmāt bhidyate śabdaḥ

abhibhava anupapattiḥ ca vyañjaka samāna deśasya abhivyaktau prāpti abhāvāt vyañjakena samāna deśaḥ ayam vyajyate iti etasmin pakṣe naḥ upapadyate abhibhavaḥ kasmāt vyañjaka samāna deśa tvāt na hi vyañjaka samāna deśena śabdena aprāptaḥ śabdaḥ abhibhavitum śakyaḥ aprāpta tvāt na hi aprāptam abhibhāvakam bhavati atha aprāptam abhibhavati iti manyase vīṇā ādi śabdānām agrahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ aprāptāḥ śaṅkha rāsabha ādi śabdāḥ abhibhāvakāḥ iti na kadā cit vīṇā ādi śabdāḥ śrūyeran

sarvatra santi iti ced na pūrva doṣa anuvṛtteḥ atha manyase yaḥ vyañjaka samāna deśam śabdam abhyupaiti tasya eṣaḥ doṣaḥ asmākam tu sarve eva śabdāḥ samāna deśāḥ tasmāt adoṣaḥ ayam iti na pūrva doṣa an ativṛtteḥ samāna deśa tve śabdānām vyañjakeṣu niyamaḥ na asti iti yat kim cit vyañjakam upāttam sarva śabda vyakti hetuḥ iti pūrva doṣa anivṛttiḥ samāna deśa tve ca vīṇā veṇu śaṅkha śabdānām nityam saṅkha śabdena vīṇā veṇu śabdayoḥ abhibhavaḥ iti vīṇā ādi śabda aśravaṇa prasaṅgaḥ tad avasthaḥ tasmāt śabdāḥ eva bhidyante iti teṣām tu bhinnānām santāna vṛtti tve sati ye karṇa śaṣkulīm ati ākāśa deśe yugapad samavayanti tatra yaḥ paṭuḥ śabdaḥ saḥ itarasya abhibhāvakaḥ iti abhibhavaḥ ca nāma mandasya paṭīyasoḥ grahaṇāt agrahaṇam iti

yadi santāna vṛttiḥ śabdaḥ karṇa śaṣkulīmat ākāśa deśam prāptaḥ ca gṛhyate diś deśa pratyayaḥ na prāpnoti iti pūrveṇa śabdaḥ uttareṇa śabdaḥ iti na hi viṣayeṣu pratyāsīdatsu diś deśa pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ gandha ādi vat iti na upādāna nimitta tvāt diś deśa vyapadeśasya yaḥ ayam śabdeṣu diś deśa vyapadeśaḥ na ayam śabda nimittaḥ pūrva apara ādi bhinnebhyaḥ nimittebhyaḥ upajāyamānānām eka deśa grahaṇāt tulyaḥ diś deśa vyapadeśaḥ syāt tasmāt na śabda nimittaḥ

kutas tarhi ayam bhavati iti vācyam nimitta bhedāt yāni tāni śabda nimittāni śabda kāraṇasya saṃyogasya anugrahakāṇi tāni diś deśavanti teṣām nimittānām bhedāt diś deśa pratyayāḥ iti nimitta deśa grahaṇāt ye upalabhyamāna nimittāḥ śabdāḥ teṣu etat yuktam vaktum yeṣām tu śabdānām nimittāni naḥ upalabhyante teṣu diś deśa pratyayaḥ na yuktaḥ na na yuktaḥ śabda santānasya nimitta bheda abhimukhyena ādau prāpteḥ yaḥ śabda santānaḥ yasmāt nimittāt upajāyate sa samantāt śabda antarāṇi santanoti tatra yaḥ śabda viśesaḥ ādau karṇa śaṣkulīm atas ākāśa deśasya tad abhimukhena bhāgena sambadhyate tad nimittaḥ pūrva apara ādi śabda vyapadeśaḥ iti yadā punar ādya śabda paricchedaḥ na asti tadā viparyayaḥ iti

eke tu bruvate naḥ eva śabdeṣu diś deśa pratyayāḥ santi kutas cakṣuḥ viṣaya siddhau diś deśa vyavasāyāt iti tathā hi jāti andhānām pūrva apara ādi pratyayāḥ śabdeṣu na santi iti apare tu diś deśa vyapadeśena cakṣuḥ śrotre aprāpya kāriṇī iti bruvate teṣām uktam uttaram pratyakṣa sūtram varṇayadbhiḥ iti
sūtrasya pūrva hetūnām anaikāntika tva jñāpanam arthaḥ śeṣam bhāṣye

nitya tvam iti atra kim tāvat tattvam ubhaya anta aparicchinna sattā saṃbandhaḥ iti viparyayāt anitya tvam etat ca abhāve na asti bhāktam tu tat bhavati nityaḥ iva nityaḥ ghaṭa abhāvaḥ na punar nityaḥ eva kāla dvayānavasthānāt pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ na prāk asti na ghaṭa kāle asti prāc abhāvaḥ na pradhvaṃsa kāle na ghaṭa kāle iti katham tarhi nityaḥ iti nityaḥ iva nityaḥ iti ucyate bhaktyā kā punar iyam bhaktiḥ prāgabhāvasya kāraṇa abhāvaḥ pradhvaṃsa abhāvasya avināśaḥ ubhayam ca etat nitya viṣayam iti etat sāmānyāt nityaḥ iva nityaḥ na punar nityaḥ eva iti

indriya pratyāsatti grāhyaḥ aindriyakaḥ iti santāna anumāna viśeṣaṇāt avyabhicāraḥ na vayam aindriyaka tvāt iti anena śabda anitya tām sādhayāmaḥ api tu aindriyaka tvāt iti anena śabdasya vyaktim pratiṣedhāmaḥ na hi vyajyamānasya aindriyaka tvam yuktam iti purastāt uktam

nityeṣu api avyabhicāraḥ na hi nityānām dravyāṇām pradeśa śabdena kāraṇam ucyate ākāśasya pradeśaḥ ātmanaḥ pradeśaḥ iti na atra ākāśa ātmanoḥ kāraṇa dravyam abhidhīyate yathā kṛtakasya kim iti na abhidhīyate avidyamāna tvāt na hi vidyante ākāśa ādeḥ pradeśāḥ iti katham na vidyante pramāṇataḥ anupalabdheḥ yadi ākāśa ādeḥ pradeśāḥ syuḥ pramāṇataḥ upalabhyeran iti katham pramāṇataḥ anupalabdhiḥ vikalpa anupapatteḥ pradeśa śabdena kāraṇam vai abhidhīyate ādhāraḥ vā na kāraṇam akṛtaka tvāt yasmāt akṛtakam ākāśam atas na kāraṇa arthaḥ pradeśa śabdena ucyate na ādhāraḥ anāśrita tvāt anāśritam ākāśam tasya ādhāra arthaḥ api na śakyaḥ vaktum iti

loka virodhaḥ iti ced na anyathā tad upapatteḥ yadi ākāśam niṣpradeśam pratipadyase nanu lokaḥ viruddhyate pūrva bhāgena nabhasaḥ ādityaḥ iti madhya bhāge nabhasaḥ ādityaḥ iti na anyathā tad upapatteḥ saṃyogasya avyāpya vṛtti tve pradeśa śabdena abhidhīyamāne na loka virodhaḥ yasmāt yat tat saṃyogasya avyāpya vṛtti tvam tat pradeśa śabdena abhidhīyate etat ca pradeśavatā dravyeṇa ākāśa sāmānyam ye khalu paricchinne dravye āmalaka ādike bhavataḥ tayoḥ yaḥ saṃyogaḥ vartate sa te na vyāpnoti pradeśavatī ca te ākāśa saṃyogaḥ api na ākāśam vyāpnoti iti pradeśa vat dravya sāmānyāt pradeśa vat ākāśam iti bhāktaḥ pratyayaḥ

kā punar iyam bhaktiḥ atathābhūtasya tathā bhāvibhiḥ sāmānyam ubhayena bhajyate iti bhaktiḥ etat sāmānyāt adhyāropita pradeśa vṛttiḥ pradeśa śabdaḥ yasmāt ākāśasya pradeśavadbhiḥ dravyaiḥ sāmānyam saṃyogasya avyāpya vṛtti tvam asti atas pradeśa śabdaḥ ākāśe prayujyate evam etat na tattvataḥ iti ced na pramāṇam asti iti ced na pramāṇataḥ anupalabdheḥ atha manyase ākāśa pradeśāḥ pradeśa vat dravya sāmānyāt ākāśe upacaryante na punar tattvataḥ santi iti na pramāṇam asti na pradeśasya pramāṇataḥ anupalabdheḥ na hi ākāśa ādi pradeśa pratipādakam pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇam sambhavati iti

sva rūpeṇa anabhidhānāt ca yadi ca ākāśasya pradeśāḥ syuḥ te sva rūpeṇa vyapadiśyeran yathā paṭasya pradeśāḥ ke tantavaḥ iti na punar ākāśasya pradeśāḥ ke iti ukte sva rūpeṇa vyapadeṣṭum śakyāḥ iti kimaḥ anupapatteḥ ca pūrvavat yān ca ākāśa pradeśān bhavān manyate te kim ākāśa ātmakāḥ uta naḥ iti kim ca atas yadi ākāśa ātmakāḥ anekam ākāśam iti prāptam atha na teṣām svabhāvaḥ vaktavyaḥ katham ca te tasya pradeśāḥ iti vaktavyam anākāśa ātmakāḥ santaḥ ākāśasya pradeśāḥ iti kena arthena abhidhīyate tat yathā tantavaḥ paṭa pradeśāḥ iti ukte kāraṇa arthaḥ ādhāra arthaḥ ca gamyate na punar ākāśasya pradeśeṣu etat asti

pradeśa abhāvāt anādhāraḥ saṃyogaḥ iti ced nānā dhāraḥ ākāśa vṛtti tvāt atha manuṣe yadi ākāśasya pradeśāḥ na santi ākāśa deśa āśrayaḥ saṃyogaḥ anādhāraḥ prāpnoti nānā dhāraḥ ākāśa vṛtti tvāt asya yasmāt tvayā eva ucyate ākāśa āśrayaḥ iti tasmāt nānā dhāraḥ iti samāna deśāḥ iti ced na ābādhanāt atha manyase mūrtimat dravya saṃyogāḥ ye ākāśe nanu te pradeśa abhāvāt sarve eva samāna deśāḥ prāpnuvanti evam ca samāna deśa tve sati na kim cit bādhyate tat evam pradeśa vat dravya sāmānyāt ākāśasya pradeśāḥ iti bhāktaḥ pratyayaḥ

niṣpradeśa tvāt sarva śabda upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na ukta uttara tvāt atha manyase yadi niṣpradeśam ākāśam tena ca tarhi sarve eva śabdāḥ samāna deśāḥ iti sarvaiḥ sarvaḥ śabdaḥ upalabhyeta na tu upalabhyate tasmāt anyonya vṛttayaḥ śabdāḥ sarvaiḥ agrahaṇāt aṅguli rūpa ādi vat iti na ukta uttara tvāt ukta uttaram etat yathā saṃyogasya avyāpya vṛtti tvam tathā śabdasya api iti

guṇa tvāt vyāpakam iti eke eke tu guṇa tvāt hetoḥ śabda saṃyoga ādi aṅguli rūpavat vyāpakam pratipadyante te idam praṣṭavyāḥ vyāpaka tvam iti kaḥ arthaḥ yadi āśraya vṛtti tvam vyāptiḥ na kim cit bādhyate atha anyat tat na vidmaḥ vayam tu vyāptim aṅguli rūpasya āśraya upalabdhau upalabhya tvam brūmaḥ na punar śabda ādayaḥ āśraya upalabdhau upalabhyante iti tasmāt aṅguli rūpavat na vyāpakāḥ iti

samudita sthānānām eka samudāyī upalabdhau upalabdhi anupalabdhī vyāpti avyāptī eka āśrayāṇām āśraya upalabdhau iti atha ye ākāśe mūrtimatām saṃyogāḥ teṣām kān cit ke cit kṛtakān pratipadyante kān cit akṛtakān iti tatra kārya dravya saṃyogaḥ kṛtakaḥ saṃyoga ja tvāt utpadyamānasya kāraṇa sambandhibhiḥ kāryasya saṃyoga jaḥ saṃyogaḥ iti kriyājam tu ke cit naḥ icchanti yāvat dravya bhāvi tvāt saṃyogasya avibhaktasya ca saṃyogaḥ na asti iti na asti ākāśe kriyājaḥ saṃyogaḥ aṇu ākāśa saṃyogam tu akṛtakam icchanti tatra aṇvākāśa saṃyogasya tāvat kṛtaka tve anumānam ākāśena kṛtaka sambandha sambandhī paramāṇuḥ mūrtimat tva ādibhyaḥ ghaṭa vat iti kārya ākāśa saṃyogaḥ api vipratipatti viṣayaḥ na yāvat dravya bhāvī avinaśyat ādhāra tve kriyāvat dravya vṛtti tve ca aprāpti pratidvandvi tvāt mūrtimat itara dravya saṃyoga vat tasmāt kārya dravyeṇa ākāśasya saṃyoga jaḥ ca saṃyogaḥ kriyājaḥ ca paramāṇoḥ tu kriyājaḥ iti

vipratipatti viṣaya avibhāginaḥ ākāśa ādayaḥ kriyāvat dravya saṃyogi tvāt paramāṇu vat yathā paramāṇoḥ kriyāvat dravya saṃyogāḥ ayāvat dravya bhāvinaḥ saṃyoga vat śabda buddhi ādayaḥ ca ātmani avyāpakāḥ saṃyogasya ca avyāpya vṛtti tvam ātmanaḥ pradeśa arthaḥ iti vyākhyātam ekasya ca aneka mūrta pradeśa vat dravya sambandhi tvam pradeśa arthaḥ yat vā yat ākāśasya ekasya sataḥ pradeśavatā anekena sambandhi tvam tat pradeśa vat dravya sāmānyam yathā ghaṭasya iti

kasmāt punar sūtrakārasya asmin arthe sūtram na śrūyate iti katam asmin arthe niṣpradeśam ākāśam niṣpradeśaḥ ātmā iti etasmin arthataḥ adhigateḥ na sūtram yasmāt ayam arthaḥ arthataḥ adhigamyate atas na sūtritaḥ iti śabda santāna pratipādane vā na sūtram arthataḥ adhigateḥ śāstra siddhāntāt vā tad adhigatiḥ śāstra siddhāntaḥ tu nyāya samākhyātam bahu śākham anumānam tena anuktam api gamyate iti na sūtryate

atha api khalu idam asti idam na asti iti bhāṣyam yaḥ ayam paryanuyogaḥ tasya kaḥ viṣayaḥ iti anupalabhyamāna śabda astitvam ye śabdam nitya tvam kalpayanti te idam paryanuyojyāḥ idam asti idam na asti iti etat bhavantaḥ katham pratipadyante iti evam anuyuktāḥ santaḥ pratibruvate pramāṇataḥ upalabdheḥ anupalabdheḥ ca iti

avidyamānaḥ tarhi śabdaḥ prāk uccāraṇāt anupalabdheḥ āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdheḥ ca yat ca ubhaya pakṣa sampratipannam ghaṭa ādi anitya tvena tena ca anuyojyāḥ iti yat idam anityam ghaṭa ādi bhavadbhiḥ pratipadyate tat katham anityam iti saḥ evam anuyuktaḥ yadi ghaṭa ādi anitya tve nyāyam bravīti sa śabde api iti sūtram sataḥ anupalabdhi kāraṇa abhāve kadā cit upalabdheḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ śeṣam bhāṣye

vyañjaka abhāvāt agrahaṇam iti ced na ukta uttara tvāt atha manyase śabdasya uccāraṇam vyañjakam vyañjaka abhāvāt naḥ upalabhyate iti asiddham viśeṣaṇam anupalabdhi kāraṇa abhāvaḥ iti kim idam uccāraṇam nāma vivakṣā janitena prayatnena kauṣṭhyasya vāyoḥ preritasya kaṇṭha ādi sthāneṣu pratighātaḥ tat naḥ ukta uttara tvāt vāyu gata vega apekṣaḥ vāyunā tālu ādi saṃyogaḥ abhighātaḥ saṃyogasya ca vyañjaka tvam prāk pratiṣiddham iti

evam ca sati tattvam pāṃśubhiḥ iva avakiran āha kaḥ asya arthaḥ tattve ukte jātyā pratyavatiṣṭhate iti sā ca jātiḥ tad anupalabdheḥ anupalambhāt āvaraṇa upapattiḥ kaḥ asya vākyasya arthaḥ āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdhyā anekāntaḥ iti ayam arthaḥ yathā āvaraṇa anupalabdhiḥ anupalabhyamānāḥ api asti tathā āvaraṇam iti anekāntaḥ atha anupalabdhiḥ anupalabhyamānā na asti tad abhāvāt upalabdhiḥ asti na ca avidyamānasya upalabdhiḥ iti siddham āvaraṇam katham punar bhavān jānīyate na āvaraṇa anupalabdhiḥ upalabhyate iti kim atra jñeyam pratyātma vedanīya tvāt pratyātmam eva ayam āvaraṇa upalabdhi vat āvaraṇa anupalabdhim ca vedayate evam ca sati apahṛta viṣayam uttaram vākyam iti apahṛta viṣayam iti na asya utthānam asti iti
abhyanujñā vādena tu ucyate anupalambhāt api anupalabdhi sadbhāvāt na āvaraṇa anupapattiḥ anupalambhāt iti asya sūtrasya anupalabdheḥ anaikāntika tvam arthaḥ

atathā jātīyena pratyavasthānāt anuttaram iti sūtra arthaḥ yathājātīyaḥ śabdaḥ anityaḥ tathā ajātīyam kim cit nityam na dṛṣṭam iti uktam ca atra kim uktam ubhaya anta aparicchinna sattā sambandhaḥ nityatā iti tasmāt ayathārtha pratyavasthānāt na kim cit etat anityaḥ śabdaḥ guṇa tve sati asmad ādi pratyakṣa tvāt buddhi vat iti avyāpakasya vyāpaka dravya samavāyi tve sati pratyakṣa tvāt sukha vat ākāśa niṣpradeśa tve hetuḥ niṣpradeśam ākāśam vyāpaka tvāt ātma vat dravyasya sataḥ sarvadā amūrta tvāt ātma vat eva vyāpaka tvāt eva akṛtaka tvam vyāpaka tvam ca dravyasya sataḥ sarvadā amūrta tvāt etena diś kālau vyākhyātau evam tāvat sva sādhana sthityā vyavasthitam anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti

atha śabdasya nitya tvam pratijānānāḥ iti bhāṣyam vipratipatteḥ pramāṇa mūla tvāt hetau paripraśnaḥ vipratipattiḥ nāma dvayoḥ eka dharma viṣayā viruddha dharma sampratipattiḥ na ca vipratipattiḥ pramāṇa antaram antareṇa yuktāḥ iti nitya tve pramāṇam vaktavyam iti nityaḥ śabdaḥ asparśa tvāt anupalabdha vipakṣa eka deśasya prayogaḥ ākāśa vat iti
tasya vyabhicāra darśana artham sūtram na karma anitya tvāt iti śeṣam asya bhāṣye
na aṇu nitya tvāt
ayam anyaḥ hetuḥ śabda nitya tve sampradānāt na hi kim cit nityam sampradīyamānam dṛṣṭam iti anvayinaḥ dṛṣṭāntasya abhāvāt viruddhaḥ

atha ayam pratijñā arthaḥ avatiṣṭhate śabdaḥ sampradānāt ghaṭa ādi vat iti evam api nitya tvam na sidhyati tad antarāla anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ avatiṣṭhamānaḥ hi dātṛ pratigrahītroḥ antarāle upalabhyeta iti iti virodhaḥ sūtra arthaḥ

na virodhaḥ anumānātaḥ upalabdheḥ na hi pratyakṣataḥ anupalabhyamānasya anumānena upalabdhiḥ sattām bādhate kim anumānam adhyāpanam kim idam adhyāpanam nāma dīyamānasya sampradāna prāptiḥ dātṛ pratigrahītroḥ antarāle śabdaḥ asti adhāpanāt śara ādi vat iti

na śabdasya adhyāpanam pratiṣidhyate api tu nṛtya upadeśa vat anityasya eva ādhyāpanam iti yat punar etat dātṛ pratigrahītroḥ antarāle śabdaḥ asti iti siddha sādhanam etat vayam api brūmaḥ dātrā uccaritaḥ śabdaḥ santāna vṛttyā sampradānam prāpnoti tasmāt sampradānam avasthāne na hetuḥ

ayam tarhi hetuḥ abhyāsāt vīṇā ādi vat iti anityeṣu eva laṅghana plavana ādiṣu abhyāsaḥ iti viruddhaḥ atha avasthānam abhyāsāt sādhyeta tathā api anavasthiteṣu teṣu eva abhyāsaḥ iti anekāntaḥ abhyāsa svarūpa anavadhāraṇāt asiddhaḥ ca abhyāsaḥ hi nāma eka viṣayaḥ aneka jñāna utpādaḥ eka ākāra viṣayaḥ vā tatra ayam abhyāsaḥ eka viṣayaḥ eka ākāra viṣayaḥ vā iti sandigdha asiddhaḥ

abhyāsā siddhau abhyāsa upacāra viṣaya tvena sādhanam tasya anaikāntika tva jñāpana artham na anya tve api abhyāsa upacāraḥ anya tva pratiṣedha artham api abhyāsasya upacārāt etat sūtram anya tva pratiṣedha artham

yat idam anyat iti manyase idam anyasmāt ananyat vā syāt ananyat vā yadi anyat ananyat na bhavati yathā brāhmaṇāt anyaḥ na brāhmaṇaḥ iti atha ananyat tathā api anyat na bhavati ananya tvāt yat ananyat tat katham anyat bhavati iti

sūtrasya arthaḥ virodhaḥ ananya tvam abhyupagatam nivartate iti katham nivartate pratiṣedhasya anya viṣaya tvāt anya abhāve ananyat na asti na hi brāhmaṇa abhāve abrāhmaṇaḥ sidhyati iti ayam tarhi hetuḥ pratyabhijñānāt tad abhāve pratyabhijñānam dṛṣṭam maṇi ādiṣu asti ca pratyabhijñānam śabde tasmāt pratyabhijñānāt avatiṣṭhate śabdaḥ iti kim idam pratyabhijñānam tad pratyaya viṣaya tvam tad pratyaya viṣaya tvam anya tve api iti anekāntaḥ atha pratyabhijñānam tad pratyaya viṣayasya avyabhicāraḥ na hi kadā cit tad pratyaya viṣaya vyabhicāraḥ asti yaḥ punar sadṛśe tad pratyayaḥ sa viśeṣa darśanāt nivartate atas yā asu tad pratyayasya śabde avyāvṛttiḥ tat pratyabhijñānam iti na tad pratyayasya avyāvṛttiḥ asiddhā ayam tāvat tad pratyayaḥ puruṣa antare nivartamānaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yat punar etat viśeṣa darśanāt tad sadṛśe tad bhāva pratyayaḥ nivartate iti satyam eva tat śabde tu kim viśeṣasya adarśanāt

tad sadṛśe tad pratyayaḥ uta tad bhāvāt eva tad pratyayaḥ iti sandihyate atha pratyabhijñānam tad bhāvāt bhavati iti pakṣaḥ tathā api anyaḥ hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ kim kāraṇam pratyabhijñānasya pakṣa viśeṣaṇa tvena upayukta tvāt yat punar etat go śabdena go śabdaḥ iti pratyayasya avyāvṛttiḥ asti iti na ca go śabdasya go pratyaya kartṛ tva vyabhicāraḥ iti etat api sandihyate kim kāraṇa sāmānyāt go śabde go pratyayasya avyāvṛttiḥ āhosvit tad bhāvāt iti etena tad pratyaya kartṛ tvam vyākhyātam yuktam tu kāraṇa sāmānyāt tad pratyayasya avyāvṛttiḥ katham iti go buddhau go buddhi pratyayaḥ na vyāvartate na ca asyāḥ go śabda buddheḥ tad pratyaya kartṛ tvam nivartate tasmāt tad pratyaya hetu tve pratyabhijñānam ahetuḥ

yaḥ ca anupalabdha viśeṣaḥ eva nivartate tam prati tasya vastunaḥ kim viśeṣaḥ asti na asti iti bhavantaḥ eva praṣṭavyāḥ yadi asti viśeṣaḥ tad pratyaya avyāvṛttiḥ ahetuḥ anekāntāt atha na asti viśeṣaḥ ekam vastu dvi ātmakam iti prāptam virodhāt ahetuḥ pratyaya avi āvṛttiḥ ca aśeṣa puruṣa viṣaya tayā asiddhā puruṣa viśeṣa viṣaya tayā anaikāntikī iti
ayam tarhi hetuḥ vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ yat anityam tasya vināśa kāraṇam upalabhyate yathā loṣṭasya kāraṇa dravya vibhāgaḥ na tu śabdasya tasmāt nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti
aśravaṇa kāraṇa anupapatteḥ satatam śravaṇa prasaṅgaḥ iti śeṣam bhāṣye

anumānena śabdasya vināśa kāraṇam upalabhyate yat ca anumānena upalabhyate na tat na asti kim anumānam santāna upapatteḥ iti varṇitam tasmāt anapadeśaḥ ayam vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ iti yathā viṣāṇī tasmāt aśvaḥ iti kim punar atra asat kim viṣāṇam āhosvit aśva viṣāṇa sambandhaḥ iti ubhayam iti āha nanu yadā viṣāṇinam aśva tvena sādhayati tadā viṣāṇam asti eva na viṣāṇam pratiṣidhyate aśva viṣāṇa sambandhasya abhāvāt anumānam asat iti yuktam vaktum asattvāt anapedeśaḥ iti karma vat iti ced na āśraya anitya tvāt atha manyase nityasya api upalabhyamānasya atyantam agrahaṇam dṛṣṭam yathā karma tvasya iti tat ca naḥ āśraya anitya tvāt āśrayasya nitya tvāt aśravaṇa kāraṇa anupapatteḥ iti brūmaḥ karma tvasya punar agrahaṇa kāraṇam āśraya anitya tvam asti tasmāt aprasaṅgaḥ iti

ghaṇṭāyām abhihanyamānāyām tāraḥ tārataraḥ mandaḥ mandataraḥ iti śruti bhedāt nānā śabda santānaḥ hi avicchedena śrūyate tatra idam cintyate śabdasya vyajyamānasya yat vyakti kāraṇam tat kim ghaṇṭā stham āhosvit anya vṛtti iti yadi ghaṇṭā stham kim avasthitam uta santāna vṛtti iti anya vṛtti tve api kim avasthitam uta santāna vṛtti iti yadi ghaṇṭā stham avasthitam ca śruti bhedaḥ na prāpnoti iti atha ghaṇṭā stham santāna vṛtti ca yugapad aneka śabdvyakti prasaṅgaḥ yāvān śabdaḥ ghaṇṭā sthena avasthitena santāna vṛttinā vā vyaṅgyaḥ sa sarvaḥ ekasmin kāle upalabhyeta ghaṇṭā stham ca abhivyakti kāraṇam katham anyatra vartamānam śabdam vyanakti iti vācyam atha anya āgatam avasthitam santāna vṛtti vā śabda abhivyakti kāraṇam manyase tadā ekasyām ghaṇṭāyām abhihatāyām śabdān vyanakti na pratyāsanna deśa vṛttiṣu ghaṇṭā antareṣu iti niyama hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ asati ca śabda bhede śrutīnām bhedaḥ upapādayitavyaḥ

tāraḥ mandaḥ iti nādaḥ bhidyate na śabdaḥ tāraḥ mandaḥ iti ced na śabda samāna ādhikaraṇyasya grahaṇāt śabda śabda samāna adhikaraṇaḥ ayam tāra manda ādi śabdaḥ pravartate na ca asati śabda viṣaya tve śabda samāna adhikaraṇa tvam yuktam nīlotpala vat iti vyāmoha pratyayaḥ saḥ iti ced na nimittān abhidhānāt atha manyase tāraḥ mandaḥ iti śabda samāna adhikaraṇaḥ vyāmoha pratyayaḥ bhavati yathā dīrghaḥ śabdaḥ mahān śabdaḥ iti na viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt vyāmoha pratyayaḥ ayam iti na viśeṣa hetuḥ asti yadi ca ayam vyāmoha pratyayaḥ bhavati vyāmoha pratyayasya nimittam vācyam yathā dīrghaḥ śabdaḥ iti avirata śabda santāna śrutau śabde dīrgha pratyayaḥ bhavati yāni khalu dīrghāṇi dravyāṇi bhavanti teṣām avayava upacaye sati grahaṇa santati viṣaya tvam tad sāmānyāt śabde dīrgha pratyayaḥ na tu nitya śabda vādinaḥ vyāmoha pratyaya bījam asti iti ayuktam etat

tulyam iti ced na tad nimittasya kadā cit bhāvāt atha manyase yasya api anityaḥ śabdaḥ tena api ghaṇṭā stham avasthitam santāna vṛtti vai anya stham avasthitam santāna vṛtti vai utpatti kāraṇam vācyam ghaṇṭā stham utpatti kāraṇam kadā cit śabdān utpādayati kadā cit naḥ iti nitya vat prasaṅgaḥ na prasaṅgaḥ nimittasya kadā cit bhāvāt yat tu tat śabda utpatti kāraṇam ghaṇṭā vṛtti tat kadā cit bhavati kadā cit bhāve api sati santāna vṛtti tasmāt nimitta bheda anuvidhāyinaḥ śabdāḥ kadā cit bhavanti santāna vṛtti tvāt ca mandataratama ādi bhinna rūpa anuvidhāyinam śabdam utpādayanti iti tat ca kāraṇam saṃskāraḥ iti

kutas tad utpattiḥ pāṇi saṃśleṣam apekṣamāṇāt karmaṇaḥ pāṇi ghaṇṭā saṃśleṣāt pāṇi gata vega apekṣāt ghaṇṭāyām karma tat karma pāṇi abhighātam apekṣamāṇam vibhāga sama kālam saṃskāram karoti sā calanti ādhyātmikam vāyum upagṛhṇāti sā vāyunā abhihatā punar karma karoti tatas saṃskāraḥ saṃskāreṇa punar karma punar vāyu upagrahaṇam iti evam mandataratamādi nyāyena saṃskāraḥ upapadyate iti tatra antyasya atimāndyāt ghaṇṭāyām mahābhūta saṃkṣobha śakteḥ abhāvaḥ tatas vāyu upagraha ucchedaḥ tatas saṃskāra kṣayaḥ iti

na saṃskāraḥ asti anupalabdheḥ iti ced atha manyase naḥ eva saṃskāraḥ asti anupalabdheḥ iti tat ca asat pāṇi nimitta praśleṣāt śabda abhāve na anupalabdhiḥ ukta artham sūtram yadi saṃskāram śabda utpatti nimittam na pratipadyase pāṇi ghaṇṭā saṃśleṣāt śabdesantāna ucchedaḥ na prāpnoti atha ghaṇṭā sthaḥ saṃskāraḥ pāṇi saṃśleṣāt nivartate tathā api katham śabda santāna ucchedaḥ iti na brūmaḥ pāṇi ghaṇṭā saṃśleṣaḥ śabdam ucchinatti iti api tu pāṇi ghaṇṭā saṃśleṣāt tad vṛttiḥ saṃskāraḥ sparśavat dravya saṃyoga virodhi tvāt nivartate nivṛtte ca tasmin kāraṇa abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ iti santāna ucchedaḥ

yat idam ucyate vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti yadi yasya vināśa kāraṇam na upalabhyate tat nityam yāni imāni śabda grahaṇāni teṣām na bhavatā vināśa kāraṇam upapādyate anupapādanāt avasthānāt nitya tvam iti atha anupalabdha vināśa kāraṇāni api śabda grahaṇāni anityāni śabdaḥ api evam iti anekāntaḥ atha anumānataḥ śabda grahaṇānām vināśa kāraṇam gamyante tad samānam śabdaḥ iti na kim cit bādhitam bhavati

vyadhikaraṇa tvāt ayuktam iti ced atha manyase vyadhikaraṇaḥ śabdaḥ katham anya vṛttinā saṃśleṣeṇa nivartyate atha vyadhikaraṇam api nivartayati sarva ghaṇṭā śabda uccheda prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt pāṇi ghaṇṭā saṃśleṣa samāna adhikaraṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti asparśa tvāt apratiṣedhaḥ asparśa vyāpi dravya āśrayaḥ śabdaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ katham anyatara vartamānasya pāṇi ghaṇṭā saṃśleṣaḥ nivartakaḥ iti na ukta uttara tvāt ukta uttaram etat kāraṇa abhāvāt anya śabda anutpādaḥ yaḥ tu utpannaḥ śabdaḥ sa mandataratamādi nyāyena antyasya atimāndyāt yena kena cit virodhi tvāt kṣīyate yaḥ ayam saṃskāraḥ śabda kāraṇa tvena samadhigataḥ sa kim ekaḥ anekaḥ vā iti sandihyate anekaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti etat tattvam śabda bhedāt kāraṇa bhede sati kārya bhedaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti yasya ca ekaḥ saṃskāraḥ tasya eṣoḥ pātaḥ prāpnoti agatvā eva yāvat gantavyam iti atha apratibadhyamāne saṃskāre dravyam gacchati na kadā cit pātaḥ prāpnoti dṛṣṭaḥ ca pātaḥ tasmāt anekaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti

tasmāt na ayam śabdaḥ gandha ādibhiḥ saha sanniviṣṭaḥ vyajyante vibhakti antara upapatteḥ vibhāgaḥ ca vibhāgānataram ca iti vibhakti antaram vidharmāṇaḥ śabdāḥ nānā rūpāḥ sarūpāḥ ca eka dravyāḥ śrūyante samāsaḥ samudāyaḥ etat ca sparśavat dravya vṛttiṣu śabdeṣu na prāpnoti gandha ādi vat yathā pratidravyam ekaḥ gandhaḥ evam pratidravyam ekaḥ śabdaḥ iti santāna upapatteḥ ca iti ca arthaḥ yadi ayam gandha ādibhiḥ saha sanniviṣṭaḥ syāt na anyatra vartamānaḥ śrotraḥ upalabhyeta tasmāt santāna vṛtti tvāt ākāśa āśrayaḥ śabdaḥ iti
iti saṃśaya jñāpana artham sūtram
iti sūtram prakṛti anuvidhānāt iti sūtra arthaḥ vikāre prakṛti anuvidhānam dṛṣṭam iti
iti sādhana pakṣe dṛṣṭānta mātra tvāt ahetuḥ
dvividhasya api hetoḥ abhāvāt asādhanam dṛṣṭāntaḥ
dūṣaṇa pakṣe na atulya prakṛtīnām vikāra vikalpāt iti asambaddham atulyāyāḥ prakṛteḥ vikalpyante vikārāḥ hrasva dīrgha anuvidhānam tu yakāre na asti iti
yathā dravya bhāvena tulyāyāḥ prakṛteḥ vikāra vikalpaḥ bhavati evam varṇa bhāvena tulyāyāḥ prakṛteḥ vikāra vikalpaḥ syāt iti
iti parihāraḥ
iti yadi vikriyante varṇāḥ punar āpattiḥ na prāpnoti
vikāra prāptānām punar āpattiḥ darśanāt anekāntaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ

sarva avastham suvarṇa darśanam na punar ikāraya kārayoḥ kaḥ cit varṇa ātmā vyavasthitaḥ asti yaḥ itvam hitvā yatvam āpadyate iti varṇa tva avyatirekāt varṇa vikārāṇām apratiṣedhaḥ varṇa vikārāḥ api varṇa tvāt na vyatiricyante iti asti varṇa tvam sāmānyam iti sāmānyavataḥ dharma yogaḥ na sāmānyasya iti parihāraḥ
varṇa vikāra anupapattiḥ nitya tve avikārāt anitya tve ca anavasthānāt nityāḥ varṇāḥ iti na yuktaḥ vikāraḥ vyāghātāt anityāḥ varṇāḥ iti na yuktaḥ vikāraḥ anavasthitānām vikāra adarśanāt
nityānām api atīndriya tva darśanāt tad dharma vikalpāt ca varṇa vikārāṇām apratiṣedhaḥ iti vikalpa samā jātiḥ
iti sādharmya samā jātiḥ

ubhayoḥ api uttaram vikāra dharmi tve nitya tva abhāvāt kāla antare vikāra upapatteḥ ca apratiṣedhaḥ nityāḥ varṇāḥ vikriyante iti vyāghātaḥ doṣaḥ upalabhyamānasya ca ikārasya yatvā anupapatteḥ varṇa aupalabdhi vat iti asambaddham
itas ca varṇa vikāra anupapattiḥ prakṛti aniyamāt vikāre prakṛtīnām niyamaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ ikāraya kārayoḥ tu aniyamaḥ tasmāt aniyamāt na vikriyante iti
sūtra arthaḥ aniyamaḥ na asti iti

anujñāta pratiṣiddhayoḥ ekatva anupapatteḥ iti virodhaḥ sūtra arthaḥ tasmāt anupalabhyamāna pṛthak dharmi viśeṣāṇām ādeśaḥ iti yadi ete varṇāḥ vikriyeran tatas pṛthak vikāra lakṣaṇebhyaḥ dharmebhyaḥ dharmī upalabhyeta na tu upalabhyate tasmāt na varṇāḥ vikriyante iti

atha vikriyante iti evam vikāraḥ bhavati guṇa antara āpatti upamarda hrāsa vṛddhi leśa śleṣebhyaḥ tu vikāra upapatteḥ varṇa vikārāḥ sūtra arthaḥ guṇa antara āpatti ādinā deśaḥ iti ayam ca vikāra ādeśa upadeśa vikāraḥ bhāṣya kāreṇa eva samyak nirūpitaḥ iti sūtra artha mātram varṇitam iti

te varṇāḥ yathādarśanam vikṛtāḥ vibhakti antāḥ pada saṃjñakāḥ bhavanti artha pratyayaḥ tarhi na prāpnoti na na prāpnoti antya varṇa pratyayāt pūrva varṇa pratisandhāna pratyaya apekṣāt artha pratyayaḥ iti vibhaktiḥ dvayī nāmikī ca ākhyātikī ca nāmikī sva ādayaḥ ākhyātikī tiba ādayaḥ tayā viśiṣyamāṇam padam dvedhā bhavati nāma ca ākhyātam ca abhidheyasya kriyā antara yogāt viśiṣyamāṇa rūpaḥ sabdaḥ nāma yathā brāhmaṇaḥ iti kriyā kāraka samudāyaḥ kāraka saṃkhyā viśiṣṭaḥ kriyā kāla yoga abhidhāyi kriyā pradhānam ākhyātam pacati iti yathā yadi dvayī vibhaktiḥ upasarga nipātāḥ tarhi na pada saṃjñakāḥ na nāmni antarbhāvāt upasarga nipātāḥ nāmnā saṃgṛhītāḥ yasmāt āha avyayāt lopaḥ iti tena subanta tvāt tena eva saṃgṛhītāḥ iti

padena vyavahāraḥ iti padārthaḥ cintyate nāma padam ca adhikṛtya vyavahāraḥ iti nāma padam cintyate nāmnaḥ ca adhikāraḥ vyāpaka tvāt yasmāt nāmnā sarva padam vyāpyate tasmāt gauḥ iti asya padasya arthaḥ cintyate na padātartha adhigatiḥ viśeṣe anavasthānāt na hi pade uccarite kaḥ cit viśeṣaḥ gamyate tasmāt padam avācakam iti na padasya viśeṣa aviṣaya tvāt kaḥ evam āha padena viśeṣaḥ gamyate api tu sāmānya varti padam viśeṣa varti vākyam na ca sāmānya abhidhānāt anarthakam bhavitum arhati iti na sāmānyasya vyavahāra aviṣaya tvāt sarvaḥ upadeṣṭā viśeṣa pratipatti artham padam uccārayati na ca sāmānye paiṣaḥ na sampratipattiḥ tasmāt padam avācakam eva iti na sāmānya viṣaya tve sati viśeṣa śruteḥ niyāmaka tvāt yadi padāni avācakāni syuḥ na ca pada śravaṇāt sāmānyam gamyeta yat avācakam na tasmāt sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ vā gamyate yathā arthāt gamyate ca padāt sāmānyam sāmānya śruteḥ ca viśeṣa śrutiḥ niyāmikā bhavati yathā gauḥ iti sāmānya adhigatau tiṣṭhati gacchati iti viśeṣa śrutyā gamyate iti katham punar iyam viśeṣa śrutiḥ gacchati tiṣṭhati iti

na eva iyam kevalāt viśeṣa śrutiḥ kim tu pūrva pada apekṣayā viśeṣa pratyaya hetutvāt viśeṣa śrutiḥ iti ucyate bhavatu vā padāt eva ubhayam etasmāt eva vā go śabdāt ubhayam gamyate kriyā ca tad sādhanam ca pradhāna upasarjana bhāvasya aniyamena yadā ayam go śabdaḥ go tva nimittaḥ go tva yogāt gauḥ iti tadā go śabdāt pradhānam sādhanam gauḥ gamyate kriyā tu aṅga bhūtāḥ viśeṣaka tvāt yadā punar kriyā pradhānam padam goḥ bhāvaḥ go tvam iti tadā api gauḥ aṅga bhūtaḥ viśeṣaka tvāt gamyate pradhānam go tvam iti tat evam pradhāna upasarjana bhāvasya aniyamena go tvam iti ca pade gauḥ iti ca ubhayam gamyate iti tatra pradhāna upasarjana bhāvam āśritya tad arthe vyakti ākṛti jāti sannidhau upacārāt saṃśayaḥ yasmāt ayam go śabdaḥ vyakti ākṛti jātiṣu avinā abhāvena vartamānāsu prayujyate avinā abhāva vṛttiḥ ca sannidhiḥ atas na jñāyate kim vyaktiḥ padārthaḥ uta ākṛtiḥ uta jātiḥ iti

śabdasya prayoga sāmarthyāt padārtha avadhāraṇam iti prayoga pradarśana artham yā śabda ādi sūtram nāmī yā śabda ādayaḥ iti jātau prayujyante kasmāt abhedāt ekā jātiḥ tasyāḥ viśeṣaṇam anarthakam yā gauḥ tiṣṭhati iti yā gauḥ niṣaṇṇāḥ iti evam śeṣeṣu ākṛteḥ api abhidhāyakam etat na bhavati niṣkriya tvāt ākṛteḥ na hi niṣkriyāḥ gacchati tiṣṭhati vā iti evam sarvatra yasya ca anena viśeṣeṇa tiṣṭhati ādinā yogaḥ tam go śabdaḥ abhidhātum arhati iti kutas viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvasya eka viṣaya tvāt yadi ca go śabdasya tiṣṭhati śabdasya ca ekam abhidheyam bhavati tatas go śabdena dharmi antarāṇi nirākriyante tiṣṭhati śabdena ca kriyā antarāṇi iti viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva āpannayoḥ tiṣṭhati go śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam yujyate anyathā naḥ iti dravyam vyaktiḥ iti na artha antaram tiṣṭhati śabda sannihitena go śabdena vyaktiḥ abhidhīyate iti

tad pratiṣedha artham sūtram na tad anavasthānāt iti na anena go śabdena vyakti mātram śuddham ucyate yadi ayam vyakti mātra abhidhāyakaḥ abhaviṣyat tena yasyām kasyām cit vyaktau pratyayaḥ abhaviṣyat iti sūtra arthaḥ

yadi vyaktiḥ na padārthaḥ katham vyaktau prayogaḥ yā gauḥ tiṣṭhati iti evam ādiḥ nimittāt atadbhāve api tad upacāraḥ kva punar nimittāt atadbhāve api tadvat upacāraḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti tasya upapādana artham sūtram sahacaraṇa sthāna tādarthya vṛtta māna dhāraṇa sāmīpya yoga sādhana ādhipatyebhyaḥ brāhmaṇa mañca kaṭa rāja saktu candana gaṅgā śāṭaka anna puruṣeṣu atadbhāve api tad upacāraḥ iti atadbhāve api tad upacāraḥ iti atad śabdasya tad śabdena abhidhānam upacāraḥ yathā yaṣṭikā śabdena dravya viśeṣaḥ abhidhīyate yaṣṭi yogāt punar sāhacaryāt brāhmaṇaḥ abhidhīyate yaṣṭikāḥ praveśaya iti evam sarvatra kim

punar atra upacāra bījam yaṣṭikāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ iti na hi upacāra bījam antareṇa upacāraḥ labhyate nanu uktam sāhacaryam iti sāhacaryam nāma yaṣṭikayā nitya sambandhaḥ yaṣṭikā sambandhāt ca yaṣṭikāvān iti syāt na yaṣṭikāḥ iti yaṣṭikāvān iti ca ayam śabdaḥ mukhyaḥ eva tasmāt upacāra bījam anyat vaktavyam iti yaṣṭikāyām tāvat ayam yaṣṭikā śabdaḥ jāti nimittaḥ yaṣṭikā tvam jātiḥ sā yaṣṭikāyām vartate iti tayā yaṣṭikā tu a yuktayā yaṣṭikayā brāhmaṇasya yogaḥ sāhacaryāt saṃyukta samavetām jātim adhyāropya brāhmaṇam yaṣṭikāḥ iti āha evam śeṣāṇi upacāra bījāni svayam utprekṣaṇīyāni iti

yadi tarhi gauḥ iti padasya na vyaktiḥ arthaḥ astu tarhi ākṛtiḥ tad apekṣa tvāt sattva vyavasthāna siddheḥ ākṛtiḥ padārthaḥ kasmāt tad apekṣa tvāt sattva vyavasthānasya gauḥ aśvaḥ puruṣaḥ iti evam ādi sattva vyavasthānam ākṛti apekṣam sidhyati yad apekṣā ca sattva vyavasthāna siddhiḥ sa go śabdasya viṣayaḥ iti atra api tat eva upasthitam na tad anavasthānāt iti yasya ca jātyā yogaḥ sa go śabdasya viṣayaḥ na ākṛtiḥ jātya yogāt kasya punar jāti yogaḥ niyata avayava vyūhasya āvayavinaḥ niyataḥ avayava vyūhaḥ yasya sa bhavati niyata avayava vyūhaḥ anya pad arthena bahu vrīhiṇā avayavī abhidhīyate iti

astu tarhi jātiḥ padārthaḥ vyakti ākṛti yukte api aprasaṅgāt prokṣaṇa ādīnām mṛd gavake jātiḥ yasmāt mṛd gavake vyakti ākṛtī staḥ na ca tatra prokṣaṇa ādīni prayujyante na hi gām ānaya gām prokṣaya gām dehī iti mṛd gavake praiṣa sampratipattī bhavataḥ yat abhāvāt tatra na sampratyayaḥ sa go śabdasya arthaḥ kasya ca abhāvāt na tatra sampratyayaḥ jāteḥ

atha mṛd gavake kasmāt go tvam na jātiḥ yasmāt mṛdgavakaḥ gauḥ na bhavati yaḥ ca gauḥ na bhavati na tatra go tvam vartate yathā aśvaḥ iti atha mṛdgavakaḥ kasmāt gauḥ na bhavati atas eva na bhavati yasmāt mṛdgavakaḥ iti na ca ayam yuktaḥ praśnaḥ mṛdgavakaḥ kasmāt gauḥ na bhavati iti kim kāraṇam pratipatti bādhita tvāt bhavān api etam artham pratipadyate na ayam gauḥ iti pratipattyā ca praśnaḥ bādhyate iti

atha mṛdgavake go śabdaḥ kutas ākṛti sāmānyāt citra ādi vat iti sarva gatāḥ iti ced atha manyase sarva gatā jātiḥ sā utpadyamānena yathā gavā sambaddhyate tathā mṛd gavakena api iti asti mṛd gavake go tvam tat na anabhyupagamāt kena sarva gata tvam jāteḥ abhyupagamyate api tu sva viṣaye sarvatra vartate iti sarva gatāḥ iti ucyate kaḥ punar go tvasya svaḥ viṣayaḥ yatra go tvam vartate kva punar go tvam vartate yatra go tva nimittaḥ anuvṛtta pratyayaḥ bhavati kva punar anuvṛtta pratyayam go tvam karoti yat tasya sādhanam kaḥ punar nitye go tve goḥ sādhana arthaḥ yat tena vyajyate na hi kakudādi mad artha vyatirekeṇa go tvasya vyaktiḥ asti

na hi piṇḍebhyaḥ artha antaram go tvam piṇḍa antarāleṣu agrahaṇāt iti ke cit tat na vikalpa anupapatteḥ piṇḍa antarāleṣu adarśanāt iti brūvāṇaḥ piṇḍa antarālam paryanuyojyaḥ kim idam piṇḍa antarālam kim ākāśam āhosvit abhāvaḥ uta dravya antaram iti yadi ākāśam na tatra go tvam na hi ākāśam gauḥ iti etena abhāvaḥ dravya antaram ca vyākhyātam
