indriyasya kuḍya kaṭa ādeḥ āvaraṇasya na sāmarthyam asti iti vṛttiḥ pratibadhyate iti ced atha manyase satyam vyāpakam indriyam tasya tu puruṣa arthena hetunā kṣobhyamānasya mahā hradāt budbudāḥ tad vṛttayaḥ niścaranti tāḥ kuḍya ādibhiḥ pratibadhyante iti na vṛtti vyatirekeṇa indriyasya sattve pramāṇa abhāvāt yā iyam viṣaya grahaṇa ātmikā vṛttiḥ tām tyaktvā tad vyatiriktam indriyam iti kim pramāṇām na ca aprāmāṇikaḥ arthaḥ śakyaḥ pratipattum na ca pratibadhyamāna apratiṣidhyamānayoḥ eka tvam eka tve ca anarthakam vṛttiḥ pratibadhyate niścarati ca iti

avyatirekāt ca tad utpatti vināśa dharmakam yadi ca vṛtti avyatireki indriyam yathā vṛtteḥ utpāda vināśau evam indriyasya api prāpnutaḥ vṛtteḥ vyaktiḥ naḥ utpattiḥ iti ced atha manyase na mayā vṛtteḥ utpattiḥ abhyupagamyate api tu vyaktiḥ na nirodhaḥ vināśaḥ api tu tirobhāvaḥ iti na utpatti viśeṣa tvāt vyaktiḥ utpatti viśeṣaḥ katham iti na anupajāta viśeṣasya vyaktiḥ iti atha anupajāta viśeṣam vyajyate iti manyase nityam vyaktiḥ syāt

etena vināśaḥ vyākhyātaḥ tirobhāvaḥ iti vidyamānam na kim cit nivṛttam na hi anivṛtta viśeṣasya agrahaṇam sambhavati iti na ca sarva nitya tā vādinaḥ grahaṇa agrahaṇe yukte viśeṣasya anupajananāt na grahaṇam viśeṣasya anupacaryāt na agrahaṇam iti nityam vyāpakam ca indriyam abhyupagacchataḥ kāraṇa arthaḥ hīyate kāraṇam hi nāma yasya anantaram yat bhavati kāraṇam ca nityam kāryam ca nityam iti kim kasya anantaram kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ ca katham ubhayoḥ nitya tvāt kāraka śabda arthaḥ ca vācyaḥ nanu ca karoti iti kārakam satyam karoti iti kārakam na punar nitya vādinaḥ kim cit kartavyam asti na ca asati kartavye

kāraka artham paśyāmaḥ vyaktau kāraka arthaḥ iti ced vyaktau api tulyam vyaktiḥ api vyaṅgya vat nityāḥ iti vyaktau api na kāraka arthaḥ asti yugapad aneka vijñāna prasaṅgāt ca yadi ca vṛttiḥ vṛttimataḥ na anyā bhavati vṛttimataḥ avasthānāt vṛttīnām avasthānam iti yugapad aneka vijñāna prasaṅgaḥ vṛtti aneka tve ca ekam indriyam anekam prāpnoti vṛttibhyaḥ ananya tvāt atha mā bhūt indriya bhedaḥ iti vṛttīnām tarhi eka tvam prāpnoti vṛtti vṛttimatoḥ ananya tvāt atha mā bhūt eṣaḥ doṣaḥ iti ubhayam naḥ iṣyate bhedaḥ tarhi vṛtti vṛttimatoḥ iti na ca anyā gatiḥ asti tasmāt ayuktam vyāpakam indriyam nityam ca iti

mahat aṇu grahaṇasya ca anyathā siddheḥ ahetuḥ yaḥ api ayam hetuḥ mahat aṇu grahaṇāt abhautikāni indriyāṇi iti ayam api anyathā siddhiḥ na mahat aṇu grahaṇa mātrāt abhautika tvam vyāpaka tvam ca indriyāṇām śakyam pratipattum kasmāt yasmāt idam raśmi artha sannikarṣa viśeṣāt tad grahaṇam yasmāt raśmi artha sannikarṣa viśeṣāt mahat aṇvoḥ grahaṇam cakṣūraśmeḥ ca arthasya ca sannikarṣa viśeṣāt mahat aṇvoḥ grahaṇam bhavati tatra sannikarṣa mātrāt sāmānya grahaṇam sannikarṣa viśeṣāt viśeṣa grahaṇam kaḥ punar sannikarṣasya

viśeṣaḥ bhūyas avayava sannikarṣa anugrahaḥ yasmāt ayam sannikarṣaḥ viśeṣa pratipatti hetuḥ bhūyobhiḥ avayava saṃyogaiḥ anugṛhyate saḥ ayam avayava antara saṃyoga apekṣaḥ avayavi indriya sannikarṣaḥ sannikarṣa viśeṣaḥ iti ucyate sa ca raśmi artha sannikarṣa viśeṣaḥ aṇoḥ mahataḥ ca tulyaḥ bhavati iti anyathā mahat aṇvoḥ grahaṇam sidhyati raśmi artha sannikarṣaḥ ca āvaraṇa liṅgaḥ kuḍya ādi vyavahitānām aprakāśaka tvāt aprāpya kāri tve tu na kuḍya ādeḥ āvaraṇasya sāmarthyam asti iti asti ca akṣaṣaḥ raśmiḥ yathā pradīpa raśmiḥ iti

āvaraṇa anumeya tve sati idam āha tad anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ na cākṣuṣaḥ raśmiḥ vidyate iti sūtra arthaḥ katham iti upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta tvāt anumāna anupapattiḥ yat khalu upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam naḥ upalabhyate tat na asti yathā ghaṭa ādi ghaṭa ādeḥ mahat aneka dravyavat tva rūpāni upalambhakāni santi iti upalabhyante ghaṭa ādayaḥ tathā ca mahat aneka dravya rūpavān cākṣuṣaḥ raśmiḥ kasmāt pratyakṣataḥ naḥ upalabhyate iti vācyam mahat tvam tāvat kāraṇa mahat tva bahutva pracayebhyaḥ aneka dravyavat tvam api kāraṇa bahu tvāt eva rūpa sparśa vat dhi tejaḥ iti na arūpam tat evam aśeṣa upalabdhi kāraṇa sannidhāne sati yena naḥ upalabhyate tena gamyate na asti iti

yat pratyakṣataḥ naḥ upalabhyate tat anumānena upalabhyamānam na asti iti ayuktam vaktum yathā candramasaḥ para bhāgasya pṛthivyāḥ ca adhobhāgasya iti yathā candramasaḥ pṛthivyāḥ ca para bhāga adhobhāgau upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptau api na pratyakṣataḥ upalabhyete na ca anumānena upalabdheḥ tau na staḥ kim punar anumānam arvāk bhāgavat tvam ubhaya pratipattau tathā cākṣuṣasya raśmeḥ kuḍya ādi āvaraṇam anumānam sambhavati iti

apare tu mahat tvāt aneka dravyavat tvāt rūpāt ca upalabdhiḥ iti upalabdhau niyamam varṇayanti na upalabhyamānaḥ iti kim uktam bhavati na brūmaḥ yatra yatra mahat aneka dravyavat tva rūpāṇi santi tat tat upalabhyate iti api tu yat yat upalabhyate tatra tatra mahat aneka dravyavat tva rūpāṇi santi iti evam tarhi idam sūtram naḥ upalabdheḥ kāraṇa pratipādakam satsu abhāvāt iti satsu mahat aneka dravya rūpeṣu upalabdhiḥ na bhavati iti naḥ etāṇi upalabdhi kāraṇāni dravya guṇa dharma bhedāt ca upalabdhi niyamaḥ iti śeṣam bhāṣye

kasmāt tarhi cākṣuṣaḥ raśmeḥ naḥ upalabhyate upalabdhi kāraṇa abhāvāt iti na etāvat eva upalabdhi kāraṇam yat uta mahat aneka dravya rūpāṇi api tu rūpa grahaṇena rūpa viśeṣaḥ abhidhīyate na rūpa mātram evam ca sūtram aneka dravyeṇa dravyeṇa samavāyāt rūpa viśeṣāt ca rūpa upalabdhiḥ iti atra rūpa viśeṣa grahaṇena rūpa dharmaḥ udbhava samākhyātaḥ abhidhīyate na rūpa tvam rūpa antarāt rūpam viśinaṣṭi api tu udbhavaḥ viśeṣaka tvāt viśeṣaḥ iti ucyate yathā brāhmaṇa viśeṣaḥ iti na brāhmaṇa tvam brāhmaṇa viśeṣaḥ evam yat samāna jātīya viśeṣaka tvam tat viśeṣaḥ iti ucyate udbhavaḥ ca kārya gamyaḥ yasya abhāvāt viṣakta avayavam āpyam dravyam hemante na gṛhyate taijasam ca grīṣme yasya ca bhāvāt pradīpa raśmiḥ upalabhyate āditya raśmiḥ ca saḥ udbhavaḥ nāma rūpa viśeṣaḥ sa tasmin na ayane raśmau rūpa viśeṣaḥ na asti iti atas cākṣuṣaḥ raśminā upalabhyate iti

dṛṣṭaḥ ca tejasaḥ dharma bhedaḥ caturvidham ca tejaḥ bhavati udbhūta rūpa sparśam yathā āditya raśmiḥ udbhūta rūpam anudbhūta sparśam yathā pradīpa raśmiḥ ubhayam ca pratyakṣam rūpasya udbhūta tvāt udbhūta sparśam anudbhūta rūpam yathā vāri sthitam tejaḥ anudbhūta rūpa sparśam yathā na ayanaḥ raśmiḥ ubhayam ca apratyakṣam rūpasya anudbhūteḥ

śeṣam bhāṣye rūpa sparśa anabhivyaktiḥ ca vyavahāra prakḷpta arthā yadi na ayanaḥ raśmiḥ udbhūta rūpa sparśaḥ bhavet tena dṛśya viśeṣe aneka raśmi sannipāte ca sati dravyam dahyeta aneka raśmi sannipāte ca sati vyavahita tvāt dravyasya anupalabdhyā bhavitavyam atha manyase yathā āditya raśmi sambaddhe arthe na ayanaḥ raśmiḥ na vyavadhīyate evam raśmi antara sannipāte api iti tat na vyatibhedāt anugrāhaka tvāt vyatibhidya āditya raśmim tad sambaddhena dravyeṇa sambadhyate udbhūta rūpa sparśavat tve ca cakṣuṣaḥ yasya

pūrvam sannipatitam cakṣuḥ tad itareṇa avyatibhinnam iti na artham gṛhṇīyāt atha aneka raśmi sannipāte sati samāna jātīya dravyebhyaḥ dravya antaram raśmiḥ utpadyate iti evam ca samagrāsam agra cakṣuṣoḥ rūpa upalabdhiḥ samānā prāpnoti na ce etat iṣṭam anupalabdheḥ iti tena sarvaḥ vyavahāraḥ na kalpate vyavahāra prakḷpti artham ca na ayanasya raśmeḥ anudbhūta rūpa sparśa vat tvam iti sarva dravyāṇām ca viśva rūpaḥ vyūhaḥ puruṣa artha tantraḥ karma kāritaḥ iti karma tu dharma adharma bhūtam cetanasya upabhoga artham iti

avyabhicārī tu pratīghātaḥ bhautika dharmaḥ bhautikam cakṣuḥ kuḍya ādibhiḥ pratīghāta darśanāt ghaṭa ādi vat iti apratīghātāt abhautikam iti ced atha manyase yadi pratīghātāt bhautikam apratīghātāt tarhi abhautikam iti dṛṣṭaḥ ca apratīghātaḥ kāca abhra paṭala sphaṭika antarita upalabdheḥ iti na anekāntāt pradīpa raśmi vat iti bhautikasya api apratīghātaḥ yathā pradīpa raśmeḥ iti sthālī ādiṣu ca pācakasya tejasaḥ apratīghātāt iti

upapadyate ca anupalabdhiḥ kāraṇa bhedāt madhyandina ulkā prakāśa anupalabdhi vat tad anupalabdhiḥ yathā upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya madhyandine ulkā prakāśasya nimittāt agrahaṇam abhibhavāt tathā upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya cākṣuṣasya raśmeḥ agrahaṇam nimittāt rūpasya anudbhūteḥ iti

madhyandina ulkā prakāśaḥ naḥ upalabhyate āditya prakāśa abhibhavāt iti ayuktam sarva raśmivat tva prasaṅgāt evam sati sarvam loṣṭa ādi raśmi vat prāpnoti atha loṣṭa ādi raśmayaḥ kasmāt naḥ upalabhyante iti atra anuyuktaḥ bruyāt āditya raśmi abhibhavāt iti etat uttara dvārakam sūtram na rātrau api anupalabdheḥ yadi loṣṭa ādi raśmayaḥ syuḥ divā ditya prakāśa abhibhavāt ca naḥ upalabhyante iti rātrau tarhi upalabhyeran rātrau api naḥ upalabhyante vyañjaka abhāvāt iti ced na hi yat yasya abhibhāvakam tat tasya abhivyañjakam iti prāptaḥ loṣṭa raśmīnām upalambhaḥ anumānataḥ ca naḥ upalabhyate loṣṭe raśmiḥ iti api śabdāt gamyate tat evam sarva pramāṇa vinivṛttena vidyate loṣṭe raśmiḥ na punar evam cākṣuṣaḥ raśmiḥ niranumānaḥ kuḍya ādeḥ āvaraṇasya sāmarthyāt iti

tasya vidyamānasya bāhya prakāśa anugrahāt viṣaya upalabdheḥ anabhivyaktitaḥ anupalabdhiḥ dṛṣṭānta sthāne eva etat sūtram kim uktam bhavati yat khalu bāhya prakāśa anugraham apekṣate tasya anupalabdhiḥ rūpasya anabhivyaktitaḥ iti anudbhūteḥ yathā viṣakta avayavasya api adravyasya rūpsyānudbhūteḥ agrahaṇam tathā cākṣuṣaḥ raśmiḥ bāhya prakāśa anugraham apekṣate tasmāt asya api rūpasya anudbhūteḥ agrahaṇam iti

kasmāt punar na ayanasya raśmeḥ anupalabdheḥ abhibhavaḥ naḥ ucyate iti abhivyaktau ca abhibhavāt yat udbhūta rūpam bāhya prakāśa anugrahaṇam ca na apekṣate tat abhibhūyate yathā madhyandine ulkā prakāśaḥ anudbhūta rūpaḥ ca nāyanaḥ raśmiḥ bāhya prakāśa anugrahaṇam ca apekṣate yat anudbhūta rūpam tat na abhibhūyate yathā tat eva viṣakta avayavam āpyam dravyam yat ca bāhya prakāśa anugraha apekṣam udbhūta rūpam api tat na abhibhūyate yathā ghaṭa ādi dravyam iti saḥ ayam ubhaya viṣayaḥ abhibhavaḥ na ayana raśmau anupapannaḥ iti vipratipatti viṣayaḥ kṛṣṇasāram raśmi vat dravya tve sati rūpa upalabdhau niyatasya sādhana aṅgasya nimitta tvāt pradīpa vat iti atha vā raśmimat cakṣuḥ dravya tve sati niyatasya sādhana aṅga tve ca sati sphaṭika ādi vyavahita artha prakāśaka tvāt pradīpa vat iti

iti dṛṣṭānta sūtram mānuṣam cakṣuḥ raśmimat aprāpti svabhāva tve sati rūpa ādi upalabdhi nimitta tvāt naktañcara cakṣuḥ vat iti jāti bheda vat indriya prabhedaḥ iti ced atha manyase viḍāla tvam jātiḥ vṛṣadaṃśe vartate na manuṣye evam raśmimat viḍālasya eva cakṣuḥ bhaviṣyati na mānuṣasya iti na āvaraṇa sāmarthyāt sati etasmin jāti bhede yathā vṛṣadaṃśa prabhṛtīnām kuḍya ādibhiḥ rāsmayaḥ āvriyante tathā manuṣyāṇām api iti samānam eva itas ca bhautikāni indriyāṇi pratighāti tvāt ghaṭa vat iti bhūtam śrotram dravya tve sati bāhya artha prakāśaka tvāt ghrāṇa ādi vat iti

raśmi artha sannikarṣa viśeṣāt tad grahaṇam ayuktam anyathā api grahaṇāt aprāpya grahaṇam kāca abhra paṭala sphaṭika antarita upalabdheḥ tṛṇa ādi sarpat dravyam kāce abhra paṭale vā vyāhanyate yadi ca cākṣuṣaḥ raśmiḥ prāpta artha prakāśakaḥ syāt kāca abhra paṭala sphaṭika vyavahita artha prakāśakaḥ na syāt asti tu tasmāt na prāpya kāri cakṣuḥ iti atas eva ca abhautikam prāpya kāri tvam hi bhautika dharmaḥ
aprāpya kāri tve indriyasya na kuḍya ādi āvaraṇasya sāmarthyam asti iti uktam śeṣam bhāṣye
na kācaḥ abhra paṭalam vā raśmim viṣṭabhnāti saḥ apratihanyamānaḥ vyatibhidya arthena sambadhyate

yat ca manyeta na bhautikasya asti apratīghātaḥ iti sarvam bhautikam pratīghāta dharmakam iti tat na āditya raśmeḥ sphaṭika antarite api dāhye avighātāt na āditya raśmeḥ avighātāt sphaṭika antarite api avighātāt dāhye api avighātāt avighātāt iti ca pada abhisambandha bhedāt vākya bhedaḥ na ekam vākyam aneka artham prativākyam ca artha bhedaḥ śeṣam bhāṣye

kaḥ ayam avighātaḥ avyuhyamāna avayava dravya anupraveśaḥ yasya dravyasya avayavāḥ na vyuhyante tasya antara avayavaiḥ avyuhyamānasya yaḥ abhisambandhaḥ saḥ avighātaḥ iti antar vyavasthitasya vā dravyasya avyuhyamāna avayavasya bahis avasthita dravya prāptiḥ dṛṣṭam hi kalase niṣiktānām apām bahis śīta sparśasya grahaṇam na ca guṇasya asvatantrasya guṇinam antareṇa bahis nirgamanam yuktam iti tatra praspandaḥ tiryak gamanam parisravaḥ pātaḥ iti
itara dharmaḥ itaratra prayujyate iti itara dharmaḥ ca itaratra yadi avighātaḥ cakṣūraśmeḥ sphaṭika ādibhiḥ kuṭādibhiḥ api prāpnoti kuḍya ādibhiḥ vā pratīghātaḥ iti sphaṭika ādibhiḥ api prāpnoti

na eṣaḥ doṣaḥ ādarśa udakayoḥ prasāda svābhāvyāt rūpa upalabdhi vat tad upalabdhiḥ ādarśa udakayoḥ prasādaḥ rūpa viśeṣaḥ sa ca svar bhavati niyamāt kaḥ punar ayam rūpa viśeṣaḥ dravya antara asaṃpṛkta dravya samavāyaḥ tasya vā rūpa upalambhana sāmarthyam svar dharmaḥ sa ca svabhāvaḥ tasya yā vidyamāna todaka ādiṣu tat svābhāvyam prasāda svabhāva tvāt ādarśa udaka ādiṣu nayana raśmiḥ pratihanyate sa ca pratihataḥ pratinivṛtya sva mukha ādinā sambadhyate tasya ca agra sambandhāt yat abhimukham agram tat abhimukham mukha ādi paśyati iti yathā agratas vyavasthitasya puruṣasya iti ādarśa mukha grahaṇam tu krameṇa bhavat api āśu bhāvāt na vibhāvyate iti ādarśa rūpa anugrahaṇāt tad anurañcitaḥ pratyayaḥ śeṣam bhāṣye

pramāṇasya tattva viṣaya tvāt dṛṣṭa anumitāḥ khalu ime dravya dharmāḥ yathābhūtāḥ bhavanti tathābhūtāḥ eva pramāṇena pratipādyante iti imau ca bhavatā niyoga pratiṣedhau deśitau kva viṣaye syātām na ca etat yuktam na hi yathā dhūmena agni pratipattiḥ tathā udaka pratipattiḥ api bhavatu iti na ca udaka pratipatti dhūmena bhavati iti agni pratipattiḥ api na yuktā arthān ca niyuñjānaḥ bhavān upekṣaṇīyaḥ pratighāta apratighātayoḥ khalu upalabdhi anupalabdhī vyavasthāpike vyavahita upalabdhyā anumīyate sphaṭika ādibhiḥ apratīghātaḥ vyavahita anupalabdhyā ca kuḍya ādibhiḥ pratighātaḥ īt yadi prāpya kāri cakṣuḥ bhavati atha kasmāt añjana śalāka ādi naḥ upalabhyate iti na indriyeṇa asambandhāt indriyeṇa sambaddhāḥ arthāḥ upalabhyante na ca añjana śalāka ādi indriyeṇa sambaddham adhiṣṭhānasya anindriya tvāt raśmiḥ indriyam na adhiṣṭhānam na ca raśmiḥ añjana śalāka ādi sambaddhaḥ iti evam tāvat bhautikāni indriyāṇi iti vyavasthitam

kim punar ekam indriyam āho anekam iti eke tu sthāna anya tve nānātvāt avayavi nānā sthāna tvāt ca saṃśayaḥ sthāna anya tve nānātvam dṛṣṭam yathā bahūnām ghaṭa ādīnām ekasya ca nānā sthāna tvam yathā avayavinaḥ iti anupapanna rūpaḥ ca ayam saṃśayaḥ katham iti yadi tāvat evam kriyate sthāna anya tve nānātva ekatva darśanāt iti tadā eka tve sthāna anyatvasya adarśanāt na samāna dharmaḥ atha nānā sthāna tve sati eka aneka tva darśanāt saṃśayaḥ iti tadā dravyam nānā sthānam anekam na kim cit dṛṣṭam iti na samāna dharma tvam yat tu ghaṭa ādi anekam na tat nānā sthānam api tu sthāna anya tvam tasya saḥ ayam saṃśayaḥ ubhayathā anupapannaḥ indriyeṣu sthāneṣu tu yuktaḥ kim nānā sthānāni uta nānā sthānam iti indriyeṣu tu na sthāna nānā tvāt sambhavati na api nānā sthāna tvāt iti śarīra vyatirekāt sattvāt ca saṃśayaḥ śarīra vyatiriktam ubhayathā dṛṣṭam ekam anekam ca yathā ākāśam ghaṭa ādi ca sat ca ubhayathā dṛṣṭam ekam anekam ca tat evam ubhayam ca indriyeṣu śarīra vyatirekaḥ sattvam ca tena sandihyate iti

ekam indriyam kim punar tat tvac avyatirekāt kaḥ punar ayam avyatirekaḥ sarva adhiṣṭhāna sambandhaḥ na hi na kim cit indriya adhiṣṭhānam tvacā na prāptam sati bhāvaḥ vā na hi asatyām tvaci kim cit viṣaya grahaṇam bhavati tasmāt tvac ekam indriyam na indriya antara artha anupalabdheḥ iti loka virodhaḥ ekam indriyam iti bruvāṇaḥ lokam viruṇaddhi vidyamāne tvac indriye sparśa upalabdhi liṅge indriya antara arthāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ andha ādibhiḥ api upalabhyeran na tu upalabhyante tasmāt na ekam indriyam iti yat api avyatirekāt iti tat api na anekāntāt anekena ca anindriyeṇa sarvāṇi indriya adhiṣṭhānāni pṛthivī ādinā prāptāni iti anekāntaḥ

avayava upaghātāt iti ced atha bhavet etat tvac avayavaḥ kaḥ cit upahataḥ bhavati tad upaghātāt andha ādibhiḥ naḥ upalabhyante rūpa ādayaḥ iti yathā tvac avayava viśeṣeṇa dhūma upalabdhiḥ yaḥ cakṣuṣi tvac avayava viśeṣaḥ tad upaghātāt dhūma sparśa anupalabdhiḥ iti na vyāghātāt tvac avayava viśeṣaṇa dhūma upalabdhi vat rūpa ādi upalabdhim bruvatā yat uktam ekam indriyam iti tat vyāhatam bhavati prāk ekam indriyam tvac iti abhyupagamya idānīm tvac avayava viśeṣāḥ rūpa ādi grāhakāḥ iti bruvāṇaḥ pratiṣedhyam abhyanujānāti na hi avayavi anatiriktāḥ avayavāḥ iti yān ca avayavān rūpa ādi grāhakān tvacaḥ manyase te kim indriya ātmakāḥ uta naḥ iti kim ca atas yadi indriya ātmakāḥ na ekam indriyam atha indriya ātmakāḥ na bhavanti na tarhi indriya grāhyāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ iti

sūtreṇa ca abhisambandhaḥ na yugapad artha anupalabdheḥ yasya ekam indriyam tasya yugapad arthānām upalabdhiḥ prasajyate katham iti ātmā manasā sambadhyate manaḥ indriyeṇa indriyam sarva arthaiḥ sannihitaiḥ iti ātma indriya manaḥ artha sannikarṣebhyaḥ yugapad buddhayaḥ prāduḥṣyuḥ iti na ekaindriya grāhyāṇām yugapad upalabdhi prasaṅgāt yathā eka indriya vādinaḥ yugapad aneka artha sannikarṣe sati yugapad upalabdhiḥ doṣaḥ bhavati iti tathā aneka indriya vādinaḥ api eka indriya grāhyeṣu yugapad upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ yaḥ eva atra parīhāraḥ saḥ eva mama api bhaviṣyati iti atha ayam aduṣṭaḥ pakṣaḥ acodyam tarhi etat yugapad upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ iti

atra ke cit parihāram varṇayanti bubhutsā bhedāt na yugapad upalabdhiḥ iti mama api evam yadi bubhutsā bhedāt na yugapad upalabdhiḥ labhyate mama api na bubhutsā bhedaḥ na daṇḍa vāritaḥ iti satyām ca bubhutsāyām ayugapad upalabdhau anyaḥ nyāyaḥ avadhāraṇīyaḥ iti karaṇa tvāt iti anye anye tu parihāram bruvate karaṇa tvāt iti karaṇasya kila ayam dharmaḥ adhiṣṭhitam api anekām kriyām na yugapad śaknoti kartum andhiṣṭhitam ca na pravartate iti tulyam yasya api ekam indriyam tasya api karaṇa tvam na nivāryate iti tasmāt yugapad artha anupalabdhiḥ iti adoṣaḥ ayam iti evam bruvāṇaḥ eka indriya vādī vikalpataḥ paryanuyojyaḥ yat tat ekam indriyam sarva artham iti manyase tat kim prāpya kāri āho naḥ iti kim ca atas yadi prāpya kāri kim tat iti vaktavyam yadi tvac tvacā aprāptānām rūpāṇām agrahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ atha aprāptam rūpam gṛhṇāti sparśa ādiṣu api evam prasaṅgaḥ

atha sāmikārī indriyam kim cit prāptam gṛhṇāti kim cit ca aprāptam evam sati karaṇa dharma atikramaḥ bhavatu karaṇa dharma atikramaḥ kim naḥ bādhyate iti etasmin pakṣe na yugapad upalabdhi prasaṅgāt iti sūtram yathā aneka indriya vādinaḥ eka indriya grāhyeṣu yugapad upalabdhi para saṅge karaṇa tvāt iti parihāraḥ saḥ asyāḥ na bhavati karaṇa dharma atikrama abhyupagamāt vyāhatam ca etat karaṇam prāpya kāri ca aprāpya kāri ca iti asāha caryāt ca na tvac sāhacaryam nāma yasya ekam viṣaya grahaṇam tasya dvitīyam api iti andha badhira ādi abhāva prasaṅgaḥ

śeṣam bhāṣye eka upaghāte tad vināśe vā sarva anupalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ atha ekam indriyam bhavati tad upaghāte tad vināśe vā sarva anupalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ āvaraṇa anupapattiḥ ca yadi tvac ekam indriyam bhavati na āvaraṇasya sāmarthyam asti iti vyavahita avasthita rūpa upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ dūra antika anuvidhānam ca upalabdhi anupalabdhyoḥ na syāt aprāpya kāri tve tvac indriyasya antike grahaṇam dūre ca agrahaṇam iti etat na syāt

pratiṣedhāt ca nānātva siddhau sthāpanā hetuḥ api upādīyate pratiṣedhāt nānātvam sidhyati iti na buddhyāmahe pratiṣedhāt eka tva sādhanam na syāt nānātvam tu katham sidhyati iti na asādhanā kriyāḥ iti eka tvam ca katham pratiṣeddhum śakyate pratiṣedhāt eka tva sādhanam anumānam nivartate na punar eka tvam aneka tvam vā nivartate iti katham tarhi ayam granthaḥ grāhyaḥ pratiṣedhāt ca anantaram nānātva siddhau sthāpanā hetuḥ api upādīyate indriya artha pañcatvāt atha vā pratiṣedhāt ca nānātva siddhau iti pratiṣedha hetunā eka tva pratiṣedhe kṛte arthān nānātvam sidhyati iti ayam arthaḥ katamaḥ punar asau pratiṣedha hetuḥ yugapad artha upalabdhi prasaṅgāt iti ayam anena eka tvam pratiṣiddham

tat evam avīta siddhau vīta darśana artham idam ucyate indriya artha pañcatvāt iti sūtram arthaḥ prayojanam iti evam ādi bhāṣye idam ca sūtram na katham cana nyāyena sambadhyate katham iti vidhīyamānaḥ arthaḥ sādhyaḥ pañca indriyāṇi iti indriya artha pañcatvāt iti asambaddham atha prayojana pañcatvam tat api evam eva atha grahaṇāni pakṣīkriyante tatra api aikāntikaḥ hetuḥ na asti iti etena viṣayāḥ vyākhyātāḥ

idam tu sūtram evam syāt rūpa rasa gandha sparśa śabdeṣu nānā sādhana kriyaḥ kartā eka viṣayau asitau viṣaya antara siddhyai karaṇa antara apekṣi tvāt yasya kartuḥ anekaḥ viṣayaḥ tasya anyatama viṣaya avasāye viṣaya antara siddhau sādhana antara apekṣi tvam dṛṣṭam yathā aneka śilpa paryavadātasya puruṣasya ratha kriyā vasāye ghaṭa ādi kriyāyām karaṇa antara apekṣi tvam tathā ca rūpa ādi anyatama viṣaya avasāye viṣaya antara siddhyai sādhana antara apekṣi tvam asti iti tasmāt rūpa rasa gandha sparśa śabdeṣu nānā sādhana kriyaḥ kartā iti

asya yathāśruti utthānam asya ca arthaḥ indriya pañcatva virodhaḥ na virodhāt artha bahu tvāt indriya bahu tvam prāpnoti iti bruvāṇaḥ yat abhyupagatam ekam indriyam iti tat bādhate nāsādhanāt na mayā artha bahu tvāt indriya bahu tvam sādhyate yatas me virodhaḥ syāt api tu bhavatā indriya artha pañcatvāt pañca indriyāṇi iti yat sādhanam uktam tasya mayā virodhaḥ deśyate yadi indriya artha pañcatvāt pañca indriyāṇi bhavanti indriya artha bahu tvāt bahūni indriyāṇi iti prasajyante iti

asya uttara dvārakam sūtram gandha tva ādi avyatirekāt gandha ādīnām apratiṣedhaḥ iti gandha tva ādibhiḥ sva sāmānyaiḥ kṛta vyavasthāḥ gandha ādayaḥ na sva karaṇa vyatirekeṇa karaṇa antarāṇi prayojayanti yāvatsu gandha tvam vartate tāvatām eka sādhana sādhya tvāt yaḥ punar apara jāti bhedaḥ iṣṭa aniṣṭa upekṣaṇīya tva ādiḥ na asau karaṇa antaram prayojayati evam sarvatra śeṣam bhāṣye
yadi sāmānyam saṃgrāhakam prāptam indriyāṇām viṣaya tva avyatirekāt eka tvam asya api arthaḥ avirodhaḥ eva na ukta uttara tvāt indriya artha pañcatvāt iti asya arthena ukta uttaram etat

asya ca arthasya jñāpana artham na buddhi lakṣaṇa adhiṣṭhāna gati ākṛti jāti pañcatvebhyaḥ iti sūtram tatra buddhayaḥ eva lakṣaṇāni iti asya arthaḥ varṇitaḥ indriya artha pañcatvāt iti nānā indriyam bhinna adhiṣṭhāna tvāt yasya adhiṣṭhānam bhinnam tat anekam dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭa ādi adhiṣṭhāna bhedaḥ ca indriyāṇām asti tasmāt nānā iti adhiṣṭhāna bhedaḥ asiddhaḥ iti ced na asiddhaḥ andha badhira ādyabhāva prasaṅgāt iti yasya punar adhiṣṭhāna bhedaḥ tasya eka adhiṣṭhāna vināśe adhiṣṭhāna antara āśrayasya indriyasya avasthānam iti na doṣaḥ gati bhedāt api indriya bhedaḥ bhinna gati tvāt iti prayogaḥ pūrvavat

ākṛtiḥ parimāṇam iyattā sva sthāna parimāṇāni ghrāṇa rasana sparśanāni cakṣuḥ bahis viniḥsṛtam viṣaya vyāpi tat mahat śrotram tu ākāśam tad adhiṣṭhāna niyamena pravartate dharma adharma saṃskṛtayā iṣṭa aniṣṭa upekṣaṇīya śabda sādhana bhūtayā karṇa śaṣkulyāḥ yaḥ ākāśasya sambandhaḥ tad sambandha anuvidhāyi ākāśam na vivara antareṇa asya ādinā śabdam upalambhayati na anyatra iti tad upakāra pratīkāra bhedāt vā upakriyate pratikriyate ca iti na punar ākāśam nitya tvāt upakriyate na pratikriyate iti prakṛṣṭa aprakṛṣṭa śrotra bhedaḥ api atas eva jātiḥ iti yonim pracakṣmahe pañca khalu imāḥ indriya yonayaḥ pṛthiva ādīni bhūtāni indriyāṇām yonayaḥ iti yoniḥ tādātmyam na punar tad kārya tvam ākāśe asambhavāt iti tat nitya tvāt

katham punar jñāyate bhūta prakṛti indriyāṇi na avyakta prakṛtīni iti na ukta uttara tvāt na avyakta prakṛtīni indriyāṇi iti ukta uttaram etat bhūta guṇa viśeṣa upalabdheḥ tādātmyam bhūta guṇa viśeṣāḥ gandha rasa rūpa sparśa śabdāḥ viśeṣaka tvāt viśeṣāḥ iti ucyante yasmāt gandhena pṛthivī abādibhyaḥ viśiṣyate rasa ādibhiḥ ap ādayaḥ iti dṛṣṭaḥ hi bāhyānām ubhaya pakṣa sampratipannānām pṛthivī ādi bhūtānām sva guṇa abhivyakti niyamaḥ asti ca ghrāṇa ādibhiḥ api gandha ādi abhivyakti niyamaḥ tena bhūta guṇa viśeṣa upalabdheḥ bhūta prakṛtīni indriyāṇi iti kim kim ātmakam iti yena yat guṇa abhivyaktiḥ tatra pārthivam ghrāṇam gandha abhivyakti hetu tvāt bāhya pārthiva vat iti evam śeṣeṣu

gandha ādayaḥ pṛthivī ādi guṇāḥ iti uddiṣṭam uddeśaḥ ca niyoga vikalpa samuccayaiḥ samānaḥ tatra niyogaḥ ekaika guṇa tvam vikalpaḥ kasya cit ekaḥ kasya cit dvau iti evam ādiḥ samuccayaḥ sarve sarvatra atas viśeṣaṇa artham gandha rasa rūpa sparśa śabdānām sparśa paryantāḥ pṛthivyāḥ ap tejaḥ vāyūnām pūrvam pūrvam apohya ākāśasya uttaraḥ niyama arthe sūtre catvāraḥ pṛthivyāḥ ekaikaśas apakarṣaḥ uttareṣu sparśa paryantānām iti vibhakti vipariṇāmaḥ tena kim kṛtam bhavati sparśa paryāntānām guṇānām viniyuktānām

yaḥ uttaraḥ saḥ ākāśasya iti ākāśasya uttaraḥ śabdaḥ uttaraḥ iti ayam tarabniḥ deśaḥ na yuktaḥ dvayoḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt iha punar prakarṣa vāci tve sati uttamaḥ iti syāt na ayam bhoḥ tarabniḥ deśaḥ api tu para abhidhānam etat yat uktam bhavati paraḥ iti tat uktam bhavati uttaraḥ iti tarabh vā sparśasya vivakṣita tvāt bhavatu vā tarabniḥ desaḥ nanu uktam uttamaḥ iti prāpnoti na sparśasya vivakṣita tvāt gandha ādibhyaḥ paraḥ sparśaḥ para ādayaḥ paraḥ iti yāvat uktam bhavati tāvat idam uktam bhavati uttaraḥ iti
na ayam guṇa viniyogaḥ sādhuḥ kasmāt pārthivena ghrāṇena pārthivānām gandha ādīnām upalabdhi prasaṅgāt evam āpyena rasanena trayāṇām taijasena cakṣuṣā dvayoḥ iti

katham tarhi ime guṇāḥ viniyoktavyāḥ ekaika śyena uttara uttara guṇa sadbhāvāt uttara uttarāṇām tad anupalabdhiḥ yasmāt ekaika guṇāni bhūtāni tasmāt ekaika guṇa grahaṇam iti ekaikaśyenaḥ iti sautraḥ nirdeśaḥ katham tarhi aneka guṇāni bhūtāni gṛhyante iti saṃsargāt tu aneka guṇa grahaṇam saṃsṛṣṭa āba ādibhiḥ pṛthivī tasmāt aneka guṇāḥ gṛhyate iti evam śeṣeṣu

saṃyogaḥ tu apratiṣiddhaḥ mithas pañcānām ca iti niyamaḥ tarhi na prāpnoti pṛthivyām catvāraḥ naḥ itareṣu saṃsargasya aniyamāt iti na na prāpnoti kasmāt viṣṭam hi aparam pareṇa aparam pareṇa viṣṭam ap ādinā na apareṇa pṛthivī ādinā parama bādi viṣṭam viṣṭa tvam saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ

na pārthiva āpyayoḥ pratyakṣa tvāt iti na iti tri sūtrīm anantara uktām anena sūtreṇa pratyācaṣṭe yasya ekaika guṇāni bhūtāni tasya taijasam eva dravyam rūpavat tvāt pratyakṣam prāpnoti na pārthivam āpyam vai arūpa tvāt asya sūtrasya vikalpataḥ anekaḥ sūtra arthaḥ prakalpyate iti bhāṣye varṇitam

tat eva nyāya viruddham pravādam pratiṣidhya na sarva guṇa anupalabdheḥ iti yat deśitam tat samādhīyate pūrvam pūrvam guṇa utkarṣāt tad tad pradhānam tasmāt na sarva guṇa upalabdhiḥ ghrāṇa ādīnām indriyāṇām pūrvam pūrvam indriyam yasmāt parasmāt parasmāt pradhānam kā pradhāna tā caturguṇa tva ādikā kaḥ guṇa utkarṣaḥ sva guṇa abhivyakti sāmarthyam yena guṇena yat dravyam utkṛṣyate sa tad jātīya abhivyañjaka tvāt utkṛṣṭaḥ bhavati yathā bāhyāṇām dravyānām iti asti ca indriyāṇām api sva guṇa abhivyakti niyamaḥ tasmāt na sarva guṇa upalabdhiḥ yaḥ punar gandha guṇa tvāt ghrāṇam gandha grāhakam iti pratijānīte tasya sarva guṇa upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ

kasmāt punar na sarvam pārthivam ghrāṇam iti vyavasthā niyama jñāpana artham tad vyavasthānam na bhūyaḥ tvāt iti sūtram kim punar idam bhūyas tvam artha nirvṛtti samarthasya pravibhaktasya dravyasya saṃsargaḥ puruṣa saṃskāra kāritaḥ bhūyas tvam dṛṣṭaḥ hi prakarṣe bhūyas tva śabdaḥ yathā loke prakṛṣṭaḥ viṣayaḥ bhūyān iti ucyate tathā ca pṛthak artha kriyā samarthāni puruṣa saṃskāra upagrahāt viṣa oṣadhi maṇi prabhṛtīni dravyāṇi nirvartyante iti

sva guṇāt naḥ upalabhante indriyāṇi kasmāt iti ced kena kāraṇena svān gandha ādīn indriyāṇi naḥ upalabhante iti sa guṇānām indriya bhāvāt saha guṇena indriyam indriyam bhavati nirguṇam tu naḥ indriyam atas na gṛhṇāti

yadi punar indriyasya sahakārī ca gandhaḥ syāt grāhyaḥ ca iti tena eva tasya agrahaṇāt ca yadi indriyam sva gandham gṛhṇīyāt te na asau indriya gandhaḥ atha indriya gandhaḥ na indriya grāhyaḥ syāt gandham ca gṛhṇat indriyam ātmānam gṛhṇīyāt ātmā hi asya gandhaḥ iti na ca ātma sādhanam karaṇam asti iti dṛṣṭa virodhaḥ na ca etat pratyakṣam yat uta ghrāṇa gandhaḥ ghrāṇa grāhyaḥ iti kasmāt punar idam na deśyate ghrāṇena ghrāṇam kasmāt na gṛhyate iti na deśyate adṛṣṭa tvāt na dṛṣṭam ghrāṇena ghrāṇasya grahaṇam iti atas na deśyate iti tulyam ghrāṇena svasya gandhasya agrahaṇam iti etat api adeśanīyam sva guṇān naḥ upalabhante indriyāṇi kasmāt iti tulyaḥ hi ubhayatra pratipatti hetu abhāvaḥ
sva guṇān naḥ upalabhante indriyāṇi iti etat ayuktam sva guṇaḥ upalabhyate śrotreṇa śabdaḥ iti

satyam upalabhyate na punar śrotram sa śabdam indriyam iti yathā itarāṇi sa guṇāni indriyāṇi ne evam ākāśam iti kasmāt śabdasya itara guṇa vaidharmyāt ākāśasya itara dravya vaidharmyāt asya arthasya jñāpana artham tad upalabdhiḥ itaretara dravya guṇa vaidharmyāt iti sūtram na śabdaḥ śabdasya vyañjakaḥ na ākāśam sa guṇam indriyam iti kim punar idam śrotram ākāśam pariśeṣāt tatra ātmā tāvat na śrotram kartṛ tvāt śrotā ātmā na śrotram manaḥ śrotram bhaviṣyati iti api na manasaḥ śrotra tve bādhirya abhāvaḥ sarva viṣaya tvāt ca manasaḥ sarva viṣayam ca śrotram prāpnoti pṛthivī ādi api na śrotram ghrāṇa ādiṣu viniyogāt ghrāṇa ādiṣu viniyuktāḥ pṛthivī ādayaḥ śrotra bhāve ca ghrāṇa ādīnām tad vaikalye

śabda anupalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ tvacaḥ śrotra bhāve badhira abhāvaḥ sarva upaghāte ca prāyaṇam diś kālayoḥ śrotra bhāve ca śabdasya anya guṇa tvāt agrahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ tad guṇa tvam eva iti ced nāmni vivādaḥ yasya śabdaḥ guṇaḥ tat ākāśam bhavatā tu saṃjñā mātram bhidyate tau diś kālau iti ākāśa pratyākhyānam ca anya guṇa tvāt śabdasya yadi tu śabdaḥ diś kāla guṇaḥ bhavati ākāśam tarhi pratyākhyātam na hi śabdam antareṇa ākāśa astitve liṅgam asti yathā diś kālayoḥ parāpara ādi liṅgam iti na ca dravya antaram śiṣyate na ca guṇānām śrotra bhāvaḥ yuktaḥ na ca karmaṇām na ca sāmānya viśeṣa samavāyānām sāmarthya anupalabdheḥ na ca idam śrotram na asti śabda upalabdhi liṅgam śiṣyate ca ākāśam tasmāt ākāśam śrotram iti

parīkṣitāni indriyāṇi arthāḥ ca buddheḥ idānīm parīkṣā kramaḥ sā kim anityāḥ nityāḥ vā iti dharma vicāraḥ sattvasya adhigata tvāt tasyām ca saṃśayam upapādayati karma ākāśa sādharmyāt saṃśayaḥ ubhābhyām sādharmyam asparśavat tvam viśeṣaḥ upajanana apāya dharmaka tvam viparyayaḥ ca buddhau naḥ upalabhyate tatas saṃśayaḥ

anupapanna rūpaḥ khalu ayam saṃśayaḥ sarva śarīriṇām pratyātma vedanīya tvāt sarva śarīriṇām pratyakṣam etat yat uta anityā buddhiḥ iti traikālya vyakteḥ ca buddhau traikālyam vyajyamānam dṛṣṭam jānāmi jñāsyāmi ajñāsiṣam iti na ca upajana apāyau antareṇa traikālya vyaktiḥ na hi anupajana apāya dharmeṣu ākāśa ādiṣu traikālyam vyajyate na ca viśeṣa darśane sati yuktaḥ saṃśayaḥ tasmāt saṃśaya prakriyā anupapattiḥ iti śeṣam bhāṣye

dṛṣṭi pravāda upalambha artham tu prakaraṇam na buddheḥ anitya tvam pratipādyam api tu parasya darśanam nivartanīyam iti evam hi paśyantaḥ pravadanti saṃkhyāḥ nityā buddhiḥ iti sādhanam ca pracakṣate viṣaya pratyabhijñānāt iti yam pūrvam ajñāsiṣam tam imam jānāmi iti jñānayoḥ samane arthe pratisandhānam avasthitāyāḥ buddheḥ upapannam buddhi nānātve tu pratyabhijñāna anupapattiḥ yathā puruṣa antara buddhiṣu

yathā eva buddheḥ nitya tvam sādhyam tathā buddheḥ pratyabhijñānam api sādhyam kasmāt cetana dharmasya karaṇe anupapatteḥ puruṣa dharmaḥ khalu ayam jñānam darśanam upalabdhi bodhaḥ iti cetanaḥ hi pūrva jñātam artham pratyabhijānāti tasya etasmāt hetoḥ nitya tvam yuktam kriyā anādhāra tvāt ca karaṇasya na hi karaṇam kriyāyāḥ ādhāraḥ bhavati upalabdhiḥ ca kriyā sā ca na karaṇe bhavitum arhati iti sva kriyā ādhāra tvāt ayuktam iti ced atha manyase sarvam kārakam sva kriyāyāḥ ādhāraḥ bhavati iti atas ayuktam karaṇam kriyāyāḥ na ādhāraḥ iti satyam bhavati sva kriyādhāraḥ na punar sva kriyātaḥ karaṇa vyapadeśaḥ sva kriyāsu sarvam kārakam kartṛ bhavati karaṇa bhāvam ca āśritya buddhau vicāraḥ tasmāt ayuktam etat

sarva kartṛ tva prasaṅgaḥ iti ced yadi punar sva kriyā nimittakaḥ kartṛ vyapadeśaḥ sarvam kārakam kartṛ prāptam satyam evam etat nābhyupagamāḥ eva doṣa tvena deśyante iti kartṛ karaṇa ādi vyapadeśaḥ ca katham pradhāna kriyā apekṣaḥ kartṛ karaṇa ādi vyapadeśaḥ yat artham karakam upādīyate sā pradhāna kriyā tasyāḥ sādhana bhāve sāmānyena vivakṣite bhede ca avivakṣite kārakam iti anena śabdena abhilapyante kartṛ ādayaḥ yadā tu bhedaḥ vivakṣitaḥ tadā kartṛ karaṇa karma śabda vācyāni iti kāraka śabdena api sāmānyena abhidhīyamāneṣu karakeṣu yaḥ sva gataḥ viṣayaḥ itaretara vyāvṛttaḥ saḥ abhidhīyate anyasya asambhavāt

pradhāna kriyā vyapekṣam tu kārakāṇām kartṛ ādi abhidhānam iti tatra yat aparā prayojyam itara kāraka prayoktṛ ca tat kartṛ kārakam evam śeṣeṣu kāraka śabdāḥ pūrvavat vaktavyāḥ yadi anya kāraka prayojya tvam kartṛ tvam nanu ayam api kārakopādānena prayujyate na prayujyate phalasya prayojaka tvāt phalam kartāram prayojayati na kārakam karaṇa ādi na ca phalam kārakam iti teṣām tat na antarīyakam upādānam na hi karaṇa ādi kāra kopa ādānam antareṇa kriyā sambhavati iti tat na antarīyaka tvāt karaṇa ādīni upādīyante iti tasmāt cetana dharmaḥ karaṇe na sambhavati iti

upetya pratyabhijñānam antaḥkaraṇe tasya eka aneka vyāvṛtteḥ asādhāraṇa tā na hi pratyabhijñānam eka tve dṛṣṭam na nānātve iti pratyabhijñāna svarūpa avadhāraṇe ca sati viruddhaḥ yadā ca idam pratyabhijñānam nirūpyate tadā buddhi bhedam pratipādayati katham iti pratyabhijñānam hi nāma ādya pratyakṣa nirodhe dvitīya darśane prāc āhita saṃskāra abhivyaktau smṛti pūrvam tṛtīyam darśanam na ca buddhi abheda vādinaḥ dvitīyam api tāvat darśanam sambhavati kutas tṛtīyam iti

pratyaya bhedaḥ iti ced atha manyase avasthitāyāḥ buddheḥ pratyayāḥ tirobhavanti vyajyante ca tatra ādya darśana tirobhāve pratyaya antara āvirbhāve ca pratyabhijñānam iti tat na yuktam tad vyatirekeṇa buddhi svabhāvān avadhāraṇāt yām tām pratyaya vyatiriktām buddhim bhavantaḥ kalpayanti tasyāḥ kaḥ svabhāvaḥ iti vaktavyam asmākam tu pratyaya mātram buddhiḥ artha grahaṇam hi buddhiḥ iti darśana dṛṣṭasya sparśanena pratyabhijñānāt nānātve pratyabhijñānam iti viruddhaḥ pradīpa antara dṛṣṭasya ca pradīpa antareṇa iti

yadi buddhiḥ adhyavasyati atha buddhau vartamānena jñānena cetanaḥ kim karoti cetayate iti ced kaḥ cetayate yadi yasya adhyavasāyaḥ sa cetayate viruddham etat atha ātmā cetayate katham buddhau vartamānena pratyayena ātmā cetayate na hi anyatra vartamānayā kriyayā anyasya tadvat tā bhavati

atha puruṣaḥ cetayate buddhiḥ jānīte iti na idam jñānāt artha antaram ucyate yāvat uktam bhavati cetayate tāvat uktam bhavati jānīte iti buddhiḥ jñāpayati iti ced atha manyase buddhiḥ jñāpayati ātmā jānīte iti addhā jānīte puruṣaḥ buddhiḥ jñāpayati iti adhyavasāya cetanayoḥ ca svabhāva bhedaḥ vaktavyaḥ bhavatā api eka tvam vaktavyam deśa kāla svabhāva abhedāt yasmāt avideśam avikālam ca buddhyā adhyavasitam ātmā adhyavasyati iti svabhāva abhedaḥ asiddhaḥ iti ced atha manyase satyam abhinna kālam abhinna deśam ca buddhyā adhyavasitam

ātmā api adhyavasyati iti na punar yā eva cetanā saḥ eva adhyavasāyaḥ iti na pratiśarīram aneka puruṣa prasaṅgāt yadi anyaḥ cetayitā anyaḥ ca adhyavasātā bhavati anyaḥ pratijānīte anyaḥ paśyati anyaḥ śṛṇoti mantā iti evam ādiṣu puruṣa antarāṇi khalu imāni draṣṭā śrotāḥ mantā iti naḥ ekasya ete dharmāḥ iti tatra bhavatām kim vaktavyam abhinna arthāḥ ete śabdāḥ iti etat vaktavyam abhinna arthāḥ ced śabdāḥ bhavanti nanu atra api arthaḥ na bhidhyate cetanaḥ adhyavasātā mantā boddha iti tasmāt ayuktam etat buddhiḥ adhyavasyati ātmā cetayate iti

yadi punar idam pratyabhijñānam manasaḥ nitya tva sādhakam syāt na yuktam evam bhavitum manasaḥ nitya tvasya abhyupagamāt abhyupagamyate manasaḥ nitya tvam iti tatra sādhanam anarthakam anekāntāt ca na ca pratyabhijñānāt karaṇa eka tvam sidhyati dṛṣṭam karaṇa bhede api pratyabhijñānam jñātuḥ eka tvāt darśana dṛṣṭasya sparśanena pratyabhijñānāt pradīpa dṛṣṭasya ca pradīpa antareṇa iti
yat ca idam manyate buddheḥ avasthitāyāḥ yathā viṣayam vṛttayaḥ prādurbhavanti vṛttiḥ ca vṛttimataḥ na anyāḥ iti etat ca na yugapad agrahaṇāt vṛttimataḥ avasthānāt vṛtteḥ avasthānam iti sūtra arthaḥ
vṛttīnām apagame vṛttimataḥ api apagamaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ
avibhu ca ekam manaḥ paryāyeṇa indriyaiḥ sambadhyate iti krama vṛtti tvāt ayugapad grahaṇam vṛtti vṛttimatoḥ nānā tvāt iti sūtra arthaḥ vṛtti vṛttimatoḥ eka tve prādurbhāva tirobhāvayoḥ abhāvaḥ iti
apratyabhijñānam ca viṣaya antara vyāsaṅgāt iti vṛtti vṛttimatoḥ bhede sati upapadyate iti eka tve tu anarthakaḥ vyāsaṅgaḥ iti

vibhu tve ca antaḥkaraṇasya paryāyeṇa indriyaiḥ saṃyogaḥ na gati abhāvāt vyāptāni antaḥkaraṇena indriyāṇi iti sūtra arthaḥ vyāpi tve ca yugapad aneka indriya sambandhāt yugapad grahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ doṣaḥ aṇau api manasi eka indriya grāhyeṣu yugapad upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ iti ced karaṇa tvāt na yugapad grahaṇam mama api evam kasmāt na parihāraḥ na karaṇa bhede dṛṣṭa tvāt yāni khalu bhinnāni karaṇāni tāni ekena eva adhiṣṭhāyakena adhiṣṭhitāni yugapad pravartamānāni dṛṣṭāni yathā ubhaya hasta adhiṣṭhite vā asyau pravartete tathā ca indriyāṇi vyāpakena antaḥkaraṇena adhiṣṭhīyante iti yugapad pravṛttiḥ prasaktā tad prasaktau ca yugapad grahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ iti

gati abhāvāt ca vibhunaḥ antaḥkaraṇasya prāpti arthasya gamanasya abhāvāt na ayugapad pratyaya utpattau pramāṇam asti yena pramāṇena pratiṣiddham api pratyaya ayaugapadyam pratipadyeta yathā kim cit pratiṣiddham api pratipadyate yathā cakṣuṣaḥ gatiḥ pratiṣiddhā kena cit sannikarṣa viprakarṣayoḥ tulya kāla grahaṇāt yasmāt sannikṛṣṭam pāṇim viprakṛṣṭam ca candramasam ekasmin kāle cakṣuṣā pratipadyate tasmāt na gatimat cakṣuḥ iti pratiṣiddhā api satī gatiḥ vyavadhāna pratighātena anumīyate iti na ca yugapad pratyaya utpattau pramāṇam asti

saḥ ayam na antaḥkaraṇe vivādaḥ na tasya nitya tve kva tarhi vivādaḥ tasya vibhu tve tat ca pramāṇataḥ anupalabdheḥ na asti na hi antaḥkaraṇasya vibhu tva pratipādakam pramāṇam asti ekam antaḥkaraṇam nānā ca imāḥ cakṣuḥ vijñāna ādi ātmikāḥ vṛttayaḥ iti etat ca vṛtti vṛttimatoḥ eka tve anupapannam yasya punar vṛtti vṛttimatoḥ nānātvam tasya antaḥkaraṇa sādhanaḥ cakṣuḥ ādi sādhanaḥ ca ātmā arthān upalabhate iti yuktam etena viṣaya antara vyāsaṅgaḥ pratyuktaḥ puruṣaḥ jānīte na antaḥkaraṇam iti kaḥ punar ayam vyāsaṅgaḥ abhīṣṭa viṣayaḥ aneka vijñāna utpādaḥ sa ca puruṣasya na antaḥkaraṇasya yaḥ punar ayam sannidhāna āsannidhāna lakṣaṇaḥ antaḥkaraṇasya vyāsaṅgaḥ saḥ anujñātaḥ iti

ekam antaḥkaraṇam nānā vṛttayaḥ iti naḥ etat nyāya vid saṃcakṣāṇakaḥ pratipattum arhati yathā eva antaḥkaraṇam ekam tathā eva ekā vṛttiḥ iti dṛṣṭa virodhaḥ iti ced atha manyase yadi ca antaḥkaraṇāt na vṛttiḥ bhidyate na tu dṛṣṭam virudhyate rūpam rasaḥ gandhaḥ sparśaḥ iti dṛṣṭaḥ pratyaya bhedaḥ na syāt na na syāt viṣaya bheda anuvidhānāt vṛttiḥ abhinnāḥ api viṣaya bhedam anuvidhīyamānāḥ bhinnāḥ iva khyāti yathā upadhāna bhedam anuvidhīyamānam sphaṭika ādi dravyam bhinnam iva prakāśate asya ca arthasya jñāpana artham sphaṭika anyatva abhimāna vat tad anyatva abhimānaḥ iti sūtram na anekāntāt ubhayathā khalu ayam nānātva abhimānaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ nānā bhūteṣu ca gandha ādiṣu abhinne ca sphaṭike iti

yathāśruti sūtre hetu abhāvaḥ dṛṣṭānta mātra tvāt dṛṣṭānta mātram etat na atra hetuḥ asti iti vikalpa anupapatteḥ ca yaḥ ca ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ sphaṭika vat iti vikalpaḥ atra kim ayam sphaṭikaḥ upadhāna bhedena bhidyate uta naḥ iti kim ca atas yadi bhidyate na dṛṣṭāntaḥ atha na bhidyate nānātva abhimānaḥ katham yadi upadhāna bhedāt bhinnam upadhānam iti katham pratipadyate yadi pratyaya bhedāt vyāghātaḥ abhinnā vṛttiḥ pratyayaḥ ca bhinnaḥ iti vyāhataḥ pratyaya paryāya tvāt vṛtteḥ

atha bhavatām vṛttīnām bhede kim pramāṇam jñānānām krameṇa upajana apāya darśanam krameṇa jñānāni upajāyante apayanti ca iti dṛśyate eka aneka viṣaya tvāt ca pratyaya nānātva abhimānasya eka aneka viṣaya adhigatiḥ katham ekasmin ca viṣaye nānātva abhimānaḥ sphaṭike dṛṣṭaḥ nānā bhūteṣu ca gandha ādiṣu nānātva abhimānaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tena nānātva abhimānasya ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt idam ekam idam anekam iti na yuktaḥ pratyayaḥ iti yaḥ ca ayam abhinne sphaṭike bheda pratyayaḥ saḥ api pratyaya bhedam antareṇa na yuktaḥ na hi pratyaya abheda vādinaḥ sphaṭike nīla ādi pratyaya bhedaḥ yuktaḥ iti sphaṭike nīla ādi pratyayaḥ asambandhāt na yuktaḥ na hi nīlam dravyam cakṣuḥ sannikṛṣṭam iti atha sannikṛṣṭam tat eva nīlam na sphaṭikaḥ iti sphaṭika samāna adhikaraṇaḥ sphaṭike nīla pratyayaḥ na yuktaḥ na nairantarya darśanāt nairantaryeṇa avasthite sphaṭika nīla dravye cakṣuṣā sannikṛśyete tatas sannikarṣāt nīla guṇa adhyāropeṇa sphaṭike mithyā pratyayaḥ nīlaḥ iti yathā sāntareṣu antarāla adarśanāt saṃyukta pratyayaḥ iti

yasya ca pratyayaḥ na bhidyate tasya trīṇi pramāṇāni iti śāstram vyāhanyate na hi pratyaya abhede pramāṇa bhedaḥ sambhavati viṣaya bhedāt tritvam iti ced atha manyase viṣayaḥ tredhā bhinnaḥ tena anurañjitaḥ pratyayaḥ tredhā eva bhavati tat na yuktam pramāṇa abhede viṣaya bhedān adhigateḥ na hi pramāṇa bhedam antareṇa viṣaya bhedaḥ adhigantum śakyate iti viṣaya tādātmyāt iti ced atha manyase viṣayaḥ eva asau tathā vyavasthitaḥ tādātmyāt tathā khyāti iti tat na pramāṇa vaiyarthya prasaṅgāt evam ca sati vyartham pramāṇam na viṣaya bhedam pramāṇa bhedaḥ avagamayati viṣayaḥ tu tādātmyāt tathā vyavatiṣṭhate iti

yathā adhyavasyati tathā cetayate iti ca vyāghātaḥ aprakāravat tvāt prakāravati etat yuktam aprakāre na yuktam buddhiḥ tam pratyayam upalabhate iti ca virodhaḥ adhikaraṇa ādheyayoḥ abhedāt yaḥ pratyayaḥ sā buddhiḥ iti adhikaraṇa ādheyayoḥ abhedaḥ evam ca sati buddhi stham pratyayam upalabhate iti vyāhatam

sphaṭika anyatva abhimāna vat tad anyatva abhimānaḥ iti etat amṛṣyamāṇaḥ kṣaṇika vādī āha sphaṭike api apara apara utpatteḥ kṣaṇika tvāt vyaktīnām ahetuḥ sphaṭikasya abhedena avasthitasya anyatva abhimānaḥ iti ayuktam kṣaṇika tvāt vyaktīnām kṣaṇika tvam upacaya apacaya prabandha darśanāt yasmāt śarīra ādiṣu pakti nirvṛttam rasa dravyam pratikṣaṇam upacīyate ca apacīyate ca upacayāt vyaktīnām utpādaḥ apacayāt vyakti nirodhaḥ tau ca utpāda nirodhau asya kāla antareṇa dṛṣṭau atas avagamyate pratikṣaṇam upacīyate ca apacīyate ca śarīram iti

yasya khalu pratikṣaṇam upacaya apacayau na dṛṣṭau tasya kāla antareṇa api na bhavataḥ yathā bhūmeḥ apacyamānāyāḥ pāka jānām iti pacyamāna bhūmi pākaja vat ca pratikṣaṇam viśeṣaḥ iti asya prayogaḥ pratikṣaṇam śarīram anyat ca anyat ca bhavati bāhya pratyaya abhede sati ante viśeṣa darśanāt pacyamāna bhūmi pākaja vat apacyamāna bhūmi pākaja vat ca iti

tat idam upacaya apacaya prabandha darśanam śarīre dṛṣṭa tvāt śarīrasya anya tvam sādhayatu na punar anupalabhyamāna upacaya apacaya viśeṣāṇām sphaṭika ādīnām etasmāt anya tvam sidhyati iti ahetuḥ yatra upalabdhiḥ tasya anya tvam iti ced atha manyase naḥ eva asmābhiḥ upacaya apacaya prabandha darśanena sarva bhāvānām kṣaṇika tvam sādhyate api tu yatra tat asti tasmin kṣaṇika tvam iti satyam yasya yasya upacaya apacaya prabandhaḥ upalabhyate tasya tasya anya tvam iti na tu kṣaṇika tvam upacaya apacaya prabandha darśanam ca anyathā bhavat ahetuḥ kṣaṇika tve katham anyathā pūrva śarīra avayava sahitāḥ āhāra avayavāḥ pūrva vyūha parityāgena

vyūha antaram āpadyamānāḥ śarīra antaram utpādayanti iti yuktaḥ bhedaḥ iti ahetuḥ eṣaḥ tulyam pakṣa pratijñānam iti ced atha manyase apūrva āhāra avayava upayoge sati śarīra avayavāḥ śarīra antaram ārabhante pūrva vyūha parityāgena na punar kṣaṇika tvāt anyat jātam iti atra kaḥ hetuḥ iti nāsādhanāt na mayā āhāra upacaya apacaya yogāt śarīrasya anya tā sādhyate api tu bhavatā viśeṣa darśanāt śarīrasya anya tvam abhyadhāyi tatas ca kṣaṇika tvam iti viśeṣa darśanam kṣaṇika tva sādhanam tat asmābhiḥ viśeṣa darśanam anyathā bhavat kṣaṇika tve na sādhanam iti etāvat mātrakam ucyate na sādhanam abhidhīyate iti

atha avaśyam sādhanam vaktavyam idam brūmaḥ naḥ utpatti vināśa kāraṇa upalabdheḥ utpatti kāraṇam vināśa kāraṇam ca upacaya apacayau valmīka ghaṭa ādīnām dṛṣṭau iti tat ubhayam kṣaṇika tve na syāt upacayaḥ iti ca vṛddhiḥ avardhata gauḥ iti apacayaḥ iti hrāsaḥ apacitaḥ gauḥ iti ubhayam ca etat avasthita vastu viṣayam na hi apūrvam jāyamānam vardhate iti ucyate na api vinaśyat apacitam iti ucyate upacaya apacaya utpatti vināśa kāraṇa upalabdheḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ

athavā kāraṇam iti ādhāraḥ abhidhīyate kāryam iti ādheyam na ca kṣanika tve ādhāra ādheya bhāvaḥ sambhavati na ca ādhāra ādheya bhāvam antareṇa kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tasmāt kārya kāraṇa bhāva upalabdheḥ akṣaṇika tvam iti asya prayogaḥ kārya kāraṇe eka kāla anubhāvinī ādhāra ādheya bhāvāt kṣīrakuṇḍa vat iti kṣīram kuṇḍe vartate tat ca kuṇḍakālam anubhavati tathā ca kāryam kāraṇe vartate iti tasmāt tat api kāraṇa kālam anubhavati na ādhāra ādheya bhāvasya asiddha tvāt iti ced atha manyase asiddhaḥ kārya kāraṇayoḥ ādhāra ādheya bhāvaḥ kāryasya anādhāra tvāt na eva hi naḥ kim cit kāryam ādhāra vat dṛṣṭam iti

na anekāntāt na ayam ekāntaḥ sarvam kāryam anādhāram iti yathā ubhaya pakṣa sampratipattyā rūpam kāryam ca ādhāra vat ca sparśaḥ tad āśrayaḥ iti vyāghātaḥ yadi ca rūpam anāśritam bhavati sparśaḥ tad āśrayaḥ iti vyāhatam anena ca rūpa dṛṣṭāntena yāvat yāvat samāna kāla tayā sādhyate sarvam tat eka kāla anubhāvi bhavati iti siddhaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ kṣaṇikeṣu api nāśa utpādayoḥ eka kāla tvāt tulā anta nāma unnāma vat iti ced atha manyase kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ kṣaṇikeṣu api sambhavati iti kāraṇa vināśa sama kālam kārya bhāvāt yadā kāraṇam vinaśyati tadā kāryam utpadyate iti vinaśyat ca kāraṇam asti kāraṇa vināśena

ca abhinna kālaḥ kārya utpādaḥ yathā tulāyāḥ antayoḥ nāma unnāmau iti na hetu artha aparijñānāt na brūmaḥ kṣaṇikeṣu kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ na asti api tu kṣaṇikeṣu ādhāra ādheya bhāvaḥ bhinna kāla tvāt kārya kāraṇayoḥ na yuktaḥ kāryam ca anādhāram iti na dṛṣṭāntaḥ asti asmat pakṣe kāryam ādhāra vat iti asti dṛṣṭāntaḥ rūpa ādi tulādhārasya ca karmaṇaḥ nāma unnāma bhāvena anabhyupagamāt yugapad bhāva anupapattiḥ eka tvāt yadi tāvat tulām adhikṛtya bravīṣi tadā ekam karma bhramaṇa ākhyam eka tvāt ca yugapad bhāvaḥ na yuktaḥ na hi ekam yugapad bhavati iti atha avayava karmaṇī tayoḥ api kārya kāraṇa bhāvena anabhyupagamāt kim

kena sambadhyate atha yugapad bhāva mātram vivakṣitam iti yugapad bhāvaḥ kāraṇa yaugapadyāt yāvatām arthānām kāraṇāni yuga padyena bhavanti tāvatām ekasmin kāle bhavaḥ iti nāma unnāmau asambaddhau kāraṇa yaugapadyam tu guru tva prayatna saṃyogāḥ unnateḥ avanateḥ api guru tva vat dravya saṃyoga anugṛhītaḥ rajju tulā saṃyogaḥ atha api na karma artha antaram saṃyogam vā paraḥ pratipadyate tasya api uktam uttaram saṃyogaḥ api artha antaram iti saṃyoga kāraṇa tvena ca karma api artha antaram iti yathā ca bhāvānām utpatti vināśa kāraṇam upalabhyate naḥ evam sphaṭikasya na ca anupalabhyamānam śakyam abhyanujñātum iti
yathā kṣīrasya vināśa kāraṇam anupalabhyamānam abhyanujñāyate dadhnaḥ ca utpatti kāraṇam evam sphaṭika ādi vyaktīnām upalabhyamāne utpatti vināśa kāraṇe abhyanujñeye iti

yat liṅgataḥ upalabhyate na tat na asti iti viparyayaḥ tu sphaṭika ādiṣu na hi sphaṭika ādi vyaktīnām apara apara utpattau liṅgam asti iti na na asti śīta uṣṇa sparśa bhedasya nānā tva sādhana tvāt śīta uṣṇa sparśa bhedaḥ nānātve dṛṣṭaḥ yathā agnau udake ca asti ayam śīta uṣṇa sparśa bhedaḥ sphaṭike sa tu nimitta antarāt bhavati kim punar nimittam ap tejaḥ avayava anupraveśaḥ udaka avayava anupraveśāt śītaḥ tejaḥ avayava anupraveśāt ca uṣṇaḥ iti

ap tejaḥ avayava anupraveśaḥ na yuktaḥ alpatara bahutara anupraveśe hetu abhāvāt hemante hi ākāśe paryuṣitānām kāṣṭha bhūmi aśma lohānām śaityasya uttarottara viśeṣaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tathā punar grīṣma ātapa santāpitānām teṣām eva auṣṇyasya na hi teṣu alpatara bahutara praveśe kāraṇam paśyāmaḥ tasmāt sva gata mahābhūta viśeṣa apekṣāṇi āsādita bāhya nimittāni bhūtāni eva tathā tathā utpadyante iti yuktam

na yuktam na hi ap tejaḥ avayava anupraveśena bhūta svabhāvaḥ nivāryate bhūta svabhāvasya ubhaya pakṣa sāmyāt asādhanam bhūta svabhāvaḥ iti viruddhaḥ ca ayam hetuḥ yadi avayava anupraveśam na pratipadyase khara sneha uṣṇa īraṇa ātmakāni bhūtāni iti vyāhanyate katham iti yat kaṭhinam tat ekasmin kāle uṣṇam api bhavati iti yat ca uṣṇam tat kaṭhinam gacchati iti tat ekam vastu dvi svabhāvakam tri svabhāvakam ca prāpnoti yasya punar avayava anupraveśaḥ tasya eṣaḥ doṣaḥ na asti anyatra avasthitasya saṃyukta samavetasya auṣṇyasya grahaṇāt iti viruddhaḥ ca ayam hetuḥ katham ekasya viśeṣa abhyupagamāt ekam tat vastu ekasmin kāle kaṭhinam uṣṇam gacchati ca iti tri svabhāvakam tatas ca viśeṣa darśanāt iti ayam hetuḥ siddhāntam abhyupetya tad virodhī viruddhaḥ iti viruddhaḥ bhavati

atha manyase na viśeṣa mātram nānātvam pratipādayati api tu virodhī viśeṣaḥ nānātve sādhanam iti nābhi prāya aparijñānāt vayam api na brūmaḥ viśeṣa mātram nānātvam api tu bhūtānām yaḥ viśeṣaḥ itaretara vyāvṛttaḥ lakṣaṇa tvena upāttar sa viruddhaḥ yadi aviruddhaḥ syāt na lakṣaṇam syāt eka vṛtti tve vā lakṣaṇa trayasya tat tat vastu kim abhidhīyate yadi tāvat pṛthivī tat na yuktam auṣṇyasya darśanāt atha tejaḥ tat api na yuktam kāṭhinyasya darśanāt etena vāyuḥ vyākhyātaḥ saḥ ayam hetu bhūta lakṣaṇam vā bādhate nānā tva sādhanam vā na bhavati etena jale tāpa viśeṣa grahaṇam pratyuktam tatra api auṣṇyam snigdha teraṇa bhāvaḥ ca yugapad bhavati iti jale agni rūpa grahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ tu na yuktaḥ abhibhavāt tat na siddhānta aparijñānāt na ayam siddhāntaḥ jala rūpena agni rūpam abhibhūyate iti api tu tejasaḥ cāturvidhyāt tatra na rūpa agrahaṇam caturvidham tejaḥ iti etat pratipāditam indriya prakaraṇe iti

yā ca iyam pratijñāḥ anyaḥ ca anyaḥ ca sphaṭikaḥ iti asyāḥ ca kaḥ arthaḥ yadi tāvat anya tva mātram tatas siddha sādhanam bhavati stambha ādibhyaḥ anyaḥ sphaṭikaḥ iti atha sphaṭika antarāt anyaḥ iti etat api tādṛś eva atha pūrva sphaṭikāt anyaḥ katamaḥ asau pūrvaḥ sphaṭikaḥ yatas ayam anyaḥ iti vyavacchedasya aśakya tvāt anabhidhānam yathā ubhaya pakṣa sampratipannāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ tebhyaḥ anya an anya vicāraḥ ghaṭa ādeḥ yuktaḥ na punar iha pūrva sphaṭika antaram ubhaya pakṣa sampratipannam yatas vartamānaḥ anya tvena sādhyate atha ubhaya pakṣa sampratipannam pūrvam sphaṭika antaram vyartham sādhanam atha vartamānam sphaṭikam abhyupagamya yat atītam sphaṭika antaram tat anyat iti sādhyate evam sati śīta uṣṇa sparśa bhedaḥ na tad dharmaḥ vartamāna sphaṭika dharma tvāt vartamānāt ca sphaṭikāt anyat atītam sphaṭika antaram iti kena etat na pratipannam atha tat eva anyat iti vyāghātaḥ tat eva anyat ca iti evam yathā yathā anya tvam vicāryate tathā tathā siddha sādhanam bhavati siddhāntam ca bādhate iti

atha ayugapad kāla pratyayānām ālambanam sphaṭikaḥ na bhavati iti ayam pratijñā arthaḥ etasmin api pratijñā arthe na dṛṣṭāntaḥ asti na na asti pradīpa ādiḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti pradīpaḥ ayugapad kāla pratyaya anālambanam sat ādi dharmāḥ ca iti vidyate dṛṣṭāntaḥ na asiddha tvāt asiddham etat ayugapad kāla pratyaya anālambanāḥ pradīpa ādayaḥ teṣām aneka kṣaṇa avasthānāt pradīpasya tāvat sva kāraṇa sattā sambandha kālaḥ sāmānya abhivyakti kālaḥ avayava karma kālaḥ tad anantaram tad vināśa kālaḥ tad anantaram tad saṃyoga vināśa kālaḥ tatas dravya nāśaḥ iti yathā ca pradīpaḥ evam sarve bhāvāḥ sva kāraṇa sattā sambandha abhivyakti tad virodhyāśraya vināśa anuvidhānena vinaśyanti akāraṇasya vināśānasya anabhyupagamāt na hi naḥ kim cit niṣkāraṇam vinaśyati iti vinaśyat avastha dravya karma vat etat syāt na karmaṇaḥ anabhyupagame virodhāt anabhyupagamāt ca

vināśa hetu abhāvāt iti ced atha manyase na atra vināśasya kāraṇam asti tasmāt utpanna mātraḥ eva ayam bhāvaḥ vinaśyati iti na vikalpa anupapatteḥ vināśasya hetuḥ na asti iti bruvāṇaḥ paryanuyoktavyaḥ kim akāraṇa tvāt vināśaḥ na asti uta akāraṇa tvāt nityaḥ iti bhavatām pakṣe akāraṇam dvedhā nityam asat ca asmākam tu nityam eva tat yadi akāraṇa tvāt nityaḥ vināśaḥ kāryasya utpādaḥ na prāpnoti anutpannasya ca vināśaḥ bhāvasya vināśaḥ na saha avasthānam iti ca doṣaḥ tatas ca bhāvānām abhāva virodhi tvāt atyanta avasthānam iti

atha āsan vināśaḥ evam api sarva nitya tvam vināśa abhāvāt yadi ca āsan vināśaḥ vinaśyati iti asati vināśe pratyayaḥ na prāpnoti nāsatyām gatau gacchati iti bhavati atha avināśi tvāt akāraṇaḥ vināśaḥ iti manyase vināśaḥ na vinaśyati iti kutas etat vinaṣṭānām punar anutpatteḥ iti ced atha manyase yadi vināśaḥ vinaśyet vinaṣṭaḥ punar utpadyate na yuktam etat na hi vināśa abhāva abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ yatas asya vināśa avināśāt bhavet api tu kāraṇavān bhāvaḥ tasya yadā kāraṇam bhavati tadā utpādaḥ iti api ca vināśaḥ kāraṇavān ca na ca vinaśyati abhāva tvāt bhāva dharmaḥ eṣaḥ yat kāraṇa vat tat

vinaśyati iti abhāvaḥ tu akāraṇaḥ api vinaśyati yathā prāgbhāvaḥ kāraṇavān api na vinaśyati yathā pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ yadi kāraṇavān vināśaḥ nanu janakam vināśakam prāpnoti yaḥ eva agni saṃyogaḥ pāka jānām utpādayitā saḥ eva pāka ja antara utpāde pūrva pāka jān ucchinatti iti janakam vināśakam prāptam na anavarodhāt na idam bhavatā kāśyapī iyam darśanam vyajñāyi na hi naḥ yaḥ eva agni saṃyogaḥ pāka jān utpādayati saḥ eva ca ucchinatti api tu agni saṃyoga antaram pūrvarūpa ādīn ucchinatti tad sama kālam rūpa ādīn ārabhate tatas tāni api anyaḥ tāni api anyaḥ iti evam janakasya vināśaka tva prasaṅgaḥ na asti

atha manyase janaka sarūpam api vināśakam na bhavati iti na na bhavati dṛṣṭaḥ hi ap ādi saṃyogāt aṅkurasya utpādaḥ saḥ eva ābādi saṃyogaḥ tad vināśakaḥ iti na asti dṛṣṭe anupapannam nāma yaḥ ca akāraṇe vināśe doṣaḥ saḥ aparihāryaḥ iti atas evam ucyate janaka sarūpam vināśakam iti evam tāvat anya tve sādhye doṣaḥ uktaḥ

ye tu kṣaṇika tvam sādhayanti ante viśeṣa darśanāt vināśa hetu abhāvāt ca tān prati idam ucyate kṣaṇikāḥ saṃskārāḥ iti bruvāṇaḥ kṣaṇika śabda artham praṣṭavyaḥ kim uktam bhavati kṣaṇikāḥ iti yadi vināśinaḥ iti siddha sādhanam atha āśu vināśinaḥ iti tadā api viśeṣaṇam siddhānta virodhi atha utpanna pradhvaṃsinaḥ iti etat api tādṛś eva utpannāḥ pradhvaṃsinaḥ iti siddha sādhanam atha utpannaḥ vinaṣṭam iti ekaḥ kālaḥ utpatti vināśau eka kālau iti tena yathā anutpannasya utpattiḥ evam anutpannasya vināśaḥ iti prāptam atha utpannam vinaśyati iti etasmin api pakṣe utpatti vat vināśaḥ kāraṇavān yathā utpattiḥ kriyā tvāt sa kāraṇā tathā vināśaḥ iti utpadya vināśa kāraṇam anubhavati tatas vinaśyati iti akāraṇe ca

vināśe doṣaḥ uktaḥ yaḥ ca ayam matvarthīyaḥ kṣaṇikaḥ iti sa katham yadi nirukta nyāyena kṣayaḥ kṣaṇaḥ iti kṣaṇaḥ asya asti iti kṣaṇikaḥ iti tat na yuktam kāla bhedāt yadā kṣayaḥ na tadā kṣayī iti bhinna kālayoḥ na matu arthīyaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ atha punar bhāvaḥ eva anantara vināśena viśiṣyamāṇaḥ kṣaṇaḥ iti ucyate tathā api tena eva tat eva tadvat na bhavati iti na yuktaḥ matu arthīyaḥ atha kṣaṇa avasthiti kālāḥ kṣaṇikāḥ iti sarva antyam kālam kṣaṇa tvena pratipadya tatra avatiṣṭhante te kṣaṇikāḥ iti etat api na yuktam saṃjñā mātreṇa kālasya abhyupagamāt pañca bhikṣavaḥ saṃjñā bheda mātram iti śāstram na ca saṃjñā mātram vastu viśeṣaṇa tvena yuktam kṣaṇikāḥ id ca pratijñām kṛtvā na dṛṣṭāntaḥ asti iti uktam pradīpa ādeḥ asiddha tvāt

ye api hetavaḥ ante viśeṣa darśanāt iti evam ādayaḥ te api asiddhāḥ vai anyathā siddhāḥ vā viruddhāḥ vā bhavanti iti ahetavaḥ upetya vā viśeṣavat tvam vartamāna eka kṣaṇa viśeṣavat tvena anaikāntikam ubhaya pakṣa sampratipattyā yaḥ eva kṣaṇaḥ vartamānaḥ sa viśeṣavān bhavati ekaḥ ca iti anekāntaḥ ante viśeṣa darśanāt iti ca viśeṣaṇa ānarthakyam anta artha anabhidhānāt katamasmin ante viśeṣa darśanam vaktavyam atha antar vināśaḥ naḥ etasmin viśeṣa darśanam asti atha antimam vastu eva anta śabda vācyam evam sati eksamin viśeṣaḥ iti viruddhaḥ hetuḥ

yaḥ api ayam hetuḥ darśana adarśanāt iti asya arthaḥ nīyamānasya kila pradīpa ādeḥ dravyasya deśa antare utpādaḥ deśa antare ca nirodhaḥ tad kṛte darśana adarśane staḥ tathā ca gacchataḥ devadatta ādeḥ darśana adarśanāt tasmāt asya api pratikṣaṇam utpāda vināśau iti na etat nyāyam devadatta ādeḥ draśana adarśanayoḥ anya nimitta tvāt saṃyoga vibhāga kṛte darśana adarśane naḥ utpāda vināśa kṛte yasmin deśe saṃyogaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ tasmin saṃyogī na gṛhyate yasmin utpannaḥ tat na gṛhyate iti samyogāt hi dravye ihabuddhiḥ bhavati bhāva abhāvayoḥ tadvat tvāt iti atha saṃyoga vibhāgau na pratipadyate tasya api saṃyogaḥ artha antaram bhavati iti pratipāditam etena vibhāgaḥ vyākhyātaḥ tat evam saṃyoga vibhāga utpatteḥ dravyasya darśana adarśane bhavataḥ na anyathā iti

yat punar etat pradīpasya desa antare utpādaḥ iti etat api na buddhyāmahe katham iti yat tāvat bhavatām pakṣe vastu utpannam yatra tatra eva tat dhvaṃsate yat utpatsu tat anāhita saṃskāram asattvāt deśa antare na utpattum arhati atha anāhita saṃskārasya api deśa antare utpādaḥ na kim cit vastu abhinna deśam utpadyate atha kāraṇam saṃskṛtam iti tad ādheya vaśāt kāryam api tathābhūtam eva utpadyate iti tulyam kāryeṇa yathā eva kārye saṃskāraḥ ādhātum aśakyaḥ tathā kāraṇe api iti tulyam nityam bhavatām pakṣe bhinna deśena kāryeṇa utpattavyam abhinna deśena vā

etena eva atulya pātaḥ vyākhyātaḥ atulya pātāt kṣaṇika tvam iti na kila ākāśe patataḥ loṣṭa ādeḥ pratibandhakam kim cit asti yat anuvidhānena loṣṭa ādi kim cit cireṇa patati kim cit āśu iti tasmāt kṣaṇika tvāt kāḥ cit avasthāḥ tādṛśyaḥ utpadyante yāsām na bhavati adhas santāna utpattau sāmarthyam punar ca tādṛśyaḥ utpadyante yāsām bhavati iti etat api anyathā siddham eva tulyānām gurutvavatām dravyāṇām ekasya guru tva prayatna kṣepāḥ kāraṇam ekasya guru tva mātram ekasya guru tva prayatnau iti tat evam kāraṇa bheda anuvidhāyīni gurutvavanti dravyāṇi

cira āśu pāta anuvidhāna bhāñji bhavati iti ahetuḥ atulya pātaḥ yat api idam iṣoḥ ca āpatanam bhavet iti saṃskāreka tva vādinaḥ doṣaḥ ayam api saṃskāreka tva anabhyupagamena pratyuktaḥ yathā ca anekaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti tathā uktam pāṇi nimitta praśleṣa sūtre iti ekaḥ ca saṃskāraḥ nimitta bhedāt kadā cit paṭūni karmāṇi karoti kadā cit mandāni iti guru tva vat draṣṭavyam yathā ekam guru tvam sahakāri saṃyoga apekṣam mandam pātam karoti tat eva pratibandha apagame paṭum karoti dṛṣṭaḥ hi grāvṇaḥ ākāse muktasya paṭuḥ pātaḥ mandaḥ apsvati tat evam atulya pātaḥ api ahetuḥ

atha akṣaṇika tve kim pramāṇam uktam ādhāra ādheya bhāvāt eka kāla anubhāvīni kārya kāraṇe kuṇḍe badara vat iti atas ca vipratipannāḥ ayugapad kālāḥ pratyayāḥ eka viṣayāḥ avyutthāyi tat pratyaya sāmānādhikaraṇye sati samāna śabda vācya tvāt vartamāna eka kṣaṇa aneka puruṣa pratyaya vat yathā vartamāna eka kṣaṇa viṣayāṇām aneka puruṣa pratyayānām avyutthāyi tat pratyaya sāmānādhikaraṇye sati samāna śabda vācyānām eka viṣaya tvam tathā ca avyutthāyi tat pratyaya samāna adhikaraṇāḥ samāna śabda vācyāḥ ca vipratipannāḥ ayugapad kālāḥ pratyayāḥ tasmāt te api eka viṣayāḥ iti pratyātmam na aneka kartṛkāḥ pratyayāḥ apratisandhāna prasaṅgāt devadatta ādi pratyaya vat iti rūpa rasa gandha sparśa pratyayāḥ eka aneka nimittāḥ pratisandhānāt kṛta samayānām bahūnām vartamāna eka kṣaṇa aneka vijñāna vat iti hyastanāt yatanāni vijñānāni eka santatau eka aneka nimittāni mayā iti pratisandhānāt pūrvavat śāstra artha pratyayāḥ eka aneka nimittāḥ pratisandhānāt pūrvat iti nānā viṣayāṇām nānā kartṛkāṇām ca pratyayānām apratisandhānāt iti pūrvavat eva nyāyaḥ iti

na evam kṣīram vinaśyati na api dadhi utpadyate api tu avasthitasya dravyasya pūrva dharma nivṛttau dharma antaram utpadyate iti eke varṇayanti apare tu avasthitasya dravyasya guṇa nivṛttau guṇa antaram utpadyate iti sa khalu ayam eka pakṣībhāvaḥ iva kaḥ upamāna arthaḥ ubhayatra dravyam avatiṣṭhate ekasya tirobhāva abhivyaktī ekasya vināśa prādurbhāvau iti upamāna arthaḥ

ubhayoḥ api ca uttaram vyūha antarāt dravya antara utpatti darśanam pūrva dravya nivṛtteḥ anumānam śeṣam bhāṣye yat punar etat ekasya tirobhāva abhivyaktī ekasya vināśa prādurbhāvau iti tat na pūrva avasthā parityāgāt yadi vināśa utpādau nivṛtti prādurbhāvau atha api abhivyakti anabhivyaktī sarvathā pūrva avasthām jahāti dravyam iti na hi anapavṛktasya pūrva avasthātaḥ abhivyakti anabhivyaktī bhavataḥ vināśa prādurbhāvau vā iti tasmāt ayuktam avasthitasya pariṇāmaḥ iti

abhyanujñāya ca niṣkāraṇam kṣīra vināśam niṣkāraṇam ca dadhi utpādam kvacid vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdeḥ kvacid ca upalabdheḥ anekāntaḥ kṣīra dadhi vat niṣkāraṇau vināśa utpādau sphaṭika vyaktīnām na punar kumbha ādi vat sa kāraṇau iti na atra hetuḥ asti iti niradhiṣṭhānam ca dṛṣṭānta vacanam kaḥ adhiṣṭhāna arthaḥ āśrayaḥ kim uktam bhavati niradhiṣṭhānam iti dharmī na asti iti yāvat uktam bhavati na hi sphaṭikasya utpāda vināśau pratikṣaṇam upalabhyete yatas iyam cintā bhavet kim etau sa kāraṇau āhosvit akāraṇau iti yathā anabhyupagata śabda sattvam prati kaḥ cit brūyāt kṛtaka tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ tādṛś etat iti dharmya prasiddheḥ ca dṛṣṭānta abhāvaḥ iti ca samānam

abhyanujñāya ca sphaṭikasya utpāda vināśau yaḥ atra sādhakaḥ tasya abhyanujñānāt apratiṣedhaḥ ubhau etau dṛṣṭāntau kṣīra dadhi vat kumbha ādi vat ca tatra kim kumbha ādi dṛṣṭāntaḥ bhavatu atha kṣīra dadhinī iti kumbha ādi vat iti yuktam kumbha ādi utpatti vināśa kāraṇasya dṛṣṭa tvāt kṣīra dadhi vat tu na yuktam anumānataḥ grahaṇāt iti siddham anityā buddhiḥ iti itas ca anityā buddhiḥ guṇa tve sati pratyakṣa tayā vyāpaka dravya samavāyāt śabda vat jātimat tve sati asmad ādi pratyakṣa tvāt āśrita tvāt ca śabdavat karaṇa bhāve sati ayogi pratyakṣa tvāt śabda vat eva

sā tu iyam buddhiḥ kasya guṇaḥ iti etat cintyate na guṇa bhāva asiddheḥ anitya tve sati niyamena ācākṣuṣa pratyakṣa tvāt rasavat siddhaḥ guṇa bhāvaḥ sannikarṣa utpatteḥ saṃśayaḥ iti tatra ayam viśeṣaḥ na indriya arthayoḥ tad vināśe api jñāna avasthānāt bhavati khalu idam indriye arthe ca vinaṣṭe jñānam adrākṣam iti adrākṣam iti etat naḥ indriya artha sannikarṣāt smṛti tvāt smṛtiḥ eṣā naḥ indriya artha sannikarṣāt bhavitum arhati smṛtau api tulyam yathā jñātāram antareṇa jñānam na bhavati evam anubhavitari naṣṭe anubhavitāram antareṇa smṛtiḥ ayuktāḥ iti

astu tarhi manaḥ guṇaḥ jñānam yugapad jñeya anupalabdheḥ ca na manasaḥ tat khalu yugapad jñeya anupalabdyā samadhigatam manaḥ na atas tasya guṇaḥ jñānam viśeṣaṇa upādānāt antaḥkaraṇa bahutva prasaṅgaḥ iti ced atha manyase yat khalu yugapad jñeya anupalabdhyā samadhigatam manaḥ na tasya guṇaḥ jñānam iti evam bruvāṇena bahūni antaḥkaraṇāni pratipannāni bhavanti na hi asati antaḥkaraṇa bahutve viśeṣaṇam arthavat iti na sarvasya indriyasya manana nimitta tvāt sarvam eva indriyam manana nimitta tvāt manaḥ iti abhidhīyate evam ca sati

yuktam viśeṣaṇam yugapad jñeya anupalabdhyā yat samadhigatam manaḥ na tasya guṇaḥ jñānam iti evam api viśeṣaṇam vyartham anyasya anabhyupagamāt yadi tasya antaḥkaraṇasya na bhavati anyasya tarhi sādhanasya jñānam guṇaḥ iti prāptam anyasya anabhyupagamāt anyasya upapatteḥ apratiṣedhaḥ anavasthita tvāt pramāṇa prameya vyavahārasya yadā ayam yogī puruṣa antareṇa puruṣa antaram paricchinatti tadā puruṣa antara paricchede puruṣa antaram sādhanam iti tattva jñāna guṇam bhavati iti yuktam viśeṣaṇam iti tasmāt na tasya guṇaḥ jñānam iti

kasya tarhi asya arthasya pradarśana artham jñāsya vaśitvāt vaśī jñātā vaśyam karaṇam iti na ca ayam jñātari niyamaḥ jñātā vaśī eva vaśyaḥ api bhavati iti acetane tu niyamaḥ acetanam tu sarvam vaśyam iti vaśyam manaḥ acetana tvāt ghrāṇa ādi vat iti jñāna guṇa tve ca saṃjñā bheda mātram vibhu ca antaḥkaraṇam jñāna guṇam ca iti saṃjñā mātram bhidyate yathā ca jñātuḥ jñāna sādhanam indriyam evam mantuḥ mati sādhanena avaśyam bhavitavyam iti ubhayoḥ cetanatve pratyaya vyavasthā anumānam na syāt vibhu ca antaḥkaraṇam jñāna guṇam iti sarva indriyaiḥ yugapad upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ
yasya api ātmā vibhuḥ ca jñāna guṇaḥ ca tasya api sarva indriyaiḥ sambandhasya apratiṣedhāt yugapad upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ
na prasaṅgaḥ kāraṇa antara bhāvāt indriya artha sannikarṣa vat indriya manaḥ sannikarṣaḥ api kāraṇam iti tasya ca ayaugapadyam aṇu tvāt manasaḥ iti

yadi punar ātma indriya artha sannikarṣāt eva jñānam utpadyeta kim syāt na utpatti kāraṇa anapadeśāt asmāt eva utpadyatām iti na kāraṇam apadiśyate iti sūtra arthaḥ ātma indriya artha sannikarṣāt jñānam utpadyate iti ayugapad utpattau vā na kāraṇa antaram apadisyate videha pratyaya anutpattau vā yadā indriyam arthena bahis avasthitena sambadhyate ātma sambandhaḥ api tatra asti iti kasmāt videha pratyayaḥ na bhavati iti vaktavyam antaḥkaraṇa pratyākhyāne ca kevalam ātmā smṛti ādi kāraṇam iti kasmāt na yugapad utpattiḥ smṛtīnām yadā ca indriyam ātmā ca arthena yugapad sambaddhau tadā kim indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ kāraṇam uta ātma artha sannikarṣaḥ uta ātma indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ iti kāraṇa anapadeśaḥ

tad ātma guṇa tve api tulyam iti etat anena samuccīyante yadi ātma guṇaḥ buddhiḥ bhavati vināśa kāraṇa abhāvāt nitya tvam asyāḥ prasajyeta katham iti guṇānām dvavidhaḥ vināśa hetuḥ āśraya abhāvaḥ virodhi guṇa prādurbhāvaḥ ca tatra nitya tvāt ātmanaḥ anupapannaḥ pūrvaḥ virodhī ca gunaḥ na asti iti nitya tva prasaṅgaḥ

anityā buddhiḥ iti etat pratipāditam tatra asyāḥ buddhi antarāt vā saṃskārāt vā vināśaḥ iti pratipattavyam na dve buddhī saha iti ced atha manyase na dve buddhī saha bhavataḥ yatas parayā pūrvā nivartyate iti tat ca na yugapad utpatti pratiṣedhāt yugapad utpattiḥ pratiṣidhyate na sahabhāvaḥ na hi buddhyoḥ yugapad bhāve kim cit virudhyate iti labdha ātmakena ca kāryeṇa kāraṇasya vināśa abhyupagamāt yadā ca kāryam labdha ātmakam bhavati tadā kāraṇam vināśayati śabda vat yathā labdha ātmakaḥ kāryaḥ śabdaḥ kāraṇam śabdam nirmārṣṭi tathā buddhiḥ api iti antyayoḥ na syāt iti ced atha manyase yadi pūrvau buddhi śabdau parābhyām vināsyete antyayoḥ buddhi śabdayoḥ kim vināśa kāraṇam iti yathā ca antyau buddhi śabdau vināśa kāraṇam vinā vinaśyataḥ evam anyat api kāryam iti na sparśavat dravya saṃyogāt tad utpatteḥ

sparśavat dravya saṃyogena antya śabdaḥ virudhyate ye kuḍya ādibhiḥ ākāraṇasya saṃyogāḥ te eka artha samavāyinam śabdam pratibadhnanti atas antyasya aśrutiḥ śabdasya iti antyā buddhiḥ sthiti hetu abhāvāt vinaśyati iti kālāt vā saṃskārāt vā katham kālāt yau antyasya janmanaḥ sthiti hetū dharma adharmau tayoḥ abhāvāt antyā buddhiḥ vinasyati iti kasmāt punar etat evam ucyate na punar ahetukaḥ vināśaḥ abhyupagamyate iti na abhyupagamyate ukta doṣāt nirhetuke vināśe uktaḥ doṣaḥ kṣaṇa bhaṅgam nirākurvadbhiḥ iti yadi kāraṇasya ayaugapadyāt buddhīnām ayugapad utpattiḥ yatra kāraṇasya yaugapadyam asti tatra yugapad utpatti prasaṅgaḥ yathā smṛtiṣu atra tāvat ekaḥ parihāraḥ karaṇasya eka kriyā nirvṛttau sāmarthyāt na hi karaṇam ekasmin kāle anekām kriyām nirvatayitum śaktam iti pariccheda tvāt ca smṛtīnām jñāna vat yugapad utpattiḥ iti
apare tu kāraṇasya ayaugapadyam upapādayiṣyantaḥ jñāna samaveta ātma pradeśa sannikarṣāt manasaḥ smṛti utpatteḥ na yugapad utpattiḥ iti āhuḥ

etat tu na samyak iti pratipādayitum āha na antar śarīra vṛtti tvāt manasaḥ antar śarīre manaḥ vartate iti kaḥ vṛtti arthaḥ na tāvat āśraya āśraya bhāvaḥ na hi manaḥ kva cit āśritam na api vṛttiḥ sva kārya sāmarthyam bahis kārya darśanāt manasā adhiṣṭhitam cakṣuḥ niḥsṛtya rūpa ādikam artham grāhayati cakṣuṣoḥ visarārvoḥ manasaḥ kāryam tad bhāva bhāvi tvāt na ca anyā vṛttiḥ sambhavati tasmāt na antar śarīra vṛtti manaḥ iti atra brūmaḥ na āśraya āśrita bhāvaḥ manasaḥ vṛttiḥ na api kārya pratilambhaḥ api tu na aśarīrasya manasaḥ kāryam iti manasaḥ vṛtti arthaḥ na hi aśarīram manaḥ puruṣasya artham karoti iti
aśarīram manaḥ puruṣa artha asamartham iti sādhyam etat
smaraṇa śarīra dhāraṇe yugapad bhavataḥ iti dṛṣṭam dṛṣṭam ca sarveṇa pratipattavyam cira niścarite ca manasi smarataḥ śarīra dhāraṇam na syāt
ubhayam sidhyati smaraṇam dhāraṇam ca
aniyataḥ smṛti kālaḥ atas ayuktam etat śarīra saṃyoga anapekṣam ca ātma manaḥ saṃyogam smṛti kāraṇam bruvataḥ śarīrasya upabhoga āyatana tvam nivartate tad nivṛttau ca śarīra utpatti vaiyarthyam iti
apare tu ātma preraṇa yadṛcchā jña tābhiḥ ca na saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ iti parihāram bruvate

eta ca vyāsakta manasaḥ pāda vyathanena saṃyoga viśeṣeṇa samānam bhavati iti aparihāraḥ karma adṛṣṭam upabhoga artham niyāmakam bhavati iti na yuktam samāna tvāt tasmāt pūrvaḥ eva parihāraḥ na antar śarīra vṛtti tvāt manasaḥ iti

yadi tarhi jñāna samaveta ātma pradeśa sannikarṣasya ayaugapadyāt iti parihāraḥ naḥ iṣyate prāptaḥ smṛtīnām yugapad utpādaḥ kāraṇasya yaugapadyāt iti praṇidhāna liṅga ādi jñānānām ayugapad bhāvāt yugapad asmaraṇam na apekṣā kāraṇasya ayugapad bhāvāt prātibhavat tu praṇidhāna ādi anapekṣe smārte yaugapadya prasaṅgaḥ yad praṇidhāna ādi ātma manaḥ saṃyogasya sahakāri kāraṇam tat na yugapad bhavati iti ayugapad utpattiḥ smṛtīnām yadi praṇidhāna ādi apekṣa ātma manaḥ saṃyogaḥ na yugapad smṛti kāraṇam yāḥ smṛtayaḥ praṇidhāna ādi sannidhānam antareṇa bhavanti tāsām yaugapadyam syāt na anabhyupagamāt na hi praṇidhāna ādi anapekṣam smārtam asti sataḥ smṛti hetoḥ tu asaṃvedanāt prātibhena samāna abhimānaḥ ayam iti prātibham tarhi yugapad bhavitum arhati na hi tasya asat nihitam kāraṇam iti na ukta uttara tvāt ukta uttaram etat na hi karaṇasya aneka kriyā nirvṛtti sāmarthyam asti prātibham ca anekam jñānam bhavat ekasmin arthe bhavet anekasmin vā tat na tāvat ekasmin vaiyarthyāt na anekasmin sāmarthya abhāvāt

na ca ayam niyamaḥ pratyayānām yaugapadyam na bhavati iti jñātuḥ vikaraṇa dharmaṇaḥ deha nānā tve pratyaya yaugapadyāt iti yadi ca jñāna samaveta ātma pradeśa āsannikarṣāt na smṛtīnām yugapad utpattiḥ ye saṃskārāḥ eka deśāḥ teṣu avasthita śarīrasya aneka jñāna samavāyāt eka pradeśe yugapadaneka artha smaraṇam syāt na ca etat asti iti atas ca aparīhāraḥ iti avasthita śarīrasya saṃskārāḥ samāna deśāḥ iti ayuktam ātma pradeśānām adravya antara tvāt evam sati sarva saṃskārāṇām samāna deśa tve pratyaya yaugapadya prasaṅgaḥ aparihāryaḥ

saṃskāra pratyāsattyā smṛti yaugapadyam na bhavati iti kā pratyāsattiḥ na hi saṃskārāṇām sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa bhāvaḥ asti samāna deśa tvāt na brūmaḥ sannikṛṣṭa tā pratyāsattiḥ api tu saṃskārasya sahakāri kāraṇa samavadhānam pratyāsattiḥ śabda vat yathā śabdāḥ santāna vartinaḥ sarve eva ākāśe samavayanti samāna deśa tve api yasya upalabdheḥ kāraṇāni santi saḥ upalabhyate naḥ itare tathā saṃskāreṣu api iti

puruṣasya jñānam icchā ādayaḥ antaḥkaraṇasya iti kasya cit darśanam tat pratiṣidhyate jñasya jñasya icchā dveṣa nimitta tvāt ārambha nivṛttyoḥ jñātuḥ eva icchā ādayaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ yadi antaḥkaraṇasya icchā ādayaḥ syuḥ na pratyakṣāḥ syuḥ na hi icchā ādayaḥ anyatra vartamānāḥ anyasya pratyakṣāḥ bhavitum arhanti iti nityam ca icchā ādayaḥ apratyakṣāḥ syuḥ manaḥ guṇānām nityam atīndriya tvāt ārambha nivṛttyoḥ ca pratyagātmani dṛṣṭa tvāt paratra anumānam
pravṛtti nivṛttibhyām sāmānādhikaraṇyāt śarīra ādiṣu prasaṅgaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ
iti anekāntaḥ vākya arthaḥ

prayujyamāna bhūta viṣaya tvam pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ niyamaḥ yāni bhūtāni prayujayante teṣu pravṛtti nivṛttī bhavataḥ na sarveṣu iti yadi punar jña tvāt bhūtānām pravṛtti nivṛttī syātām bhūtamātre syātām yathā guru tva ādibhyaḥ bhūta guṇebhyaḥ yāni guru tva ādimanti bhūtāni tāni sva guṇāt patanti iti niyamaḥ ca dṛṣṭaḥ tasmāt na bhūtāni cetanāni iti

eka śarīre ca jñātṛ bahu tvam niranumānam yasya bhūtāni cetanāni tasya eka śarīre bahūni bhūtāni iti bahavaḥ cetanāḥ syuḥ bhavantu bahavaḥ cetanāḥ kim naḥ bādhyate iti ced na bahu tve vyavasthāna anumānam na bhavet vyavasthām tu na paśyāmaḥ pratyayānām pratisandhānāt sarvaḥ pratyayaḥ pratisandhīyamānaḥ ekasmin kārya kāraṇa saṅghāte dṛṣṭaḥ iti anyathā abhidhānāt ca hita ahita prāpti parihāra arthaḥ parispandaḥ pravṛtti nivṛttī bhavatā tu kriyā mātram kriyā uparama mātram ca āśritya tad liṅga tvāt icchā dveṣayoḥ pārthiva ādyeṣu apratiṣedhaḥ iti uktam

yathāvidhe ca pravṛtti nivṛttī prayujyamāna bhūta ādhāre dṛṣṭe na tathāvidhe bhūtamātre bhavataḥ iti bhūta indriya manasām samānaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ manaḥ tu udāharaṇa mātram yathā ukta hetu tvāt pāratantryāt sva kṛta abhyāgamāt ca na manasaḥ yathā ukta hetu tvāt iti darśana sparśanābhyām eka artha grahaṇāt iti evam ādīnām ātma pratipatti hetūnām apratiṣedhāt pāratantryāt iti paratantryāṇi śarīra indriya manāṃsi dhāraṇa preraṇa vyūhana kriyāsu prayatna vaśāt pravartante caitanye punar svatantrāṇi syuḥ sva kṛta abhyāgamāt ca cetana tvāt śarīra ādīnām taiḥ kṛtam karma puruṣena bhujyate iti akṛta kṛta āgama nāśa doṣa prasaṅgaḥ acetana tve tu tad sādhanasya sva kṛta karma phala upabhogaḥ iti

atha ayam siddha upasaṅgrahaḥ pariśeṣāt yathā ukta hetu upapatteḥ ca ātmanaḥ guṇaḥ jñānam iti prakṛtam yathā ukta hetu upapatteḥ iti ātma pratipādakānām hetūnām apratiṣedhāt pariśeṣāt iti śarīra indriya manasām pratiṣedhāt anyasya ca śiṣyamāṇasya asambhavāt ātmanaḥ ca śiṣyamāṇa tvāt tasya guṇaḥ jñānam iti upapatteḥ iti vā svatantraḥ hetuḥ ātmanaḥ nitya tve iti kasya upapatteḥ saṃsāra apavargayoḥ upapatteḥ iti evam ādi bhāṣye
smaraṇam tu ātmanaḥ jña svābhāvyāt

smṛti hetūnām ayaugapadyāt ayugapad smaraṇam iti uktam atha kebhyaḥ smṛtiḥ utpadyate iti smṛti kāraṇānām ayaugapadya pratipādana artham praṇidhāna ādi sūtram p r a ṇ i d h ā n a n i b a n d h ā b h y ā s a l i ṅ g a l a k ṣ a ṇ a s ā d ṛ ś y a p a r i g r a h ā ś r a y ā ś r ita sambandha ānantarya viyoga eka kārya virodha atiśaya prāpti vyavadhāna sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa bhaya arthi tva kriyā rāga dharma adharma nimittebhyaḥ evam upapannam anityā buddhiḥ iti

anityāyām ca buddhau utpanna apavargi tvāt kāla antara avasthāyi tvāt ca nityānām saṃśayaḥ kim utpanna apavargiṇī buddhiḥ śabda vat āho kāla antara avasthāyinī kumbha vat iti utpanna apavargiṇī iti yuktam kaḥ punar ayam arthaḥ utpanna apavargiṇī iti anyebhyaḥ vināśibhyaḥ āśutaram vinaśyati iti na tu ayam arthaḥ utpatti anantaram dhvaṃsate iti kaḥ punar atra nyāyaḥ āśutara vināśinī buddhiḥ jātimat tve sati asmad ādi pratyakṣa tāyāḥ vyāpaka dravya samavāyāt śabda vat pratikṣaṇam apūrva utpattau ayugapad utpattau ca karaṇa tve sati

pratyartha prakāśaka tvāt yasya pratikṣaṇam apūrva utpanna padārtha prakāśaka tvam karaṇa tve sati tasya āśu vināśi tvam dṛṣṭam yathā pradīpasya pratikṣaṇam apūrva utpannāḥ ca pradhvaṃsinaḥ padārthān buddhiḥ prati artha niyamena prakāśayati tasmāt iyam api āśutara vināśinī iti atha vā āśutara vināśinī buddhiḥ guṇa tve sati abāhya karaṇa pratyakṣa tvāt sukha vat iti asya arthasya jñāpana artham karma anavasthāyi grahaṇāt iti sūtram yadi tarhi anavasthāyiṣu padārtheṣu evaṃbhūtā buddhiḥ atha yadā avasthitam kumbha ādikam artham upalabhate tadā

kim kumbha vat kāla antara avasthāyinī uta āśu vidhvaṃsinī iti avasthita grahaṇe api pratyakṣa nivṛtteḥ pradhvaṃsinī yadā api avasthitam kumbha ādikam artham upalabhate tadā api santānena eva buddhayaḥ vartante kasmāt vyavahite pratyakṣa nivṛtteḥ yadi kumbha vat kāla antara avasthāyinī buddhiḥ abhaviṣyat vyavahite api pratyakṣam avāsthāsyata na tu avatiṣṭhate tasmāt na kāla antara avasthāyinī iti smṛteḥ avatiṣṭhate iti ced yadi buddhiḥ pradhvaṃsinī syāt smṛtiḥ na syāt na hi buddhi bhede smṛtim paśyāmaḥ yathā puruṣa antara buddhiṣu

asti ca smṛtiḥ tasmāt avatiṣṭhate buddhiḥ iti na atas eva atas eva na avatiṣṭhate na hi buddhau avasthitāyām smṛtiḥ sambhavati smṛtiḥ nāma pratyakṣa buddhi nirodhe tad pūrvakaḥ viṣaya pratisandhiḥ yathā idam adrākṣam iti adrākṣam iti ca na pratyakṣāyām buddhau avasthitāyām yuktam iti anyatas ca tad bhāvāt smṛtiḥ aliṅgam iti yā iyam smṛtiḥ buddhi avasthāna liṅga tvena abhyupagamyate naḥ iyam liṅgam anyatas tad bhāvāt avatiṣṭhate hi buddhi jaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti tatas praṇidhāna ādi nimitta apekṣāt smṛtiḥ iti hetu abhāvaḥ iti ced atha manyase saṃskārāt smṛtiḥ na buddhi avasthānāt iti atra kaḥ hetuḥ smṛtiḥ eva yadi avatiṣṭhate buddhiḥ smṛtiḥ na syāt iti uktam
yadi anavasthāyinī buddhiḥ avyaktam vyaktasya grahaṇam prāpnoti yathā vidyutā prakāśitānām arthānām avyaktam grahaṇam iti

na virodhāt avyakta grahaṇāt avasthāyinī buddhiḥ iti bruvāṇaḥ yat pratiṣeddhavyam anavasthāyinī buddhiḥ iti tat abhyanujānāti tasya ca abhyanujñānāt yat uktam kāla antara avasthāyinī buddhiḥ iti tat bādhitam bhavati avyakta grahaṇasya ca anya nimitta tvāt na avyakta grahaṇāt buddhi anavasthānam siddhyati yat tat avyaktam vyaktam ca grahaṇam na tat buddheḥ avasthāna anavasthānābhyām api tu grahaṇa hetoḥ bhedāt iti tad asambhavāt ca na ca avyaktam nāma grahaṇam asti kasmāt artha grahaṇa mātra tvāt buddheḥ artha grahaṇa mātram hi buddhiḥ tat ca artha grahaṇam sāmānyatas viśeṣataḥ ca

yat ca sāmānya viṣayam tat sāmānyam prati vyaktam evam viśeṣa viṣayam evam tadvat viṣayam iti tat idam avyakta grahaṇam deśitam katamasmin viṣaye buddhi anavasthāna kāritam syāt loka virodhaḥ iti ced yadi tarhi vyakta avyakta grahaṇe na syātām yaḥ ayam vyavahāraḥ lokeṣu vyaktam paśyāmi iti sa katham na anyathā tad upapatteḥ na ayam sāmānya viśeṣa tadvatsu vyakta avyakta grahaṇa bhedaḥ api tu dharmiṇaḥ sāmānyatas adhigatasya viśeṣataḥ upalipsā dvārakam avyakta grahaṇam iti anekāntāt ca na ca ayam ekāntaḥ asti yat viṣaya grahaṇa hetoḥ grāhyasya ca anavasthānam tatra avyakta grahaṇam

anavasthāyi tve api yathā pradīpa arciṣām sanatatyā vartamānānām grāhya anavasthānam grahaṇa anavasthānam ca bhavati bhavati ca vyaktam grahaṇam arcīṃṣi iti yathā arciḥṣu tathā anyatra api iti vyavasthitam kṣaṇikā buddhiḥ iti

śarīra guṇaḥ cetanā sati śarīre bhāvāt asati ca abhāvāt iti yat ca yasmin sati bhavati asati ca na bhavati tasya tat iti vijñāyate yathā rūpa ādayaḥ iti na sati bhāvāt śarīra guṇa tvam cetanāyāḥ sidhyati sati bhāvasya anya guṇa tve api darśanāt na tāvat saṃyoga vibhāga ssaṃskārāḥ karma guṇāḥ atha ca sati karmaṇi bhāvaḥ asati ca abhāvaḥ iti saṃyoga vibhāga śabdeṣu ca satsu śabdaḥ bhavati atha ca na tad guṇaḥ iti tad guṇa tvam ca tatra upalabdhyā siddhyati yadi yatra vartamānam upalabhyate rūpa ādikam tat tasya guṇaḥ iti atha sati bhāvāt iti anena śarīre cetanā upalabdhim brūyāt tasya api asiddha tā doṣaḥ na hi naḥ śarīre cetanā upalabhyate cetanā mātram tu upalabhyate tat ca sandigdham kim śarīre uta anyasmin iti upetya śarīre cetanā upalabdhim kim śarīra guṇaḥ cetanāḥ uta dravya antara guṇaḥ iti dravye sva guṇa para guṇa upalabdheḥ saṃśayaḥ iti ukta artham sūtram

na śarīra guṇaḥ cetanā yāvat śarīra bhāvi tvāt rūpa ādīnām dṛṣṭānta sūtram vaidharmyeṇa ye śarīra guṇāḥ bhavanti te yavat śarīram vartante yathā rūpa ādayaḥ na tu yavat śarīram cetanā vartate tasmāt na tad guṇaḥ iti sādharmyeṇa vā na tad guṇaḥ iti yathā apsu uṣṇa tā iti saṃskāra vat iti ced atha manyase yathā saṃskāraḥ śarīra guṇaḥ na ca yavat śarīram vartate tathā cetanā api iti na kāraṇa anucchedāt saṃskārasya na śarīra mātram kāraṇam tasya nodana ādi kāraṇa sannidhāne tad abhāve ca bhāva abhāvau yuktau na tu cetanāyāḥ kāraṇa sannidhānam atas ayuktam etat iti

cetanā nimittasya api asannidhānam iti ced atha manyase yathā eva saṃskārasya kāraṇam asannihitam evam cetanā kāraṇam api iti tat ayuktam vikalpa anupapatteḥ yat śarīre cetanā utpatti kāraṇam tat kim śarīra stham uta dravya antara stham śarīra stham api kim yavat śarīra bhāvi uta naimittikam iti yadi yavat śarīra bhāvi na kadā cit cetanā hīnam śarīram upalabhyeta tad nimittasya sannihita tvāt atha naimittikam yat tad śarīre cetanā utpatteḥ nimitta kāraṇam tatra api cetanāvat prasaṅgaḥ atha dravya antara stham dravya antara vṛtti nimittam śarīre cetanām karoti na dravya antareṣu iti atra api niyama hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ dravya antara stham ca etat nityam anityam vā anityam api kāla antara avasthāyi pratikṣaṇa pradhvaṃsi vā iti cetanā vat prasaṅgaḥ

yat ca manyeta śyāma ādi guṇam ca dravyam bhavati na ca yāvat dravya bhāvinī śyāma tā iti tat ca na pāka ja guṇa antara utpatteḥ na atyantam śyāma rūpa uparame rūpa antara anutpādaḥ cetanā uparamaḥ tu atyantaḥ iti

itas ca pratidvandvi siddheḥ pāka jānām apratiṣedhaḥ yāvatsu dravyeṣu pūrva guṇa pratiṣedhaḥ tāvatsu pratidvandvinaḥ guṇa antarasya darśanam yathā śyāma ādi nivṛttau rakta ādīnām iti na punar śarīre cetanā viparītam guṇa antaram upalabhyate cetanā mātra uparamaḥ tu atyantam iti atha manyase śarīre api acetana tvam nāma guṇa antaram iti tat na svarūpataḥ anirdeśāt yat tat acetana tvam nāma kim tat cetanā viparītam dharma bhūtam vastu uta cetanā pratiṣedha mātram iti yadi viparītam vastu cetanā vat saṃvedyam syāt atha cetanā pratiṣedha mātram tat na guṇaḥ iti

itas ca na śarīra guṇaḥ cetanā śarīra vyāpi tvāt śarīra vat śarīra avayavāḥ cetanā utpattyā vyāpyante kaḥ vyāpti arthaḥ na kaḥ cit śarīra avayavaḥ cetanā hīnaḥ bhavati iti sarvasya cetanā nimitta tvāt śarīra vat śarīra avayavāḥ cetanāḥ prāpnuvanti bhavantu śarīra avayavāḥ api cetanāḥ na pratyaya vyavasthā prasaṅgāt śarīra vat śarīra avayavāḥ cetanā iti pratyaya vyavasthānam syāt
na śarīra avayavāḥ cetanāḥ na keśa nakha ādiṣu anupalabdheḥ iti dṛṣṭānta sūtram
saṃyogi dravyam keśa ādayaḥ iti na tu śarīra avayavāḥ iti tasmāt aprasaṅgaḥ ayam iti

itas ca na śarīra guṇaḥ cetanā śarīra guṇa vaidharmyāt dvaye śarīra guṇāḥ bhavanti bāhya karaṇa pratyakṣāḥ ca rūpa ādayaḥ atīndriyam ca guru tvam vidha antaram tu cetanā na bāhya karaṇa pratyakṣāḥ antar saṃvedya tvāt na atīndriyāḥ manaḥ viṣaya tvāt tasmāt na śarīra guṇaḥ iti
yathā itaretara vidharmāṇaḥ rūpa ādayaḥ na śarīra guṇa tvam ativartante tathā rūpa ādi vaidharmye api na cetanā śarīra guṇa tvam na hāsyati iti

apratyakṣa tvāt ca dvaye śarīra guṇāḥ bhavanti iti uktaḥ sūtra arthaḥ rūpa ādīnām itaretara vaidharmyam ananu saṃhitam ca avyāvṛttam ca iti vaidharmya mātram anvayavyatireki tu cetanāyāḥ śarīra guṇa tva sādhanam na bhavati tasmāt asamam etat ye hetavaḥ anena prakaraṇena labhyante teṣām prayogaḥ na śarīra guṇaḥ cetanā nimitta antara abhāve virodhi guṇa adarśane ca sati ayāvat dravya bhāvi tvāt apsu auṣṇya vat iti śarīra vyāpi tvāt iti na sādhanam kim tu śarīre cetanām bruvataḥ doṣaḥ aneka cetana tva prasaṅgaḥ na śarīra guṇaḥ cetanā bāhya karaṇa apratyakṣa tvāt sukha ādi vat iti atha idam prakaraṇam nirṇīta artham kasmāt punar ārabhyam iti bahu parīkṣyamāṇam tattvam niścitataram bhavati iti atas ārabhyate iti
