tat etat asāmpratam iha bheryā śabdaḥ iti pratibhāsasya santāna anumāna dvāreṇa adhiṣṭhāna deśaḥ eva pratibhāsāt nanu ca atra viśeṣa hetoḥ abhāvāt niścaya abhāvaḥ eva kim tad sthasya eva śabdasya upalambhaḥ santāna anumitasya vā iti na tad sthasya eva upalambhaḥ kvacid āśraya viyuktasya api śrotra deśe pratibhāsāt na ca evam sparśavatām guṇāḥ ca āśraya viyuktāḥ gṛhyante iti na asiddhatvam hetoḥ

atha sparśa vat guṇa tve api gandhasya iva tad āśraya āgamanāt upalambhaḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced na gandhasya sparśa vat guṇa tva prasiddhau āśraya avicchedena ghrāṇa adhiṣṭhāna deśaḥ eva pratibhāsāt sūkṣmasya tad ādhārasya āgamanam yuktam na ca evam śabdasya tathā sūkṣma dravya ādhārasya bherī śabdasya āgamanam eva na yuktam bheryā samavetasya utpādāt na hi anyatra samavetam anyatra samavaiti iti samavetyavādena tu āgamane api tad avayava śabdāḥ bherī śabdāḥ ca iti pratibhāsaḥ eva prasaṅgaḥ sūkṣma dravya samavāyasya aviśeṣāt

tathā bherī daṇḍa abhidhātāt bheryām utpannaḥ śabdaḥ na āgacchati eva āśrayasya tatra avasthānāt tad avayaveṣu ca sūkṣmeṣu ye jātāḥ śabdāḥ tad āśrayasya āgamanāt āgacchanti iti abhyupagame bherī ādi gambhīra dhvaneḥ aśravaṇam eva syāt na ca ahaṅkārika tvāt vyāpakasya bherī ādi deśe vṛttiḥ ghaṭate iti mantavyam pūrvam eva ahaṅkārika tva pratiṣedhāt na ca śrotreṇa bherī ādi deśa grahaṇam sambhavati iti tad avacchedena śabdasya grahaṇa abhāva prasaṅgaḥ

atha prasiddha samayasya śabda śravaṇāt āśraya anumāne sati ayam bherī śabdaḥ iti avacchedena pratibhāsate iti ced āyātaḥ tarhi madīyam panthānam katham śabda śravaṇāt santāna dvāreṇa āśraya anumitau iha bheryām śabdaḥ iti pratibhāsā abhyupagamāt tat evam āśrayāt anyatra upalabhyamāna tvāt na sparśavat viśeṣa guṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti siddham

tathā ekasmin eva vādye vādyamāne bahūnām ṣaḍja ādīnām upalambhāt na tad guṇa tvam tathā hi yadi ātodya guṇaḥ syāt śabdaḥ katham bahūnām śabdānām samāna indriya grāhyāṇām avibhuni dravye sadbhāvaḥ syāt atha citra rūpavat etat syāt na tatra eka rūpasya ārambhāt tathā hi nānā rūpāṇi ekam kāryam ārabhantaḥ iti uktam na ca evam nānā śabdaiḥ ekaḥ śabdaḥ ārabhyamāṇaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti na ca atra citra rūpavat ekasmin kāle citra śabda pratibhāsaḥ sambhavati krameṇa pratibhāsanāt tathā rūpa ādi vat citra utpāde abhyupagate yugapad upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ na ca krameṇa abhivyaktiḥ sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt iti ukta tvāt saṃyogāt ca krameṇa utpatti abhyupagame śabdasya na sparśavat viśeṣa guṇa tvam tad vaidharmyāt iti alam ati vistareṇa

nanu ca atra hetu upanyāsa anantaram pratijñopanya āsāt avayava vyatyaye kim prayojanam śāstre na ayam niyamaḥ iti upadarśanam eva tathā hi avayava viparyāsa vacanam aprāpta kālam nāma nigraha sthānam jalpaḥ eva na śāstre iti upadarśayati udāharaṇa ādi a vayava lābha artham iti anye tat ca īṣadvyatyayam vinā api artha kathanāt eva tasya anekadhā abhyupagāt

nanu ekena eva pramāṇena arthasya paricchedāt ekasmin arthe aneka hetu upanyāsaḥ vyarthaḥ eva yat vā pramāṇa antara upanyāsāni atha anupapattyā jñāyate na prāktanasya artha paricchede sāmarthyam apūrva artha paricchedaka tvam vā adhigata arthasya anuvādaka tvāt tathā hi adhigate api arthe pramāṇa antara pravṛttau aviśrāma prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt anyaḥ anya vyāvṛtta viṣaya tvāt pramāṇānām aneka hetu upanyāsaḥ parijñānāya eva na etat evam sarvatra vyavasthā anabhyupagamāt tathā hi ekasmin eva arthe aneka upāya darśanam śāstre na doṣāya tasya hi para anugrāhaka tvāt tathā vibhinna abhiprāyāḥ pratipādyāḥ iti aneka hetu upanyāsāt kaścid kenacid alpa prayāsena eva pratipadyate iti na ca atra kasyacid aprāmāṇyam sarveṣām api pramājanaka tvāt

na ca pramāṇa paramparā prasaṅgaḥ paricchinne api arthe avaśyam pramāṇa antara upanyāsa anabhyupagamāt tathā hi yatra pramāṇa antara sadbhāvaḥ tatra eva tad apekṣā na tad abhāve api iti yathā śabdena avagate anumānena api bubhutsite anumānena api adhigate pratyakṣeṇa iti tathā pratyakṣe api ekena karaṇena upalabdhe punar karaṇa antareṇa iti tathā ekasmin sukha sādhane arthe aneka pramāṇa pravṛttau sukha atiśayaḥ ca prayojanam iti

na ca anadhigata artha gantṛ tvam pramāṇa sāmānya lakṣaṇam pratyabhijñā na ādeḥ aprāmāṇya prasaṅgāt tathā hi adhigataḥ eva arthe pratyabhijñānam anumānañca pravartate iti vakṣyāmaḥ atha eka deśa vṛtti viśeṣa guṇa tvāt kṣaṇika viśeṣa guṇa tvāt ca sukha ādi vat ātma guṇaḥ bhaviṣyati iti āha *na bāhya indriya pratyakṣa tvāt* ityādi

atha prāktana anumānasya nirduṣṭa tāyām anumāna antarasya anutthānam eva na ātma guṇa tve sati śabdasya śrotreṇa aparicchedāt āśraya asiddha tvam anumānayoḥ tathā hi śrotram ātmā na bhavati akartṛ tvāt na api antaḥkaraṇam eva śrotram tasya hi bahis karaṇa tvāt abhyupagame vā yāvat sukha ādi upalabdhiḥ tāvat śabda upalabdhyā bhavitavyam iti bādhiryam na syāt

atha śabda grahaṇam antaḥkaraṇasya uparata vyāpārāt evam tarhi sukha ādīnām agrahaṇam syāt na ca karaṇam cakṣuḥ ādi ekatā uparata vyāpāram anyatra artha prakāśakam dṛṣṭam kṣiti āt ivāyu paryantañca śrotram na bhavati eva ghrāṇa ādi sampādane sāmarthya avadhāraṇāt dikkālayoḥ ca śrotra rūpa tā na sambhavati eva bhautika tvāt bāhya indriyāṇām pāriśeṣyāt anyat śrotram tena ca ātma guṇasya śabdasya agrahaṇam eva syāt iti āśraya asiddha tvam gṛhyate ca bāhya indriyeṇa śabdaḥ tasmāt ātma guṇaḥ na bhavati iti tathā ca śabdaḥ na ātma guṇaḥ bāhya indriya pratyakṣa tvāt yaḥ yaḥ bāhya indriya pratyakṣaḥ sa saḥ ātma guṇaḥ na bhavati yathā rūpa ādiḥ tathā ca ayam bāhya indriya pratyakṣaḥ tasmāt ātma guṇaḥ na bhavati iti vaidharmyeṇa tu sukha ādayaḥ tatas ca na ātma guṇaḥ śabdaḥ ātma antara grāhya tvāt rūpa ādi vat ātma guṇāḥ ca ātma antara grāhyāḥ na bhavanti yathā sukha ādayaḥ

nanu śabdasya ātma antara grāhya tvam vyakti apekṣayā na sambhavati eva tathā hi yā śabda vyaktiḥ ekasmin śrotre samaveta upajātāḥ na sā anyatra iti jāti apekṣayā tu sukha ādeḥ api ātma antara grāhya tvāt iti aneka antika tvam na etat evam yena ātmanā kriyate śabdaḥ tasmāt anyena api gṛhyate na ca evam sukha ādiḥ iti tathā hi tīvratara abhighātāt ekā śabda vyaktiḥ mahāntam ākāśa deśam vyāpya upajāyate iti anekaiḥ upalabhyate eva na ca avyāpya vṛtti tvena virodhaḥ sva āśraya avyāpaka tvāt na ca santāna abhyupagamaḥ virudhyate tīvratara ādi bheda bhinnānām śabdānām utpatti abhyupagamāt tathā hi asti tīvratara abhighātāt ekā śabda vyaktiḥ mahāntam ākāśa deśam kalpitam vyāpya upajāyate tatas tīvrataraḥ ityādi krameṇa anubhavāt tathā vyakti apekṣāyām ātma antara grāhya tvam na sambhavati iti bruvataḥ santāna abhyupagamāt apasiddhānta prasaṅgaḥ iti

na ca itas api ātma guṇaḥ śabdaḥ ātmani asamaveta tvāt rūpa ādi vat ye ca ātma guṇāḥ te tatra eva samavetāḥ sukha ādayaḥ iti atha ātmani asamaveta tvam sādhyāt na viśiṣyate iti āha *ahaṅkāreṇa vibhakta grahaṇāt ca* iti tathā hi na ātmani samavetaḥ śabdaḥ ahaṅkāreṇa vibhakta grahaṇāt rūpa ādi vat te ca ātma nimittam vinā na pravartante iti prayoga darśanāt ātma upakāri tvam nimittam iti kalpyate

atha diś kāla manasām guṇaḥ bhaviṣyati iti tad niṣedha artham āha *śrotra grāhya tva at* ityādi tathā ca śabdaḥ na diś kāla manasām guṇaḥ śrotra grāhya tvāt yat yat śotra grāhyam tat tat diś kāla manasām guṇaḥ na bhavati yathā śabda tva ādi tathā ca śabdaḥ śrotra grāhyaḥ tasmāt diś kāla manasām guṇaḥ na bhaviṣyati iti ye tu tad guṇāḥ te tu śrotra grāhyāḥ na bhavanti yathā saṃkhyā ādayaḥ iti tathā ca diś kāla manaḥ vyatiriktasya śrotrasya pratipādanāt tad tad guṇa tve tena grahaṇa abhāva prasaṅgaḥ tathā hi diś kālābhyām na sambaddham iti tad samavetasya śabdasya agrahaṇam

manasaḥ ca aṇu parimāṇa tvāt tad guṇa tve gambhīra dhvaneḥ aśravaṇa prasaṅgaḥ tad abhāve ca kvacid pradeśe śabdasya anutpattiḥ syāt na ca kāryeṇa eva kāraṇasya tatra sadbhāvaḥ kāryasya anyathā api bhāvāt na api vibhu dravya viśeṣa guṇānām sukha ādīnām iva paramāṇu viśeṣa guṇānām indriyeṇa upalambhaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ paramāṇu parimāṇañca manaḥ tat evam diś kāla manaḥ guṇa tve śabdasya śrotra grāhya tvam na syāt iti bādha kañca idam *vaiśeṣika guṇa bhāvāt ca* iti tathā viśeṣa guṇaḥ eva vaiśeṣikaḥ tasya bhāvāt iti tathā hi diś kāla manasām pakṣīkaraṇe vaiśeṣika guṇa abhāvaḥ asiddhaḥ syāt asya ca viśeṣa guṇa tvāt iti vyatireka mukhena anyā hetuḥ vyākhyāyate diś kāla manasām vaiśeṣika guṇa abhāvaḥ iti ukte śabdaḥ tu viśeṣa guṇaḥ iti hetuḥ labhyate eva tathā ca śabdaḥ diś kāla manasām guṇaḥ na bhavati viśeṣa guṇa tvāt yaḥ yaḥ viśeṣa guṇaḥ sa sa diś kāla manasām guṇaḥ na bhavati yathā rūpa ādiḥ tathā ca ayam viśeṣa guṇaḥ tasmāt na diś kāla manasām guṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti

anye tu na diś kāla manasām guṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti sādhye vaiśeṣika guṇa abhāvaḥ sādhyāt na viśiṣyate iti manyamānāḥ hetu antaram bruvate tathā hi na diś kāla manasām guṇaḥ śabdaḥ guṇa tvena guṇinaḥ liṅga tvāt yaḥ yaḥ guṇa tvena guṇinaḥ liṅgaḥ sa sa diś kāla manasām guṇaḥ na bhavati yathā sukha ādayaḥ tathā ca ayam śabdaḥ guṇa tvena guṇinaḥ liṅgaḥ tasmāt tad guṇaḥ na bhavati iti ye tu dikkālayoḥ liṅgam na te guṇa tvena guṇinaḥ liṅgam yathā pūrva apara ādi pratyayāḥ yugapad ādi pratyayāḥ ca iti te hi tad viśiṣṭa tvāt tayoḥ liṅgam guṇa tvena ca ātmanaḥ tathā yugapad a ādi śabdāḥ pūrva apara ādi śabdāḥ ca yadi api tad viśiṣṭha tvāt tayoḥ liṅgam tathā api guṇa tvena āśraya antara anumāpakāḥ iti alam ati vistareṇa

manaḥ guṇa tve ca uktam eva dūṣaṇam iti pariśeṣāt guṇaḥ bhūtvā ākāśasya adhigame paricchede kartavye liṅgam iti pariśeṣaḥ tu prasakta pratiṣedhe anyatra aprasaṅgāt tat evam sādhanam vyatireka avyabhicāreṇa eva viṣaya vyavasthāpanāya alam tathā hi śabdaḥ pṛthivī udaka jvalana pavana dikkāla ātma manaḥ vyatirikta dravya āśrayaḥ tad vṛtti bādhaka pramāṇa sadbhāve sati guṇa tvāt yaḥ tu tad vyatirikta āśrayaḥ na bhavati na ca asau tad vṛtti bādhaka pramāṇa sadbhāve sati guṇaḥ yathā rūpa ādiḥ na ca tathā śabdaḥ tasmāt tad vyatirikta dravya āśrayaḥ śabdaḥ iti siddham ākāśam tat kim ekam uta anekam iti āha *śabda liṅga aviśeṣāt eka tvam siddham* śabdaḥ hi liṅgam ākāśasya aviśiṣṭa tayā nānātva apratipādakam iti

nanu asiddham aviśiṣṭa tvam vicitra tvāt śabdānām tathā hi kārya vaicitryam kāraṇa vaicitryam vinā na syāt iti tīvra ādi bheda bhinnānām śabdānām vicitreṇa eva kāraṇena bhavitavyam iti nānātva siddhiḥ tad āśrayasya yadi ca kāraṇa vaicitryam vinā api kārya vaicitryam iṣyeta paramāṇūnām api cāturvidhyam na syāt tatra api ekasmāt eva kāraṇāt vicitram kṣiti ādi kāryam bhaviṣyati iti atha tatra kārya vaicitryeṇa kāraṇa vaicitrya anumānam iti ced tad śabda vaicitrye api samānam iti alam

tat asat sahakāri vaicitryeṇa api śabda vaicitrya upalabdheḥ na tad āśrayasya nānātvam tathā ca tīvratamāt abhighātāt tīvratamaḥ śabdaḥ mandāt ca mandaḥ ityādi na ca kṣiti ādau api evam astu iti vācyam tatra hi caturvidham kāryam itaretara vyāvṛttāt upādānāt utpadyamānam dṛṣṭam iti tad jātīyāḥ paramāṇavaḥ caturvidhāḥ eva pratīyante kārya vaicitryantu sāmagrī vaicitryāt eva tatra kvacid kāraṇa bhedaḥ kvacid karma bhedaḥ anyasya ca iti yathāsambhavam grāhyam atra kāraṇa bhedena api śabda vaicitrya upapatteḥ na samavāyi kāraṇāt bhedaḥ iti satyam etat śabda liṅga aviśiṣṭa tvāt nānātva apratipādanakam iti

atha nānātva aprasiddhau api eka tvam pramāṇam vinā na sidhyati iti abhidheyam pramāṇam iti ced na dravya tvāt eva saṃkhyā asadbhāva siddhau nānātve pramāṇa abhāvāt eka tvam eva sidhyati iti tathā saṃkhyā anantaram parimāṇam avasara prāptam parityajya krama atikrameṇa pṛthaktva nirūpaṇam kasmāt iti āha *tad anu vidhānāt* tena ekatvena anuvidhānam sāhacaryam yatra hi ekatvam tatra avaśyam eka pṛthaktvam iti na tu evam parimāṇe api tad anuvidhānam asti eva tathā hi yatra ekatvam tatra avaśyam eka pṛthaktvam bhavati iti viśeṣa anuvidhānam na ca evam yatra ekatvam tatra avaśyam aṇu tvam sthūla tvam vā iti viśeṣa anuvidhānam asti iti pūrvam pṛthaktvam nirūpyate

tathā parama mahat parimāṇam ākāśe kutas pramāṇāt iti a āha *vibhava vacana at* iti vibhavān mahān ākāśaḥ tathā ca ātmā tad abhāvāt aṇu manaḥ iti sūtre darśayati vibhavāt kāraṇāt mahān ākāśaḥ iti sāmānya śabdena asya arthāt parama mahat tvam vivakṣitam tathā hi vibhunaḥ dravyasya parama mahat tvam siddham ātma ādau iti iha api tathā sādhyate ākāśam parama mahad vibhu tvāt ātma vat iti sarveṣāñca avibhūnām pakṣīkaraṇe kevala vyatireka anumānam ākāśa ādīnām ātma paryantānām parama mahat tvam vibhu tvāt iti ukte yeṣāntu parama mahat tvam na asti na teṣām vibhu tvam iti vyatirekaḥ

atha kim idam vibhu tvam sarvaiḥ bhūtaiḥ saṃyogaḥ iti anye tu sarvatra upajātānām śabdānām ākāśe samavāyaḥ tad sadbhāve apūrṇa udreka tā vibhu tvam iti manyante yat vā aṇu parimāṇān adhikaraṇa tve sati nitya dravya tvāt parama mahat tvam iti sādhyate tathā *śabda kāraṇa vacanāt saṃyoga vibhāgau iti* saṃyogāt vibhāgāt śabdāt ca śabda niṣpattiḥ iti sūtram darśayati tathā hi saṃyoga vibhāgau śabda utpatteḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam iti abhidhānāt ākāśe samavāyaḥ labhyate anyathā hi pratyāsatteḥ abhāvāt asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam na syāt na ca anyat asamavāyi kāraṇam asti iti yatas evam guṇavat ākāśam atas guṇavat tvāt anāśrita tvāt ca dravyam paramāṇu vat iti tathā hi paramāṇoḥ guṇavat tvam anāśrita tvañca dṛṣṭam dravya tvañca asti adravye ca etat na sambhavati iti

atha kim ākāśam nityam uta anityam iti āha *samāna asamāna jātīya kāraṇā bhāvāt ca nityam* tathā hi na samāna jātīyam samavāyi kāraṇam ākāśasya eka tvāt na api asamāna jātīyam asamavāyi kāraṇam asti samāna jātīya abhāvena tad saṃyogasya api abhāvāt na ca samavāyi asamavāyi kāraṇam vinā vastu bhūtasya kāryasya utpattiḥ sambhavati iti akārya tvāt nitya tvam siddham ākāśasya atas ca *sarva prāṇinām śabda upalabdhau nimittam* kāraṇam ākāśasya eka tve api aneka artha kriyā kāri tvam darśayati na ca sattā mātreṇa ākāśam śabda upalabdheḥ kāraṇam sarvatra sarva prāṇinām aviśeṣeṇa śabda upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ sarva śabdānām ākāśe samavāya aviśeṣāt atas āha *śrotra bhāvena* śrotra tvena iti

kim tat śrotram iti āha *śrotram punar śravaṇa vivara saṃjakaḥ nabhaḥ deśaḥ* iti śrūyate anena iti śravaṇam tat ca tad vivarañcā iti tathā uktam śravaṇa vivaram iti saṃjñā yasya nabhaḥ deśasya asau śravaṇa vivara saṃjñakaḥ karṇa śaṣkulī saṃyoga upalakṣitaḥ ākāśaḥ iti tathā *śabda nimitta upabhoga prāpaka dharma adharma upanibaddhaḥ* iti śabdaḥ nimittam yasya asau tathā uktaḥ sa ca asau upabhogaḥ ca tam prāpyate iti tad prāpakaḥ ca tau dharma adhamau tābhyām upanibaddhaḥ saha kṛtaḥ iti

nanu evam api karṇa śaṣkulī a ākāśa saṃyoga upalakṣita viśiṣṭa adṛṣṭa upagṛhītaḥ nabhaḥ deśaḥ tasmāt artha antaram na bhavati iti sarva śabda upalabdhiḥ syāt na etat evam karṇa śaṣkulī saṃyoga upalakṣitasya nabhasaḥ śrotra tve tasya api avyāpya vṛtti tayā na sarveṣām grahaṇam yadi api karṇa śaṣkulī saṃyoga eka artha samavāyi tvāt śabdānām tathā api viśiṣṭa pratyāsatteḥ abhāvāt agrahaṇam yaḥ hi karṇa śaṣkulī saṃyogasya sānnidhya bhāj śabdaḥ saḥ eva upalabhyate na ca evam sarva śabdāḥ teṣām avyāpya vṛtti tvāt

na ca karṇa śaṣkulī saṃyoga avaruddha nabhaḥ deśa vyatirikta deśe sarveṣām utpāda nāda grahaṇam eva iti vācyam śabda upalambhāni atha anupapattyā santāna nyāyena śrotra deśam āgatasya pratipādyamāna tvāt iti alam atha kasmāt badhirāṇām karṇa śaṣkulī saṃyoga avaruddha nabhaḥ deśa sadbhāve api śabda agrahaṇam saha kārya bhāvāt iti āha *tasya ca nitya tve sati upabhoga nibandhakaḥ* ityādi śabda upalabdhau sahakāriṇaḥ adṛṣṭasya abhāvāt śabda upalabdhiḥ na bhavati iti bādhiryam upapadyate iti

idānīm uddeśavataḥ kālasya lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham *kālaḥ parāpara vyatikara yaugapadya ayaugapadi acira kṣipra pratyaya liṅgaḥ* ityādi prakaraṇam atra ca kāla sadbhāva pratipādakam eva liṅga m itarasmāt bhedakam bhavati iti manyamānaḥ lakṣaṇa antaram na avocat tathā hi kālaḥ itarasmāt bhidyate parāpara vyatikara yaugapadya ayaugapadi acira kṣipra pratyaya liṅga tvāt yaḥ tu na bhidyate na ca asau ukta liṅgaḥ yathā kṣiti ādiḥ na ca tathā kālaḥ tasmāt bhidyate iti vyavahāraḥ vā sādhyate vivāda gocaratā āpannam dravyam kālaḥ iti vyavahartavyam parāpara vyatikara ādi liṅga tvāt iti

atha pratibandha anupalabdheḥ katham etāni kāla sadbhāve liṅgam bhavanti viśiṣṭa kārya tayā viśiṣṭam kāryam viśiṣṭāt kāraṇāt utpadyamānam dṛṣṭam parāpara vyatikara yaugapadyāyaga padi acira kṣipra pratyayāḥ ca viśiṣṭam kāryam iti viśiṣṭa kāraṇa pūrvaka tvam sādhyate tathā ca para aparayoḥ dikkṛtayoḥ vyatikaraḥ viparyayaḥ gṛhyate yatra hi diś vivakṣayā utpannam paratvam tatra eva aparatvam yatra eva aparatvam tatra eva paratvam utpadyamānam dṛṣṭam iti artha antarañca vyavahartṛ nimittāt vyatirekaḥ sambhavati iti tathā ca adhama jātīye diś vivakṣayā parasmin sthavira piṇḍe balī palita ādi sānnidhyam apekṣamāṇasya utkṛṣṭa jātīyam yuvānam avadhim kṛtvā itarasmāt paraḥ viprakṛṣṭaḥ ayam iti buddhiḥ bhavati tām apekṣya pareṇa kāla pradeśena yogāt paratvam iti sthavirañca avadhim kṛtvā utkṛṣṭa jātīye yūni para digbhāga vyavasthite api rūḍha śmaśru kārkaśyam apekṣyamānasya sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tām apekṣya apareṇa kāla pradeśena yogāt aparatvasya utpattiḥ iti

atra diś sampādita para tva vailakṣaṇyāt na tat eva nimittam na api nikṛṣṭa jātīya tayā jāti kṛtam paratvam sambhavati na ca kṣiti ādeḥ anyatamam nimittam sāmarthya an avadhāraṇāt yaḥ tu śiṣyate sa kālaḥ iti nanu ekasmin eva dine pākaja utpatti nyāyena piṇḍayoḥ samutpādāt katham paratva aparatvam utpatteḥ prabhṛti āditya parivartana apekṣayā tathā hi janmanaḥ prabhṛti ekasya āditya parivartanāni bhūyāṃsi iti paratvam anyasya ca alpīyāṃsi iti aparatvam

atha āditya parivartanam eva astu kim kālena iti ced na yugapad ādi pratyaya anumeya tvāt na ca āditya parivartanāt eva yugapad ādi pratyayāḥ sambhavanti iti ekasmin eva āditya parivartane sarveṣām anutpādāt vyapadeśa abhāvāt ca tathā hi yugapad kālaḥ iti vyapadeśaḥ na yugapad a āditya parivartanam iti na ca kriyā eva kālaḥ iti vācyam yugapad a ādi pratyaya abhāva prasaṅgāt tathā hi kriyāyāḥ kriyā rūpa tayā viśeṣa abhyupagamāt iti pratyaya abhāvaḥ parāpara vyatikara abhāvaḥ ca na ca kriyā kālaḥ iti pratīyate yadi ca kartṛ karma vyatiriktā viśiṣṭa pratyaya sampādikā kriyā syāt saṃjñā bheda mātram avyatireke tu viśiṣṭa pratyaya abhāvaḥ eva iti alam vistareṇa

tathā yugapad bhāvaḥ yaugapadyam bahūnām kartṝṇām kārya karaṇe bahūnām kāryāṇām ātma lābhaḥ iti tathā hi yugapad ete kurvanti iti kartṛ ālambanam jñānam yugapad etāni kṛtāni iti kārya ālamba nañca dṛṣṭam na ca atra kartṛ mātram kārya mātrañca ālambana mati prasaṅgāt tathā hi yatra krameṇa kāryam tatra api kartṛ karmaṇoḥ sadbhāvāt syāt etat vijñānam na ca katarasmāt viśiṣṭam kartāram kāryam vā ālambya utpadyate vijñānam etat iti jñāyate yat ca tad viśeṣaṇam kṣiti ādi vilakṣaṇam sa kālaḥ iti na yaugapadya ayaugapadya kramaḥ iti ayugapad ete kurvanti iti kartṛ ālambanam jñānam ayugapad etāni kṛtāni iti kārya ālambanam jñānam atra api viśiṣṭayoḥ kartṛ karmaṇoḥ ālambana tvāt kṣiti ādi vilakṣaṇam nimittam vācyam iti kāla siddhiḥ

tathā ekaḥ eva kartā kiñcid kāryam cireṇa karoti vyāsaṅgāt anarthi tvāt vā kiñcid kṣipram tad arthi tayā tatra cireṇa kṛtam kṣipram kṛtam iti pratyayaḥ vilakṣaṇa tvāt vilakṣaṇam kāraṇam ākṣipati iti na ca kāryam eva nimittam tasya ubhayatra samāna tvāt na api kartā eva tasya api sādhāraṇa tvāt na ca nirnimittam kadācid bhavati iti atas vilakṣaṇena nimittena bhavitavyam iti atas āha *teṣām* yugapad a ādi pratyayānām *viṣayeṣu* kartṛṣu kāryeṣu kiṃviśiṣṭānām *pūrva pratyaya vilakṣaṇānām* pūrva pratyayāḥ kartṛ kāryeṣu tad pratyayāḥ tad vilakṣaṇānām utpattau anyasya kṣiti ādi rūpasya nimittasya asambhavāt yad nimittam sa kālaḥ iti

atha kālasya eka rūpa tayā vilakṣaṇa pratyayānām abhāva prasaṅgaḥ eva atha kriyā vailakṣaṇyāt vilakṣaṇaḥ kālaḥ tad vaiśiṣṭyāt ca pratyaya vaiśiṣṭyam iti ced evam tarhi duruttaram itaretara āśraya tvam tathā hi kriyāyāḥ kriyā rūpa tayā viśeṣa abhāvāt katham kāla viśeṣaka tvam atha yugapad kriyā viśeṣitaḥ yugapad kālaḥ tad viśeṣitā ca yugapad kriyā iti itaretara āśraya tvam eva

na etat evam nirvikalpikāyām saṃvidi paraspara vyāvṛtta kriyā svarūpa avagame sati tad viśiṣṭaḥ kālaḥ tasmāt ca yugapad a ādi pratyayāḥ iti upagamāt nirvikalpakāt ca sa vikalpa utpattiḥ iṣyate yat vā sva rūpeṇa eva kriyāyāḥ viśiṣṭa tvam tad sahakārī kālaḥ yugapad ādi pratyaya sampādakaḥ iti na ca atra viśeṣaṇam kālaḥ kim tarhi viśiṣṭa kārya utpattau viśiṣṭena nimittena bhavitavyam iti anye tu viśeṣaṇa tvena gṛhītasya vyāpāraḥ iti anumāna ādeḥ vyāpāra anupalabdheḥ pramāṇañca vinā asambhavāt iti kālasya pratyakṣatām bruvate tathā hi viśeṣya jñānāni atha anupapattyā viśeṣaṇe jñānam kalpyate tat ca pramāṇa antara vyāpāra anupalabdheḥ pratyakṣam eva

nanu sarveṣām eva kārakāṇām viśeṣya jñāna utpattau vyāpāra viśeṣe api ekam eva viśeṣaṇam na anyat iti viśeṣa hetuḥ na asti iti na sva ālambana jñāna sahitasya viśeṣya jñāna utpattau ekasya eva vyāpārāt ayam eva anurāgaḥ sva anurakta pratyaya jana kañca viśeṣaṇam na ākāra arpakam na api sva śabda abhilapya jñāna janakam asambhavāt na hi sva ākāra arpaka tvam viśeṣaṇasya ākāra vāda pratiṣedhāt na api viśeṣaṇa śabda abhilapyam viśeṣye jñānam sambhavati puruṣe daṇḍaḥ iti jñāna anutpatteḥ atha daṇḍasya atiśaya ādhāyaka tva anupapatteḥ viśeṣaṇa tva abhāvaḥ iti ced na viśiṣṭa jñāna janaka tvena asya eva atiśaya tvāt tad jñānañca atiśayaḥ tad sadbhāve kārya sadbhāvāt

atha viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ vibhinna jñāna ālambana tve na pramāṇam asti iti ced tathā hi viśeṣya jñānam utpatteḥ pūrvam viśeṣaṇasya na tad rūpa tām darśayati na krameṇa pramāṇam iti na ca vibhinna jñāna ālambana tvam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvena vyāptam na api viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ krameṇa iti ubhayathā api vyabhicārāt tathā hi liṅga liṅginoḥ vibhinna jñāna ālambana tve api na viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa bhāvaḥ iti vyabhicāraḥ na ca krame sādhye viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ hetuḥ sādhāraṇa tvāt tasya sa pakṣa vipakṣābhyām vyāvṛtteḥ iti tathā api bhinna jñāna ālambana tve viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ anumeya pratipatteḥ pratyaya lakṣaṇa tvam syāt tathā hi anumānāt gṛhītam viśeṣaṇam indriya artha sannikarṣeṇa saha vyāpārāt pratyakṣa sāmagryām antarbhūtam iti tad janitā pratipattiḥ agnimān eṣa deśaḥ iti pratyakṣaphalā syāt

na ca agneḥ nirādhārasya pūrvam anumānam sambhavati tathā agniḥ api anumīyamānaḥ agni tva viśiṣṭaḥ pratīyate iti pūrvam agni tva grahaṇam tatra api agniḥ viśeṣaṇam iti anyonya āśraya tvam atha agnau samavāyaḥ agni tvasya viśleṣaṇam tatra api agni tvam agniḥ vā viśeṣaṇam iti tat eva dūṣaṇam aviśiṣṭasya sarvatra sadbhāvāt viśeṣaka tva anupapattiḥ atha parvataḥ agneḥ viśeṣaṇam tatra api parvata tvam tatra ca samavāyaḥ viśeṣaṇam iti pūrvavat dūṣaṇam atha agni saṃyogaḥ parvatasya agneḥ ca viśeṣaṇam tasya api saṃyoginau tayoḥ api saṃyogaḥ iti pūrva doṣa prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt anumānam pramāṇīkurvatā viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya ālambanam ekam vijñānam abhyupeyam ekañca dhūma viśiṣṭasya parvatasya upalambhāt agni viśiṣṭe pratipattiḥ bhavati

atha eka jñāna ālambanayoḥ aṅgulyoḥ ivā eka jñāna ālambana pakṣe katham viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ pradhāna upasarjana bhāvena saḥ eva kasmāt iti ced vibhinna jñāna ālambana tve api samānam tathā hi idam viśeṣaṇam idam viśeṣyam iti vibhinna jñāna ālambana tva aviśeṣe katham niyamaḥ pradhāna upasarjana bhāvāt iti ced iṣṭam tad eka jñāna ālambana tve api iti doṣa abhāvāt artha ekaḥ cāryam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ na dharma padārtha antargataḥ tad tat vyatireka pratiṣedhāt na api dravya ādi padārtha antargataḥ ṣaṭsu upalambhāt iti na hi dravya ādīnām anyatamaḥ ṣaṭsu upalabhyate iti

atha viśiṣṭa pratyaya hetuḥ adṛṣṭaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ iti ced tasya ca eka tāyām idam viśeṣaṇam idam viśeṣyam iti vyavasthā anupapattiḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya tvasya eka tvāt iti tathā hi yat eva viśeṣaṇa tvam tat eva viśeṣya tvam iti ekasya puruṣasya ekasmin eva kāle tat eva viśeṣaṇam viśeṣyañca iti syāt na ca etat asti tasmāt viśiṣṭa adṛṣṭaḥ na viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ atha na ekaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya pratiniyataḥ tathā api viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ bhāvaḥ na syāt

atas yathāsambhavam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ grāhyaḥ kvacid saṃyogaḥ kvacid samavāyaḥ iti tathā ca abhāve api viśeṣa cakṣuḥ ādi sambandhaḥ eva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ tena satā ca viśiṣṭa pratyaya jananāt na ca adṛṣṭasya atra kāraṇa tvam niṣidhyate sakala kāryeṣu sādhāraṇa tvāt na api adṛṣṭaḥ dṛṣṭa kāraṇam pratyācaṣṭe śarīra ādeḥ api abhāva prasaṅgāt tathā hi sukha ādi sampādakaḥ adṛṣṭaḥ eva astu alam śarīra ādi parikalpanayā iti atha adṛṣṭa sadbhāve api śarīra ādayaḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt abhyupagamyante tarhi viśeṣya cakṣuḥ ādi sambandhaḥ eva dṛṣṭa tvāt viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ

atha viśeṣaṇe tasya āvṛtteḥ katham tat bhāvaḥ iti ced na adṛṣṭvat vyāpāra apekṣayā tad avṛtti tvāt atha eka jñāna ālambana tve surabhi dravyam iti vibhinna indriya grāhyayoḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ na syāt na hi vibhinna indriyābhyām ekam vijñānam sampādyam dṛṣṭam iti na viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ vibhinna jñāna ālambana tve bādhaka upapatteḥ anusandhāna jñānam etat tathā hi ghrāṇena gandham upalabhya cakṣuṣā sparśanena vā dravyam paścāt manasā anusaṃdhatte surabhi dravyam iti na ca sarvam viśeṣya jñānam anusandhāna jñānam iti vācyam tatra hi bādhaka anupapatteḥ tathā viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ vibhinna jñāna ālamba natāyām eka daṇḍinam aham adrākṣam iti smaraṇam na syāt tasya hi anubhava rūpa tvāt

atha puruṣa pratyaya sāmānā adhikaraṇyāt daṇḍinam ānayaḥ ityādi prayogeṣu puruṣasya eka kriyā sambandhāt tad ālambanam eva viśeṣya jñānam iti ced na puruṣasya viśeṣya tayā prādhānyāt kriyā sambandhaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇī añca upapadyate eva iti alam ati vistareṇa anye tu eka jñāna ālambana tve viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ na syāt tayoḥ karaṇa karma rūpa tvāt iti manyante tathā hi viśiṣyate anena iti viśeṣaṇam karaṇam viśeṣyate iti viśeṣyam karma tat ca eka jñāna ālamba natāyām na syāt ubhayoḥ karma tvāt iti na api ajñāta vyāpāre sahakāri tva aviśeṣāt cakṣuḥ ādibhyaḥ viśeṣaḥ syāt iti tat jñānam kalpyate yadi ca daṇḍa tva viśiṣṭaḥ daṇḍaḥ puruṣasya viśeṣaṇam iṣyeta tasya api anyat iti anavasthā daṇḍaḥ ced daṇḍa tvasya viśeṣaṇam itaretara āśraya tvañca syāt iti viśeṣya jñāna abhāva prasaṅgaḥ asti ca viśeṣya jñānam iti tat anyathā anupapattyā viśeṣaṇa jñāna mātram jñāyate

yat ca idam viśeṣya jñānam utpatteḥ pūrvam viśeṣaṇasya na tat rūpa tām darśayati iti uktam tatra kā iyam viśeṣaṇa rūpa tā iti vicāryam na hi daṇḍe daṇḍa tva ādi vat viśeṣaṇa rūpa tā pratibhāti atha sva anurakta pratyaya janaka tvam viśeṣaṇa tvam tat ca yadi sva ālambana jñāna sahitasya viśeṣya jñāna janaka tvam abhyupagama vyāghātaḥ na ca eka vijñāna ālambana tve anurāga artham paśyāmaḥ tad śabda abhilapya tva ādeḥ pratiṣedhāt na api kramaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva hetuḥ anabhyupagamāt viśeṣyajñānantu viśeṣaṇa jñānam darśayati eva anyathā hi tad viśiṣṭa tva ayogāt yat ca idam anumānāt apratipatteḥ pratyakṣa phalaka tvam iti tat ca asat bādhaka sadbhāvena atra eka jñāna ālambana tva abhyupagamāt na ca evam sarvatra bādhakam asti iti

anye tu dhūma upalambha anantaram agni anumāne sati agni mānayam parvataḥ iti jñānam pratyakṣam eva iti bruvate anyathā hi ayam iti aparokṣata anirdeśaḥ na syāt atra ca sādhya dharma viśiṣṭa dharmiṇaḥ sādhya tve katham etat sādhanam syāt iti vācyam yat ca idam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ kim ekaḥ anekaḥ vā iti tatra ekatva abhyupagame api na viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ avyavasthā nimitta antarasya asādhāraṇasya sadbhāvāt tathā hi viśeṣaṇam sva anurakta pratyaya utpādaka tvena iti uktam viśeṣyantu viśeṣya jñāna viṣaya tvena viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ tu param viśeṣya jñāna utpattau sahakārī na punar vyavasthā kāraṇam iti

na ca saṃyoga samavāyau eva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ tayoḥ samavāye abhāve ca abhāvāt atra api viśeṣya indriya sambandhaḥ asti iti ced na tasya viśeṣaṇa āvṛtti tvāt na api adṛṣṭa vat vyāpāra apekṣayā tad vṛtti tvam saṃyoga samavāyayoḥ anyatra anupalabdheḥ tathā hi saṃyoga samavāyayoḥ yadi vyāpāra apekṣayā viśeṣaṇa vṛtti tvam iṣyeta viśeṣya sambandham vinā abhāva samavāyayoḥ grahaṇam syāt yatra hi tayoḥ vṛttiḥ tatra eva grahaṇa janaka tvā upalabdheḥ adṛṣṭasya tu ātma samavetasya api sakala kārya utpattau sādhāraṇa tvāt saṃyoga ādi sadbhāve tad abhāve ca kevalasya vyāpāraḥ abhyupagamyate eva sa ca ubhayatra vyāpāra apekṣayā sambaddhaḥ iva sambaddhaḥ na paramārthataḥ

na ca upacaritasya indriya asahakāri tvam aparokṣa jñānasya anyathā sambhavena tad abhāva siddheḥ dṛṣṭañca śrotra anya upacaritasya api śabda jñāna sahakāri tvam iti yat ca idam surabhi dravyam ityādi anusandhāna jñānam iti uktam tat asat anyatra api evam prasaṅgāt na ca atra vibhinna jñāna ālambana tve kiñcid bādhakam asti iti tat eva abhyupeyam

na api daṇḍinam aham adrākṣam iti smaraṇa anupapattiḥ viśeṣaṇa jñāna janita saṃskārasya viśeṣya jñāna sahakāriṇaḥ saṃskāra ārambheṇa api tad bhāvāt yat ca idam eka jñāna ālambana tve api viśeṣyasya prādhānyāt kriyā sambandhaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyañca ghaṭataḥ iti tat na prādhānyasya eva vicārya tvāt eka jñāna ālamba natāyām hi kim kṛtam prādhānyam iti cintyam sāmāna adhikaraṇyantu eka jñāna ālambanatva aviśeṣe puruṣa pratyayena na ca daṇḍa pratyayena iti viśeṣaṇa hetu abhāvaḥ

atha vibhinna viśeṣaṇa nimittayoḥ ekasmin arthe vṛtteḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam daṇḍī iti pratyaye daṇḍaḥ viśeṣaṇam puruṣe iti na ca evam daṇḍasya viśeṣaṇa tve anyat viśeṣaṇam asti iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam na etat evam anekasya prameyasya pratibhāsā abhyupagamāt tathā hi na daṇḍī iti jñāne daṇḍa tva ādi api prameyam pratibhāsate iti abhyupagame kathanam sāmānādhikaraṇyam tathā sūtra vyāghātaḥ ca samavāyinaḥ śvaityāt śvaitya buddheḥ śvete buddhiḥ tad kārya kāraṇa bhūte kārya kāraṇa svabhāve iti

na punar bhūta abhidhānam upamāyām mukhye bādhaka anupapatteḥ na api prameya viśeṣāt eva pratyaya viśeṣaḥ sahakāri vailakṣaṇyena api bhāvāt nanu evam tarhi viśeṣaṇa vat sambandhe api jñānam kalpanīyam tatra tad anurāgasya apratibhāsena cakṣuḥ ādi vat agṛhītasya api vyāpāra abhyupagamāt na api abheda upacārāt viśeṣaṇā viśeṣya bhāvaḥ puruṣe daṇḍaḥ iti jñāna anupapatteḥ atha viśeṣaṇam viśeṣyan ca sambandham laukikīm sthitim gṛhītvā saṅkalyyā eva tathā pratyeti na anyathā iti saṅkalanā jñānam iti ced na etat yuktam etāvataḥ jñāna kalāpasya sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt tathā hi param viśeṣya jñānam utpadyamānam dṛṣṭam tat ca anyathā ca ghaṭataḥ iti viśeṣaṇe api jñānam luptam na punar jñāna antara sadbhāve pramāṇam asti iti

na ca idam niriviṣayam kalpanā jñānam artha anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānāt bādhaka anupapatteḥ ca tat evam gṛhītasya viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣya jñāna janaka tvāt liṅga ādi vyāpāra anupalabdheḥ ca pratyakṣa tvam kālasya iti satyam tathā eka jñāna ālambana tve api yugapādi pratyayāḥ na kālasya liṅgam tasya api viśeṣaṇa tayā ālambana tvāt amīṣāñca indriya anuvidhānena pratyakṣa phala tvāt iti alam

sarva kāryāṇām utpattau kāraṇa tvam pratijñātam āha *sarva kārya aṇāñca utpatti sthiti vināśa hetuḥ* iti utpattiḥ ātma lābhaḥ bhāvānām sthitiḥ krama bhāvi aneka kārya kartṛ tvam vināśaḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ teṣām kāraṇam iti atra tu yadi api sarva kāryāṇām hetuḥ iti ukte sarvam etat labhyate tathā api avāntara viśeṣa apekṣayā bheda kathanam

atha teṣām hetuḥ kālaḥ iti katham jñāyate iti āha *tad vyapadeśa at* iti tathā hi utpattau kālena vyapadeśaḥ madhyāhne utpannaḥ aparāhṇe utpannaḥ iti sthitau ca madhyāhnam yāvat sthitaḥ aparāhṇañcaḥ iti vināśe tu prātar vinaṣṭaḥ varṣa ante vinaṣṭaḥ ityādi kāraṇena tu kāryasya vyapadeśaḥ yathā cākṣuṣam vijñānam mānasam vijñānam iti

atha akāraṇena api vyapadeśaḥ sambhavati eva mūrtāḥ paramāṇavaḥ daṇḍī puruṣaḥ iti satyam tathā api sambandhe sati vyapadeśa upalabdheḥ na ca anyaḥ sambandhaḥ atra sambhavati iti kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ jñāyate atha asti saṃyogaḥ na guṇa karma ādeḥ avyapadeśya tā prasaṅgāt asti ca tatra api vyapadeśaḥ pūrvāhṇe śabdaḥ tathā utkṣepaṇam ityādi

atha ayam vyapadeśaḥ saṃyukta samavāyāt bhaviṣyati iti na abhāve tad abhāva prasaṅgāt atas kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ eva sambandhaḥ abhyupeyaḥ tasya hi vyāpaka tvāt iti tathā niyata kāle kusuma ādeḥ kāryasya upalambhaḥ na kāla antare iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām tasya kāraṇa tvam vijñāyate tathā hi vasanta samayaḥ eva pāṭalā ādi kusumānām udgamaḥ na kāla antare iti evam kārya antareṣu api ūhyam tathā prasava kālam apekṣate iti vyavahārāt kāraṇa tvam kālasya tathā hi sahakāriṇam apekṣya upalabdheḥ kālasya sahakāritām antareṇa prasūtau ayam vyavahāraḥ na syāt

tathā na param yugapad a ādi pratyaya hetuḥ *kṣaṇa lava nimeṣa kāṣṭhākalā muhūrtayāmāhorātra ardha māsa māsartu ayana saṃvatsara yuga kalpa manvantara pralaya mahāpralaya vyavahāra hetuḥ* iti tathā hi paramāṇoḥ ca avaruddha nabhaḥ deśa tyāga upalakṣitaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ tat dvayam lavaḥ iti uktaḥ nimeṣaḥ ca lava dvayam kāṣṭhāḥ nimeṣāḥ pañcadaśa ca iha prakīrtitāḥ triṃśat kāṣṭhāḥ kalā proktā kalāḥ triṃśat muhūrtakaḥ iti evam māsa ādeḥ api lakṣaṇam prasiddham grāhyam

sa ca ayam kṣaṇa ādi vyavahāraḥ viśiṣṭa tvāt viśiṣṭam nimittam ākṣipati na ca anyat nimittam sambhavati iti kriyā ādeḥ pratiṣedhāt iti kāla sadbhāva siddhiḥ tasya samavāyi tva guṇavat tva pratipādana artham *tasya guṇāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ* iti vākyam atra keṣāñcid utpattau samavāyi kāraṇam etaiḥ guṇaiḥ guṇavān kālaḥ iti

atha dravya tvāt eva saṃkhyā asadbhāva siddhau kim ekaḥ anekaḥ vā iti saṃśayaḥ tad nirāsāya āha *kāla liṅga aviśeṣāt eka tvam siddham* iti kālasya yat liṅgam yugapad a ādi pratyaya rūpam tat viśiṣṭam iti nānātva apratipādakam nanu ca asiddham etat yugapad ādi pratyayānām parasparam viśiṣṭa tvāt na ca kārya vailakṣaṇyam kāraṇa vailakṣaṇyam vinā bhavati iti nānātvam eva nyāyyam satyam kārya vailakṣaṇyāt vijñāyate eva sāmagrī vailakṣaṇyam tat ca sahakāri antara anupraveśena api ghaṭate iti katham kālasya nānātvam uktañca atra viśiṣṭa kriyā upacitasya viśiṣṭa pratyaya janaka tvam iti na ca evam paramāṇūnām cāturvidhyam vyāhanyate iti pūrvavat vācyam tat evam nānātve pramāṇa abhāvāt dravyasya ca saṃkhyeya tvāt iti eka tvam siddham

tathā *tad anu vidhānāt pṛthaktvam* iti tena ekatvena anuvidhānam sāhacaryāt yatra hi ekatvam tatra avaśyam eka pṛthaktvam bhaviṣyati iti na ca evam parimāṇa viśeṣeṇa sāhacaryam asti iti jñāna artham krama atikrameṇa pṛthaktvanirūpaṇam iti tathā *kāraṇe kālaḥ iti vacanāt parama mahat parimāṇam* iti yugapad ādi pratyayānām kāraṇe kāla ākhyāḥ iti sūtram darśayati tathā hi yugapad ādi pratyayānām kāraṇe kālaḥ iti ākhyā saṃjñā iti te ca pratyayāḥ sarvatra bhavanti iti vyāpaka tvam kālasya tasmāt ca parama mahattvam iti yat vā aṇu parimāṇān adhikaraṇa tve sati nitya dravya tvāt parama mahat tvam iti pūrvavat vācyam

tathā *kāraṇa paratva ādi vacanāt saṃyogaḥ* iti kāraṇa para tvāt kāraṇa apara tvāt ca kārye paratva aparatve iti sūtram darśayati kāraṇa para tvam hi kāla piṇḍa saṃyogaḥ paratva utpādaka tvāt upacāreṇa vivakṣitaḥ iti vakṣyāmaḥ paratva parīkṣāyām *tad vināśaka tvāt vibhāgaḥ* iti tasya hi saṃyogasya kṛtaka tvāt avaśyam vināśena bhavitavyam sa ca sarvatra āśraya vināśa abhāvāt vibhāgāt eva vinaśyati iti vibhāgaḥ siddhaḥ iti atha kālasya katham dravya tvam nitya tvañca iti āha *tasya ākāśa vat dravya tva nitya tve siddhe* iti tathā hi guṇavat tvāt anāśrita tvāt ca dravyam kālaḥ samāna asamāna jātīya kāraṇā sambhavāt ca akārya tvena nityaḥ iti atideśa arthaḥ

nanu ca atra kālasya ekatāyām vartamāna ādi vyavahāraḥ katham syāt iti āha *kāla liṅga aviśeṣāt añjasā eka tve api* ityādi yadi api kāla liṅga aviśeṣāt añjasā mukhyayā vṛttyā eka tvam siddham tathā api sarva kāryāṇām prārambhaḥ ca kriyā abhinirvṛttiḥ ca sthitiḥ ca nirodhaḥ ca iti tathā uktāḥ te eva upādhayaḥ tad bhedāt nānātvam iti tathā ca prārambha kriyā upalakṣitaḥ anāgataḥ kālaḥ abhinirvṛttiḥ ātma lābhaḥ tad upalakṣitaḥ ca vartamānaḥ tathā sthitiḥ krama bhāvi aneka kārya kartṛ tvam tad upalakṣitaḥ api vartamānaḥ eva tasya yāvat vastu sadbhāva vyāpya tvāt yāvat vivartate vastu tāvat vartamānaḥ iti tathā nirodhaḥ vināśaḥ tad upalakṣitaḥ ca atītaḥ iti

atha katham nānātvam upacaryate iti āha *maṇi vat pācaka vat vā* iti yathā maṇeḥ svarūpa aparityāgena eva upādhi bhedāt upacaryate nānātvam pītaḥ raktaḥ iti tadvat iha api bhinna kriyā upādhi vaśāt vartamāna ādi bhedaḥ iti yathā vā svarūpa aparityāgena eva puruṣasya nānā kriyā vaśāt pācaka ādi bhedaḥ tadvat iha api iti vāstave hi bhede bādhaka upapatteḥ tathā hi yadi vartamāna ādeḥ vāstavaḥ bhedaḥ vyāpaka tvañca syāt ekasya vastunaḥ aneka kāla sambandhāt avyapadeśya tā prasajyeta na hi vartamānena vyapadeśaḥ atīta anāgatābhyām api sambandhāt na api atītena itarābhyām api sambandhāt avyāpaka tvam tarhi na anekasya puruṣasya ekasmin eva deśe atīta anāgata vartamāna pratyayāḥ prāpnuvanti te tathā dṛṣṭāḥ tathā ca ekasya vidyamāna kriyā upalambhāt ekasmin eva deśe vartamāna pratyayaḥ tatra eva anyasya kriyā uparamāt atīta pratyayaḥ anyasya ca utpadyamāna kriyā upalambhāt anāgataḥ iti kriyā vaśāt eva nānā pratyaya janaka tvam na punar vāstavaḥ asya bhedaḥ iti sthitam

idānīm diśaḥ avasara prāptāyāḥ lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham *diś pūrva apara ādi pratyaya liṅgā* ityādi prakaraṇam diś iti lakṣya nirdeśaḥ pūrva apara ādi pratyaya liṅga iti lakṣaṇam tathā pūrvaḥ ca aparaḥ ca pūrva aparau tau ādiḥ yeṣām iti tathā uktāḥ te ca te pratyayāḥ ca iti te liṅgam yasyāḥ sā tathā iti saṅgraha ukteḥ vivaraṇa artham āha *mūrtam avadhim kṛtvā mūrteṣu eva dravyeṣu viṣaya bhūteṣu etasmāt mūrta dravyāt idam mūrtam pūrveṇa dakṣiṇena ityādi daśa pratyayāḥ yatas nimittāt bhavanti sā diś iti* tathā ca diś itarebhyaḥ bhidyate pūrva apara ādi pratyaya liṅga tvāt yaḥ tu na bhidyate na ca asau evam yathā kṣiti ādiḥ iti vyavahāraḥ vā sādhyaḥ

nanu ca pūrva apara ādi pratyayāḥ paraspara apekṣitayā mūrteṣu eva bhavanti iti asiddham lakṣaṇa abhidhānam na etat evam paraspara apekṣitāyām ubhaya abhāva prasaṅgāt tathā hi yadi pūrvam apekṣya apara pratyayaḥ aparañca apekṣya pūrva pratyayaḥ iti eka abhāve anyatara abhāvāt ubhaya abhāva prasaṅgaḥ na ca nirnimittaḥ kadācid utpanna tvāt anvaya vi atirekābhyām mūrta dravyasya vyāpāra upalabdheḥ aṅguli ādi vyapadeśāt ca ālambana tvam na ca tasya aviśiṣṭasya pratyaya janmani vyāpāraḥ sarvatra aviśeṣeṇa pūrva ādi pratyaya aviśeṣa prasaṅgāt

atha mūrta dravyam eva avadhi bhūtam nimittam iti ced na tasya sarva pratyayeṣu aviśeṣāt tathā hi tasya nimitta tāyām yatra eva pūrva pratyayaḥ tatra eva dakṣiṇa ādi pratyayāḥ prasajyeran aviśeṣāt na api saṅketa eva nimittam tasya hi nimittam vinā sarvatra apravṛtteḥ tathā hi ekam nimittam vinā ekatra saṅketitaḥ pūrva śabdaḥ na artha antare pravartate atha asti pūrva ādi śabdānām saṅketa pravṛtteḥ kāraṇam ekam yat sadbhāvāt artha antare api pravṛttiḥ iti ced sā tarhi diś iti atha aviśiṣṭa tayā diśaḥ na viśiṣṭa pratyaya janaka tvam iti ced na eka tve api viśiṣṭa saṃyoga vaśāt viśiṣṭa pratyaya janaka tvam iti anantaram vakṣyāmaḥ

atha vikalpa jñāna tvāt nirviṣayāḥ pūrva ādi pratyayāḥ vāsanā vaśāt bhavanti iti ced tat na abādhyamāna tvāt abādhyamānam jñānam nirviṣayam na bhavati eva śukla ādi vijñāna vat viṣayasya ca aṅguli ādi vyapadiśyamānasya anvaya vyatirekābhyām vyāpāra upalabdheḥ iti uktam na ca vāsanā eva atra nimittam tasyāḥ bodha vyatirekeṇa asambhavāt iti pūrva nyāyāt atas viśiṣṭa pratyayāḥ pūrva apara ādayaḥ na viśiṣṭam nimittam antareṇa bhavanti na ca anyat nimittam kṣiti ādi rūpam sambhavati iti atas nimitta antarā sambhavāt yat atra nimittam sā diś iti viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyam nyāyaḥ sarva utpattau kāraṇa tvam kāla vat draṣṭavyam

samavāyi tva guṇavat tva pratipādana artham āha *tasyāḥ tu guṇāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ* iti tatra ca ati deśam karoti *kāla vat ete siddhāḥ* iti tathā diś liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt ca eka tvam diśaḥ siddham nanu pūrva apara ādi pratyayāḥ parasparam vilakṣaṇasya eva nimittasya pratipādakāḥ iti nānātvam eva yuktam na sahakāri vailakṣaṇyena api pratyaya vailakṣaṇya upapattiḥ iti ukta nyāyāt atas dravya tvāt eva saṃkhyā yoga siddhau nānātve pramāṇa abhāvāt ekatvam siddham

tena ekatvena anuvidhānāt sāhacaryāt eka pṛthak tvañca iti pūrva apara ādi pratyayānām kāraṇe diś ākhyāḥ iti vākyena parama mahat tvam tathā ca pūrva apara ādi pratyayāḥ sarvatra nimittam vinā na sambhavanti iti diśaḥ vyāpaka tvāt parama mahat tvam tathā kāraṇa para tvāt kāraṇa apara tvāt ca paratva aparatve iti sūtreṇa saṃyogaḥ siddhaḥ tathā hi kāraṇa para tvam paratva utpādakaḥ diś piṇḍa saṃyogaḥ apara tvañca aparatva utpādakaḥ vivakṣitaḥ iti vakṣyāmaḥ paratva parīkṣāyām saṃyogaḥ ca kṛtaka tvāt avaśyam vināśī iti āśraya vināśasya sarvatra asambhavāt vibhāgāt api naśyati iti vibhāgaḥ siddhaḥ iti atideśa arthaḥ tathā guṇavat tvāt anāśrita tvāt ca dravyam samāna asamāna jātīya kāraṇā sambhavāt ca akārya tvena nitya tvañca iti draṣṭavyam

atha ekasyāḥ diśaḥ prācya ādi vyavahāraḥ katham syāt iti āha *digliṅga aviśeṣāt añjasā eka tve api* ityādi tatra hi yadi api diśaḥ liṅgānām aviśeṣāt nānātva aprasiddhau añjasā mukhyayā vṛttyā eka tvam siddham tathā api savituḥ ye saṃyogāḥ lokapāla parigṛhīta diś pradeśaiḥ saha iti vibhakti vipariṇāmaḥ yat vā bhagavataḥ savituḥ ye saṃyogāḥ te keṣām iti vivakṣāyām sambandhasya api vidyamāna tvāt yuktā eva ṣaṣṭhī

*lokapāla parigṛhīta diś pradeśānām* iti anvarthāḥ anugata arthāḥ *prācī ādi bhedena daśavidhāḥ* daśa prakārāḥ *saṃjñāḥ kṛtāḥ* parama ṛṣibhiḥ iti kimartham iti āha *śruti smṛti loka vyavahāra artham* śrutiḥ ca smṛtiḥ ca lokaḥ ca iti tathā uktāḥ teṣām saṃvyavahāra artham iti śrautaḥ hi vyavahāraḥ vāyavyām gavayam ālabheta smārtaḥ tu prāṅmukhaḥ bhuñjīta laukikaḥ api asmad vṛddhāḥ prāṅmukhāḥ yajante smaḥ iti ādi vyavahārasya prasiddhi artham iti

atha lokapāla parigṛhīta diś pradeśaiḥ saṃyogaḥ bhagavataḥ katham bhavati iti āha *merum pradakṣiṇam āvartamānasya* iti pradakṣiṇam hi yathā bhavati tathā merum paribhramataḥ api viśiṣṭa saṃyogāḥ tad vaśāt ca prācī ādi vyavahāraḥ anvaya vyatirekābhyām upalambhāt ca tathā hi udaya samaye savituḥ diś pradeśena yogāt prācī iti vyavahāraḥ tatra hi prāk prathamam añcati iti kṛtvā evam madhyāhna samaye diś pradeśena saṃyogāt dakṣiṇā iti vyavahāraḥ tathā ca aparāhṇe tad yogāt pratīci iti ca evam udīcya ādiṣu api vācyam

nanu evam tarhi saḥ eva āditya saṃyogaḥ astu pūrva ādi vyavahārasya nimittam alam diśaḥ kalpanayā iti na ādityasya api pūrva apara ādi vyavahāra viṣaya tve anya āditya parikalpanāyām anavasthā syāt iti nimitta antaram eva nyāyyam na ca āditya parivartanam sarvatra sambhavati iti tatra pūrva apara ādi vyavahāra abhāva prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt ekā api aneka saṃyoga upacitā viśiṣṭa vyavahāra samartha iti abhyupagantavyam atas bhaktyā upacāreṇa daśa diśaḥ siddhāḥ tāsāñca upacarita diśām devatā parigraha vaśāt punar daśa saṃjñā bhavanti mahā indreṇa parigṛhītā māhendrī vaiśvānareṇa parigṛhītā vaiśvānarī iti evam anyāsu api iti

idānīm ātmanaḥ lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham *a ātma tva abhisambandhād* iti ādi prakaraṇam ātma tvena abhisambandhaḥ ātma upalakṣitaḥ samavāyaḥ vā lakṣaṇam iti tathā hi ātmā itarasmāt bhidyate ātma tva abhisambandhāt yaḥ tu itarasmāt anātmanaḥ na bhidyate na ca asau ātma tvena abhisambaddhaḥ yathā kṣiti ādiḥ iti na ca tathā ātmā tasmāt bhidyate iti vyavahāraḥ vā sādhyaḥ tathā śabda artha nirūpaṇa paratvena pūrvavat vākyam yojanīyam tathā lakṣaṇasya ākṣepa pratisamādhānam pūrvavat vācyam

nanu sarvam etat asambaddham ātma sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt tathā hi na pratyakṣeṇa upalabhyate rūpa ādi vat svabhāva an avadhāraṇāt na api anumānam asti ātma pratibaddham iti āśaṅkya āha *tasya saukṣmyāt apratyakṣa tve sati karaṇaiḥ śabda ādi upalabdhi anumitaiḥ śrotra ādibhiḥ samadhigamaḥ kiyate* iti saukṣmyam rūpa viśeṣa eka artha samaveta mahat tva ādi abhāvaḥ abhipretaḥ na aṇu parimāṇa sambandhi tvam atas eva tasya apratyakṣa tvam

nanu ca ayuktam etat aham iti pratyaye tasya pratibhāsanāt tathā ca sukhī aham duḥkhī aham icchāvān aham iti pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na ca ayam anumāpu urvakaḥ liṅga liṅgi sambandha anusmaraṇa vyāpārasya asaṃvedanāt na api śabdaḥ tena vinā api utpadyamāna tvāt na api viparyaya jñānam etat abādhyamāna tvāt na api saṃśaya jñānam tad rūpasya asaṃvedanāt atas pramā rūpa tvāt avaśyam pramāṇa antara pratiṣedhe pratyakṣasya eva vyāpāraḥ na śarīra ālambanam antaḥkaraṇa vyāpāreṇa utpatteḥ tathā hi na śarīram antaḥkaraṇa paricchedyam bahis viṣaya tvāt

nanu evam kṛśaḥ aham sthūlaḥ aham iti pratyayaḥ tarhi katham mukhye bādhaka upapatteḥ upacāreṇa tathā hi madīyaḥ bhṛtyaḥ iti jñāna vat madīyam śarīram iti bheda pratyaya darśanāt bhṛtya vat eva śarīre api aham iti jñānasya aupacārika tvam eva yuktam upacāraḥ tu nimittam vinā na pravartate iti ātma upakāraka tvam nimittam kalpyate ātmani tu mukhya tvam sukhī iti jñānena samāna adhikaraṇa tvāt tathā hi yatra sukhī iti jñānam tatra eva aham iti jñānasya upalambhaḥ sukha ādi yogaḥ ca śarīra ādi vyatirekeṇa ātmani eva iti vakṣyāmaḥ

yat ca idam rūpa ādi vat svabhāva an avadhāraṇāt iti tat asat aham iti svabhāvasya pratibhāsanāt na ca artha antarasya artha antara svabhāvena apratyakṣa tvam doṣaḥ sarva padārthānām apratyakṣata aprasaṅgāt na ca parakīye api ātmani aham iti pratibhāsa prasaṅgaḥ syāt tasya ātma antara apratyakṣa tvāt pratyakṣa jañcā idam vijñānam na pramāṇa antara prabhavam iti uktam na ca ātmā antareṇa ātma antarasya apratyakṣatāyām sva ātmanaḥ api tathā abhāva prasaṅgaḥ sva saṃvidā bādhyamāna tvāt na api rūpa antarasya saṃkhyā ādeḥ pratyakṣatā prasaṅgaḥ tasya pratibhāsā bhāvena apratyakṣa tvāt tathā yatra hi rūpa viśeṣasya pratyakṣa tvam tatra eva saṃkhyā ādayaḥ pratyakṣāḥ iti ukta pūrvam

atha ātmanaḥ kartṛ tvāt ekasmin kāle karma tva asambhavenā pratyakṣa tvam tat na lakṣaṇa bhedena tad upapatteḥ tathā hi jñāna cikīrṣā dhāra tvasya kartṛ lakṣaṇasya upapatteḥ kartṛ tvam tadā eva ca kriyayā vyāpya tva upalabdheḥ karma tvañca iti na doṣaḥ lakṣaṇa tantra tvāt vastu vyavasthāyāḥ na ca anayoḥ ekasmin dharmiṇī ekasmin ca kāle kartṛ karaṇayoḥ iva astu virodhaḥ tathā hi svātantryam kartṛ tvam pāratantrī añca karaṇa tvam iti tu anayoḥ vidhi pratiṣedha rūpa tvāt abhinne dharmiṇī a sambhavaḥ yuktaḥ na ca evam kartṛ tva karma tvayoḥ iti

atas eva madīyam śarīram ityādi pratyayeṣu ātma anurāga sadbhāve api ātmanaḥ avacchedaka tvam śraiharṣam devakulam iti jñāne śrī harṣasya iva ubhayatra api bādhaka sadbhāvāt yatra hi anurāga sadbhāve api viśeṣaṇa tve bādhakam asti tatra avacchedaka tvam eva kalpyate iti asti ca śrī harṣasya vidyamāna tvam ātmani iti kartṛ tva karaṇa tvayoḥ asambhavaḥ iti bādhakam

na ca ekasmin eva dharmiṇi kartṛ ādi vibhāgasya upalabdheḥ avāstava tvam eva nyāyyam lakṣaṇa bhedasya vāstava tvāt yeṣāntu lakṣaṇa bhedaḥ na asti teṣām eva doṣaḥ iti kalpanā jñānañca pūrvam eva nirastam iti na kalpanā samāropitā kāraṇa ādi vyavasthā tat evam kartṛ ādi pravibhāgasya bhinna nimitta tvāt ekasmin eva ātmani anumānena pratyakṣeṇa vā paricchedyamānena tat eva kartṛ tvam na doṣāya iti

nanu evam ātmani aham iti pratyayasya pratyakṣa phala tvāt tasya saukṣmyāt apratyakṣa tve sati iti asambaddham vākyam na bāhya indriya vivakṣayā asya abhidhānāt tathā hi kasmāt ātmā kṣiti ādi vat bāhya indriya pratyakṣaḥ na bhavati iti ukte vākyam sambadhyate tasya saukṣmyāt rūpa viśeṣa eka artha samavāyasya mahat tvasya aneka dravya tva sahacaritasya abhāvāt na bāhya indriya pratyakṣa tvam tatra pratyakṣe api apratyakṣa abhidhānāt labhyate tasmin ca sati karaṇaiḥ śrotra ādibhiḥ samadhigamaḥ kriyate śrotra ādibhiḥ iti ubhayatra api yojyam tathā hi śabda upalabdhiḥ karaṇa kāryā kriyā tvāt chidi kriyāvat evam śeṣeṣu api iti tasya saukṣmyāt yathā uktāt karaṇaiḥ śrotra ādibhiḥ apratyakṣa tve sati taiḥ eva liṅga bhūtaiḥ tasya adhigamaḥ kriyate

śrotra ādīnām api sadbhāve anumānam āha *śabda ādi upalabdhi anumitaiḥ* iti śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandha upalabdhi kriyābhiḥ anumīyante iti tad anumitāni taiḥ iti tathā hi śabda upalabdhiḥ karaṇa kāryā kriyā tvāt chidi kriyāvat evam śeṣeṣu api iti vyāpti pratipādana artham āha *vā asya ādīnām iva karaṇānām kartṛ prayojya tva darśana at* iti yathā vāsya ādīni karaṇāni kartṛ prayojyāni iti tadvat śrotra ādīni api karaṇāni tasmāt kartṛ prayojyāni tathā hi śrotra ādīni karaṇāni kartṛ prayojyāni karaṇa tvāt vā asya ādi vat iti

atha atra sarva gata ātma prayojya tve sādhye sādhya vikala tvam viparyaye vā siddha sādhanam iti na sarva anumāneṣu sāmānyena eva sādhya sādhana bhāva upapatteḥ viśeṣeṇa anuvyāpti abhāve sarva anumāna uccheda prasaṅgaḥ pramāṇañca anumānam iti vakṣyāmaḥ tad adhikāre siddhe ca kartṛ sadbhāve tasya śarīra ādi vyatirekaḥ pariśeṣāt tathā na param karaṇaiḥ *śabda ādiṣu prasiddhyā ca prasādhakaḥ anumīyate* śabda ādiṣu viṣayeṣu prasiddhiḥ vijñānam tayā prasādhakaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam ātmā anumīyate tathā hi śabda ādi jñānam kvacid āśritam guṇa tvāt yaḥ yaḥ guṇaḥ sa saḥ āśritaḥ yathā rūpa ādiḥ tathā ca guṇaḥ jñānam tasmāt āśritam samavāyi kāraṇa pūrvaka tvam kāryatvāt rūpa ādi vat eva

atha śarīra ādi āśritam bhaviṣyati iti siddha sādhanam iti āśaṅkya āha *na śarīra indriya manasām* iti tathā hi pare manyante prāṇa vat śarīre sati bhāvāt tad abhāve ca abhāvāt śarīra dharmaḥ eva caitanyam iti evam indriya ādiṣu api ūhyam tad niṣedha artham na śarīra indriya manasām caitanyam iti vyavahāre sādhye na sādhya aviśiṣṭaḥ hetuḥ *ajña tva at* iti yat vā sva siddhānta upadarśanam etat asmad siddhānte na amīṣām caitanyam iti nanu evam yadi śarīrasya caitanyam na asti tarhi kim artham paraiḥ uktaḥ caitanya viśiṣṭaḥ kāyaḥ puruṣaḥ tathā indriya bhāva vyatireka anuvidhānāt indriyāṇāñca iti āśaṅkya āha *ajña tva at* iti na hi viduṣaḥ bādhakam upalabhamānasya evam vacāṃsi pravartante iti tathā manyante ebhiḥ iti manāṃsi śarīra indriyāṇi eva teṣām na caitanyam tad karaṇānām ajña tvāt acetana kāraṇa ārabdha tvāt iti arthaḥ iti kecid

atha karaṇānām ajña tvam kutas kārya ajñānāt nanu evam itaretara āśraya tvam na ghaṭa ādi kāryasya acetanatayā ubhaya vādi sampratipatteḥ karaṇānām ajña tvam siddham tad jātīyāḥ ca paramāṇavaḥ śarīra ārambhakāḥ iti acetana kāraṇa ārabdha tve tasya api acetana tvam evam indriyeṣu api yadi ca paramāṇuṣu caitanyam syāt ekasmin eva śarīre puruṣa ānantyāt pratisandhāna ādi vyavahāra uccheda prasaṅgāt

śarīra indriya aṇāñca caitanyasya utpattau anvaya vyatirekau kāraṇa tvāt api sambhavataḥ katham tad ādhāra tvam iti atha evam adṛṣṭa kalpanā doṣaḥ iti ced na pramāṇa upalambhāt tathā hi pratyakṣa vat anumeyasya api arthasya asti eva sadbhāvaḥ tatra śarīrasya caitanya pratiṣedha artham āha *na śarīrasya caitanyam* iti atra tu caitanyasya pakṣīkaraṇe bhūta kārya tvam asiddham syāt iti śarīram eva pakṣīkriyate tathā hi śarīram para parikalpita caitanya śūnyam bhūta tvāt kārya tvāt ca yat bhūtam yat ca kāryam tat caitanya śūnyam yathā ghaṭaḥ tathā ca śarīram tasmāt acetanam iti

anye tu ekaḥ eva bhūta kārya tvāt iti hetuḥ vivakṣitaḥ iti manyante tat ca asat bhūta tvāt iti uktena eva vyabhicāra abhāvāt atha bhūta kārya tvāt iti ukte asti ātmanā vyabhicāraḥ iti ced na tasya sādhya tvāt siddhe ca vyabhicāraḥ bhavati iti yasya ca ātmā prasiddhaḥ tam pratyanumāna upanyāsaḥ vyarthaḥ eva tathā kārya tvāt iti ukte na asti vyabhicāraḥ iti vyartham eva syāt bhūta padam na ca cetanayā vyabhicāraḥ tasyāḥ caitanya śūnya tvena sa pakṣa tvāt iti hetu dvitayam eva yuktam avayava vyatyaye tu uktam eva pratisamādhānam

tathā *mṛte ca asambhavāt* iti mṛta avasthāyām caitanyasya rūpa ādi vat anupalabdheḥ na śarīra viśeṣa guṇa tvam tathā hi caitamyam śarīra viśeṣa guṇaḥ na bhavati sati śarīre nivartamāna tvāt ye hi sati śarīre nivartante te tad viśeṣa guṇāḥ na bhavanti yathā saṃyoga ādayaḥ ye tu śarīra viśeṣa guṇāḥ te tasmin sati na nivartante yathā rūpa ādayaḥ iti na ca viśeṣa guṇa tva pratiṣedhena sāmānya guṇa tva prāptiḥ pratiyogi apekṣita tvāt pakṣa ādi vyavasthāyāḥ tathā hi caitanyasya pareṇa śarīra viśeṣa guṇa tvam eva iṣṭam tasya eva pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate na ca atra śarīrasya eva pakṣīkaraṇam

mṛte ca asambhavāt caitanyasya iti hetoḥ vyadhikaraṇa tā prasaṅgāt tathā indriyāṇām caitanya pratiṣedhaḥ na indriyāṇām caitanyam karaṇa tvāt vā asya ādi vat bhūta tvāt kāryatvāt iti api draṣṭavyam itas api na indriyāṇām caitanyam tad upaghāte api smṛti darśanāt na ca guṇi vināśe guṇasya sadbhāvaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tathā hi smaraṇam indriya guṇaḥ na bhavati tad vināśe api utpadyamāna tvāt yaḥ yat vināśe api utpadyate sa tasya guṇaḥ na bhavati yathā ghaṭa vināśe api paṭa rūpa ādiḥ iti tathā ca smaraṇam indriya vināśe api bhavati tasmāt na tad guṇaḥ iti

yadi ca indriyāṇām caitanyam syāt karaṇam vinā kriyāyāḥ ca anupalabdheḥ iti karaṇa antaraiḥ bhavitavyam tāni karaṇāni indriyāṇi vivāda āspadāni ca ātmānaḥ iti ekasmin eva śarīre puruṣa bahu tvam abhyupagatam syāt evañca sati devadatta upalabdhe arthe yajñadattasya iva indriya antara upalabdhe arthe na syāt indriya antareṇa pratisandhānam tat tu dṛṣṭam atas na indriyāṇām caitanyam yadi ca ekam indriyam aśeṣa karaṇa adhiṣṭhāyakam cetanam iṣyeta saṃjñā bheda mātram eva syāt

atha viṣaya guṇaḥ caitanyam bhaviṣyati iti tad niṣedha artham āha *viṣayāsān nidhye ca anusmṛti darśanāt* tathā hi viṣayāsān nidhye tad vināśe vā anusmṛtiḥ dṛṣṭā na ca tad guṇaḥ tad vināśe bhavati iti atha manaḥ guṇaḥ bhaviṣyati iti tad pratiṣedha artham āha *nā api manasaḥ* caitanyam guṇaḥ karaṇa tvāt vā asya ādi vat yat kartṛ manaḥ tat api sukha ādi upalabdhau yadi karaṇa antaram apekṣeta saṃjñā bheda mātram eva syāt tathā hi yat tad sukha ādi upalabdheḥ karaṇam tat eva antaḥkaraṇam yat cetanam manaḥ saḥ eva ātmā syāt atha karaṇa antaram na apekṣate tarhi *karaṇa antara anapekṣi tve yugapad a ālocana smṛti prasaṅgaḥ* tathā hi manasaḥ caitanye yugapad rūpa rasa sparśa śabda jñānāni prasajyeran cakṣuḥ ādīnām manaḥ sambandhe sati karaṇa antara anapekṣāṇām sva viṣayaiḥ sambandhāt

tathā hi smṛti yaugapadyañca karaṇa anapekṣi tvāt na ca ekasya krameṇa kārya janaka tvam pūrva svarūpasya aparibhraṃśāt na api yugapad eva sarvam kṛtvā punar akaraṇe hetu abhāvāt pratikāryañca pūrva svarūpa vyāvṛtti abhyupagame kṣaṇika tā prasaṅgaḥ atha karaṇasya api manasaḥ caitanyam tat na *svayam karaṇa bhāvāt ca* iti tathā hi caitanyam pradhāna kriyā sā ca kartari karmaṇi vā samavaiti na karaṇe bhavitum arhati anupalambhāt na hi karaṇam pradhāna kriyā āśrayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti svakīya apekṣayā tu sarvasya kartṛ tvam eva iti *tadevam pariśeṣāt ātma kārya tvāt* caitanyasya *tena ātmā samadhigamyate*

kaḥ punar ayam pariśeṣaḥ prasakteṣu śarīra ādiṣu jāti ādiṣu viṣayeṣu caitanya pratiṣedhe tathā tad āśrayasya vyavasthāpanāt nānā tva adhigamāt ākāśa ādīnām eka tvena aprasakteḥ śiṣyate ca dravya antaram iti pariśeṣaḥ kevala vyatireki anumānam tathā ca jñānam kṣiti jala jyotiḥ ākāśa diś kāla manaḥ vyatirikta dravya āśrayam tad vṛttau bādhaka pramāṇa sadbhāve sati guṇa tvāt yaḥ tu tad vyatirikta āśrayaḥ na bhavati na ca asau tad vṛtti bādhaka pramāṇa sadbhāve sati guṇaḥ yathā rūpa ādiḥ na ca tathā jñānam tasmāt vyatirikta āśrayam iti

nanu sarvam etat asambaddham kṣaṇika tvena āśraya āśrayi bhāva anupapatteḥ tathā ca padārthānām artha kriyayā sattvam vyāptam sā ca krama yaugapadyābhyām akṣaṇikeṣu na sambhavati krameṇa janaka tvam eka svarūpa tvāt yat eva hi pūrva kārya utpattau svarūpam tat eva uttara kāryeṣu api iti sarveṣām eka tā prasaṅgaḥ kāraṇa vailakṣaṇyam vinā kārya vailakṣaṇyasya aśakya sādhana tvāt

atha kārya vailakṣaṇyāt eva jñāyate pratikāryam pūrva svarūpa nivṛttau anyat eva svarūpam bhāvānām bhavati iti tarhi svarūpasya avasthāna anabhyupagamāt tathā asattva prasaṅgaḥ atha avasthitasya api krama yaugapadyābhyām sahakāri prāptau tathā eva janaka tvam iti ced na tasya tasmin atiśaya ādhāyaka tvena atiśaya nivartaka tvena ca tayoḥ avyatirekāt anya tvam eva vyatireke api tad bhāve api bhāvasya katham kāryasya janaka tvam dṛṣṭam iti na hi artha antara janmani artha antarasya kriyā janaka tvam dṛṣṭam iti anupakārake vastuni apekṣā eva na syāt iti sahakāri tva abhāvaḥ atha sahakāriṇām api sahakāri antara adhīnam sāmarthyam tat api yadi sahakāri antarāt iti anavasthā eva syāt atha sahakāri antaram vinā eva sahakāriṇām svatas eva sāmarthyam iti ced etat ca anyatra api samānam iti alam

tat evam akṣaṇikebhyaḥ vyāvartamāna artha kriyā sva vyāptam sattvam gṛhītvā vyāvartate iti asantaḥ akṣaṇikāḥ tat evam bādhaka upalambhāt para pakṣaḥ eva akṣaṇika śaṅkā vyavaccheda siddhau sattvam eva kṣaṇika sādhanam iti tathā nirhetuka tvāt vināśasya utpatti anantaram eva abhāvaḥ iti kṣaṇika tvam nanu mudgara ādi vyāpāreṇa ghaṭa ādi vināśasya utpāda upalambhāt ayuktam eva tat na ātma bhāga saṅgatau tad vyāpārāt yadi ca hetoḥ artha antara bhūtaḥ vināśaḥ utpādyeta tadā tad abhāvasya anupalambhaḥ na syāt tad svarūpasya aparibhraṃśāt tathā abhāvasya eva kārya janaka tva abhyupagame bhāva rūpa tva prasaṅgaḥ ca

na ca artha antara tva aviśeṣāt tasmin upajāte kasyacid bhāvasya anupalambhaḥ na sarvasya iti viśeṣa hetuḥ asti na api kāraṇa apekṣitāyām avaśyambhāvaḥ syāt vastre rāgasya iva sa apekṣi tvā avaśyambhāvi tvayoḥ virodhāt tathā hi vastre rāgaḥ sampadyamānaḥ kāraṇa sadbhāvāt bhavati abhāve na bhavati evam kvacid vastunaḥ vināśaḥ hetu pratibandhāt abhāvāt vā vināśi tvam api syāt yadi ca avinaśvara svarūpāṇām ahetutaḥ vināśaḥ gagana ādīnām api nitya tayā abhyupagatānām vināśaḥ prasajyeta atha naṅkṣoḥ bhāvasya hetu tā tatas vināśa vat kim tad kalpanayā tad svarūpa tvāt eva avaśyam vinā api hetum vināśaḥ bhavati iti

yadi karaṇa kārya tvañca syāt vināśasya kṛtaka tvāt tad vināśe avaśyam bhāva unmajjanam syāt tasmāt na tasya kiñcid bhavati na bhavati eva kevalam iti bhāva lakṣaṇa sthita dharma anāśaḥ iti na ca akṣaṇika tve pratyabhijñānam pramāṇam tasya kalpanā jñāna tvāt tat etat sarvam avidita artham kalpanā jñānasya pūrvam eva nirasta tvāt

atha saḥ eva ayam iti jñāne viruddha ullekhāt eka tvam ayuktam tathā hi saḥ iti atīta ākāram jñānam ayam iti ca vartamāna ākāram na ca viruddha ākārayoḥ ekatra sambhavaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti tat asat ākāra vāda pratiṣedhe pūrva anubhava janita saṃskāra smaraṇa sahakāri indriyeṇa saḥ eva ayam iti ubhaya ullekhi jñānam janyate tasya ca artha anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānāt nirviṣaya tvam ayuktam

atha astu pratyabhijñānāt avasthāyi tvam arthānām artha kriyā kāritvantu katham sahakāri sānnidhye sati iti tathā hi krameṇa sahakāri sadbhāve sati krameṇa janaka tvam yugapad sadbhāve ca yugapad ca iti yat ca uktam kim tasya sahakāriṇā kriyate iti na kiñcid kim tarhi sadbhāve kāryam eva anyathā sahakāri tva ayogāt yat vā tasya sāmarthyāt kāraka sākalyam eva kriyate tad sadbhāve kārya jananāt asāmarthyantu vaikalyam nivartate sākalya vaikalyayoḥ paraspara sadbhāva sthiti virodhāt na ca tayoḥ āvirbhāva tirobhāvābhyām arthasya tathā abhāva prasaṅgaḥ tayoḥ tad vyatirekāt

na ca sahakāriṇām artha antara tva aviśeṣāt aviśeṣeṇa sarva bhāva sahakāri tvam niyatasya eva sadbhāve bhāva vyatirekābhyām kārya janaka tva darśanāt na api sahakāriṇām sahakāri antarāt sāmarthyam tad nirapekṣāṇām api parasparasānnidhye tad samudāyasya eka kārya janakatva upalabdheḥ dṛṣṭañca cakṣu ūru upāloka manaskārāṇām paraspara sānnidhye sati eka kārya janaka tvam

na ca atra itara ādhipatyena antya avasthāyām atiśayaḥ sampadyate iti vācyam avyatireke tad abhāvāt na hi saḥ eva tasya eva atiśayaḥ bhavati iti tathā atiśaya rahitānām atiśaya janaka tvam iti kārya antare api na bādhā asti atha atiśaya yuktānām atiśaya janaka tvam evam tarhi teṣām api anyasmāt atiśayaḥ sampadyate iti abhyupagame anavasthāyām vivakṣita kārya anutpatti prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt sahakāriṇām paraspara sānnidhyam eva atiśayaḥ iti yuktam utpaśyāmaḥ tat evam kārya vailakṣaṇyam sāmagrī vailakṣaṇyāt bhavati iti na pratikāryam anya tvam bhāvānām

yaḥ ca ayamakṣaṇikānām krama yaugapadyābhyām artha kriyā pratiṣedhaḥ sa viśeṣa pratiṣedhasya avaśyam śeṣa abhyanujñāyām samarthaḥ iti prakāra antareṇa artha kriyā prasaṅgaḥ na ca tat asattva grāhakam pramāṇam asti iti tathā paraspara ādhipatyena kārya janaka tva abhyupagamāt rūpa ādīnām ekaikam aneka rūpa ādeḥ yugapad kāraṇam iti abhyupagame yaugapadya pratiṣedhāt eva tad antarbhūtaḥ kramaḥ niṣiddhaḥ iti tasya sva śabdena punarvacanam punaruktam eva syāt tathā hi yathā rūpam yugapad rūpa rasa gandha sparśān ārabhate tathā rasa ādayaḥ api ekaika vivakṣāyām tatra eva kramaḥ iti ekasya eva pratiṣedhaḥ vācyaḥ na ca ekam ekasmāt eva utpadyate tadārabhate ca iti niyamaḥ sambhavati

na ca anyathā ekasya krameṇa aneka kārya janaka tvam pratikṣaṇam anya tva abhyupagamāt tasmāt sahakāri sadbhāve sati krama yaugapadyābhyām artha kriyā jananāt akṣaṇikānām na asattvam iti na api nānātvam iti sattvāt iti hetoḥ avyatirekaḥ na ca pakṣaḥ eva tasya vyatirekaḥ tasya rūpa antara tvāt yat ca idam akṣaṇika tvena virodhāt bhāvat ka pakṣaḥ eva akṣaṇika śaṅkā vyavaccheda siddhaḥ bādhakaḥ iti etat asat virodhi pratipattim antareṇa virodha pratipatteḥ ayogāt atha akṣaṇikaḥ tad virodhī pratīyate eva sa tarhi pratipatti rūpa artha kriyā kāri tvāt asat na bhavati iti katham asya asmāt vyatirekaḥ yadi ca akṣaṇika śaṅkā vyavacchedaḥ bādhakāt eva pratīyeta sattvāt iti hetoḥ vaiyarthyam syāt tasya api atad rūpa vyavaccheda viṣaya tvāt iti atha maulena hetunā kṣaṇika tvam eva sādhyate tat ca yadi sva lakṣaṇa ādi bhinnam katham anumāna paricchedyam tasya hi sāmānya viṣaya tvāt iti

na ca sattvāt iti hetoḥ sa pakṣa vipakṣābhyām anvaya vyatirekābhyām antareṇa gamaka tvam nyāyyam asādhāraṇasya api gamaka tva prasaṅgāt sarvasya ca pakṣa antarbhāvāt sa pakṣa vipakṣa abhāvaḥ eva atha kalpanā samāropita tvāt pakṣa ādi vyavasthāyāḥ kalpanā samāropite sa pakṣe anvayaḥ tad āropitaḥ eva vipakṣe vyatirekaḥ iti gamaka tvam evam tarhi kalpanā samāropita pakṣa ādi vyavasthā apekṣam kālpanikam anumānam iti avāstavam kṣaṇika tvam eva syāt

atha vināśasya nirhetuka tvena kṣaṇika tvam tat na nirhetuka tvasya api katipaya kāla avasthāyi tvena vināśe virodha abhāvāt na ca nirhetuka tvam yuktam bhāvaḥ iva abhāve api anvaya vyatirekābhyām hetoḥ vyāpāra upalambhāt atha mudgara ādi vyāpārāt kapāla santānasya utpādaḥ na tasya virodhi utpanna tvāt na ca kapāla santānaḥ tasya āvaraṇam iti prāk iva tad kāle api upalabhyeta āvaraṇa tve api tad vināśe tasya upalambhaḥ syāt na ca kapāla santānena ghaṭasya virodhaḥ tad kāraṇa tvāt kapālānām

atha artha antare vināśe bhāvasya upalambhaḥ iti uktam tat na tayoḥ saha avasthiti virodhāt tathā hi bhāve tu utpanne abhāvasya agrahaṇam tad kāle tu bhāvasya iti dṛṣṭam nanu evam ghaṭa kāle tad prāgabhāvasya vināśe tasya api anyaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ tasya api anyaḥ vināśaḥ iti anavasthā syāt tad bhāve api na doṣaḥ kārya niṣpatteḥ darśanāt iti kecid

anye tu anavasthāyām kila kāryasya parisamāptiḥ na syāt iti ghaṭa tad prāgabhāva vināśayoḥ ekaḥ eva prāc abhāvaḥ iti manyante guravaḥ tu ghaṭa kāle tad prāgabhāvasya anupalabdheḥ saḥ eva tasya pratiṣedhaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ tu ghaṭasya iti tayoḥ saha avasthiti virodhāt iti bruvate atha abhāvasya artha antara tva aviśeṣāt tasmin upajāte sarveṣām anupalambhaḥ svāt na tasmin utpanne kasyacid anupalambhena tayoḥ eva virodha siddheḥ yathā artha antara tva aviśeṣe api kiñcid eva kāraṇam kasyacid eva kāryasya hetuḥ na tu sarvasya iti pratiniyamaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tadvat abhāvasya niyatena eva bhāvena virodhaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti adūṣaṇam etat

yat ca idam vināśasya kāraṇa apekṣitāyām avaśyambhāvaḥ na syāt iti vastre rāgasya iva sa apekṣi tvā avaśyambhāvi tvayoḥ virodhāt tat asat ekatra vyabhicāreṇa sarvatra tathā abhāvasya anupalabdheḥ tathā sa apekṣi tve api sa vitṛ graha nakṣatra tārāṇāñca udaya astamaya upalabdheḥ nirapekṣa tve ca udaya anantaram eva astamayaḥ syāt samarthasya upakṣepa ayogāt iti avaśyañcaḥ uditasya savituḥ astamayaḥ bhavati iti

atha uktam naṅkṣoḥ bhāvasya vināśa abhyupagame kim hetunā iti tatra vināśa ātmaka tva asambhavāt avaśyam naṅkṣoḥ vināśa yogyasya eva hetau sati vināśaḥ na gagana ādeḥ iti tathā sva kāraṇāt itthambhūtaḥ eva utpannaḥ bhāvaḥ yena asya avaśyam vināśa hetunā bhavitavyam iti atha tarhi kāraṇāt utpadyamāna tvāt abhāvasya bhāvāt aviśeṣa prasaṅgaḥ tat na svarūpa bhedasya upapatteḥ yathā hi kāraṇāt utpadyamānāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ parasparam svarūpa bhedāt bhidyante tathā abhāvaḥ api bhāvāt iti asti ca dravya ādi ṣaṣ lakṣaṇa ālakṣita tvam bhāva pāratantryeṇa gṛhyamāṇa tvam abhāvasya rūpam iti

atha utpattimat tvāt abhāvasya vināśe bhāva unmajjana prasaṅgaḥ iti uktam tat na sadbhāva dharma vilakṣaṇa tvāt abhāva dharmāṇām yathā ca anutpattimataḥ prāgabhāvasya vināśaḥ tathā utpattiḥ dharmiṇaḥ api vināśasya avināśaḥ iti na ca vināśa vināśe bhāva unmajjanam tasya atad rūpa tvāt atad kāraṇa tvāt ca tathā hi ghaṭa vināśa vināśaḥ na ghaṭa rūpaḥ na api tat kāraṇam iti katham tasya unmajjana prasaṅgaḥ na ca bhāvasya asattvam pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇaiḥ vyavasīyamāna tvāt tathā hi iha bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti jñānam indriya bhāva vyatireka anuvidhānāt indriya jam na ca nirviṣayaḥ ghaṭa abhāva viśiṣṭa bhū tala ālambana tvāt

atha ghaṭa vivikta bhū tala upalambhaḥ eva ghaṭa anupalambhaḥ na abhāvāt iti ced avyatireke tu ghaṭa avaṣṭabdhe api bhū tale syāt na asti iti jñānam tasmāt ghaṭa abhāva upalambhaḥ eva ghaṭasya anupalambhaḥ na upalambha abhāva mātram iti na ca vināśa anabhyupagame bhāvasya prāk iva paścāt api avasthānāt anupalambhaḥ ghaṭate atha kṣaṇa sthāyi tvāt eva dvitīya kṣaṇe tasya anavasthānam iti tarhi saḥ eva tasya abhāvaḥ yat sadbhāve dvitīya kṣaṇe tasya anupalambhaḥ iti anyathā hi indriyā ādeḥ tādavasthyāt vināśa abhāve nityasya anupalambhaḥ na syāt

yat ca idam na tasya kiñcid bhavati na bhavati eva kevalam iti unmatta bhāṣitam etat anutpanna vināśasya pūrvam api upalambhaḥ na syāt vinaṣṭa tvāt eva abhāvena ca avirodhe paścāt api avasthānam iti nitya tvam syāt tathā kṣaṇika tve sati anubhavituḥ vinaṣṭa tvāt anyasya smaraṇam na syāt na hi devadatta anubhūte arthe yajñadattasya smaraṇam iti

atha nānā santāneṣu kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya abhāvāt asmaraṇam ekaḥ ca santāne buddhīnām asti kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ iti āhita sakala pūrva vāsanākam kārya jñānam utpadyate iti kāraka anubhūte arthe tasya smaraṇam yuktam eva na etat evam kārya kāraṇa bhāve api nānā tvasya tādavasthyāt devadatta ādi santāneṣu iva katham syāt smaraṇam na ca santāna sadbhāve pramāṇam asti buddheḥ buddhi antara kārya tve pramāṇa abhāvāt

atha asti bodhāt bodha rūpa tā iti ced tathā hi bodha rūpam kāryam bodhāt eva bhavati yathā śuklāt śuklam ityādi nanu evam tarhi dhūmasya agni janya tvam na syāt samāna jātīyasya dhūma kṣaṇasya bhāvāt atha vilakṣaṇāt api agni kṣaṇāt dhūmasya utpattiḥ iṣyeta bodhasya api vilakṣaṇāt śarīra ādeḥ utpattiḥ bhaviṣyati iti na bodha antara sadbhāve pramāṇam asti atha kiñcid sadṛśa tayā agniḥ dhūmasya kāraṇam tadā jñāna utpattau śarīra ādau api samānam tathā kṛṣṇāt api śuklasya utpattiḥ bhavet kiñcid sādṛśya sadbhāvāt

atyanta samāna jātīyañca samanantara kāraṇam iti abhyupagamyamāne rūpa jñānāt eva rūpa jñānam rasa jñānāt eva rasa jñānam sukhāt eva sukham duḥkhāt eva duḥkham iti santān a ānantyam syāt na ca asti saṃvedanam iti atha eteṣām yugapada saṃvedanam ananubhūyamāna kṣaṇānām utpatteḥ tarhi tena vinā tasya anutpatteḥ tad santānaḥ api abhyupagantavyaḥ tathā ca sati tadā eva teṣām saṃvedanañca iti prāptam na ca etat asti tasmāt na sarvam jñānam jñāna antara janyam iti pratibandhaḥ asti

na ca vināśasya avyatirekāt anubhavasya avasthāne smaraṇam yuktam atha dvitīya kṣaṇe tasya anubhavasya abhāvāt anavasthānam iti ced na avyatireke hi tena avirodhāt avasthānam eva vyatireke tu saha avasthiti virodha abhyupagame asmad darśana anupraveśaḥ tasmāt smaraṇam avasthitam ātmānam prasādhayati iti na ca kṣaṇika tve sati kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ ghaṭate tathā ca yadā eva kāryasya utpādaḥ tadā eva kāraṇasya vināśaḥ sa ca utpādāt na bhidyate iti abhyupagame saha utpannayoḥ na syāt kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ savya itarayoḥ viṣāṇayoḥ iva vinaśyat avasthañca kāraṇam iṣṭam vaiśeṣikaiḥ vināśasya hetumat tvāt

nirhetuka vināśa vādināñca bhāva vināśa vyatirekeṇa vinaśyat avasthānam sambhavati eva tasya vināśa kāraṇa sākalya rūpa tvāt na api sva saṃvid vādinaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāva grahaṇam asti kāraṇa saṃvidaḥ sva ātmani eva paryavasānāt tathā kārya saṃvidaḥ api iti na kāraṇa jñānam kārya sattām anubhavati tad sattā kāle tasya atīta tvāt na ca jñāna antaram ekam kāraṇa sattā kāle kārya sattām tad abhāve ca asattām vijānāti iti atha kārya kāraṇa jñānābhyām vāsanā krameṇa asti vikalpa jñānam kārya kāraṇa bhāva grāhakam iti ced tasya api etad rūpa samāropa tva abhyupagame apramāṇa tvena kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya asiddhiḥ eva tathā hi yat yatra samāropyate tat tatra avāstavam eva yathā śaṅkhe pīta ādiḥ iti

atha pūrva upalabdha anusandhānam vikalpam iti ced evam tarhi kārya kāraṇa bhāva grahaṇam vinā na vāsanā tad abhāvāt tad adhyavasāya vikalpaḥ katham bhaviṣyati iti anubhava anurūpa tvāt vāsanāyāḥ na ca bodhāt anyā vāsanā sambhavati iti ukta pūrvam tasmāt avasthitam pratisandhā tāram antareṇa tu kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya agrahaṇam eva iti ayantu kṣaṇa bhaṅgaḥ asmad gurubhiḥ vistareṇa nirastaḥ iti na iha pratanyate tat evam akṣaṇika tve satya āśraya āśrayi bhāvasya upapattau satyām etat pariśeṣāt vijñānasya ātma āśrita tvam iti

tathā *pravṛtti nivṛttibhyām* ātmā jñāyate kiṃviśiṣṭābhyām *śarīra sama vāyinībhyām hita ahita prāpti parihāra yogyābhyām* iti hitam sukham ahitam duḥkham tayoḥ prāpti parihārau tad yogyābhyām tat samarthābhyām iti vyāpti pratipādana artham āha *ratha karmaṇā* sārathiḥ rathasya adhiṣṭhātā tadvat ātmā vigrahasya śarīrasya adhiṣṭhātā anumīyate tathā hi jīvat śarīram prayatna vat adhiṣṭhitam jīvat śarīra samavāyi hita ahita prāpti parihāra samartha pravṛtti nivṛtti āśraya tvāt ratha vat pravṛtti nivṛtti āśraya tvam vāyu ādau vyabhicarati iti hita ahita prāpti parihāra samartha padam tathā śākhāyantra nipīḍitasya prāṇinaḥ śākhā akarma ahita nivartakam adhastanasya phala ādi prāpteḥ hita prāpakañca iti tad artham śarīra samavāyi padam tathā api nadī srotaḥ patita śava karmaṇā vyabhicāraḥ tat api adhastanasya śunaḥ tad upayogāt sukham bhakṣyate iti sukha prāpakam upariṣṭāt ca snānam kurvataḥ tapasvinaḥ durgandha tayā duḥkham janayati iti tat nivartakañcā iti tad artham jīvat śarīra padam

nanu evam api idam viśeṣaṇam vipakṣāt iva sa pakṣa ādeḥ api ratha ādeḥ nirvṛttim darśayati iti asādhāraṇa tvam eva syāt na hi rathe jīvat śarīra samaveta kriyā āśraya tvam asti atha jīvat śarīra samavāyi hita ahita prāpti parihāra yogyā kriyā prayatna vat kāryā viśiṣṭa kriyā tvāt ratha kriyā vat iti iha api na sa viśeṣaṇasya hetoḥ sa pakṣa sadbhāvaḥ tathā suptasya nauvā ārūḍhasya yathā ukta viśeṣaṇa kriyāḥ abhipretena prāpti hetuḥ ahitena nivṛtti hetuḥ ca na ca prayatna vat kārya iti vyabhicāraḥ tasmāt icchā anuvidhāyi kriyā āśraya tvam hetuḥ iti tathā hi jīvat śarīram prayatna vat adhiṣṭhitam icchā anuvidhāyi kriyā āśraya tvāt ratha vat kriyā vā prayatna vat kāryā icchā anuvidhāyi kriyā tvāt ratha kriyāvat

tathā *prāṇa ādibhiḥ ca iti* prāṇa apāna nimeṣa unmeṣa jīvana manaḥ gati indriya antara vikārāḥ sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatnāḥ ca ātma liṅgāni iti sūtram darśayati atha ātmanā sārdham anupalabdheḥ katham eṣām gamaka tvam iti āha *śarīra parigṛhīte vāyau vikṛta karma darśanāt bhastrā ādhmāpayitā iva* anumīyate iti vyāpti pratipādanam etat prayogaḥ tu jīvat śarīram prayatna vat adhiṣṭhitam jīvat śarīra parigṛhīta vikṛta vāyu āśraya tvāt bhastrāvat vāyu āśraya tvam anyeṣām api asti iti vikṛta grahaṇam vikāraḥ tu tiryak gati śīlasya vāyoḥ yat etat ūrdhvam adhas ca gamanam tathā api vāyuḥ vāyu antareṇa pratihataḥ ūrdhvam gacchati iti parigṛhīta padam tathā hi antar suṣira vṛkṣe chidra pradeśena praviṣṭasya vāyoḥ ūrdhvam adhas ca gamanam sambhavati iti śarīra padam tathā api śuṣka anubaddha śarīre praviṣṭasya vikāraḥ sambhavati iti jīva grahaṇam

nanu evam api jīvat śarīra parigṛhīta vikṛta vāyu āśraya tvam bhastrā ādeḥ na sambhavati iti sādhana vikalatā prasaṅgaḥ tat na bhastrā sādharmyāt bhastrā śabdena mahiṣī śarīrasya vivakṣita tvāt upacāreṇa yathā hi bhastrā dhmāpyate prayatnavatā tathā mahiṣī śarīram iti dṛṣṭam atas sādhya sādhana adhikaraṇa tvam yat vā jīvat śarīra parigṛhīta vikṛtaḥ vāyuḥ prayatna vat adhiṣṭhitaḥ jīvat śarīra parigṛhīta vikṛta vāyu tvāt bhastrā parigṛhīta vikṛta vāyu vat yathā ukta vikṛta vāyu karma prayatna vat kāryam yathā uktasya vāyoḥ vikṛta karma tvāt bhastrā parigṛhīta vikṛta vāyu karma vat

tathā *nimeṣa unmeṣa karmaṇā niyatena * iti na vāta doṣāt utpannena *dāru yantra prayoktā iva* ātmā anumīyate iti vyāpti pratipādanam etat yathā hi prayatnavatā adhiṣṭhitasya dāru yantrasya nimeṣa unmeṣa karma tathā jīvat śarīrasya api iti akṣi pakṣmaṇoḥ saṃyoga artham karma nimeṣaḥ unmeṣaḥ tu tad vibhāga artham iti tathā hi jīvat śarīram prayatna vat adhiṣṭhitam nimeṣa unmeṣa karma ādhārasya avayavi tvāt dāru yantra vat akṣi pakṣmaṇī tu nimeṣa unmeṣa karma ādhāra tvāt dāru yantra akṣi pakṣma vat nimeṣa unmeṣa karmaṇī vā prayatna vat kārye nimeṣa unmeṣa karma tvāt dāru yantra nimeṣa unmeṣa karma vat

tathā *dehasya vṛddhi kṣata bhagna saṃrohaṇa ādi nimitta tvāt gṛhapatiḥ iva* ātmā anumīyate iti vyāpti pratipādanam eva vṛddhiḥ avayava upacayaḥ kṣatasya śastra ādi sambandhāt bhagnasya vā avayavasya saṃrohaṇam loka prasiddham vyaḥ tañca etat vivakṣitam sāmastye hi vyavacchedya abhāvāt tathā jīvat śarīram prayatna vat adhiṣṭhitam vṛddhi nimitta tvāt kṣata bhagna saṃrohaṇa ādi nimitta tvāt ca gṛha vat ādi śabdena keśa ādeḥ udbhavanam puruṣa guṇa pūrvakam vyākhyeyam gṛhe alaṅkāra viśeṣa vat anyathā hi mṛta avasthāyām api etat syāt na ca etat asti tathā vṛddhi kṣata bhagna saṃrohaṇāni prayatna vat kāryāṇi tad rūpa tvāt gṛha gata vṛkṣa ādi vat

nanu sarvam etat anaikāntikam acetaneṣu vṛkṣa ādiṣu upalambhāt tathā ca pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ pratyagātmani dṛṣṭa tvāt paratra anumānam iti sūtreṇa icchā anuvidhāyi kriyā paratra cetane pratīyate iti ucyate tathā hi sva ātmani viśiṣṭa pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ cetana kārya tvena upalambhāt anyatra upalambhane tad kārya tvam yuktam tad abhāvaḥ tu vṛkṣa ādau

yat ca idam pāda prasāraṇa ādi tat ayasaḥ ayaskānta abhisarpaṇa vat vastu svābhāvyāt bhaviṣyati iti āgamaḥ tu sulabha tvāt upacāreṇa api vyākhyātum śakyataḥ eva iti anaikāntika tvam eva atha tad adhiṣṭhāyakasya sadbhāvāt na anaikāntika tvam iti ced na tasya loṣṭa ādiṣu api sadbhāvena vṛddhi kṣata bhagna saṃrohaṇa ādi prasaṅgāt

tat etat sarvam asāmpratam vṛkṣa ādeḥ api pakṣa antarbhāvāt na ca sādhyena eva sādhanasya vyabhicāraḥ na api sūtra vyāghātaḥ tatra api pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ sadbhāvāt tathā ca dravya sannidhāne ca pāda prasāraṇam na vastu svābhāvyāt śarīre api tad bhāva prasaṅgāt niyata dravya abhilāṣaḥ ca vṛkṣāyurvede paripaṭhitaḥ teṣām jñāyate tad upabhoge puṣpa ādi darśanāt āgamasya ca aupacārika tvam ayuktam mukhye bādhaka anupapatteḥ iti alam atha vālukā ādi nicayeṣu prayatnam vinā api vṛddheḥ upalambhāt vyabhicāraḥ na īśvara prayatnasya tatra api sadbhāva abhyupagamāt tasya api pakṣe antarbhāvāt śarīra vat puruṣa guṇa pūrvaka tvam sadhanīyam iti

tathā * abhimata viṣaya prāhaka karaṇa sambandha nimittena manaḥ karmaṇā gṛha koṇeṣu pelaka prerakaḥ iva dārakaḥ * ātmā anumīyate iti vyāpti pratipādanam eva yathā hi gṛhe dārakaḥ pailakaḥ saṃkrīḍamānaḥ hasta sthita pelakena madhyastha pelakam abhihatya pelaka antareṇa sambandhayati tadvat ātmā api śarīre manasā cakṣuḥ ādikam abhihatya viṣayaiḥ saṃyojayati iti tathā ca abhimataḥ ca asau viṣayaḥ ca rūpa ādiḥ tat gṛhṇāti iti tad grāhakam tat ca grahaṇam cakṣuḥ ādi tena saha sambandhaḥ tad nimittena manaḥ karmaṇā jñāyate prayogaḥ tu jīvat śarīram a prayala vat adhiṣṭhitam abhimata viṣaya prāhaka karaṇa ādhāra tvāt

gṛha vat manaḥ vā prayatna preryam abhimata viṣaya grāhaka karaṇa sambandhi tvāt hasta sthita pelaka vat manaḥ karma vā prayatna vat kāryam a abhimata viṣaya prāhaka karaṇa sambandhi karma svāt hasta sthita pelaka karma vat manasaḥ vā cakṣuḥ ādi sambandhaḥ prayatna vat kāryaḥ abhimata viṣaya grāhaka karaṇa sambandha tvāt pailaka antara sambandhi sambandha vat cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ vā prabala vat prayāḥ abhimata viṣaya grāhaka karaṇa tvāt pelaka antara vat viṣaya sambandhaḥ vā prayala vat kāryaḥ abhimata viṣaya grāhaka karaṇa sambandhi sambandha tvāt koṇa sthita pelaka sambandha vat

tathā * nayana viṣaya ālocana anantaram rasa anusmṛti krameṇa rasana vikriyā darśanāt aneka gavākṣa antargata prekṣaka vat upayaśī kaścid ekaḥ vijñāyate iti vyāpti pratipādanam eva tathā hi yena rūpa ādi viśiṣṭa rasa avinābhāvitayā upalabdha tasya nayana viṣaya ālocana anantaram iti nayanasya viṣayaḥ rūpam tatra ālocanāt vijñānam tad ananta smavinābhūte rase anusmṛtiḥ bhavati tad krameṇa rasana vikriyā iti rasa anusmaraṇa anantaram ssa buddhiḥ tatas prayatne sati manasi kriyā prabandhāt rasanā indriya sambandhaḥ tasmāt radana antargata udaka saṃplava lakṣaṇaḥ vikāraḥ sampadyate iti utpatti kramaḥ

jñaptikramaḥ tu rasanā indriya vikārān manaḥ sambandhaḥ tena api manasi kriyā prabandhaḥ anu mīyate tasmāt prayalaḥ tatas bhīnchā tayā ca smaraṇam tatas saṃskāraḥ tasmāt cā nubhavaḥ tena anubhavena anubhavitā iti atra tu mama iti pratisaṃdhānam sarvatra upalabdham iti eka kartṛka tvam niścīyate bhinna kartṛkeṣu mama iti pratisandhāna vyāvṛtteḥ na hi devadatta ādiṣu utpannāḥ smaraṇa ādayaḥ yajñadattena mama smaraṇam mama icchā iti saṃvedyante indriyāṇa an tu pratiniyata viṣaya tvāt sāhacaryā nupalabdhau indriya antareṇa upalabdhe arthe na syāt indriya antareṇa smaraṇam tad abhāvāt rasanā indriyasya vikāra asambhavaḥ eva syāt sa ca upalabdhaḥ iti ubhaya darśī ekaḥ jñāyate

atha śarīrasya eva cakṣūrasana adhiṣṭhāyaka tve rūpa rasayoḥ sāhacarya upalabdhau smaraṇam iti ced na tasya api anyatvāt tathā hi kuvalaya āmalaka bilva ādīnām iva parimāṇa bhedasya śarīre sadbhāvāt anya tvam na hi anya parimāṇe api avatiṣṭamāne parimāṇavati parimāṇa pratiṣedhāt uttara parimāṇena śakyam bhavitum iti parimāṇāni atha anupapatyā pūrva parimāṇa nivṛttiḥ sā ca āśraya vināśāt eva iti anya tvam na ca śarīrasya śarīra anta rārambhaka tvam ekasya ārambhaka tva pratiṣedhāt kārya kāraṇa virodhena sarveṣām upalambha prasaṅgāt atha avasthā bheda mātra na avasthāyinaḥ bhedaḥ iti ced tat na yadi avasthā parimāṇam tabhede tasya api avaśyam bhedaḥ atha avayava viśeṣaḥ tad vināśe api tad ā ārabdhasya vināśāt na api rūpa ādayaḥ teṣām api āśraya vināśena vināśāt na ca saṃyogi samavāyi vā dharma antara masti iti śarīrasya anya tvena smaraṇa ādi asambhavaḥ eva

atha buddhau kāraṇa vāsa nāsakrānti krameṇa smaraṇa utpattiḥ rasanā indriya vikāra sampadyate iti ced na kṣaṇika tve sati smaraṇasya pūrvam eva pratiṣedhāt tasmāt eka kartṛkāḥ smaraṇa icchā ādayaḥ mama iti pratisandhīyamāna tvāt vibhinna kartṛkeṣu pratisandhānāḥ bhāvaḥ eka kartṛkeṣu tu nartakī bhrū vikṣepe kṛta samayānām asti mama iti pratisandhānam

atha nityasya anupakāri tvāt ātmanaḥ kim anubhava ādyaiḥ kriyate iti ced na kiñcid anubhava ādeḥ eva upakāri tvāt tena hi satā anubhavitā smartā iti vyapadeśāt tad kāyam vā tasya upakāraḥ tathā ca anubhavena tasya saṃskāraḥ kriyate vena tu smaraṇa mupakāraḥ tena api sva kāryam iti uttarottaram abhyūhyam na ca anubhava ādeḥ āvirbhāva tiras bhāvābhyām anubhavituḥ tathā abhāvaḥ tad vyatirekāt atha vyatireke katham ātmanā unu bhava adiḥ na anyasya iti ced tena sambandhāt sambandhasya tu sambandha antara anapekṣasya api sambandhi niṣṭhasya upalabdhe pyanavasthā iti vakṣyāmaḥ

na ca anyasya anubhava utpāde anyasya anubhavitā iti vyapadeśaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ atha anubhava ādeḥ ātmanya tiśaya ādhāyaka tva asambhave vyapadeśa asambhavaḥ iti ced na asya eva atiśaya tvāt tad prāga bhāvaḥ ca anatiśayaḥ nivartate iti kāraka sākalī añca atiśayaḥ tava aikalī añcān atiśayaḥ iti ukta pūrvam na ca avyatireke atiśayaḥ sambhāvyate iti alam ati vistareṇa

tathā pūrva uktaḥ * sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatnaḥ ca guṇaiḥ guṇyanumīyate tathā hi sukha ādayaḥ kvacid āśritāḥ guṇa tvāt rūpa ādi vat atha śarīra indriya guṇāḥ bhaviṣyanti iti atas āha * te ca na śarīra indriya guṇāḥ kasmāt iti āha * ahaṅkāreṇaka vākya tva abhāvāt * iti aham pratyayena asamāna adhikaraṇa tvāt vijñāma vat ye tu śarora indriya guṇāḥ te ahaṅkāreṇa samāna adhikaraṇāḥ na bhavanti rūpa ādayaḥ iti

atha rūpavān aham iti pratyaya darśanāt yuktam eva tat na mukhya bādhaka sadbhāvena asya gauṇa tvāt tathā ca na aham a iti pratyaya ālambana tvam pūrvam eva uktam iti śarīra guṇe rupacaritam eva sāmānādhikaraṇyam smaraṇa jñānena tu sāmānādhikaraṇyam aaham smatā iti dṛṣṭam na ca smaraṇam śarīre samavetam iti uktam itas ca na śarīra indriya guṇāḥ sukha ādayaḥ * pradeśa vṛtti tvāt viśeṣa guṇāḥ ca āśraya vyāpakāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ iti śarīra viśeṣa guṇa pratiṣedhe sādhye na saṃyoga ādibhiḥ anekāntaḥ teṣām api ca pakṣa tvāt tathā na śarīra indriya viśeṣa guṇāḥ sukha ādayaḥ yā at ravya abhāvi tvāt * śabda vat ye tu tad viśeṣa guṇāḥ te yāvat davya bhāvinaḥ rūpa ādayaḥ iti na ca pārthiva paramāṇu rūpa ādibhiḥ vyabhicāraḥ

teṣām api sādhya adhikaraṇa tayā sa pakṣa tvāt tathā hi śarīra indriya viśeṣa guṇa pratiṣedhe sādhye te api saṃyoga ādi vat tad viśeṣa guṇāḥ na bhavanti iti sa pakṣāḥ eva itas api na śarīra indriya viśeṣa guṇāḥ sukha ādayaḥ * bāhya indriya apratyakṣa tvāt * vijñāna vat ye tu tad viśeṣa muṇāḥ te bāhya indriya pratyakṣāḥ rūpākṣyaḥ iti guru tva ādīmāntu bāha undriya apratyakṣa tve api na śarīra indriya viśeṣa guṇavam iti vyabhicāra abhāvaḥ māhondhiya pratiṣedhena ca antaḥkaraṇa pratyakṣa tvam vivakṣitam iti tathā śarīra viśeṣa guṇāḥ ca pratyakṣāḥ na ca evam sukha ādayaḥ iti atha triguṇa ātmaka tvāt sarva sukha duḥkha ādi samambitam iti na ātma viśeṣa guṇa tvam na triguṇa ātmaka tva pratiṣedhasya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt pradhāna pratiṣedha avasare
