atha pratyakṣeṇa eva hasta pustaka vibhāga sama kālam śarīrasya api tena vibhāga upalabdheḥ karma eva asamavāyi kāraṇam iti kalpyate na āśu bhāvi tvena utpala patra śata vyatibheda vat pratyakṣa abhimānasya bhrānta tvāt yathā hi yugapad utpala patra śatam vyatibhinnam iti pratyakṣa jñānam grāhiṇa anumānena bādhyamāna tvāt apramāṇam evam tatra api hasta vibhāga sama kālam śarīrasya api tena vibhāgaḥ iti yaugapadya jñānam anumāna bādhita tvāt apramāṇam kim anumānam iti ced

avayava karmaṇaḥ vibhinna āśraya tvam tathā hi vivakṣita avayava karma sva āśraya vyatirikta ādhāra samavetam eva vibhāgam na ārabhate karma tvāt ubhaya abhimata karma vat na ca anuṣṇaḥ agniḥ kṛtaka tvāt iti anumāna vat pratyakṣeṇa asya virodhaḥ pañca rūpa tvāt tathā hi duṣṭam anumānam pratyakṣeṇa sva viṣaya sahakāriṇā bādhyate duṣṭañca pratyakṣam anumānena iti tasmāt anumānasya ābādhita viṣaya tvāt vibhāge api āśu bhauvi tvena yaugapadya grahaṇam na artha tathā bhāvāt iti dṛṣṭaḥ ca aneka kṣaṇa śata vyavadhāne api āśu bhauvi tvam bhrama nimittam utpala patra śata vyatibhede kim punar eka kṣaṇa vyavadhāne kṣaṇa dvaya vyavadhāne vā iti

tathā hi kāraṇa akāraṇa vibhāgāt saṃyoga vināśe sati kārya akārya vibhāga abhyupagamāt eka kṣaṇa vyavadhānam kāraṇa vibhāga pūrvakasya tu vibhāgasya saṃyoga vināśe dravya vināśe ca anantaram bhavanam iti kṣaṇa dvaya vyavadhānam utpala patra avayaveṣu tu vegavat sūcī ādi sambandhāt karma utpattau vibhāgāt saṃyoga vināśe sati patra vināśaḥ punar patra antare sambandhāt avayava karma utpattiḥ iti ayam kramaḥ patra śate api ūhyaḥ iti aneka kṣaṇa śata vyavadhāne api āśubhau i tvasya bhrama nimitta tva abhyupagamāt eka kṣaṇa vyavadhāne tu bhaviṣyati eva tasmāt āśu bhāvi tvena yaugapadya abhimānasya bhrānta tvāt kāraṇa akāraṇa vibhāgāḥ kārya akārya vibhāgān ārabhante iti

*tad anantaram* kārya akārya vibhāga anantaram prāktana saṃyoga vināśe sati kāraṇa akāraṇa saṃyogaḥ ca kārya akārya saṃyogān ārabhante na pūrvam prāktana saṃyogasya pratibandhakasya avasthānāt idantu cira utpannānām saṃyoga ja saṃyogasya pūrvam pratijñātasya vibhāga ja vibhāga anantara bhāvi tvāt samāna upāya tayā ca atra eva nirūpaṇam iti

atha śarīrasya ākāśa ādinā vibhāgaḥ saṃyogaḥ ca iti kim pramāṇam anumānam tathā hi śarīram sva kāraṇa vibhāginā vibhajate tad vibhāgi kāraṇa kārya tvāt vīraṇa vibhāgi tantu kārya paṭa vat ākāśa ādi vā sva vibhāgi kāraṇa kāryeṇa vibhajate tad kāraṇa vibhāgi tvāt tantu vibhāgi vīraṇa vat evam śarīram sva kāraṇa saṃyoginā saṃyujyate tad saṃyukta kāraṇa kārya tvāt vīraṇa saṃyukta tantu kārya paṭa vat siddhe tu śarīra ākāśa ādi saṃyoge śarīrasya tasmin kāle niṣkriya tvāt avayava kriyāyāḥ ca sattvena āśraya antareṇa eva samaveta kārya janaka tva pratiṣedhāt asamavāyikāraṇañca vinā bhāvasya utpatteḥ adarśanāt anyasya ca asambhave sati kāraṇa akāraṇa saṃyogāt tasya utpattiḥ kalpyate iti śarīra ākāśa ādi samavāyi kāraṇam viśiṣṭā ca diś nimitta kāraṇam iti

evam nirṇīte vibhāga ja vibhāge pūrva pakṣa vādī asat dūṣaṇam āha *yadi kāraṇa vibhāga anantaram kārya vibhāga utpattiḥ kāraṇa saṃyogāt ca anantaram kārya saṃyoga utpattiḥ* na sama kālam *nanu evam avayava avayavinoḥ yuta siddhi doṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti* na yuktam etat kutas *yuta siddhi aparijñānāt* na pareṇa yuta siddhiḥ vijñātā yatas evamāha iti tathā hi paraspara saṃyoga vibhāga yogya tā yuta siddhiḥ avayavānām hi padārtha antaraiḥ saṃyoga vibhāga yogya tā tathā avayavinaḥ sambhavati eva na tu parasparam iti avyabhicāraḥ sambhave vā yuta siddhiḥ eva iti na samavāyaḥ syāt asti ca asau iti vakṣyāmaḥ

idantu sāmānya lakṣaṇam yuta siddheḥ viśeṣa lakṣaṇāt labhyate eva viśeṣasya sāmānya vyāpta tvāt iti viśeṣa lakṣaṇam āha *sā punar dvayoḥ anyatarasya vā pṛthak gatimat tvam* iti iyam nityānām yuta siddhiḥ dvayoḥ paramāṇvoḥ pṛthak gatimat tvam yuta siddhiḥ ākāśa paramāṇvoḥ ca anyatarasya pṛthak gatimat tvam iti tat ca parasparam saṃyoga vibhāga janana yogya tvam vivakṣitam anyathā hi dvi aṇuka ārambhakayoḥ paramāṇvaḥ rdvi aṇuke vrajati gamana upalabdheḥ dvi aṇukena saha yuta siddhiḥ syāt

anityānāntu yuteṣu pṛthak bhūteṣu āśrayeṣu samavāyaḥ yuta siddhiḥ iti nanu evam api avayava avayavinoḥ yuta āśraya samavāyāt yuta siddhiḥ syāt tathā hi avayavī avayaveṣu vartate avayavāḥ ca sva avayaveṣu iti yuta āśraya samavāyaḥ na abhiprāya aparijñānāt yathā ghaṭa tad āśraya vyatirekeṇa āśraya antare samavāyaḥ paṭasya paṭa tat āśraya vyatirekeṇa ghaṭasya na evam avayavinaḥ avayava vyatirekeṇa āśraya antare samavāyaḥ tasmāt na yuta siddhiḥ atra api dvayoḥ yuta āśraya samavāyi tvam anyatarasya vā iti anuvartate dvayoḥ yathā ghaṭa paṭayoḥ anyatarasya yathā ākāśa ghaṭayoḥ anyatarasya ghaṭasya yuteṣu āśrayeṣu asamavāyaḥ na ākāśasya anāśrita tvāt

nanu evam tarhi nityeṣu iva anityeṣu api pṛthak gatimat tvasya sambhavāt sā eva astu kṛtam yuta āśraya samavāyi tvena avyāpinā na etat evam anityeṣu pṛthak gatimat tvasya anvaya vyatireka abhāvāt yuta āśraya samavāyi tvam eva tad sadbhāvāt sā eva yuta siddhiḥ iti āha *tvac indriya śarīrayoḥ pṛthak gatimat tvam nāsti* yuteṣu tu samavāyaḥ asti iti *paraspareṇa saṃyogaḥ siddhaḥ* tathā hi tvac indriya śarīra yoḥ āmaraṇam vibhāga anupapatteḥ pṛthak gati mat tva abhāve api paraspareṇa saṃyoga prasiddheḥ yuta āśraya samavāyi tvam eva yuta siddhiḥ tayoḥ itaretara āśraya parihāreṇa sva āśrayeṣu eva samavāyāt evam utpanna mātrasya ghaṭa ādeḥ gati mat tva abhāve api rūpa ādi utpatti sama kālam ākāśa ādinā saṃyoga upalabdheḥ anyatarasya yuta āśraya samavāyi tvam eva yuta siddhiḥ nityānāntu yuta āśraya samavāya abhāve api saṃyoga vibhāga upalabdheḥ pṛthak gatimat tvam eva yuta siddhiḥ iti āha *aṇu ākāśayoḥ tu* yuta āśraya samavāyi tva abhāve api *anyatarasya pṛthak gatimat tvāt saṃyoga vibhāgau siddhau* iti

evam anityānām yuta āśraya samavāyi tvasya nityānāntu pṛthak gatimat tvasya anvaya upadarśana antaram vyatirekam āha *tantu paṭayoḥ anityayoḥ āśraya antara abhāvāt parasparataḥ saṃyoga vibhāga abhāvaḥ iti* yadi api tantavaḥ aṃśuṣu vartante tathā api paṭa dravye na tantu vyatirekeṇa āśraya antaram asti iti yuta āśraya samavāyi tva abhāvaḥ tad abhāvāt na paraspareṇa saṃyoga vibhāgau iti viśiṣṭañca pṛthak gatimat tvasya ghaṭa paramāṇu oḥ tu ubhaya sambhavāt ubhaya avarodhaḥ anyatara avarodhaḥ vā iti ubhaya avarodhaḥ iva anyatara avarodhe viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt tathā hi nitye paramāṇau pṛthak gatimat tvam anitye tu ghaṭe yuta āśraya samavāyi tvam ubhaya urubhayatra anvaya vyatirekābhyām samarthanāt atra sambhavena grahaṇam nyāyyam yatra ca anityam eva tatra pṛthak gatimat tva sadbhāve api yuta āśraya samavāyi tvasya avarodhaḥ yathā ghaṭa ākāśayoḥ dvayoḥ vā ghaṭayoḥ iti alam ati vistareṇa tasmāt kāraṇa vibhāga anantaram kārya vibhāgaḥ kāraṇa saṃyoga antaram kārya saṃyogaḥ yuta siddhiḥ iti aparijñāta yuta siddheḥ vacanam iti

atha idānīm vināśam āha *vināśaḥ tu sarvasya vibhāgasya kṣaṇika tva at* ityādinā nanu kṣaṇika tvam āśutara vināśi tvam tat ca vibhāgasya vināśe sādhye sādhyāt na viśiṣyate na vyavahārasya sādhya tvāt tathā hi vibhāgaḥ vināśī iti vyavahartavyaḥ kṣaṇika tvāt yat vā kṣaṇika tvam āśutara vināśa kāraṇa saṃyogi tvam tasmāt vibhāgasya vināśe sādhye na sādhya aviśiṣṭa tā atha kim tat vināśa kāraṇam uttara saṃyogaḥ katham *uttara saṃyoga avadhi sadbhāvāt* uttara saṃyogaḥ eva avadhiḥ sīmā sadbhāve yasya iti uttara saṃyogam yāvat sadbhāvaḥ tad anantaram abhāvaḥ iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām upalabdham *na tu saṃyogavat* asya vināśaḥ iti yathā hi yayoḥ eva saṃyogaḥ tayoḥ eva vibhāgāt saṃyogasya vināśaḥ na evam *yayoḥ eva vibhāgaḥ tayoḥ eva saṃyogāt* vibhāgasya vināśaḥ kim tarhi tayoḥ anyena vā sva kāraṇa karma jaḥ tad saṃyoga jaḥ vā saṃyogaḥ astu tasmāt vinaśyati iti

atha saṃyogasya vibhāga mātrāt avināśa vat vibhāgasya api saṃyoga mātreṇa avināśaḥ kim iti na iṣyate iti āha *saṃyukta pratyaya vat vibhakta pratyaya anuvṛtti abhāvāt* asya vināśa prasaṅgāt yathā hi saṃyoge vibhāga mātra utpāde saṃyukta pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ saṃyukta saṃyuktam iti dṛṣṭā na evam vibhāgasya saṃyoga mātra utpāde vibhakta pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ asti *tasmāt uttara saṃyoga avadhi sadbhāvāt kṣaṇikaḥ* iti upasaṃhāraḥ

anye na tu saṃyoga vat avasthitaḥ vibhāgaḥ kasmāt yayoḥ eva saṃyogāt asya vināśa prasaṅgāt yathā hi avasthitaḥ saṃyogaḥ tayoḥ eva vibhāgāt nivartate vibhāgaḥ api evam tayoḥ eva saṃyogāt nivarteta iṣyate eva iti ced tat asat saṃyukta pratyaya vat vibhakta pratyaya anuvṛtti abhāvāt na hi artha antareṇa vibhāge saṃyukta pratyaya anuvṛtti vat artha antareṇa saṃyoge vibhakta pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ asti iti yat ca aprāpti jñānam tat bādhaka sadbhāvāt saṃyoga abhāve draṣṭavyam iti anyathā hi piṇḍasya deśa antara gamane maraṇe vā avasthita tvāt eka piṇḍa grahaṇe api grahaṇam syāt na ca etat asti tasmāt vidyamāna kriye dravye vibhakta pratyayaḥ mukhyaḥ anyadā tu tad sāmānyāt bhāktaḥ iti

evam saṃyogāt vibhāgasya vināśam pratipādya āśraya vināśena vināśam āha *kvacit ca āśraya vināśāt vinaśyati* ityādinā katham iti avyutpanna praśna anantaram āha *yadā dvi tantuka kāraṇa avayave aṃśau* ityādi dvi tantukasya kāraṇam tantuḥ tasya avayavaḥ aṃśuḥ tasmin sva kāraṇāt karma utpannam yadā aṃśvantarāt vibhāgam ārabhate tasmin eva kāle *tantu antare api karma utpadyate vibhāgāt ca tantu ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tantu karmaṇā tantu antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate* iti anayoḥ ekaḥ kālaḥ *tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt* tantu saṃyogasya dvi tantuka ārambhakasya vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle tantu ārambhakasya aṃśu saṃyogasya vināśāt tantu vināśaḥ *tasmin vinaṣṭe tad āśritasya tantu antara vibhāgasya vināśaḥ* anyasya vināśa kāraṇasya abhāvāt tadā eva dvi tantukasya api āśraya vināśāt saṃyoga vināśāt ca vināśaḥ iti

evam āśraya vināśāt vināśe abhihite aniṣṭam upapādayati *evam tarhi uttara vibhāga anutpatti prasaṅga* iti uttara vibhāgaḥ tantoḥ ākāśa ādi deśena vibhāgaḥ tasya anutpattiḥ *kāraṇa vibhāga abhāvāt* kāraṇayoḥ tantvoḥ vibhāgaḥ yat vā kāraṇañca tat vibhāgaḥ ca tasya dravya vināśa sama kālam abhāvāt ākāśa deśena vibhāgasya anutpattiḥ na ca saṃyoga vināśam apekṣya dravya vināśa sama kālam kāraṇa vibhāgasya vibhāga ārambhaka tvam vinaśyat avasthasya asamavāyi kāraṇa tva anabhyupagamāt yathā aśruta granthe vācā udyam etat

tatas ca tantoḥ ākāśa ādi deśena vibhāga anutpāde tad saṃyogasya pratibandhakasya avasthānāt na karma uttara saṃyogam kuryāt iti āha *pradeśa antara saṃyogavati saṃyoga abhāvaḥ* iti atas pradeśa antara saṃyogasya virodhi guṇasya asambhavāt karmaṇaḥ kāla antara avasthāyi tvam tasya ca kṣaṇika tvam pramāṇa siddham iti vyāghātaḥ tathā nitya dravya samavetasya karmaṇaḥ nitya tvam iti doṣaḥ katham iti āha *yadā dvi aṇuka ārambhaka paramāṇau* sva kāraṇāt karma utpannam aṇu antarāt vibhāgam dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhinam ārabhate *tadā eva aṇu antare api* anārambhake karma utpadyate tatas anantaram *yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt* dravya ārambhaka saṃyogasya vināśaḥ tadā eva anārambha kāṇu karmaṇā *dvi aṇukāṇvoḥ vibhāgaḥ kriyate

tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāga at* dvi aṇukasya aṇunā *saṃyogasya vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle* saṃyogasya dravya ārambhakasya vināśāt *dvi aṇukasya vināśaḥ* tasmin dvi aṇuke vinaṣṭe *tad āśritasya dvi aṇuka aṇu vibhāgasya vināśaḥ* tatas kāraṇa vibhāga abhāvāt uttara vibhāga anutpattau tad saṃyogasya avyāvṛtteḥ na karma uttara saṃyogam karoti iti virodhi guṇasya asambhavāt paramāṇu samavetasya karmaṇaḥ nitya tvam syāt iti prāktana codyasya pratisamādhānam āha *tantu aṃśu antara vibhāgāt vibhāgaḥ iti adoṣaḥ*

nanu tantu aṃśu vibhāgaḥ tantu kriyā kāryaḥ na bhavati eva aṃśoḥ dvi tantuka utpattau ākāśa ādi vat akāraṇa tvāt na api aṃśu kriyā kāryaḥ tantu utpattau tantu antarasya ākāśa vat eva akāraṇa tvāt kāraṇe ca utpannam karma kāraṇa antara vibhāga sama kāla kāraṇena vibhāgam na ārabhate viśiṣṭa vibhāga anutpatti prasaṅgāt iti uktam na ca kāraṇam vinā kāryam bhavati iti tantu aṃśu vibhāga asambhavaḥ eva na etat evam aṃśukriyā janitāt vibhāgāt tasya utpatti abhyupagamāt tathā hi

aṃśu kriyā janitaḥ vibhāgaḥ saṃyoga vināśa viśiṣṭam kālam apekṣya tantu vināśa sama kālam ākāśa ādi deśena iva tantu antareṇa api vibhāgam ārabhate tantu vināśa viśiṣṭañca apekṣya dvi tantuka vināśa sama kālañca āśraya vināśāt tantvoḥ eva parasparam vibhāgaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ na tantu antara vibhāgaḥ aṃśukriyā janitāt vibhāgāt utpannaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ iti ekasmāt tantu antara vibhāgāt uttaraḥ vibhāgaḥ tantu ākāśa ādi vibhāgaḥ jāyate *aṅgulī ākāśa vibhāgāt śarīra ākāśa vibhāgavat* iti udāharaṇam yathā aṅguli ākāśa ādi vibhāgāt hasta ākāśa vibhāgaḥ tasmāt ca vibhāgāt śarīra ākāśa vibhāgaḥ tadvat iha api aṃśu kriyā janitāt vibhāgāt tantu aṃśu vibhāgaḥ tasmāt ca vibhāgāt tantu ākāśa vibhāgaḥ jāyate iti tasmin utpanne prāktana saṃyogasya pratibandhakasya abhāvāt karma uttara saṃyogam kṛtvā tasmāt vinaśyati iti na kāla antara avasthāyi tvam doṣaḥ

nanu etasmin pakṣe katham uttara saṃyogāt tantu ākāśa ādi vibhāgasya nivṛttiḥ tantu karmaṇā pāramparyeṇa api ajanita tvāt na vibhāga janite vibhāge niyama anupalabdheḥ anye tu tantau utpannā kriyā tantu antareṇa iva tad ārambhakeṇa aṃśunā api vibhāgam karoti eva pāramparyeṇa aṃśoḥ api kāraṇa tvāt ākāśa ādiḥ ca pāramparyeṇa api dvi tantuka utpattau akāraṇam iti tantu kriyā avayava antara vibhāga sama kālam na tena vibhāgam karoti iti yat vai aṃśu kriyā aṃśvantara ādi vat tantu antareṇa api vibhāgam ārabhate aṃśu kāryeṇa saha eva kārya ārambhaka tvāt atas ca āśraya vināśāt tantvoḥ eva vibhāgaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ na tu tantu antara vibhāgaḥ tasmāt tantu ākāśa ādi vibhāgaḥ jāyate aṅguli ākāśa ādi vibhāgāt śarīra ākāśa ādi vibhāga vat

nanu aṅgulī ākāśa vibhāgāt hasta ākāśa vibhāgaḥ kāraṇa akāraṇa vibhāgasya kārya akārya vibhāga ārambhaka tvāt na tu aṅguleḥ śarīram kāryam iti atas yadi api aṅguli ākāśa vibhāgasya śarīra ākāśa vibhāgena saha ākāśa vṛtti tvāt pratyāsattiḥ asti tathā api akāraṇa tvam eva tasmāt śarīra ārambhaka tvāt upacāreṇa hastaḥ eva śarīram iti yuktam etāvat ca udāharaṇam yathā aṅgulī ākāśa vibhāgāt kāraṇa akāraṇa vibhāgāt hasta ākāśa vibhāgaḥ tathā tantu aṃśu vibhāgāt tantu ākāśa vibhāgaḥ iti

*atha vā* iti vibhāgasya āśraya vināśena vināśe prakāra antara upanyāsaḥ na tu prakṛta ākṣepa samādhānam kāla antara avasthāyini dravye karmaṇaḥ kāla antara avasthāyitva udbhāvanāt atas *aṃśvantara vibhāga utpatti sama kālam tasmin eva tantau* vibhajyamāna aṃśau karma utpadyate tatas anantaram aṃśu vibhāgāt *tantu ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tantu karmaṇā ca tantu antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas saṃyoga vināśāt tantu vināśaḥ* tantu antara vibhāgāt ca tad saṃyoga vināśaḥ tatas dvi tantukasya ubhaya vināśāt vināśaḥ tantu vināśāt ca *tad ā āśritayoḥ vibhāga karmaṇoḥ yugapad vināśaḥ* iti

atha nitya dravya samavetasya nitya tvam syāt iti ākṣepa pratisamādhāna dvārakam vākyam *tantu vīraṇayoḥ vā* ityādi yathā hi tantu vīraṇayoḥ saṃyoge sati dravya anutpattiḥ vijātīya tvāt evam dvi aṇukāṇvoḥ api saṃyogāt dravyam na utpadyate tathā hi eka dvi aṇukam anityam anyaḥ ca paramāṇuḥ nityam iti vijātīya tvam vijātīya saṃyogaḥ ca dravya anārambhakaḥ iti dvi aṇukāṇvoḥ saṃyoge api dravya anutpattau paramāṇau utpannam karma dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhi vibhāga anutpādaka tvāt ākāśa dideśena api vibhāgam ārabhate vīraṇa karma vat evam prāktana saṃyoga nivṛttau uttara saṃyogam kṛtvā vinaśyati iti *pūrva uktena vidhānena* vināśaḥ

yat vā pūrva ukta vidhānena iti ayam arthaḥ tantu ārambhake aṃśau karma utpatti sama kālam vīraṇe api karma aṃśu karmaṇā ca aṃśvantarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate vīraṇa karmaṇā ca tantu antarāt iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas vibhāgāt aṃśu saṃyoga vināśe vīraṇa vibhāgāt ca vīraṇa tantu saṃyoga vināśaḥ tatas dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśāt tantu vināśaḥ tantu vīraṇa saṃyoga vināśe ca uttara saṃyogaḥ tatas ca āśraya vināśa saṃyogābhyām tantu vīraṇa vibhāga vināśaḥ iti

anye tu vā śabdasya upama artha tvāt tantu vīraṇayoḥ iva dvi aṇukāṇvoḥ saṃyoge sati dravyam na utpadyate dravya anutpattau ca dvi aṇukā aṇu vibhāgasya paramāṇu karmaṇā dvi aṇuka ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśa sama kālam janitasya katham vināśaḥ pūrva uktena vidhānena iti āśraya vināśena iti arthaḥ yadā tu paramāṇau karma utpattau paramāṇu antara vibhāga utpatti sama kālam asmin eva dvi aṇuke karma sañcintanam tadā pūrva uktena vidhānena āśraya vināśāt vibhāga karmaṇoḥ yugapad vināśaḥ iti dvi aṇuka ārambhake ca paramāṇau karma utpatti sama kālam anārambhake api karma sañcintanāt tad āśraya vināśa saṃyogābhyām tantu vīraṇa vibhāga vināśa vat vināśaḥ iti alam

idānīm paratva aparatvayoḥ lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham *paratvam* ityādi prakaraṇam abhidhānañca pratyayaḥ ca iti tayoḥ nimittam *paratvam aparatvañca* iti ukte ati prasaṅgaḥ tad artham parāpara grahaṇam tathā api para apara abhidhāna pratyaya nimitta tvam ākāśa ātmanoḥ na vyāvṛttam iti viśeṣaṇa tve satī iti ūhyam tathā sāmānyam api viśeṣaṇa tve sati para apara abhidhāna pratyaya nimittam atas dravya grahaṇam tathā hi paratva aparatve anyasmāt bhidyate dravya viśeṣaṇa tve sati para apara abhidhāna pratyaya nimitta tvāt yaḥ tu itarāt na bhidyate na ca asau evam yathā rūpa ādiḥ iti vyavahāraḥ vā sādhyaḥ atra ca abhidhāna padena saṃkhyā ādi lakṣaṇeṣu api karaṇa vyutpattyā abhidhānam bhāva vyutpattyā ca jñānam iti ubhaya rūpaḥ vyavahāraḥ pratyayaḥ ca vivakṣitaḥ iti jñāpayati ekasmin ca prakaraṇe guṇa dvaya nirūpaṇam eka utpatteḥ itaropāya āpekṣika tvāt pṛthak abhidhāne tu grantha bahu tvam syāt iti saṅgraha tvāt ekadā abhidhānam

paratva aparatvayoḥ sadbhāve kim pramāṇam iti apekṣāyām paratvam aparatvañca para apara abhidhāna pratyaya nimittam iti vākyam parīkṣā paratvena ca yojanīyam tathā hi para apara abhidhāna pratyayaḥ viśeṣaṇa pūrvakaḥ viśeṣya abhidhāna pratyaya tvāt daṇḍī iti viśeṣya abhidhāna pratyaya vat na ca rūpa ādīnām anyatamam viśeṣaṇam tad vyavahāra vilakṣaṇa tvāt abādhyamānañca jñānam nimittam vinā na sambhavati eva vāsanā tu nimittam tatra na bhavati iti uktam atha dravyam eva viśiṣṭa utpāda vaśāt parāpara vyavahāra janakam tat na kṣaṇika tva pratiṣedhāt abhyupagamena tu ucyate viśiṣṭa tāyāḥ vyatireka abhyupagame viśiṣṭa vyavahāra janaka tve ca saṃjñā bheda mātram avyatireketu samāna deśa avasthita piṇḍhe samāna vayasi ca parāpara vyavahāraḥ syāt dravya sadbhāvasya aviśeṣāt atas para apara vyavahāre rūpa ādi vilakṣaṇam nimittam asti iti jñātam

tat dvividham kāraṇa bhedāt iti āha *dikkṛtam kāla kṛtañca* iti nanu diś kālayoḥ sarva utpattimatām nimitti kāraṇa tva abhidhānāt viśeṣa abhidhānā sambhavaḥ eva na diś kāla piṇḍa saṃyogayoḥ tad śabda vācya tvena tad kṛta tva upapatteḥ dikpiṇḍa saṃyoga kṛtam dikkṛtam kāla piṇḍa saṃyoga kṛtañca kāla kṛtam iti tathā anayoḥ parasparam bhedam āha *tatra diś kṛtam deśa viśeṣa pratyāyakam* iti deśa viśeṣaḥ pratyāyakaḥ asya iti deśe viśeṣam vā pratyāyayati iti kāla kṛtāt bhidyate * kāla kṛtañca vayaḥ bheda pratyāyakam* iti vayaḥ bhedaḥ pratyāyakaḥ yasya iti vayaḥ bheda pratyāyakam vayaḥ bhedam vā pratyāyayati iti diś kṛtāt bhidyate

*tatra dikkṛtasya utpattiḥ abhidhīyate* *katham* iti avyutpanna praśna anantaram āha *ekasyām diśi avasthitayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ* ityādi piṇḍayoḥ iti samavāyi kāraṇa nirdeśaḥ ekasyām diśi avasthitayoḥ na vibhinna diśi avasthitayoḥ iti niyama pratipādanam *saṃyukta saṃyoga bahu alpa bhāve sati* iti bhū pradeśān adhikṛtya etat saṃyuktena saha saṃyogāḥ teṣām bahu alpa bhāvaḥ iti ekasmin piṇḍe saṃyukta saṃyoga alpīyaḥ tvam anyasmin tatas bahu tvam tasmin sati *ekasya draṣṭuḥ* na vibhinnasya *sannikṛṣṭam avadhim kṛtvā etasmāt viprakṛṣṭaḥ ayam iti paratva ādhāre* utpatsyamāna paratve *buddhiḥ utpadyate tām apekṣya pareṇa diś pradeśena saṃyogāt *paratva utpattiḥ iti diś pradeśayoḥ para apara vyapadeśaḥ tad sampādaka tvāt upacāreṇa

viprakṛṣṭañca piṇḍam avadhim kṛtvā itarasmin piṇḍa saṃyukta saṃyoga alpīyaḥ tvāt nimittāt sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tām sannikṛṣṭām buddhim apekṣya apareṇa diś pradeśena yogāt paratva utpattiḥ iti piṇḍaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam diś piṇḍa saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam viśiṣṭā ca buddhiḥ nimitta kāraṇam iti nanu ca atra sannikṛṣṭam avadhim kṛtvā viprakṛṣṭe buddhiḥ viprakṛṣṭañca avadhim kṛtvā sannikṛṣṭe buddhiḥ iti viprakṛṣṭa sannikṛṣṭa buddhyoḥ paraspara apekṣi tvāt ubhaya abhāva prasaṅgaḥ tat na nirvikalpaka jñāne pratibhātasya avadhi tvena abhyupagamāt tathā hi sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭayoḥ pratyakṣeṇa eva nirvikalpaka avabhāse sati etasmāt ayam sannikṛṣṭaḥ viprakṛṣṭaḥ ca iti sa vikalpakam jñānam bhavati eva

anye tu nirvikalpa avabhāsa janita saṃskāra ja smṛti upasthāpitayoḥ sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭayoḥ paraspara avadhibhāvaḥ ghaṭataḥ iti bruvate tasmāt na paraspara apekṣita tvāt ubhaya abhāvaḥ iti sthitam kāla kṛtayoḥ api paratva aparatvayoḥ katham utpattiḥ iti āha *vartamāna kālayoḥ* ityādi vartamānaḥ kālaḥ yayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ tau ca tathā uktau tayoḥ iti ubhayatra api diś kāla kṛta paratva aparatvayoḥ utpattau niyamaḥ *a niyata diś deśayoḥ* iti na niyataḥ diś deśaḥ yayoḥ tau tathā uktau tayoḥ iti kāla kṛtayoḥ utpattau aniyama upadarśanam *yuvasthavirayoḥ* iti vayaḥ bheda upadarśana artham samāna vayasi para apara vyavahāra adarśanāt *rūḍha śmaśru kārkaśyavali palita ādi sānnidhye sati* rūḍha śmaśru ca kārkaśyañca valayaḥ ca palitāni ca tāni ādiḥ yeṣām tāni tathā uktāni teṣām sānnidhye sati iti rūḍha śmaśru kārka śyā ādi sānnidhyam sannikṛṣṭa buddheḥ kāraṇam

valī palita ādi sānnidhyañca viprakṛṣṭa buddheḥ iti *ekasya draṣṭuḥ* iti yaḥ hi draṣṭā paratva aparatve draṣṭum abhivāñchati tasya *yuvānam avadhim kṛtvā sthavire viprakṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate* tām viprakṛṣṭām buddhim apekṣya pareṇa kāla pradeśena yogāt paratvasya utpattiḥ iti viprakṛṣṭañca sthaviram avadhim kṛtvā yūni etasmāt sthavira āt ayam sannikṛṣṭaḥ iti sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate *tām apekṣya apareṇa kāla pradeśena saṃyogāt aparatvasya utpattiḥ iti* sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa piṇḍayoḥ samavāyi kāraṇa tvam kāla piṇḍayoḥ saṃyogasya ca asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa buddhyoḥ ca nimitta kāraṇa tvam iti

nanu ca ayuktam etat āhāra upayoge sati pākaja utpatti nyāyena ekasmin ahani upajāta tva aviśeṣeṇa sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa buddhyoḥ abhāvāt paratva aparatvayoḥ asambhavaḥ na etat evam janmanaḥ prabhṛti ekasyām śarīra santatau āditya parivartana apekṣayā tad upapatteḥ tathā hi ekasya januḥ prabhṛti bhūyāṃsi āditya parivartanāni aparasya alpīyāṃsi iti tad apekṣayā sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa buddhyoḥ bhāvaḥ sthavire bhūyāṃsi āditya parivartanāni iti viprakṛṣṭa buddhiḥ yūni ca alpīyāṃsi iti sannikṛṣṭa buddhiḥ tad apekṣayā paratva aparatvayoḥ utpattiḥ iti śarīra santānasya āditya parivartana apekṣayā ghaṭataḥ eva etat dikkṛta paratva aparatva vailakṣaṇī añca anayoḥ nimitta antarā sambhave sati kāla kṛta tvam iṣṭam na hi tasmāt eva nimittāt vyatikaraḥ sambhavati iti

tat evam paratva aparatvayoḥ utpāde vyavasthite sūtreṇa abhisambandha upadarśanañca tathā ca sūtram eka dikkā ālābhyām sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭābhyām parama parañcaḥ iti ekā diś kālaḥ ca yayoḥ tau tathā uktau tābhyām iti samavāyi kāraṇa nirdeśaḥ eka digbhyām iti diś kṛta paratva aparatva apekṣayā eva niyamaḥ eka kālābhyām varttamāna kālābhyām ubhayatra api iti na hi asadbhyām sat asat bhyāñca paratva aparatve jāyate sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭābhyām iti samavāyi kāraṇa upasarjana tayā sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa buddhyoḥ nimitta kāraṇa tvam uktam eva tathā hi parama parañca iti buddhi apekṣam iti apekṣā śabdaḥ ca atra kāraṇe varttate iti kāraṇa para tvāt kāraṇa apara tvāt ca paratva aparatve iti asamavāyi kāraṇam darśayati nanu ca kāraṇa para tvāt kāraṇa apara tvāt ca yadi kārye paratva aparatve bhavataḥ tarhi rūpa ādi vat cira utpanna tvāt sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa buddhim vinā api samāne deśe samāne vayasi ca piṇḍe tayoḥ grahaṇam syāt na ca etat asti atha anabhivyaktitaḥ anupalabdhiḥ

tat na sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa buddhi ādi sadbhāve ca idānīm utpanna mātrasya api grahaṇam upapadyate eva tasmāt diś piṇḍa saṃyogaḥ kāla piṇḍa saṃyogaḥ ca paratva aparatva sampādaka tvāt upacāreṇa paratva aparatve iti abhidhīyate na ca paratva aparatvayoḥ paraspara apekṣita tvāt asambaddham utpatti ādi nirūpaṇam iti vācyam sarvatra paraspara apekṣita tva anupalabdheḥ tathā hi na bīja aṅkurayoḥ paraspara apekṣi tvam bīja vināśe sati kāla antare dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa aṅkurasya utpatteḥ evam aṅkura vināśe sati uttarottara kāryāṇām pūrva pūrva vināśe sati bhāvāt na aṅkurāt bījam iti paraspara apekṣi tva abhāvaḥ tathā pitṛ putrayoḥ dharma śarīrayoḥ ca na paraspara apekṣi tvam yatas eva upalabdhiḥ tad kāraṇa tva anupalabdheḥ kārya antare tu kāraṇa tvam na pratiṣidhyate iti alam ati prasaṅgena

tat evam paratva aparatvayoḥ utpattimat tvāt avaśyam vināśaḥ iti tasya sa hetuka tvāt kāraṇam vācyam iti āha *vināśaḥ tu apekṣā buddhi saṃyoga dravya vināśa at* iti tredhā tritaya vināśāt ca aparaḥ pakṣaḥ iti saptadhā vināśaḥ tatra apekṣā buddhi vināśāt tāvat vināśam āha *utpanne paratve* sva kāraṇāt viśeṣaṇa tvāt pūrvam tad saṃyukta samaveta samavāyāt sāmānya buddhiḥ utpadyate sā ca yasmin kāle samutpannā bhavati tadā eva tad sāmānya jñānāt *apekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyattā* vināśa kāraṇa sānnidhyam *sāmānya tad jñāna tad sambandhebhyaḥ paratva guṇa buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā* utpatti kāraṇa sānnidhyam iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas apekṣā buddheḥ vināśaḥ guṇa jñānasya utpādaḥ apekṣā buddhi vināśāt guṇasya vinaśyattā sāmānya jñānasya vinaśyattā guṇāḥ ca tat jñānañca tad sambandhaḥ ca iti tebhyaḥ dravya buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas dravya buddheḥ utpattiḥ apekṣā buddhi vināśāt guṇasya ca vināśaḥ anyasya vināśa kāraṇasya anupalabdheḥ

saṃyoga vināśāt api katham vināśaḥ iti avyutpanna praśna anantaram āha *apekṣā buddhi sama kālam eva paratva aparatva ādhāre karma utpadyate* vibhāga paratva aparatvayoḥ utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas *tena karmaṇā diś piṇḍa vibhāgaḥ kriyate* paratvasya ca utpattiḥ sāmānya buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā diś piṇḍa saṃyogasya vinaśyattā *tataḥ sāmānya buddheḥ utpattiḥ dikpiṇḍa saṃyogasya ca vināśaḥ* sāmānya jñānāt apekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyattā guṇa buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā saṃyoga vināśāt guṇasya vinaśyattā *tatas yasmin kāle guṇa buddhiḥ utpadyate tasmin eva kāle* diś piṇḍa saṃyogasya asamavāyi kāraṇasya vināśāt *guṇasya* paratvasya vināśaḥ

dravya vināśāt api katham vināśaḥ iti āha *paratva ādhāra avayave karma utpannam* yasmin kāle avayava antara vibhāgam dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhinam ārabhate saṃyogasya vinaśyattā tasmin eva kāle sva kāraṇāt apekṣā buddhiḥ utpadyate paratvasya utpadyamāna tā vibhāgāt yasmin kāle saṃyogasya dravya ārambhakasya vināśaḥ dravyasya vinaśyattā tasmin eva kāle paratvam utpadyate tad sāmānya jñānasya utpadyamāna tā tatas saṃyoga vināśāt dravya vināśaḥ sāmānya jñānasya utpādaḥ apekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyattā paratva guṇasya api vinaśyattā tatas dravya vināśāt tad āśritasya guṇasya vināśaḥ sāmānya jñānāt apekṣā buddheḥ ca vināśaḥ iti pūrva kāla tvāt āśraya vināśaḥ eva guṇa vināśe kāraṇam iti

dravya apekṣā buddhyoḥ yugapad vināśāt api katham paratva aparatvayoḥ vināśaḥ tat āha *yadā* paratva ādhārasya utpatsyamāna paratvasya avayave karma utpadyate vibhāgasya utpadyamāna tā tadā eva apekṣā buddhiḥ utpadyate paratvasya utpadyamāna tā karmaṇā ca avayava antarāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhi vibhāgaḥ saṃyogasya vinaśyattā paratvasya utpattiḥ tad sāmānya jñānasya utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ *tatas yasmin eva kāle* vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ dravyasya vinaśyattā *tasmin eva kāle sāmānya buddhiḥ utpadyate* apekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyattā *tad anantaram saṃyoga vināśāt dravya vināśaḥ sāmānya buddheḥ ca apekṣā buddhi vināśaḥ* guṇasya vinaśyatta iti ekaḥ kālaḥ *tatas dravya apekṣā buddhyoḥ vināśāt* tad āśritasya *paratvasya vināśaḥ* iti ekaikasya anyatra guṇa vināśe sāmarthya avadhāraṇāt ubhayoḥ atra pūrva kāla bhāvi tve sati kāraṇa tvam niścīyate

dravya saṃyoga vināśāt api katham paratva aparatvayoḥ vināśaḥ iti āha *yadā* paratva ādhāra avayave karma utpannam avayava antarāt vibhāgam karoti saṃyogasya vinaśyattā tasmin eva kāle piṇḍe api samavāyi kāraṇe karma ca apekṣā buddhiḥ ca sva kāraṇāt tayoḥ yugapad utpattiḥ diś piṇḍa vibhāga paratva aparatvayoḥ utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas yasmin eva kāle paratvam utpadyate tad sāmānya jñānasya utpadyamāna tā tasmin eva kāle avayava vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ dravyasya vinaśyattā piṇḍa karmaṇā ca diś piṇḍa vibhāgaḥ kriyate saṃyogasya vinaśyatta iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas yasmin eva kāle sāmānya buddhiḥ utpadyate guṇa buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā apekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyattā tad sama kālam saṃyoga vināśāt piṇḍa vināśaḥ vibhāgāt ca diś piṇḍa saṃyoga vināśaḥ guṇasya vinaśyattā tatas guṇa buddhi sama kālam piṇḍa saṃyogayoḥ vināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ sāmānya buddheḥ ca apekṣā buddhi vināśaḥ iti atas eva sama kāla tvāt apekṣā buddhi vināśaḥ na kāraṇam piṇḍa saṃyoga vināśayoḥ ca anyatra sāmarthya avadhāraṇe sati pūrva kāla bhāvi tvāt kāraṇa tvam iti

saṃyoga apekṣā buddhyoḥ yugapad vināśāt api katham vināśaḥ iti āha *yadā paratvam utpadyate* sva kāraṇa paratva sāmānya jñānasya utpadyamāna tā *tadā paratva ādhāre* sva kāraṇāt karma vibhāgasya utpadyamāna tā *tatas yasmin eva kāle paratva sāmānya buddhiḥ utpadyate* guṇa buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā apekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyattā *tasmin eva kāle piṇḍa karmaṇā diś piṇḍa vibhāgaḥ kriyate* tad saṃyogasya vinaśyattā *tataḥ sāmānya buddhitaḥ apekṣā buddhi vināśaḥ vibhāgāt ca diś piṇḍa saṃyoga vināśaḥ* guṇasya vinaśyatta iti ekaḥ kālaḥ *tatas saṃyoga apekṣā buddhyoḥ vināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ* iti

trayāṇām samavāyi asamavāyi nimittānām yugapad vināśāt api katham vināśaḥ iti āha *yadā apekṣā buddhiḥ utpadyate* paratvasya utpadyamāna tā *tadā piṇḍa avayave karma* vibhāgasya utpadyamāna tā tatas yasmin eva kāle avayava antarāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhi vibhāgaḥ kriyate avayava karmaṇā saṃyogasya vinaśyattā paratvasya utpattiḥ tad sāmānya jñānasya utpadyamāna tā tasmin eva kāle sva kāraṇāt piṇḍe api karma vibhāgasya utpadyamāna tā tatas vibhāgāt piṇḍa ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ piṇḍasya vinaśyattā piṇḍa karmaṇā ca vibhāgaḥ kriyate diś piṇḍa saṃyogasya vinaśyattā sāmānya buddheḥ ca utpattiḥ apekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyattā guṇa buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas saṃyoga vināśāt piṇḍa vināśaḥ vibhāgāt ca diś piṇḍa saṃyoga vināśaḥ sāmānya jñānāt apekṣā buddheḥ vināśaḥ iti etat sarvam yugapad bhavati iti tatra trayāṇām samavāyi asamavāyi nimittānām vināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ iti anyatra hi vyastānām kāraṇa tva upalabdheḥ samuditānām atra sambhavāt guṇa vināśe kāraṇa tvam iti sambhāvyamāna aneka kāraṇa tva upanyāsaḥ

atha idānīm buddheḥ avasara prāptāyāḥ lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham *buddhiḥ upalabdhiḥ* ityādi prakaraṇam buddhiḥ iti padam āvarttyamānam lakṣya nirdeśaḥ lakṣaṇa nirdeśaḥ ca bhavati tathā hi buddhiḥ iti lakṣya nirdeśaḥ buddhiḥ upalabdhiḥ jñānam pratyayaḥ iti paryāyāḥ lakṣaṇam atha ākāśe paryāya śabda rūpa tvāt vartamānāḥ katham vyadhikaraṇa tvāt buddheḥ lakṣaṇam vācya vācaka bhāvena tad dharma tvāt lakṣaṇa vaicitrya jñāpana arthañca atra paryāya lakṣaṇa abhidhānam tathā hi na param asādhāraṇa tvāt kārya karaṇa ādi lakṣaṇam paryāya ātma kañca iti

atha śabdānām puruṣa icchā anuvidhāyitayā artha antare api vṛttiḥ sambhavati iti vyabhicāraḥ na anādi kāla pravāha āyāta tvena viśeṣita tvāt tathā hi buddhiḥ itarasmāt bhidyate anādi kāla pravāha āyāta ittham bhūta paryāya abhidheya tvāt yaḥ tu itarasmāt na bhidyate na ca asau evam yathā rūpa ādiḥ iti vyavahāraḥ vā sādhyaḥ nanu buddheḥ anye api paryāyāḥ vidyante iti tad parihāreṇa am īṣām eva lakṣaṇa tvena abhidhāne viśeṣa hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ sa ca ayam viśeṣaḥ atra eva vipratipatteḥ lakṣaṇa artham api idam vākyam sāmarthyāt tad nirāsa param bhavati iti

tathā ca sāṃkhyāḥ pradhānasya ādyaḥ vikāraḥ buddhiḥ bījasya ucchūnatā iva pradhānañca sattva rajaḥ tamasām sāmya avasthā tad vikāraḥ vaiṣamyam upalabdhiḥ tu sukha duḥkha ākāra pariṇatāyām buddhau ātmanaḥ pratibimba udayaḥ bhogaḥ tat āha vivikta dṛś pariṇataḥ buddhau bhogaḥ asya kathyate pratibimba udayaḥ svacche yathā candram asaḥ ambhasi iti

vivikta dṛś viṣaya ākāra pariṇata indriya ākāra pariṇatiḥ yasyāḥ sā tathā uktā tasyām buddhau satyām ātmanaḥ bhogaḥ kathyate kim rūpaḥ pratibimba udayaḥ na vāstavaḥ yathā candramasaḥ pratibimbanam svacche na kaluṣa ambhasi evam viśiṣṭa pariṇāma upacitāyām buddhau ātmanaḥ iti vāstave hi bhoge puruṣasya pūrva svarūpa nivṛttau svarūpa antara āpattiḥ vikāraḥ syāt tatra ca acetana tvāt aneka dūṣaṇam iti anye tu anyathā bhogam manyante yathā hi puruṣaḥ avikṛta ātmā eva sva nirbhāsena cetanam manaḥ karoti sānnidhyāt upādhi sphaṭikam yathā iti

sānnidhyāt upādhi sphaṭikam atad rūpam sva nirbhāsam su a ākāram karoti evam ayam puruṣaḥ avikṛta svarūpaḥ acetanam manaḥ sva nirbhāsam cetanam iva karoti sānnidhyāt na punarvastutas tasya caitanyam vikāri tvāt jñānantu viṣaya ākāra pariṇata indriya ākāratayā buddheḥ pariṇāmaḥ tadā bhoga utsukam puruṣam matvā buddheḥ ākūtiḥ sampadyate tad ākūta saṃvedanāt ca indriyāṇām pūrva svarūpa nivṛtteḥ viṣaya ākāra pariṇāmaḥ anyathā hi pūrvarūpa aparityāge prāk iva paścāt api viṣaya avabodhaḥ na syāt viṣaya ākāra pariṇāmaḥ ca pratikarma vyavasthātaḥ nīlasya idam pītasya idam iti jñeyam anyathā hi viṣaya ākāram vinā pariṇāmasya aviśeṣāt iyam vyavasthā na syāt evam viṣaya ākāra pariṇata indriyeṣu tad ākāratayā buddheḥ pariṇāmaḥ

tathā asiddhi ādi pratyayāḥ pañcāśat buddheḥ pariṇāma viśeṣāḥ eva aṣṭadhā siddhiḥ navadhā tuṣṭiḥ pañca viparyaya bhedāḥ tathā aśaktiḥ aṣṭāviṃśati dhetya siddhi tuṣṭyoḥ bhedāḥ saptadaśa ekādaśa indriya vadhāḥ ca iti pañcāśat bhavanti iti paryāya tvam buddhi ādi śabdānām na siddhāḥ vibhinna artha vācaka tvāt abhinna pravṛtti nimittāḥ ca eka artha vācakāḥ śabdāḥ paryāyāḥ iti

tat etat asāmpratam eṣām prayogataḥ paryāyata apratīteḥ tathā hi buddhaḥ upalabdhaḥ jñātaḥ pratītaḥ iti ekasmin arthe prayujyamānāḥ pratīyante vibhinna artha tā āyāntu upalabdhaḥ na buddhaḥ jñātaḥ na pratītaḥ iti saṃvedanam syāt na ca etat asti na ca pradhāna asattvasya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt tad vikārasya buddheḥ sadbhāvaḥ tad abhāvāt ātmani buddheḥ na bimbanam upalabdhiḥ tad pariṇāmaḥ vā jñānam pratyayaḥ ca iti yadi na vāstavaḥ bhogaḥ syāt na saṃsārya ātmanaḥ muktāt viśeṣaḥ sva niṣṭhāyāḥ citeḥ u bhayatra aviśeṣāt

na ca vyāpi tvā aviśeṣāt saṃsārya ātmanaḥ eva buddheḥ viśeṣeṇa sānnidhyāt pratibimbanam na itarasya iti vācyam bhogya bhoktṛ tva sambandhaḥ tu bhogasya āvāstava tvāt vicāryaḥ na ca karma eva niyāmakam tasya buddhyā sampādi tvāt tathā hi buddhyā sampāditam karma puruṣeṇa viśiṣṭa sambandha abhāvāt aśeṣa puruṣa upabhogyam syāt na ca buddheḥ karttṛ tvam acetana tvāt caitanyam hi pradhānam na kriyā karaṇe varttate iti karttṛ tvam hi svātantryam tatra karaṇa tvam pāratantryam na syāt svātantrya pāratantryoḥ vidhi pratiṣedha rūpa tvāt iti puruṣasya eva kartṛ tvam abhyupeyam na ca tasya pūrvam akṛtvā kurvataḥ pariṇāmi tvam kāraka sākalye kārya karaṇāt tad vaikalye ca akaraṇāt sākalya vaikalyayoḥ ca āvirbhāva tirobhāvābhyām na ātmanaḥ tathā abhāvaḥ tatas anya tvāt atas puruṣasya karttṛ tve yuktam vāstavam bhoktṛ tvam anyathā hi bhoga kriyām akurvataḥ katham udāsīnasya bhoktṛ tvam syāt bhogasya sukha duḥkha vedanā rūpa tvāt tad ādhāra tā tu bhoktṛ tvam iti

yat ca idam puruṣasya bhoga utsuka tām manyamānāyāḥ buddheḥ ākṛtiḥ sampadyate tad saṃvedanāt ca indriyāṇām iti asat etat acetana tvāt acetanā hi buddhiḥ tathā indriyāṇi teṣām ākūta saṃvedana abhāve katham niyataḥ viṣaya ākāra tayā pariṇāmaḥ puruṣasya tu cit rūpa tā vyatirekeṇa na aparā bhoga utsukatā asti yaḥ ca ayam indriyāṇām viṣaya ākāra pariṇāmaḥ tasya viṣaya ākāra tāyām na pratikarma vyavasthā pramāṇam tad antareṇa api tad bhāvāt iti vakṣyamāṇa nyāyāt yadi ca buddheḥ pūrvarūpa nivṛttau indriya ākāratayā pariṇāmaḥ tarhi svarūpasya avyatirekāt buddheḥ eva utpattiḥ nivṛttiḥ ca iti anya tve pratisandhāna ādi abhāvaḥ eva na hi ekena upalabdham artham anyaḥ pratisandhātum arhati iti pariṇāmāḥ tu buddheḥ tādātmyena vartante iti teṣām aneka tve buddheḥ api aneka tvam viparyaye tādātmya virahāt

yat api idam buddheḥ pariṇāma viśeṣāḥ pañcāśat pratyayāḥ tad abuddhi pūrvakam tad pariṇāma viśeṣānām ānantyāt na ca teṣām eṣu eva antarbhāvaḥ pratiniyata lakṣaṇa avarodhasya anupalabdheḥ iti alam ati prasaṅgena tat evam buddhi ādi paryāyāḥ para pakṣa vyudāse sati lakṣaṇam iṣyante iti sthite lakṣaṇena lakṣyamāṇasya eka aneka tva upalabdheḥ vipratipatteḥ ca saṃśaye sati tad nirāsa artham *sā ca aneka prakārā* iti vākyam kutas etat *artha ānantyāt pratyartha niyata tvāt ca

nanu ca artha ānantyam artha dharmaḥ iti vyadhikaraṇa tvam na anyathā tad upapatteḥ tathā hi buddheḥ artha ānantyam iti artha upadarśanam etat sādhanañca ananta artha tvāt iti arthaḥ anantaḥ yasyāḥ sā tathā uktā tasyāḥ bhāvaḥ ananta artha tvam iti arthaḥ tu arthyate anena iti kāraka sāmagryam na kāraka eka deśaḥ tad bhede api kāryasya abheda upalabdheḥ tathā hi aneka kāraka sampādyam ghaṭa ādi ekam dṛṣṭam iti sāmagrī tu pratikārya niyata tvāt na tad bhedam vyabhicarati iti atas aneka prakārāḥ buddhiḥ ananta artha tvāt ananta kāraka sāmagrī janya tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat iti yaḥ ca ekaḥ na ca asau ananta kāraka sāmagrī janyaḥ yathā ghaṭaḥ iti na tu karma vyutpattyai ananta karma kāraka janya tvam sādhanam vivakṣitam iti vyākhyeyam pratyartha niyata tvāt iti anena gata artha tvāt tathā hi artham artham prati niyatam yāvat bheda bhinnam karma kārakam tāvat bheda bhinnā buddhayaḥ iti buddhiḥ aneka prakārā pratyartha niyata tvāt ghrāṇa ādi vat

anye tu pūrvasmin eva vākye karma vyutpattyā ananta karma kāraka janya tvam sādhanam labhyate eva iti pratyartha niyata tvam pratyātma vṛtti tvam vivakṣitam iti manyante tathā hi arthate asmin ityātmā iti arthaḥ tam prati niyata tvam pratyātma vṛtti tvam eva sāmānyasya tu ananta ātma vṛtti tvāt na pratyātma niyata tvam asti iti sambhave api buddheḥ viśeṣa guṇa tvāt viśeṣa guṇa tve sati iti viśeṣaṇam abhyūhyam

anye tu rūpa jñānam rasa jñānam ityādi buddheḥ nānātvasya pratyakṣeṇa eva prasiddheḥ īśvara buddheḥ asmad buddheḥ ca paraspara bheda jñāpana artham artha anantyāt prati artha niyata tvāt ca iti pada dvayam iti bruvate tathā hi īśvara buddhiḥ ananta artha tvāt asmad buddheḥ bhidyate asmad buddhiḥ ca pratyartha niyata tvāt īśvara buddheḥ iti atra ca buddheḥ aneka tvam sāmānyena pratijñātam iti ayam viśeṣaḥ kutas labhyate iti cintyam

atha buddhi vyatirekeṇa arthasya sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt ayuktam artha ānantyam pratyartha niyata tvañca iti tathā hi vijñānam svayam prakāśa rūpa tvāt ātmānam prakāśayati arthāḥ tu jaḍa ātmānaḥ teṣām katham prakāśaḥ yadi jñānam pragṛhītam prakāśakamiṣyeta tasya api jñāna antareṇa grahaṇa abhyupagame jñāna paramparāyām upakṣīṇa tvāt abhipretasya arthasya aprakāśanam eva na ca pūrva jñāna agrahaṇe api arthasya eva grahaṇam iti vācyam teṣām āsanna tve sati grāhya lakṣaṇa prāpta tvāt tat āha tām grāhya lakṣaṇa prāptām āsannām janikām dhiyam agṛhītvā uttaram jñānam gṛhaṇīyāt aparam katham

atha agṛhītam eva artha prakāśakam evam tarhi santāna antara udbhūtānām api sarveṣām prakāśakam syāt yathā hi svasantatau upajātam ajñātam eva artha prakāśakam evam santāna antare api syāt aviśeṣāt atha sva samvedya svasantatau vijñānam artha prakāśakam evam tarhi bodha śarīrāt artha antarasya vastunaḥ aprakāśaḥ eva tathā hi yadi amī padārthāḥ prakāśa rūpāḥ katham bodhāt vyatiricyante bodhasya eva tad rūpa tvāt aprakāśa rūpa tayā ca sarvadā na prakāśaḥ syāt atas jñānam eva prakāśa svarūpa tvāt iti vyavahriyate prakāśa rūpa tayā hi sattvam vyāptam sā ca vyāvarttamānā bāhya arthebhyaḥ sva vyāptam sattvam gṛhītvā vyāvarttate iti asattvam bodha vyatirekiṇām na ca bodhasya bodha rūpa tayā sarvatra aviśeṣāt viśiṣṭa artha prakāśaka tvam syāt atha nīlasya idam pītasya idam iti pratikarma vyavasthātaḥ sa ākāram vijñānam iṣṭam tarhi vijñānam eva astu tad ākāra malam bāhya artha kalpanayā iti tat uktam dhiyaḥ nīla ādi rūpa tve bāhyaḥ arthaḥ kiṃnibandhanaḥ iti

tathā vijñāna kāle arthasya asadbhāvāt artha kāle tu jñānasya iti katham tayoḥ grāhya grāhaka bhāvaḥ sat asat rūpayoḥ tad abhāvāt ekasmin ca kāle dvayoḥ utpatti abhyupagame kim grāhyam kiñca grāhakam iti aviśeṣāt na ca vijñāna arthayoḥ sva ātmani eva paryavasāne artha adhīna tāyāḥ pratipattum aśakya tvāt grāhya grāhaka bhāvaḥ tathā avayavi pratiṣedha dvāreṇa rūpa ādi samudāya mātram tat ca samudīyamānebhyaḥ na artha antaram iti vyavasthāyām artha abhāvaḥ eva samudāyasya parama artha sattvena apratibhāsanāt ye tu parama artha santaḥ paramāṇavaḥ te asmad darśana viṣayāḥ na bhavanti eva atīndriya tvāt kāryañca aparama artha sattvāt pratibhāsamānam aliṅgam eva tasmāt anādi vāsanā vaśāt vijñāna aṃśaḥ eva grāhya grāhaka pravibhāgaḥ etat āha avibhāgaḥ api buddhi ātmā viparyāsita darśanaiḥ grāhya grāhaka saṃvitti bhedavān iva lakṣyate na tu paramārthataḥ tat āha na anyaḥ anubhāvyaḥ buddhyā asti tasyāḥ na anubhavaḥ aparaḥ grāhya grāhaka vaidhuryāt svayam sā eva prakāśate

nanu tarhi nīlam aham vedmi cakṣuṣā iti pratibhāsaḥ katham tathā hi nīlam iti karma aham iti kartā vedmi iti kriyā cakṣuṣā iti karaṇam eteṣām paraspara vyāvṛtta vapuṣām pratibhāsanāt abheda pratipādanam unmatta bhāṣitam na etat evam taimirikasya dvi candra darśana vadasya api upapatteḥ yathā hi taimirikasya artha abhāve api tat ākāram vijñānam udeti evam karma ādiṣu avidyamāneṣu api anādi vāsanā vaśāt tad ākāram vijñānam iti atha taimirikasya keśa ādi jñānam bādhyamāna tvāt nirviṣayam na ca evam etat tat asat bādhya bādhaka bhāvasya eva asambhavāt tathā hi na vijñānam arthena bādhyate pratīyamānā pratīyamānābhyām bādhya tve ati prasaṅgāt pratīyamānena hi bādhāyām sarvam vijñānam bādhyam syāt evam apratīyamānena api iti

atha jñānena eva jñānam bādhyate tatra api na vibhinna viṣayeṇa rūpa jñānena rasa ādi jñānasya api bādha prasaṅgāt samāna viṣaya tve tu sampādaka tvam eva syāt na bādhaka tvam na ca vijñānasya utpattiḥ vināśaḥ vā bādhāt sarvasya api tathā abhāva prasaṅgāt atha viṣaya antara upasarpaṇā mithyāpattiḥ bādhaḥ tat asat viṣayasya karma kāraka rūpa tvāt yatra utpadyate jñānam saḥ eva tasya viṣayaḥ iti viṣaya antara upasarpaṇam asiddham vijñāne bādhya bādhaka sadbhāvasya eva aprasiddheḥ na mithyājñānam asti iti na api saṃvidi samyak tvam pramāṇa abhāvāt

atha artha kriyā saṃvādaḥ pramāṇam na tatra api saṃvādaka apekṣāyām anavasthā prasaṅgāt saṃvāda kañca vinā na samyaktva siddhiḥ iti na ca artha kriyā api bodhāt bhidyate sarvasya api pratibhāsamānasya bodhāt avyatirekāt yathā uktam prakāśamānaḥ tādātmyāt svarūpasya prakāśakaḥ yathā prakāśaḥ abhimataḥ tathā dhīḥ a ātma vedinī iti

yadi ca padārthānām nijam sva rūpa ādi yathā ekasya pratibhāsaḥ tathā sarveṣām api iti visaṃvādaḥ na syāt na ca etat asti tathā hi mantra ādi upapluta akṣāṇām yathā mṛd śakala ādayaḥ anyathā eva avabhāsante tad rūpa rahitāḥ api iti atha ca upapluta cakṣuṣām anyathā pratibhāsaḥ tatas iti kim pramāṇam anupapluta cakṣuṣām tathā eva darśanam iti tat āha tathā eva darśanāt teṣām anupapluta cakṣuṣām dūre yathā vā maruṣu mahān alpaḥ api dṛśyate iti

avyavasthām eva uttara ardhena darśayati evam ekaśas buddhyā vicāryamāṇeṣu bhāveṣu rūpam na vyavatiṣṭhate yathā hi tantuṣu vicāryamāṇeṣu paṭasya avyavasthānam aṃśu vyatirekeṇa tantūnām ityādyūhyam katham tarhi śākyāḥ snāna ādi kriyāsu pravartante bāhya arthasya asattvāt iti loka vyavahāra anusāritayā yathā hi aparīkṣakāḥ bāhyam artham avidyā vaśāt pratipadyamānāḥ pravartante tadvat parīkṣakā api iti aloka vyavahāram prati sadṛśau bāla paṇḍitau a iti nyāyāt

tat etat asat artha viśeṣāt utpattim antareṇa buddhi viśeṣasya abhāva prasaṅgāt rūpa jñānam rasa jñānam ityādi parasparam vyāvṛtta svarūpāṇi jñānāni prathantaḥ iti artha viśeṣaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ atha vāsanā viśeṣāt vijñāna viśeṣaḥ tasyāḥ api viśiṣṭa jñāna janaka tve api jñānāt vyatireke ca saṃjñā bheda mātram avyatireke tu jñāna rūpa ubhayam sarvatra aviśiṣṭam iti rūpa jñānam rasa jñānam ityādi vaicitrya abhāvaḥ na ca ākāra viśeṣāt vijñāna viśeṣaḥ tasya api asambhavāt tathā hi jñāna mātrasya vāstava ākāra tāyām nīla ādi jñānam vāstava ākāra tvāt pramāṇam dvi candra ādi jñānañcau āḥ tava ākāra tvāt apramāṇam iti viśeṣa vyāghātaḥ vāstava ākāra tāyāḥ savatra aviśeṣāt atha āvāstava ākāram tathā api viśeṣa abhyupagama hāniḥ vādi prativādinoḥ ca jaya parājaya vyavasthā na syāt ubhayoḥ apramāṇena pravṛtteḥ aviśeṣāt

na ca avāstavasya vijñāna tādātmyam sat asat rūpayoḥ khara viṣāṇayoḥ ivā eka tva adarśanāt atas eva saha upalambha niyamāt abhedaḥ nīla tad dhiyoḥ iti eka tva sādhanam unmatta bhāṣitam asataḥ sat tādātmye sattvam asat tādātmye tu tad rūpa tvam iti tathā para prasiddhyā niyamena saha upalabhyamāna tvam bhedena eva vyāptam iti viruddham syāt atha sāhāyyam yaugapadyam vā vivakṣitam saha upalabhyamāna tvam tathā api tayoḥ bhedena eva vyāpta tvāt viruddha tvam tathā sarvajñaḥ sva cittena saha upalabhate para cittam na ca tasya tasmāt abhedaḥ iti vyabhicāraḥ sarveṣām sarvajña tā prasaṅgāt na ca ekasya eva upalambha niyamaḥ hetuḥ aśabda artha tvāt sādhya aviśiṣṭa tvāt ca tathā aneka rūpa ādi avayavasya hi tasya arthasya upalambhe svarūpa asiddhaḥ api iti

atha bāhya artha abhāvāt eka upalambha niyamaḥ tat na itaretara āśraya tva prasaṅgāt tathā ca eka upalambha niyamāt bāhya artha abhāva siddhiḥ tad siddheḥ ca eka upalambha niyama siddhiḥ iti eka abhāva āditara abhāvaḥ atha ekena eva upalabhyamāna tvam sādhanam na anya vedanā bhāvasya aprasiddheḥ arthaḥ tu tad samāna kṣaṇaiḥ anyaiḥ api upalabhyate iti ekena eva upalabhyamāna tvam asiddham sat candra asat candra dṛṣṭāntaḥ sat asatoḥ eka tva virodhāt sādhya vikalaḥ sādhana vikalaḥ ca asataḥ candrasya sattvena upalambha abhāvāt

tathā jñānam grāhaka svarūpam nīla ādi grāhya svarūpam iti anayoḥ śukla pītayoḥ iva svabhāva bhedāt bhedaḥ abhede hi bodhaḥ api nīlasya grāhyaḥ nīlañca bodhasya grāhakam iti syāt na ca etat asti kāraṇa bhedāt ca nīlāt bodhaḥ artha antaram tathā hi abodhāt bodha rūpa tā a aindriyāt viṣaya pratiniyamaḥ a aviṣayāt ākāra grahaṇam a iti bhedāt eṣām bhedaḥ eva atha na kāraṇa bhedaḥ kim tarhi vyāvṛtti bheda mātram abodha vyāvṛttiḥ bodhaḥ nirākāra tā vyāvṛttiḥ sa ākāra tvam atad rūpa vyāvṛttiḥ viṣaya pratiniyamaḥ iti evam tarhi nīla avabodha cakṣuṣām ākāra bodha viṣaya pratiniyameṣu vyāvṛtti svarūpeṣu vyāpāra asambhavāt akāraṇa tvam eva vyāvṛtteḥ avastu rūpa tvāt atha vyāvṛttāt bodhāt abodha ādi vyāvṛttiḥ na anyā tarhi bodhasya eka rūpa tvāt kāraṇa bheda pratipādanam asambaddham syāt atas kāraṇa bhedāt eva nīla tad bodhayoḥ bhedaḥ citra pratibhāse tu nīla pīta ādi aneka ākāram vijñānam bodha mātra tāyām katham syāt iti cintyam tathā hi teṣām ākārāṇām eka bodha tādātmyāt eka tvam tad tādātmye vā bodhasya aneka tvam iti durnivāraḥ prasaṅgaḥ

atha yāvantaḥ tatra ākārāḥ tāvanti eva jñānāni iti tarhi teṣām pratiniyata ākāra tvāt citra pratibhāsā bhāvaḥ na ca ākāra sadbhāve pratikarma vyavasthā pramāṇam anyathā api bhāvāt tathā hi sakala kāraka janya tva aviśeṣe api nīlasya karma rūpa tayā vyāpārāt tena eva vyapadeśaḥ na ākāra arpaka tvāt iti sarveṣām janakatvā aviśeṣe api arthasya eva ākāra arpaka tve viśeṣa hetuḥ vācyaḥ atha arthasya karma rūpa tayā vyāpārāt tasya eva ākāra arpaka tvam tarhi karma rūpa tā eva astu vyapadeśa niyame hetuḥ kim ākāreṇa asambhavinā kalpitena iti tathā hi nīla ādeḥ asādhāraṇa ākāra arpaka tve bodha rūpa tā na syāt sādhāraṇa ākāra arpaka tve tu pratikarma vyavasthā bhāvaḥ iti

atha samāropita ākāram vijñānam iti na ayam doṣaḥ tat asat ātmanaḥ avasthitasya abhāve katham jñāna ātmani ākāraḥ samāropyate na tāvat anutpannasya vinaṣṭasya vā samāropaka tvam na ca utpatti sama kālam ātma lābha kāle samāropaṇe vyāpāra asambhavāt tasmāt ākāra sat abhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt artha viśeṣāt eva ayam viśeṣaḥ iti yuktam

atha aprakāśa svarūpa tvāt arthānām kathaṃprakāśaḥ tad viṣaya jñāna utpādaḥ eva tathā hi yasmin viṣaye jñānam utpannam saḥ eva upalabdhaḥ na itaraḥ iti viṣaya viṣayi bhāvasya niyāmaka tvam atas jñānam artha prakāśaḥ na tu prakāśakam iti kim gṛhītam artha prakāśakam uta agṛhītam ityādi vikalpaḥ parama tā sparśī cakṣuḥ ādeḥ kāraka jātasya artha prakāśaka tva abhyupagamāt yatra ca jñānam viśeṣa liṅgam vā tatra gṛhītasya artha paricchede vyāpāraḥ abhyupagamyate eva tasya ca ātma antaḥkaraṇa sambandhāt grahaṇam na avaśyam tatra api jñāna antaram iti anavasthā bhāvaḥ

na ca utpanne jñāne saṃvedana abhāvasya aviśeṣāt santāna antare api artha prakāśaḥ niyata ātma sambandhasya niyāmaka tvāt tathā hi yasmin ātmani samavetam tat jñānam upajātam saḥ eva draṣṭā na anyaḥ tatra vivakṣita jñāna samavāyāt yasya tu sva saṃvedyam jñānam nirādhāram tasya santāna antare artha prakāśaḥ kasmāt na bhavati iti cintyam kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tu kṣaṇika tve sati pūrvam pratiṣiddhaḥ eva

yat ca idam sva saṃvedyam vijñānam iti artha antarasya asaṃvedanam eva tat asata vikalpa anupapatteḥ tathā hi yadi sva saṃvedyam ātma antaḥkaraṇa saṃyogāt upalabhyam tat iṣṭam eva atha tat eva jñānam pramāṇam prameyam phalañca iti tat na anyatra tritayasya abheda adarśanāt bhedetu anekam daṇḍa ādi udāharaṇam atas na jñāne karaṇa karmaṇā uḥ abhedaḥ sva saṃvedya tvam na api kriyā karmaṇoḥ iti tasmāt jñāna antara saṃvedyam saṃvedanam vedya tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat

yat ca idam prakāśa svarūpa tvāt ātmanā eva prakāśate pradīpa vat iti uktam tatra yadi prakāśaka tvam bodha rūpa tvam vivakṣitam tadā sādhana vikalam udāharaṇam pradīpe bodha rūpa tvasya asambhavāt atha prakāśaka tvam bhāsvara rūpa sambandhi tvam tat vijñāne na asti atas jñāna antarasya tad viṣayasya utpādaḥ eva jñānasya paricchedaḥ iti

yat ca idam kim prakāśa svarūpāḥ tad viparītāḥ vā padārthāḥ jñānena prakāśante iti uktam tatra yadi prakāśa svarūpa tvam bodha rūpa tvam tat na asti arthānām abodha rūpa tvāt teṣām katham prakāśaḥ tad viṣaya jñāna utpādāt yat viṣayam jñānam utpannam asau arthaḥ paricchinnaḥ iti vyavahāraḥ tasmāt nirākāra tve vijñānasya viṣaya viṣayi bhāvaḥ niyāmakaḥ iti dhiyaḥ nīla ādi rūpa tve bāhyaḥ arthaḥ kiṃnibandhanaḥ iti apāstam eva

yat ca idam grāhya grāhakayoḥ eka kāla anubhava abhāvena dūṣaṇam tat api apāstam kṣaṇika tva anabhyupagamāt yaḥ hi kṣaṇika tvam manyate tasya ayam doṣaḥ jñāna kāle arthasya asadbhāvaḥ artha kāle jñānasya iti tayoḥ grāhya grāhaka bhāva anupapattiḥ iti tathā avayavinaḥ pūrvam eva vyavasthāpanāt na rūpa ādi samudāyasya aparamārtha tvena vijñāna viṣaya tvam iti paramāṇūnām sadbhāva siddheḥ vijñāna mātram eva iti adūṣaṇam anabhyupagamāt atas yat āha vijñāna vādī evam grāhya grāhaka pravibhāgaḥ kalpanā vaśāt iti tat api apāstam eva bodha rūpa vyatirekeṇa bāhya arthasya cakṣuḥ ādinā pratibhāsanāt pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ ca tad viṣaya tvāt iti tathā hi artha avarodhe sati artha kriyā arthinaḥ tad abhimukhāḥ pravartante ca iti dṛṣṭam na ca bhrāntyā eva pravṛttiḥ avisaṃvāda upalabdheḥ

atha pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ artha kriyāyāḥ ca vijñānāt avyatirekaḥ eva tat na vastu rūpa tayā pratibhāsamānānām paraspara byāvṛtta ātmanām jñāna abhede pramāṇa abhāvāt artha anabhyupagame ca saṃvāda an utpattiḥ vyāpāra vyāhāra abhyāñca santāna antara anubhavāt artha ākāre saṃvādaḥ tat na tasya asattvāt na ca utpādanā viśeṣeṇa saṃvādaḥ rūpa jñāna antaram rasa jñāna utpattau visaṃvāda prasaṅgāt atha sva santatau vyāpāra vyāhārayoḥ sva citta iha apūrvaka tvena upalambhāt santāna antare api tad pūrvakatva anumānam iti santāna antara siddhiḥ na pratīyamānayoḥ vyāpāra vyāhārayoḥ sva cittāt abhede para citta pūrvaka tva abhāva prasaṅgāt bhede ca bahirmukha avabhāsi tvena pratīyamāna tve katham na bāhya artha sadbhāvaḥ

na ca sva saṃvid vādinaḥ avinā bhāva grahaṇa abhāve anumāna pravṛttiḥ yuktā tathā hi vyāpāra vyāhāraḥ pratibhāsi jñāna ātmanaḥ citta antara pūrvaka tām gṛhṇāti ātmani eva paryavasānāt etat kāraṇam api cittam na tad kāraṇa tām gṛhṇāti na api ubhābhyām vāsanā krameṇa vikalpa jñānam kārya kāraṇa bhāva grāhakam iti vācyam anubhava anurūpa tvāt vāsanāyāḥ katham kārya kāraṇa bhāva agrahe tad adhyavasāyi vikalpaḥ iti na ca atad rūpa samāropitaḥ vikalpaḥ tasya pāramparyeṇa api artha aviṣaya tve kārya kāraṇa bhāva agrahe anumāna apravṛttiḥ eva tasmāt ubhayoḥ liṅga liṅginoḥ idam asya vyāpyam idam asya vyāpakam iti avinābhāva grahe sati anumānam pravartate iti bodhāt anyaḥ arthaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ

yat ca idam nīlam aham vedmi iti jñānam taimirikasya dvi candra darśana vat bhrāntam iti asat etat abādhyamāna tvāt tathā hi taimirikasya timira vināśāt ūrdhvam eka tva jñāne sati dvi candra darśanam bhrāntam iti pratibhāti anutpanna timirasya anyasya na evam nīlam ityādi jñāne viparīta artha grāhaka pramāṇa anupapatteḥ na mithyātvam iti

nanu uktam kim kena bādhyate jñānam jñānena iti tathā hi udaka jñānasya udakam viṣayaḥ sarva jana pratītaḥ tad parityāgena viṣaya antare marīci ādau utpannam tad grāhiṇā jñānena bādhyate mithyātva viśiṣṭa tayā jñāpyate mithyā idam mama udaka jñānam utpannam iti tad janita saṃskāra nivṛttiḥ vā tathā hi marīci jñāne sati udaka jñāna janita saṃskāra nivṛttau kāla antare api udakam mayā dṛṣṭam iti smaraṇa anutpattau tad deśa abhimukhyena pravṛtti abhāvaḥ iti bādhaka anabhyupagame ca jñānasya satyetara viveka anupapatteḥ vādi prativādinā ūrjaya parājaya vyavasthā na syāt iti uktam

yat tu amantra ādi upapluta akṣāṇām a ityādi vākyam tat na parihāra arham svatas eva pratibhāsasya anyathā tva abhyupagamāt tathā hi mṛd śakala ādayaḥ anyathā pratibhāsante na sva rūpeṇa upapluta cakṣuṣām na sarveṣām iti iṣyate eva idam mithyājñānam bādhaka upapatteḥ iṣṭañca bādhakam atathā eva darśanam teṣām anupapluta cakṣuṣāma iti dūre ca maruṣu alpaḥ api mahān upalabhyate sannikṛṣṭe ca alpaḥ eva iti anena tasya bādhā na ca tena eva asya bādhā pramātṛ mātrasya sarva deśeṣu atad rūpa tayā pratibhāsanāt mahat tvan ca deśa viśeṣaḥ eva pratibhāsate na anyatra iti asat eva tat eva hi padārthānām svarūpam yat avisaṃvādi svastha ātmanām artha kriyā sampāda kañca iti atas mṛd śakala ādayaḥ yena rūpeṇa avipluta cakṣuṣām pratibhāsante artha kriyāñca sampādayanti tena eva rūpeṇa santaḥ na rūpa antareṇa iti katham arthānām avyavasthānāt atha svapna avasthāyām arthānām asattve api pratibhāsaḥ viśiṣṭa artha kriyā ca retasaḥ visargaḥ sambhavati iti nanu evam tarhi svapna avasthāyām arthānām asattvam katham jñātam iti vācyam yadi jāgrat avasthāyām anupalambhāt

tarhi yeṣām upalambhaḥ teṣām sattvam āyātam anyathā hi jāgrat avasthāyām anupalambhena svapna avasthāyām asattvam na syāt atas pratīyamāna tvāt svapna avasthāyām iva jāgrat avasthāyām api asattvam iti na vācyam pratibhāsamāna tvasya sādhanasya sadbhāve api asattvasya sādhyasya aniścayāt pratīyamāna tvañca bodhe asti na ca asattvam iti vyabhicāraḥ tathā arthānām asattve pratīyamāna tvasya sādhanasya apakṣa dharma tvam syāt udāharaṇe pratīyamāna tvena na asattvam api tu pramāṇataḥ anupalabdheḥ iti anyathā siddhañca iti na ca asarvam vijñānam a iti vādinaḥ svapna avasthā jāgrat avasthā ca iti viśeṣaḥ sambhavati ubhayatra api sva saṃvedyasya jñānasya avasthāna abhyupagamāt vratavaḥ ca pūrvam nirastāḥ eva tasmāt akṣa ādi janita jñāna samavāyaḥ jāgrat avasthā tad viparītā tu svapna avasthā iti yuktam

yat ca idam buddhyā vivecanāt bhāvānām asattvam iti uktam tat asat sva buddhi pratibhāsamāna vapuṣām asattve bodhasya api asattva prasaṅgāt tathā hi rūpa ādayaḥ paraspara svarūpa parihāreṇa vyavasthitāḥ sva buddhi viṣayāḥ paṭa ādayaḥ api evam atas yadi api paṭaḥ tantu ādi buddhau na pratibhāsate tathā api sva buddhi viṣaya tvāt paramārtha san ā iva tat evam paṭa ādayaḥ paraspara vyāvṛtta buddhi viṣayāḥ viśiṣṭa artha kriyā kāriṇaḥ ca iti parama artha santaḥ eva

na ca pramāṇam vinā prameya siddhiḥ iti vijñāna vyatirekiṇām asattve pramāṇam abhidheyam pramāṇam vinā ca padārthānām asattva siddhau sattvam api syāt pramāṇa abhāvasya ubhayatra aviśeṣāt atha arthānām asattva siddhau grāhya lakṣaṇa ayogaḥ pramāṇam na tasya api bhāva dharma tve viruddha tvam abhāva dharma tve ca āśraya asiddha tvam ubhaya dharma tve tu vyabhicārāt asādhanatvam iti vyadhikaraṇa tvāt ca tathā hi grāhya lakṣaṇasya ayogaḥ na grāhya dharmaḥ iti katham tasya asattvam sādhayet svarūpa asiddhaḥ ca grāhya lakṣaṇasya sadbhāvāt tathā ca mahat tva ādi grāhya lakṣaṇam vakṣyamānam iti sādhya aviśiṣṭañca grāhya lakṣaṇa ayogasya api sādhya tvāt na ca pramāṇa antaram asti iti

etena śūnyavādaḥ api niraste eva iti na pṛthak abhidhīyate tathā hi sarva arthānām asattve vijñānasya api grāhya grāhaka ākāra rahita tvāt asatve ca sarvam śūnyam iti syāt tat ca nirastam eva pramāṇa abhāvena prameyasya asiddheḥ bodhasya artha an āñca pramāṇataḥ vyavasthāpanāt iti tat evam bodha vyatirekeṇa artha sadbhāva siddheḥ ānantyāt pratyartha niyata tvāt ca buddheḥ aneka tvam yuktam iti

anye tu ātmanaḥ pariṇāma viśeṣaḥ buddhiḥ tad rūpa tayā ca anityā ātma rūpa tayā tu nitya iti matam tasya nirāsa artham sā ca aneka prakāra iti vākyam manyante tathā hi buddheḥ aneka tvāt ātmanaḥ api aneka tvam abhedāt ātmā eka tve vā buddheḥ eka tvam na ca bheda abheda pakṣaḥ sambhavati anekānta vādasya pūrvam eva pratiṣedhāt atas buddheḥ guṇa tvāt aneka tve api ātmanaḥ tathā abhāvaḥ na bhavati iti digvāsasām matam niṣiddham

nanu evam tarhi buddheḥ ānantyāt katham tattva jñāna viṣaya tvam iti āha *tasyāḥ sati api anekavidha tve samāsataḥ* saṃkṣepataḥ dvividhā iti parijñānam kāryam iti kena rūpeṇa dvaividhyam iti āha *vidyā ca avidyā ca iti anye tu vedānta mate vidyā vidyayoḥ śravaṇāt buddheḥ ānantya pratipādanam āgama viruddham syāt iti āśaṅkā niṣedha artham āha atasyāḥ sati api anekavidha tve samāsataḥ a saṃkṣepataḥ dvaividhyam iṣyate eva avidyā ca avidyā ca iti a

vidyā hi deśa kāla avasthā ādi bhedena abādhyamānaḥ adhyavasāyaḥ tad viparīta arthā ca avidyati na tu pramāṇa apramāṇa tve vidyā vidya tve vyabhicārāt tathā hi yadi pramīyate anena iti pramāṇam iti vivakṣitam saṃśaya ādeḥ api ātma antaḥkaraṇa adhigame pramāṇa tvam asti iti vyabhicāraḥ sarveṣu ca pratyakṣa ādi jñāneṣu kāraṇa tva anupapatteḥ avyāptiḥ ca phala vivakṣāya antu na smṛteḥ pramāṇa phala tvam iti vidyā tvam na syāt

guravaḥ tu viśiṣṭa vyavahāra kāraṇam vijñānam vidyā viparītañcā avidyā iti bruvate tatra yadi pravṛtti nivṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ viśiṣṭa vyavahāraḥ vivakṣitaḥ tadā saṃśaya ādi jñāneṣu api bhāvāt ati vyāptiḥ na ca pakṣe sarvatra asti iti avyāptiḥ ca atha deśa ādi bhedena api samyaktayā mayā upalabdham iti jñānam viśiṣṭa vyavahāraḥ tad janaka tvam api na sarveṣu vidyā bhedeṣu asti iti avyāptiḥ tathā ca samyak mayā upalabdham iti vyavahāraḥ na sarveṣu vidyā bhedeṣu vidyate iti avyāpaka tvam eva tatra api avidyā caturvidhā iti krama atikrameṇa avidyāyāḥ svarūpa nirūpaṇam artha prakāśasya vivakṣita tvāt tad ucchedya tva jñāpana artham iti ca anye avidyā hi vidyayā samucchidyate iti

atha kena rūpeṇa caturvidhā *saṃśaya viparyaya anadhyavasāya svapna lakṣaṇā* svarūpa iti nanūha jñānam api asti tasya antarbhāvaḥ na vidyāyām na api avidyāyām ubhayatra api cāturvidhyā abhidhānāt na yuktam etat saṃśaya niścaya vyatirekeṇa ūha jñānasya asaṃvedanāt atha asti saṃśayāt ūrdhvam bāhya āli pradeśe sambandha upalabdheḥ sthāṇu pakṣa pratiṣedhe sati puruṣeṇa anena bhavitavyam iti sambhāvanā pratyayaḥ sa tu tasmin tat iti rūpa tvāt niścayaḥ eva tathā hi kim ayam sthāṇuḥ syāt puruṣaḥ vā iti ubhaya prasaṅge sati ekasya pratiṣedhāt tad anyasya apratiṣiddhasya avasthānam bhavati eva

atha vyadhikaraṇa viśeṣa upalambhāt na yuktaḥ niścayaḥ tat asat saṃyogi viśeṣasya abhyupagamāt yathā hi kāka nilayana ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ saṃyogini sthāṇau niścayam utpādayanti evam bāhya ālī pradeśe puruṣe api iti tad sambandhaḥ tu samavetaḥ eva viśeṣaḥ iti na vyadhikaraṇa tvam atha na ayam sthāṇuḥ bāhya ālī pradeśa sambandhi tvāt iti viṣayāt sādhanāt na nirṇayaḥ tat na vyāpāra apekṣayā puruṣa viṣaya tvasya api sambhavāt jñāna antara tve tu ūha jñānasya avyabhicāri artha jñāna tvāt pramāṇa rūpa tāyām pramāṇa antaram abhidheyam pramāṇam vinā tad phalasya anupapatteḥ vyabhicāri vā pramāṇa sāmānya lakṣaṇam syāt atha indriya artha sannikarṣa ādi eva pramāṇam ūha utpattau katham tarhi jñāna antaram pratyakṣa phala tvāt iti alam anye tu ūhasya sadbhāve api samāna tantra prasiddha tayā lābhāt iha anabhidhānam iti bruvate na ca pratyakṣa ādeḥ api anena eva nyāyena lābhaḥ sva mata abhāve samāna tantra tā si dheira bhāvāt

atha saṃśayasya itarasmāt bheda viṣaya vibhāga nirūpaṇa artham * saṃśayaḥ tāvat * iti ādi prakaraṇam saṃśayaḥ tāvat byākhyāyate avasara prāpta tvāt iti prasiddhāḥ aneke viśeṣāḥ yayoḥ tau tathā uktau tayoḥ iti viṣaya nirūpaṇam na tu prasiddhau ca tau aneka viśeṣau ca iti karma dhāraya parigrahaḥ saṃśayasya ca dharmi viṣaya tvāt atha ekasya eva dharmiṇaḥ tatra sadbhāvāt ubhayoḥ katham viṣaya tva sambhavaḥ pakṣa upanyāsāda doṣaḥ tathā hi yatra aneke viśeṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ tatra eva saṃśayaḥ iti niyamyate na tu ekasmin eva kāle tayaḥ viṣaya tvam ekasya tatra asambhavāt kāla bhedena tu ubhayaḥ viṣaya tvam yat yatra sambhāvyate saṃśaya utpattau sa tasya viṣayaḥ iti

kāraṇam iha * sādṛśya mātra darśanāt iti sādṛśyamānam dṛśyate asmi niti sādṛśya viśeṣina te midarśanam labhyate iti vyākhyeyam na tu sādṛśya mātrasya darśanam iti abhyupagamena dharma upalambhāt miṇi saṃśayasya vyadhi karaṇa tvāt atra sādṛśya mātra darśanāt iti mātrā abhidhānena atyanta viśeṣāḥ nupalabdhi darśayati

sāmānyasya viśeṣa sahitasya upalambhe api saṃśaya adarśanāt iti na ca sāmānya upalambham vinā viśeṣa anupalabdhiḥ saṃśaya janikā iti ubhaya abhidhānam tathā api nauvādya ārūḍhasya vṛkṣa ādiṣu ubhaya sadbhāve api na saṃśayaḥ iti * ubhaya viśeṣa anusmaraṇāt iti padam viśeṣa anusmaraṇañca na pūrva uktam vinā saṃśaya janakam dṛṣṭam iti samuditam kāraṇam tat evam sāmānya darśanāt viśeṣa adarśanāt ubhaya viśeṣa anusmaraṇāt adharma ādibhyaḥ ca utpadyamāna tvāt saṃśayaḥ itarebhyaḥ bhidyate iti kāraṇa ātmakam lakṣaṇam tathā ca sūtram sāmānya pratyakṣāt viśeṣa apratyakṣāt viśeṣa smṛteḥ ca saṃśayaḥ iti sāmānyam pratyakṣam yasmin dharmiṇī asau tathā uktaḥ tasmāt iti pratyakṣa śabcaḥ ca dṛḍha pramāṇa vacanaḥ atra anumānikasya api saṃśayasya abhyupagamāt viśeṣa apratyakṣāt iti viśeṣān upa labdheḥ tad smṛteḥ ca saṃśayaḥ iti

nanu ca ayuktam etat devadattasya sva priyatamām parityajya vrajataḥ deśa vyava dhānāt tritaya sadbhāve api tatra saṃśaya anupalabdheḥ tathā hi strī tva sāmānya upa lambhe api aneka ādi viśeṣa upalambhāt tad smaraṇāt ca kim madīyāḥ anyadīyā vā iti saṃśayaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ para pakṣa pratiṣedhakasya deśa kāla viśeṣasya bādhakasya upalabdhaḥ ekasmin deśe kāle ca anyā na sambhavati iti atas asya vyavaccheda artham bādhaka sādhaka pramāṇa avyavasthātaḥ ca iti padam kāryam na viśeṣa anupalabdhi padena eva nirasta tvāt tathā hi viśeṣa anupalabdhi padena samasta viśeṣa anupalabdhiḥ vivakṣitā sā ca atra na asti deśa kāla viśeṣasya niścita tvāt atas viśeṣa anupalabdhi padena eva asya nirasta tvāt iti vyavacchedya abhāvam manyamānaḥ muniḥ na viśeṣa antara māha iti

tasya svarūpam āha* kim svid iti ubhaya avalambī vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ iti saṃśītiḥ saṃśayaḥ saṃśayyate anena ātmā suptaḥ iva bhavati iti nirukti lakṣaṇam vimarśanam vimarśaḥ kim idam eva āhosvit evam na bhavatoti pratyayaḥ sa ca ubhaya mā ālambate tad śīlaḥ ca iti ubhaya avalambī vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ iti na ca ubhayaḥ viṣaya tvam ghaṭataḥ iti ubhaya ullekhī iti vyākhyeyam atas vimarśaḥ itarasmāt bhidyate saṃśayaḥ iti vā vyavartavyaḥ vimarśa rūpa tvāt kim syāt iti ubhaya ālambi tvāt vā iti

*sa ca dvividhaḥ a iti vibhāgaḥ kena rūpeṇa *antar bahis ca nanu pañcavidha tvāt saṃśayasya dvaividhyam anupapannam na asya eva avāntara bhedena tad upapatteḥ tathā hi samāna dharma upapatteḥ aneka dharma upapatteḥ vipratipattaḥ ca iti bāhyaḥ trividhaḥ saṃśayaḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhyoḥ ca manaḥ paricchedya tvāt āntaraḥ dvividhaḥ iti abhipretañca etat bhāṣya kartuḥ yatas āha samānaḥ anekaḥ ca dharmaḥ jñeya sthaḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhī punar jñātṛ sthe iti avirodhaḥ saṅgrahānabhyupagame ca pratyakṣa apratyakṣa viṣaya bhedena api saṃśayasya bhedāt pañcatvam asambaddham syāt atha anena eva saṅgrahāt anabhidhānam tarhi dvaividhyena eva saṅgrahāt na pañcatvama bhidhīyate tasya hi tad bheda tvāt iti anekaḥ ca dharmaḥ sādhāraṇa tvāt saṃśaya hetuḥ na bhavati eva viruddha viśeṣaiḥ saha anu palambhena tad smaraṇā janaka tvāt na api viruddha avyabhicārī saṃśaya hetuḥ tasya eva asambhavāt iti vakṣyāmaḥ anaikāntika avasare

tatra antar saṃśayasya svarūpa nirūpaṇa artham * antar tāvat ādeśikasya ityādi yathā hi ādeśikena viśiṣṭam nimittam upalabhya ādiṣṭam ekadā vṛṣṭiḥ bha viṣyati iti samyak jātam anyadā tu viparītam punar tathā eva ādiśataḥ triṣu kāleṣu asatsu tasmin jñāne saṃśayaḥ bhavati kinnu samyak mithyā vā iti atha jñānasya sāmānya darśana viśeṣa anusmaraṇa kāle avasthāna abhāvāta katham saṃśaya viṣaya tvam tathā hi tasmin jñāne bhaviṣyat vṛṣṭi viṣaya tvam samānaḥ dharmaḥ tad viśiṣṭa jñāne jñānam utpadyate tasya tu vinaśyattā samyaktva asamyaktva viśeṣa smaraṇasya utpadya mānatā tatas viśeṣa smaraṇa kāle jñānam atītam katham viṣayaḥ tad upalakṣita ātmanaḥ viṣaya tvāt adoṣaḥ tathā ca kinnu samyak jñānavān aham mithyā jñānavān vā iti saṃśayaḥ

anye tu vidyamānasya iva atītasya api viṣaya tvam asti iti bruvate * bahit vividhaḥ * kena rūpeṇa * pratyakṣa viṣaye ca apratyakṣa viṣaye ca * iti * tatra apratyakṣa viṣaye tāvat * abhidhīyate saṃśayaḥ * sādhāraṇa liṅga darśanāt * iti yat liṅga viruddha viśeṣaiḥ saha upalabdham tad arśanāt viśeṣa anu palabdheḥ * ubhaya viśeṣa anusmaraṇāt adharmāt * diś kāla ādibhyaḥ ca saṃśayaḥ bhavati * yathā aṭavyām viṣāṇa mātra darśanāt * tad gata viśeṣa anupalabdhaḥ tad smaraṇāt saṃśayaḥ bhavati * gauḥ gavayaḥ vā iti *

atha pratyakṣāt asya viśeṣaḥ katham sāmānya viśeṣitasya dharmiṇaḥ pratyakṣa tvam viśeṣa lakṣaṇa anabhidhānāt atha kim go gavaya viṣāṇeṣu sāmānyam tulya avayava racanā yogaḥ yathā bhūtāḥ hi avayava racanā goviṣāṇe dṛṣṭā tathā gavaya viṣāṇe api iti ye tu go viṣāṇa viśeṣāḥ gavaya viṣāṇa viśeṣāḥ ca pūrva upa labdhāḥ teṣām atra anupalambhaḥ iti atas sādṛśya mātra viśeṣitam viṣāṇam upalabha mānasya viśeṣa anupalabdheḥ tad smaraṇāt ca kim gauḥ syāt gavaya uvā iti saṃśayaḥ

* pratyakṣa viṣaye api sthāṇu puruṣayorūrvatā mātra sādṛśya darśanāt vakra tāḥ diviśeṣa anupalabdhitaḥ * iti ādipadena kāka nilayana ādayaḥ sthāṇī śiraḥ pāṇi ādayaḥ ca puruṣeṣu viśeṣāḥ teṣām anupalambhāt iti sthāṇu tvam ādirya sya ityādi padena puruṣa tva grahaṇam tat ca sāmānyam eva viśeṣaḥ tasyāna bhivyakti vyañjakasya śiraḥ pāṇi ādeḥ anupalambhāt atas tat * anabhivyaktauvu bhaya viśeṣa anusmaraṇāt ubhayatra * sthāṇau puruṣe ca * ākṛṣyamāṇasya ātmanaḥ pratyayaḥ dolāyate * na eka koṭau vyavatiṣṭhate sa ca kisvarūpaḥ iti āha * kinnu khalu ayam sthāṇuḥ syāt puruṣaḥ vā iti *

atha kim idam ekam jñānam āhosvit anekam iti yadi ane krameṇa utpadyate sthāṇuḥ iti ekam puruṣaḥ iti ca anyat tarhi yat tasmiḥ tat iti rūpam tat sasyaka jñānam viparītantu mithyājñānam iti saṃśaya ucchedaḥ na aneka tvān abhyupa gamāt tathā hi ekam eva kim ayam sthāṇuḥ syāt puruṣaḥ vā iti viruddha ullekhi jñānam viruddha viśeṣa anusmaraṇa upalakṣita sāmagrī janya tvāt ekaḥ tu saṃskārāḥ viśeṣa anubhavāt pūrva pūrva saṃskāra sacivāt utpadyate iti ekam smaraṇam viruddha viśeṣa viṣayam janayati eva

yat vā pratiniyata viśeṣa anubhava janitāḥ saṃskārāḥ saṃśaya upabhoga prāpakā dṛṣṭa niyamitāḥ saṃskāram ārabhante tasmāt aneka viśeṣa viṣayam smaraṇam iti viṣaya saṃśaya utpattau aviśeṣāt pratyakṣa tvañcobhayatra api samānam iti satyam tathā api sāmānya viśeṣitasya liṅga upalambhāt sādhya dharma viśeṣite miṇi saṃśaya abhyupaga maḥ anyatra ca aliṅga bhūte sādhya dharma rahite sāmānyavati pratyakṣe dharmiṇī iti viśeṣaḥ kiñcid sādharmyantu na niṣidhyate sāmānya lakṣaṇa ākrāntiḥ ca anvayavyatire kābhyām upalabhyate pratyabhijñānāt ca tathā hi mama atra saṃśaya jñānam utpannam iti paścāt vijānāti iti sa viṣaya tvam asya

atha viparyayasya kāraṇa svarūpa viṣaya vibhāga nirūpaṇa artham na param saṃśayaḥ * viparyayaḥ api pratyakṣa anumāna viṣayaḥ eva bhavati * iti evamādi prakaraṇam yat vā sa śayasya pratyakṣa anumāna viṣaya tva abhyupagamāt viparyayasya viṣaya abhāvāt asambhavaḥ bhābhūt iti āha viparyayaḥ api pratyakṣa anumāna viṣayaḥ eva bhavati iti na ca viṣaya abhedāt eka tvam svarūpa bhedasya kāraṇa bhedasya ca sambhavāt āgamike api viṣaye visaṃvāda upalabdhe viparyaya darśanāt vyāhatam avadhāraṇam pratyakṣa anumāna viṣayaḥ eva viparyayaḥ iti na niviṣayatu apratiṣedha paratvāt

yat ca idam asatī api pratyakṣe pratyakṣa abhimānaḥ iti vākyam tat anyathā vyākhyeyam iti kecid anye tu para abhyupagatasya kalpanā jñānasya nirāsa artham viparyayaḥ api pratyakṣāḥ numāna viṣayaḥ eva na tu sarvaḥ sa viṣayaḥ kvacid aviṣayasya api sambhavāt yatra hi viṣayaḥ anvaya vyatirekābhyām upalabhyate asau sa viṣayaḥ anyaḥ tu niviṣayaḥ na tu sarve iti anye tu pratyakṣa anumāna viṣayaḥ bhavati eva viparyayaḥ iti abhavana pratiṣedhaḥ vivakṣitaḥ nitya viparyaya vyavaccheda artham iti bruvate tat ayuktam vyākhyānam tasyai vā asiddhaḥ na ca nityasya pratyakṣa anumāna viṣaya tvam vyāpārāt ṛte sambhāvyate iti katham asya atra abhavana pratiṣedhaḥ iti alam

pratyakṣa viṣaye tāvat viparyamāha * prasiddha aneka viśeṣayoḥ * prasiddhāḥ anekā viśeṣāḥ yayoḥ tau tathā uktau tayoḥ iti viṣaya nirūpaṇam * pitta kaphāḥ nila upahata indriyasya * iti pittañca kaphaḥ ca anilaḥ ca iti pitta kapha anilāḥ taiḥ upa hatāni indriyāṇi yasya asau sa tathā uktaḥ tasya viparyayaḥ bhavati kebhyaḥ iti āha * ayatha artha ālocanāt * ityādi ayathārtham ālā ucyate anena iti ayathā artha ālocanam sādṛśya jñānam

yat vā ālocitiḥ ālocanam ayathārthañca tadālocanañcā iti upacāreṇa sādṛśya jñānam ayatha artha ālocana hetu tvāt vivakṣitam tasmāt asat nihitaḥ ca asāḥ viṣayaḥ ca iti tathā uktaḥ tasmin jñānam tasmāt jātaḥ asat nihita viṣaya jñāna jaḥ sa ca asau saṃskāraḥ ca iti saṃskāra kārya tvāt smṛtiḥ saṃskāra padena vivakṣitā tad saṃskāram apekṣate iti ātma manaḥ saṃyogaḥ tad apekṣaḥ tasmāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt adharmāt ca viparyayaḥ sa ca ki svarūpaḥ * asmiḥ tat iti pratyayaḥ * iti tathā hi atasmiḥ tat iti pratyayaḥ itarasmāt bhidyate viparyayaḥ iti vā vyavahartavyaḥ ayathārtha ālocana ādibhyaḥ utpadyamāna tvāt iti yaḥ tu evam na bhavati na ca asau ukta kāraṇebhyaḥ niṣpadyate yathā saṃśayā diriti tasya udāharaṇam * yathā gavyevāḥ ca iti * yathā hi dūrāt viṣāṇāḥ diviśeṣam anupalabhamānasya aśva sādṛśya viśeṣita piṇḍa upalambhāt aśva anusmaraṇāt ca gavyeva aśvaḥ ayam iti jñānam utpadyate tathā marīciṣu udaka jñānam śuktikāyāḥ rajata jñānam iti

nanu ca ayuktam etat viparyaya jñāna sampādakasya kārakasya eva asambhavāt tathā hi indriyāṇi samyaka jñāna sampādanāya utpannāni tasmiḥ tat iti rūpa tvāt katha mithyājñānam kuryuḥ iti na ca kāca kāmalā ādi doṣa vaśāt viparīta jñāna janaka tvam duṣṭasya kārakasya kārya ajanaka tvāt yathā hi śālibījasya taila ādinā abhyattasya śāli a kurājanaka tvam na punar yava aṅkura sampādaka tvam evam indriyāṇām samyak jñāna sampādaka tvam eva syāt na viparīta jñāna utpādaka tvam iti na ca rajata ādi jñānasya śuktikā ādi ālambana tve pramāṇam asti tasmāt sādṛśya jñānāḥ nantaram su a ākāra paribhraṣṭam smaraṇam utpadyate idam rajatam iti tathā hi idam iti sādṛśya jñānam rajatam iti smaraṇam tat iti ākāra śūnyam

na etat yuktam rajata arthinaḥ pravṛtti nivṛttyorabhāva prasaṅgāt atha jñāna yobhade api idam eva rajatam iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam manyamānaḥ pravartate tahi idam eva vyadhikaraṇayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇya jñānam mithyājñānam iti atha idam iti sādṛśyam tatra rajatam iti bheda apratibhāse sati pravṛttiḥ veṣyate tat na pratipattya bhāvasya apravartaka tvāt tathā hi rajata arthī idam eva rajatam iti manyamānaḥ pravartate na itarathā idam iti jñānasya aparokṣata anirdeśaḥ na jñāna antaram anyathā hi idam rūpam ayam rasaḥ iti ādau api smṛti pramoṣaḥ syāt

yat ca idam rajatam iti jñānasya śuktikā ādi ālambana tve pramāṇa abhāvaḥ iti uktam tat asat pratyabhijñāna ādeḥ sambhavāt tathā hi iyam śuktikā mama rajatam iti pratibhātā tathā na idam rajatam iti jñānasya śuktikā viṣaya tvāt rajatam iti jñānasya tat viṣaya tvam anyathā hi rajatam iti jñānasya śuktikā viṣaya tā mantareṇa na idam rajatam iti pratiṣedhaḥ na syāt prasaktaya bhāvāt aprasaktasya ca niṣedhe na ayam ghaṭādiḥ iti api syāt tathā ca sati sarvatra prati ṣadha paramparā prasaṅgaḥ na ca etat asti tasmāt jñāna dvāreṇa rajatam tatra prasakta miti niṣidhyate

yat ca idam utpatti kāraṇa abhāvāt iti uktam tat asat doṣa anugṛhītasya indriyāḥ dona janaka tvāt yathā hi doṣa abhāve sati indriyam bhāva vyatirekābhyām samyaka jñānasya janakam upalabdham tathā doṣa sadbhāve sati mithyājñānasya api iti ubhaya rūpasya kāryasya indriya vyāpāreṇa upalabdheḥ ubhaya artham indriyāṇām sargaḥ niścīyate mithyā tvañcā asya sva viṣaya parityāgena viṣaya antara upasarpaṇāt

atha alaukikam rajatam eva asya viṣayam iti viṣaya antara upasarpaṇam asiddham tat na alaukika rajata adhyavasāye sati pravṛtti nivṛttyorabhāva prasaṅgāt atha ālaukikasya api laukika tām manyamānaḥ pravartate katham tarhi mithyājñānasya sambhavaḥ iti na ca etasmin pakṣe mithyā idam mama utpannam jñānam iti bādhaka jñānam syāt pratyabhijñāna ādi a sambhavaḥ ca asti pratyabhijñānam śaktika ādau mama atra rajata jñānam utpannam mithyātva pratipattiḥ ca iti katham mithyājñānasya asambhavaḥ yadi ca idam rajatam iti jñānam rajata ālambanam eva syāt tasya upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta tvāt samīpattinaḥ katham agrahaṇam yat vastu upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam dūra sthe na api upalabhyate tat avaśyam samīpatinā gṛhyate eva indriya ādeḥ tādavasthyāt na ca etat asti tasmāt rajata ādi jñānam śuktikā ādau utpannam iti

anye tu yat eva rajatam anya deśa kāla viśeṣitam upalabdham tat eva anya deśa ādi viśeṣitam upalabhyate iti mithyātvam bruvate tat asat tasya atrā vidyamāna tayā viṣaya tva asambhavāt tasmāt indriya vyāpāra viṣayaḥ aṅgalyādinā vyapadiśyamānaḥ ca śuktikā ādiḥ eva viṣayaḥ anyathā viṣaya antara utpannam rajata jñānam katham śuktikā jñānena bādhyeta vibhinna viṣaya tve bādhya bādhaka bhāvasya eva asambha vāt atas rajata jñānam śuktikāyām upajātam śuktikā jñānena sva viṣaya sahakāriṇā bādhyate mithyātva viśiṣṭa tayā jñāpyate viṣaya antara upasarpaṇāt rajata jñānasya tu rajatam viṣayaḥ sarva jana pratītaḥ tad tyāgena śuktikāyām utpadyamāna tvāt vyabhicā ritvam etena niviṣayam kalpanā jñānam etat iti apāstam viṣayasya śuktikā ādeḥ pramāṇataḥ vyavasthāpanāt

* asati api pratyakṣe pratyakṣa abhimānaḥ * ityādinā niviṣayam viparyaya māha iti kecid udāharaṇantu * yathā vyapagata ghana paṭalam acala jalanidhi sadṛśa vapuḥ ambaram añjana cūrṇa puñja śyāmam śārvaram tamaḥ * iti vyapagatāni dhanānā paṭalāni yasmin ambare tat tathā uktam tathā na calaḥ acalaḥ sa ca asā jalanidhiḥ ca tena sadṛśam tulyam vapuḥ svarūpam asya iti tat ca jalanidhi sadṛśava purambaram iti jñānam ambarasya atīndriya tvāt ukta rūpasya api na jalanidhinā sādṛśya grahaṇam sambhavati iti niviṣayaḥ pratyakṣa abhimānaḥ tathā śayām bhava śārvaram tamaḥ ki viśiṣṭam a añjana cūrṇa pūñja śyāmam iti na ca abhāva rūpasya tamasaḥ śyāma rūpa sambandhi tvam asti iti niviṣaya tvam sa viṣaya tva abhyupagame api deśa kāla viśeṣitasya tejasaḥ abhāvasya ālambana tvāt adoṣaḥ

tathā sva āśrayāt vinivṛttāḥ cakṣuḥ aśmayaḥ sva ātmīyam golaka rūpam yathā uktena jalanidhinā sadṛśa vapuḥ ambaram iti upalambham janayanti ādarśāt pratiskhalitānām sva mukha grahaṇa vat iti yathā hi ādarśāt pratiskhalitāḥ cakṣu ḥ aśmayaḥ sva mukhe viparyayam utpādayanti ādarśa mukham iti tadvat iha api dūrāt vinivṛttāḥ sva golakam eva ambaram iti upadarśayanti

anumāna viṣaye api viparyayam āha * vā aṣpa ādibhiḥ * ityādinā atra ādi padena nīhāra maśaka āvarta ādi grahaṇam taiḥ kimbhūtaiḥ * dhūma abhimataiḥ * dhūma rūpa tayā jñātaiḥ agni anumānam iti tathā * gavaya viṣāṇa darśanāt ca gauḥ iti * jñānam viparyayaḥ atra tu liṅga viparyaya jñānam indriya jam tad vyāpāra jañcā anumānikam

idānīm asat darśana abhyāsāt viparyayam āha * trayī darśana viparīteṣu śākya ādi daśaneṣu idam śreyaḥ iti mithyā pratyayaḥ * ityādinā trayāṇām samāhāraḥ trayī kāḍha vaśāt ṛc yajuḥ sāma lakṣaṇā gṛhyate trayī ā iva darśanam tad viparītāni śākya ādi darśanāni ityādi padena naiśanā jaināḥ didarśanasya avarodhaḥ teṣu * idam śreyaḥ * iti sarvam kṣaṇikam iti jñānam śūnyam nirātmakam iti jñānam śreyaḥ sādhaka tvāt śreyaḥ iti śākya darśana abhyāsāt viparyayaḥ kṣaṇikā ādi pakṣa bādhakasya ukta tvāt eṣu artheṣu anekānta jñānena darśane viparyayaḥ tathe taraṣu api ūhyaḥ na ca śākya ādi darśana viparīta tvāt trayyām api viparyayaḥ iti vācyam pradhāna artheṣu ātma ādiṣu artheṣu bādhaka anupapatteḥ śākya ādi darśaneṣu kṣaṇika tva ādi padārtheṣu uktam bādhakam abādhyamānam iti

anye tu trayāṇām pratyakṣa anumāna āgamānām samāhāraḥ trayī tat eva dṛśyate anena iti darśanam tad viparītāni śākya ādi darśanāni taiḥ bādha upapatteḥ tat upa lakṣitam vā vaiśeṣika darśanam tad viparītāni śākya ādi darśanāni bādhyamāna tvā diti uktam tathā * śarīra indriya manaḥsu ātma abhimānaḥ * viparyayaḥ śarīra meva ātmā iti viparyayaḥ laukāyatikānām indriyāṇi eva ātmā iti indriya caitanyavā dinām manaḥ caitanya vādinām manaḥ eva iti * kṛtakeṣu nitya tva darśanam viparyayaḥ mīmāṃsakānām tathā hi kṣiti ādeḥ kṛtaka tvam pūrvam eva vyavasthāpitam tatra ca nitya tva darśanam teṣām iti yat vā sāṃkhyānām ayam viparyayaḥ kṛtakeṣu ghaṭa ādiṣu nitya tva darśanam iti na samutpadyate bhāvaḥ na sva ātmānam jahāti iti

uktaḥ * kāraṇa vaikalye kārya utpatti jñānam * viparyayaḥ svabhāva vādinām tathā ca niruktam kṣiti ādi vaicitryam kartāram antareṇa svabhāvataḥ eva bhavati iti etat ca asat kāryatvasya sva kartṛ pūrvaka tvena vyāptasya upalambhāt kṣiti ādau api kartṛ pūrvaka tvasya vyavasthāpita tvāt svabhāva vādinām viparyaya jñānam etat tathā cetanam adhiṣṭhātāram vinā kāryasya anupalabdheḥ jaiminīyānām śauddhodaneḥ śiṣyāṇāñca kartāram vinā kṣiti ādi kārya vijñānam viparyayaḥ

pradhāne pralīnayoḥ ca dharma adharmayoḥ abhivyakta tvāt na kārya utpattau vyāpāraḥ sambhavati iti tad vaikalye kārya utpatti jñānam viparyayaḥ sāṃkhyānām saugāta anāñca kāraṇa vaikalye kārya utpatti jñānam viparyayaḥ katham utpatti vināśayoḥ tādātmyāt kṣaṇika tve sati yadā eva kārya utpādaḥ tat eva kāraṇasya vināśaḥ sa ca utpatteḥ tha aintaram iti saha utpannayoḥ na kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ iti kāraṇa vaikalye kārya utpatti jñānam viparyayaḥ

tathā sarvam idam kārya parameśa pūrvakam tadārādhanañca paramasya śreyasaḥ sādhanam veda anāñca svarūpe api arthe prāmāṇyam iti evam * hitam upadiśatsu * vaiśeṣikeṣu na evam bhavati iti jñānam viparyayaḥ mīmāṃsaka saugata janānām yadā tu na parama śiva ādeḥ sadbhāvaḥ iti vaiyātyāt vadanti vaiśeṣikā stadā na idam paramārthataḥ hitam iti hitam upadiśatsu vaiśeṣikeṣu ahitam eva idam iti jñānam viparyayaḥ teṣām

yat vā saṃsārya ātmanām nānātvam parama śivaḥ ca etebhyaḥ bhinnaḥ tadā ārādha nāt ca asmad ādeḥ śreyaḥ bhavati iti evam hitam upadiśatsu vaiśeṣikeṣu ahitam iti jñānam viparyayaḥ dvaita vādinām tad arthāna bhyupagamena ca vacanena hitam iti jñānam viparyayaḥ teṣām kṣiti ādi kārya parama aṇu bhi vyaṇukā ādi prakrameṇa ārabdham īśvara kartṛ kañca iti evam hitam upadiśatsu vaiśeṣikeṣu na evam etat pradhāna pūrvaka tvāt jagataḥ iti jñānam viparyayaḥ sāṃkhyānām pradhāna stitve pramāṇa abhāvāt

atha asti anvaya parimāṇa śakti pravṛtti upakārya upakāraka bhāva vaiśvarūpyebhyaḥ pradhānam tathā hi sarvam idam śarīra ādi kārya sukha duḥkha moha anvitam upalabhyate yat ca anvitam tat ekasmāt kāraṇāt utpadyamānam dṛṣṭam yathā ekasmāt mṛd piṇḍāt mṛd anvitam aneka ghaṭa ādi tathā ca anumānam bhuvana ādi kāryam ekasmāt kāraṇā dutpadyate anvita tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat tathā ca asya pakṣa dharma tvam sukha duḥkha ādi samanvayasya sarveṣu śarīra ādiṣu bhāvāt na ca atatsvabhāvāt kāraṇāt sukha ādeḥ utpattiḥ iti śarīra ādeḥ sukha duḥkha moha ātmaka tvam tad janaka tvāt tathā prasāda ādi janaka tva upalabdheḥ ca tad svabhāva tvam sukha ādayaḥ tu sattva rajaḥ tamasām pariṇāma viśeṣāḥ tatas artha antaram na bhavanti kāryasya kāraṇāt bheda anupapatteḥ atas sattva rajaḥ tamāṃsi eva śabda ādi ātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānāni sukha duḥkha moha ātmakam kāryam upajanayanti iti śabda ādayaḥ api na sattva ādibhyaḥ vyatiricyante sattva raja stamasā añca sāmya avasthā pradhānam

tathā parimita tvāt ca yat parimitam tat ekasmāt kāraṇāt utpadyate yathāṅa kura ādi bījāt parimita tvañca iyattā avadhāraṇa viṣaya tvam tathā śarīra ādi kāryam ekasmāt utpadyate parimita tvāt aṅkura ādi vat śakti pravṛtteḥ ca śaktyā hi kāraṇam kārya athinā upādīyate iti sarvam kārya sva kāraṇe śakti rūpa tayā vyavasthitam tāvat yāvat pradhānam iti nanu evam sarve syā api kāryasya pradhānāt abhede vidyamāna tvāt katham utpatti vināśau iti asataḥ khara viṣāṇa ādeḥ iva kāryatva anupapatteḥ sataḥ eva āvirbhāva tirobhau iti brūmaḥ śakti rūpa tayā hi vyavasthitam kārya param vyakti rūpa tām āpadyate punar tu tirobhāve śakti rūpa tayā vyavatiṣṭhate na sat nirudhyate iti

tathā parasparam upakārya upakāraka bhāvena avasthitānām āsandikā aṅgānāma kasmāt kārakāt utpatteḥ upalambhāt śarīra ādeḥ api tathā abhāva upalabdheḥ eka kāraṇa pūrvaka tvam sādhyate tathā dadhi ādi vaiśvarūpyasya ekasmāt kṣīrāt utpatteḥ upalambhāt śarīra ādi vaici tryasya api eka kāraṇa pūrvaka tvam sādhyate yat ca ekam kāraṇam tat pradhānam iti tasmāt ca mahān mahataḥ ahaṅkāraḥ tasmāt pañca tanmātrāṇi ekādaśa indriyāṇi tebhyaḥ bhūtāni iti
