sarvam etat asat anvaya ādeḥ gamaka tva anupapatteḥ tathā hi śarīra ādeḥ eka kāraṇa pūrvaka tve sādhye anvita tvam ahetuḥ sandigdha tvāt atha sukha duḥkha ādi samanvita tvam hetuḥ tat na svarūpa asiddha tvāt tathā hi sukhaḥkha ādīnām pūrvam eva ātma guṇa tvena pratipādita tvāt śarīra ādi guṇa tvam asiddham ghaṭa ādi dṛṣṭāntaḥ api sādhana vikalaḥ tatra anvitasya eka kāraṇa pūrvaka tvena vyāptasya anupalambhāt atha mṛd anvita tvam ghaṭādau asti tat ca asiddham pakṣe pratyakṣeṇa ca śarīra ādeḥ upādānam pratiniyata jātīyam anekam upalabhyate iti kāla atyaya apadiṣṭañca sādhanam

evam parimita tvam iyatta avadhāraṇa viṣaya tvam asiddham avāntara bhedena śarīrāḥ derānantyāt atha varga apekṣayā parimita tvam tathā api anaikāntika tvam para dṛṣṭayā nityeṣu api bhāvāt sattva rajaḥ tamāṃsi ca parimitāni na ca eka kāraṇa pūrvakā nīti pradhānasya eva tad rūpa tvāt tathā eka kāraṇa pūrvakatva abhāve api paramāṇvā dīni varga apekṣayā parimitāni iti aṅakura ādeḥ api bhauma anala sambandhāt bījā vayava kriyā krameṇa pūrva dravya vināśe sati dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa utpādāt eka kāraṇa pūrvaka tvam asiddham

yat ca idam śaktānām kāraṇānām kārya utpattau vyāpārāt śakti rūpa tayā kāryasyāḥ vasthānam iti uktam tat asat śakteḥ caramasahakāri rūpa tayā kāryāt artha antara tvāt na ca kārya kāraṇayoḥ ekatvam vibhinna pratibhāsa viṣaya tvāt pratibhāsa bhedaḥ ca padārthānām bheda vyavahāre hetuḥ tad sadbhāve api ekatva abhyupagame sarveṣām eka tā prasa jānna caturviṃśati tattvāni iti syāt tathā svarūpa bhedaḥ artha kriyā bhedaḥ ca kārya kāraṇayoḥ sūkṣmam anekañca samavāyi kāraṇam adhikam ekañca kāryam iti tasya pūrva kāraṇeṣu asattvam anupalambhāt atha anabhivyakteḥ anupalambhaḥ

sadbhāve kim pramāṇam utpatteḥ iti ced na vidyamānasya utpatteḥ ayogāt atha avidyamānaḥ sya utpattau khara viṣāṇa ādīnām utpattiḥ syāt na kāraṇa abhāvāt yeṣām hi kāraṇam asti janakam teṣām eva utpatti khara viṣāṇa ādiṣu etat asti kārya abhāvena eva kāraṇa abhāva pratīteḥ evam tantuṣu ghaṭa ādeḥ mūpiṇḍe ca paṭa ādeḥ anutpattiḥ vācyā pratiniyata sāmagryāḥ pratiniyata kārya janaka tvāt tantu upalakṣitā hi sāmagnī paṭasya eva janikā upalabdhā anyā tu anyasya iti upādāneṣu kārya niyamaḥ na sattvāḥ diti yat ca utpadyate tad utpatteḥ pūrvam asat na punar yat yat asat tat utpadyate iti vyāptiḥ yat ca utpadyamāna tvena hetunā sattvam tat asat tasya asādhāraṇa tvena āgama katvāt tathā hi sati ākāśa ādau asati ca khara viṣāṇa ādau utpadyamāna tvam na asti iti

yat ca ayam vyapadeśaḥ aṅakuraḥ jāyate ghaṭam kuviti ayam api mukhya bādhaka pramāṇa sadbhāvāt bhāktaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ tathā hi yadi vidyamānasya eva ghaṭasya karma tva maṅakurasya ca kartṛ tvam idhi eta utpattiāhatā syāt vidyamāna tvāt eva kāraka vyāpāra vaiyarthyañca atha abhivyakti artham vyāpāraḥ tat asat abhivyaktar api vidya māna tvāt atha abhivyaktiḥ avidyamānā eva kriyate tarhi sat utpadyate iti vyāha tam abhivyakteḥ tu svarūpa upalambhasya avidyamānasya eva utpatteḥ na ca āvaraṇa vyapagamaḥ abhivyaktiḥ āvaraṇasya eva anupalabdhaḥ tasmāt vidyamānasya utpatti arthā sambhavāt upacaritam aṅakura ādeḥ sva janikartṛ tvam karma tvañca iti vyapadeśasya anyathā siddha tvam

yat ca idam upakārya upakāraka bhāva āpanna tvāt eka kāraṇa pūrvakatvam iti uktam tada pyasat yadi paraspara apekṣāṇām eka kārya janaka tvam upakārya upakāraka bhāvaḥ viva kṣitaḥ sa ca nityeṣu asti iti vyabhicārī sādhya vikalaḥ ca dṛṣṭāntaḥ vibhinna kāraka janya tvāt āsandikā aṅgānām tathā dadhi ādi vaiśva rūpyam api ukta kāraṇa pūrvakam na bhavati sva avayava kārya tvāt tathā hi sva avayavebhyaḥ dadhyutpadyate na kṣīrāt bhauma anala sambandhāt avayava kriyā nyāyena vinaṣṭe hi kṣīre punar utpanna pāka vyaṇuka ādi krameṇa dadhi ādeḥ utpatti rityataḥ vaiśvarūpyasya eka kāraṇa pūrvakatva abhāvaḥ pratyakṣeṇa ca pakṣe pratiniyata jātīyam aneka kāraṇam upalabdham iti kāla atyaya apadiṣṭañca vaiśvarūpyam iti

na ca kiñcid kāryam ekasmāt eva kāraṇāt utpadyamānam upalabdham iti avidya mānasa pakṣasya anvayādevi pakṣe sadbhāvaḥ tat evam anvaya ādīnām agamaka tvāt pradhāna asiddhau buddhi ādeḥ a sambhavaḥ eva pratihataḥ ca pradhāna vādaḥ asmad gurubhiḥ vista reṇa iti na iha pratanyate atas sāṃkhyānām ayam viparyayaḥ pradhāna pūrvakam jagat iti

tathā śarīrasya parimāṇa bhedena bheda upapatteḥ śarīram eva ātmā iti abhyupagame pratisandhānam na syāt iti ātmanaḥ śarīra ādi vyatirekeṇa nitya tvam pratipattavyam iti hitam upadiśatsu vaiśeṣikeṣu ahita jñānam viparyayaḥ laukāyatikānām samānañcai tat saugata ja enānām tathā hi saṅkoca vikāsa dharmaka tvāt ātmanaḥ sa pariṇāma tve anya tvena bheda upapatteḥ smaraṇam na syāt bodhāt ca bodha rūpa tā iti pratibandha pratiṣedhāt bodha mātre api ātmani smaraṇa anutpattau śreyaḥ buddheḥ abhāvaḥ iti alam vistareṇa iti

sajāyate tatra pratyakṣa viṣaye tāvat prasiddhārtheṣu aprasiddhārtheṣu vā vyāsaṅgāt anathi tvāt vā kim iti ālocana mātram anadhyavasāyaḥ yathā bāhīkasya panasa ādiṣu anadhya vasāyaḥ bhavati tatra sattā dravya tva pṛthivī tva vṛkṣa tva śākhā adya pekṣaḥ adhyavasāyaḥ bhavati panasa tvam api panaseṣu anuvṛtta bhāmra ādibhyaḥ vyāvṛttam pratyakṣam eva kevalantu upadeśa abhāvāt viśeṣa saṃjñā pratipattiḥ na bhavati ) idānīm anadhyavasāyasya kāraṇa svarūpa viṣaya vibhāga nirūpaṇa artham na param viparyayaḥ * anadhyavasāyaḥ api pratyakṣa anumāna viṣaye san jāyate ityādi prakaraṇam anadhyavasitiḥ anadhyavasāyaḥ jñānam aniścaya ātmakam tat ca saṃśayāḥ dibhyaḥ artha antaram kāraṇa bhedāt viṣaya bhedāt ca iti

* tatra pratyakṣa viṣaye tāvat * vyākhyāyate * prasiddha artheṣu aprasi ddhārtheṣu * ca viṣayeṣu bhavati iti atas saṃśayāt bhidyate saṃśayaḥ hi prasiddha artheṣu eva bhavati iti atha prasiddha artheṣu kutas kāraṇāt anadhyavasāyaḥ iti āha * vyāsaṅgāda na thi tvāt vā * iti yathā vyāsaṅgāt iṣukārasya iṣau āsakta manasaḥ mahati gate api rājani kinnāmā ayam gataḥ iti anadhyavasāyaḥ anarthi tvāt sva anuṣṭhāna niratasya tapasvinaḥ mahati api rājani anadhyavasāyaḥ kinnāmā ayam gataḥ iti

na ca ayam saṃśayaḥ tasya ubhayollekhitvāt sāmānya upalambha ādibhyaḥ caḥ tpadyamāna tvāt ca iti atas anadhyavasāyaḥ itarasmāt bhidyate yathā ukta kāraṇa janya tvāt yathā uktam vā jñānam anadhyavasāyaḥ iti vyavahartavyam ukta kāraṇebhyaḥ niṣpadyamāna tvāt yaḥ tu na bhidyate na ca evam vyavahriyate na ca asābukta kāraṇebhyaḥ niṣpadyate yathā saṃśaya ādiḥ iti tasya svarūpam āha * kim iti ālocana mātram * kim nāma iti jñānam viśeṣa saṃjñā ullekha śūnyam anadhyavasāyaḥ iti

aprasiddha artheṣu * yathā bāhīkasya panasa ādiṣu anadhyavasāyaḥ bhavati * bāhīkaḥ hiṭhakaḥ hiraṭhakaḥ tasya panasa ādiṣu saṅketa abhāvāt viśeṣa saṃjñā ullekha śūnyam kinnāmā ayam iti jñānam utpadyate tatra hi * sattā dravya tva pṛthivī tva vṛkṣa tu arūpa ādi śākhā ādi apekṣaḥ adhyavasāyaḥ * eva tathā hi san ayam iti niścaya jñānam tathā dravyam pṛthivī vṛkṣaḥ rūpa ādimān chākhā ādimān ca iti adhyavasāyaḥ eva tathā panasatvam api nirvikalpaka bodhe * panaseṣu anuvṛttam āmra ādibhyaḥ vyāvṛ ttam pratyakṣam eva

nanu evam tarhi kva viṣaye anadhyavasāyaḥ iti āha * kevalantu upadeśa abhāvāt * saṅketa abhāvāt viśeṣa saṃjñā ullekhinī panasaḥ ayam iti * pratipattiḥ na bhavati * iti nanu evam tarhi pratipatti abhāvaḥ anadhyavasāyaḥ syāt tasya ca abhāva rūpa tvāt avi dyāyām antarbhāvaḥ anupapannaḥ na etat evam kinnāma ayam iti aniścaya ātmaka jñānasya saṃśaya ādi vilakṣaṇasya anubhūyamāna tayā palāpa ayogāt tasya ca avidyā lakṣaṇa yukta tvāt avidyāyām antarbhāvaḥ iti

* anumāna viṣaye api nālikera dvīpa vāsinaḥ * akṛta samayasya piṇḍān upa lambhe * sāsnā mātra darśanāt kaḥ nu khalu atra prāṇī syāt iti anadhi avasāyaḥ bhavati * pūrvam hi saṅketa apratipattau api sāsnā prāmāṇya abinā bhūta upalabdhā tad upala mbhāt piṇḍa anupalambhe api avinā abhā a sambandha smaraṇa anantaram parāmarśa jñāne sati kaḥ nu khalu atra pradeśe prāṇi iti kinnāmā atra prāṇi iti syāt iti anadhyavasāyaḥ

tat evam anadhyavasāyasya kāraṇa ādi bhedena bhedam abhidhāya svapna nirūpaṇam āha * uparata indriya grāmasya * ityādi uparataḥ sva viṣaya grahaṇam prati nivṛttaḥ indriyāṇām grāmaḥ yasya asau tathā uktaḥ tasya pralīna manaskasya * iti pralīna na indriya deśena saṃyuktam manaḥ yasya asau tasya pralīna manaskasya * indriya dvāreṇa iva yat anubhavanam mānasam utpadyate * tat svapna jñānam iti manasi bhavam mānasam tat ca smaraṇa sukha adya pi bhavati iti tad nivṛtti artham anubhavana padam anubhavanañca bāhya indriya ja mapi iti mānasa grahaṇam tathā api sukha duḥkha ādi anubhavaiḥ vyabhicāraḥ tad artham uparata indriya grāmasya iti sukha ādi anubhavaḥ ca indriya jaḥ eva manasaḥ tatra vyāpārāt atha uparata indri yagrāmasya mānasam svapna antikam api bhavati iti vyabhicāraḥ tat na tasya smṛtirū patayā anubhavana padena eva vyavacchinna tvāt

anye tu asya vyavaccheda artham avidyā sāmānya lakṣaṇam anuvartayanti iti na ca nimīlita akṣasya nīla pīta ādi jñānam uparata indriya grāmasya bhavati ityā śaṅkanīyam viṣaya sānnidhye sati indriya antareṇa tasya jñāna utpādāt yadā hi viṣaya sānnidhye api na indriyeṇa · jñānam tadā eva uparata indriya grāmaḥ puruṣaḥ amidhīyate iti na ca cakṣuḥ vyāpāram vinā nīla pīta ādiṣu anubhavanam sambhavati iti smaraṇa metat nāyyam tat ca anubhava padena eva vyavacchinnam nanu evam api uparata indriya grāmasya mānasa anubhavana tvāt svapna jñānam itarasmāt bhidyate iti ukte vyabhicāra abhāvaḥ kimartham pralīna manaskasya indriya dvāreṇa iva iti pada dvayam lakṣaṇa antara artham tathā hi pralīna manaskasya yat anubhavanam mānasam tat svapna jñānam iti dvitīyam lakṣaṇam pralona manaskasya svapna antikam api bhavati iti anubhavana padam anubhavanañca sukha ādiṣu bhavati iti pralīna m anaskapadam

atas pralīna manaskā anu bhava tvāt itarasmāt bhidyate tathā indriya dvāreṇa iva utpa dyamāna tve sati mānasa anubhavana tvāt iti indriya dvāreṇa iva utpadyate svapna antika mataḥ anubhavanam iti anubhavanañca sukha ādau api bhavati iti indriya dvāreṇa iva iti padam atha katham svapna jñānam utpadyate puruṣaḥ ca uparata indriya grāmaḥ pralīna manaskaḥ ca bhavati iti āha * yadā * ityādi yadā anta hṛdaye na bāhye nirgatāni indriyāṇi yasya asau tathā uktaḥ tasmin ātma pradeśe niścalam kriyā śūnyam manaḥ tiṣṭhati tadā puruṣaḥ pralīna manaskaḥ iti ākhyāyate

anye tu āgama abhimatam adhomukham kamalam nirindriya ātma pradeśaḥ tatra niścalam manaḥ tiṣṭhati iti bruvate sa ca viśiṣṭa ātma sambandhaḥ kriyā prabandhāt kriyā santānāt bhavati kriyā prabandhaḥ ca ātmā antaḥkaraṇa saṃyogāt adṛṣṭa kāritāt prayatna apekṣāt utpadyate tathā hi manaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam ātma manaḥ saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam adṛṣṭa kārita prayatnaḥ nimitta kāraṇam iti evam manasi kriyā prabandhāt viśiṣṭa ātma pradeśena saṃyogaḥ svā pākhyaḥ sampadyate sa ca kadā * niśi * iti bāhulya apekṣayā tasya kimarthañca bhava ti iti *viśrāma artham āhāra pariṇāma artham vā * iti puruṣa bheda apekṣayā samastam vyaḥ tañca etat vivakṣitam kasyacid ekam prayojanam kasyacid ubhayam api bhavati iti kiviśiṣṭasya prāṇinaḥ ahani khinnasya kutas

śarīra vyāpārāt sa ca nāvādya ārūḍhasya api sambhavati na ca tasmāt khedaḥ tad artham * buddhi pūrvāt * buddhiḥ ca smaraṇa icchā dvāreṇa vyāpāra utpattau kāraṇam na sākṣāt tathā api śarīra antareṣu buddhi pūrvakaḥ vyāpāraḥ niyoga dvāreṇa sambhavati na ca tasmāt khedaḥ tad artham * ātmanaḥ * sva śarīrasya iti evam ukta krameṇa nirindriya pradeśa sambaddham pralīnam manaḥ apadiśyate pralīne ca tasmin uparata indriya grāmaḥ puruṣaḥ bhavati manasā anadhiṣṭhitānām indriyāṇām sva viṣaye vyāpāra asambhavāt jīva nantu tasyām avasthāyām anumīyate * prabandhena * sātatyena prāṇa apāna santā nasya pravṛttau satyām tathā hi prāṇa apāna santāna pravṛttiḥ prayatna kāryā na ca icchā dveṣa pūrvakaḥ prayatnaḥ atra sambhavati atas jīvana pūrvakaḥ prayatnaḥ anumīyate iti vakṣyāmaḥ prayatna adhikāre

atha evam pralīna manaskasya uparata indriya grāmasya ātmanaḥ kutas svapna jñānam utpadyate iti āha * ātma manaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt * asamavāyi kāraṇāt svāpaḥ iti ākhyā saṃjñā yasya ātma manaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣasya asau tathā uktaḥ tasmāt * saṃskārāt ca * iti saṃskāraḥ smṛti utpatti dvāreṇa svapna jñāna utpattau kāraṇam iti yat vā svāpa ākhyāt iti saṃskāra viśeṣaṇam yaḥ hi saṃskāraḥ svāpāva sthāyām smṛti dvāreṇa sva saṃjñāna hetuḥ bhavati asau svāpa ākhyaḥ iti tasmāt diś kāladibhyaḥ ca indriya dvāreṇa iva asatsu avidyamāneṣu viṣayeṣu hasti ādiṣu pratyakṣa ākāram pratyakṣam iva svapna jñānam utpadyate

anye tu kuḍya ādayaḥ eva hasti ātmanā vyavasthitāḥ svapna jñānasya ālambana miti manyante yat ca idam asatsu viṣayeṣu utpadyate svapna jñānam iti uktam tat api hasti ādi svarūpa apekṣayā tena hi rūpeṇa teṣām asattvāt iti tat etat asat kuḍya ādeḥ ālambana tve pramāṇa abhāvāt na ca svapna utthitasya mama ete kuḍya ādayaḥ hasti ādi rūpa tayā pratibhātā iti pratyabhijñānam asti na api indriyāṇām kuḍya ādiṣu hasti ādi jñāna janmani vyāpāraḥ sambhavati tat vyā pāra uparame sati tatra jñānasya bhavanāt manasaḥ api bahis viṣaye svātantryeṇa vyāpāraḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ eva tasmāt niviṣayaḥ eva svapna jñānam iti

atha svapna jñānam na viparyaya ādibhyaḥ artha antaram tathā hi svapna jñānam atas smiḥ tat iti utpadyamānam viparyaya jñānam eva kim ayam sthāṇuḥ puruṣaḥ vā iti ubhaya ullekhitve sati saṃśaya jñānam kināma ayam iti ca utpāde anadhyavasāyaḥ iti na svapna jñāna metebhyaḥ artha antaram pṛthak abhidhānantu śubha aśubha sūcaka tvāt iti

na etat yuktam kāraṇa ādi bhedena asya viparyaya ādibhyaḥ artha antara tvāt iti kecid tathā hi viparyaya jñānam pratyakṣa anumāna viṣaye pitta kapha anila upahata indriyasya puruṣasya utpadyate saṃśayaḥ tu sāmānya upalambha āt itaḥ pratyakṣa anumāna viṣaye prasiddhaḥ bhaya viśeṣasya bhavati iti evam anadhyavasāyasya api vilakṣaṇam eva kāraṇam uktam tat vi parītāni tu svapna jñāna utpattau kāraṇāni iti kāraṇa bhedāt bhedaḥ lakṣaṇa bhede api abheda abhyupagame sarvatra tathā abhāva prasaṅgaḥ tathā atyanta aprasiddhe api artha svapna jñāna mutpadyate na ca evam viparyaya ādau iti tasmāt u ubhayā ullekhitvā ādi sat abhāve api svapna lakṣaṇa upapatteḥ saṃśaya ādi vilakṣaṇam svapna jñānam eva etat iti abhyupagantavyam

tasya kāraṇa bhedāt bhedam āha * tat tu * svapna jñānam * trividham saṃskāra pāṭavāt dhātu doṣāt adṛṣṭāt ca * iti saṃskāra pāṭavāt tāvat svapna jñāna mā āha * kāmī * yasyām aṅganāyām anuraktaḥ tām ādṛtaḥ atiśayena prayatna yuktaḥ cinta yat kruddhaḥ vā ayam śatru prayatnāt cintayan svapiti * sā eva * suptasya * cintā santatiḥ pratyakṣa ākārā san jāyate * na adṛṣṭāt

dhātu doṣāt svapnam āha * vāta prakṛtiḥ bātam adhikam nimittam apekṣamāṇaiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ ārabdhaḥ vāta dūṣitaḥ ca tathāvidha āhāra upagamāt ākāśa ādi gamanāni paśyati evam pitta prakṛtiḥ iti ādau api draṣṭavyam adṛṣṭa kāritam svapnam āha * yat svayam anubhūteṣu ananubhūteṣu * artheṣu * prasiddheṣu aprasiddheṣu vā * śubha avedakam utpadyate svapna jñānam tat adṛṣṭāt tatra yat gaja ārohaṇa chatra lābha ādi śubha āvedakam * tat sarvam saṃskāra dharmābhyām * utpadyate saṃskāraḥ hi pūrva anubhava janitaḥ sa ca smṛti utpatti dvāreṇa svapna jñāna utpattau kāraṇam

viparītam aśubha avedakam * taila abhyañjana khara uṣṭra ārohaṇa ādi * tat ca adharma saṃskārābhyām bhavati atyanta aprasiddheṣu ananubhūteṣu adṛṣṭāt eva svapna jñānam utpadyate tathā hi brahma ādi pada ārūḍham ātmānam paśyati iti atha svapna antam svapna jñānam eva āhosvit artha antaram iti āha * svapnānti kam * svapna ante svapna avasāne bhavam svapna antikam * yadi api uparata indriya grāmasya bhavati tathā api * smṛtiḥ eva iti atīta jñāna prabandha pratyavekṣaṇāt * iti atītaḥ ca asau jñāna prabandhaḥ ca tasmin pratyavekṣaṇa rūpa tvāt smṛtiḥ eva iti

evam yathā ukta rūpā caturvidhā bhavati avidyā iti upasaṃhāraḥ anye tu * eṣā * yathā mayā vyākhyātā tathā caturvidhā bhavati avidyā anyathā hi vividhā eva iti atha idānī vidyā svarūpa nirūpaṇa artha na kevalam avidyā vidyā api caturvidhāḥ * ityādi prakaraṇam kena rūpeṇa iti āha * pratyakṣa laiṅgika smṛti ārṣa lakṣaṇā * tad svarūpa iti pratyaṣṭiḥ pratyakṣam liṅga darśanāt sañjāyamānam laiṅgikam smaraṇam smṛtiḥ ṛṣīṇām idam ārṣam iti

nanu śābda jñānasya api vidyā rūpa tvāt iha anupanyāse kim prayojanam vipratipatti jñāpanam iti tathā hi śābdam anumāne antarbhavati iti kecid anye tu pramāṇa antaram iti vaiśeṣikāṇām vipratipattiḥ tena iha an abhidhānam atra tu vidyā vibhāga pareṇa api vākyena upasarjana tayā tad janakam api sāmagrayām pratijñātam eva prādhānyena tu karaṇa vyutpatti dvāreṇa pratyakṣa ādi vibhāga abhyupagame vidyā vibhāgani rūpaṇam upasarjana tayā syāt tat tu na yuktam buddhi bhedasya pūrva pratijñātasya iha nirūpaṇāt

tatra pratyakṣasya nirūpaṇa artham āha * akṣam akṣam pratītya utpadyate iti pratyakṣam * pratigatam akṣam pratyakṣam iti prādi samāsaḥ anyathā avyayībhāva samāsāḥ bhyupagame pratyakṣa rūpam pratyakṣāḥ pumāṃsaḥ pratyakṣā strī iti liṅga bhedaḥ vacana bhedaḥ ca na syāt akṣam akṣam iti bīpsā vidhānam sakala indriya avarodha artham atha akṣam iti sāmānya śabdāt sakala indriya avarodhaḥ bhavati eva na sāmānya śabda syobhayatha api pravṛtteḥ tathā hi brāhmaṇaḥ na hantavyaḥ iti sakala brāhmaṇa apekṣayā pratiṣedhaḥ brāhmaṇān bhojaya iti brāhmaṇa viśeṣa apekṣayā niyogaḥ tasmāt vyāpti artham vīpsā karaṇam iti atha vīpsā sadbhāve api vyāpti palabdhā yathā antarvedyām nāmaḥ grāmaḥ ramaṇīyaḥ rimaṇīyaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣe guṇa viśeṣaḥ iti vīpsā karaṇam atra satyam a tathā api alpa saṃkhyā yogini padārthe vyāptau ava vīpsā upalabdha iti

anye tu dvitīya akṣa padam avadhāraṇa artham iti manyante akṣam eva pratītya prāpya yat utpadyate jñānam tat pratyakṣam atha jñānasya anutpanna tvāt akṣeṇa prāptinā asti iti katham akṣam prāpya utpadyate upacārasya vivakṣita tvāt adoṣaḥ yathā hi śiśuraya mātaram bhakṣayitvā upajātaḥ iti ataeva akṣa āśritam kāryam iti tittvena tat jñānam iti indriya rūpa ādiḥ ca indriya āśritaḥ na ca jñānam iti

nanu evam api saṃśaya jñānañcākṣam pratītya utpadyate iti atiprasaṅgaḥ tat na vidyā sāmānya lakṣaṇa anuvṛttiḥ tu viśeṣa lakṣaṇe anukte api labhyate iti vakṣyāta ca ayat avitatham avyapadeśyam jñānam utpadyate tat pratyakṣa pramāṇam iti na vitatham avi tatham iti anena viparyaya saṃśaya jñāna yoguṃdāsaḥ vitatham hi saṃśaya jñānam vipayaya jñānañca iti

anye tu pratitantra nyāyena vyavasāya ātmaka padam anuvartanīyam iti manyante avyapadeśyam iti vyapadeśaḥ śabdaḥ tasya idam vyapadeśyam na vyapadeśyam avyapadeśyam aśabda janyam jñānam iti nanu akṣam prāpya na utpadyate śābda jñānam iti anena iva vyavacchinnam na indriya sahakāriṇā śabdena yat janyate tasya vyavaccheda atha tvāt tathā hi akṛta samayaḥ rūpam paśyan api cakṣuṣā rūpam iti na jānīta rūpam iti śabda uccāraṇa anantaram pratipadyate iti ubhaya jam jñānam

nanu ca śabda indriyayoḥ ekasmin eva kāle vyāpāra asambhavāt ayuktam etat tathā hi manasā adhiṣṭhitantu śrotram śabdam gṛhṇāti punar kriyā krameṇa cakṣuṣā sambandha sati rūpa grahaṇam na ca śabda jñānasya etāvatakālam avasthānam sambhavati iti kathana bhaya jam jñānam atra ekā śrotra sambaddhe manasi kriyā utpannā vibhāgam ārabhata vibhāgāt ca yadā eva saṃyogasya vinaśyattā tadā eva śabda jñānasya utpadyamāna tā tatas śabda jñānasya utpādaḥ saṃyogasya vināśaḥ uttara saṃyogasya utpadyamāna tā tatas viṣaya sambaddha na caluṣā saha saṃyogasya utpādaḥ rūpa jñānasya utpadyamāna tā tatas sva jñāna sahāya śabda sahakāriṇā cakṣuṣā rūpa jñānam utpadyate iti ubhaya jam jñānam

yat vā gṛhītasya śabdasya artha paricchede vyāpāraḥ iti ayam niyamaḥ na avaśyam ahaṇa sahakāriṇā iti kāla antareṇa api manasaḥ cakṣuṣā sambandhe rūpa śabdasya gṛhāta tvāt bhavati eva ubhaya jam jñānam kārya sadbhāvena ca kāraṇa kalpanā kriyate tat caha upalabdham iti anena krameṇa utpattiḥ cintyate tathā śabdena vyapadeśāt cakṣuṣā paśyatā api rūpam iti mayā na jñātam rūpa śabdāt ca pratipannam iti ubhaya jam jñānam yāda śabdasya vyāpārāt apratyakṣa tarhi indriya vyāpārāt na śābdam iti pramāṇa antara kala syāt na etat evam pratyakṣa lakṣaṇe avyapadeśyam iti viśeṣaṇa vat śabda lakṣaṇe ānandriya jam iti viśeṣaṇa aśravaṇāt śabde sahakāri niyamāḥ bhāvaḥ śābdam hi śāna śabdāt indriya sahakāriṇaḥ tad rahitāt vā bhavatu sarvathā tad janakam śābda pramāṇam bhavati

atra ca akṣam pratītya utpadyate yat jñānam tat pratyakṣam iti vākye vivaraṇa vāki eṣa catuṣṭaya ādi sannikarṣa abhidhānāta ṣoḍhā sambandhaḥ labhyate eva sa ca saṃyogaḥ sa yukta samavāyaḥ saṃyukta samaveta samavāyaḥ samaveta samavāyaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ ca iti nanu evam api indriya artha sannikarṣa padena eva vyavacchinnam atha indriyam manaḥ artha ca ātmā tad sannikarṣāt anumāna ādi jñānam api bhavati iti pratyakṣa phalam syāt jñāna mātra utpattau antaḥkaraṇasya indriya tva anapapatteḥ karaṇa tva ādi viśeṣaṇasyā parākṣa jñāna janaka tvam indriya lakṣaṇam iti uktam na ca anumāna jñānam indri grāhye arthe bhavati iti tat evam indriyam pratītya arthe yat avitatham avyapadeśyam vyavasāya ātmakam jñānam utpadyate tat yatas bhavati tat pratyakṣam iti phala viśeṣaṇa pakṣaḥ etāni tu avyabhicāritva ādīni vyavacchedakāni atīte api viśeṣya jñāne buddhi samāropaṇāt bhavanti iti

sāmagrī viśeṣaṇa pakṣe tu na sākṣāt avyabhicāri tva ādi viśeṣaṇa yogaḥ atha akṣam akṣam pratītya utpadyate sāmagrī tasyāḥ kāraka sākalya rūpa tvāt sākalyantu caramasahakāri prāptau eva na pūrvam iti utpadyate eva tathā jñāyate anayā iti jñāna makṣa ādhupa lakṣitā sāmagrī eva avyabhicāri vyavasāya ātmikā avyapadeśya padena jñāna janaka tvena sāmagryāḥ tat vyapadeśaḥ iti sāmagrī viśeṣaṇa pakṣe api viśe ṣaṇa yogaḥ satyam tathā api avyabhicāritvā ādi viśeṣaṇāni phalasya tad dvāreṇa tu sāmagryāḥ bhavanti iti param phala viśeṣaṇa pakṣaḥ

sva rūpa viśeṣaṇa pakṣaḥ tu nirastaḥ eva pramāṇa śabdasya karaṇa artha tvāt tathā hi pramīyate anena iti pramāṇam yena kartṛ karma vilakṣaṇena pramā kriyate sva rūpa viśeṣaṇa pakṣe tu na janya janaka rūpa tayā pramāṇasya prāmāṇyam kintvavya bhicāri tva ādi dharma upeta tvena eva tat ca ati vyāpakam avyāpakañca tathā ca parāmarśa ādi jñānasya api evam rūpam asti na ca tasya pratyakṣa tvam anumiti janaka tvena anumāna tvāt sa anayāḥ tu pratyakṣa tvena abhimatāyāḥ pratyakṣa tvam na labhyate iti avyāptiḥ

saugatānān tu pramāṇa phalayoḥ avyatirekaḥ iti tad pakṣe sva rūpa viśeṣaṇa tā eva ghaṭate tathā hi sautra antikānām ākāraḥ pramāṇam prameyaḥ arthaḥ sva saṃvid phalam iṣyate iti jñānam saḥ eva pramāṇa phala vyavahāraḥ kalpanam vā na ca etat yuktam kriyā karaṇayoḥ abheda anapalabdheḥ na ca bodhe viṣaya ākāraḥ sambhavati ityu ktam katham tasya prāmāṇyam na ca meya rūpa tayā viṣaya paricchedye prāmāṇyam yuktam viṣayasya atyanta parokṣa tayā tena saha pratibandha anupalabdheḥ yadi ca agṛ hīta pratibandhaḥ vyāpāraḥ viṣaya viśeṣam gamayet atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt tathā ca rūpa ākārasya rūpavat rasa ādi vyavasthāpaka tvam api syāt ubhayatra api pratibandhā nupalambhasya aviśeṣāt na ca ākāra mātra saṃvedana vādinaḥ viṣaya viśeṣa antara grahaṇam ākāre sambhavati viṣayasya atyanta parokṣa tve avasthitasya pratisandha ātuḥ abhāve ca anvaya vyatirekayoḥ atyanta parokṣa tvāt

parakīyañca pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam guru bhi vistareṇa nirastam iti na uktam akṣa śabdasya aneka artha tvāt āha * akṣāṇi indriyāṇi * tāni tu * ghrāṇa rasana cakṣuḥ tvakṭotra manāṃsi * na karmendriyāṇi para abhyupagatāni nirviṣaya jñānasya pratiṣedhena smṛti vyavaccheda artham āha * tat hi * pratyakṣam yasmāt * dravya ādiṣu padārtha ghṛtpadyate * tasmāt na niviṣayam iti atra ca ādi śabdena guṇa karma sāmānyāni gṛhyante samavāyaḥ apoti anye anye tu indriyasya arthena sannikarṣa pratipādana artham atat hi dravya ādiṣu padārtheṣu tpadyate pratyakṣam tasmāt asti indriyeṇa saṃyukta samavāya ādi sambandhaḥ

yatas vā dravya ādiṣu padārtha īṣat padyate pratyakṣam atas * dravye tāvat * vyākhyāyate iti kim viśiṣṭe * trividhe * tisraḥ vidhā yasya tat tathā uktam tasmin * mahati * mahat tva adhikaraṇe * svarūpa ālocanam * nirvikalpakam jñānam utpadyate kutas * aneka dravyavattva udbhūta rūpa prakāśa catuṣṭaya sannikarṣāt * aneka dravya tvam vattvam ca udbhūta rūpañca prakāśaḥ ca catuṣṭaya sannikarṣaḥ ca iti tathā uktaḥ tasmāt * dharma ādi sāmagraye ca * iti anekañca dravyañca iti aneka dravyam tada yasya asti tat tadvat tasya bhāvaḥ aneka dravyavat tvam rūpañca atra rūpa viśeṣaḥ vivakṣitaḥ tathā ca sūtram mahat tvāt aneka dravyavat tvāt rūpa viśeṣāt ca dravyam pratyakṣam iti aparokṣa jñāna sadbhāve sati samastam vyaḥ tañca idam pratyakṣa jñānasya kāraṇam vivakṣitam iti uktam vāyu adhikāre catuṣṭaya sannikarṣaḥ ca ātmā manasā saṃyujyate manaḥ indriyeṇa indriyam arthana iti catuṣṭaya sannikarṣaḥ tasmāt dharma ādi sāmanaye ca iti ādi padāt diś kāla ādegrahaṇam iti

atha astu evam nirvikalpaka jñāna utpattiḥ sadbhāve kim pramāṇam sa vikalpa kajñāna utpattiḥ eva anyathā hi viśiṣṭa artha anupalabdhau viśiṣṭasya saṅketa smaraṇa sya anupapatteḥ sa vikalpakam jñānam na syāt tasya tad kāryatvāt na ca saṅketa smaraṇam eva tasya nimittam akṣaṇika tve sati arthasya nirvikalpa jñāna utpattā viva sa vikalpaka jñāna utpattau anvaya vyatirekābhyām vyāpāra upalabdheḥ iti ukta nyāyāt

tat evam nirvikalpakam pratipādya sa vikalpakam viśeṣya jñānam āha *sāmānya viśeṣa dravya guṇa karma viśeṣaṇa apekṣāt ityādinā sāmānyañca sāmānya viśeṣaḥ ca dravyañca guṇaḥ ca karma ca iti tathā uktāni tāni eva viśeṣaṇāni tānya pekṣate iti tad apekṣaḥ samuccaye na kevalam svarūpa ālocana mātra mukta kāraṇebhyaḥ niṣpadyate sāmānya ādi viśeṣaṇa apekṣañca tatas eva utpadyate iti

nanu catuṣṭaya sannikarṣasya apavādam vinā ūrdhvam sarvatra anuvṛtteḥ abhyupagamāt vyartham ātma manaḥ sannikarṣasya abhidhānam na anantara jñāne api asya asamavāyi kāraṇa tva jñāpana artha tvāt tatra sat iti sattā viśeṣaṇam dravyam iti sāmānyam viśeṣa apekṣam pṛthivī iti tathā viṣāṇi iti dravya viśeṣaṇam śuklaḥ iti guṇa viśeṣaṇa apekṣam gauḥ iti sāmānya viśeṣa viśeṣaṇa apekṣam gacchati iti kriyā viśiṣṭam jñānam iti udāharaṇāni

guṇa ādiṣu pratyakṣam āha * rūpa rasa gandha sparśeṣu viṣayeṣu aneka dravyeṇa saha samavāyāt *svagata viśeṣāt ca yat kṛtā kvacid viṣaye teṣām upa labdhiḥ yat abhāvāt ca anupalabdhiḥ saḥ udbhava samākhyātaḥ rūpa ādi dharmaḥ sahakāri viśeṣa stasmāt * sva āśraya sannikarṣāt * ca sva āśrayeṇa dravyeṇa saṃyuktam indriyam tat samavāyāt dharma ādi sāmagrace ca sati pratiniyata indriya nimittam utpadyate jñānam * śabdasya traya sannikarṣāt iti ātmā manasā saṃyujyate manaḥ indriyeṇa iti trayasya sannikarṣaḥ * śrotra samavetasya * iti indriya artha sanni karṣaḥ api upardāśataḥ eva tena eva śrotraṇa upalabdhiḥ na indriya antaraṇa iti

anye tu trayaḥ ca asau sannikarṣaḥ ca iti indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ api upalabhyate tasmāt śotra samaveta stha tena eva upalabdhiḥ iti * saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatvasnedvatva vega karmaṇām * grahaṇam kutas * pratyakṣa dravya samavāyāt cakṣuḥ sparśanābhyām * tad samavāyāt saṃkhyā ādīnām grahaṇam iti * buddhi sukha duḥkha iccha dveṣa prayatnānām dvayoḥ ātmanasoḥ * sannikarṣāt upalabdhiḥ buddhi ādayaḥ hi ātmani samavetāḥ tad sambaddhena manasā gṛhyante

sāmānye pratyakṣam āha * bhāva dravya tva guṇa tva karma tva ādīnām upalabhya ādhāra samavetānām āśraya grāhakaiḥ indriyaiḥ grahaṇam * bhāvaḥ ca dravya tvañca karma tvañca tathaḥ tāni tāni ādiḥ yeṣām ityādi padena pṛthivī tva utkṣepaṇa tva ādīnām grahaṇam upalabhyaḥ ca asau ādhāraḥ ca tad samavetānām āśraya grāhakaiḥ indriyaiḥ grahaṇam yenai vā indriyeṇa āśraya grahaṇam tena eva tad samavetānām sattā ādīnām grahaṇam iti tathā hi sattā dravye vartamānā saṃyukta samavāyena cakṣuḥ sparśanābhyām upalabhyate gandha rasa rūpaspa śeṣu samavetāḥ ghrāṇa rasana cakṣuḥ tvac indriyar upalabhyante saṃyukta samaveta samavāyena śabde tu samaveta samavāyāt śotreṇa sukha ādi tu saṃyukta samaveta samavāyāt manasā gṛhyate guṇa tvam api evam atas sattāyām guṇa tve ca sarva indriyam jñānam iti dravya tvam saṃyukta samavāyena cakṣuḥ sparśanābhyām upalabhyate karma tvañca saṃyukta samaveta samavāyāt rūpa tva ādau api evam grahaṇam iti etat asmad ādīnām pratyakṣam * ityu saṃhāraḥ

tathā asmad viśiṣṭānām yoginām keṣu artheṣu kathañca pratyakṣam utpadyate iti vyākhyāyate tatra yuktānām samādhi avasthānām yoga ja dharma anugṛhītena tad sahakāriṇā manasā aparokṣa svarūpa darśanam janyate keṣu artheṣu sva ātmā ca ātmā antarañcākāśañca diś ca kālaḥ ca vāyuḥ ca paramāṇavaḥ ca manaḥ ca iti tathā uktāni teṣu tathā na param sva ātma ādiṣu saṃyuktena manasā yoginām aparokṣa grahaṇam tad samaveteṣu guṇa karma sāmānya ādi viśeṣeṣu saṃyukta samavāyena samavāye ca saṃyukta viśeṣaṇa viśe vyabhāvena grahaṇam ataeva samavāyasya pṛthak abhidhānam vibhinna sannikarṣa paricche dyatvāt guṇa karmasu paramāṇu ādi gateṣu yat sāmānyam tatra saṃyukta samaveta sama vāyena

atha yogī yadā svam antaḥkaraṇam gṛhṇāti tadā kim karaṇam ātma manaḥ saṃyogaḥ tasmin manaḥ paricchedye manaḥ eva karaṇam iti parakīyena ca manasā sūkṣma śarīra stham manaḥ preryam abhisambandhayati tad sambadvañca tat gṛhṇāti iti * viyuktānām punar catuṣṭaya sannikarṣāt * asmad ādīnām iva pratyakṣam utpa dyate jñānam keṣu artheṣu sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭeṣu * iti sūkṣmāḥ paramā ṇavaḥ vyavahitāḥ nāga bhuvana ādayaḥ viprakṛṣṭāḥ mervādayaḥ teṣu aparokṣam jñānam asamādhi avasthānām yoga ja dharma anugraha sāmarthyāt tat utpadyate yogi indriyāṇām hi dharma viśeṣa anugraheṇa sarvatra apratibandhāt catuṣṭaya sannikarṣa grahaṇam udāharaṇa artham traya sannikarṣaṇā api grahaṇāt tathā hi yogī brahma ādi bhāṣitam yoga ja dharma anugrahāda pratibadhyamāna santāna nyāyena śrotra deśam āgatam gṛhṇāti traya sannikarṣeṇa

nanu sarvam etat asat yoginām sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt bādhaka upapatteḥ ca tathā ca na yogī atīndriya artha draṣṭā prāṇi tvāt asmad ādi vat yogi indriyāṇi vā na sarva viṣayāṇi indriya tvāt asmad ādi indriya vat na etat yuktam svatantre yogi nām aprasiddha tayā prāṇi tva ādi hetoḥ a āśraya asiddha tvāt atha para vyāptyā parasya aniṣṭa āpādanam etat tatra yadi samyak pramāṇena para prasiddhiḥ tena eva bādhya māna tvāt anutthānam tad pratiṣedha hetūnām na ca kāryeṇa eva kāraṇasya vyāghātaḥ tad antareṇa apakṣa dharma tayā tad mūlasya hetoḥ aprāmāṇya prasaṅgāt atha pramāṇam vinā eva pareṇa abhyupagatāḥ yoginaḥ iti pratiṣidhyante tarhi pramāṇa abhāvena eva prameyasya aprasiddharvi artham tad pratiṣedha anumānam

asti ca yoginām sadbhāve anumānam tathā hi asmad ādīnām pratyakṣeṇa anupalabhyamānāḥ paramāṇu ādayaḥ kasyacid pratyakṣāḥ prameya tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat iti pakṣīkṛteṣu paramāṇu ādiṣu prameya tvasya hetoḥ sadbhāvāt pakṣa dharma tvam tathā kasyacid pratyakṣeṇa sādhyena prameya tvasya hetaḥ ghaṃṭa ādau vyāpteḥ upalambhaḥ na ca asya pratyakṣa āgamābhyām asti bādhā na ayam sat pratipakṣaḥ iti avyabhicāri tvāt gamakaḥ eva

sarvañca anumānam sāmānyena vyāpti grahaṇa apekṣam pravartamānam pakṣe viśeṣa prasādha yati iti atas kasyacid pratyakṣam eva paramāṇu ādeḥ sāmānyena sādhyate yasya ca pratyakṣāḥ paramāṇu ādayaḥ saḥ asmad ādi vilakṣaṇaḥ yogī tathā abhyāsa vaśāt buddhaḥ tāratamyam upalabhyamānam kvacid viśrāntam tāra tamya śabda vācya tvāt aṇu parimāṇa tāratamya vat yatra viśrāmaḥ te asmad ādi vilakṣaṇā yoginaḥ iti anumānasya tu nirdiṣṭa tāyām yogi sadbhāva siddhaḥ śeṣam vacana mātram na bādhakam iti upekṣyate

tat evam yoginām ayogināñca pratyakṣam vyākhyāya śiṣya vyutpādanāya viprati patti nirāsa arthañca pramāṇa phala vibhāgam nirūpayati * tatra sāmānya viśeṣeṣu svarūpā locana mātram * ityādinā sāmānya viśeṣeṣu dravya tva guṇa tva karma tva ādiṣu svarūpa ālocana mātram ālocitiḥ ālocanam nirvikalpakam jñānam * pratyakṣa pramāṇam * tad upalakṣitā sāmagrī pratyakṣam pramāṇam iti mātrā abhidhānāt jñāna antara abhāvam darśayati * prameyāḥ iti pramīyante iti prameyāḥ pramāṇa paricchedyāḥ dravya ādayaḥ padārthāḥ pramiṇoti iti pramādhāra tvāt pramātā ātmā pramitiḥ pramāṇa ādi sādhyā pratītiḥ dravya ādi viṣayam jñānam phalam iti eva mitaretara vyāvṛtta lakṣaṇa yogi tvāt pramāṇa ādayaḥ paraspara vibhinnāḥ iti tad abheda vādinaḥ nirastāḥ bhavanti

atha pramāṇa phalayoḥ vyatireka abhyupagamāt sāmānya viśeṣeṣu svarūpa ālocanasya pramā rūpa tvāt utpattau kim pramāṇam iti āha * sāmānya viśeṣa jñāna utpattau avibhaktam » viśeṣaṇa jñāna śūnyam ālocyate anena iti ālocana mātram indriya artha sannikarṣā dhupa lakṣitam kāraka sāma agrayam pratyakṣam pramāṇam prameyam sāmānya viśeṣāḥ iti atha tasmin api svarūpa ālocane kasmāt na jñāna antaram iṣyate iti āha na tasmin svarūpa ālocane anyat pramāṇa antaram jñāna antaram asti iti aphala rūpa tva aniṣprayaḥ jana tvāt iti tathā hi viśeṣya jñānam viśeṣaṇa anuraktam anyathā anupapadyamāna viśeṣaṇa jñāna sattām darśayati na ca evam viśeṣaṇa jñāne viśeṣaṇa anurāgaḥ asti jñāna antara abhyupagame ca anavasthā syāt iti viśeṣya jñāna anutpattiḥ eva dṛṣṭañca viśeṣya jñānam atas na viśeṣaṇa jñāne jñāna antaram asti iti

anye tu sāmānya viśeṣeṣu svarūpa ālocana mātram iti mātrā abhidhānena nirākāram pratyakṣa pramāṇa phalam iti avate sāmānya viśeṣāḥ ca dravya ādayaḥ evāḥ nugata vyāvṛtta jñāna viyaya tvāt upacāreṇa vivakṣitāḥ atra hi jñāna viśeṣasya ākāra pratiṣedhe anyatra ākārabhyupagamaḥ syāt śeṣam pūrvavat yathā jñāne na ākāraḥ sambhavati tathā uktam jñāna kāravāda pratiṣedha avasare

* athavā * iti pramāṇa phala vibhāge prakāra antara upadarśanam na tu vikalpa na artham heya ādi jñāna utpattau api dravya ādi jñānam pramāṇam iti vākya arthaḥ tat āha * sarveṣu padārtheṣu * dravya ādiṣu * yat avitatham avyapadeśyam jñānam utpadyate tat pratyakṣa pramāṇam prameyāḥ dravya ādayaḥ padārthāḥ pramātā ātmā pramitiḥ guṇa doṣa m ādhyasthya darśanam * iti guṇa darśanam upādeya jñānam doṣa darśanam heya jñānam upekṣaṇīya jñānañca mādhyasthya darśanam iti

nanu dravya ādi jñāna utpattau aneka kāla vyavadhānena upādeya ādi jñānasya utpatteḥ katha dravya ādi jñāna phala tvam pāramparyaṇa iti tathā hi dravya tva ādi jātīyasya pūrva sukha duḥkha sādhanatva upalabdheḥ tad jñāna anantaram yat yat dravya tva ādi jātīyam tat tat sukha sādhanam iti avinā abhāva smaraṇam tathā ca idam dravya tva ādi jātīyam iti parāmarśa jñānam tasmāt sukha sādhanam iti viniścayaḥ tatas upādeya jñānam atas pāramparyeṇa dravya ādi jñāna phala tvam a samānañca etat hayā upekṣaṇīya jñāna utpattau api iti

atha upādeya ādi jñānasya sukha sādhana tva ādi viniścayāt viṣaya bhedaḥ vaktavyaḥ anyathā hi anumāna phala tvam eva syāt pratyakṣa phala tvañca sukha duḥkha ādi sādhana tva ādi viniścaya anantaram indriya artha sannikarṣeṇa upādeya ādi jñānasya utpatteḥ satyam tathā api viṣaya bhedaḥ viśeṣaṇa bhedāt sukha ādi sādhana tva viśeṣaṇam sukha sādhana ādi jñānāt tasmāt ca upādeya ādi jñānam iti pratyakṣa anantaram uddeśavataḥ laiṅgikasya lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham āha liṅga darśanāt sañjāyamānam laiṅgikam iti yadi api liṅga darśanāt saṃskāraḥ viparyaya jñānam sa śayajñānañca bhavati tathā api vidyā sāmānya lakṣaṇa anuvṛttau viśeṣa lakṣaṇasya abhidhānāt na atiprasaṅgaḥ

yat vai avitatham vyavasāya ātmakam avyapadeśyam iti viśeṣaṇam iha api anuvarta na ayam avinā abhau a sambandha smaraṇantu vidyā rūpa liṅga darśanāt san jāyate tavyavat cheda artham dravya ādiṣu utpadyate iti anuvartanīyam tat evam liṅga darśanāt padavyabhicāri tva ādi viśeṣaṇam jñānam anumeye tat yatas parāmarśa jñāna upalakṣitāt kāraka samūhāt bhavati tad laiṅgikam iti parāmarśa jñānam vā liṅga darśanāt pākti viśeṣaṇa jñānam utpadyate sādhakatama tva apekṣayā anumānam

kim puliṅgam iti āha * liṅga punar yat anumeyena sambaddham * ityādi anumeyaḥ pakṣaḥ pratyaya ādi adharma pratipipādayiṣita dharma viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī tena vyāptyā sambaddham vyāptiḥ tu vivaraṇa vākya sahacarita padāt labhyate anyathā hi pakṣa eka deśe vartamānasya anumeyena sāhacaryam syāt yathā nityāḥ paramāṇavaḥ gandhavat tvāt atas asya vyavacchedaḥ sahacarita padena anye tu punar iti vīpsā abhidhānasya vivakṣita tvāt liṅgam punar punar yat anu meyena sambaddham iti pakṣe vyāptilabhyate iti brūvate anumeyena sambaddham eva iti avadhāraṇāt bhāga asiddha vyudāsaḥ iti ca anye tat asat yatas ebakāra karaṇam tatas anyatra avadhāraṇam iti nyāya abhyupagamena anumaya sama dhṛtam

vyāptam syāt liṅgam anumeyaḥ hi liṅgam na jahātāta vyāptyā pakṣe sambandhaḥ jñāyate liṅgasya tu anavadhāraṇāt anyatra api vṛtti jñāyate iti vyartham tad anvite prasiddham iti padam avadhāraṇa artham kriyate tatra api tad anvita prasiddham eva iti avadhāraṇa abhyupagame sa pakṣaka deśa vṛtteḥ agamaka tva prasaṅgāt atha vipakṣa vṛtti pratiṣedha artham tad anvitaḥ eva prasiddham iti avadhāryate nanu evam anavadhāraṇa nava vipakṣāt vyāvṛtti siddheḥ vyartham tad abhāve ca na asti eva iti padam tathā anu meyena eva sambaddham iti avadhāraṇam bādhitam atha samuccīyamāna avadhāraṇam etat tathā hi

pakṣe vṛttau siddhāyām vipakṣāt eva vyavaccheda artham avadhāraṇam tathā api ava dhāraṇasya vidyamāna jñāpaka tvāt vipakṣāt atyantam vyāvṛttiḥ tatas api labhyata hāta vyayam tad abhāve ca na asti eva a iti padam tasya api vidya māna jñāpaka tvāt iti na ca anvaya upadarśane sati vyatireka abhidhānam a vyatireka abhidhāne tu anvayasyā pratipādanam eka abhidhānena aparasya arthāt āpanna tvāt sva śabdena punarvacanam punar uta mā iva syāt iti evaṃvidha artha kathana artham tad abhāve ca na asti eva iti vacanam aśabdāya tvāta para artha anumānasya ca aprastuta tvāt tatra eṣa nyāyaḥ iti tasmāt avadhāraṇa vinā eva prakāra antareṇa pakṣaka deśa vṛtti vyudāsaḥ vācyaḥ

yeṣāntu sarvam vākyam sa avadhāraṇam iti matam tad lakṣaṇe hi etat dūṣaṇamāna vāryam ūhyam yathā aanumeye atha tad tulye sadbhāvaḥ asati na astitāa iti anumeyaḥ pakṣaḥ tatra sadbhāvaḥ tad tulyaḥ sa pakṣaḥ tatra ca iti athaśabdaḥ caśabda sthāne asati vipakṣe na astitāḥ vyāvṛttiḥ yasya tāt laṅgam iti vipakṣaḥ tu tatas anyaḥ tad viruddhaḥ tad abhāvaḥ vā trividhaḥ avyasati iti anena avaruddhaḥ sādhya abhāva rūpa tāyāḥ sarvatra samāna tvāt tatra anumeye eva sadbhāvaḥ iti avadhāraṇe asādhāraṇasya gamaka tva prasaṅgaḥ na ca asmāt bhāga asiddhi vyudāsaḥ pada antara vaiyarthyañca atha anumeye sadbhāvaḥ eva itya yoga vyavacchedaḥ tathā api sadbhāvasya anavadhāraṇāt liṅgasya anyatra api vṛtti labhyate iti vyartham tad tulye sadbhāvaḥ iti padam atha avadhāraṇa artham kriyate

tatra api tad tulyaḥ eva sadbhāvaḥ iti avadhāraṇe pūrva uttara vyāghātaḥ atha pakṣa vṛttau siddhāyām vipakṣa ādeḥ vyavaccheda artham samuccīyamāna avadhāraṇam etat tathā api asati na astitāḥ iti na kāryam avadhāraṇena gata artha tvāt na ca tulye sadbhāvaḥ eva iti avadhāraṇam yuktam sa pakṣa eka deśa vṛtteḥ api gamakatva abhyupa gamāt atha asati eva na asti iti avadhāraṇa artham padam tathā api vipakṣaka deśa vṛtte gaṃmaka tva prasaṅgaḥ tasya hi vipakṣaḥ eva na astitā iti asati na asti eva iti ava dhāraṇam tathā api na astitāyāḥ vipakṣa vyatirekeṇa anyatra api sadbhāvaḥ labhyate iti asādhāraṇa ādeḥ gamaka tva prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt sarvam vākyam sa avadhāraṇam iti pakṣe dūṣaṇam etat anivāryam vistareṇa ca avadhāraṇa pakṣaḥ asmad guru bhinirastaḥ iti na iha pratanyate

atha astu avadhāraṇam vinā eva sahacarita padāt bhāga asiddhi vyudāsaḥ tathā api eta dūpam viruddha asā dhāraṇayoḥ asti iti tad vyavaccheda artham prasiddhañca tad anvite iti tana anumeya samāna dharmeṇa anvitaḥ yuktaḥ tasmin tad anvite prasiddham na ca evam viruddha asā dhāraṇau iti tathā api anaikāntikasya pakṣa dharma tvam sa pakṣe sattvañca asti iti tad abhāve ca na asti eva a iti padam tasya sādhya samāna dharmasya abhāvaḥ yasmin ghāmaṇi tatra atyantam na asti eva iti na ca evam anaikāntikam nanu evam api prakaraṇa sama kāla atyaya apadiṣṭayostra lakṣaṇya upapatteḥ gamaka tva prasaṅgaḥ thā ca anuṣṇaḥ tajaḥ avayavī kṛtaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti sati api trailakṣaṇye pratyakṣeṇa uṣṇatā grāhiṇā bādhyamāna tvāt kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ prakaraṇa samastāvat nityaḥ śabdaḥ anupalabhyamāna anitya dharmaka tvāt ākāśa ādi vat

anityaḥ śabdaḥ anupalabhyamāna nitya dharmaka tvāt ghaṭa vat atra api trailakṣaṇī a sadbhāve api agamaka tvam sat pratipakṣa tvāt atas ca anayoḥ vyavaccheda artham abādhita viṣaya tvam asat pratipakṣa tvañca samāna tantra gatam abhyūhyam a caśabdasya anukta samuccaya artha tvāt anye tu pratijñā doṣeṇa gata artha tvāt na kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ hetvābhāsa antaram tathā ca nitya anitya viśeṣa anupalabdheḥ itaretarava ādi abhiprāyeṇa asiddhe antarbhāvaḥ iti bruvate tat ca asat pratijñā doṣa sat abhāve api hetoḥ duṣṭa pakṣa upanyāsa anantaram upa nyāsāt kāla atyaya apadiṣṭa tvam ucyate atha bādhā vinā abhāva yaḥ virodhāt na pratyakṣeṇa vilakṣaṇasya bādhā abhyupagame vā na lakṣaṇyam iti tat na tejaḥ avayavinaḥ anuṣṇa tve sādhye kṛtaka tvasya hetoḥ trailakṣaṇī a sadbhāve api pakṣeṇa viparīta artha upa sthāpanāt bādhita viṣaya tvena avinābhāvasya eva aprasiddheḥ pratyakṣa vyavasthāpitena ca vapuṣā sarva prāṇabhṛtām artha kriyā janakaḥ agniḥ na rūpa antareṇa iti sva viṣaya sahakāri pratyakṣam na ca evam anumānam iti bādhyate

atha duṣṭasya eva anumānasya pratyakṣeṇa eva bādhanāt yena doṣeṇa duṣṭam tat eva astu dūṣaṇa malam pratyakṣa bādhayā na pratyakṣeṇa dūṣaṇasya eva jñāpanāt tathā hi vipa rīta artham upasthāpayatā pratyakṣeṇa upardāśatam bādhita viṣayam etat anumānam iti atha kāryasya anuṣṇa tve sādhye taijasa paramāṇūnām uṣṇa anuṣṇa tve pramāṇa abhāvāt sandigdha vyatireki tvena kṛtaka tvasya āgamaka tvam na kāla atyaya apadiṣṭa tvāt iti ced neta devam yaḥ hi paramāṇuṣaṣṇa tvam abhyupagamya tad kārye anuṣṇa tvam prasādhayet tam prati vyatireka niścaya upapatteḥ na ca sandigdha vyatirekasya api uṣṇa pakṣa upanyāsāna ntaram abhidhānāt kāla atyaya apadiṣṭa tvam virudhyate na ca ayam niyamaḥ yatraka dūṣaṇam tatra anyat na asti iti yathā aneka viśeṣaṇā siddha tva ādi hetoḥ iti

yat ca idam tattva anupalabdheḥ ita retarava ādi abhiprāyeṇa asiddhatvam iti uktam tat asat ubhayoḥ sandigdha tvāt tathā hi sāmānya upalambha ādi sadbhāve sati viśeṣa anupala mbhāt vādi prativādinoḥ pūrvam upajātaḥ saṃśayaḥ tatra ekaḥ sandigdhaḥ para pratāraṇā bhiprāyeṇa saṃśaya yitam hetum eva minirṇaya artham upādatte tathā itaraḥ api sandigdhaḥ tat evam ubhayoḥ saṃśayāt na anyatarasya api asiddha tā udbhāvane sāmarthyam iti yadi ca anyataraḥ api nitya anitya viśeṣa upalambham pramāṇena brūyāt tadā asiddha tvam eva na prakaraṇa sama tvam iti na ca sandigdha avasthāyām viruddha avyabhicāriṇaḥ prayogaḥ iti tasmāt vyatirekaḥ na api viruddha avyabhicārī sambhavati iti vakṣyāmaḥ

tat evam anayoḥ vyavaccheda arthama abādhita viṣaya tvam asat pratipakṣita tvañca rūpa anta ramabhyupagantavyam anyathā hi pratya vyaḥ vayavam vākyam syāt na pañcāva yavam avayava dvayasya etat vyavaccheda artha paratvāt iti nanu evam api nyūnam lakṣaṇa vākyam kevala anvayinaḥ kevala vyatirekiṇaḥ cā yāpanāt iti asti ca tayoḥ sādhya sādhana tvam tathā ca yatra sāmānyam eva sādhya tatra sāmānyam eva hetaḥ yathā abhidheyaḥ viśeṣaḥ prameya tvāt sāmānya pādāta viśeṣāṇām abhidheya tve sādhye anabhidheyasya vastunaḥ asambhavāt vipakṣāḥ bhāvaḥ pramāṇena hi vipakṣam upalabhya tasmāt vyatirekam vacanena upapādayataḥ tatrā madhaya tva prameya tvayoḥ prāpteḥ tasya sa pakṣa tvam eva syāt iti na vipakṣāt vyati rakaḥ asti iti atas anvaya avi abhicāreṇa eva gamaka tvam

tathā jīvat śarīram nirātmakam na bhavati aprāṇa ādimattva prasaṅgāt yat yat nirātmakam tad tad aprāṇādimat yathā ghaṭa ādi na ca tathā jīvat śaroram smāt nirātmakam na bhavati iti sarvasya nirātmaka tva abhyupagamājīvat śarīrasya narātmya pratiṣedhe sādhye na sa pakṣaḥ asti prāṇa ādimat tvañca vipakṣāt eva atyantavyā vṛttam atas vyatireka avyabhicāreṇa eva gamaka tvam na ca evam asādhāraṇam tasya pakṣa ādi vat sa pakṣāt api vyāvṛtteḥ vyabhicāreṇa āgamaka tvāt atha nairātmya prati mā atra sa ātmaka tvam vivakṣitam na ca ātmā prasiddhaḥ iti aprasiddha viśeṣaṇaḥ pakṣaḥ rātmye api samānam aprasiddha tvāt ātmanaḥ katham tat pratiṣedhaḥ

na ca panāsam āropitasya pratiṣedhaḥ vāstava tvena pratipādanāt pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇe paḥ ātmā pratipādakasya prasiddhaḥ tad apekṣayā na aprasiddha viśeṣaṇa tā pakṣa doṣaḥ pratipādya apekṣayā tu na etat dūṣaṇam apratipanna tattvasya pratipādya tvāt sa pakṣe tu aprasiddha tvam na vyatirekiṇaḥ dūṣaṇam tasya vyāta reka avyabhicāreṇa eva gamaka tvāt ayam sa pakṣa abhāvaḥ eva sa pakṣaḥ tasmin anuvṛttau anvaya upapattiḥ vyāvṛttau tu asādhāraṇa tvam eva tat uktam nivṛttiḥ yadi tasmin na hetaḥ vṛttiḥ kim iṣyate sā api na pratiṣedhaḥ ayam nivṛttiḥ kim niṣidhyate iti

asya arthaḥ tasmin sa pakṣa abhāve hetoḥ yadi nivṛttiḥ na asti vṛttiḥ syāt tavya āvṛtti rūpa tvāt vṛtti pratiṣedhe tu nivṛttiḥ eva syāt iti na ca vidhi pratiṣedha vyatirekeṇa aparaḥ śābdaḥ vyavahāraḥ sambhavati iti mūka tā prasaṅgaḥ tat etat asat pakṣa abhāvasya api sādhya an adhikaraṇa tvena vipakṣa tvāt tasmāt ca nivṛttiḥ eva aprāṇa ādimattvāt iti hetoḥ

na ca kalpanā samāropita tvāt pakṣa ādi vyavasthāyāḥ kalpite sa pakṣa hetaḥ vṛttau anvaya vyatireki tvam vyāvṛttau tu asādhāraṇa tvam iti dūṣaṇam vāsta vatvāt pakṣa ādi vyavasthāyāḥ kalpita tve tu katham hetu tad ābhāsa vyavasthā kalpa nāyāḥ sarvatra aviśeṣāt atha ghaṭa ādau ki sa ātmaka tva vyāvṛttyā prāṇa dimattvavyā vṛttiḥ uta vastu svābhāvyāt iti sandigdhaḥ vyetiḥ ekaḥ na ca ghaṭa ādau sa ātmaka tu asya sat asat tve pramāṇam asti na etat evam prāṇa ādimattvasya kārya viśeṣasya ābhā vena tad kāraṇa viśeṣasya sa ātmaka tvasya tatra vyāvṛtti prasiddheḥ tathā hi prāṇāḥ dimati śarīre prāṇa ādi utpādana samartha ātma sambandha viśeṣaḥ sa ātmaka tvam sādhayati tad abhāvaḥ tu prāṇa ādi kārya abhāvena eva jñāyate ghaṭa ādau iti

nanu evam kāryasya kāraṇa pūrvaka tvena upala mbha bdha tvāt anvaya upapattaḥ katham kevala vyatireki tvam na kārya viśeṣeṇa kāraṇa viśeṣe sādhye anvaya abhāvāt jīvat śarīre hi prāṇa ādi utpādana samartha ātma sambandha viśeṣaḥ sādhyaḥ tena ca anvaya abhāvaḥ eva yasya tu sarvam nirātmakam iti pakṣaḥ sa katham ghaṭa ādau sa ātmaka tva vyāvṛttam na vā iti sandeham brūyāt

na api buddhi ādi nivṛttau eva prāṇa ādi nivṛttiḥ ghaṭa ādau iti vācyam ādi śabdena sarveṣām avarodhāt tad utpādana samarthaḥ ca ātma sambandha viśeṣaḥ sādhyaḥ tava bhāve tu katham buddhi ādīnām utpattiḥ jīvat śarīre kāraṇa abhāvena kāryasya abhāva prasaṅgāt kṣaṇika tve ca sati kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ pūrvam pratiṣiddhaḥ iti na bodhāt buddhi ādīnām utpattiḥ tat evam prāṇa ādi kārya viśeṣaḥ kāraṇa viśeṣe sādhye vyati reka avyabhicāreṇa eva gamakaḥ iti

nanu śaśa viṣāṇa ādi vat śarīram prāṇa ādimattvena sādhyam syāt iti dūṣaṇam sat abhāva āyatta vyāvṛtteḥ pratipattam aśakya tvāt iti prāṇa adhutpattau ca kāraṇa tva abhyu pagamana kārya viśeṣa vyāvṛttyā yadi kāraṇa viśeṣa vyāvṛttiḥ iṣyate saṃjñā bheda mātram syāt viparyaye tu sa na syāt tad abhāva āyatta pratipatti abhāvaḥ iti alam

nanu evam katham anayoḥ lakṣaṇa vākyena avarodhaḥ vākya bhedena tathā hi ayat anume cana sambaddham vipakṣa abhāve ca tad anvitaḥ eva prasiddham iti kevala anvayī pakṣa dharma tve sāta sa pakṣa abhāvāt tad abhāvaḥ eva na asti eva iti kevala vyatirekī sāmānya lakṣaṇantu sāta sādhane sādhyasya avaśyambhāva niyamaḥ sādhya sādhana tvam anumāpaka tva padena ukta miti liṅga bhāsa nirūpaṇa artham āha * viparītam atas yat syāt ekena dvitayena vā viruddha asiddha sandigdhamaliṅgam kāśyapaḥ abravīt * iti

atas iti ukta rūpāt ligāt yat viparītam ekena dharmeṇa dharma dvitayena vā bdāt tribhiḥ ca iti tad aliṅaga liṅagapratirūpakam iti kāśyapaḥ abravīta paddhā siddha sandigdham iti viśeṣa saṃjñā nirdeśaḥ tatra dharma dvaya sadbhāve api digdhaḥ na vipakṣāt vyāvṛttaḥ iti ekena dharmaṇa viparītaḥ viruddhaḥ tu pakṣa matva sadbhāve api na sa pakṣe vartate na api vipakṣāt vyāvṛttaḥ iti dharma dvayana sarātaḥ asiddhaḥ tu ekena dvābhyām tribhiḥ ca viparītaḥ bhavati iti

tatra nityaḥ śabdaḥ sāmānyavat tve sati cākṣuṣa tvāt iti ekena viparītaḥ ca asya sa pakṣe ghaṭa ādau sat abhāve api vipakṣāt ca sāmānyāt eāvṛttau api pakṣa dharma tvam astoti tathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ aprameya tvāt iti dvitayana viparītaḥ yatu asya hi vipakṣāt eva vyāvṛttiḥ na sa pakṣe sadbhāvaḥ na api pakṣaḥ iti nābhaḥ ca viparītaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ akārya tva āditi asya hi na śabde pakṣe sat abhāvaḥ na sa pakṣe ghaṭa ādau na api vipakṣāda vyāvṛttiḥ iti

pūrvasya saṅgraha vākyasya spaṣṭa artham vivaraṇam āha * yat anumeyena arthena * ityādi anumeyena sambaddham iti asya vivaraṇam anumeyena arthena paricchedyamānena sahacaritama jahat vṛtti iti * deśa viśeṣe kāla viśeṣe vā * sarvasmin deśe sarvasmiḥ ca kālaḥ iti prasiddhañca tad anvite iti asya vivaraṇam * anumeya dharma anvite ca anyatra sarvasmin eka deśe vā prasiddham iti anumeyaḥ pakṣaḥ tasya dharmaḥ tena tad samāna dharmeṇa anvitaḥ yuktaḥ sa pakṣaḥ tasmin sarvatra eka deśe vā prasiddhaḥ ityādi niyamaḥ tad abhāve ca na asti eva iti asya vivaraṇam * anumeya viparīte ca sarvasmin pramāṇa taḥ asat eva * iti anumeya viparītaḥ anumeya dharma rahitaḥ vipakṣaḥ tasmin sarvatrā sadeva pramāṇataḥ iti pramāṇena sādhya vyāvṛttyā sādhana vyāvṛttiḥ vācyā iti upa darśayati anumāpakam iti asya vivaraṇam yat etat ukta rūpam liṅga * tada prasiddhārthasya anumāpakam bhavati iti

dvitīyasya saṅgraha vākyasya vivaraṇam yat tu yathā uktāt trirūpāt liṅgāt * iti abādhita viṣaya tvāt sat pratipakṣa tva sahitāt ekena dharmeṇa dvābhyām vā dharmābhyām tribhiḥ ca viparītam tad anumeyasya adhigame kartavye liṅga na bhavati iti * etat eva āha sūtrakāraḥ * aprasiddhaḥ anapadeśaḥ asan sandigdhaḥ ca iti sūtrita tva upadarśanam

aprasiddhaḥ anapadeśaḥ iti biruddha avarodhaḥ tasya sa pakṣe aprasiddha tvāt asan iti asiddhaḥ tasya hi pakṣa dharma tvena asattvāt asandigdha śvāna padaśas iti anaikāntika saṅgrahaḥ kāla atyaya apadiṣṭa prakaraṇa samayoḥ ca aprasiddha padena eva avarādhaḥ tayoḥ abādhita viṣaya tva asat pratipakṣa tvena aprasiddha tvāt samāna tantra nyāyana saṅgrahaḥ yathā ukta rūpam liṅga nāga hīta avinābhāvasya gamakam iti avinābhāva svarūpa upa pavanātham vidhiḥ tu yatra yatra dhūmaḥ ityādi vākyam vidhiāptiḥ avinā abhāvaḥ iti

atha yadi sāmānyayoḥ avinā abhāvaḥ siddha sādhanam apāsta viśeṣasya sāmānyasya siddha tvāta niyata deśa avacchedena viśeṣa arthinām pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ aprasaṅgaḥ na ca viśeṣayoḥ avinābhāvaḥ teṣām ānantyena aprasiddhaḥ tadāyattasyāḥ na ama avasya aprasiddhaḥ manuṣya anukta dharmāṇāñca sarve eva viśeṣāḥ sātapat tu na śakyante iti yāvatām upalambhaḥ tāvatsu eva avinābhāva grahaṇe ca gṛhīta avinābhāvasya viśeṣa antarasya upalambhāt anumānam syāt

na etat dūṣaṇam a sāmānyavatoḥ avinā abhāva grahaṇa abhyupagamāt yadi api agni sapāḥ dhūma viśeṣāḥ ca ānantyena avasthitāḥ tathā api teṣu eva avasthitam agni tvam saca sāmānyamaḥ upagrāhakam asti iti tad upagrāhaka vaśāda bhayaḥ darśana balāt agni bādaśa ādi vyabhicāre api avyabhicāra grahaṇam tathā hi prāta madhyāhna ādi bhedena tya bheda sama viṣama ādi bhedana ca daśa bheda dhumasya agninā sāhacarya upa śāntare kāla antare ca dhamaḥ agni vinā api bhaviṣyati iti āśaṅkā na syāt na kulālasya rāsabhena vyāpti grahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ kāla antara ca vinā api upalambhāt

anye tu vyāpti grahaṇa kāle pratipattayoṃginaḥ iva aśeṣa viṣayam parijñānam aśuvata anyathā hi sarvaḥ dhamaḥ agni vinā na bhavati iti vyāpti smaraṇam syāt vivekena ca apratibhāsaḥ samāna abhivyāhārāt yathā dhānya rasāyāḥ dhānya vyaktar iti tat evam yatra yatra iti vīpsā arthasya vivakṣita tvāt * yatra yatra dhūmaḥ tatra tatra agniḥ agni abhāve ca dhūmaḥ api na bhavati iti evam prasiddha samayasya * gṛhīta āvinā bhāvasya pratipattuḥ asandigdha dhūma darśana anantaram sāhacarya anusmaraṇam ayatra yatra aham dhūmam adrākṣam tatra tatra agniḥ asti iti * sāhacarya anusmaraṇāt tad anantaram agni radhi avasīyate anena iti * agni adhyavasāyaḥ * parāmarśa jñānam tasmāt ca agni pratipattiḥ iti

anye tu parāmarśa jñānasya abhāvam eva brūvate tat ca asat avinā abhā a sambandha smaraṇasya aniyata tvāt niyata pradeśe agni pratipattiḥ na syāt upanaya vaiyarthyañca upanaya arthasya anabhyupagamāt tasmāt vyutpattyā upacāreṇa vā agni adhyavasāyaḥ parāmarśa jñānam vyākhyeyam iti anye tu kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt svabhāvāt ca niyāmakāt avinābhāva grahaṇam iti manyante tat ca asat kārya kāraṇa bhāve api avaśyam bhūyas darśana balāt eva avinābhāva grahaṇam iti vācyam anyathā hi deśa antare kāla antare vai agni vinā api dhūmaḥ bhaviṣyati iti āśaṅkā syāt atha agni dhūmayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāva avagatau katham agni vinā dhūmasya sambhavaḥ iti āśaṅkā tasya nirhetuka tva pratiṣedhena avaśyam sva kāraṇā deva utpatteḥ iti satyam etat yadi nāma sarvaḥ dhūmaḥ agni kāryaḥ iti jñānam api bhūyas darśanam vinā na bhavati iti tat abhyupagantavyam

na ca agneḥ asādhāraṇam kāryam dhūmaḥ tasya dhuma antarāt api utpatti abhyupagamāt tathā hi gopāla ghuṭikā ādiṣu cira nivṛtte vahnau dhūma kṣaṇāt eva dhūma utpattiḥ iti katham atad kāryasya dhūmasya upalabdheḥ agni anumānam atha agni kāryasya upalambhā danu mānam iti ced na agni pratipatti vinā dhūme tad janya tva viniścayasyā sambhavāt pratipattau vā kim anumānena dhūma svarūpa pratipatti vat ca agṛhīta analasya nārikela dvīpa vāsinaḥ dhūme agni janya tva pratipattiḥ dṛṣṭā tathā prayoga anupapatteḥ ca tathā hi parvatasya agnimat tve sādhye kāryatvam anaikāntikam eva atha dhūmasya agni mattvam sādhyeta tatra api kāryatvam anaikāntikam eva dhūma tve sati kārya tvam hetuḥ tarhi dhūma tvam eva samartham iti vyartha viśeṣya tā hetoḥ doṣaḥ na ca agni kārya tvam dhūmasya agni sambandhāt pūrva dravya nivṛttau utpanna pāka jaiyaṇuka ādi prakrameṇa utpatte riti alam

tathā vṛkṣa tva śiśapātvayoḥ na tādātmya pratibandhaḥ tathā ca sati sādhya sādhana bhāva anupapatti prasaṅgāt tathā hi miṇyupalabdhe tad tādātmyāḥ dubhayoḥ api upalambhe katham sādhya sādhana bhāvaḥ tad upalambhe api anupalabdhau tu tādāḥ tmyam na syāt iti atha sāmānya viśeṣavat tvāt anumānasya samāropa vyāvṛttyoḥ gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ tatra ca tādātmya tad utpattyoḥ asambhavaḥ eva tādātmya abhyupagame api na sādhya sādhana tvam ekatā prasaṅgāt iti tathā ubhayoḥ tādātmya aviśeṣe api śiṃśa pātvena vṛkṣa tvasya pratipatti vat vṛkṣa tvena śiṃśapātu apratipattiḥ api syāt

na ca tādātmya tad utpatti lakṣaṇa pratibandha abhyupagame rūpa darśanāt sparśa anu mānam udayāt astamaya pratipattiḥ kṛttikā udayāt ca rohiṇya ṇi udayā numāna syāt tādātmya tad utpatti abhāvāt atha eka sāmagrayadhīna tayā rūpāt sparśa anumānam tat asat samāna kṣaṇayoḥ gamya gamaka bhāva upalabdheḥ tathā hi rūpa kṣaṇāt samāna kālaḥ sparśaḥ anumīyate na pūrvaḥ tatra ca eka sāma agrayadhīnatvā sambhavaḥ eva na ca rūpa sparśayoḥ paraspara utpattau kāraṇa tve pramāṇam asti itara anvayasya itaratra anupalabdheḥ iti alam ati prasaṅgena

* evam sarvatra deśa kāla avinābhūtam itarasya * sādhyasya liṅgam iti upasaṃhāraḥ deśāvinābhūtam yathā kedāragirim āroha tām kalakalā śabda śravaṇā daśa nipāta anumānam iti atha asya sūtreṇa asaṅgrahaḥ tathā ca sūtram asya idam kārya kāraṇam saṃyogi samavāyi virodhi ca iti laiṅgikam na ca kalakalā śabdaḥ aśani pāta kāryaḥ tad antareṇa api sva kāraṇāt eva utpatteḥ na api kāraṇa maśa ni pātasya pratibandhaka abhāva viśiṣṭa guru tva kārya tvāt ubhayoḥ ca adravya tvāt na saṃyogi tvam parasparam ekasmin arthe samavāya abhāvāt sva ātmani anārambhaka tvāt na samavāyi tvam paraspara virodha abhāvāt ca avirodhi tvam iti artha antara tvam

atha kārya ādeḥ katham liṅga tvam avinābhūta tvāt tathā hi kārya kāraṇa pūrvaka tvena upalambhāt upalabhyamānam sat gamakam yathā hi viśiṣṭa nadī pūra upalambhāt upariṣṭāt vṛṣṭaḥ devaḥ iti tathā ca bahula svarūpa phena phenila parṇa kāṣṭha ādi vahana viśiṣṭasya nadī pūrasya vṛṣṭi kārya tvena pūrvam upalambhāt punar tad upalambhe sati yukta manu mānam ayam nadī pūraḥ vṛṣṭi kāryaḥ viśiṣṭa nadī pūra tvāt pūrva upalabdha nadīpūra vat iti pūraḥ tu ubhaya taṭa vyāpaka udaka saṃyogaḥ sa pāramparyeṇa vṛṣṭi kāryaḥ iti kāraṇam api kārya janaka tvena pūrvam upalabdheḥ upalabhyamānam tat liṅgam

yathā ca viśiṣṭa megha unnatiḥ varṣa karmaṇaḥ iti atha kāraṇasya avaśyam kārya janaka tvena anupalambhāt kārya aṇāñca aniyatāt kāraṇāt utpatteḥ vyabhicāraḥ tathā hi megha unnati sadbhāve api ekadā vṛṣṭiḥ na dṛṣṭā kāryañca aniyatāt kāraṇāḥ dutpadyamānam dṛṣṭam yathā vṛścikāt vṛścikaḥ jāyate gomayāt sarpāt ca iti evam anyatra api aniyatam kāraṇam abhyūhyam iti katham kāryāt kāraṇa viśeṣa pratipattiḥ kāraṇāt ca kārya viśeṣasya iti na etat evam kāraṇa viśeṣasya kārya viśeṣa gamaka tva miti abhyupagamāt yaḥ tu vidyamānam api viśeṣa na avabudhyate tasya aparādhaḥ na anu mānasya iti adoṣaḥ

tathā dhūmaḥ agneḥ saṃyogī atha saṃyogasya ubhaya niṣṭhatvā viśeṣe katham ekam niyamena sādhanam itarat ca sādhyam iti vyavasthā tad avinā abhāve api samānam tasya api ubhaya niṣṭha tvāt katham eṣā vyavasthā syāt atha yasya upalambhāt anumeye pratipattiḥ tat eva sādhanam na anyat iti ced saṃyogi tve api samānam etat avinā bhūtasya avāntara viśeṣa nirūpaṇāt samavāyī ca uṣṇa sparśaḥ vāri stham tejaḥ gamayati iti virodhī ca yathā ahi visphūrjana viśiṣṭaḥ nakula āliṅgam iti atha sūtre kārya ādi grahaṇam udāharaṇa artham avadhāraṇa ārya vā iti āha * śāstre kārya ādi grahaṇam nidarśana artham kṛtam na avadhāraṇa artham * katham etat jñāyate

* vyatireka darśanāt * * tat yathā adhvaryurom śrāvayan vyavahitasya hotuliṅgam * iti na ca hotuḥ om śrāvaya iti śabdaḥ kāraṇam kārya vā anvaya vyatirekāḥ bhāvāt tathā ca hotāram vinā eva upapattiḥ hotuḥ ca anena vinā api iti saṃyogāḥ diṣu api antar bhāva anupapattiḥ sa tra yāga bhūmau eva asya avinā abhāvaḥ na ca deśa antare iti tathā ca ayam adhvaryuḥ api dūra deśena hotrā tadvān om śrāvaya iti śabda kartṛ tbāt pūrva upalabdha adhvaryu vat * candra udayaḥ samudra vṛddhaḥ kumuda vikāśasya ca * liṅgam samudrasya ca vṛddhiḥ avayava upacayaḥ

sa ca sva avayavebhyaḥ niṣpadyate na candra udayāt kumuda vikāśaḥ api avayavānām ārabdha kāryāṇām parasparam vibhāgaḥ dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga avirodhi kriyā kāryaḥ iti kāraṇañca atra abhivyaṅgayasya janaka vivakṣitam na pratipatteḥ sarveṣām kāraṇa bhāvaḥ eva antar bhāva prasaṅgāt * śaradi jala prasādaḥ agastya udayasya * liṅgam asya api tad kārya ādiṣva nantarbhāvaḥ śaradi jala prasādaḥ agastya udayavān jala prasāda tvāt pūrva upalabdhā evaṃvidha jala prasāda bat * iti evamādi * ityādi padena udaya ādi rudayādeḥ astaḥ ca āstāde liṅga miti ūhyam atha katham eṣām sūtreṇa saṅgrahaḥ tat āha * tat sarvam asya idam iti sambandha mātra vadanāt siddham * tathā hi idam asya gamakam aidam asya gamyam iti sāmānyena sarva liṅga parigrahaḥ viśeṣa apekṣayā tu aidam asya kāryaḥ a kāraṇa mityādi yojyam

anye tu avadhāraṇa artham etat sūtram iti manyante śāstre kārya ādi grahaṇam nida rśana artham iti vākyam anyathā vyākhyāyante tathā hi tat uktam paraiḥ vyatireka darśanāt śāstre kārya ādi grahaṇam nidarśana artham kṛtam iti jñāyate iti etat na kintva vadhāraṇa artham sarveṣām atra eva antar bhāvena vyatireka darśanasya asiddha tvāt tathā ca hotari sannihite adhvaryurom śrāvaya iti śabdam uccārayati yāga bhūmau na tena vinā api iti katham na tasya kāraṇa tvam evam candra udayaḥ api samudra vṛddheḥ kāraṇam anvayavyatire kavat tvāt tathā ca tena satā jalanidheḥ vaddhiḥ na tad abhāvaḥ iti kāryeṇa megha paṭa lāntaritaḥ candraḥ anumīyate gṛhīta vyāptikasya deśa antare api candra udaya upalambhā dambhaḥ nidhevṛdhi anumānam evam kumuda vikāśe api iti yat vā raśmi dvāreṇa saṃyogi tvam eva tathā agastya udayaḥ api jala prasādasya kāraṇam saṃyogi vā raśmi dvāreṇa iti

pakṣa dvaye ca guṇa doṣa nirūpaṇam svatas eva kāryam parīkṣakaiḥ iti bhedam āha * tat * anumānam * dvividham * kena rūpeṇa * dṛṣṭam sāmā nyatas dṛṣṭañca * iti * tatra dṛṣṭam prasiddha sādhyayoḥ jātya bhede anumānam * prasi ddhaḥ ca sādhyaḥ ca iti prasiddha sādhyau tayoḥ prasiddha sādhyayoḥ dṛṣṭānta dārṭa antikayoḥ rjāti abhede sati yat anumānam tat dṛṣṭam yathā hi sādhya dharmaḥ dṛṣṭāntam irmāṇa pratyakṣa arhaḥ tathā dāntike api iti sādhya dharma abhedaḥ na tu jāteḥ sāmānyasya tathā hi brāhmaṇa kartṛkam citra ādi kārya pratipadya punar kṣatriya ādi kartṛkasyā pi upalambhāt kenacid kartā sampāditam etat citra ādi kārya tvāt pūrva upalabdhā eva vidha citra ādi kārya vat iti anumānam jāteḥ sāmānyasya bhede api dṛṣṭam eva sādhya dharma sya anumānāt pūrvaḥ ūrdhvañca pratyakṣa grahaṇa artha tvāt

anye tu prasiddhau ca tau sādhyau ca iti prasiddha sādhyau iti samāsa kurvate tatra dṛṣṭānta dharmī prasiddha tvāt sādhyaḥ na bhavati dārṭa antikaḥ ca na prasiddhaḥ iti katham etat upacārasya vivakṣita tvāt adoṣaḥ tathā hi dṛṣṭānta dhamā sādhya samāna dharma adhikaraṇa tvāt upacāreṇa sādhyaḥ dāntikaḥ tu anumānāva prasiddhi yāsyati iti pūrvam api prasiddhaḥ śeṣam pūrvavat iti asya udāharaṇam yathā gavyā iva sāsnām upalabhya punar deśa antare gopiṇḍavyavadhāḥ ne api sāsnā darśanāt gavi pratipattiḥ gauḥ iyam sāsnāvat tvāt pūrva upalabdha sāstī divat iti

sāmānyatas dṛṣṭañca * prasiddha sādhyayoḥ dṛṣṭānta dāntikayoḥ atyantam sarvathā jāti bhede sādhya dharma bhede anumānam tathā ca sādhya dharmaḥ anumānāt pūrva m añca sa vadā aprasiddhaḥ eva iti atha sādhya dharmasya bhede avinābhauvasya eva aprasiddheḥ katha manu mānam iti āha * liṅga anameya dharma sāmānyāna vṛttitaḥ * iti liṅgañca anumaya dharmaḥ ca tayoḥ sāmānya nāna vṛttiḥ yatra yatra idam sādhana sāmānyam tatra pada sādhya sāmānyam iti tad agrahaṇe anumānam pravartate eva yathā karṣa kavaṇij rāja puruṣāṇām pravṛtteḥ abhipreta phala tvena phalavat tvam upalabhya varṇa āśramiṇām api viśiṣṭānām dṛṣṭam bhikṣā lābha ādikam prayojanam anuddiśya pravartamānānām abhi sakala anumānam tathā hi varṇa āśramiṇāñca pravṛttiḥ abhipreta phalena phalavatī prekṣā pūrva kāri pravṛtti tvāt karṣaka ādi pravṛtti vat

na ca dṛṣṭa prayojana apekṣayā siddha sādha namini dūṣaṇam dṛṣṭam prayojanam anudi māta pakṣa viśeṣaṇena nirasta tvāt ye tu dṛṣṭam eva uddiśya pravartate na te pakṣīkriyante iti na api adṛṣṭa phalena phalavat tvam sādhyate yena dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhya vikalaḥ ca viruddhaḥ syāt kim tarhi sāmānyena abhipreta phalena phalavat tvam sādhyate va karṣaka ādi pravṛttau asti eva iti na dṛṣṭāntasya sādhya vikala tvam viruddha tvam vā hetoḥ doṣaḥ

sarva anumāneṣu samānañca viśeṣa viruddha anumānam iti anumāna mātrasya uccheda prasaṅgaḥ atha iṣyate eva āna mānasya aprāmāṇyam tathā ca sāmānya siddha sādhanam parāṣa anugama abhāvaḥ dharmiṇoḥ ca samudāye sādhye na hetoḥ pakṣa dharma tvam na ca anvayaḥ samudāyasya anyatra āvṛtteḥ atha samudāya eka deśe api vartamānaḥ samudāya vartate iti upacaryate tarhi pramāṇasya gauṇa tvāt anumāna artha niścayaḥ darlabhaḥ tathā hi pramāṇam pratyakṣama gauṇamaḥ anumānam upacarita pakṣa dharma apekṣi tvāt gauṇam iti apramāṇam a dharmasya api sādhya tve anvaya sadbhāve api na pakṣadhama tva sama tyān i atra atha pratipādyamāna dharma viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī sādhyaḥ tena ca anvayādāya abhāvaḥ eva iti sarvam anumānam apramāṇam

tat atat asat pratipādya dharma viśiṣṭasya dharmiṇaḥ sādhya tve pakṣa dharma tva upapatteḥ yaḥ tu sādhya samāna dharmeṇa na hi ekatra deśe hetoḥ vṛttiḥ vyatirekaḥ tu tad abhāve vyāvṛttiḥ iti liṅga upalambhāt ca sādhyamiṇi pratipatteḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt ittham bhūtā nvaya parikalpanā kriyate anabhyupagame vā ca vyabhicāri jñānam eva na syāt tat tu dṛṣṭam iti viśeṣaḥ viruddhena tuni yata viśeṣa pratiṣedhe viśeṣa antara upagamaḥ syāt samasta viśeṣa pratiṣedhe tu tat niyatasya sāmānyasya api asiddhiḥ sādhana sāmānya vyāpakam vā avaśyam sādhya sāmānya sidhyati iti atas sādhya sāmānya sya eva ākṣipta viśeṣasya eva anumānāt prasiddharvarṇa āśramiṇām phalantu adṛṣṭa viśeṣa atītam eva sidhyati iti

śiṣya vyutpādanāya pramāṇa phala vibhāgam darśayati * tatra liṅga darśanam pramāṇam anumeyam jñānam phalam prameyaḥ agniḥ pramātā ātmā * iti nanu liṅga darśana vyadhikaraṇa tvāt katham agni jñāna utpattau pramāṇam vyāpāra apekṣayā tat viṣaya tvāt yathā hi dhūma jñānam dhūma viṣayam ātma lābha apekṣayā tathā agni prāta pattau vyāpāra apekṣayā agni viṣayam api iti sva avayava samavetasya cakṣuṣaḥ samutpāda vyāpāra apekṣayā rūpa viṣaya tvam iva iti

nanu evam ekasmin viṣaye vyāpāra apekṣayā karaṇa ādi vyavasthā anupapattiḥ vibhinna lakṣaṇa yogi tvena tad bhāvāt tathā hi pramādhāra tvam pramātuḥ lakṣaṇam uktam evam pramiteviṣayaḥ prameyam tad vyatiriktañca pramājanaka pramāṇam tad sādhyaḥ ca phalam iti evam lakṣaṇa bhedāt eṣām bhedaḥ iti * athavā * iti pramāṇa phala vibhāge prakāra antaram āha * agni jñāna maya pramāṇam pramitiḥ agnau guṇa doṣa mādhyasthya darśanam * iti agni jñāne satya vinā bhāva sambandha smaraṇāt parāmarśa jñānāt sukhaṃsādhana tva avabodhe sati upādeya jñānam duḥkha sādhanatva avabodhe ca heya jñānam yasya na idam sūkha sādhanam na api duḥkha sādhanaḥ iti evam bodhaḥ tasya upekṣaṇīya jñānam iti agni jñāna phala tvañca upādeya ādi jñānasya pāramparyeṇa iti pūrvavat vācyam

* iti etat sva niścaya artham anumānam * iti upasaṃhāraḥ para artha anumāna saṃsūcakaḥ atha idānī pramāṇa vibhāgasya nyūna tā parihārāya tad sāmānya lakṣaṇasya vyabhicāra parihāra artham * śabda ādīnām api anumāne antarbhāvaḥ * ityādi prakaraṇam nanu pūrvam anyeṣām anumāne antarbhāvasya anukta tvāt api śabda vaiyarthyam na anumāna padena abhisambandhāt na param pratyakṣaḥ eva anumāne api antarbhāvaḥ iti pramāṇa vibhāgaḥ ca vidyā vibhāga pareṇa api vākyena pūrvam upadarśitaḥ eva tatra ca sanda ādīnām api pramāṇānām sadbhāvāt anupapannaḥ ayam iti āśaṅkā tad vyudāsā artham antaḥ bhāva prakaraṇam tathā śabda ādeḥ kāraka jātasya anumāna sāmagra bām antarbhāve tad phala syāpi phale antarbhāvaḥ jñāyate eva

tatra śabdaḥ ādau yeṣām tāni tathā uktāni atas teṣām anumāne antarbhāvaḥ kṣaṇakyam iti tad guṇa saṃvijñāna bahu vrīhi abhyupagame śabdasya api anumāne antarbhāvaḥ sat guṇa saṃvijñāne śabdam vinā apareṣām iti antarbhāva vyavahāre ca * samāna vidhi tvāt * samāna lakṣaṇa yogi tvāt iti panyāsaḥ katham sādhyāt na viśiṣyate lakṣaṇa eka tvasya tad vyavahārāt anya tvāt samānāḥ vidhiḥ upāyaḥ lakṣaṇam yeṣām tāni tathā uktāni teṣām bhāvaḥ tattvam tasmāt iti tat eva āha * yathā prasiddha samayasya asan digdha liṅga darśana prasiddhi anusmaraṇābhyām atīndriye arthe bhavati anumānam evam śabda ādibhyaḥ api iti yathā hi gṛhīta sambandhasya liṅga darśana anantaram avinā abhau a sambandha smaraṇam tābhyāma atha paricchedya bhavati anamānam a anamīyate anena iti parāmarśa jñānam eva upacāreṇa vyutpattyā vā tat vivakṣitam evam śabda ādibhyaḥ api iti dārṭa antika vyākhyānam

anye tu parāmarśa jñānasya asattvam eva iti manyante tat ca asat avinābhāva sambandha smaraṇasya aniyata tvāt niyata deśe pratipattiḥ na syāt upanaya vaiyarthyañce tyuktam atas pūrvam eva nyāyyam atra tad guṇa saṃvijñāna pakṣe śabdasya api anumāne antarbhāvaḥ tathā ca śabda śravaṇāt samaya anusmaraṇe sati parāmarśa jñānam tasmāt parokṣa artha pratipattiḥ iti ayam go śabdaḥ kakudādimad arthavān go śabda tvāt pūrva upalabdhā evaṃvidha go śabda vat iti sambandha avagamena artha pratipādaka tvāt ca dhūma vat

tat etat asat go śabdasya kakudādimad arthavattāyāḥ pratipādayitum aśakya tvāt tathā hi śabdasya arthena anya sambandha abhāvāt vācya vācaka tvena artha pratipādaka tve sādhye go śabda tvam ahetuḥ pratipādaka tvasya pratipatti avaseya tvāt svābhāvika sambandha anupapatteḥ ca dhūmaḥ hi svābhāvika sambandhena sarva prāṇabhṛtā manumeya artha pratipādakaḥ na ca evam śabdaḥ puruṣa icchā sampādita samaya apekṣasya artha pratipādaka tvāt svābhāvika sambandhe hi vinā api saṅketam mleccha ādi śabda śravaṇāt artha pratipattiḥ syāt saṅketa apekṣasya tu artha pratipādaka tve saḥ eva astu alam nitya sambandhena iti na ca nitya sambandha abhāve ati prasaṅgaḥ naimittika śabdānām dravya tva ādi nimitta sadbhāve sati eva saṅketāt yādṛcchika śabdānāntu puruṣa icchā nu vidhānāt iti yatra ca viśiṣṭa ānupūrvī mattva sadbhāvaḥ tat eva niyamena vācakam itarat ca vācyam iti vyavasthā saṅketa jñānasya ubhaya niṣṭhatvā viśeṣāt iti

saṅketaḥ tu śabdāt vṛddha vyavahārataḥ ca pratīyate tathā hi idam asya vācakam idam asya vācyam iti vākyāt saṅketa pratipattiḥ vṛddha vyavahārāt yathā devadatta gām abhyāja śuklām daṇḍena iti prayogāt avyutpannaḥ anvaya vyatirekābhyām deva datta ādi śabdeṣu saṅketam pratipadyate vṛddha vyavahartṛṇām api saṅketa pratipattiḥ anyatas vyavahārāt iti anādi tvam parihāraḥ yat vā ādipuruṣaḥ sākṣāt raṣṭā keṣāñcid saṅketakartā asti iti vākya rūpaḥ tu śabdaḥ artha pratipattau samayam api na apekṣate iti sambandha balena artha pratipādaka tvam asiddham

na ca śabdasya anumāna tvam eva niṣidhyate vivakṣā ākāśa yora dhik ame liṅga tvāt yathā hi ākāśa adhigame sarvaḥ śabdaḥ anumānam vivakṣā kāryaḥ tu vivakṣā adhigame api iti na ca śabda jñāna vallaiṅgika jñānam āpta ukta tvam apekṣate tathā hi śabda jñāne kim ida samyaṅa mithyā vā iti saṃśaya utpatta avāpta uktam anāpta uktam ca a vā anvīkṣate laiṅgikantu pakṣa dharma tva ādikam iti vyatirekaḥ tat āha * śruti smṛti lakṣaṇaḥ api āmnāyaḥ vaktṛ prāmāṇya apekṣaḥ * iti na ca param laukikaḥ śabdaḥ vaktṛ prāmāṇyam apekṣate śruti smṛti lakṣaṇaḥ apoti

nanu vaktṛ prāmāṇyena āmnāya prāmāṇya abhyupagame bahūnā manyo anya āśraya tvam syāt tathā hi artha prāptyā āpta ukta tvam śabde niścīyate niścayāt ca arthāva bodhe sati pravartamānasya artha prāptiḥ iti tathā pauruṣeye vacasi satya asatya tvaḥ palabdheḥ vede api puruṣa anupraveśe tad āśaṅkāyām aprāmāṇyam eva syāt na ca sākṣāt atīndriya artha draṣṭā puruṣaḥ sambhavati iti katham tad vācakāni vacāṃsi tad pūrvakāni iti

yadi ca anyasmāt veda vākyāt artham pratipadya vacana racanām kuryāt tasya api nitya tvena kiñcid bādhitam syāt anitya tve tu tat kartuḥ api anyasmāt vākyāḥ dartha avabodhaḥ iti anavasthā syāt na ca anitya tvam veda vākyānām pramāṇa prasiddham iti katham vaktṛ viśeṣa apekṣam prāmāṇyam artha pratipattau ca śabdasya sva abhidhā śakti balena eva vyāpāraḥ na āpta ukta tvama pekṣamāṇasya iti sā ca tasya sva ātma bhūtā eva na paścāt pareṇa sampādyate iti svatas eva prāmāṇyam na ca āpta ukta tvam śakyate pratipattum pratipakṣā bandhā dera viṣaya tvāt aprāmāṇyantu duṣṭa puruṣa praṇīta tva apekṣam iti paratas

tathā sarva pramāṇānām api prāmāṇye na para apekṣitā sambhavati sva kāraṇe bhyaḥ artha avabodha svarūpāṇām utpatteḥ yadi ca avidyamānam artha paricchedaka tvam pari niṣpanne vijñāne kāraka antarāt utpadyate pratipadyemahi paratas prāmāṇyam na ca etat asti iti āha svatas sarva pramāṇānām prāmāṇyam iti gṛhyatām na hi svatas asatī śaktiḥ kartum anyena śakyate na ca jñānasya artha paricchedaka tvam kāraṇa guṇa pūrvakam indriyeṣu tad abhāvāt tat āha vyāpāraḥ kārakāṇām hi dṛṣṭaḥ janma atirekataḥ pramāṇe api tathā mā bhūt iti janma vivakṣyate

yathā hi indriyāṇām janma vyatirekaṇa aparaḥ vyāpāraḥ na evam jñānasya anantara mā iva phala sampādaka tvāt dṛṣṭañca pareṇa api viśeṣaṇa ādi jñānasya viśeṣya ādi jñāna janmani prāmāṇyam iti atha upajātam api jñānam na kāraka pariśaddheḥ bodham vinā artha paricchedaka tva bhāj tarhi tatra api kāraka pariśuddhi grahaṇam vācyam iti ana vasthā tat āha jāte api yadi vijñāne tāvat na arthaḥ avadhāryate yāvat kāraṇa śuddha tvam na pramāṇa antara āgatam tatra jñāna antara utpādaḥ pratīkṣyaḥ kāraṇa antarāt yāvat hi na paricchinnā śuddhiḥ tāvat asat samā tasya api kāraṇe śuddhe tad jñānasya pramāṇa tā tasya api evam itī sthañca na kaścid vyavatiṣṭhate

atha vidyamānam api pramāṇasya prāmāṇyam na pramāṇa antara saṃvāda vinā pramāṇa vyavahāra kāraṇam tarhi pramāṇa paramparāyām apakṣīṇa śakta vivakṣita jñāna pramāṇa vyavahāraḥ na syāt tat āha sammatyā yadi ca iṣyeta pūrva pūrva pramāṇa tā pramāṇa antaram icchantaḥ na vyavasthām labhemahi yadi ca kasyacid svatas eva prāmāṇyam iṣyeta param ādyasya eva astu iti āha kasyacid tu yadīṣyeta svatas eva pramāṇa tā prathamasya tathā abhāve pradveṣaḥ kim nibandhanaḥ

prathama uttarayoḥ paraspara apekṣam prāmāṇyam iti abhyupagame ca itaretara āśraya tvam syāt atas svatas eva prāmāṇyam aprāmāṇyantu paratas tathā hi laukikāḥ nāmava śabdānām aprāmāṇyam puruṣa doṣa anupraveśāt vaidikānāntu tad abhāvāda prāmāṇya śajha eva na asti iti arthandriyāṇām kāca kāmalā ādi doṣa vaśāt aprāmāṇyam na svarūpataḥ tathā hi kāmalā ādi doṣa sad abhāve sati mithyājñāna janaka tvam na tad abhāvaḥ iti

jñaptau ca avabodhaka tvena mithyāmateḥ autsargika māna tvam na nivṛttam iti paka pratyayāt mithyātvā avagatau vyāvartate na ca asmad pakṣe śuktikā jñānena api śuktikā jñānasya bādhāyām anavasthā kāraka śuddhi grahaṇa paramparā vā iti pacyam avabodhaka tvena autsargikasya pramāṇa tvasya doṣa darśana mātreṇa eva āva ānava sthānāt tat āha yadā svatas pramāṇa tvam tadā anyam na eva mṛgyate nivartate ca mithyātvam doṣa jñānāt ayatnataḥ doṣa jñāne tu anat panne na āśaṅkā niṣpramāṇikā eva tri catur ajñāna janmanaḥ na adhikā matiḥ iti anavasthā parihāraḥ

tat etat sarvam avidita artham sarva pramāṇānām utpattau jñaptau ca para apekṣita upa yaḥ tathā hi āpta ukta tvam apekṣamāṇaḥ śabdaḥ arthe samyak jñānam upajanayati parantareṇa iti dṛṣṭam yat ca bahūnām anyonya āśraya tvam uktam tat na yuktam patitvasya āgṛhyamāṇasya eva śabda sahakāri tva abhyupagamāt artha prāptau ca śāntareṇa paścāt tat grahaṇam iṣyate eva tathā hi laukika śabdānām artha ca āptakti tvam niścīyate pratyakṣeṇa api gṛhyate iti anye tathā ca śrotravyā vākya śravaṇe sati cāṇakyā uktam kāli dāsa uktañca etat iti abādhyamānaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ vadika vākyānāntu pradhāna artheṣu avisaṃvādāt āpta akta tvānaḥ cayaḥ

yadi pauruṣeye vacasi dvaividhya upalabdheḥ vede api puruṣa anupraveśe aprāmāṇya śaṅkā bāta dūṣaṇam tat na tad kartuḥ doṣa abhāvāt tathā hi yasya rāga ādi doṣaḥ asti tad vacanam eva apramāṇam iti upalabdham veda kartuḥ ca tad sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvaḥ sākṣāt atīndriya artha draṣṭā puruṣaḥ sambhavati iti uktam adhastāt atas tad vacanādāḥ mnāyasya prāmāṇyam iti sūtrakāreṇa uktam

atha śabdasya anitya tve satya āpta ukta tvena prāmāṇyam syāt tat tu na astā tyāśaṅkayā āha * liṅgāt ca anitya ḥ śabdaḥ * iti param pratyakṣa ṇa uccāraṇāt prāk ūrdhvañca anupalambhāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratīyate liṅgāt ca iti tat tu vakṣyāmaḥ śabda parokṣāyām veda an āñca anitya tve anumānam anityāni veda vākyāni vākya tvāt abhaya abhimata vākya vat tathā * buddhi pūrvā vākya kṛtiḥ vākya racanā vede buddhi pūrvā vākya racanā tvāt ubhaya abhimata vākya racanā vat yat ca idam veda racanāyāḥ sarvadā anyathātva upalambhāt iti vaidhamyaṇa pratyavasthānam tat sarva anumāneṣu samānam iti evam * buddhi pūvā dadātiḥ * vede buddhi pūrvaḥ dadāti śabdaḥ dadāti iti ukta tvāt ubhaya abhimata dadāti iti śabda vat

yā ca iyam puruṣa anupraveśe satya prāmāṇya śaṅkā sā nitya tve api na nivartata śrotuḥ puruṣasya tatra api anupraveśāt tad vaiguṇyena ca aprāmāṇya upalabdheḥ tathā hi śrotura pratibhā ādemithyā jñāna utpattau kāraṇa tvam tad abhāvaḥ ca samyak jñāna utpattā viti upalabdham eva na ca nitya tvam vedānām ekāntena prāmāṇya hetuḥ tad bhāva jāpa śrotra antaḥkaraṇayoḥ pratipattṛ doṣa anupraveśena kvacid aprāmāṇyāt

sva abhidhā śakti balena eva śabdasya prāmāṇyam iti abhyapagame ca amulī agna kariṇaḥ tiṣṭhanti iti evamādeḥ aprāmāṇyam na syāt atha anāpta praṇīta tvena visavāḥ dāda prāmāṇyam eṣām tarhi yat āpta praṇītam tat eva pramāṇam iti prāptam yasa hi puruṣa gatasya rāga ādeḥ aprāmāṇye anvaya vyatirekābhyām vyāpāraḥ tathā tad guṇāda prāmāṇye prīti ubhayam paratas abhidhānasya ca varṇa tvā nupūrvī saṅketa vyatirekeṇa atīndriyā śaktiḥ na vidyate tasyāḥ pūrvam eva pratiṣedhāt varṇa tva ādi sadbhāve ca kārya karaṇāta sa ca paratas evam pratiniyata jāti sambandhasya adṛṣṭa kāryatvāt saṅkatasyā pyanyat kāraṇam uktam iti

yat tu sākṣādarśana ādiḥ puruṣasya rāga ādi vināśe vyāpriyate na jñāna utpattā pratyuktam tat asat samyak jñāna utpattau anvaya vyatireka upapatteḥ yathārtha draṣṭā tad śaṣyāṇām upadeṣṭā ca iti samuditam āpta lakṣaṇam yathārtha upadeśe hetuḥ tad antareṇa anu aśāt yadi ca anvaya vyatirekavataḥ api yathā artha darśi tvāde rāga ādi vināśaḥ eva vyāpāraḥ tarhi rāga ādeḥ api etat avināśaka tvam eva iti ubhayam paratas syāt tasmāt dira prāmāṇya utpattau iva yathārtha upalambha ādeḥ api samyak jñāna utpattau vyāpāraḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ

tathā indriyāṇām api kāca kāmalā ādi doṣa sadbhāve api mithyājñānam eva tad abhāva samyak jñāna jananāt ubhayam paratas pareṇa api abhāvasya kāraṇa tvam anekadheṣṭam yathā sat upalambhaka pramāṇa pañcaka vyāvṛtteḥ mānasa jñāna utpattau pakṣa dharma tādyanata pāya ca liṅgasya mithyājñāna utpattau ityādi atha kācakāmalā ādeḥ doṣasya yājñāna utpattau kāraṇatā upalabdhaḥ tad abhāve tasya eva anupalabdhiḥ na samyak jñāna te ced na anvaya vyatirekavataḥ akāraṇa tve ati prasaṅgāt yadi tathā ca deṣa abhāve anvaya vyatirekavān api na samyak jñāna utpattau kāraṇam tad sadbhāve api na mithyājñāna utpattau iti ubhayam svatas syāt sargaḥ ca indriyāṇām ubhaya rūpasya kāryasya upalabdha rubhayā artham iti jñāyeta

nanu doṣa sadbhāve sati indriyam mithyājñānam janayati tad abhāve ca yam jñānam iti abhyupagamāt ubhaya abhāve ca ubhaya vikalam vijñānam kuryādi dacodyam ubhaya vikalasya indriyasya asambhavāt yathā hi pūrvam asatām doṣāṇā tarūvaṃñca pradhvaṃsaḥ iti na asti ubhaya vikalam indriyam na ca ubhaya viśeṣa vikalam jñāna tva sāmānyam sambhavati sāmānyavataḥ viśeṣa yogāt yathā go tva sāmānya ādhārasya śāvaleya ādi viśeṣaḥ iti

yat ca idam na kāraṇa guṇa pūrvakam paricchedaka tvam tat iṣyate eva anubhava mānasyandriyāt utpannasya artha paricchitti rūpa tvāt tad jana kañca indriya ādi kāraka antarā apekṣañca iti paratas prāmāṇyam kāraka sāmagrayantu na paścāt abhāvi nimittam apekṣate iti tad apekṣayā tabhayam svatas iti na mithyājñānam paratas syāt

atha jñātṛ vyāpāraḥ jñānam tat ca artha paricchede anapekṣam iti svatas nat mithyā jñāne api samānam atha mithyājñānam doṣam apekṣate tarhi samyaga jñānam api tad abhāva ādi apekṣate iti na ca jñātṛ vyāpāraḥ sambhāvyate artha prati patteḥ anyathā bhāvāt tathā hi sarva kārakam caramasahakāri sat abhāve sati kārya karoti iti na tasmāt anyaḥ vyāpāraḥ sadbhāve api nityatāyām sarva kārya utpatti prasaṅgaḥ tasya anapekṣa kāraṇa tva abhyupagamāt anitya tve tu tat utpattā a āpa nirvyāpārasya kāraṇa tva ayogāt anyaḥ vyāpāraḥ tad utpattau api anyaḥ iti anavasthā syāt caramasahakāri rūpe tu vyāpāre na ayam doṣaḥ tata sadbhāve kāya karaṇam na tad abhāvaḥ iti

yat ca idam kāraka śuddha grahaṇa apekṣitāyām dūṣaṇam tad apāstam anabhyupagama na iti atha pramāṇasya prāmāṇyam vinā eva pramāṇam vijñāyate iti tat asat savasya prameyasya pramāṇa paricchedyatva upalabdheḥ tathā ca prāmāṇyam pramāṇa paricchā prameya tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat na ca anavasthā sarvatra avaśyam prāmāṇya grahaṇān abhyupa gamāt yatra hi jñāna udaye sati kim idam samyaṅamithyā vā iti saṃśaya utpattiḥ tatrava pramāṇa antara apekṣā artha prāpti paryanta vyavahāra sambhave vai apekṣā vinivṛttanāna vastha ādi doṣaḥ yadi ca jñāna dharma tvāt prāmāṇyasya sva saṃvedya tvam iṣyeta aprāmāṇyam api ana syāt iti katham paratas tathā mithyājñāna utpāde na pravartate mithyātvasya pratipad na tvāt samyak jñāna utpattau ca samyakta adhyavasāye kim idam samyak mithyā vāra saṃśaya ādi abhāvaḥ

yat ca idam avabodhaka tvena pramāṇasya prāmāṇyam doṣa adarśana mātreṇavāvātaḥ iti uktam a tatra yadi doṣa adarśana doṣa jñānānatpattiḥ na tayā prāmāṇyam jñāpyata nāra kriyate iti katham aniścita sthiteḥ avasthāna vacanam a atha doṣa darśanasya bābā pratyayasya mithyātva jñāpaka tvam iva tad abhāva jñānasya prāmāṇyajñāpaka tvam iṣyata tasya api prāmāṇyam anyasmāt vijñāyate iti anavasthā syāta atha jñānāla saṃśayam vinā na sarvatra prāmāṇya grahaṇa apekṣā iti parihāraḥ tarhi na svata prāmāṇyam utpattau jñaptau ca para apekṣi tva abhyupagamāt atha indriya ādi kārakeṣu vidyamānam samyaktvam na kāraṇa guṇa prakrameṇa śāneṣutpadyate iti svatas tad aprāmāṇye api samānam tatra api hi viparyaya ādi rūpa tā naḥ indriya ādiṣu vidyamānā jāyate iti

bodha ātmaka pramāṇa apekṣayā tu svatas prāmāṇyam vivakṣitam iti abhyupagamasya ca uda nāyāḥ vaktṛ viśeṣa apekṣam prāmāṇyam iti abhyupagamena avirodhāt avivādaḥ eva syāt asya hi samarthana artham anya pramāṇānām paratas prāmāṇya upadarśanāt na ca coda nāyāḥ svatas prāmāṇya abhyupagame codanā janitam jñānam pramāṇam doṣa jitaiḥ rikarjanyamāna tvāt liṅgāt pratyakṣa buddhi vat iti parīkṣā artham prayāsaḥ ghaṭate atha aparaṣāḥ vyāmoha vyāvartana dvāreṇa samyak jñāna sampādana artha parīkṣā vākyam tad ja nita jñāne api vyāmohe sati anyā parīkṣā syāt iti anavasthā sā ca ukta nyāyena eva rāhayate iti katham na paratas pramāṇasya prāmāṇyam utpadyate jñāyate vā iti

śeṣañcā atra dūṣaṇa pratisamādhānam asmad guru bhi vistareṇa abhihitam iti na ihaḥ m atas śabdasya āpta ukta tvena prāmāṇyāt na anumāne antarbhāvaḥ atha śabdānām arthena pratibandha abhāvāt aprāmāṇyam eva tathā ca dṛśya kalpyau arthau ekīkṛtya tad samāropeṇa śrotuḥ pravṛtti nivṛttī iti uktam yaḥ ayam vikalpa gataḥ ākāraḥ saḥ eva bāhyaḥ arthaḥ iti manyamānaḥ pratipattā pravartate na māhyārtha pratipattau artha darśane sati vivakṣā krameṇa śabda utpatti kāle arthasya kṣaṇika tvena atikrānta tvāt

pratyakṣa anumāna viṣayasya a tirikta viṣaya abhāvāt ca na śabdaḥ māṇa antaram tathā hi sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam pratyakṣam sāmānya viṣayam anumānam yat u avidhyāt pramāṇa dvaividhyam iti katham śabdaḥ artha antara tve sati pramāṇam yadi ca indriyeṇa samāna viṣayaḥ śabdaḥ bhavet andha anandhayoḥ aviśeṣaḥ syāt tat āha anya deva indriya grāhyam anyaḥ śabdasya gocaraḥ śabdāt pratyeti bhinna akṣaḥ na tu pratyakṣam īkṣate
